1364005110.name: Hunter Cloak
1364005110.lore:
OK, here's where I give you this big pep talk about "what it means to be a Hunter" and "follow these rules" and blah blah blah. 

So. Here's the one rule to being a Hunter: can you see me? I'm—I'm shrugging. It's—hard to convey in a written— 

Anyway. It's a shrug. Get it? There's no one way to be a Hunter. Just—figure it out as you go along. I know you can. Otherwise you wouldn't be a Hunter. OK?  

So what are you waiting for? Get out of here. Wait, wait—that'll be 1000 Glimmer. I'm kidding! Now go make me proud. Or don't. Just make you proud, okay? 

Wow. Sometimes I inspire even myself.
1364005110.lore_zh:
好的，我来和你好好谈谈“成为猎人意味着什么”和“要遵守的规则”等等等等。

是这样的。成为猎人有一个规则：看见没？我——我在耸肩。很难——用书面语表达清楚——

不管怎么说。就是耸耸肩。明白了吗？成为猎人没什么规则。但——你自己会慢慢领悟的。我相信你。否则你就不是猎人。好吧？

那你还在等什么呢？出去吧。等等，等等——那可是1000微光啊。我开玩笑的！别让我失望啊。不是不是。是别让自己失望，好吧？

哇，有时候我都佩服我自己。

1844055850.name: Titan Mark
1844055850.lore:
Do you see the walls that surround the Last City? Picture them in your mind. They don't just protect our people. They also serve as a reminder— a reminder of what you are. 

You are a Titan. The wall against which evil breaks. The candle in the darkest of these days. The protector of the Traveler's last gifts. 

This City is your home. Its people are your blood. And its walls are your shields, your weapons, your temple. 

Take your place, Titan, and know this: when you fight for the Last City, you will never suffer defeat. 

– Zavala, Titan Vanguard
1844055850.lore_zh:
你看到环绕最后的城市的高墙了吗？记住这个画面。它们不仅仅保护了我们的人民，也时刻提醒着——提醒着你是谁。

你是一名泰坦，是抵抗邪恶破坏者的高墙，是黑暗时代中的烛光，是旅行者最后馈赠的保护者。

圣城是你的家。人民是你的血液。高墙是你的护盾，你的武器，你的神殿。

泰坦，认清你的位置，听着：当你为最后的城市战斗时，你将永远不会失败。

——泰坦先锋，萨瓦拉

2969943001.name: Warlock Bond
2969943001.lore:
Look around you. Wherever you are. Really look. 
No matter where you stand, no matter what lies before you, millions of infinite mysteries hide within your view. Think about that. And then know that you will one day know the answers to all of them. 
You are a Warlock. Your armor is wisdom, your weapons wit and ingenuity. You hold the power to draw strength from the places where imagination and possibility collide. 
The universe is a complex machine. But all machines can be understood, taken apart, modified, improved. 
All you have to do is look. 

—Ikora Rey
2969943001.lore_zh:
环顾四周，无论你身处何处，看仔细。

无论你站在何处，无论你前方有何物，其中都蕴藏着千万个无尽奥秘。好好想一下，总有一天你会参透所有这一切的答案。

你是一名术士。睿智是你的护甲，智慧和巧思是你的武器，从想象力和可能性碰撞的火花中吸取力量。
宇宙是一个复杂的机器。但所有的机器都可以被解读、拆分、修改和改良。
你要做的，就是去看。

——艾可拉·蕾伊

152583919.name: Finishers

When triggered, a random finisher in your inventory plays.

If no finishers are in your inventory, your default class finisher plays.

如果物品栏中没有终结技，则将施展你的默认职业终结技。

4142409631.typeName_zh: 传说 专注本影记忆水晶

616392721.name: Treasure Key
616392721.description:
An odd key earned by completing the Dares of Eternity.

Can be used to open a chest in Xûr's Treasure Hoard.
616392721.description_zh:
一把通过完成永恒挑战获得的奇异钥匙。

可以用来在仄的宝藏窖藏中开启一个宝箱。

800069450.name: Strange Coin
800069450.description:
This unusual coin is warm to the touch and vibrates gently in your hand.

Can be exchanged for items, including Exotic gear, from Xûr at the Tower.
800069450.description_zh:
这枚不同寻常的硬币摸上去有些温热，在你的手中轻轻颤动。

可以用来在高塔的仄处交换包括异域装备在内的物品。
800069450.source: Source: Standard Ritual Playlist. (Vanguard Ops, Crucible, Gambit)
800069450.source_zh: 来源：标准仪式游戏列表。（先锋行动、熔炉竞技场、智谋）

578342144.name: Strange Engram
578342144.description:
An engram with strange markings.

Contains a random Legendary weapon from Xûr's paraversal collection.
578342144.description_zh:
一个有着奇怪标记的记忆水晶。

包含一件来自仄的超宇宙收藏的随机传说武器。

2965853200.name: Strange Engram
2965853200.description:
An engram with strange markings.

Contains a random Legendary weapon from Xûr's paraversal collection.
2965853200.description_zh:
一个有着奇怪标记的记忆水晶。

包含一件来自仄的超宇宙收藏的随机传说武器。

852042224.name: Strange Engram
852042224.description:
An engram with strange markings.

Contains a random Legendary weapon from Xûr's paraversal collection.
852042224.description_zh:
一个有着奇怪标记的记忆水晶。

包含一件来自仄的超宇宙收藏的随机传说武器。

2969409160.name: Legendary Engram
2969409160.description:
An engram with complex markers.

Contains a random Legendary weapon or armor piece.
2969409160.description_zh:
一个有着复杂标记的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机传说武器或护甲。

3707960957.name: Legendary Engram
3707960957.description:
An engram with complex markers.

Contains a random Legendary weapon or armor piece.
3707960957.description_zh:
一个有着复杂标记的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机传说武器或护甲。

1734290428.name: Resplendent Reward Package
1734290428.description: Contains a curated selection of rewards from Xûr.
1734290428.description_zh: 包含由仄精挑细选出的奖励。

3189943763.name: Streetwear Hunter Pack
3189943763.description: Contains a full set of Streetwear Hunter universal ornaments.
3189943763.description_zh: 包含一套完整的时尚休闲猎人通用皮肤。

360592365.name: Streetwear Titan Pack
360592365.description: Contains a full set of Streetwear Titan universal ornaments.
360592365.description_zh: 包含一套完整的时尚休闲泰坦通用皮肤。

344925188.name: Streetwear Warlock Pack
344925188.description: Contains a full set of Streetwear Warlock universal ornaments.
344925188.description_zh: 包含一套完整的时尚休闲术士通用皮肤。

1116049802.name: Paraversal Haul
1116049802.description:
A haphazard package of treasures plucked from the impossible rubble of clashing realities. While the package's contents are unknown, it may hold great value. 

May contain:
Exotic Gear
Legendary Gear
Strange Coins
Treasure Keys
1116049802.description_zh:
从因不同现实碰撞而产生的废墟中找出的随性宝物包裹。虽然包裹内容未知，但里面也许包含着超值的物品。

可能包含：
异域装备
传说装备
奇异硬币
宝藏钥匙
1116049802.flavor: "I know not what I offer you, only that it has traveled far to rest in your hands." —Xûr

3325717727.name: Qualichor
3325717727.description: A strange device of tube, glass, and chitin. Fynch might be able to identify it.
3325717727.description_zh: 一个由管道、玻璃和壳质组成的奇怪装置。芬奇也许能认出这是什么。

2289944966.name: Refined Qualichor
2289944966.description: Use to bring the nearly-forgotten memory of a great treasure into the present.
2289944966.description_zh: 用于将几近湮没的大宝藏的记忆带入当世。

2257609142.name: Normal
2257609142.description:
Survive the horrifying revelations of Savathûn's throne world in a definitively Destiny 2 campaign, alone or with a fireteam of friends.

Be Brave.
2257609142.description_zh:
在终极《命运2》战役中，从萨瓦图恩王座世界骇人听闻的启示中，独自一人或与火力战队的好友们一同存活下来。

勇者无畏。

49116856.name: Legendary
49116856.description:
Battle against more powerful enemies as you unravel Savathûn's lies, earning greater rewards. Test your skills in the most challenging Destiny 2 campaign yet alone or with a fireteam of friends.

Become Legend.
49116856.description_zh:
揭露萨瓦图恩谎言的同时与更强大的敌人战斗，赢取更为丰厚的奖励。独自一人或与火力战队的好友们一同在迄今最具挑战性的《命运2》战役中考验技艺。

成为传说。

4013738640.name: Throne World Engram
4013738640.description:
An engram with shifting markers.

Contains previously acquired Throne World gear or weapons. Once upgraded, this engram rewards previously acquired Throne World weapons.
4013738640.description_zh:
一枚标记在不停变化的记忆水晶。

包含曾经获得的王座世界装备或武器。升级后，此水晶会奖励之前获得过的王座世界武器。

1227820936.name: Warsat Control Nexus Keycard
1227820936.name_zh: 战争卫星控制枢纽钥匙卡

107323930.name: Polymorphic Shellcode
107323930.description: A Shellcode that is constantly adapting to shield the bearer from VexNet defenses.
107323930.description_zh: 不断调适、保护持有者免受Vex网络防御攻击的壳代码。

1471199156.name: Terminal Overload Key
1471199156.description: Unlocks an additional chest at the end of Terminal Overload in Neomuna.
1471199156.description_zh: 在内欧姆那的终端过载结束时解锁额外宝箱。

2946312594.name: Shadow Legion Orders
2946312594.description: The orders, in Ulurant, roughly translate to "Strip the fort down to its studs. Bring the loot to the Typhon Imperator for inspection."
2946312594.description_zh: 这些用乌鲁兰语写的命令大致可翻译为“将堡垒拆个精光。把战利品带到提丰大帝号那里接受检验。”

1077836170.name: Veil Spectrometer
1077836170.description: A delicate piece of Irkalla Institute equipment, designed by Dr. Chioma Esi to measure variations in the Veil's paracausal byproduct (aka Strand).
1077836170.description_zh: 伊尔卡拉研究院的一件精致设备，由希欧玛·艾西博士设计，用于测量各种面纱的超因果副产品（又名缚丝）。

1140031396.name: Neomuna Engram
1140031396.description:
An engram with shifting markers.

Contains previously acquired Neomuna gear or weapons. Once upgraded, this engram rewards previously acquired Neomuna weapons.
1140031396.description_zh:
一枚标记在不停变化的记忆水晶。

包含曾经获得的内欧姆那装备或武器。升级后，此水晶会奖励之前获得过的内欧姆那武器。

2099896459.name: EARNING STRAND MEDITATIONS
2099896459.description:
• Strand Meditations can be spent at the Pouka Pond to unlock additional Strand grenades, Aspects, and Fragments. 

• Collect Strand Meditations by using Strand anywhere in the system and completing activities in Neomuna.

• Earn additional Strand Meditations while in the Vex Incursion Zone in Neomuna.
2099896459.description_zh:
• 缚丝冥想可在普卡池花费以解锁额外的缚丝手雷、星相和碎片。

通过在星系各处使用缚丝并完成内欧姆那的各项活动来收集缚丝冥想。

• 额外的缚丝冥想可在内欧姆那的Vex入侵区中获取。
2099896459.flavor: There are many ways to earn your recommended daily dose of Meditations!

1002354686.name: Memory of the Witness
1002354686.description: Allows access to the bonus chest in Excision.
1002354686.description_zh: 允许开启切除中的奖励宝箱。

805381928.name: Memory Vestige: Light
805381928.description: A vestige of a Light-wielding Guardian's memory. Collecting more might reveal hidden secrets.
805381928.description_zh: 一位操控光能的守护者的一段记忆残余。收集更多也许会揭开隐藏的秘密。

3101709158.name: Memory: Refractions of Light
3101709158.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Refraction in the Pale Heart.
3101709158.description_zh: 在苍白之心折射之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
3101709158.flavor:
"Let Light wash over me, let it grasp my hands and wrap me in its might, strengthen me in its resilience and lead me to victory."

—Memories of a Guardian

3101709157.name: Memory: Blooming of Light
3101709157.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Blooming in the Pale Heart.
3101709157.description_zh: 在苍白之心繁盛之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
3101709157.flavor:
"The power of the Sun itself: unparalleled restoration, righteous destruction. A boon up until the moment it isn't. 

In that same power lies unfettered, rampant restoration and unimaginable, unforgivable, destruction…"

—Memories of a Guardian

3101709156.name: Memory: Seclusions of Light
3101709156.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Seclusion in the Pale Heart.
3101709156.description_zh: 在苍白之心隔绝之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
3101709156.flavor:
"I am awake but at what cost? In one moment, I am given the gift of life eternal and in that same moment burdened by the crushing weight of trying to make it all mean something…"

—Memories of a Guardian

4116837065.name: Memory Vestige: Darkness
4116837065.description: A vestige of a Darkness-wielding Guardian's memory. Collecting more might reveal hidden secrets.
4116837065.description_zh: 一位操控暗影的守护者的一段记忆残余。收集更多也许会揭开隐藏的秘密。

4089840981.name: Memory: Divisive Darkness
4089840981.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Divide in the Pale Heart.
4089840981.description_zh: 在苍白之心分歧之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
4089840981.flavor:
"If I am to wield Darkness, let it be atonement for all the harm I have done with the Light. Let it be my redemption."

—Memories of a Guardian

4089840982.name: Memory: Impassive Darkness
4089840982.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Impasse in the Pale Heart.
4089840982.description_zh: 在苍白之心的僵局之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
4089840982.flavor:
"I have no memories of my childhood…was I once scared of the dark? What would my younger self say if they could see me now, greeting Darkness as an old friend."

—Memories of a Guardian

4089840983.name: Memory: Transgressive Darkness
4089840983.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Transgression in the Pale Heart.
4089840983.description_zh: 在苍白之心罪过之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。
4089840983.flavor:
"In Darkness I find comfort. I find peace."

—Memories of a Guardian

1955791387.name: Luminescent Seed
1955791387.description: A seed from an unknown flora. It is small and vibrant, emitting feelings of reassurance and gratitude. The seed resonates when near Witness-created hands found in the Pale Heart.
1955791387.description_zh: 一粒来自未知植物的种子。它小巧而充满活力，散发着慰藉与感恩的感觉。种子靠近苍白之心见证者所造之手时，就会产生共鸣。

2085536058.name: Flickering Blessing Mod Socket
2085536058.description: Flickering Blessing mods provide Guardians with powerful new ways to harness Light and Darkness. Once equipped, Flickering Blessing mod perks are always active within the Traveler's Pale Heart.
2085536058.description_zh: 闪烁祝福模组可为守护者提供利用光能与暗影的全新强力手段。装备闪烁祝福模组后，其特性将在旅行者的苍白之心内始终生效。
2085536058.typeName_zh: 普通 闪烁祝福目的地模组

1396048722.typeName_zh: 普通 闪烁祝福目的地模组

1710813116.name: Information
1710813116.description:
• Traveler's Blessings have a chance to be awarded from most chests in the Traveler's Pale Heart. This includes Cyst chests, Lost Sector chests, Overthrow Level 2 and Level 3 encounter chests, Pathfinder Field Assignment chests, and Triage chests.

• Each daily reset, a Lost Sector, Cyst, or Overthrow grant a guaranteed Traveler's Blessing upon completion. Look on the Traveler's Pale Heart map to find out which activity grants a guaranteed blessing!

• Traveler's Blessings awarded from the above sources will always be chosen from the list of expired Traveler's Blessings.

• Once acquired, Traveler's Blessings can be used for 27 hours before expiring.
1710813116.description_zh:
• 旅行者苍白之心的大多数宝箱有一定几率奖励旅行者的祝福。具体而言，包括囊肿宝箱、遗失区域宝箱、颠覆等级2和等级3遭遇战宝箱、寻路者外勤任务宝箱、分诊宝箱。

• 每次日常重置后，遗失区域、囊肿或颠覆活动完成时必定奖励一次旅行者的祝福。查看旅行者苍白之心地图，找出必定奖励祝福的活动！

• 上述来源奖励的旅行者的祝福将始终从已过期的旅行者的祝福列表中选取。

• 获得奖励后，旅行者的祝福将在27小时后过期。
1710813116.typeName_zh: 普通 目的地模组信息

3725942064.name: Pale Blessing Mod Socket
3725942064.description: Pale Blessing mods grant temporary buffs to Guardians upon interaction with Traveler's Flowers, found in the Traveler's Pale Heart.
3725942064.description_zh: 守护者与旅行者苍白之心的旅行者之花互动后，苍白祝福模组会在提供临时增益。
3725942064.typeName_zh: 普通 苍白祝福目的地模组

79833170.name: Traveler's Insight
79833170.typeName_zh: 普通 苍白祝福目的地模组

79833169.typeName_zh: 普通 苍白祝福目的地模组

79833168.typeName_zh: 普通 苍白祝福目的地模组

79833172.name: Traveler's Grace

4045313562.name: Traveler's Blessings
4045313562.description: Manage Traveler's Blessings acquired in the Pale Heart. Equip them to gain powerful effects while in the Pale Heart.
4045313562.description_zh: 管理在苍白之心获得的旅行者祝福。装备它们即可在苍白之心获得强大效果。

1717863290.name: Attunement
1717863290.description: Attuning to a perk will increase the chance for Exotic class items to drop with the selected perk. Only one perk may be attuned to at a time.
1717863290.description_zh: 同调特性后，带有选定特性的异域职业物品掉落率会增加。一次只能同调一个特性。

395351585.name: Pale Heart Engram
395351585.description: An engram containing weapons and armor from the Traveler's Pale Heart.
395351585.description_zh: 一个包含旅行者苍白之心武器和护甲的记忆水晶。

1668074673.name: Graviton Through the Ages
1668074673.description: Collect components to reconstruct a lost weapon from the Department of External Observations.
1668074673.description_zh: 收集组件以重建对外观察部遗失的武器。

3237432282.name: Fragment of Graviton Spike Catalyst acquired
3237432282.name_zh: 已获得引力子尖刺催化碎片

3497905637.name: Fragment of Graviton Spike Catalyst acquired
3497905637.name_zh: 已获得引力子尖刺催化碎片

1307516444.name: Fragment of Graviton Spike Catalyst acquired
1307516444.name_zh: 已获得引力子尖刺催化碎片

2184219247.name: Fragment of Graviton Spike Catalyst acquired
2184219247.name_zh: 已获得引力子尖刺催化碎片

2590014486.name: Unlock AION Adapter armor variants
2590014486.name_zh: 解锁艾昂适配护甲变体

892683995.name: Kepler Gear Tier Upgrade: +1
892683995.description: Permanently increases the Gear Tier for all Kepler gear rewards by 1.
892683995.description_zh: 所有开普勒装备奖励的阶级永久提升1阶。

892683994.name: Kepler Gear Tier Upgrade: +2
892683994.description: Permanently increases the Gear Tier for all Kepler gear rewards by 2.
892683994.description_zh: 所有开普勒装备奖励的阶级永久提升2阶。

1087344267.name: Reactivate Mysteries
1087344267.description: Purchase to reset mysteries in the Gorge region. These will reappear as discoverables on your map.
1087344267.description_zh: 购买以重置峡谷区域的谜团。它们将在地图上重新显示为可发现物品。

4224283322.name: Reactivate Mysteries
4224283322.description: Purchase to reset mysteries in the Exile's Accord region. These will reappear as discoverables on your map.
4224283322.description_zh: 购买以重置流亡氏族协议地区域的谜团。它们将在地图上重新显示为可发现物品。

2938627541.name: Reactivate Mysteries
2938627541.description: Purchase to reset mysteries in the Central Academy region. These will reappear as discoverables on your map.
2938627541.description_zh: 购买以重置中央学院区域的谜团。它们将在地图上重新显示为可发现物品。

1250188421.name: Reactivate Mysteries
1250188421.description: Purchase to reset mysteries in the Outer Steppes region. These will reappear as discoverables on your map.
1250188421.description_zh: 购买以重置外域草原区域的谜团。它们将在地图上重新显示为可发现物品。

488311250.name: Help
488311250.description:
Use Attunement to increase the drop chance of an item.

Gear Focusing is a great way to seek your attuned item.

Every day, a different region of Kepler is targeted. Mysteries can be reset in that region, and gear focusing uses that region's materials.

Higher World Tiers multiply all material rewards and increase chances of gear drops.

Unlock higher gear tiers by completing World Tier quests and purchasing vendor upgrades.
488311250.description_zh:
使用同调来提高某个物品的掉落几率。

装备聚焦是寻觅已同调装备的极佳方式。

每天，开普勒的不同地区会被指定。该地区的谜题可被重置，装备聚焦会使用该地区的材料。

更高世界等级会加倍所有材料奖励，并提升装备掉落概率。

通过完成世界等级任务并购买商人升级来解锁更高装备阶级。

1816441351.name: Daily Region: The Gorge
1816441351.description: All gear focusing uses Phaseglass Refraction found in the Gorge region.
1816441351.description_zh: 所有装备聚焦均使用相位琉璃折射体，可在峡谷地区找到。

15628614.name: Daily Region: Exile's Accord
15628614.name_zh: 每日地区：流亡氏族协议地
15628614.description: All gear focusing uses Alkane Mutation found in Exile's Accord region.
15628614.description_zh: 所有装备聚焦均使用烷烃变异体，可在流亡氏族协议地地区找到。

3002603177.name: Daily Region: Central Academy
3002603177.description: All gear focusing uses Timelost Spirit Bloom found in the Central Academy region.
3002603177.description_zh: 所有装备聚焦均使用失时灵魂之花，可在中央学院地区找到。

2657527105.name: Daily Region: Outer Steppes
2657527105.description: All gear focusing uses Nine-Touched Relic Iron found in the Outer Steppes region.
2657527105.description_zh: 所有装备聚焦均使用玖触碰过的钢铁圣物，可在外域草原地区找到。

2599227111.name: Attunement
2599227111.description: Attune to an item to increase its drop chance from all sources on Kepler. Only one item may be attuned to at a time.
2599227111.description_zh: 同调某件物品来提高其在开普勒所有来源的掉落几率。每次仅可同调一件物品。

557875470.name: Deactivate Attunement
557875470.description: Deactivating attunement will return all items in this category to have equal drop rates.
557875470.description_zh: 关闭同调将使此类别中的所有物品恢复为相等的掉落率。

1458212702.description: Unattuning from a piece of raid gear will reset drop chances. As a result, all raid gear will return to its original drop rates.

2367456861.name: Phaseglass Refraction
2367456861.description: Found in the Assimilated Easement and the Stellar Sink. May be exchanged for valuables and gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2367456861.description_zh: 可在同化地役和恒星之壑找到。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换珍贵物品和装备。
2367456861.flavor: A temporal fractal of a mysterious crystal found on Io, held in a state of quantum entanglement with Phaseglass elsewhere in the system. It resonates with itself.

3793612644.name: Alkane Mutation
3793612644.description: Found in the Curtilage Divide and Augur's Bethel. May be exchanged for valuables and gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
3793612644.description_zh: 可在宅地鸿沟和预言者圣地找到。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换珍贵物品和装备。
3793612644.flavor: A mutated strain of alkane spores originally found on Titan. On Kepler, it has fused with dark matter and tar, mutating into symbiosis with the surrounding slime molds.

2174713383.name: Timelost Spirit Bloom
2174713383.description: Found in the Aionian Campus and the Caldera. May be exchanged for valuables and gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2174713383.description_zh: 可在艾昂校园和火山喷口找到。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换珍贵物品和装备。
2174713383.flavor: A Venusian substance lost to time and carrying traces of energy from Unknown Space. No trace of how it arrived on Kepler can be found.

3388913371.name: Nine-Touched Relic Iron
3388913371.description: Found in the Outer Steppes and the Invitation. May be exchanged for valuables and gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
3388913371.description_zh: 可在外域草原和邀约之地找到。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换珍贵物品和装备。
3388913371.flavor: On Mars, it is extraordinarily dense; but on Kepler, it has been touched by the Nine and altered into a substance with negative mass density. It hums with cold detachment.

2217640604.name: Quantum Substance (Word-Bearer)
2217640604.description: Harvested from Word-Bearer Shanks roaming the Stacks and Augur's Bethel. May be exchanged for gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2217640604.description_zh: 从漫游在资料库和预言者圣地的承言者侦察机处收集。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换装备。
2217640604.flavor: A form of dark matter, touched by the Nine, and marked with a specific density tied to its provenance.

2217640605.name: Quantum Substance (Assimilation Scout)
2217640605.description: Harvested from Assimilation Scouts, which sometimes appear in the Caldera and the Stellar Sink. May be exchanged for gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2217640605.description_zh: 从有时出现在火山喷口和恒星之壑的同化斥候处收集。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换装备。
2217640605.flavor: A form of dark matter, touched by the Nine, and marked with a specific density tied to its provenance.

2217640606.name: Quantum Substance (Well of the Archon)
2217640606.description: Harvested from House Exile Servitors known as Wells of the Archon, which sometimes appear in the Curtilage Divide and the Outer Steppes. May be exchanged for gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2217640606.description_zh: 从有时出现在宅地鸿沟和外域草原、被称为执政官之井的流亡魔眼处收集。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换装备。
2217640606.flavor: A form of dark matter, touched by the Nine, and marked with a specific density tied to its provenance.

2217640607.name: Quantum Substance (Polus)
2217640607.description: Harvested from iterations of Polus, the Singular Volley, who sometimes patrols the Assimilated Easement and the Aionian Campus. May be exchanged for gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2217640607.description_zh: 从有时会在同化地役和艾昂校园巡逻的奇异制造者波鲁斯的迭代处收集。用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛兑换装备。
2217640607.flavor: A form of dark matter, touched by the Nine, and marked with a specific density tied to its provenance.

1782768110.name: Acceleron (Surveillance)
1782768110.description: Gathered from the Surveillance patrol in the Assimilated Easement.
1782768110.description_zh: 从同化地役的监控巡逻中收集。
1782768110.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

3561149313.name: Acceleron (Siphon)
3561149313.description: Gathered from the Siphon patrol in the Stellar Sink.
3561149313.description_zh: 从恒星之壑的虹吸巡逻中收集。
3561149313.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

3703045304.name: Acceleron (Locksmith)
3703045304.description: Gathered from the Locksmith patrol in the Stacks.
3703045304.description_zh: 从资料库的锁匠巡逻中收集。
3703045304.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

4164299630.name: Acceleron (Laboratory)

4164299630.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

3564890687.name: Acceleron (Displacement)

3564890687.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

2149531002.description_zh: 从预言者圣地的污染巡逻中收集。
2149531002.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

2667112711.name: Acceleron (Reflux)

2667112711.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

722310193.name: Acceleron (Translate)
722310193.description: Gathered from the Translate patrol in the Caldera.
722310193.description_zh: 从火山喷口的翻译巡逻中收集。
722310193.flavor: A sub-atomic particle that reacts with neutrinos to produce dark energy. Strange energy radiates from the containment field holding the particle, twisting the fabric of reality.

2610515000.name: Fated Cipher
2610515000.description: A gift from the Nine, used to focus gear at the Altar of Relativity on Kepler.
2610515000.description_zh: 来自玖的礼物，用于在开普勒的相对论圣坛聚焦装备。

353704689.name: Ascendant Alloy
353704689.description: Used in weapon shaping to enhance traits and upgrading weapon tiers. Obtained from challenging activities or purchasable from the Cryptarch in the Tower.
353704689.description_zh: 在武器塑形中用于强化特性与升级武器阶级。可从极具挑战性的活动中获取，或从高塔的解密大师处购买获得。

2228452164.name: Deepsight Harmonizer
2228452164.description: A strange device that can grant Deepsight activation to shapeable weapons. Cannot be used on weapons with Deepsight Resonance already available or completed. Raid weapons require Spoils of Conquest for activation.
2228452164.description_zh: 一个奇异装置，可以为可塑形武器提供深视激活。不能用于深视共振已可用或已完成的武器。突袭武器需要征服战利品来激活。

843838860.name: Shaping Whetstone
843838860.description:
A useful item that can instantly provide a weapon level-up to Shaped weapons under Weapon Level {var:2648023885}. 

In the inspection screen of a Shaped weapon, navigate to the Weapon Level Boost socket to expend this item.
843838860.description_zh:
可以将低于武器等级{var:2648023885}的塑形武器立即升级的实用道具。

在塑形武器的检视界面中，前往武器升级加速器插槽来消耗此物品。

1922808508.name: Shaped Weapon
1922808508.description:
This weapon has been shaped by the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.

Increase the weapon level by equipping and using this weapon in combat and activities. Higher levels unlock more components and perks to shape or reshape a weapon.
1922808508.description_zh:
这件武器由位于火星飞地中的圣物塑造成形。

通过在战斗和活动中装备并使用这件武器来提高武器等级。提升等级可以解锁更多的组件和特性，以塑造或重塑武器。

2728416798.name: Enhancement 1
2728416798.description:
Once enhanced, this weapon will be granted a weapon level, a Memento socket, and access to additional weapon mods.

Enhancing will immediately replace this weapon's Masterwork with an enhanced intrinsic that is aligned with the current Masterwork stat.
2728416798.description_zh:
强化后，这件武器会被赋予一个武器等级、一个纪念物插槽和额外武器模组权限。

强化武器会立即将大师杰作替换为符合当前大师杰作属性的强化固有特性。

2728416797.name: Enhancement 2
2728416797.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 2 will update the left-column trait perk(s).
2728416797.description_zh: 将此武器升级至强化2会更新左栏特性。

2728416796.name: Enhancement 3
2728416796.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 3 will update the right-column trait perk(s).
2728416796.description_zh: 将此武器升级至强化3会更新右栏特性。

253922071.name: Empty Enhancement Socket
253922071.description: This weapon can be upgraded with additional capabilities.
253922071.description_zh: 这个武器可升级额外能力。

3665398231.name: Trait Locked
3665398231.description: Reshaping an enhanced trait in the third column's trait perk requires the weapon to be upgraded to Enhancement 2.
3665398231.description_zh: 重塑第三栏特性中的强化特性需要将武器升级到强化2。

2106726848.name: Trait Locked
2106726848.description: Reshaping an enhanced trait in the fourth column's trait perk requires the weapon to be upgraded to Enhancement 3.
2106726848.description_zh: 重塑第四栏特性中的强化特性需要将武器升级到强化3。

1791833453.name: Extract Pattern
1791833453.description:
Obtain Weapon Pattern progress from this weapon.

Can only be performed once per weapon, but leaves the weapon intact.
1791833453.description_zh:
通过此武器获得武器模式进度。

每件武器只能进行一次，但可保持武器完好无损。

3674581496.name: Extract Pattern
3674581496.description:
Obtain Weapon Pattern progress from this weapon.

Can only be performed once per weapon, but leaves the weapon intact.
3674581496.description_zh:
通过此武器获得武器模式进度。

每件武器只能进行一次，但可保持武器完好无损。

2400712188.name: Deepsight Resonance
2400712188.description:
This weapon possesses a resonance detectable by your Deepsight ability.

Acquire weapon Pattern progress by either extracting the Pattern mod and retaining the weapon, or dismantling the weapon.
2400712188.description_zh:
这个武器拥有能被你的回声深视技能探测到的共振。

通过萃取模式模组保留武器，或拆解武器会获得武器模式进度。

1961918267.name: Empty Deepsight Socket
1961918267.description: Deepsight can be applied to this weapon.
1961918267.description_zh: 深视可以应用在此武器上。

4043342755.name: Empty Weapon Level Boost Socket
4043342755.name_zh: 空的武器升级加速插槽
4043342755.description: Inserting a Weapon Level Boost into this socket will increase the weapon's level.
4043342755.description_zh: 将一个武器升级加速器插入此插槽将会增加武器的等级。

4275472612.name: Increase Weapon Level
4275472612.description:
Apply to increase this weapon's level. Repeated applications are allowed.

Higher weapon levels have a greater currency cost.
4275472612.description_zh:
应用以提升此武器的等级。允许重复应用。

武器等级越高，货币费用越高。

3324845151.description: Apply to increase this weapon's level. This weapon level boost can only be applied when the weapon is under Level {var:2648023885}.
3324845151.description_zh: 应用以提升此武器的等级。该武器升级加速器仅可在武器等级低于{var:2648023885}时应用。

3794465708.name: Tier 1 Upgrade
3794465708.description:
Upgrades this Shaped weapon to Gear Tier 1.

Future Gear Tier upgrades will become available as the weapon levels up unlocking more enhanced perks and stat boosts.
3794465708.description_zh:
将此塑形武器升级至装备阶级1。

随着武器等级的提升，更多强化特性和属性加成将会解锁，从而提升装备阶级。

3794465711.name: Tier 2 Upgrade
3794465711.description:
Upgrades this Shaped weapon to Gear Tier 2.

Enhanced traits are available at the Shaping Table on Mars.
3794465711.description_zh:
将此塑形武器升级至装备阶级2。

可在火星的塑形桌获取强化特性。

3794465710.name: Tier 3 Upgrade
3794465710.description:
Upgrades this Shaped weapon to Gear Tier 3.

Unlocks access to Enhanced Weapon mods.
3794465710.description_zh:
将此塑形武器升级至装备阶级3。

解锁强化武器模组的权限。

3794465705.name: Tier 4 Upgrade
3794465705.description:

Enhanced components are available at the Shaping Table on Mars (barrels/magazines/etc.).
3794465705.description_zh:
将此塑形武器升级至装备阶级4。

可在火星的塑形桌获取强化组件（枪管/弹匣/等等）。

3794465704.name: Tier 5 Upgrade
3794465704.description:
Upgrades this Shaped weapon to Gear Tier 5.

Unlocks access to a Gear Tier 5 ornament and Combat Flair.

Enhanced traits are available at the Shaping Table on Mars.
3794465704.description_zh:
将此塑形武器升级至装备阶级5。

解锁装备阶级5皮肤和战斗特效。

可在火星的塑形桌获取强化特性。

3074755706.name: Empty Arrows Socket
3074755706.description:

1392806621.description: A large, neatly wrapped gift box to celebrate Solstice.
1392806621.description_zh: 一个包装精美的至日庆祝大礼盒。

1044534005.name: Solstice Package
1044534005.description: A small, neatly wrapped gift box to celebrate Solstice.
1044534005.description_zh: 一个包装精美的至日庆祝小礼盒。

3041849475.name: Solstice Alloy
3041849475.description: A brilliant alloy used to forge Lustrous armor and imbue it with a glow. Acquired by completing activities throughout the system.
3041849475.description_zh: 一种璀璨合金，可用于锻造光泽护甲并使其闪耀光芒。通过完成星系各处的活动获得。

3179318628.name: Solstice Forge
3179318628.description: Spend Solstice Alloy to forge Lustrous armor and its Incandescent glow.
3179318628.description_zh: 消耗至日合金来锻造光泽护甲及其辉炽炫彩。

4139659913.name: Candy
4139659913.description:
Acquired by defeating combatants throughout the system while you are wearing a Festival of the Lost mask.

Used to purchase exclusive rewards from Eva Levante in the Tower.

Available only during the Festival of the Lost.
4139659913.description_zh:
装备英灵日面具后，消灭星系内的战斗人员即可获得。

用于在高塔的伊娃·莱万特处购买专属奖励。

仅在英灵日期间可用。

3654020043.name: Manifested Page
3654020043.description:
Return this page to the "Tales of the Forgotten" book in the Tower to decipher it.

Available exclusively during Festival of the Lost.
3654020043.description_zh:
将这一页放回高塔里的《被遗忘者的故事》来将其破译。

仅限英灵日。
3654020043.flavor: A sheet of parchment filled with indecipherable arcane script.

2777868042.name_zh: 布瑞科技狼人（随机特性）
2777868042.description: Awards a random roll of BrayTech Werewolf.
2777868042.description_zh: 奖励一件随机特性的布瑞科技狼人。

3790856148.name: Epic Mystery Grab Bag
3790856148.description: A large, mysterious bag of goodies given in exchange for Candy.
3790856148.description_zh: 一个巨大而神秘的福利背包，可以通过糖果进行交换。

4205213276.name: Mystery Grab Bag
4205213276.description: A small, mysterious bag of goodies given in exchange for candy.
4205213276.description_zh: 一个小巧而神秘的福利背包，可以通过糖果进行交换。

4260972671.name: Higher Purpose
4260972671.description:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to enemies and provide near-invulnerability while airborne. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest.
4260972671.description_zh:
此面具可通过升级提高对敌人的伤害，且在空中时会处于近乎无敌状态。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。

4260972670.name: Vampiric Touch
4260972670.description:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to challenging enemies and trigger health regeneration on precision kills. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest.
4260972670.description_zh:
此面具可通过升级提高对高阶敌人的伤害，且精准击杀会触发生命值回复效果。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。

4260972669.name: Energetic Assassin
4260972669.description:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to Terrors and grant grenade and melee energy on precision kills. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest.
4260972669.description_zh:
此面具可通过升级提高对恐魔的伤害，且精准击杀会获得手雷和近战能量。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。

1632244010.name: Eerie Engram
1632244010.description: An engram humming with uncanny energy. Can be opened as is, or can be focused into an Exotic Engram with Eva in the Tower Courtyard.
1632244010.description_zh: 一块激荡着神秘能量的记忆水晶。可以直接开启，或在高塔庭院的伊娃处聚焦为异域记忆水晶。

2835311748.description_zh: 一块激荡着神秘能量的记忆水晶。包含异域护臂。

3809706287.description: Focus previously discovered Exotics with the Paragon archetype, guaranteeing Super as a primary stat and Melee as a secondary stat.
3809706287.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的楷模典范框架异域装备，保证超能为主要属性，近战为次要属性。

783205573.name: Grenadier Exotic Focusing
783205573.description: Focus previously discovered Exotics with the Grenadier archetype, guaranteeing Grenade as a primary stat and Super as a secondary stat.
783205573.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的掷雷手框架异域装备，保证手雷为主要属性，超能为次要属性。

3011363535.name: Gunner Exotic Focusing
3011363535.description: Focus previously discovered Exotics with the Gunner archetype, guaranteeing Weapons as a primary stat and Grenade as a secondary stat.
3011363535.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的枪手框架异域装备，保证武器为主要属性，手雷为次要属性。

3877269260.name: Brawler Exotic Focusing

3877269260.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的搏击手框架异域装备，保证近战为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

3181599365.name: Specialist Exotic Focusing
3181599365.description: Focus previously discovered Exotics with the Specialist archetype, guaranteeing Class as a primary stat and Weapons as a secondary stat.
3181599365.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的专家框架异域装备，保证职业为主要属性，武器为次要属性。

1817647442.name: Bulwark Exotic Focusing
1817647442.description: Focus previously discovered Exotics with the Bulwark archetype, guaranteeing Health as a primary stat and Class as a secondary stat.
1817647442.description_zh: 聚焦已发现的堡垒框架异域装备，保证生命值为主要属性，职业为次要属性。

3065473125.description: An engram humming with uncanny energy. Contains a random Festival of the Lost weapon.
3065473125.description_zh: 一块激荡着神秘能量的记忆水晶。包含一件随机英灵日武器。

3478033487.description: An engram with a Tier 3 weapon or armor gear item.
3478033487.description_zh: 一块包含一件3阶武器或护甲装备物品的记忆水晶。

2105109359.name: Essence
2105109359.description:
Add Essence of Dawning to complete the baking process.

Can be found by completing activities and challenges anywhere in the system.
2105109359.description_zh:
添加曙光精华以完成烘焙过程。

可以通过在星系各处完成活动和挑战获得。

3750865260.name: Essence of Dawning
3750865260.description: An ingredient needed for all recipes. It embodies the spirit of the Dawning and can be found by completing activities and challenges anywhere in the system.
3750865260.description_zh: 一种所有食谱都需要的原料。它是曙光节精神的具象化，可以通过在星系各处完成活动和挑战获得。

1914374939.name: Ingredient
1914374939.description: Choose an ingredient from the list below.
1914374939.description_zh: 从以下列表中选择一种原料。

4274829954.name: Uncommon Ingredients
4274829954.description:
Review available Uncommon ingredients from the list below.

Gathered by defeating specific combatant factions.
4274829954.description_zh:
从下方列表中查看可用的罕见原料。

通过击败特定的战斗人员阵营收集。

4274829953.name: Rare Ingredients
4274829953.description:
Review available Rare ingredients from the list below.

Gathered by defeating combatants in specific ways.
4274829953.description_zh:
从下方列表中查看可用的稀有原料。

通过特定方式击败战斗人员收集。

759016287.name: Pantry
759016287.description: Review available ingredients from the list below.
759016287.description_zh: 从下方列表中查看可用的原料。

4090950690.name: Discovered Recipes
4090950690.description: After successfully baking a new recipe for the first time, it will appear in this list for easy access.
4090950690.description_zh: 在首次成功烘培出一个新食谱后，它就会出现在这个列表里，方便你下次使用。

793351985.name: Masterworked Holiday Oven
793351985.description: Once you've successfully used Eva's Holiday Oven to bake one of everything, it can be upgraded into a Masterwork.
793351985.description_zh: 在你使用伊娃的节日烤箱成功烘焙了所有点心后，可以将其升级为大师杰作。

1671745951.name: Masterworked Holiday Oven
1671745951.description: Eva's Holiday Oven has unlocked its true potential, reducing the Essence of Dawning cost for all recipes.
1671745951.description_zh: 已发掘伊娃的节日烤箱的真正实力，可以降低制作所有食谱时使用的曙光精华的数量。

1327083312.name: Essence of Dawning
1327083312.description:
Essence of Dawning can be used to bake gifts in Eva's Holiday Oven.

Find essence by engaging in activities and completing challenges all over the system.
1327083312.description_zh:
曙光精华可用于在伊娃的节日烤箱中烘焙礼物。

可通过参与活动以及在全星系完成挑战获得。

3867293161.name: Vex Milk
3867293161.description:
Gained by defeating Vex opponents.

An ingredient that adds a bit of radiolarian liquid to anything it touches.
3867293161.description_zh:
击败Vex后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许放射性液体的原料。

3867293160.name: Ether Cane
3867293160.description:
Gained by defeating Fallen opponents.

An ingredient that adds an ethereal sweetness to anything it touches.
3867293160.description_zh:
击败堕落者后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许以太甜味的原料。

3867293163.name: Cabal Oil
3867293163.description:
Gained by defeating Cabal opponents.

An ingredient that toughens and thickens up anything it touches.
3867293163.description_zh:
通过击败卡巴尔获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许浓稠度的原料。

3867293162.name: Chitin Powder
3867293162.description:
Gained by defeating Hive opponents.

An ingredient that adds a bit of spice to anything it touches.
3867293162.description_zh:
击败邪魔族对手获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许辛辣味的原料。

3867293165.name: Taken Butter
3867293165.description:
Gained by defeating Taken opponents.

An ingredient that adds an echoing deliciousness to anything it touches.
3867293165.description_zh:
击败傀儡军团后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许美味回味的原料。

3867293164.name: Dark Ether Cane
3867293164.description:
Gained by defeating Scorn opponents.

An ingredient that adds a darkly sweet aroma to anything it touches.
3867293164.description_zh:
击败嗤魅后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许黑暗甜味的原料。

3867293167.name: Delicious Explosion
3867293167.description:
Gained by defeating opponents with Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Grenade abilities.

Sudden and violent. And also tasty.
3867293167.description_zh:
使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、和手雷技能击败对手后获得。

突兀而强烈，但也很美味。

3867293166.name: Sharp Flavor
3867293166.description:
Gained by defeating opponents with Swords.

A taste that will cut right through your taste buds.
3867293166.description_zh:
使用刀剑击败对手获得。

能穿透你味蕾的味道。

3867293153.name: Impossible Heat
3867293153.description:
Gained by defeating opponents with Solar damage.

Hotter than a Golden Gun on the surface of the sun.
3867293153.description_zh:
使用烈日伤害击败对手获得。

比在太阳表面的黄金枪还要火热。

3867293152.name: Electric Flavor
3867293152.description:
Gained by defeating opponents with Arc damage.

It courses through everything we touch… and taste.
3867293152.description_zh:
使用电弧伤害击败对手获得。

它流淌在一切我们触碰……和品尝到的东西中。

3338329096.name: Null Taste
3338329096.description:
Gained by defeating opponents with Void damage.

Between the light and the dark lies deliciousness.

3980154334.description_zh: 这个已经过期的曙光节消耗品已无任何作用，可拆解为光尘。

709082555.name: Expired Dawning Gift
709082555.description: The contents of this gift have expired, and it contains nothing of value. You may safely discard it.
709082555.description_zh: 此礼物中的内容已经过期。你可以安全地扔掉它了。

2086902186.name: BrayTech Gift Certificate
2086902186.description: Thank you for choosing BrayTech! Certificate valid only at our Mars branch.
2086902186.description_zh: 感谢你选择布瑞科技！本礼券仅在我们的火星分部有效。

2086902187.name: Donation Receipt
2086902187.description: A large donation has been made in your name to The Guardian Fund: Glimmer for Guardians.
2086902187.description_zh: “守护者基金：守护者的微光”收到了一笔以你的名义捐赠的款项。

2086902184.name: Infinite Fruitcake
2086902184.description: There is no reality in which this is an acceptable gift.
2086902184.description_zh: 在任何现实中这都不是一份可以接受的礼物。

2086902185.name: Sock Engram
2086902185.description: An Engram containing a single sensible sock.
2086902185.description_zh: 一个包含一只恰好合适的袜子记忆水晶。

2086902190.name: Vex Nog
2086902190.description: Hints of cinnamon and nutmeg round out the custardy flavor of this seasonal drink. DO NOT CONSUME.
2086902190.description_zh: 这种季节性饮品的乳蛋糕中散发出肉桂和肉豆蔻的丝丝香气。不要食用。

3589159886.name: Cosmic Sugar Cube
3589159886.description:
A small crystalline hexahedron, each facet encrusted with miniature sugared galaxies. It shimmers in and out of this reality.

You believe a certain impossible horse might appreciate this.
3589159886.description_zh:
一个小型透明六面体，每个面都覆有微型糖衣星系。它来回闪烁于这个现实之中。

你相信某匹不可思议之马会喜欢这个。

1537854340.name: A Gift in Return
1537854340.description: The cheer you've spread has come full circle. Unwrap this gift to receive a token of appreciation from your friends in the Last City.
1537854340.description_zh: 你所散播的欢愉，现已圆满归航。拆开这个礼物，它代表了圣城好友们对你的感谢。

3315824223.name: Dawning Spirit
3315824223.description:
Dawning Spirit can be redeemed through Eva to enhance your ability to spread holiday cheer.

Generated by delivering cookies and completing other Dawning objectives.

Available only during the Dawning.
3315824223.description_zh:
你可以在伊娃处兑换曙光节精神，强化你分享节日喜庆的能力。

曙光节精神可通过送饼干和完成其他曙光节任务产生。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

2840472324.name: RENEGADE ABILITY SELECTION INSTRUCTIONS
2840472324.description: You may equip two Renegade Abilities for use in the Lawless Frontier through the Renegade Abilities Selector. Currently equipped abilities are visible under Equipped Renegade Abilities.
2840472324.description_zh: 你可以使用“反叛者技能选择器”为无序边界装备两种反叛者技能。当前装备的技能可在“已装备反叛者技能”下查看。
2840472324.flavor: See Renegade Ability descriptions for more information.

4114681644.name: Unequip All
4114681644.description_zh: 卸下当前所有选取的技能。
4114681644.flavor: See Renegade Ability descriptions for more information.

3540391529.name: TOTALITY REPUTATION INFO
3540391529.description:
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Totality Division War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Reputation unlocks access to many rewards:

• The Totality gear shop, where you can directly purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Armorer Aghol.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.
3540391529.description_zh:
将暗物质锭存入总合部军资箱以获取在此帮派处的声望。声望可解锁大量奖励：

• 总合部装备商店，你可在那里用信用点直接购买改装B-7手枪和英勇利刃的修改器。你提升声望等级时也会获得额外装备。

• 反叛者技能，可在护甲商阿戈尔处解锁和购买。

• 周常补给，其规模将随你当前声望提升。
3540391529.flavor: See item descriptions for additional information.

2893288903.name: Rank 1
2893288903.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• Dark Matter Ingots can be deposited at the Totality Division War Chest in exchange for Reputation and gear, including a chance for Modified B-7 Pistol. 

• The Imperium Pod Renegade Ability can be upgraded up to Level 4.

• Small Weekly Shipments can be earned by completing Totality Division Priority Contracts.
2893288903.description_zh:
赋予以下福利：

• 可在总合部军资箱处存入暗物质锭以换取声望与装备，并有机会获得改装B-7手枪。

• 帝国空降仓反叛者技能可升级至等级4。

• 完成总合部首要合约可获得小型周常补给。

2893288902.name: Rank 2
2893288902.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• You can access the Totality gear shop and purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Crystal Strength I for Credits.

• The Totality Division shares their access codes, allowing access to some locked areas in the Lawless Frontier.
2893288902.description_zh:
赋予以下福利：

• 你可使用总合部装备商店，并以信用点购买改装B-7手枪和水晶之力I。

• 总合部会分享他们的访问代码，允许你进入无序边界中部分锁定区域。

2893288901.name: Rank 3
2893288901.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• The Imperium Behemoth Renegade Ability can be purchased and upgraded through Level 4 for Credits.

• Large Weekly Shipments can be earned.

• Higher quality Totality Division Contracts can appear.
2893288901.description_zh:
赋予以下福利：

• 可购买帝国巨兽反叛者技能，并以信用点将其升级至等级4。

• 可获得大型周常补给。

• 有机会出现更高品质的总合部合约。

2893288900.name: Rank 4
2893288900.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• All gear shops in the Tharsis Bazaar offer 1 additional discounted purchase per day.

• The Totality gear shop also offers 2 discounted purchases of Modified B-7 Pistol
 per day.

• Crystal Strength II can be purchased in the Totality Division gear shop.

• Totality Division Renegade Abilities can be upgraded to level 6.
2893288900.description_zh:
赋予以下福利：

• 塔尔西斯集市中的所有装备商店每天提供额外1次优惠购买。

• 总合部装备商店每天
还提供2次优惠购买改装B-7手枪。

• 可在总合部装备商店购买水晶之力II。

• 总合部反叛者技能可升级至等级6。

2893288899.name: Rank 5
2893288899.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• Crystal Strength III can be purchased in the Totality Division gear shop.

• The Totality gear shop offers 3 discounted purchases of the Modified B-7 Pistol per day.

• Massive Weekly Shipments can be earned.

• Totality Division Renegade Abilities can be fully upgraded.
2893288899.description_zh:
赋予以下福利：

• 可在总合部装备商店购买水晶之力III。

• 总合部装备商店每天提供3次优惠购买改装B-7手枪。

• 可获得巨型周常补给。

• 总合部反叛者技能可升至满级。

380637670.name: Small Totality Shipment
380637670.description: A modest shipment from the Totality Division in exchange for completing Totality Priority Contracts. Shipments arrive once a week.
380637670.description_zh: 完成总合部首要合约获得的适量补给。补给每周送达一次。

1315728068.name: Large Totality Shipment
1315728068.description:
A sizeable shipment from the Totality Division in exchange for completing Totality Priority Contracts. Shipments arrive once a week.

This is an upgrade to the Small Totality Shipment and can be earned at Totality Division Reputation Rank 3.
1315728068.description_zh:
完成总合部首要合约获得的中量补给。补给每周送达一次。

这是小型周常补给的升级，可在总合部声望等级3时获得。

805756410.name: Massive Totality Shipment
805756410.description:

This is an upgrade to the Large Weekly Shipment and can be earned at Totality Division Reputation Rank 5.
805756410.description_zh:
完成总合部首要合约获得的巨量补给。补给每周送达一次。

这是大型周常补给的升级，可在总合部声望等级5时获得。

4109798877.name: THARSIS REFORMATION REPUTATION INFO
4109798877.name_zh: 塔尔西斯革新会声望信息
4109798877.description:
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Tharsis Reformation War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Reputation unlocks access to many rewards:

• The Reformation gear shop, where you can directly purchase All or Nothing and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your Reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Reformancer Guzheng.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.
4109798877.description_zh:
将暗物质锭存入塔尔西斯革新会军资箱以获取在此帮派处的声望。声望可解锁大量奖励：

• 革新会装备商店，你可在那里用信用点直接购买不胜即亡和英勇利刃的修改器。你提升声望等级时也会获得额外装备。

• 反叛者技能，可在革新师古筝处解锁和购买。

• 周常补给，其规模将随你当前声望提升。
4109798877.flavor: See item descriptions for additional information.

4231469209.name: Keycard (Adamant)
4231469209.description: Grants access to a high-security vault on the wind-blasted plains of Europa.
4231469209.description_zh: 提供进入木卫二风蚀平原的高安全性保险库的权限。

4271401910.name: Keycard (Forging Matrix)
4271401910.description: Grants access to a high-security vault in the rime-encrusted stronghold on Europa.
4271401910.description_zh: 提供进入木卫二的覆霜据点的高安全性保险库的权限。

1561544959.name: Keycard (Selina Morass)
1561544959.description: Grants access to a high-security vault in the treacherous swamps of Venus.
1561544959.description_zh: 提供进入金星的危险沼泽的高安全性保险库的权限。

3070632546.name: Keycard (Artesia Mons)
3070632546.description: Grants access to a high-security vault in the wilderness of Venus.
3070632546.description_zh: 提供进入金星的荒野的高安全性保险库的权限。

3457574567.name: Imperium Behemoth: Standard Loadout
3457574567.description: Uses the factory-standard weapons systems common to any baseline pattern Imperium Behemoth. Equipped with dual-power Heat weapons. Perform a powered evade stomp with [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_vehicle_dodge_button###].
3457574567.description_zh: 使用常见于任意基线型号帝国巨兽的出厂标准武器系统。装备双动力热量武器。通过[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_vehicle_dodge_button###]释放充能闪避践踏。

3457574566.name: Behemoth: Missile Loadout
3457574566.description: This Behemoth retains all purchased upgrades. It gains an additional missile system upgrade. Fire missiles with [Vehicle Secondary Fire].
3457574566.description_zh: 此巨兽保留所有已购买升级。它将获得一项额外的导弹系统升级。通过[载具次要攻击]发射导弹。

3457574565.name: Behemoth: Mortar Loadout
3457574565.description: This Behemoth retains all purchased upgrades. It gains an additional mortar system upgrade. Mortars can be detonated remotely for longer range. Hold [Vehicle Secondary Fire], then release to detonate.
3457574565.description_zh: 此巨兽保留所有已购买升级。它将获得一项额外的迫击炮系统升级。迫击炮可远程引爆以获得更长射程。按住[载具次要攻击]，然后松开以引爆。

3457574564.name: Behemoth: Seismic Charge Loadout
3457574564.description: This Behemoth retains all purchased upgrades. It gains an additional seismic charge system upgrade. Freeze the entire battlefield with a single seismic charge. Launch a seismic charge with [Vehicle Secondary Fire].
3457574564.description_zh: 此巨兽保留所有已购买升级。它将获得一项额外的地震充能系统升级。用单次地震充能冻结整片战场。通过[载具次要攻击]发射地震充能。

296300392.name: Piker Chop Shop: Falcon
296300392.description: The Falcon has an incredible top speed and heavy mounted Heat weapons, which can be fired while in motion. The Falcon can cause high-collision damage when traveling at high speeds.
296300392.description_zh: 鹘鹰拥有惊人的最高速度，以及能在移动中开火的重型挂载热量武器。鹘鹰在高速行进时会造成高碰撞伤害。

296300393.name: Piker Chop Shop: Strand Pike
296300393.name_zh: 派克组拆车厂：缚丝派克
296300393.description: This Pike is infused with Strand energy. Dodging launches a large Strand projectile that can tie up Imperium Behemoths.
296300393.description_zh: 这辆派克注入了缚丝能量。闪身会发射一枚大型缚丝射弹，可束缚帝国巨兽。

296300394.name: Piker Chop Shop: Stasis Interceptor
296300394.name_zh: 派克组拆车厂：冰影拦截者
296300394.description: The Piker's Interceptor is outfitted with experimental Stasis weaponry that can freeze targets. Unlimited boost allows you smash through any frozen target. The vehicle can spawn its own Stasis crystals using its secondary fire with [Vehicle Secondary Fire].
296300394.description_zh: 派克组的拦截者配备了实验型冰影武器，可冻结目标。无限加速可撞碎任何冻结目标。载具可通过副武器[载具次要攻击]生成冰影水晶。

3495047237.name: Ghost Parts
3495047237.description: Needed to repair Drifter's Ghost's voice. Could use a scrubbing.
3495047237.description_zh: 用于修复浪客机灵的声音。需要好好清理一下。

3374656737.name: Ally Yourself
3374656737.description: Choose this reputation reward to promise allyship with your current Syndicate and increase your reputation with them.
3374656737.description_zh: 选择此声望奖励来承诺与当前帮派结盟，并提升你在该帮派处的声望。

3083188238.name: Make No Promises
3083188238.description:
Choose this reputation reward to leave your current allied Syndicate and be a renegade who only looks out for yourself.

You will receive lesser amounts of reputation for the other Syndicates.
3083188238.description_zh:
选择此声望奖励来离开当前结盟的帮派，做个只顾自己的反叛者。

你将在其他帮派处获得少量声望。

1235471577.name: Infamous Engram
1235471577.description: This rare engram is guaranteed to contain an Infamous weapon.
1235471577.description_zh: 这个稀有记忆水晶必定包含一件恶名武器。

1274190840.name: Dark Matter Ingot
1274190840.description:
A rare material found on Mars since its return. Valued highly by the denizens of the Lawless Frontier.

Can be donated to any of the three Syndicates in the Tharsis Bazaar to increase standing and earn rewards.
1274190840.description_zh:
自火星回归后发现的珍稀材料，备受无序边界居民的追捧。

可捐赠给塔尔西斯集市中三大帮派中任一帮派，来提升声望并获取奖励。

As the de facto currency of the Lawless Frontier, these golden chits have greased untold palms.

Used to purchase goods from merchants in the Tharsis Bazaar.
589719184.description_zh:
作为无序边界实际上的货币，这些金色单据不知在多少双手上流转过。

4150228564.description:

Can be exchanged for weapons and armor in the Tharsis Bazaar.
4150228564.description_zh:

402110270.description: Used to unlock rewards from the Monument of Triumph. Acquired by completing Triumphs from the Monument and Legendary Orders.
402110270.description_zh: 用于在凯旋纪念碑处解锁奖励。通过完成来自纪念碑的成就和传说命令获得。

3332402597.name: Unlock: Stag Pincer Exotic Sparrow
3332402597.name_zh: 解锁：鹿角甲虫异域快雀

1982436757.description: Clear the Artifact and begin anew.

1387688628.name: The Gate Lord's Eye
1387688628.flavor: The charged eye of a Vex Gate Lord can be used to infiltrate the most protected layers of their network… and reverse engineered to confer incredible powers to its bearer.
1387688628.lore:
An iris unfurls. Our gaze caught. Cortex clutched. Suspended.

A million lights bend inward. Pulled on a wave of enigmatic tone.

A million lights rip inward. Fall. Link. Scream. Cycle. Bleed. Blend. Cycle.

One light alone. Pulled. Discordant. Suspended in the Endless.

Screams.

An iris unfurls.

Run. Run. Run.

An iris unfurls.

Run. Run.

An iris unfurls.

Run.

Blink. An iris folds in.
1387688628.lore_zh:
虹膜张开。抓住了我们的目光。大脑皮层缩成一团。停止了工作。

数以百万计的光亮向内弯曲。拉扯着一股有着神秘色调的波。

数以百万计的光亮向内撕裂。坠落。连接。尖叫。循环。流血。混合。循环。

只有一束光。被拉扯。不和谐。停留在无限之中。

尖叫。

虹膜张开。

奔跑。奔跑。奔跑。

虹膜张开。

奔跑。奔跑。

虹膜张开。

奔跑。

眨眼。虹膜摺起。

3452825266.name: The Gate Lord's Eye
3452825266.description: The charged eye of a Vex Gate Lord can be used to infiltrate the most protected layers of their network… and reverse engineered to confer incredible powers to its bearer.
3452825266.description_zh: Vex门神的充能之眼可用于渗透到他们网络中最受保护的那一层……并且通过逆向工程赋予它的承载者不可思议的力量。

3770475779.name: Solstice Grasps (Drained)
3770475779.description: Hold too tight and it could all slip away.
3770475779.description_zh: 好似流沙，握越紧，越易逝。

1519942861.name: Solstice Vest (Drained)
1519942861.description: Memories of lost loves burn in your heart.
1519942861.description_zh: 失落爱情的记忆在你心中燃烬。

3970398144.name: Solstice Vest (Drained)
3970398144.description: Mistakes can burn, even in the dead of night.

1533101114.name: Solstice Mask (Drained)
1533101114.description: Hide your true face from the sun, lest you get burned.
1533101114.description_zh: 唯恐灼伤，将真正面容隐于烈日之下。

1820842677.name: Solstice Strides (Drained)
1820842677.description: Jump not from the pan into the flames.
1820842677.description_zh: 万不可从锅中跃入烈焰。

3770475778.name: Solstice Grasps (Renewed)
3770475778.description: Lift your arms high to welcome the power of the sun.
3770475778.description_zh: 高举双臂，拥抱太阳的力量。

1519942860.name: Solstice Vest (Renewed)
1519942860.description: Let the feeling of reunion be in your heart.

1533101115.name: Solstice Mask (Renewed)
1533101115.description: Be renewed in mind and spirit.
1533101115.description_zh: 让思维和心灵重焕新生。

1820842676.name: Solstice Strides (Renewed)
1820842676.description: Go in health and new vigor.

298089927.name: Solstice Gauntlets (Drained)
298089927.description: Sometimes the battle burns you up.
298089927.description_zh: 你也会有战至力竭之时。

2047844849.name: Solstice Plate (Drained)
2047844849.description: Memories of the City burn in your heart.
2047844849.description_zh: 圣城的记忆在你心中燃烬。

4201697932.name: Solstice Mark (Drained)
4201697932.description: Battle scars may burn and leave a mark.
4201697932.description_zh: 历战伤痕也会燃起，留下印记。

3389066870.name: Solstice Helm (Drained)
3389066870.description: Stare into the sun and get burned.

3345862921.name: Solstice Greaves (Drained)
3345862921.description: Go swift as a steed newly awakened.
3345862921.description_zh: 化作初醒神驹，一跃千里。

298089926.name: Solstice Gauntlets (Renewed)
298089926.description: Lift and rise with renewed strength.

2047844848.name: Solstice Plate (Renewed)
2047844848.description: Let the spirit swell in your heart.

4201697933.name: Solstice Mark (Renewed)
4201697933.description: Wear the aspect of surging renewal.
4201697933.description_zh: 身着汹涌复兴的那一面。

3345862920.name: Solstice Greaves (Renewed)
3345862920.description: Rally and run with renewed vigor.
3345862920.description_zh: 带着新唤的活力集结冲锋。

592288414.name: Solstice Gloves (Drained)
592288414.description: Heat can burn as much as it warms.
592288414.description_zh: 热量既可焚毁一切，亦可温暖身心。

942888402.name: Solstice Robes (Drained)
942888402.description: Even the warmest light can sometimes burn you up.
942888402.description_zh: 即使是最温暖的光，有时也能让你筋疲力尽。

1579706083.name: Solstice Bond (Drained)
1579706083.description: The brightest lights sometimes burn out fastest.
1579706083.description_zh: 有时候，最耀眼的光最短命。

1518774295.name: Solstice Hood (Drained)
1518774295.description: Beloved cities burn in your mind's eye.
1518774295.description_zh: 挚爱城市在你的思想中燃烧。

1011670904.name: Solstice Boots (Drained)
1011670904.description_zh: 有时，站着不动也是一种勇气。

592288415.name: Solstice Gloves (Renewed)
592288415.description: Renewal can begin with just a spark.

942888403.name: Solstice Robes (Renewed)
942888403.description: A reawakening stirs deep within you and radiates outward.
942888403.description_zh: 内心重燃之烈火，散发着熊熊火光。

1579706082.name: Solstice Bond (Renewed)
1579706082.description: Show them! You are here, awake at last!
1579706082.description_zh: 让他们看看！你终于苏醒！

1518774294.name: Solstice Hood (Renewed)
1518774294.description: The flame of reawakening ignites in your mind.
1518774294.description_zh: 觉醒烈焰在你脑中点燃。

1011670905.name: Solstice Boots (Renewed)
1011670905.description: Run! For you are awake now and may never sleep again!
1011670905.description_zh: 冲！你既已清醒，就不再沉睡！

3360014173.name: The Lantern of Osiris
3360014173.flavor: "To light your way from time to time." —Osiris
3360014173.lore: "I created the Sundial to rectify my greatest regret. I failed. And now the Red Legion has turned my failure to catastrophe. Time is broken on Mercury. It has taken all my resources, all my Echoes, to monitor the timestreams the Legion has created on Mercury. So this Lantern is yours now. To light your way from time to time. May it serve you better than it served me." —Osiris
3360014173.lore_zh: “我创造日晷是为了弥补我最大的遗憾。我失败了。而现在，猩红军团将我的这个失败变成了灾难。水星上的时间破碎了。我耗尽了所有的资源，所有的回声来监测猩红军团在水星上制造的时间线。这个灯笼现在属于你了。不时点亮你的道路。希望它在你手里能比我发挥更大的作用。”——奥斯里斯

939066213.name: The Lantern of Osiris
939066213.description: "To light your way from time to time." —Osiris
939066213.description_zh: “为了不时点亮你的道路。”——奥斯里斯
939066213.lore: "I created the Sundial to rectify my greatest regret. I failed. And now the Red Legion has turned my failure to catastrophe. Time is broken on Mercury. It has taken all my resources, all my Echoes, to monitor the timestreams the Legion has created on Mercury. So this Lantern is yours now. To light your way from time to time. May it serve you better than it served me." —Osiris
939066213.lore_zh: “我创造日晷是为了弥补我最大的遗憾。我失败了。而现在，猩红军团将我的这个失败变成了灾难。水星上的时间破碎了。我耗尽了所有的资源，所有的回声来监测猩红军团在水星上制造的时间线。这个灯笼现在属于你了。不时点亮你的道路。希望它在你手里能比我发挥更大的作用。”——奥斯里斯

1631206822.name: Seed of Silver Wings
1631206822.flavor: Malleable and hungering. Speak not of what it becomes.
1631206822.lore:
[GST-ENCODED=9: Sndr.1//MSTC

[GST-ENCODED=9@: Rcpt.1//GLNT; Rcpt.2//SCRB

To our little trio,

I write out of concern, and independently, my findings. I sense the tension brimming at the forefront of our correspondences, and I feel the need to again impress upon you the gravity of our current standing.

I understand the Vanguard's position. Contact has been made. I have felt it. I cannot ignore it, nor can I purge it—that much you should know. It is not a temptation. It is not a disease. It is an appeal to reason. I know you see the worth; long have the thanatonauts delved into these questions. Where they went, I simply walk a parallel road. Do not abandon me in this. There is little time, and it may be all we have left.

Now, Ikora, to the matter of your inquiry—thank you for that, by the way. That you would not come yourself, I will say nothing.

There is a second Tree, obviously. It has grown, and from it, the Guardian has taken a Seed that we intend to use for study. With the Tree's parent felled in the Black Garden, this may be a rarely given opportunity. I am only now beginning to record its most lightly guarded secrets. It is fluid in nature—no, Asher, not physically. It acts as an engine of integration, incorporating that which it contacts into its structure. It feeds from paracausal energy. The Light. The Dark. They are vying for dominance within its every particle.

I wonder whether we are meant to enact a second unveiling; whether this is to be a peeling away of an existence nurtured within its bark. One in which we may play out the paths that are yet to come. There are many answers, but the question remains: By whom was it planted?

I hope this message finds you in good health, and less pain.

I look forward to your thoughts.

To the Gallant, the Mystic, the Scribe: May our bond hold strong. Ever-sworn,

Eris Morn
1631206822.lore_zh:
[GST-ENCODED=9:Sndr.1//MSTC

[GST-ENCODED=9@:Rcpt.1//GLNT; Rcpt.2//SCRB

致我们小小的三人组，

出于忧虑和我的发现，我是独立不受影响地写下这封信。我感觉到我们之间的通信笼罩着紧张的气氛，我感到有必要再次强调下目前情况的严重性。

我理解先锋的立场。已经联系上了。我能感觉到。无法忽略它，也无法清除——这一点你应该知道。它不是一种诱惑，也不是一种病。它是对理性的诉求。我知道你能看到价值，探灵人研究这些问题研究了很长时间。他们去的地方，我干脆就走一条平行的路。不要在这个问题上抛弃我。时间不多，可能所剩无几。

那么，艾可拉，对于你的问题——谢谢你，顺便说。你不会自己来的，我什么也不会说。

显然还有第二棵树。那棵树已经长大，守护者从它那里取得了一颗种子，我们准备用来进行研究。那棵树的父母已经在黑暗花园中陨落，这可能是个难得的机会。我现在才开始记录它守卫最松弛的秘密。本质上它是流体，不，阿什，并不是物理意义上的流体。它就像一个整合引擎，把所接触的东西纳入到自己的结构中。以超因果能量为食。光能。暗影。它们在它每一颗粒子内争夺着主导地位。

我不禁好奇，我们是否要开启第二次揭露。这样是否会剥离它树皮内所孕育的存在。在这其中，我们也许可以探索到尚未到来的道路。答案有很多，但问题仍在：究竟是谁种下这棵树的？

希望你收到这条消息的时候身体健康，少些痛苦。

也期待听到你的想法。

致英勇，神秘，文士：愿我们的情谊永固。永誓的，

埃里斯·摩恩

4221096044.name: Fang of Xivu Arath
4221096044.flavor: A relic from the Hive god of war, passed down to you from Osiris and his followers.
4221096044.lore:
[Report by VanNet encrypted router.]

Zavala, your most recent correspondence came as a surprise; while I thank you and Ikora for undergoing the formality of lifting my exile, I had not expected any additional direction from Vanguard High Command—and so I have not read it.

The zealots that followed me to Mercury have proved themselves useful… twice now, actually. They possessed an artifact in their stores: a Hive fang. Look to the grooves that run along its root. They allow it to break away from the jaw so that another may take its place. The Hive bear resemblance to another predator I found in simulations of ancient Earth. I don't imagine you've ever seen a shark, Zavala, but you would admire their simplicity and single-minded devotion. They are creatures of predatory instinct. Pure, in a way, to know what one is and act on it. They are not unlike our enemy. Not evil, but driven.

You will receive a case. Within it, you will find said fang; it is of Xivu Arath, Hive aspect of war. In my travels, I found similar artifacts ground and burnt upon a shrine buried deep beneath Luna's crust. The shrine reeks of Hive magic, and it is obviously the site of a ritual. I fear that in reaction to our Dark visitors, the broken ranks, left leaderless after Hashladûn's demise, called out to be recommitted into the fold. It is time to act, Zavala. She means to test our vulnerability.

Do not wait in your office for the Traveler to guide you. The City looks to the Vanguard to lead us to something better than fear. Be that leader, and I will stand by you.
4221096044.lore_zh:
【报告来自VanNet加密路由器。】

萨瓦拉，最近收到你的信让我很意外。很感谢你和艾可拉为我办理了解除流放的手续，但我并不愿意接受先锋军最高指挥部的指使，所以我没有看。

跟随我一同到达水星的那些狂热分子已经充分发挥了他们的作用...已经有两次了。他们收藏有一件神器：一根邪魔族的利齿。看看这根部的凹槽，这种结构可以让他从颚部脱落，换上一根新的。我在模拟地球远古生物的时候发现有一种生物跟邪魔族非常相似，那种生物叫鲨鱼，可能你完全没有见过也没有什么概念，但是你如果见到的话一定会被他们的牙齿震撼。它们是天生的掠食者。它们的动机也非常纯粹，跟我们的敌人一样。并非邪恶，而是本能的驱使。

你会收到一个箱子，箱子里有一根希乌·阿拉斯的牙，邪魔族的战神。我在旅途中曾发现过类似的神器，就埋在月球地壳下的神殿里碎裂、燃烧着。整座神殿散发着邪魔族魔法的能量，看起来就是个仪式场所。恐怕是为了呼应那些黑暗中的来客，自从哈什拉顿死后，整个军团群龙无首，急需有人来重整。所以，萨瓦拉，该行动了，这是至关重要的时刻。

别坐在办公室里等待旅行者给你指引了。整个城市都需要一位先锋扛起大旗成为领导者，带领大家战胜恐惧。而这位领导者就是你，我也会辅佐你，成为你的左膀右臂。

3234265291.name: Bell of Conquests
3234265291.description: Hear the seventh strike, calling blades to meet.
3234265291.description_zh: 聆听第七次打击，召唤利刃相会。
3234265291.lore:
This style of Cabal war bell, known as the Bell of Conquests, is a standout example of the traditional combat artistry known as scal'sangus—literally "blood etching"—popular during the Era of Lead, before the Cabal extended their reach beyond their immediate star system. These objects commemorated martial feats and personal victories but varied widely in appearance. Peasant mercenaries often simply stitched the carved teeth of their defeated foes into their leathers; those with more resources sometimes claimed the entire torsos of vanquished opponents to preserve, lacquer, and display as busts.

The Bell of Conquests was a less grisly chronicle of the victories of its owner. Unadorned bells were given to warriors at their first blood. Those who wished to challenge a warrior in combat would request their bell and ring it seven times.

As warriors collected victories, they could have artisans decorate their bells to commemorate their glories. These adornments allowed the bearers to call upon benefits for honorable combat related to their past victories: a warrior who had completed the Trial of Beasts could bring a trained war beast into a duel; a survivor of the Flayed Night was allowed to cut their opponent twice across the stomach; those who had withstood the Cold Iron Mouth could coat their blades in caustic white ash.

Defeating the bearer of a war bell entitled the victor to claim the bell as their own. The clapper of the bell would be carved with a shallow engraving representing the previous owner's cause of death. Ownership would fully transfer after the engraving had been worn away by new challengers ringing the bell. At that point, all the privileges the bell bestowed upon its former owner would be granted to the new holder. For this reason, elaborate war bells were both highly sought after and heavily defended.

War bells continued to be carried into the galactic-colonial period, and their decorations became even more refined. Intricate mosaics pressed with precious gems became symbols of wealth and granted further allowances in duels, while also creating a larger incentive for would-be challengers. As the scale of warfare increased, the logistical difficulties of claiming war bells became apparent. Captured war bells were sometimes melted down en masse and recast as elaborate war gongs, and there were specific rituals in place for spacefaring rivals to ring the gong in challenge.

In the post-Red War Cabal, few soldiers adhere to the tradition, as the Bell of Conquests is seen as a cumbersome relic. Nevertheless, they may still find a place of honor aboard the ships of those who wish to respect the combat traditions of their ancestors.
3234265291.lore_zh:
这种被称为“征服之钟”的卡巴尔战钟，是传统战斗艺术的一个典型代表，被称为“血蚀”（scal'sangus，字面意思为“血蚀”），流行于铅时代，在卡巴尔将他们的影响力扩展到直接星系外之前。这些器物纪念着军事功绩和个人胜利，但外观差别很大。农民雇佣兵通常只是将他们击败敌人的刻牙缝在他们的皮革上；那些有更多资源的人，有时会索要击败对手的整个躯干，来保存、上漆和作为半身像展示。

征服之钟是一部不那么残酷的编年史，记载了它的主人的胜利。不加修饰的钟，在战士们第一次流血的时候就送给了他们。想在战斗中挑战勇士的人，会请求他们的铃铛，并敲响七下。

当勇士们收集胜利的时候，他们可以让工匠们装饰他们的战钟，纪念他们的荣耀。这些装饰品让持有者能够调用与他们过去胜利有关的荣誉战斗的福利：完成了野兽试炼的战士，可以带着一只训练有素的战兽参加决斗；剥皮之夜的幸存者，可以在对手的肚子上划两刀；经受住寒铁之口的人，可以在他们的刀刃上涂上腐蚀性的白灰。

如果打败战钟的持有者，胜利者就有资格将战钟据为己有。战钟的铃舌上，会刻有代表前主人死因的浅刻。在敲响战钟的新挑战者磨损铭刻后，所有权将会完全转移。此时，战钟的前主人所享有的所有特权都将授予新的持有人。因为这个原因，精心制作的战钟既备受追捧，又防备森严。

战钟一直延续到银河系殖民时期，其装饰也越发精致。繁复的马赛克上压满珍贵的宝石，成为财富的象征，并在决斗中获得更多津贴，同时也给潜在的挑战者带来更大的激励。随着战争规模的扩大，申领战钟的后勤困难就显现出来。被夺取的战钟有时会被集体熔化，重新铸造成精巧的战锣，并且有特定的仪式，让太空中的对手敲锣挑战。

在猩红战争后的卡巴尔，很少再有士兵坚持这一传统，因为征服之钟被视为累赘的遗物。尽管如此，在那些希望尊重祖先战斗传统的人的飞船上，他们仍然能够找到一席之地。

As warriors collected victories, they could have artisans decorate their bells to commemorate their glories. These adornments allowed the bearers to call upon benefits for honorable combat related to their past victories: a warrior who had completed the Trial of Beasts could bring a trained war beast into a duel; a survivor of the Flayed Night was allowed to cut their opponent twice across the stomach; those who had withstood the Cold Iron Mouth could coat their blades in caustic white ash.

Defeating the bearer of a war bell entitled the victor to claim the bell as their own. The clapper of the bell would be carved with a shallow engraving representing the previous owner's cause of death. Ownership would fully transfer after the engraving had been worn away by new challengers ringing the bell. At that point, all the privileges the bell bestowed upon its former owner would be granted to the new holder. For this reason, elaborate war bells were both highly sought after and heavily defended.

War bells continued to be carried into the galactic-colonial period, and their decorations became even more refined. Intricate mosaics pressed with precious gems became symbols of wealth and granted further allowances in duels, while also creating a larger incentive for would-be challengers. As the scale of warfare increased, the logistical difficulties of claiming war bells became apparent. Captured war bells were sometimes melted down en masse and recast as elaborate war gongs, and there were specific rituals in place for spacefaring rivals to ring the gong in challenge.

In the post-Red War Cabal, few soldiers adhere to the tradition, as the Bell of Conquests is seen as a cumbersome relic. Nevertheless, they may still find a place of honor aboard the ships of those who wish to respect the combat traditions of their ancestors.
3587990247.lore_zh:
这种被称为“征服之钟”的卡巴尔战钟，是传统战斗艺术的一个典型代表，被称为“血蚀”（scal'sangus，字面意思为“血蚀”），流行于铅时代，在卡巴尔将他们的影响力扩展到直接星系外之前。这些器物纪念着军事功绩和个人胜利，但外观差别很大。农民雇佣兵通常只是将他们击败敌人的刻牙缝在他们的皮革上；那些有更多资源的人，有时会索要击败对手的整个躯干，来保存、上漆和作为半身像展示。

征服之钟是一部不那么残酷的编年史，记载了它的主人的胜利。不加修饰的钟，在战士们第一次流血的时候就送给了他们。想在战斗中挑战勇士的人，会请求他们的铃铛，并敲响七下。

当勇士们收集胜利的时候，他们可以让工匠们装饰他们的战钟，纪念他们的荣耀。这些装饰品让持有者能够调用与他们过去胜利有关的荣誉战斗的福利：完成了野兽试炼的战士，可以带着一只训练有素的战兽参加决斗；剥皮之夜的幸存者，可以在对手的肚子上划两刀；经受住寒铁之口的人，可以在他们的刀刃上涂上腐蚀性的白灰。

如果打败战钟的持有者，胜利者就有资格将战钟据为己有。战钟的铃舌上，会刻有代表前主人死因的浅刻。在敲响战钟的新挑战者磨损铭刻后，所有权将会完全转移。此时，战钟的前主人所享有的所有特权都将授予新的持有人。因为这个原因，精心制作的战钟既备受追捧，又防备森严。

战钟一直延续到银河系殖民时期，其装饰也越发精致。繁复的马赛克上压满珍贵的宝石，成为财富的象征，并在决斗中获得更多津贴，同时也给潜在的挑战者带来更大的激励。随着战争规模的扩大，申领战钟的后勤困难就显现出来。被夺取的战钟有时会被集体熔化，重新铸造成精巧的战锣，并且有特定的仪式，让太空中的对手敲锣挑战。

在猩红战争后的卡巴尔，很少再有士兵坚持这一传统，因为征服之钟被视为累赘的遗物。尽管如此，在那些希望尊重祖先战斗传统的人的飞船上，他们仍然能够找到一席之地。

3380377210.name: Paradrome Cube
3380377210.description: A cube of living code claimed from the Vex domain.
3380377210.description_zh: 从Vex领域获取的活体代码方块。
3380377210.lore:
Mithrax sat on a carpet in his meager quarters, held the Paradrome Cube in his hand, and concentrated.

Hours passed before Eido, concerned, sat beside him. She touched his arm.

"What do you see?" she whispered.

He saw the Endless Night split open. He saw fluid falling like white rain on the City. Massive Minotaurs rising from the shallow seas. He saw the gunfire of the Guardians in the Tower, but it did not reflect on the rippling liquid, and he dismissed the vision.

A hundred more illusions took its place, then a thousand, then a thousand lifetimes' worth:

—a shape frozen inside a crystal prison a towering figure in white recognition flooding bloodshot eyes a city of voices speaking at once shadow taking form the realization they had always been watched tears on metal—

A choice, and its consequences.

"Lies," he answered plainly.
3380377210.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯坐在其陋室里的地毯上，手上拿着帕拉多姆方块，全神贯注。

数小时之后，艾多担心地坐到他身旁。她碰了一下他的手臂。

“你看到了什么？”她轻声问道。

他看到永夜撕裂开来。他看到液体如白雨般倾泄而下落到圣城之上。巨型米诺陶从浅海里升起。他看到守护者从高塔中射出的炮火，但它并没有映照在涟漪的液体上，于是他驱散了幻象。

取而代之的是一百个幻觉，接着是一千个，然后是一千世：

一个冰冻于水晶监狱之内的形状，一个高大的白衣人，充血的眼睛恍然大悟，整座城市的声音同时诉说，阴影成形，意识到他们一直被监视，金属上的眼泪——

一个选择，及其后果。

“谎言，”他简单地回答道。

3799750641.name: Wayfinder's Compass
3799750641.description: The needle guides the thread to a goal and strips obstacles from the path.
3799750641.description_zh: 针引导线到达目标，并清除路上的障碍。
3799750641.lore:
[Cimmerian Garrison]
Borrowed a Wayfinder's Compass. It keeps leading me to places that are almost familiar. But there are missing pieces. I tell Glint I feel drawn here when he asks. I know he doesn't buy it, but he doesn't want to call me a liar. It's pretty deep in the caves. I found a shard of glass, stained with queensfoil. Sniffing the glass made my mouth flare with menthol. Smelled nostalgic. That's the only way I can explain it.

[Ouroborea]
Compass keeps leading me around here, but… only for a few weeks at a time. I feel like I know which weeks it'll be before the compass tries to bring me here. It's like an internal clock going off. I saw a Taken Wizard disappear in thin air. I feel like I should know why, but it's buried underneath a fog. I'll keep looking and see if it clears up.

[Forfeit Shrine]
Waking up on that gravestone was like carving a border through my brain. Sometimes I feel like things cross over it, one way or the other. But it blurs and I'm not sure if it's something new or just new to this me. I remember standing here, making a wish. I don't know if it was before or… I just know it's something I started doing… or kept doing… back when I first became a Lightbearer. I'd flick coins off the cliff and whisper little wishes—nothing big, just little stuff I thought I could get away with. Seems less silly now that I know about the Ahamkara.

[Shattered Ruins]
There's this spot near the Spine of Keres. Big guy, that Keres. Carrying the whole Dreaming City on his back. Her back? Every day, I realize how little I actually know, and no one seems keen on filling in the blanks. Anyway, it feels… right. Like home. Glint tells me there's some kind of palace hidden underneath the Dreaming City, but I just see more mist. Jumping might be a good idea… the worst it could do is kill me. Maybe I'll see something useful on my way down. Glint disagrees.

[Keep of Honed Edges]
There's something wrong happening here. When I touch the stone architecture, it feels hollow. Not physically, but like it's an imitation of what it used to be. I don't like how familiar that feels.

I think I can hear voices.

[Agonarch Abyss]
I was standing in the bay for a long time before I figured it out. All these places, they're gateways. Not the only ones, I think. The queensfoil does the trick. Thanks, Glint. The taste is… well, it's still disgusting, still nostalgic. What does it say about me if I'm starting to like it? Now I just need to get enough so I can map out all of these secret paths. Time to go hunting.
3799750641.lore_zh:
[辛梅里安卫戍营]
借走了一个寻迹者罗盘。它总能把我带到一些非常眼熟的地方。但是我觉得还差了点什么。每当格林特问起，我会告诉他我感觉像被吸引到了这里。我知道他不买账，但是他也不想把话说破。在一个很深的洞穴里，我找到了一片玻璃碎片，上面还沾着女王兰。闻了这块玻璃后，我的嘴里冒出了薄荷味。这是一股让我想念的味道。我只能这么解释了。

[衔尾蛇]
罗盘把我带到了这里，但是…它每次只会带我来几周而已。我觉得我在罗盘带我来这里之前就能感觉到会是哪几周。就像是我的生物钟响了似的。我目睹到一个傀儡巫师凭空消失。我感觉自己应该知道原因，但真相总是扑朔迷离。我会继续调查，看看能否云开雾散。

[失却神殿]
在那块墓碑上苏醒时，我感觉我脑袋都要裂开了。不知怎么地，有些时候我感觉有东西在我脑子里穿过去。但那感觉很模糊，我不确定那感觉是新的，还是说只对现在的我而言是新的。我还记得我在这里站着，许了一个愿。我不知道那是之前还是…我只知道那是我开始做的事…或是一直在做的事…在我刚成为负光者的时候。我会把硬币弹下悬崖，低语许下些小愿望…不是什么大愿望，都是些我觉得无伤大雅的小事。得知阿罕卡拉的事情后，那些事感觉上就没那么蠢了。

[破碎废墟]
克蕾丝脊柱附近有个特别的地方。克蕾丝是个大家伙。整个幽梦之城都在他的背上。或者说，我应该称克蕾丝为“她”？每一天，我都会意识到我是多么的无知，而且好像没有人打算填补这些空白。无论怎样，这地方都让我觉得…舒服。就像家一样。格林特告诉我，在幽梦之城的底下有一座隐藏的宫殿，但我却只能看到一堆迷雾。跳下去可能是个好主意…最坏也就是丧命而已。搞不好我在落下去的过程中还能看见些有用的东西呢。不过格林特不同意。

[锋刃要塞]
这里有些事不对劲。我触碰那座石砌建筑时，它给人一种空洞的感觉。我指的不是物理触感，而是它好似在模仿过去。我不喜欢那种熟悉的感觉。

我好像能听见声音。

[权威深渊]
我在海湾旁站了很久才弄明白。这里的所有地方，都是出入口。而且我认为，它们还不是所有的出入口。女王兰很有效。谢了，格林特。那味道…还是很恶心，但确实令我怀念。如果我开始喜欢上了这种味道，那我是不是变了？现在我只需要找到足够的女王兰，就能标明这些秘密通道的位置。是时候去找找了。

3358687360.name: Synaptic Spear
3358687360.description: A lance aligned with the psychic plane, capable of dispelling Light.
3358687360.description_zh: 与心灵位面契合，能够驱散光能的长矛。
3358687360.lore:
Commander,

I regret to disclose that the Cryptarchy's following report on the so-called "Synaptic Spear" is woefully ill-prepared, even coming as it does from the few fledgling Cryptarchs who are not busy studying Savathûn's throne world. I myself am overseeing the construction of the Psisorium, where a Psionically gifted individual could theoretically scan through the networked memories of preserved minds, but I digress…

Based as it is on the Light-suppressing technology that Dominus Ghaul used to restrain the Traveler during the Red War, the Synaptic Spear is capable of interrupting or dispelling a single instance of Light if, and only if, it is wielded by a Lightbearer. However, this repellant effect is too weak to be of any use in the physical plane—the spear is only capable of disrupting Light in an environment charged with Psionic energies.

Even then, it cannot be used against a subject unless they are also a Lightbearer (perish the thought!) who believes themselves in such a perilous situation that they manifest an aspect of their Light in the Psionic environment. That aspect could then, it is theorized, be slain by the spear, leaving the subject Lightless in the physical plane.

In short, Commander, any use of the Synaptic Spear relies on a truly improbable chain of hypotheticals. With such an inconceivably narrow usage, it is difficult to imagine how this spear will be of any use to us in the battles ahead.

—Master Rahool
3358687360.lore_zh:
指挥官，

我遗憾地告知您，那篇由解密大师所攥写的，关于所谓“突触之矛”的跟进报告准备得极为不充分。毕竟那篇报告是那几位未投身于萨瓦图恩王座世界研究的新晋解密大师写出来的。我正在亲自监督“灵能馆”的建设。理论上，有灵能天赋的人可以借助它扫描妥善保存的大脑中的关联记忆…不好意思，我说离题了…

突触之矛基于尊主盖欧在猩红战争用来控制旅行者的抑光技术，可以打断或驱散一股光能，但它只能在该股光能被负光者操纵时起作用。然而，这种驱散效果非常之弱，无法在任何物理位面上产生实际作用。因此，这根长矛只能在充满灵能能量的环境中干扰光能。

然而，就算是位于该环境下，这把长矛也无法影响负光者以外的个体（然而除我们之外，根本不可能有其他负光者！）。该负光者还必须相信自身有能力在充满灵能的险恶环境下使光能具象化。在理论上，突触之矛只有在这种特定情况下，才能斩杀负光者，并夺走该个体在物理位面的光能。

总而言之，指挥官，突触之矛能派上用场的情况只会在一串几乎不可能出现的假设链的尽头出现。其用途是如此局限，我很难想到这把长矛在以后的战斗中会对我们有什么用处。

——拉乎尔大师

3938069942.name: Synaptic Spear
3938069942.description: A lance aligned with the psychic plane, capable of dispelling Light.
3938069942.description_zh: 与心灵位面契合，能够驱散光能的长矛。
3938069942.lore:
Commander,

I regret to disclose that the Cryptarchy's following report on the so-called "Synaptic Spear" is woefully ill-prepared, even coming as it does from the few fledgling Cryptarchs who are not busy studying Savathûn's throne world. I myself am overseeing the construction of the Psisorium, where a Psionically gifted individual could theoretically scan through the networked memories of preserved minds, but I digress…

Based as it is on the Light-suppressing technology that Dominus Ghaul used to restrain the Traveler during the Red War, the Synaptic Spear is capable of interrupting or dispelling a single instance of Light if, and only if, it is wielded by a Lightbearer. However, this repellant effect is too weak to be of any use in the physical plane—the spear is only capable of disrupting Light in an environment charged with Psionic energies.

Even then, it cannot be used against a subject unless they are also a Lightbearer (perish the thought!) who believes themselves in such a perilous situation that they manifest an aspect of their Light in the Psionic environment. That aspect could then, it is theorized, be slain by the spear, leaving the subject Lightless in the physical plane.

In short, Commander, any use of the Synaptic Spear relies on a truly improbable chain of hypotheticals. With such an inconceivably narrow usage, it is difficult to imagine how this spear will be of any use to us in the battles ahead.

—Master Rahool
