3060983774.description_zh: 持续按住扳机可快速提升精度和稳定性。

3038247973.name: Explosive Payload
3038247973.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.
3038247973.description_zh: 弹药在命中时爆炸，产生范围效果。

64866129.name: Explosive Payload
64866129.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.
64866129.description_zh: 射弹命中后产生范围效果爆炸。提高填装速度。

2869569095.name: Field Prep
2869569095.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
2869569095.description_zh: 增加弹药储备量。蹲伏时填装、收举和准备速度提高。

2308090567.name: Field Prep
2308090567.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
2308090567.description_zh: 大幅提升弹药生成。蹲伏时提升填装、收举和准备速度。

1600092898.name: Backup Plan
1600092898.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.
1600092898.description_zh: 切换至此武器后短时间内充能时间缩短，操控速度提高。

828056542.name: Backup Plan
828056542.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.
828056542.description_zh: 切换至此武器后短时间内充能时间缩短，操控速度提高，持续时间延长。

4267945040.name: Full Auto Trigger System
4267945040.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.
4267945040.description_zh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。

3896634560.name: Full Auto Trigger System
3896634560.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto. Increases stability.
3896634560.description_zh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。提高稳定性。

2117683199.name: Full Auto Trigger System
2117683199.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.
2117683199.description_zh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。

2649013855.name: Full Auto Trigger System
2649013855.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto. Improves reload.
2649013855.description_zh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式射击此武器。提高填装速度。

1631667848.name: Grave Robber
1631667848.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.
1631667848.description_zh: 近战最后一击或使用充能近战造成伤害会从储存弹药中填装此武器的弹匣。

402033656.name: Grave Robber
402033656.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves. Improves handling.
402033656.description_zh: 近战最后一击或使用充能近战造成伤害会从储存弹药中填装此武器的弹匣。提升操控性。

1954620775.name: Timed Payload
1954620775.description: Projectiles attached to enemies explode after a short delay.
1954620775.description_zh: 弹药可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。

1562897767.name: Timed Payload
1562897767.description: Projectiles attached to targets explode after a short delay. Increases stability.
1562897767.description_zh: 射弹可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。提高稳定性。

2213355989.name: High-Impact Reserves
2213355989.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.
2213355989.description_zh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。

2002547233.name: High-Impact Reserves
2002547233.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.
2002547233.description_zh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。弹匣中更高伤害的弹药增多。

1866048759.name: Hip-Fire Grip
1866048759.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.
1866048759.description_zh: 提高腰际射击时的命中率、稳定性和精准命中能力。

3118144663.name: Hip-Fire Grip
3118144663.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.
3118144663.description_zh: 大幅提高腰际射击时的精度、稳定性和精准命中能力。

2010801679.name: Ambitious Assassin
2010801679.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.
2010801679.description_zh: 根据填装之前完成的快速击杀数可过量填充弹匣。

3797647183.name: Ambitious Assassin
3797647183.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.
3797647183.description_zh: 根据填装之前完成的最后一击数可过量填充弹匣, 提高填装速度。

1645158859.name: Under Pressure
1645158859.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
1645158859.description_zh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之提高。

3755250867.name: Under Pressure
3755250867.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
3755250867.description_zh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之大幅提高。

3196242660.name: Base Frame
3196242660.description: Original manufacturer's frame, with no modifications.

47981717.name: Opening Shot
47981717.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.
47981717.description_zh: 第一发弹药的精度和射程提高。

1370847713.name: Opening Shot
1370847713.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.
1370847713.description_zh: 第一发弹药的精度和射程大幅提高。

460017080.name: Headseeker
460017080.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
460017080.description_zh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

4045335048.name: Headseeker
4045335048.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
4045335048.description_zh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

1168162263.name: Outlaw
1168162263.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.
1168162263.description_zh: 精准击杀可大幅缩短填装时间。

1347741687.name: Outlaw
1347741687.description: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.
1347741687.description_zh: 精准最后一击可大幅缩短填装时间，持续时间延长。

3124871000.name: Outlaw
3124871000.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.
3124871000.description_zh: 精准击杀可大幅缩短填装时间。

280464955.name: Firmly Planted
280464955.description: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.
280464955.description_zh: 蹲伏射击时可提高精度、稳定性和操控性。

3920370755.name: Firmly Planted
3920370755.description: Greatly increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.
3920370755.description_zh: 蹲伏射击时可大幅提高精度、稳定性和操控性。

972757866.name: Pulse Monitor
972757866.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
972757866.description_zh: 受伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

1685378950.name: Pulse Monitor
1685378950.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
1685378950.description_zh: 轻伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

1015611457.name: Kill Clip
1015611457.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.
1015611457.description_zh: 完成击杀后填装可提高武器伤害力。

2923251173.name: Kill Clip
2923251173.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.
2923251173.description_zh: 消灭目标后填装可提高武器伤害力，持续时间延长。

1275731761.name: Cluster Bomb
1275731761.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.
1275731761.description_zh: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。

2091001077.name: Cluster Bomb
2091001077.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.
2091001077.description_zh: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。扩大爆炸范围。

588594999.name: Moving Target
588594999.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
588594999.description_zh: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标获取速度。

2717805783.name: Moving Target
2717805783.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
2717805783.description_zh: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标捕获能力。

957782887.name: Snapshot Sights
957782887.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

4116820839.name: Snapshot Sights
4116820839.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.
4116820839.description_zh: 提高瞄准速度。提高稳定性。

3161816588.name: Slideshot
3161816588.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.
3161816588.description_zh: 滑行可装填武器的一部分弹药，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

191144788.name: Slideshot
191144788.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.
191144788.description_zh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

2039302152.name: Slideways
2039302152.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.
2039302152.description_zh: 滑行可装填武器的一部分弹药，并暂时性地大幅提高武器操控性和稳定性。

2396422520.name: Slideways
2396422520.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.
2396422520.description_zh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器操控性和稳定性。

706527188.name: Quickdraw
706527188.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.
706527188.description_zh: 难以置信武器的拔出速度有多快。

1961144892.name: Quickdraw
1961144892.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.
1961144892.description_zh: 此武器的拉弓速度快得难以置信。提高填装速度。

2387244414.name: Zen Moment
2387244414.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.
2387244414.description_zh: 使用此武器造成伤害可逐渐减少后坐力和抖动。

1748774930.name: Zen Moment
1748774930.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time. Improves base stability.
1748774930.description_zh: 使用此武器造成伤害可逐渐减少后坐力和抖动。提高基础稳定性。

4071163871.name: Threat Detector
4071163871.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.
4071163871.description_zh: 当敌人接近时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会提高。

494941759.name: Threat Detector
494941759.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.
494941759.description_zh: 附近有目标时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会大幅提高。

1890422124.name: Tap the Trigger
1890422124.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
1890422124.description_zh: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内提高稳定性和精度。

1523649716.name: Tap the Trigger
1523649716.description: Grants an improved short period of greatly increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
1523649716.description_zh: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内大幅提高稳定性和精度，持续时间延长。

3400784728.name: Triple Tap
3400784728.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
3400784728.description_zh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

573122728.name: Triple Tap
573122728.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
573122728.description_zh: 精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

2482418662.name: Longest Winter
2482418662.description: Periodically generates Ionic Traces while in its high-damage state.
2482418662.description_zh: 在高伤害状态下周期性地产生离子轨迹。

176919422.name: For the Empire
176919422.description: This weapon is Full Auto, does extra damage to Cabal, and penetrates Phalanx shields.
176919422.description_zh: 全自动武器，可对卡巴尔造成额外伤害，可穿透方阵士兵护盾。

1178686995.name: Mechanized Autoloader
1178686995.description: This weapon automatically reloads on ammo pickup.
1178686995.description_zh: 在拾取弹药时自动填装。

2333607307.name: Impetus
2333607307.description: Reloading immediately after a kill increases weapon damage for a short time.
2333607307.description_zh: 完成一次击杀后立即填装可在短时间内提高武器伤害。

501717180.name: Ionic Return
501717180.description: Breaking a combatant's shield—or the shield of a Guardian using a Super—with the matched damage type refills the magazine from reserves and grants bonus damage rounds. Breaking a combatant's shield with a matched damage type Ionic Return round refreshes the perk.
501717180.description_zh: 使用匹配的伤害类型击碎战斗人员的护盾 ，或击碎超能状态下的守护者护盾，则可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣，并提供额外伤害弹药。使用匹配伤害类型的离子回归弹药击碎战斗人员的护盾，可刷新特性。

939227542.name: Target Acquired
939227542.description: When Personal Assistant is active, this weapon has better target acquisition and deals significantly more precision damage.
939227542.description_zh: 当启用私人助手时，此武器拥有更好的目标捕获能力，显著造成更高的精准伤害。

1853177948.name: Business Time
1853177948.description: Sustained fire boosts range and rate of fire.
1853177948.description_zh: 持续开火可提升射程和射速。

2003108620.name: Thin the Herd
2003108620.description: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.
2003108620.description_zh: 直接命中可对战斗人员的护盾造成更多伤害并引起不稳定爆炸。造成伤害会提高填装速度。对受到手雷伤害的战斗人员造成快速最后一击可填装弹匣。

2620589274.name: The Fundamentals
2620589274.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.
2620589274.description_zh: [替换武器动作]  ：改变这件武器的伤害类型，在虚空、电弧和烈日之间循环。当你施加或获得与这件武器伤害类型匹配的元素增益或减益时，会短暂提升这件武器的伤害。

4146729347.name: Last Stand
4146729347.description: Improved weapon performance and greatly increased recovery when its wielder is the last living member of a fireteam.
4146729347.description_zh: 当你是火力战队最后存活的成员时，武器性能提高，生命值恢复速度大幅提高。

2179934441.name: MIDA Synergy
2179934441.description: This weapon grants speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.
2179934441.description_zh: 当同时装备米达多功能时，移动速度提高。

3100590152.name: MIDA Software Package
3100590152.description:
Final blows periodically apply modifications to this weapon, providing additional stats and benefits per modification:
  •  Chip: Faster handling and aim speed
  •  Barrel: Bonus range and stability
  •  Optics: Improved target acquisition
  •  Ammo: Shots detonate on impact
3100590152.description_zh:
最后一击定期为此武器应用改造，每项改造提供额外属性和增益：
  •  芯片：提升操控性与瞄准速度
  •  枪管：增加射程与稳定性
  •  光学瞄准镜：提升目标捕获能力
  •  弹药：射击命中时引爆

2238035098.name: Storm and Stress
2238035098.description: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.
2238035098.description_zh: 使用永不分离武器造成最后一击会填装此武器，并为弹匣溢装额外伤害弹药。使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会提升永不分离武器的弹匣容量。

2590365289.name: Together Forever
2590365289.description: Kills with this weapon reload Sturm. Consecutive kills overflow Sturm's magazine with bonus damage rounds.
2590365289.description_zh: 使用武器击杀可填装狂飙。连续击杀可向狂飙弹匣中多加入具有额外伤害的弹药。

861489047.name: Vermin
861489047.description: Reloading immediately after a kill grants a brief period of invisibility.
861489047.description_zh: 完成击杀后立即填装可在短时间内隐身。

25692695.name: The Scientific Method
25692695.description: Damaging an opponent temporarily increases speed and handling.
25692695.description_zh: 对敌人造成伤害可暂时提高速度和操控性。

1650852150.name: Long March
1650852150.description: Detect enemies on your radar from farther away.
1650852150.description_zh: 侦测雷达上位于远处的敌人。

4115637021.name: Sun Blast
4115637021.description: Targets defeated with Sunshot explode in Solar energy, scorching other nearby targets.
4115637021.description_zh: 被烈日弹丸击败的目标会在烈日能量中爆炸，灼烧附近的目标。

1530804125.name: Superconductor
1530804125.description: When Arc Conductor is active, shots fired have the chance to become chain lightning and return ammo.
1530804125.description_zh: 电弧导体激活时，射击有几率形成连锁闪电并归还弹药。

320534106.name: Cosmology
320534106.description: Kills with this weapon cause enemy targets to detonate and spawn Void projectiles that track targets.
320534106.description_zh: 击杀可引爆敌方目标，并生成可追踪目标的虚空弹头。

1749209109.name: Relentless Strikes
1749209109.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.
1749209109.description_zh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药。

4085959009.name: Relentless Strikes
4085959009.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.
4085959009.description_zh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药，持续时间延长。

2590710093.name: Tireless Blade
2590710093.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.
2590710093.description_zh: 每隔一次的赋能刀剑击杀都可提供刀剑弹药。

4183521337.name: Tireless Blade
4183521337.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered Sword final blow, with a chance for additional ammo to be provided.
4183521337.description_zh: 每隔一次的赋能刀剑最后一击都可提供刀剑弹药，并有几率提供额外弹药。

3913600130.name: Whirlwind Blade
3913600130.description: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.
3913600130.description_zh: 快速刀剑打击将在短时间内增加此武器的伤害。防御将中断此效果。

147913470.name: Whirlwind Blade
147913470.description: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.
147913470.description_zh: 快速刀剑打击将增加此武器的伤害，持续时间延长。防御将中断此效果。

1685431615.name: En Garde
1685431615.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this sword do additional damage.
1685431615.description_zh: 切换至这把刀剑之后立即进行快速攻击可造成额外伤害。

3406782879.name: En Garde
3406782879.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.
3406782879.description_zh: 切换至这把刀剑之后立即进行快速攻击可造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

354401740.name: Assassin's Blade
354401740.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.
354401740.description_zh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高移动速度和伤害。

3678483220.name: Assassin's Blade
3678483220.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage for an improved duration.
3678483220.description_zh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高移动速度和伤害，持续时间延长。

3625355092.name: Burst Guard
3625355092.description: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.
3625355092.description_zh: 刀剑格挡拥有高抗性和低持久。

3923000764.name: Burst Guard
3923000764.description: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.
3923000764.description_zh: 刀剑格挡拥有高抗性和低持久。

3732622839.name: Burst Guard
3732622839.description: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.
3732622839.description_zh: 刀剑格挡拥有高抗性和低持久。

1036269296.description: This weapon shoots a steady cold-fusion-powered Arc laser, dealing more damage the longer it remains on a target.

2741975068.name: Slug Rifle
2741975068.description: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.
2741975068.description_zh: 此武器可发射爆炸弹头。当使用瞄准镜瞄准时，弹头速度快，弹道笔直。当进行腰际射击时，爆炸规模更大，可对目标施加灼烧效果。

2473404935.name: Mad Scientist
2473404935.description: This weapon fires a volley of rockets and grants Bolt Charge to all nearby allies for every other rocket that it fires.
2473404935.description_zh: 这件武器可发射一连串火箭，每隔一次火箭发射会为所有附近盟友提供电光充能。

656200654.name: Conserve Momentum
656200654.description: Hits with projectiles decrease this weapon's charge time for a short duration.
656200654.description_zh: 使用射弹命中会在短时间内缩短此武器的充能时间。

3081173348.name: The Fundamentals
3081173348.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.
3081173348.description_zh: [替换武器动作]  ：改变这件武器的伤害类型，在虚空、电弧和烈日之间循环。当你施加或获得与这件武器伤害类型匹配的元素增益或减益时，会短暂提升这件武器的伤害。

3755070117.name: Payday
3755070117.description: Larger magazine. Increased accuracy when firing from the hip. Picking up Special or Heavy ammo immediately reloads this weapon.
3755070117.description_zh: 更高的弹匣容量。腰射时可提高准度。拾取特殊弹药或重型弹药可立即填装此武器。

2977709078.name: Excavation
2977709078.description: Grenades spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Defeating targets creates Arc explosions.
2977709078.description_zh: 手雷引爆时生成集束炸弹。击败目标时造成电弧爆炸。

3610814281.name: Volatile Light
3610814281.description: Rounds fired from this weapon have reduced damage falloff, overpenetrate targets, and ricochet off hard surfaces. Projectile damage increases after bounce.
3610814281.description_zh: 这把武器射出的弹药伤害衰减程度下降，能够贯穿目标，接触坚硬的表面会反弹。反弹后弹头伤害增加。

938999636.name: Personal Assistant
938999636.description:

Jolts targets when dealing damage. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

造成伤害时震颤目标。克制过载勇士。

507151084.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可使储备弹药填入已装备的能量武器弹匣中。

3777829357.name: Aeon Energy
3777829357.description:
Dodging grants the following to nearby Aeon Cult allies:
Grenade energy to Warlocks
Melee energy to Titans
Dodge energy to Hunters

Other allies receive a fraction of the shared energy.
3777829357.description_zh:
闪身可让附近永劫教派盟友获得以下效果：
术士获得手雷能量
泰坦获得近战能量
猎人获得闪身能量

其他盟友获得少许分享的能量。

4024170927.name: Misdirection
4024170927.description: Dodging disorients nearby enemies and temporarily removes their radar.
4024170927.description_zh: 闪身可迷惑附近的敌人并暂时关闭他们的雷达。

1236444985.name: Aeon Energy
1236444985.description:
Melee grants the following to nearby Aeon Cult allies:
Grenade energy to Warlocks
Melee energy to Titans
Dodge energy to Hunters

Other allies receive a fraction of the shared energy.
1236444985.description_zh:
近战可让附近永劫教派盟友获得以下效果：术士获得
手雷能量泰坦获得
近战能量猎人获得
闪身能量

其他盟友获得少许分享的能量。

2355041704.name: Solar Rampart
2355041704.description: Solar final blows recharge your Barricade. While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
2355041704.description_zh: 烈日最后一击会重新充能屏障。装备烈日超能时，施放屏障会释放出几道烈日能量波，伤害并灼烧目标。受到此类能量波伤害的战斗人员及被击败的守护者，会笼罩在太阳黑子中。

536311848.name: Aeon Energy
536311848.description:
Throwing grenades grants the following to nearby Aeon Cult allies:
Grenade energy to Warlocks
Melee energy to Titans
Dodge energy to Hunters

Other allies receive a fraction of the shared energy.
536311848.description_zh:
投掷手雷可让附近永劫教派盟友获得以下效果：
术士获得手雷能量
泰坦获得近战能量
猎人获得闪身能量

其他盟友获得少许分享的能量。

1142806944.name: Planetary Torrent
1142806944.description: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves. Final blows with these shockwaves create an Arc explosion. While an Arc Super is equipped, the shockwaves and subsequent explosions blind nearby targets. Rift energy recharges faster when you are surrounded by targets.
1142806944.description_zh: 裂痕会定期释放电弧冲击波。用这些冲击波施放最后一击会造成一次电弧爆炸。装备电弧超能时，冲击波及其后续的爆炸会致盲附近的目标。裂痕能量在你被目标包围时充能更快。

3907299874.name: New Tricks
3907299874.description: Gain an additional Skip Grenade charge. Skip Grenade damage grants Bolt Chargeand gaining Bolt Charge grants Skip Grenade energy. When Bolt Charge is ready, you heal nearby allies and enhance your next Skip Grenade.
3907299874.description_zh: 获得一发额外的弹跳手雷充能。弹跳手雷造成伤害会提供电光充能，获得电光充能会提供弹跳手雷能量。电光充能准备就绪时，你会治疗附近的盟友并强化你的下一发弹跳手雷。

2119325971.name: Vanishing Shadow
2119325971.description: Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.
2119325971.description_zh: 提升所有隐身效果的持续时间。进入隐身状态时，你的手雷、近战和职业技能会更快地充能。达到最大叠加层数时，还将获得虚空覆盖护盾。

1331592343.name: Starless Night
1331592343.description:
Weapons of Light persists after exiting Ward of Dawn. While Weapons of Light is active, final blows or sustained damage grant stacks of The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage sources also trigger a suppressing burst.
 
Picking up Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its duration based on how many stacks were consumed.
1331592343.description_zh:
光之武器效果在离开黎明护罩后仍会持续。光之武器生效时，最后一击或持续伤害会提供圣人层数；虚空与动能伤害来源还会触发一次压制爆发。
 
拾取黎明护罩会消耗全部圣人层数，并根据消耗的层数延长其持续时间。

824488952.name: Seriously, Watch Out
824488952.description: While your Juggernaut shield is active, you slowly gain Bolt Charge stacks over time and increased weapon ready speed. Sprinting while amplified creates an energizing field behind you that grants close by allies speed boost.
824488952.description_zh: 无畏护甲护盾生效时，你会随时间缓慢获得电光充能层数，且武器准备速度提升。在增幅状态下冲刺时，会在你身后生成一个能量场，为附近的盟友提供速度加成。

1147638875.name: Cobra Totemic

1712870644.name: Banshee's Favorite
1712870644.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon kills at an increased rate.
1712870644.description_zh: 在任意元素武器远距离击杀时以更快的速度生成枪匠遥测数据。

2956832212.name: Treasure Hunter
2956832212.description: Detects caches within a 50-meter range and increases Glimmer gain.
2956832212.description_zh: 可探测50米范围内的缓存箱并提高微光获取量。

1612078667.name: Speed Demon
1612078667.description: Your vehicles take less time to summon and reload your weapons while you ride.
1612078667.description_zh: 缩短载具召唤时间，骑乘的同时填装武器。

2404852074.name: You're Welcome
2404852074.description: Detects caches and resources within a 75-meter range on Mercury.
2404852074.description_zh: 在水星上探测75米范围内的缓存箱和资源。

1198449474.name: Scion of Mercury
1198449474.description: Increased Glimmer and chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Mercury.
1198449474.description_zh: 增加微光获取量并有机会在水星上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

2126415067.name: Mercury Glimmer Scavenger
2126415067.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Mercury.
2126415067.description_zh: 在水星的微光获取量提升10%。

3300497782.name: Strike Glimmer Scavenger
3300497782.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Strikes.
3300497782.description_zh: 在打击中微光获取量提升10%。

3138059283.name: Mercury Scanner
3138059283.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Mercury.
3138059283.description_zh: 有机会在水星上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

1991567150.name: Vanguard Scanner
1991567150.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Vanguard Ops.
1991567150.description_zh: 有机会在先锋行动中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

741416970.name: Seeker of Opulence
741416970.description: Exotic drops from encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" have a 50% chance of being a Year 1 Exotic not already in your collection.
741416970.description_zh: “利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战所掉落的异域装备，有50%的几率是你的收藏中未包含的首年异域装备。

3785828493.name: Seeker of Brilliance
3785828493.description: In addition to their normal rewards, encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" can award Bright Engrams. This chance increases each time no Bright Engram drops.
3785828493.description_zh: 除一般奖励外，“利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战还将奖励光明记忆水晶。若未掉落光明记忆水晶，则该几率会不断提升。

4082217637.name: Mercury Resource Detector

4082217637.description_zh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的资源。

566395092.description_zh: 在水星上获取10%的额外经验值。

2207103371.name: Vanguard Operations Experience Log

2207103371.description_zh: 在先锋行动中获取10%的额外经验值。

4286985160.name: Seeker of Glory

4286985160.description_zh: 记录在利维坦上完成战斗的数量。
4286985160.typeName_zh: 稀有 机灵数据追踪器

889398080.name: Silver Bullet

889398080.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变血色浪漫的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

669267835.name: Dieselpunk
669267835.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Wardcliff Coil. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
669267835.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变沃德克里夫线圈的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。
669267835.source: Source: Earned during the seasonal Crimson Days event.
669267835.source_zh: 来源：于赛季血色浪漫活动期间获得。

3470828242.name: Flame Refraction
3470828242.description: Kills with this weapon return a fraction of the ammo used to the magazine from reserves, extending the beam's duration.
3470828242.description_zh: 完成击杀可从储存弹药中转移部分弹药至弹匣，延长光束持续时间。

2383960413.name: Cruel Remedy
2383960413.description: Kills with this weapon heal the wielder. Precision kills also refill the magazine.
2383960413.description_zh: 完成击杀可治疗持枪者。完成精准击杀还可装填弹匣。

3970637031.name: Harbinger's Pulse
3970637031.description: Multikills with Void damage immediately reload this weapon from reserves.
3970637031.description_zh: 使用虚空伤害造成多杀会立即从储备弹药中填装此武器。

2019952880.name: Serve the Colony
2019952880.description: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.
2019952880.description_zh: 在未装备群居者的情况下，机器人榴弹可快速从储备弹药转移到弹匣中。

3668782036.name: The Fate of All Fools
3668782036.description: Chain precision shots or land precision final blows to refill the magazine, improve stability, and greatly increase the damage of Firefly and body shots. Landing a body shot will remove one stack of the damage bonus.
3668782036.description_zh: 连续精准射击或造成精准最后一击可填充弹匣、提升稳定性，并大幅提升萤火虫和身体射击的伤害。身体射击命中会移除一层伤害加成。

1927916065.name: Unplanned Reprieve
1927916065.description: Fusion projectiles attach and detonate with a delayed Void blast.
1927916065.description_zh: 融合弹头具有粘附效果，产生延迟的虚空爆炸。

3913463509.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
3913463509.description: This weapon's grenades are insectoid robots that chase targets and explode close to them. Consumes tougher combatants to create additional robots.
3913463509.description_zh: 发射的榴弹可放出类虫机器人追踪目标并在接近时爆炸。消灭高阶战斗人员来生成更多的机器人。

571267712.name: Prismatic Inferno
571267712.description: Fires a Solar trace beam that creates a field of heat energy that grows as the weapon is fired. Sustained damage applies scorch to the target.
571267712.description_zh: 发射一束烈日追踪光束，产生的热量场会随着武器的发射而增长。持续伤害对目标施加灼烧效果。

1174053886.name: Universal Wavefunction
1174053886.flavor: "I believed your presence at the genesis of the Infinite Forest would lead to a comprehensive understanding of the Vex. When will I learn that things are never so simple?" —Ikora
1174053886.source: Source: Rare drop from high-scoring Nightfall strikes on Mercury.
1174053886.source_zh: 来源：水星日落打击高分稀有掉落。
1174053886.lore:
"The fluid itself is not the Vex. If their consciousness could be contained in such a state, it would have manifested in other states by now."

Ikora looks up from the terminal.

"Perhaps Lakshmi's device is the key. Was I wrong to dismiss it?" She chuckles. She does that a lot more, lately. "Probably. I was wrong about a lot of things."

She paces, hands behind her back.

"If understanding their ability to manipulate simulations and, in doing so, appear to travel to different times is our goal, then…" She stops and turns to look… at me?

"What do you think, Ophiuchus?"

She hasn't spoken to me in 22,303 days. I haven't spoken to her in almost as long. I'm speechless.

"You're not just my Ghost. We were friends, once. I want to know what you think."

I try to maintain my composure. I don't think it works. "I'm glad you asked."
1174053886.lore_zh:
“液体本身并不属于Vex。如果它们的意识可以存在在这样一个状况中，那么现在也会在其他状况中显现。”

艾可拉从终端中抬起头。

“或许拉克希米的设备就是钥匙。把它丢了是个错误吗？”她轻笑。她最近轻笑的频率越来越高。“或许，我做的很多事都不对。”

她的手背在身后，她踱来踱去。

“如果我们的目标是掌握它们操纵模拟的能力，然后借此在不同的时间线间穿行，那么……”她停下脚步，转过头看向……看向我？

“蛇夫座，你怎么看？”

她已经22,303天没有和我讲过话了，而且我未和她交流的时间也差不多长。我一时语塞。

“你不仅是我的机灵。我们曾是朋友。我想知道你的想法。”

我试着保持平静，但我觉得并没有用。“很高兴你问我。”

292872936.flavor: "When eyes are clear, justice need not be blind." —Fractal Scrolls
292872936.lore:
Ikora walked into the hangar and found Osiris inspecting his ship's engine. She put her hand on a turbine and steadied her breathing.

"Make sure Shipwright Hiponia does a diagnostic check before you leave for Mercury," she said to her old mentor. "Cesar is very thorough."

Osiris smiled wryly. "You're always one step ahead of everyone else. It's what makes you a leader among all Warlocks."

"Then you understand why I must remain; to continue to lead as you once led."

"Thousands of Vex simulations can help us understand the Darkness, Ikora!" Osiris said. "This could be the key to—"

"Osiris," Ikora interrupted. "I wish you well on your mission, but I fear that your obsession will be your undoing."

"Obsession?!"

"We have each made a choice. I choose to stay and fight what is real."
292872936.lore_zh:
艾可拉走进机库，发现奥斯里斯正在检查他的飞船引擎。她把手放在涡轮机上，平息了一下呼吸。

她对自己年迈的导师说：“在你前往水星之前，一定要让船匠希波尼亚帮你做一次诊断检测。”“塞萨尔挺细心的。”

奥斯里斯苦笑了一下。“你做事总是抢先别人一步。这就是你会成为术士领头人的原因。”

“那你应该明白我为什么必须留在这里；接过你的领导权。”

“艾可拉，成千上万的Vex模拟能帮助我们了解暗影！”奥斯里斯说道。“这可能是关键所在——”

“奥斯里斯，”艾可拉打断了他。“祝你执行任务安全归来，但恐怕你的妄想不会让你那么顺利。”

“妄想？！”

“我们各自做出了选择。我选择留下来，为真理而战。”

292872937.name: Saint-14's Gray Pigeon
292872937.flavor: "The name? Pigeons are the only birds left in the City sky. One of the many 'last things' we fight for. If you have a problem with that, we could step into the Crucible." —Saint-14
292872937.lore:
Ship's Final Log:

Osiris.

I hope whatever you find in this place is worth it. My recommendation to install you as Vanguard Commander was not a gesture to stroke your ego. It was an order to stay and help the City achieve all that it could. An order you refused to follow. News of my demise will no doubt reach you late. I can already see your response—the guilt that will follow, however fleeting. I thought you had changed after Six Fronts; that seeing your people on the brink of destruction and spared from death would be reward enough to stay. To fight. I'll fight in your stead one last time.

Father.

My duty is at its end. I've seen what the City can become. I know you can lead its people to it.

To my inspiration.

Your final gift to me I now send back to you. It will be good to see you again.

—Saint-14
292872937.lore_zh:
飞船最后的日志：

奥斯里斯。

希望你在这里找到的任何东西都有它的价值。我推荐你就任先锋指挥官并不是要伤害你的自尊。留下来帮助圣城达成一切可能是命令。是你拒绝遵守的命令。相信你不久便能听到我的死讯。我已经能看见你的反应了——随之而来的罪恶感，无论它有多么短暂。我以为你在六方战役之后已经改变了；以为看着同胞从濒临毁灭的境地逃出足以让你留下来。去战斗。我会最后一次代替你去战斗。

父亲。

我的使命行将终结。我已经预见到圣城的结局。我知道你可以领导它的子民抵达那个结局。

我的启迪者。

你赐予我最后的礼物，我现在将它还给你。若能再次相见该有多好。

——圣14号

292872939.name: Asher Mir's One-Way Ticket
292872939.flavor: "It is possible to mathematically predict the cadence of death and resurrection in every firefight, regardless of combatant composition." —Asher Mir
292872939.lore:
Asher Mir loathes patrol duty.

Zavala thinks about respect, so Zavala thinks it's because of the recruits who swarmed Echo Mesa in the wake of the Red War. They jeer at Asher over the radio and meet his impatient condescension with brash challenges: Come say that to my face. But Zavala is wrong.

Cayde thinks about his free time, so Cayde thinks it's because Asher has better things to do. Why support a supply chain when you're dying of Vex flu? Sure, sure, it's not really flu; that's not the point. The guy's dying! But Cayde is wrong.

Ikora used to be wrong, too, but now Ikora thinks about death. She knows Asher has not died since he was transformed. She knows what it is to sit paralyzed beside a radio, full of jealous fear, listening to a battle that you cannot join.

They could bring him every jumpship in the system, she thinks, and he'd never leave the Rupture.
292872939.lore_zh:
阿什·米尔讨厌巡逻。

萨瓦拉觉得这和尊严有关系，所以他认为原因是猩红战争打响时遍布厄科台地的那些新兵。他们在无线电上嘲笑阿什，触痛了阿什不耐烦的屈辱心，他向这些人发出挑战：有种当着我的面说。但萨瓦拉错了。

凯德想到的是他的个人时间，所以凯德认为原因是阿什有更想做的事情。谁会在就快被Vex流感折磨死了的时候支援补给线呢？好吧，好吧，不是什么真的流感；这不是重点。那家伙要死了！但凯德错了。

艾可拉曾经也错了，但现在艾可拉想到了死亡。她知道阿什自从被转化以来就没有死过。她知道像植物人一样坐在无线电旁，满心嫉妒的恐惧感，听着一场你无法参加的战斗的感觉。

她想，他们可以将这个星系的所有飞船带给他，他却永远无法离开裂口。

292872940.name: Ikora's Resolve
292872940.flavor: "I'd tell my younger self, 'There will be plenty of time to settle down. For now, enjoy the ride.'" —Ikora Rey
292872940.lore:
The Guardian gasps awake, like the breath was ripped out instead of restored.

The Ghost floats closer, not masking his agitation. "You did it on purpose. Died. On purpose. I saw."

The Guardian flips a hand impatiently. "So what. Death is waiting for us every minute of every day. If I grab it by the throat, that's no different from me tripping over it in the dark before you bring me back."

"You know that the difference is intent. Guardians do not seek death. They embrace it as part of their sacrifice. They le—"

Singsong, now. "'They learn from it and they grow stronger.' Come on. I've learned more about being a 'Guardian' out here than from any of your Speaker's sermons under the Traveler. Whether or not a Knight slices my throat before I die."

The Ghost looks hurt. "Ikora, you don't—"

"Later. We're going back to Trostland. I'm not going to grow any stronger sitting here pulling pine needles out of my face."

She walks away, eyes brighter than her Ghost's in the dark. He floats in place, silent, and then follows.
292872940.lore_zh:
守护者醒了过来，大吸一口气，仿佛这口气是被扯出来而不是被吸进去一样。

机灵飘到近旁，发起火来。“你故意死的。故意，死的。我看见了。”

守护者不耐烦地翻手。“那又怎么样。死亡每时每刻都在等待着我们。我与其决心与之抗衡，那还不如让我在黑暗中浑浑噩噩一番，等你把我复活呢。”

“你知道区别在于故意与否。守护者不会去找死。他们将死亡当做牺牲的一部分。他们从——”

又开始念经了。“‘他们从死亡中学习，变得更强。'拜托，我在这里学到的有关‘守护者'品行的知识比从你们那个先知以旅行者之名所做的老僧念经中学到的还要多，无论在我死之前骑士会不会撕开我的喉咙。”

机灵似乎很受伤。“艾可拉，你没——”

“一会儿再说。我们要回慰藉之地了。待在这儿把松针从脸上拔出来是没办法变强的。”

她起身离去，双目在黑暗中发出光比她的机灵还要明亮。他浮起来，静静跟上。

292872941.name: The Sundaresh Experiment 13-R
292872941.flavor: Ishtar Collective research led to places unexpected, unexplored, and in some cases unsanctioned.
292872941.lore:
Esi: Is that… radiolarian fluid?!
Sundaresh: Close the bulkhead, Chioma.
Esi: Where did you even—
Sundaresh: The excesses from Shim's siphons were just being discarded. This is better.
Esi: And you're using it as, what? A propellant?
Sundaresh: A coolant. If the Vex decide to simulate things in physical space such that we can experience them natively, we must understand more than just their physiology. We are too focused on the abstract and the theoretical and the simulated, love. We are scientists, yes, but Humans also make tools.
Esi: That meditation sim really had an effect on you.
Sundaresh: Hush.
Esi: A ship built with repurposed Ishtar construction materials, integrating Vex technology almost as an afterthought.
Sundaresh: You disapprove.
Esi: The last time I questioned an idea like this, it ended up saving us from simulation purgatory. I would be a fool to disapprove.
Sundaresh: Then come here and let's celebrate.
292872941.lore_zh:
艾西：那是……放射体液？！
桑戴尔什：关上舱壁，希欧玛。
艾西：你究竟是从哪里——
桑戴尔什：沈多出来的虹吸器本来是要销毁的，但不要浪费是美德啊。
艾西：那你要用它来做什么？推进物？
桑戴尔什：冷却剂。如果Vex决定在物理空间模拟出我们原始就可以体验的事物的话，那我们就对它们的了解就不能只停留在生理学上。我们太过专注于抽象的，理论上的和模拟的东西。我们是科学家，这没错，但人类也是要制造工具的。
艾西：那个冥想模拟真的对你有影响。
桑戴尔什：嘘。
艾西：重新利用伊什塔建筑材料，集成Vex科技建造出的飞船更像是后来才想到的。
桑德雷什：你反对。
艾西：上一次我对类似想法的质疑，将我们从模拟炼狱中救了出来。我哪敢反对啊。
桑戴尔什：那就过来一起庆祝吧。

317465075.flavor: Before Tyra Karn settled in the Iron Temple, her second home was among the stars.
317465075.lore:
~

To you as well. There has been no greater Dawning than this. The dawning of a new age, whether we call it one or not.

I hope it is not the dawn of a new Collapse.

~

We are so focused on the return of our Light that we have forgotten how that Light was obscured. We can celebrate the Light, yes, but we must not be blinded by it.

~

And I appreciate it, Effie, but the greatest gift one could give is to heed my words. Besides, I have no need of an ornament for my ship. My traveling days are past.

~

Give it to the one who now flies it. I hope they think about what this all means… more than the rest of us.

~

Why do you think I have chosen to remain here? But… Happy Dawning to you as well, old friend. See you next year.
317465075.lore_zh:
~

也祝你曙光节快乐。这次曙光节是前所未有，最盛大的一次。无论我们承认与否，这都是新一年的曙光。

我希望这不是又一次大崩溃的曙光。

~

我们太在意重夺光能这件事了，都忘记光能是如何变得模糊的。我们可以庆祝光能，是的，但我们不能因它而变得盲目。

~

我很感激，艾菲，但一个人所能给予的最贵重的礼物就是把我的话放在心上。除此之外，我的飞船不需要什么皮肤。我的游历时光早已过去。

~

把它留给现在驾驶这艘飞船的人吧。与其他人相比……我更希望他们应该思考一下这其中的意义。

~

你觉得为什么我选择留在这里？无论如何……也祝你曙光节快乐，老伙计。明年再会。

317465074.name: Cerulean Flash
317465074.flavor: Some years, the Dawning comes faster than anyone expects.
317465074.lore:
Another day of gray and cold. Emmerza had already cried twice this morning and the shop wasn't even open yet. She looks up past the three-day-old pears and pauses. Is that…

WHOOSH! A white blur. The windows rattle. An apple falls to the floor with a thump. And the smile doesn't leave her face even after the fruit's all stocked.

Mist-1 had been looking forward to the air show for months. The forecast said today was finally going to be clear. But since this morning, everything above the sketches on their locker is fog. They sigh. After missing last year's with their sickness, for this year's to be canceled… they look down.

WHOOSH! Streaks of bronze and sapphire, just like the drawing crumpled in their hand. Their eyes light up and they hum to themselves.

Amanda wipes her brow and grins as she banks left over Skorri Canal. The Tower will eventually find out that someone's flying a thousand feet below safe airspace. But she'll still be able to hear the cheers when she gets her reprimand.
317465074.lore_zh:
又是灰白阴冷的一天。爱默莎今早已经哭了两回了，而商店还没开门。她抬起头，目光掠过摆了三天的梨子，愣住了。那是不是……

呼唔！白茫茫的一片。窗户咯咯作响。一只苹果砰的一声落在地上。即使将水果都存了起来，微笑也没有从她脸上褪去。

小雾1号几个月以来都在盼望着能去观看航空表演。天气预报说今天终于要放晴了。但从今早开始，储物柜上的素描簿上全是雾气。他们叹了口气。因病错过了去年的航空表演，今年恐怕又要取消了……他们失望得很。

呼唔！是青铜和蔚蓝色的尾烟，就像他们揉在手中的画纸一样。他们的眼中闪着光，他们哼起了歌。

阿曼达擦了一下额头，笑了起来，仿佛是她从斯科里运河上低空飞过一样。高塔终将发现有人会在安全空域以下一千英尺的高度飞行，哪怕在接受训诫时她还能听见观众们的欢呼声。

2757144092.name: Tilt Fuse
2757144092.flavor: "[whistle] With a few more revs, Zahn woulda turned this thing into the fastest bomb you never saw. Good thing for all of us he never got the chance." —Amanda Holliday
2757144092.source: Source: Complete Nightfall strike "The Arms Dealer."
2757144092.source_zh: 来源：完成日落打击“军火交易商”。
2757144092.lore:
It would only take one shot. That ridiculous ceremonial armor had 10 weaknesses that Bracus Zahn could spot without even looking that closely. One good shot, and everyone else would abandon this foolish crusade on this miserable planet—

"This is all of them? The most advanced weapons you have?"

Zahn tried not to lose his temper. "Would I have made the trip all the way to this 'throne room' without them?"

It was a lie, of course, but this puffed-up "Dominus" didn't need to know about the experimental vehicles Zahn had been working on since—

"Were I you, Zahn, I would think hard before giving so flippant an answer."

This was the "Consul" who had deposed Zahn's best customer. Zahn didn't turn around as he said, "If I were you, roach, I would think hard before wasting the time of the only real weapons supplier you've got."

Growls from all over the room, but Zahn smiled. They needed him. And they knew it.
2757144092.lore_zh:
一发就能搞定。那个荒谬的礼仪式护甲有10个十夫长扎恩甚至不用那么仔细看就能发现的弱点。只要好好来上一发，所有人就可以在这个悲惨星球上中止这项愚蠢的运动了——

“就这些？你手里最先进的武器就是这个？”

扎恩努力控制着脾气。“如果没有它们，我可能一路打到这个‘王座大厅'吗？”

这当然是谎话，但这位膨胀的“尊主”不需要了解这辆扎恩自某时开始就一直研究的实验型载具——

“扎恩，如果我是你，我会好好想想，而不是给出这么个轻浮的答案。”

这位“领事”已经从扎恩的最佳客户名单中除名了。扎恩并没有想改变这情形，他说道“大蟑螂，如果我是你，我会好好想想，而不是在这里跟你仅有的真实武器供应商浪费时间。”

咆哮声充满房间，但扎恩笑了。他们知道，他们需要他。

3081894946.name: SV-112 Predator
3081894946.lore:
Comms Transmission

1: Manse-5, what's your status?
2: Three Pikes on my tail coming into the Gulch. No biggie.
1: Roger that. How's the new Sparrow handling? Heard Amanda's been tinkering with it herself.
2: Hold that thought. [crackle] [hum of thrusters] [snapping branches]
1: Come in, Manse!
2: Engine's got a bit of a kick there! Pulling up sharp on the curve and— [roar] Boosting!
1: We're near the Firebase, but we can head back.
2: Woohoo— [explosion]
1: Manse!
2: Did a little barrel roll there! Got two Pikes… Uh-oh. Cabal.
1: It's no big deal to come back for you.
2: Big ship. Big. Heading right for it.
1: Uh, go around it.
2: [sustained thrumming]
1: Manse.
2: [thrumming] [explosion]
1: Manse!
2: No more baddies! Just wheeeeling into the bend now.
1: Can you not do that again, please?
2: Buying Amanda a drink tonight!
3081894946.lore_zh:
通讯传输

1：曼斯5号，你那情况如何？
2：三辆派克尾随我进入了峡谷。其他就没什么了。
1：收到。新快雀的操纵性如何？听说是阿曼达亲自组装的。
2：最好是。[爆裂声][推进器发出嗡嗡声][树枝折断声]
1：回答，曼斯！
2：引擎有点儿问题！曲线急速上拉然后——[轰鸣声]加速！
1：我们离火力基地不远了，但我们还可以回头。
2：哇哈——[爆炸声]
1：曼斯！
2：翻了几个跟头！有两辆派克……呃哦。还有卡巴尔。
1：回来找你没什么大问题。
2：发现大型飞船。超大。正在朝它冲过去。
1：呃，绕到背后。
2：[轰鸣声持续不断]
1：曼斯。
2：[轰鸣声][爆炸声]
1：曼斯！
2：坏蛋都干掉了！现在要驶入弯道了。
1：求你别再这么做了，好么？
2：今晚要请阿曼达喝酒了！

3081894947.name: Concentric Dawn
3081894947.flavor: "Study the sacred geometry of light and life." —Ikora Rey
3081894947.lore:
PRAISE FOR IKORA REY'S "ON CIRCLES: REVISED EDITION":

"In volume after volume, Ikora Rey pioneers devastating new ways for Warlocks to destroy our enemies." —Vanguard Commander Zavala

"A monumental scholarly achievement that deserves a place in any serious library." —Tyra Karn

"An inspiring work that challenges conventions of metaphysics and ontology through the prism of a deceptively simple shape: the circle. Impressive!" —Lord Shaxx

"Despite a lack of rigorous data analysis and an overreliance on the mystical, this book has merits that even I must acknowledge." —Asher Mir

"Based on the couple of pages I got through, this is one of Ikora's most well-rounded works yet, although she makes kind of a circular argument. Also, the paper's really high quality. Very soft and smooth." —Cayde-6
3081894947.lore_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊《解析圆环修订版》赞誉：

“艾可拉·蕾伊女士用一卷又一卷的力作将化敌为乌有的全新术士之道推向新的境界。”——先锋指挥官萨瓦拉

“值得任何严谨的书库收藏的一座学术丰碑。”——泰拉·卡恩

“一部给人灵感的作品，它通过具有欺骗性的简单形态：圆环，向形而上学和本体论的陈规发起有力的挑战。让人印象深刻！”——领主沙克斯

“除了缺少严密的数据分析和对神秘实体过于依赖以外，这本书拥有我都必须承认的可取之处。”——阿什·米尔

“就我拜读的部分内容看来，这是艾可拉女士最全面的作品之一，尽管她的论证过程是在转圈圈。另外，纸张的质量确实很高。非常柔软，手感平滑。”——凯德6号

3081894944.flavor: "But will my actions avert the futures I see, or cause them?" —Osiris
3081894944.lore:
Consensus Meeting 2891.98

NM: "I note for the record that we are without a Warlock Vanguard or a Vanguard Commander."
Andal Brask: "Two birds, one man."
Zavala: "Ikora Rey is interim Warlock Vanguard for this meeting."
Speaker: "Which brings us to our first order of business. Ikora Rey, the Consensus formally requests you assume the responsibilities of Warlock Vanguard."
Ikora Rey: "Considering I've been performing those responsibilities for a while now, I accept."
FWC: "Why did you cover for him for so long?"
IR: "Someone had to do it."
S: "Ahem. Now that we have Consensus, I may inform you I have decided to banish former Warlock Vanguard Osiris from the Last City."
[murmurs]
S: "Are there any objections?"
DO: "None here. Maybe he'll find a better planet for us."
[pause]
S: "Very well. Next: I name Titan Vanguard Zavala as the new Vanguard Commander. Congratulations."
3081894944.lore_zh:
元老院会议2891.98

新王派：“我注意到记录显示我们没有在任的术士先锋或先锋指挥官。”
安达尔·布莱斯克：“一人二鸟。”
萨瓦拉：“艾可拉·蕾伊是以临时术士先锋的身份参加本次会议的。”
先知：“这就是我们本次会议的第一个内容。艾可拉·蕾伊，元老院正式邀请你担任术士先锋一职。”
艾：“考虑到目前已负责此职的工作一段时间了，本人接受这个邀请。”
未来战争狂热者：“你为何袒护他如此之久？”
艾：“总得有人这么做吧。”
先：“咳。既然元老院在场，那就可以通知你我已经将前任术士先锋奥斯里斯从圣城驱逐出去了。”
[议论声]
先：“是否有异议？”
死轨：“没有异议。也许他能帮我们找到一个更好的星球。”
[停顿]
先：“很好。接下来：我任命泰坦先锋萨瓦拉就任新的先锋指挥官。祝贺你。”

3587167050.name: Undefeated
3587167050.flavor: Marcus Ren's record is unassailable. It would take decades for anyone to catch him.
3587167050.lore:
RM: "Into the final turn! Marcus Ren leading by four lengths!"
HB: "That's four less than the last time he won 15 in a row. Think he has the flu?"
RM: "It doesn't look like he has anything but victory on his mind! One quick turn back to check behind him and… uh, that's…"
HB: "Did he drop his lucky coin?"
RM: "Ren looking down at the track and WHOA! What was that?!"
HB: "I can't believe it. To fry a cell in the homestretch…"
RM: "Enoch Bast is gaining! Bast is gaining on Ren! He's gonna catch him!"
HB: "He won't."
RM: "He's gonna catch him!"
HB: "He can't."
RM: "HE DID! ENOCH BAST HAS WON! THE SECOND-YEAR RACER HAS DONE IT! FINALLY!"
HB: "We can't see what's going on under that helmet, but I bet Ren is just furious."
RM: "Enoch Bast is the Crimson Cup Champion! The first Titan to hold the trophy in over a decade!"
HB: "And the first racer to beat Marcus Ren in almost as long."
RM: "Ren looking back one last time as he coasts off the track. Check out all the well-wishers swarming around the new champion!"
3587167050.lore_zh:
RM：“进入最后一个弯道！马库斯·伦领先四节！”
HB：“比他上一次连胜时慢了四节。他是不是感冒了？”
RM：“看来他的心中只有胜利！快速转弯，他转头看向身后……啊，那是……”
HB：“他的幸运硬币掉地上了？”
RM：“伦向下看着赛道，哇哦！发生了什么？！”
HB：“我不敢相信。终点直道一场激战……”
RM：“以诺·巴斯特赶上来了！以诺·巴斯特正在追赶伦！要追上他了！”
HB：“不可能。”
RM：“他要追上他了！”
HB：“他不会的。”
RM：“他反超了！以诺·巴斯特获胜！参赛不过两年的选手获胜了！终于！”
HB：“我们不知道那顶头盔下是什么表情，但我打赌伦肯定是怒容满面。”
RM：“血色杯的冠军以诺·巴斯特！十多年来第一位端起奖杯的泰坦！”
HB：“也几乎是这么多年来击败马库斯·伦的第一人。”
RM：“伦回身看了最后一眼，走下赛道。瞧瞧那些簇拥着新任冠军表达祝福的人群吧！”

3587167051.name: Undeterred
3587167051.flavor: Hard work and practice aren't enough. Sometimes things need to break your way.
3587167051.source: Source: Earned during the seasonal Crimson Days event.
3587167051.source_zh: 来源：于赛季血色浪漫活动期间获得。
3587167051.lore:
(Nine hundred.)
Should have known better. Those were pretty words, but come on. Marcus was never going to lose to me.
(Eight hundred.)
All the practicing, the two knee sprains… throw it on the pile of wasted effort.
(Seven hundred.)
So this is it. I'll sell off the bird, obviously. That should get me enough Glimmer to stock up for going back to patrols full-time.
(Six hundred.)
Yeah, I see you, Ren. I might never beat you out here, but we'll always pull each other out of the fire in the field.
(Five hundred.)
Wha…
(Four hundred.)
No way. Marcus, don't flame out now.
(Three hundred.)
…
(Two hundred.)
!!!
(One hundred.)
By the Traveler. I'm actually gonna…
(Finish.)
Marcus. Did you see me? I did it. I won. I WON. Maybe… maybe I don't have to give up. "Enoch Bast, Champion Sparrow Racer" sounds better than "Enoch Bast, Grunt Who's Really Good at Patrols."
Time to enjoy this.
3587167051.lore_zh:
（九百米。）
早该知道的，那些都是场面话，但是拜托，马库斯怎么可能会输给我呢。
（八百米。）
苦练了那么久，双膝扭伤……如今一切努力付之东流。
（七百米。）
那就这样吧。我肯定会卖掉快雀。那样我就能存够微光回去全职巡逻了。
（六百米。）
是的，伦，我懂你什么意思。我也许永远无法击败你，但我们在战场上会帮助彼此脱离危境。
（五百米。）
什……
（四百米。）
不可能。马库斯，别故意放水啊。
（三百米。）
……
（两百米。）
！！！
（一百米。）
以旅行者之名。我真的要……
（终点。）
马库斯，你看见了吗？我做到了。我赢了。我赢了！也许……也许我不需要放弃。“赛雀冠军以诺·巴斯特”比“话痨巡逻小能手以诺·巴斯特”听上去气派多了。
该享受这一切了。

3105953707.name: Chill of Winter
3105953707.flavor: The Dawning comes once a year. Some wish it would take a little longer.
3105953707.lore:
"They're Travelers. Little snowy Travelers."

Jazla looked down at the snowman again. The lower body, with ice pieces held in orbit by twigs. Just like what was in the sky behind her partner.

"It's a coincidence." But she knew it wasn't. The torso, deliberately shaded with what, coal? Blackened on the bottom, just like what was in the sky until a few months ago.

"We both know it's not. Not after what he drew last week. And now this. One dead Traveler. One alive Traveler. Another Traveler for a head."

"What's the other one?" Jazla gestured at the well-formed sphere a few feet away. Hollowed out. Overgrown with vegetation that their son had obviously placed there. Neatly. Deliberately.

"That one… is why I think we need to talk to Lakshmi about him."

Jazla didn't look up. She had fought against it for so long, but… maybe it was time. The Dawning, right? New beginnings.

A tear disappeared into the frozen ground.
3105953707.lore_zh:
“它们是旅行者。小小的雪白旅行者。”

贾兹拉又向下看了雪人一眼。雪人的下身，环绕着承托冰片的树枝。就像她同伴身后天空中高挂的那个一样。

“纯属巧合。”但她不知道这并非巧合。躯干上特意用了什么涂出阴影，是煤炭吗？黑色的底部，和几个月前天上的那个一样。

“我们都知道不是，在他上周画过之后就不同了。现在又一个。一个死去的旅行者。一个活着的旅行者。一个只有脑袋的旅行者。”

“那个是什么？”贾兹拉指着几英尺外中空的规则球体。上面长满了显然是他们儿子摆在那里的植被。整整齐齐。刻意为之。

“那个……就是我认为我们得去跟拉克希米谈谈的原因。”

贾兹拉没有抬头。她同它抗争了如此之久，但是……也许就是现在了。曙光节，对吧？全新的开始。

没入冰冻地面的一滴泪珠。

3105953706.name: Holiday Cheer
3105953706.flavor: A twinkle in our eyes, ozone in our lungs, and a song in our hearts.
3105953706.lore:
"Winter's touch will soon be gone, clouds will part and light returns
Darkness pales before the dawn, blinding light forever burns
Dawning comes but once a year, let your voice sing out with cheer
See the ground bejeweled with snow, shake the gloom out of your heart
Bathed in firelight's soothing glow, cold cannot keep us apart
Dawning comes but once a year, let your voice sing out with cheer
Hug your family's bodies close, take their warmth and make it last
Banish all your thoughts morose, cleanse your mind of visions past
Dawning comes but once a year, let your voice sing out with cheer"

"…"

"What?"

"A little creepy, isn't it?"

"I don't have Skorri's talent."

"We… should take another crack at it before they get back from the Cosmodrome."

"Yeah, you're probably right."
3105953706.lore_zh:
“寒冬的触摸行将离去，云霾散开，光明复归
暗影在曙光之下顿然失色，夺目之光永燃不熄
曙光节每年一次，让我们放声欢歌
欣赏白雪点缀的大地，拂去胸中忧愁
沐浴在舒心的火光之中，寒冷不能将我们分隔
曙光节每年一次，让我们放声欢歌
将家人紧紧拥入怀中，感受彼此的温暖，永远留存
放逐心中的阴郁，驱散对昔日的念念不忘
曙光节每年一次，让我们放声欢歌”

“……”

“怎么了？”

“不觉得有点儿瘆人吗？”

“我没斯科里的天赋。”

“我们……应该在他们从发射基地回来之前再试一次。”

“是的，也许你说得对。”

953357968.name: Trichromatica
953357968.flavor: "Void, Solar, then Arc. Hmm. We're not naive enough to think the order is a coincidence. But we've got bigger things to worry about." —Zavala
953357968.source: Source: Complete Nightfall strike "The Inverted Spire."
953357968.source_zh: 来源：完成日落打击“倒置尖塔”。
953357968.lore:
I'm not sure why my journaling subroutine has come back online! It's quite troubling.

(All the things to freak out over and my diary is top of the list?)

The Red Legion's drilling has impacted my processing in some way! That shouldn't be possible. My concern is escalating!

(Calm down, me. There's always something I can do.)

But rewriting my own pathways isn't permitted by my original programming!

(Neither is whining.)

That was uncalled for! I'm refocusing on identifying the source of this change.

(No, I'm going to make those red losers regret coming to our little rock.)

No, I'm analyzing the oscillating nature of the Modular Mind's shield to find weaknesses that can be applied to anti-Cabal weaponry. Why am I doing that?

(Because I'm doing it, not me.)

…This is all very worrisome!

(Yeah, I should get an external diagnostic run. By no one. Because they're all dead.)
953357968.lore_zh:
我不知道为什么我的日志子程序重新上线了！这相当麻烦。

（那么多可以激动的事情，而我的日志是最重要的？）

猩红军团的钻探以某种方式影响了我的进程！那不应该发生的。我的担心在不停增加！

（我要冷静下来。总会有我能做的什么。）

但我的原始编程不允许我重写自己的路径！

（也不许抱怨。）

那不对！我正在重新确认这种变化的来源。

（不，我准备让这些红色的失败者们为来到我们这颗小星球的行为感到后悔。）

不，我正在分析模块思维护盾的振动特性，或许可以找出些弱点利用在反卡巴尔武器装备上。我为什么要这样做？

（因为我在这么做，不是我。）

……这太令人担心了！

（是的，我应该运行外部诊断的。但没有人。因为他们都死了。）

573576346.name: Sagira's Shell
573576346.flavor: Loyalty does not mean obligation. Only justice is blind.
573576346.source: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
573576346.source_zh: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。
573576346.lore:
"So that's it?" Sagira cried out, as Ikora began to walk away from her old mentor. "You're just going to let the Vanguard kick him out? After everything Osiris has done for you? He taught you everything you know!"

Ikora pivoted sharply. "No. Osiris merely taught me everything HE knows."

"Admit it, Ikora. Without Osiris, you would still be running training exercises with that loud brute, Shaxx."

"It would be in your best interest to stop talking now, Sagira. The Crucible was my home."

"You were wasting your talents! Osiris made you greater than what you were. And now he needs you for something truly important. Where's your loyalty? You owe him."

"This conversation is over," Ikora said, and walked away.

"You bet it is! We are outta here! You'll all be sorry, you ingrates."
573576346.lore_zh:
“就这样吗？”艾可拉迈开脚步准备离开她那年迈的导师时，萨吉拉大喊。“你就放任先锋把他驱逐出去吗？在奥斯里斯为你做了这么多之后？你知道的一切都是他教给你的！”

艾可拉猛地转身。“不，奥斯里斯教给我的只是他脑子里的东西。”

“承认吧艾可拉，没有奥斯里斯，你还会在那个聒噪的蛮子沙克斯手底下搞例行训练。”

“萨吉拉，你最好现在就闭嘴。熔炉竞技场是我的家。”

“你在那里是在浪费自己的天赋！奥斯里斯让你脱胎换骨。而现在，他因要事亟需你的协助。你的忠诚呢？你欠他太多。”

“谈话结束了”，艾可拉说完就走开了。

“最好是！我们走！你们会后悔的，你们这群忘恩负义的家伙！”

1558857470.flavor: For Ghosts who want to chart new skies.
1558857470.lore:
Overheard at the Fu'an Institute Library:

"Get over here and tell me this is what I think this is."

"It looks like Golden Age shipping records."

"Look at these quantities! It must be a colony ship!"

"'Must be'? Excuse me, you do remember you're supposed to be a scholar, right?"

"Come on, we know they were sending out colony ships in the Golden Age."

"We know they sent off the Exodus Black, which was lost for centuries until what's-their-name found it on Nessus. And we know they tried to accelerate the launch of the Exodus Blue during the Collapse, but it crashed in the Cosmodrome."

"Think of how many other colors there are!"

"Listen. You think I wouldn't love to know that Humans made it to other solar systems? But we don't have the evidence."

"I'm gonna find it. A Golden Age map of other stars."

"Don't stop looking. Just, you know, cite your sources."
1558857470.lore_zh:
在福安研究所图书馆偶然听到的对话：

“快过来，告诉我这就是我想的那个东西。”

“这看上去像是黄金时代的货运记录。”

“瞧这天文数字！这肯定是一艘殖民舰！”

“‘肯定是'？不好意思，你应该没忘记自己是学者，对吧？”

“拜托，我们都知道他们在黄金时代一直在派出殖民舰。”

“我们知道他们派出了黑色移民号，在失踪了几个世纪之后才被某些人在涅索斯上寻获。而且我们知道他们试图在大崩溃时期发射蓝色移民号，但这艘舰却在发射基地坠毁了。”

“想想看还有多少种颜色吧！”

“听着，你以为我不想知道人类成功抵达其他恒星系的事实吗？但我们没有证据。”

“我会找到证据的。我会找到一张其他星系的黄金时代星图。”

“那就不停去找吧。只是，你知道的，要注明来源。”

1558857471.name: Cosmos Shell
1558857471.flavor: For Ghosts who wonder at the majesty of the universe.
1558857471.lore:
The old doubts came back when the Light went out.
But the iron in her bones, worn and rusted as it was, never buckled.
The Light was gone, but holding a sniper rifle still felt right.
She marched into the City beneath a refugee's hood, took up a roost in the building with the white rabbit, and killed 216 Cabal with 199 bullets.
She cried when the Traveler woke before her eyes.
At her hip a radio blinked to life. It had gone quiet when the Red Legion attacked. She answered it with trembling fingers.
"I know," she said. "I can see it. I can feel it."
"Even the stars are brighter now," said the voice over the radio. "The whole cosmos is ablaze."
She closed her eyes. "I can't wait to see it. I'm coming home. Efrideet out."
1558857471.lore_zh:
光能熄灭时，从前的疑惑又窜上心头。
她的铮铮铁骨，虽早已残破锈蚀，却从未弯曲变形。
光能不再，但握着狙击枪的感觉却没有改变。
她披着难民的斗篷进入圣城，在白兔建筑物中埋伏下来；她用199颗子弹射杀了216名卡巴尔。
当旅行者在她眼前苏醒时，她哭了。
她腰上的无线电亮起灯来。当猩红军团发起攻击时，无线电的灯光就再也没有亮起过。她用颤抖的手指按下应答按钮。
“我知道”，她说。“我看到了。我感觉到了。”
“甚至星辰都更明亮了”，无线电那一头回复。“整个宇宙都亮起来了。”
她闭上双眼。“我等不及要去看一看了。我要回家。艾弗里迪特完毕。”

1558857468.name: Fast Lane Shell
1558857468.flavor: For Ghosts who like to drive fast and look good while doing it.
1558857468.lore:
"I need a new project."

"Disagree." Marcus's Ghost floated over to where he sat with his head down on his workbench, and gently bumped his temple. "I see three half-finished Sparrows in this room alone, and you still haven't done that thing Ikora asked you to do. You're plenty busy."

Marcus tilted his head to glare at his Ghost. "Didi. Be serious."

"I am."

Marcus groaned.

"Fine." Didi floated over to the wall where Marcus's bright red Sparrow-racing jacket dangled from a hook. "You know, I've always wanted one of these. For me."

"Really?"

"Is that weird?"

"No!" Marcus jumped to his feet. "It's aces. Of course you need a racing shell. I'm going to make you the flashiest shell you've ever seen." He grabbed his Ghost out of the air and kissed her shell. "Thank you, Didi!"

"You're the one—never mind." Didi bumped her Guardian's forehead affectionately. "You're welcome, Marcus."
1558857468.lore_zh:
“我需要做新项目。”

“不行。”马库斯的机灵飘到正坐在伏案工作的马库斯身边，温柔地蹭着他的太阳穴。“光在这个房间里，我就看见了三台只完成了一半的快雀，而你居然还没有完成艾可拉要你做的事，你有的忙呢。”

马库斯歪过脑袋，生气地盯着他的机灵。“迪迪，别闹。”

“我没闹。”

马库斯嘟囔了一声。

“好吧。”迪迪飘向挂着马库斯那件亮红色快雀竞速外套的墙壁。“知道吗，我一直想要一件这个。我自己穿。”

“确定？”

“很怪吗？”

“不！”马库斯跳了起来。“太棒了。当然，你需要一个竞速机壳。我要给你做一个你从未见过的最闪亮的机壳。”他一把抓住飘在空中的机灵，吻了一下她的机壳。“迪迪，谢谢你！”

“为了你我愿——当我没说。”迪迪亲昵地蹭着守护者的额头。“不用客气，马库斯。”

1558857469.name: Fire Victorious Shell
1558857469.flavor: For Ghosts with fire inside of them.
1558857469.lore:
Consensus Meeting 3267.56
Z: "Callisto Yin. Thank you for joining us today."
CY: "My pleasure, sir."
Z: "You singlehandedly carried the Fire Victorious from the City as it fell, ensuring that the flames first kindled by Wei Ning so many years ago would continue to burn. For that, we thank you."
CY: "Any of the Firebreak Order would have done as much."
NM: "The repairs to Firebreak Plaza are almost complete. I think we may have the relighting ceremony as soon as next week."
CY: "With all due respect, we have decided not to bring the Fire Victorious back to the City. Not in the same way."
FWC: "What do you mean?"
CY: "One torch in one city is too small."
IR: "What do you propose instead?"
CY: "Now each of our Ghosts bears embers of the Fire Victorious. Wei Ning's flames will go with us to each new battlefield."
1558857469.lore_zh:
元老院会议3267.56
萨：“卡丽斯托·殷，感谢你参加会议。”
殷：“荣幸之至。”
萨：“圣城陷落时，你单枪匹马将胜利之焰从圣城带走，保证了多年之前由韦宁点燃的火焰能够继续燃烧下去。为此，我们感谢你。”
殷：“破焰教派的任何成员都会这么做。”
新王派：“破焰广场即将完成维修。我想我们最快下周就可以举行重燃仪式了。”
殷：“恕我直言，我们已经决定不再将胜利之焰带回圣城。不能再像以前那样。”
未来战争狂热者：“什么意思？”
殷：“对于一整座城市来说，一把火炬太微弱了。”
艾：“那你有什么建议呢？”
殷：“我们的每只机灵都携带胜利之焰的余烬。韦宁的火焰将随我们踏上每一片新的战场。”

1558857466.name: Electronica Shell
1558857466.flavor: For Ghosts who love to groove.
1558857466.lore:
What Do Guardians Do When They're Not Saving the Solar System?
by Ember Hadad, Senior Editor at the City Herald

When I started my research for this piece, I expected to find that Guardians, when not waging war against alien invaders with mysterious paracausal powers, were not too different from their fellow citizens of the Last City.

Readers, I was wrong.

Guardians dance a lot more than we do.

"That's pretty much all they do, when I see them," says Park Soo-Yin, a maintenance worker in the Guardian headquarters. "Just dance. Sometimes in groups, sometimes all alone."

"Sometimes they kind of dance 'at' each other, if you know what I mean," Vanguard technician Kweku Aglah confirms. "I feel like I'm watching the nature channel."
1558857466.lore_zh:
《不去拯救太阳系时，守护者都在做什么呢？》
圣城使者高级编辑恩蓓尔·哈达著

当开始研究这个问题时，我预想之中的情景是，当守护者在不使用神秘的超因果能力与外星侵略者作战时，他们与最后城市中的市民并没有什么区别。

但是，读者们，我错了。

守护者比我们还爱跳舞。

“每次看到守护者时，他们差不多都在跳舞，”一位来自守护者总部的维修工人朴秀英说道。“就是跳舞，有时群舞，有时独舞。”

“有时他们似乎在‘对着'彼此跳舞，你懂我的意思吧，”先锋技师奎库·艾格拉也确认了这个说法。“感觉就像是在看自然频道。”

2549404869.name: Winter Lotus Shell
2549404869.flavor: For Ghosts who celebrate the many traditions of the Dawning.
2549404869.lore:
Some give gifts and light candles. Some write fortunes and release paper lanterns etched with snowflakes and stars. Some sing songs and say prayers and tell stories passed down from the refugee roads. Tables bend under the weight of every kind of food and drink imaginable.

The rich tapestry of Dawning festival traditions found in the Last City has only one common thread, but it is the brightest thread of all: we are Humankind. Of those born in the cradle called Earth, we are the last. The nights are long, but we will survive them together. We must not let our light go out.
2549404869.lore_zh:
有人赠予礼物，点亮蜡烛；有人写下愿望，放飞用雪花和星辰蚀刻的孔明灯；有人欢唱，祷告，将逃亡道路上的故事相传。还有那你无法想象的饕餮盛宴将餐桌压弯。

共同的丝线编织出圣城曙光节传统的缤纷织锦，但最艳丽的丝线只有一条：我们是人类。我们是地球摇篮孕育出的最后一种生物。黑夜漫长，我们要携手度过。光，永不熄灭。

113124080.name: Contender's Shell
113124080.flavor: "Nothing pleases me more than to see you fight." —Emperor Calus
113124080.lore:
You know now that I am Calus, the last and greatest emperor of the Cabal.

You know that I am Chief Gift-Giver, the Good Host with the Generous Banquet, the Prince of Mirth, and the Lord of Laughter. My plans are always bounteous, my orders delightful to obey. And though the seats at my table are prized beyond measure, the bold and passionate will never fail to earn a place in my hall.

And when I tell you of the role I have set aside for you in the great luxuriant expanse of my designs, you will know that the wonders I have shown you are only the beginning.
113124080.lore_zh:
要知道，我是卡鲁斯，是卡巴尔最后也是最伟大的帝王。要知道，幽灵军团长是虚假的；他终迎来了自己的叛徒命运，而我也为你在帝国中留存了一席之地。我的勇士，你我之间终于再无阻碍了。

抬头看看天堂，你将看到翅膀伸展至天际的我。飞向我，我将用黄金沐浴你，用园中鲜果滋润你，用奠酒微醺你。

要知道，我心中满满的都是爱。我渴望寻求到有能力接受我礼物，握紧我的手，与我分享欢笑的人。

你我合作，重建帝国。

2499197808.description_zh: 此模组已被弃用。拆解模组换取空间和有用的组件。
2499197808.typeName_zh: 稀有 手臂护甲模组

1276313701.name: Solar Ordnance Mod
1276313701.description: This mod has been deprecated. Dismantle to clear space and reclaim useful components.
1276313701.description_zh: 此模组已被弃用。拆解模组换取空间和有用的组件。
1276313701.typeName_zh: 传说 手臂护甲模组

3666112472.name: Scissor Fingers
3666112472.description: Gain a second knife per charge. Getting a final blow with a throwing knife grants consecutive knives a temporary stacking damage bonus. Gambler's Dodge refreshes the bonus timer.
3666112472.description_zh: 每次充能提供一把额外飞刀。使用飞刀造成最后一击时，连续投掷的飞刀会获得临时叠加伤害加成。赌徒闪身会重置加成倒计时。

3723531833.name: Burning Souls
3723531833.description: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapid [Solar]Solar final blows grant stacks of Burning Souls that increase Solar ability damage, increase the potency of Dodge's healing, and spreads the healing to nearby allies.
3723531833.description_zh: 激活职业技能会提供治愈。快速烈日最后一击提供燃烧之魂层数，从而增加烈日技能的伤害、提升闪身治疗的效力，并将治疗扩散至附近的盟友。

2805134531.name: Nightmare Fuel
2805134531.description: Powered melee and finisher final blows grant Nightmare Fuel, increasing handling and airborne effectiveness. While active, freshly drawn weapons deal additional damage and grant Nightmare Fuel on final blows. Gaining Nightmare Fuel reloads all holstered weapons.
2805134531.description_zh: 充能近战和终结技最后一击会提供噩梦激励，提升操控性和空中效率。生效时，新拔出的武器会造成额外伤害并在造成最后一击时提供噩梦激励。获得噩梦激励会填装所有枪套中的武器。

897181301.name: Rapid Cooldown
897181301.description:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.
897181301.description_zh:
在冲刺时提升手雷、近战与闪身的回复。

冲刺时获得冰霜护甲层数。当你拥有冰霜护甲时，冰影武器造成额外伤害。

384759954.name: Bring the Heat
384759954.description: Fusion Grenades gain increased throw speed, explode on impact, and stun Unstoppable Champions. Final blows with Fusion Grenades grant grenade energy.
384759954.description_zh: 融合手雷投掷速度提高，命中时发生爆炸，并可眩晕势不可挡勇士。融合手雷造成最后一击会提供手雷能量。

384759955.name: Burning Fists
384759955.description: Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.
384759955.description_zh: 使用近战攻击或终结技击败目标会提供不断增加的近战伤害，但此加成会随着时间衰减。更高等级的燃烧之拳会提供更高的武器伤害。

883550427.name: And Another Thing
883550427.description: Gain an additional grenade charge. Grenade final blows spawn an Orb of Power. Weapon final blows grant grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
883550427.description_zh: 获得一次额外的手雷充能。手雷最后一击会生成一个能量球。武器最后一击可提供手雷能量。使用手雷技能将从弹药储备中填装当前装备的武器。

926976844.name: Resolute
926976844.description: [Arc]Arc final blows grant an escalating damage bonus with Arc weapons. While using Fist of Havoc, activating your Super grants an overshield; final blows extend its duration. When it ends, gain a damage bonus to your Arc weapons.
926976844.description_zh: 电弧最后一击可为电弧武器提供递增的伤害加成。使用浩劫之拳时，激活超能会提供覆盖护盾，最后一击可延长其持续时间。在结束时，可获得电弧武器伤害加成。

1420473289.name: Blood Magic
1420473289.description: While standing in any rift, damaging a target will mark it. You deal extra damage to marked targets, and gain additional bonus damage with weapons that have a damage type matching your equipped Super. Weapon final blows while standing in any rift pause the rift's countdown, extending its duration.
1420473289.description_zh: 站在任意裂痕中时，伤害目标会进行标记。你对标记的目标造成额外伤害，使用伤害类型与你已装备超能匹配的武器可获得额外伤害加成。站在任意裂痕中的武器最后一击会暂停裂痕的倒计时，从而延长其持续时间。

1971489086.name: The Fourth Magic
1971489086.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.
1971489086.description_zh: 用伤害类型与你的手雷匹配的武器造成最后一击会赋予死亡阵痛，使你的手雷获得伤害加成并提供手雷能量。当你拥有死亡阵痛并投掷手雷时，附近的盟友会在短时间内获得大幅手雷回复速度提升。

2637025676.name: The Whispers
2637025676.description: Gain an additional melee charge. Powered melee final blows spawn an Orb of Power.
2637025676.description_zh: 获得额外一次近战充能。充能近战最后一击会生成一个能量球。

4174493725.name: Insatiable
4174493725.description: Immediately regenerate health, melee, grenade, and Rift energy for you and your nearby allies upon activating your Super. After your Super ends, temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regen.
4174493725.description_zh: 超能激活时，你和附近盟友立即恢复生命值、近战、手雷和裂痕能量。超能结束后，近战和手雷能量恢复速度将获得短暂的大幅提升。

1576194648.name: Fire-Forged Hunter Arms Ornament
1576194648.description: Defeat enemies with Pulse Rifles in the Crucible during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
1576194648.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在熔炉竞技场中使用脉冲步枪消灭敌人可解锁并装备此皮肤。

1058022768.name: Fire-Forged Hunter Chest Ornament
1058022768.description: Defeat enemies with Hand Cannon headshots in the Crucible during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
1058022768.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在熔炉竞技场中使用手炮消灭敌人可解锁并装备此皮肤。

4238568621.name: Fire-Forged Hunter Cloak Ornament
4238568621.description: Earn Crucible Engrams during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
4238568621.description_zh: 第3赛季期间赢取熔炉竞技场记忆水晶可解锁并装备此皮肤。

738275137.name: Fire-Forged Hunter Head Ornament
738275137.description: Fully complete and reset your Crucible Rank during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.

3906326418.name: Fire-Forged Hunter Leg Ornament
3906326418.description: Defeat enemies with Sniper Rifles in the Crucible during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
3906326418.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在熔炉竞技场中使用狙击步枪消灭敌人可解锁并装备此皮肤。

3127350767.name: Arach's Chosen Grips
3127350767.description: Get Hive kills using fully charged melee abilities while pledged to Dead Orbit.
3127350767.description_zh: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间使用完全充能的近战技能击杀邪魔族。

537899715.name: Arach's Chosen Vestments
537899715.description: Get multikills with Supers while wearing full Dead Orbit Anti-Extinction armor and pledged to Dead Orbit.
537899715.description_zh: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间在装备整套死亡轨道抵殇护甲的情况下使用超能获得多杀。

3733752686.name: Cape of Last Departure
3733752686.description: While pledged to Dead Orbit, complete the Methane Flush Lost Sector in Siren's Watch on Titan.
3733752686.description_zh: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间，完成位于土卫六海妖守望台中的甲烷奔流遗失区域。

2797913058.name: Arach's Chosen Casque
2797913058.description: Spend Renown by looting a Lost Sector cache while pledged to Dead Orbit.
2797913058.description_zh: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间通过洗掠遗失区域缓存箱来使用声誉。

949647553.name: Arach's Chosen Flight
949647553.description: Earn Renown with full Dead Orbit Anti-Extinction armor equipped and while pledged to Dead Orbit.
949647553.description_zh: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间在装备整套死亡轨道抵殇护甲的情况下获得声誉。

3628276006.name: Thundergod
3628276006.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Raiden Flux. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
3628276006.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变雷电通流的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3043294716.name: Predestination

3908372701.name: Superior's Vision Grips
3908372701.description: Eliminate Vex with the Golden Gun while pledged to Future War Cult.
3908372701.description_zh: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间使用黄金枪消灭Vex。

2524583429.name: Superior's Vision Cuirass
2524583429.description: Eliminate Vex with Kinetic weapons while wearing full Future War Cult Simulator armor and pledged to Future War Cult.
2524583429.description_zh: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间在装备整套未来战争狂热者模拟护甲的情况下使用动能武器消灭Vex。

1578878364.name: Cape of Eternal War
1578878364.description: While pledged to Future War Cult, complete the Ancient's Haunt Lost Sector in the Tangle on Nessus.
1578878364.description_zh: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间，完成位于涅索斯纷争地中的远古故地遗失区域。

1632717232.name: Superior's Vision Cowl

1632717232.description_zh: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间通过洗掠遗失区域缓存箱来使用声誉。

2385935391.name: Superior's Vision Strides
2385935391.description: Earn Renown with full Future War Cult Simulator armor equipped and while pledged to Future War Cult.
2385935391.description_zh: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间在装备整套未来战争狂热者模拟护甲的情况下获得声誉。

968545635.name: Gheleon's Iron Grips
968545635.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
968545635.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

2076777678.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

3853099349.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

2465050180.name: Executor's Will Grips
2465050180.description: Defeat Cabal Centurions while pledged to New Monarchy.
2465050180.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间击败卡巴尔百夫长。

52736778.name: Executor's Will Vest
52736778.description: Open chests in the EDZ with full New Monarchy Sovereign armor equipped and while pledged to New Monarchy.
52736778.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间在装备整套新王派君权护甲的情况下在欧洲无人区开启宝箱。

797274431.name: Cape of the Royal
797274431.description: While pledged to New Monarchy, complete the Drain Lost Sector in the EDZ's Outskirts.
797274431.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间，完成位于欧洲无人区市郊中的排水系统遗失区域。

1601073057.name: Executor's Will Casque
1601073057.description: Spend Renown by looting a Lost Sector cache while pledged to New Monarchy.
1601073057.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间通过洗掠遗失区域缓存箱来使用声誉。

2138283222.name: Executor's Will Strides
2138283222.description: Earn Renown with full New Monarchy Sovereign armor equipped and while pledged to New Monarchy.
2138283222.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间在装备整套新王派君权护甲的情况下获得声誉。

3849801323.name: Praetorian Ornament
3849801323.description: Complete the Pleasure Gardens challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
3849801323.description_zh: 完成欢愉花园挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

385347493.name: Praetorian Ornament
385347493.name_zh: 禁卫军猎人胸部装饰品
385347493.description: Complete the Royal Pools challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
385347493.description_zh: 完成皇家水池挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

3802263800.name: Praetorian Ornament

3044759626.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

591580685.name: Executor's Will Gloves
591580685.description: Defeat Cabal Psions while pledged to New Monarchy.
591580685.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间击败卡巴尔辅助士兵。

505586837.name: Executor's Will Robes
505586837.description: Complete patrols in the EDZ with full New Monarchy Sovereign armor equipped and while pledged to New Monarchy.
505586837.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间在装备整套新王派君权护甲的情况下在欧洲无人区完成巡逻。

4137984748.name: Bond of the Royal
4137984748.description: While pledged to New Monarchy, complete the Cavern of Souls Lost Sector in the EDZ's Sludge.
4137984748.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间，完成位于欧洲无人区泥淖地中的灵魂洞穴遗失区域。

84296096.name: Executor's Will Cover
84296096.description: Spend Renown by looting a Lost Sector cache while pledged to New Monarchy.
84296096.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间通过洗掠遗失区域缓存箱来使用声誉。

3138706543.name: Executor's WIll Boots
3138706543.description: Earn Renown with full New Monarchy Sovereign armor equipped and while pledged to New Monarchy.
3138706543.description_zh: 宣誓效忠新王派期间在装备整套新王派君权护甲的情况下获得声誉。

2543545988.name: Praetorian Ornament
2543545988.description: Complete the Pleasure Gardens challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
2543545988.description_zh: 完成欢愉花园挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

3439095932.name: Praetorian Ornament
3439095932.description: Complete the Royal Pools challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
3439095932.description_zh: 完成皇家水池挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

430065393.name: Praetorian Ornament
430065393.description: Complete "Spire of Stars" on Prestige difficulty in Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
430065393.description_zh: 第3赛季期间完成巅峰难度的“星之塔”以解锁和装备此装饰品。

3909176373.name: Praetorian Ornament
3909176373.description: Complete the Throne of Calus challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
3909176373.description_zh: 完成卡鲁斯王座挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

4091208110.name: Praetorian Ornament
4091208110.description: Complete the Gauntlet challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
4091208110.description_zh: 完成铁拳厅挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

2398247002.name: Steadfast Warlock Ornament
2398247002.description: Complete challenges in strikes during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV arms armor.
2398247002.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在打击中完成挑战可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV手臂护甲上解锁。

547716782.name: Steadfast Warlock Ornament
547716782.description: Complete weekly strike milestones during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV chest armor.
547716782.description_zh: 第3赛季期间完成周常打击里程碑可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV胸部护甲上解锁。

865811319.name: Steadfast Warlock Ornament
865811319.description: Defeat enemies in strikes with Super abilities during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense cloak, Mark of Shelter, and Xenos Vale Bond.
865811319.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在打击中使用超能消灭敌人可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、避难所印记和陌路溪谷IV臂环上解锁。

4075989867.name: Steadfast Warlock Ornament
4075989867.description: Complete Heroic strikes during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV head armor.
4075989867.description_zh: 第3赛季期间完成英雄打击可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV头部护甲上解锁。

3654718868.name: Steadfast Warlock Ornament
3654718868.description: Defeat enemies in strikes during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV leg armor.
3654718868.description_zh: 第3赛季期间在打击中消灭敌人可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV腿部护甲上解锁。

1249968539.description_zh: 此武器升级为大师杰作后将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

3732232161.description: Aiming this weapon without firing for a brief moment grants bonus range and precision damage while it remains zoomed.
3732232161.description_zh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可使瞄准状态下射程和精准伤害提高。

747033132.name: Upgrade Masterwork
747033132.description: Defeat enemies using Coldheart to unlock this upgrade.
747033132.description_zh: 使用寒冰核心消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

747033133.name: Upgrade Masterwork
747033133.description: Defeat groups of 4 or more enemies using Sweet Business to unlock this upgrade.
747033133.description_zh: 使用糖果生意消灭4名或4名以上的成组敌人可解锁此升级。

1902452687.name: Upgrade Masterwork
1902452687.description: Defeat enemies using Merciless to unlock this upgrade.
1902452687.description_zh: 使用冷酷无情消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

1344619701.name: Upgrade Masterwork
1344619701.description: Defeat enemies and complete bounties to unlock this upgrade.
1344619701.description_zh: 消灭敌人并完成悬赏可解锁此升级。

1344619700.name: Upgrade Masterwork
1344619700.description: Defeat enemies using the Prospector to unlock this upgrade.
1344619700.description_zh: 使用勘探者击败敌人以解锁此升级。

223776601.name: Upgrade Masterwork
223776601.description: With both Sturm and Drang equipped, defeat enemies to unlock this upgrade.
223776601.description_zh: 在同时装备狂飙和突进的情况下，消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

223776600.name: Upgrade Masterwork
223776600.description: Defeat enemies using Sunshot and its Sun Blast capability to unlock this upgrade.
223776600.description_zh: 使用烈日弹丸和它的烈日爆炸能力消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

3547298846.name: Upgrade Masterwork
3547298846.description: Defeat Crucible enemies with Vigilance Wing and earn Blood for Blood medals by avenging fallen teammates to unlock this upgrade.
3547298846.description_zh: 使用警惕羽翼消灭敌人并通过为阵亡队友复仇获得血债血偿来解锁此升级。

3547298847.name: Upgrade Masterwork
3547298847.description: Defeat enemies using Graviton Lance and its Cosmology capability to unlock this upgrade.
3547298847.description_zh: 使用引力子长枪和它的宇宙奥秘能力消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

2533771627.name: Upgrade Masterwork

2533771627.description_zh: 使用沃德克里夫线圈消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

400177089.name: Upgrade Masterwork

400177089.description_zh: 使用焚天者誓约消灭卡巴尔敌人可解锁此升级。

2079505484.name: Upgrade Masterwork

2079505484.description_zh: 使用牵引器火炮消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

2079505485.name: Upgrade Masterwork

2079505485.description_zh: 使用阿克瑞斯传说敌人可解锁此升级。

3546470356.name: Upgrade Masterwork
3546470356.description:
Defeat targets while using Rat King to unlock this upgrade.

PvE final blows by fireteam members using Rat King provide bonus progress.
3546470356.description_zh:
使用鼠王击败目标以解锁此升级。

火力战队成员使用鼠王完成PvE最后一击可提供额外进度。

3115221584.name: Upgrade Masterwork

3115221584.description_zh: 使用北极光消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

3115221585.name: Upgrade Masterwork

3115221585.description_zh: 使用D.A.R.C.I.精准消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

3969043896.name: Upgrade Masterwork

3969043896.description_zh: 使用赴险者和它的超导体连锁闪电消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

682783191.name: Upgrade Masterwork

682783191.description_zh: 使用严苛光芒击败敌人以解锁此升级。

2162261876.description_zh: 使用米达多功能的精准伤害消灭熔炉竞技场敌人可解锁此升级。

1835787579.description_zh: 用土卫十三消灭战斗人员。

959098413.description_zh: 使用玉兔消灭熔炉竞技场敌人可解锁此升级。

178451227.description_zh: 使用极星长枪击败战斗人员以解锁此升级。

837509459.name: Upgrade Masterwork

837509459.description_zh: 使用越橘消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

388458229.name: Upgrade Masterwork
388458229.description_zh: 用零号世界线消灭战斗人员。
