640411453.description_zh: 使用SUROS政权击败熔炉竞技场对手以解锁此升级。

3386680334.name: Upgrade Masterwork
3386680334.description_zh: 用睡者之吼消灭战斗人员。

1277486053.name: Upgrade Masterwork
1277486053.description: Defeat targets with Whisper of the Worm.
1277486053.description_zh: 使用蠕虫低语打败目标。

1000724343.name: The Perfect Fifth
1000724343.description: Precision hits return ammo to the mag. Landing 4 precision hits loads a delayed Solar explosive round that scorches targets for your next shot.
1000724343.description_zh: 精准命中可向弹匣返还弹药。完成4次精准命中可为你的下一次射击填装一枚可以灼烧目标的延时烈日高爆弹药。

630329983.name: Ride the Bull
630329983.description: Increases rate of fire and recoil while you're holding down the trigger. Final blows dealt with this weapon reload the magazine.
630329983.description_zh: 扣住扳机可提高射速但会增加后坐力。使用此武器造成最后一击可填装弹匣。

3642491337.name: Tesseract
3642491337.description: [Heavy Attack]  : Use while sprinting with full energy to launch a heavy blink attack. Defeating a target with this attack allows it to be immediately used again.
3642491337.description_zh: [重攻击]  ：在满能量冲刺时使用，以发出闪烁重击。使用此攻击击败目标后可立即再次使用。

944506345.name: SUROS Legacy
944506345.description: The bottom half of each magazine deals bonus damage and has a chance to return health on kill.
944506345.description_zh: 每只弹匣剩余一半的弹药可造成额外伤害，并有几率在完成击杀时返还生命值。

3884127242.name: Dornröschen
3884127242.description: The weapon's laser overpenetrates enemies and refracts off hard surfaces.
3884127242.description_zh: 武器发射的激光可穿透敌人，遇到坚硬表面可产生折射。

281315705.name: White Nail
281315705.description: Higher base precision damage. Rapidly landing three precision hits will refill the magazine.
281315705.description_zh: 更高的基础精准伤害。快速完成三次精准命中可重新填装弹匣。

4285971293.name: White Nail II

4285971293.description_zh: 更高的基础精准伤害。快速完成三次精准命中可重新填装弹匣。

4285971292.description_zh: 更高的基础精准伤害。快速完成三次精准命中可重新填装弹匣。

4285971291.name: White Nail IV
4285971291.description: Higher base precision damage. Rapidly landing three precision hits will refill the magazine.
4285971291.description_zh: 更高的基础精准伤害。快速完成三次精准命中可重新填装弹匣。

1378047685.name: Spinning Up
1378047685.description: Holding down the trigger increases rate of fire. Final blows while spun up grant bonus Special ammo progress.  [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Dual Speed Receiver.
1378047685.description_zh: 按住扳机可提升射速。旋转加速期间造成最后一击可提供特殊弹药进度加成。按下[替换武器动作] 切换至双重速率接收器。

3337692349.name: Mulligan
3337692349.description: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
3337692349.description_zh: 子弹未命中时有几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

4012962526.name: Dual Speed Receiver
4012962526.description: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
4012962526.description_zh: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

3794558792.name: Aggressive Frame
3794558792.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

2101490074.name: Aggressive Frame
2101490074.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

1739861752.name: Aggressive Frame
1739861752.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

1748364716.name: Aggressive Frame
1748364716.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

2551157718.name: Box Breathing
2551157718.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
2551157718.description_zh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可提高在射击或退出瞄准后重置的射程和精准伤害。

23371658.name: Box Breathing
23371658.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
23371658.description_zh: 在更短的一小段时间内瞄准此武器而不射击可提高射程和精准伤害，射击或退出瞄准后重置。

2846385770.name: Rangefinder
2846385770.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
2846385770.description_zh: 使用这款武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

509594246.name: Rangefinder
509594246.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
509594246.description_zh: 使用此武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率，并改善操控性。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

3047969693.name: Desperado
3047969693.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.
3047969693.description_zh: 造成精准最后一击或快速击败目标后进行填装可提升你的射速。

624891305.name: Desperado
624891305.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire for an improved duration.
624891305.description_zh: 造成精准最后一击或快速击败目标后进行填装可提升你的射速，持续时间延长。

806159697.name: Trench Barrel
806159697.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
806159697.description_zh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度会提高。

3871884143.name: Disruption Break
3871884143.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.
3871884143.description_zh: 使用武器破坏敌人的护盾，使他们在一小段时间内对动能伤害的承受力更低。

1206702241.name: Genesis Rounds
1206702241.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.
1206702241.description_zh: 使用武器打破战斗护盾可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。若能量武器与战斗护盾伤害类型吻合，击中目标时可重生弹药。

3721627275.name: Swap Mag
3721627275.description: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
3721627275.description_zh: 提高此武器的准备和收起速度。

714384243.name: Swap Mag
714384243.description: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
714384243.description_zh: 提高此武器的准备和收起速度。

1140096971.name: Seraph Rounds
1140096971.description:
Rounds overpenetrate targets and bounce off hard surfaces.
• Slightly increases range
• Increases stability
1140096971.description_zh:
弹药可穿透目标，接触坚硬表面可反弹。
• 略微增加射程
• 提高稳定性

463405747.name: Seraph Rounds
463405747.description:
Rounds overpenetrate targets and bounce off hard surfaces.

• Increases stability

• 提高稳定性

777589559.name: Field Prep
777589559.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
777589559.description_zh: 增加弹药储备量。蹲伏时填装、收举和准备速度提高。

777589556.name: No Distractions
777589556.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.
777589556.description_zh: 使用这款武器瞄准可在短时间内减少抖动。

777589557.name: Enlightened Action
777589557.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.
777589557.description_zh: 造成伤害可提升填装速度与操控性。

3556728490.name: Dread from Below
3556728490.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Telesto. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
3556728490.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变土卫十三的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

4288562036.name: Heaven's Vigil
4288562036.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Vigilance Wing. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
4288562036.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变警惕羽翼的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3686084858.name: Quark Star

3686084858.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变烈日弹丸的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2036459008.name: The Bray Legacy

2036459008.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变极星长枪的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2775242452.name: The Devil's Work

2775242452.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变越橘的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2425317590.name: Positive Infinity

2425317590.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变零号世界线的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2409312095.name: Hypnopompic
2409312095.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Sleeper Simulant. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
2409312095.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变睡者之吼的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

4280582304.name: Coup de Main

4280582304.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变SUROS政权的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3436915924.name: Lupus Visage

3436915924.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变战狮的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2516883975.name: Glory and Grandeur
2516883975.description: Earn this ornament by reaching Glory Rank "Legend." Equip it to change the appearance of Redrix's Claymore. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
2516883975.description_zh: 可通过达到荣耀等级“传说”来获得此皮肤。装备此皮肤以改变莱德瑞克斯斩剑的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。
2516883975.source: Source: Reach Glory Rank "Legend" in the Crucible.
2516883975.source_zh: 来源：在熔炉竞技场中达到荣耀等级“传说”。

2038017661.name: Blowing a Kiss

1897536429.name: Slow Clap
1897536429.flavor: Great. Just great. That was really, really great.

874877120.name: Watch Your Back

3389746221.name: Cower

48790291.name: Nope

1229016681.name: Zeus-Like Physique

3210179545.name: Victory Taunt

Once you pledge to a faction during this Faction Rally, you can no longer use the other two factions' emotes until this Rally ends.

2733199859.name: Odder Dance

799898425.name: Overnight Dance

2381763476.name: Disco Dance

2764644855.name: Flaunting Dance

265428940.name: Funky Dance
265428940.flavor: It's raid night, and we've got this fight.

1711459689.name: Dancehall
1711459689.flavor: When your space needs some dance in it…

930064526.name: Bureaucratic Walk

1449701838.name: Dancy Dance
1449701838.flavor: Sometimes you've got to dance like nobody's watching.

253898492.name: Salute of the Lords
253898492.flavor: "Beneath the branches of our iron tree we reminisce and sing dirges for the lost." —Lady Skorri

3179188489.name: Curtain Call
3179188489.flavor: Thank you, thank you! Oh, thank you!

530754878.name: Luxurious Toast
530754878.flavor: Life's good when you make friends.

569940092.name: Fireworks
569940092.flavor: Guardians don't need to ignite their Light to shine.

870041067.name: Popcorn

3494199208.name: Giving
3494199208.flavor: You didn't think I'd forget, did you?

1311389413.name: Worm God Incarnation

1311389413.description_zh: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更有格调。

1311389414.description_zh: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更有格调。

2224144604.name: Hellas Basin Cache Detector
2224144604.name_zh: 赫拉斯盆地缓存箱探测器

2224144604.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

1586768444.name: Improved Hellas Basin Cache Detector
1586768444.name_zh: 增强版赫拉斯盆地缓存箱探测器

1586768444.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

819844944.name: Hellas Basin Combo Detector
819844944.name_zh: 赫拉斯盆地缓存箱综合探测器

819844944.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

281656579.name: Hellas Basin Glimmer Scavenger
281656579.name_zh: 赫拉斯盆地微光回收利用
281656579.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Hellas Basin.
281656579.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地的微光获取量提升10%。

183999083.name: Hellas Basin Scanner
183999083.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Hellas Basin.
183999083.description_zh: 有机会在赫拉斯盆地中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

30834361.name: Hellas Basin Resource Detector
30834361.name_zh: 赫拉斯盆地资源探测器

30834361.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的资源。

3900721702.name: Hellas Basin Experience Log

3900721702.description_zh: 在赫拉斯盆地中获取10%的额外经验值。

3146477522.name: EDZ Engram
3146477522.description: Contains a reward for your efforts within the European Dead Zone.
3146477522.description_zh: 内含一份对你在欧洲无人区中所做努力的奖励。

2189764947.name: Gunsmith Engram
2189764947.description: Contains a reward for your efforts assisting the Gunsmiths.
2189764947.description_zh: 内含一份对你在协助枪匠时所做努力的奖励。

914894006.name: Legendary Engram
914894006.description: An engram with complex markers. A Cryptarch should be able to decode this into a piece of powerful equipment.
914894006.description_zh: 有着复杂标记的记忆水晶。解密大师可将它解码成一件强大的装备。

379434727.name: Nessus Engram
379434727.description: Contains a reward for your efforts in the Arcadian Valley of Nessus.
379434727.description_zh: 内含一份对你在涅索斯阿卡狄亚谷中所做努力的奖励。

134357953.name: Imperial Engram
134357953.description: Contains a reward for your efforts within Emperor Calus's Leviathan.
134357953.description_zh: 内含一份对你在卡鲁斯大帝的利维坦中所做努力的奖励。

3780056901.name: Warmind Engram
3780056901.description: An engram containing items crafted by Rasputin.
3780056901.description_zh: 内含由拉斯普廷所制物品的记忆水晶。

3784800263.name: Vanguard Tactician Engram
3784800263.description: Contains a reward for your efforts aiding Zavala in eliminating prime targets.
3784800263.description_zh: 内含一份对你在协助萨瓦拉消灭我们的首要目标时所做努力的奖励。

3565864927.name: Prototype Engram
3565864927.description: A vibrant engram containing many different Season 3 customization options—including ornaments for Exotics found in Warmind. Return it to Tess to reveal its contents.
3565864927.description_zh: 一个包含许多不同第3赛季自定义选项的光芒四射的记忆水晶——可能包含《战争思维》中发现的异域物品的皮肤。将它带回泰斯那里以取出其中的宝物。
3565864927.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

72250566.name: Prototype Engram
72250566.description: A vibrant engram containing many different Season 3 customization options—including ornaments for Exotics found in Warmind. Return it to Tess to reveal its contents.
72250566.description_zh: 一个包含许多不同第3赛季自定义选项的光芒四射的记忆水晶——可能包含《战争思维》中发现的异域物品的皮肤。将它带回泰斯那里以取出其中的宝物。
72250566.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

3002413497.name: Discovery Bundle
3002413497.description:
A bundle for Guardians whose eyes are on the stars.

Contains Season 3 shaders, Bright Engrams, and 500 Bright Dust.
3002413497.description_zh:
为凝望星辰的守护者准备的包裹。

内含第3赛季着色器、光明记忆水晶和500份光尘。

3002413496.name: Sleeper's Bundle
3002413496.description: Lull your enemies to sleep as they burn to a crisp—and do it in style, with this stunning weapon ornament for Sleeper Simulant.
3002413496.description_zh: 引诱敌人沉沉睡去，趁机将他们焚烧殆尽——有这件睡者之吼专属武器皮肤在手，你的英姿将纵横战场。

3002413499.name: Deep Freeze Bundle
3002413499.description:
A bundle for Guardians who want to survive the ice caps of Mars.

Contains the Azure Azazyel Sparrow, a transmat effect, and 10 shaders.
3002413499.description_zh:
为想在火星极冠生存下去的守护者准备的包裹。

内含蓝色的阿撒耶勒快雀、一个传送效果和10个着色器。

3002413498.name: BrayTech Bundle
3002413498.description:
A bundle for Guardians who want to evoke the heights of the Golden Age.

Contains a Legendary jumpship, a Legendary Sparrow, a Legendary Ghost Shell, and 10 Clovis Bray shaders.
3002413498.description_zh:
为意在唤起黄金时代巅峰的守护者准备的包裹。

内含一艘传说跃迁飞船、一辆传说快雀、一个传说机灵机壳和10个克洛维斯·布瑞着色器。

3002413501.name: Destructive Research Bundle
3002413501.description:
A bundle for Guardians who've bonded with a returning legend.

Contains a weapon ornament for Polaris Lance, 3 Gleaming Boons of the Vanguard, and 3 Fireteam Medallions.
3002413501.description_zh:
为与回归传奇缔结羁绊的守护者准备的包裹。

内含一件极星长枪专属武器皮肤、3份闪亮先锋福利和3枚火力战队大勋章。

3002413500.name: Boons of Bray Bundle
3002413500.description:
A bundle for Guardians who embrace the new way of things.

Contains 3 Bright Engrams and 1 Gleaming Boon of the Vanguard.
3002413500.description_zh:
为拥抱万物新貌的守护者准备的包裹。

内含3个光明记忆水晶和一份闪亮先锋福利。

3002413503.name: Iron Emote Bundle

386046805.name: Stark Baffler
386046805.lore:
Seyphine Delrig, Captain

I'll tell you the strangest thing we ever saw. This was in my first year commanding the ship. We had to race to a battle just at the edge of the Reef. And of course the Reef itself is made up of an almost impossibly large sort of "coral," the amassing of countless Golden Age ships. Anyway, we were in the middle of battle when I saw the letter I spelled out by a bunch of ships. At first I wasn't even sure it was on purpose. But when the battle was over, we kept our cameras trained on this one set of ships as we traveled just so they remained together in our view. And soon we saw that there were more letters, miles long. An H before the I. And soon the rest: the words TELL THEM WE SAID HI. Spelled out in dead ships, arranged just so that you could only see them from the right angle. It's just so… odd. And obviously human. And whoever did it had a sense of humor. But we never did learn who.
386046805.lore_zh:
船长塞拉芬·戴瑞格

我要告诉你我们见过的最奇怪的事。那还是我指挥飞船的第一年。我们需要赶往暗礁边缘的一场战斗。暗礁本身是一块令人称奇的大“珊瑚”，散布着无数黄金时代的飞船。不管怎样吧，那场战斗过程中，我看到由一堆船只组成的字母。一开始我甚至不确定是不是有人故意为之。但战斗结束后，我们将船上所有镜头穿在一起，以便它们在航行过程中可以保持在我们的视线范围内。然后我们就看到了更多字母，好几公里长。H在I前。余下的，是一些字：写着“告诉他们我们说大家好”。能从报废的飞船中拼出一句话，而且这是之前安排好的，因为只有从正确的角度才可以读出这句话。这件事实在是……太古怪了。而且明显是人类干的。这人还挺有幽默感。但我们从未发现他是谁。

806017499.name: Zavala's Authority
806017499.flavor: When it moves, it's a ribbon of violet moonlight.

806017499.lore:
Zavala: The problem with Rasputin is that it's a machine.

Cayde-6: You know, I'm standing right here.

Z: There's a difference between a trigger-happy Exo and artificial intelligence. Rasputin is satisfied. Complete. It regards itself as the pinnacle of creation. It doesn't want to be equal, or stand around a table and banter. It wants to be better, and we've programmed it to get what it wants. That's the nature of the machine.

C6: Of THAT machine.

Z: The problem with Rasputin is that we made it what it is, we modeled it, and it learned well.

C6: So you don't trust machines, but *I'm* OK 'cause I'm one of the good ones. That's not very generous, boss.

Z: I don't remember saying that you were OK.

C6: …

Z: What?

C6: IKORA! ZAVALA MADE A JOKE! You're not Ikora. Where's Ikora? IKORA!
806017499.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉：拉斯普廷的问题在于它是个机器。

凯德6号：嘿，我不也是站在这里嘛。

萨：好战的Exo和人工智能是不一样的。拉斯普廷感到满意，完整。它将自己视为创造的巅峰。它不需要平等，或是站在桌旁说笑。它需要的是变强，而得到它想要的是由我们为它制定的。那才是机器的本性。

凯6：那个机器的本性。

萨：拉斯普廷的麻烦在于是我们造就了它，我们塑造了它，而它本身也学得很好。

凯6：你不相信机器，但相信“我”，因为我是好的那部分。这说起来不太好啊，大佬。

萨：我不记得我说过你“好”啊。

凯6：……

萨：怎么了？

凯6：艾可拉！萨瓦拉开了一个玩笑！你不是艾可拉。艾可拉呢？艾可拉！

1748147690.name: Lost Legend
1748147690.lore:
[TIMESTAMP REDACTED]
I swear, this ship is going to kill me. Not because it's unsafe, mind you. But let's just say flying around in a restored Golden Age relic tends to attract a certain… criminal element.
I'm currently in the [redacted] system looking for some replacement ion rotors. I parked her behind some dunes and went to the shipwright, but when I got back a group of sneaky Exos had nearly taken her apart! I tried to be diplomatic, but before I knew it one of those [redacted] boltheads drew on me. Let's just say he won't be putting together any fine machinery for a while.
I managed to reassemble everything in under [redacted] hours; I've gotten to know her guts pretty well. Maybe I'm crazy, but when I work on the ship I feel… something familiar. Something safe.
The old girl's a pain, but she's worth it.
1748147690.lore_zh:
[时间戳已删]
我发誓，这艘飞船想要我的命。不过听好，这并不是因为它不安全。但是，绕着一件修复好的黄金时代圣物飞行是很容易吸引某种……犯罪活动。
我目前在[已删]系寻找离子旋翼替代品。我把她停到沙丘后面，接着就去找船匠了，但在我返回时却发现一群狡猾的Exo几乎已经把她拆得四分五裂。我想跟他们理论一番，但其中一个[已删]螺栓脑袋突然对我亮出武器。应该说那家伙会有好一阵子没法儿摆弄任何精美机器了吧。
我在[已删]小时内将所有零件重新组装完毕；我对她的构造可是了如指掌。也许我疯了，但当我组装这艘飞船时，我感觉到……某种熟悉的东西。某种安全感。
老姑娘是个负担，但她有这个资格。

1748147691.name: Shadow Trespass
1748147691.lore:
From the journals of Beatrix Danai, Pilot

Elsie Bray designed this ship—she was even at the naming ceremony. I wasn't the pilot of the ship back then. Back then there wasn't even a war to worry about. That was the Golden Age, and it's as if all anybody ever did was improve themselves, expand knowledge, build amazing machines, and eat lotus or whatever you do in endless paradise.

But I'll tell you what, those dark panels? Those avoid detection by other ships' sensors. Which kind of makes you wonder, why did she design something so great for war in a time of peace? Maybe for some people, perfection in the Golden Age meant developing something like perfect vision of just what could become of Humankind. Not all of it would be pretty.
1748147691.lore_zh:
来自驾驶员比阿特丽克斯·达娜伊的日记

这艘飞船是由艾尔西·布瑞设计的——甚至在命名仪式上都出现了她的身影。那时我还未成为一名飞船的驾驶员。那时甚至不存在战争的威胁。那是一个黄金时代，就好像每个人做的每件事都是在提升自我、充实知识、创造帅气的机器，以及在那无尽的天堂中服下忘忧果。

但我来告诉你，关于那些暗色翼片的事。它们无法被其他飞船传感器的检测。你想问什么，为什么她会在如此和平的年代设计出这些会在战争中占据优势的东西吗？或许是为了防备某些人吧。完美的黄金时代同时意味着需要对人性做出完美的预判。人性并非那么美好。

1748147688.name: Holborn's Splint
1748147688.flavor: This craft saw some strange action on Phobos, both planned and… otherwise.
1748147688.lore:
No! Wait, wait. You guys are just talking about what you can do with a ship that's WORKING. Lemme tell you something. You remember the early missions on Phobos? Okay, picture this— here, gimme that bottle. This bottle is the ship. So we'd taken damage—yes, the sunflower seeds, that's damage—and so we're entering the atmosphere and we're gonna have to touch down for repairs.

But here's the thing: the weapons systems are toast. Fine. Happens. So we're headed for the surface when we pick up this Cabal Troop Carrier coming down RIGHT behind us —this bottle can be the carrier—which doesn't have the most powerful weapons but, you know, it definitely can blow us out of the atmosphere. Plus forget putting down! So, Holborn's on the horn with us and he gives us this idea, really he ORDERS us: he guides the engineers through ripping out our Distant Early Warning array so we can turn the listening mics into a broadcaster, and we cripple all the energy grounding in the array. Then we're like, what do we do with this? And he has us just dump it out the back with a timer we got from the galley. It goes off under the carrier and—wham. Sends them into the ground.

He had us build an EMP device. In five minutes.

—Jonas McConnaugh, Navigator
1748147688.lore_zh:
不！停一停，停一停。你们只是在讨论当飞船正常的时候能做什么。听我说，你们还记得在火卫一上的早期任务吗？是的，情景是这样的——来，把那个瓶子递给我。假设这个瓶子是艘飞船。然后我们来让飞船受损——对，葵花籽就是损毁处——接着我们进入大气层，我们必须要降落对船体进行维修。

但问题是：武器系统烧毁了。是的，烧毁了。那么当我们降落在地表时，卡巴尔士兵的运输飞船也会跟着我们降落——这个瓶子就当做运输飞船——虽然它并未装备火力最强的武器，但是你也知道，它还是能将我们炸出大气层。而且根本忘记要降落！这时霍尔本在喇叭上和我们通话说他有个主意，他真是这么命令我们的：他指导工程师们将我们从远程预警序列中剥离，这样我们就能将收听话筒变为广播。我们将序列上的所有接地能量都关闭了。当时我们想的都是，这到底有什么用？他让我们把它连着厨房里找到的定时器一起扔出去。它在运输飞船底爆炸了——嘭。他们全部掉落在地面。

他给我们做了个电磁脉冲设备，在短短五分钟的时间里。

——领航员乔纳斯·麦康瑙希

777818278.lore:
I'd forgotten what this place looks like. It feels like only yesterday I had a badge and a desk. Not a lot survived, but somehow this old thing is still around. If you've come this far, we have a lot in common. You feel that same drive to see something through to the end, don't you? 

I've never been the sentimental type, but at this point I'm a stranger to my own nature. It just feels right that I'm back, for now. By the time you read this, we'll have just missed each other. I've run the simulations, and I can't stay. Not yet. 

Take care of her for me.
777818278.lore_zh:
我都忘记这个地方长什么样子了。我拥有徽章和桌位的景象仿佛还是昨日。留存下的东西不多，但不知为何这件旧物仍在。如果你能读到这里，说明我们是有共同点的。你同样有想要将事物一看到底的动力，不是吗？

我从不是容易伤感的人，但现在我对自己感到陌生。我觉得自己暂时又活过来了。就在你读这条信息的时候，我们将互相思念。模拟已开始，我要走了。还没说完。

帮我照顾好她。

777818276.name: Vespulaser
777818276.lore:
Central Library A/V

Student: Mr. Canton?

(Former) Lt. Max Canton: Shoot.

S: I'm looking for material on Io. Something different.

MC: Oh! I'll tell you something about Io. No, really. You won't find this anywhere. I remember once my partner and I were lost for a week straight in a canyon on Io—we weren't eying one another like turkey legs or anything, but it was close. We were running out of rations. Then we saw Vespulaser come in and disappear over the canyon walls. We knew it by those stripes, they make it look like some kind of dangerous insect. We knew it would be hours of climbing, but we hurried toward it immediately. Look it up.

S: Vespulaser?

MC: Vespulaser.
777818276.lore_zh:
中央图书馆音频/视频

学生：康顿先生？

（前）讲师麦克斯·康顿：讲。

学生：我正在木卫一上寻找材料。找到些不一样的东西。

麦·康：哦！我正准备告诉你木卫一的事情。嗯，真的真的。别的地方你找不到的。我记得有一次我和我的同伴在木卫一的一个峡谷中连续迷路了一周——我们还没饿到把对方看做火鸡腿还是什么的，不过也差不多了。我们的补给都快没了。这时我们看到黄胡蜂飞了进来然后沿着峡谷的岩壁消失。我们是从那些条纹认出它来的，条纹是为了让自己看起来像某种危险的昆虫。我们知道需要攀岩数小时，但我们还是立即就冲上去了。找找它。

学生：黄胡蜂吗？

麦·康：对，黄胡蜂。

777818274.name: Azure Azazyel
777818274.flavor: Primarily used on the ice caps of Mars during the Golden Age.
777818274.lore: We treated the ship like its name, like one of the Guardians of old. But I swear to you that Sparrows have personalities, even spirits. I know that sounds crazy, but I believe that. AA's name was cold, and the Sparrow was cold. You couldn't warm it up. But boy it could fly.
777818274.lore_zh: 我们像对待它的名字一样，像对待一名年迈守护者一样对待这辆快雀。但我向你保证快雀是有性格的，它们甚至有灵魂。我知道这听起来很疯狂，但我相信。阿撒耶勒这个名字很古老，快雀本身很冰冷。你无法热启动，但这家伙依旧能飞。

1173626681.flavor: There is always a player on the nightside, unseen and perfect—and patient.

1173626681.lore:
Kanata Tektono

Do you know what the player on the other side meant? It was an idea that people talked about long ago, before the Golden Age. And the idea was that each of us has a player on the other side—a perfect enemy, just as powerful, just as smart, just as experienced. And that perfect enemy was waiting for each of us, waiting patiently, because the day of meeting would come in time. The other-side enemy didn't have to rush it. Sheer time and chance would bring you together.

Think of that. Right now, someone out there is waiting for you, and they know you so well they practically are you. That's the player on the other side.
1173626681.lore_zh:
坎纳塔·泰克托诺

你知道彼端的存在者是什么意思吗？这是一个在黄金时代前人们就讨论了很久的想法：我们每个人都有一位彼端的存在者——一个完美敌人，一样的强大，一样的聪明，一样的阅历。而那个完美敌人正等待着我们每个人，等得如此耐心，因为相见的那天终会如期而至。彼端的敌人并不仓促。时间和机遇会单纯地将你们指引到一起。

想象一下。就是现在，有人在那里正等待着你，他们那么了解你，他们实际上就是你。那就是彼端的存在者。

4222882592.name: G-335 Anseris Overdrive
4222882592.flavor: A lost artifact of the Golden Age.
4222882592.lore:
I was thirteen when I built my first Sparrow. I don't even remember why I wanted to, only that I could not bear to stop until I completed it. The way individual parts perform independent actions to cause reactions within a complex system is like hearing a beautiful symphony come alive.

Like pieces of a machine, we all have a role to play in the coming calamity. If you ever feel lost or alone or hopeless, remember that you are a part of something greater.

I've always used science to create art, whereas Ana applied art to science. I couldn't have finished that Sparrow without my sister's help. The original prototype is long gone, but I've held on to one of the final models. It won't be of much use to me where I'm going, so I leave it to you.
4222882592.lore_zh:
我组造自己第一艘快雀的时候只有十三岁。我甚至不记得我为什么想要这么做，我只是无法在未完成前停下来。看到个体零件在复杂系统中的独立运行就像是听到了一首现场演奏的美妙交响曲。

和机器部件相同，我们在即将来临的灾难中也扮演着各自的角色。如果你曾感到失去、孤独或无望，要记住你是更伟大存在中的一部分。

我总是用科学去创造艺术，而阿娜将艺术融入科学。没有我妹妹的帮助，我是无法完成那辆快雀的。最早的原型已不复存在，但我有最终几个模型中的一个。对于我要去的地方它起不了什么作用，我就把它留给你吧。

3867275449.name: The Right Choice
3867275449.flavor: "And… thanks. You know. For being my Guardian."
3867275449.lore:
The Light was gone.

He drifted in and out of… something, and saw a ship hanging from guidewires in a Cosmodrome warehouse. Fields of flowers amid alien canals, stretching to the horizon.

He realized he was muttering. "I have to find… my Guardian."

Where had he said that before? His own voice answered him. Confident, and in control. "We don't know what they look like. Not on the outside, anyway."

He was beneath a bridge now, somehow. Cabal searchlights lit the puddles on either side. He didn't want to look at what was under the surface.

"On the inside. I'd always known who you were." He blinked. He wished he could cry. "Together, we could be something… more." It started raining again.

Drift. A masked woman with black tears streaming down her face.

"Everything we've seen."

Drift. Red braids of nanotechnology around the throats of angry scavengers.

"Everything we've done."

The Cabal continued their grim work, and the last safe place on Earth cracked beneath their booted heels.

"I made the right choice."

Ghost opened his shell to cast back the darkness. He was alone.

And in the night beyond, the rain came down.
3867275449.lore_zh:
光能不再。

他在空中飘来飘去，看到发射基地仓库中导丝吊着的一艘飞船。外来运河中的花海，一直延伸至地平线。

他意识到自己一直在嘟囔。“我一定要找到……我的守护者。”

他在哪儿说过这话来着？自问自答，自信又理智。“我们不知道他们长什么样。至少不知道外在什么样。”

他现在差不多在一座桥下。卡巴尔的探照灯点亮了两边的水坑。他没有低头看，不想知道那水坑里面有什么。

“但说起内在，我一直都知道你是什么样的人。”他眨了眨眼。他希望自己能掉个一两滴眼泪。“我们一起，会成就一些……大事的。”雨点再次落了下来。

飘荡。蒙面的女人，脸上滑落黑色的泪水。

“我们所经历的。”

继续飘荡。愤怒拾荒者脖子上系有红色的纳米穗带。

“我们所完成的。”

卡巴尔继续着他们冷酷的工作，地球上最后一片安全的土地在他们的靴跟下撕裂。

“我都做出了正确的选择。”

机灵打开他的机壳，投下光芒消除黑暗。他形单影只。

那天的夜晚，大雨倾盆。

3403859120.flavor: Extinguish the stars. Devour the planets. Soar through a universe of utter dark.
3403859120.source: Source: An Exotic quest or challenge.
3403859120.lore:
"The demiurge of the Hive is the worm; the demiurge of the Vex is the thought; the demiurge of the Fallen is the Ether, which is survival; the demiurge of the Cabal is authority. These are the things, both constraint and power, which define the universe of possible actions. These are the rule makers and instruments which enforce reality.

Give a power to a Guardian and they shall know that power as a weapon, for when a Guardian chooses to alter the world, they do so with the bullet and the blade. Grant a Guardian godly power, and that Guardian shall fashion it into a perfect rifle. The demiurge of the Guardian is the gun.

But we must remember that the demiurge is not the god. It is only the thing that converts perfect divine will into imperfect material form. We may wield the demiurge; but if we do, what god wields us?" —Ulan-Tan
3403859120.lore_zh:
“邪魔族的造物主是虫；Vex的造物主是思想；堕落者的造物主是乙太，也就是生存；卡巴尔的造物主是权力。它们是这个宇宙的行为准则，既具有压迫性又充满能量。它们是规则的制定者，现实的执行者。

将能量赋予守护者，他们就会知晓，能量即武器。当他们选择改变世界，他们的工具是子弹和剑刃。将近乎于神的力量交给守护者，守护者会将其装饰成一把完美的枪械。守护者的造物主乃是枪械。

但我们需要铭记于心，造物主不是神。它只是将完美的神圣意志转变为不完美的物质形态。我们能利用造物主；但如果是这样，神又会如何利用我们？”——乌兰-坦

682682138.name: Estival Excursion
682682138.flavor: Returning home is never as fast as you want it to be.
682682138.lore:
The silence from the radio was deafening. Uncomfortable, Ghost outlined a figure-eight in the air.

"Why don't we… do an after-action report? The radios will come back on. I'm sure of it." Ghost cleared his throat.

"Report ALPHA SIX FOUR BLUE PHI. Visual inspection and scans at Mount Esja confirmed the debris came from the Reef." He paused.

"We attempted communication with Awoken allies. Signals to the Queen's Wrath, the Trials beacon, and even intel source GREENRAVEN went unanswered."

He sighed. "That likely attracted the enemy attention that followed. For the record, I'll take the blame—trying to call Petra was my idea."

"The site was under observation by remnants of the House of Winter. Unlike many of the Fallen we've seen lately, they bore the crests and colors from one of the original Eliksni factions. They were starving and desperate. But none of them tried to flee."

Ghost let the words hang in the air for a moment. "Returning to the Tower for a debrief."

They flew in silence for a long moment before Ghost activated the comms again—and despite the static, spoke into the void. "Tower Approach, this is City Hawk 7-2-3, please respond."
682682138.lore_zh:
无线电的静默却让人觉得震耳欲聋。机灵感到不舒服，在空中画了一个8。

“我们为什么不……为什么不做一个行动后报告呢？无线电会重新开通的。我保证。”机灵清了清嗓子。

“报告阿尔法六四蓝斐。通过在埃斯加山的目视检查和扫描，确认碎片来自暗礁。”他顿了下。

“我们尝试与同盟觉醒者取得联系。发往女王之怒、试炼信标，甚至是情报来源绿色渡鸦的信号均无回应。”

他叹了口气。“这很可能会引起敌人的注意和跟踪。作为记录，责任由我承担——尝试与佩特拉联系是我的主意。”

“此站点是由寒冬氏族的残余力量所监测的。与我们近来遇见的很多堕落者不太一样的是，他们身上的徽章和颜色是来自一个原始的埃里克斯尼阵营。他们饥饿而绝望，而且无人试图逃跑。”

机灵听到这话愣了一下。“即刻返回高塔进行汇报。”

长久沉默的飞行后，机灵重新启动了通讯——虽然是向虚空发送的静电。“高塔，圣城之鹰-723正在接近。请回复。”

4213271811.lore:
"Does that thing fly?"

"Why would you ask that?"

"I'm telling you it looks heavy."

"Don't be ridiculous. It's not heavy. You have triple-redundant shielding, sure, but that's because of the power under the hood. You put in an engine powerful enough, you can make a boulder fly. But this ain't no Boulder. You'll be zipping around the enemy so fast they'll wonder if you're even there. Try it. I'm telling you."
4213271811.lore_zh:
“那玩意儿能飞吗？”

“你怎么会这么问？”

“我说它看上去也太沉了吧。”

“别瞎说。一点儿不沉。确实，它带有三余度防护，但那是为了引擎盖下的动力系统。只要引擎够强，连大石头都能飞起来。况且这又不是大石头。你会在敌人周围飞得快到他们都搞不清你到底来没来过。试一下，不骗你。”

4213271810.name: Blacklight Razor
4213271810.flavor: Mounted with harmonized twin pulse engines for a blazing attack.
4213271810.lore:
Hey hey hey— 

Hoping this finds you well, buddy! I gotta say those twin cutters do exactly what you said they did, pulling against each other and whipping the Sparrow forward constantly. It's like being on a slingshot. The thing vibrates constantly, but you get used to it after a while.

Here's the coolest thing, though—a few days ago, I had to move off a cliff and dive down 11,000 feet, and the thing literally cut the clouds, leaving swirls of mist around me as I went. It was beautiful.

Tell the guys at the shop that I'm happy and to take care of my little brother. He may have some other ideas for you.

Sail on,
Rafael Rizz
4213271810.lore_zh:
嗨，嗨，嗨——

见信好啊，兄弟！我说这双刀和你讲得一模一样，相互摩擦又不时抽一抽前面的快雀，像个石弩一样。这玩意儿时不时会晃，但骑一会儿就习惯了。

最酷炫的事是——几天前，我不得不从悬崖上下来，极速下降了大概11,000英尺，这家伙真的能削掉云朵，在我经过的周围形成薄雾漩涡。那场景真美。

跟商店的人说我很开心，同时也要好好照顾我的小兄弟。他可能会给你些其他的灵感。

继续前行吧，
拉斐尔·里兹

4243004391.name: Comrades in Arms
4243004391.flavor: None of us can do it alone. And none of us should want to.
4243004391.lore:
In his head, the commentary was enthusiastic.

"Ren sideslips the burning tank and punches through the back wall!"

The racer redlined and the machine beneath him screamed in protest.

"The Cabal has the City on the brink but he's at the top of his game! He heads for Peregrine district at top speed. Can he make it?"

Damn right he'll make it. Just three more blo—

An explosion split the sky, and the Hunter distantly heard Didi screaming a warning as the bike disintegrated. A pile of debris rose to meet him.

His next memory: a pitted Cabal mask and the shouts of a Centurion. It had Marcus by the neck. His vision tunneled. Everything hurt. His leg was broken. "Been a good run for this racer, folks, but looks like…"

A shoulder charge took the monster off its feet, and Marcus dropped to the ground. He heard more than saw the brutal hand-to-hand battle that followed.

After, the other man dropped to a knee at his side. His shadow fell over Marcus.

No words, just a hand on his shoulder. Then a lightness. The Hunter felt himself borne up into the familiar arms of a Titan.

Enoch Bast strode away through the end of the world, carrying his partner to safety.
4243004391.lore_zh:
他的头脑中响起了热情洋溢的评论。

“伦侧滑过燃烧着的坦克，并从后墙穿了过去！”

赛雀手冲过了边界线，他身下的机器尖叫着抗议。

“卡巴尔位于圣城的边缘，但他已火力全开！他正全速向呼鹰台冲去。他能做到吗？”

当然他做得到，只要再来三次爆——

一次爆炸点亮了天际，猎人远远地听到迪迪在快雀解体前尖叫着提醒他。紧接着就看到眼前一堆碎片的飞起。

接下来的记忆只有眼前一个坑坑洼洼的卡巴尔面具和耳边百夫长的咆哮。它扼住了马库斯的喉咙。他的视线变得受限又模糊。身上没有不痛的地方，腿也断了。“朋友们，对这名赛雀手来说，这段路跑得不赖，但现在看起来……”

一个肩撞将怪物撞倒，马库斯也跌在了地上。但除了眼前的，他还听到了残酷肉搏的声音。

突然，一个男人单膝跪在他身旁，将马库斯环绕在了自己的巨大身影中。

他没有说话，只是将一只手放在了伦的肩上。伦双脚悬空。猎人觉得自己被一副熟悉的泰坦手臂抱起。

以诺·巴斯特来到了世界尽头，给同伴以安全。

2323170449.name: Destabilizers
2323170449.description: [Brake]  : Use while airborne to release roll stabilizers, and move [Movement] to roll.
2323170449.description_zh: [刹车]  ：在空中使用以松开翻滚稳定装置，使用[移动]进行翻滚。

1449897497.name: Sharp Edges
1449897497.description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.
1449897497.description_zh: 飞刀最后一击会减少超能的冷却时间。一轮齐射中被利刃弹幕飞刀命中最多的目标会释放一次剧烈的烈日爆炸，发射灼烧烈日碎片。使用利刃弹幕造成命中和最后一击将于超能结束后返还超能能量。

1449897496.name: Adamantine Brace
1449897496.description: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely. Gain a bonus to the Bow's damage when released, based on how long perfect draw was held. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Bows.
1449897496.description_zh: 弓箭可以不限时地完美拉弓。根据完美拉弓持续时间，箭矢在射出时会得到相应的伤害加成。中幅提高弓箭的空中效率属性。

2192678015.name: Double Dodge
2192678015.description: Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
2192678015.description_zh: 获得一次额外的闪身充能。在闪身后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

2192678014.name: Roving Assassin
2192678014.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.
2192678014.description_zh:
在你进入鬼灵利刃隐形状态前，你的每次命中或最后一击都会恢复更多的超能能量。

在靠近目标时离开隐形状态，会在你周围产生一团削弱烟雾。

4190535237.name: Ursine Guard
4190535237.description: Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
4190535237.description_zh: 使用哨兵圣盾或坚不可摧护盾防卫时移动速度更快。使用哨兵圣盾抵挡的伤害都会转化为超能能量，而使用坚不可摧抵挡的伤害都会转化为手雷能量。

699693452.name: Vengeance
699693452.description: Highlights the target who dares to damage you. Track down and destroy them for an overshield.
699693452.description_zh: 高亮胆敢对你造成伤害的目标。追踪并消灭他们以获得覆盖护盾。

1919923227.name: Overflowing Light
1919923227.description: Using an ability (grenade, melee, or Barricade) empowers the other two abilities. Empowered means abilities have faster regen, melees and grenades do more damage, and Barricades have more hit points.
1919923227.description_zh: 使用一个技能（手雷、近战或屏障）可为另外两个技能赋能。赋能意味着技能充能速度更快，近战和手雷可造成更多伤害，屏障可抵挡更多伤害。

242794439.name: Reflective Vents
242794439.description: While sliding with full class ability energy, you gain a frontal shield that reflects incoming damage. After reflecting damage, your class ability energy is depleted based on the amount of damage reflected.
242794439.description_zh: 拥有全部职业技能能量时滑行，你会获得一个正面护盾，来反弹受到的伤害。反弹伤害后，你的职业技能能量会根据反弹的伤害量有所消耗。

8507332.name: Chaotic Exchanger
8507332.description: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.
8507332.description_zh: 使用混沌加速为你的虚空手雷充能时，可抵挡受到的伤害。充能完毕的虚空手雷在命中及施加削弱时会返还手雷能量。

2204713148.name: Crystalline Transistor
2204713148.description:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.
2204713148.description_zh:
使用动能武器造成最后一击，会根据你已装备超能的元素产生爆炸，造成伤害并施加相应的元素效果：
•  致盲目标。
•  灼烧目标。
•  削弱目标。
•  减速目标。
•  割裂目标。
元素最后一击会提供临时性爆炸范围提升。精准最后一击直接达到最大爆炸范围。

2204713149.name: Battle-Hearth
2204713149.description: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.
2204713149.description_zh: 站在你的光焰之井中时完成击杀和助攻可返还超能能量。

1939153390.name: Close Enough
1939153390.description: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.
1939153390.description_zh: 使用混沌之触对目标造成伤害可延长它的持续时间。收集离子轨迹可提供混沌之触能量。接近电光充能最大层数时，冲刺会随时间提供层数。

3504197951.name: Unforeseen Repercussions
3504197951.description: This weapon's beam superheats its targets upon impact, causing delayed scorching explosions.
3504197951.description_zh: 武器的光束会使命中的目标过热，片刻之后引发灼烧爆炸。

1289604610.name: Spread Shot Package
1289604610.description: Aiming this weapon reduces the spread of its projectiles.
1289604610.description_zh: 瞄准可降低弹药的散射。

2130042297.name: Taken Predator
2130042297.description: Bonus damage against Taken enemies and Gambit invaders.
2130042297.description_zh: 对傀儡敌人和智谋入侵者造成额外伤害。

1408087975.name: Marksman Sights
1408087975.description: Long-range sights with slower charge time and greater damage. Fires a single bolt that chains to nearby targets and blinds them on hit. Displays ammo and charge levels. Select this scope to spawn with it equipped by default.
1408087975.description_zh: 拥有远距离瞄具，充能时间变慢但可造成更多伤害。发射单发电光弹，连锁至附近目标，命中时施加致盲。显示弹药和充能阶段。选择此瞄准镜，它将在生成时作为默认装备自动配备。

1408087974.name: Combat Sights
1408087974.description: Low-zoom sights with faster charge time and handling. Fires a three-round burst that reduces charge time even further on sustained hits. Displays ability energy. Select this scope to spawn with it equipped by default.
1408087974.description_zh: 拥有低倍率瞄具，充能时间变快且操控性增强。进行三发点射，持续命中时进一步缩短充能时间。显示技能能量。选择此瞄准镜，它将在生成时作为默认装备自动配备。

2306441428.name: Supercharged Battery
2306441428.description: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.
2306441428.description_zh: 收集一颗能量球会在一段时间内给予最大能量，并进行自动填装。在此模式中持续开火可压制目标。

200829441.name: Lightning Rod
200829441.description: Precision kills grant the next shot chain-lightning capabilities.
200829441.description_zh: 精准击杀提供下次射击连锁闪电的能力。

299272945.name: Release the Wolves
299272945.description: When firing from the hip, this weapon shoots in full auto and damage and rate of fire are increased, but accuracy and range are decreased.
299272945.description_zh: 腰射时，此武器以全自动模式射击，提升伤害和射速，但降低精度和射程。

1658733671.name: The Roadborn
1658733671.description: Precision final blows and rapid precision hits briefly grant bonus handling, range, rate of fire, and precision damage with this weapon.
1658733671.description_zh: 精准最后一击和快速精准击杀会短暂提供武器额外的操控性、射程、射速和精准伤害。

777637181.name: Play with Your Prey
777637181.description: The Void rocket suppresses combatants. The Solar rocket scorches.
777637181.description_zh: 虚空火箭压制战斗人员。烈日火箭可造成灼烧。

1561789734.name: Firefly
1561789734.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.
1561789734.description_zh: 完成精准击杀可以提高填装速度并使目标爆炸，对附近的敌人造成烈日伤害。

1791592647.name: Explosive Shadow
1791592647.description: Shoot tainted slugs that burrow into combatants. Stacking enough slugs causes them all to explode, stunning surviving combatants. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
1791592647.description_zh: 发射一枚钻入战斗人员内部的污染弹头。叠加足够多的弹头引发爆炸，眩晕存活的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

3208839961.name: Four-Headed Dog
3208839961.description: Shoots erratic bullets from all gun barrels at the same time.
3208839961.description_zh: 从所有枪管中同时发射不稳定的子弹。

1657056865.name: Ahamkara's Eye
1657056865.description: Charging this weapon unleashes a giant continuous beam of death.
1657056865.description_zh: 充能武器时释放一道持续的巨型死亡光束。

647617635.name: Memento Mori
647617635.description: Reloading after a kill loads magazine with a few extra-damage bullets. Grants radar while aiming down sights.
647617635.description_zh: 击杀后填装会加入一些具有额外伤害的弹药。瞄准时启动雷达。

4072668471.name: Crow's Wings
4072668471.description: [Heavy Attack]  : Fire a Heavy projectile attack that suppresses targets. Hitting a target already suppressed spreads the effect to nearby targets.
4072668471.description_zh: [重攻击]  ：发射一枚重型射弹攻击，压制目标。命中已被压制的目标会将该效果扩散至附近目标。

1394384862.name: Precision Slug
1394384862.description_zh: 发射一枚单发精准弹药。

1531126198.name: Wire Rifle
1531126198.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between scopes and alter this weapon's firing behavior. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
1531126198.description_zh: 按下[替换武器动作] 来切换瞄准镜并改变此武器的射击性能。克制势不可挡勇士。

459441288.name: Harmonic Laser
459441288.description: Laser damage has three power levels that oscillate while the trigger is held down.
459441288.description_zh: 激光伤害有三层功率级，按下扳机后发生谐振。

1573888036.name: Split Electron
1573888036.description: Fires an arrow that splits when released. Aiming down sights and fully drawing the bow both decrease the spread.
1573888036.description_zh: 发射一支释放后会分裂的箭矢。瞄准和满弓均可减小扩散范围。

481338655.name: Shrapnel Launcher
481338655.description: Fires a powerful short-range burst of Solar damage.
481338655.description_zh: 发射一次威力强大的近距离冲击，造成烈日伤害。

1470121888.name: Queen's Wrath
1470121888.description: While aiming down sights with a fully drawn Bow, combatants behind walls are highlighted and arrows pierce shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
1470121888.description_zh: 当满弓瞄准时，高亮显示墙壁后的战斗人员，且弓箭可穿透护盾。克制屏障勇士。

3649430342.name: Twintails
3649430342.description: Shoots two rockets, one Void and one Solar, that can track onto the same target. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
3649430342.description_zh: 发射两枚可以跟踪同一个目标的火箭，一枚虚空一枚烈日。克制过载勇士。

2812729351.name: Masterwork Weapon
2812729351.description: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
2812729351.description_zh: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

460688467.name: Aeviternal XXII
460688467.flavor: A remarkably preserved Golden Age pattern recovered from the excavation in Hellas Basin.
460688467.lore:
"The designs are sound. Slipstream out past Jupiter and things get much smoother. It's easy sailing all the way to the Belt. Just mind your tailwind as you go over the cliff."

"That's right, we're on an approach vector to city 7. Tala, you wanna tell Kofi we're bringing in a batch of extra-system tholins fresh from Makemake?"

"No sweetie, daddy won't make your birthday. Well… I'm very far away right now. That's right. And what is it called? No sweetie, not porpoise. Orcus."

"Hey we've got… we've got signals coming back at us from the black. Is anyone getting this? We're transmitting from 12 degrees north of the ecliptic and at about 50 AU out. This isn't background radiation out here!"

"…just going to keep sailing. If I rig the pod just so, I should make it to Ross 128 b before the systems die. I can rally some ships and try to make it back. If you can hear this, stay strong. You are not alone! I will be…" 

—Fragmented data file from a collapsed comms tower near Alton Dynamo
460688467.lore_zh:
“设计很合理。飞过木星后，事情变得顺畅多了。很容易就可以一路飞到小行星带。只要注意在飞跃悬崖时你是顺风就好了。”

“那就对了，我们正在飞往城市-7的航线上。塔拉，你想要告诉寇飞我们正带着一组从鸟神星新鲜出炉的体制外托林吗？”

“当然不，亲爱的，大佬不会高兴的。嗯……我现在离得很远。没关系。它叫什么来着？不，亲爱的，不是鼠海豚。是奥伽斯。”

“嗨，我们……我们终于连上信号恢复通讯了。有人能收到这条消息吗？我们正由黄道以北12度进行传输，距离地面大约50个天文单位。这不是背景辐射！”

“……那就继续航行了。如果我操纵飞行仓，我应该可以在太阳系毁灭前抵达罗斯128b。我可以集结几艘飞船，把它带回来。如果你听见这条信息的话，坚持住。你不是一个人！我要……”

——来自奥尔顿散热区附近的一座倒塌的通讯塔中的数据片段文件

460688466.name: Death to Kells
460688466.flavor: What is a Kell to a Spider?
460688466.lore:
Avrok knew Kells.

He had never spoken to one—had never even been on the same battlefield as one—but as a twice-docked dreg of House Kings, oh, how he knew Kells.

Kells were stronger, faster, smarter. In other words: They had better resources. Ate better, slept safer, lived longer.

They were like Guardians in that way.

Avrok had had enough of both.

He stopped bringing all his salvage to his Captain. They didn't notice. And if they did, it's not like they could have cut his Ether rations any more without killing him. Nothing left to lose.

He built his ship piece by piece in a gully far away from prying eyes.

When the Awoken Prince arrived, he knew a distraction when he saw one. While the Kell mocked his newest prisoner, Avrok made his escape.

He flew his ship to the Tangled Shore.

Starving and weak, he stood before the one they called the Spider. Offered his ship as a sign of his good will. 

Spider rubbed his chin, an alien gesture. "What is it called, your ship?"

Avrok lifted his chin, looked Spider directly in the eyes. "Death to Kells."

Spider hired him on the spot.
460688466.lore_zh:
埃弗罗克知道凯尔。

他从未同他人讲过话——也从未单枪匹马地在战场上出现——而是作为一个两次投靠的国王氏族的堕落士兵，哦，他就是这么认识凯尔的。

凯尔更强壮、更迅速、更精明。换句话说：他们拥有更好的资源。吃得更好、睡得更安稳、活得更长。

这么看来他们挺像守护者的。

埃弗罗克受够了两者。

他不再将自己回收的物品交给他的队长。他们也没有注意到这件事。如果他们注意到了，不可能只是仅仅切断他的乙太供给，而是杀了他。毕竟没什么损失。

他在别人看不到的一个沟壑中一块一块地建造着自己的飞船。

当觉醒者王子抵达时，他看一眼便心痒痒。趁着凯尔嘲笑他的新囚犯时，埃弗罗克逃走了。

他开着飞船飞向了纷争海岸。

又饿又虚弱，他站在了那个被称作蛛王的人面前，将自己的飞船呈上表明诚意。

蛛王揉揉下巴，这是个异乎寻常的姿势。“你这船，叫什么？”

埃弗罗克抬起头，直视着蛛王的眼睛。“凯尔殒没。”

蛛王当场雇佣了他。

460688465.name: Unfinal Shapes
460688465.flavor: "Mine is not a final shape. She showed me that." –Eris Morn
460688465.lore:
Asher,

I took a slough of Hive chitin, and with my own hands, I bent it into the shape of a starship. I think you of all people might understand why. But it's more than just a reminder of the green flames behind my brow.

Asher, I saw a throne world built for the Light. Built with Darkness, of course, and the bitter logic of swords. But built for Light.

It made me wonder.

This will be my last letter for a long while. The Queen needs me more than the City does. And I need her. When she looks at me, she does not see an invalid, or a madwoman, or a burden.

She sees a Hunter.

She has pointed me at the true enemy, and with her help, I will see my quarry caught.

Clarity in action,
Eris Morn
460688465.lore_zh:
阿什，

我拿了块邪魔族蜕下的壳儿，而且我徒手把它扳成了一个星船的形状。我觉得众人之中的你或许能明白为什么。但它不仅仅是对我眉毛后面的绿色火焰的提醒。

阿什，我见到了一个为光能而建造的王座世界。用暗影建造那是当然的了，还有令人痛苦的邪剑守则。但却是为了光能建造的。

它令我感到迷惑。

这会是我很长一段时间内的最后一封信。女王比圣城更需要我。而我也需要她。当她看向我时，她不要看到一个病人、疯女人或是负担。

她要看到的是一名猎人。

她指出了我真正的敌人，有了她的帮助，我会见证我的猎物被捕食殆尽。

头脑清晰并已经行动的，
埃里斯·摩恩

460688464.name: The Tall Tale
460688464.flavor: "Every story is true if you tell it right." —Andal Brask
460688464.lore:
When I got to the City, Tallulah Fairwind was waiting for me at the gate.

"Ho, Andal Brask," she said with that big grin of hers. "Micah warned me about you."

I said, "Warned you? I was dead, then I floated here. All I've ever done in my entire life is barf into the Pacific Ocean."

Tallulah slapped my shoulder so hard I actually died right there. My Ghost had to rez me. I was so embarrassed.

When I came to, she was crouched next to me. "Well, then let's add to your story," she said without missing a beat, as if she hadn't just murdered me. "Starting with some wings. I hear there's a Devil around these parts stole a ship that sings like an angel. Might need some refurb, but we can get that in Ishtar. I know how to sweet-talk the Library. She likes it when you tell her about the Never-Be."

"I don't understand anything you're saying."

She slung an arm around my shoulder. "Buck up, little buddy. It's not like we're gonna tap a Vex gate. Not yet, anyway."

And you'll never believe what happened then…
460688464.lore_zh:
当我到达圣城时，塔鲁·和风正在大门口等着我。

“嚯，安达尔·布莱斯克，”她咧着嘴笑着说到。“米迦警告要我小心你。”

我说，“警告你？我死了，然后就是往这儿漂。我这辈子做的就只有在太平洋中狂吐。”

塔鲁使劲拍了拍我的肩膀，我当场归西。我的机灵不得不再次将我复活。这太尴尬了。

但我再醒来时，她蹲在我身边。“那么，我们来聊聊你的故事吧。”她连个停顿都没有，仿佛刚才干掉我的是别人一样。“先随便聊聊吧。我听说这周围有个恶魔偷走了艘哼鸣起来像天使一样的飞船。可能需要做些翻新，但我们可以在伊什塔中得到它。我知道怎么和管理员说好话。你只要跟她聊永远不要做的事她就会很开心。”

“我不懂你在讲什么。”

她搂着我的肩膀。“系好安全带，小兄弟。这可和我们敲敲Vex的门不一样。至少现在还不像。”

之后发生的事你是永远不会相信的……

523189763.name: Hecuba-S
523189763.flavor: "Function over flair… but a little flair never hurt anybody." —Hektor 99-40
523189763.lore:
Banshee-44 scratches the back of his head. It's a habit he developed when he had hair, lifetimes ago. He broke the habit during his fifteenth development, but the shadow of it still lives in his trillions of lines of code.

Banshee doesn't know any of this. Not consciously, at least.

He's trying to figure out what he's looking at.

"If this is a gun, my thinker's in worse shape than I thought."

Hektor 99-40, official frame of the Häkke foundry, gives a hearty laugh and slaps Banshee-44 on the back.

"Your thinker's fine, Banshee. It's a Sparrow!"

Banshee grunts. "Why." It's a question, but he doesn't pronounce it like one.

"Why what?"

"Why'd Häkke make a Sparrow."

"We realized that our design pillars are good for more than just guns. Relatable design, exciting function. And what's more exciting than a Sparrow?"

Banshee grunts again.

"Do you like it?" Hektor asks.

"Don't see what it's got to do with me. I stock guns. Not rides." 

"Still. Tell me what you think. I want to know."

Banshee settles his hands on his hips. Looks back at the Sparrow's sleek curves and hard edges.

Something warm flickers in the cool blue of his eyes.

"Looks like a real good time."

He gives a jerky nod and, without further ado, limps back to his stall.

Hektor watches him go. The frame's fingers scrape against the back of his cranial unit. Then he shrugs.

"I'll take it."
523189763.lore_zh:
班西-44搔了搔他的后脑勺。这是他在前几生还有头发的时候养成的习惯。他在第十五次重启时了放弃了这个习惯，但这习惯仍隐藏在他上兆条的编码中。

班西不知道，至少还没意识到。

他试图搞懂他在看什么。

“如果这是把枪，那我的思维器比想象的情况更糟糕。”

Häkke铸造厂的官方机械仆从黑克特99-40爽朗地笑了，拍拍班西-44的背。

“你的思维器没问题，班西。这是辆快雀。”

班西嘟囔着问：“为什么。”这是个问题，但他说的音调很平。

“什么为什么？”

“为什么Häkke要做一辆快雀。”

“我们意识到我们的射击理念不只适用于枪械。多用的设计，令人兴奋的功能，用在快雀上多么合适啊。”

班西又嘟囔了什么。

“你喜欢吗？”黑克特问。

“我不知道它和我有什么关系。我储藏枪支，不需要载具。”

“还是告诉我你怎么想的吧，我想知道。”

班西把手放在臀部，重新看向快雀那圆润的曲线和分明的棱角。

他发着冷光蓝的眼睛中闪烁着一丝温暖。

“看起来真的很不错。”

他匆匆点了点头，没有犹豫地返回了他的摊位。

黑克特看着他离去。这名机械仆从的手指蹭了蹭脑袋后的零件，耸了耸肩。

“我买了。”

523189762.name: Warrior's Steed
523189762.flavor: Ride gloriously into adventure… and through it.
523189762.lore:
I don't know why you brought me on this job. This is not what I do. I'm not a Hunter. Have you seen the size of my feet? Graceful I am not. Sneaky I am not. I break down doors; barrel through walls; stomp on things. I move like a battering ram. You want speed. Not this. Best I can offer is momentum. Push me down a hill and maybe—maybe—I'll get moving half as fast as these other guys here, if I'm lucky. I'm flattered and all, and yeah, I've always wanted to do something like this. I mean, who wouldn't, you know? Live out that high-class thief-in-the night fantasy. Disguises. Fancy parties. Steal the old man's jewels. I one hundred percent get it. But trust me—you do not want me on this job. You do not—

Oh. Oh, I see. I get it. Your team does its thing, grab the goods, while I hang back… what, over here? Behind these boulders? Right. Yeah, I see, I see. You grab the goods, the team hightails it out of there. And when they roll out the Interceptors in pursuit, that's where I come in and—WHAM! Titan T-bone! Yeah, this could work. You guys get away with the loot, and I—

Wait a minute.

Bump my cut to thirty percent and we're cool. Cool?

Cool, cool, cool, cool, cool.
523189762.lore_zh:
我不知道你为什么让我加入，我不是做这个的啊。我又不是猎人。你没看到我脚有多大吗？我既不优雅，又不卑鄙。我撞破大门，我射穿墙壁，我对物粗暴。我走起路来像一辆冲撞车。你要求的是速度，我可不是。我能提供的最多就只是冲力。把我从山上推下去或许就——或许——我的速度就能达到其他人的一半了，这还是往快里说呢。我很荣幸你来找我，确实，我也一直都像做一些像这样的事情。我是说，谁不想呢，你懂的吧？幻想成为一名怪盗基德一样的午夜飞贼，伪装自己，参加华丽的派对，盗走有钱老人的珠宝。我百分百了解。但相信我——让我加入你会后悔的。你不会——

哦，哦，我懂了，我知道了。你干你的，拿东西什么的，我在……什么，在这儿等着？就在这些巨石后面？好吧。是，我懂了，我懂了。你取货，团队不参与进去。等他们开着拦截者追出来的时候，我就上场——哈！泰坦横祸！嗯，可行。你们带着战利品逃走，我——

等一下。

那我得拿三成，不然免谈。成吗？

成，成，成，成，成。

523189761.name: Ravager's Ride
523189761.flavor: Not everything found in the depths of a prison should be left there.
523189761.lore:
"There's an old saying: 'If you walk long enough, you'll find yourself.' Trick is, this far out, you gotta find yourself before someone else does, cuz the only company the Shore offers is bad company.

"Outlaws and enemies hide around every bend—stalk every rock, every crack. Even allies—them closest you call kin? Out here, where the only law is survival, loyalties can shift with the breeze. Bonds can break.

"And trust is a lie easily dismissed when the tables turn and the bad times roll.

"So walk weary, and stay ever alert. Should you find yourself out there… have one in the chamber and a steady aim, cuz chances are you won't like what you see."

—Excerpt from C.C. LaGrange's translations of "Writings and Observations from the Tangled Shore: A Fallen Text"
523189761.lore_zh:
“有句老话说得好：‘行万里路，方能寻得自我。'问题是，在这荒郊野岭的，你得在其他人之前找到自我，因为海岸上遇到的只有坏人。”

不法之徒和敌人会出现在每个转角——他们藏匿在每块岩石、每条裂缝中。即使是盟友——哪怕是你的亲戚。在这里，唯一的法则就是生存，忠诚随风倒。羁绊也很脆弱。

“当情势转变、糟糕的日子到来时，信任就是个随时可以废弃的谎言。”

“所以要小心潜行，保持警惕。如果你发现了自己……最好子弹上膛锁定目标，因为很可能接下来看到的不是什么好事。”

——摘自C.C.拉格朗译制的《纷争海岸的观察与记录：一份堕落者文本》

4148158229.description: Final blows with this weapon generate stunning lighting strikes from above. Lightning strikes grant a stack of Bolt Charge. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

1171147302.description_zh: 此武器的每个快速最后一击将在短时间内累积大幅增加填装速度。

375770440.name: Prankster Dance
375770440.flavor: …and kick and kick and kick and kick…

393325292.name: Ephemeral Pack
393325292.description:
A pack for Guardians to celebrate the Festival of the Lost.

Contains 3 Ephemeral Engrams, 150 Bright Dust, and 5 Dark Fluorescence shaders.
393325292.description_zh:
为庆祝英灵日的守护者准备的包裹。

内含3个转瞬记忆水晶、150个光尘和5个黑暗荧光着色器。

393325293.name: Misbehaving Pack
393325293.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who understand the need to keep everyone's spirits up.

Contains the exclusive Prankster Dance emote, the Arachnophile transmat effect, and 1 Fireteam Medallion.
393325293.description_zh:
为懂得提高士气必要性的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

内含专属小丑舞步动作表情、蛛网派传送效果和1枚火力战队大勋章。

393325294.name: Prideglass Pack
393325294.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who embody the fighting spirit of kings.

Contains the Prideglass ornament for Fighting Lion, 3 Ephemeral Engrams, and 5 Eververse Bounty Notes.
393325294.description_zh:
为体现君主斗争精神的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

内含战狮的自豪琉璃皮肤、3个转瞬记忆水晶和5个永恒之诗悬赏说明。

2231414197.name: Faster than Speed Pack
2231414197.description:
A pack for Guardians whose firepower can always be faster.

Contains the exclusive Hypervelocity ornament for Thunderlord, the Corrupt Ether transmat effect, and 150 Bright Dust.
2231414197.description_zh:
为火力总是可以更快的守护者准备的包裹。

内含专属雷神的超高速皮肤、腐化乙太传送效果和150个光尘。

2231414196.name: Sky Deity Pack
2231414196.description:
A pack for Guardians who know the power in the clouds.

Contains the exclusive Tlāloc's Wrath ornament for Thunderlord, the Reef Oracle transmat effect, and 150 Bright Dust.
2231414196.description_zh:
为知道云中力量的守护者准备的包裹。

内含专属雷神的雨神之怒皮肤、暗礁神谕传送效果和150个光尘。

3260691474.name: A Single Flame Pack
3260691474.description:
A pack for Guardians who don't let the light go out.

Contains 1 Ephemeral Engram and 1 random shader.
3260691474.description_zh:
为不让光芒熄灭的守护者准备的包裹。

内含1个转瞬记忆水晶和一个随机着色器。

3260691475.name: Three Candles Pack
3260691475.description:
A pack for Guardians who've begun to illuminate the dark.

Contains 3 Ephemeral Engrams and 2 random shaders.
3260691475.description_zh:

内含3个转瞬记忆水晶和2个随机着色器。

3260691472.name: Five Glow Bright Pack

3260691472.description_zh:

内含5个转瞬记忆水晶和3个随机着色器。

1473368767.description: And again, and again, and again.

1473368760.description_zh: 无法在任何地方寻找购买，拯救大地和天空。

1473368761.description: He squinted and it was gone… but she swore it never moved.
1473368761.description_zh: 他眯起了眼睛，它消失了……而她发誓它从未移动。

1579897985.name: Forge's Ignition Pack
1579897985.description:
A one-time pack to kick off the Season of the Forge.

Contains 5 Bright Engrams, 3 Fireteam Medallions, and 250 Bright Dust.
1579897985.description_zh:
为开启锻炉赛季而准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含5个光明记忆水晶、3枚火力战队大勋章和250个光尘。

1579897984.name: Curator's Pack
1579897984.description:
A pack for Guardians who welcome the past's return.

Contains the exclusive Dark Horse Sparrow, 2 Bright Engrams, and 10 shaders from the Season of the Forge.
1579897984.description_zh:
为迎接历史回归的守护者所准备的包裹。

包含来自锻炉赛季的专属黑马快雀、2个光明记忆水晶和10个着色器。

1579897987.name: Visions of Iron Pack
1579897987.description:
A one-time pack to welcome the Iron Banner's return.

Contains three Ghost projections exclusive to this pack, 1 Fireteam Medallion, and 2 Gleaming Boons of the Crucible.
1579897987.description_zh:
为欢迎铁旗归来而准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含该包裹专属三个机灵投影、1枚火力战队大勋章和2个闪亮熔炉竞技场福利。

1579897986.name: Feathered Friend Pack
1579897986.description:
A one-time pack for true friends of Cayde-6.

Contains the Salute to the Colonel ornament for Ace of Spades, 3 Bright Engrams, and the Only the Finest transmat effect.
1579897986.description_zh:
为凯德6号的真正朋友准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含黑桃A的致敬上校皮肤、3个光明记忆水晶和精益求精传送效果。

1579897989.name: Forges Burn Bright Pack
1579897989.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who welcome the Black Armory's return.

Contains 5 Bright Engrams, 3 Fireteam Medallions, and 10 Lilac Bombast shaders.
1579897989.description_zh:
为欢迎黑色军械库回归的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含5个光明记忆水晶、3枚火力战队大勋章和10个浮夸丁香着色器。

1579897988.name: Form Given Function Pack
1579897988.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who believe in elegance amidst brutality.

Contains the Suros Chrome ornament for Suros Regime, 3 Bright Engrams, and the Past Unearthed transmat effect.
1579897988.description_zh:
为相信野蛮中自有优雅的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包Suros政权的Suros铬合金皮肤、3个光明记忆水晶和往日重现传送效果。

3694103465.name: Dawning's Genesis Pack
3694103465.description:
A one-time pack to celebrate the return of the Dawning.

Contains 5 Winterdrift Engrams, the Glad Tidings jumpship, the Dawning Ghost projection, and 250 Bright Dust.
3694103465.description_zh:
为庆祝曙光节回归而准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含5个冬日漂泊记忆水晶、喜讯跃迁飞船、曙光节机灵投影和250个光尘。

3694103464.name: Mixing It Up Pack
3694103464.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who want to bake it to the limit.

Contains the exclusive Baking Cookies emote, the Shower of Gifts transmat effect, and 1 Fireteam Medallion.
3694103464.description_zh:
为想要将烘培发挥到极致的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含专属烤饼干动作表情、礼物雨传送效果和1枚火力战队大勋章。

3694103467.name: Dawning's Delight Pack
3694103467.description:
A pack for Guardians who wish the Dawning would never end.

Contains 3 Winterdrift Engrams, 5 Aniline Shock shaders, and 1 Gleaming Boon of the Vanguard.
3694103467.description_zh:
为希望曙光节永不结束的守护者准备的包裹。

包含3个冬日漂泊记忆水晶、5个苯胺冲击着色器和1个闪亮先锋福利。

1316229364.name: Lovestruck Pack
1316229364.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who want to spread the love.

Contains the exclusive Tiny Bow emote, shaders, and a Fireteam Medallion.
1316229364.description_zh:
为想要传播爱的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含一个专属迷你弓箭动作表情、着色器和一枚火力战队大勋章。

1316229365.name: Dressed to Thrill Pack
1316229365.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who want to look their best for their Crimson Bond.

Contains an exclusive Legendary ornament and Fireteam Medallions.
1316229365.description_zh:
为想要成为血色羁绊眼中最佳的守护者们准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含一个专属传说皮肤和火力战队大勋章。

2522587563.name: Once Etched Pack
2522587563.description:

2522587563.description_zh:

包含1个光明记忆水晶和1个随机着色器。

2522587562.description:

2417017737.name: Ada-1's Lone Wolf
2417017737.flavor: "It's an old-fashioned oxymoron. There is no such thing. But, you must admit, there is something charming about old fashions…" —Ada-1
2417017737.lore:
Ada-1 prefers places to people.

She sits on the hull of her ship, staring out over the wreckage of an abandoned theme park in New Vancouver. Her eyes crawl up the spine of a rusted-out roller coaster with tracks that stop dead in midair, sticking out like a diving board over a 250-foot drop.

She likes empty places like this. Places that were once full. Places where countless people had the time of their lives, and now there's nothing but the remnants.

She thinks of them as shrines to humanity and comes to pay her respects to what humanity was before it all got so complicated.

Sitting in the shadow of the park's sign—ROCK T W RLD, it says, in faded block letters—she drags the toe of her boot through the dirt and feels the weight of the centuries around her. That weight, and the emptiness…

They help her breathe.

She doesn't picture this place in its heyday, thick with crowds. She likes it just as it is now, but she likes to know that it was once full of people. Good people, she imagines.

Now she can sit here alone, with the echo of those people for company, and just… be.

She closes her eyes and smiles.
2417017737.lore_zh:
相对于人类，艾达-1更喜欢地方。

她坐在飞船上，看着新温哥华中的一个废弃主题公园的残骸。她的眼睛沿着生锈过山车的轨道，看到骨架在半空中折断，仿佛一个高耸250英尺的跳板。

她喜欢像这样的空旷场地。这些地方曾经人山人海，曾有无数的人们在此度过美妙的人生，但如今只剩残骸。

她将这些地方看做人类的神社，前来向曾经不那么复杂的人类文明表示敬意。

坐在斑驳黑体的公园门牌——摇氵世界——的阴影中，她用靴头在土上划来划去，感受围绕着她的百年来的重量。那种重量，还有那种空虚感……

都能帮助她呼吸。

她没有想象这地方曾经充斥人群的辉煌时光。她喜欢现在这样，但她也喜欢知道这里人声鼎沸的过去。都是好人，她想。

现在她可以独自坐在这里，人们的回声陪伴着她，就这样……这样。

她闭上双眼，嘴角微扬。

2417017738.name: Ódrerir
2417017738.flavor: "Kinsmen to kinsmen should be true." —The Saga of Olaf Haraldson
2417017738.lore:
We post these words 
for all to see,
though words 
are soon forgot.
The works of our 
Black Armory
live on, though 
bodies rot.

Lest working hands 
grow idle now,
with gaze 
fixed 'pon the sky,
we plant our feet 
on solid ground,
and earthward 
turn our eye.

Though boundless space 
does treasure hold,
and gifts 
seem cheap or free,
we wait and watch 
this age of gold,
sad vigil 
though it be.

We place our works 
in hands of all
and guard 
'gainst threats unknown.
For though we gaze
into the stars,
we first must
shield our own.
2417017738.lore_zh:
我们将这些言语发布
让所有人都看到，
尽管言语
很快会被遗忘。
我们的作品
黑色军械库
虽然永存
但肉体会腐烂。

只恐工匠
停滞不前，
双目
望向天际，
我们的双脚
扎根土地，
转动双眸，
回望地球。

即便宇宙无际
宝藏有边，
财富
变得廉价，
我们等待，我们凝望
这黄金纪元，
不过是悲伤百年

我们将作品
交付众人
以抵挡
未知的威胁。
若要放眼
星空，
首先
保全自己。

855351524.name: Glad Tidings
855351524.description: "This may be the 'Last Safe City,' but we've still gotta look out for each other." —Suraya Hawthorne
855351524.description_zh: “这里也许是‘最后的避难所'，但我们还是得相互照顾。”——苏拉娅·霍桑
855351524.lore:
"There you go," Hawthorne says, climbing down from the stepladder. "All done."

"Thank you, Suraya," Mrs. Hasan replies as she leans out of her shop to look up at the string of blue lanterns. "I just can't get up on those ladders anymore." She beckons. "Why don't you come in and have a hot drink? Farrah's home." She wiggles her eyebrows, still cheeky at 85. "She's still single—have I mentioned?"

Hawthorne smiles. "A few times, Mrs. H.," she says. "But no, thank you. I should get going."

She packs up the stepladder for Mrs. Hasan, reluctantly accepts a tin of soft powdered cookies, and then sets off through the snow-blanketed streets of the Last City. It's getting dark, but she still has a few stops to make. She makes a lot of house calls during the Dawning.

She slows as a Guardian ship whips by overhead. An Exo transmats onto the sidewalk, takes four steps, then stops dead to gawk up at the lanterns that zigzag the neighborhood.

New Guardian, no doubt. Hawthorne's gotten good at spotting them. They stop to inspect everything, usually without warning. Very little spatial awareness.

"Where did they come from?" the Guardian asks reverently, without looking at Hawthorne.

"The lanterns? We hang them." She's accustomed to this. "For the Dawning."

The Guardian looks at her like she's a sorcerer. "The Dawning?"

Hawthorne has a soft spot for the new ones. She's been alone before, out in the wilds of the EDZ. And she can't imagine many experiences lonelier than stumbling like a grown-up baby into a fully formed world, with no one but a little flying robot to explain it all to you.
 
"Come on," she says. "Let's walk and talk. I bet you're hungry, and I know a guy who makes some mean tamales this time of year."
855351524.lore_zh:
“好了”，霍桑从梯子上爬了下来，“都弄好了。”

“谢谢你，苏拉娅。”哈桑夫人从店铺里伸出头来，看着那一串蓝色的灯笼，“我真的没法爬那些梯子了。”她招了招手。“你进来喝杯热饮怎么样？法拉也在家呢。”她挑了挑眉毛，都85岁了还话不过脑子，“她还是单身——我应该说过吧？”

霍桑笑了。“说过好几次了，哈桑夫人”，她说道，“不过不用了，谢谢你。我得走了。”

她帮哈桑夫人收拾好梯子，勉强收下了一罐软饼干，然后便走上了最后的城市中被白雪覆盖的街道。天快要黑了，但她还有好几个地方要去。她在曙光节的时候会拜访不少人。

一艘守护者飞船突然出现在她头顶，她的脚步慢了下来。一个Exo被传送到了路旁，连跨四步，然后突然停了下来，死死地盯着街道上蜿蜒曲折的灯笼串。

新守护者，毫无疑问。霍桑很擅长分辨他们。他们会停下来检视一切，而且通常都不会预先通知。对于空间的认知有点混乱。

“这些东西是哪来的？”守护者没有看霍桑，但还是恭敬地问道。

“这些灯笼吗？是我们挂上去的。”她已经习惯了，“因为曙光节到了。”

守护者像是见鬼似的看着她：“曙光节？”

霍桑对于新人总是比较心软。她以前一个人生活在欧洲无人区的荒野之中，她无法想象有多少经历能比像一个跌跌撞撞的婴儿一样走进一个完全成形的世界更加孤独，而且这个时候能为你解释一切的还只有一个会飞的小小机器人。

“来吧”，她说，“我们边走边聊。你应该饿了吧，我知道有个家伙每年这个时候都会做好吃的塔马利。”

855351525.name: Home Away
855351525.description: We celebrate the Dawning no matter what's under our feet.
855351525.description_zh: 无论我们在哪里，都要庆祝曙光节。
855351525.lore:
Del-3 watches the churning waves of the methane sea and sighs.

It's not just that she wants to go back to the City; she wants to go back in time. Before the Red War, before they lost so many people. The Dawning isn't the same without them. Ari told her the day she flew to Titan that she'd "get her legs" soon enough. But if this cold, unsteady, lonely place is what she has to look forward to every year, she doesn't really see the point.

She's trying so hard to fight back tears that she doesn't notice her CO. "Del."

She snaps to attention. "Deputy Commander," she says. "Sorry, I was—"

"At ease, soldier," Sloane says warmly. "Come inside. Dinner's ready."

Dinner?

Del follows Sloane into the mess hall, ducking under a paper snowflake hung from the ceiling. The big, ugly metal slab of a table is covered with a blue and silver tablecloth. Ration food is spread out like a makeshift feast. Ari is lighting candles.

"What is this?" Del asks.

Sloane's smile is sheepish but proud. "It's not the Tower, but no reason the celebrations shouldn't reach all the way out here. Come on. Let's tuck in."
855351525.lore_zh:
德尔-3看着甲烷海里翻滚的波涛，叹了口气。

她想要的不只是回到圣城，她更想要让时间倒流，回到猩红战争以前，回到他们失去如此之多的亲人以前。没有了他们，曙光节不再是以前的曙光节了。阿里在她飞到土卫六的那天就告诉她，她很快就能习惯了。但如果这个寒冷、动荡、孤独的地方就是她每年都要期盼的地方，她真的不知道该怎么习惯。

她非常努力地想要忍住泪水，以至于没看到指挥官的到来。“德尔。”

她突然缓过神来。“代理指挥官”，她说道，“抱歉，我刚才——”

“放松点儿，士兵”，斯隆亲切地说道，“进来吧，晚餐准备好了。”

晚餐？

德尔跟着斯隆走进一片狼藉的大堂，躲闪着从天花板上落下的如雪花般的纸片。一张又大又丑的金属桌板上铺好了一块蓝色和银色交织的桌布。配给食物摆得到处都是，感觉像是一场临时准备的盛宴。阿里正在点蜡烛。

“这是怎么回事？”德尔问道。

斯隆笑得很温柔，但也很自豪：“这里不是高塔，但我们没理由因为在这里就不举办庆祝活动。来吧，我们开始吧。”

3268592500.name: Approaching Infinity
3268592500.lore:
"Driving my Sparrow at breakneck speed reminds me that I'm still alive."

This is a very Hunter thing to say. Not to disparage Hunters, but I don't get it (and I try very hard to "get" things, let me tell you). I don't need to be reminded that I'm still alive. I'm reminded of that every time I die.

I drive my Sparrow at breakneck speed because it reminds me of my place in the universe. It reminds me of every force that acts on me, every "law" of motion I can or can't break. I'm most interested in the ones I can't break, honestly. Considering I am myself an aberration of the laws of physics, I rather like finding the edges of things. Not that I'm content to leave those edges as they are. I just get a sort of… thrill out of finding them.

And if I have to drive my Sparrow over a waterfall of Vex milk to do that, then damn it, I will.
3268592500.lore_zh:
“骑着快雀疾行时我才能感受到我还活着。”

只有猎人才会说这种话。这不是在贬低猎人，而是我真的不明白（说实话，我很难理解事物）。我不需要外界来提醒自己是否还活着，每次死的时候就能感受到了。

我之所以骑着快雀疾行是因为，它可以提醒我我在这个宇宙中的位置。它提醒着我去感受作用在我身上的每种力量，每种我能或不能打破的动力“法则”。话说我对那些我无法打破的法则更感兴趣。我已经是物理法则的反常现象了，因此我更希望找到事物的边界。我并不满足于极限的本身，我比较……渴望挖掘它们。

如果为此需要我骑着快雀穿过Vex奶白色的瀑布，该死的，我也会去的。

3268592501.name: Dark Horse
3268592501.flavor: There's no recognizable maker's mark. Just a "1" stamped onto the side.
3268592501.lore:
Right out of the gate, Marcus is in the lead.

He's already planning tonight's victory party as he decelerates to match speed with Enoch.

"You're welcome," he shouts, "for the great view!"

He zips ahead, laughing. He waits for the next lap to fall back again beside Enoch. Didi tries to amp the volume on the announcer feed, but Marcus doesn't want to hear it. He mutes the line.

"Keep it up, Ren," Enoch growls. "I could use the Glimmer."

Under his helmet, Marcus grins. "I don't think this is one of those 'tortoise and the hare' things, Bast," he says. "I—"

A Sparrow shoots by them so fast that Marcus almost loses his balance.

For a second, he just stares. Then he flattens himself against his handlebars and guns his thrusters. He doesn't recognize the Sparrow, nor the rider. But that won't matter when he closes the gap…

Half a lap to the finish line, and he can't make up the lost ground. The other rider just pulls further and further ahead.

This time Marcus doesn't stop Didi when she maxes the announcer feed. "Looks like Ren's going to be eating dust today, folks!"

The win goes to "Jane Doe," who doesn't stick around to claim the prize money.
3268592501.lore_zh:
一冲出大门，马库斯就一马当先。

他减速与以诺并行，应该是在计划今晚庆祝胜利的派对呢吧。

“能看到前方这番美景”，他喊道，“不用谢我！”

他大笑着冲了出去。他准备下一圈再减速回到以诺身边。迪迪试着放大播音员频道的音量，但马库斯根本不想听。他开了静音。

“加把劲啊，伦”，以诺大吼道。“我需要得到那些微光。”

马库斯在头盔下讥笑。“巴斯特，我可不觉得这会是什么‘龟兔赛跑'的老套剧情”，他说。“我——”

一辆快雀从他们身边嗖的一下飞过，快到马库斯差点失去平衡。

他愣了一下，然后附身握把飞速前行。他没见过那辆快雀，也不认识骑手。但只要能缩短差距，其他不重要……

离终点还有半圈，他竟然无法弥补失地。那位骑手将距离越拉越远。

这次迪迪将播音员广播开到最大声时，马库斯没有阻止。“朋友们，看来伦今天要吃败仗了！”

这次的冠军是“简·多伊”，连奖金都没领就离开了。

3268592502.name: Burnout
3268592502.flavor: Fight fire with fire. And fight everything else with fire, too.
3268592502.lore:
"…Is it supposed to be on fire?"

Marcus brushed his hands off, leaving streaks of soot on his pants. "It wasn't," he admitted. "But I can't get it to stop burning."

Ariadne tilted her head, watching the flames. "Why's that?"

"The Solar energy that Ana helped integrate," he said. "It's not totally… contained. But it's stable enough to ride. I've tried it."

"Does the fire ever go out?"

"Not as far as I can tell."

"Huh." Ariadne crossed her arms. "Seems dangerous."

"Yeah. Like I said, it's stable for now, and I can ride it, but who knows how long that'll last. It could probably explode at any second."

They stood in silence, watching the charred Sparrow burn.

"Cool," Ariadne whispered.

Marcus grinned. "I know, right?"
3268592502.lore_zh:
“……这东西着了是正常的吗？”

马库斯擦了擦手，裤子上留下了烟灰道儿。“曾经不算正常”，他说。“但我扑不灭。”

阿里阿德涅歪着头，看着火苗。“怎么会这样？”

“是阿娜帮忙整合的烈日能量”，他说。“还无法完全……控制住，但稳定度足可以支撑骑行了。我试过了。”

“这火苗熄灭过吗？”

“我暂时还没见过。”

“啊。” 阿里阿德涅双臂交叉。“感觉挺危险的。”

“是啊。就像我说的，现在挺稳定的，能骑，但谁知道能撑多久呢。随时都可能爆炸。”

他们沉默地看着焦黑的快雀燃烧。

“挺帅的”，阿里阿德涅小声说。

马库斯笑了，“对吧？”

3268592503.name: The Bronco
3268592503.flavor: "A man's only as good as his ride." —Tex 99-40
3268592503.lore:
"They don't make 'em like they used to."

Here at Tex Mechanica, we've been saying that about guns for years. In these days of technological advancement, when everyone's gone starry-eyed over what's new and what's next, neat gadgets and slick design win out over pure firepower every time. But that ain't always how it was. And with a Tex gun, that ain't how it has to be now, either.

We make guns the way they're meant to be: fast, powerful, and built to last.

Now we're setting our sights on a new frontier. That's right—saddle up and get ready to ride, because Tex Mechanica is in the Sparrow business.

Designed with the true Guardian experience in mind, this beauty will let you ride hard and fast over rough terrain, laying waste to anything that dares stand in your path.

I may be nothin' but an old hunk of metal with a personality built around a corporate brand identity, but I tell you what… I know quality, Guardian, and quality's what you get when you go with Tex Mechanica.

Like we always say: If you're gonna play, play for keeps.
3268592503.lore_zh:
“他们的东西不如从前了。”

在特克斯机械，我们关于枪械的这种态度已经持续多年了。在这个技术爆发的时代，人们的目光永远聚焦在新兴事物上，简洁的小程序和利落的设计总是比单纯的火力更吸引目光。从前可不是这样。可特克斯的枪，和市面上的也不太一样。

我们遵循枪的用途：快速、威猛且耐用。

如今，我们将我们的业务发展至新的前线。没错——特克斯机械增加了快雀业务，准备好策马奔腾吧。

以真正的守护者体验为核心进行设计，此商品可以让你在各类崎岖地形中快速前行，面前的一切障碍物都不在话下。

我可能只是一个企业品牌制造出的大型个性旧式金属，但我告诉你……我懂什么是质量，守护者，你拥有的特克斯机械就是质量品质的保证。

就如我们常说：要干，就认真干。

1847708611.name: Dawning Cheer
1847708611.flavor: Some traditions are too good to be true.
1847708611.lore:
"What is that?"

Grinning, Kasim stood back to let the kids get a better look at his Sparrow. "It's Kringle's sleigh."

"Who's that?" barked Runa. At eleven, she was the oldest of the group.

"Mr. Kringle," said Kasim, who had been reading all about pre-Collapse traditions. "Every Dawning, Kringle visits the good children of the City. He comes at night, while you're asleep, and leaves presents in your house."

"But the door's locked because of prowlers," Tomas said.

"He slithers down the chimney," Kasim said. Or was it 'slides'?

"How does he fit?" asked Matsuko, the youngest.

"Well." Kasim hesitated. "He's magic…" 

"So he's a Guardian," Runa said.

"No, he's not a Guardian."

The children exchanged looks and erupted into nervous chatter. 

"If there's a fire in the fireplace, can he still get in?" Tomas asked, alarmed.

"He can't get hurt by the fire." Kasim was losing steam. "Listen. He—"

"He's immune to fire," Runa said gravely.

Matsuko started to cry. Tomas kicked the Sparrow. "Hey!" Kasim said. "Listen! He's not real, OK? Kringle's not real. He's made up." He moved the Sparrow away. "Just… forget I said anything."

Runa watched Kasim go. "Don't worry," she told Matsuko. "Lord Shaxx will stop Kringle."
1847708611.lore_zh:
“那是什么？”

卡西姆微笑着，退后一步让孩子们能更清楚地看到他的快雀。“这是克林格尔的雪橇。”

“克林格尔是谁？”鲁纳问道。11岁的她是这群孩子中年纪最大的一个。

“克林格尔先生”，卡西姆说道，他读到过不少关于大崩溃之前的传统，“每个曙光节，克林格尔都会来看望圣城里的乖孩子们。他会在晚上到来，趁你睡觉的时候，在你家里留下礼物。”

“但是为了防小偷，我们都会锁门呀。”托马斯说道。

“他会从烟囱里溜下来”，卡西姆说道。还是“滑”下来来着？

“他怎么进得去呢？”年纪最小的松子问道。

“这个嘛。” 卡西姆犹豫了一会儿。“他会魔法……”

“这么说他是个守护者咯。”鲁纳说道。

“不，他不是守护者。”

孩子们互相看了一眼，然后热烈地讨论起来。

“如果说壁炉里点了火，他还能进来吗？” 托马斯担心地问道。

“他是不会被火烧伤的。” 卡西姆有点儿泄气，“听着。他——”

“他对火焰免疫，”鲁纳严肃地说道。

松子哭了起来。托马斯踢了快雀一脚。“嘿！” 卡西姆说道：“听好了！他不是真的，明白了吗？克林格尔不是真的。他是大家编造出来的。” 他将快雀移到一旁。“唔……就当我刚才什么都没说。”

鲁纳看着卡西姆离开。“不用担心”，她对松子说道，“领主沙克斯会阻止克林格尔的。”

1125119861.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of 21% Delirium. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1125119861.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变21%的亢奋的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

1546799103.name: Perfluorocarbon
1546799103.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Oxygen SR3. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1546799103.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变氧气SR3的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

1414396215.name: Itsy-Bitsy Spider
1414396215.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of the Recluse. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1414396215.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变隐士的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3086696388.name: Itsy-Bitsy Spider
3086696388.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of the Recluse. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3086696388.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变隐士的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

925771554.name: Watching You
925771554.flavor: I see what you did there.

2879093413.name: Boxer's Dance
2879093413.flavor: Float like a Warlock, sting like a Shank.

240371989.name: Grooving
240371989.flavor: Turn it up—I love this song!

3325808341.name: Arcstrider's Patience
3325808341.flavor: "It may look like fun—and trust me, it is—but don't drop that thing. You might hurt yourself." —Cayde-6

429106713.name: Striker's Patience
429106713.flavor: "When a Striker turns her entire body into a projectile, no one is truly safe. And at close quarters, a fist is better than any gun." —Commander Zavala

3225062820.name: Stormcaller's Patience
3225062820.flavor: "Let it flow through you, but not consume you. You are a conduit. Between sky and earth. Electricity and matter. Life and death." —Ikora Rey

1552235509.name: Newish Dance
1552235509.flavor: Nobody is watching. Time to bust out some new moves.

2873996295.name: Ricochet Dance
2873996295.flavor: They thought they brought it. They didn't.

4128095381.name: Hyped Dance
4128095381.flavor: Crank it and get pumped up!

2218275250.name: Chair Pop
2218275250.flavor: This is going to be good…

2578928835.name: Rapid Hit
2578928835.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.
2578928835.description_zh: 快速精准命中目标会暂时提高稳定性和填装速度。

2578928832.name: Rewind Rounds
2578928832.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
2578928832.description_zh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数从储存弹药中填装。

2578928833.name: Headseeker
2578928833.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
2578928833.description_zh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

3735277403.name: Prime Palette
3735277403.description: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
3735277403.description_zh: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。
3735277403.source: Source: Complete Gambit Prime matches and increase your rank.
3735277403.source_zh: 来源：完成全盛智谋比赛并提高你的排名等级。

1987234560.name: Iron Ruby
1987234560.description: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
1987234560.description_zh: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。
1987234560.source: Source: Dismantle an item with this shader applied to it.
1987234560.source_zh: 来源：拆解一件应用此着色器的物品。
