1368521327.name: Volk-CER
1368521327.flavor: A Häkke Vimana class refit, painted in honor of the Iron Banner.

2200702883.name: SCRAP CF-717-91
2200702883.flavor: Refurbished salvage recovered from the ruins of the original Tower.

554648945.name: Black Peregrine
554648945.flavor: I am the needle that threads the fabric of time.

554648944.name: Skulking Fox
554648944.flavor: I am the scavenger who will outrun you all.

554648947.name: Threat Display
554648947.flavor: I do not need to hide.

4063523622.name: Vimana-S
4063523622.description: Again descend they from the seat of Orders.
4063523622.description_zh: 他们再次从神权之位上坠落。

4063523623.name: Reclaimer-IS
4063523623.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, favored by inner-system scrappers.
4063523623.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，深受星系内好事者的喜爱。

4063523621.name: Broadcast-IS
4063523621.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, preferred by satcomm technicians.
4063523621.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，卫星通讯技工的首选。

4063523619.name: Safe Passage
4063523619.description: Echo-class refit. Experimental tech for AI-manned civilian transport.
4063523619.description_zh: 厄科级改装型。无人驾驶民用运输船的实验科技。

4063523616.name: Holacanthus
4063523616.description: Warn away predators of the Reef.

4063523630.name: DSV-Huygens IX
4063523630.description: Nautilus-class aerosub, designed for seamless transition between methane submersion and low-atmosphere flight on Titan.
4063523630.description_zh: 鹦鹉螺级小型飞行器，专为在沼气池之间的无缝过渡和土卫六上的低大气层飞行而设计。

4063523631.name: SCRAP MS-123-88
4063523631.description: Salvage recovered from the Valley of the Kings, Mars.

1871791701.name: Monument-CER
1871791701.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, with custom paint for Solstice parades.
1871791701.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，拥有为至日英雄游行定制的涂装。

1871791700.name: Ignition-CER
1871791700.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, with custom paint for Dawning lantern lighting celebrations.
1871791700.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，拥有为曙光节点灯笼活动定制的涂装。

3252358301.name: Carouse-CER
3252358301.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, painted for Revelry festivities in the Last City.
3252358301.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，为最后的城市中的狂欢节日而涂装。

3252358300.name: Congregate-IS
3252358300.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, repurposed for civilian transport to and from the Last City during the Revelry.
3252358300.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，在狂欢期间作为进出最后的城市的民用运输机使用。

3252358303.name: Wassail-CER
3252358303.description: A Häkke Vimana class refit, painted for Revelry festivities in the Last City.
3252358303.description_zh: Häkke维摩那级改装型，为最后的城市中的狂欢节日而涂装。

3252358302.name: Equatorial Equilibrium
3252358302.description: The period of time during which day and night are the same around a planetary body.
3252358302.description_zh: 行星体处于日与夜时长相同的一段时间。

3252358297.name: Bombos-CER
3252358297.description: Bring life and new ideas with you wherever you go.
3252358297.description_zh: 让生活和新点子伴你同行。

3252358296.name: Wander-CER
3252358296.description: A gift from the Guardians of the Tower to Suraya Hawthorne during the inaugural Revelry.
3252358296.description_zh: 在首次狂欢期间由高塔守护者送给苏拉娅·霍桑的礼物。

928095169.name: Barebones SL-19
928095169.flavor: An exceptionally lightweight carbon fiber frame that promises smooth-as-butter suspension and a swift ride.

928095168.name: Another Inspired Idea
928095168.flavor: "Whoa, whoa, whoa. Strap yourself to a rocket? Be reasonable, Marcus. …Just the engine? Hmm. You're right. That does change things." —Amanda Holliday

928095171.name: Zambezi-00
928095171.flavor: A Golden Age paint job, reconstructed by Old Russian Cryptarchs after meticulous archaeology of abandoned airfields.

928095170.name: Praxic Finery
928095170.flavor: Be the fire, or be smoke on the wind.

3330250541.name: Aerolite HW-42
3330250541.flavor: "Here. Try this one. S'got a low center of gravity, like you and your big Titan butt." —Marcus Ren

3330250542.name: The Whipcrack
3330250542.flavor: "I don't care if you 'really, really, really like it,' Marcus. It looks just like your others. You don't need it." —Didi

3330250543.name: Spaded Knife
3330250543.flavor: Designed for navigating dense undergrowth and foliage.

3330250538.name: Sgian Dubh
3330250538.flavor: A hidden blade. A hospitable smile.

3330250539.name: Praxic Justice
3330250539.flavor: "Hold everyone accountable. Most of all, yourself." —Warlock Aunor, Cormorant Blade

3330250532.name: Arion
3330250532.flavor: A retired Sparrow once used to ferry Lord Shaxx and Cayde-6 from a City dodgeball game.

3330250533.name: RJSV 99-40
3330250533.flavor: A scouting vehicle favored by Lord Shaxx's Redjacks.

2816146406.name: Beat Patrol
2816146406.flavor: A common model for Vanguard-authorized civilian security patrols in the Last City.

281718534.name: Circumpolar Light
281718534.flavor: Universal heat death? Nah. Not while you're around.

281718535.name: Equinoctial Edge
281718535.flavor: "Hmm… Looks like you've got blades for hands." —Enoch Bast

2717540197.name: The Saturnalian
2717540197.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower. Sponsored by Daito.

2717540196.name: Saturnalia-DAI-SP1
2717540196.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower. Sponsored by Daito.

2717540199.name: Raucous Edge
2717540199.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower.

2717540198.name: The Merry Gunner
2717540198.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower.

2717540193.name: The Festive Hauler
2717540193.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower.

2717540192.name: The Convivial Racer
2717540192.flavor: Commissioned to commemorate the first-ever Revelry in the Tower.

2801591300.name: Notorious Engram
2801591300.description: An engram containing different customization options, including Eververse Bounty Notes. Return it to Tess Everis in the Tower Courtyard to reveal its contents.
2801591300.description_zh: 包含多种定制物品的记忆水晶——内含永恒之诗悬赏说明。带它去高塔庭院中找泰斯·艾夫瑞斯解码其内容。
2801591300.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

3884317539.name: Notorious Engram
3884317539.description: An engram containing different customization options, including Eververse Bounty Notes. Return it to Tess Everis in the Tower Courtyard to reveal its contents.
3884317539.description_zh: 包含多种定制物品的记忆水晶——内含永恒之诗悬赏说明。带它去高塔庭院中找泰斯·艾夫瑞斯解码其内容。
3884317539.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

377183285.name: Jubilant Engram
377183285.description: An engram containing different customization options found exclusively during the Revelry. Return it to Tess Everis in the Tower Courtyard to reveal its contents.
377183285.description_zh: 包含只有在狂欢期间能找到的不同个性化选项的记忆水晶。带它去高塔庭院中找泰斯·艾夫瑞斯解码其内容。
377183285.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

4186704536.name: Jubilant Engram
4186704536.description: An engram containing different customization options found exclusively during the Revelry. Return it to Tess Everis in the Tower Courtyard to reveal its contents.
4186704536.description_zh: 包含只有在狂欢期间能找到的不同个性化选项的记忆水晶。带它去高塔庭院中找泰斯·艾夫瑞斯解码其内容。
4186704536.typeName_zh: 传说 光明记忆水晶

1318547450.name: Prime Time Pack
1318547450.description:
A one-time pack to kick off the Season of the Drifter.

Contains 5 Bright Engrams, 3 Fireteam Medallions, and 250 Bright Dust.
1318547450.description_zh:
为开启浪客赛季而准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含5个光明记忆水晶、3枚火力战队大勋章和250个光尘。

1318547451.name: Gravitational Effects Pack
1318547451.description:
A one-time pack for Guardians who are fascinated by the inexorable power of black holes.

Contains the exclusive General Relativity ornament for Graviton Lance, 3 Bright Engrams, and the Sterile Neutrino transmat effect.
1318547451.description_zh:
为对黑洞的无情力量着迷的守护者准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含为引力子长枪准备的专属广义相对论皮肤、3个光明记忆水晶和惰性中微子传送效果。

1318547448.name: Ether Supply Pack
1318547448.description:
A pack for Guardians who seek symbiosis with their Ghost.

Contains the exclusive Totem Shell Ghost, 2 Bright Engrams, and 5 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547448.description_zh:
为追求与自己机灵通力合作的守护者准备的包裹。

包含专属图腾机壳、2个光明记忆水晶和5个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547449.name: Sorrowful Pack
1318547449.description:
A pack for Guardians who are fated to walk a darker path.

Contains the exclusive Wishes of Sorrow ornament for Thorn, 3 Bright Engrams, and the Illicit Transmat transmat effect.
1318547449.description_zh:
为命中注定要走上更黑暗道路的守护者准备的包裹。

包含荆棘的专属皮肤忧愁愿望、3个光明记忆水晶和非法传送传送效果。

1318547454.name: Warshark Pack
1318547454.description:
A pack for Guardians who look toward the past with curious minds.

Contains the exclusive Zambezi-00 Sparrow, 2 Bright Engrams, and 10 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547454.description_zh:
为带着好奇之心回顾过去的守护者准备的包裹。

包含专属赞比西-00快雀、2个光明记忆水晶和10个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547455.name: Forward Scout Pack
1318547455.description:
A pack for Guardians who wish to forge new fronts for the Vanguard.

Contains the exclusive Black Peregrine jumpship, 3 Gleaming Boons of the Vanguard, and 5 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547455.description_zh:
为想要为先锋开辟新前线的守护者准备的包裹。

包含专属黑色呼鹰台跃迁飞船、3份闪亮先锋福利和5个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547452.name: Delectable Motes Pack
1318547452.description:
A pack for Guardians who have thrown themselves head first into the Drifter's latest scheme.

Contains the exclusive Still Hungry ornament for Gnawing Hunger, 1 Bright Engram, and 5 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547452.description_zh:
为首先潜入浪客最新计谋的守护者准备的包裹。

包含痛苦的饥饿的专属皮肤饥饿依旧、1个光明记忆水晶和5个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547453.name: You Gonna Eat That Pack
1318547453.description:
A pack for Guardians who reject etiquette and push boundaries.

Contains the exclusive Table Scraps ornament for Spare Rations, 1 Bright Engram, and 5 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547453.description_zh:
为不守规矩、在规则的边缘试探的守护者准备的包裹。

包含备用口粮的专属皮肤残羹冷炙、1个光明记忆水晶和5个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547442.name: Street Smarts Pack
1318547442.description:
A pack for Guardians with a talent for surviving ruthless times.

Contains the exclusive Outwit ornament for Outlast, 1 Bright Engram, and 5 shaders from the Season of the Drifter.
1318547442.description_zh:
为天生有能力在艰难时代中存活的守护者准备的包裹。

包含长命的专属皮肤智胜、1个光明记忆水晶和5个来自浪客赛季的着色器。

1318547443.name: Lightning Rod Pack
1318547443.description:
A pack for any Arcstrider looking to quietly pass the time.

Contains the exclusive class-locked Arcstrider's Patience emote, 1 Fireteam Medallion, and 150 Bright Dust.
1318547443.description_zh:
为想要安静度过时间的神行准备的包裹。

包含职业专属动作表情神行的耐心、1个火力战队大勋章和150个光尘。

3009759249.name: Lightning Before Thunder Pack
3009759249.description:
A pack for any Striker who knows that time is on their side.

Contains the exclusive class-locked Striker's Patience emote, 1 Fireteam Medallion, and 150 Bright Dust.
3009759249.description_zh:
为所有知道时间与其同行的强袭准备的包裹包裹。

包含职业专属动作表情强袭的耐心、1枚火力战队大勋章和150个光尘。

3009759248.name: Resting Storm Pack
3009759248.description:
A pack for any Stormcaller who relishes moments of silence.

Contains the exclusive class-locked Stormcaller's Patience emote, 1 Fireteam Medallion, and 150 Bright Dust.
3009759248.description_zh:
为所有憧憬沉默时刻的唤雷准备的包裹。

包含职业专属动作表情唤雷的耐心、1枚火力战队大勋章和150个光尘。

3009759251.name: A Guardian's Best Friend Pack
3009759251.description:
A pack for any Guardian who wishes they could flip a coin and instantly receive unconditional love and constant companionship. And hair. So much hair.

Contains the exclusive emote Good Doggo, 1 Fireteam Medallion, and the Jade Coin transmat effect.
3009759251.description_zh:
为希望自己扔个硬币后就能立即获得无条件的爱、长久友情，最好还有很多很多毛发的守护者准备的包裹。

包含专属动作表情乖狗狗、1枚火力战队大勋章和玉币传送效果。

3550590206.name: Exfiltration Pack
3550590206.description:
A pack for any Guardian daring enough to enter the quarantine zone in the old Tower.

Contains the exclusive Patient Zero ornament for Outbreak Perfected, 150 Bright Dust, and the Sterile Neutrino transmat effect.
3550590206.description_zh:
为有足够胆量进入旧高塔隔离区的守护者准备的包裹。

包含全面爆发的专属皮肤浮躁、150个光尘和惰性中微子传送效果。

3550590207.name: Memory of the Plague Pack
3550590207.description:
A pack for any Guardian who remembers the Warmind Rasputin's involvement in the SIVA project.

Contains the Pandemic ornament for Outbreak Perfected, 150 Bright Dust, and the Illicit Transmat transmat effect.
3550590207.description_zh:
为还记得战争思维拉斯普廷在湿婆项目中参与过的守护者准备的包裹。

包含全面爆发的专属皮肤蔓延、150个光尘和非法传送传送效果。

3124601571.name: Mood to Party Pack
3124601571.description:
A pack for any Guardian looking to jump headlong into the festivities of the Revelry.

Contains 5 Jubilant Engrams, 3 Fireteam Medallions, and 250 Bright Dust.
3124601571.description_zh:
为想要立刻加入狂欢活动的守护者准备的包裹。

包含5个欢庆记忆水晶、3枚火力战队大勋章和250个光尘。

3124601570.name: Hop Along Pack
3124601570.description:
A pack for any Guardian who believes rabbits are a symbol of good luck.

Contains the exclusive Cottontail Shell Ghost, 3 Jubilant Engrams, and 5 shaders from the Revelry.
3124601570.description_zh:
为相信兔子是好运的象征的守护者准备的包裹。

包含专属棉尾兔机壳、3个欢庆记忆水晶和5个来自狂欢的着色器。

3124601568.name: Spring Cleaning Pack
3124601568.description:
A pack for any Guardian with their thoughts on those who came before us.

Contains the exclusive Qingming ornament for Jade Rabbit, the Spring Fountain transmat effect, and 150 Bright Dust.
3124601568.description_zh:
为对活在我们生命之前的人们有感悟的守护者准备的包裹。

包含玉兔专属皮肤清明、春日喷泉传送效果和150个光尘。

1003670743.name: One Shot Pack
1003670743.description:
A pack for Guardians who know how to make the most of any advantage.

Contains 1 Bright Engram and 1 random shader.
1003670743.description_zh:
为知道如何将优势最大化利用的守护者准备的包裹。

包含1个光明记忆水晶和1个随机着色器。

1003670742.name: Two Breaths Pack
1003670742.description:
A pack for Guardians who can change their fate in an instant.

Contains 3 Bright Engrams and 2 random shaders.
1003670742.description_zh:
为可以瞬间改变其命运的守护者准备的包裹。

3295796664.name: Move to Survive
3295796664.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.
3295796664.description_zh:
装备瞬移时，可在空中使用[空中闪身]来施展暗影瞬移。

使用瞬移或暗影瞬移可获得不稳定弹药。瞬移距离更远并对你附近的目标施加不稳定，且冷却时间更短。新星折跃超能生效期间，暗影瞬移不会消耗超能能量。中幅提升所有武器的空中效率。

235075862.name: Peregrine Strike
235075862.description: All shoulder charge abilities (Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, or Shield Bash) deal bonus damage when activated in the air. Damaging mini-bosses, Tormentors, or Champions with your shoulder charge refunds your melee. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
235075862.description_zh: 所有肩部冲撞技能（地震打击、战锤打击和圣盾强袭）在空中激活时会造成额外伤害。使用肩部冲撞对初级首领、折磨者或勇士造成伤害会返还你的近战能量。小幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

4102900702.name: Touch of Venom

4102900702.description_zh: 击败被削弱的目标时，会释放一股削弱烟雾，并返还虚空近战技能能量。

2271572658.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain an additional perk.

2271572658.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得一项额外的特性。

使用高尚弹药治疗盟友以解锁这项升级。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

3414324643.name: Archer's Gambit
3414324643.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.
3414324643.description_zh: 腰射精准命中会在短时间内给予极大的拉弓速度加成。

2662236651.name: Archer's Gambit
2662236651.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.
2662236651.description_zh: 腰射精准命中会提供大量拉弓速度加成，效果持续时间延长。更多精准命中可延长持续时间。

743139589.name: Blessing of the Sky
743139589.description: Using a Noble Round on an ally heals them and grants both you and them a weapon damage bonus for a short duration.
743139589.description_zh: 对一位盟友使用高尚弹药可对其进行治疗，并在短时间内给予你和该盟友武器伤害加成。

3351002503.name: Bottomless Appetite
3351002503.description: Dealing continuous damage extends the duration of Ravenous Beast.
3351002503.description_zh: 造成持续伤害会延长贪食野兽的持续时间。

699525795.name: Eye of the Storm
699525795.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.
699525795.description_zh: 你的生命值越低，这款武器的精度和操控性就越好。

3719974635.name: Eye of the Storm
3719974635.description: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.
3719974635.description_zh: 你的生命值越低，此武器的精度和操控性提升越大。

2911329003.name: Grenades and Horseshoes
2911329003.description: Projectiles will detonate when they are within close proximity of their targets.
2911329003.description_zh: 射弹靠近目标时会引爆。

2866798147.name: No Distractions
2866798147.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.
2866798147.description_zh: 使用这款武器瞄准可在短时间内减少抖动。

3974407819.name: No Distractions
3974407819.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.
3974407819.description_zh: 使用此武器进行极短时间的瞄准可减少抖动。

3194351027.name: Explosive Light
3194351027.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.
3194351027.description_zh: 拾取能量球会增加下一枚射弹的爆炸范围和伤害。

2275087323.name: Explosive Light
2275087323.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.
2275087323.description_zh: 拾取能量球会增加下一枚射弹的爆炸范围和伤害。提升层数限制。

136456835.name: Reversal of Fortune
136456835.description: Missing 2 shots returns a bullet to the magazine after a short duration.
136456835.description_zh: 射偏2发子弹会在短时间后将1发子弹返回弹匣。

3016987351.name: Counterattack
3016987351.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.
3016987351.description_zh: 在防御后立刻格挡攻击将会在短时间内增加伤害。

1145640183.name: Counterattack
1145640183.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for an improved duration.
1145640183.description_zh: 在防御后立刻格挡攻击可增加伤害，持续时间延长。

2030760728.name: Energy Transfer
2030760728.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.
2030760728.description_zh: 在受到伤害时进行防护可产生职业技能能量。

2856365672.name: Energy Transfer
2856365672.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy at an improved rate.
2856365672.description_zh: 在受到伤害时进行防御可生成职业技能能量，生成速度提高。

205890336.name: Pulse Monitor
205890336.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
205890336.description_zh: 受伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

320071920.name: Pulse Monitor
320071920.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
320071920.description_zh: 轻伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

1546637391.name: Vorpal Weapon
1546637391.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.
1546637391.description_zh: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。

3418165135.name: Vorpal Weapon
3418165135.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.
3418165135.description_zh: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。提升稳定性。刀剑拥有更高的防御抗性。

2491817779.name: Prototype Trueseeker
2491817779.description: This weapon's rockets have tracking. Lock onto targets when aiming down sights. Landing hits with a full magazine grants ammo and boosts the next magazine with increased tracking strength, stability, fire rate, and cluster bombs.
2491817779.description_zh: 这款武器的火箭有追踪能力。瞄准时可锁定目标。弹匣全数命中目标可获得弹药并强化下一个弹匣，提升其追踪能力、稳定性、射速，并附带集束炸弹效果。

2144092201.name: Noble Rounds
2144092201.description: Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants. Absorbing a Remnant converts your next hipfired shot into an ally-seeking Noble Round and partially refills the magazine.
2144092201.description_zh: 使用武器完成击杀会留下遗灵。吸收一个遗灵可将你的下一次腰射转换成寻找盟友的高尚弹药，并填装部分弹匣。

2540536653.name: Ravenous Beast
2540536653.description:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage; defeating combatants or dealing damage to Scorched combatants grants increased progress.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Unleashes the beast when full, increasing outgoing damage and reducing incoming Solar damage.
2540536653.description_zh:
这款武器可在造成或受到伤害时储存能量；击败战斗人员或伤害灼烧状态的战斗人员可获得更多进度。
[替换武器动作]  ：蓄满后释放野兽，增加输出伤害并减少受到的烈日伤害。

4004944400.name: String of Curses
4004944400.description: Kills refill the magazine, increase damage for a short duration, and grant Super energy based on the strength of String of Curses. Fires full-auto.
4004944400.description_zh: 完成击杀可填装弹匣，并可在短时间内增加伤害，还可根据诅咒之绳的强度给予超能能量。全自动射击。

Contains 5 Bright Engrams, 3 Fireteam Medallions, and 250 Bright Dust.

236605015.name: Vanishing Execution
236605015.description: Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.
236605015.description_zh: 充能近战最后一击将赋予隐身并回复一部分生命值与护盾。终结技和对强大敌人的最后一击将增加隐身的时间与回复护盾及生命值的数量。

2951499542.name: Beacons of Empowerment
2951499542.description: Sol Invictus lasts twice as long. Allies who pass through your Sunspot are granted Sol Invictus and Restoration. Dealing sustained [Solar]Solar damage in a Sunspot extends the duration of the Sunspot. Applying Solar buffs to allies has a chance to create a Sunspot at your feet.
2951499542.description_zh: “无敌索尔”增益的持续时间加倍。经过你的太阳黑子的盟友会获得无敌索尔和恢复增益。在太阳黑子内造成持续烈日伤害可延长太阳黑子持续时间。为盟友施加烈日增益时有几率在脚下生成太阳黑子。

1211775759.name: Ascending Amplitude
1211775759.description: Stormtrance hits and final blows increase the damage it deals. Refunds Super energy when it ends. While Stormtrance is equipped, ability damage while amplified grants Bolt Charge.
1211775759.description_zh: 雷霆万钧命中和最后一击会提升其造成的伤害。技能结束后返还超能能量。装备雷霆万钧时，处于增幅状态下造成技能伤害可获得电光充能。

2362217257.name: Leviathan's Breath Catalyst
2362217257.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat combatants while using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Defeating high-tier Wrathborn with any weapon or ability will unlock this objective significantly faster.

使用任意武器或技能消灭高阶暴怒之子会使解锁此目标的速度显著加快。

1484442054.name: Monte Carlo Method
1484442054.description: Dealing damage with this weapon reduces your melee cooldown and grants a chance to fully charge your melee ability with each kill.
1484442054.description_zh: 使用此武器造成伤害可缩短近战技能冷却时间，并且让你有机会在每次击杀时充满你的近战技能。

1797707170.name: Judgment
1797707170.description: Sustained damage with this weapon envelops the target in a field that weakens and stuns them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
1797707170.description_zh: 此武器的持续伤害会将目标包围在一个可削弱并眩晕他们的区域。克制过载勇士。

411799453.name: Dark Deliverance
411799453.description:
Fires remotely detonated projectiles that drop Void orbs on combatants.
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
411799453.description_zh:
发射可远程引爆的弹药，向战斗人员投射虚空能量球。
[射击]  ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

3174300811.name: Looks Can Kill
3174300811.description: This weapon fires shield-piercing ammunition and comes with a scope. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Breaking a matched shield or piercing a Champion's barrier will cause the target to ignite.
3174300811.description_zh: 此武器可发射护盾穿透弹药且配有瞄准镜。克制屏障勇士。打破匹配的护盾或穿透勇士的屏障可对目标造成点燃效果。

1699724249.name: Big-Game Hunter
1699724249.description: Fires a massive heavy bolt that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
1699724249.description_zh: 发射一枚巨大的重型箭矢，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

3333994164.name: Dark Descent
3333994164.description: The further a Void orb falls, the more powerful its detonation becomes.
3333994164.description_zh: 虚空能量球下落的距离越长，它的爆炸威力就越强大。

2399646028.name: Leviathan's Sigh
2399646028.description: When fully drawn, the bolt creates a large concussive blast that knocks combatants back and makes them volatile.
2399646028.description_zh: 拉满弓后所射出的箭矢可以产生一次震荡大爆炸，击退战斗人员并造成不稳定状态。

3551326236.name: Rampage
3551326236.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.
3551326236.description_zh: 完成击杀可暂时性地提高武器伤害力。可叠加3次。

2814973067.name: Markov Chain
2814973067.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon. Melee kills grant ammo for this weapon.
2814973067.description_zh: 使用近战和此武器获得击杀，可提高此武器造成的伤害。近战击杀可为此武器恢复弹药。

1687327062.name: Death at First Glance
1687327062.description: Bonus damage when aiming down sights on the opening shot of an attack. This bonus is preserved if the shot deals precision damage or strikes an elemental shield.
1687327062.description_zh: 举枪瞄准时的第一发子弹造成额外伤害。如果射击造成精准伤害或击中元素护盾，此加成保持不变。

1185480639.name: Penance
1185480639.description: Targets under the effects of Judgment long enough are struck with a burst of damage.
1185480639.description_zh: 受审判效果影响时间足够长的目标会受到爆发性伤害。

1457434304.name: Never Live It Down
1457434304.flavor: "You think I can't fly a ship into the Black Garden?" —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
1457434304.lore:
Zavala: "He's late."

Ikora: "Zavala—"

Zavala: "Again."

Ikora: "Cayde has his… methods—"

Zavala: "His habits, you mean."

Ikora: "They get results. The Hunters and fireteams Cayde marshals would not be as effective under your command, and you know it, Zavala."

Zavala: "Yes, well, I just wish he'd exercise a little more—"

Cayde-6: "Who needs to exercise more? Maybe it's me, 'cause that… was a lot of stairs."

Zavala: "Cayde. I take it you had enough time to put together a report of your scouts' findings?"

Cayde-6: "A report? I didn't even bring a pencil."

Zavala: "Cayde, you know how important this is. The Kentarch 3 harbored a Cryptochron."

Ikora: "They're Warlocks, Zavala—fellow Guardians, not a disease."

Zavala: "And yet, you agreed to dismantle the order and banish them from the City."

Ikora: "After Osiris's exile, it had to be done. But they are still Guardians."

Cayde-6: "Oh boy, Mom and Dad are fighting again. Hey folks, how about I just give my report, and you two can argue about this later?"

Zavala: "Very well."

Ikora: "Fine."

Cayde-6: "Right. So their ship crashed after passing through the gate. From signs on the ground, their little Black Garden adventure didn't go so well after that. Huge Vex resistance. But then it looks like they turned on each other as they ran back to the gate."

Zavala: "Turned on each other? Are you certain?"

Cayde-6: "Zavala, they fought Vex, for sure. But that last fight? Just three Guardians, two against one. I put my best team on this—well, second best, but they're really good."

Ikora: "So what did they find?"

Cayde-6: "The fight went up a hill. One of them had the high ground."

Zavala: "Lisbon."

Cayde-6: "Seems like it. It took a lot of guts to charge a good sniper like him, especially without Ghosts."

Ikora: "Without Ghosts?"

Cayde-6: "Yeah. Pieces of two Ghosts were found near the entrance to the Undergrowth a few klicks away."

Zavala: "The battle started that far away?"

Cayde-6: "Eh… that's not so clear. It doesn't look like the actual scrap started until they got well away from there."

Ikora: "Cayde, this doesn't make a lot of sense."

Cayde-6: "Oh, I know. Wanna hear the weirdest part?"

Zavala: "Go on."

Cayde-6: "No bodies… Spooky, right?"

Zavala: "Your second-best team, you said?"
1457434304.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉：“他又……”

艾可拉：“萨瓦拉…”

萨瓦拉：“迟到了。”

艾可拉：“凯德有他的…办法……”

萨瓦拉：“你是想说，他的习惯。”

艾可拉：“他们能完成任务。在你的指挥下，凯德负责的那些猎人们和火力战队可没这么有效，你知道的，萨瓦拉。”

萨瓦拉：“好吧，我就是希望他有多锻炼……”

凯德6号：“谁要多锻炼？也许是我，因为这……楼梯太高了。”

萨瓦拉：“凯德。我想你有充足的时间从你那些斥候的“发现”里拼凑出一份报告吧？”

凯德6号：“报告？我甚至连笔都没带。”

萨瓦拉：“凯德，你知道这有多重要。第三百夫长庇护了一个隐者。”

艾可拉：“他们是术士，萨瓦拉……我们的同伴守护者，不是疾病。”

萨瓦拉：“与此同时，你却同意拆分教团，把他们从圣城里驱逐出去。”

艾可拉：“在奥斯里斯流放后，必须这样做。但他们仍然是守护者。”

凯德6号：“我的天，妈妈和爸爸又在吵架了。伙计们，要不让我先交报告，然后你们俩再接着吵？”

萨瓦拉：“很好。”

艾可拉：“好吧。”

凯德6号：“好吧。所以他们的飞船在经过大门后坠毁了。从地面信号来看，他们在那之后的黑暗花园之旅并不怎么顺利。遭到了很猛烈的Vex抵抗。但之后看起来他们相互反目，然后跑回了大门。”

萨瓦拉：“相互反目？你确定吗？”

凯德6号：“萨瓦拉，他们和Vex战斗，这是肯定的。但最后的那场战斗？只是三个守护者，二对一。我派出了最棒的队伍查这件事情，好吧，第二棒的，但他们仍然很棒。”

艾可拉：“他们发现了什么？”

凯德6号：“战斗在一个山上进行。其中一人占据了高地。”

萨瓦拉：“里斯本。”

凯德6号：“看起来像是的。要对一个他这样优秀的狙击手发起冲击，需要很大的勇气，尤其是没有机灵的情况下。”

艾可拉：“没有机灵？”

凯德6号：“是的。林下灌丛入口附近，大概几公里之外，发现了两架机灵的碎片。”

萨瓦拉：“战斗从那么远的地方就开始了？”

凯德6号：“呃……这个还不清楚。看起来实际的争斗是在离这里相当远的地方之后才开始的。”

艾可拉：“凯德，这个说不通。”

凯德6号：“我知道。想知道最诡异的事吗？”

萨瓦拉：“接着说。”

凯德6号：“没有尸体……很诡异吧？”

萨瓦拉：“你说你派出的是第二棒的队伍，你确定？”

1844314558.name: Parting Gift
1844314558.description:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Suppresses targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
1844314558.description_zh:
闪身会在原地留下一个延时引爆的爆炸装置，对周围目标造成伤害并基于你的超能元素施加次级效果：
•  致盲目标。
•  灼烧目标。
•  压制目标。
•  减速目标。
•  割裂目标。

1095471953.name: Embers of Light
1095471953.description: While a Solar Super is equipped, weapon final blows grant class ability energy. Defeating targets with your weapon while standing in a healing rift creates a pulse that grants Radiant to you and nearby allies; an empowering rift instead grants Cure to you and nearby allies. Daybreak final blows grant both effects.
1095471953.description_zh: 装备烈日超能时，武器最后一击可提供职业技能能量。站在治愈裂痕内用武器击败目标会生成脉冲，为你和附近盟友提供焕光；站在强能裂痕内则转而为你和附近盟友提供治愈。黎明最后一击同时提供两种效果。

3449001998.name: Spheromatik Trigger
3449001998.description: Powered melee final blows unleash a damaging explosion. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius and damage of the explosion.
3449001998.description_zh: 充能近战最后一击可制造一次爆炸。终结技和对强大敌人的最后一击可增加爆炸的伤害与范围。

4273298922.name: Bastion Catalyst
4273298922.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
4273298922.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

2732252706.name: Devil's Ruin Catalyst
2732252706.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2732252706.description_zh:

1186480754.name: Saint's Fists
1186480754.description:
Rapidly fires 3 spreads of pure force.

After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, reduced charge time, and improved reload speed for a short duration. Hitting a target with most of the pellets in a burst increases melee damage for a short duration.
1186480754.description_zh:
快速发射3束强力攻击。

成功的近战命中可让此武器在短时间内增加伤害，减少充能时间，并提升填装速度。使用大部分弹丸爆发击中目标可在短时间内提升近战伤害。

334466122.name: Close the Gap
334466122.description: Final blows create Firesprites. After picking up a Firesprite, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to enable a high-powered Solar laser beam mode. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
334466122.description_zh: 最后一击会生成焰灵。拾取焰灵后，[替换武器动作] 以启用高能烈日激光束模式。克制势不可挡勇士。

4185339856.name: Revolution

1430140002.name: Amnestia-S2
1430140002.lore:
For the last three weeks, the Guardian has been camping in a rusted-out shipping container, far off the main pathways that are always buzzing with Sparrows. He stays out of the way of other Guardians, and if he can't do that, he keeps his helmet on. Always.

All he has to his name is some beat up gear, a ring, and a silk sheet. Those are the things he woke up with. He wears the ring on a chain and keeps the sheet as a comforting reminder of something he can't remember. Sometimes he wears it draped over his shoulder. The fabric is so fine that it makes him think about the place he must've come from before this life, and how much nicer it is than where he is now.

He spends his days alone. Other Guardians are an unpredictable source of pain and confusion, and they see him the same way. Some react to him with outright hostility. Others are overcome by some personal and unexplained grief. He doesn't know why. That was the most painful lesson of being reborn: It's better to be alone. So he's always alone now, except for his Ghost.

One night, he sits with his head against his knees and listens to the distant snaps of gunfire. He hasn't seen anyone in about a week, but he can hear them. Somehow that makes the loneliness worse. More potent.

"Did you know," his Ghost says, bright but gentle. The purple glint of his shell reflects the half-light outside the crate. "That in the Last City, they are celebrating? They call it the Dawning. It is a celebration of friendship and hope and warmth."

The Guardian keeps his eyes closed and forces down his bitterness. The silence lingers between them, heavy and filled with unsaid things, until his Ghost gently bumps his shoulder. "To feel good, they say to each other: Happy Dawning."

Still, the Guardian says nothing, and his own silence makes him sick with himself. His Ghost has never doubted him. Never doubted anyone, really. He is a well of relentless optimism. And as infuriating as that is, it's also heartbreaking, and comforting, and a relief. The Guardian is not going to be the one to disappoint him.

There's been too much disappointment in this life already.

"Happy Dawning," he says.
1430140002.lore_zh:
在过去的三周，守护者一直在一个锈迹斑斑的集装箱里露营，远离那些总是充斥快雀轰鸣声的主干道。他远离其他守护者，如果没法远离的话，他就戴着头盔，总是如此。

他拥有的东西只有几件破旧不堪的装备，一个戒指，一张丝绸薄被。这些就是他醒来后所有的东西。他用一条链子串着戒指，把薄被当成是一种安慰的回忆，提醒他那些记不起的事。有的时候他会把薄被披在肩上。薄被的面料非常精致，他不禁思考在现在的生活之前，他来自什么样的地方，那个地方要比现在身处的地方好多少。

他整天都一个人独处。其他守护者是无法预测的痛苦和困惑的源头，他们也以同样的方式看待他。有些人对他表现出明显的敌意。其他人则被一些无法解释的个人悲伤所压倒。他也不知道为什么。这是重生后最痛苦的教训：独处会更好。所以他现在除了他的机灵，总是孤身一人。

有一天晚上，他的头顶着膝盖坐着，听着远方的枪声。他有一周没见过人了，但仍然可以听到他们。不知为何，这种孤独感更糟了。孤独更加强烈。

“你知道吗，”他的机灵说道，愉快而温柔。他外壳的紫色闪光，反射着箱子外的光。“圣城里，你知道他们正在庆祝吗？他们称之为曙光节。庆祝友谊，希望和温暖。”

守护者紧闭着双眼，强忍着苦涩。他们之间沉默蔓延，蔓延着没有言说的沉重，知道他的机灵轻轻触碰他的肩膀。“他们会相互说曙光节快乐，让大家都感觉开心点。”

但守护者仍然什么都没说，他的沉默让他对自己感到懊丧不已。他的机灵从来没有怀疑过他。事实上从来没有怀疑过任何人。他一直是个乐观主义者。这一点既让人生气，也令人心碎，安慰和释怀。守护者不会是让他失望的那个人。

这一生已经有太多失望了。

“曙光节快乐。”他说道。

1430140003.name: Sleepless Flight
1430140003.flavor: "We want people to be able to sleep easy, and that means we can't sleep at all. It's a responsibility I accepted a long time ago." —Abdi
1430140003.lore:
Eva welcomes troubled Guardians into her home all the time, but especially at this time of year.

She sees some that relax into the spirit of the holiday, like it's a well-fitting glove. They dance. They sing. They play games and give gifts and laugh. She doesn't need to worry about them. Even with all their burdens, they can find time to relax and celebrate, just for a little while.

There are others, though, who can't slow down. They see the decorations and ask, "Isn't it too soon to celebrate?" They know their work isn't over just because the Tower looks warmer than usual. They've seen all the cold out in the system that can't be reconciled with warm, cheerful traditions. They know, keenly, what's at stake. They want the people to be able to have these holidays, but they feel they can't participate—not when there's still so much to do. It's irresponsible.

These are the ones she seeks out, because they hang around the edges of the celebration, sullen or stunned or grieving. Some are sad. Some are angry. They lash out at her, but they always apologize. Some feel guilty, because they want to be part of it. They just can't let themselves.

Sometimes they can only participate through work, and so she gives it to them. Other times, all she does is talk to them and then, implicitly, gives them permission to stand on the sidelines, if that's what they really want. But she reminds them that the Dawning—and the Festival of the Lost, and the Solstice, and the Revelry—will always welcome them back when they're finally able to stop and take a breath. She hopes that day comes soon.
1430140003.lore_zh:
伊娃随时都欢迎备受困扰的守护者去她家，尤其是每年的这个时候。

她看到一些可以活跃融入到节日气氛中的人，就像，那是尺寸合适的手套。他们跳舞，唱歌，他们玩着游戏，赠送礼物，开怀大笑。她不需要担心他们。即使重任在神，他们可以有片刻的时间放松和庆祝。

但也有“其他人”，没人能让他们放缓脚步。他们看着装饰问道，“现在庆祝是不是太早了？”他们知道他们的工作还没有结束，只是因为高塔看起来比平时更温暖。他们见过星系里其他地方的寒冷，那是温暖和欢乐的庆祝也无法缓解的寒冷。他们敏锐地知道，危险是什么。他们想让人们能够拥有这些节日，但觉得自己不能参与——尤其是要做的事太多，这是不负责任的。

这些是她要找的人，因为他们都游离在庆祝的边缘，要么愁眉苦脸，要么错愕不已，要么一脸悲伤。有些人悲伤，有些人生气。他们讽刺了她，但他们总会道歉。有些人觉得内疚，因为他们也想参与其中。他们只是无法让自己加入。

有时他们只能借助工作参与，她也把东西给他们。其他时候，她所做的只是和他们说说话，然后暗示他们可以站在场外，如果他们真正想要的话。但她在曙光节，还有英灵日，至日以及狂欢节的时候，都提醒他们，当最终他们可以停下来喘口气的时候，都欢迎他们随时回来加入节日活动。她希望那一天能够早日到来。

430387801.name: Chrysopelea-S
430387801.flavor: Out of the grass. Into the sky.
430387801.lore:
Sure, we've had you covered on the ground with our impressive arsenal of apex munitions for some time, but VEIST recognizes when it's time to step up the game.

Now, we're elevating the fight to new horizons with our Chrysopelea-S, possessing all the attributes you've come to expect from the Last City's leading foundry. This noxious wonder makes the skies friendly again, with weapons-grade onboard AI, defensive lateral undulation flight patterns, and a cockpit cozier than a hug from a python.

Your enemies (probably your friends too) will be seething with jealousy when you take off faster than a Viper's strike. Shed your old ride and slide into the Chrysopelea-S. It'll feel like a brand new skin.
430387801.lore_zh:
当然，我们已经用我们强大的顶级武备为你在地面上掩护了一段时间，但VEIST意识到是时候开始行动了。

现在，我们通过我们的金花蛇-S将战斗提升到新的境界，拥有你对圣城领先的铸造场所期待的所有属性。这个毒性的奇迹让天空再次变得友好，配备武器级的机载AI，防御性的横向波动飞行模式，还有比蟒蛇的拥抱更舒适的驾驶舱。

你的敌人（很可能你的朋友也是）看到你起飞比蝰蛇打击还快时，肯定会嫉妒不已。摆脱你的旧座驾，进入这款金花蛇-S里，感觉会像是全新的肌肤。

430387802.name: The Prod
430387802.lore:
Feeling stuck, partner?

Introducing Tex Mechanica's latest foray into hardware, the Prod. We live and die by the standards set here at Tex. We don't rest on our laurels, like some other foundries might. As we continue to look to the past, we gain inspiration to build better futures. The Tex Mechanica brand means quality, reliability, and power that sends vermin fleeing.

Whether you're roaming the cold loneliness of space or blasting some meddling Dreg back where it came from, we know you'll feel safer and stronger using authentic Tex-made machinery.

Rest those weary eyes, Guardian. You're riding with Tex now.
430387802.lore_zh:
伙计，感觉被卡住了？

硬件引进了特克斯机械最新技术，尖刺。无论生死，我们都遵照特克斯所设立的标准。我们不会像其他铸造场一样满足现有的荣誉。在回望过去的同时，我们会获得灵感，展望更好的未来。特克斯机械品牌意味着高质、稳定，以及让害虫望风而逃的力量。

无论你是否独自漫游在太空中把捣乱的堕落士兵轰回老家，我们都知道，使用真正的特克斯制造的机械，你会感觉更安全，更强大。

让疲倦的双眼休息下吧，守护者。你现在乘坐的是特克斯产品。

430387803.name: Tachyon-4
430387803.lore:
These days, it seems like everyone is getting into the ship business. While they deliberate performance, we actually deliver.

We've been working tirelessly to produce generation-bending technology that's not only leveraging reliable Golden Age tech, but is also brave enough to pioneer the roadmap for the future.

Omolon is proud to present Tachyon-4, the first interstellar ship with our proprietary liquid-cooled dual engines. They do all the work while you travel at near superluminal speeds* enjoying this sensationally sleek ride.

Now you can look as cool as our engines run—and save the universe while you're at it.

Tachyon-4. For the future.

*Disclaimer: IN NO EVENT WILL OMOLON BE LIABLE FOR ANY LOST PROFITS, INDIRECT DAMAGES, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, HOWEVER CAUSED AND REGARDLESS OF THEORY OF LIABILITY, STEMMING FROM THE USE OF OR INABILITY TO USE THE TACHYON-4. ACTUAL SHIP SPEED MAY VARY.
430387803.lore_zh:
如今似乎所有人都在涉足飞船业务。他们考虑性能的时候，我们已经交付了实际的产品。

我们一直不懈努力，生产跨时代的技术，不仅利用可靠的黄金时代的技术，还勇于开拓未来的路线图。

Omolon很荣幸能带来光子-4，配备我们专利液冷双引擎的第一款星际飞船。当你以接近超光速*飞行时它们会搞定所有的工作，让您享受平滑旅行。

现在你可以和我们引擎运行时一样酷，然后顺便解救整个宇宙。

光子-4。为了未来。

*免责声明：OMOLON在任何情况下均不会对任何由于光子-4的使用或无法使用而造成的利润损失、间接损害或继发性损害而承担责任，无论该损害是如何造成也无论责任归属，OMOLON均不承担责任。飞船实际速度可能会有所变化。

430387804.name: Saint's Invocation
430387804.lore:
"A ship can be more than fancy machinery and a means of transportation.

"It can be a destination in and of itself. A place of serenity. In times of war, those places are few and far between. Cherish the time in between battles. Allow yourself time to decompress, relax your mind and loosen your grip. Recharge. Those moments don't last long, but offer enough time for reflection and preparation.

"Perhaps cleaning up an overstocked inventory is a cathartic act for you, Guardian. A short meditative stretch or simply resting one's eyes can afford you the clarity you'll need to stay sharp and focused on the battlefield.

"Whatever that may be for you, be sure to grant yourself the break you need. Appreciate the momentary respite. May it be a reminder of the peace we hope to bring to the Last City."

—Saint-14
430387804.lore_zh:
“飞船不仅仅只是炫酷的机器和交通方式。

“飞船本身就是目的地。一个宁静所在。在战争的年代，这种地方极少，而且距离遥远。在战斗之间珍惜这个宁静的片刻时光。让你自己独处的时刻能够减压，放松心情，舒缓紧张。再次充能。这些时刻不会太久，但能够提供足够的时间供你沉思和准备。

“也许清理积压的库存物品对你来说是种宣泄，守护者。短暂的冥想延伸，哪怕简单让眼睛休息下，就能让你在战场保持锐利和专注。

“不论如何，不要忘记给自己休息。珍惜这短暂的喘息机会。也提醒我们想要带给圣城的宁静。”

——圣人14号

• Reduced flinch from incoming fire

·减少收到伤害时的屏幕抖动

3927691568.name: Nano Redux
3927691568.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Raiden Flux. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3927691568.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变雷电通流的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

879895999.name: Huskcrushers
879895999.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Dunemarchers. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
879895999.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变沙丘行者的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3505404632.name: Diadem of Deceit
3505404632.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Crown of Tempests. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3505404632.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变风暴头冠的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

4251375227.name: Mobius Conduit
4251375227.description: Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning on all nearby targets, jolting them while also amplifying allies. Defeating Arc debuffed targets grants a small amount of Gathering Storm energy.
4251375227.description_zh: 激活风起云涌会召唤闪电攻击附近所有目标，震颤他们的同时增幅盟友。击败受到电弧减益的目标会提供少量的风起云涌能量。

1828251441.name: Assault Barricade
1828251441.description: You and allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade. Your Towering Barricade takes increased damage from Guardians.
1828251441.description_zh: 你和盟友可以穿过你的巍峨屏障进行射击。你的巍峨屏障受到的守护者伤害会增加。

622433369.name: Warlord's End
622433369.description: Powered melee hits weaken targets. Powered melee final blows create a burst of energy that dramatically weakens nearby targets. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius of the burst and the length of the weakening effect.
622433369.description_zh: 充能近战命中会削弱目标。充能近战最后一击可制造一次能量爆发，大幅削弱附近的敌人。对强大目标的终结技和最后一击会增加爆发的范围和削弱效果的持续时间。

302488496.name: Spirit of Competition
302488496.description: During Guardian Games 2020, completing Crucible matches, Gambit matches, Vanguard strikes, patrols, adventures, and forges grants additional Glimmer and XP rewards.
302488496.description_zh: 在守护者游戏2020期间，完成熔炉竞技场比赛、智谋比赛、先锋打击、巡逻、冒险、锻炉以获取额外的微光和经验奖励。

10656656.name: Torch Light
10656656.flavor: Torches: recommended for adventurers and evil castles.

2007350539.name: Carry The Load
2007350539.flavor: Let's take a trip across the EDZ.

2737290434.name: Master Chef
2737290434.flavor: Welcome to "Cooking with Light: How to Stay Trim and Eat Well."

2144724879.name: Patty Cake
2144724879.flavor: How does this get us cake?

3736949607.name: Taunt and Flaunt
3736949607.flavor: Too smooth to lose. Too slick to quit.

2270918090.name: I Surrender!
2270918090.flavor: Relax! It was just a prank!

3245326556.name: Infinity Cubes
3245326556.flavor: In one of these timelines there must be a solution…

213458862.name: One… Two… Uh…
213458862.flavor: Four shalt thou not count, neither count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out…

3973089432.name: All Right, Let's GO!
3973089432.flavor: Get a move on, little doggy.

648966840.name: Premium Hunter Rewards
648966840.description: A bundle of rewards for Guardians who activate the Season Pass.
648966840.description_zh: 激活季票的守护者的奖励包裹。

1060399716.name: Premium Titan Rewards

1344380113.name: Additional Rewards
1344380113.description: Rewards earned as you level the Season Pass. Includes weapon ornaments, universal armor ornaments, and more.
1344380113.description_zh: 你升级季票的过程中获得的奖励。包括武器皮肤、通用护甲皮肤等。

1692586900.name: Season of the Worthy Starter Pack
1692586900.description:
A one-time pack to kick off Season of the Worthy.

Contains 2 exclusive items, 5 consumables, and Bright Dust.
1692586900.description_zh:
为开启英杰赛季而准备的包裹，仅可购买一次。

包含2个专用物品、5个消耗品和光尘。

1397382690.description:

Pack price reduced for each item you already own.

若已拥有其中部分物品，则包裹价格相应下降。

3030850318.name: Tatarstan
3030850318.lore:
"OK, Red. Back it up. These 'Seraphs' you keep referencing—what were they?"

::They were all things to me. Everything I required.::

"That… doesn't help. What were these Seraphs for? These files suggest that you built and stored planetary combat platforms for 'seven Seraphs.' I thought the Golden Age was a time of peace."

::It was a time of peace.::

"This is a lot of firepower, Red."

::Swords keep peace.::

"And this armor—even a Guardian wouldn't turn this down."

::They protected me. I protected them.::

"The Seraphs are gone now?"

::Everything is gone.::

"So those blades you gave to the Guardians belonged to the Seraphs."

::Yes.::

"You trust them?"

::Everything is gone.::
3030850318.lore_zh:
“好的，小红。备份起来。你一直说的这些‘炽天使'…到底是什么？”

::对我来说他们曾是一切。我曾经需要的一切。::

“这个…并不能解释清楚啊。这些炽天使是干嘛的？这些文件显示，你为‘七个炽天使'建造和存储了行星战斗平台。我还以为黄金时代是个和平的时代。”

::确实曾是个和平的时代。::

“这可是很强大的火力，小红。”

::利剑才能维持和平。::

“这个护甲——即使守护者也没办法击破。”

::它们保护着我。我也保护着他们。::

“炽天使现在不在了吗？”

::一切都不在了。::

“那么你给守护者的这些利刃，曾经是属于炽天使的。”

::是的。::

“你相信他们？”

::一切都不在了。::

1205148160.name: The Underdog
1205148160.flavor: Kicked, starved, or scorned, I always get up. I always go on.
1205148160.lore:
Hawthorne walked through the courtyard, her eyes trained on Zavala. He stood looking out over the City, but turned as she approached. "Suraya," he said, inclining his head.

"I want to compete in the Guardian Games," she said.

Zavala paused. "Ah," he began. "Well, I'd imagined them as being…" He studied the unchanging expression on her face: expectant, determined, prepared for an argument. "For Guardians."

"I've seen the events," she said. "I can't do them all, but some don't seem Guardian-exclusive. I can collect resources. I can clear out Lost Sectors. Don't need to be a Guardian for that."

"True," Zavala said. "But…"

Hawthorne leaned close to him and dropped her voice. "When we were taking back the City, you said…"

"I remember what I said," Zavala murmured.

"You called me 'Guardian.' So?"

Zavala folded his arms behind his back and shifted his weight. "Which team would you fight for?"

"None of them," she said, then paused. "All of them."

"You have to choose."

Hawthorne crossed her arms. She studied Zavala. "Titans."

Zavala opened his mouth, then closed it again. "I'm not going to FORBID it, but…"

"Great," Hawthorne said, turning to go. "See you at the award ceremony."
1205148160.lore_zh:
霍桑步行走过庭院，她的双眼紧盯着萨瓦拉。他站在那里眺望着整座城市，当她靠近的时候转过身来。“苏拉娅，”他微微颔首说道，

“我想参加守护者游戏的竞争。”她说道。

萨瓦拉顿住了。“啊，”他开始说道，“好吧，我想那是作为……”他研究者她脸上不变的表情：期望，坚定，准备好了进行辩论。“守护者参加的。”

“我看过他们的活动。”她说道，“我也许不能全部参加，但有些活动似乎并不是守护者专属的。我可以收集资源，我可以清理遗失区域。这些不需要守护者也可以做。”

“确实如此，”萨瓦拉说道，“但是……”

霍桑靠近他，放低了声音。“当我们夺回这座城市的时候，你说过……”

“我记得我说过什么。”萨瓦拉喃喃自语道。

“你称呼我为‘守护者'。所以呢？”

萨瓦拉双臂交叉在身后，改变了身体重心。“你要为哪支队伍而战？”

“谁都不为。”她说着，然后顿了顿。“为所有人。”

“你必须选择。”

霍桑交叉了双臂，她盯着萨瓦拉。“泰坦。”

萨瓦拉张了张嘴，然后又闭上。“我不会阻止，但……”

“很好。”霍桑说道，转身就走。“颁奖礼时再见。”

1205148161.name: Team Spirit
1205148161.lore:
"I thought you were against me competing in the Games," Hawthorne said, leaning against one of the wooden supports in the barn. They'd just come back from the Weep, and her exhaustion was catching up with her. The light was starting to fade, too. "Thought it was 'only for Guardians.'"

"Semantics," Zavala said. He stood over a map laid out on a wooden table. "And that was before you pushed us into the lead for Lost Sector clearance." He pointed at a place on the map. "What do you think? Our next point of attack."

Hawthorne sighed. "Maybe tomorrow?"

"Titans never rest," Zavala said gravely.

Hawthorne eyed him, then leaned forward to peer at the map. "Yeah," she murmured. "Yeah, I could get in there, especially with the dark to cover me. There's a couple good sniping perches in that cave. If you go in as the heavy…"

"You can cover me."

"Right." Hawthorne grinned. "You know, maybe 'we' Titans have this thing in the bag."

"Oh, we do," Zavala said, studying the map. "We most certainly do."
1205148161.lore_zh:
“我还以为你反对我参加比赛。”霍桑说着，靠在谷仓的一根木头柱子上。他们刚刚从泪地回来，她的倦意正逐渐涌上来。光也开始变得暗淡。“还以为只是面对守护者。”

“文字游戏。”萨瓦拉说道。他站在一个木桌上摊开的地图前。“那是在你迫使我们成为清理遗失区域的领头羊之前。”他指着地图上的一个地方。“你怎么看？关于我们下一个进攻点。”

霍桑叹了口气。“也许放在明天？”

“泰坦从不休息。”萨瓦拉郑重说道。

霍桑看了他一眼，然后附身盯着地图。“是啊。”她低声道。“是的，我可以进入那里，尤其是有黑暗掩护的情况下。那个洞里有几个很好的狙击手栖身点。如果你进去作为……”

“你可以掩护我。”

“好的。”霍桑咧嘴笑了。“你知道，也许我们‘泰坦'足够搞定这个了。”

“理所当然。”萨瓦拉一边研究着地图一边说道。“绝无问题。”

3528646495.name: Obsidian Wings
3528646495.lore:
Lord Felwinter inserted his hands into the piloting board, and the lights in the ship's cabin bloomed to life.

"How did you find it?" he asked his Ghost.

"I hacked a Rasputin bunker," Felspring said, shaking her shell. "This time along the coast of Varuna."

"The drive is fully functional," Felwinter noted. "We can escape orbit with this."

"We can get all the way across the system with this," Felspring replied.

The Exo's eyes blazed inside his sleek, black skull. He sat listening to the hum of the ship's mechanics.

"You've fought this fight a long time," Felspring continued. "We can plot a course around the Warsat network. We'd never have to touch a single planet with a Warmind presence. Any of them."

"We've gotten very good at hiding," Felwinter said.

"Yes."

"You would leave the Iron Lords to fend for themselves?"

"Would you?"

Felwinter released his hold on the piloting board in response, and the ship shuddered and died. The Exo turned his seat around, lowered the landing ramp, and descended, his greatcoat trailing behind him.

"You've changed," Felspring said.

"So have you," Felwinter replied.
3528646495.lore_zh:
领主邪冬把手插入到驾驶板中，飞船舱内的灯光亮了起来。

“你怎么找到的？”他问他的机灵。

“我入侵了拉斯普廷的地堡。”邪春说道，摇了摇她的机壳。“这一次沿着维纶娜的海岸。”

“驾驶功能完好无损。”邪冬说道，“我们可以用这个逃离轨道。”

“我们可以用它横穿整个星系。”邪春回答道。

Exo的双眼在他黑色的闪亮的外壳中闪闪发光。他坐下来听着飞船机械的轰鸣声。

“这场战争你已经打了很久。”邪春继续说道，“我们可以沿着战争卫星的网络规划一条路径。我们可以避开战争思维所在的任何星球。所有的。”

“我们已经变得非常擅长躲避了。”邪冬说道。

“是的。”

“你就让钢铁领主们自生自灭？”

“你会吗？”

邪冬放开了握着驾驶板的手作为回应，飞船颤抖了下然后熄火了。Exo转了下椅子，放下登陆架走了下来，他的外衣在身后跟随者他。

“你变了。”邪春说道。

“你也是。”邪冬回道。

3528646494.name: Waking Nightmare
3528646494.flavor: "As Darkness approaches, my vision grows clearer." —Eris Morn
3528646494.lore:
Ikora,

The Nightmares continue to haunt us all. But we are fighting back. Taking power from them. Using the strength gained to fuel our crusade against the Darkness.

I'm coming to understand what the costs will be. It will take more than many are willing to give to overcome this threat. The road ahead is treacherous and presents unforeseen challenges. Steel yourself.

I still believe in a future where our pain and hardship was not in vain.

We will make our trauma theirs. They will know what it means to suffer.

Clarity in action,
Eris Morn
3528646494.lore_zh:
艾可拉，

梦魇还在缠绕着我们所有人。但我们也在奋力还击。从他们身上夺取力量。使用获得的力量为我们对抗黑暗的圣战提供能量。

我开始逐渐明白代价将会是什么。要克服这一威胁，需要比很多愿意付出更大的代价。前方的路充满荆棘，还会有许多未知的挑战。请你保持坚强如钢铁。

我仍然相信，在未来，我们的痛苦和艰难不会白费。

我们所遭受的痛苦将加倍奉还。他们将会明白什么是真正的痛苦。

行动清晰，
埃里斯·摩恩

3528646493.name: NS81 Reprisal Sprint
3528646493.flavor: "Hey, hey, don't give up! Everything you ever wanted's on the other side of tomorrow." —Cayde-6
3528646493.lore:
"How's the Warmind effort going?" Amanda asks, elbow deep in the guts of a jumpship. She can't see Zavala, but she knows it's him. He visits her here sometimes when things are quiet. Hands her tools. Talks about the early days of the City. Makes jabs about how he remembers when she was "yea high."

"Well enough," he says. He sounds tired, but he always does now. Ever since the Red War. "We'll make it through this. We always do."

"You sound like Cayde," she says, smiling. Optimistic, almost nonchalant.

When Zavala doesn't say anything, she crawls out from under the ship and wipes her hands on her pants. "A lot's happened around here since then, huh?" she says, searching his face. "The Tower's seen a lot of changes. Some new faces."

"Old ones, as well," Zavala says, looking over to the place where Saint-14 usually stands.

Amanda nods. "Hard pill to swallow," she says softly. "That some people can come back…"

"And others can't," Zavala says, almost too quiet to hear.
 
They don't say anything. Amanda wipes at her eye with the back of her hand, leaving a streak of grease across her cheek. 

"You've earned a break," he says abruptly. "Maybe something to eat. Maybe…"

"Ramen," she says immediately. She doesn't have to think about it.

Zavala smiles, sad but warm. "My thoughts exactly."
3528646493.lore_zh:
“战争思维那边的尝试怎么样？”阿曼达胳膊肘放在跃迁飞船的里问到。她看不到萨尔瓦拉，但知道是他。有时在安静的时候，他会拜访她。交给她工具。和她谈论城里往日的时光。他如何记起她说“耶嗨”的样子。

“够了，”他说道。他听起来很累，但他现在经常如此。自从猩红战争之后就是如此。“我们会度过这次难关的。我们每次都能。”

“你说话好像凯德。”她微笑说道。乐观，几乎漠不关心。

当萨瓦拉什么都不说的时候，她从飞船下爬出来，在裤子上擦了擦手。“从那以后，这里发生了太多事，是吧？”她一边说着，一边盯着他的脸。“高塔见证了了许多的变化，也有一些新面孔。”

“还有些老面孔。”萨瓦拉说道，看着圣人14号经常站的地方。

阿曼达点点头。“苦涩难以下咽，”她轻声说道。“有些人回来了……”

“有些人却再也回不来了。”萨瓦拉以几乎细不可闻的声音说道。

他们什么都没再说。阿曼达用手背擦了擦眼睛，脸颊留下一道润滑油的痕迹。

“你该休息了。”他突然说道。“也许该吃些东西。也许……”

“拉面。”她立即说道。她完全不需要考虑。

萨瓦拉笑了，悲伤而温暖。“我也这么想。”

3528646492.name: Solar Sails
3528646492.flavor: It's going to be a long, cold ride.
3528646492.lore:
"What did they find out there?"

"Everyone's being tight-lipped. Whatever it is, it's important enough to drag us out here. We're not the only ones, either."

"Wish we were going to Titan instead. Hell, anywhere but Europa. Was hoping not to spend my summer on a frozen tundra."

"Hey, I get it. We just got a new pool. Now Dave's going to be stuck cleaning it."

"We'll have to bring the kids over when we get back. Hopefully this is a quick turnaround."

 "Doubt it. This feels big. I heard even the old man himself is there."

"Crap. Really? Another one of his pet projects?"

"Aren't they all at this point?"

"I wish that guy would take a break."

"He's not happy unless he's broken some natural law and made us all complicit."

"I may start looking for other work."

"Yeah…"
3528646492.lore_zh:
“他们在那里发现了什么？”

“所有人都守口如瓶。不管是什么，都足够重要到把我们都拉到这里来。我们也不是唯一来这里的。”

“希望我们能去土卫六。见鬼，除了木卫二，哪里都行。我原本还想在个冰冻荒原上过夏天。”

“嘿，我明白。我们有了个新工具。现在戴夫要忙着清理了。”

“我们回来的时候，必须要把孩子们带回来。希望这次能快速周转。”

“我很怀疑。这次感觉事情很大。我听说老家伙自己都来了。”

“该死。真的吗？他的又一个宠物计划？”

“他们现在不都在这事情上吗？”

“希望那家伙能休息下。”

“除非打破一些自然法则，而且让我们参与其中，否则他不会高兴。”

“我也许该开始找其他工作了。”

“是啊……”

3528646491.name: Arrow of Time
3528646491.flavor: We must continue to move forward, even if it means aiming backward.
3528646491.lore:
"I've seen through time. To say I understand its intricate machinations would be folly. It's too complex and incomprehensible to be taken as a whole. Its eternal vastness has nearly unhinged my mind.

"There are moments, though—fixed positions—where I've seen the impact we have made. The outcome is not as stochastic as we think. The cause, the effect, and the triumph of our continued sacrifices becomes more evident with each passing day. We are making a difference.

"The threat from the Darkness is substantive. I've witnessed too much to be swayed against that irrefutable truth. The deniers will one day have nothing left to deny. The collision course is set.

"For now, press on. Be unrelenting. I already know you will be."

—Osiris
3528646491.lore_zh:
“我看过时间的长河，要是硕我能理解它错综复杂的诡计，那无疑是蠢话。它太复杂和难以理解，无法将其作为整体思考。他永恒的辽阔几乎让我心烦意乱。

“但有些时候，，一些固定的位置，我看到因我们而造成的影响。结果并非我们想的那样随机。我们不断牺牲的事业、影响和胜利，日复一日都越加明显。我们正在不断产生影响。

“来自黑暗的威胁真实存在。我目睹了太多，无法对这个无可辩驳的事实动摇。拒绝承认这件事的人，终有一天将无话可说。碰撞的路径早已定好。

“现在，继续前进。百折不挠。我知道你们会的。”

——奥斯里斯

3528646489.name: Saint's Vocation
3528646489.flavor: A new chance. A new calling.
3528646489.lore:
Saint,

I regret that we must once again part ways so soon after your return. Knowing you are there to watch over the Trials assuages my concerns and is the only reason I feel comfortable departing on this urgent mission. I must leave you with a monition, though. Be forewarned, the former custodian of the Lighthouse was delving into dangerous territory. The Lighthouses are not what they seem. They may bring a ruin upon us that we have no answer for. They may also be innocuous, but you know their architects as well as I. Lean toward caution. I urge a careful eye and ear. Their final intent is not known to me. 

I will return. I look forward to our reunion. Stay vigilant.

Yours, in time,
Osiris
3528646489.lore_zh:
圣人，

我感到遗憾的是，在你回来后，我们必须再一次分道扬镳。知道你在那里观察着试炼，这让我的担忧得以缓解，这也是我能放心离开去完成这项紧急任务的原因。但我还是必须要给你一个忠告。你要注意，灯塔的前监护人正在深入危险区域。灯塔不是看起来的样子。它们可能会给我们带来无法应付的毁灭。它们可能是无害的，但你对他们建筑师的了解和我一样。务必小心。一定要注意观察和倾听。他们最终的意图，我尚且还不知道。

我会回来的。非常期待我们的重聚。保持警惕。

你诚挚的，时光中的，
奥斯里斯

873720784.flavor: From a whisper to a roar, be the calm and the storm.
873720784.typeName_zh: 普通 猎人分支职业
873720784.lore:
A Fallen Captain stalks his prey through the barrens of Europa, Servitor at his back. The wind kicks up shimmering plumes of frost; he doesn't see the frozen kama hurtling towards him. It strikes with a deafening crack; the Servitor is gone. The Captain flees for cover, but it's too late — he is frozen in a crystalline prison.

His battle cry freezes in his throat; there is only deafening silence. He sees a shadow approaching, cloaked in the ice and whirling snow, but it vanishes as quickly as it appeared. Fear grips him as he scans the white wastes.

A second kama pierces the ice shelf. Biting whirlwinds erupt and tear at his frozen body. He catches a glimpse of the shadow in the squall, rifle in hand. The hunt has ended; he shatters in the wind.
873720784.lore_zh:
一位堕落者队长在木卫二的荒原上跟踪他的猎物，他的身后跟着一只魔眼。他没有注意到，风吹起的霜羽向他疾速飘来。夹杂着一阵风雷之声，魔眼转眼便消失了。队长立刻躲进了掩体，但为时已晚，整个人被冻成了一根冰柱。

他的战吼卡在喉咙中没有喊出来；唯有震耳欲聋的寂静。他看到一个阴影在靠近，包裹在冰雪旋风之中，但它的出现和消失都极为迅速。在他扫描白色垃圾堆的同时，恐惧笼罩了他。

第二阵风夹杂着碎裂的冰渣袭来，撕扯他冻僵的身体。他手握步枪，望着眼前那团黑影，就这样碎裂在风中。

613647804.name: Behemoth
613647804.flavor: Particle or planet, it all shatters with enough force.
613647804.typeName_zh: 普通 泰坦分支职业
613647804.lore:
The ground ruptured and sizzled as Scorch Cannons and Wire Rifles pummeled my cover from all directions. Fallen war cries echoed through their endless ranks; despair grew within me, but with it came a whisper. An offer. I closed my eyes and accepted.

The cold embraced me, dimming the sounds of battle into reverberant echoes, thin and distant. I flexed my gauntlets and felt the roar of glaciers grinding against the bones of the world.

I crashed my fists into the earth and frozen obelisks erupted, encasing Dregs and Vandals into helpless effigies. I gazed through the crystals enveloping my enemies, and in the myriad refractions, I saw their fear. I felt their desperate will to escape my grip, and in the moment before release, I shattered it.
613647804.lore_zh:
大炮和光线步枪从四面八方向我的掩体猛烈射击，灼热的地面碎裂开来，扭曲了周围的空气。数不清的堕落者令人胆寒的怒吼在战场上回荡；绝望在我内心滋生，但随之而来的是一阵耳语声。一份提议。我闭上眼睛，接受了。寒冷拥抱着我，将战斗的声音逐渐变成细碎而遥远的回响。我握紧双拳，感受着冰冷碾压浑身的骨骼。

我一拳砸向大地，寒气喷薄而出，将那些堕落士兵和暴徒包裹成冰冷的雕像。透过冰晶我观察那些敌人，看到了他们恐惧的面容，感受到他们想要拼命摆脱束缚的绝望...没等他们挣脱，我便一拳把他们打成了碎屑。

3291545503.name: Shadebinder
3291545503.flavor: Reality is chaotic and unruly; bind it and bring order.
3291545503.typeName_zh: 普通 术士分支职业
3291545503.lore:
I first heard it in the Thrall-carved tunnels on Callisto as I saw Light torn from my friend: a chaotic chime like breaking glass, ringing in the corners of my mind. I ignored it then and burned the Hive vermin with vengeance and fire.

But it returned when Ghaul's wicked contraption gripped the Traveler and the Light fled from my bones: a cold chorus in my ears, a shattered song demanding to be heard. I clung to it then, shivering in the rubble of the Last City. It drowned out the marching of Centurions and focused my will to survive.

It was in the shadow of the Pyramid on Europa that I finally understood. What was noise became a chilling harmony born of dissonance, a structure I could finally grasp. I joined the song, and as my voice perfected the chord my hands gripped a staff of ice—chaos given shape. It sealed my hands in rime, and the song resonated through my flesh. I was its instrument, and it was mine; when we sang "be still" to the world, it would obey.
3291545503.lore_zh:
我第一次听到它是在卡丽斯托，一个怨魂雕凿的隧道里。我身边的朋友被一阵光能撕裂，而我的脑子里突然像是有无数玻璃碎裂一般。但我无暇顾及，复仇的怒火驱使着我杀光那些邪魔族。

后来在盖欧用某个装置抓捕旅行者时，那种感觉又出现了，就像是光能从我的骨子里被抽了出去：我的耳朵里响起冰冷的歌声，断断续续，又那么清晰。我当时惊慌失措，躲在废墟中瑟瑟发抖。让我无暇顾及身边的一切，生存本能被最大限度地激发了出来。

后来在木卫二金字塔的阴影之下我彻底明白了。原本那些噪音变得诡异地和谐起来，我也开始可以跟它产生共鸣。我将自己融入歌曲之中，轻声跟着哼唱起来，一根冰杖从混沌之中凭空显现。在我的手跟冰杖接触的一瞬间，也被冰块牢牢封在里面。歌声让我的肉体更加强悍。我是它的工具，它也能为我所用。当我们齐声向这个世界歌唱时，世界也要向我们臣服。

318471196.name: Any Other Sky
318471196.source: Source: Earned as a Deluxe Edition bonus.
318471196.lore:
I'm back at the start. It's always confusing, even on my third (fourth?) time around. There's Cayde-6. Zavala. Ikora. The parade. I can't waste time here. Too many lost moments. I need to… find… whom? Damn it. Think. Ana? No. Who?!

Or is it… what?

I'm so disoriented. I remember pieces of past attempts, but not every detail. There has to be something I can do to make the refresh easier. Maybe new gear or tech. If my family's legacy has anything to offer, it's technological advancements. When I wake up, I need something familiar to ground me. Something I can carry back with me. It could be small. I need to think ahead. Plan more.

Even though I seem to have an endless supply of it, time is still a precious commodity. The more time squandered, the more likely I am to repeat the mistakes of past attempts. I do remember trying to warn the Vanguard. They regarded me as another doomsayer and had me promptly removed from the Tower. I'm sure I sounded like a raving lunatic. By the time I was proved right, it was too late. Eris was corrupted, like always. Drifter lost to his hopeless pursuit. No one believes me. No one trusts me. I need to stick to the shadows.

Something is happening around this time that's preventing me from making a discernible impact. Somewhere, there is the key to stopping this. I will find it.

I've been given an opportunity to right the wrongs of this world. Instead of hurtling headfirst without a plan, I'll stock up. This time, I'm going to focus on making the next cycle better. Let's call this one a wash. I'll save you next time, Ana. Cheers.
318471196.lore_zh:
我又回到了起点。这总是让人困惑，即使这是我的第三次（第四次？）轮回。有凯德6号，萨瓦拉，艾可拉。游行。我不能在这里浪费时间。太多遗失的时刻。我需要……找到……谁来着？该死！好好想想。阿娜？不，是谁？！

还是……什么东西？

我很迷茫。我记得过去尝试的片段，但记不住每个细节。一定有什么办法，能让这种刷新更加容易。也许是新的装备或技术。如果我的家庭传统有什么好东西，那就是科技的进步。当我醒来的时候，我需要一些熟悉的东西来支撑我。一些我可以随身带回去的东西。可以是很小的东西。我要提前想好，做好计划。

尽管我似乎有用不完的时间，但时间仍然是一种珍贵的商品。挥霍的时间越多，我就越有可能重蹈过去尝试的覆辙。我仍然记得尝试警告先锋。他们认为我是另一个末日论者，并立即把我从高塔中赶出去。我敢肯定，我听起来就像个狂热的疯子。在我被证明是正确的时候，已经太迟了。埃里斯被腐蚀，一如往常。浪客迷失在他毫无希望的追寻中。没人相信我，没人信任我。我要紧跟着阴影。

这一次发生了一些事情，让我无法产生明显的影响。在某个地方，有个关键的事可以阻止这一切。我会找到它。

我有机会纠正这个世界的错误。与其在没有计划的情况下硬着头皮往前冲，我不如做好准备。这一次，我要重点做好下一个循环的准备工作。这一次就称之为洗牌吧。下一次我再救你，阿娜。再会。

3363948245.name: Firecrest
3363948245.flavor: Speed can be a means… or an end.
3363948245.lore:
The tinker circles the massive Sparrow, assessing his work. He nods in satisfaction. One would never guess that two weeks ago, the thing was a shrapnel-ridden wreck.

Just as he begins polishing, there's an ominous pounding on the garage door. The tinker takes deep breath, and opens up to find a full fireteam in the street. The Warlock strides into the shop while the remaining Guardians lounge on their Sparrows, idly examining their weaponry. 

The Warlock makes a slow circuit around the Sparrow. "Nice job on the bullet holes. Half-assed polish job, though." The Guardian's ferocious helmet makes it impossible for the tinker to tell if she's joking. 

"Stabilization fixed?" The Warlock mounts the machine and hits the ignition. 

"Yeah, but obviously I couldn't test it at speed. If it wobbles on you, bring it back for free." The tinker nervously eyes the Pulse Rifle slung across the Warlock's back. 

Suddenly, a smallish robot is floating beside the Warlock. The tinker had seen Ghosts before, but never this close. It speaks. "This is irrational. I'm capable of reproducing your Sparrow on command and in mint condition. Why pay this person to repair your old one? It increases the failure rate by 18% at minimum." 

The tinker stares at the Ghost, his face reddening. He had worked day and night for two full weeks on this Sparrow, and the proceeds would keep his shop open for another three months. It was the biggest job he'd had in a year. 

"I know, but sometime you just need that Human touch." The Warlock taps the datapad on her wrist. "Glimmer's in your account." 

"Thanks. Come back anytime." The tinker holds out his hand and the Warlock shakes it, like in the old days. 

"See?" The Warlock says to her Ghost as they rejoin her fireteam. "Well worth the money."
3363948245.lore_zh:
那位工匠围着快雀转了一圈，仔细欣赏自己的杰作，一边看一边满意得点头。谁也看不出来，两周前这玩意还是一堆破烂。

就在他开始打磨的时候，车库大门传来了不吉利的敲打声。修补匠深深吸口气，打开们，发现街上一整队的火力战队。术士大步走进商店，其余的守护者则靠在他们的快雀上，漫不经心地检查着他们的武器装备。

术士慢慢悠悠围着快雀转了一圈，说：“不错，弹孔都修补上了，只是表面打磨得还不够仔细。”她的脸被头盔遮住了，根本看不出到底是不是在开玩笑。

“稳定器修好了？”术士装上机器，按了点火器。

“修好了，不过没跑起来我也不知道到底有没有问题。如果你在驾驶过程中发现有些不稳，开回来我再帮你调整。”工匠有些紧张的望着术士背后的脉冲步枪说道。忽然，一个小小的机器人漂飞了起来，停在术士身旁。工匠以前也见过机灵，但从来没有这么近距离地观察过。它它突然开口说话：“你这么做不太明智，我完全有能力为你复制一台全新的快雀。为什么要花钱让这个家伙修理旧快雀？这会让故障率上升18个百分点。” 

工匠盯着机灵，脸涨得通红。为了这只快雀，他没日没夜地工作了整整两个星期，所得的收入够他三个月的房租，也算是他这一年来最大的一单了。

“我知道，但有时候一些情感是很难说明白的。”术士敲了敲手腕上的数据版说：“微光都转到你账上了。”

“非常感谢，随时欢迎啊。”工匠伸出一只手跟术士握了握。

“瞧见没？”术士一边带着机灵重新回到火力战队一边对它说：“这钱花的很值。”

3102002768.name: Retrocausality
3102002768.flavor: "This is a puzzle with missing pieces." —Elsie Bray
3102002768.lore:
"I'm not sure I can do this anymore," I say to her, weary and drained. It took so much convincing to get her to believe me. I can hardly make eye contact, so I study the intricate stitching on her robe.

"From what you've told me, I do not believe you have a choice," she replies earnestly. "But your path isn't as predetermined as it seems. I am here now, after all."

It feels like a gift to have her standing beside me this time. To hear her voice finally. It's soft and reassuring.

"You're making a difference," she continues. "Little by little. This is a battle of attrition. You're chipping away until you find the core, the heart. The event you can prevent."

"You don't know what this is like," I say and break down, and putting my head in my hands. "Every mistake costs years that I have to see through."

"I believe you have the strength to do it, Elsie. If you alone are caught in this, then it's you alone who will break the cycle."

I look up to meet her eyes. There is a fire behind them. A fervor that fills me with hope.

"This is your charge. You are in control. I have nothing but faith in you." She places her hand on my shoulder and that familiar feeling of warmth returns.

"Thank you. I'm… ready now."

"Then it's time to pay Eris a visit," she says firmly before stopping me. "Just out of curiosity, how many times is this?"

"Seven."

"Perhaps this is the one," Ikora says with such optimism, I almost believe her.

It's not. We're all dead in a week. Now she'll never remember me, or how close we grew.

But I will carry her words with me until my mission is complete.
3102002768.lore_zh:
“我不知道自己还能不能坚持下去。”我疲惫不堪地对她说道。好不容易说服了她，让她相信我。我甚至无法接触她的眼神，所以我转而研究她袍子上复杂的阵脚。

“从你告诉我的话里，我相信你没有选择。”她真诚地回道。“但是，你的道路并不像表面上那样是注定的。毕竟，我现在就在这里。”

这次能有她站在我身边，感觉是一种恩赐。终于能听到她的声音。柔软而抚慰人心。

“你改变了一切，”她继续说道：“一点点改变。这是一场消耗战。在你找到核心，那颗心脏之前，都是小打小闹。你可以阻止那件事。”

“你不知道这是什么感觉。”我说着说着，就崩溃了，我的头埋在手里。“每一个错误的代价都是我必须经历的年月。”

“我相信你有力量能够做到，艾尔西。如果只有你一个人陷入其中，那么只有你自己才能打破这个循环。”

我抬头看向她的目光。在她的目光背后有一道火焰。一种让我充满希望的热忱。

“这是你的责任。你来掌控。我对你有绝对的信心。”她的手放在我的肩上，那种熟悉的温暖的感觉又回来了。

“谢谢你。我……做好准备了。”

“那么是时候去拜访下埃里斯了。”在阻止我之前，她坚定地说道。“纯粹出于好奇问你下，这是多少次了？””

“七次。”

“也许这就是改变的那一次。”艾可拉乐观地说道，我几乎相信了她的话。

但并不是。一周内我们都死了。现在她再也不会记得我，也不会记得我们变得多么亲密。

但我会记着她的话，直到我的任务完成。

2673955019.name: Digital Cortex
2673955019.flavor: For Ghosts with a mind of their own.

296637832.name: No Love Lost
296637832.flavor: "I'll do it again, and again, for her." —Elsie Bray
296637832.lore:
I'm living the definition of insanity. Repeating myself over and over, hoping something will change, but I know it's coming. Blood and betrayal. I've learned not to be fooled anymore. In any other circumstance, this mission would be hopeless, and I, a failure. Yet every time I come to that bitter end, I see a glimmer of who she was in her eyes. I know she's in there. I know that if I can keep her out of this, shield her from this world, I can save her. I can stop this madness.

At least that's what I tell myself these days. I thought I would grow numb, going through the motions. I'm not. It's always painful. Sometimes, I'm so angry at her for putting me in this position. There are times I want to end it all as soon as she finds me. Take her out and turn over in my cot, hoping this is all a dream. Save us all the trouble and heartbreak. But then we get there, and I see that look in her eyes—the one that tells me she's sorry—and I have to try again.

Then there were times I was weak. Gave in, hoping it would change the outcome. I thought it might save the world if we were a family again… It didn't. I couldn't live with the choices I'd made.

Then I'm right back where I started.

This time, I know what to do. The Vanguard has been keeping secrets. I was foolish to take them at face value. Clandestine missions to Mars… and beyond. Realms outside the boundaries of time. The Black Garden they call it. Darkness lives inside, beating, and pulsing. I believe it is the source of our misery. I'll see to its destruction… and I won't have to kill my sister ever again.
296637832.lore_zh:
我活在疯狂的定义中。一遍遍重复着自己，希望能有所改变，但我知道这一切都会到来。鲜血与背叛。我已经得到教训，不会再被愚弄。在任何情况下，这个任务都毫无希望，我注定要失败。然而每次我走到那个苦涩的终点，我都会看到她眼中的一丝光芒。我知道她就在那里。我知道如果我能把她带出这件事，让她与这个世界隔离开，我就可以救她。我可以阻止这场疯狂。

至少这些天我是这样告诉自己的。我以为我会逐渐变得麻木，敷衍了事。但我并没有，痛苦依然。有时候，我很愤怒，她把我陷入到这种情形中。有时候我想她找到我的时候，我立即结束这一切。带她出去，在我的小床上翻身，希望这一切都是梦。让我们不再承受这所有的麻烦和心碎。但到了那里，我看到她的眼神——那种她很抱歉的眼神——我不得不再试一次。

有的时候我也会很脆弱。放弃，希望可以改变结果。我以为如果我们重新成为一家人，就能拯救世界……但并没有。我无法接受我做出的选择。

然后我又回到开始的地方。

这一次，我知道该怎么做。先锋一直保守着秘密。我当时很傻，相信了他们的表明价值。秘密前往火星的任务……还有更多。时间界限以外的维度。他们称之为黑暗花园。阴影就在其中，跳动，脉动着。我相信这就是我们痛苦的根源。我要看着它毁灭……让我不用再杀掉我的妹妹。
