构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。
250902314.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

2839173408.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
2839173408.description: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
2839173408.description_zh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有更高的填装速度和稳定性。

1186131696.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
1186131696.description: This weapon has improved reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
1186131696.description_zh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有进一步提升的填装速度和稳定性。
1186131696.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

3988215619.name: Veist Stinger
3988215619.description: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.
3988215619.description_zh: 使用此武器对敌人造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提高瞄准时的移速。此特性生效时弓箭可获得更快的拉弓速度，而刀剑可获得更快的充能速度。

54024075.name: Veist Stinger
54024075.description: Damaging a combatant with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights by an improved amount. Bows receive improved draw speed, and Swords receive improved charge rate while this perk is active.
54024075.description_zh: 使用此武器对战斗人员造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提升更多瞄准时的移动速度。当此特性生效时，弓箭获得更多拉弓速度，刀剑获得更多充能速度。
54024075.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

844190854.name: Lightning Seeker
844190854.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot track targets across the ground, jolting them and unleashing chain lightning on impact.
844190854.description_zh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在地面上追踪目标，震颤目标并在命中后释放连锁闪电。

2379536009.name: Remote Shield
2379536009.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a protective shield on impact. Passing through the protective shield provides a Void Overshield and improves weapon damage, reload speed, and handling.
2379536009.description_zh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在命中后部署一个防御护盾。穿过它会提供一个虚空覆盖护盾，提升武器伤害、填装速度和操控性。

3492337375.name: Restorative Turret
3492337375.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a healing turret on impact that provides Cure and Restoration to nearby allies.
3492337375.description_zh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在命中后部署一个治疗炮台，为附近盟友提供治愈和恢复效果。

4015745376.name: Toxic Overload
4015745376.description: Landing a final blow or multiple precision hits triggers a burst that inflicts nearby targets with potent corruption.
4015745376.description_zh: 最后一击或多次精准射击命中后可触发一次对附近目标施加强效腐化的爆炸。

1408800487.name: Omega Strike
1408800487.description: Land hits with the Slug Launcher to load micro-missiles[Alternate Weapon Action]  and then fire to launch several micro-missiles in a volley.
1408800487.description_zh: 使用重弹发射器命中目标可装载微型导弹[替换武器动作] ，然后射击即可一次性发射几枚微型导弹。

2395713912.name: Umbral Sustenance
2395713912.description: This weapon's magazine is automatically reloaded when you gain Devour, a Void overshield, or become invisible.
2395713912.description_zh: 此武器的弹匣在你获得吞食、虚空覆盖护盾或隐身时会自动填装弹药。

1679262379.name: Worm Byproduct
1679262379.description: Taking damage from your own worm projectile detonation empowers your weapons for a short time.
1679262379.description_zh: 受到自身的蠕虫射弹爆炸造成的伤害可在短时间内强化武器。

1048183818.name: Adaptive Munitions
1048183818.description: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.
1048183818.description_zh: 此武器可调整其伤害输出和效率来对抗与其伤害类型不匹配的能量护盾。

3431277734.name: Adaptive Munitions
3431277734.description: This weapon adapts its damage output to be more effective against energy shields that don't match its damage type. Improves damage increase.
3431277734.description_zh: 此武器可调整其伤害输出以更有效地对抗与其伤害类型不匹配的能量护盾。伤害提升量提高。

1583705720.name: Stats for All
1583705720.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.
1583705720.description_zh: 命中三个不同目标可在一定时间内提高武器操控性、稳定性、填装和射程。

1409206216.name: Stats for All
1409206216.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.
1409206216.description_zh: 命中三个不同目标可提高武器操控性、稳定性、填装和射程，持续时间延长。

2209918983.name: Turnabout
2209918983.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.
2209918983.description_zh: 使用此武器打破正在使用超能的战斗人员或守护者的护盾将获得覆盖护盾。

2000295559.name: Turnabout
2000295559.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.
2000295559.description_zh: 使用此武器打破正在使用超能的战斗人员或守护者的护盾将获得覆盖护盾，持续时间延长。

2896038713.name: Focused Fury
2896038713.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
2896038713.description_zh: 弹匣内的部分弹药造成精准伤害后可赋予此武器额外伤害。在填装或是收起武器时重置命中数量。

2402480669.name: Focused Fury
2402480669.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
2402480669.description_zh: 弹匣内的部分弹药造成精准伤害后可赋予此武器一段更长时间的额外伤害。在填装或是收起武器时重置命中数量。

3526486541.name: Tilting at Windmills
3526486541.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed while shielding.
3526486541.description_zh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可提高举盾时的移动速度。

1738338041.name: Tilting at Windmills
1738338041.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed for an improved duration while you are shielding.
1738338041.description_zh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在更长时间内提高举盾时的移动速度。

2224838837.name: Unstoppable Force
2224838837.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.
2224838837.description_zh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在短时间内提高射弹伤害。

3102670337.name: Unstoppable Force
3102670337.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for an improved duration.
3102670337.description_zh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在短时间内提高射弹伤害，持续时间延长。

3800201097.name: Immovable Object
3800201097.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
3800201097.description_zh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供更多的武器能量。

3674673997.name: Immovable Object
3674673997.description: Dealing ranged damage grants substantially increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
3674673997.description_zh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供大幅增加的武器能量。

2652708987.name: Successful Warm-Up
2652708987.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.
2652708987.description_zh: 每次最后一击都能提高充能/拉弓速度。

617966211.name: Successful Warm-Up
617966211.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.
617966211.description_zh: 每次最后一击都能提高充能/拉弓速度，持续时间延长。

509074078.name: Steady Hands
509074078.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.
509074078.description_zh: 击杀可在短时间内为所有武器提供更高的操控性。

843318450.name: Steady Hands
843318450.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.
843318450.description_zh: 击杀可为所有武器提供更高的操控性，持续时间延长。

671806388.name: Compulsive Reloader
671806388.description: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.
671806388.description_zh: 接近满弹匣时赋予更快的填装速度。

595108252.name: Compulsive Reloader
595108252.description: Grants greatly increased reload speed when close to full magazine.
595108252.description_zh: 接近满弹匣时赋予大幅提高的填装速度。

3078487919.name: Bait and Switch
3078487919.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.
3078487919.description_zh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成。

3744057135.name: Bait and Switch
3744057135.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.
3744057135.description_zh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成，持续时间延长。

2172504645.name: Sleight of Hand
2172504645.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.
2172504645.description_zh: 在此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击可在短时间内提高其操控性、稳定性和填装速度。

1172098417.name: Sleight of Hand
1172098417.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for an improved duration.
1172098417.description_zh: 在此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击可提高其操控性、稳定性和填装速度，持续时间延长。

2978966579.name: Chill Clip
2978966579.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
2978966579.description_zh: 使用前半弹匣弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

344235611.name: Chill Clip
344235611.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
344235611.description_zh: 弹匣的大多数弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

1623332175.name: Cunning of the Contender Gloves
1623332175.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
1623332175.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
1623332175.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

4029022121.name: Cunning of the Contender Robes
4029022121.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
4029022121.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
4029022121.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

1514358116.name: Cunning of the Contender Bond
1514358116.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
1514358116.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
1514358116.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

2353359390.name: Cunning of the Contender Hood
2353359390.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
2353359390.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
2353359390.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

2197832433.name: Cunning of the Contender Boots
2197832433.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
2197832433.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
2197832433.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

921817150.name: Fervid Coldsnap
921817150.description: Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge that recharges quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
921817150.description_zh: 你的急冻手雷有一发额外充能且命中时充能更快。急冻手雷产生的追踪弹移动得更远。

1341199512.name: Devouring Rift
1341199512.description: While using a Void Super, casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Damage dealt by you and your allies from within your Empowering Rift will [Disruption] disrupt combatants. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants you class ability energy.
1341199512.description_zh: 使用虚空超能时，施放强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。你和你的盟友从强能裂痕中输出的伤害将扰乱战斗人员。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

1457189155.name: Depths of Duskfield
1457189155.description: Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.
1457189155.description_zh: 使你的暮域手雷的影响范围大幅增加。处于暮域内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，并且该区域内的目标造成的伤害会减少。

3556461530.name: Voltaic Mirror
3556461530.description: Guarding with your Arc Staff does not consume extra Super energy. [Super]  : Cancel Arc Staff early, temporarily increasing Arc weapon damage and creating a blinding burst. Reflected attacks increase the damage of the burst, extend your Super, and deal additional damage.
3556461530.description_zh: 使用你的电弧法杖进行防御不会消耗额外超能能量。[超能]  ：提前取消电弧法杖，暂时提升电弧武器伤害并产生致盲爆发。反射攻击会增加爆发伤害，延长你的超能持续时间，并造成额外伤害。

2471523345.name: Glacial Fortification
2471523345.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.
2471523345.description_zh: 装备冰影超能时，你的屏障出现后会变成一堵由冰影水晶构成的，能减缓周围目标速度的墙壁。站在该屏障后方时，你和你的盟友会获得武器填装速度、稳定性以及射程提升。

1163213078.name: Cauterizing Flame
1163213078.description: While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade or becoming critically wounded with full class ability energy creates a Sunspot at your location.
1163213078.description_zh: 装备烈日超能时，施放屏障或在职业技能能量已满的情况下受到重伤，会在你的位置创造一个太阳黑子。

3115540150.name: Sweet Embrace
3115540150.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Omnioculus. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3115540150.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变全知之眼的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

599904805.name: Tekeli-li
599904805.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Star-Eater Scales. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
599904805.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变噬星者之鳞的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3472374302.name: Trace of the Throne
3472374302.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Citan's Ramparts. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3472374302.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变西坦壁垒的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2471221568.name: Terminus Emissary
2471221568.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Cuirass of the Falling Star. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
2471221568.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变陨星胸甲的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2316352266.name: Nouveau Filigree
2316352266.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Necrotic Grip. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
2316352266.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变亡灵之握的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

3192251706.name: Homespun Boots
3192251706.description: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Boots of the Assembler. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3192251706.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变汇编器战靴的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

2722573683.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
2722573683.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
2722573683.description_zh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

2722573682.name: Spectral Blades
2722573682.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
2722573682.description_zh:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。

 [轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。

 [重攻击] ：进行一次可削弱目标的重攻击，并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

2722573681.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver
2722573681.name_zh: 暗影箭矢：莫比乌斯箭袋
2722573681.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
2722573681.description_zh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和盟友大幅削弱和压制他们。

发射两组三发虚空箭矢，搜寻附近目标。暗影箭矢会使敌人变得不稳定，对已被束缚的目标造成更高伤害。击败被束缚的目标会生成能量球。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

4260353953.name: Ward of Dawn
4260353953.description:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.
4260353953.description_zh:
为你和你的盟友制造一个防护圆顶护罩。

你和你的盟友处在黎明护罩中时，会获得虚空覆盖护盾并且提升武器伤害，护罩内的目标则会被削弱。

护罩的制造者在护罩中时还会获得近战伤害提升，并且可以拾取并投掷护罩核心，以此重新放置护罩，最多两次。

4260353952.name: Sentinel Shield
4260353952.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
4260353952.description_zh:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空光能圣盾。
哨兵圣盾生效时：
[轻攻击]  ：攻击。
[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

4260353955.name: Twilight Arsenal
4260353955.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
4260353955.description_zh:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

1656118680.name: Nova Warp
1656118680.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
1656118680.description_zh:
穿梭于位面之间以颠覆物理定律。

[超能附技能]  ：传送一小段距离并放出削弱追踪弹。

[超能主技能]  ：释放一次致命虚空爆发。完全充能的攻击可对目标施加不稳定效果。

1656118681.name: Nova Bomb: Vortex
1656118681.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
1656118681.description_zh:
向目标抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹可产生一个奇点，将目标拉入其中，并对困在其中的敌人造成持续性伤害。

1656118682.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
1656118682.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
1656118682.description_zh:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

1139822081.name: Snare Bomb
1139822081.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
1139822081.description_zh:
投掷一个烟雾弹，它会附着在表面上，发信号给敌人的雷达，然后引爆为一团使人迷失方向的烟云，削弱附近的目标。烟云内的目标会受到持续伤害。

部署后，让附近的盟友隐身。

1139822080.name: Phantom Surge
1139822080.description:
Dash forward, slashing combatants as you pass through them. Deals significantly increased damage to Void-debuffed targets, or targets marked by On The Prowl.
 
Generate Void Overshield for each combatant hit. Defeating at least one combatant grants additional Overshield and refunds melee ability energy.
1139822080.description_zh:
向前冲刺，穿过战斗人员时对其猛击。对受到虚空减益的目标或被伺机而动标记的目标造成显著提升的伤害。
 
每命中一名战斗人员都会生成虚空覆盖护盾。击败至少一名战斗人员提供额外覆盖护盾并返还近战技能能量。

4220332375.name: Shield Bash
4220332375.description: After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to unleash a devastating Shield Bash that suppresses the target. Final blows with Shield Bash grant an Overshield.
4220332375.description_zh: 短时间冲刺后，使用此近战技能释放出极具破坏力的圣盾强袭来压制目标。使用圣盾强袭完成最后一击赋予覆盖护盾。

4220332374.name: Shield Throw
4220332374.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
4220332374.description_zh: 向目标投掷你的虚空护盾。盾牌可在目标和表面弹射，每击中一个目标都会赋予覆盖护盾。

2299867342.name: Pocket Singularity
2299867342.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
2299867342.description_zh:
发射一个不稳定的球形虚空能量，在靠近目标的时候引爆，将目标从爆炸中心推开，并使其变得不稳定。

可多次使用。

1255073825.name: Void Spike
1255073825.description: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging Void Light.
1255073825.description_zh: 可吸附在任意表面并散发出连续不断的伤害性虚空之光的手雷。

2809141585.name: Void Wall
2809141585.description: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light.
2809141585.description_zh: 可产生一堵燃烧着虚空之光的横向墙壁的手雷。

2265076177.name: Suppressor Grenade
2265076177.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
2265076177.description_zh: 一种能造成 压制效果的高爆手雷，可以使目标在短时间内无法使用 技能。

1016030582.name: Vortex Grenade
1016030582.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
1016030582.description_zh: 可产生涡流将目标吸入其中，对困在其中的目标造成持续性伤害的手雷。

1514173218.name: Scatter Grenade
1514173218.description: A grenade that splits into many submunitions and covers a large area with multiple explosions.
1514173218.description_zh: 可分裂出大量子弹药并造成可覆盖大片区域的多次爆炸的手雷。

1547656727.name: Magnetic Grenade
1547656727.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
1547656727.description_zh: 可粘附在目标身上并发生两次爆炸的手雷。

3232422679.name: Axion Bolt
3232422679.description: A bolt of Void Light that forks on impact into smaller bolts that seek out targets.
3232422679.description_zh: 命中后可迸发出追踪目标的多个小型光束的虚空光能。

187655372.name: Trapper's Ambush
187655372.flavor: The eyes which bear down upon you from a place you cannot see. Strike your enemies before they see you coming.

187655373.name: Vanishing Step
187655373.flavor: The wiles of a seasoned interlocutor; dodge any unwanted affronts and slip by unseen.

187655374.name: Stylish Executioner
187655374.flavor: The boast which sucks the air from the room. Let your enemies know your might before you take them down.

187655375.name: On the Prowl
187655375.flavor: A roughly hewn hatchet, covered in dirt and moss. A remnant that does not boast of killing, but attests to survival.

1602994568.name: Controlled Demolition
1602994568.flavor: The seed of the unknown, which sprouts into yawning absence. Sustain your allies with the destruction of those who oppose you.

1602994569.name: Bastion
1602994569.flavor: Food for the schism between allies and enemies. Protect those close to you with a barrier of distilled time.

1602994570.name: Offensive Bulwark
1602994570.flavor: A dilation in space used to manipulate the timing of Void abilities. Press the attack to double down on your advantage.

1602994571.name: Unbreakable
1602994571.flavor: A handful of lavender ribbons, gently wrapped around your forearm. This gift from the Saint reminds you not to just roll with the punches—send them back twice as hard.

2321824285.name: Chaos Accelerant
2321824285.flavor: More than emptiness, an emptiness magnifier. The Void passes through, growing ever more like itself.

2321824284.name: Feed the Void
2321824284.flavor: The hunger which derives from absence. Only sustenance can prolong it, yet nothing will ever satiate.

2321824287.name: Child of the Old Gods
2321824287.flavor: In the deepest reaches, a pact made between unknowable entities created something from nothing. It lives on.

2321824286.name: Soul Siphon
2321824286.flavor: All existence is cradled within an aching nonexistence. The Void calls eternally for more life.

20616658.name: High Jump
20616658.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
20616658.description_zh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

20616659.name: Strafe Jump
20616659.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
20616659.description_zh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

20616656.name: Triple Jump
20616656.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
20616656.description_zh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

1380268166.name: High Lift
1380268166.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
1380268166.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

1380268167.name: Strafe Lift
1380268167.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
1380268167.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

1380268164.name: Catapult Lift
1380268164.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
1380268164.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

1237488987.name: Strafe Glide
1237488987.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
1237488987.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

1237488986.name: Burst Glide
1237488986.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
1237488986.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

1237488985.name: Balanced Glide
1237488985.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
1237488985.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

1237488984.name: Blink
1237488984.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
1237488984.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

2816982784.name: Marksman's Dodge
2816982784.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
2816982784.description_zh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

2816982785.name: Gambler's Dodge
2816982785.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
2816982785.description_zh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

3499782248.name: Star Jasmine
3499782248.flavor: The scent emerges as the sun sets, a testimony carried through warm summer nights.
3499782248.lore:
TYPE: RECOVERED SENSOR LOGS 

PARTIES: Two [2] Human-type, designate Umiña, Osiris. One [1] Ascendant Hive, designate Savathûn. Eighty-one [81] Hive-type, designate unknown. 

ASSOCIATIONS: Light [Umiña]; Darkness, [Savathûn, Hive] 

ENGINES: Offline 

LIFE SUPPORT: Offline 

SENSORS: Nominal 

//AUDIO RECOVERED// 

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS// 

U: Is that… Osiris! Osiris, can you hear me?  

S: Reverence, please, child. He is the first to see this realm. 

U: What did you do to him? 

S: He merely sleeps to dream a better world… one that I awaken to make reality. 

//REBOOTING// 

U: —some kind of fountain? 

S: It is the trough at which gods gorge.  

U: And you're going to feed me to them there? 

S: Nothing so dramatic, Lightbearer. You will be a scent. A texture. An added detail no one would notice, but whose absence would be felt. After all, one cannot cast a shadow without Light. 

U: But… with Osiris's Light… Wait! Are you saying Sagira is gone?! Then he doesn't have— 

//REBOOTING// 

U: —what you're saying is true, then we're on the same side! 

S: No, child. We work to the same ends. Our roads are quite different. 

U: You don't have to do this. 

S: An end must be reached. A journey chosen. We are not all of us burdened by the comforting lie of false sacrifice.  

U: Please— 

S: All I require is to relieve you of that burden.  

//REBOOTING// 

S: The vessel's sensors appear to be recording. Dispose of it.
3499782248.lore_zh:
类型：回收的感应器日志 

参与者：二[2] 人类，代号Umiña，奥斯里斯。一[1] 邪魔族后裔，代号萨瓦图恩。八十一[81]邪魔族类型，代号未知。 

组织：光能[Umiña]；暗影，[萨瓦图恩，邪魔族] 

引擎：离线 

生命维持：离线 

感应器：运行正常 

//已回收音频// 

//转录如下// 

U：那是…奥斯里斯！奥斯里斯，奥斯里斯，能听见吗？  

S：孩子，请保持尊敬。他还是第一次见到这个位面。 

U：你对他做了什么？ 

S：他只是在睡梦中体验更好的世界…一个我在觉醒后要将其变成现实的世界。 

//正在重启// 

U：——某种喷泉？ 

S：只是神明尽情享受的饲料厂罢了。  

U：而你会将我在那里喂给它们？ 

S：没那么戏剧性，负光者。你会成为一种味道。一种口感。没人会留意，但缺少了也会被注意到的一种辅料。毕竟，没有光哪里会有影子。 

U：但是…用奥斯里斯的光能…等一下！你是说萨吉拉没了？！那么他不就没有… 

//正在重启// 

U：你说的是真的，那么我们就是同一边的！ 

S：不，孩子。我们的目的相同，但我们的道路不同。 

U：你不需要这么做。 

S：一个必须抵达的重点。一段被选定的旅程。不是所有人都承受着虚假牺牲造就的舒适谎言的重担。  

U：求求你…… 

S：我只是想要将你从那种重担中解脱出来。  

//正在重启// 

S：飞船的感应器好像正在记录。处理掉它。

2235731789.name: Sovereign Order
2235731789.flavor: Do not fly so far that you can no longer hear her voice.
2235731789.lore:
Three ships flew overhead in tight formation.

Their shadows flickered across Grutuk's iris as she calculated their probable landing zones. Satisfied, she rose from the tangle of blackberries where she had been hiding, the thorns scraping harmlessly against her ivory shell. 

Xavol sat quietly, one dark claw scratching idly at the dirt. He had drawn the old runes, once powerful symbols of tithing, now nothing more than shallow scrawls. 

Grutuk nudged him. "Time to get to work," she said.

Xavol rose slowly, then kicked away the drawings with his foot. He hissed and clacked his jaws. 

"You always say that," she sighed, and the two headed toward the trees to wait for the Guardians.
2235731789.lore_zh:
三艘飞船以密集队形飞过。

格鲁图克看在眼里，计算它们可能着陆的区域，然后满意地从她藏身的黑莓丛中站了起来，荆棘从她的乳白色外壳上刮落，没有留下一丝伤痕。

泽沃静静地坐着，用一只黑色的爪子懒洋洋地刮着泥土。他画出了个古老的符文，那曾经是什一奉献的有力象征，现在却只是肤浅的涂鸦。

格鲁图克轻推了他一下。“该开工了，”她说道。

泽沃慢慢站了起来，然后一脚把画踢散了。他发出嘶嘶声，下颚咔嚓作响。

“你总是这么说，”她叹了口气，然后他们一同朝树林走去，等待守护者的到来。

2873488357.name: Unauthorized Departure
2873488357.flavor: Sometimes the ship chooses the pilot.
2873488357.lore:
Amanda circled the new SUROS jumpship, admiring its flat planes and sharp edges. It looked like something from the Golden Age.

She pulled up the specs on her datapad and whistled. No wonder the Warlock wanted to get rid of it. Too much juice for a New Light.

She looked over both shoulders before casually sliding into the cockpit. She wasn't cleared for takeoff, but she'd be damned if she let this opportunity slip by.

As she powered up the engines, a nearby Redjack began beeping in alarm. 

"Don't worry, darlin'," Amanda cooed to the ship. "The Guardian will take good care of you."

"But first," she said as she engaged the thrusters, "let's see what you can do."
2873488357.lore_zh:
阿曼达绕着新的SUROS跃迁飞船转了一圈，欣赏着它的平面和锐缘。它看起来像是黄金时代的产物。

她在数据板上调出了飞船的规格，吹了声口哨，难怪那个术士想摆脱它。这对新生的负光者来说太难驾驭了。

她看了看四周，然后漫不经心地溜进了驾驶舱。她还没获准起飞，但如果错过这个机会，她肯定会后悔死的。

她启动引擎时，附近的一个红桃杰克开始发出了警报声。 

“别担心，亲爱的，”阿曼达轻声对飞船说。“我会好好照顾你的。”

“但首先，”她一边启动推进器一边说。“让我看看你有什么能耐。”

1194864990.name: Criticality of Quickness
1194864990.flavor: A lot can happen in 72 hours. Three days can change the course of a hundred lives.
1194864990.source: Source: Earned as a Deluxe Edition bonus.
1194864990.lore:
Darkness signatures decay in just under two days.

Ether residue degrades in as little as 4 hours.

Hive ritual oils dissipate in less than 20 minutes.

As agents of the Hidden, you must understand: evidence is fleeting, and time is your enemy. That means you must act in swiftness… but not in haste. Never in haste.

Put your hands down. I recognize that look. 

A few years after I bonded with Ikora Rey—long before the Last City—we happened upon a settlement near the ruins of Sturivon in the EDZ. We discovered the locals slaughtered, with no surviving eyewitnesses. But Ikora was quite familiar with Fallen weapons, even by then, and recognized the impact marks immediately. She wasted no time mounting an assault on the Fallen camp in the nearby hills. 

Only when she got there, she found no one but the sick and the young, completely unarmed.

Had Ikora investigated the ruins of the settlement more thoroughly, she would have discovered the Human boot prints. You see, it turns out the Warlord Benyo Lukacs had raided the Fallen camp days earlier; he put their warriors to the sword and stole their weapons for his own use.

Ikora spent 14 hours tracking the Fallen encampment, and another 11 rushing back to find the clues she missed. Her haste gave Lukacs a 25-hour lead. Time enough for him to wipe out two refugee caravans. One-hundred and eighty-four lives lost… all because she did not spare another five minutes' investigation.

Begin your new lives understanding the vital difference between quickness and recklessness. Unless you think yourself strong enough to carry the weight of 184 mistakes.

—Audio Recording, Advanced Forensics Introductory Lecture, Ophiuchus
1194864990.lore_zh:
暗影信号不到两天的时间就会消失。

乙太残留物在4小时内就能降解。

邪魔族仪式油不到20分钟就将消散。

作为隐秘者特工，你们必须明白：证据转瞬即逝，时间就是你们的敌人。这意味着你们必须迅速行动…但不是仓促行事。千万不要急于求成。

把手放下。我认得那个表情。 

在我与艾可拉·蕾伊缔结羁绊的几年后，那时离圣城还早着呢，我们碰巧在欧洲无人区的斯图瑞文废墟附近找到了一个定居点。我们发现当地人都被屠杀了，没有幸存的目击者。但艾可拉早在那时就对堕落者的武器相当熟悉，并立即认出来这些伤害痕迹。她没有浪费时间，对附近山上的堕落者营地发动了攻击。 

但当她到达那里时，才发现除了老幼病残外空无一人，完全没有任何武装。

要是当时艾可拉更彻底地调查了定居点的废墟，她就会发现人类的靴印。要知道，战争领主本约·卢卡奇恰好在几天前突袭了堕落者集中营；他杀死了他们的战士，偷走他们的刀剑为己所用。

艾可拉花了14个小时追踪到堕落者营地，又花了11个小时赶回去找寻她错过的线索。她的仓促匆忙让卢卡奇领先了25小时。这时间足以让他消灭两支难民船队。一百八十四人丧生…这一切都是因为她没有多抽出五分钟的时间进行调查。

开始你们全新的生活时，要理解快速和鲁莽之间的重要区别。除非你们认为自己足够强大到能够承载184份错误的重量。

高级取证入门讲座录音，蛇夫座

1112018949.name: Ivory Empress
1112018949.flavor: When atop this vehicle, the crowds will part before you. By force, if necessary.
1112018949.source_zh: 来源：“暗屋之声”异域任务
1112018949.lore:
Amanda raised her eyebrows as Crow cruised onto the landing pad. He sat atop a gleaming new Sparrow, adorned with gold and ivory. 

"Fancy ride, huh?" he asked.

"Yeah, fit for a prince," Amanda replied dourly. 

Crow ignored the dig with a wan smile. "It's not mine. Just borrowing it while I'm on Earth."

Amanda gave a small harrumph. "Borrowing it from the Cabal?" 

Crow rapped one of the curling ivory horns with his knuckle. "How could you tell?"

"Guess that means you've got some new friends now," she snapped, sharper than intended.

Crow scuffed the ground with his toe. "Not really. I don't have a lot of close friends. There's Glint, of course. But he's more like an appendage."

"Well, you used to have plenty of friends," she said, "but that was a lifetime ago."

Crow opened his mouth to retort but stopped short. The silence stretched on.

"Don't let me find that thing on my landing pad when I get back," Amanda finally said, crossing her arms. "This ain't a parking lot."

Crow nodded and slowly scooted past, keeping his eyes forward. As Amanda watched him go, she heard a small, digital voice chirp, "Did you call me an appendage?"

The shipwright smiled and then immediately caught herself. Her smile curdled into a sour frown. She clenched her fists in frustration.

"Why do you do this to yourself, Holliday?" she muttered as she stormed back to the Hangar. "Every time. Every damn time."
1112018949.lore_zh:
乌鸦来到着陆坪上时，阿曼达扬起了眉毛。他骑的是一艘闪闪发光、镶着黄金和象牙白的崭新快雀。 

“这座驾真华丽，是吧？”他问道。

“是啊，非常适合王子的身份，”阿曼达闷闷不乐地答道。 

乌鸦笑着不理睬她嘲讽的语气。“这不是我的。我只是在地球上的时候借用一下。”

阿曼达轻轻哼了一声。“从卡巴尔那里借来的？” 

乌鸦用指关节敲了敲其中一个卷曲的象牙角。“你怎么知道的？”

“看来你结交到了一些新朋友，”她厉声说道，语气分外尖锐。

乌鸦用脚蹭了蹭地面。“那倒不是。我的亲密朋友不多。格林特算一个，但他更像是个附属物。”

“你曾有过很多朋友，”她说道。“但那是上辈子的事了。”

乌鸦张口想反驳，却又打住了。两人保持着沉默。

“等我回来时，别让我看到那个东西还在我的着陆坪上，”阿曼达终于双臂交叉发了话。“这里不是停车场。”

乌鸦点点头，目视前方，慢慢地加速离去。阿曼达看着他离开的时候，听到一个微弱而有数码味的声音问道，“你刚才说我是个附属物？”

这个船匠露出了笑意，然后立刻止住，笑容逐渐凝成了酸涩的表情。她沮丧地握紧了拳。

“你为什么要这么对自己，霍利迪？”她嘟囔着，气冲冲地回到机库。“每一次都如此。”

3645278673.name: Gouging Light
3645278673.flavor: All told, I can't believe Holliday was able to put it back together. Not a lot left after a small-scale nuclear blast.
3645278673.lore_zh:
在他的快雀坠毁的那一刻，一切都来不及了。来不及作出反应。来不及缓冲。来不及思考。然而，就在马尔科的世界唯独剩下痛苦的时候，他有一瞬间能感觉到：一阵不堪忍受的短暂永恒。除了构成他整个宇宙的那种纯粹的剧痛，别的什么都不复存在。很快，它就消失了。悄然无声。

他先是听见了一阵机动的哀鸣声，与他头上的搏动疼痛形成了鲜明的对比。眼睛渐渐适应后，他瞥见了火星阳光那难耐的亮度。

疼痛缓缓卷土重来，刹时抑制了其他感官。

他盯着地上划出的那道长长的沟槽，摩托车贴地在这片红土上刮出了一道划痕，滚过他的——  

他低头看了看腿上还残留下些什么。皮开肉绽，血肉模糊。胆汁哽在他的喉咙里，但他咽了下去，这才意识到被轧烂的肢体是他身上唯一没有疼痛的角落。 

]]]阳光翻腾起来。一缕缕赫赫之光舔舐着各个星球。希望孕育出痛苦，孕育出寂静。[[[

快雀的扬声器里还在噼啪地传出紧张的马里亚奇电子音乐。马尔科挣扎着吸气，一阵胸口的颤动暗示着他的肺被刺穿了。 

肺部穿孔。 

他呼吸急促，开始寻找那些在王座世界金字塔突袭中幸存下来的守护者们小心翼翼地包装起来的样品容器。 

他的目光落在6010号容器上，它靠在玄武岩晶石上，已经开裂。

]]]门户洞开的等离子体深情地拥抱沟槽里明亮的光能，只留下温暖的残影。[[[

黑色的血管蜿蜒着穿过红土，穿过残骸。 

]]]亲自呈递的荣耀从那些无福消受之人身上夺走了痛苦。[[[

血管在泥土中穿行，在肉体与泥土的交汇处，延伸到了他那扭曲的肢体。快雀的车厢像心脏一样跳动，马尔科能感觉到他腿上赞美诗集般的节奏。

]]]各个星球自由地燃烧。让人痛快，却仍要化作灰烬。[[[

幻象充斥着他的脑海，渗进了他的口腔和肺部，扬言要让他淹没在极乐之中。他那条断掉的腿转了过来，砰的一声恢复了原样，兴奋感渗进了他本该感到疼痛的地方。

]]]深情、寂静、安全的拥抱。[[[

他从枪套中抽出手枪，一边仔细瞄准破裂的反应堆蔽罩，一边倒抽了一口气。

如此地轻柔寂静。

他的思想挣脱了束缚，在不堪忍受的短暂永恒之中，他咽下了最后一口气。 

]]]静卧着——[[[

马尔科尚存的一切扣动了扳机。

2073952954.name: Mind Shard
2073952954.lore:
Prime-40 leaned against the side of the small café and watched the children of the City happily chasing Artemis.

Artemis seemed to enjoy it as much as the children did. He barked playfully and wagged his tail as if to encourage them as they ran to him, only to suddenly juke and sprint quick circles around the courtyard over and over as they laughed. Finally, he flopped down in the shade of a wooden table, and the children descended on him in a whirlwind of head pats and belly rubs.

The roar of a Sparrow broke the calm. Prime-40 stepped forward as it tore past, his cloak whipping around him in the dusty air.

Another Guardian heading up to the Tower, Prime-40 thought. He squinted into the distance and saw a stream of ships leaving the Hangar, heading east. 

"Something's happening at the Cosmodrome," he said quietly. 

Artemis trotted over to him and whined. Prime-40 knelt and scratched him behind his ears.

"Come on," he said.

The Exo and his dog walked along the low wall at the edge of the City. Prime-40 ran a gloved hand along the rough and crumbling surface, his fingers absentmindedly skimming over cracks from years of wear. 

When they reached a gap in the easternmost point, Prime-40 climbed through without trouble and gazed for a moment at the dry grassland stretching far into the distant mountains. He kicked a stone block upright and sat down, resting his strong back against the City wall.

Artemis sat obediently at his feet.

"If trouble's coming," Prime-40 said, gesturing past the scrub and blooming mesquite, "it's coming from over there."

Artemis barked in agreement.

"Whatever it is, we'll handle it together," Prime-40 said. "Same as always."

Artemis huffed contentedly, laid down, and crossed his front paws protectively over Prime-40's boots.

The two looked out over the plains, and together, they waited for what would come next.
2073952954.lore_zh:
普莱姆-40倚在小咖啡馆的边上，看着圣城里的孩子们快乐地追逐着阿提米斯。

阿提米斯似乎和孩子们一样乐此不疲。当孩子跑向它时，它会摇着尾巴欢快地叫着，就像在鼓励孩子们一般。当他们笑着追了上来，它忽然往旁边一闪，开始在院子里不断跑圈。最后，它扑倒在了一张木桌的阴凉处，让孩子们纷纷围过来，拍拍它的头，摸摸它的肚皮。

快雀的引擎声打破了平静。当它飞驰而过时，普莱姆-40往前踏了几步，他的斗篷在尘土飞扬的空气中拍打着。

“又一个前往高塔的守护者，”普莱姆-40想道。他眯起眼睛望向远处，看见不少飞船离开机库，向东飞去。

“发射基地出事了，”他轻声说道。

阿提米斯小跑过来，哀嚎着。普莱姆-40蹲下来，挠了挠它的耳后。

“走吧，”他说。

Exo和他的狗沿着圣城边的矮墙走着。普莱姆-40戴着手套的手抚摸着已部分破损失修的墙面。他心不在焉地用指尖掠过了那些年久失修的裂痕。

当他们到达最东端的缺口后，普莱姆-40毫不费力地爬了过去，并望着延伸到远处山脉的干燥草原看了一会儿。他把一块石块踢了起来，坐了上去，然后把他强壮的脊背靠在了圣城的墙壁上。

阿提米斯乖巧地坐在他的脚边。

“如果有麻烦来，”普莱姆-40指着灌木丛和盛开的牧豆树的后面，“肯定会从那边过来。”

阿提米斯赞同地吠了一声。

“无论来的是什么，我们都会一起应对，”普莱姆-40说道。“就像以前那样。”

阿提米斯安心地躺了下来，把前爪交叉放在普莱姆-40的战靴上，做出保护的防御姿态。

他们望着平原，一起等待着接下来即将发生的事情。

2453351420.name: Nightstalker
2453351420.flavor: Draw from the Void. Light the way.
2453351420.typeName_zh: 普通 猎人分支职业
2453351420.lore:
I can't seem to commune with the Void on a full stomach. Gotta be hungry, starving for best effect. I start getting those pangs, and that's when I hear it, almost like a voice whispering through me. When I first learned that lesson, I thought morning jobs would be a dealbreaker, with breakfast being the most important meal of the day and all. Yet here I am, at the crack of dawn, perched on top of a big ol' tree, fantasizing about my next bite. Not terrible as far as stakeouts go, and if you gotta pay off a debt to a scummy scum-lord, then you're lucky to have a place to sit.

I've got eyes on my mark; have for days. This Kell's finally looking nice and cozy, asleep in the open and surrounded by his servants. Thought they're supposed to be the last line of defense, but they haven't noticed me yet. Guess good help is hard to come by.

I'd have taken the shot hours ago, but I'm supposed to shoot a warning first, so he knows what's coming. That way he "goes out knowing who got him." Warlords love sending their little messages, and it's gonna fall on deaf ears if he's asleep. This guy just keeps snoozing. I envy that.

Which reminds me, I've discovered another little trick to getting in good with that yawning mouth of nothing we call the Void: exhaustion. When I start slipping into that twilight, where I'm not sure if I'm awake or dreaming, I can feel the absence. It's close enough to touch. I guess it doesn't matter if it's literal or metaphorical. The Void just likes it when I'm running on empty.

He's stirring now. Time to get this done. I loose a volley into his bed post. The telltale otherworldly sucking sound—poor guy tries to fight it, but he's got no chance. He looks around frantically for the shooter, then recognition hits his face. That's my cue! …Boom, job done. Can't do that on a full stomach.
2453351420.lore_zh:
吃饱喝足了，我似乎就无法与虚空交流。一定得饿了，饿坏了才会有最好的效果。我开始感到那种疼痛，就在那时我听到了它，几乎就像某个声音在我耳边低语。我第一次学到这点时，还以为早起干活会搞砸买卖，毕竟早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。而我却在破晓时分，栖息在一棵巨大的老树上，幻想着我的下一口猎物。就盯梢而言还不算太糟，要是你要还清一个卑鄙的无良领主的债，那你有个坐的地儿已经很幸运了。

我盯了我的目标好几天了。这名凯尔在露天的环境下入睡，身边被仆人簇拥着，总算露出了惬意自在的神情。我想他们应该是最后一道防线，但他们还没有注意到我。看来好帮手可没那么好找。

我几小时前就该开枪了，但我应该先发出一枪预警，让他知道接下来会发生什么。这样他“丧命的时候就知道是谁了结了他”。战争领主们喜欢传他们的小信息，而要是他睡着就听不到了。这家伙一直在打盹。真羡慕这一点。

这提醒了我，我发现了另一个小技巧，可以让你和那张我们称之为虚空的无边巨口搞好关系：筋疲力尽。我开始进入那种朦胧状态的时候，那种我不确定自己是醒着还是在做梦的状态，我能感觉到那种缺失感。近到好像能触摸到一样。我想不管是字面意思还是象征意义。虚空就是喜欢我被掏空的样子。

他现在在翻身。是时候完成任务了。我朝他的床柱射了一枪。那是一阵明显的异界啜食声——这个可怜的家伙试图反抗，但他毫无胜算。他疯狂地四处寻找射手，然后脸上露出了觉悟的神情。这时就该我动手了！…砰，任务完成。吃饱了可做不到这样。

2842471112.name: Sentinel
2842471112.typeName_zh: 普通 泰坦分支职业
2842471112.lore:
"I am the wall against which Darkness breaks… I am the wall against which Darkness breaks… I am the wall against which Darkness breaks…"

I repeat these words amongst the rubble. Smoldering heaps, scarred earth; the warriors and their spoils. This is victory. This should be the moment where everything clicks. All I feel is emptiness.

No one thinks of Titans as meditators, but I can think of no better provocation than the comedown after battle. All that I am is tied up in combat. And when it's over, space itself crashes in around me. In the old days, I stayed there, in agony. The urge to escape that feeling would gnaw at me, so I'd find a reason to start something. Anything. Just to watch the sparks fly. Now…  I meditate.

In time, I learned to thrust my enemies into this same anguish. When you aren't prepared for it, the weight of your own insignificance measured against the vastness of the cosmos can be debilitating.

I still must confront the silence after glory; I feel the nature of the Void most keenly in these moments. I have begun, I think, to look forward to them.
2842471112.lore_zh:
“我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…我是暗影冲破的那堵墙…”

我在瓦砾之中重复着这些话。闷燃不止的废墟，遍体鳞伤的土地，战士们和他们的战利品。这就是胜利。这本该是一切得偿所愿的时刻。但我只感觉到了空虚。

没人觉得泰坦会冥想，但我想不到比战后失意更好的挑衅了。我所做的一切都是为了战斗。而它结束时，空间就会在我周围崩塌瓦解开来。在过去的日子里，我就这么痛苦不堪地待在那里。想要逃离那种感觉的冲动会折磨着我，这样我就能找借口制造点麻烦。无事生非。只是为了看事态愈演愈烈。如今…我开始了冥想。

久而久之，我学会了让我的敌人也陷入同样的痛苦。在你还没准备好的时候，与浩瀚的宇宙相比自身微不足道的重压只会让人变得虚弱。

我仍然必须面对荣耀过后的沉寂；在这些瞬间，我最深切地感受到了虚空的本质。我想，我已经开始期待它们的到来了。

2849050827.name: Voidwalker
2849050827.flavor: Those who have stared into the Void are not bound by the laws of space and time.
2849050827.typeName_zh: 普通 术士分支职业
2849050827.lore:
"The space between defines the shape. The rest before the note, the breath before the word, the blank space on the page."  

A chill hit the air, and I looked up from my studies. There was a stillness, an uneasy calm before the storm. An ambush awaited me; of that, I was certain. No time to wonder how my defenses had failed. No time to ponder how they had found my hidden library in the first place. I had only just lifted my eyes from those insightful words on the Void. Now, I'd have to take my first steps upon it and hope I didn't fall right through. 

"Seize her," the lead marauder thundered. Through every window crashed enemies intent on my destruction. Time stretched out before me. With a thought, I was at the center of the fray. A gaping, celestial maw drained the life from them. I found my footing: the power of the Void was manifest, yet this was not its full nature. 

The next instant, reality snapped back into its traditional rhythm. I was alone once more. The intruders didn't even have time to comprehend their fate. I was barely more enlightened than they were, yet I had gleaned one fundamental truth. 

A step upon the Void is a step upon that nothing which can bear the weight.
2849050827.lore_zh:
“空间定义了形状。定义了音符前的休止，话语前的气口，书页上的空白。”  

一阵寒意袭来，我停下研究，抬起头来。周遭一片寂静，暴风雨来临前那令人不安的平静。一场伏击在等着我；这一点我十分肯定。没时间去琢磨我的防御是怎么被突破的。没时间去思考他们是如何找到我隐秘的图书馆的。我刚刚把目光从那些有关虚空的深刻语句中移开。现在我必须迈出踏入虚空的第一步，希望自己不会踩空。 

“抓住她。”领头的狂暴劫匪吼道。敌人从每一扇窗户闯入，企图毁掉我。时间在我眼前流逝。一念之间我就已处在冲突的中央。一张星界的血盆大口吸干了他们的生命。 我找到了我的立足点：虚空的力量显现了出来，但这并不是它的全部本质。 

下一个瞬间，现实又闪回了它惯有的韵律。我又一次陷入孤寂。入侵者甚至没时间去理解自身的命运。我所领悟的并不比他们多，但我发现了一个基本事实。 

踏在虚空之上，就是踏在可承重的无物之上。

2240888816.name: Gunslinger
2240888816.flavor: A lone wolf who lives for the perfect shot.
2240888816.typeName_zh: 普通 猎人分支职业
2240888816.lore:
What a sorry excuse for a stakeout this is. He's resting against my Sparrow, balanced on a knife's edge, ready to spring to action at a moment's notice. Posse's got him flanked and eyes all on a swivel and they're looking for trouble. Looking for me.

They try to squint the sun out of their eyes, but it won't help them. I remember when I used to shield my eyes. I remember when I tried to stay in the shadows. I don't squint no more.

I drain my cup, and I stand, stretching my weary hands. The sun glints off the barrel of his pistol, and I can tell it's gonna be quick. Group's getting antsy. And where there's impatience, there's imprecision. I don't forgive imprecision.

Stepping into the sunlight, it's like I can breathe again. All at once, they skitter to attention like I ain't been watching them for the past 20 minutes. Big one gets his rear off my ride. Small victory. Then he puffs himself up, hand inching toward his pistol. Mine stays planted on my belt.

"Look who finally stepped into the light of day."  

I sure did. And you're gonna wish I hadn't.
2240888816.lore_zh:
好一个糟糕的盯梢借口。他靠在我的快雀上，竭力稳住局势，随时准备一接到通知就采取行动。一群民兵在他两侧排开，全都怒目圆睁，他们在寻找麻烦。寻找我。

他们试图眯起眼睛避开阳光，但这无济于事。我还记得我以前常常遮住双眼。我还记得我试图躲在阴影里。我再也不眯眼了。

我喝干了杯里的水，站在那伸了伸疲惫的懒腰。烈日在他的枪管上闪闪发光，我知道事情很快就会发生。这群人变得焦躁不安，急躁的时候失误就会随之而来。我可决不饶恕失误。

走进阳光里，我仿佛又能呼吸了。突然间，他们吓得全都四散开来，就好像我没有盯着他们看了20分钟似的。领头的家伙从我的坐骑上起身。一个小小的胜利。然后他就趾高气扬起来，手慢慢地伸向手枪。我的枪还牢牢挂在腰带上。

“看看是谁终于来到太阳底下见人了。”  

当然是我。而你会希望我没有这样做。

2550323932.name: Sunbreaker
2550323932.flavor: Forge the fury of undying suns.
2550323932.typeName_zh: 普通 泰坦分支职业
2550323932.lore:
When the longing to steep in that blessed heat was at its most intoxicating, the reins were pulled taught, and the hammer fell. Fell upon the wretched, fell upon those who would do evil to Sol, fell upon the land baptizing it in fire.

When the smoke cleared, the reins were no more. The fire began to die until there was barely a hammer left among us. The righteous order, those who would shatter stars, dissolved amid the crackling of embers.

When the winds changed, the embers caught and ignited a new flame. That flame swells for those who seek out the destruction lurking in shadows, that they may cleanse it in the sun.

When that flame reaches its zenith, none shall escape its warmth. Arise, all you who carry the hammer! There are yet more suns to break.
2550323932.lore_zh:
就在沉浸于那神圣热浪中的渴望最让人陶醉之际，缰绳被勒紧，战锤落了下来。落在那些不幸之人身上，落在那些想对烈日作恶的人身上，落在那以火洗礼的土地上。

烟雾散去，缰绳也不复存在。火焰开始熄灭，直至我们之中几乎一把战锤也不剩。正义的秩序，那些想要碎裂群星的人，在余烬的爆裂声中消散无踪。

风向转变，余烬又燃起了新的火焰。那火焰为那些潜藏在阴影中寻求毁灭的人而涌动，这样他们就可以在阳光下进行净化。

那火焰达到巅峰时，没人能逃脱它的暖热。所有手持战锤的人都站起来吧！还有更多的烈日要去击碎。

3941205951.name: Dawnblade
3941205951.flavor: Spread your wings and set the sky ablaze.
3941205951.typeName_zh: 普通 术士分支职业
3941205951.lore:
Rise. Closer, closer to the sun.
Your life shall be restored; the three shall be as one.

Dash. Swiftly, swiftly as the Light.
A scorched earth lies below; foes flee from the fight.

An incandescent ray; behold the mighty way.

Rise. Closer, closer to the blaze.
My wings shall never melt. They're already aflame.
3941205951.lore_zh:
上升。靠近，靠近烈日。
你的生命将会恢复；三者合而为一。

冲刺。迅捷，迅捷如光。
底下是一片焦土；敌人落荒而逃。

炽热的光束；注视这通天大道。

上升。靠近，靠近烈焰。
我的双翼决不会熔化。它们早已燃起。

634549439.name: Phantasmal Shell
634549439.lore:
Mithrax repeats the mantra to himself as he makes his way across the H.E.L.M. It was not long ago that this wing housed the Servitor that sustained the House of Light and aided the Vanguard in stopping the Endless Night.

But now, something altogether different lurks within these walls.
As he descends the stairs into the hangar bay, he sees it for the first time: the Crown of Sorrow, large and grotesque, seated ominously in the spot the Servitor once occupied. That is when he hears the voices.

"Miiiissssraaakssss," they hiss in unison.

Out of the corners of his eyes, he sees their shadows skittering along the walls and ceiling. Dregs. Vandals. Faces he vaguely recognizes. Names he barely knew or never learned.

"The Light provides." Even in his own mind, his voice sounds somehow smaller.

"Kell of Light… Captain of Death…"

They swarm toward him now, phantasmal Ether bleeding from wounds he inflicted in another life.

"We remember. We remember what you did. We remember who you are."

"The Light provides," he tells himself as a shiver runs down his back. "The Light provides. The Light—" 

"Misraaks?"

He spins around, Splicer Gauntlet poised to strike. Only when he sees Crow standing at the wing's entrance does he lower it.

"What's going on?" the Hunter asks.

"It is nothing," Mithrax lies. The voices are silent—their shadows, gone. But not forgotten. "Excuse me."

He pushes past Crow without another word, desperate to leave the past behind.
634549439.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯一边穿行过应急后勤行动中心，一边念叨着口头禅。不久前，这座翼楼里还住着维系着光能氏族并帮助先锋阻止了永夜的魔眼。

而现在，一些完全不同的东西潜伏在这些高墙内。
当他走下楼梯进入机库时，他第一次见到了它：忧愁王冠，巨大而怪异，不祥地坐落在魔眼曾经占据的地方。就在这时他听到了那些声音。

“米…斯…拉…阿…克…斯”他们齐声发出嘶鸣。

他从眼角看到了他们的影子沿着墙壁和天花板掠过。堕落士兵。暴徒。他依稀认得的面孔。他几乎不知道或从未了解过的名字。

“光能赐予我们所需。”即使在他自己的内心里，他的声音听起来也有点小。

“光能凯尔…死亡队长…”

他们开始向他蜂拥而来，幻想的乙太从他在另一段生命中受到的创伤里不断渗出。

“我们记得。我们记得你做了什么。我们记得你是谁。”

“光能赐予我们所需，”他自言自语，后背一阵冷颤。“光能赐予我们所需。光能——” 

“米斯拉阿克斯？”

他转过身，熔岩臂铠摆出攻击姿态。直到他看到乌鸦站在翼楼的入口处时，才放松下来。

“怎么了？”猎人问道。

“没什么，”米瑟拉克斯撒了谎。那些声音沉寂了——他们的影子，消失不见了。但却难以忘怀。“失陪了。”

他一言不发地从乌鸦身边挤过，拼命地想把过去抛在脑后。

3692900164.name: Eidolon Shell
3692900164.flavor: For Ghosts whose Guardians have no doubts to bind.
3692900164.source: Source: Season of the Haunted Triumph
3692900164.lore:
//OWL COMM-chat4: Opn, Log, Midas-003//
//Archival Access Designation: VG-GREEN//

OWL-3-RaGo: Camrin, I read the report you sent on the link established between the Leviathan and the Lunar Pyramid. Some of these details are alarming.

OWL-7-CaDu: It concerns me, that's for sure. There's almost a direct 1:1 transaction correlation between data leaving the Leviathan—a great deal of it, mind you—and the psychoactive Pyramid projections we're seeing flood INTO the Leviathan.
 
OWL-3-RaGo: If that's true, then the material destabilizations we're seeing from the Leviathan… the Pyramid may be the source for all of it. 

OWL-7-CaDu: Do we have an updated ETA on the Leviathan spectral analysis from the H.E.L.M.? That might give us some additional answers.

OWL-3-RaGo: Forty-five percent of the analysis remains… not surprising, though—the Leviathan is quite large. In the meantime, we should contact Lab-C for updates on Eg-999. I'm curious to see what, if any, connection exists to the Pyramid.

OWL-1-ShLi: I've got some bad news there. The analysis can't be completed.

OWL-3-RaGo: What? Why?

OWL-1-ShLi: Safety protocols, repeated containment breaches. All Earth-side lab samples of the egregore fungus were incinerated.

OWL-3-RaGo: …

OWL-1-ShLi: BUT a certain Hidden contact, Eris Morn, has informed me that the fungus is similar to a synapse within a nervous system. She claims it is a physical manifestation of the Darkness, like Stasis. But unlike Stasis, it appears to be an "impure" manifestation—her words, not mine.

OWL-7-CaDu: There are a lot of implications there.

OWL-1-ShLi: Morn never delivers a lack of implications with her theories. In any case, I suggest we make a note and move on for now. Our best path to understanding is still a spectral analysis of the signals the Leviathan is throwing out and deciphering their meaning.
3692900164.lore_zh:
//OWL通讯聊天4：行动，日志，迈达斯-003//
//档案权限指定：VG-GREEN//

OWL-3-RaGo：卡姆林，我看了你发来的关于利维坦和月球金字塔之间联系的报告。其中有些细节让人十分警觉。

OWL-7-CaDu：确实很让我担忧。离开利维坦的数据——请注意，这可是大量的数据——和我们看到涌入利维坦的金字塔灵能投影之间几乎存在着1:1的影响关联。
 
OWL-3-RaGo：如果这是真的，那我们从利维坦上看到的实体扰动…金字塔可能就是这一切的源头。 

OWL-7-CaDu：来自应急后勤行动中心的利维坦光谱分析有最新的预计抵达时间吗？那也许能给我们带来更多的答案。

OWL-3-RaGo：还剩下45%的分析…不过这也不奇怪——利维坦相当庞大。与此同时，我们应该联系Lab-C获取Eg-999的更新信息。我很好奇这和金字塔之间有什么样的联系，如果有的话。

OWL-1-ShLi：我带来了坏消息。分析工作无法完成。

OWL-3-RaGo：什么？为什么？

OWL-1-ShLi：安全协议，反复的遏制失效。所有地球实验室的守望者真菌样本都被焚化了。

OWL-3-RaGo：…

OWL-1-ShLi：但是某个隐秘者线人，埃里斯·摩恩，告诉过我这种真菌类似于神经系统里的突触。她说这是暗影的实体具象，就像冰影一样。但与冰影不同，这似乎是一种“不纯”的具象——她的原话，不是我说的。

OWL-7-CaDu：这里头有很多暗示。

OWL-1-ShLi：摩恩的理论从来不缺暗示。无论如何，我建议我们先做个记录，然后继续下去。我们想获得了解的最佳途径，仍然是对利维坦发出的信号进行光谱分析并破译其含义。

1554105351.name: Horus Shell
1554105351.flavor: One day you will be whole again. No matter how many pieces you have shattered into.
1554105351.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼胜场
1554105351.lore:
Electric lights recessed above the airstair of Saint-14's jumpship buzz, punctuated by the occasional plink from a loose ballast. The mechanical din is reminiscent of insects, a subtlety normally lost to the noise of the Tower's Hangar. But the area is quiet at this hour, long before dawn, the absence of activity felt deeper. Lonelier. 

Saint sits on the steps beneath his ship, a dog-eared journal clasped in his large hands. The bronze eye embossed on the cover marks it as belonging to Osiris. A delicate lock conceals the contents; Saint's thumb teases the corner of the clasp. It would take insignificant effort to break it—a significant violation of Osiris's privacy. Still, the temptation pulls at his fingers.

Geppetto, Saint's Ghost, transmats in over his shoulder. "Call for you," she says with a glance down to the journal and then affixes a firm eye of judgment on him. The Titan shrinks away from her stare.

"Put it through," Saint says. He welcomes a distraction.

"Saint." Mithrax's voice comes loud and clear through Geppetto. "I… did not expect you to answer. It seems we are both unable to find proper rest."

"Yes," Saint agrees in a small voice, his attention wavering. "What… was it you needed, Mithrax?"

"We have a supply shipment that just came in," Mithrax says with a hint of hope in his voice. "We could use another set of hands." 

Saint does not immediately reply as he runs one hand over the journal. Geppetto nudges him, and he sighs, setting the journal aside. "I can help," he says. "You point, I lift, right?" His weary laugh is telling.

"That's good to hear. Eido has been looking forward to seeing you again," Mithrax says, gently. Saint nods to himself, slowly rising from the steps. Geppetto zips over and transmats the journal back to Saint's home in a crackling stream of light.

"Thank you for thinking of me, friend," Saint says over his shoulder. Geppetto looks to him, unsure if his words were directed at her or Mithrax. But then, she realizes:

It was both.
1554105351.lore_zh:
内嵌在圣人-14号跃迁飞船舷梯上方的电灯所发出的嗡鸣声，偶尔会被松动的压舱物发出的叮当声打断。机械的喧闹声让人不禁想起了昆虫，这种微妙的声音常常会被高塔机库的噪音所掩盖。但这个时候这块地方很安静，离破晓还早，一片死寂的感觉更加深刻。更加孤独。 

圣人坐在飞船下的台阶上，大手里紧握着一本折了角的日记。封面上的青铜眼浮雕表明着它属于奥斯里斯。一把精致的锁将里面的东西隐藏起来；圣人的拇指拨弄着扣环的一角。破解它花不了多少功夫，这是对奥斯里斯隐私的严重侵犯。尽管如此，诱惑仍在拉扯着他的手指。

圣人的机灵盖比特，越过他的肩膀传送了进来。“你的电话，”她说着瞥了一眼日记，然后坚定地审视着他。这名泰坦顿时畏缩了起来。

“接进来，”圣人说道。他正需要分散一下注意力。

“圣人。”透过盖比特，米瑟拉克斯的声音响亮而清晰。“我…没想到你会接。看来我们俩都没法好好休息。”

“没错，”圣人小声表示同意，他的注意力摇摆不定。“需要我做什么吗，米瑟拉克斯？”

“我们刚刚收到一批补给，”米瑟拉克斯的声音中透着一丝希望。“需要人搭把手。” 

圣人没有立即回应，他用一只手翻着日记。盖比特推了推他，他叹了口气，把日记放在一边。“我可以帮忙，”他说。“你来指，我来搬，是吧？”他发出了疲倦的笑声。

“那太好了。艾多一直期待再次见到你，”米瑟拉克斯轻声说道。圣人暗自点点头，慢慢从台阶上站起来。盖比特拉上锁，在一道噼啪作响的光流中把日记传送回了圣人的家。

“谢谢你能想到我，朋友，”圣人回过头说道。盖比特看着他，不确定他是在跟谁说话，她还是米瑟拉克斯。但随后，她意识到：

那是对他们俩说的。

你的黎明射弹在命中时会灼烧目标。

2274196887.name: Well of Radiance
2274196887.description: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
2274196887.description_zh: 将你的刀剑刺入地面，对附近目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。刀剑会发出持续的光环，为附近盟友提供焕光和恢复效果，使其免受冰影效果的影响。

2274196884.name: Song of Flame
2274196884.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
2274196884.description_zh:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

4016776974.name: Lightweight Knife
4016776974.description: Quickly throw a knife that deals moderate damage. Precision hits with this knife make you radiant for a short duration.
4016776974.description_zh: 快速投掷一把飞刀造成中等伤害。使用此飞刀精准命中可在短时间内获得焕光效果。

4016776975.name: Weighted Throwing Knife
4016776975.description:
Throw a knife that deals extra precision damage and causes scorched targets to ignite.

Precision final blows with this knife immediately recharge your class ability.
4016776975.description_zh:
投掷一把飞刀造成额外精准伤害并点燃被灼烧的目标。

使用此飞刀造成精准最后一击可立即重新充能职业技能。

4016776972.name: Knife Trick
4016776972.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
4016776972.description_zh: 投掷烈火刀扇， 灼烧 命中的目标。

4016776973.name: Proximity Explosive Knife
4016776973.description: Throw a knife that attaches to surfaces upon impact and explodes when it detects a nearby target.
4016776973.description_zh: 丢出一把飞刀，接触时附着于表面并在侦测到附近的目标时爆炸。

852252788.name: Hammer Strike
852252788.description:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
852252788.description_zh:
短时间冲刺后，使用此近战技能挥出一支燃烧的战锤，灼烧目标并在其身后锥形区域造成伤害。

如果目标被战锤打击消灭，其将会被点燃。

852252789.name: Throwing Hammer
852252789.description: Throw a hammer from a distance. Picking up a thrown hammer grants melee energy. Energy generated is scaled by your Melee stat. If the hammer struck a target, picking it up grants cure.
852252789.description_zh: 从远处投掷飞锤。拾起飞锤会获得近战能量。生成的能量会根据你的近战属性进行调整。如果飞锤击中目标，拾起时可提供治愈效果。

1470370539.name: Celestial Fire
1470370539.description: Send out a spiral of three explosive Solar energy blasts, scorching targets with each hit.
1470370539.description_zh: 发射一道螺旋的三个爆炸性烈日能量飞弹，每次击中都会灼烧目标。

1470370538.name: Incinerator Snap
1470370538.description: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
1470370538.description_zh: 打响手指生成一个燃烧火扇，可爆炸并灼烧目标。

2946990961.name: Tripmine Grenade
2946990961.description: An explosive grenade that sticks to surfaces and detonates when targets pass through its laser trigger, dealing damage and moderately scorching them.
2946990961.description_zh: 可粘附在表面上的高爆手雷，在目标穿过它的激光触发装置时引爆，对其造成伤害及中等灼烧效果。

3969294337.name: Thermite Grenade
3969294337.description: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
3969294337.description_zh: 能向前发射一道燃烧火焰的手雷，对路径上的目标造成伤害及灼烧效果。

2581086849.name: Incendiary Grenade
2581086849.description: A grenade that explodes in a fiery burst and heavily scorches nearby targets.
2581086849.description_zh: 可燃焰爆裂并对附近目标造成严重灼烧效果的手雷。

2216698406.name: Solar Grenade
2216698406.description: A grenade that creates a flare of Solar Light that continuously damages and scorches targets trapped inside.
2216698406.description_zh: 可迸发出烈日之光的手雷，对困在其中的目标造成持续性伤害及灼烧效果。

3199702642.name: Swarm Grenade
3199702642.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
3199702642.description_zh: 命中时会发生爆炸的手雷，可释放出多个无人机追踪附近目标。每个无人机可对受影响的目标造成轻微的灼烧效果。

1013086087.name: Fusion Grenade
1013086087.description: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets, damaging and moderately scorching them on detonation.
1013086087.description_zh: 可粘附在目标身上的高爆手雷，爆炸时对其造成伤害及中等灼烧效果。

2202441959.name: Firebolt Grenade
2202441959.description: A grenade that unleashes bolts of damaging Solar Light at nearby targets and slightly scorches them.
2202441959.description_zh: 能够对附近目标释放伤害性烈日光束，并对其造成轻微灼烧效果的手雷。

1841016428.name: Healing Grenade
1841016428.description: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
1841016428.description_zh: 可在击中时治疗友军并制造仁慈烈日光能能量球的手雷，拾取能量球时可为友军提供恢复效果。

3066103998.name: Knock 'Em Down
3066103998.flavor: A scorched shell casing smelling of gunpowder, somehow still warm to the touch. You flash, brilliant, in dark times.

3066103999.name: On Your Mark
3066103999.flavor: A leather holster, well-worn. You were always quicker on the draw.

3066103996.name: Gunpowder Gamble
3066103996.flavor: A book of matches, just one left. Light 'em up.

3066103997.name: Crackshot
3066103997.flavor: A dusty leather hat, scarred by the nicks of countless forgotten skirmishes. You walked away from those fights. Your foes didn't.

2984351204.name: Roaring Flames
2984351204.flavor: A shard of obsidian, brimming with the light of day. Eons will pass before you fade.

2984351205.name: Sol Invictus
2984351205.flavor: A golden medallion emblazoned with the symbol of a hammer, weighing heavy around your neck. Your inferno starts with a single flicker.

2984351206.name: Consecration
2984351206.flavor: The pommel stone of a battle-scarred war hammer, radiant with an inner fire. You reclaim this once-hallowed ground.

2984351207.name: Shieldburst
2984351207.flavor: A worn radio detonator whose use brought victory in pitched battle. The best defense is vaporizing your foes before they ever strike.

83039195.name: Icarus Dash
83039195.flavor: A golden feather, drifting in the wind. One gust carries you where you need to go.

83039194.name: Heat Rises
83039194.flavor: A singed tome, bound in leather with notes scratched in the margins. You hold immeasurable knowledge of the approaching dawn.

83039193.name: Touch of Flame
83039193.flavor: A radiant cinder, still crackling as you hold it. With it, you could set the world aflame.

83039192.name: Hellion
83039192.flavor: The molten remains of a Cabal magma launcher barrel still sing with the Solar Light that ended its fire. The heavens open at your command, and from them rains vengeful flame.

3636300854.name: Marksman's Dodge
3636300854.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
3636300854.description_zh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

3636300855.name: Gambler's Dodge
3636300855.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
3636300855.description_zh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

3636300852.name: Acrobat's Dodge
3636300852.description: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.
3636300852.description_zh: 闪身以施展一次特技之跃。着陆时，使自身和附近友军获得焕光效果。

2495523340.name: Towering Barricade
2495523340.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
2495523340.description_zh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

2495523341.name: Rally Barricade
2495523341.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
2495523341.description_zh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

2979486803.name: Healing Rift
2979486803.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
2979486803.description_zh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

2979486802.name: Empowering Rift
2979486802.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
2979486802.description_zh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

2979486801.name: Phoenix Dive
2979486801.description:
Dive to the ground and create a burst of Solar Light that cures nearby allies.

While Heat Rises is active, you gain restoration while diving and scorch targets upon landing.
2979486801.description_zh:
向地面俯冲并生成一束可治愈附近友军的烈日光能。

激活炙热升腾时，你可以在俯冲时获得恢复效果并在落地时灼烧敌人。

1128768654.name: High Jump
1128768654.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
1128768654.description_zh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

1128768655.name: Strafe Jump
1128768655.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
1128768655.description_zh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

1128768652.name: Triple Jump
1128768652.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
1128768652.description_zh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

2225231092.name: High Lift
2225231092.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
2225231092.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

2225231093.name: Strafe Lift
2225231093.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
2225231093.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

2225231094.name: Catapult Lift
2225231094.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
2225231094.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

3686638443.name: Strafe Glide
3686638443.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
3686638443.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

3686638442.name: Burst Glide
3686638442.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
3686638442.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

3686638441.name: Balanced Glide
3686638441.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
3686638441.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

2895039606.name: Trespasser Catalyst
2895039606.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
2895039606.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

3072857252.name: Heartshadow Catalyst
3072857252.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
3072857252.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

2641107734.name: Unrepentant
2641107734.description: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.
2641107734.description_zh: 击杀后重新填装可使下次爆发连射成为时间延长、威力增大的超级爆发。

1100877327.name: Exhumation
1100877327.description: Heavy attacks made with full Sword energy turn you invisible and fire exploding Void projectiles.
1100877327.description_zh: 使用满格刀剑能量进行的重攻击可让你进入隐形状态，并发射爆炸虚空射弹。

3049431773.name: Adaptive Burst
3049431773.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

451371216.name: Adaptive Burst
451371216.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

4269485650.name: Adaptive Burst
4269485650.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

1655963600.name: Adaptive Burst
1655963600.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

1063261332.name: Adaptive Burst
1063261332.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

1579862386.name: Unrepentant
1579862386.description: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.
1579862386.description_zh: 击杀后重新填装可使下次爆发连射成为时间延长、威力增大的超级爆发。

1271851280.name: Be the Danger
1271851280.description: Final blows with Unrepentant superbursts automatically reload your weapon and provide an Unrepentant superburst.
1271851280.description_zh: 使用不知悔改超级爆发击杀可自动重新填装武器并提供不知悔改超级爆发。

1563633475.name: Exhumation
1563633475.description: Heavy attacks made with full Sword energy turn you invisible and fire exploding Void projectiles.
1563633475.description_zh: 使用满格刀剑能量进行的重攻击可让你进入隐形状态，并发射爆炸虚空射弹。

873883409.name: Shot in the Dark
873883409.description:
Remaining invisible grants this weapon increased damage for a brief duration.

Hitting a target with this weapon's projectiles while Shot in the Dark is active weakens them. Defeating a target with this weapon while Shot in the Dark is active turns you invisible once more.
873883409.description_zh:
保持隐形会在短时间内提高此武器的伤害。

启用暗地一击时，使用此武器的射弹击中目标会对其造成虚弱效果。启用暗地一击时，使用此武器击败目标会使你再次隐形。

2997472817.name: Osmosis
2997472817.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.
2997472817.description_zh: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。

2060213237.name: Osmosis
2060213237.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it. Handling is improved.
2060213237.description_zh: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

744594675.name: Well-Rounded
744594675.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
744594675.description_zh:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可提供武器稳定性、操控性和射程叠加加成。

使用超能可提供最大叠加次数。

2139363611.name: Well-Rounded
2139363611.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants an improved stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
2139363611.description_zh:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可提供更多的武器稳定性、操控性和射程叠加加成。

使用超能可提供最大叠加次数。

4293542123.name: Incandescent
4293542123.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
4293542123.description_zh:
消灭一个目标会向附近目标蔓延灼烧效果。
更强大的战斗人员和敌方守护者会在更大的范围内造成灼烧效果。

2675184851.name: Incandescent
2675184851.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
2675184851.description_zh:
消灭一个目标会向附近目标蔓延持续时间更长的灼烧效果。
更强大的战斗人员和敌方守护者会在更大的范围内造成灼烧效果。

776531651.name: Repulsor Brace
776531651.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.
776531651.description_zh: 消灭虚空减益目标可提供覆盖护盾。

2541826827.name: Repulsor Brace
2541826827.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.
2541826827.description_zh: 消灭虚空减益目标可提供覆盖护盾，持续时间延长。

2451262963.name: Fragile Focus
2451262963.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.
2451262963.description_zh: 此武器可获得射程加成，直至你的护盾被摧毁。在你的护盾重新充满能量后，该加成将重新生效。

1609056795.name: Fragile Focus
1609056795.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.
1609056795.description_zh: 此武器可获得射程加成，直至你的护盾被摧毁。在你的护盾重新充满能量后，该加成将更快地重新生效。

557221067.name: Killing Tally
557221067.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.
557221067.description_zh: 完成击杀可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。

2896748467.name: Killing Tally
2896748467.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.
2896748467.description_zh: 完成最后一击可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。提高弹匣容量。

1380061575.name: Dream Work
1380061575.description: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves and increase reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive faster draw time.
1380061575.description_zh: 每次重新填装时，助攻或协助最后一击可从储存弹药中部分填装武器，并在短时间内提高填装速度。弓箭的开弓速度更快。

1198287879.name: Dream Work
1198287879.description: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves for an improved amount and improve reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive improved draw time.
1198287879.description_zh: 每次重新填装时，助攻或协助最后一击可更多地从储存弹药中部分填装武器，并在短时间内进一步提升填装速度。弓箭的开弓速度进一步加快。
1198287879.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1905044254.name: To Excess
1905044254.description: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.
1905044254.description_zh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供近战和手雷属性加成。

1347309874.name: To Excess
1347309874.description: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant an improved bonus to Melee and Grenade stats for a moderate duration.
1347309874.description_zh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供更多近战和手雷属性加成。
1347309874.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1250481499.name: Extrovert
1250481499.description: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores health.
1250481499.description_zh: 在多个战斗人员或梦魇附近完成最后一击可恢复生命值。

2012402531.name: Extrovert
2012402531.description: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores an improved amount of health.

2179827240.name: Roast 'Em
2179827240.description:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.
2179827240.description_zh:
你的感应飞刀会灼烧爆炸时造成伤害的目标，或在最后一击时点燃目标。

在投掷感应飞刀后，你会在飞刀爆炸前获得更高的近战回复能力。当你用灼烧伤害目标时，获得少量近战能量，点燃最后一击会完全返还近战能量，并可满溢为额外的飞刀充能。

1437147326.name: Myrmidon's Reach
1437147326.description: Gain a second charge of your Shield Throw melee. Your Shield Throws now weaken targets, create a Void Breach on final blows, and become shield-piercing, stunning [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and refunding a Shield Throw charge when you do. Picking up a Void Breach grants you Shield Throw energy.
1437147326.description_zh: 获得第二次圣盾投掷近战充能。圣盾投掷现在会削弱目标，并在最后一击时生成一个虚空裂口；具备护盾穿透能力，可眩晕屏障勇士，且在眩晕成功时返还一次圣盾投掷充能。拾取虚空裂口可提供圣盾投掷能量。

4222205045.name: Soaring Fusilier
4222205045.description: Air dodge reloads all of your weapons and improves the airborne effectiveness of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles; final blows with these weapons make you radiant. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.
4222205045.description_zh: 空中闪避可重新填装所有武器，提升融合步枪和线性融合步枪的空中效率；使用这些武器完成最后一击将使你获得焕光效果。中幅提高融合步枪和线性融合步枪的空中效率属性。
