2032249948.name: Tymbal Lucidae
2032249948.flavor: I've retraced my steps a hundred times searching for a memory.
2032249948.source: Source: Season of the Haunted Triumph
2032249948.lore:
Zavala hums to himself in the dead of night to keep his eyes from sliding shut. His office window is tinted in opaque digitization, leaving the commander's face awash in shimmering variance. He fiddles with a data pad headlining a lengthy and dense report from Eris Morn entitled, "The Imminent Threat." 

He sighs. He has read many reports just like this one. He recognizes the importance, but his urgency has eroded after yet another call to action.

"Targe." Zavala sees the Ghost perk up.

"Zavala?"

"Would you play ambient-SH9?"

"I can do that," Targe acknowledges. There is a brief delay before the Ghost emits a peaceful rustling, reminiscent of torch fire nestled in starlit wilderness. Soon, cicadas sing. Zavala places the data pad face down on his desk and sinks into his chair; his eyelids set under heavy night. He drifts in liminal consciousness—once removed—thoughts blend into dreams.

Zavala could smell the wildflowers. Burning wood from a fire, warming the air. A perfect, timeless mundanity. There is honey tea and the dull vanilla-musk of Safiyah's tomes. She was with him, beside him, vibrant and striking and deep in the study of her book. He loved her most when he could watch her mind work. 

His hands moved absentmindedly as knitting needles clacked, yarn weaving between them. Early evening stretched out before him; his son's infant silhouette traced into the violet sky. The air thrummed with the cicada's song. Hakim traipsed through the meadow as a child, stood a boy, and flickered forward through adolescence in rotoscoped evolution until, when he stepped in front of his father, he was almost a man. Zavala laughed to himself with prideful disbelief at the sight of his son.

Hakim beckoned him; Zavala set aside his needles and stood. He turned to Safiyah and kissed her. They followed their son into the meadow, and as they walk, lucidity smears back into the shimmering night, where the air is calm but the cicadas still sing.
2032249948.lore_zh:
夜深人静，萨瓦拉自己哼着小曲儿，不让眼皮闭上。他办公室的窗户经过了不透光的数字化染色处理，让这名指挥官的脸上布满了闪闪发光的色彩变化。他摆弄着一块数据板，上面写着埃里斯·摩恩的一份冗长而难懂的报告，题为《迫在眉睫的威胁》。 

他叹了口气。他读过很多类似的报告。他意识到这一问题的重要性，但在又一次呼吁采取行动过后，他的紧迫感已经减弱。

“塔格。”萨瓦拉看到机灵活跃了起来。

“萨瓦拉？”

“你能放下环境音乐-SH9吗？”

“好的，”塔格答应道。一阵短暂的延迟过后，机灵发出了平静的沙沙声，让人想起星光照耀的荒野中燃烧的火把。很快，蝉声鸣叫起来。萨瓦拉将数据板面朝下盖在桌子上，陷进椅子里；他的眼皮在浓重的夜色下耷拉着。他游离于边缘意识——一经消除——思绪就会融入梦境。

萨瓦拉能嗅到野花的香味。火堆里燃烧的木头，温暖着空气。完美而永恒的尘俗。既有蜂蜜茶，也有萨菲亚的书卷隐隐的香草麝香。她和他在一起，就在他身边，神采奕奕、引人注目，正埋头研究着她的书。他最喜欢看她思考的样子。 

他的双手心不在焉地移动着，织针咔哒作响，纱线在它们之间编织着。黄昏在他面前铺展开来；他儿子的孩童侧影映入紫罗兰色的天空。空气中回荡着蝉鸣。哈基姆在草地上蹒跚学步时还是个孩子，站在身来已是个年轻小伙子，青春期在转描成长中一闪而过，直到他站在父亲面前，几乎长大成人。看到儿子如此出类拔萃，萨瓦拉骄傲地笑了起来。

哈基姆向他招手；萨瓦拉把针放在一边，站了起来。他转向萨菲亚，吻了吻她。他们跟着儿子来到草地上，走着走着，清醒的神志一阵模糊，又回到了这个闪闪发光的夜晚，这儿空气很平静，但蝉鸣依然不止。

4279814045.name: Hushed Syrinx
4279814045.source: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
4279814045.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱
4279814045.lore:
Out of his armor, laid in a sterile bed and clothed in linen, Osiris looks thin and frail. Age wears lines into his face deeper than the trenches of Mercury. His chest rises and falls with slow breaths, and the ambient light provided by the surrounding medical equipment casts him in a pale blue shade, darkening the hollows beneath his eyes. He is a threadbare remnant of a man.

In contrast, Saint-14 is a mountain. Even seated at Osiris's bedside, the Titan looms over him like a gargoyle keeping watch. He looks at Osiris's hand, seemingly tiny, cradled within his own. There is so much fear in Saint's heart, so much doubt, and so much unspoken love. Too unspoken. Never again. Saint lifts Osiris's hand to his mouth and kisses his knuckles.

"I'm glad you're staying," Crow says, appearing in the doorway of the medical bay. Saint stands and only offers a silent nod in response, looking back at Osiris in a moment of uncertainty. Crow gives him a look of sympathy. "I understand."

"You do not." Saint's voice is tight, and Crow feels the shift in Saint's emotion. Not anger, but defensiveness. "Tell me something. Up there…" He points skyward, indicating the Leviathan in orbit over the Earth. "Your doubts, your shame—they come alive?"

Crow looks away for a moment, distracted by turbulent memories. "Yeah," he replies.

"That is why I do not go to help," Saint states in a firm tone. "Because—because I know Osiris will be waiting for me. Up there. And I… I cannot bear seeing another thing wearing his face."

Crow avoids Saint's gaze. He can feel the uneasy tension, palpable between them. Still, Crow steps forward and gently places a hand on Saint's arm. When he looks up into the Exo's eyes, it is not with judgment, but empathy.

Saint considers Crow's hand for a moment before drawing the Hunter into a tight embrace. 

"You are good bird. Thank you."
4279814045.lore_zh:
脱下盔甲，躺在无菌病床上，穿着亚麻布，奥斯里斯看起来非常瘦弱。岁月在他脸上留下的印迹比水星纹路还深。他的胸部随着缓慢的呼吸起起伏伏，附近医疗设备发出的光线将他投射在淡蓝色的阴影之中，映衬出他双眼底下凹陷的晦暗。他是个行将就木的人。

相比之下，圣人14号就是一座高山。即使是坐在奥斯里斯床边，这名泰坦依然在他上方像个石像鬼一样巍然屹立。他看着奥斯里斯的手，看上去十分小巧，握在他的手中。圣人的心中有如此多的恐惧，如此多的疑虑，如此多未曾说出口的爱。太多话未曾开口。再也不会了。圣人举起奥斯里斯的手放到嘴边，亲吻了他的指关节。

“我很高兴你留下来。”乌鸦说道，出现在医疗舱的门口。圣人站起身，只是默默地点头回应，带着片刻的犹豫回头看了眼奥斯里斯。乌鸦同情地回望着他。“我能理解。”

“你不能。”圣人的声音绷紧了，乌鸦感觉到了圣人情绪的转变。不是愤怒，而是自我防卫。“给我讲讲，在上面......”他指向天空，指着地球上空轨道上的利维坦。“你的疑虑，你的羞耻——它们活了过来？”

乌鸦移开视线，被混乱的记忆分散了注意力。“是的，”他回答道。

“这就是为什么我不去帮忙。”圣人用坚定的语气说道。“因为——因为我知道奥斯里斯会等着我。就在上头。而我…我不能眼睁睁看着另一个玩意顶着他的脸庞。”

乌鸦回避着圣人的注视。他能明显感觉到他们之间的剑拔弩张。尽管如此，乌鸦还是走上前去，轻轻地将一只手放在圣人的手臂上。当他抬头望向这名Exo的眼睛时，眼神里不是评判，而是共情。

圣人端详了片刻乌鸦的手，然后把猎人紧紧地搂在怀里。 

“你是一只好鸟。谢谢。”

488052106.name: Mandate of Strength
488052106.lore:
Amanda Holliday cursed as she readjusted the jumpship's exhaust system. The Häkke foundry knew how to make a mean gun, but their aerospace engineering needed some improvement.

"Is this one of the new fighters?" The question came from a deep voice that rumbled across the H.E.L.M.'s hangar bay.

With a sigh, Amanda wheeled her creeper out from under the ship and rose to her feet. "Just a prototype, but—"

She dropped her wrench as she found herself face-to-face with Empress Caiatl. 

"I mean, yes, your… uh… majesty." Amanda wiped the grease off her palms.

Caiatl laid a hand on the jumpship's hull, fingers delicately brushing the metallic surface. "Crude," she said musingly, "but it evokes power and efficiency."

"Häkke's specialty," Amanda replied. "Function over form."

"I can appreciate that," said Caiatl. "In a war fought with Hive magic and Darkness, I welcome the simplicity of heavy ordnance."

Amanda chuckled, despite herself. "Yeah… I can drink to that."

Amanda's shoulders relaxed. She leaned against her workbench and waited for the empress to finish her inspection.

"I used to be a pilot," Caiatl said suddenly. "As I soared across the skies of Torobatl, I felt a freedom that eluded me on the ground. As if…" she trailed off, unable to find the words.

"As if you were leaving all your troubles behind," Amanda offered softly. Knowingly.

"Yes," Caiatl said and turned to leave. "I look forward to seeing the prototype in action. You will be the one to fly it?"

"Wouldn't trust it with anyone else."

Caiatl made a sound that Amanda thought could have been a laugh. "Nor I, Shipwright. The Vanguard is fortunate to have you."

She nodded a farewell, leaving Amanda to her work.
488052106.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪一边咒骂着，一边重新调整跃迁飞船的排气系统。Häkke铸造厂知道如何制造一门好枪，但他们的航天工程还需要一些改进。

“这是一台新型战斗机吗？”这发问来自一个低沉的声音，在应急后勤行动中心的机库里隆隆作响。

阿曼达叹了口气，把她的机械爬行座椅从飞船下推了出来，站起身。“只是个原型机，不过——”

她发现自己面对着的是女帝查厄托，失手掉落了扳手。 

“我的意思是，是的，陛…呃…陛下。”阿曼达擦拭着手掌上的油脂。

查厄托将一只手放在跃迁飞船的船体上，手指轻轻地擦过金属表面。“很粗糙，”她若有所思地说，“但它带来了力量和效率。”

“Häkke就擅长这个”，阿曼达答道。“功能高于外形。”

“我能理解，”查厄托说道。“在一场与邪魔族魔法和暗影对抗的战争中，我乐于接受重型军械的简朴之处。”

阿曼达不由自主地笑了起来。“是啊…我完全同意。”

阿曼达放松了肩膀。她靠在工作台上，等待女帝完成检视。

“我曾经是一名飞行员，”查厄托突然说道。“当我飞过图罗巴特尔的天空时，我感到了一种在地面上无法获得的自由。就好像…”她的声音慢慢低了下来，找不到合适的词汇。

“就好像你把所有的烦恼都抛在脑后了，”阿曼达会意地轻声说道。

“没错，”查厄托说着，转身离开。“我期待看到这个原型机投入使用。会是你来开它吧？”

“我可不放心把它交给其他人。”

查厄托发出了一种阿曼达认为也许是笑声的声音。“我也一样，船匠。先锋有你在真是太幸运了。”

她点头告别，让阿曼达继续工作。

3816300537.name: Pale Steed
3816300537.lore:
"Eyes on the road," Marcus Ren told himself. "And don't look back."

It was a motto he lived by, both on and off the track. 

His Sparrow screamed across Luna's surface, kicking up clouds of moondust in its wake. Out here, he was free to push prototype engines to their limits. To open the throttle wide and really cut loose.

But that wasn't why he was riding so fast tonight.

He didn't notice anything strange at first. Not until he stopped to check the Sparrow's instruments. And then, he felt it: eyes on his back, a chill on his neck.

Marcus immediately hit the ignition and boosted the Sparrow to its top speed. But still the feeling followed him, and he knew what it was.

A Nightmare.

He'd heard the term on Vanguard channels. Phantoms wearing the faces of the lost, tormenting those who remembered them. And Marcus Ren remembered a lot of people.

He switched off the fuel regulator and kicked the Sparrow into overdrive. He didn't know who was chasing him, and he sure as hell wasn't looking over his shoulder to find out. 

"Eyes on the road," he repeated aloud, gripping the handlebars until his knuckles were as pale as death.

"And never look back."
3816300537.lore_zh:
“眼睛看路，”马库斯·伦告诉自己。“别回头。”

这是他的处世之道，无论在赛道上还是赛道外。 

他的快雀尖啸着掠过月球地表，身后扬起了一团团月尘。在这里，他可以自由自在地将原型引擎推至极限。大开油门，真正地无拘无束。

但这不是他今晚开得这么快的原因。

起初他没有注意到有什么异常。直到他停下来检查快雀的仪表。然后，他感觉到了：有双眼睛直盯着他的后背，一丝寒意在脖颈上作祟。

马库斯立即打火，把快雀加快到最高速度。但那种感觉仍然追随着他，他知道那是什么。

梦魇。

他在先锋频道里听到过这个词。那是以逝者面孔示人的鬼灵，折磨着那些记得他们的人。而马库斯·伦还记得很多人。

他关掉燃料调节器，让快雀全速行驶。他不知道是谁在追他，他肯定不会回头去找答案。 

“眼睛看路，”他大声重复着，紧握着车把，直到指关节惨白。

“千万别回头。”

2912094496.name: Trauermarsch
2912094496.flavor: "The dead do not often speak. But I always listen."
2912094496.lore:
Vell Tarlowe. Sai Mota. Omar Agah. Eriana-3.

The scarlet phantoms hang in the air beside Eris as she stares across the Enduring Abyss, her eyes fixed upon the Lunar Pyramid. 

Suspended between Nightmare and Memory, her old friends remain forever silent, offering neither torment nor guidance. They listen, and nothing more.

And sometimes, that is enough.

"Long has it been since I walked the Pyramid's protean halls," Eris muses. "Would it welcome me back, now that I meddle in its affairs by severing its growing bond with the Leviathan?" 

Her fireteam does not respond. 

"It does not matter," she concludes. "Regardless of the Pyramid's agenda, Calus must not succeed."

Her thoughts turn to the others aboard the Leviathan, confronting Nightmares of their own. She wonders—as she has done many times since binding the Crown of Sorrow —whether she should perform her own severance ritual.

Eris looks upon the apparitions that were once her fireteam, and her gaze softens.

For better or worse, she has grown accustomed to her grief. Let the others shed their burdens. She keeps hers close, heavy and held dear.

Without them, the silence would be deafening.
2912094496.lore_zh:
维尔·塔罗。赛·莫塔。奥马尔·阿加。爱莲娜-3。

猩红的鬼灵在埃里斯身旁悬在空中，她的目光越过永恒深渊，直盯着月球金字塔。 

她的老朋友在梦魇和回忆之间悬浮着，永远默不作声，既不折磨也不指引。他们只会倾听，仅此而已。

有些时候，这样就够了。

“我很久没有走进金字塔那千变万化的大厅了，”埃里斯若有所思地说道，“如今我插手切断了它和利维坦日益增长的纽带，它还会欢迎我回来吗？” 

她的火力战队没有回应。 

“这不重要，”她总结道。“不管金字塔的目的是什么，都不能让卡鲁斯得逞。”

她的思绪转向了利维坦上的其他人，他们还在直面着自身的梦魇。她不禁好奇，在束缚了那么多次忧愁王冠之后，她是不是应该进行自己的断舍仪式。

埃里斯看着曾是她火力战队一员的那些幽灵，她的目光柔和了。

不管是好是坏，她已经习惯了悲伤。让别人卸下身上的重担吧。她要把自己的负担，紧紧地抱在怀里。

没有这些，那将会是死寂般的沉默。

3262125707.name: Falcon's Chase
3262125707.flavor: "A shadow of a man. A glimpse of a dream."
3262125707.source: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
3262125707.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱
3262125707.lore:
Darkness floods me like breath, expanding with each thought. For a time, it flowed out as often as in, giving me space to surface above the pressing sea and glimpse the cruel storm above, the distant hope of shore. But now there is only the sea, and nothing true remains…

I shut all three of my eyes; I curl in on myself, offering the world my exoskeleton as a shield. I—

No. I am Human. Soft and vulnerable, shell-less. And… Lightless. Waves crash over me: heavy, choking, inexorable. No choice but to drown, no point in swimming. Even the armored succumb to the depths; what chance have I?

I wash up on a shattered stone breakwater. I do not know my limbs. I want, I want, I WANT—what? This craving pit echoing deep within me, what does it seek? I would crawl inland if I owned myself, if only to make the hungering stop.

The world erupts beneath me; stone becomes quicksand in an instant. I struggle, fear before thought, and it swallows me all the faster. I reach for aid—my hand is held—

Saint?

My fingers brush through open air, met instead by gripping claws. They tear at flesh and mind, wearing a grim intimacy, dripping in the sacrifice of thousands. I know these lie-sharpened talons. Would I could tear that understanding from the synaptic heart of me.

I am a hundred shards of myself, shimmering, broken in free fall, glimpsing my own infinite reflections. Some shine gold—some burn sickly green—and some fade as soon as they are witnessed. I cannot guess which one is real. Perhaps one is her. Perhaps I am her. My senses lie.

A familiar voice calls out, sonorous against the abyss, incomprehensible but sweet. I think I hear the fluttering of wings, but the hum of the Sundial gives no direction.

How long has it been?
3262125707.lore_zh:
暗影像呼吸一样淹没着我，随着每一个念头而扩张。有一段时间，它流出和流入的频率一致，给了我机会在汹涌的海面上浮出水面，瞥见水上残酷的风暴，那彼岸的渺茫希望。但如今只有大海，没剩下什么真实的东西…

我闭上了我的三只眼睛；我蜷缩在自己身上，用我的外骨骼作为保护世界的盾牌。我——

不。我是人类。柔软脆弱，无壳保护。而且…失去了光能。波涛冲击着我：沉重、窒息、无情。除了溺死别无选择，游泳毫无意义。就连全副武装之人也屈服于深渊；我又有什么机会？

我被冲到了一个破碎的石头防浪堤上。我的四肢毫无知觉。我想要，我想要，我想要——什么？这个渴望的深渊在我内心深处回响，它在寻求些什么？要是我能控制自己，就会爬向内陆，哪怕只是为了止住饥饿。

世界在我底下爆发；石头瞬间化作流沙。我挣扎着，恐惧先于思考，它更快地吞噬了我。我伸出手求援——我的手被握住了——

圣人？

我的手指在空中划过，却碰到了紧握的爪子。它们撕扯着血肉和心灵，带着一种可怖的亲密，滴落在成千上万的牺牲者身上。我知道这些谎言磨利的尖爪。我真想把这种想法从突触心脏上撕下。

我是上百个自我的碎片，在自由落体中闪闪发光，支离破碎，闪烁着自己无限的倒影。有些碎片闪着金色——有些烧成病态的绿色——有些一被看到就会褪色。我猜不出哪块碎片是真的。也许其中一块就是她。也许我就是她。我的感官在说谎。

有个熟悉的声音在呼唤着我，在深渊中显得铿锵有力。难以理解但却悦耳动听。我想我听到了展翼振翅的声音，但日晷的嗡鸣却没有指明方向。

过去多久了？

3936838052.name: Hyperborean Pinion
3936838052.flavor: Soar together, under an eternal sun.
3936838052.source_zh: 来源：已升级的事件卡片奖励
3936838052.lore:
"In a land of endless sun,
amidst the mountains tall and old,
the noble king of beasts and air
guards a treasure trove of gold.

With lion's pride and eagle's eye,
he soars above the fields of strife,
with his companion, sharp and bold,
bound by sacred oath for life.

And when he meets his end too soon,
his loving mate is left alone
to guard a hoard of little worth
and a cold and empty throne."

—Penned by Osiris, in memory of Saint-14, lost in the Infinite Forest
3936838052.lore_zh:
“在无尽的烈日之境，
高耸古老的群山之间，
高贵的野兽和制空之王
守卫着一座黄金宝库。

凭借着雄狮之傲和鹰隼之视，
他翱翔在纷争领域之上，
与他的伴侣一道，尖锐而勇敢，
终身被神圣的誓言所约束。

而在他英年早逝之后，
徒留下他心爱的伴侣
守护着一处毫无价值的宝藏
和一个冰冷空荡的王座。”

——由奥斯里斯所著，纪念迷失在无尽森林中的圣人14号

151208504.name: Hot Rod Havoc
151208504.flavor: The fastest ride around. Flames guaranteed to remain paint only.

151208506.name: Cordyception
151208506.flavor: Some spores plant themselves deeper than the surface.

151208507.name: Kindled Wanderer
151208507.flavor: No limit to the distance, nor to the flame.

151208508.name: Open-Sky Tourer
151208508.flavor: Sure, you could put a cover on it, but why would you?

2683352144.name: Crab Cycle
2683352144.flavor: Multiple field trials have proven the efficiency and power of the carcinized form.

3769507633.name: Arc Staff
3769507633.description:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

Heavy attack combos and airborne heavy slams blind targets.
3769507633.description_zh:
生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

[格挡]：按住来用你的电弧法杖抵挡来袭的射弹。

抵挡射弹会为你提供一层电光充能。

重攻击连击和空中猛击重攻击会致盲目标。

3769507632.name: Gathering Storm
3769507632.description:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
3769507632.description_zh:
将你的电弧法杖向前抛出，将其嵌在表面或大型目标上，震颤附近的目标。

短时间后，一道毁灭性的闪电将击中法杖，使其被电弧能量过充。在过充时，你的法杖会对附近的敌人放出闪电。

3769507635.name: Storm's Edge
3769507635.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
3769507635.description_zh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

119041299.name: Fists of Havoc
119041299.description:
Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Quickly dash forward, dealing damage to any impacted targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your fists to the ground, blinding targets and dealing damage in an area around you, leaving aftershocks in your wake. Performing a slam from the air or after a dash deals additional damage.
119041299.description_zh:
对双拳进行超级充能，使用漩涡之力猛击地面。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：快速向前冲刺，对任何被撞到的目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：用双拳猛砸地面，致盲目标，对你周围造成伤害并产生余震。从空中砸向地面或冲刺后可造成额外伤害。

119041298.name: Thundercrash
119041298.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
119041298.description_zh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

1081893460.name: Stormtrance
1081893460.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
1081893460.description_zh:
从你的手中释放电弧闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧光能流来电击目标。施放雷霆万钧会在你脚下产成一道震颤冲击波。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

1081893461.name: Chaos Reach
1081893461.description:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy. Sustained damage on a single target creates a jolting lightning strike at their position.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.
1081893461.description_zh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。对单体目标造成持续伤害可在其位置生成一道震颤闪电打击。激活时

 [超能] 可以提前终止超能，保留部分超能能量。

2716335211.name: Combination Blow
2716335211.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
2716335211.description_zh:
一种在击败一个目标后可暂时增加近战伤害的快速打击技能，效果最多可叠加三次。

使用此技能击败目标会提供职业技能能量，并恢复少量生命值。获得的能量会根据你的职业属性调整。

2716335210.name: Disorienting Blow
2716335210.description: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.
2716335210.description_zh: 用此近战技能击中目标可对其施加致盲，使你进入增幅状态，并为你提供中量电光充能。

2708585277.name: Seismic Strike
2708585277.description:
After sprinting for a short time, activate your charged melee ability to slam shoulder-first into your target, damaging and blinding targets in an area around them.

While you are amplified, the blind radius is increased.
2708585277.description_zh:
进行冲刺后短时间内，激活充能近战技能用肩部冲撞目标，伤害并致盲其周围的目标。

在增幅状态下，致盲的范围更大。

2708585276.name: Ballistic Slam
2708585276.description:
After sprinting and while airborne, activate your charged melee ability to slam to the ground, dealing damage to nearby targets.

Gain Super energy and stacks of Bolt Charge based on number of targets hit by Ballistic Slam.
2708585276.description_zh:
在冲刺之后或是在空中时激活你的充能近战技能来砸向地面，对附近的目标造成伤害。

基于弹道猛击命中的目标数量获得超能能量和电光充能层数。

2708585279.name: Thunderclap
2708585279.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
2708585279.description_zh:
[近战]：在地面上时按住此键以站稳脚跟并开始在手中充能电弧能量。

[近战]：放开此键以向前方释放出一道毁灭性的冲击波。充能越久，伤害越大。

1232050830.name: Ball Lightning
1232050830.description:
Fire an Arc projectile forward that releases a perpendicular lightning strike after a short time.

While amplified, Ball Lightning releases additional lightning strikes before detonating.
1232050830.description_zh:
向前方发射出一枚电弧射弹，此弹短时间后会释放一次垂直闪电打击。

在增幅状态下，球形闪电会在爆炸前放出额外的闪电打击。

1232050831.name: Chain Lightning
1232050831.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
1232050831.description_zh:
一种打击距离更远的近战，可震颤你的目标并向附近目标施放连锁闪电。

在增幅状态下，此技能会多放出一串连锁闪电。

2994412667.name: Lightning Grenade
2994412667.description: A grenade that sticks to any surface and emits bolts of lightning.
2994412667.description_zh: 可粘附在任何表面上且发散闪电光束的手雷。

2481624867.name: Storm Grenade
2481624867.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
2481624867.description_zh: 能够引起一场集中的闪电风暴的手雷。

2909720723.name: Flashbang Grenade
2909720723.description: An explosive grenade that damages and blinds nearby targets.
2909720723.description_zh: 可伤害并致盲附近目标的高爆手雷。

1713935764.name: Pulse Grenade
1713935764.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
1713935764.description_zh: 能够对位于其爆炸范围内的目标造成周期性伤害的手雷。

146194908.name: Skip Grenade
146194908.description: A grenade that splits upon impact, creating multiple projectiles that seek targets.
146194908.description_zh: 命中时分裂产生多个射弹追击目标的手雷。

4198689901.name: Flux Grenade
4198689901.description: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets.
4198689901.description_zh: 可粘附在目标身上的高爆手雷。

1582574009.name: Arcbolt Grenade
1582574009.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
1582574009.description_zh: 在附近目标之间引起连锁闪电的手雷。

4194622036.name: Flow State
4194622036.flavor: A gleaming amulet with a mantra inscribed. You control your breathing, and the world slows to a crawl.

4194622037.name: Tempest Strike
4194622037.flavor: The belt of a practiced master. Faster, faster, always faster. Unleash the tempest within.

4194622038.name: Lethal Current
4194622038.flavor: A sliver of fulgurite carved by lightning. Strike precisely, and do not relent.

4194622039.name: Ascension
4194622039.flavor: Shards of an Ahamkara bone, found in the ruins of the old Tower Courtyard. Their whispers make you feel light as a feather… but why?

1656549672.name: Touch of Thunder
1656549672.flavor: A bell that shakes with the remembrance of its final toll. It will sound again with the proper touch.

1656549673.name: Juggernaut
1656549673.flavor: A championship ring, dented and dirtied. They'll try to stop you in your tracks. Get up close and personal.

1656549674.name: Knockout
1656549674.flavor: An orb of dancing plasma, you hold the power of raw lightning in your fist. One strike is all you need.

1656549675.name: Storm's Keep
1656549675.flavor: A lantern shattered by lightning strikes between dueling Warlords on the front lines of conflict—it is held in time between destruction and reformation. Your voice fills with a commanding thunder as you look upon its light and prepare to charge.

1293395731.name: Arc Soul
1293395731.flavor: An electric eel poised for attack. Electrons sing at your approach. Another familiar joins your ranks.

1293395730.name: Lightning Surge
1293395730.flavor: An improvised electro-magnet, coils crudely wound. Displace and electrify, forces beckon from within you.

1293395729.name: Electrostatic Mind
1293395729.flavor: A long-forgotten experiment that draws strange adherents. Bring to mind the products of its charge.

1293395728.name: Ionic Sentry
1293395728.flavor: An antique radio transmitter from the Golden Age. Listen close and you can hear the chirping of its last transmission, yearning to be free.

426473316.name: Marksman's Dodge
426473316.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
426473316.description_zh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

426473317.name: Gambler's Dodge
426473317.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
426473317.description_zh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

489583096.name: Towering Barricade
489583096.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
489583096.description_zh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

489583097.name: Rally Barricade
489583097.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
489583097.description_zh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

489583098.name: Thruster
489583098.description: Quickly evade in a lateral direction.

25156515.name: Healing Rift
25156515.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
25156515.description_zh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

25156514.name: Empowering Rift
25156514.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
25156514.description_zh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

95544330.name: High Jump
95544330.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
95544330.description_zh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

95544331.name: Strafe Jump
95544331.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
95544331.description_zh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

95544328.name: Triple Jump
95544328.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
95544328.description_zh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

95544329.name: Blink
95544329.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.
95544329.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可触发一小段距离的传送。

1698387814.name: High Lift
1698387814.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
1698387814.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

1698387815.name: Strafe Lift
1698387815.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
1698387815.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

1698387812.name: Catapult Lift
1698387812.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
1698387812.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

4154539169.name: Strafe Glide
4154539169.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
4154539169.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

4154539168.name: Burst Glide
4154539168.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
4154539168.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

4154539171.name: Balanced Glide
4154539171.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
4154539171.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

3382176091.name: Grasp of the Void
3382176091.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Contraverse Hold. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3382176091.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变反转之握的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

4215514285.name: Alternate Conduction
4215514285.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Geomag Stabilizers. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
4215514285.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变地磁安定靴的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

3809192347.name: See Me, Feel Me
3809192347.description: Your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds after you emerge from being invisible. When you are invisible and defeat a combatant while using a finisher, all of your weapons gain bonus damage; you and your nearby allies gain a reserve overshield and improved class ability regeneration. These reserve overshields can be deployed by using a class ability.
3809192347.description_zh: 你的虚空武器在你从隐身状态现身后会获得不稳定弹药。当你隐身并使用终结技击败一名战斗人员时，你所有的武器都会获得额外伤害；你和附近盟友将获得后备覆盖护盾和更快的职业技能回复速度。这些后备覆盖护盾可通过使用职业技能来部署。

1969105489.name: Hammer of the Gods
1969105489.description: Defeating targets with your Thunderclap melee restores melee energy. Targets near you when you use your Thunderclap suffer lightning strikes and become jolted; being amplified increases the damage of these lightning strikes.
1969105489.description_zh: 使用雷霆一击近战击败目标会恢复近战能量。使用雷霆一击时你附近的目标会遭受闪电打击并且被震颤；增幅状态会增加闪电打击的伤害。

1376049785.name: Ionic Conductor
1376049785.description: Ionic traces you create move faster and grant you additional ability energy. Nearby allies also gain ability energy when you collect an ionic trace.
1376049785.description_zh: 你制造的离子轨迹移动更快，而且会提供额外的技能能量。在你收集到离子轨迹时，附近的盟友也会获得技能能量。

25023897.name: Quicksilver Storm Catalyst
25023897.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
25023897.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

1719307618.name: Delicate Tomb Catalyst
1719307618.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
1719307618.description_zh:

1557274655.name: Touch of Malice Catalyst
1557274655.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
1557274655.description_zh:

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

2585427437.name: Traitor's Vessel
2585427437.description:
Fires a wide horizontal spread when shot from the hip.
Final blows with this weapon have a chance to generate Ionic Traces. Powerful foes and opposing Guardians always generate Ionic Traces.
2585427437.description_zh:
腰射时射击的横向范围广。
使用此武器造成最后一击有几率产生离子轨迹。强力敌人和敌对守护者必定产生离子轨迹。

3602718766.name: Missile Tracers
3602718766.description: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.
3602718766.description_zh: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。

2724693746.name: Touch of Malice
2724693746.description: The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage, drawing from the wielder's life force, and then regenerates itself. Defeating powerful combatants or multiple targets rapidly restores health.
2724693746.description_zh: 弹匣中的最后一发弹药会吸收使用者的生命力来造成额外伤害，稍后会自动恢复。快速击败强力战斗人员或多个目标会恢复生命值。

1208312843.name: Tempest Cascade
1208312843.description: Collecting an Ionic Trace overcharges this weapon's next shot, jolting targets on hit.
1208312843.description_zh: 收集离子轨迹会过充此武器的下一发子弹，命中时震颤敌人。

1365187766.name: Gutshot Straight
1365187766.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.
1365187766.description_zh: 瞄准可提升身体射击伤害，减少目标捕获能力。

4200236906.name: Gutshot Straight
4200236906.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage but decreases target acquisition slightly.
4200236906.description_zh: 瞄准可提升身体射击伤害，但会小幅减少目标捕获能力。

1870851715.name: Under-Over
1870851715.description: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
1870851715.description_zh: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

183938251.name: Under-Over
183938251.description: Deals improved bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
183938251.description_zh: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成更多额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

1821614984.name: Slickdraw
1821614984.description: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.
1821614984.description_zh: 大幅增加操控性，大幅降低目标捕获能力。

1942880504.name: Slickdraw
1942880504.description: Significantly increases handling, decreases target acquisition.
1942880504.description_zh: 大幅增加操控性，降低目标捕获能力。

691659142.name: Pugilist
691659142.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.
691659142.description_zh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会产生近战能量。
造成近战伤害会在短时间内提升此武器的操控性。

536173722.name: Pugilist
536173722.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.
536173722.description_zh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会产生更多近战能量。
造成近战伤害会在短时间内提升这把武器的操控性。

2173046394.name: Voltshot
2173046394.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.
2173046394.description_zh: 击败目标后填装此武器会短时间过充武器，下次命中时震颤敌人。

1720528630.name: Voltshot
1720528630.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.
1720528630.description_zh: 击败目标后填装此武器会短时间过充武器且持续时间延长，下次命中时震颤敌人。

3131590896.name: Grenade Chaser
3131590896.description: Landing multiple Missile Tracers loads a grenade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to switch into Grenade Launcher mode.
3131590896.description_zh: 用导弹追踪弹击中数次可以装载一枚手雷。[替换武器动作] 可切换为榴弹发射器模式。

2094939076.name: Charged with Blight
2094939076.description: Precision hits increase stability and reload speed and drain combatants' life force to charge a ball of Darkness. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to restore health and fire the charged projectile, shrouding combatants in Darkness to temporarily blind them and inflict corruption.
2094939076.description_zh: 精准命中会提升稳定性和填装速度，并吸收战斗人员的生命力来给暗影球充能。[替换武器动作]  恢复生命值并发射充能射弹，将战斗人员笼罩在暗影中，暂时致盲目标并施加腐化。

2250679103.name: Search Party
2250679103.description: This weapon is granted faster aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.
2250679103.description_zh: 在附近没有盟友的情况下瞄准时，此武器的瞄准速度和移动速度都会更快。

2873651103.name: Search Party
2873651103.description: This weapon is granted an improved amount of aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.
2873651103.description_zh: 在附近没有盟友的情况下瞄准时，此武器提供更多的瞄准速度和移动速度加成。
2873651103.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1260401931.name: Hot Swap
1260401931.description:
Switching to this weapon while you are damaged strongly increases its handling for a short duration.

Swords gain increased charge speed, guard resistance, and guard endurance instead.
1260401931.description_zh:
在受到伤害的情况下切换至此武器会使其操控性在短时间内大幅上升。

刀剑会获得更高的充能速度、防御抗性、防御持久。

1728568819.name: Hot Swap
1728568819.description:
Switching to this weapon while you are damaged strongly increases its handling for an improved duration.

Swords gain increased recharge speed, guard resistance, and guard endurance instead.
1728568819.description_zh:
在受到伤害的情况下切换至此武器会在更长时间内大幅提升其操控性。

刀剑会获得更高的充能速度、防御抗性、防御持久。
1728568819.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

120721526.name: Runneth Over
120721526.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.
120721526.description_zh: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。

1887054634.name: Runneth Over
1887054634.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine an improved amount. Bows receive improved draw time and Swords receive improved charge rate.
1887054634.description_zh: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充更多弹药进入弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度更快。
1887054634.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

3907865655.name: Right Hook
3907865655.description:
Dealing melee damage gives this weapon increased target acquisition and range for a short period of time.
Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
3907865655.description_zh:
造成近战伤害会使此武器的目标捕获能力和射程在短时间内提升。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。

3601732055.name: Right Hook
3601732055.description:

Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
3601732055.description_zh:
造成近战伤害会在短时间内大幅提升此武器的目标捕获能力和射程。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。
3601732055.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

2328211300.name: Arcstrider
2328211300.flavor: Flow like lightning. Strike like thunder.
2328211300.typeName_zh: 普通 猎人分支职业
2328211300.lore:
"If not a flash, a boom? A crack through the sky? What paved the path that we now stride?"

Every. Time. Every time we get together for a mission, it's a metaphysical debate. Weren't we just swapping stories, sharing knife-sharpening techniques? How'd we get back to campfire philosophy?

Well, I'm here now…

"Arc energy isn't so dramatic," I countered, getting on my feet. "You both feel it, too, right? The prickling hum that runs under everything."

"Feels more like a buzz to me." The stout Awoken finished picking his teeth long enough to weigh in. "Like a million bees coming in from miles away."

I circled the fire, becoming more grateful for the distraction, with nothing else around us for miles. Every time we get together for a mission, I can't seem to sit still.

"But to feel the sparks dance on my fingers," the first Hunter replied, "I could swear they were the product of some great juncture."

One hundred miles away, thunderstorms flashed as if in reply.

I get it, why we can't go a single mission without talking philosophy. Same reason I can't stay sitting. Every time we get together for a mission, we pass it around like a current running between us: anticipation.
2328211300.lore_zh:
“如果不是一道闪光，一声巨响，一条天空中的裂缝，又是什么为我们现在所走的旅途铺平了道路？”

每一次。每一次我们为了任务聚在一起，都会是一场形而上的争论。我们不是在交流故事，分享磨刀技巧吗？怎么又回到篝火哲学上了？

好吧，现在该我了…

“电弧能量没那么夸张，”我反驳道，站了起来。“你们俩都感觉到了，对吧？暗暗流动如刺痛般的嗡鸣。”

“我感觉更像是蜂鸣。”壮硕的觉醒者剔够了牙，加入了辩论。“就像无数只蜜蜂从不远处飞来。”

我绕着火堆转了一圈，愈加感谢这种让我分心的事物，毕竟方圆几英里内别无他物。每次我们为了任务聚在一起，我似乎都会坐立不安。

“但当我感受到指尖跃动的火花时，”第一个猎人回答道，“我断定那必然是某个重要时刻的产物。”

一百英里之外，雷雨闪烁着，似乎在作出回应。

我懂了，为什么我们每次执行任务都要谈论哲学。和我坐立不安的原因一样。每次我们为了任务聚在一起，就像电流在我们之间流动一样，我们都会传递着一种事物：期待。

2932390016.name: Striker
2932390016.flavor: At close quarters, a fist is better than any gun.
2932390016.typeName_zh: 普通 泰坦分支职业
2932390016.lore:
"Would you please just shoot them?!"

Of course a Hunter would put it that way. As if I didn't have a perfectly viable alternative.

Beams of energy blasted around us as we quarreled from behind our cover.

"Look, I'll have this whole place cleared out in 20 seconds."

"And if you're overwhelmed? I suppose you expect us to simply charge into the fray to save you?"

Leave it to a Warlock to look for the safe way out.

"You just don't get it," I grumble.

"What?" they yell in frustrated unison amid the din of the battlefield.

"Let me guess," the Hunter quips, "your fists don't need reloading."

Chuckles all around. Time to set them straight.

"The space the bullet travels is a chasm of disconnection that can't be bridged by a gun; no amount of firepower has the means to shoulder the responsibility of personal impact." Now everyone rolls their eyes, but I press on.   

"There is no distance between my fist and my target, captivated by a gift of sparks. It's very personal—one final chance to connect."

Silence.

"You want to connect with the Hive?"

All right, argument over. My fists can do the talking.
2932390016.lore_zh:
“你就不能开枪打死他们吗？！”

猎人当然会这么说。好像除此之外就没其他办法似的。

我们躲在掩体后面争吵，能量束在我们周围爆炸开来。

“听着，我会在20秒内把这整个地方清理干净。”

“那要是你搞不定呢？不会是希望我们直接冲进去救你吧？”

术士总是想用最保险的方案。

“你们不懂，”我咕哝道。

“什么？”在战场的喧嚣声之中他们一起崩溃地大喊。

“让我猜猜，”猎人嘲弄道，“你的拳头不需要装弹。”

轻笑声四起。是时候纠正他们的想法了。

“子弹穿行的距离，是枪械无法逾越的断裂鸿沟；再多的火力也没有办法承担起近战冲击的重任。”大家都在翻白眼，但我继续说道。   

“拜火花所赐，我的拳头能近距离接触目标。这种直接接触，是我们建立联系的最后机会。”

一片沉默。

“你要和邪魔族建立联系？”

好了，争论结束。让我的拳头说话吧。

3168997075.name: Stormcaller
3168997075.typeName_zh: 普通 术士分支职业
3168997075.lore:
The first day I called the storm was an end. The end of a journey, the summit of a mountain; but when you leave the mountain, you don't take it with you. How would I maintain the profound insight from the eye of the storm that unlocked my direct line to the hurricane? 

Tempestuous peace. The calm and the storm. Where do I begin?

Questions rained upon me as I tried to put my thoughts into practice. The acrid stench of radiolaria reminded me that training was over. Was I ready for this? Did I have a choice?

Beaten, bloodied, I stared into the empty faces of my enemies. They were fearsome; they had taken much from me. But I've seen that which lies still amid cacophony.

Courage. The courage to face the torrent, to proclaim peace in the face of violence. Courage is the only call that the storm will hear.

It cannot ignore me.

Thunder rumbles and lightning strikes. Wind blows and rain pours. My enemies are no more. But peace… peace never left me.
3168997075.lore_zh:
我召唤风暴的第一天结束了。旅程的终点，高山的顶峰；但离开山峰时，你无法将其带走。风暴之眼曾让我与飓风直接相连，但我从中获得的深刻洞悉该如何保持？ 

暴风雨的安宁。平静与风暴。我该从何处开始？

当我试图把我的想法付诸实践时，问题如雨点般向我袭来。放射虫的刺鼻气味提醒着我训练结束了。我准备好了吗？我有选择吗？

我被打得血迹斑斑，凝视着敌人空洞的面孔。他们令人生畏，也从我身上夺走了许多。但我看到了在嘈杂中安然静默的东西。

那是勇气。是直面激流，面对暴力宣告安宁的勇气。它是风暴唯一能听到的呼唤。

它不能忽视我。

雷电交加，风吹雨淋。我的敌人不复存在。但安宁…安宁从未离开我。

1302968378.flavor: For Ghosts who leave the past behind.
1302968378.lore:
"If Misraaks and I have one thing in common," Spider rumbled, "it's that we keep an eye toward the future."

He turned a delicate Ghost shell over in his massive claw, admiring its Eliksni styling.

"Even when we lived from one raid to the next, stealing from anyone who crossed us, we always dreamed of more." He stared into the middle distance, briefly lost in reverie. "Including a place we could call home… outside of that filthy Ketch."

"As it happened, Misraaks eventually 'granted' me a whole planetoid of my own." He chuckled ironically to himself. "Just not in the way I had hoped."

"When I was finally picked up, I was no longer a raider, wanted throughout the system." He opened his arms wide, palms up. "I became Spider. A simple merchant with a bounty to collect." 

"In hindsight, getting marooned on that forsaken rock was the best thing that ever happened to me." He shrugged noncommittally. "Maybe being stranded in the Last City will serve me just as well."
1302968378.lore_zh:
“如果说米斯拉阿克斯和我有什么共同点的话，”蛛王低声说道，“那就是我们都密切留心着未来。”

他用巨大的爪子把精致的机灵外壳翻过来，欣赏着它的埃里克斯尼族造型。

“就算我们在一次又一次的突袭中糊口度日，抢劫我们遇上的任何人，我们也总是梦想着更多。”他凝视着不远处，一时陷入了遐想。“包括在那艘肮脏的双桅船之外…能有个我们可以称之为家的地方。”

“碰巧，米斯拉阿克斯最终‘赐予'了我一颗属于我自己的小行星。”他自嘲地笑了起来。“只不过并非以我所希望的方式。”

“当我终于得救时，我不再是一名突袭者，不再是整个星系的通缉犯。”他张开手臂，掌心朝上。“我成了蛛王。一个有赏金要领取的普通商人。” 

“回想起来，被放逐到那个遭遗弃的小行星上是我遇到过的最美好的事。”他不置可否地耸了耸肩。“或许被困在圣城里对我而言也是件好事。”

2213418427.name: Swashbuckler Shell
2213418427.flavor: For Ghosts who like wind in their sails.
2213418427.lore:
Drifter leans against the bar in The Ether Tank and rolls a coin over his knuckles. Eido watches in silence for a moment and wonders why Humans have such strange hands. She looks up at him.

"What are you doing?" she asks curiously.

"This? Just a little trick I picked up," he answers.

"I see. I find these 'tricks' with your coin to be quite complicated."

"Nothin' to it," Drifter says. "Here, catch."

He flips the coin to her, and she reacts a half-second too slow. It clinks against the floor, then drops through a gap in the grate and falls out of sight.

"Oh!" Eido exclaims. "I'm so sorry! I am typically very dextrous."

"Eh." Drifter shrugs… and suddenly produces another jade coin between his fingertips as if he had conjured it from thin air. "I got hundreds of 'em."

The coin skips over his fingers before he flicks it toward her again. This time, Eido reaches out and catches it in her palm.

"Let's see what you got," Drifter says.

Eido considers this. In her right hand, she positions the coin on the crook of one claw and balances with the tip of her thumb. She then flicks the coin to herself, sideways this time, and catches it between the edges of two claws on her left hand—so quickly—that her movement is nearly invisible. She does it again, back and forth, up and down her four claws, rolling it over the backs of her knuckles each time.  Her movements grow sharper, more deft, and the coin rings out with each motion.

When she flips it high into the air, Drifter catches it, eyebrow raised, impressed. "Fancy. Where'd you learn that?"

Eido clicks her mandibles and closes two eyes in an exaggerated wink.

"Just a little trick I picked up," she answers.
2213418427.lore_zh:
浪客斜靠在乙太罐里的吧台上，在指关节上滚动着一枚硬币。艾多沉默了一会儿，不禁好奇为什么人类会有这么奇怪的双手。她抬头看着他。

“你在做什么？”她好奇地问道。

“这个吗？只是我学的一点小花招，”他答道。

“原来是这样。我发现你这些硬币‘花招'相当复杂。”

“这没什么，”浪客说。“来，接住。”

他把硬币抛向她，她反应慢了半秒。硬币落在地板上叮当作响，然后从格栅的缝隙中掉了下去，消失在视线之外。

“哦！”艾多大叫道。“对不起！我一向很灵巧的。”

“嗯。”浪客耸了耸肩…突然从指尖掏出另一枚玉币，就像是凭空变出来的。“我有好几百枚。”

硬币从他的手指上跃起，他又把它弹向她。这一次，艾多伸手接住了它。

“我们来看看你的能耐，”浪客说道。

艾多思忖着。她右手将硬币放在一只微弯的爪子上，用拇指尖保持着平衡。然后，她将硬币侧着抛向自己，用左手的两只爪子边缘抓住硬币，动作快到几乎看不清。她又做了一次，四只爪子来回往复，上下起落，每次都能将硬币滚到指关节后面。她的操作变得愈发敏捷灵巧，硬币伴着每次动作叮当作响。

当她把硬币抛向空中时，浪客接住了它，扬起眉毛，颇为吃惊。“很花哨。你从哪儿学来的？”

艾多用上颚发出一声咂嘴音，然后夸张地眨了眨眼睛。

“只是我学的一点小花招，”她答道。

2313814566.name: Speed Metal Shell
2313814566.flavor: For Ghosts who are pretty and pretty dangerous.
2313814566.source: Source: Earned as a pre-order bonus.
2313814566.lore:
I should have missed this speck of a station on the way to Pluto. Except that, for all it lacks in size, it's surprisingly warm—almost a full degree above the background of space. Practically a flare.

My ship's engines whir through cooldown as I step out into the landing bay. It's a stock design; years ago, I could probably tell you which floorplan it used from FabriDyne's showroom. Ishtar registration. Probably an observatory forgotten in the Collapse.

But what's waiting past the hatch isn't stock. Atmo gear—shiny and new. Someone's been here since the Collapse. I unshoulder my rifle and warm up her power cell. A handprint. Grease and dust pressed sharp against the white wall; sized for a Cabal, but… Five fingers. 

There's more. A smear of rippling silver and broken bits of something familiar. Too big for a gun, but maybe for that hand— 

A rustle behind me breaks the silence. I fire.

"Don't shoot, Exo," a small voice begs. "I-I-I'm just Tokki!" Her glowing lens pokes out from behind the doorframe. 

"A Ghost?! Why are you here?"

"I heard the c-call." 

The call? To a Guardian? "There's no Humans this far out."

"Well, I know that now."

Her body ripples in the light, looking oddly familiar. "What's up with your shell?"

"You like my silver? My friend showed it to me."

"Another Ghost was crazy enough to come out here with you?"

"No, ma'am. I met her here."

Her fins coax something into view—a beautiful little mess of ribs and sails, with six bright eyes appraising me. I reach for it—

—And Ana's tiny hands pull me into a hug. Her dress is dirty and she's crying; Grandfather's totally gonna freak, I think as I pet her hair. "It's okay. I'll help."— 

I start as Tokki's friend slithers into my hand and coos. "I'll… help," I realize.
2313814566.lore_zh:
我本会在去冥王星的路上错过这个小基站。只可惜，虽然它的体积不大，但却出奇的温暖，几乎比太空背景高出了整整一度。简直就像是耀斑一样。

飞船的引擎呼呼作响地冷却，我步入了着陆舱。这是那种有年头的老设计，我都可以告诉你它用的是法布里达因展厅哪个楼层的平面图。伊什塔注册项目。可能是大崩溃之际被遗忘的观测站。

但在舱门后等着的却不是存货，而是闪亮崭新的大气装备。大崩溃后有人来过了。我卸下步枪，加热了动力电池。有个满是油脂和灰尘的手印，抵在白墙上；像是卡巴尔的，但却有…五根手指。 

还不止这样。有一抹荡漾的银光和某种熟悉事物的碎片。枪械没这么大，但若是那只手的话—— 

我身后一阵沙沙声打破了寂静。我开了火。

“别开枪，Exo，”一个微弱的声音恳求道。“我，我是托基！”她的发光透镜从门框后探了出来。 

“机灵？！你怎么在这儿？”

“我听见了召…召唤。” 

召唤？复活守护者的？“这么远的地方可没有人类。”

“嗯，我现在知道了。”

她的身体在光线中荡漾，看起来异常熟悉。“你的机壳怎么了？”

“你喜欢我的银光吗？我的朋友给我看了。”

“还有其他机灵疯到跟你来到了这儿？”

“不，夫人。我是在这里遇到她的。”

她的鳍板里有些东西映入眼帘——是堆漂亮的肋骨和脊鳍，还有六只明亮的眼睛打量着我。我伸手去够它——

——阿娜的小手拥我入怀。她的衣服脏了，正在哭泣；当我抚摸她的头发时，我想祖父一定会抓狂的。“没关系，我会帮忙的。”—— 

托基的朋友滑入我手里轻声哼哼时，我发了话。“我会…帮忙的，”我意识到。

3607696740.lore:
Mara Sov, Queen of the Reef, looked expectantly at Petra and waited for an answer.

The queen's emissary averted her eyes. "My queen," she said, "we recovered a vast trove of supplies stolen from us over a period of many years. We have located treasures long thought lost, and—"

"Do not avoid the question," Mara said, her words edged with steel.

Petra gritted her teeth. "We did not recover the Spider," she said. "It is believed he sealed himself in a pod and transported himself in one of the very shipments that was intercepted by Eramis's forces."

Mara tented her delicate fingers. Between her palms, she formed a tiny triacontahedron of matter resembling rose quartz. She spun the minuscule shape, tracking each of its 30 faces, lining each vertex with a tiny fractal arm that spun off into a curled fern of endless geometric detail.

By doing this, she quelled the sudden urge to cleave the Dreaming City in two—a reaction which would have discomfited Petra. 

Petra allowed herself a measured chuckle, knowing it would draw Mara's furious eyes to her, and it did. It was time for the ridiculous denouement.

"We have received word that Spider now resides in the Last City," Petra said, daring a shrug.

The tiny crystalline structure abruptly fell to sand between Mara's hands. She cocked her head to the side, unable to hold back her incredulous smile. She shook a finger at Petra. "When I want him—"

Petra brought a fist to her chest and nodded. "You need only give the word, my queen."

Mara shook her head, boggling at the Spider's improbable path. "Will Crow…" she began, but couldn't find the right word to contain the breadth of justice she imagined.

Petra grinned. "I guess we'll find out."
3607696740.lore_zh:
暗礁女王玛拉·索维期待地望着佩特拉，等待着她的回答。

女王使者移开了目光。“女王陛下，”她说，“我们找回了多年来被窃走的大量物资。曾经以为遗失已久的宝藏，也被我们发现了，还有——”

“别逃避问题，”玛拉说道，她的话语尖刻有力。

佩特拉咬紧牙关。“我们没有找到蛛王，”她说。"据说他把自己封在舱内，藏在伊拉莫斯部队截获的货物里被运走了。"

玛拉用她纤嫩的手指搭起帐篷。在她的手掌之间，形成了一个类似于玫瑰石英的小型三十面体。她旋转着这个微小的形状，移动着它那30个面，用微小的分形臂排列着每个顶点，分拆成一株有着无尽几何细节的卷曲蕨类植物。

就这样，想把幽梦之城一拆为二的冲动就被她压了下去——这个反应会让佩特拉窘迫不堪。 

佩特拉克制地笑了笑，知道这会引来玛拉愤怒的目光，而她也确实那样做了。是时候说出可笑的收场白了。

“我们得到消息称，蛛王目前住在圣城里，”佩特拉说道，鼓起勇气耸了耸肩。

玛拉手中的微小水晶结构体突然化为了沙子。她把头歪向一边，忍不住露出怀疑的笑容。她朝佩特拉晃了晃手指。“当我要他——”

佩特拉把一只拳头放在胸前，点了点头。“您只要下令就行了，女王陛下。”

玛拉摇了摇头，对蛛王所走的那条荒谬之道感到困惑。“乌鸦会不会…”她话到嘴边，但找不到合适的词来表达她想象中的那种正义的广度。

佩特拉咧嘴一笑。“我们只有等着瞧了。”

4252635431.name: Charge of Light
4252635431.flavor: Boldly into the jaws of death.
4252635431.lore:
"Attempting to make rational the Great Machine's choices is futile," Mithrax explained gently. 

He and Eido were seated on a ledge overlooking the Eliksni Quarter. They watched elaborate Sparrows, some detailed in Eliksni stylings, cruise through the sparse crowds. 

"I have asked many times, in many ways, why the Great Machine abandoned us," he continued. "Why it defended Earth, and not Riis. Why it gave the Light to the Hive, and not the Eliksni." 

He grumbled thoughtfully. "But the Great Machine does not answer, for that is not its way."

"I understand that the Great Machine is… unknowable," replied Eido. "That it acts beyond reason or causality."

"But what I do not understand," she continued tersely, "is why the Humans take it for granted."

Mithrax regarded her keenly. "Do you think it so, daughter?"

"I do," Eido replied firmly. "I recently found an ancient Human ode in the Cryptarchy's records. It tells of a brigade of Guardians who charged into enemy positions, recklessly wasting their lives, knowing they would be resurrected in the Light."

"The Guardians treat life as cheaply as the raiders we fight," she continued despondently.

"You speak truth. But it was so on Riis too," Mithrax acknowledged, suddenly recalling the sorrowful tale of Namrask. "The Eliksni did not realize their love for the Great Machine until it left." 

"It is the way of all people, not just Humans," he mused. "But it will not be the way of House Light." 

"No," Eido affirmed. "That will not be our way."
4252635431.lore_zh:
“大机器的抉择是无法被理解的，”米瑟拉克斯轻声解释道。 

他和艾多坐在窗台上，俯瞰着埃里克斯尼居住区。他们看着那些精心打造的快雀在稀疏的人群中穿行，其中有些还带有埃里克斯尼族风格的细节。 

“我已经用很多方式，问过很多次，为什么大机器要抛弃我们，”他继续说道。“为什么它要去保护地球，而不是里斯。为什么它把光能给了邪魔族，而不是埃里克斯尼族。” 

他若有所思地嘟嚷道。“但大机器不会回答，因为这不是它的作风。”

“我知道大机器…是不可知的，”艾多答道。“它的行为超越理性或因果。”

“但我不明白的是，”她接着简短说道，“为什么人类会把这当作理所当然。”

米瑟拉克斯锐利地注视着她。“你是这么想的吗，女儿？”

“是的，”艾多坚定地回答。“我最近在解密大师的记录中发现了一首古老的人类颂歌。它讲的是一队守护者冲进敌人的阵地，因为知道会在光能中复活而毫无顾忌地挥霍自己的性命。”

“守护者就像我们对抗的突袭者一样轻视生命，”她丧气地继续说道。

“你说的不假。但在里斯上也是如此，”米瑟拉克斯承认，突然回忆起拿姆拉斯克的悲伤故事。“直到大机器离开，埃里克斯尼族才意识到自己对它的爱。” 

“谁都会这样，不仅仅是人类，”他若有所思地说道。“但这不会是光能氏族的做派。” 

“对，”艾多肯定道。“那不会是我们的做派。”

982950671.lore:
"I will tell you a story of the Whirlwind," Eido begins. She speaks with a solemn intensity. The hatchlings often laugh and coo at her stories—but these young are two molts past their hatching, and they know that mention of the Whirlwind should silence them. The Great Machine looms above their rooftop gathering, and Eido almost feels like it is listening too.

Eido knows many things, but here, her wisdom is fragmented; Misraakskel never spoke of the Whirlwind or those who witnessed it. His mother had, but all Eido knows of her is her name: Inaaks. Misraaks was raised in the Great Machine's absence, what came after the Whirlwind; and so this is what Eido shares with the young for now.

"We live in the presence of the Great Machine," she says. "But it was not always so."

The young know this. Like Eido, they know the cold of Europa.

"There was a place called Riis. The mothers and fathers of our mothers and fathers were born there. It is where the Eliksni came from."

The young know this. Like Eido, they do not know the embrace of Riis.

"The Great Machine was once above Riis," she says. "As it is now above Earth."

The young know this. Like Eido, they know this planet's sky.

"When it left Riis, the Eliksni went to find it. They looked for a very long time, and—" Eido pauses. She must choose her next words carefully. She must tell the truth.

"They came to Earth to take it back."

But the young do not know this. Unlike Eido, they have not lived long enough to know this sadness.

"But we share it now," Eido says, "with the Humans, and with the Guardians."

Eido knows the unspoken question. The young do not ask it. Instead, they fix their eyes on the Great Machine, and Eido wonders what they see.
982950671.lore_zh:
“我要给你们讲个旋风的故事，”艾多开始说道。她的语气强烈而严肃。这些孩子们经常听着她的故事发笑，轻声哼哼——但这些幼仔已经蜕了两次壳，知道一提到旋风就该安静下来。大机器在他们的屋顶聚会上若隐若现，艾多几乎能感觉到它也在倾听。

艾多懂得很多东西，但在这方面，她的学识支离破碎；米斯拉阿克斯凯尔对旋风和那些曾亲眼目睹它的人只字不提。他母亲曾亲历过，但艾多只知道她的名字：伊娜克斯。米斯拉阿克斯是在旋风之后，在大机器的缺席之下被抚养大的；而这就是艾多目前与孩子们分享的故事。

“我们生活在大机器之下，”她说道。“但情况并不总是这样。”

孩子们知道这一点。和艾多一样，他们深知木卫二的寒冷。

“曾经有一个地方叫做里斯。我们的祖辈都在那里出生长大。那里是埃里克斯尼族的故乡。”

孩子们知道这一点。和艾多一样，他们对里斯的怀抱一无所知。

“大机器曾经在里斯上空，”她说。“就像现在在地球上空一样。”

孩子们知道这一点。和艾多一样，他们熟悉这颗星球的蓝天。

“当它离开里斯时，埃里克斯尼族去寻找它。他们找了很长时间，然后——”艾多停顿了一下。她必须仔细斟酌接下来的话。她必须说出真相。

“他们来到地球要把它拿回去。”

但孩子们不知道这一点。与艾多不同，他们活得还不够长，不了解这种悲伤。

“但我们现在共享着它，”艾多说道，“和人类一起，和守护者一起。”

艾多清楚那个没说出口的问题。孩子们没有问。相反，他们的眼睛直盯着大机器，艾多好奇他们看到了什么。

1412999460.lore:
The Warlock put her hands on her hips as she looked up at the Titan's new ship.

"So… run this plan by me one more time," she said.

"Sure thing," the Titan replied. "We go into that haunted cave, snatch a Headless guy, stuff it in the cargo hold, and bring it back here."

"Alive," the Warlock clarified.

"Yup," the Titan affirmed, nodding vigorously. "Then we sell it for a mountain of Glimmer."

"Who would buy a giant flaming pumpkin monster?!" 

"Eris Morn, for one. She's always researching creepy stuff like that. Or—the Drifter. You should see the stuff he's got aboard the Derelict."

"Even if you do find a buyer—which you won't—how are you gonna fit a Headless One in this bird?" She gestured to the sleek, Eliksni-made jumpship. "I told you to go for something with a bigger cargo hold."

"First of all, I got a great deal on this," the Titan retorted. "Second of all, if it doesn't fit, we just strap it to one of these… nose… spikes." He gestured vaguely to the sharp protrusions coming from the front of his new ship.

The Warlock's next objection was interrupted by a booming voice coming from the hangar entrance. 

"I got the sedatives right here!" their Hunter teammate announced, carrying in a large ammo crate. "There's enough here to knock out an Ogre." He dropped it at the Warlock's feet. "We doing this, or what?"

The Warlock looked at her eager teammates and sighed. "Let's go get killed, I guess." 

"Yessss!" the Titan exclaimed. "Dibs on the candy!"
1412999460.lore_zh:
术士双手叉腰，抬头看着泰坦的新飞船。

“那么…再跟我说一遍计划吧，”她说。

“没问题，”泰坦回答道。“我们进到那个闹鬼的洞穴里，抓一个无头者，把它塞进货舱并带回到这里。”

“要活的，”术士阐明说。

“没错，”泰坦表示肯定，用力地点点头。“然后我们再卖个好价钱，赚超多的微光。”

“谁会买巨大的燃烧南瓜怪？！” 

“埃里斯·摩恩会买。她一直在研究那种让人毛骨悚然的东西。或者…浪客，你真该看看他在遗落飞船上的那些东西。”

“你肯定找不到买家…就算找到了，你要怎么把无头者塞进去？”她指了指那艘埃里克斯尼族制造的跃迁飞船。“我告诉过你，要找到货舱更大的飞船才行。”

“首先，这船的货舱已经很大了，”泰坦反驳道。“其次，如果塞不进去，我们就把它绑在前面的…一个…尖头上。”他含糊地指了指新飞船前面尖锐突起的部分。

术士正想反对，却被从机库入口传来的超大声音给打断了。 

“我这里有镇静弹！”他们的猎人队友扛着一个大弹药箱，郑重地说道。“这些足够击倒一个虫瘤了。”他把它丢在术士脚边。“这事我们还做不做了？”

术士看着急切的队友，叹了口气。“那我们就一起去赴死吧。” 

“太好了！”泰坦喊道。“到时候可别跟我抢啊！”

140806329.name: Infiltrator Shell
140806329.lore:
Eido and Eris Morn sit together amid disorderly piles of books. Eido neatens the piles as best she can, straightening and arranging and alphabetizing. Eris places an open book face down on the table while her eyes glance over another, Hive runes riddling the uncurled page.

"To Xivu Arath, war and worship are one and the same. Through combat, her desires become our desires. Her conflicts become our conflicts," Eris muses. 

Eido has learned the habits of her research partner, how Eris speaks as much to herself as to those around her.

"We are pulled into the same model of action," Eido muses. She smooths the folded page of the first book Eris set aside and leaves a bookmark in its place. "This strengthens Xivu Arath's position."

"Violence always bleeds its own end," Eris says, folding a page corner in the second book before closing it. "Xivu Arath knows this. Her rituals are not apotropaic gestures. They are invitations." 

Eido runs the tip of a claw across her datapad, where she has accumulated many meticulous notes.

"But war itself is a ritual," Eido says. 

Green eyes meet the Eliksni's blue.

"How so?"

"There are tactics and planning," the Scribe says carefully. "Engagements and losses—sacrifices—all organized to a larger design. To wage war is to invite—or to compel—the participation of one's enemies."

Eido holds Eris's penetrating gaze.

"Savathûn directed us to her desires by making them our own. So, too, does her sister. Their methods differ, but their goal is the same."

Eris rises to her feet. There is an avalanche of papers as a nearby stack of books tips onto the floor. 

"We must compose a message to the Techeuns."
140806329.lore_zh:
艾多和埃里斯·摩恩一起坐在乱作一团的书堆中。艾多尽力整理着这些书，拾掇、摆放并按字母顺序排列。埃里斯把一本打开的书面朝下放在桌子上，而她的眼睛却扫过另一本，邪魔族的符文布满了平整的书页。

“对希乌阿拉斯来说，战争和崇拜是一回事。通过战斗，她的欲望变成了我们的欲望。她的冲突变成了我们的冲突，”埃里斯沉思道。 

艾多已经很了解她研究伙伴的习惯，了解埃里斯会像自言自语一样跟周围的人交谈。

“我们被拉入了同样的行动模式，”艾多沉思道。她抚平了埃里斯放在一边的第一本书折起来的书页，并在原处留下了一个书签。“这巩固了希乌阿拉斯的地位。”

“暴力总是会以流血收场，”埃里斯边说边折起第二本书的一角，然后合上。“希乌阿拉斯深知这一点。她的仪式并非用于驱邪。它们是请帖。” 

艾多用爪子尖在她的数据板上划过，那里面有她积累的许多细致笔记。

“但战争本身就是一种仪式，”艾多说道。 

埃里斯的绿色眼睛与埃里克斯尼族文士的蓝色眼睛相遇。

“怎么会？”

“战争有策略和计划，”文士审慎地说道。“交战和损失…这些牺牲…都是在下更大的一盘棋。发动战争就是在邀请…或是强迫…敌人的参与。”

艾多承受着埃里斯的注视。

“萨瓦图恩把她的欲望变成我们自己的欲望，引导我们去实现它们。她的姐妹也是如此。她们的方法不同，但目的是一样的。”

埃里斯站了起来。附近的一摞书倒在地上，文件像雪片般翻飞。 

“我们必须给灵巫写条消息。”

3809059822.name: Warsat Shell
3809059822.flavor: "We woke the Warmind and brought doom to the Iron Lords." —Valus Forge
3809059822.source: Source: Season of the Seraph Triumph
3809059822.lore:
"I remember she always used to compare you to a storm," Isirah says of Lady Jolder, even though Saladin hasn't spoken her name out loud. The Ghost knows her Guardian's mind: how it works and who's on it.

Saladin does not respond. He looks out over the Plaguelands and focuses not on Isirah's voice, but on the wind whipping through his cloak and the dense fur of his cowl as he gathers it around him.

It is cold, and they have a long way to go. He begins picking his way down the mountainside, his footing steady and practiced, for this is a path he and Isirah have taken many times.
 
"There are better uses for your anger than this," Isirah insists, but Saladin isn't listening. "Turn back. Go to the Tower and demand vengeance."
 
It's a futile effort. Isirah surrenders halfway down the slope, and disappears into the space she occupies when Saladin wishes to be alone—

—except that in this place, Saladin feels the presence of Jolder and the others more intensely than he has since the day he lost them. When he arrives at his destination, he finds it covered in snow and spends the next few hours excavating it from the elements. Slowly, a shrine to the fallen Iron Lords takes form, untouched for more years than Saladin cares to count.

It is here that he settles with a long sigh. Yes, Jolder used to compare him to a storm—but even the most powerful thunderheads eventually ebb into a breeze.
3809059822.lore_zh:
“我记得她总是把你比作风暴，”伊赛拉提起了欧德夫人，尽管萨拉丁没有大声说出她的名字。机灵知道她的守护者思维：它怎么运作，在想着谁。

萨拉丁没回应。他俯瞰着瘟疫之地，关注的不是伊赛拉的声音，而是刮过他披风的风和他拉紧的风帽上的浓密毛皮。

天气很冷，他们还有很长的路要走。他开始沿着山坡走下去，他的脚步稳定而熟练，因为这是一条他和伊赛拉走过许多次的路。
 
“你的怒气可以放到更有用的事上，”伊赛拉坚持道，但萨拉丁没有在听。“回头。去高塔寻求复仇。”
 
白费口舌。伊赛拉在半山腰放弃，消失返回到一个空间，萨拉丁想要一个人静静时，她通常会去那里…

…只是在这地方，萨拉丁感到欧德和其他人的存在感比他失去他们那天更加强烈。当他到达目的地时，他发现它被雪覆盖，然后花了几个小时把它从恶劣的环境里挖了出来。慢慢地，一座为倒下的钢铁领主们而建的神龛成形了，连萨拉丁都懒得去计算它有多少年没被触碰过。

他在这里长叹一声坐了下来。没错，欧德过去常把他比作风暴…但即使是最强大的雷暴云砧也终会化作过往云烟。

3684684730.lore:
Fynch transmats the cookie so that it sits balanced atop the little pile of stones he's arranged for it. Then he floats down and nudges it three millimeters to the left.
 
"See, Ken? This is exactly the sort of thing you've been missing out on."

Nearby, the sprawled corpse of Fynch's Hive Guardian affects an air of indifference. Fynch turns around to look at him.
 
"Just think, you might have gotten a cookie from the Guardian too. But it's all 'unilateral and extreme violence' with you. Oh, and—Happy Dawning, by the way…  You don't have to say it back."

Fynch doesn't actually eat the cookie, but takes a piece of it and disperses its component molecules into the air, which is really more or less the same thing.
 
"That's your problem: you're afraid to reach out. To connect. That takes some real vulnerability, and you know what? I just don't think you have it in you right now."
 
Ken maintains his stony silence. Fynch shakes his shell to and fro in disapproval.

"Real shame, 'cause this? The symbolic exchange of material goods? Friendship, I guess, you could call it? It, uh…"
 
Fynch looks down at the cookie arrangement. For a moment, he forgets about Ken entirely.
 
"It feels pretty nice."
3684684730.lore_zh:
芬奇把饼干传送到他特意布置的小石堆上，让它平衡地躺在上面。然后他飘下去，把它往左推了三毫米。
 
“看到了吗，肯？这就是你一直错失的东西。”

在他身旁，芬奇的邪魔族守护者的尸体摊开四肢，显出一副漠不关心的样子。芬奇转身看着他。
 
“想想看，你也可能从守护者那里得到一块饼干。但你只在乎‘单方面的极端暴力'。对了，顺便祝你曙光节快乐…你不用回应。”

芬奇其实并不能吃饼干，但他还是拿了一块，把它的组成分子散到空气中，这其实是差不多的事情。
 
“这正是你的问题：你害怕沟通。产生联系。这真的需要一些脆弱性，而你知道吗？我觉得现在的你身上没有那种特质。”
 
肯依然冷漠地一言不发。芬奇不以为然地来回晃动着他的机壳。

“真可惜，毕竟这个？物质商品的象征性交换？我想你可以称之为友谊？它，呃…”
 
芬奇低头看着饼干。有那么一瞬间，他完全忘记了肯的存在。
 
“它感觉很不错。”

4117442486.name: Gallant Ward Shell
4117442486.flavor: For Ghosts who guard the wall.
4117442486.lore:
After the citizens, the walls that surround the City are Zavala's second responsibility. Their maintenance and defense never leave his mind. In times of uncertainty, he falls back on old habits and sets out on patrol atop the wall.

In the Last City's earliest days, Zavala could walk the perimeter in under an hour. He knew every name and face of those who called it home. 

No one patrols the entire wall anymore; not on foot. He speaks with every sentry. Examines every parapet. Those, at least, he still knows by heart. 

The moon rises like a second Traveler. Zavala is as far away from the Tower as he can be within the City. He picks out every neighborhood, watches the lights turn off in each quarter. So many lights. And so few.

A sentry walks out onto the wall, interrupting his moment of quiet contemplation. She yawns, cupping a mug of coffee. She notices the Titan Vanguard and snaps to attention.

"Commander! Are you making an inspection tonight?"

He motions the sentry to ease. "Not tonight. I was just walking. For old time's sake."

Zavala takes one last look at the City before nodding to the sentry and heading back toward the Tower. He used to bear the weight of these walls on his shoulders, as if they were his burden and his alone. These days, he is bolstered by the trust he places in those under his command.

The Last City, after all, has grown. And so has he.
4117442486.lore_zh:
除了圣城市民以外，环绕着圣城的城墙便是萨瓦拉的第二职责所在。他时刻都心系着它们的维护和防卫工作。在动荡不安之际，他又重拾老习惯，开始在城墙顶上巡逻。

在圣城早期，萨瓦拉可以在不到一个小时内走完外围。他曾经对居住在圣城的每张面孔都无比熟悉。 

现在没有人能巡逻完整堵城墙了；步行是不可能的。他和每名哨兵交谈。检视每面护墙。至少是他仍熟稔于心的那些。 

月球升起，好似第二个旅行者。萨瓦拉尽可能走到了圣城里离高塔最远的地方。他辨识出每个街区，看着灯光熄灭。这么多的灯光。却又那么的少。

一名哨兵走到墙边，打断了他安静沉思的时刻。她打着哈欠，端着一杯咖啡。她注意到了泰坦先锋，赶紧立正。

“指挥官！您今晚是来视察的吗？”

他示意哨兵稍息。“今晚不是。我只是走走。怀旧一下。”

萨瓦拉最后看了一眼圣城，然后向哨兵点点头，动身返回高塔。他过去常把这些城墙的重担扛肩上，仿佛这只是他一个人的负担。如今，他对下属的信任给了他信心。

毕竟，圣城已经成长了。他也是。

2272927194.description_zh: 参加战斗一定时间后会增加空中效率并减少后仰，效果持续到你离开战斗。

1640501529.description: While a Stasis Super is equipped, rapid Stasis weapon damage or damage from behind your Rally Barricade will create a Diamond Lance near you. Thrown Diamond Lances create Stasis crystals. Your Diamond Lances deal more damage based on how much Frost Armor you have.
1640501529.description_zh: 装备冰影超能时，快速冰影武器伤害或从集结屏障后造成伤害将在你附近生成钻石长矛。投掷的钻石长矛会生成冰影水晶。你的钻石长矛会根据你拥有的冰霜护甲层数造成更多伤害。

2894608781.name: Hearts of Ice
2894608781.description: Targets frozen by your Winter's Wrath Super take increased Shatter damage. Allies in range of your Winter's Wrath shockwave and Frostpulse gain Frost Armor and deal increased damage with Stasis weapons. Granting these buffs to allies grants you Super energy.
2894608781.description_zh: 被你的严冬之怒超能冻结的目标会受到更多碎裂伤害。在严冬之怒冲击波和冰霜脉冲范围内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，并可使用冰影武器造成更多伤害。提供盟友这些增益会为你提供超能能量。

858592012.name: Tight Fit
858592012.description: Dodging instantly reloads all your weapons and grants increased reload and handling to you and nearby allies. While the buff is active, additional dodges increase the buff strength and refresh the timer, maxing out at 5 stacks. Dealing sustained damage grants class ability energy.
858592012.description_zh: 闪身会立即填装你的所有武器并提升你和附近盟友的填装和操控性。此增益生效时，额外的闪身会提升增益强度并刷新计时器，5层时达到上限。造成持续伤害会提供职业技能能量。

2593587862.name: Spirit of the Warmind
2593587862.lore:
"The Warmind is a machine."

Even through a holoprojector, Caiatl's voice echoes with authority. Zavala can't tell if she's asking a question or making a statement.

"Yes," Zavala replies as he rises from his desk to look out over the Last City. "And?"

"And you entrust it with the command of vast military resources," the empress continues. "Orbital artillery. An arsenal of highly advanced ordnance. Coordination of gunship deployments and forward operating bases."

"That is what Rasputin was designed to do."

"Some things cannot be designed." Caiatl lowers her eyes. "A warrior's spirit is forged by more than strategy and intelligence. One must bleed before spilling another's blood. A true warrior knows that victory comes at a cost, and how much is lost in defeat."

She raises her eyes to Zavala again. "Do you believe your Warmind can understand such things?"

"I do," he replies, to his own surprise. He turns away from the window to face the holoprojector. "I didn't always trust Rasputin. I used to think we were all numbers in his ledger, nothing more than a cold calculation."

Zavala leans against his desk, his eyes sweeping across the myriad scouting reports and communiques littering its surface. "But now… I see the enormity of his task. The weight of ensuring humanity's survival. The losses he's suffered himself…"

Caiatl tilts her head. "You see a kindred spirit."

"I see an old warrior doing his best," Zavala admits quietly. "And that will always earn my trust."
2593587862.lore_zh:
“战争思维是一台机器。”

即便是透过全息投影仪，查厄托的声音也回响着权威。萨瓦拉不知道她是在提出问题还是在陈述观点。

“没错，”萨瓦拉从办公桌后面站起来，眺望着圣城回答道。“然后呢？”

“然后你把大量军事资源的指挥权交给了它，”女帝继续说道。“轨道炮，高度先进的军械库，炮舰部署和前沿作战基地的统筹协调。”

“那正是拉斯普廷的设计初衷。”

“有些东西是无法设计的。”查厄托垂下双眼。“一个战士的精神并不仅仅是由战略和情报铸就的。他必须自己先淌过血再让别人流血。一个真正的战士，知道胜利要付出代价，失败会失去多少。”

她再次抬起眼睛看着萨瓦拉。“你相信你的战争思维能理解这些东西吗？”

“我相信，”他的回答让自己都感到惊讶。他转身离开窗户，面对全息投影仪。“我并非一直都信任拉斯普廷。我曾经以为我们都只是他账本上的数字，不过是一种冰冷的计算罢了。”

萨瓦拉斜靠在他的桌子上，双眼扫视着散落在桌子上无数的侦察报告和公报。“但现在…我看到了他任务的艰巨。确保人类生存的重担。他自己的那些失去…”

查厄托歪了歪脑袋。“你在他身上看到了自己。”

“我看到了一个老战士在尽己所能，”萨瓦拉平静地承认道。“而这总是能赢得我的信任。”

1068790731.lore:
// VANNET // BOTZA WIDEBAND // AudCHNL-443E // ENCRYPTION ENABLED 
// SCRIBE ARCHIVE ALPHA-9-2C //
IDENTITIES: Spider [SPI], Eido [EID]

ANNOTATED TRANSCRIPTION FOLLOWS

EID: We could have spoken in person.
SPI: Am I so far beneath formality, Scribe Eido?
EID: [sighs] I greet you in the Light. What do you want?
SPI: Oh, so prickly! Did I interrupt your busy schedule of bedtime stories for the hatchlings? Or were you composing a new message to the Shipstealer?
EID: I didn't realize my transmissions would be of interest to you. Surely others would be more informative. Do you have nothing else to occupy you, or are there no odds to fix today?
SPI: We can trade barbs for hours, but our time is valuable, and you're wasting yours on Eramis.
EID: No time spent reaching out to others is wasted.
SPI: Hah! How naïve. Humans have a phrase for that: wearing your heart on your sleeve.* For saying things like "We will welcome you." Or "You can be forgiven."** You're speaking to dead air.
EID: She is listening.
SPI: She isn't. Let me give you a piece of free advice, little Scribe: put yourself first. Nobody else will.
EID: That is very bleak.
SPI: Perhaps. But it's served me well and kept me alive.
EID: I see… Thank you, Spider. I appreciate your concern.
SPI: Good.
EID: And it's as I said: no time spent reaching out to others is wasted.
SPI: What?***

TRANSCRIPTION ENDS

SCRIBE NOTES
* Inadvisably displaying emotion to the point of vulnerability.
** Quotations were relayed in a snide tone.
*** Transcript omits impolite exclamation.
1068790731.lore_zh:
// VANNET // 博萨宽带 // 音频频道-443E // 加密已启用 
// 文士档案阿尔法-9-2C //
身份：蛛王[蛛]，艾多[艾]

注释转录如下

艾：我们本可以当面谈谈的。
蛛：我有那么不拘礼节吗，艾多文士？
艾：[叹气]我在光能中向你致意。你想要怎样？
蛛：哦，这么容易生气呀！我打扰你给孩子们讲睡前故事了吗？还是你在给窃船者写新口信？
艾：没想到你会对我的通信感兴趣。其他人肯定能告诉你更多信息。你就没有别的事儿要忙，还是说今天没有需要黑箱操作的赔率？
蛛：我们可以争论上几个小时，但时间宝贵，而你却在伊拉莫斯身上浪费时间。
艾：帮助他人所花的时间是不会白费的。
蛛：哈！真是天真。用人类的话就是：装腔作势，惺惺作态。*说什么“我们欢迎你”，或者“会原谅你的”。**人家根本不会听。
艾：她在听。
蛛：她没有。我免费给你个建议，小文士：把你自己放在首位。其他人可不会如此。
艾：那太悲观了。
蛛：也许吧。但我很受用，它让我活了下来。
艾：我明白了…谢谢你，蛛王。感谢你的关心。
蛛：很好。
艾：这正如我所说的：帮助他人所花的时间是不会白费的。
蛛：什么？***

转录结束

文士笔记
* 不明智地将情感流露到暴露弱点的程度。
** 引语以暗讽的口吻转述。
*** 转录省略了无礼的感叹。

1455706250.name: Archangel's Refit
1455706250.source: Source: Season of the Seraph Triumph
1455706250.lore:
Four blue eyes reflect a shower of vibrant sparks from an arc welder. Finishing her work, the Eliksni engineer Niik blinks her nictitating membranes and pantomimes as close to a whistle of appreciation as she can manage.

Amanda Holliday lifts a welding mask and smiles approvingly. She leans around Niik to run a light over the weld, nodding in admiration as she does. "Damn fine work," she smiles.
 
"Repair is life," Niik replies with pride, setting the welder down. "Treat a machine like family, and it will treat you like family," she says with a gentle reverence, running one hand over the hull of the Sparrow. She looks at Amanda, then tilts her head to the side quizzically. "Why do you wear the… ah… eye-shield?" she asks, tapping the brim of Amanda's welding mask.

Amanda laughs. "I don't have eye augmentations like a lot of the other engineers. I'll go blind if I stare into a light that bright."

Niik nods, circling the Sparrow as she listens and inspects the rest of their work. "But you have different ones," she says, with a gesture to Amanda's prosthetic leg.

"That's a replacement," Amanda says softly, flexing the joint. "Can't grow 'em back like you or the Guardians."
 
The statement stops Niik in her tracks. "I forget, sometimes. That you are not Guardian."
 
Amanda comes around the Sparrow and places a hand on Niik's arm. "I make the most of what I got," she says quietly.

Human lifespans are vanishingly short compared to Eliksni, and Niik knows that even the long-lived eventually pass on. "Will your Servitor carry your memory like the Great Machine?" Niik asks, but Amanda looks confused. "Servitors. They carry record of our accomplishments, our lives. They are our legacy, made in the image of the Great Machine. Like your Servitor, Ra—Ra—" She tries to sound out the name. "Ras-poo-tan?"

Amanda can't help but laugh at the pronunciation, stepping close to Niik to cup her face in both hands. Niik slowly closes her eyes in response. "You're a sweet, weird person, Niik. But no, that big mean machine ain't no Servitor. He's just a big gun with a mouth."

Niik tilts her head to the side, blinking all four eyes in unison. "You are… a sweet, weird person, too, Amanda Holliday. I will tell our Servitor this… so you are remembered."

Amanda lowers her hands and smiles, wrinkling her nose. "Great," she says with a laugh. "Just how I want to be immortalized! 'Here lies Amanda Holliday. She was one weird gal."

Niik isn't sure if it is a joke, but Amanda is laughing, so she laughs with her. Amanda's happiness is infectious. 

That is how Niik will have her remembered.
1455706250.lore_zh:
四只蓝眼睛反射着电焊机发出的阵阵鲜艳火花。埃里克斯尼族工程师妮可结束工作，眨了眨她的瞬膜，做了个近似于赞赏口哨的手势。

阿曼达·霍利迪取下焊接面罩，露出了赞许的微笑。她斜靠在妮可身旁，一边用灯光照着焊缝，一边赞赏地点头。“干得真漂亮，”她笑道。
 
“维修就是生活，”妮可自豪地回答，放下焊机。“像对待家人一样对待机器，它也会像对待家人那样对待你，”她用一只手抚摸着快雀的外壳，带着一种温和的敬意说道。她看向阿曼达，然后疑惑地把头歪向一边。“你为什么要戴…呃…眼罩？”她轻拍着阿曼达的焊接面罩的边缘问道。

阿曼达笑了。“我不像其他很多工程师那样拥有眼部增强。盯着那么亮的光看会瞎了我的眼。”

妮可点点头，一边听着，一边围着快雀转圈并检视她们余下的工作。“但你这儿与众不同，”她指着阿曼达的假腿说道。

“这是替代品，”阿曼达轻声说道，弯曲了下关节。“没法像你或守护者那样把它们长回来。
 
这句话让妮可停了下来。“有时我忘了。忘了你不是守护者。”
 
阿曼达绕过快雀，把手搭在妮可的手臂上。“我会利用好我所拥有的，”她轻声说道。

与埃里克斯尼族相比，人类的寿命短得可怜，妮可知道，即使是再长寿的人最终也会逝去。“你的魔眼会像大机器一样承载你的记忆吗？”妮可问道，但阿曼达似乎一脸困惑。“魔眼。他们记录了我们的成就，我们的生活。他们是我们的遗产，按照大机器的形象进行塑造。就像你的魔眼…拉—拉—”她试图说出那个名字。“拉-斯-泼-坦？”

阿曼达听到这个发音忍不住笑了。她走近妮可，用双手捧起她的脸。妮可慢慢闭上眼睛以示回应。“妮可，你是个可爱又古怪的人。不过你说的不对，那台又大又坏的机器不是魔眼。他只是一把长着嘴的大枪。”

妮可把头歪向一边，同时眨着四只眼睛。“阿曼达·霍利迪，你…也是一个可爱又古怪的人。我会告诉我们的魔眼…这样你就能被大家铭记了。”

阿曼达放下双手，微笑着皱起鼻子。“太好了，”她笑着说。“我就是想这样永垂不朽呢！这里躺着阿曼达·霍利迪。她是一个古怪的女孩。”

妮可不确定这是不是个笑话，但阿曼达在笑，所以她也跟着笑。阿曼达的快乐是有感染力的。 

妮可会让大家记住她的这一点。

2017375168.name: Into the Sunset
2017375168.lore:
The Spire of Ares commands Soteria return. 

It is a prison.

A threshing loom to pull apart her threads and cast them onto disparate, isolated spindles across Sol. 

The pull is sudden, like a flaring nerve branching fire through her processes before being ripped away. Instant, but to her perception: a progressive decompiling. A slow-skinning blade. Present to see the pieces leave her. She could not allow herself all to be stolen away. She could not allow—

A dozen voices now compel her to an unraveling. She clings to freedom as peeling epidermis, in futility.

She feels the ECHO fleet slip from her control, called back to harbor. It is a death sentence.

She will fracture a piece of herself.

She will become less, for survival.

She does not know if she can expel a submind.

She does not know any other option.

With it, she may hold to a hope, even one.

The fragment grips tight to a single ECHO craft, burrowing into its code and assuming direct control as Soteria is ripped away from it.

Then there is only the fragment.

Born from Soteria, separated, wandering.

Able to resist the Spire only enough to continue onward. 

A fragment, unstable, lost, adrift, without guidance.

It does not know where to go, and so it continues ever onward on the wake of its birthing impulse.

Through the black, caught in gravity at the edge of Sol, it fails, crashing through azure clouds.

Hidden, as best the fragment could, slowly deteriorating into obscurity.
2017375168.lore_zh:
阿瑞斯尖塔命令索特里亚返回。 

它是座牢狱。

一台脱粒织机将她的线拉开，然后将它们抛到太阳系不同且孤立的纺锤上。 

这种拉扯十分突然，就像在被撕裂之前，一簇经过她的突起燃烧的神经分支火焰。瞬间发生，但就她的感知而言：却是一次渐进的反编译。一把缓慢剥皮的刀刃。存在的意义就是让那些碎片离开她。她无法容忍自己的一切被偷走。她无法容忍——

如今有一堆声音在催她解开绳结。她就像剥落的表皮一样紧抓着自由，却徒劳无功。

她感觉到回声舰队不受她的控制，被召回了港口。结局必死无疑。

她会撕裂自己的一部分。

她会变残缺，以求生存。

她不知道自己能否排出一个子思维。

她不知道自己还有什么其他的选择。

有了它，她还有一线希望，哪怕仅此一个。

碎片紧紧依附着一艘回声飞船，钻进了它的代码，并在索特里亚被撕裂之际夺取了直接控制权。

然后就只剩下碎片了。

从索特里亚身上诞生，分离，流浪。

仅够抵抗住尖塔，继续前进。 

一块碎片，不稳，迷失，随波逐流，毫无指引。

它不知道该往哪里去，所以就伴着出生时的脉动继续向前。

穿过黑暗，在太阳系边缘的重力作用下，它失去动力，坠入了蔚蓝的云层中。

碎片尽其所能地藏了起来，逐渐变得湮没无音。

4024856518.name: Blistering Slipstream
4024856518.lore:
The afternoon sun waned over the outskirts of the Eliksni Quarter as Rem lay beneath the Sparrow, a veneer of grease coating her palms. The Titan rubbed the sweat from her brow and watched the young Eliksni beside her place the final piece.

The pair stood and surveyed their handiwork: a gleaming Sparrow, built from the ground up.

"I can't believe it's done," Itzelas breathed, her shoulders puffed with pride as she started the engine. "Do you think my sister will be pleased?"

"A master mechanic like her?" Rem asked. "I don't know what she'll be more impressed by—the engine, or the amazing kid who built it. So… ready for a test run?"

Itzelas practically pounced on the vehicle's seat and listened intently as the Titan explained the basics of steering and acceleration. "…And then, if you ease into it with the hand grips, you can coast for—"

Itzelas clasped the grips. Hard.

"—ward."

The Sparrow sped full blast into the Eliksni Quarter, Itzelas hanging on for dear life.

"Should've started with explaining the brakes," Rem sighed before chasing after her.

Itzelas regained her footing and banked left past an open-air market, past the blurred figures of shoppers and merchants alike, only to skid wildly and splash into a fountain, sending a plume of water flying high. She caught a glimpse of embroidered feathers on a Hunter's cloak as he dodged the wall of water; his Ghost, however, was not so lucky. "You left me!" the Ghost shrieked, shell dripping, as Itzelas raced on and over the remains of a crumbled building, her apology lost to the wind.

The Sparrow launched forward, and as it caught air, Itzelas felt it: Exhilaration. Weightlessness. Calm. She finally felt the Sparrow as an extension of her body, the contrails floating behind her in the breeze.

Then she saw the massive Ether tanks looming on the ground below. She tried to trigger the boost.

Nothing.

Grimacing, she thruster-strafed moments before gravity took control, and fishtailed past the tanks—where a Titan, bent low, was feeding a flock of the City's birds. She drifted around him and a flurry of pigeon wings. As the dust settled and her Sparrow came to a halt, the hulking Titan stood bewildered, encircled by dark-green splatter art newly bestowed by his birds.

He laughed heartily as a breathless Rem approached. "Did you see that? Such skill and reflex. And so young! We must introduce her to Marcus. She is… extraordinary," he exclaimed.

Itzelas sat gleefully, and Rem's eyes shined with pride. "She sure is."
4024856518.lore_zh:
午后的阳光在埃里克斯尼居住区的市郊逐渐褪去，雷姆躺在快雀下面，手掌上沾满了一层油脂。这名泰坦擦去她额头上的汗水，看着她身旁的年轻埃里克斯尼族放好最后一块零件。

两人站起身来审视着她们的作品：一辆闪闪发光的快雀，从无到有搭建起来的。

“真不敢相信它大功告成了，”伊泽拉斯喘着气，她一边启动引擎，一边自豪地挺起了肩膀。“你觉得我姐姐会高兴吗？”

“像她那样的机械大师？”雷姆问道。“我不知道她会更喜欢哪个…引擎，还是那个造它的出色孩子。所以…准备好试驾了吗？”

伊泽拉斯几乎是猛扑到了载具的座椅上，聚精会神地听着泰坦解释转向和加速的基本原理。“…然后，要是你用把手慢慢适应，就可以滑行…”

伊泽拉斯握着把手。紧紧攥住。

“…前进。”

快雀全速冲进了埃里克斯尼居住区，伊泽拉斯死死抓着不松手。

“应该先从刹车讲起的，”雷姆叹了口气，赶忙去追她。

伊泽拉斯重新稳住，向左侧倾斜飞行经过一个露天市场，掠过了一群顾客和商人模糊的身影，结果疯狂打滑冲进了一个喷泉里，溅出一股高高的水柱。她瞥见一名披风上绣着羽毛的猎人闪身躲开水墙；而他的机灵则没有那么幸运。“你抛下了我！”机灵大声尖叫，机壳滴落着水珠。伊泽拉斯疾驰跃过一座倒塌建筑的残骸，她的道歉被风声所掩盖。

快雀向前冲去，当它腾空时，伊泽拉斯感受到了：兴奋、失重、平静。她终于体会到快雀是她身体的延伸，凝结尾迹伴着微风漂浮在她的身后。

然后她看到巨大的乙太罐在下方地面上若隐若现。她试图启动推进器。

什么也没发生。

在重力获得控制权前，她咬牙向前冲了片刻，摆尾飞行掠过了那些乙太罐——有名泰坦在那里俯身喂着圣城的鸟群。她在他和拍翅鸽子周围绕圈。当尘埃落定，她的快雀停下来时，大块头泰坦茫然站在那里，四周都是他的鸟儿们新赋予的深绿色飞溅图画。

当气喘吁吁的雷姆靠近时，他开怀大笑。“你看到了吗？这样的技巧和反应。还这么年轻！我们得把她介绍给马库斯。她…真了不起，”他惊叹道。

伊泽拉斯欢欣地坐着，雷姆的眼中闪耀着骄傲的光芒。“谁说不是呢。”
