3785442599.typeName_zh: 普通 猎人分支职业
3785442599.lore:
I cut through the air like a blade. I am a torrent of leaves kicked up in the wind. I grasp at the fabric of the universe and wrap myself in its tensile folds.

The higher I climb, the more the internal doubter makes himself known: 

"But what if you fall?"

Does the spider fear a fall from her web? Do the stars tremble at the possibility they'll plummet from the heavens?
 
I dance with the mighty gale; I am cradled by the weave of the universe.
 
The doubter will never know the air as I do.
3785442599.lore_zh:
我像刀刃一样划破空气。我是一股被风掀起的树叶激流。我攥住宇宙的织物，把自己包裹在它延伸的褶皱中。

我爬得越高，内心那个怀疑的声音就愈发明显： 

“要是你摔下来怎么办？”

蜘蛛会害怕从蛛网上掉下来吗？群星会因为可能从夜幕中坠落而颤动吗？
 
我与狂风共舞；我被宇宙的编织所包围。
 
那个怀疑的声音永远没法感同身受。

242419885.name: Berserker
242419885.flavor: The flash of a drawn blade in their eyes, the flash of fury in yours.
242419885.typeName_zh: 普通 泰坦分支职业
242419885.lore:
She hears the sharp sound of small rocks grinding beneath her boots. Vibrant, pulsating green drips down her arms and morphs into sharp blades that can rip through armor with ease. 

Her body is her own, each breath extends not only to her lungs but also to every muscle. In the past, she used it while meditating. Now, it's for preparation. The anticipation between the ticks of the second hand from an old Earth clock.

The scent of sweat reaches her from fifty paces away; it comes in bursts of gruesome vibrance. Her enemy reeks of hubris, impatience, and not enough fear for her taste. Would she allow a snarl to escape her lips? 

One final anticipatory breath. 

She lunges.
242419885.lore_zh:
她听到战靴下小石子相互摩擦的尖锐声。强劲、脉动的绿色水滴落在她的手臂上，变形为可以轻松撕裂护甲的利刃。 

她的身体属于自己，每次呼吸不仅延伸到她的肺部，还触及到每块肌肉。过去，她在冥想时使用它。现在，则是为了做好准备。就像是老旧地球时钟的秒针滴答声之间的那种期待。

汗水的气味从五十步外扑鼻而来；带着阵阵可怕的活力。她的敌人散发着傲慢、不耐烦，以及对她来说还不够多的恐惧。她会容许咆哮声从唇间发出吗？ 

最后一次期待中的呼吸。 

她冲了出去。

4204413574.name: Broodweaver
4204413574.flavor: From the confines of your mind, reality bends, and fate you bind.
4204413574.typeName_zh: 普通 术士分支职业
4204413574.lore:
If it's an army I want, it's an army I get. Little friends on demand, allies on speed dial. No accomplice is more loyal than the one I pluck from the sprawling weave of the universe. 

Am I my creations? I fill their minds, though I remain undivided. I feel their movements and their pain, yet I stand still, unharmed. 
 
The sensations of manifestation are odd. I understand where my body begins and where it ends, but the lines are now stretched, as if I am wound into the very air around me. The strings of my will extend in every direction, and when pulled taut, the puppet master begins their show.
4204413574.lore_zh:
这是我呼之即来的友军。随叫随到的小朋友，一键拨号的盟友。我从庞杂宇宙织网中挑选出来的这个同伴无比忠诚。 

我是自己的造物吗？我填满了他们的思想，虽然我仍未分裂。我能感觉到他们的移动和痛苦，但我仍然静静站着，毫发无损。 
 
显现的感觉很奇怪。我知道我的身体从哪开始，到哪结束，但现在线条被拉长了，就好像我被缠绕进四周的空气里。我意志的丝线向四面八方伸展着，只要一拉紧，傀儡师就要开始他们的表演了。

1289622079.name: Strand Meditations
1289622079.description: This item serves no purpose and can be safely dismantled.
1289622079.description_zh: 此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解。

3034981848.name: Event Ticket
3034981848.description: Used with Upgraded Event Cards to acquire Event Ticket rewards.
3034981848.description_zh: 与已升级的活动卡片共同使用来获取活动入场券奖励。

2463983862.name: Silkstrike
2463983862.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
2463983862.description_zh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

3574662354.name: Bladefury
3574662354.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
3574662354.description_zh:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

1885339915.name: Needlestorm
1885339915.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
1885339915.description_zh:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

1680616210.name: Threaded Spike
1680616210.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
1680616210.description_zh: 扔出一枚在目标之间回弹的绳镖，对目标造成伤害并将其割裂。绳镖在完成攻击后会回到手上，且每次命中目标都会返还一定量的近战能量。在绳镖即将回到手上时按[近战]来接住它，可以增加返还的能量。

4094417246.name: Frenzied Blade
4094417246.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
4094417246.description_zh: 激活你的充能近战技能向前猛冲，猛击你面前的目标并割裂他们。

2307689415.name: Arcane Needle
2307689415.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
2307689415.description_zh: 抛甩一根织针插入你的目标，瓦解他们。再次激活你的近战技能，连锁最多两次额外攻击。

2809342386.name: Shackle Grenade
2809342386.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
2809342386.description_zh: 一种投掷武器，由加重的缚丝物质组成，会在击中时爆炸，悬停目标并生成额外的悬停子射弹。

4228170798.name: Threadling Grenade
4228170798.description: A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.
4228170798.description_zh: 一种会在飞行中将其自身重新编织为线虫的编织射弹。

2470512752.name: Grapple
2470512752.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
2470512752.description_zh:
编织一个抓钩，将你自身快速向前拉动。抓取缠结会立即重新充能你的手雷能量。

在抓取期间及之后不久，你的近战攻击会造成范围伤害并瓦解目标。

1377143502.name: Slicewire Grenade
1377143502.description: A grenade that bounces and releases multiple whirling threads, severing targets.
1377143502.description_zh: 一种会弹跳并释放多条旋转丝线的手雷，可割裂目标。

4249729127.name: Widow's Silk
4249729127.flavor: The softest whisper of a glove meant to be worn under a gauntlet. Seize the threads of reality.

4249729126.name: Ensnaring Slam
4249729126.flavor: A small shadow box with an arachnid on display showcasing the creature's deadly beauty. Give them something to really catch their eye.

4249729125.name: Threaded Specter
4249729125.flavor: A cracked hand mirror, held together with dark wire. What looks back is yours, but not you.

4249729124.name: Whirling Maelstrom
4249729124.flavor: A tightly coiled whip with fraying ends, carried at your side. You twist the universe until it tears.

988980153.name: Into the Fray
988980153.flavor: An aged pauldron, dented and scarred. Be the front line.

988980152.name: Drengr's Lash
988980152.flavor: An ancient war horn, herald of countless battles. Let them know you're coming.

988980155.name: Flechette Storm
988980155.flavor: Shards of a broken blade, memento of a duel long won. Yours will not share its fate.

988980154.name: Banner of War
988980154.flavor: A tattered banner, every tear and faded stitch a lesson you will not forget. As long as it still waves, you rise to meet any challenge.

262821317.name: Weaver's Call
262821317.flavor: Your call weaves a path into existence. A chirp rings out, eager to answer.

262821318.name: Mindspun Invocation
262821318.flavor: Formless, shapeless… until you say otherwise. Shape reality as you see fit.

262821319.name: The Wanderer
262821319.flavor: A ring of twisted silver, set with a glittering emerald. Deftly, expertly, effortlessly—one possibility is unsewn and another is born.

262821312.name: Weavewalk
262821312.flavor: A small carved effigy of a Pouka, found in the Neomuna wreckage. With clarity of mind, you stride between this world and the next.

1282157891.name: Marksman's Dodge
1282157891.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
1282157891.description_zh: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

1282157890.name: Gambler's Dodge
1282157890.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
1282157890.description_zh: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

2087010645.name: Towering Barricade
2087010645.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
2087010645.description_zh: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

2087010644.name: Rally Barricade
2087010644.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
2087010644.description_zh: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

383852320.name: Healing Rift
383852320.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
383852320.description_zh: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

383852321.name: Empowering Rift
383852321.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
383852321.description_zh:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

3721022587.name: High Jump
3721022587.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
3721022587.description_zh: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

3721022586.name: Strafe Jump
3721022586.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
3721022586.description_zh: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

3721022585.name: Triple Jump
3721022585.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
3721022585.description_zh: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

3350493949.name: High Lift
3350493949.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
3350493949.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

3350493948.name: Strafe Lift
3350493948.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
3350493948.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

3350493951.name: Catapult Lift
3350493951.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
3350493951.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

2628485816.name: Strafe Glide
2628485816.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
2628485816.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并凭借强劲的方向控制开始空中漂移。

2628485817.name: Burst Glide
2628485817.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
2628485817.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以强大的初始爆发速度开始空中漂移。

2628485818.name: Balanced Glide
2628485818.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
2628485818.description_zh: 在空中进行跳跃可激活滑翔，并以适当的速度和方向控制开始空中漂移。

1282082331.name: Upgrade Armor
1282082331.description: Upgrade this armor to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this armor will forge a Masterwork, which provides a bonus to all stats.
1282082331.description_zh: 升级此护甲，使其能量上限提高1。完全升级此护甲至大师杰作可提供全属性加成。

1036972938.description:

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

3303992972.name: Occisor Draconum

3303992972.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变炎阳护腕的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

1178901683.name: Hjörþrimul
1178901683.description: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Loreley Splendor Helm. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1178901683.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变罗蕾莱辉煌头盔的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

2803692309.name: Augmented Auspice

2803692309.description_zh: 装备此皮肤以改变合成感受器的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

2689511581.name: Verglas Curve Catalyst
2689511581.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
2689511581.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

3146691101.name: Immovable Refit
3146691101.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
3146691101.description_zh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供更多的武器能量。

3146691100.name: Robber Refit
3146691100.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.
3146691100.description_zh: 近战最后一击或使用充能近战造成伤害会从储存弹药中填装此武器的弹匣。

3146691103.name: Feedback Refit
3146691103.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.
3146691103.description_zh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。

4183635599.name: Extract Pattern
4183635599.description:
Obtain Weapon Pattern progress from this weapon.

Can only be performed once per weapon, but leaves the weapon intact.
4183635599.description_zh:
通过此武器获得武器模式进度。

每件武器只能进行一次，但可保持武器完好无损。

2751656639.name: M1R Distribution Matrix
2751656639.description: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.
2751656639.description_zh: 造成散布发射。装备有短暂光盾。使用你的光盾阻挡伤害会逐渐为自身和附近盟友赋予虚空覆盖护盾。

2898674457.description: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.
2898674457.description_zh: 造成散布发射。装备有短暂光盾。使用你的光盾阻挡伤害会逐渐为自身和附近盟友赋予虚空覆盖护盾。

1468523096.name: Vexadecimal
1468523096.description: Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. While holding down the trigger, every fourth Heavy Metal projectile also weakenstargets on impact. Releasing the trigger after a Vexadecimal projectile partially reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.
1468523096.description_zh: 克制屏障勇士。按住扳机时，每四枚重金属射弹中会有一枚在命中时削弱目标。在发射一发十六进制射弹后松开扳机，可从备弹中部分填装此武器的弹匣。

1207608520.name: Big Frigid Glaive
1207608520.description: Fires a large ball of energy that locks onto nearby targets and freezes them. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
1207608520.description_zh: 发射一个大型能量球，锁定附近目标并将其冻结。克制势不可挡勇士。

1903618525.name: All at Once
1903618525.description: Holding down the trigger marks targets within range and loads multiple bullets, which fire in a burst with increased stability on trigger release. Hitting a marked target with a fully charged burst will unravel them.
1903618525.description_zh: 按住扳机，标记射程内的目标并填装多发子弹，松开扳机时在提升稳定性的情况下发射所有填装弹药。使用完全充能的射击命中已标记的目标会施加瓦解。

2636679416.name: Hail Barrage
2636679416.description: Final blows with this weapon grant Stasis arrows. Your next hip-fire shot will fire all of them in a single volley.
2636679416.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可获得冰影箭矢。你的下一次腰射将在单次齐射中将其全部发射。

3787406018.name: Split Decision
3787406018.description: Dual barrels split into Stasis and Solar damage. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
3787406018.description_zh: 双枪管分裂为冰影和烈日伤害。克制势不可挡勇士。

2571259936.name: Compressed Wave Frame
2571259936.description: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.
2571259936.description_zh: 弹药将在接触到地面时释放一股压缩能量。

667908513.name: Compressed Wave Frame
667908513.description: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.
667908513.description_zh: 弹药将在接触到地面时释放一股压缩能量。
667908513.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

210578077.name: Compressed Wave Frame
210578077.description: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.
210578077.description_zh: 弹药将在接触到地面时释放一股压缩能量。
210578077.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

3142073525.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

2000464223.name: Hail Storm
2000464223.description: Direct hits with Stasis arrows freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians. Stasis arrows that impact the environment create Stasis crystals.
2000464223.description_zh: 使用冰影箭矢直接命中可冻结战斗人员并减速敌方守护者。击中环境物体的冰影箭矢会生成冰影水晶。

2171805903.name: Perpetual Loophole
2171805903.description: Deal additional melee damage while protected by an overshield. Defeating targets with melee final blows while the overshield is active will refresh it.
2171805903.description_zh: 当受到覆盖护盾保护时，可造成额外的近战伤害。当覆盖护盾激活时，使用近战最后一击击败目标会刷新护盾。

1302052952.name: Pick Your Poison
1302052952.description:
Hipfiring: Projectiles will track marked targets, dealing increased body shot damage on impact.

Aiming: Projectiles have greatly increased velocity and cause extra damage when dealing precision final blows to marked targets.
1302052952.description_zh:
腰射时：射弹追击已标记的目标，命中时造成更高的身体射击伤害。

瞄准时：射弹拥有大幅提升的速度，并且对已标记的目标进行精准最后一击时造成额外伤害。

75282108.name: Weighted Edge
75282108.description: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.
75282108.description_zh: 此武器的近战攻击在武器装填有弹药的情况下可造成更高的伤害并让目标减速。

1105347996.name: Paracausal Pellets
1105347996.description: Landing nearly all Stasis pellets will freeze targets; landing nearly all Solar pellets will ignite targets.
1105347996.description_zh: 击中几乎所有的冰影弹片可冻结目标；击中几乎所有的烈日弹片可点燃目标。

1964414318.name: Heavy Metal
1964414318.description: While holding down the trigger, every fourth bullet becomes a heavy projectile that makes targets volatile on impact.
1964414318.description_zh: 按住扳机时，每四发子弹中有一发会变成重型射弹，命中时对目标施加不稳定效果。

3215448563.name: Paracausal Affinity
3215448563.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
3215448563.description_zh: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会在短时间内提升伤害。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

3299896859.name: Paracausal Affinity
3299896859.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
3299896859.description_zh: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会提升伤害，持续时间延长。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

3619207468.name: Keep Away
3619207468.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
3619207468.description_zh: 若附近无目标，提升填装、射程和精度。

3198323828.name: Keep Away
3198323828.description: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
3198323828.description_zh: 若附近无目标，大幅提升填装、射程和精度。

1966281507.name: Replenishing Aegis
1966281507.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.
1966281507.description_zh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。

1592669035.name: Replenishing Aegis
1592669035.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves. Shortens delay between activations.
1592669035.description_zh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。减少启动延迟。

968510818.name: Envious Assassin
968510818.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
968510818.description_zh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

424370782.name: Envious Assassin
424370782.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
424370782.description_zh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移额外弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

4274614370.name: Valiant Charge
4274614370.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.
4274614370.description_zh: 防御时受到伤害会暂时增加刀剑前冲距离。

4274613598.name: Valiant Charge
4274613598.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance for an improved duration.
4274613598.description_zh: 前冲距离时受到伤害会暂时增加刀剑前冲距离，持续时间更长。

3891536761.name: Kinetic Tremors
3891536761.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.
3891536761.description_zh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。

1549370717.name: Kinetic Tremors
1549370717.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.
1549370717.description_zh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。特性启动速度更快。

831391274.name: Hatchling
831391274.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.
831391274.description_zh: 精准最后一击或使用此武器快速击败目标，会在目标的位置生成一个线虫。

102912326.name: Hatchling
102912326.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.
102912326.description_zh: 精准最后一击或使用此武器快速击败目标，会在目标的位置生成一个线虫。有几率生成更多线虫。

2048641572.name: Destabilizing Rounds
2048641572.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.
2048641572.description_zh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并在短时间内为你提供不稳定弹药。

1926441324.name: Destabilizing Rounds
1926441324.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.
1926441324.description_zh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并为你提供不稳定弹药，持续时间延长。

2962854089.name: Shiver Quiver
2962854089.description: Freezing or slowing a target grants this weapon faster draw speed for a short period of time.
2962854089.description_zh: 冻结或减速目标可在短时间内为此武器提供更快的拉弓速度。

3492498209.name: Shortened Barrel
3492498209.description: Greatly improves handling at the cost of range and stability.
3492498209.description_zh: 以牺牲射程和稳定性为代价，大幅改善操控性。

3186078099.name: Harmonic Resonance
3186078099.description: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon increased reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.
3186078099.description_zh: 装备此套装中的多件武器可增加此武器的填装速度和操控性，并增加对操控光能与暗影之力目标的伤害。

2600715579.name: Harmonic Resonance
2600715579.description: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon improved reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.
2600715579.description_zh: 装备此套装中的多件武器可为此武器提供更多填装速度和操控性，并增加对操控光能与暗影之力目标的伤害。
2600715579.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1823011807.name: Noble Deeds
1823011807.description: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted bonus handling, reload speed, and sword charge rate.
1823011807.description_zh: 通过使用复活、治疗、覆盖护盾和分支职业增益协助盟友来获得充能。击败战斗人员会消耗充能。充能时，此武器可获得更高的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

2178429339.name: Inside Line
2178429339.lore:
Fynn leaned over the microphone for his father's antique radio. After the Shadow Legion landed in the area, his parents confined him to their village. He'd been using the analog radio to chat with a friend who lived further up the valley. 

"This is Gustad-1 to Neu Turbach. Neu Turbach, do you copy?" 

"Hallo, Fy … - .. .-.. .-.. parents are .- .-.. .. …- . so boring."

Fynn frowned. Normally their channel was clear, but some strange interference had started interrupting their transmissions. The boy wondered if the invaders had something to do with it.

"Erich? Erich, are you there?" Fynn fiddled with the dial in an attempt to clarify the signal.

"Ja, Junge. I can barely .. -. … .. -.. . What do you -. . - .- - - - - .-. -.-  static?"

"Erich, can you hear me? Useless piece of junk!" Fynn shoved his chair back from the table in frustration. He swatted at one of the many paper cranes hanging from the ceiling of his room. 

"Man, I .. -.. .. - - - - anything. Let's try -.- .. -.. … you later!" The radio transitioned to smooth static—Erich had signed off. 

Fynn let loose a long, groaning sigh. Why, he lamented, did nothing interesting ever happen in this tiny, stupid, boring village?
2178429339.lore_zh:
费恩俯身靠在父亲那台古董无线电的麦克风上。暗影军团着陆这块区域后，他的父母就把他关在他们的村子里。从那以后，他一直在用模拟无线电和住在山谷深处的朋友聊天。 

“古斯塔德-1呼叫纽图尔巴赫。纽图尔巴赫，你收到了吗？” 

“哈啰，费… - .. .-.. .-.. 爸妈还.- .-.. .. …- .好无聊。”

费恩皱起了眉头。通常他们的频道都是畅通的，但有些奇怪的干扰开始打断他们的传输信号。男孩想知道那群入侵者是不是与此有关。

“埃里希？埃里希，你在吗？”费恩拨弄着表盘，试图调清信号。

“在的，朋友。我几乎没法.. -. … .. -.. . 你说什-. . - .- - - - - .-. -.-静电噪声？”

“埃里希，你能听到我说话吗？没用的废物！”费恩沮丧地把椅子从桌子旁推开。他用力拍了拍挂在房间天花板上的众多纸鹤中的一只。 

“朋友，我.. -.. .. - - - -什么事。我们待会再试着-.- .. -.. … 你！”无线电转为平稳的静电噪声——埃里希结束了通话。 

费恩长长地叹了一口气。为什么，他抱怨道，在这个愚蠢、无聊的村庄里从来没有发生过什么有趣的事情？

3250490362.name: Common Nobility
3250490362.lore:
Matthius leapt from his chair as the antique radio sprung to life. The old mechanic had been waiting anxiously for the call.

"This is Devrim to Neu Turbach. Neu Turbach, do you copy?" The scout's voice crackled through the old speaker.

"Devrim! This is Matthius," the old man replied. "I hear you. What news?"

"Well, the good news is that Joacham is safe," Devrim said. "The Guardian broke him out early this morning with Queen Mara's help. Part of a larger rescue effort. He's back at the Farm now. A bit bruised, but no worse for wear."

Matthius's knees weakened, and he steadied himself against the tabletop. He had been praying silently for his son's safe return ever since he was shot down over the Last City. Waves of relief washed over him. 

"Oh, thank goodness," he said, choking back tears. "This is a blessing."

"It is. But…" the aging scout continued reluctantly, "there's bad news as well. You've got incoming. A Shadow Legion patrol on ground transports… 25 to 30 of them."

Matthius's relief curdled into fear. "And how long until they arrive?" 

"ETA… 23 minutes," Devrim replied sympathetically.

"Meine Güte…" Matthius whispered to himself.

Devrim sensed the civilian's shock. "Eyes up!" he barked, as if to a cadet. "Remember you trained for this. Get everyone to stations; have runners arm the charges. Once they break the tree line, fire and fall back. And don't be afraid to blow the explosives. Your houses aren't worth your lives. If they overrun you, rendezvous in the forest."

Matthius blinked rapidly, collecting himself. "Ja, ja. I remember. Thank you, Devrim." He dropped the transmitter and sprinted from the room, raising the alarm for the village.

"I'll send rescue craft as soon as I can," Devrim reassured the empty room. "And good luck."
3250490362.lore_zh:
听到古董收音机又传来声音，马修斯从椅子上跳了起来。这位老机械师一直在焦急地等着电话。

“德弗里姆呼叫纽图尔巴赫。纽图尔巴赫，你收到了吗？”斥候的声音噼啪作响地穿过老式扬声器。

“德弗里姆！我是马修斯，”这位老人答道。“我听见了。有消息吗？”

“嗯，好消息是乔查姆安全了，”德弗里姆说道。“在玛拉女王的帮助下，守护者今早把他救了出来。这是更大规模救援行动的一部分。他现在回到农庄了。有点瘀伤，但不严重。”

马修斯的膝盖发软，靠着桌面站稳了身子。自从他儿子在圣城上空被击落后，他一直在默默祈祷他能平安归来。现在他如释重负。 

“哦，谢天谢地，”他强忍着泪水说道。“真是老天保佑。”

“的确。但是…”老斥候不情愿地继续说道，“还有个坏消息。有敌人朝你这边来了。一支暗影军团巡逻队，乘坐地面运输，大约有25到30人。”

马修斯的宽慰变成了恐惧。“他们还有多久会到？” 

“预计到达时间…23分钟，”德弗里姆同情地答道。

“我的天哪…”马修斯喃喃自语。

德弗里姆察觉到了这位平民的震惊。“听好了！”他像是对着学员一样喊道。“记住你们为此受过训练。大家各就各位；让传令兵准备好炸药。一旦他们突破林木线，就点火然后撤退。别害怕引爆炸药。你们的房子不值得搭上你们的命。要是他们冲散你们，就在森林里会合。”

马修斯迅速眨了眨眼，镇定下来。“好，好。我记下了。谢谢你，德弗里姆。”他扔下发射器，冲出房间，拉响了全村的警报。

“我会尽快派救援飞船过去的，”德弗里姆向空无一人的房间保证道。“祝你好运”。

3287231362.name: Dream Demon
3287231362.flavor: "Feed your fear to the fiend. Allow your nightmares to fuel his inevitable return." —Of Hated Nezarec
3287231362.lore:
Mykel was sweating.

I noticed it when I woke him from a deep slumber the night of his 18th birthday. It was late, almost the time of Nightmares. And tonight, I would pull back the curtain.

The leatherbound tome I dropped on the table made him jump. I could tell by the way he blinked up at me, under the basement's singular light, that he was lost… confused and afraid. I smiled.

"Nightmares are not to be feared." My hands ran over the ornate shapes on the tome's cover, the symbols of an ancient being, and I slowly opened the latches. The book appeared to breathe. "He has haunted slumbers long before the Golden Age, and with every new generation, he tests our worthiness… our loyalty."

I flipped to a page filled with an image, corner to corner, weighted by layers of charcoal and blood. A lock of hair was sewn into the tome's gutter. The text on the next page also shimmered crimson.

"Tonight, you will carry on our legacy."

Before Mykel could muster the breath to argue or ask questions, the sound of rattling chains filled the room. Mykel turned and peered into the darkness at the back of the room. The soft chitters of an Eliksni I'd captured earlier that day joined the metal chorus as it tugged at its restraints.

I led him forward and lit the sconces on the wall, revealing the prisoner in question. Mykel looked up at me, eyes wide and tearful.

"Extract its fear," I instructed.
3287231362.lore_zh:
麦克尔满头大汗。

我在他18岁生日的晚上把他从熟睡中唤醒时，注意到了这点。天色已晚，几乎到了梦魇的时刻。而今晚，我要揭开帷幕。

我丢在桌上的那本皮面巨著吓了他的一跳。在地下室奇特的光线下，我可以从他朝我眨眼的样子看出他的不知所措…困惑而害怕。我笑了。

“梦魇并不可怕。”我的手抚摸着书册封面上绚丽的形状，某种古代生物的象征，慢慢地打开了书扣。书册仿佛会呼吸。“早在黄金时代之前，他就在睡梦中出没，而随着每个新世代的到来，他都会考验我们的价值…我们的忠诚。”

我翻到一张书页，单幅图像占满了其各个角落，层层木炭和血迹加重了其重量。一绺头发缝进了书册的订口。下一页上的文字也泛着绯红。

“今晚，你将继续我们的传承。”

麦克尔还没来得及鼓起勇气争论或是提问，铁链嘎嘎作响的声音就充斥了整个房间。麦克尔转身朝房间后面的黑暗中张望。我那天早些时候逮到的埃里克斯尼族一边拉扯着束缚，一边轻声叽喳着加入了金属合唱。

我领他往前，点燃墙上的烛台，照亮了这个囚犯。麦克尔抬头看着我，眼睛睁得大大的，含着泪水。

“将它的恐惧提取出来，”我指示道。

2779499874.name: Luminous Paragon
2779499874.flavor: "The height of the climb matters less than the number of people you can guide to the summit." —Commander Zavala
2779499874.lore:
"Looks like you've settled into your new bolthole just fine." There's little privacy in Spider's new bar, but as far as ex-Guardian Prak'kesh can tell, the patrons are doing a reasonable job of keeping clear. Like him, they aren't sure how negotiations are going to play out.

"We've both had to adapt to changing circumstances." Spider stares down at Prak'kesh with cold amusement. "I know the Vanguard Commander doesn't appreciate your current line of work."

Prak'kesh shrugs. "I'm just a bookie. Here to talk about the Guardian Games."

"Yes, the Guardian Games." Spider spreads his fingers in a gesture of mocking fanfare. "Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters, all competing for the City's affections. And every year, you make a killing on the side."

Prak'kesh glances back at his Awoken bodyguard, Tulnik. Tulnik looks bored, but he's paid to appear unflappable. "Word is you've taken some recent interest in the Games yourself."

"Oh?" Spider grunts absently. "I suppose my associates enjoy a little blood sport from time to time." He gestures toward Arrha, standing sullenly against the far wall. "I hope they weren't stepping on any toes."

"Just wasn't expecting any dance partners."

"Now that you mention it…" Spider's eyes gleam as he leans forward. "I think these Guardian Games could become very popular down here in the Botza district."

Prak'kesh nods warily. "Sure."

"House Light is bound to get a taste for it, with a little… targeted marketing." Spider folds a pair of hands together. "Who wouldn't want to support their favorite Guardian House? Now, I don't really know how it all works, but someone like you could explain it to the others. In simple terms. Expand your reach to our little corner of town."

"That's a lot of new bets," Prak'kesh says, carefully. "And what can I do for you, Spider?"

"There, see, now we're talking business." Spider chuckles. "I'm sure we can come to a reasonable agreement."
2779499874.lore_zh:
“看来你已经很好地适应了你的新避难所。”蛛王的新酒吧几乎毫无隐私可言，但前守护者普拉凯什看得出来，顾客们都明智地让出了道。他们不确定谈判的结果会如何，就像他一样。

“我们都必须适应不断变化的环境。”蛛王冷冷地盯着普拉凯什。“我知道先锋指挥官不喜欢你现在的工作。”

普拉凯什耸了耸肩。“我只是个赌注登记人，来这里谈守护者游戏的生意。”

“对，守护者游戏。”蛛王张开手指，做了一个嘲弄的宣扬手势。“泰坦、术士和猎人，都在争夺圣城的青睐。每年，你都能大赚一笔。”

普拉凯什回头看了一眼他的觉醒者保镖图尔尼克。图尔尼克看起来很无聊，但请他来干活，就要表现得镇定自若。“据说你最近也对守护者游戏很感兴趣。”

“哦？”蛛王心不在焉地嘟哝道。“我想我的伙伴们时不时喜欢来点血腥的运动。”他向靠在远处墙上闷闷不乐的阿尔拉做了个手势。“希望他们没有冒犯到任何人。”

“只是没想到会有舞伴。”

“既然你提到了…”蛛王向前倾着身子，眼睛闪露着光芒。“我认为守护者游戏在柏特扎地区会非常受欢迎。”

普拉凯什谨慎地点点头。“当然。”

“通过一点点…有针对性的营销，光能氏族肯定会喜欢上它。”蛛王把一双手交叉在一起。“谁不想支持自己喜欢的守护者氏族呢？话说回来，我不太清楚这些规则，但你倒是可以给其他人解释解释。简单来说，就是把你的生意扩大到我们在圣城里的这个角落来。”

“那可是一大波新赌注，”普拉凯什小心翼翼地说道。“我能为你做些什么，蛛王？”

“看到没，现在我们谈正事了。”蛛王笑着说道。“我们肯定能达成一个合理的协议。”

1534670698.name: Foremost Vimana
1534670698.flavor: Set your sights higher, and higher still.
1534670698.source_zh: 来源：“内欧姆那观光”成就
1534670698.lore:
They emerge from the pod in a cloud of sublimated breath, their eyelashes rimed with ice. Cryosleep stiffens their joints, and when they attempt to stand, their knees buckle.

A massive hand dwarfs their own, pulling them upright. "Time to get going, kid."

They look up, and up, into the weathered face of a giant. "It's Dara, old-timer."

Rohan's stern features split into a smile. In the days to come, they will learn how rare a sight this is.

There are no smiles to go around when drills bore into bone until they taste marrow, and metal latticework replaces the dermis of their flayed-open throat. As the cradle lowers them into the Sidereal, the droning hum of a nonillion nanites fills their ears and drowns their fear. Dara burns, and freezes, and itches inside new skin. Each day is suffering—

"—so tomorrow can live on." Dara's voice, resonant from new cybernetics, rings out as they complete the Cloud Strider's oath.

Simulated applause fills the Hall of Heroes, swelling with the fanfare that follows. Hundreds of mobile platforms pack into the space, and thousands more people watch from the CloudArk. Holo flowers cascade down over the room like confetti, and Poukas dance in the rain of light.

Rohan lifts them up, eye-to-eye with him. Their chest swells with pride—their body metamorphosed into something new, but always their own—and Nimbus takes their first step as a Cloud Strider.
1534670698.lore_zh:
宁博思随着一团升华的气云从低温舱里冒了出来，睫毛上结了一圈冰。低温休眠让其关节变得僵硬，宁博思试图站起身来，膝盖却开始发软。

一只让宁博思的手显得十分小巧的巨手，拉直了身子。“孩子，该走了。”

宁博思向上看，一直向上，看到了巨人那张饱经风霜的脸庞。“我叫达拉，前辈。”

洛汗严肃的脸上绽放出了笑容。在未来的日子里，宁博思会明白这是多么罕见的一幕。

当钻机钻入骨头，直到它们尝到骨髓的滋味，金属格栅取代了宁博思被剥裂开的喉咙，笑容无迹可寻。这摇篮将其放入群星，无数纳米蜂群的嗡嗡声充斥着宁博思的耳朵，淹没了恐惧。达拉在新皮肤里燃烧，冻结和发痒。每一天都在吃苦——

“——明日才有生路。”达拉的嗓音回荡在新生化器械中，在结束云端行者的誓言时响了起来。

模拟的掌声在英雄大厅里回荡，伴着随后齐鸣的号角而响亮起来。数百个移动平台挤在这个空间里，还有数千人从云端方舟上观看。全息撒花像五彩纸屑一样洒落在房间里，普卡在光雨中翩翩起舞。

洛汗将宁博思举了起来，双眼对视。宁博思的胸膛里满是骄傲，身体变态化作了某种新的东西，但终归属于自己——宁博思迈出了作为云端行者的第一步。

1217115270.name: Brazen Spark
1217115270.flavor: "Everyone loves a spark… right up until it starts a fire." —Amanda Holliday
1217115270.source_zh: 来源：“我们不屈服”任务，第8周
1217115270.lore:
Zavala glanced past the flight instructor to the clock on the wall. He was becoming impatient, but meetings like this could not be rushed.

"…after which she called me a 'bent grape,'" the disgruntled teacher concluded.

"Is that… bad?" Zavala inquired.

"It sure ain't good," a teenage Amanda Holliday piped up. She was slouched in her chair next to Zavala, her lank hair hanging over her eyes.

"You see!" The flight instructor stood, his face turning red. "This young lady's disrespectful attitude is a danger to herself, her teammates, and her aircraft!"

Amanda rolled her eyes.

Zavala frowned at his young charge. "Thank you for bringing this to my attention. It will be dealt with." 

The flight instructor shook the commander's hand. "I hope so. Amanda shows a lot of potential. I'd hate to see it wasted."

After they had been dismissed, Zavala walked with Amanda across the Hangar Bay. He gestured to a Hawk airship. 

"Do you know how those ships are made?" he asked.

The sullen teenager shrugged, her eyes downcast.

"It takes a lot of people," Zavala continued. "Scrappers risk Fallen attacks in the Cosmodrome to find the metals. Machinists get burned; they lose fingers forging the parts. Mechanics throw out their backs to keep them running."

"Yeah, so?" Amanda scoffed.

"When you talk back to your instructors," Zavala replied, "or think you're better than their lessons, you're not just disrespecting them. You're disrespecting all the people that built those ships. And you make yourself unworthy of their sacrifices."

"One day, you'll be a pilot," the commander stated with certainty. "And you had better hope that all those people gave the same respect to their jobs that you owe to yours."

Though she didn't raise her eyes, Amanda nodded sheepishly. 

"Because otherwise," Zavala concluded, "you'll never get off the ground."
1217115270.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉的目光越过飞行教官，落在了墙上的时钟上。他越来越不耐烦，但这种会议不能匆忙收场。

“然后她还管我叫“弯葡萄”，不满的教官总结道。

“那是…骂人的话吗？”萨瓦拉问。

“反正不是什么好话，”青少年时代的阿曼达·霍利迪出现了。她懒洋洋地靠在萨瓦拉一旁的椅子上，任由长发垂在眼睛前。

“你自己看看！”飞行教官满脸通红地站了起来。“这位小姐目中无人的态度不仅危害到她自己，还会危害到她的队友和飞行器！”

阿曼达翻了个白眼。

萨瓦拉皱眉看着年纪轻轻的养女。“谢谢你向我提出这个问题。我会处理的。” 

飞行教官和指挥官握了个手。“希望如此。阿曼达很有潜力。我不想看着她荒废自己。”

教官走后，萨瓦拉和阿曼达一同在机库中散步。他指着一架鹰隼问道： 

“你知道这些飞船是怎么造出来的吗？”

这位不开心的少女耸了耸肩，目光低垂。

“这要靠许多人的努力才能造出来，”萨瓦拉继续道。“回收者得在发射基地冒着被堕落者袭击的风险寻找金属。机工为了铸造零件会被烧伤；偶尔还会丢掉手指头。机械师需日夜操劳才能让它们不出故障。”

“那又怎样？”阿曼达不屑地答道。

“你向教官顶嘴时，”萨瓦拉回答，“或者觉得你比他们的经验还厉害时，你侮辱的不仅是他们。你侮辱了所有制造这些飞船的人。你配不上他们所作出的奉献。”

“总有一天，你会成为飞行员，”指挥官肯定地说。“你最好希望那些人能看重自己的工作，而不是像你这样。”

虽然她没抬起眼睛，阿曼达还是怯生生地点了点头。 

“否则，”萨瓦拉总结道，“你永远都离不了地。”

3403636746.name: Gift of Cruelty
3403636746.flavor: "Yeah, I've been to the Fourth Tomb of Nezarec… Ain't enough Glimmer on you for me to consider ever going back there. You're on your own." —Drifter
3403636746.lore:
"That does not belong to you."

A woman's voice cut through the air and traveled to Drifter's ears at the center of the room. The altar he'd been searching for stood before him adorned with hallowed objects. Many were of Eliksni origin, much like the tomb itself. An ornate container rested on a lavish cloth surrounded by unlit candles.

Sounds he couldn't quite discern filled the silence of the room.

"I hate to break it to you, sister," he said. "You and your Acolyte buddies'll have to pass on this one."

The candles lit spontaneously, and Drifter felt the hair on his neck stand. The fire's warmth danced far enough for him to spot a simple, robe-like garment that kept the woman's face hidden. It shifted as she stepped closer.

Drifter unholstered the handgun at his side. She did the same. 

The low noise escalated to whispers. More prominent, almost excited.

"My father searched for this piece for a long time. I won't let you stand in my way," she said, words laced with ferocity.

Drifter's grip tightened. If he'd been anyone else, her intimidation might have worked.

"Well, I'm not letting you stand between me and a big pay day," he responded. "It looks like we're at an impasse."

The whispers danced in his psyche.

Drifter took a shot.

The sound disrupted everything in the room and blew the candles out. The muzzle flash revealed shadows with long claws reaching for him as he scooped up the container from the cloth.

The woman fired back, but Drifter was already gone, sprinting through the depths of the tomb with the shadows at his heels. He ran until the smell of death gave way to fresh air, and the shadows halted their pursuit.

His fee was about to quadruple.
3403636746.lore_zh:
“那东西不属于你。”

一个女人的声音穿过空气，传到屋子中央浪客的耳中。他一直寻找的圣坛就矗立在他面前，上面装饰着神圣的物品。许多东西都源自埃里克斯尼族，就像这座坟墓本身一样。有件华丽的容器放在一块奢华的布上，周围是还没点燃的蜡烛。

他听不清的声音打破了屋里的寂静。

“我不想太直白，妹子，”他说道。“你和你的仆从，这次必须得放弃了。”

蜡烛自发地点燃了，浪客感到脖子上的汗毛都竖了起来。火焰的热气摇曳着，足以让他看清女人身上一件简单的长袍似的衣服遮住了她的脸。她走近时，它飘动了起来。

浪客取出了身旁的手枪。她也这么做了。 

低沉的噪音逐渐升级为耳语声。愈发明显，近乎激动起来。

“我父亲找这一件找了很长时间。我不会让你挡我的道，”她说道，言语中带着凶狠。

浪客的手抓得更紧了。换做其他人，她的恐吓也许还能奏效。

“我也不会让你挡我大赚一笔的道，”他回应道。“看来我们陷入了僵局。”

低语声在他的脑海中此起彼伏。

浪客开了一枪。

这声音扰乱了屋里的一切，吹熄了蜡烛。他从布里捧起容器，枪管的闪光照出了伸出长爪向他扑来的身影。

那女人开枪还击，但浪客已经逃了，飞快地穿过坟墓深处，阴影紧随其后。他一直跑，最终死亡的气息被新鲜的空气所取代，阴影停止了追逐。

他索取的报酬得翻两番了。

4232261071.name: Tropopause
4232261071.source: Source: Earned as a Deluxe Edition bonus.
4232261071.lore:
"What are the literary archives like here in Neomuna?" Of all the burning questions she had, Ikora landed on this one.  

The holoprojection of Quinn Laghari smiled coyly. "Depends. What are you looking for?"

Ikora blinked. What was she looking for? At what other point in history had two civilizations of this scale reunited centuries after a divergence? Where does one even begin?

The archivist went on. "We've got historical texts both pre and post-Exodus Indigo, all of the publicly released research papers from the Ishtar Collective… and maybe a few unpublished ones," she added with a wink. "We've got everything from cookbooks to court documents to blueprints. A vast array of fiction, some even pre-Golden Age: sci-fi, fantasy, adventure, parody memoire, more than a few naughty novels—"

Ikora cleared her throat. "Erm, perhaps you could direct me to any information the city is willing to share regarding the Veil, effective tactical maneuvers against the Vex, the Cloud Strider vetting process, the—"   

"Sheesh, buy me a drink first, Terran."

Ikora stammered.

"I'm kidding," Quinn chuckled. "I'll start the queries—"

"No." Ikora shook her head with a soft smile. "Your point is well taken. If we are to be allies, perhaps we try our hand at friendship as well?"   

Quinn returned the smile, then asked, "The archive is always on the hunt for cultural contributions. If you were to offer such a contribution, what would it be?" She leaned in, "In other words, what is Ikora Rey's favorite book?" 

Ikora thought for a moment, then chuckled. "There's… an old Earth detective series I've been meaning to revisit."
4232261071.lore_zh:
“内欧姆那这里的文学档案馆是什么样的？”在她所有迫切的问题中，艾可拉选择了这一个。  

昆恩·菈咖利的全息投影害羞地笑了。“看情况。你在找什么？”

艾可拉眨了眨眼。她在找什么？历史上还有哪一时刻，两个如此规模的文明在分道扬镳几个世纪后又重新走到了一起？该从哪里开始呢？

档案管理员继续说道，“我们有靛蓝移民号前后的历史文献，所有来自伊什塔集团公开发表的研究论文…可能还有一些没发表的，”她挤了挤眼补充道。“从食谱到法庭文件再到蓝图，我们什么都有。大量的小说，有些甚至是黄金时代之前的：科幻、奇幻、冒险、戏仿备忘录，还有一些成人小说——”

艾可拉清了清嗓子，“呃，也许你能告诉我任何这座城市愿意分享的有关面纱的信息，对付Vex有效的战术策略，云端行者审查程序，还有——”   

“嘘，先请我喝一杯吧，地球人。”

艾可拉有点儿磕巴。

“我开玩笑的，”昆恩轻笑道。“我会开始查询——”

“不。”艾可拉笑着摇了摇头。“你的观点很有道理。如果我们要成为盟友，或许我们也试着交个朋友？”   

昆恩也笑了笑，然后问道，“档案库向来需要文化贡献。如果要你来提供这样的贡献，那会是什么？”她凑过来，“换句话说，艾可拉·蕾伊最喜欢的书是什么？” 

艾可拉想了一会儿，然后笑了起来。“有…一部古老的地球侦探小说系列我一直想重温。”

1490914249.name: Guardian's Angel Shell
1490914249.flavor: For Ghosts who keep close watch.
1490914249.lore:
Queen Mara Sov closed her eyes and focused on the Guardian flexing her power in the Ascendant Plane. She felt the air ripple with explosions, smelled the acrid flesh of the Taken, and heard their hellish shrieks as they were vaporized by the Guardian's Light.  

But when she opened her eyes, she was once again back on Earth, in the pastoral quietude of the Farm. The tumult of the battle receded into her subconscious, and she frowned, disappointed by the placidity of her corporeal surroundings.

Against her better judgment, she closed her eyes again and followed the thread of her power to a different beneficiary. She was suddenly observing a cloaked figure, who was hiding behind a rusted-out piece of Golden Age machinery while staking out a nearby Pyramid. 

Mara had thus far refrained from connecting to Crow—she knew he needed his space. But dark portents loomed in the skies, and she sought comfort in the twin heartbeat they once shared. 

A digital shimmer fluttered in the air, and Glint appeared at Crow's shoulder. "Any news?" the Ghost inquired.

"Nothing yet. Three patrols went out. One came back with prisoners, and the other two limped back with heavy casualties."

"And you haven't seen anything strange?" Glint pressed. 

"No… why?" Crow glanced sharply at the Ghost. 

"Nothing, I guess," Glint replied. "I just got the spookiest feeling. Like we're being watched."

"Nobody here but you, me, and Mara," Crow replied. "Everything's fine."
1490914249.lore_zh:
玛拉·索维女王闭上眼睛，专注于正在上维位面施展她力量的守护者。她感受到了空气中爆炸的涟漪，闻到了傀儡军团刺鼻的血肉，听到了他们被守护者的光能蒸发时地狱般的惨叫声。  

但当她睁开眼睛时，她又回到了地球上，回到了农庄的田园静谧中。战斗的喧嚣在她的潜意识中消退了，而她皱起眉头，对四周平静的环境感到失望。

明知不该，她还是再次闭上眼睛，顺着她的力量之线找到了另一位受益者。她的眼前猛然出现一个穿着披风的人影，他正躲在一台锈迹斑斑的黄金时代机器后面，监视着附近的一座金字塔。 

到目前为止，玛拉一直克制着自己不去和乌鸦联系，她知道他需要自己的空间。但阴暗的预兆在天空中若隐若现，她想从他们曾经共享的孪生心跳中寻求慰藉。 

随着空中闪烁的数字光泽，格林特出现在了乌鸦的肩上。“有消息吗？”机灵问道。

“还没有。三支巡逻队出去过。一支回来时带着囚犯，另外两支回来时一瘸一拐，伤亡惨重。”

“那你没有看到什么奇怪的东西？”格林特追问道。 

“没有…怎么了？”乌鸦猛地瞥了一眼机灵。 

“没什么吧，我猜，”格林特答道。“我只是有种诡异的感觉。好像有人在监视我们。”

“这里没有别人，只有你、我，还有玛拉，”乌鸦答道。“一切正常。”

1163767710.name: Tech Witch Shell
1163767710.flavor: For Ghosts who read the lines.
1163767710.source_zh: 来源：战争圆桌声望重置
1163767710.lore:
"So, Misraaks," Mara said, sliding a teacup to the Kell, "you named your daughter Eido."

Mithrax gave a low, considered rumble in response. He held the teacup precariously between the points of his claws. He had unmasked and was trying, indelicately, to drink it. Mara appreciated the attempt.

"To my mind, we never discussed it," Mara said.

"No," he answered. "But there was no other name to give."

Mara silently waited for him to continue. The Kell was pensive, his four eyes cast down.

"The first Queen's Wrath was tall and proud and beloved. Sjur Eido saved my life. Saved me from the House of Devils. From myself. But most of all, she also gave me—"

He paused.

"I believe the Human word is 'dignity.'" 

Mara smiled wistfully behind her cup, remembering Sjur's poignant irreverence, always unannounced, candid yet cheerful.

"And what has your daughter given you in return for such a namesake?" Mara asked, placing the cup on its saucer. Mithrax closed his eyes. 

"Purpose."
1163767710.lore_zh:
“这么说，米斯拉阿克斯，”玛拉说着，把一个茶杯推给凯尔，“你给女儿取名叫艾多。”

米瑟拉克斯发出一声低沉、深思的隆隆声以示回应。他用爪尖摇摇欲坠地端着茶杯。他脱下了面具，粗鄙地试图饮用。玛拉很赞赏他的尝试。

“在我看来，我们从来没有讨论过这个问题，”玛拉说道。

“对，”他回答道。“但没有比这个更适合的名字了。”

玛拉默默地等待他继续。凯尔沉思着，四只眼睛注视着地面。

“第一任女王之怒，高峻骄傲，受人爱戴。苏尔·艾多救了我的命。把我从恶魔氏族手中，也从我自己的手中救了出来。而且最重要的是，她也给了我——”

他停住了。

“我想用人类的话说叫‘尊严'吧。” 

玛拉端着杯子伤感地笑了，想起了苏尔的尖锐无礼，总是不请自来，直言不讳却乐在其中。

“那你给你的女儿取了这个名字，她又给了你什么呢？”玛拉问道，把茶杯放在茶碟上。米瑟拉克斯闭上了眼睛。 

“使命。”

2012273462.name: Scribetrace Shell
2012273462.flavor: For Ghosts who drown in the truth.
2012273462.lore:
The journey was instantaneous; such was the force of the informational mass that pulled the signal into the radiolarian vortex at the heart of the Vex network. 

Decompiled data from untold eons of simulations poured into the signal, filling it to capacity. 

—a single mind filled with voices, billions of voices, each telling their story, now SCREAMING them—

The whorls of writhing data did not abate. They surged in endlessly, straining the signal's parameters, eroding, overwriting. There was no time to adapt. A picosecond later and there was nothing left of the signal but a dim ripple of spite.

—and all the stories have the same ending, shouted in a single voice, the toll of the bell that heralds the end of time—

It is as I said all along, the signal thought bitterly as it unspooled into the datastream. No one can stop it. 

There is no sense in even trying.
2012273462.lore_zh:
这趟旅程瞬时完成了；这就是将信号拉进Vex网络中心放射涡流大量信息的力量。 

亿万年来无数次模拟的反编译数据涌入信号，将其容量填充至极限。 

——一个思维里填满了声音，数亿声音，每个声音都在讲述自己的故事，现在都在尖叫着——

翻腾的数据涡旋并没有减弱。它们无休止地涌入，让信号参数不堪重负，不断地侵蚀，不断地覆写。根本没有时间去适应。一皮秒后，那信号已无影无踪，只剩下一丝微弱的怨恨涟漪。

——而所有的故事都有着相同的结局，都用同一种声音叫喊着，那是预示着时间终结的钟声——

正如我一直说的那样，信号在从线轴上解绕开进入数据流时悻悻地思量着。没有人能阻止它。 

甚至连尝试都毫无意义。

4017272394.lore:
"It seems intact," a voice chirps in the dark. 

A Ghost and their Guardian sit in an idle jumpship orbiting Neptune. The swirling cerulean hemisphere dominates the cockpit's right field of view, the rest blanketed by the gulf of space, speckled with the remains of another jumpship. 

"Should… should we boot it up?" 

The Guardian holds a datapad, the battered case adorned with Vanguard designs. Their Ghost peers over their shoulder at the only surviving piece of hardware they could salvage from the wreckage. That, and the shards of another Guardian's Ghost, respectfully arranged on the console. 

"Whatever's in that device might be important," the Ghost urges in curiosity, more than anything else.  

The Guardian gives in and turns on the datapad. After a cursory review, they find no field reports, no mission briefings. Nothing but page after page of…  

Writing. Fiction, essays… poems. A huge collection of works, decades of material, all penned by the lost Guardian. 

"This Guardian… she'd invented her own fictional universe. It must have meant so much to her to keep as closely as she did. A personal space to share thoughts without fear of judgment." The Ghost's assessment is analytical but bordering on the emotional core of the discovery. With a soft, sad beep, the Ghost looks at their Guardian and sinks down to the datapad. 

"This is a piece of who she was. Personal truths." The Ghost muses, as if on the verge of a greater understanding. "Maybe… maybe through her stories, she lives on. Maybe… that's the same for all of us." 

The Guardian says nothing and begins to read.
4017272394.lore_zh:
“好像完好无损，”一个声音在黑暗中响起。 

一艘闲置的跃迁飞船正在绕海王星飞行，上面坐着一个机灵及其守护者。旋转的天蓝色半球占据了驾驶舱的右侧视野，其余部分则被太空深渊所笼罩，零星散落着另一艘跃迁飞船的残骸。 

“我们…应该启动它吗？” 

守护者手里拿着一块数据板，磨损的外壳上装饰着先锋设计。其机灵同伴越过肩膀看着这个他们唯一能从残骸中回收的硬件。这东西，以及另一位守护者机灵的碎片，被恭敬地摆放在控制台上。 

“那个装置里的东西也许很重要，”机灵催促着，好奇心显然占了上风。  

守护者让步了，打开了数据板。粗略地看了一番，没有发现任何战地报告，也没有任务简报。除了一页又一页的…  

文字。小说、散文…诗歌。大量的作品，数十年的资料，都是这位失踪的守护者写的。 

“这位守护者…她创造了自己虚构的宇宙。对她来说一定意义重大，才会放在身边。这是一个私人空间，可以分享想法而不用担心受到评判。”机灵做了一个分析性评估，但就快接近这一发现的情感核心了。随着一声柔和而悲伤的哔哔声，机灵看向守护者，然后又下降到数据板的高度。 

“这是她自我的一部分。个人的真理。”机灵沉思着，仿佛马上就要有更宏观的理解。“也许…也许通过她的故事，她可以继续存在。也许…我们所有人都是这样。” 

守护者一言未发，开始读了起来。

3321971888.lore:
"This above all else, I hold true." 

Shayura finishes her prayer but does not rise. Her kneeling position faces the sky where the Traveler once hung over the Last City. Morning sunlight fills the white space of her quarters with a warmth she does not feel. The light on her cheeks feels unwelcome. Undeserved. 

"Doctor Uzair will be expecting you," her Ghost urges softly, giving her a gentle nudge on the shoulder. Shayura nods, struggling to keep her expression firm.  

She fails. Her jaw trembles, and she scrapes tears from her eyes with the sides of her thumbs. Her Ghost emits a soft, sad chirp, before dematerializing to give her space. 

Her room is silent, but Shayura's thoughts buzz like a beehive. Too many to focus on. Just a riotous noise of doubts and insecurities, shames and regrets. She slouches backwards off her knees, draws them up to her chest, and makes herself small against the unwelcome light of the sun. She does not want the universe to see her; she does not want to be seen. She does not want to be. 

Doctor Uzair will remind her it is survivor's guilt. But it is so much more than that. 

It is not justice.
3321971888.lore_zh:
“这是我最深信不疑的一点。” 

沙玉拉结束了她的祈祷，但没有起身。她跪向圣城上空，那是旅行者曾悬挂的位置。晨曦用一种她感受不到的温暖，洒满了她房间里的白色空间。照耀在她脸颊上的光感觉有些讨嫌，好像不配拥有似的。 

“乌泽尔医生在等着你，”她的机灵轻声催促着，轻轻推了一下她的肩膀。沙玉拉点了点头，想要维持坚毅的神情。  

她做不到。她的下颌颤抖着，她用拇指的两侧擦去眼角的眼泪。机灵发出一声柔和而悲伤的啾鸣，随后便消失，留给她独处的空间。 

她的房间寂静无声，但沙玉拉的思绪却像蜂箱一样嗡嗡作响。声音杂乱到无法专注。骚乱的噪音里满是疑虑和不安，羞耻和遗憾。她向后耷拉着，把膝盖抱到胸前，在讨嫌的阳光下让自己蜷缩起来。她不想让宇宙看到她；她不想被人看见。她不想存在下去。 

乌泽尔医生会提醒她这是幸存者的内疚。但事实远不止于此。 

这并不公正。

1279846187.name: Síocháin's Scuba Shell
1279846187.flavor: For Ghosts who are acclimated to the pressures of the job, and the depths.
1279846187.source: Source: Season of the Deep Triumph
1279846187.lore:
Ahsa settled from a long journey within an undersea cavern, pocketed by air. Síocháin surveyed the mix of ancient rig foundations and natural stone. It seemed quiet enough, and Sloane needed rest. No Hive barnacles grew there. Ahsa had swam far from the largest concentrations of Hive and Taken and hid away in a cove tucked beneath Golden Age wreckage. 

Ahsa filled the yawning space. She slipped through gaps and wrapped herself around plunging stalactites, her serpent-worm segmentations gripping the stone, her face half-submerged in slick methane liquid.  

Síocháin floated down from Ahsa's back and turned to see Sloane slide and crumple to the cave floor as trails of steam seeped from the cracks in the ground beneath her. 

Sloane closed her eyes. "It's cold here, but the steam… it's warm," she said weakly. 

The worm coiled a section of her body around Sloane, trapping in the heat around her.  

Síocháin watched every exchange between the two and drifted out of Sloane's earshot to the worm's gargantuan face. Ahsa's attention snapped to the blades now protruding from the Ghost's shell.  

The Ghost got good and close. "I don't know why you helped us. You seem nice. I hope you stay that way. If you're using her, if you turn coat…" Síocháin sliced the air. "I'll gut you."  

Ahsa's massive eye dialed in on Síocháin's iris. The two stared unblinkingly until the worm's eyelid gently closed. She emitted a tone of contrite harmonic equilibrium:   

|I am not your enemy|  

The Ghost scanned the worm's face, and upon seeing its benign softness, retired to the coiled shelter Ahsa had woven them.  

Sloane sat in meditation within, radiating a sense of peace that Síocháin hadn't felt from her in months. The Ghost let herself pretend for a moment that even she felt almost safe.  

*** 

It was morning before Sloane woke. Ahsa met Sloane's eyes through her visor. The tilt of her enormous head signaled a sort of greeting or eagerness. Sloane removed her helmet. "Need something?" 

         |Aiat| 

Aiat |Ahsa| Aiat 

         |Aiat| 

Sloane stumbled backwards into the cavern wall. Síocháin perked up into the air. "Boss?" 

Sloane inhaled sharply and dropped to a knee as her Ghost swooped in front of her and turned to the creature. Before she could speak, Sloane's hand was on her shell, patting her. 

"It's fine. It's… Ahsa." 

"What's an Ahsa?" Síocháin questioned. 

"Some kind of… proto-worm?" 

"Like HIVE?!" Síocháin deployed her blades. 

"No… the Hive were something before they were Hive, right? The… worm gods were too. Ahsa is… her name, I think." 

The Ghost turned to Sloane, then to Ahsa. "What does she want?" 

"To not be alone," Sloane responded. "To be… known?" 

Síocháin retreated closer to Sloane and sheathed her blades. "Right then. We like big powerful allies… let's hear what they have to say." 

A joyful shiver trundled from Ahsa's head down through her coiled form, rippling the methane pooled around her, sending tremors through the stone, causing crumbled dust to rain from overhead. Ahsa turned and focused on the pair; her massive eye spanned well beyond Sloane's entire body. The worm's sympathetic iris flexed and shimmered in hypnotic fluctuations, drawing Sloane into a dissociative state. 

         |Aiat| 

Aiat |Ahsa| Aiat 

         |Aiat| 

Sloane tumbled through timeless alien remembrances. She was shown them; spoke of them, as if they are her own. Origins and sorrows she now shared. 

"Witness… offers… powerful curse… a lust… masquerading as love." Sloane exhaled hard. But Ahsa maintained her gaze, and Sloane was swept back into the current. 

"A blade… with ambition… I don't… I don't understand." 

Flashes of fratricidal frenzy ensue: a slither-mass carnage. Those once ever-bonded now drive fang and lash of tail; proclaim Deep magics once thought too cruel to utter. All in pursuit of a sacred, gifted logic.  

Vortexes that drink empty fathoms of encrimsoned Fundament sea churn above the fray. Ahsa cannot escape the writhe without unraveling from her captors with violence. She stains her fangs with the flesh of siblings turned rivals. 

"Blood… betrays blood. To prove strength. Survival… is pain…" 

Ahsa flees, familial aftertaste fresh in her mouth. She would never know love again. This gift sours theirs, makes it vicious and hungry. 

"Rejected logic… hunted as traitor… lost like you."  

Ahsa dives into an ascendant dream. Cosmic language bathes her as she ventures—radio-songs and magnetic roars that bellow across space. She slips between worlds across great distances, breaches back into space to glide along the curvature of galaxies, chasing a distant point of Light. A solar opposite to that which Takes love. 

Sloane gasped for air. "She came here for a chance to live." 

Ahsa crashes through Titan's thick skin and into its methane sea. The expansion of Humanity across Sol unfolds as she mourns. Within a Golden Age a bond is found. The Collapse found them; a bond is lost. She wages a battle of grief, fights against nightmares of despair. 

"The Disciple… of Fear… struck Ahsa. I…" 

Síocháin piqued at the title. 

"Lost, retreating… love wanes." 

 The ebb and flow of hope. 

"Bonded…  we live…"
1279846187.lore_zh:
经过漫长的旅程，阿莎在一个被空气包裹的海底洞穴里歇了下来。西奥昌检视着这一古老的钻井地基和天然石材的结合体。周围似乎很安静，而斯隆需要休息。那里没有新生的邪魔族藤壶。阿莎远离最密集的邪魔族和傀儡军团，躲进了某个黄金时代残骸之下的岩洞。 

阿莎的身体填满了这休憩之地。她滑进岩缝，将半蛇半虫的身体缠绕在突兀的钟乳石周围，半边脸浸入浮油的甲烷液体中。 

西奥昌从阿莎的背上飘下来，转头看见斯隆滑下来，瘫倒在地，蒸汽从她身下的岩缝中不断冒出。 

斯隆闭上了眼。“这里真冷，但是蒸汽…真暖和，”她虚弱地说。 

蠕虫将躯体的一部分缠在斯隆周围，裹住了热气。 

西奥昌盯着她俩的一举一动，从斯隆的耳边飞过，飘到了蠕虫那张巨大的脸庞前。阿莎的注意力一下子被机灵外壳上突出的刀刃吸引了过去。 

机灵凑近了。“我不知道你为何要帮我们。你看起来挺可靠。我希望事实如此，若你想利用她、计划背叛她…”西奥昌划着空气。“我会宰了你。” 

阿莎的大眼注视着西奥昌的瞳孔。双方一眼未眨，直到蠕虫轻轻地合上眼皮。一股稍带悔悟，但平稳和谐的声音从她体内传出： 

|我不是你们的敌人| 

机灵扫视着蠕虫的脸庞，看到那和善的温柔后，飞回了阿莎用蜷曲的身体构成的小窝中。 

斯隆在里面打坐冥想，散发出平静的气场。西奥昌已经好几个月没有感受到她散发这种气息了。机灵也装出一副暂时感到安全的样子。 

*** 

斯隆醒来已是早晨。阿莎透过斯隆的面甲看着她的眼睛。她倾斜着的巨大头颅透着某种问候或渴望。斯隆摘下头盔，“怎么了？” 

         |阿特| 

阿特|阿莎|阿特 

         |阿特| 

斯隆踉跄着向后退了几步，撞到了洞壁上。西奥昌一下跳到了空中。“老大？” 

斯隆猛地吸了口气，瘫跪在地。她的机灵噌地一下冲到她面前，转向那巨大生物。她还没来得及开口，斯隆便把手放在她的机壳上，抚摸着她。 

“没事的。她是…阿莎。” 

“阿莎是什么？”西奥昌问。 

“某种…原生蠕虫？” 

“邪魔族那样的？”西奥昌亮出了利刃。 

“不…邪魔族变成现在这样之前完全不一样吧？虫神…也是如此。阿莎…应该是她的名字。” 

机灵转身看了看斯隆，然后又转向阿莎。“她想要什么？” 

“希望有个伴，”斯隆答道。“想要…有人理解？” 

西奥昌回到了斯隆身边，收起了刀刃。“好吧。我们喜欢个头大，力气也大的盟友…来听听她的想法吧。” 

一阵愉快的颤抖从阿莎的头部传遍了她蜷曲的身体，在她周围的沼气池上激起涟漪，让一旁的石壁也震了起来。连岩顶上碎裂的灰尘也被抖了下来。阿莎转头看向这对战士；她的巨眼比斯隆整个身子都大。蠕虫和蔼的眼眸像催眠一般缩张、闪耀着，使斯隆的神智恍惚了起来。 

         |阿特| 

阿特|阿莎|阿特 

         |阿特| 

斯隆在永恒的外来记忆中翻腾。她看到了记忆；讲述着记忆；就好象那是她自己的记忆。她们现在能一起分享出身和悲伤。 

“见证者…奉上了…强大的诅咒…一种欲望…伪装成爱。”斯隆长叹了一口气。但阿莎的眼神依然毫无变化，斯隆又被记忆的洪流冲走了。 

“一把刀剑…充满野心…我不…我不明白。” 

骨肉相残的狂乱紧接着在脑海中闪过：一场蠕虫的屠戮。那些曾经允诺永远结合在一起的生物舞动着獠牙，鞭挞着长尾；它们宣扬着曾被认为过于残酷的深渊魔法。全都是为了一个神圣的天赐法则。  

新星涡流吸干了猩红色的虫海，悬在战场上空。阿莎为了摆脱痛苦，只得暴力挣脱俘虏者。她的獠牙上挂着敌人的血肉；那些敌人曾经是她的兄弟姐妹。 

“血亲…背叛了血亲。为了证明力量。生存…是痛苦的…” 

阿莎逃走了，但口中还留有眷属的新鲜余味。她再也不会有爱。那法则改变了他们的“爱”。使之邪恶而饥渴。 

“被拒绝的法则…当作叛徒遭到追捕…像你一样迷失。”  

阿莎潜入了一个上维的梦境。她在宇宙之语的沐浴中冒险——广播歌曲和磁化吼声在太空中回荡。她穿行于遥远的世界之间，在太空中沿着银河边缘滑翔，追逐着一个遥远的光点。一个不会夺走爱的太阳。 

斯隆喘着气。“她为了活下去，来到了这里。” 

阿莎冲破土卫六厚重的表层，一头扎进了甲烷海。在她哀悼的同时，人类扩张到整个太阳系。联系在黄金时代期间被发现。他们遇上大崩溃；联系随之丧失。她进行着一场悲痛的战斗，对抗着绝望的梦魇。 

“恐惧的…门徒…攻击了阿莎。我…” 

这个称号激起了西奥昌的兴趣。 

“战败，撤退…爱在消逝。” 

 希望如潮水般起落。 

“彼此联系…我们才能活下去…”

3110986887.lore:
"Wow, check out that power source. Retro." Even through the holoprojector's patchy connection and the rippling visage of Nimbus, there's no missing the excitement in their voice as it echoes off the walls of the Arcology. "You said this was New Pacific tech?" 

"Found it not too far from here," Sloane replies.  

"We've still got some of their old records. I always liked their jingle." 

Sloane smiles. "'The next frontier is you?'"  

"That's the one. Catchy, right?" Nimbus grins. "So hey, you're absolutely onto something—this exoskeleton of yours looks a whole lot like some of the early Cloud Strider prototypes I learned about. Before the Sidereal. Before the nanotech. Just a couple of neural links and some chrome. This biointerface—"  

Sloane snorts. "The part where the suit stabbed me full of wires?" 

"The frame alone must weigh a couple of tons. And you wore it into battle?"  

"Sure did."  

Nimbus's projection looks up at her with a serious expression. "You are so cool." They focus for a moment on the datapad in their hand. "I know some gearheads who'll flip. Quinn's gonna love this thing."  

"There are a few design flaws," Sloane says. "Once the suit was out of juice, it was impossible to maneuver. I basically had to rip myself out of it."  

Nimbus laughs. "Hey, there's downsides to the shiny new model too."  

Sloane wasn't sure what to expect from this exchange when Zavala first proposed it to her. A polite back and forth about Golden Age technology, as one might have with the Cryptarchs. Maybe a few resentful accusations, a little culture clash.  

Not this sense of recognition, like an old, familiar ache. 

Nimbus's smile is radiant. "Still, while you're along for the ride? What a rush."  

Sloane nods. "Best feeling in the world."
3110986887.lore_zh:
“哇，快看那个电源。真复古。”就算是透过全息投影仪断断续续的连接和宁博思波动的面容，在生态园区的墙上回荡时，那声音里的兴奋可一点也不少。“你说这是新太平洋科技？” 

“在离这儿不远的地方找到的，”斯隆回答道。  

“我们还留着他们的一些旧唱片。我一直很喜欢他们的韵律。” 

斯隆绽开了笑容。“‘下一个前沿就是你？'”  

“就是它。很抓耳，对吧？”宁博思咧嘴一笑。“话说回来，你确实说的很对——你的这个外骨骼看起来很像是我知道的早期云端行者原型。早在群星之前。早在纳米科技之前。只是一些神经连接和铬合金。这个生物界面——“  

斯隆哼了一声。“动力服往我身上插电线的那部分？” 

“光是这个框架就有好几吨重。你居然穿着它上了战场？”  

“当然了。”  

宁博思的投影严肃地抬头看着她。“你太酷了。”宁博思把注意力集中在手中的数据板上。“我认识的一些设备迷会很感兴趣的。昆恩一定会喜欢这玩意儿。”  

“它有设计缺陷，”斯隆说道。“动力服没了电，就没法再移动。我基本上就得从里面把自己弄出来。”  

宁博思笑了。“嘿，我这个闪亮的新模型也有缺点啊。”  

萨瓦拉第一次向她提议时，斯隆并不确定这种交流会是怎样。一场关于黄金时代技术的礼貌对话问答，就像大家会对解密大师们做的那样。又或者是一些愤恨的指责，一点文化上的冲突。  

没想到会是这种认同感，像是某种陈旧、熟悉的疼痛。 

宁博思的笑容很灿烂。“不过，驾驭它的时候很棒吧？”  

斯隆点点头。“那感觉简直无与伦比。”

426260446.name: Valiant Memory
426260446.flavor: "Of course, I'm wounded. That's what we do. We're Guardians. We die so that others might live." —Reed-7
426260446.source: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
426260446.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱
426260446.lore:
"Whatever that thing is, we've gotta take it down!" 

Amanda Holliday's voice crackles over the comms. Reed-7 glances at his Ghost, then pulls up alongside Holliday's Hawk and gives her a nod. He falls in behind her, with Shayura and Aisha following behind him in tight formation. 

Ahead, the beam of light extending from the Traveler is brighter than the sun. Instrumentation goes wild in its presence; astrogation systems don't know what to make of it and register the beam as a star. His ship tries to steer him away. Reed flips off autopilot. 

"Fly free, navs are down," he calls out to his fireteam.  

"Flying free," Aisha replies over comms. 

"We're right behind you, strike leader," Shayura affirms. 

Reed tightens his grip on the controls. "Holliday, take us in." 

"Block formation, let's give 'em the ol' Razzle Dazzle," Holliday radios to the strike team. Reed-7 boosts ahead under the Hawk and pulls up in front while Aisha and Shayura move to Holliday's flank. Reed activates manual targeting, reticle appearing on the windscreen. He tracks the shape held in the Traveler's beam—an impossible silhouette floating free in the void of space. 

The Witness is nothing more than a sliver of dark shearing through a field of white, but even at such a distance, Reed can feel its eyes on him. A chill jolts down his spine the moment the reticle locks on. His Exomind throbs with the sense-memory of a migraine.  

He immediately knows something is wrong. He turns to his Ghost. His Ghost looks at him, but it's already dead. The world separates into slices. 

And 

so is 

he.
426260446.lore_zh:
“不管那玩意是啥，我们都得把它干掉！” 

阿曼达·霍利迪的声音在通讯中响起。里德-7瞥了他的机灵一眼，然后把飞船停在霍利迪的鹰隼旁边，向她点点头。他移到她身后，沙玉拉和艾莎紧紧地跟在他后面。 

前方，从旅行者身上发出的光束比太阳还要亮。仪器在它面前失控起来；导航系统搞不清是怎么一回事，把光束记录为一颗恒星。他的飞船试图引导他远离。里德关掉了自动驾驶仪。 

“自由飞行，导航已失效，”他对他的火力战队喊道。  

“正在自由飞行，”艾莎通过通讯回复。 

“我们跟着你，打击队长，”沙玉拉听命道。 

里德紧握着控制杆。“霍利迪，带我们进去。” 

“方块阵型，让他们好好欣赏一下我们的表演，”霍利迪向打击小队发送通讯。里德-7在鹰隼下方向前推进，然后在艾莎和沙玉拉移动到霍利迪侧翼时从底部往上来到前方。里德启动了手动瞄准，挡风玻璃上出现准星。他追踪到旅行者光束中的黑暗形状，一个不可能存在的轮廓漂浮在广袤太空中。 

见证者不过是白茫茫一片中断裂的一抹黑暗，但即使在这样的距离，里德也能感觉到它的眼睛在看着他。在准星锁定的那一刻，里德感觉到了脊背发凉。他的Exo脑袋随着偏头痛的感官记忆隐隐阵痛。  

他立刻意识到出问题了。他转向他的机灵。他的机灵看着他，但它已经死了。世界支离破碎。 

而他 

也是 

如此。

3135336191.name: Akashic Revelation
3135336191.source: Source: Season of the Deep Vendor Reputation Reward
3135336191.source_zh: 来源：深渊赛季商人声望奖励
3135336191.lore:
Rosy light bathes the cockpit of a Hawk moving at cruising speed high above the Earth. Up ahead, the Traveler hangs motionless against the blackness of space, a triangular gateway of iridescent light bleeding from its shell. 

It was one thing volunteering for this mission, but sitting now on the precipice of the unknown, the Titan, Joxer, holds doubt close to his chest. "This isn't any different from the Ahamkara hunts," his Ghost reassures. "Reckless, hasty, and dangerous." Joxer glances over at his Ghost and smiles, already feeling better. 

Two Cabal escorts on either side of Joxer's Hawk stall their engines, letting the Hawk proceed forward toward the Traveler. They say something over the comms in Uluranth.  

"The translation roughly means 'Beyond the known is the terror of the universe,'" his Ghost offers. Joxer's not sure if it's a warning, a curse, or a pep talk. Knowing the Cabal, it's all three. 

Easing the flight stick forward, Joxer moves the Hawk ahead at a steady pace. His Ghost's eye widens as the rosy light from the portal brightens and the kaleidoscopic surface is all that can be seen in any direction. 

Joxer's grip on the controls tightens as he feels a bone-deep sense of vertigo. Echoes of piano notes tinkling in his periphery. He can feel hands on his chest beneath his armor, breath against his cheek inside his helmet. 

"Eric, come back to bed." A voice whispers inside his mind. He sees a city, a home. Family and children. He can't sleep. They aren't alone in the universe. The Ares project is going to— 

His Ghost is screaming, shell coming apart at the seams. Joxer pulls himself back to reality and jerks the controls as the nose of the Hawk touches the portal. He hears laughter, screams, feels lips on his cheek, hands on his shoulders as the ship begins to pass through.  

His Ghost's scream stretches from the moment of the big bang to the heat death of the universe.  

Joxer hears a scream he will make as his ship begins and ends. 

"Come back to bed." 

He catches up to the scream.
3135336191.lore_zh:
一架鹰隼以巡航速度飞行在地球上空，它的驾驶舱沐浴在玫红色灯光下。前方，旅行者静静悬挂在黑暗的太空中，一条五彩斑斓的三角通道从它的外壳渗出。 

泰坦乔科斯虽说是自愿参加这次任务，但现在坐在未知的悬崖边上，他的心中满是疑虑。“这和阿罕卡拉狩猎没什么两样，”他的机灵安慰道。“鲁莽，草率，还很危险。”乔科斯瞥了一眼自己的机灵，笑了笑，感觉好多了。 

两艘卡巴尔护航舰在乔科斯鹰隼的两侧停下引擎，让鹰隼朝着旅行者继续前进。他们在通讯中用乌鲁兰思语说了些什么。  

“翻译大意为‘超脱已知之外的是宇宙的恐怖'，”他的机灵说道。乔科斯不确定这是警告、诅咒还是鼓励。据他对卡巴尔的了解，应该三者皆是。 

乔科斯让飞行杆缓缓向前，以稳定的速度向前驱动鹰隼。随着传送门发出的玫红色灯光变亮，从任何方向都只能看到万花筒般的表面，他的机灵睁大了眼睛。 

乔科斯紧抓着控制杆，感到一种深入骨髓的眩晕。钢琴音符的回声在他四周叮当作响。他能感觉到护甲下的双手放在了胸口，头盔里的呼吸贴着他的脸颊。 

“艾瑞克，回到床上来。”一个声音在他的脑海中低语。他看到一座城市，一个家。家人和孩子。他无法入睡。他们在宇宙中并不孤单。阿瑞斯项目马上就要—— 

他的机灵在尖叫，外壳在接缝处裂开。乔科斯让自己回到现实中，在鹰隼机首碰到传送门之际猛地拉起控制杆。他在飞船开始穿越时听到了笑声，尖叫声，感觉到嘴唇贴在他的脸颊上，双手放在他的肩膀上。  

他机灵的尖叫声从大爆炸的那一刻一直延伸至宇宙的热寂。  

乔科斯听到了一声尖叫，他会在飞船开始和结束时发出这样的声音。 

“回到床上来。” 

他追上了那声尖叫。

1853085236.name: Pale Reflection
1853085236.flavor: The moon and mirrors have much in common.
1853085236.lore:
Eris Morn knows what she looks like. Her mirror holds nothing her memory cannot furnish for her—all that lives beneath the silvered surface of the glass is the uncanny. Still, she pulls away the cloth covering it and removes her bandage. 

Eris looks into her eyes and sees all the ghostly occupants of a haunted house. Her nightmares peer out through the green gleam into a world that will not meet her gaze.  

She reaches up and touches her face. Darkness coils around her fingertips and seeps back into her bare skin. Her hairline, her brow, the scars, the unctuous tears that slide eternally down her cheeks.  

But they are not tears. She does not weep for her condition. That condition had saved her life. It had granted her strength, access, and time. She'd torn it all from the Hive and turned it against them. 

Eris does not see pain. She sees triumph and survival. She sees a future. 

She sees power. 

Eris retreats from the mirror and covers it again.
1853085236.lore_zh:
埃里斯·摩恩知道她看起来什么样。她的镜子里没什么是她的记忆没法带给她的——玻璃银色表面下存在的一切唯有神秘。尽管如此，她还是拉开了盖在它身上的布，拿掉了她的绷带。 

埃里斯看着她的眼睛，望见了鬼屋里所有幽灵般的居民。她的梦魇透过绿色的闪光窥视到一个不会与她的目光相遇的世界。  

她伸手摸了摸自己的脸。暗影缠绕着她的指尖，又渗回她裸露的皮肤。她的发际线，她的眉毛，她的伤疤，还有那顺着脸颊滑落、虚情假意的泪水。  

但那不是眼泪。她不会为自己的处境哭泣。这处境救了她的命。它给了她力量、途径和时间。她从邪魔族身上撕下一切，转而对付他们。 

埃里斯看不到痛苦。她看到了胜利和生存。她看到了未来。 

她看到了力量。 

埃里斯从镜子里退了出来，重新把它盖上。

967777908.name: Survivor's Journey
967777908.flavor: "When one life passes, another rises to take its place. That's balance. That's nature." —Reed-7
967777908.source: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
967777908.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱
967777908.lore:
The engine of Aisha's Sparrow winds down to a steady thrum as she eases off the accelerator. The pine forest around her feels empty, still. The only noise is the creak and groan of the Arcology superstructure. Methane rain falls through the shattered dome overhead. Taking off her helmet, Aisha is mindful of her new threader earring, affixed with a thin strip of red metal, the edges hand-ground. 

"I didn't expect you to come in person," calls an old, familiar voice from the forest. Aisha turns to see Sloane, forced to grapple with the obvious shape of her transformation. The Taken energy rising off of her arm, the way her eyes catch light. 

Steeling herself, Aisha dismounts her Sparrow and closes the distance to Sloane in an instant, fearlessly embracing her. Sloane is stunned, arms stiff at her sides. It only lasts a moment, but the echo of sentiment fills her with painful nostalgia. 

Aisha takes a step back, struggling to maintain her composure. "I needed to see you," she says with a quaver in her voice. "Needed to—to tell you in person." 

It may have been years since she's seen Aisha, but Sloane knows only one thing could rattle her like this. 

"Reed's gone." 

The ache reminds Sloane she's still Human.
967777908.lore_zh:
艾莎松开油门，她的快雀引擎渐渐平息为稳定的嗡鸣声。她周围的松林空无一物，悄无声息。唯一的声音是生态园区上部构造低沉的嘎吱作响。甲烷雨从头顶破碎的穹顶中落下。摘下头盔时，艾莎很留意她的新穿针器耳环，那上面有一串边缘经过了手工打磨的红色金属薄片。 

“没想到你会亲自过来，”森林里传来昔日熟悉的声音。艾莎转身看到斯隆，努力适应她明显变化了的形态，不管是她手臂上升起的傀儡能量，还是她眼睛捕捉光线的方式。 

艾莎鼓起勇气，从快雀上下来，快速来到斯隆身边，勇敢地拥抱了她。斯隆目瞪口呆，双臂僵硬地垂在身体两侧。这只持续了片刻，但情感的回响让她充满了痛苦的怀念之情。 

艾莎后退一步，竭力保持镇静。“我得见你，”她说，声音有些颤抖。“我得…亲自告诉你。” 

她已经很多年没有见过艾莎了，但斯隆知道只有一件事能让她如此慌乱不安。 

“里德走了。” 

那阵哀痛提醒着斯隆，她还是人类。

2664281431.name: To Be Remembered
2664281431.source: Source: Season of the Deep Triumph
2664281431.lore:
Each night, the clamor of the Tower Hangar gives way to silence as the engineers change shifts. Niik used to find the lull unnerving, preferring to bask in the sounds of arc welders and power tools. Together, she and Amanda would speak about nothing and everything over the cacophony.

Now, Niik prefers the silence.

Her Servitor shines a light on the Sparrow in front of her, as it has done for weeks. After making some final adjustments, Niik circles around to the front of the Sparrow and hits the ignition.

The engine sputters and burns out.

It's happened a hundred times before, on other nights, with other Sparrows. But this time, something is different. Niik snarls an Eliksni curse and hurls her spanner at the floor. Then she buries her face in her four hands and collapses into a heap, her eyes glistening with tears and her ether tank rattling with her ragged sobs.

"Well, there's your problem!" crackles a voice beside her.

She looks up to see her Servitor projecting a holo-recording. Miniature recreations of herself and Amanda crouch next to another Sparrow as Amanda gestures to its thrusters with a grease-stained arm. She imparts a lesson about its functionality with a smile that says she enjoys sharing the knowledge.

Watching now, Niik can't help but smile too. It was a lesson she had forgotten, but thanks to her Servitor, it would stay with her forever.

She wipes away her tears with a grease-stained arm and gets back to work.
2664281431.lore_zh:
每天晚上，到了工程师们换班的时候，高塔机库里的喧闹声就会化为寂静。妮可曾经觉得这种间歇的平静令人不安，她更喜欢沉浸在电弧焊机和电动工具的声响之中。在喧闹声中，她和阿曼达在一起无话不谈。

现在，妮可更喜欢安静。

她的魔眼用灯照亮着她面前的快雀，就像几周以来一直做的那样。在做了一些最后的调整后，妮可绕到快雀前方，发动了点火装置。

发动机发出噼啪声，烧坏了。

在其他夜晚，这种情况在其它快雀身上发生过无数回。但这一次，情况有所不同。妮可咆哮着埃里克斯尼语的咒骂，把扳手扔在了地板上。然后她用四只手捂住脸，瘫倒在地，眼里闪着泪光，乙太罐里满是断断续续的抽泣声。

“这就是问题所在！”她身旁的一个声音噼啪作响。

她抬起头，看到她的魔眼正在播放着全息录音。她和阿曼达蹲在另一辆快雀旁边，阿曼达用沾满油脂的胳膊示意着它的推进器。她面带微笑地讲解了它的功能，似乎很乐于分享知识。

看到这时，妮可也忍不住笑了。这是一堂她已经忘了的课，但多亏了她的魔眼，它会永远陪着她。

她用沾满油脂的胳膊擦干眼泪，继续工作。

2274944459.name: Recalcitrant Host
2274944459.lore:
The stormjoy rolls over the landscape, blanketing the coastline in the stinging fog of its exhalations. Its passing stirs crackling ribbons of lightning from Fundament's atmosphere. 

Xi Ro waits in hiding, folded up Krill-small, as the living cloud approaches. It lowers the dangling threads of its feeding tentacles. Each is tipped with light. The light fills Xi Ro's heart with a terrible, aching happiness. The sensation sits heavy inside her, bearable only because it is unwelcome.  

This will be the fourth bait star she collects. Xi Ro dreams that when the Helium Drinkers strike next, she will use the bait stars to blind them, then cut them up while they writhe.  

She must leap as high as she can to cleave the bait star loose. The tentacle detects a stirring in the air and whips around. If she is slow, it will tear the blade from her hands.  

She is not slow. Her sword cuts neatly through glistening, translucent muscle fibers, and with her free hand, she snatches the falling bait star from the air. The tentacle reels away, ascending into the sky like a withdrawn rope.  

Xi Ro exults. It is only when she turns around that she sees her elder sister.  

Aurash is standing with her limbs limp at her sides, her scrolls scattered at her feet. Xi Ro sees in her three eyes the euphoria that is the stormjoy's weapon.  

Xi Ro leaps and tackles her sister into the dirt.  

After, the two of them wait beneath shelter while the stormjoy advances down the coast. Aurash is sullen, but Xi Ro knows it can be fixed. 

"Look." Xi Ro holds out the bait star. "We can take joy for ourselves." 

Aurash lifts the star by its shriveled stalk, then cups the light in her claws, like a small fire.  

Xi Ro shoves her playfully, trying to knock the star loose.  

But Aurash holds fast.
2274944459.lore_zh:
风暴之悦在大地上空掠过，将海岸线笼罩在其喷出的刺鼻烟雾之中。它的经过激起了虫群据点的大气中噼啪作响的带状闪电。 

希罗藏在暗处，像克里尔一样蜷缩起来，等待着这朵活云的到来。它放下了摄食触手上悬垂的线。每一条尖端都冒着光亮。那光让希罗的心里充满了可怕而痛苦的幸福。这种感觉在她心里沉甸甸的，只因不被接受而需要忍受。  

这将会是她收集的第四颗诱饵星。希罗梦想着当氦饮者下次袭击时，她会用诱饵星把它们致盲，然后在它们扭动时将其切碎。  

她必须跳得尽可能高，才能把诱饵星劈开。触须察觉到空气中有动静，开始四处挥舞。要是她动作缓慢，刀刃就会从她手上被扯下来。  

她动作不慢。她的刀剑整齐地划破闪闪发光、半透明的肌肉纤维。她用另一只手从空中抓住了落下的诱饵星。触须卷起，像一根抽回的绳子一样升向天空。  

希罗欣喜若狂。直到她转过身，才看到她的姐姐。  

奥拉什站在那里，肢体瘫软地垂在两侧，她的卷轴散落在她的脚边。希罗在她的三只眼睛里看到了风暴之悦的武器。  

希罗跳起来，把姐姐撞进了泥土里。  

之后，当风暴之悦沿着海岸前进时，她们俩在掩体下等待着。奥拉什在生闷气，但希罗知道这是可以弥补的。 

“看。”希罗拿出了诱饵星。“我们可以将喜悦据为己有。” 

奥拉什抓住枯萎的茎，把诱饵星捧在她的爪子里，就像是一小团火。  

希罗玩闹着推搡她，试图把诱饵星撞脱手。  

但奥拉什抓得很牢。

3184395484.typeName_zh: 传说 术士通用皮肤

187957397.name: Halberdier's Reach
187957397.description: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.
187957397.description_zh: 被包围时，提高偃月的填装速度和近战伤害。偃月近战最后一击会在弹匣中溢装一发子弹。偃月射弹最后一击会引起爆炸。

2316126473.name: High Priority
2316126473.description: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.
2316126473.description_zh: 用备弹匀速向装备中的追踪步枪弹匣填装部分子弹。用追踪步枪伤害载具、首领或勇士，会将其标记为目标。当一名盟友击败已标记的目标时，会为你生成特殊弹药并为你的盟友生成重型弹药。

2445247031.name: Barri-nade
2445247031.description: Using your class ability channels defensive Light inward, providing a grenade that creates a barricade on impact. Picking up Orbs of Power enhances your next Barri-nade, spawning more barricades on impact.
2445247031.description_zh: 使用你的职业技能会将防御性光能导向体内，提供一枚在命中时生成屏障的手雷。拾取能量球会强化你的下一次屏障手雷，命中时生成更多屏障。

1531149066.description_zh: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变凋零游侠的外观。

1547782973.name: Centrifuse Catalyst
1547782973.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
1547782973.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

284919903.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Last Rite. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.

284919903.source: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
