4013202920.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变条件终局的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

2763305228.name: Agkistrodon-5SR
2763305228.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Wicked Implement. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
2763305228.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变邪恶工具的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

4620383.name: Weft Cutter
4620383.description: Dealing sustained damage severs the target.
4620383.description_zh: 造成持续伤害可割裂目标。

3782773412.name: Tithing Harvest
3782773412.description: While Creeping Attrition is active, destroying Stasis crystals or landing precision final blows creates a Stasis shard. The Stasis shard returns to you, and collecting Stasis shards refills the magazine.
3782773412.description_zh: 在蔓延羸弱生效时，摧毁冰影水晶或造成精准最后一击会生成冰影碎片。冰影碎片可返回给你，收集冰影碎片可填装弹匣。

2804762401.name: Regenerative Motion
2804762401.description_zh: 冲刺会逐渐填装此武器。

1385166695.name: Overcharge Capacitor
1385166695.description: Sprinting, sliding, and firing this weapon builds a temporary electrostatic charge, increasing range and reload speed. Final blows with high charge cause explosions, and maximum charge explosions blind targets.
1385166695.description_zh: 冲刺、滑行以及用此武器射击，可积攒短暂的静电充能，并提高射程和填装速度。高充能的最后一击可造成爆炸，最大充能的爆炸可致盲目标。

1266604956.name: Creeping Attrition
1266604956.description: Rapidly landing precision hits causes targets to become slowed. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
1266604956.description_zh: 快速精准命中会使目标进入减速状态。克制过载勇士。

3172115769.name: Protective Weave
3172115769.description: Firing this weapon at an ally grants Woven Mail to both the user and the target. Deals more damage while you have Woven Mail.
3172115769.description_zh: 使用此武器朝一名盟友射击会为使用者和目标提供织造铠甲。你拥有织造铠甲时会造成更多伤害。

1489048135.name: Explosive Pact
1489048135.description: This weapon gains bonus stability and reload speed when activating a grenade ability. Healing grenades and grenade final blows grant additional stacks of the bonus.
1489048135.description_zh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。

1513240263.name: Explosive Pact
1513240263.description: This weapon gains an improved amount of stability and reload speed when activating a grenade ability. Healing grenades and grenade final blows grant additional stacks of the bonus.
1513240263.description_zh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得更多的稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。
1513240263.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1004814308.name: Disaster Plan
1004814308.description:
Picking up ammunition increases this weapon's flinch resistance and range, which lasts until it is fired again.

Swords gain a large increase to charge rate instead.
1004814308.description_zh:
拾取弹药可提高此武器的抖动抗性和射程，并可持续至再次射击。

而刀剑则可大幅提高充能速度。

2053642371.name: Unsated Hunger
2053642371.description:
Increased handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain increased guard resistance and charge rate instead.
2053642371.description_zh:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

而刀剑则可提高防御抗性和充能速度。

2976024267.name: Unsated Hunger
2976024267.description:
Improved handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain improved guard resistance and charge rate instead.
2976024267.description_zh:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

刀剑则提高防御抗性和充能速度。
2976024267.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

398661035.name: Restoration Ritual
398661035.description: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo.
398661035.description_zh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。

2295881363.name: Restoration Ritual
2295881363.description: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Handling is improved.
2295881363.description_zh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。提升操控性。
2295881363.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

3324494224.name: Collective Action
3324494224.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
3324494224.description_zh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

2562668800.name: Collective Action
2562668800.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
2562668800.description_zh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间进一步提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

3978468247.name: Discord
3978468247.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.
3978468247.description_zh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击，可在短时间内提升此武器的瞄准速度、精度和空中效率。失调协议效果激活时，最后一击会返还弹药。

906981559.name: Discord
906981559.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.
906981559.description_zh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击，可提升此武器的瞄准速度、精度和空中效率，且持续时间延长。失调协议效果激活时，最后一击会返还弹药。

2594592626.name: Controlled Burst
2594592626.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.
2594592626.description_zh: 在连射中，每一次射击命中都会在短时间内提高此武器的伤害并减少充能时间。

2037312142.name: Controlled Burst
2037312142.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.
2037312142.description_zh: 在连射中，每一次射击命中都会提高此武器的伤害并减少充能时间，持续时间延长。

1439600632.name: Bipod
1439600632.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.
1439600632.description_zh: 可提升弹药和备弹，但会减少伤害、爆炸范围和填装速度。

2282937672.name: Bipod
2282937672.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.
2282937672.description_zh: 可提升弹药和备弹，但会减少伤害。爆炸范围和填装速度将轻微降低。

3018146897.name: Invisible Hand
3018146897.description: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a short duration after a target is hit.

3775649487.name: Hexed Shell
3775649487.flavor: For Ghosts who put a spell on you.
3775649487.lore:
The Knight wrenched his cleaver from the skull of the fallen Wizard. His opponent's body twitched and sizzled with latent Arc energy. He raised his blade above his head, saluting the statue of the Witch Queen that loomed above them.  

"Existence is worthiness," the Knight intoned. "That which cannot defend itself must die. This is the one true shape. Aiat." 

The Knight's salute went unanswered, as expected. The small stone chamber lapsed into silence. It had been thus for as long as he could remember.    

A fragile bringer of Light materialized in the air above the Wizard. The Knight quelled the urge to reach out and crush it. This restraint was the Queen's only decree. 

*  *  * 

The Wizard screeched with rage as she was pulled unwillingly back into consciousness. Her eyes flew open, blazing with fury. 

Her opponent crouched warily, his cleaver still smoldering with soulfire. The Wizard propelled herself upward, mustering her Light into crackling Arc bolts. She unleashed them upon the Knight, who erected a barricade to intercept the blast. 

In his moment of defensiveness, the Knight lost sight of the Wizard. When he lowered his barricade, he discovered a ball of Arc energy pulsing at his feet. It exploded, burning the flesh beneath his chitinous armor to a blackened char.  

The Wizard hovered over the Knight. His smoking corpse filled the chamber with acrid fumes.  

She raised her clawed hand toward the silent statue. "Existence is worthiness," she intoned. "That which cannot defend itself must die. This is the one true shape. Aiat!"
3775649487.lore_zh:
骑士从倒下巫师的头骨中拔出了他的大砍刀。他对手的身体抽搐着，散发着蛰伏的电弧能量。他把大砍刀举过头顶，向他们上方赫然耸现的巫妖女王雕像致敬。  

“存在即是价值，”骑士吟诵道。“凡无力自卫者，必死无疑。此乃唯一真实之形。阿特。” 

不出所料，骑士的致敬没有得到回应。小石室里一片寂静。从他记事起，就一直是这样。    

在巫师上方的空中，脆弱的光能使者显现了。骑士抑制住了伸手去粉碎它的冲动。这个克制是女王唯一的命令。 

*  *  * 

巫师愤怒地尖啸着，不情愿地恢复了知觉。她睁大了眼睛，怒火中烧。 

她的对手警惕地蹲伏着，他的大砍刀还在燃烧着灵魂之火。巫师推动自己向上，把她的光能聚集成噼啪作响的电光。她向骑士释放电光，骑士竖起了一道屏障来拦截冲击。 

在他防守的瞬间，巫师消失在骑士的视野。当他放下屏障时，发现一个电弧能量球在他的脚下跳动。它爆炸了，把他那壳质护甲下的血肉烧成一片黑炭。  

巫师在骑士上方盘旋着。他那冒着烟的尸体让房间里充满了刺鼻的气味。  

她朝着沉默的雕像举起爪形手。“存在即是价值，”她吟诵道。“凡无力自卫者，必死无疑。此乃唯一真实之形。阿特！”

601741876.name: Pharmakos Shell
601741876.lore:
A little flock of unpaired Ghosts shivered and murmured together in their luminous cage. Their chitinous shells clacked together as they huddled. When their queen opened their cage, the Ghosts shied back.

"Come now," Savathûn said. Cloying. Vicious. "The Light belongs to all of us. And aren't you curious?"

They didn't move. Only stared at her and the litter of Ghost shells behind her. She changed tack.

"The others wanted the Traveler to be safe. Don't you want that, too?"

They did. That's all they wanted. One Ghost shifted forward. The others tried to close ranks and keep it with them. It pushed forward.

The needle-fingered one reached out, and the Ghost floated willingly into her claws.
601741876.lore_zh:
一小群无主的机灵在发光的笼子里边颤抖边咕哝着。它们挤在一起，壳质的机壳咔哒作响。在它们的女王打开笼子时，机灵缩了回去。

“来吧，”萨瓦图恩说道。带着厌烦、恶毒的口吻。“光能属于我们所有人。你们难道不好奇吗？”

它们一动不动。只是盯着她和她身后那堆机灵机壳。她改变了策略。

“其他机灵都希望旅行者安然无恙。你们不也一样吗？”

它们当然希望。这就是它们想要的。有个机灵向前挪了挪。其他机灵试图向前靠拢，想要挽留它。它继续向前移动。

指头如针的她将手伸出，而那机灵心甘情愿地飘进了她的爪中。

2757631052.flavor: "The Witch Queen's crystals are powered by elemental Light. I believe you know how." —Eris Morn
2757631052.lore:
The Arc crystal hung in the air, crackling and spitting with energy. Savathûn inspected it: no fractures, no unstable charges pouring from unseen fissures. When she ran a claw down its surface, she could feel static bolt down her arm.

Savathûn turned to her assembled brood.

"You," she said, and a Lucent Hive Knight advanced to kneel before his queen.

Suddenly his fellow Hive descended upon him, tearing at his chitin, pulling apart his flesh. When Savathûn reached out and crushed his Ghost, a burst of crystalline Light erupted from its remains, the energy arranging itself into a triclinic lattice.

This crystal pulsed with Void Light.

"And you." An Acolyte whose eyes gleamed with vital, endless fire stepped forward and bowed.
2757631052.lore_zh:
电弧水晶悬在空中吐出能量，噼啪作响。萨瓦图恩查看了一番：它没有裂缝，没有从看不见的裂隙里涌出的不稳定电荷。当她把一只爪子伸向它的表面时，她能感觉到顺着手臂而下的静电流。

萨瓦图恩转向聚在一起的虫群。

“你，”她说道。一名光明邪魔族骑士上前跪在了女王的面前。

忽然，他的邪魔族同伴扑向他，撕扯他的壳质，扯开他的血肉。就在萨瓦图恩伸出手粉碎他的机灵时，一束水晶光能从它的残骸中爆发出来，能量排列成一个三斜晶格。

这块水晶闪烁着虚空光能。

“还有你。”一名眼睛里闪烁着无尽活力火焰的仆从走上前来，低下了头。

409337865.name: Acroamatis
409337865.flavor: Hidden truths are the most valuable.
409337865.lore:
Ikora took a deep breath to compose herself—she had been dreading the conversation she was about to initiate. She ran through all the anticipated objections and corresponding de-escalation tactics in her mind. It was important to keep the situation in-hand, at any cost. 

Once she had steeled herself, she nodded to her Ghost, Ophiuchus, who engaged the holoprojector. A moment later, the bust of Empress Caiatl illuminated Ikora's office. Even translucent and digitized, the empress was an imposing figure. 

With a steady voice and unwavering gaze, Ikora detailed the Vanguard's plan to resurrect Savathûn in exchange for the knowledge of how to breach the Witness's portal. Once she finished, Ikora braced for the empress's fury. Instead, she was met with pensive silence. 

When Caiatl finally spoke, her tone was measured. "There was a time, not so long ago, when the Witch Queen's resurrection would have seemed like… a betrayal." 

Ikora held her breath. 

"But after working with Eris aboard the Leviathan… after speaking with Ghaul…" The empress lowered and shook her tusks—a gesture of uncertainty. "I must accept that the ways of Light and Dark are beyond my reckoning." 

Caiatl raised her tusks once again and hardened her voice. "I trust Eris Morn as I would my own mythkeeper. If the Vanguard agrees that this is the only way to stop the Witness… then so be it. My legions will not stand in your way." 

"My thanks, Empress," Ikora replied, with obvious relief. 

"Besides," the empress concluded, "if this plan brings me one step closer to crushing Xivu Arath's skull, then it has my blessing."
409337865.lore_zh:
艾可拉深吸一口气，让自己镇定下来——她对即将开始的谈话担忧已久。她把所有预料到的反对意见和相应缓和冲突的策略都在脑子里过了一遍。重要的是，要不惜任何代价控制住局势。 

她打起精神，向她的机灵蛇夫座点头，后者启动了全息投影仪。不一会儿，女帝查厄托的半身像便照亮了艾可拉的办公室。即便是半透明、数字化的女帝，也是个威严的人物。 

艾可拉带着平稳的语气、坚定的目光详细描述了先锋复活萨瓦图恩，来换取如何攻破见证者传送门情报的计划。她一说完，就准备迎接女帝的愤怒。可等到的却是沉思的静默。 

查厄托终于开口说话时，语气十分慎重。“曾经，就在不久前，复活巫妖女王算是…一种背叛。” 

艾可拉屏住了呼吸。 

“但在利维坦与埃里斯合作后…与盖欧交谈之后…”女帝放低并抖了抖她的獠牙，显得犹疑不决。“我必须承认，光明与黑暗之道超出了我的想象。” 

查厄托又抬起她的獠牙，语气强硬起来。“我信任埃里斯·摩恩，就像相信我自己的神话守护者一样。如果先锋认同这是阻止见证者的唯一方法…那就去做吧。我的军团不会妨碍你们。” 

“非常感谢，女帝，”艾可拉回答道，明显松了一口气。 

“何况，”女帝总结道，“要是这个计划能让我离粉碎希乌阿拉斯的头骨更近一步，那我就会支持它。”

2091889892.name: Crota's Exile
2091889892.flavor: The thin line between perseverance and folly.
2091889892.source_zh: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭
2091889892.lore:
My poor nephew. So headstrong. So ambitious. Attacking every problem with the only tool he knows: his sword. 

He hacks at his insecurity, his sisters' cleverness… even his father's throne. Desperate to carve his own shape into the world, sovereign from the Great Navigator. 

And where did his overweening pride lead him? Into exile. Such a shame. 

But do you know what? I predict he'll return stronger than ever.  

And when he does, it won't be because he grew as cunning as his auntie. Or as clever as his sisters. Or as thoughtful as his father.  

It'll be because he finally found a bigger sword.
2091889892.lore_zh:
我可怜的侄子。如此顽固任性。如此雄心勃勃。解决所有问题全靠他唯一知晓的工具：他的刀剑。 

他斩断了他的不安，他姐妹的聪慧…甚至他父亲的王座。渴望将自己的形象雕刻进世界，脱离领航员的控制。 

他的狂妄傲慢又给他带来了什么呢？流放。真是丢脸。 

但你知道吗？我预测他归来时会比以前更加强大。  

可那不会是因为他像他的姨妈一样狡猾。或像他的姐妹们一样聪慧。抑或是像他父亲那样深思熟虑。  

那是因为他终于找到了一把更大的刀剑。

2119182608.name: Laminos
2119182608.lore:
"So there she was," Glint continued, "lost deep beneath the Hellmouth, hunted by the Hive." 

Immaru tilted forward, uncharacteristically rapt. Crow sat nearby, sipping an Ether Fizz. The Hive Ghost had made an offhand inquiry as to where Eris Morn got her third eye, and soon the trio were fully invested in Glint's campfire tale.  

Glint lowered his voice ominously. "With her loyal Ghost, Brya, drained of his Light, Eris was left defenseless. Her final hope was the bone she'd been gifted by a grateful Ahamkara she saved from certain death once."  

Crow cleared his throat uncomfortably. "Actually," he whispered to Glint, "I think she killed that Ahamkara…"  

"And good thing, too," Glint continued without missing a beat. "Because in her time of need, the spirit of the Ahamkara whispered to her, offering the solution to her problems." 

"Easy," Immaru interjected. "Ambush an Acolyte, rip its head off, and graft its eyes onto her face, right?"  

Crow nodded grimly, while Glint rolled his eye. "No," the Ghost corrected Immaru. "The Ahamkara told her to befriend a certain Knight of Crota who was tired of serving the Darkness." 

Crow choked on his Ether Fizz, dissolving into a coughing fit. "That's not quite—" 

"Eris found the Knight, and they quickly forged a bond of friendship," Glint pressed on. "The Knight taught her an ancient Hive spell to help her grow her very own third eye! In exchange, Eris helped the Knight free himself from Crota's service. Together they fought through a whole army of Hive and escaped as allies." 

"So, you're telling me," Immaru asked, narrowing his iris, "that Eris Morn escaped Crota's clutches with the power of friendship?" 

After an uncomfortable pause, Crow sighed. "It's close enough… I suppose."
2119182608.lore_zh:
“她就在那里，”格林特继续说道，“迷失在地狱深渊深处，被邪魔族追杀。” 

伊马鲁向前倾斜，一反常态专注地听着。乌鸦坐在旁边，喝着乙太气泡酒。这名邪魔族机灵随口问了问埃里斯·摩恩的第三只眼是从哪里得来的，结果三人很快就完全沉浸在了格林特的篝火故事中。  

格林特故意压低了声音。“在她忠诚的机灵布瑞亚光能耗尽后，埃里斯就失去了防护。她的最后希望来自于一块骨头，那是一只曾被她救了性命、心怀感激的阿罕卡拉送给她的。”  

乌鸦尴尬地清了清嗓子。“实际上，”他小声对格林特说，“我认为是她杀了那只阿罕卡拉…”  

“还好她那么做了，”格林特没有停顿地继续说道。“因为在她需要帮助的时候，那只阿罕卡拉的灵魂向她低语，提出摆脱困境的解决方案。” 

“很简单，”伊马鲁插嘴道。“伏击一个仆从，把它的头扯下来，再把它的眼睛移植到她的脸上，对吗？”  

乌鸦严肃地点点头，格林特则翻起了白眼。“不，”这个机灵纠正了伊马鲁。“克洛塔的一位骑士不想再听命于暗影，那只阿罕卡拉让她去交个朋友。” 

乌鸦被乙太气泡酒呛到，咳嗽了起来。“这不太——” 

“埃里斯找到了骑士，然后他们很快建立起了友谊，”格林特继续说道，“那位骑士教了她一个古老的邪魔族咒语，帮助她长出了自己的第三只眼睛！而作为交换，埃里斯帮助那位骑士摆脱了克洛塔的奴役。他们联手杀出邪魔族大军的重围，一起逃走了。” 

“所以，你是在跟我说，”伊马鲁眯起眼睛问道，“埃里斯·摩恩凭借友谊的力量逃脱了克洛塔的魔掌？” 

一阵不安的沉默之后，乌鸦叹了口气。“差不多吧…我觉得。”

1630940558.name: Percussive Flames
1630940558.description: Modifies Burning Maul into a single, high-damage slam of your hammer that creates several cyclones of flame. Consecration's second slam creates a cyclone of flame.
1630940558.description_zh: 将燃烧锻锤转换为生成若干火焰旋风的高伤害猛击。神圣献祭的第二次猛击会生成一个火焰旋风。

4094452600.name: Winged Eclipse
4094452600.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.
4094452600.description_zh:
击败目标为一笼忠诚飞蛾充能，飞蛾会飞向附近的目标或盟友。
 
[手雷]  ：投掷这笼忠诚飞蛾，命中时释放飞蛾。飞蛾接触目标后将引发致盲爆炸；接触盟友后将为其提供虚空覆盖护盾。

1513013523.name: One with the Void
1513013523.description: Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.
1513013523.description_zh: 你的虚空灵魂的持续时间延长。它们击败目标时会获得递增的伤害和耐久度。你可以通过与虚空灵魂互动来收回它们，以重新部署。

2538516770.name: Tessellation Catalyst
2538516770.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
2538516770.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

1826222780.name: Ex Diris Catalyst
1826222780.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
1826222780.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

1931066670.name: Necrochasm Catalyst
1931066670.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork.

The weapon will gain a tracker that displays the number of combatants defeated with it. The Masterworked weapon will also receive additional capabilities.

Collect Essence of the Oversoul to unlock this upgrade.
1931066670.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。

该武器会获得一个追踪器，显示使用它击败战斗人员的数量。大师杰作武器还会获得额外能力。

收集超灵精华来解锁此升级。

2769013282.name: Property: Undecidable
2769013282.description: This [weapon|instrument|topology] adapts its damage type to match your equipped grenade. Final blows grant grenade and Transcendence energy.
2769013282.description_zh: 此[武器|工具|机构]会根据你所装备的手雷来改变自身的伤害类型。最后一击可提供手雷和超凡能量。

3183537623.name: Corrupted Nucleosynthesis
3183537623.description: This weapon enrages when dealing or taking sustained damage, gaining increased rate of fire while enraged.
3183537623.description_zh: 此武器会在造成伤害或受到伤害时发怒，处于发怒状态时可获得更高的射速。

4184462049.name: Cursebringer
4184462049.description: Precision final blows with this weapon increase reload speed and trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion that inflicts corruption. Final blows with Cursed Thrall explosions refill the magazine.
4184462049.description_zh: 使用此武器造成精准最后一击会提升填装速度，触发一次施加腐化的诅咒怨魂爆炸。使用诅咒怨魂爆炸造成最后一击可填满弹匣。

2024652627.name: Property: Irreducible
2024652627.description: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume your grenade to load a large [projectile|shape|language] that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.
2024652627.description_zh: [替换武器动作] ：消耗你的手雷，为你的武器装填一枚大型[射弹|形状|语言]。命中时它会造成一次元素爆炸，并在超凡生效的情况下造成更高伤害。

1992365846.name: Loyal Moths
1992365846.description: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.
1992365846.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击和快速直接命中会产生一只忠诚飞蛾。这只飞蛾会寻找附近的目标并引爆，对目标造成伤害和致盲效果。

525593296.name: Desperation
525593296.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or a final blow with a Cursed Thrall explosion increases your rate of fire and improves stability and aim assist.
525593296.description_zh: 获得精准最后一击后填装或以诅咒怨魂爆炸造成最后一击会提升你的射速，改善稳定性和瞄准辅助。

3017780555.name: Heal Clip
3017780555.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.
3017780555.description_zh: 最后一击后短时间内填装，可为自身和附近盟友提供治愈。

4223976499.name: Heal Clip
4223976499.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.
4223976499.description_zh: 最后一击后填装，可为自身和附近盟友提供治愈。你有额外的时间来进行填装。

555281244.name: Precision Instrument
555281244.description: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.
555281244.description_zh: 造成持续伤害会提升精准伤害。

332733060.name: Precision Instrument
332733060.description: Dealing sustained damage significantly increases precision damage.
332733060.description_zh: 造成精准伤害会大幅提升精准伤害。

3828510309.name: Enlightened Action
3828510309.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.
3828510309.description_zh: 造成伤害可提升填装速度与操控性。

1771736209.name: Enlightened Action
1771736209.description: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.
1771736209.description_zh: 造成伤害可大幅提升填装速度与操控性。

1451849462.name: Barrel Constrictor
1451849462.description: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.
1451849462.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内降低其弹道分布。

4175584682.name: Barrel Constrictor
4175584682.description: Final blows with this weapon significantly reduce its projectile spread for an improved duration.
4175584682.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可大幅降低其弹道分布，持续时间延长。

2319119708.name: High Ground
2319119708.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.
2319119708.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会提供可叠加的额外伤害。从高处攻击目标可立即获得最大层数。

2140591236.name: High Ground
2140591236.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
2140591236.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会提供可叠加的额外伤害。从高处攻击目标可立即获得最大层数。提升填装速度。

31345821.name: Sword Logic
31345821.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
31345821.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

639190697.name: Sword Logic
639190697.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
639190697.description_zh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害，且持续时间延长。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

1119449540.name: Loose Change
1119449540.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.
1119449540.description_zh: 对一个目标造成元素减益会在较短时间内提升此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度。

561986700.name: Loose Change
561986700.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for an improved duration.
561986700.description_zh: 对一个目标造成元素减益可提升此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度，持续时间延长。

1156201379.name: Cursed Thrall
1156201379.description: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for a short duration.
1156201379.description_zh: 使用近战攻击击败目标后，在短时间内使用此武器造成最后一击可使目标爆炸。

2460489707.name: Cursed Thrall
2460489707.description: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for an improved duration.
2460489707.description_zh: 使用近战攻击击败目标后，在更长时间内使用此武器造成最后一击可使目标爆炸。
2460489707.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

2565067140.name: Head Rush
2565067140.description: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
2565067140.description_zh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。

2085665100.name: Head Rush
2085665100.description: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of improved bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
2085665100.description_zh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升更多操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。
2085665100.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

1050127423.name: Wild Card
1050127423.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.
1050127423.description_zh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。

501821599.name: Wild Card
501821599.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location. Cooldown between activations reduced.
501821599.description_zh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。减少启动冷却时间。
501821599.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

2509860981.name: Nadir Focus
2509860981.description: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.
2509860981.description_zh: 持续射击会提升精度和射程。提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。

1585115329.name: Nadir Focus
1585115329.description: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range by an improved amount. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers is improved amount.
1585115329.description_zh: 持续射击会进一步提升精度和射程。进一步提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。
1585115329.typeName_zh: 罕见 强化原始特性

2005566727.name: Nucleosynthetic Magazine
2005566727.description: This magazine continuously draws ammo from reserves. The magazine also enables firing Arc projectiles that detonate on impact.
2005566727.description_zh: 此弹匣会不断从备弹中抽取弹药。此弹匣还可以使电弧射弹在命中时引爆。

3494457418.name: Flowing Phoenix
3494457418.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Final Warning. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3494457418.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变最终警告的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

1787190130.name: Anomalous Domain
1787190130.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Deterministic Chaos. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1787190130.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变命定混沌的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

3341687311.name: Inner Beauty
3341687311.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Grand Overture. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3341687311.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变大序曲的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

1396812221.name: Future Past
1396812221.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Hierarchy of Needs. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1396812221.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变需求层级的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

3804935529.name: Infinite Quiver
3804935529.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Le Monarque. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3804935529.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变帝王蝶的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

73064000.name: Ceremonial Arsenal
73064000.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Navigator. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
73064000.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变领航员的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

1102224360.name: Dancing Harlequin
1102224360.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Huckleberry. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1102224360.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变越橘的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

3174376906.name: Fatebinder
3174376906.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Ex Diris. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
3174376906.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变不祥之兆的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

571791574.description: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.

2799667909.name: Silkbound Slayer
2799667909.description: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.
2799667909.description_zh: 此武器会对被悬停目标造成额外伤害。当你通过任意来源悬停目标或使用此武器对被悬停的目标造成伤害时，可在短时间内获得更快的拔枪速度。

2727957645.name: High Octane
2727957645.description: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.
2727957645.description_zh: 点燃附近的目标可部分补充燃料。该武器在获得最大燃料后会从储备中重新填充。

2823622571.name: Refined Soul
2823622571.description: Grants bonus range and stability. Dealing a final blow or absorbing a Remnant grants additional increased weapon range, as well as increased mobility and handling for a short time.
2823622571.description_zh: 提供额外射程和稳定性。造成最后一击或吸收残余会提供额外的武器射程，并在短时间内提升敏捷和操控性。

220689851.name: Sundering
220689851.description:
Destroying vehicles and constructs or breaking target shields grants this weapon bonus reload speed and charge rate.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
220689851.description_zh:
摧毁载具和构造体或击碎目标护盾可以增加此武器的填装速度和充能速度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

1214302147.name: Sundering

930692523.name: Advanced Reflexes
930692523.description: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for a short time.

1771914899.name: Advanced Reflexes
1771914899.description: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for an improved duration.

967107980.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
967107980.description: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.
967107980.description_zh: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。

3906784980.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
3906784980.description: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile. Cooldown between activations is reduced.

43555494.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

43555494.description_zh:
使用此武器击败目标或造成伤害会逐渐增加其射程、稳定性、操控性、填装速度。

刀剑会获得提升的充能速度和防御抗性。

3978094547.name: Dragon's Vengeance
3978094547.description: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills, and it gains bonus range, charge rate, and handling.
3978094547.description_zh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

73373563.name: Dragon's Vengeance
73373563.description: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills and it gains improved range, charge rate, and handling.

19542588.name: Nano-Munitions
19542588.description: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
19542588.description_zh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

2302125028.name: Nano-Munitions

3059244728.lore:
Trihn digs through what is left of the twisted insides of a derailed cargo-liner—her knuckles singed and bloody from contact with hot wires and ragged edges. 

Her Ghost, Shakto, illuminates the solid surface of a newly revealed metal crate, marked with a tiny sigil, with his flashlight. "Is that it?" 

"As Spider described. I'm surprised it's still in one piece." Trihn places a palm on the metal, tensing. The Darkness pours from within her, freezing the crate and shattering its hinges. 

"Someone will notice that!" says Shakto in hushed alarm.  

But Trihn is not listening. After a few blessed weeks of silence, War's voice had begun to corkscrew itself through her mind once more. She pries the lid off of the crate, hopeful that soon she may be rid of War's driving whips. 

Inside is a single bone.  

"This is not a whim… or an egg. Spider said—" 

"It's an Ahamkara bone!" Shakto exclaims. "This could work…" 

Trihn's fingertips drag across the bone's pitted surface. She hears a whisper—a slithering panacea for War's screams. 

"Someone is coming," Shakto warns, suddenly at attention. He peeks out the top-hatch of the derailed train, now on its side. 

Trihn breaks from her trance. "What? Who else knows?" 

Shakto decompiles as Trihn stands. "Could be anyone. Maybe someone else following Spider's rumor. Either way, they're coming from the north." 

Trihn draws her Eliksni-style cutlass from its scabbard, deftly exits, and moves behind the car, listening closely. Soon, she hears light footsteps. 

Trihn waits for them to get close, then springs from behind the train, putting blade to chest. 

An Exo Hunter stands before her. They size each other up. 

"I'm Gaelin, Gaelin-4. And you got two Wire Rifles trained on your back, so I'd suggest putting that sword down." 

Before Trihn can respond, two Eliksni marked with House Light sigils run towards them. One shouts Trihn's name and throws her four arms around the Warlock.  

"Vynriis!" Shakto shouts after he recompiles, dancing around them. 

Gaelin turns to the second, larger Eliksni."Why didn't you tell me you two knew her?" 

"Guardians so paranoid. Makes for good entertainment," Nivviks croaks in Eliksni, then shrugs "Also owed Trihn prank." 

Trihn gives Nivviks a dirty look, then her eyes wander to the train. She turns to Gaelin-4. "You're the bounty hunter Mithrax sent?" Trihn asks, sheathing her sword.  

"Mithrax and Spider both want the Ahamkara bone, but I need it. So, who gets it?" 

Nivviks steps forward, swapping to Human speech. "Mithrax ordered it destroyed or given to Dreaming City. But for you, old friend…" He assesses his compatriots and slings his Wire Rifle over his shoulder. "Captain Nivviks will look other way. Missing almost the same as destroyed."
3059244728.lore_zh:
特岚在出轨货轮扭曲的内部挖掘着残留的东西——她的指关节因接触到发热的电线和粗糙的边缘而被灼伤，鲜血淋漓。 

她的机灵沙克托照亮了一个刚露出来的金属箱的坚固表面。上面标有一个小小的符号。“是这个吗？” 

“与蛛王的描述相符。它竟然还完好无损。”特岚把手放在金属表面，释放出力量。暗影之力从她体内涌出，冻住了箱子，击碎了铰链。 

“会被人注意到的！”沙克托低声警告道。  

但特岚没听进去。在经历了为时几周的幸福沉默之后，战争的声音又开始在她的脑海中回荡。她撬开箱子的盖子，希望很快就能摆脱战争的鞭策。 

里面是一根骨头。  

“这不是一只奇思…也不是一枚蛋。蛛王说——” 

“这是一根阿罕卡拉的骨头！”沙克托惊呼道。“这也许能行…” 

特岚的指尖划过骨头凹陷的表面。她听到了一阵低语——战争的尖叫立刻消失了。 

“有人来了，”沙克托忽然提醒道。他从侧翻的脱轨列车的顶盖往外探了探头。 

特岚清醒了过来。“什么？还有谁知道这件事？” 

沙克托在特岚起身的同时解构消失。“可能是任何人。也许有其他人在调查蛛王的传闻。无论如何，他们是从北边来的。” 

特岚从刀鞘中拔出埃里克斯尼族弯刀，灵巧地离开列车，藏到车厢之后，听着动静。很快，她听到了轻微的脚步声。 

特岚等到这个不速之客走近，从车厢后面窜出，将刀刃抵在此人胸前。 

一名Exo猎人站在她面前。他们互相打量着对方。 

“我是盖尔林，盖尔林-4。现在有两把导线步枪指着你的后背，所以我建议你把剑放下。” 

特岚还没反应过来，两个有光能氏族标志的埃里克斯尼族便向他们跑来。其中一人喊着特岚的名字，用四只手臂抱住了这位术士。  

“维内瑞斯！”沙克托重构显现，大叫一声，在众人周围上下翻飞。 

盖尔林转身面向个子更大的那个埃里克斯尼族说：“你怎么不告诉我你们俩认识她？” 

“守护者很多疑。所以很好玩。”尼维克用埃里克斯尼语慢慢说道，“而且我欠特岚一个恶作剧。” 

特岚鄙夷地看了尼维克一眼，然后又看向了火车。她转身面向盖尔林-4。“你就是米瑟拉克斯派来的赏金猎人？”特岚问道，同时把剑收进了鞘里。  

“米瑟拉克斯和蛛王都想要这块阿罕卡拉骨头，但我更需要它。那么，谁能得到它？” 

尼维克向前走了一步，说起了人类的语言。“米瑟拉克斯下令销毁它，或者把它交给幽梦之城。但看在我们的交情上，老朋友…”他一边打量着自己的同胞，一边把导线步枪放回肩上。“尼维克队长就当是没看见它。失踪和被摧毁差不多是一回事。”

1146779865.name: Wyrmguard Shell
1146779865.flavor: For Ghosts who preserve the next generation.
1146779865.lore:
Do you understand what you've done? 

Vowing to free Riven's eggs. Ensuring the next generation of Ahamkara will live, and thrive, and carry on her legacy. 

Do you have deep enough vision to foresee the consequences of your action? All the players you've sent scrambling for their next move? 

I suspect not. You couldn't see one little wish without help. 

What else could you be missing, I wonder? 

It's your job to find out. 

So much power in the world. So much about to enter it. It makes one think about all the uses that power could be put to. 

I'm reminded of a hatchling in her first instar. Soft-shelled and squirming on the floor, thinking she's taking big steps. Those legs have some molting to do before they're ready. 

Bringing another power into the world. One you'll inevitably find yourself making bargains with. Really, my dear… 

A point of financial advice from a friend: there are only so many liens one can take out on a single property. The creditors always come calling eventually–if they haven't sold the debt to a collector. 

You're certainly getting tangled in your own vows. Much like a little lizard I could name. Not a close friend, but something of an in-law, maybe. My brother brings such interesting people into the family. 

Keep in mind that you made a promise.  

And heroes do keep their promises, don't they?
1146779865.lore_zh:
你知道你做了什么吗？ 

誓言解救魅痕的蛋。确保阿罕卡拉下一代会生存下去，茁壮成长，继承她的遗志。 

你有足够的远见来预见到你的行为的后果吗？多少人争先恐后地谋划下一步？ 

我看没有。要是没人帮忙，你连一个小小的愿望都看不见。 

不知你还看漏了什么呢？ 

得由你去找出答案。 

世界上有如此多的力量。还有如此巨大力量即将进入这个世界。这令人不禁想象这些力量的用途。 

我想起了她成熟后诞下的第一只幼雏。那个柔软的小生物在地板上蠕动，以为自己在大步前行。在准备好之前，那几条腿还得蜕几次皮， 

给这个世界带来另一股力量。总有一天得与其讨价还价。你认真的吗，亲爱的… 

这是我作为朋友给你的财务建议：一个人通过抵押一处房产换来的资产是有限的。债权人最终总会找上门来…如果他们还没把债务卖给收债人的话。 

你肯定是被自己的誓言给困住了。就像是我认识的某个小蜥蜴。不算亲近，但或许是姻亲。我的兄弟往家里带的人真有趣。 

记住，你许下了一个诺言。  

英雄都会信守诺言，不是吗？

4141762315.lore:
Cold swept down from frigid mountaintops against already old stones of a Dark Age castle. Winter slicked the ramparts as night fell across the European expanse. 

Naeem stood at a long and narrow bridge, helmet shielding her face from deafening wind and stinging snow. She'd left her bloodstained fingertips in Old Russia, gone West, until they no longer called her Warlord. Here, she had heard the Lightbearers hunted and felled a dragon. Maybe some of its magic remained… enough to start anew. 

She followed the whispers through the storm and rubble. Ran her fingers over scars in the stone. This was the place the old warrior had told her to go, and so she pressed deeper into the keep, until the whispers turned to words, and the bones of a great beast laid at rest before her eyes. 

She approached the skull at the center of the skeleton. "Dragon. Ahamkara." 

The language that filled the room ceased to be ambient, their attention focused on her. They drew desire from her heart, and passion from her blood. She spoke, as if by instinct.  

"I wish for your kindness." 

The whispers twisted into hissing laughter. She almost felt the skeleton's anticipation, vibrating through its dry-hollow marrow. Then it spoke to her. "Kindness. There is so little left. And the cost, so high… The gulf between your want, and your reality… this is truly what you wish for?" 

"I've spent my power poorly, like you, to survive. That is why they hunted us. Killed us." Naeem stepped forward slowly. "Wouldn't you rather be loved than feared?" 

The Ahamkara bones were silent in consideration. 

"I know the Lightbearer who slew you. I know you respect their determination," Naeem pressed. "Grant me kindness. Let us share that kindness. Let us make them love us as much as we were feared." 

The voice focused again. "Charity does not sate my hunger." 

"Then do not be charitable. Let me face the debts of your wishes, while those who benefit live freely." 

The voice hissed and cackled. "You would take their debts upon your head?" 

"I have as many lives to give, as the weight of their debts." Naeem placed a hand on the skull. 

"Your wish is granted."
4141762315.lore_zh:
冷气从寒冷的山顶席卷而来，侵袭着黑暗纪元城堡的古老石块。夜幕降临，欧洲大地一片漆黑，城墙被寒冬包裹。 

纳伊姆站在一座又长又窄的桥上，她的头盔挡住了震耳欲聋的风和刺骨的雪。她把沾满鲜血的指尖留在了旧俄罗斯，去了西方，直到人们不再称她为战争领主。在这里，她听说负光者猎杀了一头龙。也许它身上还残留着一些魔法…足够让她重新开始。 

她循着低语穿过风暴和瓦砾。手指划过石头上的痕迹。这是老战士叫她来的地方。于是她继续往城堡深处走，直到低语变成了文字，一头巨兽的骸骨在她眼前安息。 

她靠近骨架中央的颅骨。“龙。阿罕卡拉。” 

充满房间的语言不再是背景声。它们的注意力集中到她的身上。它们从她的心中汲取欲望，从她的血液中汲取激情。她开了口，仿佛是受本能驱使。  

“我希望得到你的仁慈。” 

低语扭曲成了嘶笑。她几乎感觉到了骨架的期盼在它干枯的骨髓里震荡着。它对她说话了。“仁慈，所剩无几。代价，相当高昂…你的愿望与现实之间的鸿沟…这真的是你的愿望吗？” 

“和你一样，我为了生存，白白耗尽力量。而那正是我们被他们追捕、猎杀的原因。”纳伊姆缓缓向前迈步。“难道你不想被爱，而不是被畏惧吗？” 

阿罕卡拉的骨头陷入了沉思。 

“我认识杀死你的负光者。我知道你尊重其决心。”纳伊姆继续说道。“赐予我仁慈。让我们分享这份仁慈。让我们在他们的心中激起不逊于畏惧的敬爱。” 

声音又集中了起来。“没有回报的仁慈不能满足我的饥渴。” 

“那就索取回报吧。让我来偿还你的愿望留下的债务。让那些受益的人自由地生活。” 

那声音嘶笑着。“你要背负他们的债务？” 

“我有许多条命，也背负着许多重债。”纳伊姆将手放在了颅骨上。 

“你的愿望实现了。”

3584868541.name: Unforeseen Consequences
3584868541.flavor: Be careful what you wish for.
3584868541.lore:
He remembers his sister's throne differently: an amalgam of Eliksni flotsam built from the spoils of war, its great weight suspended from the rafters. 

A throne Uldren set ablaze in the wake of losing her. His first step down a forsaken path. 

Crow lays a hand on the throne before him. It is empty and ponderous, silhouetted by distant nebulae and cosmic dust. It feels smooth. Too smooth. 

"It was here that I first heard the news of your death," calls a familiar voice behind him. 

He turns to see his sister striding down the hall. Mara takes her place beside him and gazes out into the far reaches of space. 

"Did you mourn for me?" Crow asks. 

"I did," his sister replies. She is silent for a moment. "And I regret what I did to you. The manipulation, the subtle coercion. None of it went the way I intended." 

Crow follows her gaze out into the endless void. "I know what that's like." 

"Remorse and recriminations," Mara says absently. She turns her eyes toward him. "If you could go back, alter the course of your history, what would you change?" 

He can't help but laugh. "Where to begin?" Crow muses with a smirk. It fades soon enough. "Cayde," he whispers. 

Mara raises an eyebrow. "Oh?" 

"Before then, I could have taken a different road. But once I pulled that trigger…" He shakes his head. "Everything else, I can set right. But not that. I just wish I could tell him I shouldn't have done it." 

"I see," Mara murmurs. Her eyes shine in the starlight. 

Crow sighs and rolls his shoulders back. "I should get going. Vanguard's waiting on my report." 

"We all have our obligations, I suppose." 

"Don't I know it." Crow nods as he heads down the hall.  

He pauses at the portal to the Dreaming City and glances back at Mara. Ringed by the distant nebulae, she shimmers like a mirage on desert sands. And then Crow is gone. 

"See you soon." Mara's voice echoes across the empty chamber as the illusion fades. "O brother mine."
3584868541.lore_zh:
他记忆中姐姐的王座与眼前的有所不同：那是用战利品建造的埃里克斯尼族残骸混合物，其巨大的重量悬在椽子上。 

一个欧顿在失去她之后点燃的王座。他踏上遗落之路的第一步。 

乌鸦把一只手放在他面前的王座上。它空洞而笨重，远处的星云和宇宙尘埃凸显着它的轮廓。摸起来很光滑。太光滑了。 

“就是在这里，我第一次听到了你的死讯，”他身后一个熟悉的声音说道。 

他转过身，看到姐姐阔步走过大厅。玛拉坐到他身边，凝视着遥远的太空。 

“你为我哀悼吗？”乌鸦问道。 

“是的，”他姐姐回答。她沉默了一会儿。“我很后悔我曾经想控制你，暗中给你施压。我的本意并不是那样。” 

乌鸦顺着她的目光望向无尽的虚空。“我知道那是什么感觉。” 

“悔恨和相互指责，”玛拉心不在焉地说。她把目光转向他。“如果你能回到过去，重新走一遍，你会改变什么？” 

他忍不住笑了。“那么多要从何说起呢？”乌鸦陷入了沉思。那笑容很快就消失了。“凯德，”他低声说道。 

玛拉扬起眉毛。“哦？” 

“在那之前，我本可以选择一条不同的路。但在扣动扳机后…”他摇了摇头。“其他一切，我都可以纠正。但除了这一件事。真希望我能告诉他我不应该那么做。” 

“我明白，”玛拉低语道。她的眼睛在星光下熠熠生辉。 

乌鸦叹了口气，耸了耸肩膀。“我该走了。先锋在等我的报告。” 

“我想，我们都有应尽的职责。” 

“我怎么会不知道呢。”乌鸦点点头，朝大厅走去。  

他在通往幽梦之城的传送门前停了下来，回头看了玛拉一眼。她被遥远的星云环绕着，像沙漠上的海市蜃楼一样闪烁着光芒。接着乌鸦就离开了。 

“再见。”玛拉的声音回荡在空旷的房间里，幻象渐渐消退。“我的弟弟。”

159093681.name: Hiera Hodos

159093681.source_zh: 来源：于赛季曙光节活动期间获得。
159093681.lore:
Queen Mara Sov of the Reef walks the wall tonight, faintly lit by the City's celebrations. This high up, the wind pulls at her cape, beckoning her farther along. 

The streets below throng with celebrants. The Awoken among them—Earthborn, Reefborn, Lightbearers—all gleam twilight in Mara's mind. 

The celebrations tonight are for the City; Mara has no wish to make herself a place in them. Instead, she walks alone and thinks to her first Night of Ascents. 

It had trickled upwards to Mara from her people; a folk holiday that eventually turned into an institution. It took decades to settle into its current form: a journey through the dark on the anniversary of the Awoken exodus from the Distributary. 

On that first night, Sjur had blown in like a breeze, banging the door open, equipped as always with sturdy boots and her longbow, ready to bully her queen outdoors. She had led Mara by the hand, laughing, and laughing Mara had let her. 

As they walked, Sjur's were the strides of a tall woman used to outdoor work. Mara had the pace of a leader who primarily focused on cognitive action. The difference often slipped Sjur's mind. 

"Slow down," Mara had said, as they neared the gates of the Watchtower. 

"I could carry you." 

"Don't," Mara retorted—too hastily, not stern enough to put off a woman like Sjur Eido. 

Mara hurried through the gate before she could be picked up, Sjur lunging after her shouting, "But my queen, my heart's calling is to serve you!" 

The night continued on as they walked the asteroids side by side through space's endless night, reliving memories of that first journey to the Reef: escaping the missiles that followed them through the wormhole. The giddy adrenaline and cool calculation needed to make it to their new home.  

Despite the cold of the thin air, Sjur radiated warmth—enormous, laughing, alive. It was Sjur's hand on hers that Mara remembered most in later years. One moment tugging Mara towards a climb; the next, supporting Mara through a gully like the most courtly of knights. 

For many years, it was Sjur at her side during the Night of Ascents. Other years Uldren, eager to show Mara some new vista, some ancient treasures along the way. Twice Riven, inspecting their masterwork together on long walks through the Dreaming City. 

In the Reef and the Dreaming City, Mara's people celebrate together. Remember their history. Enact it, making it new, returning it to life. 

Now, she watches over the Awoken below, celebrating another holiday in a City with traditions of its own. 

And Mara walks alone, between the City and the dark outside.
159093681.lore_zh:
今晚，暗礁的玛拉·索维女王走在城墙上，被圣城的庆祝活动微微照亮着。在这么高的地方，风拉扯着她的斗篷，召唤她继续前行。 

下面的街道挤满了庆祝者。他们中的觉醒者——地球后裔、暗礁后裔、负光者——全都在玛拉的脑海中闪烁着微光。 

今晚的庆典是为了圣城举办的；玛拉不想在其中占有一席之地。相反，她独自一人走着，想着她的第一个攀升之夜。 

那是玛拉的族人传下来，最终变成了一种制度的民间节日。经过数十年的发展，演变成了现在的形式：在觉醒者离开两仪界的周年纪念日进行一次穿越黑暗之旅。 

在第一个攀升之夜，苏尔像阵风一样冲了进来，砰地一声把门打开，像往常那样穿着结实的靴子，拿着长弓，准备在外面狠狠欺负她的女王。她牵着玛拉的手，笑着，而玛拉任由她笑着。 

她们走路的时候，苏尔迈着那种习惯于户外作业的高个子女人的步伐。玛拉则有一种主要专注于认知行为的领袖气场。这种差异常常被苏尔忽略。 

“慢点，”她们快到守望塔的大门时，玛拉说道。 

“我可以背你。” 

“不要，”玛拉反驳道——她说得太匆忙，不够严厉，没法让苏尔·艾多那样的女人退却。 

玛拉趁着还没被抱起，匆匆穿过大门，苏尔追着她大喊，“但我的女王，我的内心在召唤我为您效劳！” 

夜晚继续着，她们并肩在小行星上行走，穿越太空无尽的黑夜，重温着第一次前往暗礁的旅程记忆：逃离跟随她们穿过虫洞的导弹。兴奋的肾上腺素和冷静的计算是到达新家的必要条件。  

尽管空气稀薄寒冷，苏尔身上却散发着温暖的气息——高大、欢笑、充满活力。在后来的岁月里，玛拉记忆最深的就是苏尔握着她的手。她一会儿拉着玛拉攀爬，一会儿又像最有风度的骑士一样搀扶着玛拉穿过沟壑。 

许多年来，在攀升之夜，都是苏尔陪伴在她身边。其他时候则是欧顿渴望向玛拉展示一些新的美景，一些古老的宝藏。还有两次是和魅痕一起漫步于幽梦之城，欣赏着她们的杰作。 

在暗礁和幽梦之城里，玛拉的人民一起庆祝。铭记他们的历史。付诸实践，让它焕然一新，让它重焕生机。 

现在，她看着底下的觉醒者，在一个有着自身传统的圣城里庆祝着另一个节日。 

玛拉独自行走在圣城和其外的黑暗之间。

2504786634.lore:
Eramis anchored her Ketch on the shadowed side of an asteroid and cut the engines. She gazed out the viewport at a wrecked House of Wolves Ketch lying half-buried under the rubble of the Tangled Shore.  

Her reverie was broken by Kylaksis, her lieutenant. "Eramiskel. Your plan is working," the Vandal chittered gleefully. "A Reef patrol is inbound, sweeping for nests. If we board them quickly, we can take the ship intact." 

"No," Eramis replied, still gazing out the viewport. "Let them pass."  

"It's a Corsair patrol vessel," Kylaksis insisted, his chitters staccato with frustration. "Even as scrap, it's worth—" 

"LET THEM PASS," Eramis thundered, whirling to face the Vandal. "The time of The Shipstealer has gone."  

"All that matters now," Eramis said, "is where we are when the end arrives." The Kell of Darkness activated her transmat, leaving a frustrated Kylaksis alone on the bridge. 

Eramis rematerialized in the wrecked House of Wolves Ketch. The walls of the ship were pitted by bullet holes and desiccated Hive growths; only Hive and Lightbearers had dared to enter since it was shot down during the Reef Wars. She shook her head. What a waste. 

She stepped over Thrall and Acolyte corpses, picking her way carefully to the ship's navigation. Once inside, she opened an access panel and pulled out a centuries-old data core. She sifted through the archives until she found it: a detailed map of Riis, the Eliksni home world. 

It was the same map that Eramis's mate, Athrys, had followed out of Sol. It even included the habitable zones she'd tabbed as potential landing sites. 

By now, Athrys might be Kell of her own settlement, living happily alongside their grown hatchlings. Or they might all be long-dead. In truth, Eramis hadn't wondered at either possibility for decades. 

But ever since she saw the Witness disappear into its portal, Eramis could think of little else. All her prior aspirations were made suddenly small. Eliksni solidarity, revenge against the Traveler, enmity with the Humans… they were all irrelevant.  

If a second Whirlwind was her fate, Eramis would suffer it as she had the first: with Athrys by her side.
2504786634.lore_zh:
伊拉莫斯将她的双桅船停泊在一颗小行星的阴影一侧，并关闭了引擎。她凝视着观察孔外一艘半掩在纷争海岸废墟之下的残破恶狼氏族双桅船。  

她的遐想被副手凯拉克西斯打断了。“伊拉莫斯凯尔。你的计划成功了，”这名暴徒高兴地说。“一支暗礁巡逻队正为扫荡巢穴而来。如果我们迅速登船，就能完好无损地夺取那艘飞船。” 

“不，”伊拉莫斯答道。“让他们过去。”  

“那可是一艘海盗军巡逻舰，”凯拉克西斯不满地坚持道。“就算当作废铁，它也值——” 

“让他们过去，”伊拉莫斯转身朝这位暴徒大吼道。“窃船者的时代已经过去了。”  

“现在最重要的是，”伊拉莫斯说，“当末日来临时，我们身处何方。”暗影凯尔启动传送装置，把沮丧的凯拉克西斯一个人留在了舰桥上。 

伊拉莫斯出现在恶狼氏族双桅船的残骸上。飞船壁布满了弹孔和枯死的邪魔族植物。自从它在暗礁战争中被击落后，只有邪魔族和负光者才敢进去。她摇着头。真是浪费。 

她跨过怨魂和仆从的尸体，小心翼翼地走到飞船的导航室。进去之后，她打开一个检修面板，拿出一个有几个世纪历史的数据核心。她在档案库中翻找着，直到她找出一个东西：一张里斯的详细地图，它是埃里克斯尼族的母星。 

伊拉莫斯的伴侣阿斯瑞思就是跟着这张地图走出了太阳系。它甚至包括了被她标记为潜在着陆点的宜居区。 

现在，阿斯瑞思可能已经成了一个定居点的凯尔，和她的孩子们快乐地生活在一起。或者，他们可能早已死去。事实上，伊拉莫斯几十年来从未考虑过这两种可能性。 

但自从她目睹见证者消失在传送门中，伊拉莫斯就没想过其他事。相比之下，她之前所有的愿望都显得渺小不已。团结埃里克斯尼族，向旅行者复仇，与人类的恩怨…都无关紧要了。  

如果她命中注定要面对第二场旋风，伊拉莫斯想要像第一次那样承受它：在阿斯瑞思的陪伴下。

1813883445.name: Gloaming Journeyer
1813883445.lore:
"The path to the Witness is within sight. We do not know what shape Riven's bargain will take, but I know that we two will not make that crossing." 

Drifter listened quietly as Eris spoke, her voice tense. The dark tendrils flowed thickly from beneath her bandage. 

"I watch as those closest to me edge toward oblivion," Eris said, her hands restless in her lap. "Ikora. Mara. I am unused to helplessness." 

She looked to Drifter, her mouth a tight line. When she spoke, it was in a ragged breath, "It's happening again. We will be alone at the end." 

Drifter stood after a quiet moment. Eris watched him curiously. He reached out and took her by the hand. She rose, following his silent urging. Then he put his arms around her. 

She tensed. He began to step away, unsure. But then her arms came up and she clung to him for a desperate moment. She felt the words in his chest as he spoke again.  

"I remember what you said. I think about it more than I should these days." 

"What did I say?" 

"That we'll live in the night if we have to. We do it for what comes after." 

Eris nodded, and sighed. The pair parted, but he kept a reassuring hand on her arm. 

"So this is where you wish to be," she said cautiously. "At the end of all things?" 

"Nowhere else." 

"No more schemes to leave Sol?" 

He was quiet for a moment, then shook his head, smirking. "Nah," he said, and looked into her eyes. "I'd miss the moonlight."
1813883445.lore_zh:
“通往见证者的路近在眼前。我们不知道与魅痕的交易会以什么形式生效，但我知道我们俩没办法过去。” 

浪客静静地听着埃里斯把话说完。她的声音有些紧张。浓密的黑暗卷须从她的绷带下流淌了出来。 

“我眼睁睁地看着最亲近的人走向毁灭，”埃里斯的双手放在膝上，无所适从。“艾可拉。玛拉。我不习惯这种无助感。” 

她双唇紧闭，看向了浪客。她喘着粗气，说道：“又是这样。我们最终难逃孤独。” 

浪客静静地站了一会儿。埃里斯好奇地看着他。他拉住了她的手。在他无声的催促下，她站了起来。然后他用双臂抱住了她。 

她绷紧了身体。他开始不知所措地走开。但她的双臂伸了过来，绝望地紧紧抱住了他。当他再次开口时，她感觉到了他胸中传出的话语。  

“我还记得你说的话。我这些天总想起它。” 

“我说了什么？” 

“如果有必要，我们会生活在黑夜中。为了未来。” 

埃里斯点点头，叹了口气。两人分开了，但他的手依然安慰地按着她的手臂。 

“所以你想待在这里，”她谨慎地说道。“待在这个万物终结的地方？” 

“就是这里。” 

“没有离开太阳系的计划吗？” 

他沉默了一会儿，然后笑着摇了摇头。“没有，”他看着她的眼睛，说，“我会想念月光的。”

2894282039.name: Allstar Vector
2894282039.lore:
"You're telling me these…'Skimmers' just turned up?"  

Prak'kesh prods gingerly at one of the boards with his foot. It floats gently in place at the center of the storeroom.  

"A donation for the games," Spider says distractedly. "Is that unusual?"  

He grunts, displeased, and gestures sharply—Arrha moves the painting slightly left of its current position, wobbling precariously atop his chair. 

"Usually there's a bet involved," Prak'kesh explains. "Or it's official Vanguard merchandise." This almost looks like one of the Neomuna skyboards, though, and the Vanguard wouldn't be passing that around. 

"Well, then it seems we've lucked out this year. The right, Arrha!" 

Arrha grumbles but obeys, hefting the frame into position.  

"I think that did it," Prak'kesh says, squinting at the painting. He doesn't see the point of it—a series of splotchy purple flowers along a dirt path, indistinct trees—but Spider is gazing up at it like it's made of pure Ether. "Your donor leave a name, at least?" 

Spider sighs and reaches for a datapad. "Egh, let's see…two shipments…personal vehicle, Skimmer…gift to the City…Ah, here—Concordat."  

Spider looks over at Prak'kesh, who shrugs. "No idea who that is."
2894282039.lore_zh:
“你是说这些…‘采集船'就这么出现了？”  

普拉凯什用脚轻轻地戳了戳其中一块木板。它轻轻地漂浮在储藏室的中央。  

“比赛捐的。”蛛王心不在焉地说。“这不寻常吗？”  

他不满地哼了一声，然后猛地做了个手势——阿尔拉把画从现在的位置往左移了一点，在椅子上摇摇欲坠。 

“通常都和赌局有关。”普拉凯什解释说。“或者是先锋的官方商品。”不过，这看起来像是内欧姆那的浮空板，先锋可不会把它传出来。 

“好吧，看来我们今年运气不错。右边，阿尔拉！” 

阿尔拉哼了一声，但还是听话地把框架举到了合适的位置。  

“我觉得这样就可以了。”普拉凯什眯着眼睛看着这幅画说道。他看不出这幅画有什么意义——沿着泥土小路开着一丛丛斑驳的紫色花朵，树木模糊不清——但蛛王正仰头凝视着这幅画，仿佛它是由纯净以太制成的。“你的捐赠者至少留下了名字吧？” 

蛛王叹了口气，伸手去拿数据板。“唉，让我想想…两批货物…私人车辆，采集船…给圣城的礼物…啊，这里——和谐派。”  

蛛王看了看普拉凯什，他耸了耸肩。“不知道那是谁。”

1278053348.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

4024789138.name: Micro-Missile Frame
4024789138.description: This weapon fires a high-speed micro-missile in a straight line and deals reduced self-damage. Move faster with this weapon equipped.
4024789138.description_zh: 此武器会发射一个直线前进的高速微型导弹并造成较少的自我伤害。装备此武器时移动速度更快。
4024789138.typeName_zh: 传说 强化固有特性

2109543898.name: Desperate Measures
2109543898.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.
2109543898.description_zh: 武器最后一击会造成额外伤害。近战和手雷最后一击会造成更多额外伤害，而且可叠加。

2799030358.name: Desperate Measures
2799030358.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.
2799030358.description_zh: 武器最后一击会造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。近战和手雷最后一击会造成更多额外伤害，而且可叠加。

3249416164.name: BRAVE Blast Furnace
3249416164.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Blast Furnace.
3249416164.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变高炉的外观。

2109718917.name: BRAVE Hammerhead
2109718917.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Hammerhead.
2109718917.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变锤头的外观。

1994315035.name: BRAVE Edge Transit
1994315035.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Edge Transit.
1994315035.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变边缘交通的外观。

3196661293.name: BRAVE Luna's Howl
3196661293.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Luna's Howl.
3196661293.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变月之狂嚎的外观。

1300379878.name: BRAVE Midnight Coup
1300379878.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Midnight Coup.
1300379878.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变午夜政变的外观。

2058926660.name: BRAVE The Mountaintop
2058926660.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Mountaintop.
2058926660.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变山巅的外观。

2233206981.name: BRAVE Recluse
2233206981.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Recluse.
2233206981.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变隐士的外观。

56761761.name: BRAVE Hung Jury SR4
56761761.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Hung Jury SR4.
56761761.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变绞刑判官SR4的外观。

2269504796.name: BRAVE Succession
2269504796.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Succession.
2269504796.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变继承的外观。

2442840529.name: BRAVE Forbearance
2442840529.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Forbearance.
2442840529.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变自制的外观。

1874228155.name: BRAVE Elsie's Rifle
1874228155.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Elsie's Rifle.
1874228155.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变艾尔西的步枪的外观。

2245749463.name: BRAVE Falling Guillotine
2245749463.description: Equip this limited edition weapon ornament to change the appearance of Falling Guillotine.
2245749463.description_zh: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变陨落铡刀的外观。

723070326.name: Midnight Coup
723070326.description: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
723070326.description_zh: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

2653012761.name: Superblack
2653012761.description: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
2653012761.description_zh: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

2653012760.name: Blue Steel
2653012760.description: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
2653012760.description_zh: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

3671448995.name: Karve of the Worm
3671448995.flavor: "Is it us who wield paracausal forces… or the other way round?" —Osiris
3671448995.source_zh: 来源：异域任务“冥冥低语”

3671448994.name: Vimana Junker
3671448994.flavor: "I don't trust a ship without a few scratches and dents. Same goes for people. We ain't meant to be clean." —Drifter
3671448994.source_zh: 来源：异域任务“行动时刻”

1676252281.name: Expired Ramen Coupon
1676252281.description:
Archie found this under a chair in the Bazaar. Someone was probably angry they couldn't use it.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
1676252281.description_zh:
阿奇在集市里的一把椅子下找到了这个。无法使用它可能让某人很生气吧。

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

3470237739.name: Spinfoil Hat
3470237739.description:
Archie found this while poking through the offices of the Lunar Complex. Whoever it belonged to would probably be saying "I was right!" right now.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
3470237739.description_zh:
阿奇在月球设施的办公室里打探时发现了这个。不管它的主人是谁，现在都很可能在说“我是对的！”

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

2446304953.name: Devrim's Favorite Mug
2446304953.description:
Archie snagged this from Devrim's hideout while he wasn't looking. It once held something delicious, but the contents have spilled out.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
2446304953.description_zh:
阿奇趁德弗里姆不注意，从他的藏身处拿走了这个。它曾装过美味的东西，但东西已经洒掉了。

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

2106367500.name: A Cool Rock
2106367500.description:
Archie found this sitting next to a Wizard's crown while exploring around the Hellmouth. He thought it was cool.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
2106367500.description_zh:
阿奇在地狱深渊附近探险时，在一个巫师的冠冕旁发现了这个他觉得很酷的东西。

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

775189549.name: Ahamkara Bone
775189549.description:
Archie picked this up in the Dreaming City—or at least what looked like the Dreaming City. Some weird stuff happened afterward, but Archie has just been gnawing on it since.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
775189549.description_zh:
阿奇在幽梦之城——或者是看起来像幽梦之城的地方捡到了这个。后来发生了一些奇怪的事情，但阿奇只不过是在啃它。

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

3595878960.name: Archie Plush Toy
3595878960.description:
Archie went through a ton of tokens to get this from the Thrilladrome. He's not sure how it exists, but we don't need to worry about that.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
3595878960.description_zh:
阿奇花了很多代币才从惊颤竞速拿到这个。他不确定它为何存在，但我们不需要担心这个问题。

此物品无任何作用，可安全地进行拆解…但阿奇或许会难过。

1149655156.name: Stylostixis
1149655156.description: Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against [Shield-Piercing]Barrier Champions.
1149655156.description_zh: 受到神秘织针伤害的目标被击败时会触发悬停爆炸。用神秘织针或织针风暴多次命中同一目标可立即触发一次更大更强力的爆炸。击败被悬停的目标会提供近战能量。你的神秘织针克制屏障勇士。

1358612221.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
1358612221.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.
1358612221.description_zh: 获得一次额外的狂暴利刃充能。狂暴利刃和镖弹风暴会随每次打击短暂提升其伤害。战争旗帜发出的脉冲会基于治疗的盟友数量返还近战能量。

3481195123.name: Double Down
3481195123.description: Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.
3481195123.description_zh: 你的线织幽灵的持续时间与耐久度提升，对其造成伤害会释放出额外的线虫。在你的线织幽灵附近时，你不会出现在雷达上。

4234468055.name: The Gift of Certainty
4234468055.description: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.
4234468055.description_zh: 激活飞升或裂空打击会朝附近目标投掷出不断弹跳的爆炸物，震颤敌人并对其造成伤害。震颤附近目标可为你提供伤害抗性。

2710254013.name: The Lost Voice
2710254013.description: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.
2710254013.description_zh: 治愈手雷会生成一个恢复炮台。治疗盟友有时会生成一个能量球。

3495263107.name: Danger Close
3495263107.description: Weapon precision hits or final blows have a chance to load a Kinetic Exodus micro-missile. Activating your class ability fires loaded Exodus micro-missiles. Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.
3495263107.description_zh: 武器精准命中或最后一击有几率装填一枚动能移民号微型导弹。激活你的职业技能来发射填装的移民号微型导弹。使用移民号微型导弹伤害目标会暂时提升你使用其他微型导弹和火箭发射器造成的伤害。

3751917999.name: Spirit of the Dragon
3751917999.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
3751917999.description_zh: 你的武器准备得更快且更稳定。使用你的职业技能会暂时提升此加成，并从储备弹药中填装当前装备的武器。

3751917998.name: Spirit of Galanor
3751917998.description: Hits and final blows with your Super will return Super energy after it ends.
3751917998.description_zh: 使用超能造成命中和最后一击将于超能结束后返还超能能量

3751917997.name: Spirit of the Foetracer
3751917997.description: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability grants you a temporary damage bonus for weapons matching that ability's element.
3751917997.description_zh: 使用技能对强力战斗人员或守护者造成伤害，会为与该技能元素匹配的武器提供临时伤害加成。

3751917996.name: Spirit of Caliban
3751917996.description: Powered melee final blows trigger an ignition.
3751917996.description_zh: 充能近战最后一击会触发一次点燃。

3751917995.name: Spirit of Renewal
3751917995.description: Allies inside the Duskfield grenade field gain Frost Armor and targets inside the field deal reduced damage.
3751917995.description_zh: 处于暮域手雷范围内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，处于范围内的目标造成的伤害减少。

3751917994.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne
3751917994.description: Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
3751917994.description_zh: 使用手雷时会获得织造铠甲。

3751917993.name: Spirit of the Gyrfalcon
3751917993.description: Your Void weapons gain volatile rounds after you emerge from being invisible.
3751917993.description_zh: 当你从隐身状态出现时，你的虚空武器会获得不稳定弹药。

3751917992.name: Spirit of the Liar
3751917992.description: Dealing damage with a powered melee or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful Arc melee counterpunch.
3751917992.description_zh: 使用充能近战造成伤害或被近战攻击命中将允许你追加一次相当强大的电弧近战反击。

3751917991.name: Spirit of the Wormhusk
3751917991.description: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapidly defeating combatants grants Burning Souls that increase the potency of healing when using Dodge and spread the healing to nearby allies.
3751917991.description_zh: 激活职业技能会提供治愈。快速击败战斗人员提供燃烧之魂，从而提升使用闪身时治疗的效力，并将治疗扩散至附近的盟友。

3751917990.name: Spirit of the Coyote
3751917990.description: Gain an additional class ability charge.
3751917990.description_zh: 获得额外一次职业技能充能。

183430254.name: Spirit of Harmony
183430254.description: Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element grant you Super energy.
183430254.description_zh: 使用伤害类型与你的超能元素匹配的武器造成最后一击，会为你提供超能能量。

183430255.name: Spirit of the Filaments
183430255.description: Casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
183430255.description_zh: 施放一个强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

183430252.name: Spirit of the Necrotic
183430252.description: Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.
183430252.description_zh: 使用近战对目标造成伤害会施加强效腐化。击败腐化的目标会扩散此状态。

183430253.name: Spirit of Osmiomancy
183430253.description: Your grenades recharge quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
183430253.description_zh: 你的手雷命中时充能更快。急冻手雷产生的追踪弹移动得更远。

183430250.name: Spirit of Apotheosis
183430250.description: Temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
183430250.description_zh: 超能结束后，暂时获得大幅提升的近战和手雷回复。

183430251.name: Spirit of Vesper
183430251.description_zh: 裂痕定期释放电弧冲击波。

183430248.name: Spirit of the Stag
183430248.description: Your Rift provides damage reduction to allies standing in it.
183430248.description_zh: 你的裂痕为在裂痕内的盟友提供伤害减免。

183430249.name: Spirit of Starfire
183430249.description: Grenades recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy.
183430249.description_zh: 手雷会从赋能武器伤害中充能，且赋能武器最后一击可提供更多能量。

183430247.name: Spirit of the Claw
183430247.description_zh: 获得额外一次近战充能。

3573490509.name: Spirit of Severance
3573490509.description: Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.
3573490509.description_zh: 充能近战或终结技最后一击会释放一次伤害性爆炸。

3573490508.name: Spirit of Hoarfrost
3573490508.description: Your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Activating Thruster creates Stasis crystals.
3573490508.description_zh: 你的屏障出现后会变成一堵由冰影水晶构成的，能减缓周围目标速度的墙壁。启动推进器会生成冰影水晶。

3573490511.name: Spirit of the Eternal Warrior
3573490511.description: Gain bonus damage for weapons matching your Super's element when your Super ends.
3573490511.description_zh: 当你的超能结束时，与超能元素相匹配的武器会获得伤害加成。

3573490510.name: Spirit of the Abeyant
3573490510.description: Improves Drengr's Lash. Drengr's Lash projectiles track targets more aggressively and travel farther.
3573490510.description_zh: 提升勇士之鞭。勇士之鞭射弹会更主动地跟踪目标，并且移动得更远。

3573490505.name: Spirit of the Bear
3573490505.description: Move faster while guarding with the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
3573490505.description_zh: 使用坚不可摧护盾防卫时移动速度更快。使用坚不可摧抵挡的伤害会转化为手雷能量。

3573490504.name: Spirit of Contact
3573490504.description: Damaging a target with a powered melee causes all nearby targets to suffer lightning strikes and become jolted.
3573490504.description_zh: 使用充能近战对目标造成伤害，会对所有附近目标造成闪电打击和震颤效果。

3573490507.name: Spirit of Scars
3573490507.description: Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration.
3573490507.description_zh: 使用伤害类型与你的超能元素匹配的武器造成最后一击，会在你周围产生爆发治疗，为盟友提供恢复。

3573490506.name: Spirit of the Horn
3573490506.description: Your class ability unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch nearby targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
3573490506.description_zh: 你的职业技能会释放出几道烈日能量波，伤害并灼烧附近的目标。受到此类能量波伤害的战斗人员及被击败的守护者，会笼罩在太阳黑子中。

3573490501.name: Spirit of Alpha Lupi
3573490501.description: Creates a healing pulse when your class ability is activated. Healing allies provides class ability energy.
3573490501.description_zh: 激活你的职业技能时会产生一股具有治疗功能的脉冲。治疗盟友可提供职业技能能量。

3573490500.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium
3573490500.description_zh: 获得额外一次手雷充能。

1476923952.name: Spirit of the Assassin
1476923952.description: Finishers and powered melee final blows grant invisibility.
1476923952.description_zh: 终结技和充能近战最后一击会赋予隐身。

1476923953.name: Spirit of Inmost Light
1476923953.description: Using an ability empowers the other two abilities, granting them improved energy regeneration.
1476923953.description_zh: 使用技能会为其他两项技能赋能，提升其能量回复速度。

1476923954.name: Spirit of the Ophidian
1476923954.description_zh: 武器的准备速度非常快。

1476923955.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater
1476923955.description: While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, granting it bonus damage.
1476923955.description_zh: 超能能量已满时，拾取能量球会过充你的超能，使其造成额外伤害。

1476923956.name: Spirit of Synthoceps
1476923956.description: Improves melee damage when you're surrounded.
1476923956.description_zh: 当你被包围时提升近战伤害。

1476923957.name: Spirit of Verity
1476923957.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant a stacking grenade damage bonus and improved grenade regeneration.
1476923957.description_zh: 与你的手雷伤害类型匹配的武器最后一击会提供可叠加的手雷伤害加成和改进的手雷回复。

3179415481.name: Chromacloak Grips
3179415481.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
3179415481.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
3179415481.typeName_zh: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

584746015.name: Chromacloak Vest
584746015.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
584746015.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
584746015.typeName_zh: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

2297835694.name: Chromacloak Cape
2297835694.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
2297835694.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
2297835694.typeName_zh: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

3044904.name: Chromacloak Mask
3044904.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
3044904.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
3044904.typeName_zh: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

1818107307.name: Chromacloak Strides

1931951168.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
1931951168.description_zh: 消灭目标会使弹药从储存弹药中转移并填装部分弹匣。

1931951169.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.
1931951169.description_zh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并在短时间内为你提供不稳定弹药。

1931951170.name: Onslaught Refit

1931951170.description_zh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高其射速。

2993090545.name: Still Hunt Catalyst
2993090545.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
2993090545.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

1745945065.name: Monolithic Memento
1745945065.description:
A rare curio obtained from "Salvation's Edge."

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
1745945065.description_zh:
一件从“救赎的边缘”中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。
