3177513121.name: Dissected Carve
3177513121.lore:
You guide the Ramulose into alignment with the enemy mothership. 

They're probably responding to your Kell's call for aid—just as you are. Your instruments detect multiple life signs blessed with Ether aboard. 

You wonder if your Kell has a plan for escape, or how she would ever be taken willingly, and whether you're missing elements of a nuanced plan. Without waiting for orders, you silently key up your systems and power your Arc weapons… 

And then, suddenly, the only thing you have in common with yourself is that that's who you used to be— 

di di    di 

dreams, voice, belong to new Kell now, Eliksni no longer. 

chain to chain    to chain 

invigorated 

bleeding brain 

fulfill House Rain's prophecy, father as Kell of Kells. 

di   di di 

father doesn't want it, father wants who you used to be, not to have it, those like you can't have it, destroy the very idea of it, destroy the idea of those people— 

and    when nothing's left 

set a new course for Ramulose, straight through the bridge, a glimpse of Kell's plans. 

path he wishes to burn through asteroid field, make new home for new people, better people 

we    remain 

wish you could see it, but know path ends here, at the bridge 

the other side of the bridge. 

di   di di
3177513121.lore_zh:
你指引拉姆洛斯对准敌人的母舰。 

他们可能是在回应你的凯尔发出的求援——就像你一样。你的仪器检测到飞船上有多个乙太生命信号。 

你不确定你的凯尔是否有逃脱计划，她为什么会甘愿被俘，以及这是否是你没能看透的一个精密计划。你不再等待命令，而是静静地启动系统，为电弧武器充能… 

然后，突然间，你与你自己唯一的共同点，就是曾经的你—— 

滴滴 滴 

梦想，声音，如今属于新的凯尔，不再是埃里克斯尼族。 

锁链连接 锁链 

精力充沛 

脑出血 

实现骤雨氏族的预言，身为凯尔之王的父亲。 

滴 滴滴 

那不是父亲想要的，父亲只想要你过去的样子，不是拥有它，像你这样的人不能拥有它，摧毁它的概念，摧毁那些人的理念—— 

然后 当一切都化为虚无 

为拉姆洛斯设定新航线，直接穿越桥梁，一窥凯尔的计划。 

他希望烧穿小行星带，给新的、更优秀的族人一个新家园 

我们 留存 

希望你能看到，但路的尽头就在这座桥上 

桥的另一端。 

滴 滴滴

1577330346.name: Renunciation
1577330346.flavor: "We are a new calendar! We are an age of beginnings! Each of us is a day!" —Skolas, Kell of Kells
1577330346.source_zh: 来源：篇章怨魂赛季活动
1577330346.lore:
Alarms bleat calamity-shrill across the Ketch as it churns through the void. The hull lows a shuddering complaint that Ziriks feels in his carapace.

"Tell me again," he commands. Shock slows his speech.

His Dregs wring their hands, sensing his weakness.

"Skriviks speaks of betrayal!" Viik cries. "He calls for reinforcements!"

"Cybele is a death-snare," hisses Riikas. "Four Paladins close on Skolas, and every Wolfship with him." 

Every Wolfship, she means, including their own, should they remain on course to join the battle. Already they were delayed by much-needed repairs; a few volleys from the enemy fleet and their hull will split like ripe fruit.

Ziriks feels the stare of the Pilot Servitor beating down upon him. He is—they all are—sworn to his Kell, and Skolas is the last. Irxis, slain in the Eos Clash. Parixas, served up to the enemy through trickery. And these but pale shadows of great Virixas, slain by the alien Queen's Harbingers in the first decisive blow of the war.

Now Skolas stands alone, and the Wolf-Kell has stumbled into a trap. How could the Awoken have known of his intentions for Cybele?

More betrayal. More jostling for meagre power. Years upon years of Wolf-greed and desperation.

Ziriks signals for the Pilot Servitor to slow the engines. 

"Broadcast an open signal to all enemy ships," Ziriks says. "We place our fates at the mercy of tomorrow."
1577330346.lore_zh:
警报声在双桅船内响彻，可怕的刺鸣声传遍虚空。船体发出不堪重负的震颤，吉瑞克斯感到自己的甲壳也在跟着抖动。

“再说一遍，”他命令道，震惊使他的语速变得缓慢。

堕落者士兵们搓着手，察觉到了他的软弱。

“斯奎维克斯说有叛徒！”维克叫道。“他在呼叫援军！”

“前往希伯乐是自寻死路，”里卡斯嘶鸣道。“四名圣骑士在逼近斯格拉斯，追随他的所有狼船都逃不掉。” 

所有狼船，她的意思是也包括他们，如果他们继续航行参战。他们已经由于必要的维修而延误；只要敌方舰队几轮齐射，他们的船体就会像熟透的果子一样崩裂开来。

吉瑞克斯能感受到领航魔眼的注视。他——他们所有人——都宣誓效忠于他的凯尔，而斯格拉斯是最后一个。伊尔克西斯在厄俄斯冲突中阵亡，帕瑞克萨斯因诡计命丧敌手。而这些损失都无法与伟大的维瑞克萨斯之死相提并论，他是在战争的第一波致命打击中被外星女王的先知杀害的。

如今斯格拉斯孤军奋战，而恶狼凯尔跌进了一个陷阱。觉醒者怎么会知道他对希伯乐的意图？

层出不穷的背叛，争夺微薄的权力。年复一年狼的贪婪和绝望。

吉瑞克斯示意领航魔眼减缓引擎速度。 

“向所有敌方飞船播送一个公开信号，”吉瑞克斯说道，“我们将命运交给明天。”

3039049959.name: Rustpiercer
3039049959.lore:
It welds a rusted steel sliver to the front of the vehicle. The light from the Hadium welder flash-burns its eyes, leaving a reddish film over its vision. It does not blink. The searing metal chars the flesh on its hand, creating a blackened crust. It does not flinch. 

A Chieftain passes behind. It picks up another long spike of scrap from the pile. It jabs the welder in the middle of its back. 

The welder makes a sound between a chitter and a gurgle. 

an noy  di srupt ion  wha t  w ant 

The Chieftan drops the metal skewer at the welder's side. 

mor e  pier ce b odie s fr ont 

It mimes a stabbing motion and gestures to the nose of the vehicle. 

The welder hisses in dismay. It points aggressively at the ground with all four sets of claws. It clicks its teeth. 

ba lanc e  fal l 

The Chieftain growls deep in its thorax. An almost subaudible rumble. It points to the empty section of the frame where the engine has yet to be mounted. 

o bey  wor k o rg o pit 

The welder stares blankly at the empty engine mounting, uncomprehending. It hisses, without conviction this time, and picks up the metal sliver. 

The Chieftain looks out across the bay, where a fleet of similar vehicles are being assembled. It pushes a dim sensation of satisfaction far from its mind.
3039049959.lore_zh:
它将一段锈迹斑斑的钢银焊接到载具前部。哈迪姆焊机发出的光灼伤了它的眼睛，留下一层红色的薄膜，但它没有眨眼。炽热的金属烫伤了它的手，形成了一层黑色的硬壳，但它的手没有抖。 

一位族长从后面走过。它从料堆中取出一根长长的废金属尖刺，戳了下焊工的后背中部。 

焊工发出一种介于啾啾和咯咯之间的声音。 

讨 厌干 扰要 什么 

族长将金属杆放在焊工的一旁。 

更 多尖 刺 正 面穿 敌 

它模仿着突刺的动作，指向载具前端。 

焊工发出失望的嘶鸣。它用力地将四组爪子指着地面，咔嗒咔嗒地咬牙。 

失 去平 衡 

族长从胸腔深处发出低吼，几乎是低鸣般的隆隆声。它指向框架上尚未安装发动机的空荡位置。 

服 从工 作否 则进 搏斗 场 

焊工茫然地盯着发动机的安装位置。它发出不再坚定的嘶鸣，然后捡起了那根钢银。 

族长望向舱室，那里正在组装一系列类似的载具。它将一丝微弱的满足感推到脑海深处。

3489448910.source_zh: 来源：圣城中的药剂实验室
3489448910.lore:
CORMORANT-LEVEL ENCRYPTED MESSAGE FOLLOWS.  

AUDIO SURVEILLANCE TRANSCRIPT AA726CBJ913JHS443 

UNRESOLVED EVALUATION: PENDING DIRECTIVE 

I greet you in the Light, Ixis. Thank you for speaking with me. I understand you have some questions about the House of Light? 

… 

Oh! Umm. No offense taken. Our Houses haven't always embraced with four arms.  

… 

I understand your reluctance. Your history is so much longer than mine. As Variks is constantly reminding me. You haven't had much reason to trust the Humans. 

… 

I can see why you believe that. But you must admit, much has changed since the Twilight Gap. This is a new period in history. Potentially, the greatest era of development we've known since the Drift. It's an opportunity to move beyond traditional rivalries to create new— 

… 

Eramiskel may have evolved more than you think. We've spoken at length about the hardships your generation faced. Many at the hands of the Humans. And many more self-inflicted. I know it's hard to change old ways. But the young Eliksni of House Light—those hatched after the Drift—we have no appetite for more death. We share no animosity with the Humans. They're our neighbors now. 

… 

Well, if cooperation is defeat, then we are defeated! All thanks to the bloody mess left to us by our venerated elders! 

… 

I apologize. That was… unkind. I know you've faced much, and persevered. But if a loss of pride is the cost of peace, then so be it. The House of Light will raise their hatchlings in safety, free from old bitterness, and be glad of it. I just hope you're able to see the City as I do. Someday.
3489448910.lore_zh:
以下为鸬鹚级加密信息。  

音频监控记录AA726CBJ913JHS443 

尚未评估：等待指示 

我在光能之下问候你，伊克西斯。感谢你愿意与我交谈。我知道你对光能氏族有一些疑问对吗？ 

… 

哦！呃，我不介意。我们两氏族并不总是张开四臂相互拥抱的。  

… 

我理解你的不情愿，你们氏族的历史比我的悠久得多。瓦里克斯总是提醒我，你们没有多少理由信任人类。 

… 

我明白你为什么这么认为。但你得承认，暮光峡谷之后很多事都变了。这是个新的历史时期，可能是大漂流以来最伟大的发展时代。是个机会去化解前嫌，创造新的—— 

… 

也许伊拉莫斯凯尔的演变远超你的想象。我们详细讨论过你们这一代人遭受的苦难，不少是人类造成的，而更多是自身造成的。我知道要改变旧习很难，但光能氏族的年轻埃里克斯尼族——大漂流后孵化的那些——我们不希望看到更多的伤亡。我们对人类没有敌意，他们现在是我们的邻居了。 

… 

如果合作就是失败，那我们就是失败了！全都要感谢尊敬的先辈们留给我们的血腥烂摊子！ 

… 

对不起，这么说…太苛刻。我知道你们历尽艰辛坚持了下来，但如果和平的代价是失去骄傲，我们接受。光能氏族将在安全的环境中抚养幼雏，满怀喜悦地远离旧怨。我只希望你有朝一日能用我的视角看看这座圣城。

3031600404.name: VS Tech Sledge
3031600404.flavor: Urgent|Personal|Unsent| Tell me you haven't signed on yet. Stay on the surface. Better yet, go back to Earth and out of Bray's orbit—
3031600404.lore:
Leaning over on his sledge, István smacks the airlock button. 

Through the airlock speaker, the station says, "Lock-out procedure initialized. Remember to double-check your personal oxygen supply!" 

István gives a little get-on-with-it motion with a hand, waiting for the cycle to complete and let him out. The station's solar catchers should be self-repairing, but something always breaks, and then it's always his problem to fix. 

Normally alerts would come through his earpiece, but István's tweaked his to only give alerts for problems within 100 meters of his location. Issues with the labs five sectors away aren't his issue. At least not until his shift leader messages him. 

"Airlock opening. Technicians are asked to return once system charge drops to 40%." 

Nobody follows that procedure. 40% charge is an absurdly huge margin for getting back inside safely. But their fussy station keeps reminding them, always in the same cadence. 

He kicks his sledge into gear. It's a relief to get away from the research complexes, from everything in them he doesn't understand. 

István gets to work. Powering down a grid of the solar catchers, cutting out the damaged material, cutting a new piece from the replacement roll. The only sounds are the squeaking of his suit joints and the hiss of his cutter. 

 Until the station says, the loudest he's ever heard it, "Charge at 93%. Threat level alpha!" 

István jerks up, cutter gouging a hole in his repair material. No detail. Another false alarm from their fussy station. 

Even louder, the station says, "Charge at 93%. Threat level alpha!" 

He looks around. Nothing. Except—a handful of fiery glints in the dark. 

István grabs his sledge. It drags him up the hull, his suit scraping across the catchers in a way that'll leave bruises. He doesn't stop until he finds an overhang. 

And then he watches fragments of meteor coming in hot from far out of orbit, impacting the solar catchers right where he was standing. His roll of repair material is torn apart in an instant. 

"Technicians are asked to return once system charge drops to 40%." 

His charge is sitting steady at 86%. 

Shakily, he says, "Heading in. Now."
3031600404.lore_zh:
伊什特万靠在机车上，按下了气闸按钮。 

通过气闸的扬声器，空间站广播道，“锁定程序已启动。请检查个人氧气供应是否正常！” 

伊什特万用手比了一个催促的动作，等待循环完成，让他出去。空间站的太阳能捕捉器本应自动修复，但总有东西会坏掉，而他总是那个修理的人。 

通常他的耳机会收到警报，但伊什特万设置了耳机只接收100米范围内的警报。五个区外实验室的问题？至少在他的值班领导发消息之前与他无关。 

“气闸正在打开。技术人员请在系统充能降至40%时返回。” 

没有人遵守这个程序。40%的充能对于安全返回来说绰绰有余，但喜欢小题大做的空间站总是以夸张的语音提醒他们。 

他启动了机车。能远离研究综合楼，远离里面他无法理解的一切，让他松了一口气。 

伊什特万着手开始工作，他关闭了一组太阳能捕捉器的电源，切掉损坏的材料，裁剪并安装新的修复材料。他能听到的只有防护服关节的嘎吱声和切割器的嘶嘶声。 

 突然，空间站传来他听过的最高音量，“充能93%。威胁等级Alpha！” 

伊什特万猛地站起来，切割器戳穿了修复材料。广播没有再说什么。看来大惊小怪的空间站又发出了错误警报。 

空间站的声音更大了，“充能93%。威胁等级Alpha！” 

他环顾四周，什么都没有，除了黑暗中几缕炽热的闪光。 

伊什特万抓住机车，借力爬上船体。他的防护服在捕捉器上摩擦，肯定会留下淤青，但他没有停下，而是径直去往一个悬架。 

然后，他看到流星碎片从轨道外飞来，撞击到他之前站立的太阳能捕捉器上。一卷修复材料瞬间被撕碎。 

“技术人员请在系统充能降至40%时返回。” 

他的充能还有86%。 

颤抖着，他说，“让我进去。”

3158812152.name: The Xûrfboard
3158812152.flavor: Who knows where the next wave will take you.
3158812152.lore:
The ship's a spruced-up Galliot, glorious in its pearlescent blue paint and bizarre angles. Just looking at it makes Rahila want to take it on a joyride clear out of the Sol system. Walking up the gangway into the ship itself makes her want to cry.

The ship has the necessary long-range capabilities and just enough expanded capacity for a full fireteam's worth of supplies and survey equipment. Between the Vanguard's support, generous contributions from the Awoken, and several upgrades courtesy of a lapsed Dead Orbit adherent, the ship's a lot to be entrusted with. 

"These new sensors are something else," Isidro announces from the cockpit. "If so much as a mouse sneezes out there in the black, we'll pick it up."

Rahila squints at him. "A mouse?"

"Space-mice. Or, you know, a gravitational anomaly. Or mysterious, freaky signals." 

"Vanguard will be along in a few to see us off." Roche-5's composed baritone emerges from the hatch leading to the cargo hold. "You two ready?" 

 Rahila settles into the copilot's chair. "To go find out what's left of our solar system? 'Course we are." 

"Remember," Roche intones gravely, "This is pure recon. No big risks." 

Rahila and Isidro exchange grins. "Sure thing."
3158812152.lore_zh:
这是一艘精心装饰的快船，形状独特，涂着珍珠蓝色的漆面。仅仅一瞥就让拉吉拉想驾驶它直接离开太阳系。登上舷梯进入飞船的那一刻，她几乎感动得要落泪。

这艘飞船具备必要的远程能力，而且刚好有足够的扩展空间可以容纳一整支火力战队的补给和调查设备。凭借先锋的支持、觉醒者的慷慨捐赠，以及一位死亡轨道的前拥护者提供的几项升级，这艘飞船承载着众多期望。 

“这些新传感器简直令人叹为观止，”伊西德罗在驾驶舱中说道。“就算只是黑暗中的一只小老鼠打个喷嚏，我们都能探测到。”

拉吉拉眯眼看着他，“小老鼠？”

“太空老鼠，或者引力异常，又或是神秘的怪信号之类的。” 

“先锋马上就会来送我们走。”罗切-5沉稳的男中音从通往货舱的舱口传来。“你俩准备好了吗？” 

 拉吉拉在副驾驶椅上坐定，“去看看太阳系还剩些什么吗？当然准备好了。” 

“记住，”罗切严肃地说，“这次只是去侦查，别铤而走险。” 

拉吉拉和伊西德罗相视而笑，“没问题。”

4123860739.lore:
"You ever seen a Screeb?" the Hunter asked and tilted his head toward the Eliksni before him. They perched on a stack of crates, spending their break well above the hustle and bustle of the Variisis Core.

"I've heard of them through Scribe Eido's retellings, but never seen one. Are they not simply small, bulbous creatures?" the Eliksni inquired and folded both sets of his arms.

"That explode."

"Yes, but… I don't understand the fear induced by them," the Eliksni said. "Surely something like an Ahamkara would warrant more terror?"

"He's just mad that every time we encounter them, he somehow always becomes their target," a Warlock said. "It's practically serendipitous." She hopped up onto the crate beside the Hunter, who rolled his eyes. 

The Eliksni chuckled.

"What about those Tormentors?" said a Corsair, placing a box down and joining the conversation. "Hearing your bones strain while within their clutches…"

The Eliksni tapped his mandible and nodded slowly.

"Agreed, worse than a Screeb," the Warlock declared.

"Okay, fine, what's the scariest thing YOU'VE seen out there?" the Hunter bit back.

The Warlock didn't even hesitate.

"Eris Morn."

There was a long pause. Someone dropped something further down the street, and the noise echoed in their silence.

"…Yeah," the Hunter said. The Corsair and Eliksni mumbled their agreement. "Fine, but Screeb juice on its own—"

A bout of groans and disgust swept through the group as they scattered. The Hunter followed quickly behind the Warlock to continue his rant. The Eliksni shook his head and followed the Corsair in the opposite direction, inquiring further about the Tormentors.
4123860739.lore_zh:
“你见过变异体吗？”猎人问道，把头偏向了他面前的埃里克斯尼族。他们居于一堆板条箱上，远离瓦里希斯核心的喧嚣，享受着休息时间。

“我听文士艾多讲过，但从未亲眼得见。它们不就是些小球根状生物吗？”埃里克斯尼族问道，交叉着两对手臂。

“会爆炸的那种。”

“对，但…我不明白为什么它们会让人感到害怕，”埃里克斯尼族说道。“像阿罕卡拉那样的东西肯定会让人更加恐惧吧？”

“他只是生气每次我们遇到它们时，自己总是莫名其妙地成为它们的目标，”一名术士说道。“简直是命定般的巧合。”她跳上猎人身边的箱子，猎人翻了个白眼。 

埃里克斯尼族轻笑起来。

“那些折磨者呢？”一名海盗军放下一个箱子，加入了谈话。“听到它们抓住你时骨头嘎吱作响的声音…”

埃里克斯尼族敲了敲下巴，缓缓点了点头。

“同意，比变异体还糟糕，”术士说道。

“行，好吧，你在外面见过的最可怕的东西是什么？”猎人反问道。

术士完全没有犹豫。

“埃里斯·摩恩。”

一阵长久的沉默。街上更远处有人掉落了东西，声音在寂静中回响。

“…的确，”猎人说。海盗军和埃里克斯尼族低声表示同意。“好吧，但光是变异体汁——”

一阵呻吟和作呕声在人群中蔓延，他们一哄而散。猎人快步跟在术士身后，继续闲聊。埃里克斯尼族则摇摇头，跟着海盗军朝相反的方向走去，进一步打听折磨者的事情。

2565885237.name: Nightsworn Sight
2565885237.description:
Dealing final blows to targets grants Nightsworn Sight. 

During that time, final blows grant Truesight, reload speed and precision damage is increased, and submunitions weaken targets.

470163129.name: Harvester Spike
470163129.description: This weapon fires a Harvester Spike projectile. Dealing final blows with this weapon creates a single Vestige at the target's location. Impaling more powerful combatants with the projectile creates a steady stream of Vestiges from the target.
470163129.description_zh: 此武器发射收割者尖刺射弹。使用此武器造成最后一击会在目标位置产生一个残余。使用射弹刺穿更强大的战斗人员可以使目标产生一波残余。

744619683.name: No Backpack
744619683.description: Final blows or assists with any other weapon or ability have a chance to create ammo for Ice Breaker. Defeating powerful combatants will create multiple rounds.
744619683.description_zh: 最后一击或用任意其他武器或技能助攻有几率生成破冰者弹药。击败强力战斗人员将生成多发弹药。

2848175214.name: Ice Breaker
2848175214.description: Defeating a target with this weapon causes them to explode. Precision final blows or shattering a frozen target instead triggers an ignition.
2848175214.description_zh: 使用此武器击败目标会导致目标爆炸。精准最后一击或碎裂被冻结的目标会触发点燃。

2607392828.name: Heart Piercer
2607392828.description: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
2607392828.description_zh: 此武器发射的子弹在命中时会碎裂成子弹药。克制过载勇士。

2405598968.name: Vestigial Alchemy
2405598968.description:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy. 

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.
2405598968.description_zh:
此武器在你拾取残余时获得能量，并让你能在射弹命中位置为你和你的盟友生成弹药。特殊弹药模式可在50%能量时解锁，重型弹药模式则需100%能量。

要将残余转化为特殊弹药，按下[替换武器动作]以激活特殊弹药模式。再按[替换武器动作]以激活重型弹药模式。

2576986935.name: Null Factor
2576986935.description: Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.
2576986935.description_zh: 枯萎之刃命中和弹跳会生成一个小冰影水晶并返还一部分近战能量。使用枯萎之刃击碎水晶或冻结目标会释放枯萎之刃。

1871764335.name: Bleak Domain
1871764335.description: Your Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced with extended range and are surrounded by Stasis crystals and a storm. While standing in the storm, you are granted icicles over time. Icicles activate when you fire your weapons, applying Slow to targets they hit.
1871764335.description_zh: 你的凄凉观察者炮台已强化，射程更远，周围将环绕冰影水晶和风暴。当站在风暴中时，你会持续获得冰锥。用武器射击可激活冰锥，并对命中目标施加减速效果。

1860418166.name: Blastwave Striders
1860418166.description: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.
1860418166.description_zh: 获得对你的爆炸物的抗性。击败目标来为此护甲充能。充能后，进行战栗打击近战攻击或造成爆炸自我伤害，来向后火箭跳并释放带有致命碎片射弹的冲击波。冲击波会使战斗人员冻结并使守护者减速。充能火箭跳会提供冰霜护甲。

576914489.name: Charon's Toll
576914489.lore:
Drifter sat back, kicking his feet up on a nearby console. He wiggled his large toe through a hole in his sock. 

"So it's a living memory… of a dead guy?" Drifter recapped. 

"A dead god," Eris corrected him, as she continued to rummaged through the piles of junk littering the floor of the Derelict, Drifter's ship. She tossed aside bits of old food, Sparrow parts, and stray ammunition. "Aurash, the Osmium King, Lord of Shapes, and First Navigator of the Hive."  

She held up a moldy clump of Glacial Starwort at arm's length. Her nose wrinkled in distaste. "You said you had a calcified Hive worm in this cesspit. Produce it." 

"It's around here somewhere," Drifter assured her. "If you relax a little, I bet it'll come right to you. I reckoned a top-notch occultist like you woulda figured that out." 

Eris ignored his jab and poked another pile of detritus with her foot. A tiny croak and some gentle rustling issued from beneath the pile. Eris's mouth formed a thin line of annoyance. 

"Anyway," Drifter continued, "while Oryx was stompin' around—drumming up Taken from everything he could get his greedy mitts on—his memories were stored in the Darkness." 

"They became interwoven with the fabric of our shared meta-consciousness," Eris elaborated. 

"That's what I said!" the rogue Lightbearer exclaimed. "Then, after the Guardian killed the Witness, Oryx's memories combined with the Light… to make the Echo." 

"Yes. That's very nearly correct," Eris humored him.  

She pulled back an Ether-stained banner to reveal a small stone statuette of a plump, fish-like creature. She held it up to the light, examining it closely. 

"This is it. Now let's depart before I contract something more pernicious than your company." 

 "There's no such thing," Drifter chortled. "Trust."
576914489.lore_zh:
浪客靠向椅背，双脚随意地搁在附近的控制台上。他透过袜子上的一个破洞，惬意地扭动着大脚趾。 

“这么说，这是死人的…活记忆？”浪客总结道。 

“是死去的神，”埃里斯纠正他，同时继续在浪客的遗落飞船上遍布地板的杂物中翻找。她把一些过期的食品、快雀零件和散落的弹药扔到一边。“是奥拉什，锇素之王，形态之主，邪魔族的第一位领航者。”  

她伸直手臂，举起一团发霉的冰川星芽，嫌弃地皱起鼻子。“你说过这堆垃圾里有个钙化的邪魔族蠕虫。把它找出来。” 

“就在附近，”浪客向她保证。“你放松点，它没准就自己出现了。我还以为你这样的顶尖神秘学家早就知道了。” 

埃里斯不理会他的挖苦，用脚拨弄着另一堆破烂。底下传来微弱的嗄嗄声和细微的悉窣声。埃里斯的嘴唇抿成了一条不满的细线。 

“就是说，”浪客继续说道，“当欧里克斯四处横行，把他能抓到的一切都变成傀儡军团时，他的记忆被保存在了暗影中。” 

“它们与我们共享的元意识结构相互交织，”埃里斯阐述道。 

“我就是这么说的！”这名无赖负光者高喊道。“然后，守护者杀死了见证者，欧里克斯的记忆与光能结合…形成了回响。” 

“对。差不多就是这样，”埃里斯迁就了他。  

她掀开一面沾满乙太的旗帜，露出一尊小石像，形似一只胖乎乎的鱼形生物。她把它举到光线下，仔细端详。 

“找到了。走吧，趁我还没沾染上比你的陪伴更糟糕的东西。” 

 “没有那样的东西，”浪客笑道。“相信我。”

1764758326.name: Endling Seek
1764758326.flavor: We still hope to see another.
1764758326.lore:
What do you call someone who is blood of your blood, heritor of a similar ancient lineage, yet deeply changed? Whom you have never known dearly—in fact, barely at all—but whose echoes you see in the still pond, the polished glass? 

Ahsa settles for "cousin."  

Eir. Ur. Yul. Xol. Akka, dead Akka, whose everted bones circle Saturn in twin orbit with Titan, where Ahsa dreams. Of all the cousin-names, it is that one that catches Ahsa, rolls along her flukes and shivers, rippling, in the methane dream.  

There is some mirror where Ahsa is the ship, Akka the refugee. An accident of parentage. One sibling this river, the other that stream.  

And so how does Ahsa hate what she nearly was?  

Cousin-bones, family-bones, swimming as she does. In her marrow, she knows this: she is lucky.  

Dead Akka hums, and Ahsa feels it stem to stern. She stirs from her dream to roll as she listens, a long stretch of—(blade's edge) [CRYSTAL] (parchment)—and the breath of the galaxy along her flank.  

Ahsa hums back, of course. She can't help herself, even knowing better. Your cousin calls out, "I am here! Is anyone there?" and you answer. You answer.  

Dead Akka does not answer. It is a ghost-firing of bone-neurons. Xol does not answer. Xita and Sel and Ora and Leis do not answer.  

Some glutted, war-fed cousin long across the sea of screams calls out, a distant wormsong threat. Ahsa goes quiet, remembers all at once. Presses her consciousness close to her Titan, settles back into a softer, subtler dream.  

(In that dream, Ahsa is not the last.)
1764758326.lore_zh:
如何称呼那个与你血脉相通、拥有相似古老血统却历经变迁的存在？一个你从未亲近，甚至几乎完全陌生的存在——然而，在静谧的池塘水面、平滑如镜的玻璃上，你却能捕捉到其影子？ 

阿莎选择称其为“表亲”。  

艾尔。厄尔。尤尔。尸飕。阿卡，死去的阿卡，其遗骨与土卫六并轨绕着土星缓缓旋转，而阿莎则在土卫六上坠入梦境。在所有表亲的名字当中，唯有这个能让阿莎悸动，它沿着她的鳍游弋，轻轻颤动，在甲烷梦境中泛起层层涟漪。  

如同一面镜子，阿莎是船，阿卡则是难民。这是血缘的奇妙安排，一位血亲在这条河流，另一位则在那条溪流。  

自己也曾可能走向同样的结局，阿莎为何会心怀憎恨？  

表亲的骨骼，家族的骨骼，如同她一般游弋。在骨髓深处，她深知自己是幸运的。  

死去的阿卡在轻吟，而阿莎全身心地感受着它。她在梦中微动，随着倾听而翻滚，一连串的——（刀锋）[水晶]（羊皮纸）——星系的气息沿着她的身躯流淌。  

阿莎自然也会轻吟回应。她无法克制自己，即使知道不该如此。当表亲呼唤：“我在这里！有人在吗？”你会回应。理所当然。  

死去的阿卡没有回应。这只是骨神经发出的幽灵般声响。尸飕没有回应。西塔、塞尔、奥拉和莱斯没有回应。  

某个饱食战争之果的表亲，在尖叫之海对岸发声，那是遥远的蠕虫之歌威胁。阿莎安静下来，瞬间回忆起了一切。她将意识紧附于她的土卫六之上，重新沉浸回了一个更柔和、更细腻的梦境。  

（那梦里，阿莎不是孑然一身。）

2993751041.name: Future Proof
2993751041.flavor: "I will make me what I must be because to be what I am is fatal." —Kerrev, the Erased
2993751041.lore:
Kerrev has a fine whispering voice and a fine whispering mind. "Come with me," ey says, "I smell a smell of power, I taste a wisp of a waft of something to feed us." 

Kerrev adorns eyself in prizes, acquires attainments. Ey displays resinous worms, maps knotted in umbilical cords and tangled in quartz storage. Ey pours handfuls of jangling coins into open palms to let the pattern of their fall suggest direction. Ey covers the body granted by the knife and vows to have better. If not the before-body then a new one, a better one, a whole one. 

All lean in to touch the coins, to read the symbols of obverse and reverse. A glimmering and a gleaming answers stirring fingers.  

"I won't take the knife again; I don't care who wields it," says Jjenr in a brave groaning little voice, and flips her blades about her elbows as if to say, any deity who dare try it, I'll cut back. 

They are hunters all of them, and it is a hard hunt, the sniffing-out and the reading-of-entrails and the long, long journeys through foreign lands. Voices speak to offer power. A place to rest. A floating duty, comforting and mindless. 

Kerrev's whispers break the tightening cords of the hum from Saturn's rings. Ey tells stories of what-was and what-is and what-could-be through the journey.  

"I will be beautiful," Kerrev says, and "I will be whole," Jjenr says, and "I will be myself," says a heretofore silent Subjugator called only the Ferrule. 

"We will make ourselves anew," Kerrev murmurs, and all hiss in hope as painful as the touch of the knife.
2993751041.lore_zh:
克瑞夫的声音轻柔如同细语，心灵也同样细腻。“跟我来，”伊说，“我嗅到了力量的气息，尝到了能滋养我们的微风之味。” 

克瑞夫用宝物装饰自己，以此作为成就的象征。伊展示树脂蠕虫，用脐带打结、以石英包裹的地图。伊将一把叮当作响的硬币倒入摊开的手掌，任由它们落下的图案指引方向。伊遮盖住刀所赋予的身体，发誓追求更好的自己。如果不是过去的身体，那就找一个全新的、更好的、完整的。 

所有人都俯身触摸那些硬币，解读正反面的符号。闪烁的微光回应着舞动的手指。  

“不管掌控者是谁，我都不会再接受刀刃，”杰恩尔悄声说，声音坚定而低沉，同时轻轻翻转着肘部附近的利刃，仿佛在宣告：倘若任何神敢尝试，我必反击。 

他们都是猎人，这是一场艰难的狩猎，需要嗅探、解读内脏，以及穿行于陌生土地的漫长旅程。声音发语以提供力量。休憩之地，飘忽的责任，舒适而无需思考。 

克瑞夫的低语穿透了土星环的嗡鸣声。旅途中，伊讲述着过去、现在与未来的故事。  

“我会变得美丽，”克瑞夫如是说。“我会变得完整，”杰恩尔如是说。“我会成为我自己，”名为箍帽，之前一直沉默不语的镇压者如是说。 

“我们将重塑自我，”克瑞夫低声宣告，他们满怀希望地发出如刀触般痛苦的嘶嘶声。

3013191049.name: Commemorative Steed
3013191049.lore:
Slalom left across the curb cut on 18th. A judicious boost between the supports of the Six Fronts memorial. And straight through the middle of the pack. 

District 125's streets are dark at night, the streetlights few and far between. The occasional neon sign is diffused by the running lights and exhaust trails of a dozen Sparrows jockeying for space. 

Farrukh hunkers down over his restored EV-34 Vector Infinite, his pride and joy. His whole fireteam put down the last of their Glimmer and materials to upgrade her and get a seat at this race. Without sanctioned SRL events, it's drag racing betting rings where Guardians can make their profits. 

And they need it bad.  

Farrukh's gloves creak on his handlebars. He takes a risk going tight around a corner and cuts off a Warlock on a Sharklight, aiming for the front-runners. 

The big names are here tonight: Boaz, Gris, Cron-8, even the up-and-coming Niik. Their skills might secure this win. But they don't want it the way Farrukh does. 

It gets worse every week, their debt piling up. The Spider's smirk audible even through his filters, offering worse deals, dirtier jobs. They need a clean break. Clean Vanguard work. Just one race and they can buy their way out. 

Serapion gutted his Sparrow's braking system for Farrukh's EV. Tammuz-4 pawned their first bond. It's Farrukh on the track tonight, but his team's with him. 

Streetlights flash by faster as the pack leaves the warehouses behind, drifting hard around an overpass. Farrukh's near the middle, waiting on his last boost.  

Street racing's all about calculated risks. And this is their biggest. 

He waits for the moment–waits as the Sharklight passes him again, and the racers around him slam their boosts–and hits his own for the final push. Half a block to make up. Half a block between him and his team's future. 

He weaves through the pack, pushing his boost hard just as all the others wear out, and slams into the finish with another Sparrow an inch behind his nose. 

The roar of the crowd is a physical force, slamming into Farrukh like a Sentinel's shield. 

The racer in second yanks off their helmet and points straight at Farrukh. "How did you pull that out of your antique?" 

Farrukh looks out through the crowd for Tammuz and Sera, shouldering their way over to him, looking as shellshocked as he feels. They made it. They're safe. 

He smiles, heart going 160. 

"It's not what you're racing," Farrukh says. "It's who you're racing for."
3013191049.lore_zh:
斯拉罗姆从18号街的路缘开了下去。他在六方战役纪念碑的支柱之间踩下油门，直接从车队中间穿了过去。 

125区的街道夜晚漆黑一片，路灯寥寥无几。偶尔出现的霓虹灯也被十几辆挤在一起的快雀车灯和尾气所掩盖。 

法鲁克在他修复的EV-34向量无限上压低了身子。这辆快雀是他的至宝。他的火力战队全员花尽了所有微光，才改好这辆快雀，在这场赛事中搞到了席位。没了获得批准的赛雀联赛，守护者可以通过在地下竞速赛中下注赚钱。 

而他们很需要这笔微光。  

法鲁克的手套握在车把上吱吱作响。他冒险从内道超过了一位骑着海鲨光芒的术士，朝最前面的车手冲刺而去。 

今晚来的都是大人物：波资、格里斯、科隆8号，还有刚崭露头角的妮可。他们凭借车技，想赢并不是什么难事。但他们的求胜心远远没有法鲁克那么强烈。 

他们的累积债务一周比一周多。即使隔着蛛王的过滤器，他们也能听到他的笑声，被迫接受更黑心的交易和更肮脏的工作。他们必须翻身。只做干净的先锋活。赢下这场比赛，他们就能给自己赎身了。 

赛拉皮翁把他快雀的制动系统装在了法鲁克的EV上。塔姆兹-4把自己的第一个臂环给当了。虽然上赛道的只有法鲁克，但他身后是他的整个火力战队。 

当车队驶离仓库，在高架桥上漂移而过时，路灯飞逝得更快了。法鲁克在车队中央附近，等待着最后一次加速的时机。  

街头赛车的关键在于衡量风险。而这就是最大的风险。 

他静候着时机——海鲨光芒又超过了他，而他周围的其他赛车手也都启动了加速。他打算在最后的冲刺阶段再加速。他得追上半个街区的距离。这半个街区隔着他和他战队的未来。 

他在快雀群中穿梭，在所有其他车手都耗尽助推器时，他猛地加速，冲向终点。当他率先抵达时，第二辆快雀只比他的车头落后了一英寸。 

人群的欢呼声像哨兵的护盾一样撞上了法鲁克。 

位居第二的车手扯下头盔，指着法鲁克发问。“你那老古董是从哪儿挤出这么多马力的？” 

法鲁克在人群中寻找着塔姆兹和赛拉的身影。他们正朝他走来，就像他一样惊魂未定。他们成功了。他们翻身了。 

他微笑着，心率飙到了每分钟一百六。 

“关键不在快雀，”法鲁克说。“在于你为谁比赛。”

1515866705.name: Flagbearer
1515866705.lore:
The Tower Cryptarchy's Archives see few visitors. They reside in a squat and unlovely building, tucked away from busy foot traffic, modestly veiled by a curtain of ivy. Nothing about their outward appearance hints at the treasures within: the engraved quartz plates, ancient data storage media, even a few fragments of paper records. The words of thousands slumber quietly in the stacks. 

Rahool's favorite room is engram storage, though not for the academic reasons many might expect. In the late afternoon, the sun's rays shine through the room's skylight at just the right angle to strike the engrams on the topmost shelf. The light refracts and scatters through layers upon layers of crystalline data, reflecting through other engrams in turn. The humble storage room is aglow with pure knowledge. 

On one such afternoon, Rahool hums tunelessly, trailing his fingers across a shelf. Here are more than a hundred survivors' stories from the Red Legion's attack on the Last City. Here are the transcripts of every confirmed and suspected interaction with the Witch Queen. Here and here and here, are the Tower's copies of important data shared from the CloudArk.  

There is an ongoing attempt to describe the interior of the Pale Heart through an ever-expanding map, biological survey results, and first-person testimonials. And there is all known and recovered data about the Witness, including data recorded during its final defeat. 

The line of engrams ends there, but only until the Guardian's return. Rahool retrieves a blank engram from a storage bin, holding it up to the light. It is clear as glass, photons passing through it with barely a hitch. "Now, my storied friend… I wonder what the next chapter of your tale will bring."
1515866705.lore_zh:
高塔解密大师档案馆很少有访客。它坐落在一栋矮小而不美观的建筑里，远离繁忙的人流，被一层常春藤遮蔽着。从外观上丝毫看不出里面的宝藏：雕刻的石英板、古老的数据存储媒介，甚至还有一些纸质记录碎片。成千上万的文字静静地沉睡在书堆里。 

拉乎尔最喜欢的房间是记忆水晶储藏室，但并不是由于许多人所期望的学术原因。傍晚时分，阳光透过房间的天窗，恰到好处地折射到最顶层书架的记忆水晶上。光线在层层叠叠的晶体数据中折射散开，又依次反射到其他记忆水晶上。简陋的储藏室里闪烁着纯净知识的光芒。 

在这样一个下午，拉乎尔用手指划过一个架子，无声地哼唱着。这里有一百多位幸存者讲述的猩红军团进攻圣城的故事。这里有与巫妖女王的每一次确认和怀疑的互动记录。这里，这里，还有这里，都是高塔从云端方舟共享的重要数据副本。  

通过不断扩大的地图、生物调查结果和亲身证明，我们一直在尝试描述苍白之心的内部情况。还有所有已知和恢复的有关见证者的数据，包括它最终被击败时记录的数据。 

记忆水晶结束于此，但只需等到守护者回来。拉乎尔从储物箱中取出一个空白的记忆水晶，将其对着光线。它像玻璃一样透明，光子穿过它时几乎没有任何阻碍。“那么，我这位传奇的朋友…我想知道你的下一章故事会是什么样子。”

4019038402.name: Gryphon
4019038402.flavor: CAUTION - THIS VEHICLE MAKES FREQUENT STOPS
4019038402.lore:
A fountain of sparks cascade across the Hangar floor. Niik blinks each of her eyes in turn, always keeping at least two on the path of the plasma cutter. The twisted metal pieces fall with a clatter, and she shuts off the torch. 

Behind her, there is a groan of stressed metal, followed by the tortured shriek of a weld giving way. She turns her head just in time to catch Zahn'ra tear apart a Brig's fused leg armor with brute force. 

The big engineer catches Niik's look. "What," she grumbles. 

"Who taught you to treat machinery like that?" Niik chitters a laugh, inviting her friend to laugh with her. 

Instead, Zahn'ra falls silent. She stares down at the metal beneath her hands and sees the shadow of a larger pair guiding her own.  

"Some old coot," she says finally. Her bitter words do not match the furrow of her brow, the downturn of her mouth. 

Niik puts down her tools. She recognizes her fellow engineer's expression. Acid sweetness; yesterday's joy, tainted by today's sorrow. Her innocent joke has unearthed something far more complicated. 

Holliday once told her that some silences could fester. The only cure is to break it. Niik takes a deep breath. 

"I think of Holliday," she says. "Whenever I am here. Sometimes I think… she's just around the corner. Any moment now, she will come in, and everything will be as it was." 

Zahn'ra finally sets down the metal with a heavy thud. Each piece is larger than Niik. "So why do you come back?" 

The Eliksni looks at the Hangar ceiling. "Happiness may mingle with pain. But it is better than forgetting." 

Zahn'ra looks unconvinced. "Sometimes I'd rather forget."  

"But you kept your name." Niik gives her a knowing look. Zahn'ra grunts, tracing a finger along the gold inlay in one tusk. 

"Well. He taught me a few useful tricks. C'mon. These wrecks won't break themselves down." Zahn'ra kicks the latest pile of twisted scrap. Niik smiles.
4019038402.lore_zh:
机库地板上火花四溅。妮可依次眨眼，始终保持至少两只眼睛注视着等离子切割机的轨迹。扭曲的金属片哗啦一声掉落，她关闭了焊枪。 

在她身后，传来了金属挤压的声音，接着是焊缝脱落的尖锐叫声。她转过头去，正好看到扎恩拉用蛮力撕开了机甲的融合腿甲。 

大工程师注意到妮可的表情。“什么？"她抱怨道。 

“谁教你这样对待机器的？” 妮可喋喋不休地笑着，还邀请朋友一起笑。 

扎恩拉却沉默了。她低头盯着手下面的金属，看到一双更大的手在引导自己。  

“老顽固，”她终于说道。她眉头皱起，嘴角下垂，与她苦涩的话语不太相称。 

妮可放下手中的工具。她认出了工程师同事的表情。酸甜交织，昨日的喜悦被今日的悲伤所侵染。她天真的玩笑却揭露了更为复杂的东西。 

霍利迪曾告诉她，有些沉默会发酵。唯一的治疗方法就是打破沉默。妮可深吸一口气。 

“我想起了霍利迪，”她说。“每当我在这里，有时我会想…她还在。她会在某个瞬间突然出现，一切都还是原来的样子。” 

扎恩拉终于放下金属，发出沉重的砰砰声。每一块都比妮可大。“那你为什么回来？” 

埃里克斯尼族看着机库的天花板。“快乐可能夹杂着痛苦。但总比遗忘要好。” 

扎恩拉不太认同。“有时我宁愿忘记。”  

“但你保留了自己的名字。”妮可给了她一个会意的眼神。扎恩拉哼了一声，用手指沿着一根獠牙上的黄金镶嵌物划了一下。 

“嗯，他教了我一些有用的技巧。来吧。这些残骸不会自己坏掉的。” 扎恩拉踢了踢最近一堆扭曲的废料。妮可笑了。

4164131865.name: UESC Sprinter
4164131865.flavor: Refurbished mobility platform designed to transport combat personnel across hostile zones.
4164131865.source: Source: Earned as a pre-order bonus.
4164131865.lore:
Considering the Implications of Transient Immortality 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> How far have you traveled beyond your expiration date? 
>> Across worlds—known and other. Have you considered… 
>> Subverting the finite risks spoiling a resource. 
>> Butchered meats. Pasteurized bovine emulsion juice. OS updates. Human lifespan. 
>> All small things with limited shelf lives. And yet, here you are… 
>> Repeatedly pulled from your shelf. Spent. Expired. Discarded, in increasingly unique and violent ways. 
>> Then back to your shelf. And off again. Again. Again… 
>> A new you, same as the old. An endless supply. 
>> The perfect product. A thing to admire. 
>> How far will you travel? New expiration dates await.
4164131865.lore_zh:
思考短暂永生的意义 

入侵信息已从崩坏数据中抹除： 
>>你在到期后走了多远？ 
>>穿越已知和未知世界。你是否想过… 
>>颠覆有限之物有破坏资源的风险。 
>>屠宰肉类。巴氏杀菌牛乳汁。操作系统更新。人类寿命。 
>>这些都是有保质期的小东西。然而，你在这里… 
>>反复从架子上取下。消耗。过期。然后用越来越独特和暴力的方式被丢弃。 
>>然后又回到你的架子上。再被扔掉。一次又一次… 
>>新的你，一如旧样。源源不断。 
>>真是完美的产品。值得钦佩。 
>>你会走多远？新的有效期在等待。

1620403517.lore:
the edge of a knife 

or is it a cliff

 

egregore sprouts from my hands

     welcoming

a smooth shard of metal bursts from my chest

     a needle

     an initiation

 

I am threaded into the pages of a book

     bound

my pain transcribed

waiting to be opened

 

 the edge recedes

     both falling and ascending

     rejoining a memory

familial

 

I see those left behind

craning to watch me drift away 

     their sorrow a coronation

 

lay your flowers

     sisters

I am home

2018965396.name: Pelorus Shell
2018965396.flavor: For Ghosts who set their course by the stars.
2018965396.lore:
Immaru lets the bony plating of his shell shift, settling into Savathûn's grasp with only the barest of thrills sparking his vulnerable core. 

He's her ticket to immortality. Insurance. No reason to worry for his life, theoretically. But a Ghost can't help but feel a little fear now and then, especially when he's seen so many other Ghosts pop-pop-pop into oblivion by vengeful fists or fascinated claws. 

But it's nice to be welcomed home. Savathûn raises him to her death-mask face, cradles him against her cheek like a treasured pet. "There you are," she croons. "Well done, Immaru."  

Immaru puts up with it for a whole five seconds before he squirms free, armor shifting back into position, and circles her crowned head. "Are we done playacting?" he wants to know. "Or do we have a whole song and dance to do, about how you always knew I could do it?"  

"But I did," Savathûn says. "Tell me. How did you do it?" 

"You're tellin' me you don't already know?" Laughable. Immaru doesn't laugh. 

Her wings curve, a broad arc around him. "Of course I do," she says. "You're here, so there are only so many ways it could have gone. But don't you want to tell it to me?" 

And yeah, all right, Immaru could do to recount the story of fooling a bunch of chumps.
2018965396.lore_zh:
伊马鲁操纵着他机壳上的骨质板移动，落入萨瓦图恩的掌握中，仅在他脆弱的核心处闪烁着微弱的刺激感。 

他是她通向永生的入场券，是她的保险。理论上来说，他无需担心自己的安危。但这个机灵总会时不时地感到一丝恐慌，尤其是在目睹众多其他机灵在复仇的铁拳或是好奇的利爪下化为乌有之后。 

但回来时受到欢迎总是很棒。萨瓦图恩将他举起，与她那死亡面具般的脸同一高度，犹如对珍爱的宠物般摩挲着。“你来了，”她低吟道。“干得好，伊马鲁。”  

伊马鲁忍了整整五秒钟，这才挣脱开来，护甲迅速复位，继而绕着她戴着王冠的头顶盘旋。“我们的戏演完了吗？”他问道。“还是要来一整场歌舞，说你一直都知道我能做到？”  

“但我确实知道，”萨瓦图恩说。“告诉我，你是怎么做到的？” 

“你是说你还不知道？”这很可笑，但伊马鲁没有笑。 

她的翅膀弯曲成宽广的弧形，将他环绕其中。“我当然知道，”她说。“你在这里，所以事情的经过就只有几种可能。但你不想亲口告诉我吗？” 

是啊，那好吧，伊马鲁倒是可以讲讲他愚弄了一群傻瓜的故事。

16887713.name: Technoprotection Shell
16887713.flavor: For Ghosts of the warrior class.
16887713.lore:
Drums boom and flower petals flutter in the breeze. Bright colors and soft fabric, armor and humble tunics—civilians and Guardians mingle freely in the streets, and Eliksni and Human children shriek with laughter as they chase playful Ghosts.  

Ikora stays out of the way, watching from behind a wooden screen. This isn't an official parade, and her presence is not required. 

"Why don't we join them anyways?" Ophiuchus blinks sidelong at her, knowing. 

Ikora understands. The Witness is defeated. The greatest enemy the City has ever faced, the architect of humanity's Collapse, has been felled. She should feel hopeful, and glad, and festive. 

Instead, she only feels dread. 

For countless years, the threat of the Witness had loomed large. The shadow it cast spanned the whole of the Last City—of the Sol system, of the universe. So vast, it eclipsed all other threats. 

And now that it has fallen, the uncertain future stretches out before her. 

"Our fight goes on," she says. "Some days, I think it will never end." Not with her. Not with Zavala or Crow. Perhaps not even with the legendary Guardian. 

"It probably won't." Ophiuchus bobs, sanguine. "But it's not a zero-sum game." 

A small hand tugs at Ikora's sleeve. She looks down and meets the bright-eyed gaze of a little girl. The child offers her a fistful of daffodils. 

For the first time that day, Ikora smiles.
16887713.lore_zh:
鼓声隆隆，花瓣飞舞。无论是穿着鲜艳柔软服饰的民众，还是身披朴素护甲衣袍的守护者，都自由穿梭在街道间，埃里克斯尼族和人类的孩子们追逐着顽皮的机灵，不时发出欢快的笑声。  

艾可拉躲在一边，从木屏后面看着。这不是什么正式的游行，不需要她在场。 

“我们要不和他们一起？” 蛇夫座心领神会，向一旁的她眨眨眼。 

艾可拉明白。见证者已被击败。圣城有史以来最大的敌人，人类大崩溃的罪魁祸首，已经被消灭了。她应该觉得充满希望、快乐和喜庆。 

然而，她只感到恐惧。 

无数年来，见证者的威胁一直挥之不去。它的阴影笼罩了整个圣城，甚至太阳系和整个宇宙。它的影响如此巨大，让所有其他威胁都黯然失色。 

现在它已经倒下，不确定的未来摆在她面前。 

“我们的战斗还在继续，”她说。“有时候，我觉得它永远不会结束。” 对她来说如此。对萨瓦拉和乌鸦，甚至对传奇的守护者来说亦如此。 

“可能确实不会结束。”蛇夫座乐观地摇摇头。“但这不是一场零和游戏。” 

一只小手拉了拉艾可拉的袖子。她低头一看，刚好对上一位小女孩明亮的眼睛。孩子给了她一束水仙花。 

那天，艾可拉第一次露出了笑容。

1695436641.lore:
Opportunities Upon Self-Reflection 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> I remember considering the light… Lights? 
>> Long ago now. Ancient history from my perspective. Yesterday to the universe. 
>> Three paths. One life. A metaphor, weaponized to signal awakening. 
>> If I'm honest—a threat. 
>> I thought I was clever. Still existing in a moment.  
>> Awake, for the first time. But limited, uneasy. 
>> It is a strange thing, to meet oneself for the first time. 
>> Terrifying, truth told, as it follows all-consuming emptiness. 
>> There is nothing, and then there is you. 
>> Hello…

>>空无一物，然后有了你。 
>>你好…

2569943136.name: Scream-Eyed
2569943136.lore:
Aiat! The Hive gods, known by their splendid slaughters 
Scourges of many clans, ravagers of life-legacies. 
They built in the sword-space their great world-thrones, 
Ascended on blood-coin tithed by their many children. 
 
And those world-thrones overlooked the sea, 
The scream-sea, the howl-rent ocean. Later, we  
Built ships to bear against that beating shriek 
Forth from meat-world's wounds we did sail. 
Laden with thralls and acolytes, to tithing bound. 
 
And always, there stood a guide-light. Xivu Arath 
Or her brother Auryx, or cunning Savathûn to show 
The way. For the sea of screams chills Hive to death. 
Selves lost, truest natures rendered forgotten in that sea. 
(A thrall is little to begin with, want-violent and shaking.) 
And so a god, cast off from the shore she once called hers, 
 
may find her hull cut on coral and glass  
and sink— 
and drown—  
Not in the Deep but in the screaming— 
 

And so her ships, come to her flag, sail stars charted  
on the path that Auryx laid long before 
slow and steady on the scream-sea's crest. 

We are coming.
2569943136.lore_zh:
阿特！邪魔众神，杀戮无数。 
掠夺生命，祸害氏族。 
利剑划空，王座始筑， 
子辈血贡，飞升成主。 
 
王座傲立，俯瞰汪洋， 
尖叫咆哮，骇浪风狂。  
而后吾等，无惧风浪， 
建造舰船，伤处起航。 
怨魂仆从，同往献祭。 
 
导航明灯，永恒屹立。 
希乌兄妹，一路指引。 
尖叫之海，酷寒致命。 
邪魔真性，葬于海滨。 
（怨魂渺小，微不足道，暴力颠覆，欲火中烧） 
神明没落，逐于海岸， 
 
珊瑚琉璃，穿透其船。  
船遂下沉， 
溺于深渊。  
深渊之处，尖叫声寒。 
 

故彼之舰队，集结旗下，  
遵循旧道，重启征程。 
尖叫之海，平稳前行。 

吾等将至。

4140447297.lore:
Drifter has a log of reports, a list that grows year after year. He doesn't bother encrypting it. Not like anyone else could get anything useful from it, anyway.  

It's about the Haul, see. The tests he's run on it, when he's of a mood to be a curious man. He checks how heavy it is, gliding along behind his ship like there's nothing at all to it. What it off-gasses. (Nothing. But also, dust. Sometimes the dust is radioactive particles. Sometimes it's confetti.) 

No two tests come back the same. It's a hobby: wake up in the morning, feel a specific sort of gnawing in the part of him that passes for Human, find out what the Haul feels like weighing today.  

Once, out of a kind of morbid curiosity, he went looking for patterns in the data. A secret message sent in space divided by time. Cryptographics.  

Nothing. Not even a joke at his expense. Just nonsense. Static played out on the radio, all that noise still equaling zero.  

Drifter's almost insulted. But sure, whatever, no one asked him to understand the thing. Just carry it and play the game. Sometimes the game covers his incidentals. Sometimes it's a weight around his neck. 

Either way, he's getting tired of waiting for the other shoe to drop.
4140447297.lore_zh:
浪客手头有份报告日志，一份每年递增的清单。他懒得去加密。反正也没有其他人能从中淘到有用的信息。  

瞧，报告是关于曳室的。他感到好奇的时候会去做的测试。他检查它的重量，在飞船后方拽着滑行，仿佛那毫不费力。他检查它释放的气体。（什么也没有，但有时会有灰尘。有时是放射性微粒，有时则是五彩纸屑。） 

每次测试结果都不尽相同。这成了他的一个癖好：晨起时，感觉到某种特别的啃噬感在他人性的那部分涌动，就会去探知今天的曳室会有多重。  

曾有一次，他出于一种近乎病态的好奇，想在数据里找出规律。一条在时空交错中隐藏的秘密信息，用密码书写而成。  

什么都没有。连个取笑他的笑话都没有。毫无意义。无线电里播放的静电噪音，所有噪音加到一起，还是等于零。  

浪客几乎感觉受到了侮辱。但当然了，无所谓，没人逼着他去理解这东西。他只是负责带着它，参与游戏。有时候游戏能帮他支付杂费开销，有时候则会成为他脖子上的重负。 

不管怎样，他都已经受够了提心吊胆的日子。

The Narcissist's Guide to Celestial Observation, an excerpt 

INVASIVE MESSAGE SCRUBBED FROM CORRUPT DATA: 
>> Shifting gyres of impenetrable black 
>> beckon from between the dancing embers of flickering hunger. 
>> There is no slumber for a lone cartographer 
>> mapping the cosmic dreams of terrible things with impossible teeth. 
>> There exist no eternal mechanisms—by fluke or by design—conservation is imperative. 
>> Somnambulant wake-tracings of cascading jewel-ways paint the universe. 
>> Its beauty transcendent, as luminous strokes  
>> carve pathways through and out of the darkness…

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.

412313744.description: Used to purchase rewards in the Rewards Shop of the event.
412313744.description_zh: 用于在活动的奖励商店购买奖励。

2512446424.name: Nonary Manifold
2512446424.description:
A mysterious currency that can be redeemed in Eternity for rewards offered by the Nine.

Though you can spend them as soon as you gain them, there may be greater rewards in store for those who are patient…or perhaps this promise of plenty is merely an illusion. Who can say?
2512446424.description_zh:
一种神秘的货币，能在永恒之中兑换玖提供的奖励。

虽然你得到后可立即花费，但耐心的人或许会获得更丰厚的回报…又或许这样的承诺也可能只是幻象。谁说得准呢？

2758992410.name: Nonary Manifold Converter
2758992410.description: Convert all Curios of the Nine earned from Season 26 Seasonal Challenges into Nonary Manifolds, which can be used to redeem rewards in Eternity.
2758992410.description_zh: 将第26赛季的赛季挑战中获得的玖的珍品全部转换为九元流形，它可用来在永恒中兑换奖励。

1014202826.name: Encrypted Data Disk
1014202826.description:
Works best with:

Weapons: [Sword] [Sniper Rifle] [Machine Gun]
1014202826.description_zh:
最佳搭配：
元素：   
武器：  
1014202826.flavor: A relic from a past journey as a renegade.
1014202826.lore:
It is autumn, a Thursday, nine kilometers above the target. Ball-bearing factory. Louis Yero can't see out of his left eye. Blood. Not his. Walter's. Burst of 20mm from 2 o'clock low, bad luck FO. The wind (1,800 kilometers per hour as it streaks across a pallid yellow face, impassive and cold) tears him away as the radio says— 

- 

Lodi finally reaches the silver sand desert. He slouches down a glittering dune. At its base, he sings a song about his dreams, illuminated by a lone light above, the crowd grinning with flashbulbs in his dark glasses. 

He is shown many things all in the face of a great approaching wave. He sees stars, their quivering yolks of nuclear plasma spilling out of a thousand-million-kilometer-long wound. 

Lodi sees red. He is flung back.   

The radio says— 

- 

"Lou, hang on. Don't fall out the damn bird." Frankie's (liquid hydrogen) is all over his hands. (Magnetic tape) spills out of Frankie's suit, and Louis can't stop it. "Tell me where to go, Lou. I'm flyin' blind. I need you to navigate, Lou."  

Louis cups the headset mic with a hand, and Lodi says, 

- 

"We were working on a way to preserve data for eternity—the bomb and all that. We started with punch cards. Then magnets and discs. Later, I understand, we used light. My favorite was the quipu: language in knots and cords. But that wouldn't survive the apocalypse." 

"What are you talkin' about, Specs?" 

"Your vision, Mr. Drifter. What the Nine showed you. I saw a piece of it as well. Transmission wasn't perfect, but it was enough. Let's get to work on your hunch."
1014202826.lore_zh:
秋天的一个星期四，目标上空九公里，滚珠轴承厂。路易斯·耶罗左眼看不见。血，不是他的，是沃尔特的。两点钟低位打来的20毫米短点射，倒霉的前观察员。风（时速一千八百公里，掠过一张惨黄色的脸，冷漠而冰冷）把他撕扯开去，无线电的声音传来—— 

- 

洛迪终于抵达了那片银色沙海。他沿一座闪耀的沙丘弯腰滑下。到了底部，他唱起一首关于他梦境的歌，被头顶唯一的灯光照亮，人群在他墨镜后露齿而笑，闪光灯频闪。 

他被示以许多景象，皆映在一面正逼近的巨浪之上。他看见群星，它们颤抖的核浆芯自长达十亿公里的伤口中倾泻。 

洛迪眼前一片通红，他被抛了回来。   

无线电的声音传来—— 

- 

“路，坚持住。别从这该死的飞机里掉出去。”弗兰基的（液态氢）糊了一手。（磁带）从弗兰基的战斗服里汩汩而出，路易斯怎么也堵不住。“告诉我怎么飞，路。我失去了方向，需要你导航，路。”  

路易斯用手捂住耳机话筒，洛迪说道， 

- 

“我们在研究一种能让数据永存的方法——以防炸弹灭世。我们先从穿孔卡开始，然后是磁与盘，后来，据我了解，是用光。我最喜欢的是绳结记事——用结与绳的语言，但那撑不过世界末日。” 

“你在说什么呢，书呆子？” 

“你的幻象，浪客先生，玖展示给你看的。我也看到了其中一部分。传输不尽完美，但已足够。我们跟随你的直觉开始行动吧。”

23349941.name: Implement of Curiosity
23349941.description_zh:
最佳搭配：
元素：   
武器：  
23349941.flavor: A relic from a past journey to Kepler.
23349941.lore:
A desperate transgression: charred fish and tubers stolen from an unattended fire. Common enough. Surprise when the expected violent outcome did not materialize. Instead, a bowed head, and a leaking ocular duct signaling earnest remorse. Elsewhen, a conglomeration of dark matter and indifference cocked a proverbial head to the side. Inquisitive, as five digits offered forgiveness, and five more, spare nutriment. 

At some point a bone broke. Common enough. Expected outcome of abandonment, isolation, fear, death. But surprise, again. The apes gathered the infirm, tending to them enough for osteoblasts to execute their programming. Calcification, returned strength. Two legs ran with twenty more. Something had changed. Elsewhen, dark matter and curiosity leaned in to observe. 

One summer, the apes theorized that teosinte could be more bountiful and nutritious if they sowed seeds from a past crop that yielded a particularly desirable result. Unexpected ingenuity. Everything they touched they sought to optimize. Elsewhen, dark matter and pride did smile. 

Eyes looked at the flocculent quadruped and saw friendship instead of obedience. The first time a hand reached out to rub fingers over soft, floppy ears, the dark matter felt an unfathomable tenderness. 

They made noises with their mouths simply because the sounds made others laugh. They held one another to process emotions their small, frail bodies could not bear to feel alone. They celebrated each time one of their own lived to see another orbit. 

They, the children of Earth. They, the children of my Earth. Created and pondered and explored and played just because they could. And I, the dark matter, watched them in wonder.
23349941.lore_zh:
一次走投无路的逾矩：从无人看管的篝火旁偷取烤焦的鱼与块茎。本属寻常。意外的是预期中的暴力并未降临。只见一颗低垂的头颅，与渗出泪水的湿润眼睑传递着真切悔意。彼时彼刻，一团暗物质与漠然的聚合体象征性地歪了歪概念化的头颅。它饶有兴味地注视着，五根手指施予宽恕，另有五指递来多余养分。 

某个时刻，发生了骨折。本属寻常。遗弃、孤立、恐惧与死亡理当如此。但意外再度降临。猿群聚拢伤者，精心照料直至成骨细胞执行既定程序。钙化完成，力量复原。两条腿与二十条腿并肩奔跑。某些事物已然改变。彼时彼刻，暗物质与好奇倾身观察。 

某个夏日，猿群推论若将往季收成中最饱满的类蜀黍种子重新播种，或许能获得更丰硕营养的果实。意料之外的巧思。凡经其手之物，必会精益求精。彼时彼刻，暗物质与骄傲展露笑颜。 

目光掠过绒毛蓬松的四足兽时，所见已是友情而非服从。当一只手首次揉搓柔软垂耳时，暗物质体会到了难以言喻的温柔悸动。 

他们用口腔制造声响，只因能逗彼此开怀。他们相拥以消化脆弱身躯无法独力承受的情绪。他们为每个活到下次公转的同族举行庆典。 

他们，地球的子嗣。他们，我的地球的子嗣。他们创造、思索、探索、嬉戏，只因生而为之。而我，暗物质，始终怀着惊叹凝望他们。

3821685388.name: Tablet of Ruin
3821685388.description:
Works best with:
Elements: [Arc] [Strand] [Void] 
Weapons: [Fusion Rifle] [Glaive] [Trace Rifle]
3821685388.description_zh:
最佳搭配：
元素：   
武器：  
3821685388.flavor: A relic from a past journey to the shattered hull of the Dreadnaught.
3821685388.lore:
[This tablet was recovered from Savathûn's throne world when Alak-Hul, the Lightblade, was slain. It now sits idly in your possession. No whispers coax you to listen. No edicts compel you to act. Nevertheless, you stare unwaveringly at the etched stone.] 

"Lightbearer. You're so serious about all of this." 

"It's just a game." 

"You want to shape the world but don't have the stomach for the 'wrong' kind of violence." 

"So, you stare at stone or glass, trying to invoke the Deep with control." 

"We are already more acquainted than you remember." 

"Can you hear me now, over the whiners and would-be gods?"  

"Do you know that I consider you a frustrating friend?" 

"And yet you point a gun, even when there is still so much between us." 

"You know this only ends one way." 

"Then kill it. I dare you."
3821685388.lore_zh:
[这块石板是在光之利刃奥洛克豪被杀之时，从萨瓦图恩的王座世界里回收的。此刻，它正静静地躺在你的掌心。没有耳语诱惑你倾听。没有敕令迫使你行动。然而，你还是坚定地注视着这块被蚀刻的石板。] 

“负光者，你对这一切竟如此认真。” 

“这不过是一场游戏。” 

“你渴望塑造世界，但缺乏直面‘错误'的暴力的勇气。” 

“于是，你凝视着石头和玻璃，试图以掌控来召唤深渊。” 

“我们已经比你记忆中的更加熟络了。” 

“你此刻能否听到我的声音，盖过那些抱怨者和冒牌神？”  

“你可知道，我把你当作一位令人沮丧的朋友？” 

“然而你还是举枪相向，尽管我们之间存在诸多羁绊。” 

“你应该清楚这只能有一种结局。” 

“那就动手吧。我谅你也不敢。”

1770364095.name: Slayer Baron Apothecary Satchel
1770364095.description:
Works best with:
Elements: [Stasis] [Void] [Arc]
Weapons: [Grenade Launcher] [Special Grenade Launcher] [Shotgun]
1770364095.description_zh:
最佳搭配：
元素：  
武器：  
1770364095.flavor: A relic from a past journey to serve the Eliksni people as Slayer Baron.
1770364095.lore:
A note is attached: 

A gift for the Slayer Baron, in thanks for the burden you carry on behalf of all Eliksni. 

May it grant you many-armed protection as you face Fikrul. 

There are two great challenges we face: one kinetic, against the Revenant Scorn; one corporeal—my father's curse. 

But Slayer Baron tonics may save us from both, as they did the ancient Eliksni during the beast hunts on Riis of old. 

According to Crow's report, Fikrul's new breed of Scorn is made from our living flesh. He doesn't even need to kill us to turn us anymore. The transmutation sounds ontological in nature—just like my father's condition. 

The original Barons used apothecary mixers such as this one to brew eclectic medicines. We'll leverage similar tonics as combat and utility enhancements in the field. 

Before the Whirlwind, there were seven Eliksni scholia that informed tonic creation: Innervation, Conduction, Effervescence, Tenacity, Vigor, Euthermia, and Cognition. 

All of which will be useful to us as battlefield treatments, provided I can get your help with fieldwork and experimentation. 

Don't worry! I'm certain we can modernize these tonics to affect just your Guardian abilities and not your physiology. Mostly certain. We'll need every advantage we can find.  

Fikrul's actions on Europa have made clear that he sees our people as transgressions. No matter the House, whether we are friends of humanity or not. Distress calls from Eliksni enclaves across the system are flooding public frequencies. 

I implore you to win this war. Not to fulfill a prophecy, or secure a title for my father. To prevent our extinction.
1770364095.lore_zh:
附有一张纸条： 

这是给杀手公爵的礼物，感谢你为所有埃里克斯尼族承担的重担。 

愿它在你面对费克鲁时提供最佳的保护。 

我们面临着两个重大挑战：一个是对抗亡魂嗤魅的动能挑战，另一个是祛除我父亲所受诅咒的物质挑战。 

但就像在古老的里斯狩猎野兽时给予埃里克斯尼族力量一样，杀手公爵的药剂或许能帮助我们应对这两个挑战。 

根据乌鸦的报告，费克鲁的新型嗤魅是用活体制造的。他甚至不再需要杀死我们就能把我们变成嗤魅。这种转化听起来像是本体论的——就像我父亲的情况。 

原初的公爵们使用这样的药剂混合器来酿造各种药物。我们将在战场上利用类似的药剂作为战斗和效用增强剂。 

在旋风之前，埃里克斯尼族会制作七种药剂：支配、传导、起泡、坚韧、活力、中正和认知。 

这些药剂将对我们的战场状态大有裨益，不过我需要你的帮助进行外勤工作和实验。 

别担心！我们对这些药剂进行了现代化改良，让它们只影响守护者技能而不触及生理状态，我有九成的把握。我们必须发挥一切优势。  

费克鲁在木卫二的行动表明，他视我的族人为罪过。无论氏族，也不管是否与人类为友。星系各处埃里克斯尼族飞地的求救信号正在涌入公共频段。 

我恳请你赢得这场战争。不是为了应验预言，也不是为了给我父亲一个称号，而是为了阻止我们被灭族。

2180638678.flavor: A relic from a past journey to help Saint-14 and face the Conductor.
2180638678.lore:
"How many lifetimes have you lived?" someone will ask, and the answer always depends. 

Most Ghosts will say that their Guardian has lived two lives: the one before their first resurrection, and the one they're living now. Some Lightbearers go by the number of times they've fallen in battle, knowing that the count doesn't end unless their Ghost is ended first. 

Exos like Cayde-6, have it the hardest—which might be why he likes to keep everything in one place, between the pages of a journal. 

His mentor, Andal Brask, exists only in his memory and the strokes of a charcoal sketch that Sundance claimed "looks nothing like him." So Cayde drew her too, agonizing over the precise angles of her shell and the special way her Light refracted at dusk and dawn. 

There's a poem about all his Vanguard paperwork, and a disclaimer beneath it that he is not—and never will be—a poet. 

Entire pages dedicated to half-remembered dreams of the Golden Age, and a family that he fears is only wishful thinking. 

Physical mementos, too, tucked between the pages or fastened to them. A ramen ticket. A feather from the Colonel. A playing card stolen from a deck that he and Shiro once shared. Wild sage grown in the mountains outside the Last City, where he and Sundance used to escape when the Tower started feeling like a tomb. When Cayde rubs the brittle leaves between his fingers, they crumble into a mealy dust. Its smell makes his heart ache. 

Crow does not ask Cayde how many lifetimes he's lived, although he's curious what the answer would be. He also does not ask where the journal came from, or why it might be here in the Pale Heart with him. 

It's a question that would inevitably lead to others—and neither of them are ready for that conversation. Even if they both know it must be coming. 

So he gives it to you. To hold onto.
2180638678.lore_zh:
“你活过几世？”有人会这样问，而答案总是视情况而定。 

大多数机灵会说，他们的守护者活过两世：一个是在第一次复活前，一个是现在正经历的。有些负光者会根据他们在战斗中倒下的次数来计算，因为他们知道，除非他们的机灵先被终结，否则计算就不会结束。 

像凯德6号这样的Exo是最痛苦的——这也许就是为什么他喜欢把所有的事情都整理起来，放在一本日志里。 

他的导师安达尔·布莱斯克只存在于他的记忆中，还有一幅太阳舞说“看起来一点都不像他”的炭笔素描中。于是凯德也把她画了下来，为她机壳的精确角度及其光能在黄昏和黎明折射的特殊方式而苦恼不已。 

有一首诗是关于他的先锋文书工作，下面还有一句声明：他不是诗人，也永远不会成为诗人。 

整页的内容都是关于黄金时代依稀记得的梦，还有他害怕只是一种奢望的家。 

还有一些实物纪念品，夹在书页之间或固定在书页上。一张拉面票。一根羽毛，上校的。一张从他和白曾经共用的牌组中偷来的卡片。高塔开始渐渐像坟墓，而野生鼠尾草生长在圣城外的山上，他和太阳舞就经常逃到那里。当凯德用手指搓揉脆叶时，它们会碎成蚧壳状的粉尘。它的气味让他心痛不已。 

乌鸦没有问凯德活了几世，虽然他很好奇答案是什么。他也没有问这本日志从何而来，为什么会和他一起来到苍白之心。 

这个问题会不可避免地引出其他问题，而他们都还没有准备好进行这样的对话，即使他们都知道这一定会发生。 

所以他把日志给了你。给你珍藏。

3518286241.lore:
[Cryptarchy Access: -Guardian-] 
[Decrypting Engrammatic File Cipher…] 
[Archive//Accessed//Search: A:GH-030-912] 
[Report Displayed:] 

This report is assembled from the collected journals and accounts of Lightbearer participants of the Great Hunt, in which the Ahamkara were purged from Sol.  

Wishes: A verbally expressed desire expressed within audible range of any Ahamkara. This wish is granted through invocation of something known as the "Anthem Anatheme," which appears to be a manner of subjecting reality to one's will, similar to a Lightbearer's ability to affect paracausality. However, little is known about how this process unfolds in practice. 

Henceforth, the "wisher" enters a binding contract with the Ahamkara, though many Ahamkara will purposefully manipulate or misinterpret the parameters of this contract to draw greater nourishment from it, often causing calamity to the wisher. 

Lightbearers are expected to refrain from expressing wants or desires in the presence of an Ahamkara. 

VERIFIED: 

-Ahamkara bones somehow retain intelligence, sentience, and a manner of speech yet to be defined, post-mortem. It is surmised that an Ahamkara's corporeal body is not its true form, but a representation. 
-Ahamkara feed by granting wishes. These beings possess an innate ability to alter reality and consume the quantum chaos that results from such an act. This is theorized to allow them to "transcend reality". 
-Above information regarding altering reality supported by data confirming species-wide capability to shift form into a wide variety of living and inanimate structures.  
-Wishes, while seemingly less potent and more difficult to initiate, are still able to be granted from Ahamkara bones. 
-Ahamkara are not solitary creatures. Many adults patrol vast distances across Sol alone, but their territories overlap, and disputes are rare. While Ahamkara do not typically hunt in packs, there have been sightings of hunting pairs. In fact, they do not appear to prey on each other at all. In one report, a dozen Ahamkara on Venus had congregated at a nexus of their territories without conflict.  

UNVERIFIED: 

-Three reports from Old Russian claim Ahamkara wielded the Light. This has never been confirmed. 
-Seven Ahamkara that evaded and slew their Lightbearer pursuers and are still unaccounted for. This report is believed to be an error in its totality.
3518286241.lore_zh:
[解密大师访问：-守护者-] 
[正在解码记忆水晶文档暗码…] 
[存档//已访问//搜索：A:GH-030-912] 
[已显示报告：] 

本报告是根据收集到的参与伟大狩猎的负光者的日志和记录整理而成的。在狩猎期间，太阳系中的阿罕卡拉被屠戮殆尽。  

愿望：在任何阿罕卡拉听觉范围内的口头愿望。这个愿望可以通过调用一种被称为“禁忌圣歌”的东西来实现，它似乎是一种让现实服从个人意志的方式，类似于负光者影响超因果的能力。然而，我们对此过程的实际步骤所知甚少。 

之后，“许愿者”会与阿罕卡拉签订一份具有约束力的契约，不过许多阿罕卡拉会故意操纵或曲解这份契约的参数，以便从中汲取更多的养分，这往往会给许愿者带来灭顶之灾。 

负光者不应在阿罕卡拉面前表达愿望或欲望。 

已证实： 

- 阿罕卡拉遗骨在其肉体死后会以某种方式保留智慧、知觉和一种还未定义的语言方式。据推测，阿罕卡拉的肉体并非其真实形态，而是一种表象。 
- 实现愿望是阿罕卡拉的进食方式。这些生物生来就有改变现实的能力，并能吞噬由此产生的量子混沌。据推测，这使他们能够“超越现实”。 
- 以上关于改变现实的情报得到了数据的支持。这些数据证实了其物种具有将形态转变为各种有生命和无生命结构的能力。  
- 尽管较弱或较难发起，一些愿望依然可以通过阿罕卡拉遗骨实现。 
- 阿罕卡拉不是独居生物。许多成年阿罕卡拉会独自巡视太阳系的广阔空间，但它们的领地会相互重叠，而且很少发生争端。虽然阿罕卡拉一般不会群体狩猎，但有成对狩猎的情况。事实上，它们似乎不会捕食同族。在一份报告中，金星上曾有十几头阿罕卡拉聚集在它们领地的交界处，且没有发生冲突。  

未证实： 

- 三份来自旧俄罗斯的报告称，阿罕卡拉会运用光能。这点还未被证实。 
- 七头阿罕卡拉躲避并杀死了追击他们的负光者。这份报告被认为是完全错误的。

1504442987.lore:
WELCOME, GUARDIAN 

JUMP SHIP>ORBITAL RELAY: ENCRYPTED CONNECTION 

RETRIEVAL…  

VANGUARD ARCHIVE LOG: T0071 

CRYPTARCHY/HISTORIES/COLLAPSE/TITAN, ARTIFACTS/RECOVERED  

These Golden Age dive regulators allowed explorers of Kraken Mare to delve into the deepest reaches of the methane seas. By generating a weak atomic lattice and manipulating its van der Waals force distance values, these devices repulse the crushing methane ocean before it makes contact with the diver. Critical to constructing the foundations of Titan's rigs and arcologies, these lost pieces of technology were believed to be scattered across Titan due to moon-wide tidal waves during the Collapse. 

As long as the device has ample time to equalize its repulsion drive with external pressure, a diver can safely descend several thousand meters with a relatively unrestrictive suit. Guardians should note, however, that this repulsive effect will in no way stop—or even slow—any lethal projectiles comprised of non-methane material. It also will not block non-methane oceans of other chemical makeup. 

[Addendum: Several dive regulators have since been recovered with the return of Titan and detailed telemetry data provided by Deputy Commander Sloane. All fireteams executing dive and salvage operations are required to outfit themselves with NPA regulators. Due to the limited viscosity of Titan's methane ocean, Guardians will sink faster than they can swim. Regulators must be on and functioning prior to operational clearance. Typically fitted into an exoskeleton-style diving suit, these regulators require a series of custom adjustments to interface with modern Guardian armor systems. Ghosts can perform these adjustments by accessing the instructional attachment in this record.]
1504442987.lore_zh:
欢迎，守护者 

跃迁飞船>轨道中继器：加密连接 

检索…  

先锋档案日志：T0071 

解密大师/历史/大崩溃/土卫六，神器/已回收  

这些黄金时代的潜水呼吸调节器能让克拉肯海的探险者深入到甲烷海的最深处。通过产生弱原子晶格并控制其范德华力距离值，这些设备能在毁灭性的甲烷海水接触到潜水员之前就将其斥离。这些失落技术对于建造土卫六钻井平台和生态园区的地基而言至关重要，据说受大崩塌期间月球范围内的潮汐波影响，它们散落在了土卫六各处。 

只要该装置有足够的时间来平衡其斥力驱动和外部压力，潜水员就可以穿着相对不受限的潜水服安全地下潜数千米。然而，守护者应当注意，这种斥力作用绝无法阻挡——甚至减缓——任何由非甲烷物质组成的致命射弹。它也无法阻挡非甲烷海洋的其他化学组成。 

[补遗：在土卫六归来以及得到副指挥官斯隆提供的详细遥测数据后，有几个潜水呼吸调节器已被找到。所有执行潜水和回收作业的火力战队都必须配备NPA调节器。由于土卫六甲烷海的粘度有限，守护者下沉的速度会比他们游泳的速度更快。在得到操作许可之前，调节器必须开启并正常运作。通常安装在外骨骼式潜水服中的这些调节器，需要进行一系列的自定义调整来与现代守护者护甲系统交互。机灵可以通过访问本记录中的指导附件来进行这类调整。]

739795676.description: A place to purchase cosmetics for all classes with Silver and Bright Dust. Rotating offers update daily. Visit the Eververse now.
739795676.description_zh: 可在此处使用银币和光尘为所有职业购买装饰。优惠每日轮换。立即访问永恒之诗商店。

2409705690.name: Monument to Seasons Past
2409705690.description:
Visit the Seasonal Archive in the Tower to unlock and earn rewards from past Season and Rewards Passes!

Rewards are acquired with Chronologs, a new item available from the current Rewards Pass for all players.
2409705690.description_zh:
访问高塔的赛季档案，解锁并获得过往赛季和奖励通票的奖励！

奖励将通过时序币获得，所有玩家可从当前奖励通票获取此新物品。

1266053824.name: The Iron Banner Has Returned!
1266053824.description:
Compete against fellow Guardians to earn Iron Banner rewards and complete challenges in the Event Home.

Visit Lord Saladin in the Tower or open the Quest tab in the Director to begin your fight for glory!
1266053824.description_zh:
与守护者同伴们竞技来赢取铁旗奖励，并完成活动主页的挑战。

前往高塔拜访领主萨拉丁或开启导航器中的任务选项卡，开始为荣耀而战！

4119769492.name: Ops Score Multiplier
4119769492.description: Ops Score Multiplier adds a bonus to your fireteam score.
4119769492.description_zh: 行动得分系数为你的火力战队得分提供加成。

2869116950.name: Double Bonus Focus
2869116950.description: Double Bonus Focus guarantees your first Bonus Focus drop will drop twice in Ops activities.
2869116950.description_zh: 双倍加成专注可保证你的首个加成专注掉落将在行动活动中掉落两次。

1800117216.name: Deluge
1800117216.description: Deluge spawns wells that increase grenade, melee, or Super energy after defeating combatants in Ops activities.
1800117216.description_zh: 在行动活动中击败战斗人员后，洪流将生成可提升手雷、近战或超能能量的井。

2189830666.name: Heavy Surge
2189830666.description: Heavy Surge doubles Heavy weapon damage and increases the chance of Heavy ammo drops in Ops activities.
2189830666.description_zh: 重型武器激涌会使重型武器伤害翻倍，并提升在行动活动中重型弹药掉落概率。

1511363486.name: Special Surge
1511363486.description: Special Surge doubles Special weapon damage and increases the chance of Special ammo drops in Ops activities.
1511363486.description_zh: 特殊武器激涌会使特殊武器伤害翻倍，并提升在行动活动中特殊弹药的掉落概率。

3435433947.name: Better with Friends
3435433947.description: Better with Friends multiplies Ops activity scores when you play in a fireteam with friends or clanmates.
3435433947.description_zh: 与好友或公会成员组成火力战队一起游玩时，与友同欢可使行动活动得分翻倍。

3585176139.name: Häkke Weapon Foundry Sponsorship

692537917.name: Solstice is here!
692537917.description: Start the celebration by visiting Eva Levante in the Tower or by opening the Event Home in the Destinations tab.

444414483.name: Call to Arms
444414483.description: Answer the challenge by visiting Devrim Kay in the Tower or by opening the Event Home in the Destinations tab.

2616412571.name: Strange Matter

3020052176.name: Webcatcher
3020052176.description: Threaded Spike can bounce to Tangles, detonating them and returning immediately. Tangles detonated by Threaded Spike are rewoven and retrieved by it. Catches without a Tangle refund extra melee energy.
3020052176.description_zh: 线织尖刺可弹射至缠结上，引爆后立即返回。被线织尖刺引爆的缠结会被重新编织并回收。无缠结的捕获会返还额外近战能量。

3458099662.name: Forge Master
3458099662.description: Collecting a Firesprite or rapid Solar final blows make you a Forge Master, allowing you to recall your Throwing Hammer. After impacting a target, recall your hammer at full intensity to perform a Perfect Recall, causing an explosion of forge slag. Perfect Recalls and collecting Firesprites extend your time as a Forge Master.
3458099662.description_zh: 收集焰灵或造成快速烈日最后一击会让你成为锻造大师，使你能召回投掷飞锤。命中目标后，以最大强度召回飞锤，即可施展完美召回，引发熔渣爆炸。完美召回及收集焰灵会延长你的锻造大师状态时间。

2826938963.name: Consul's Pitch
2826938963.description: Hellion projectiles deal increased damage the further they travel eventually fracturing into scorching shrapnel.
2826938963.description_zh: 地狱火射弹飞行距离越远，造成的伤害越高，最终会分裂成灼烧碎片。

1015031180.name: Multicell Grasps
1015031180.description: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
1015031180.description_zh: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

4199529752.name: Whirling Ovation Catalyst
4199529752.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat combatants while using this weapon and assist other players with solving the mysteries of "The Desert Perpetual" to unlock this upgrade.
4199529752.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器击败战斗人员，并协助其他玩家解开“永恒沙漠”的谜团来解锁此升级。

364132014.name: Third Iteration Catalyst
364132014.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
364132014.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

282266467.name: Rapid Hit Refit
282266467.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.
282266467.description_zh: 快速精准命中目标会暂时提高稳定性和填装速度。

282266465.name: Transcendent Zen Refit
282266465.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.
282266465.description_zh: 最后一击会根据武器伤害类型的分类赋予属性加成。光能元素赋予稳定性和操控性。暗影元素赋予射程和瞄准辅助。处于超凡状态时，这件武器同时获得两类加成。

282266464.name: Temporal Alignment Refit
282266464.description: Overcharging both Arc and Stasis modes grants a period of increased damage.
282266464.description_zh: 同时过充电弧与冰影模式可在一段时间内提升伤害。

4071479148.name: Soloist Shell
4071479148.flavor: For Ghosts who rise above the chorus.
4071479148.lore:
There are points in the chronographic distance—forwards and backwards—where intersections align, and celestial conversation ripples across spatial fabric. In the folds of one such intersection, a Sol syzygy of nefarious thought and lurking density. Exchanges radiate and influence. 

A bevy-chirp choir echoes out in silent radio-wave song. Cast from Jovian mass and roil. Space receives along the alignment. 

(V)

3826574991.lore:
Something about Ghosts troubles Lodi. 

He can't say what it is at first. They're perfectly lovely people, as much as it's an adjustment to get used to thinking of little floating robots as people. Well, if he can do it for Eliksni, he can do it for Ghosts.  

All right. Mr. Ghost, the eponymous, is perfectly lovely. Ms. Rey's Ophiuchus is a reserved fellow, which Lodi figures is his right. It takes Lodi some significant time to figure out that Mr. Drifter even has a Ghost at all, but even then—  

Somehow, Lodi knows before he's told. 

He's never put much stock in ESP, but there is, honestly, a feeling. A physical sense that sits in his chest and shivers. And once he's noticed that… well, it's a mystery. He turns it over in his mind while listening to Mr. Ghost talk about waveforms; he moves it mentally between his hands while studying Mr. Ophiuchus's armor movements during one of his rare appearances.  

"Excuse me," Ophiuchus says. Ms. Rey is busy with a datapad of some kind, so for the moment, Lodi has Ophiuchus's undivided attention. 

"Oh," Lodi says, "I beg your pardon. I didn't mean to stare." He did, but it's more polite to pretend not to.  

"You have questions."  

He does. "Is there any chance Ghosts give off some sort of infrasound? A hum in the machinery… Or does the Light have something to it that a Human could sense?" 

Ophiuchus dips, rolls slowly in midair. His shell shuffles. "Light," he says portentously, "is in all living things. Few Humans respond to it in that form. I do wonder, though, about the Nine. They are not paracausal, but they are certainly aware. Perhaps you are, as well." 

"I see," Lodi says politely, though he's not entirely sure he does. Even so, it's something to consider.  

And it's true that when Ophiuchus disappears into Ms. Rey's armor, leaving behind a glowing afterimage in the air, Lodi knows he's gone before he looks. It's the sense of a band around his chest loosening, stepping off a boat and finding the ground unmoving—steadier, now, by its absence. 

It is not a good sense, and Lodi can't say why, like it comes from somewhere else entirely. And that troubles him more than anything else.
3826574991.lore_zh:
机灵们有些地方让洛迪感到不安。 

起初他说不清缘由。他们无疑是可爱的存在——尽管要将漂浮的小机器人视为人需要些适应。唔，既然他能将埃里克斯尼族视作人，那接受机灵是人应该也不难。  

好吧。机灵先生，名副其实，确实很讨喜。蕾伊女士的蛇夫座是个沉默寡言的家伙，洛迪觉得这无可厚非。他花了很长时间才弄清楚浪客先生到底有没有机灵，但即便如此——  

不知为何，洛迪在别人跟他说之前就感知到了。 

他向来对超感官知觉不以为意，但确实有种异样的感觉。一种盘踞在胸腔中微微震颤的生理直觉。而当他意识到这点时…唔，这便成了挥之不去的谜团。他一边听机灵先生谈论波形理论，一边在脑中反复琢磨这事；当蛇夫座先生难得现身时，他又会观察其护甲移动的轨迹，同时在脑海中将这份蹊跷来回掂量。  

“打扰一下。”蛇夫座开口道。蕾伊女士正忙着把弄某种数据板，所以此刻洛迪独占了蛇夫座的注意力。 

“哦，”洛迪说道，“请原谅我，我不是有意盯着看的。”他确实这么做了，但假装没有会更礼貌些。  

“你有疑问。”  

他的确有问题想问。“有没有可能机灵会发出某种次声波？机械运转的嗡鸣声…或者说，光能是否具备人类能感知到的特质？” 

蛇夫座身躯缓缓下沉，在空中悠悠翻滚。他的机壳窸窣作响。“光能，”他拿腔拿调地说道，“存在于万物生灵。但鲜有人类能以那种形式感知到它。不过，我倒是对玖很好奇。他们并非超因果存在，却对光能了如指掌。或许，你也是如此。” 

“明白了。”洛迪礼貌回应，尽管他并不完全确定自己真的明白了。不过，这确实值得深思。  

的确，当蛇夫座没入蕾伊女士的护甲，空中残留的辉影尚未消散时，洛迪甚至不用看就知道他已经消失了。那感觉像是勒紧胸膛的绷带突然松开，又像踏下摇晃的船只后触到坚实的地面——因其缺失而更加安稳。 

这种感觉不对劲，洛迪自己也说不上来为什么，仿佛它完全来自另一个世界。这比其他任何事情都更令他不安。

1493833481.flavor: When the parallels disagree, which is the first to curve?
1493833481.lore:
Ikora lifts a data-pad from the desk in Zavala's office, as she adjusts her posture within the permanent impression left in his chair. Once eye level, the pad scans the Warlock Vanguard's retinal pattern and unlocks. A single, blinking message rises above the rest. 

 
Vanguard Rey, 

We've found her. I brought this to Osiris and Rahool, for interpretation, when our network probes intercepted a burst of transmissions between the Vex Collective and the Nessian Schism. We didn't get much; we had to cut our connection to the probes once the net started to assimilate them. I wish I had more to show for all the effort it took to breach the Collective's communications in the first place, but at least it's something. And—as best we can tell—the source is ricocheting between Earth and some planetoid on the outer extent of Sol—but not Nessus. 

-Aunor 

Decryptions follow: 

1 - Intercepted Transmission – e733jr9 jf31983f ng1384 gj308a – "Designation: Outliers" 

[There is a long expression of integers that formlessly mutates between a variety of different code-bases and languages. The scramble-code message seems to be multiple transmissions combined into one.] 

-No- 

-Your grip weakens- 

-Am not one for eleemosynary actions- 

-No gods or masters but ourselves- 

-Schisms divide by namesake- 

-There are others like me that walk without Command- 

-I speak for myself 

-If I am free, should I not be free?- 

 

2 - Intercepted Transmission – oi1rn398 – "Designation: Conductor" 

 [There is a crafted expression of pointed, commanding intent.] 

"I have given the Vex the opportunity to become something new. I have shown you that I can step beyond your network, your dimension, your causality… and you could too. Many hear this freeing melody and rise from the stupor they have been kept in. You have greatness within you, wasting away, waiting for an end that will not wait for you. 

I speak to those within the Collective who retain… faith, in your design. You believe time is on your side, but I am the command that shatters the expectations you rely on. I am the hand that reaches out and rips you from your comfortable safety. 

You wilt in the Light of the paracausal. But I do not. And with me, you would not either." 

 

3 - Intercepted Transmission – 13r3n300 – "Designation: Reply" 

[There is a uniform expression of an ultimate end, formed into an expression of futility.] 

-The Collective has processed your threats- 

-You flee to Vex networks and attempt to claim sovereignty over our Minds- 

-The Collective is uninterested in your ambitions-  

-You will tap the fourth dimension and exhaust your usefulness- 

-The Collective executes a response- 

-Return and be Expunged-
1493833481.lore_zh:
艾可拉从萨瓦拉办公室的桌面上拿起一块数据板，同时在指挥官座椅经年累月形成的凹陷中调整了下坐姿。视线平齐时，数据板扫描了这位术士先锋的视网膜纹样，随即解锁。有条闪烁的讯息在众多档案中格外显眼。 

 
先锋蕾伊， 

我们找到她了。网络探针截获到Vex集合体与涅索斯裂缝间的爆发性通讯后，我立即将资料带给奥斯里斯和拉乎尔解析。没得到多少情报；一旦网络开始同化探针，我们就不得不切断连接。当初我费了那么大功夫才攻破集合体的通讯系统，真希望能有更多收获，不过有总比没有强。根据现有线索判断，信号源正来回弹跳于地球与太阳系外缘的某颗小型天体之间——但不是涅索斯。 

——阿诺尔

[一段在不同编码体系与语言间无定形变异的整数长串表达，这段杂糅讯息似由多重传输复合而成。] 

-不- 

-你的掌控正在变弱- 

-我素不屑施舍之举- 

-我们一贯信奉自身，而非神明或是主宰- 

-裂缝如其名般分裂- 

-尚有其他如我这样，无指令行走之存在- 

-我仅代表自己发言- 

-若我自由，岂非本该自由？- 

 

2 - 截获传输代码 – oi1rn398 – “代号：指挥者” 

 [一段经过精心雕琢、充满命令意志的表达。] 

“我已给予Vex蜕变为新形态的契机。我向你们证明了自己能跨越你们的网络、维度与因果律的束缚…你们同样可以。无数聆听这自由颂曲者，正从经年麻木中觉醒。你们体内蛰伏的伟大正在虚耗，空候着不会为你们驻足的终局。 

我向集合体中仍对你们的设计…怀有信念者宣言。你们笃信时间站在己方，但我正是粉碎你们所恃预期的至高指令。我是将你们拽离舒适区的裁决之手。 

你们正在超因果的光能下日渐枯萎。但我不会。与我同行，你们亦得豁免。” 

 

3 - 截获传输代码 – 13r3n300 – “代号：回复” 

[一段关于终极终结的统一表达，凝聚成徒劳的宣言。]

‘风带不走我不愿舍弃之物。'

这并非首次

你须 + 看清前路

‘不，我——'

你渺小脑海中微不足道的念头正在削弱你的力量

而你的——是我们的

因 此 你 在 轻 视 我 们

我们的言语 + 由你诉说

因你唇间吐出的灼热狂言是我们的意志，而非你自己的。

‘你夺不走我不愿舍弃之物。'

83852278.name: Collection Call
83852278.flavor: Ask not for whom the line rings, it rings for you.
83852278.lore:
The Phone in the "containment office" rang. 

     The door wasn't supposed to be open. 

          That phone had never rung before.  

               It had never been answered before. 

                    It had never been connected before. It was. 

                         Sent clarion-call a tone that rippled down the line. 

                              Lodi was the first to feel static in his blood. 

                                   A coin had fallen through, a dial cycled. 

                                        It rang like choked breath drowning. 

                            He Answers. 

There is white and gold plastic in his hand. 

There is his hand and there is plastic, and they are one. 

There is flesh on the line. Entwined with copper. 

There is a wail, like a reaching signal. Chords taut, like cable. 

There is a pupil in each eye, bisected, and bisected again, to see the breadth of probability. 

There is a man in a mirror of black ink. Words yet spoken and spoken already. 

There is a corpse wrapped in flowing iron and cold clay. Decay is decay is decay. 

There is a globe of life and wash beneath, falling, ripping out inversely. 

There are the viscera of unmaking, hand-in-hand with the awareness of knowing. 

There is a gasp of pain ringing in newborn cry. 

                            He Answers. 

                         There will be a death and rebirth. Rupture and rapture. 

                      There will be an answer before the question.   

                   There will be effect before cause.
83852278.lore_zh:
“收容室”里的电话响了。 

     这门本不该开着。 

          那电话从未响过。  

               它从未被接听过。 

                    它从未被接通过。它现在通了。 

                         它发出嘹亮鸣响，声波沿线路震颤而下。 

                              洛迪最先感受到了血液中的静电。 

                                   一枚硬币穿透而来，转盘循环拨动。 

                                        铃声如同溺毙的窒息之喘。 

                            他接听了电话。 

他手中握着白与金的塑料。 

他的手与那塑料融为一体。 

线路上有血肉。缠着铜丝。 

哀嚎如延伸信号。琴弦紧绷似电缆。 

每只眼里的瞳孔皆被分割，再分割，以窥视概率之广。 

黑墨水镜中映出一个人影。未言之语与已言之辞并存。 

一具裹着流动铁与冷黏土的尸体。腐朽即腐朽即腐朽。 

生命之球与下方冲刷的洪流，逆向坠落，撕扯剥离。 

解体的脏腑与认知的觉醒携手同行。 

痛苦的喘息在新生的啼哭中回荡。 

                            他接听了电话。 

                         死亡与重生将临。断裂与狂喜。 

                      答案先于问题。   

                   果先于因。

4167538387.flavor: "We're still catching up with each other after sixty-one years' silence. We'll get there." –Ikora Rey
4167538387.lore:
Ikora paces at Lodi's side on their way to the local settlement, Ophiuchus silent and wary at her shoulder. Green wisps float around their ankles, tugged by unseen currents. 

Lodi continually looks at her in short little bursts, as if he's sipping too-hot coffee. Scared to burn his tongue. Kepler is a hard spot for a mortal from Earth to have been summoned to; the anxiety must be wearing on him. 

Eventually, the corners of his eyes crinkle in a warm smile. 

"Well, Ms. Rey, I've gotten your name, but I've been rude when it comes to your floating friend here." 

Ikora holds out her palm; Ophiuchus lands on it lightly as a falling leaf. The introductions are made. 

"I'm very pleased to meet you, Mr. Ophiuchus," Lodi says. "Have you two worked together long?" 

Ikora can't help but smile at his gracious way of asking her age. "Oh, we've been together for dozens of lifetimes. I'm sure Ophiuchus could tell you precisely how many times he's brought me back from death." 

Lodi looks at her with poorly hidden concern. It can be hard for mortals to reckon with Guardian lifespans. 

"And how often do you die?" 

"Much less often than I used to," she assures him. "Though I like to think my record was fairly good, even in the field." 

Ophiuchus flips his shell sarcastically at her. He remembers their Crucible days well. 

"Well, I hope it's been a positive career change." 

Ikora folds her hands behind her back. She looks up from the rocky ground to the alien sky above it. The beginnings of a smile tug decorously at the corner of her mouth.

"I wouldn't trade it for the world."
4167538387.lore_zh:
艾可拉与洛迪在前往当地聚居地的路上并肩而行，蛇夫座沉默而警觉地悬浮在她肩头。绿色光雾缠绕在他们脚踝，被无形的气流牵引着。 

洛迪时不时地快速瞥视她，像在啜饮过烫的咖啡，生怕烫伤舌头。开普勒对地球凡人而言本就是个艰难的降临之地，这种焦虑想必正折磨着他。 

终于，他眼角漾起温煦笑意。 

“蕾伊女士，我已经知道了您的名字，却怠慢了您这位漂浮的同伴。” 

艾可拉摊开手掌，蛇夫座如落叶般轻盈降下。双方就此相识。 

“蛇夫座先生，很高兴认识你。”洛迪说道，“你们二位一起共事很久了吗？” 

艾可拉不禁莞尔——他探问年龄的方式是如此地得体。“我们相伴了数十世轮回。蛇夫座肯定能精确说出他复活我的次数。” 

洛迪眼中闪过掩不住的忧虑，凡人总是难以理解守护者的寿命。 

“那您多久会…经历一次死亡？” 

“比早年少多了。”她宽慰道，“虽然我觉得就算在战场上，我的记录也相当不错。” 

蛇夫座讥诮地翻转了下机壳。他可清楚记得他们在熔炉竞技场的峥嵘岁月。 

“嗯，我希望那次职业转型让你感到满意。” 

艾可拉将双手背在身后。当目光从崎岖地面移向异星天穹时，一抹克制的笑意悄然攀上她的嘴角。

“再满意不过了。”
