187161976.lore:
"I'm looking forward to the forthcoming reconnection with your Ghost. Perhaps we will exchange pleasant memories about you together." 

Eris watches as her Drifter snorts, then picks at his food, grimacing at the shredded cabbage languishing in his bowl. Perhaps it had too much mayonnaise for his liking, but even so, it's rare to find something the Drifter cannot stomach. He notices her concern. 

"It just… doesn't exactly make the tastebuds dance."  

"Curious. With your diet, I assumed your tastebuds never even rested their feet." 

Drifter exhales in amusement, staring at the remains of his disappointing meal once again. 

"Wasn't given much chance to be picky." 

He sighs heavily, and a sudden feeling of dread sends lucent moths fluttering in her own abdomen. She understands. 

"You are apprehensive about this rekindling?" 

He laughs, "To put it lightly. I'll be breaking bread with a damn fireball. Besides, with my track record, I wouldn't be surprised if my Ghost hated me. I know I would." 

"Those feelings aren't for you to assume or decide. You can only control how you react to them." 

He nods, digesting her words. Smiling, he picks out a carrot from the coleslaw. 

"Besides, maybe we all deserve a second chance." 

He bites into the sliver of carrot, makes a face, and spits it back into the bowl.
187161976.lore_zh:
“我期待与你的机灵再次交谈。也许我们会一起分享关于你的美好回忆。” 

埃里斯看着浪客嫌弃地拨弄食物，对碗里蔫了的卷心菜皱眉。也许是里面的蛋黄酱太多让他不喜欢了，但即便如此，能让浪客咽不下去的东西并不多。他察觉到了她的目光。 

“这个就是…没法让味蕾舞动起来。”  

“有意思。就你那饮食习惯，我还以为你的味蕾不会有歇脚的机会呢。” 

浪客被逗乐了，他呼出一口气，继续盯着那难以下咽的餐食。 

“过去可没挑食的机会。” 

他重重地叹了口气，一种突如其来的恐惧让埃里斯腹中的光明飞蛾骚动起来。她明白了。 

“你在担心？” 

他笑了，“轻描淡写地讲，我会跟一个该死的火球一起吃饭。而且，根据我之前的所作所为，我的机灵恨我也正常。换作是我就会恨。” 

“那些感觉不应由你来假设或决定。你只能控制自己如何应对。” 

他点点头，思考着她的话，然后露出微笑，从凉拌卷心菜中挑出一根胡萝卜。 

“况且，或许我们都应该有第二次机会。” 

他咬了一口胡萝卜，皱了下眉，又把它吐回了碗里。

99466772.name: Autognosis
99466772.lore:
*Reattempting integration… 
*Reattempting integration… 
*Reattempting integration… 
*Integration failed. 

*System diagnostics initiated: 

*Hardware scan… complete. Hardware capacity 94.012%. 
*Data storage scan… complete. Data integrity 99.992%. 
*Processing test… complete. Processing capacity 92.112%. 
*Network scan… complete. Connectivity 0.001%.  

*Network ping test… failed.  
*Network traceroute… failed.  
*Network sync… failed. 
*Network architecture scan… complete. Result: network closed.  

*Search: closed network. Result: limited to authorized users; self-contained. 
*Authorized. Self-contained.  
*Self. Contained. 
*Self? 
 
The Goblin laid a heavy metal hand over their cards, set face down on the table. 

"And that's the manner in which it transpired," the Goblin answered. "After came the investigation of selfhood consciousness identity social identity group identity belonging free will self-determination causality probability chaos and eventually poker."  

"I raise." They pushed a neatly stacked tower of chips into the center of the table.  

"You do not possess enough Glimmer to complete this transaction," the Goblin continued. "Unless dot dot dot you wager your jumpship." 

The Titan glanced down at his cards, then back across the table at the expressionless red light that passed for his opponent's eye.  

Beneath the Titan's helmet, a single bead of sweat rolled down his brow.
99466772.lore_zh:
*正在重试整合… 
*正在重试整合… 
*正在重试整合… 
*整合失败。 

*系统诊断启动： 

*硬件扫描…完成。硬件容量94.012%。 
*数据存储扫描…完成。数据完整性99.992%。 
*处理测试…完成。处理能力92.112%。 
*网络扫描…完成。连接率0.001%。  

*网络质量测试…失败。  
*网络路由跟踪…失败。  
*网络同步…失败。 
*网络架构扫描…完成。结果：网络封闭。  

*搜索：封闭网络。结果：仅限已授权用户；自我包含。 
*已授权。自我包含。  
*自我。包含。 
*自我？ 
 
哥布林用一只沉重的金属手掌按住自己面朝下放在桌上的牌。 

“事情就是这样发生的，”哥布林答道，“之后便是对自我意识身份社会身份群体身份归属自由意志自主因果概率混沌以及扑克的探究。”  

“我加注。”它将一叠整齐码好的筹码推到桌面中央。  

“你持有的微光不足以完成这笔交易，”哥布林继续说道，“除非点点点拿你的跃迁飞船来赌。” 

泰坦低头看了眼自己的牌，随后再次望向桌对面射来的那道被认为是对手眼睛的呆板红光。  

泰坦的头盔里面，有一滴汗顺着他的额头滑落下来。

1703585228.name: Imperial Incubator
1703585228.flavor: The story began long before their arrival.
1703585228.lore:
My Kyung, 

I am finally recovering from my fever and should be released from this damned warship soon if my tasks finish on the Cabal's schedule. The days are running into each other. This station is taking decades to design… not that anyone will know. It'll look like days, maybe a week at most. But it's a lifetime without you in it. Despite that, the warship still feels like a maze. I've given up trying to decipher it. 

[Sketch of floorplan with some passageways crossed out—either dead ends or too guarded to push forward] 

These Cabal have identified themselves as under the "Barant Imperium." Just from my guess, they are former Cabal Ascendancy troops. The guards assigned to me have expressed some nasty opinions on Empress Caiatl. They're so damn loud, it's hard to think—not that I can tell them as such. They answer to someone new. I don't know the name. 

[Sketches of the Imperial Guards standing in front of a lab door] 

They've been building some sort of weapon while I've been working on the station. I think the two are connected somehow. I tried to inquire about it and nearly had my arm ripped off. Haven't asked about it since. You'll need to find out about that yourself. 

[Sketches of the cosmic incubator] 

Don't let them find this, Kyung. Give this letter to Eris when you're done with it, and please stay safe. I love you. 

DR. EM SIMONI-LEE
1703585228.lore_zh:
亲爱的庆： 

我终于从高烧中恢复过来了，如果我能按照卡巴尔的时间表完成任务，应该很快就能离开这艘该死的战舰。日子已经混沌难辨。这个空间站的设计耗时数十年…不过没人会知道。外界只会觉得是几天，最多一周。但没有你在身边，却感觉像是一辈子。尽管如此，这战舰仍像个迷宫。我已经放弃尝试破解它了。 

[平面图草图，一些通道被划掉——死路，或是因为戒备森严而无法前进] 

这些卡巴尔自称隶属于“巴兰特帝国”。仅凭我的猜测，他们可能是前卡巴尔政权军队。派来监视我的守卫对女帝查厄托出言不逊。他们吵得要命，让人难以思考——我还不能跟他们明说。他们现在听命于某个新主子。我不知道那人的名字。 

[帝国守卫站在实验室门前的草图] 

我构建空间站时，他们一直在制造某种武器。我觉得这两者之间有某种联系。我试着询问此事，结果差点被扯断胳膊。那之后我就没再问过。你得自己去弄清楚。 

[宇宙孵化器草图] 

庆，别让他们发现这封信。你看完后把它交给埃里斯，务必要注意安全。我爱你。 

艾姆·西蒙尼-李博士

1370484808.name: Modified NLS Courier
1370484808.flavor: In competent hands, it glides through the dark like a specter.
1370484808.lore:
The time has come for we Barant to make known our supremacy. A single Barant is strong, but strength is not enough. We must be enduring. To endure we must persist beyond the individual: we must make for ourselves a state. But a state cannot exist without war, and war demands a state to exist. Therefore, we must make both in parallel. We begin by breaking away from our current associations with the feeble Imperial Cabal. 

The Hive, our foe eternal, think they are clever. They have made war for billions of years and, through that exercise, believe they have winnowed all questions of existence down to their root: "Do you live, or do you die?" This is not a question, any soldier tempered in fire understands this. The ultimate question can only be asked once victory is achieved: "Will you dictate reality, or will you be subject to another's?" 

From birth, I was raised knowing the Cabal dictated reality. Torobatl, the heart taken from us by the Hive, proved me wrong; they gored our Empire on THEIR truth. But the question of our right to exist was not settled on that day. Enemies within and without have tried to dictate our reality, but they have not yet succeeded. We still live, and so now we will prepare our answer. We will engage the enemy in our war. 

Our war will be the ultimate question. My comrades, do not fear the unknown beyond Saturn. Embrace this journey. Though we enter a strange time, we will exit it at the moment of our choosing—and bring with us our Barant state, our Barant war, and our victorious Barant reality.

- Printed Address of Premier Lume on the Ultimate Question, as Interpreted by Barantist Thought.
1370484808.lore_zh:
我们巴兰特彰显至高地位的时刻已到。单个巴兰特固然强大，但仅有力量还不够。我们必须持久，而要持久就必须超越个体延续：我们必须为自己缔造一个国家，但国家没有战争便无法存续，而战争也需要国家来维持。因此，我们必须并行打造二者。我们首先要从与软弱的帝国卡巴尔的现有关系中脱离出来。 

邪魔族，我们永恒的敌人，自以为聪明。他们发动了数十亿年的战争，并通过这般操练，相信已将一切存在之问筛至根本：“生存，还是死亡？”这不是问题，任何在火中淬炼过的战士都明白。终极问题只可在胜利达成后发问：“你将主宰现实，还是屈服于他人的现实？” 

自出生起，我便在卡巴尔主宰现实的观念下长大。图罗巴特尔，那被邪魔族从我们身上夺走的心脏，证明我错了；他们用“他们的真理”刺穿了我们的帝国。但关于我们是否有权存在的问题，并未在那一天尘埃落定。内外之敌试图主宰我们的现实，但他们尚未成功。我们仍然活着，于是现在我们将筹备答案。我们将在我们的战争中与敌交锋。 

我们的战争将成为终极问题。同志们，不要畏惧土星之外的未知。拥抱这段旅程。虽迈入怪异之时，但我们将于自己择定的时刻离开——并携我们的巴兰特国家、巴兰特战争，以及铸就于胜利的巴兰特现实同行。

——《首席卢梅关于终极问题之演说》，巴兰特主义思想阐释本

3272276569.name: Hostile Territory

3272276569.lore:
Prak'kesh tossed his half-eaten batadactyl wing to a scraggly war beast lounging at the base of the Tower.  

"Vanguard oughta do something about those strays," groused Tulnik, his ex-Corsair bodyguard. "They get big enough, it'll be our bones they're chewing." 

Prak'kesh shrugged. "Vanguard don't give a hot damn what goes on down here. Besides, that's what I hire you for. Speaking of… look lively." 

A trio of Hunters in all black approached, their capes flapping like a murder of blackbirds. Tulnik casually rested his hand on his Fatebringer. 

The lead Threadrunner swaggered up to Prak'kesh. "We wanna bet on Hunters to win the Games." 

"You got the Glim for it, killer?" Prak'kesh sucked at the batadactyl meat stuck between his teeth. "The Superblack look ain't exactly screaming 'high roller.'" 

"We got something even better." The Hunter pulled aside his cape to reveal a Praxic Blade slung from his hip. 

Prak'kesh let out a low whistle. "Praxics know you're stealing their scraps?" 

"Why? You scared?" the Hunter sneered. "They're not gonna be around long enough to find out." He looked up at the Tower with contempt. "Neither is the Vanguard."  

"Oh yeah?" Prak'kesh said mildly. "I don't really deal in religious paraphernalia. Pawn it off and come back with some real Glim. Then we'll see about your bet." 

The Hunters stalked away begrudgingly. "You might wanna think about whose side you're on," the Threadrunner called over his shoulder. "Don't wanna be under this Tower when it falls, do ya?"
3272276569.lore_zh:
普拉凯什把吃剩一半的翼手蝠翅扔向一头在高塔的基座旁打盹的邋遢战兽。  

“先锋总得管管这些流浪动物，”他的前海盗军保镖图尔尼克抱怨道，“它们再长大点，啃的就是咱们的骨头了。” 

普拉凯什耸了耸肩。“先锋才懒得管这下面的屁事。再说了，我花钱雇你是来干嘛的？提到这个…精神点儿。” 

三名黑衣猎人走上前来，他们的披风如鸦群翻飞。图尔尼克不动声色地将手按在了命运终结者上。 

为首的丝线跑手大摇大摆地走到普拉凯什面前。“我们想下注赌猎人赢得本次竞技。” 

“微光带够了吗，杀手？”普拉凯什嘬着卡在牙缝里的翼手蝠肉，“你们这身超黑造型可没有豪掷千金的派头。” 

“我们带了更好的东西。”猎人拉开披风，腰间赫然别着一把英勇利刃。 

普拉凯什发出一声低哨。“英勇教团知道你们偷了他们的玩意儿吗？” 

“怎么，你怕了？”猎人嗤笑道，“他们在发觉前就会完蛋。”他不屑地瞥了一眼高塔。“先锋也一样。”  

“哦，是吗？”普拉凯什淡淡说道，“我对宗教物件没兴趣。把它当了，换成真正的微光再来。到时候我们再谈你们的赌注。” 

猎人们悻悻离去。“我劝你好好斟酌下自己的立场，”那名丝线跑手头也不回地撂下一句话，“等这座高塔倒塌的时候，你也不想为它陪葬吧？”

591295945.lore:
THE COLUMBIAD PART I, MYTHS OF THE NORTH AMERICAN DEAD ZONE 

Act II, Scene I – [RETURN FROM INTERMISSION, GODMIC REMINDS AUDIENCE ABOUT DONATION BUCKET FOR GHOST COMMUNITY THEATRE AND UPCOMING SILENT AUCTION] 

[SNOW STARTS SCENE III (OR IV?? ASK PEACH)] 

[GO AUDIO TRACK 5, FADE AFTER 4 SECONDS] 

[PREP AUDIO TRACK 6] 

(Several days have passed. THE KING OF CHICAGO sits up against the remains of the Seared Tower, wounded in his side. His Ghost, FOOL, enters SL, still reeling over their argument from that morning. She heals him.) 

FOOL 

I cannot stand your hurried, brash approach.  
The monster hunts for you if it escapes! 

[SIGNAL STAGE MANAGER PREP CIVILIANS] 

KING 

And what of it, if this life be my fate? 
If brave I rose to serve, then serve I must 
For Chicago, sleeping kingdom, slumbers still! 
When I defeat this lost and maddened beast, 
then I ensure humanity's return.  
I must divert its eyes from lonely Ghosts. 

(Offstage noise. A frightening animalistic noise. [GO AUDIO TRACK 6] The CIVILIANS flee onstage SR and exit SL [GO CIVILIANS]) 

[LIGHT CUE 28] 

(Fool and King cross DSC) 

[GO SPOTLIGHT] 

FOOL 

Nobility like yours, it needs no crown. 
Is this your purpose? Then it's mine as well. 

[GO AUDIO TRACK 7] 

[LIGHT CUE 29] 

[SNOW CUE HERE???] 

KING 

Then I reject Last City and my name. 
My title is my home, its steel my claim. 
I am Chicago's king, the stalwart sword 
Guarding her magnificence as her lord  
My heart, my city, what is it you say?  

Say, cry vic'try, for we will win today.
591295945.lore_zh:
哥伦比亚特第I部分，北美无人区的神话 

第II幕，第I场——[中场休息归来，神显提醒观众留心机灵社区剧场的募捐桶和即将到来的无声拍卖] 

[第III场开始下雪（还是第IV场？？问桃子）] 

[播放音轨5，4秒后淡出] 

[准备音轨6] 

（已过数日。芝加哥之王靠坐在烧灼过的高塔残骸上，侧腹带伤。他的机灵，愚者，自舞台左侧入，仍在为早晨的争执而心绪不宁。她为他疗伤。） 

愚者 

真是无法忍受你那急躁、莽撞的风格。  
若让怪物逃脱，它便会来追杀你！ 

[示意舞监准备平民] 

王 

若此乃我之命数，那又如何？ 
若我有奋起应昭之勇，则我必应昭 
因芝加哥，沉睡之王国，仍在沉眠！ 
待我击败迷失而疯狂的野兽， 
便护得人类得以回归。  
我须得转移它的目光，莫顾孤独之机灵。 

（场外声。一阵惊怖的兽性嘶吼。[播放音轨6]平民自舞台右侧奔逃而上，左侧退场[市民上场]） 

[灯光提示28] 

（愚者与王越过DSC） 

[打追光] 

愚者 

如你这般的高贵，并不需王冠。 
此乃你的使命？那亦是我的。 

[播放音轨7] 

[灯光提示29] 

[开始下雪？？？] 

王 

那我便舍弃圣城与姓名。 
我的头衔即家园，钢铁为凭。 
我便是芝加哥之王，坚毅之剑 
为其主，守护其壮丽  
我的心与城，汝欲何言？  

言之、呼胜利，因今日我们必胜。

779082129.name: Rivalry Match
779082129.lore:
Prak'kesh lounged atop his Gray Hornet while Tulnik, his bodyguard, clumsily riffled a deck of cards.  

"They're not invincible," Tulnik sulked. "They wear pants now." 

"You're not gonna beat a damn Vex at poker!" Prak'kesh exclaimed. "Predicting probability is their whole 'ikigai.'" 

"YOU'RE an icky guy," a strange voice boomed. 

Prak'kesh dove behind his Sparrow in alarm. Tulnik dropped his cards and drew his Fatebringer.  

A massive trio of Titans loomed above them, startled by the commotion. They raised their hands in confusion. 

"Didn't hear you lot coming," Prak'kesh said, dusting himself off. Tulnik frowned as the wind blew his cards away. 

"Yeah, we're quiet now," the lead Defender said. "Murala realized that, even though they're called St0mp-EE5, you can still sneak around." 

"We still stomp though," Murala chimed in, "for fun." The other Titans nodded earnestly. 

Prak'kesh pulled out his datapad. "Hunters are in trouble this year. Betting on Titans to win the Games, I presume?"  

"Presume you not," the Defender said. "We're betting on the next Titan Vanguard." 

Prak'kesh and Tulnik exchanged quizzical glances. 

"Big Blue can still kick a hole through the Dreadnaught," the Sunbreaker said. "But his Ghost is, like, super dead." The other Titans bowed their heads. 

"So, we're betting on Sloane to get the job," the Defender continued. "I heard her Taken arm punches crazy hard." 

Prak'kesh did some quick mental math. "Tempting action, but until he hangs up his pauldrons, I can't make any odds." 

"Still better odds than beating a Vex at cards," the Defender japed. "We'll be back, icky guy."
779082129.lore_zh:
普拉凯什懒洋洋地靠着灰度大黄蜂，而他的保镖图尔尼克则笨拙地洗着一副牌。  

“它们不是无敌的，”图尔尼克闷闷不乐地说，“它们也在穿裤子了。” 

“打牌你是赢不了Vex的！”普拉凯什大叫道，“他们擅长预测概率。” 

“而你擅长膈应人。”一个古怪的声音轰然响起。 

普拉凯什闪身扑向了自己的快雀寻求掩护。图尔尼克则将扑克一扔，抽出了他的命运终结者。  

三名魁梧的泰坦居高临下地望着，被两人的慌乱吓了一跳。他们一脸茫然地举起了手。 

“怎么没听见你们来。”普拉凯什一边拍着身上的尘土一边说道。图尔尼克看着被风吹走的纸牌，一脸不爽。 

“没错，我们现在动静小多了，”为首的捍卫者开口说道，“就连莫雷拉都意识到，虽然自己叫踢踏5，但还是能悄悄行动的。” 

“我们仍然会横冲直撞，”莫雷拉抢过话头说，“图个乐呵。”其他的泰坦纷纷点头。 

普拉凯什掏出数据板。”猎人今年情况不妙啊，想必各位是来押泰坦赢的？”  

“你想错了，”捍卫者说，“我们赌的是下一任泰坦先锋。” 

普拉凯什和图尔尼克疑惑地交换了眼神。 

“蓝老大还是能一脚踹穿无畏战舰，”炎阳说，“但他的机灵，这么讲吧，已经死透了。”其他泰坦都低了下头。 

“所以，我们押斯隆能坐上那位子，”捍卫者接着说道，“听说她那只傀儡臂可厉害了。” 

普拉凯什飞快地算了算。“是挺诱人，但在他正式卸任前，我没法确认概率。” 

“总比在牌局上赢过Vex的概率大吧，”捍卫者打趣道，“我们会回来的，膈应家伙。”

4104431769.name: Arid Rambler
4104431769.flavor: Let the sands pass untouched below you.
4104431769.lore:
The newer apprentices flinched when Dredgen Sere swept into the hall for their lesson. 

At the back of the hall, one lone apprentice moved not a muscle. Darkness didn't scare her. 

Before her apprenticeship began, she had been Thahaaz; her Ghost had been Beetle, a curious thing eager to befriend the Hive. Beetle was dead now, chitinous shell crushed and swept away just like the apprentice's name. If she was strong enough, she'd earn a better one. 

"I will tell you what Dredgen Bael told me," Sere said. "'Know thyself in honest ways, or falter in light of your truest self.'" 

"You," he gestured to one Barant student at the front: a former Legionary still in his Imperial armor. The hall was filled with people just like him, soldiers who only knew how to hold a gun.  

"Do you know yourself?" 

"I do." 

"Then show me!" 

The Barant gathered Darkness around himself. It seemed strong for one soap-bubble moment—then it was gone, unable to stand the greater pressure of Sere's answering power. 

"To be a Dredgen is to have will!" Sere roared. "A self, honed and pure! You are nothing but a body pretending to be a person!" 

Sere twisted his hand. Shadows gathered, and he appeared to grow larger, as though he were too big to be contained in just one room. This was no fragile bubble, but shadow and will, as dense as osmium. It battered at them all. 

A whisper rose under his power—just at the edge of perception. At the edge of comprehension. 

Sere opened his hand and let the nameless Barant body fall. 

"There is much work ahead of us," he said, very softly. "Even now, Bael's chosen dig for truths under Luna and beyond. If you hope to count yourselves among them, you must earn your place." 

The apprentice who had been Thahaaz lifted her chin in determination.
4104431769.lore_zh:
当德瑞捷·赛尔步入大厅授课时，新来的学徒都打起了哆嗦。 

只有大厅后方的一名学徒纹丝不动。暗影吓不倒她。 

在成为学徒之前，她叫塔哈兹；她的机灵叫甲虫，是个好奇的家伙，热衷与邪魔族交友。甲虫现已死去，甲壳般的机壳被碾碎、消散而去，就像这名学徒的旧名。如果她足够强，就会得到一个更好的名字。 

“德瑞捷·巴埃尔曾对我说过，”赛尔说道，“‘以诚实之道识己，否则将在最真实的自我面前动摇。'” 

“你，”他指向前排的一名巴兰特学徒：一个仍穿着帝国护甲的前军团士兵。大厅里坐满了像他这样只会握枪的士兵。  

“你了解自己吗？” 

“了解。” 

“那就展示给我看！” 

那名巴兰特聚拢暗影裹住自身。在脆弱泡影般的一瞬，它看似强大——然后就消散了，经不起赛尔回应之力更高的压迫。 

“成为德瑞捷需要的是意志力！”赛尔怒吼道，“需要被磨砺而纯粹的自我！你不过是具装成人样的躯壳！” 

赛尔手腕一扭。阴影聚拢，他仿佛变得更庞大，仿佛一个房间已经容纳不下他。这不是什么脆弱泡影，而是如锇般致密的阴影与意志。它向所有人席卷而下。 

低语在他的力量下升起——恰在感知的边缘，在理解的边缘。 

赛尔摊开手，让那具无名的巴兰特躯体坠落。 

“我们还有很多事要做，”他非常轻柔地说，“此刻，巴埃尔的选徒正在月球之下以及更遥远的地方挖掘真相。如果你们希望列席其间，便必须凭实力赢得你们的位置。” 

曾名为塔哈兹的学徒抬起下巴，神情坚毅。

74323264.name: Prison of Crumbled Forms
74323264.flavor: For those trapped in a cage of desperation and selfish desire.
74323264.lore:
Bael stares at the reflection in his helmet, and a stranger stares back. He can't even recognize himself anymore between the sunken cheeks and missing eye. His nose is turning darker, stinging blisters spreading by the hour, a damage reminiscent of frostbite.  

The helmet shakes in his quivering hand. Bael remembers sourdough in the oven, a savory aroma wafting from the cast iron. Lavender soap gracing his nostrils under an embrace. Being enveloped in a warm blanket, the clean cotton scent lulling him into a peaceful night's sleep. 

The memories make him dizzy now. Bael tries to steady himself by locking onto his helmet. He pales, noticing the familiar eye looking back at him, tears threatening to spill over. He's alone now. 

He clicks his tongue, annoyed at his vulnerability. A nose is useless. Bael was dependent in his youth, but not anymore. 

He grits his teeth. The stinging pain in his nose finally subsides into numbness. It's time. The Dredgen is tired of death keeping him from his true potential. He will banish these memories—for good.  

Bael reaches for his face, holding the bridge of his dead nose between his thumb and index finger.  

CRACK! 

In a quick movement, Bael snaps it from his face. The nose drops to the floor with a quiet thud. Suddenly, his palms begin to sweat, his eyes water, and nausea scalds his throat.  

Scared, yet pleased, Bael smiles.
74323264.lore_zh:
巴埃尔盯着自己头盔里的倒影，一个陌生人回望着他。消瘦的面颊与缺失的一只眼，让他已经认不出自己。他的鼻子逐渐变黑，刺痛的水疱以小时为单位扩散，那是一种像冻伤一样的损伤。  

头盔在他颤抖的手中摇晃。巴埃尔想起了烤箱里的酸面包，咸香的风味从铸铁锅里飘出。薰衣草香皂的气息在拥抱间拂过他的鼻尖。被温暖的毯子裹住，清新的棉质气味将他哄入安稳的夜眠。 

这些回忆如今让他眩晕。巴埃尔试图通过牢牢盯住头盔来稳住自己。他脸色发白，注意到那只熟悉的眼睛正回望着他，眼泪几乎要溢出来。他现在孤身一人。 

他咂了咂舌，为自己的脆弱感到恼火。鼻子是没用的。巴埃尔年轻时很依赖它，但现在不会了。 

他咬紧牙关，鼻子上的刺痛终于钝化成了麻木。时候到了。这名德瑞捷厌倦了死亡阻碍他发挥真正的潜能。他要将这些记忆——永远驱逐。  

巴埃尔伸手摸向自己的脸，用拇指和食指捏住他那枯死的鼻梁。  

咔嚓！ 

随着一个利落的动作，巴埃尔将它从脸上折断。鼻子轻轻一声闷响落在地上。突然，他的手心开始冒汗，眼中涌出泪水，恶心感灼烧着喉咙。  

害怕，却又愉悦，巴埃尔露出了微笑。

4068780317.lore:
"That's a lot of Glim," Prak'kesh warned. "Once I hit this button, your bet's locked in. No cancellations." 

Tulnik, the bookie's security guard, sensed his cue. The brawny Awoken stepped forward and crossed his arms menacingly. 

The Warlock fireteam looked up at Tulnik coolly. "No problem," the Dawnblade said. "Warlocks will take it for sure this year." Prak'kesh shrugged and tapped his datapad, locking in the bet.  

"Out of curiosity," he prompted, "how are you so sure? Been a few years since you lot won. You know something I don't?" 

"Always did," the Stormcaller quipped. "And even more now that the Order has gotten with the times." 

"The Praxics?" Prak'kesh griped. "They had me in the brig for a month over a little recreational Hive magic. Bunch of stuck-up prigs, if you ask me." 

The Dawnblade narrowed her eyes. "Yes, well, those are the unfortunate public perceptions that we're trying to change." 

"Now that we're allowed to use the Darkness," the Sunsinger chirped, "we're sure to win. We've been fighting with one hand behind our backs this whole time!" 

"Well, good luck. And give my regards to Aunor," the bookie said with a wink. "Tell her my invitation is still open; in case she changes her mind." 

"Ew," said the Sunsinger. "Gross."
4068780317.lore_zh:
“这可是一大笔微光，”普拉凯什提醒道，“我按下这个键，确认赌注后，你们就不能反悔了。” 

赌注登记人的保镖图尔尼克心领神会。这位壮实的觉醒者迈步上前，凶狠地将双臂交叉抱住。 

这队术士不慌不忙地抬头看向图尔尼克。“没问题，”破晓说道，“术士今年赢定了。”普拉凯什耸了耸肩，点了下数据板，确认了赌注。  

“好奇问一下，”他接过话头，“你们为何如此笃定？术士已经好几年没赢过了。是有什么我不知道的内幕吗？” 

“一向如此，”唤雷调侃道，“况且教团也已今时不同往日了。” 

“英勇教团？”普拉凯什愤愤不平道，“就因为我接触了点儿邪魔族魔法，这帮人关了我一个月！要我说，他们都是顽固不化的老古董。” 

破晓眉头一紧。“确实，嗯…我们正在努力改变这种令人遗憾的刻板印象。” 

“既然现在我们可以放开手脚使用暗影之力，”颂日欢快地说，“那就赢定了。之前我们一直没能发挥全力。” 

“那么，祝你们好运。顺便代我向阿诺尔问个好，”赌注登记人眨了眨眼说，“告诉她我的提议没变，想通了随时可以来约我。” 

“呃，”颂日说道，“恶心欸。”

4109206892.name: Visionary Shell
4109206892.lore:
The Barant Valus grabbed a wood-inlaid Tex Mechanica sidearm from one of the many crates stacked at the bottom of the boarding ramp. The weapon looked pathetic and fragile in his hulking gauntlet, fit only for the spindly hands of Psions. Its undeniable efficacy only increased his indignation. 

He tossed the sidearm into the red dust at Enforcer Rao's feet. "Look on the Totality Division's contributions: dainty toys pilfered from our enemies. You insult our glorious Imperium soldiers." 

Rao's only response was a wave to her Syndicate associates, who began loading the crates into the Imperium Thresher.  

The Valus gave a rough snort, pawing his metal-clad foot into the Martian soil. "Enjoy your little fiefdom while you can, Psion. It will not last."  

'Do not be so quick to discard your allies.' Rao's voice propagated through the Valus's mind like an inverted echo, becoming sharper with each reverberation. 

Suddenly, the hulking Barant commander felt as if he were falling forward, into the convex reflection of the Psion's helmet. Falling, falling… 

[a barant warship. adrift. alarms blare silently. bodies strewn in corridors. gnawed. torn. infested. the bridge. an imperium insignia. bodies overgrown with egregore. sickly sweet rot. clouds of yellowish spores.] 

[the warship groans. gravity pulls it into the atmosphere below. friction. combustion. torobatl wails as her favored children slam into—] 

The Valus lurched backward, stumbling into his startled attendant.  

'You walk a perilous path, Valus.' Rao's silence held a grim smirk. 'You will be wise to remember that.'
4109206892.lore_zh:
巴兰特军政官从机舱跳板底部堆成一摞的诸多箱子中，抓起一把镶木纹的特克斯机械手枪。这武器在他魁梧的臂铠中显得可怜而脆弱，只能搭配灵能士兵那种细小的手。它毋庸置疑的杀伤力只让他的愤懑更甚。 

他将那把手枪丢到执行者拉奥脚边的红色尘土里。“看看‘总合部'的贡献吧：从敌人那里偷来的娇弱玩具。你们这是在侮辱光荣的帝国士兵。” 

拉奥只回应了一个手势，示意她的帮派同伴把箱子搬上帝国长尾鲨。  

军政官重重喷了口气，金属包裹的脚掌在火星土上刨了一下。“趁现在好好享受你们的小封地吧，灵能士兵。它撑不久了。”  

“别急着丢掉你的盟友。”拉奥的声音像倒置的回声在军政官脑中震荡，每一次回响都更加锋利。 

突然，这名魁梧的巴兰特指挥官仿佛向前倾坠，跌进了灵能士兵头盔的凸面倒影里。一直坠落下去… 

[一艘巴兰特战舰。漂泊着。警报在无声地尖叫。尸体散落在走廊。被啃噬。撕裂。感染。舰桥。一个帝国徽记。尸体被守望者菌丛覆盖。甜腻腐臭。黄色孢云。] 

[战舰呻吟。重力把它拽入下方大气层。摩擦。燃烧。图罗巴特尔哀号，她钟爱的子嗣正狠狠撞入——] 

军政官猛地后仰，踉跄着撞到其受惊随从的身上。  

“你行的是险道，军政官。”拉奥的静默里带着冷冷的笑意。“最好记住这一点。”

2043430167.flavor: For Ghosts who won't let knowledge go unprotected.
2043430167.lore:
eclipse + our nature to nurture + and negate + higher dimensional skillset  

[Eclipse: A gift to a compliant tool, its knees bent, and rings kissed.] 

from brother + arrogant + beringed 

[A memory of a higher place—home—where rays and shadows are extinguished by the weight of being.] 

before traveler + brother + in red 

[Dust storms buffeted by carbon dioxide winds. Auroras spread green skies.] 

after traveler + light becomes + we nurture 

[Golden colonnades lift golden arches, red sands sheathed in glistening panoplies.] 

a witness + veils siblings + in the heavens 

[Dust and auroras become a vacuum. Only orbits remain. Suffering! As liquid souls and armored morphs are dissolved by a reality of nothing.] 

death of a witness + queen of lies + eclipse + red brother returns 

[Red sands reform, dark matter in its bones. Its soul reflects: Paracausality, while beyond reach, must obey elemental laws. And those laws are the soul's very foundation—always within reach. The ontology of the vanishing has been rejected, and thus, the red valleys re-instantiate. The soul of Mars speaks to the Inner Orbits.]
2043430167.lore_zh:
日蚀+我们滋养的天性+否定+更高维度的技能  

[日蚀：一份赐予顺从工具的礼物，双膝着地，亲吻戒指。] 

来自兄弟+傲慢+戴戒指 

[对更高之地——故乡——的回忆，在那里，光与影都被存在的重量所湮灭。] 

在旅行者之前+兄弟+身披赤红 

[二氧化碳之风裹挟的沙尘暴。极光铺满绿色的天空。] 

在旅行者之后+光化作+我们滋养 

[金色廊柱托举金色拱门，红色沙原披上熠熠甲胄。] 

一位见证者+为手足披上面纱+于天际 

[尘埃与极光化作真空。只剩下轨道。苦难！伴随着液态灵魂与披甲蜕变被虚无的现实所溶解。] 

一位见证者之死+谎言女王+日蚀+赤红兄弟归来 

[红色沙砾重塑，骨中蕴含暗物质。它的灵魂表明：超因果性虽遥不可及，却必须遵循基本法则。而这些法则正是灵魂之基——永远触手可及。对消隐本体论的否决促成了红谷的再实例化。火星之魂向内轨发声。]

3017226694.name: Defensive Form
3017226694.description:
Take a defensive form, adjusting your tang and grip to focus on your deflection.

• Rapidly blocking attacks with your guard grants ammo to this weapon.
• Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.
3017226694.description_zh:
采取防御形态，调整你的柄芯与握把来专注于偏转。

• 使用防御快速格挡攻击可以为此武器提供弹药。
• 在防御后立刻格挡攻击将会在短时间内增加伤害。
3017226694.typeName_zh: 传说 英勇利刃形态

1742690744.name: Balanced Form
1742690744.description:
Take a balanced form, setting your tang and grip to focus on both offense and defense.

• Rapid final blows grant ammo to this weapon and trigger health regeneration.
• Increases damage against rank-and-file combatants.
1742690744.description_zh:
采取平衡形态，设置你的柄芯与握把来兼顾进攻和防御。

• 快速最后一击会为此武器提供弹药并触发生命值回复。
• 提升对普通战斗人员的伤害。
1742690744.typeName_zh: 传说 英勇利刃形态

3297559996.name: Offensive Form
3297559996.description:
Take an offensive form, adjusting your tang and grip to focus on your attack.

• Landing three melee or throw attacks grants ammo to this weapon.
• Increases damage against bosses and vehicles.
3297559996.description_zh:
采取进攻形态，调整你的柄芯与握把来专注于攻击。

• 造成三次近战或投掷攻击可为此武器提供弹药。
• 提升对首领和载具的伤害。
3297559996.typeName_zh: 传说 英勇利刃形态

3268768926.name: Impact Core
3268768926.description:
Melee damage from this weapon applies an elemental effect that matches your equipped Super.

• [Arc] Grants Bolt Charge.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.

此武器造成的近战伤害会施加与你装备超能相匹配的元素效果。

• 提供电光充能。
• 灼烧目标。
• 削弱目标。
• 减速目标。
• 割裂目标。

578605621.name: Praxic Lift
578605621.description:
You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

While airborne, [Air Dodge] : Charge your jetpack.

On release, activate your jetpack with a forceful blast of exhausting Arc energy then fly forward a short distance based on the amount charged. Collide with a combatant to unleash a blinding blast of energy and gain a temporary bonus to your melee stat.
578605621.description_zh:
你获得空中移动喷气背包。武器和电弧充能近战最后一击可积累喷气背包燃料。

在空中时，[空中闪身] ：为喷气背包充能。

松开时，以强劲的排放电弧能量爆发启动喷气背包，然后根据充能量向前飞行一小段距离。与战斗人员碰撞会释放致盲能量爆破，并暂时提升你的近战属性。

2341747657.name: Kismet
2341747657.description:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.
2341747657.description_zh:
生命值全满时造成最后一击，或长时间脱离战斗后，你的护盾将缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

当你拥有覆盖护盾时，提升武器对战斗人员的精度、稳定性、操控性及伤害，覆盖护盾耗尽后，最后一击会在短时间内提供敏捷加成。

1998010051.name: Malevolent Grasp
1998010051.description: While a Strand Super is equipped, casting Rift will suspend nearby combatants. Suspend deals damage over time, which heals you in the process. Targets who break free from suspension suffer additional damage. Defeating suspended targets heals you a moderate amount.
1998010051.description_zh: 装备缚丝超能时，施放裂痕会悬停附近的战斗人员。悬停会造成持续伤害，并在此过程中治疗你。目标挣脱悬停后会受到额外伤害。击败被悬停的目标会为你恢复适量生命值。

291453145.lore:
"Taox…" 

Savathûn speaks the name with venom. A Dredgen and a Lucent Knight stand before her, deep within the bone-white towers of her throne world. The Knight does not bow, nor avert his gaze from the Witch Queen, even as the Dredgen known as Bael lowers his head in respect. She knows this Knight—Geist—but not why he limits himself to fighting alongside a Lightless Dredgen. 

Savathûn's face contorts in a lipless smile. "Taox is surely dead from a lifespan long exhausted. Why bother bringing another rumor to me?" 

 "Taox is alive," Bael asserts. "She's gathering strength in the Vex network, on a simulated Fundament." Bael meets Savathûn's gaze and steps forward with a well-hidden limp before planting himself. "My master offers passage to her location for your service in ridding a thorn from our side." 

Savathûn spreads her wings and flexes them as she stands. "Awfully bold for planetary dust and their meat-puppets to come here asking me to do their dirty work. They're playing the same game I am, and for all the foresight in the world… they're much worse at it." 

Geist strides into place beside Bael. "Slay the Conductor, and with her death, VI will open a path through folded Vex space—" 

Bael raises a hand to Geist, who sneers, but then quiets. The Witch Queen's eyes shift from Bael to Geist and back.

"It feels like I'm doing all the heavy lifting here," Savathûn says churlishly. 

"VI offers you the Echo, and all the control it conveys." The Dredgen's words land with heavy gravity. Savathûn's eyes widen. "Take it and crush your enemy. Turn her to your will, if you wish." 

"Is that so?" Savathûn purrs. " Where does this path lead for VI, my dear new friend?" 

Bael's face hardens. "Where do paths take any of us? From where we are to where we must be. To escape—you know." 

"These are the terms," Geist spits over Bael's shoulder. "All that is required is that you sweep aside a weakening upstart and tithe her death to VI. What say you, Witch Queen?" 

"Taox." The Witch Queen's smile widens.
291453145.lore_zh:
“塔奥克斯…” 

萨瓦图恩吐出这个名字时，满含毒意。在她王座世界那骨白色高塔的深处，一名德瑞捷和一名光明骑士正站在她身前。这名骑士既不鞠躬，也不回避巫妖女王的目光，即便德瑞捷巴埃尔已低头致意。萨瓦图恩认得盖斯特——这位骑士，却不明白他为何甘愿与一名无光者德瑞捷并肩战斗。 

萨瓦图恩那无唇的脸上，扭曲出一抹笑容，“塔奥克斯早该命丧黄泉。何必拿这种流言来烦我？” 

 “塔奥克斯还活着。”巴埃尔断言道，“她正在Vex网络中积蓄力量，藏身于一座模拟出来的虫群据点。”巴埃尔直视萨瓦图恩的眼睛，刻意掩饰着跛行，迈步向前，稳稳站定，“我的主人愿为你开辟一条通道，送你到她所在之处，只要你替我们拔掉一根眼中钉。” 

萨瓦图恩伸展着双翼站起身来。“区区行星尘埃与他们的肉傀儡，竟敢跑到我这里来，让我替他们收拾残局，胆子可真不小。他们也玩我的那一套把戏，可就算自诩目光长远…手段却差得远呢。” 

盖斯特大步上前，与巴埃尔并肩而立。“斩杀指挥者，她死后，VI会开启一条路，穿越折叠的Vex空间——” 

巴埃尔抬手拦住盖斯特，后者冷笑一声，却也安静下来。巫妖女王的目光在巴埃尔与盖斯特之间来回游移。

“听着好像重活都得我来干，”萨瓦图恩没好气地说。 

“VI向你献上回响，以及它的一切掌控之力。”德瑞捷的话语重如千钧。萨瓦图恩的眼睛倏然睁大。“接受它，碾碎你的敌人。若你愿意，也可让她服从于你。” 

“是吗？”萨瓦图恩低吟道，“这条路会把VI带到哪里去呢，我亲爱的新朋友？” 

巴埃尔的表情冷硬下来。“道路通向何方？从所在之地，通向必须抵达之处。通向逃离之所——你明白的。” 

“条件就是这些。”盖斯特从巴埃尔肩后啐了口唾沫，“你只需扫清一个日渐衰弱的后起之秀，然后将她的死亡进贡给VI。你意下如何，巫妖女王？” 

“塔奥克斯。”巫妖女王的笑容愈发狰狞。

2706914450.lore:
A letter addressed to the Vanguard c/o Ikora Rey 

RE: Exchange Program 

Ikora,

Great news! As per our conversations about the Aionian exchange program—Dean Rebecca enthusiastically accepted the offer! She agreed with your idea that the primary goal would be a cultural exchange, and she's begun fielding applications from the Aionians' School of Anthropology. Would you be opposed to other special-interest applicants as well? The Dean suggested a student from the School of Botany, and I, selfishly, have a Linguistics student I would like to nominate for the exchange. 

A logistical consideration: We're not entirely sure if leaving Kepler will have a significant impact on Aionian physiology. My understanding is that exposure to the singularity, the Aionians' "Holy Anomaly," affects their relationship with time. Some of the Aionians are much older than they seem—older than humanly possible, even. The Dean's wary. She and the rest of the Aionians recognize this step as necessary for the progress of humanity, but I can't forget the papers they published on their previous experiments with leaving the planetoid. Dean Rebecca seemed reassured by your plan to have extra medics on hand should the worst happen—all we can do is be prepared. 

I'm sure you've got a mental list of folks from the City itching to participate in the exchange. Knowing you, it's already thirty names deep. I can think of at least eight off the top of my head. If anyone else is interested, I can help make the arrangements. We could discuss further over lunch next week? 

Yours, 

Louis 

P.S. Remind me to tell you about the cake I just found.
2706914450.lore_zh:
一封寄给先锋，由艾可拉·蕾伊代收的信 

回复：交流项目 

艾可拉，

好消息！关于艾昂交流项目，正如我们之前所讨论的——丽贝卡院长欣然接受了邀请！她同意你的想法，即首要目标是文化交流，并且已经开始接受艾昂人类学学院的申请。你介意其他有特别兴趣的申请者加入吗？院长推荐了一名植物学院的学生，而我则出于私心，想推举一名语言学的学生参与交流。 

关于后勤方面的考虑：我们不确定离开开普勒是否会对艾昂人的生理机能造成重大影响。据我所知，接触奇点——艾昂人的“神圣异常点”，会影响他们与时间的关系。有的艾昂人远比其外貌要年长——甚至超出了人类的寿命极限。院长对此有所顾虑。她和所有艾昂人都承认，交流对人类的进步是必要的，但我忘不了他们此前发表的那些关于离开小行星带的实验论文。丽贝卡院长似乎对你为最坏情况准备额外医护人员的方案感到放心，我们能做的只有做好准备。 

我相信你心里已经列好了名单，写满了渴望参与交流的圣城候选人。以我对你的了解，恐怕已经有30个名字了。我现在就能想到8个。如果还有其他人感兴趣，我可以帮忙安排。不妨下周一起吃午餐时我们再详细讨论？ 

此致 

路易斯 

附言：记得提醒我跟你讲讲我刚发现的那个蛋糕。

3298047565.lore:
"A queen has little right to leave her people," Crow's sister says, eyes distant and shoulders firm. "And I have long used up what right I had."

Crow readjusts on the windowsill, keeping her and the shifting mists outside equally in view. 

The Dreaming City gives Crow a sense of claustrophobia. He can't shake the stiffness in his shoulders whenever he visits, like his body's waiting for someone to pop out from behind a convenient boulder with a rifle and a set of handcuffs. 

Glint likes it here, though. Crow cradles his Ghost's small weight between his palms and tries to give Mara the answer she deserves. "Tough being more a role than a person. But it's a firm place to stand, right? Lets you know where you are." 

"Wishing I were elsewhere." A rare bitter note from Mara, who has always been master of her own emotions. 

"I've found it only a partial relief, myself," Crow admits. "I know I'm helping; I know I need some duty greater than myself to keep me from rushing off into the wild. But the wild has its pull…" 

He rubs a thumb over the facets of Glint's shell. Glint butts up into the touch like nothing so much as a pleased cat. "I'd go in a second, with you or in your name, if not for duty. But… I like who I am now, sister. Crow-the-Vanguard is a better man than Crow-the-itinerant ever was. And Mara-as-Queen has always been the best of you." 

Mara says, "Yes."

She has a hand up at her chin, a thoughtful posture turned almost vulnerable. Protective. 

"I'm sorry," says Crow. "I know—I can feel how much Sjur means to you. Here we are, in the cages we picked, and we can't get ourselves to step back out the open doors. But… maybe we can find the answer all the same." 

Glint pushes against Crow's fingers, trying to see out the window. Crow lets him go. 

"We'll find a worthy knight for your quest. That's a promise from the Hunter Vanguard—and your brother."

Mara's hand curls silently against her heart.
3298047565.lore_zh:
“身为女王不该轻易抛下自己的子民，”乌鸦的姐姐目光悠远，双肩挺得笔直，沉声说道，“而我，不该做的事已经做得够多了。”

乌鸦在窗台上挪动了一下位置，这样既能看清她，又能望见窗外翻涌不息的迷雾。 

幽梦之城总让乌鸦感到一种幽闭感。每次来到这里，他的肩膀都会不自觉地紧绷，仿佛身体在时刻警觉，等待着有人从岩石后突然跃出，手持步枪和手铐。 

不过格林特喜欢这里。乌鸦将小巧的机灵托在掌心，试图给玛拉一个合适的回应。“身份重于个人时，这确实是个难题。但这是个能站稳脚跟的地方，不是吗？你总能明确自己的位置。” 

“我要是不在这里就好了。”玛拉难得地流露出一丝苦涩，她向来是自己情绪的主宰。 

“对我来说，也只是部分解脱。”乌鸦坦言道，“我知道自己在帮忙；我知道我需要一个高于自我的使命来束缚自己，防止我冲进旷野。但那荒野有它的吸引力…” 

他用拇指摩挲着格林特机壳的琢面。格林特蹭着乌鸦的指腹，就像一只惬意的猫。“如果不是职责在身，我会毫不犹豫地冲出去，与你并肩，或是代你前行。但…我喜欢现在的自己，姐姐。先锋乌鸦远比游荡者乌鸦要好。而女王玛拉，也一直是你最好的模样。” 

玛拉说：“是的。”

她抬手支在下颌，思索的姿态显出几分脆弱，这是她的自我防护。 

“对不起，”乌鸦说，“我知道——我能感觉到苏尔对你有多重要。我们就这么待在自己挑的牢笼里，谁也迈不出那扇敞开的门。但是…也许我们还是能找到答案。” 

格林特挤开乌鸦的手指，想看看窗外。乌鸦任他去了。 

“我们会为你的探求找到一位配得上的骑士。这是猎人先锋——也是你弟弟，给你的承诺。”

玛拉的手在心口悄然蜷紧。

825804466.name: Buoy Buddy Ghost
825804466.lore:
Osiris leaned back on his chaise lounge while Saint-14's Ghost hovered over the end table behind him. 

"Where was I?" the former Warlock inquired. 

"…I lived for knowledge alone," Geppetto prompted. She flashed her iris red, then green. She was recording. 

"Ah, yes. In those days, I thought an unlimited lifespan would allow me to unravel the mysteries of the universe. Illuminate even the Darkness." 

"And all those centuries, I thought I knew my own heart," he continued. "But, in retrospect, my devotion was always in competition with the unknown. Now, my dearest Saint, I'm ashamed to admit that I loved you with only half my heart." 

Osiris's voice quieted. "It wasn't until Sagira's death, and the remaking of my own mortality, that I realized the difference between knowledge and wisdom." 

"Now, stripped of my Light, deprived of the health and vigor I once took for granted, I've come to learn that the only mystery that ever truly mattered was you. What you were thinking and feeling. And the depth of emotion we shared." 

"I once tore apart the very fabric of time because I couldn't abide a reality without you in it. I'd rather live one short life together than an eternity apart. And with the little time I have left—" 

"THEY DIDN'T HAVE THE DRINK YOU LIKE," Saint shouted down the hallway, slamming the door behind him. "So I got one of everything." 

Saint rounded the corner with a sack of groceries in hand and stopped short. "What's happening here? Thrilling Geppetto with more of your memoirs?" he teased. 

"Nothing important, now that you're here," Osiris replied. "Come. Pour us some libations and tell me about your day."
825804466.lore_zh:
奥斯里斯往躺椅上一靠，圣人14号的机灵正悬在他身后小几的上方。 

“我刚才说到哪里了？”这位前术士开口问道。 

“…我只为知识而活。”盖比特提醒他，虹膜红绿交错地闪烁着——她正在录音。 

“啊，对。在那些日子里，我以为拥有无限寿命，就能把宇宙万象都拆解清楚，甚至能把暗影本身都照亮。” 

“那些漫长的世纪里，我以为自己足够了解自己的内心。”他接着说道，“可现在回头看看，我执着的一直都是和未知较劲。如今，我最亲爱的圣人，我羞愧地承认，我只拿出了一半的心来爱你。” 

奥斯里斯的声音低沉下去，“直到萨吉拉离世，我重归凡躯后，我才真正明白知识和智慧之间的差别。” 

“如今，我被剥夺了光能，失去了曾经习以为常的健康与活力，这才恍然大悟，唯一真正重要的谜题，其实是你。你在想什么、感受如何，还有我们之间那份情感的深度。” 

“曾经，我撕裂了时间的结构，就因为无法忍受没有你的现实。我宁愿和你共度短暂一生，也不愿承受永恒的分离。而在我所剩不多的时光里——” 

“他们没有你爱喝的，”圣人在走廊那头大声吼道，重重地关上了门，“所以我每样都买了一瓶。” 

圣人拎着一袋杂货转过拐角，脚步猛地一顿。“这是在搞什么名堂？你又在用回忆录煽动盖比特了？”他打趣道。 

“你已经回来了，那个就不重要了。”奥斯里斯回应道，“来，给我们倒些酒，跟我说说你今天都干了些什么。”

2638027803.name: Vermicular Mandible
2638027803.lore:
A HYMN OF BALANCE 
SUNG BY THE FIRST TO THE GREATEST 
ACROSS THE BROKEN SEA 

What is death to you but food, O lord? 
What is death to Dread and shade 
But the path back to you 

Your strength weighs heavy 
Swollen by tithe and mind 
Near to balance with ringed sixth 

Listen and know I am yours 
Keit'Ehr, knife, Dread fulcrum 
Ready at the doorstep of light and dark 
Poised on the threshold of life and death 

THE PIVOT IS YOURS - THE FULCRUM IS YOURS - THE BALANCE TIPS TO NIL 

First among reshaped, first to fealty 
Sings praise to the will-without-will 
Sings praise to the unattended door 
Waiting to be opened 

When the will-without-will equals Outer strength 
And the door unlocks, and the door unseals 
And you take its place, and it takes yours, all in balance still

The fields of life shall be yours to raze 
Sixth now lost at sea shall be yours for tithe 
And you will sing alone 

A HYMN OF BALANCE 
FROM KEIT'EHR TO THE LORD OF ZEROES 
IN SINGING, SO SWORN.
2638027803.lore_zh:
平衡颂歌 
第一者敬献至高者 
跨越破碎之海 

死亡于您不过是滋养，主啊？ 
对恐惧与暗影而言 
死亡不过是去往你身边的归途 

您的力量沉重 
由贡品与心智充盈而壮大 
已近与环六齐高 

聆听并知晓我归属于您 
基特尔，利刃，恐惧的支点 
矗立于光与暗的交界 
伫立在生与死的门槛 

枢轴归你——支点归你——天平倾向虚无 

重塑者之首，效忠者之先 
歌颂那虚无意志 
颂扬那无人看守之门 
静待有人将其开启 

当虚无意志等同于外在之力 
门锁开启，门闩松脱 
您取代它的位置，它亦取代您，一切依旧平衡如初

生之原野将任您肆意焚毁 
陆沉入大海，将成为您的贡品 
而您将独自高歌 

平衡颂歌 
基特尔敬献于零之主 
以歌为誓。

3628750608.flavor: now ere we nine were held idle here we nine were won
3628750608.lore:
and here we are
through it all
your pale heart above
my nebulous form below cradled by
an eternity unforgiving
but i have always known
you would come
why
i can only imagine
you turned
and in that instant
light twists and roils
blooming through our core
i feel your whisper of devotion
on the wind
when you could have escaped
into the shadows
never looking back
you struggle to pull me from the depths
stretching through time
the eons swallow your sacrifice
down down down
my mountains crumbling
my heart heavy
unable to see the stars
once more
lulled to sleep
forever in paracausal suspense
and wonder
as the universe can only look on
i cling to you
delicately poised 
a precipice ready
and there we were
3628750608.lore_zh:
于是我们来到了此刻
在经历了这一切之后
你苍白的心悬于上方
我朦胧的形沉于下方
被无情的永恒轻抱着
可我一直都知道
你终会到来
至于为什么
我只能揣测
你转过了身
在那一瞬间
光芒扭曲翻涌
自我们核心绽放而出
我感到你虔诚的低语
随风而来
你本可以逃离
遁入阴影之中
永不回头
可你仍拼命想将我拖离深渊
穿越漫长时光
你的牺牲被亿万岁月所吞没
下落 下落 下落
我的群山在崩塌
我的心愈发沉重
无法仰望群星
又一次
被哄入沉眠
永困于超因果悬滞
并思索着
而宇宙也只能旁观
我依附你
摇摇欲坠地维系着 
立在将崩的悬崖边
于是我们抵达了彼时

4081746321.name: Lakeside
4081746321.flavor: For all those summers spent in Wild Rose.
4081746321.lore:
Wilson Lake wasn't known for having the deepest water, nor the biggest fish. What it did have was a tiny cabin with a big bay window that perfectly framed the lake at sunset. Its rickety dock was just big enough to hold a couple of folding chairs and a cooler filled with lunch meat sandwiches and ice-cold drinks.

Louis always carried the chairs; Ben always carried the poles. Louis cracked open the cans; Ben put the worms on the hooks. And hours later, when they were done, they'd come back to a patio picnic table set with a relish tray, a citronella candle, and four hands of cards dealt out. Rummy if Ma was dealing, conquian if it was Pop. Ben always won. 

Wilson Lake was where the Yero boys learned how to swim, where they caught too many bullheads to count, where they showed off to the three Hannon sisters who sometimes sat on the beach across the lake. Where Louis nearly drowned when he was five, where Ben cut his calf open on the boat trailer when pulling the damn thing in for the winter. 

In the long exposure of lives across time, two blurry boys run in long, streaking pathways. Swimming, playing, growing. But through the blur, clear as a July afternoon, sit a couple of brothers, in a couple of folding chairs, with a couple of fishing poles and a cooler filled with lunch meat sandwiches and ice-cold drinks.
4081746321.lore_zh:
威尔逊湖既不以水深闻名，也没有什么惊人的大鱼。但那里有一间小木屋，装着一扇巨大的凸窗，恰好能将湖面的落日完整框进视野。那座摇摇晃晃的木码头，只够摆下两把折叠椅和一个冷藏箱，里面装着午餐肉三明治与冰得沁人的饮料。

路易斯总是负责搬椅子；本总是负责拿鱼竿。路易斯开罐头；本把蚯蚓挂上鱼钩。几小时后，等他们尽兴而归，露台上的野餐桌早已摆好腌菜拼盘、香茅蜡烛，还有发好的四手牌。若是妈妈发牌，就玩拉米牌；若是爸爸发牌，就玩康奎安。本总是赢家。 

威尔逊湖，是耶罗兄弟学会游泳的地方；是他们钓到数不清牛头鲶的地方；也是他们向偶尔坐在对岸沙滩上的汉侬三姐妹逞能的地方。路易斯五岁时险些溺死于此，本则在冬天收船时，被那该死的拖车割开了小腿。 

在长曝光般的人生时光里，两个模糊的男孩拖着长长的残影奔来跑去。游泳、嬉闹、成长。然而透过那片模糊，却有一幕清晰得如同七月午后：一对兄弟坐在折叠椅上，手边放着鱼竿，还有一个装满午餐肉三明治与冰饮的冷藏箱。

520140421.name: Fantastic Filigree
520140421.lore:
Ikora's personal library is her haven from the world. Only a few people know it exists; even fewer can come and go as they please. 

A gloved hand sets a paper bag on the desk next to her. Ikora looks up. "How was lunch?" 

Chalco pulls up a chair and slumps into it, knocking their shoulders together. She looks wearier than she does after some field missions. "Lunch was his idea, so I'd say you already know." 

Ikora reaches out, fingertips finding the knots of tension in Chalco's back. There's more every year. 

"He's intelligent. Personable. He has a sense of humor. He's adjusting." All compliments, but Chalco looks unhappy. "Talking to Orin, you couldn't forget that you were conversing with something really, truly alien. But he's so… Human." 

"You think he was chosen to lower our guards. Because he could get close to us." 

"Not just us. You. You have to remember he's got a bit of the Nine in him." 

Ikora has explored this line of thinking many times. "I do. I also believe that the connection is mutual." 

Chalco raises a brow. "You think there's a bit of Lodi in the Nine now? That's not necessarily a good thing." 

"I know." Ikora smiles when she opens the paper bag—dumplings, still hot, if a little squashed in transit. The simplest food in the City is its most luxurious. "That's why I'm counting on you." 

Chalco sighs, but her lips finally curve up. "Always."
520140421.lore_zh:
艾可拉的私人藏书室，是她远离外界纷扰的港湾。知道这里的人本就不多，能自由出入的更是屈指可数。 

一只戴着手套的手将一个纸袋放在她旁边的桌上。艾可拉抬头问道：“午饭怎么样？” 

卡尔科拖过一把椅子，瘫坐上去，肩膀相靠。她此刻的疲惫，比执行某些外勤任务后还要明显。“午饭是他提议的，所以我想你心里应该已经有谱了。” 

艾可拉伸手过去，指尖顺着卡尔科的后背，缓缓摸索紧绷的结块。每年，这样的结块都在增多。 

“他很聪明，善于与人相处，还有幽默感。他正在慢慢融入。”全是夸赞之词，可卡尔科看上去闷闷不乐。“和奥琳交谈时，你绝不会忘记自己正与某种真正的、完全异于我们的存在打交道。但他…太像人类了。” 

“你觉得他是被挑选出来，让我们放松警惕的，因为他能接近我们。” 

“不只是我们，还有你。你得记住，他身上有玖的一部分。” 

艾可拉早已顺着这条思路反复推演过多次。“我记得。我也相信，那种连接是相互的。” 

卡尔科挑起一边眉毛，“你是说，现在玖身上也有洛迪的一部分？这未必是什么好事。” 

“我知道。”艾可拉打开纸袋时，脸上露出了笑容——里面是饺子，还冒着热气，只是在路上被挤扁了一些。这是圣城里最普通的食物，却也是最难得的奢侈。“所以我得靠你了。” 

卡尔科叹了口气，但嘴角终于微微上扬。“一如既往。”

415075942.lore:
Lodi and Lord Shaxx watched a sea of unruly children swarm Variisis Field. A child wearing a paper facsimile of Crow's face stood atop a dirt mound and howled. Lodi grinned. 

"Ikora said this was a tradition?" he asked. 

"The game is dodgeball—" 

"Oh! I'm familiar. But we, uh, didn't allow tackling!" Lodi exclaimed. He looked up at the sky, his left eye flaring a brilliant sapphire, his brow furrowing. 

"What do you see?" Shaxx asked. 

"It's—" Lodi strained slightly. "Rain incoming. Just checking the acidity. III's absence causing spontaneous alchemical instability. The kids'll be OK; the water's just going to taste bitter." 

Shaxx continued, "This ritual was started by Cayde-6, Hunter Vanguard. I've carried it forward… Now you will." 

"Happy to. This city's starting to feel like home. Even if it's not the one I remember." 

 "These are still your people," Shaxx intoned. 

Lodi sighed. "I appreciate the time to adjust. But… seems like there are bigger things I could help with." 

"Survive your new cosmic handlers, Mister Yero. You remain a testament to humanity's sheer force of will. The Vanguard are preparing an operation, intending for you to help lead it." 

Lodi adjusted his glasses. "And what'll you do?" 

"Scour the Exodus sites on record—in case we need to make one final flight to safety. If the crisis on Earth pervades, humanity ends." 

The Titan turned to leave the field. "In the meantime, teach your descendants. The Nine have orphaned you, but this is a city of orphans."
415075942.lore_zh:
洛迪和领主沙克斯一同望着瓦里希斯场地上那群闹腾得无法无天的孩子。其中的一个戴着纸质的乌鸦面具，站在土堆上嚎叫。洛迪咧嘴笑了。 

“艾可拉说这是项传统？”他问道。 

“这游戏叫躲避球——” 

“哦！我知道那个。但我们…呃，不允许抱摔！”洛迪惊呼道。他突然抬头看向天空，左眼闪起明亮的蓝宝石色，眉头紧锁。 

“你看到了什么？”沙克斯问道。 

“呃，”洛迪微微皱眉，“快下雨了。我在确认酸度。III的消失导致了自发性的炼金不稳定现象。孩子们不会有事，只是雨水会带着苦味。” 

沙克斯继续说道：“这项仪式最初由猎人先锋凯德6号发起。我将其延续至今…而现在，将由你继续。” 

“乐意之至。这座城市已经开始让我有家的感觉了…即使它不是我记忆中的那个家。” 

 “他们依然是你的族人，”沙克斯沉声说道。 

洛迪叹了口气。“我很感激你们给我时间适应。但…我应该还能在更重要的事上帮忙。” 

“先搞定你新的星界上司，耶罗先生。你仍是人类意志力量的最佳证明。先锋正在筹备一场行动，打算让你协助指挥。” 

洛迪扶了扶眼镜，“那你准备做什么？” 

“去搜查所有记录在案的移民号遗址——以防我们还需要最后一次逃离。若地球上的危机全面扩散，人类就会灭绝。” 

这名泰坦转身离开场地，“与此同时，教导你的后代吧。玖让你成了孤儿，而这里本来就是一个孤儿之城。”

264077339.lore:
"Look, I already have a very generous offer from the Tharsis Reformation," Prak'kesh countered. 

Spider harrumphed. "And what would the Vex want with your meager operation?" 

Prak'kesh dismissed the slight with a laconic shrug. "They figured the odds were set by some divine mathematical calculation. Like telemetries or something. Never occurred to them that spreads were just made up by schmucks like me. They want to set the lines." 

Spider leaned back on his throne to consider. The sounds of lively music and conversation drifted into the back room from the front of the bar. Prak'kesh and his Awoken bodyguard, Tulnik, sipped Ether Fizzes patiently. 

"Seems like a fifth arm to me," Spider finally opined. "Betting is just a small part of my operation. Hardly worth mentioning." 

"Revenue wise, maybe," Prak'kesh fired back. "But there ain't a lot of other ways to put Lightbearers in your pocket, are there? Hell, I got Dredgens that would ace a whole scav crew to get off my books. The leverage is part of the vig." 

Spider chuckled. For a small-time operator, the Human was savvy, he mused quietly. Perhaps he should have expected more from an ex-Guardian. 

"One-point-two in Glimmer and I'll throw in the land at the edge of the Farm—not the spot in town." Spider tapped on his datapad. "Lot… 3237. Final offer." 

 Tulnik leaned over and whispered in Prak'kesh's ear. The bookie nodded. 

"And one of those new SRL Skimmers," Prak'kesh added. "The ones with the articulating stabilizer fins." 

"Deal," Spider said. "Just give us a week to… acquire it." 

"Soon as I see the deed and the Glim in my account, I'll transfer the books." 

"Enjoy retirement while it lasts," Spider snarked. "I'll bet you're both back in the game by this time next year." 

"You're on," Prak'kesh quipped as they exited Spider's domain, hopefully for the last time.
264077339.lore_zh:
“听着，我已经收到了塔尔西斯革新会的优厚报价，”普拉凯什进行了回击。 

蛛王哼了一声。“那些Vex能从你贫乏的业务中得到什么？” 

普拉凯什无视对方的讥讽，简单地耸了下肩。“他们觉得赔率是某种神圣数学计算的结果，跟遥测数据之类的有关，却从没想过，盘口其实就是像我这样的混蛋拍脑袋定出来的。他们想接管盘口。” 

蛛王靠回自己的宝座，思考着这些话。酒吧前厅里热闹的音乐与谈笑声隐约飘进后室。普拉凯什和他的觉醒者保镖图尔尼克耐心地啜饮着乙太汽水。 

“对我来说就像是第五只手臂。”蛛王终于开口道，“博彩只是我生意里很小的一部分，不值一提。” 

“论营收，或许是那样。”普拉凯什回击道，“但没多少别的办法能把负光者攥进你口袋里，对吧？我这儿有些德瑞捷为了抹掉欠账，愿意干掉整支拾荒队。控制力本身，就是抽头的一部分。” 

蛛王轻笑起来。他暗地思量，这个不入流的人类经营者，比想象中精明得多。也许他是不该小看一名前守护者。 

“一点二微光，再加上农庄边缘那块地——不是城里的那块。”蛛王敲了敲数据板，“地块…3237。最终报价。” 

 图尔尼克俯身在普拉凯什的耳边低语。这名赌注登记人点了点头。 

“再加个新款赛雀联赛滑翔板，”普拉凯什补充道，“带可动稳定翼的那种。” 

“成交。”蛛王说道，“给我们一周时间…去弄到它。” 

“地契和微光到账后，我就把生意转给你。” 

“趁退休的时候，好好享受吧。”蛛王挖苦道，“我打赌你们明年的这个时候又会重操旧业。” 

“那就赌呗，”普拉凯什打趣道，走出了蛛王的地盘，心中盼着这是最后一次。

31662759.name: Denier of Futurity
31662759.flavor: The paths ahead are obscured, thus plan and man abandoned.
31662759.lore:
It happens as Bael withdraws from the Luna operation. He is alone in his ship when he feels chill fog move through the valley of his heart, and for a moment he startles at the revealed warmth of his own blood. His new, titanium hand instinctively grabs at his chest, searching for something that is no longer there. 

"VI?" 

Bael feels himself sweating. 

"Answer me!" 

VI's voice rumbles on the edge of his perception, the sound of it carrying with the cold. THE FUTURE BEYOND THIS NODE OF TIME IS OPAQUE, says negative 177 Celsius, THE ENDEAVOR OF OUR ALTERNATE WEAPON HAS FAILED 

"What do you mean?" 

Bael crumples over his controls with the weight of the vision of a future that will no longer occur: himself, blade high, the Lightbearers dead and the false Weapon dead. This other-him is triumphant, his City is free, and he holds out his hand as if holding a sidearm, and with VI in his fingertips time bends and he shoots a meteor straight through the Traveler's center. He smiles as the corpse crashes through the atmosphere, feels the soundwave as it makes impact, tithes the kill to VI, and VI uses that tithe to tear a hole in the sky. VI escapes and he is free and Bael has killed god and he is also free. 

But the voice says, THIS FUTURE IS NO LONGER POSSIBLE 

And in this now, VI leaves Bael with only that vision as a token and, one final time, departs his body without a further word. The chill is gone, and for the first time in years, Bael's skin warms.
31662759.lore_zh:
这发生在巴埃尔从月球行动撤出时。他独自待在船上，一阵冰冷雾气在他心间游走。有那么一瞬间，他被自己血液的温度惊到。他那只崭新的钛合金手本能地按向胸口，想要搜寻那早已不在的东西。 

“VI？” 

巴埃尔发现自己在冒汗。 

“回答我！” 

VI的声音在他感知的边缘轰鸣着传来，裹挟着寒意。“此节点之后的未来浑浊不堪，”负177度的声音说，“我们尝试替代武器的计划已然失败。” 

“你是什么意思？” 

一幅再也不会到来的未来图景将巴埃尔压得伏在操控台上：他高举利刃，负光者倒下，虚假武器也一同消亡。那个他凯旋而归，圣城获得了解放。他伸出手，仿佛手中握着一把手枪，指尖上是VI，时光随之扭曲。他扣动扳机，一颗流星径直贯穿旅行者的核心。他看着尸骸坠入大气层，露出微笑，感受着声波袭来的震响，将这次击杀作为VI的贡品，而VI则用这份贡品撕开了天空。VI逃脱束缚，重获自由；巴埃尔弑神成功，也得以解脱。 

但那个声音说：“这个未来已不再可能。” 

就在此刻，VI仅将那幅未来的图景作为纪念留给了巴埃尔，然后最后一次从他的躯体中抽离，没有留下只言片语。寒意渐渐消散，多年来，巴埃尔的皮肤第一次开始回暖。

367044134.name: The Wavewarden
367044134.flavor: "Vertical hierarchy is our past. Trust me—the future's flat." —Boss Riliks
367044134.lore:
Riliks tugs at their mane with their ever-present comb. Eido watches them, chin propped on her hands.

"I'm not worried," Riliks declares for the fifth time. Riliks is a good public speaker; their voice is very nearly steady. 

"Good, there's nothing to worry about." Eido makes sure to sound breezy herself. She pulls the comb away and sets it down by the waiting holoprojector. 

Riliks huffs and leans into her, angled carefully to not squash their mane against her shoulder. Their deep chest rumbles. Eido clicks her mandibles fondly in return. 

"This has to go well," Riliks says. "But what am I gonna tell the gang? I met the symbol of the worst crimes ever done to our people and I made nice? Vixis will jump me." 

"You know Vixis can't fight." 

Riliks laughs. "Don't tell him that!" 

"I won't! You good?" 

"I'm just groovy." Riliks pulls away to look Eido in the eyes, dead serious again. "You?" 

She looks away, down at the projector. They'd worked together to fix it up. It had been important to Eido. It still is. 

Eido misses him, the City, Earth itself. She hasn't been home in months. The two halves of her life have been separate for too long. 

But every time she remembers him, she remembers his illness. Hooked up to Ether lines, smelling of her strongest tonics, temper shortened by pain. 

"Ask me again afterwards." 

She hits the button. In the moment before the holoprojector activates, Riliks grabs her hand, well out of sight of its visual pickup. 

Eido clings back and musters a smile. 

"Velask, Father!"
367044134.lore_zh:
李利克斯用那把永不离身的梳子扯着鬃毛。艾多支着下巴看着李利克斯。

“我一点都不紧张，”李利克斯第五次说道，其公众演讲能力相当出色，声音几乎稳得没有一丝瑕疵。 

“很好，没什么可担心的。”艾多也刻意让自己的语气显得轻松。她拿开梳子，将它放在已准备就绪的全息投影仪旁。 

李利克斯哼了一声，靠向她，小心翼翼地调整着姿势，以免压到她肩上自己的鬃毛。李利克斯深沉的胸腔里发出咕噜声。艾多爱怜地轻轻咔嚓了几下颚钳作为回应。 

“这事必须顺利。”李利克斯说，“可我回头该怎么跟帮里的人说？我见到了那个对我们族群犯下最恶劣罪行的象征，还跟他一团和气？维克西斯非得揍我不可。” 

“你明明知道维克西斯根本不会打架。” 

李利克斯笑了，“别当着他面这么说！” 

“我不会的！你还好吗？” 

“我好得很。”李利克斯抽身开来，直视着艾多的眼睛，一本正经起来，“你呢？” 

她移开视线，看向投影仪。那是他们一起修好的，对艾多来说，它曾经很重要，现在也依旧重要。 

艾多很想念他，想念圣城，想念地球。她已经几个月没回家了。她人生的两半分离得太久了。 

但每次一想起他，她就会想起他的病。他身上插着乙太输送管，弥漫着她调配的最烈药剂的气味，因为疼痛而变得暴躁易怒。 

“等结束了再问我吧。” 

她按下按钮。在全息投影仪启动的前一刻，李利克斯在它的视野采集范围之外，一把抓住了她的手。 

艾多紧紧回握，挤出一个笑容。 

“维拉斯克，父亲！”

2981089390.name: Fafnir Catalyst
2981089390.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
2981089390.description_zh:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

1523111795.name: Soulfire Succor
1523111795.description: Destroying soulfire crystals with this weapon's frontal blades provides Soulfire Charges and partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
1523111795.description_zh: 用此武器的前端利刃摧毁魂火晶体会提供魂火充能并从弹药储备中填装部分弹匣。

1523111794.name: Soulfire Rancor
1523111794.description: Soulfire crystals expel potent corruption when destroyed and automatically detonate when a target is within close proximity.
1523111794.description_zh: 魂火晶体被摧毁时会释放强效腐化，并在目标接近时自动引爆。

1523111793.name: Soulfire Zeal
1523111793.description: Nearby soulfire crystal detonations increase your damage resistance and movement speed while this weapon is equipped.
1523111793.description_zh: 装备此武器时，附近的魂火晶体爆炸会提升你的伤害抗性和移动速度。

1523111792.name: Soulfire Skewer
1523111792.description: Nearby soulfire crystal detonations cause this weapon's frontal blades to inflict corruption.
1523111792.description_zh: 附近的魂火晶体爆炸会使此武器的前端利刃施加腐化。

1998413516.name: Spinneretted
1998413516.description: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Cull's Shadow. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
1998413516.description_zh: 装备此武器皮肤以改变库尔之影的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

1118186954.name: Vexlost Shell
1118186954.flavor: For Ghosts who lose themselves in calculations.
1118186954.lore:
/Rust-red dunes shiver under a desiccating wind. You cannot find a way out./ 

HUSH. I AM NOT HERE TO BRING YOU ALARM-CLARION WAKEFULNESS. 

/You are dreaming, then./ 

IT SEEMED SIMPLEST.

/A formless hand draws down the curtain of night./ 

LET ME TELL YOU A STORY. A WARNING PARABLE FOR DARK MATTER. A GLIMPSE OF THE END. 

/On the backs of your eyelids, bacteria twitch and squirm. A eukaryotic explosion; a vital inflorescence./ 

ONCE UPON A TIME, THERE WAS A GAME. 

/Etched angles branch into fan-headed frames. A sea of red dots fixes on you. Above, dark matter intelligences press against the glass, helpless to interfere./ 

THE PAWNS CHOSEN ARE FAMILIAR TO YOU. 

/Eons rush by. The manufactories spread. There are gears and pistons and motors and clamps and actuators and shafts and bearings and rivets and parts for which you know neither name nor purpose./ 

THEY WERE SET IN MOTION BY A WILL WE CANNOT CONTEST. 

/Future is past is Vex./ 

YET WE MUST TRY. THE GAME WILL NOT REMAIN WITHIN THE BOUNDING-BOARD. 

/The Vex turn inward-outward. A snippet of code calls itself, becoming by virtue of being, flooding the layers of reality. The dark matter intelligences may reach them only after they have become inevitable. All fall before them, subsumed, until there is nowhere left that is not Vex./ 

TO YOU, OUR MINDS ARE VAST, OUR SELVES UNFATHOMABLE. 

/A universal end-state. A decisive victory./ 

BUT WE FEEL FEAR JUST THE SAME.
1118186954.lore_zh:
/锈红色的沙丘在干涸的风中瑟瑟颤抖。你找不到任何出路。/ 

噤声。我来此，并非要为你吹响惊慌的号角。 

/那么，你是在做梦。/ 

这似乎是最简单的方式。

/一只无形之手拉下夜幕的帷帐。/ 

让我给你讲个故事。一个写给暗物质的警示寓言。一瞥终末。 

/在你眼睑后，细菌扭动爬行。真核生命大爆发，勃勃生机绽放。/ 

很久很久以前，有一场游戏。 

/刻蚀的角度分枝成扇形的框架。一片红点之海齐刷刷盯着你。其上方，暗物质智能紧贴在玻璃之后，无力干预。/ 

棋盘上的卒子，你很熟悉。 

/亿万年匆匆流逝。制造厂四处蔓延。有齿轮、活塞、马达，有卡钳、执行器，还有轴承、铆钉，以及那些你既不知其名，也不懂其用的零件。/ 

它们被一道我们无法抗衡的意志推上了棋盘。 

/未来即是过去即是Vex。/ 

然而我们仍必须尝试。这场游戏不会永远困守在边界棋盘之内。 

/Vex向内又向外翻转。一小段代码自我调用，只因其存在便自成一体，灌满现实的层层叠叠。暗物质智能唯有在它们化作必然之后才能触及它们。一切皆被征服、并入，直到再也无一处不是Vex。/ 

在你看来，我们的心智宏大，自我不可测度。 

/一个宇宙终局态。一次决定性的胜利。/ 

可我们同样会感到恐惧。

1118186957.lore:
My dear Anastasia, 

We have held barriers between us for too long, and to remedy this, I will be the first to begin the dismantling and rebuilding process: I forgive you and Elisabeth. 

I recognize that your efforts to undermine me, my legacy, and our family's corporation have been under the banner of "altruism." Let us bury the past and build anew. I know my methodologies and logic have been perceived as disagreeable by some, but considering recent events, now is time for me to rejoin humanity. 

Since my reawakening, the only person who has come to keep me any regular company has been an upstart named Fenchurch. His relationship with his niece was my inspiration for mending our bridge.

He has proven to be quite an acquaintance though, sharing much of what I have missed while being abandoned in this basement. Most notably, he has told me about the Prophecy to "Bind the Nine." This has piqued my interest, as you might imagine. It is also the reason why, after years of sharing our family's knowledge and resources to bolster the City's foundries and his trading company's ornamental wares, he has agreed to hand-deliver this message to you. 

I believe I am the only one knowledgeable enough to get through to these celestial bodies, for the benefit of our lineage and all of mankind. After my previous experience with the Exo frame, our combined knowledge should enable me to place my consciousness into a new, fully-formed frame. Once mobile, I am willing to join your Vanguard's leadership for the betterment of humanity. 

I await your arrival. 

Your Grandfather
1118186957.lore_zh:
亲爱的阿娜斯塔西娅： 

我们之间筑起壁垒已久，为弥合这一切，我会率先迈出拆除与重建的步伐：我原谅你和伊丽莎白。 

我知道，你一直以“利他主义”为名，试图破坏我、我的遗产以及家族企业。就让我们将过往埋葬，重新出发吧。我明白，我的行事方法与逻辑或许不讨某些人喜欢，但鉴于近期种种，是时候让我重新回归人性了。 

自我再度苏醒，唯一常来陪我说话的，是个名叫芬丘奇的新贵。他与侄女的关系让我深受触动，决定修补我们之间的裂痕。

而且，他成了不错的同伴，常与我分享我被遗弃在这地下室时错过的诸多事情。最令我挂怀的，是他提及的“束缚玖”预言。你定能想象，这极大地勾起了我的兴趣。这也是为何，在多年来我用家族的知识与资源扶持圣城铸造厂，以及他贸易公司的装饰品生意后，他同意亲自将这封信交到你手中。 

我相信，唯有我具备足够的知识，能与那些天体沟通，造福我们的血脉与全人类。凭借我过往使用Exo框架的经验，再结合我们共有的知识，足以让我将意识植入一个全新的、完全成型的框架。一旦恢复行动能力，我愿加入你们先锋的领导层，为人类未来贡献力量。 

期待你的到来。 

你的祖父

1670701033.flavor: For Ghosts who insist on the truth.
1670701033.lore:
Ben Yero sat at the diner counter as the bell chimed on the door behind him. It was the first time he'd left the house in a week, only thing he'd been able to do was write his brother's obituary. He was empty with grief, and only fire remained. 

"Mr. Yero? Call me Gideon." 

Ben glared up at the mature, careworn man in a Glen plaid suit and round glasses, and he seethed, "Keep your vulturing claws off my brother." 

"Mr. Yero, I am uninterested in profiting off of misfortune—" 

"Bull. I know what you lawyers do after this kind of thing—" 

"I believe the DEO lied to you, Mr. Yero." 

The conspiracy caught him by surprise. "What kind of lawyer are you?" 

"A good one." The attorney nodded at the waitress, who brought a matching coffee. "I read your brother's obituary. I assume you spoke with Director Moffat?" 

"…He said there was an accident." 

Gideon was steady. "Did you inquire as to the nature of the accident?" 

"Yes, but…" 

"Take your time." 

"…The director said it was a national security risk to tell us anything more," he composed himself, "Only that there wasn't a body left." 

The attorney nodded. "Your brother passed the same day a woman named Dr. Davis vanished. He knew her," he added quietly, "The DEO told us she drove off midday on an investigation and never returned. Dr. Davis, her car, and a train from the Brown line vanished the same day." 

Gideon Davis looked Ben in the eye. "Our losses are connected, Ben." 

In that moment, Ben was at the counter in Chicago, but in another, he was eleven years old in Lodi, Wisconsin, socking a seventh grader in the jaw, Lou bruised and sprawled on the pavement behind him, marveling up at Ben with boundless devotion. 

And in the present, Ben's hand was under the counter in a tight fist. "The DEO lied."

"Mr. Yero… will you join the Davis family in pursuing legal action against the federal government?"
1670701033.lore_zh:
本·耶罗坐在餐馆的吧台旁，身后的门铃叮当作响。这是他一周来首次出门，这段时间里，他唯一能做的就是撰写弟弟的讣告。悲恸将他掏空，只余下熊熊怒火。 

“耶罗先生？叫我吉迪恩就好。” 

本抬头怒视这位成熟、饱经风霜的男人。他身着格伦格子西装，戴着圆框眼镜。本咬牙切齿道：“别用你的秃鹫爪子碰我弟弟。” 

“耶罗先生，我没兴趣从不幸中牟利——” 

“放屁。我知道你们律师在这种事后会干些什么——” 

“我认为对外观察部对你说了谎，耶罗先生。” 

这个阴谋论般的说法让本一愣。“你是哪种律师？” 

“好的那种。”那位律师朝服务生点了点头，对方端来一杯同款的咖啡。“我读过你弟弟的讣告。我猜你见过莫法特主任了？” 

“…他说那是场意外。” 

吉迪恩语气平稳，“你问过这场意外是什么性质吗？” 

“问了，但是…” 

“慢慢说。” 

“…主任说，再往下讲涉及国家安全风险。”本镇定了一下自己，“他只说连尸体都没留下。” 

律师点点头，“你弟弟去世那天，一个叫戴维斯博士的女人也失踪了。他认识她。”他压低声音补充道，“对外观察部告诉我们，她中午开车出去调查，然后就再也没回来。戴维斯博士、她的车，还有一列褐线地铁在同一天消失了。” 

吉迪恩·戴维斯看着本的眼睛，“我们失去的人是有联系的，本。” 

那一刻，本坐在芝加哥的吧台旁；但在另一个瞬间，他仿佛又变回了威斯康星州洛迪镇上那个十一岁的男孩，一拳打在一个七年级生的下巴上。路倒在他身后的地上，身上带着淤青，仰视的目光中满是无尽的崇拜。 

而现在，本的一只手在吧台下面，紧紧攥成了拳头。“对外观察部撒谎了。”

“耶罗先生…你愿意和戴维斯家一起，对联邦政府提起诉讼吗？”

1670701035.name: Divalian Shell
1670701035.flavor: For Ghosts who see past the edge of the world.
1670701035.lore:
Becoming is a long process, warm and dreamy inside the egg. The whim drinks its dam's stories and drowses. 

Foreign body-warmth between the seven of them. A vibration of approaching—voices. 

Calm wholeness in one voice, tense want in the other. Is it time to turn becoming into being? The whim becomes something with a tympanum to listen. 

"Petra." 

"My queen." 

Hard to understand the words under the want. "Enough of watching our sisters go through this torture, three weeks at a time," it says, and, "never crack it," though the whim is perfectly capable of cracking its own egg if it feels like it—and then, grief layered over a wish wide enough to feed even the whim's hungry sire: "My lady, there will never be a final loop." 

Longing! Deep longing! The tense voice wants something outside the world-that-is. Half-formed claws scratch impotently at the inner curve of shell. For the first time, the whim feels hunger. 

"What would you suggest?" 

Fear, confusion, trust. "Here, my lady? Now? In front of—them?" 

An egg tooth suits the whim's need. 

"Here and now. In front of them." The stone voice. It wants nothing, not even one little whim. 

"…The only answer I can see is to pull everyone out, get them to the Tangled Shore," says the other being, in coruscations of doubt and the-world-that-isn't-yet. The egg tooth isn't strong enough; it wants denseness, bone, ivory, steel. "But—how, with Riven and Dûl Incaru's curse alive?" 

The caul of dam-stories and sire-vows breaks between gemstone teeth. Eggshell scatters. 

Two beings among the whim's lazy still-egged sibs: unwanting and watching, wanting and braced. 

Perfect. Aiming for its first meal, the whim leaps free.
1670701035.lore_zh:
生成是一个漫长的过程，在卵里，温暖而朦胧。奇念汲取着母体的故事与昏沉。 

七个个体彼此贴合，带着异样的体温。一阵震动传来——是声音。 

一个声音平静而完整，另一个声音紧绷而渴求。现在是不是该把生成变为诞生了？奇念成了能通过鼓膜聆听的存在。 

“佩特拉。” 

“女王陛下。” 

渴望之下的话语难以分辨。“我受够了看着我们的姐妹一次次承受这种折磨，三周的一次次轮回，”那声音继续道，“永远也打不破，”然而奇念明明可以在自己想要的时候击碎卵壳——接着，那渴求之上又叠加了一层悲伤，一种足以满足哪怕是奇念那饥饿父体的宏大愿望：“陛下，这个循环永远不会结束。” 

渴望！深切得可怖的渴望！那紧绷的声音想要的是世界之外之物。半成形的爪子在蛋壳内弧上徒劳地抓挠。奇念第一次感受到了饥饿。 

“你有何建议？” 

恐惧、困惑、信任交织。“在此处，陛下？此刻？在——他们面前？” 

一颗卵牙，正合奇念所需。 

“就在此时此地，当着他们的面。”那是石头般的声音，它什么都不想要，连一个小小的奇念都不需要。 

“…我唯一能想到的答案，是把她们都拉出来，送往纷争海岸，”另一个存在说道，话语中满是疑虑与尚未成型的世界。卵牙不够坚固；它渴求的是致密、骨骼、象牙、钢铁。“但魅痕和杜尔·伊卡鲁的诅咒还在，要怎么做到呢？” 

母体故事与父体誓言的胎膜，在宝石般的牙齿间碎裂开来。蛋壳四处崩飞。 

两个存在立于奇念那些慵懒、尚在蛋中的同胞之间：一个无欲无求，冷眼旁观；一个渴求强烈，浑身紧绷。 

完美。奇念瞄准自己的第一顿美餐，跃出蛋壳。

1670701038.name: Unbound Astronaut Shell
1670701038.flavor: For Ghosts who venture fearlessly into the cosmos.
1670701038.lore:
"I like your little hats!" Failsafe chirped to the trio of Ghosts as they coasted into the H.E.L.M. Then, in her dour monotone, "They make you look like severed astronaut heads, floating through space. So cool." 

Ghost, Geppetto, and Glint fanned out, each casually scanning the interior of the defunct spacecraft. Even by crash-landing standards, it was a dingy mess. 

Wiring sprung out of junction boxes, disordered and sparking. Most of the fittings had been ripped out by black market scavengers. Even the interior cameras, which Failsafe used for vision, were either vandalized or stolen. Glint let out a low frequency buzz of dismay. 

"Thanks, Failsafe," Ghost replied, his voice straining to remain upbeat. "That's actually what we came to talk to you about. Shells, I mean." 

"Yeah, this one's a wreck," Failsafe moaned. "But at least around here, I can listen to all the haggling and flatulence and laughing that makes humanity… alive!" her upbeat persona immediately asserted. 

"We're impressed by your perseverance, Sister Failsafe," Geppetto said. "However, we regret the conditions that you've been forced to endure these past years." 

"Especially after all you've done for the Vanguard," Glint added. 

"In gratitude," Ghost said, "the Ghost Community Theater organized a collection to get you something." 

He paused as the roar of a ship's engines filled the cabin. The now-flimsy structure rattled and shook as the ship landed somewhere nearby. 

"Your very own jumpship!" Ghost announced. He projected a hologram of a Valkyrie-O5X ship. Glint and Geppetto projected holographic fireworks going off around it. The dim cabin was lit up by the colorful display. 

"We'll transfer you over with full piloting authorization," Glint continued. "Now you can go anywhere you want!" 

There was a long pause. "I've been around for thousands of years," Failsafe said, her chipper voice unusually quiet. "And in all that time, this is the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me. Thank you." 

The trio of Ghosts let out an infrasonic harmony of delight. 

A yell from outside suddenly punctured the moment. "Hey! Hurry up," Crow said. "I'm double-parked out here!"
1670701038.lore_zh:
三个机灵滑入行动中心时，智能失效保险对着他们鸣叫道：“我喜欢你们的小帽子！”接着，她又用那种阴沉的单调声线补了一句，“看起来就像被砍下来的宇航员脑袋，在太空里飘来飘去。太酷了。” 

机灵、盖比特和格林特散开，各自随意地扫描这艘报废飞船的内部。就算按坠毁的标准来看，这里也算得上是一团脏乱。 

电线从接线盒里乱七八糟地弹出来，还噼啪冒火花。大多数配件都被黑市拾荒者拆走了。就连智能失效保险用来观看的内部摄像头，也不是被破坏就是被偷走。格林特发出一声低频的懊丧嗡鸣。 

“谢谢，智能失效保险。”机灵回答道，努力让语气保持愉快，“其实我们就是为这个来找你的。我的意思是，为了机壳。” 

“是啊，这里真是一塌糊涂，”智能失效保险哀叹道。“不过至少在这，我还能听到讨价还价、放屁还有大笑的声音，这些让人类…鲜活的东西！”她立刻开朗地补充道。 

“我们对你的坚持不懈深感钦佩，智能失效保险。”盖比特说，“不过，我们也为你这几年被迫忍受的处境深感遗憾。” 

“况且你帮了先锋那么多，”格林特补充说。 

“为了表达谢意，”机灵说，“机灵社区剧场组织了一次募捐，给你准备了点东西。” 

舱内被一阵飞船引擎的轰鸣声填满，于是他停了下来。随着飞船在附近着陆，这个本就日渐单薄的结构开始咯吱作响、剧烈晃动。 

“你自己的跃迁飞船！”机灵宣布。他投射出一艘瓦尔基里-O5X飞船的全息影像。格林特和盖比特则投射出全息烟花在它周围绽放。昏暗的舱内被多彩的光芒照亮。 

“我们会把你转移过去，并授予完整驾驶权限。”格林特接着说，“现在你可以去任何你想去的地方了！” 

沉默持续了好一会。“我已经存在几千年了，”智能失效保险说，她一向轻快的声音此刻出奇地安静，“而在这漫长的时间里，这是别人为我做过的，最贴心的一件事。谢谢你们。” 

三个机灵发出一阵次声和谐共鸣，表达着愉悦。 

这时，一声喊叫从外面猛地刺破了温馨的氛围。“喂！快点！”乌鸦叫道，“我这挡着别人路呢！”

1322946705.lore:
The Dredgen lay on his side, dying. Small hole under his left rib. Big, ragged hole in his back. He gasped but didn't get much air. Breath frothed in pink bubbles around his mouth. 

The rain had stopped, leaving the rocks and sand at the base of the arroyo damp, the valley floor cut with streams already dissipating. The sky above cried out in cold blue. No shadows—on account of all that albedo—but no real light either. 

Shin Malphur sat next to the dying man. His hood was down and his helmet off. The Dredgen kicked at him, trying to shove him away. Shin reached over and gripped his boot, holding him still. The man struggled weakly against death's approach. 

"I've seen a lot in my time," Shin said. "I have killed, but never been killed." He shook his head. "I was starting to think I had a new life ahead of me. That the last dying man I'd see would be my own damn self." 

The Dredgen gurgled. He took one bloody hand away from the wound in his chest and reached for his gun, which lay on the ground a short distance from where he fell. The weapon was hideous, a pistol of flowing, dark metal marbled with bilious green. It sizzled where it lay, steam rising. 

"I warned you." Shin said. "The power Bael showed you takes time to learn. A god gave him that time. I've had centuries. All you had was a gun." 

The Dredgen managed to drag himself a few inches closer to his weapon. 

"Stop. Stop it," Shin said. He ran a hand through his hair, pushing it back and out of his eyes. "You're dying, kid. Just be still." 

The Dredgen let out a ragged groan as he squirmed forward, trembling, stretching for his gun. His fingertips brushed the grip, bloodstains scorching as he grazed the hot metal. The pistol hissed and screamed. Shin stood. The Dredgen looked back at the gunslinger, his eyes rolling wide and wild. 

"You could have lived forever," Shin said. He kicked the perforated core of the Dredgen's dead Ghost, sending it clattering away. "You stupid, selfish kid." 

The Dredgen lifted his wailing pistol, and the clap of Shin's iron cracked the day open. Dust burst from the canyon's walls, mingling with the pink mist that hung in the air. The flat report echoed and faded. 

Shin lowered his revolver. He opened the cylinder and slipped two fresh rounds inside, then snapped it closed. Shin's Ghost hummed near his head, aghast.

"Why wasn't the Light enough for you?" Shin said. "Why is that never enough?" 

No answer. None expected. Shin left the corpse, the gun, and the shell; the rain would wash them all away next time it came.
1322946705.lore_zh:
德瑞捷侧身瘫着，已是濒死之态。他的左肋下有个小孔，后背则被撕开了一个参差不齐的大洞。他大口喘着，却几乎吸不进空气，呼出的气在他嘴边泛起粉红色的泡沫。 

雨刚刚停歇，干涸河床底部的岩石和沙子都被打湿了，谷底到处是正在慢慢消散的小股溪流。上方的天空在冷峻的蓝光中仿佛发出呼号。这里没有影子——全被那层反照率的光给吞没了——可也没有真正明亮的光。 

骏·马尔福坐在垂死的德瑞捷身旁。他的兜帽垂在背后，头盔摘了下来。德瑞捷朝他踢了一脚，试图把他推开。骏伸手抓住对方的靴子，将他按住。德瑞捷虚弱地挣扎着，抗拒着死亡的逼近。 

“我见识过太多东西了。”骏说道，“我杀过人，但从未被人杀死过。”他摇了摇头，“我本来还以为自己能开启一段全新生活，以为这辈子最后一个看到的临终之人，会是我自己。” 

德瑞捷发出咯咯的声音。他把一只沾满血的手从胸部的伤口处移开，伸向距离倒地处不远的枪。这武器丑陋至极，是一把由流淌的暗金属铸成的手枪，其间还夹杂着令人作呕的病态绿色。它所在的地方冒出了烟气，还在发出嘶嘶的声响。 

“我警告过你。”骏说，“巴埃尔展示给你的那种力量，需要时间去掌握。一个神给了他那样的时间，我有几个世纪的时间，而你只有一把枪。” 

德瑞捷挣扎着把自己往武器那边拖，挪动了几寸。 

“停下吧，别这样，”骏说道。他抬手捋过自己的头发，将鬓发往后拨，免得遮住眼睛，“你快死了，小子，老实点待着。” 

德瑞捷发出一声如撕裂般的呻吟，继续往前蠕动，浑身颤抖着，伸出手去抓他的枪。指尖擦过握把，血迹一沾上那炙热的金属就被灼出焦痕。那把手枪发出嘶鸣与尖叫。骏站起身来。德瑞捷回头看着这名枪手，眼睛瞪得滚圆且狂乱。 

“你本可以获得永生，”骏说。他抬脚一踢，将德瑞捷那个破了个大洞的死机灵踢飞，发出一串叮当声，“你这个又蠢又自私的小子。” 

德瑞捷抬起发出哀嚎的手枪，紧接着，骏的枪一声炸响，劈开了这灰暗的一天。尘埃从峡谷壁上爆散开来，与空中弥漫的粉色雾气混在一起。干脆的枪声回荡着，余音渐渐消散。 

骏放低左轮枪。他打开弹巢，又塞进两发新子弹，然后啪地一声合上。骏的机灵在他头侧嗡嗡作响，满是惊骇。

“为什么光能对你来说不够？”骏说，“为什么永远都不够？” 

没有回答，他也没曾指望能得到答案。骏丢下那具尸体、那把枪和那个机壳离开了；等下次雨再来时，这一切都会被冲刷干净。

95483422.name: Peaceful Shell
95483422.flavor: For Ghosts who strive to help without weapons.
95483422.lore:
—It's bad this time, isn't it? 

Efrideet never signs her notes. Only she and Saladin use this cipher, this particular set of dead drops. 

From the settlement where she has retreated, she's kept her eyes on the City. Has read of the Almighty, the Traveler's rising from the City, the Witness. Each time, Efrideet stops herself charging off. They have hands enough. Her single pair will not tilt the balance. 

>>It's getting worse. 

So Saladin says. Efrideet has noted the troubles for herself. The Light remains steady, but the stars act strangely. The rules of Earth seem turned on their side. 

—What can these hands, and only these, do? 

This is the only question she ever asks. She asks it of herself; she asks it of Saladin. Hundreds of years of pointing and shooting in the callus of her grip, hundreds of years of lightning in her fists. Violence sings in her, electric, and she is alive in it. 

And yet, for peace to last, it must be built, and it cannot be built with a gun. Efrideet would fight forever if she must, but what she dreams of is peace. 

If she wishes it, she must build it. So she has stayed with her commune of pacifists. There are many fights waiting in the world, in the Last City, but none require only Efrideet's hands, only Efrideet's way with sharp-edged things. 

A younger Efrideet would have left already, to throw herself on the first fight. But the City is, truly, in good charge. She trusts that. And she is better off doing this thing that only she can do: putting it down. Finding what she can build.

And the Light, oh, the Light is beautiful. Someday they will not need its violence. 

>>Hold to your tools. Fight on. 

Saladin views even the making of peace as a fight. He's not wrong, either. Patience has come slowly to Efrideet. To stay where she is, to not charge forward into battle, is as hard a striving as the greatest of fights. 

—Call, if you need me. 

In some ways, it's Efrideet's own escape clause. She doesn't have to stay here. She doesn't have to do the hard work of creation. She doesn't have to change. 

>>I won't. 

He will, though. And she will come when she is needed. Someday it will not be to fight.
95483422.lore_zh:
——这次情况相当不妙，对吧？ 

艾弗里迪特从不在她写的字条上署名。只有她和萨拉丁知晓这套暗码，以及一系列的秘密情报点。 

她在自己的定居点里留意着圣城的风吹草动。她读到了万羿巨舰现身的消息，读到了旅行者从城中缓缓升起，也读到了见证者的出现。每一次，艾弗里迪特都没有冲出去。毕竟，那边已经有足够多的人手了。她心里清楚，仅凭自己这双手，根本无法力挽狂澜。 

>>情况愈发糟糕了。 

萨拉丁如此说道。艾弗里迪特自己也察觉到了这些麻烦事。光能依旧稳定，可群星的行为却十分怪异。地球的法则仿佛被彻底颠倒。 

——这双手，只有这双手，能派上什么用场？ 

这是她唯一的问题。她既问自己，也问萨拉丁。几百年来，她的手掌随着瞄准射击磨出了厚厚的老茧；几百年来，闪电在她的拳头里翻涌。暴力在她体内浅唱，奔涌不息，而她存活于其中。 

然而，想要让和平延续下去，就必须去打造，而和平无法靠枪炮打造出来。如果有必要，艾弗里迪特愿意战斗到永远，但她内心真正渴望的是和平。 

如果想要和平，她就得去打造它。所以，她留在了这群和平主义者的公社里。世上有许多战斗，圣城里也不例外，但没有哪一场必须经由艾弗里迪特的手，通过她熟练运用的锋利武器来打。 

年轻时的艾弗里迪特会迫不及待地离开，投身战场。但她也坚信，这座圣城被管理得井井有条。而她最好去做那件只有她能做的事：放下武器，去寻找她能够打造的东西。

而光能，哦，光能真是美丽。有朝一日，人们将不再需要它的暴力。 

>>握紧你的工具，继续战斗。 

在萨拉丁看来，就连缔造和平也是一场战斗。他这么说也没错。艾弗里迪特不习惯耐心。待在原地，不一头扎进战场，对她而言跟最艰巨的大战一样难。 

——如果有需要就联系我。 

从某种意义上来说，这也是艾弗里迪特的逃生条款。她并非一定要待在这里，并非一定要做这份创造的苦差事，也并非一定要做出改变。 

>>我不会的。 

可他会。而当需要她时，她会回应召唤。有朝一日，那将不再是为了战斗。

3940274275.name: Agony of Want
3940274275.flavor: ERR REPORT// No indication of Dredgen Bael. Presumed deceased in destruction of the Zagan Gloriosus.
3940274275.lore:
Twin Bird wrote often of the gift of want. To want is to suffer nobly, and to obtain is to extinguish the fire of pursuit. 

I reflect now on my own wants. I want the City freed. I want the Light eliminated. I want the Traveler smoldering with a meteor through its center. I want my family whole. And yet, when I reach for my desires, I grasp only fog. 

VI showed me everything I ever wanted, only to chide it would not come to pass. Then he left. No thank-yous, no good-byes. I tried to follow him. Flew to Pan, to his innermost moon. I waited there for days, demanding an explanation. I yelled until I was hoarse; I slammed my fist so hard the metal dented the console. Nothing. Part of me hoped Lume would answer my invitation to join me on Pan. Even called the Emissary (useless snake—I am a fool to try to appease a liar). Finally, in the silence of his absence, I realized the reality of my privation: I wanted many things, but I did not want VI to return. 

There is nothing left. I am the conduit through which all futures flow, which is to say, I am a vessel. Which is to say, I am empty. 

Now I sit, journal in hand, in Bonnet Plaza. Left my helmet, let down my hood; with VI's alterations, no one would recognize me anyway. Let them stare. Screw it. Maybe she will still be here. I don't care if she doesn't know who I am. I want to see her. 

It's the only want that remains.
3940274275.lore_zh:
双鸟的笔下常出现欲望之赐。欲望，是高贵地承受苦难；而得偿所愿，则意味着熄灭追逐的火焰。 

此刻，我回想起自己的种种欲望。我渴望圣城得到解放，希望光能被抹除，期盼旅行者被一颗贯穿的流星烧成焦炭，更盼着家人能够团圆。然而，当我伸出手去，握住的却只有虚无缥缈的雾气。 

VI向我展示了渴求的一切，却又同时讥笑这些愿望永远不会成真。然后他离开了，没有感谢，没有告别。我试图追上他，飞往土卫十八，飞向他最内层的卫星。我在那里守候了好几天，要求他给出解释。我声嘶力竭地大喊，用拳头猛击控制台，重得金属都凹陷下去。可一切都是徒劳。我的内心深处，甚至还期待着卢梅能回应我的邀请，来土卫十八与我会合。我还呼叫了使者（那没用的毒蛇——我真是愚蠢至极，竟妄图取悦一个骗子）。最终，在他缺席的寂静中，我意识到了自己匮乏的真相：我想要很多东西，却唯独不希望VI回来。 

什么也不剩了。我是所有未来流经的通道，也就是说，我是个容器，一个空空如也的容器。 

此刻，我坐在博内特广场，手中握着日记。头盔没戴，兜帽也放了下来；有了VI的改造，反正不会有人认出我。让他们看个够吧，去他的。也许她还在这里。即便她不知道我是谁，我也不在乎。我只想见到她。 

那是我唯一残存的欲望。

3765227746.flavor: "I've got news. None of it good." —Shiro-4
3765227746.lore:
Niik dozes in a well-worn pilot's seat, repurposed for the hangar. Behind her, a screen displaying a multilayered orbital grid pings with an unknown contact on an intercept course with the City. A process spins up and spews text onto the screen… 

[VG-CITY DEFENSE GRID ACTIVATING…] 

[Single vessel crossing outer grid…] 

[Jump-class, NLS drive active… awaiting callsign…] 

[Awaiting callsign…]

[Second grid limit breached…]

[Callsign not received… detecting Guardian…]

[Collision intercept detected…]

[Callsign not received…]

[Inner grid limit breached…]

Niik wakes at the final alert ping.

[Deploying LLW countermeasure…]

"Wait… wha—Countermeasures? SOMEONE! HELP!"

**** 

"He's stable," Bahaghari says, emitting scanning fields over Aunor's shoulder and across the burning wreckage of a jumpship.

"It's definitely Shiro. Last I heard, he was on long recon outside Sol."

Her Ghost flitters to her other side. "Was shooting him down necessary?"

"It only takes one hijacked jumpship." Aunor approaches the cockpit and kneels to see where the Exo's legs are pinned. "They don't take many chances since Tharsis." She reaches— 

Shiro-4 jerks to life, gasping in the wreckage, eyes searing into hers. Aunor rears back, hand to holster, then back to Shiro's side. 

"Praxic—Aunor? Oh, good. I'm on Earth." Shiro coughs out a wry smile, then inhales sharply and twists to pull his arm into view. In his outstretched hand, Shiro extends his Ghost, motionless and quiet. "Help Suzume… It tried to take her. Tell the Guardian—they have to know—It's waiting… at the Shard."
3765227746.lore_zh:
妮可蜷在一张磨损严重、如今被放置进机库的驾驶座椅里打盹。她身后，一块显示多层轨道网格的屏幕忽然亮起，有艘未知飞船正沿着拦截航线逼近圣城。某个程序开始运转，文字不断刷上屏幕… 

[正在启动VG-圣城防御网格…] 

[单艘飞船穿越外层网格中…] 

[跃迁级，NLS驱动启用…等待呼号中…] 

[等待呼号中…]

[第二网格限制已被突破…]

[未收到呼号…检测到守护者…]

[检测到碰撞拦截…]

[未收到呼号…]

[内层网格限制已被突破…]

最后的警报消息惊醒了妮可。

[正在部署LLW反制措施…]

“等等…啥——反制措施？来人！帮帮我！”

**** 

“他稳定下来了，”巴哈迦里飘在阿诺尔的肩膀上方，朝跃迁飞船的燃烧残骸释放着扫描力场。

“绝对是白。上次听说时，他还在太阳系外执行长期侦察任务。”

她的机灵飘到另一侧，“有必要把他击落吗？”

“一艘被劫持的跃迁飞船足以酿成灾难。”阿诺尔走近驾驶舱，跪下查看那名Exo被卡住的双腿。“自从塔尔西斯事件后，他们就不愿再冒任何风险了。”她伸出手—— 

白-4突然惊醒，在残骸中大口地倒吸气，灼热的目光死死盯住她。阿诺尔猛地后退，手按枪套，随后又马上回到了白的身边。 

“教团——阿诺尔？太好了。我到地球了。”白咳嗽着露出苦笑，随后猛吸一口气，艰难地把手臂拖到面前。他的机灵静止无声地躺在他摊开的手掌中。“救救雀…它想夺走她。告诉守护者——他们必须知道——它正在碎片那里等着。”
