119228495.name: Tusked Allegiance Gloves
119228495.flavor: "Bonds are forged on the battlefield and broken at the War Table." —Empress Caiatl
119228495.lore:
Crow was already reloading when the strange Hive's lifeless body crashed to the forest floor.

Glint flew toward the corpse without a word. Crow pretended not to notice and kept walking through the woods. He's been in a mood all day, Glint thought with a static sigh. He could use some time alone.

When he reached the Hive, Glint resisted the absurd reflex to scan it for compatibility. Instead, he simply assessed, noting the strong arms that could handle the recoil from heavy weapons; the thick shell, built to absorb all manner of firepower; the remains of a bony shield that sizzled nearby, powerful enough to protect—

The space next to Glint fluctuated as a bone-white Hive Ghost appeared. 

The two froze warily in midair.

"Hey," the Hive Ghost whispered after a moment. "It's okay." Its voice was surprisingly soft. 

Its green eye flickered reassuringly and it began to focus Light.

Glint bobbed unsteadily. Crow was fifty yards off, moving carefully through the trees. "You shouldn't—"

"It'll be all right," it said and hovered lower to the ground, pouring Light into the fallen Hive. The surrounding ferns trembled with the sudden flow of energy.

"Wait," Glint pressed. But the Ghost ignored him as the thick armor of the Hive began to reform. 

"Crow!" Glint screamed, "Crow, here!" And he flew to him without turning back.
119228495.lore_zh:
当这具怪异的邪魔族尸体坠落到森林地面时，乌鸦已经在填装弹药了。

格林特一言不发地飞向尸体。乌鸦假装没注意到，继续穿过树林。他一整天都情绪不佳，格林特边想边轻轻叹了口气。他需要一些独处的时间。

当他找到那个邪魔族时，格林特忍住了想要扫描其兼容性的荒唐反射。他只是简单地评估了一下眼前的邪魔族：他注意到那些强壮的手臂可以承受重型武器的后坐力；厚厚的机壳，可以吸收各种形式的火力；一个骨质盾牌的残骸在附近嘶嘶作响，强大到足以保护——

格林特身旁的空间出现了波动，一个骨白色的邪魔族机灵随即现身。

两个机灵警惕地愣在半空中。

“嘿，”过了一会儿，邪魔族机灵轻声说。“没事的。”它的声音出奇地柔和。

它安慰地眨了眨绿色的眼睛，开始聚焦光能。

格林特晃悠悠地上下浮动着。乌鸦在五十码开外，小心翼翼地穿过树林。“你不该——”

“不会有事的，”它边说着，边降低着自己的悬停高度，把光能灌注进了倒下的邪魔族。周围的蕨类植物伴随着忽如其来的能量流动而颤动。

“等等，”格林特急促地说道。但那个机灵没有理会他。邪魔族厚重的盔甲已开始重构。

“乌鸦！”格林特尖叫道，“乌鸦，这边！”他头也不回地朝着乌鸦飞去。

3465627817.name: Tusked Allegiance Robes
3465627817.flavor: "Were the Light a glory to be earned, the Cabal would have claimed it long ago." —Empress Caiatl
3465627817.lore:
Mithrax delicately pushed the low curtain aside as he entered the bedroom.

Tall shelves crowded him, cluttered with relics from Mercury and beyond: piles of intricate scrolls, silver hourglasses that turned of their own accord, ceramic pots of red soil sprouting delicate metallic vines beneath glass domes. An enormous feathered mantle was mounted carefully on a wooden stand and crowned with a birdlike cowl.

The hulking form of Saint-14 sat in a wooden chair facing the bed where, impossibly small beneath the blankets, rested the man known as Osiris.

Mithrax rapped politely on the doorframe.

"My friend," Saint-14 said. "It is good of you to come."

Mithrax approached Saint and bowed. "It is an honor to be invited," he said. "These visits are pleasant to me." 

He held out the covered dish he was carrying in his lower arms, but Saint's eyes remained fixed on Osiris. 

The Titan took a ragged breath. His voice was a hoarse whisper: "Could the Psion machine… connect my mind with his? So that I might share his dreams?"

Mithrax felt useless. He spoke softly: "The Psion tells me the subject must have residual activity for a reading, and Osiris has been asleep very long. Besides, the connection you seek joins the Light of one being to the Light of another, and Osiris is—"

"Lightless, yes," Saint finished flatly. He leaned forward in his chair, his elbows on his knees, hands clasped before him. He was silent for some time.

"I will let him sleep alone," Saint finally said, and caressed Osiris's hand with impossible tenderness. "When he wakes, we will dream together once more."

He adjusted the blankets, stood, and nodded toward the covered dish Mithrax still clutched awkwardly.

"I am hoping that is not more eggplant," he said.

Mithrax coughed on his Ether. "The eggplant is most nourishing," he protested weakly, and Saint groaned.
3465627817.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯进入卧室时，小心翼翼地把低矮的帘子推到一边。

房间里摆满了高大的架子，来自水星和其他地方的圣物杂乱无章地堆积其上：成堆的复杂卷轴、自动转动的银色沙漏、玻璃穹顶下长出精致金属藤蔓的红土陶罐。一件巨大的羽毛披风被小心地挂在木架上，其顶部有一个鸟状的风帽。

圣人14号庞大的身躯坐落在一张面对着床的木椅上。床上躺着的是一个被称作奥斯里斯的人；毯子下的他显得格外娇小。

米瑟拉克斯礼貌地敲了敲门框。

“我的朋友，”圣人14号说。“你能来真是太好了。”

米瑟拉克斯走到圣人跟前，鞠了一躬。“能受到邀请是我的荣幸，”他说。“造访别人让我感到愉快。”

他伸出端着餐食的下臂，但圣人仍然目不转睛地盯着奥斯里斯。

泰坦喘了一口粗气，用沙哑的声音低语道：“灵能机器能不能…把我的思想和他的联系起来？让我分享他的梦境？”

米瑟拉克斯感到无能为力。他轻声开口道：“灵能士兵告诉我，受试对象必须具有可读取的残留活性，而奥斯里斯已经沉睡很久了。而且，你所寻求的连接需要将一个生命的光能与另一个生命的光能连接起来，而奥斯里斯已经——”

“失去光能了，没错，”圣人平静地接了对方的话。他坐在椅子上向前倾，手肘放在膝盖上，双手紧握在面前。他沉默了好一阵子。

“我会让他独自沉睡，”圣人最后说道，无比温柔地抚摸着奥斯里斯的手。“等他醒来后，我们会再次同享梦境。”

他整理了一下毛毯，站了起来，朝米瑟拉克斯依然笨拙抓着的有盖餐盘点了点头。

“我希望这回不是茄子了，”他说。

米瑟拉克斯被他的乙太呛了一下。“茄子最有营养了，”他轻声抗议道，而圣人则发出了一阵呻吟。

950963812.name: Tusked Allegiance Bond
950963812.flavor: "I do not sit and theologize my enemies. I crush them." —Empress Caiatl
950963812.lore:
The huddled Guardians fell into shocked silence as Commander Zavala's silhouette loomed over the table.

A hooded figure sat, suddenly enveloped by the shadow, and leaned backward until his head bumped against Zavala's chestplate. He tilted his chin up and craned his neck to fix Zavala with an upside-down smile. 

His hood fell back. "What's with the face, Big Blue?" Drifter said. "Somebody's gotta teach 'em how to play offense."

"Get this out of my Tower." There was iron in the Titan's voice. 

An old fear split Drifter's face. He leaned forward, swept the contents of the table into his knapsack—tangled cables, a red lens, shards of bone, a green eye spinning madly in a jar of thick fluid—and left without a word.
950963812.lore_zh:
当指挥官萨瓦拉的轮廓在桌子上显现时，凑作一团的守护者们陷入了震惊的沉默中。

一个戴着兜帽的人坐在那里，忽然被人影盖住。他向后仰了仰，头抵到了萨瓦拉的胸甲上。他仰起头，伸长脖子，盯着萨瓦拉那张倒映的脸庞，笑了。

他的兜帽向后滑了下去。“你的脸怎么了，蓝色大块头？”浪客说。“总得有人教他们怎么进攻吧。”

“把这些玩意儿从我的高塔里弄出去。”这位泰坦的语气颇为强硬。

旧日的恐惧撕裂了浪客的脸。他倾身向前，把桌上的东西都扫进背包里——一堆乱糟糟的电缆，一个红透镜，几块骨头，一只在浓稠的液体里疯狂地旋转着的绿眼睛——一言不发就走了。

849255710.name: Tusked Allegiance Hood
849255710.flavor: "They have succeeded, somehow. But they will succeed no longer." —Empress Caiatl
849255710.lore:
AGAIN.

Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, felt flame surge through his body as he was resurrected. 

He became aware of many things at once: the altar beneath him. The roaring of Acolytes. The powerful grip on his shoulders, which even now began to crack under the pressure. 

Above him, a trio of Wizards held his Ghost tight, its bleached shell ensnared by ebony tendrils of controlling spellcraft. It pulled against the bonds but could do nothing but look down at him helplessly.

SING OF HER LIES. SPEAK OF HER TRUTHS.

The voice was everywhere. As Sok'tol strained to sit up, something slammed him down, pounding his chitinous skull into the stone again and again. He screeched as the bony frill surrounding his face splintered and snapped loose. He felt his jaw dislodge, felt his own teeth crush against his face, felt himself crack and shatter.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.

As his shell knit and restored soulfire flowed anew, Sok'tol, Fifth of the Light, shuddered awake. 

The Acolytes roared again. They crowded the altar, surrounded by a haze of green. Sok'tol peered upward at the Ogre pinning him against the altar. 

It tightened its grip on his shoulders, claws crackling with wrathful energy. It shook its massive head, crowned in an emerald corona, and bellowed in a voice that was not its own:

YOUR STRENGTH BECOMES MINE. AS WILL HERS. SPEAK.

Sok'tol concentrated the Light in his armored hand and began to form a grenade, but the shrieking Acolytes reached forward and tore his fingers apart in their claws. 

Sok'tol bared his teeth and hissed up at the Ogre, whose eyes rolled with fury as a blast of soulfire erupted from its mouth. Sok'tol opened his jaws to howl as he was obliterated.

Blackness. And then—

AGAIN.
849255710.lore_zh:
周而复始。

索克托尔，光能五世，在复活时感到火焰在他的身体里涌动。

他一下子意识到了许多事情：他脚下的祭坛。仆从们的咆哮。他感到有一股强大的力量在钳着他：他的肩膀本身甚至开始在重压之下劈啪作响。

在他上方，三名巫师紧紧抓住他的机灵，它那褪色的外壳陷入控制法术的乌木触须之中。它拉扯着束缚，但除了无可奈何地低头看着他，什么也做不了。

歌唱她的谎言。道出她的真相。

这声音如影随形。就在索克托尔挣扎着要坐起来的时候，有什么东西把他砸了下去，他那壳质的头骨一次又一次地撞到石头上。他尖叫着，脸周围的骨质褶边崩裂开来，啪的一声脱落了。他觉得自己的下巴掉了下来，觉得自己的牙齿压在脸上，觉得自己裂开了，粉碎了。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

当他的机壳缝合并重新燃起灵魂之火时，索克托尔，光能五世，颤抖着醒来了。

仆从们再次咆哮起来。它们挤在圣坛上，周围是一片绿色的薄雾。索克托尔抬头望着那个把他钉在祭坛上的虫瘤。

它紧紧抓着他的肩膀，怒不可遏的爪子噼啪作响。它摇晃着巨大的脑袋，戴着翡翠色的皇冠，用不属于它自己的声音吼叫：

你的力量化作了我的力量。她的也会如此。说话。

索克托尔把光能集中在他那穿着护甲的手上，开始形成一个手雷，但尖叫的仆从们向前伸出爪子撕裂了他的手指。

索克托尔龇着牙，向虫瘤发出嘶嘶声。随着一股灵魂之火从嘴里喷发出来，虫瘤那满是怒意的双眼在滴溜溜地打转。索克托尔在行将湮灭之际，张开了下颚嚎叫。

一片漆黑袭来。然后——

周而复始。

693728753.lore:
Bask materialized near a low wall and zipped to where Jolur had collapsed. The Ghost began to focus his Light when incoming fire sent him spinning to the ground.

"What did I tell you about dying in the open?" the little Ghost cried in frustration. Determined, he rose into the air, but the Hive Knight was already charging across the Trostland cobblestones.

A sudden explosion of Void energy took the Knight by surprise, but it dodged the pulsing shockwaves of a Vortex Grenade. A tall Warlock in a worn green robe loped from the treeline and slid to a stop before Bask. She hastily formed a ball of Light in her palm and slammed it into the ground. Delicate wisps of energy began to rise from the soil.

"That's not gonna help!" Bask whirred angrily.

The Warlock stood, sheltering Bask with her body as he resumed his focus on Jolur. The Knight screeched and resumed fire. A volley of Shredder bolts doubled the Warlock over, but the energy seeping from the rift gave her the strength to keep standing. 

"Thanks," said Bask sheepishly.

"Don't mention it," she said, gritting her teeth through the gunfire. 

A blinding burst of energy surged as Jolur rose to his feet, body shimmering with Light. He braced himself and lobbed an orb of unstable energy that reduced the Knight to howling ash on impact. 

"Appreciate the assist," Jolur said to Bask and the Warlock as he brushed dirt from his decrepit boots. "These guys are stronger than I thought, but it's nothing a Nova Bomb can't handle."

The Warlock inspected the damage to her robe. "What's going on with these Hive?"

"I don't know," Jolur said. "Lord Saladin sent a group of us down to figure out—"

Another blinding burst of energy surged nearby. The Knight rose to its feet, body shimmering with Light. 

The Guardians stood frozen in horror. 

"Since when can they do that?" Bask squeaked, and the fight began in earnest.
693728753.lore_zh:
巴斯克出现在一堵矮墙附近，然后迅速移动到了乔鲁倒下的地方。这个机灵已开始聚焦光能，但却被来袭的炮火击倒在地。

“我不是说过别死在开阔的地方吗？”小机灵沮丧地叫道。他下定决心，向空中飞去，但邪魔族骑士已踩着慰藉之地的鹅卵石冲了过来。

虚空能量的突然爆发把骑士打了个措手不及，但它还是躲开了涡流手雷的脉冲冲击波。一个身穿破旧绿袍的高个术士从树林里大步跑出来，滑停到巴斯克面前。她匆忙在手掌上形成一个光球，把它砸到地上。微妙的缕缕能量开始从土壤中升起。

“那根本没用！”巴斯克愤怒地喊道。

术士站了起来，用她的身体护住巴斯克，把注意力集中在了乔鲁身上。骑士尖叫了一声，继续开火。一连串的粉碎者飞弹把术士的身子都压弯了，但裂痕中渗出的能量给了她继续站立的力量。

“谢谢，”巴斯克羞怯地说。

“别客气，”她强顶着枪林弹雨答道。

乔鲁站起来时，身体闪着光能，迸发出了一阵眩目的能量。他振作起来，并抛出了一个不稳定的能量球。骑士受到冲击后嚎叫着化为了一堆灰烬。

“多谢帮忙，”乔鲁一边擦洗破旧战靴上的污垢，一边对巴斯克和术士道谢。“这些家伙比我想象的还要强大，但没有什么是新星炸弹解决不了的。”

术士检查着她受损的袍子。“这些邪魔族到底是怎么回事？”

“我不知道，”乔鲁说道。“领主萨拉丁派了我们一群人去调查——”

附近迸发出了另一股眩目的能量。那骑士又站了起来，全身上下闪烁着光能。

守护者们被惊得僵立在原地。

“他们什么时候开始能做到这个了？”巴斯克尖叫了一声，战斗再次打响。

1599443272.lore:
Prak'kesh and his Awoken bodyguard, Tulnik, had been watching crowds of bettors come in and out of the Eliksni Quarter for an hour. Clearly, whoever was stealing their business was gaining momentum.

The bookmaker spotted a fireteam of Warlocks wafting down the street like a perfumed breeze. He approached them with his most disarming smile.

"Hey, you guys are Warlocks, right?" Prak'kesh feigned a slight bumpkin accent.

The leader, a Shadebinder, held out his hand and summoned a shimmering crystal staff out of thin air. "What tipped you off?" he smirked. His teammates posed smugly behind him.

"It was your… uh… fancy bracelets," Prak'kesh replied, pointing to the Warlock's arm.

"That's a Celestine Bond, goober," the posing Dawnblade sneered.

"Neat! I just got here from the Farm," Prak'kesh said, leaning into his plucky yokel act. "I want to bet on the Warlocks to win the Guardian Games, because you guys are obviously the toughest and most dangerous class." Behind him, Tulnik faked a coughing fit to hide a guffaw.

"You're smarter than you look," the Shadebinder sniffed. 

"The problem is," Prak'kesh went on, "I don't know where to place my bet. Do you know of any bookers around here?"

The Dawnblade rolled her eyes, "They're called 'bookies.'"

"Wow," Prak'kesh replied. "You guys sure are sophisticated."

"Just show this to one of the Fallen," the Shadebinder offered, "and they'll point you in the right direction." He handed Prak'kesh a scrap of paper. 

"Now step aside," he continued. "We have to meditate on the nature of un-being before getting drunk tonight."

The trio pushed past Prak'kesh, floating their way toward the Tower. The bookie made a rude gesture at the retreating fireteam and walked back to Tulnik. They looked down at the calling card. It was worse than they feared. 

Emblazoned across the paper was the emblem of a big black spider.
1599443272.lore_zh:
普拉凯什和他的觉醒者保镖图尔尼克，已经盯着一群群投注者在埃里克斯尼居住区进进出出一个小时了。很显然，抢了他们生意的人势头越来越猛。

这个赌注登记人发现一个术士火力战队如微风般在街上飘荡。他带着最无害的微笑走近了他们。

“嘿，你们是术士，对吧？”普拉凯什假装自己是个乡巴佬。

那名队长是个影宗，他伸出手，凭空召唤出一根闪闪发光的水晶杖。“你怎么知道的？”他得意地笑了笑。他的队友们则洋洋自得地在他的身后摆姿势。

“因为你们…呃…华丽的手镯，”普拉凯什指着术士的手臂答道。

“这是个天青臂环，蠢货，”摆姿势的破晓嘲笑道。

“酷啊！我刚从农庄到这儿来，”普拉凯什说着，尽力模仿乡巴佬的行为。“我想投注术士会在守护者游戏中胜出，因为你们术士显然是最坚韧又最危险的职业。”在他身后，图尔尼克假装咳嗽来掩饰自己的哄笑。

“你比看上去聪明多了，”那名影宗哼了哼。 

“问题是，”普拉凯什继续说道，“我不知道该在哪里投注。你知道这附近有赌注人吗？”

那名破晓翻了个白眼，“是‘赌注登记人'。”

“哇，”普拉凯什答道。“你们真是见多识广。”

“把这个给其中一个堕落者看，”那名影宗说，“他们就会为你指引方向。”他递给了普拉凯什一张纸。 

“现在给我站一边去，”他继续说道。“在今晚喝醉之前，我们还得冥想非存在的本质。”

三人随后穿过普拉凯什，朝着高塔飘去。赌注登记人对远去的火力战队做了个粗鲁的手势，然后走向图尔尼克。他们低头看了看名片，情况比他们担心的还要糟。 

纸上绣着一只巨大的黑蜘蛛徽标。

3259193988.name: Osmiomancy Gloves
3259193988.flavor: Osmium's existence requires near-divine intervention—a supernova—to forge.
3259193988.lore:
As we count the dead and make plans for recovery, I wish to record some of my recent scientific inquiries and theories before they are muddled by or altogether forgotten in the tangle of rebuilding what was lost.
 
Possibility. It exists within each life, an expanse and myriad of complexity explored openly through the philosophical constructs of choice and free will. Even when life ends, possibility carries forward in the lives touched and the projects created. When the actions of another end a life, Humans often refer to this act as killing or "taking a life." But where killing brings about a singular conclusion, Oryx's "Taking" was quite the opposite: he imposed a singular origin and all decisions that followed. He shaped the causality, the very history of another being, by force of will—recasting it into fanatical loyalty. In short, possibility never existed.

Like Ikora, my role is anticipating threats. While these Taken and their king may have been the most dangerous opponents we have ever faced, they likely will be the least of what is yet to come. And Taking has terrible potential if wielded by a mind more nuanced than Oryx's. Taking involves reforming matter in a self-contained reality, where the creator defines past, present, and future; imagine how a more insightful being could expand these definitions, to different ends. Overcoming a target's will must consume a large portion of energy. What if you used that energy for larger shifts in reality? You could teleport an army into a Hive mothership… move a fleet outside time and space… perhaps even alter a moon's orbit, devastating the planet below. The military applications could be far graver than simply creating an army.

Clearly, this is a subject in dire need of study. As the Taken themselves are frustratingly ephemeral, I have instead retrieved a variety of osmium ore samples from Oryx's flagship. They resonate in harmony with the Taken and thus may provide guidance in understanding the profane science behind them.

—Personal Logs, Ophiuchus
3259193988.lore_zh:
清点死亡人数并制定恢复计划时，我希望把我最近的一些科学研究和理论记录下来，以免在我们重建所失去时，它们在混乱之中被弄乱或完全被遗忘。
 
可能性——它存在于每个人的生命中，通过选择和自由意志的哲学建构，让你自由探索广阔无边又充满了无数的复杂性。即使生命结束了，可能性仍会在被接触的生命体和创造的项目中延续。当一人的行为结束了另一人的生命时，人类常把这种行为称为“杀害”或“夺取生命”。但杀害只能带来单一结果，而欧里克斯的“夺走生命”恰恰相反：他把单一的起源和随之而来的所有决定强加于人。他靠意志力强行塑造了因果关系，塑造了另一个人的历史，进而将其转变为疯狂的忠诚者。简而言之，可能性从来就不存在。

和艾可拉一样，我的职责是预测威胁。虽然傀儡军团和邪神可能是我们所遇到过的最危险的对手，但比起将要到来的他们算是微不足道。如果由一个比欧里克斯更微妙的头脑夺取生命，那么这种行为可能造成的威胁将非常巨大。这包括在一个自给自足的现实中改造物质，而且那里的创造者将会定义过去、现在和未来；想象一下，如果一个更有洞察力的人将这些定义扩展到不同的目的将会如何？战胜目标的意志必定需要消耗大量的能量，可是如果你把那能量用于现实中更大的转变呢？你或许能把一支军队传送到邪魔族母舰上…也许能将舰队脱离时间和空间…甚至可能改变卫星的轨道，摧毁下面的行星。而军事应用上可能远比简单地创建一支军队更为严重。

显而易见，这是一个迫切需要研究的课题。由于傀儡军团本身就有着令人沮丧的短暂寿命，所以我从欧里克斯的舰船上取回了各种锇素矿石样品。这些样品与傀儡军团和谐共振，因此可能可以帮助我们为理解其背后的世俗科学提供指导。

——个人日志，蛇夫座

511888814.name: Secant Filaments
511888814.flavor: The nature of the secant is to intercept a curve, a role all human relationships likewise fill.
511888814.lore:
In this treatise, I plan to revisit earlier mathematical theorems and revise them considering our new observations on the Light, the Darkness, and lifeforms imbued with those respective powers. But before I do so, I must preface it with a personal note.

Despite high-minded assumptions, mathematics is not an intrinsic language of the universe. It is how we describe the portions of the universe that we can observe. While numbers can track the abstract and find pattern in chaos, they cannot account for fundamental aspects of reality such as compassion or justice. The existence of the Lucent Hive, and Hive Ghosts in particular, may expand our understanding of causality, but they themselves are not "new"—the only thing that is new is our awareness and observation of them. These Ghosts have already been living alongside us. They've traveled with us. Endured with us.

What we see is the mushroom, the fruit of the fungus. The fungus itself is a vast mycorrhizal network of filaments growing and working unseen below the soil, often barely connected to the fruiting bodies we observe. Similarly, we have observed Ghosts—Hive Ghosts included—without understanding the nature of the unseen filaments that may guide us. 

In our eagerness to understand the universe, we must not assume our observations are complete, or objective. Otherwise, we blind ourselves to possibilities… like the possibility that an unnoticed faction among us may be one temptation away from betrayal. Or that what drives our creator is no more than the same base desire for survival that drives all living things.

—On Secants, Introduction, Ophiuchus
511888814.lore_zh:
在这篇论文中，考虑到我们对光能、暗影和具有这两种能力的生命形态的新观察，我打算重新审视之前的数学定理并对它们进行修正。但在此之前，我必须先说下我个人的观点。

尽管有高尚的假设，数学不是宇宙的固有语言，而是我们用来描述所能观察到的宇宙的一种方式。虽然数字可以追踪和寻找混乱中的抽象概念和规律，但无法用于解释现实的根本方面，如同情或正义。光明邪魔族的存在，尤其是邪魔族机灵的存在，可能可以帮助我们扩展我们对因果关系的理解，但其实他们的存在并不是什么新鲜事——能称得上新鲜的只是我们对他们的观察和认知。这些机灵早已经和我们一起生活了，还与我们同行，共同经历风雨。

我们所看到的其实是蘑菇，也就是真菌的果实。“真菌”本身就是一个巨大的菌根网络，细丝在肉眼看不到的土壤之下无形地生长和工作，并且通常与我们观察到的子实体几乎没有联系。同样地，我们观察了机灵，包括邪魔族机灵，却不了解那些指引我们的无形细丝的本质。 

在我们急于了解宇宙的时候，我们不能认为自己的观察是完整或客观的。否则，我们就无法看清各种可能性…例如我们之中被忽视的派系，离背叛只有一步之遥的可能性；又或者是，驱使我们造物主的只不过是和驱使所有生物相同的基本求生欲望。

——关于割线，引言，蛇夫座

1796949035.lore:
"Glint."

"Yeah, buddy?" His Ghost's voice is eager. It had been a few hours since Crow last spoke.

"Is there anything you hate about yourself?" Crow turns in the seat of his tree saddle overlooking a sparsely forested valley split by clear Trostland waterways.

"Whoa. That's intense. Um… well—"

"It feels like my guts were pulled out in different directions, and I'm just… standing here, trying to reel them in. Nothing fits back the way it was." 

He had walked behind a god while she led him on a leash of his entrails—one he'd accepted in enthusiastic fashion. The thought of it was surreal, like another life presented in horrifying detail, in vivid waking visions. It was a wound worsened by the sight of the severity, and of course, he couldn't look away.

"Well, that's rather graphic," Glint chirps, processing. 

"Do you really have to put… uh, it… back in? Is it maybe OK being out?"

"Forget it," Crow relents. "Different question."

"Sounds good!" Glint agrees with an awkward chuckle.

"Do you think the Spear…" Crow stops himself and reforms his thoughts. "…Wherever Savathûn pulled Uldren from… he was always buried somewhere in me, right? Maybe I could use the Spear to step into that place. Step into my past and… put whatever's left of him to rest." Crow exhales and stares blanky into the horizon. "I want him gone. If the Spear could let me do that… I don't know."

"Oh… Crow, I don't think it works that way." Glint is quiet long enough for Crow to shift nervously. "Look Crow, we've been through a lot of bad things together. But you've never been the bad part about any of it. I wouldn't change a single thing about you… even a little."

Glint sinks into Crow's lap. "Besides… that last guy didn't have me."
1796949035.lore_zh:
“格林特。”

“怎么了，伙计？”他的机灵急切地回答道。乌鸦已经有几个小时没说话了。

“你有讨厌自己的哪一点吗？”乌鸦在他的树鞍座上转过身来，望向被清澈的慰藉之地水道分割的稀疏森林山谷。

“哇，这个话题好沉重。呃…这个嘛…”

“我感觉我的五脏六腑就像是在被四面拉扯，而我只是站在这里，试图把它们收回来，可怎么都回不到原来的样子。” 

他曾跟随过一个神。她用他的内脏当牵绳，而他还是欣然接受了。光是想想就觉得不可思议。那段回忆就像是以可怕的细节展现的另一段人生，一场生动的白日幻梦，一条愈发破裂的伤痕；而他却只能眼睁睁着看。

“那可真形象，”格林特答道，思考着刚才那番话。 

“那你觉得自己需要…呃…把那些东西放回去吗？还是说放着在外头也没事？”

“不提它了，”乌鸦的语气稍有缓和。“问个其他的问题吧。”

“好主意！”格林特尴尬地笑了笑，表示同意。

“你认为长矛…”乌鸦想了想，改口说。“不管萨瓦图恩是从哪把欧顿拉来的…他永远都埋在我心里的某个地方，对吧？也许我可以用突触之矛进去那个地方。走进我的过去…让他安息。”乌鸦呼出了一口气，茫然地盯着地平线。“我想要他消失。也许长矛能帮我实现这一点…但我不确定。”

“哦…乌鸦，我觉得这行不通。”格林特沉默了很久，久到乌鸦紧张地挪了挪身子。“听着，我们一起吃过不少苦。但那都不是你的错。我不想让你改变…一点都不。”

格林特降到了乌鸦的腿上。“而且…那个家伙可没我陪着。”

3216652511.lore:
EDZ-224107

You can't beat Hive into submission, or threaten them with pain. They live pain, speak it even. But they're vulnerable to hubris. 

Glint whirs, moving to get a better angle. "You're lucky that cleaver didn't chop you in half." 

Crow understands the danger. Glint's sure said it enough—but he knows that his intel saves fireteams from ambushes and uncovers Lucent Hive positions. Self-destruction be damned; you can't argue with results. 

"Just because I can fix you doesn't mean you shouldn't protect yourself," Glint hums. Rain washes blood from accumulated holes in Crow's armor. There is thunder, but he can't see the flash.

COSMODROME-224112

Crow trades blows with a Lucent Wizard until she grounds him with an Arc lance. He writhes across the dirt. She promises to sacrifice his Light to a vessel in the Hellmouth. He feigns begging. The Wizard cackles with delight and lets slip her commander's name on the Moon. Crow thanks her with a well-placed Solar blade. Glint materializes as Crow calls the Accipiter.

"I know it's not what Saladin would do."
 
Crow winces as Glint stitches the gushing split in his neck with Light-thread restoration. 

"The Hive need to think they're winning," Crow says through gritted teeth. 

They monologue, like their words are torture; reveal tiny scraps as they mock him, when they think he's done for. And he lets them. He collects the grains of truth and turns them into something useful. 

MOON-224120

Crow stares down over thirty Hive emerging from the gaping Hellmouth. Two Lightbearing Knights lead them. They shriek and posture over the corpse of a freshly drained Guardian.

"You should go," Crow says to Glint, removing his helmet. He sets it on the stone at his feet. The thin Moon air is coarse with particulate. He dashes toward the gnashing swarm.

"At least put your helmet back on!" Glint calls after him meekly. "…I'll get help!"

Solar Light flows through Crow. "Come on! YOU WANT ME? I'M HERE!" 

Hand flexes around the grip of his cannon; flames sputter from fingertips across cylinder—a series of firebolts crack from Crow's freshly kindled Golden Gun. He unloads as many rounds as he can before the Hive close the distance to him. It's enough to incinerate the Knight and their Ghost, but not the army of Thrall still rushing him down. Crow primes a Tripmine Grenade as the churn of Thrall claws tear him apart.

*****

Crow opens his eyes. Glint floats over him beside a strange woman. 

"That was a wasteful life, Prince of the Reef," she says disapprovingly.

"Don't call me that." He sits up in a hanging trail of moondust, realizing she likely dragged his body from the Hellmouth.

"He's not a fan of nicknames," Glint whispers to her.

"Very well. I'm Eris Morn, a friend," the woman croons with an outstretched hand.

"Right." Crow takes her hand and stands. "Makes sense… with the…" Crow gestures to his eyes, but Eris doesn't seem to react. He coughs awkwardly. "Uh, Ikora mentioned you… being on Europa, and Mars, I think."

"The Hive move against Earth. Something approaches, and I am deciphering its course. Though regarding Savathûn's plots and the whims of queens, I imagine our motivations are not dissimilar."

Crow sighs. "Well, I'm done being strung along by people with plans."

"The powerful have plans for us all. It's better to see them laid out before you," Eris offers.

Crow glares at his Ghost. "Hm. Sounds like someone's been sharing again…"

"I knew you, and I know of you." Eris grips the scales of his sleeve and pulls him uncomfortably close. "Your memories will be lessons in time, when you've burned out your vengeance and self-pity. Trust."
3216652511.lore_zh:
欧洲无人区-224107

你无法以武力让邪魔族屈服，也不能利用痛楚威胁他们。他们一生活在痛楚中，甚至所表达的，都是痛楚。但他们容易受到傲慢的影响。 

格林特呼呼地开始移动，以找到一个更好的角度。“那把大刀没把你劈成两半，算你走运。” 

乌鸦明白那有多危险。格林特已经说得够多了…但他知道，是他的情报将火力战队从伏击中解救了出来，并暴露了光明邪魔族的位置。去他的自毁吧，结果是有目共睹的。 

“就算我能治好你，也不表示你不用保护自己，”格林特嗡鸣着说道。雨水冲掉了乌鸦护甲上累积的孔洞中所流出来的鲜血。雷声不停地响，但他看不到闪光。

发射基地-224112

乌鸦与一名光明巫师正打得难舍难分，只见那巫师施展电弧长矛将他击倒。他在地上痛苦地扭动。她承诺将他的光能奉献给地狱深渊的一个容器。这时他假装乞求。而就在巫师高兴地咯咯笑着，并不谨透露了月球上指挥官的名字的时候，乌鸦抓住时机使出一记烈日刀结果了她。格林特在乌鸦调用光辉鹫鹰时出现了。

“我知道萨拉丁肯定不会这么做。”
 
当格林特用光能修复术缝合他脖子上不断涌出鲜血的伤口时，乌鸦不禁抽搐了一下。 

“我得让邪魔族以为自己要赢了，”乌鸦咬紧着牙关说道。 

他们自言自语，就像话语本身就是一种折磨。在他们嘲笑他，认为他已经完蛋了的时候，就会透露他们所知道的小情报。而这都是他诱使他们这么做的。他将这些小小的真相收集起来，整理成有用的资料。 

月球-224120

乌鸦凝视着从地狱深渊的裂口里冒出来的三十多个邪魔族。两名持有光能的骑士带领着它们。他们尖叫着，站在刚被抽干光能的守护者的尸体前。

“你该走了，”乌鸦对格林特说。他摘下头盔，然后把它放在了脚边的石头上。稀薄的月球空气中夹杂着细小的颗粒。他冲向了张牙舞爪的虫群。

“至少戴上头盔啊！”格林特无力地朝着他身影喊道。“…我这就去找援兵！”

烈日光能流过乌鸦。“来呀！想要我的命？我就在这里！” 

他抓紧手炮的握柄，火焰从指尖越过枪筒溅射，一连串的烈焰从乌鸦刚点燃的黄金枪上爆发。他想在邪魔族近身之前，尽量多开几次火。虽然骑士和它们的机灵都被烧成了灰烬，它们身后的怨魂大军仍在源源不断地扑过来。在怨魂的疯狂撕咬下即将被撕成碎片的乌鸦，激活了一枚感应手雷。

*****

乌鸦睁开了眼睛。格林特悬浮在他的身上，旁边还有一位陌生女性。 

“你是在挥霍生命，暗礁王子，”她不赞同地说道。

“别这么叫我。”他坐起身来，扬起了一缕月尘。看来是她把他从地狱深渊里拖了出来。

“他不喜欢被起外号，”格林特悄悄对她说。

“好吧。我叫埃里斯·摩恩，是你的朋友，”女子低声说道，伸出了一只手。

“哦，”乌鸦握住她的手，站了起来。“在看到你这后…”乌鸦指了指他的眼睛，但埃里斯似乎没有反应。他尴尬地咳了咳。“艾可拉曾提到过你…你以前在木卫二和火星，是吧？”

“邪魔族大举进攻地球。某个东西在接近，而我正在解密它的路线。鉴于萨瓦图恩的计划和女王们的反复无常，我想我们的动机并没有太大的不同。”

乌鸦叹了一口气。“我受够了那些满腹计策的人的摆布。”

“强者为我们所有人制定了计划。最好先看清摆在面前的计划，”埃里斯建议道。

乌鸦瞪了他的机灵一眼。“嗯。看来某个人又没管住嘴…”

“我知道你，也了解你。”埃里斯抓住他袖子上的鳞片，把他拉得很近。“当你耗尽复仇和自怜之后，你的记忆将会成为有用的教训。相信我。”

1572896086.flavor: It's enough to drive someone out of their mind.
1572896086.lore:
Crow feels unease when he touches the active Psisorium. There's a throbbing sensation at the base of his skull. It starts at the back of his head and works its way forward. A compelling aura flows from the Psisorium, ushering buried memories to the surface of Crow's mind.

Uldren Sov felt unease as he stood with fingertips against the Dark Shard. Everything was wrong, but he ignored it. There was a throbbing sensation at the base of his skull. It burrowed underneath and snaked in between his vertebrae: an impulse taking hold in his nerves that he was helpless to follow. A whisper he strained to hear, "Save her."

The Psisorium vibrates against the nails of his ungloved fingertips. Lucent Hive bodies twitch in unfeeling response to the mental scrying. Crow feels the rhythm of alien thoughts sweep over him like wind on stone, catching in ruts and divots worn by time. He sees glimpses, reflections of an end to justify the means.

A voice rattled Uldren Sov's mind, the cool tones of his sister slipping into well-worn grooves as he watched dreams carve themselves into his reality. Lucidity flashed like panicked gasps under thin sheets of ice. His desire taken: wishes turning sour in his mouth as he spoke them, tasting no longer of promise, now only of regret.
1572896086.lore_zh:
乌鸦碰触到活跃的灵能馆时感到了不安。他的头骨底部有一种悸动的感觉。这种感觉从后脑勺开始，一直向前延伸。一种无法抵抗的气场从灵能馆涌出，将埋藏的记忆带到了乌鸦的脑海表面。

欧顿·索维不安地用指尖触碰着黑暗碎片。一切都不对劲，但他没有理会。他的头骨底部有一种悸动的感觉。它在底下钻来钻去，在脊椎骨之间蜿蜒而行：有股冲动牢牢地控制着他的神经，他却无能为力。他勉强听到了一声低语，“救救她。”

灵能馆振动着他裸露指尖的指甲。光明邪魔族的身体在对精神探知的无情反应中抽搐着。乌鸦感觉到外来思想的节奏像风吹在石头上一样掠过他，陷入了被时间磨损的车辙和凹痕。他看到了无数片段和反思，都抱着合理化那些手段的目的。

有个声音不断用他姐姐的冷静腔调搅得欧顿·索维心神不宁。他看到了融入现实的梦境。清醒的意识犹如纤薄冰层下惊恐的喘息般闪过。他被夺走的愿望，被诉说着的同时，在嘴中变得酸涩。如今希望已不复存在；能从中品味到的只有悔恨。

1248372789.name: Sweet Sorrow
1248372789.flavor: A scratched-out inscription on the barrel reads, "A birthday is just a number. How about we pick this one?"
1248372789.lore:
Amanda Holliday hurls a wrench at the wall, her grunt of effort punctuated by the sharp clang of metal striking metal. Her shoulders rise and fall with each labored breath in the silence that follows. 

She gasps softly and rushes forward—eyes scanning the surface of the wrench for cracks as her fingers frantically reach for the socket. She turns the ratchet, hoping to hear the reassuring click of the gears. But there is nothing, no movement inside from either direction.

"Damn it," Amanda hisses, rubbing the heel of her palm against her eye. "Dammit!" 

She sees a racing helmet at her feet and kicks it across the garage floor. 

Everything around her is a painful reminder of her ignorance: A blue-and-white auto rifle of Cabal design with an inscribed message on the barrel. Her favorite ramen bar and sightseeing locations circled on a map of the Last City. A datapad loaded with coordinates for the old Haakon Precipice racetrack. The nearly finished Sparrow she and Niik had been working on, blazoned with airbrushed feathers of ebony and white.

"Damn it," Amanda whispers. Her back brushes against the wall, and she leans into it as her body slowly crumples to the floor. Her head dips to the side and rests on the cold engine of the Sparrow beside her. She pulls her legs toward her chest and curses into her knees, burying her face in them as her shoulders begin to rise and fall in trembling bursts. 

Of all the friends she could have made, of all the people who could have become important in her life, of all the horrible twists of fate she could have endured…

…why did they all have to be him?
1248372789.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪将一把扳手朝墙面扔了去；她使劲的吭哧声中夹杂着金属撞击的尖锐响声。在撞击之后那短暂的静默里，她的肩膀随着每次费力的呼吸而起伏。 

她缓慢地吸了口气，然后冲向前去——她扫视着扳手的表面，检查是否砸出了裂缝，同时拼命地将手指伸向插槽。她转了转棘轮，希望能听见齿轮发出令人安心的“咔哒”声。但她什么都没听见。里面什么动静都没有。

“该死，”阿曼达一边嘶吼着，一边用手掌根部揉着她的眼睛。“真该死！” 

她瞅见脚边有一顶竞速头盔，于是一脚把它踢飞到了车库的另一头。 

她周围的一切都在提醒着她的无知：一把枪管上有铭文的卡巴尔蓝白色自动步枪；一张圈出了她最爱的拉面馆和观光地点的圣城地图；一张装着了老哈肯·普雷西皮赛车场坐标的数据板；一辆她和尼克耗尽心思喷上黑白羽毛涂装，几近完成的快雀。这令她痛苦不堪。

“该死，”阿曼达嘟囔道。她背靠在墙上，又逐渐滑坐到地板上。她的头垂向一边，靠在旁边那辆快雀冰冷的引擎上。最后，她一边咒骂着，一边埋头蜷缩起来，双肩颤抖着，起伏着。 

为什么她交到的那个朋友，那个成为了她一生惦念的人，那个被可怕的悲运牵连到的人…

…都非得是他？

2097055732.lore:
Mithrax squeezed through the tight Bazaar alleyway. Visiting the Tower made him feel out of place, like a creature moving through a world designed for smaller beings—which, he supposed, he was.

As he reached back to pull his Ether tubes free from a snag in the jagged brickwork, he felt something collide sharply with his elbow. 

His mind was suddenly filled with a flare of hot bitterness—a burst of bladed anger.

Mithrax looked down to see a Psion, clothed in Empress Caiatl's colors, wincing in pain and rubbing its eye. 

"Forgive me," Mithrax said graciously. "You must be the one assisting the Guardians against the Hive." 

The Psion looked up at him, then ducked its head in apology. The vision immediately dissolved from Mithrax's mind. 

"I am Misraaks, Kell of House Light," he said, putting a hand to his chest. 

The Psion paused, then gestured to its chest and Mithrax's head. It held its hand open as if waiting for a response.

Mithrax nodded his assent, and into his mind was placed a scattering of orange cubes, a spiraling helix of inky fins, and the sensation of biting through an unripe fruit.

The vision faded. "That is your true name?" Mithrax asked. The Psion gave a short bow. 

Mithrax smiled. "I understand why Guardians simply call you 'the Psion,'" he said. 

A swarm of smooth yellow planes fluttered through Mithrax's mind: laughter. 

Mithrax stepped to the side, and the Psion moved past him. As it did so, there was a final vision: a wink of warm, cheerful brightness, fading but promising to return. 

"To you, as well," Mithrax called, and the Psion vanished around the corner.
2097055732.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯挤过狭窄的集市小巷。造访高塔让他感到格格不入，就像是一个生物穿行于一个专为更娇小的存在设计的世界里一样。他也曾是其中一员，他心想。

当他回过头去想把这根乙太管从参差不齐的砖缝中拔出来时，他感到有什么东西猛烈地撞击了他的胳膊肘。

一股炽热的愤恨突然灌进了他的脑海，犹如一阵阵刀锋般的怒火。

米瑟拉克斯低下头，看到一个身披查厄托女帝军装的灵能士兵，痛苦地抽搐着，揉着自己的眼睛。

“请见谅，”米瑟拉克斯和蔼地说。“你一定是那个帮助守护者对抗邪魔族的灵能士兵吧。”

灵能士兵抬头看了看他，然后低下头道了歉。那幻象立刻从米瑟拉克斯的脑海中消失了。

“我是米斯拉阿克斯，光能氏族的凯尔，”他边说，边把手放在了胸口上。

灵能士兵停顿了一下，然后对着自己的胸口和米瑟拉克斯的头做了个手势。他张开手，似乎在等待回应。

米瑟拉克斯点点头表示同意，脑海中浮现出一片散落的橙色管道，一串螺旋状的墨色鳍，以及一阵咬住未熟果实的感觉。

幻象消失了。“那是你的真名吗？”米瑟拉克斯问道。灵能士兵微微鞠了一躬。

米瑟拉克斯笑了。“我明白守护者为什么只是管你们叫做‘灵能士兵'了，”他说道。

一群黄色飞机在米瑟拉克斯的脑海里平稳地掠过：那代表着笑声。

米瑟拉克斯走到一边，灵能士兵从他身边走过。他这么做的时候，最后的幻象出现了：一抹温暖、欢快的亮光，逐渐黯淡，但似乎还会重现。

“你也是，”米瑟拉克斯喊道。那个灵能士兵消失在了拐角后面。

2638190703.name: Aisha's Embrace
2638190703.flavor: Fill my wounds with molten gold and make me whole again.
2638190703.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
2638190703.lore:
She has been here before.

Pale whisps of clouds swirl over pine trees the color of blackened emerald. No birds sing here; only the cold wind whistles through the tree branches. Flares of atomic fire bloom in the woods and lick against smoldering bark. There is poison in the ground, violence in the air. Screams, both human and inhuman, erupt and echo out into the gloom.

She has been here before.

Two dozen Hive Thrall erupt from the mouth of a cave, shimmering and opalescent like mollusk corpses. They scramble through the dark, shrieking cries of death and birth. Shayura stands, sword of fire held fast, screaming against the crashing tide of chitin and bone.

She has been here before.

Burning embers of Thrall rain around her, but with each dispatched wave of necrotic soldiers, their numbers seem to double. They press forward, inching her closer and closer to the crumbling ravine. Shayura knows that the only way out is through. Wings of flame roar off her back, leaving a trail of rippling heat and charred Thrall in her wake.

She has been here before.

The Thrall finally recede, but the towering Knight that strides through their parted ranks is an escalation, not a victory. Her sword clashes with the Knight's shield, shattering it in a single blow before tearing through the Knight's arm and sinking her blade into its chest.

She has been here before.

She can feel her Light ebbing and wastes no time splitting the Knight in half and separating head from body. Shayura exhales with relief, but with her next breath comes a blinding flash of light. It manifests above the Knight. Her vision swims, her mind reels; the shape is at once familiar and alien—a Ghost. Shayura sees the Hive Knight reborn, reconstructed, as a Guardian would be.

She has been here before. But not like this.

Deep panic builds in her chest. This is no Hive death ritual; this is not Titan. She runs from the Knight's next swing and slips into the reach of Thrall that tear at her armor. Mustering the last of her Solar energy, Shayura calls up a cyclonic pillar of flame that twists up into the sky and consumes the Knight.

…not like this.

The revenant Knight collapses in the flames, and its Ghost manifests again. Shayura leaps forward and drives her sword through, pinning the screaming Ghost to the forest floor. Her Solar aura flickers and fades; smoke and steam billow from her back and shoulders.

"NOT LIKE THIS!"

"Shay!"

Shayura's breath catches, her mind jostled. She feels the soft grass beneath her and sees the flower-dappled park that surrounds her, all sitting beneath the shadow of the Traveler in the heart of the City. Her SMG lies on the ground at her side. Tears shine below exhausted eyes, dark hair in a tangle matted to her head.

Aisha kneels in front of her friend as one might before a wild animal. Reed-7 stands at her back in abject silence, hand over his mouth. City security fans out behind him, their weapons trained on Shayura. 

"Shay?" Aisha pleads this time. She gingerly places her hands on Shayura's cheeks and looks into her eyes, searching for a sign of recognition. Shayura eventually reaches up and touches one of Aisha's hands. She tries to talk, but her words are merely whimpers.

Aisha wraps her arms around Shayura's shoulders and pulls her into an embrace. "It's going to be okay," Aisha whispers into Shayura's hair.

"We're going to get you help," Aisha promises.

Shayura does not trust herself or the world she thought she knew. Light is Dark, Dark is Light. The lines have blurred beyond recognition.

But at least in surrender, there is peace.
2638190703.lore_zh:
她经历过这个。

苍白的云朵盘旋在近乎黑色的深绿色松树上方。这里没有鸟儿歌唱；只有寒风呼啸着穿过树枝。原子火焰的光辉在树林的黑暗中绽放，舔舐着闷燃的树皮。地上毒药泛滥，空中暴力弥漫。人类和非人类的尖叫声在幽暗之中回荡。

她经历过这个。

二十几只邪魔族怨魂从洞口喷涌而出，闪烁着乳白色的光芒，如软体动物的尸体一般。它们在黑暗中窜来窜去，死亡与重生的尖叫不绝于耳。沙玉拉双手紧握一把火焰之刃，朝甲壳和骨头的浪潮咆哮着。

她经历过这个。

怨魂燃烧殆尽的残渣如雨点般落在她的身边，但是这些死灵士兵无论杀掉多少，数量却总是越来越多。在它们的强攻下，她被一步步地逼向了崩塌中的峡谷。沙玉拉知道，现在唯一的生路就是杀出重围。她张开一对火焰之翼，把荡漾的热浪和烧焦的怨魂留在了身后。

她经历过这个。

怨魂之潮退去，但从阵中大步上前的高大骑士说明这并不是胜利的迹象，而是战事的扩大。她用剑一击砍碎了骑士的盾牌，乘势斩下了它的手臂，然后一把刺进了它的胸膛。

她经历过这个。

她感到光能正在衰弱，于是利落地将骑士劈成了两半，取下了它的首级。沙玉拉如释重负地松了一口气，但气还没喘完，一道刺眼的光亮便出现了在她的眼前。这道光亮在骑士的尸体上具象化了出来——这幅既熟悉又陌生的景象使她的视线飘忽，心神不宁：那是一只机灵。邪魔族骑士在沙玉拉的眼前重生、重构，与守护者无异。

她经历过这个，但不是这样的。

沙玉拉的胸中升起了一股惧意。这不是邪魔族的死亡仪式；这不是土卫六。她为了躲开骑士的挥击而朝一旁跑去，却没想到刚起身就遭遇了一群怨魂撕扯着她的铠甲。她使出了全身最后的烈日能量，召唤出一道火焰龙卷风：这股灼热的能量立刻吞噬了眼前的骑士。

…不是这样的。

复生的骑士倒在了火焰里，而他的机灵又出现了。沙玉拉向前一跃，用手中利刃刺穿了机灵；它尖叫着，被扎定在了森林的地面上。围绕周身的烈日光环逐渐消褪，她的背后和肩膀上升起了片片雾气。

“不是这样的！”

“沙？”

沙玉拉缓过神来，思绪仍处于混乱之中。她感到了身下柔软的草地，看见了她四周花团锦簇的公园；所有的一切都坐落在圣城的中央，旅行者的阴影之下。沙玉拉的微型冲锋枪躺在她身旁。泪水从她疲惫的双眼中落下，挂在脸颊上闪闪发光。

艾莎跪在她的朋友前，好像面对着一只野兽。里德-7站在艾莎的身后，一只手捂着嘴，一声不吭。圣城安保人员在他身后呈扇形展开，将手中的武器一齐对准了沙玉拉。 

“沙？”艾莎的言语中带着乞求。她小心翼翼地将双手放在沙玉拉的脸颊上，注视着她的眼眸，寻找着沙玉拉认出她来的迹象。沙玉拉最终伸手碰了碰艾莎的手。她想要说些什么，但她的话语出口后成了一串细声呜咽。

艾莎一把抱住沙玉拉，把她拉进了怀里。“一切都会好起来的，”艾莎对着沙玉拉的头发轻声说道。

“我们会帮助你的，”艾莎许诺道。

沙玉拉不信任自己，也不信任她自以为了解的世界。光明就是黑暗，黑暗就是光明。两者的界线已模糊得无法辨清。

但至少屈服能带来和平。

艾莎跪在她的朋友前，好像面对着一只野兽。里德-7站在艾莎的身后，一只手捂着嘴，一声不吭。圣城安保人员在他身后呈扇形展开，将手中的武器一齐对准了沙玉拉。 

“沙？”艾莎的言语中带着乞求。她小心翼翼地将双手放在沙玉拉的脸颊上，注视着她的眼眸，寻找着沙玉拉认出她来的迹象。沙玉拉最终伸手碰了碰艾莎的手。她想要说些什么，但她的话语出口后成了一串细声呜咽。

艾莎一把抱住沙玉拉，把她拉进了怀里。“一切都会好起来的，”艾莎对着沙玉拉的头发轻声说道。

“我们会帮助你的，”艾莎许诺道。

沙玉拉不信任自己，也不信任她自以为了解的世界。光明就是黑暗，黑暗就是光明。两者的界线已模糊得无法辨清。

但至少屈服能带来和平。

542203595.flavor: An echo of an ancient weapon, forged from a memory of ambition.
542203595.lore:
With a fresh mind and searching eyes, the Scheme-Mother-Reborn returned to her throne world, which, without the edge of sword logic, had become a shell of itself.

Here, she strolled the parapets and fell deep into contemplation. Although she could remember nothing, her mind was as sharp as a tooth.

When she emerged from her contemplation, the Whisper-Queen addressed her brood.

She said:

My children, I know the truth, and out of my love for you, I will share it.

Before them, she killed her most trusted witch in a transcendent blaze of Light. 

This witch became the first of the Lucent, the first resurrected in the image of the queen herself.

—An excerpt from "The Books of Rememoration, A Story Sewn into Flesh with Sinew and Malice, A Record of the Scheme-Mother's Resurrection and Return"
542203595.lore_zh:
头脑清醒和目光敏锐的重生阴谋之母回到了她的王座世界，而这个世界没有了邪剑守则已然变成了一副空壳。

她在护墙上漫步，陷入了沉思。虽然她什么也记不起来，但她的头脑像牙齿一样锋利。

当她从沉思中走出来，低语女王向她的爪牙发表了讲话。

她说：

“我的孩子们，我知道真相。出于我对你们的爱，我将分享这个真相。”

就在他们的面前，她用超然的光能杀了她最信任的女巫。 

这个女巫就此成为了第一个光明邪魔族，第一个以女王的形象重生的邪魔族。

——摘自《纪念之书，由肌腱和怨恨编织成血肉的故事，阴谋之母复活与回归的记录》

2535142413.lore:
The Scheme-Mother-Reborn returned to her Lure. Here, her Ghost companion and her most trusted witch led her to a broken statue.

The statue held a fragmented weapon in its alien arms. When the Scheme-Mother asked why these broken things were on her ship, her most trusted witch told her:

You broke them, my queen, because they belong to a traitor.

The great Goddess of Whispers reached to hold the broken weapon. Although she did not remember its shape, she could feel its power and potential.

The Mother of Lies said:

This vile artifact holds memory, and it is memory that I lack.

Perhaps the-thing-I-was could retrieve these memories, but the-thing-I-am cannot.

I must find a creature capable of holding two wrestling paracausal forces in its breast.

I must outsource my remembering to someone else.

—An excerpt from "The Books of Rememoration, A Story Sewn into Flesh with Sinew and Malice, A Record of the Scheme-Mother's Resurrection and Return"
2535142413.lore_zh:
重生的阴谋之母回到了她的诱饵。在这里，她的机灵同伴和她最信任的女巫把她带到一尊碎裂的雕像前。

这座外星雕像怀里抱着一件破碎的武器。当阴谋之母问这些破东西为何在她的飞船上时，她最信任的女巫告诉了她：

“我的女王，你击碎了它们，因为它们属于叛徒。”

伟大的低语女神伸手去拿那件破碎的武器。虽然她不记得武器的完整形状，但她能感觉到它的力量和潜力。

谎言之母说道：

“这个邪恶的神器存着记忆，而那正是我所缺乏的记忆。

也许过去的我能够找回这些记忆，但现在的我不能。

我必须找到一种能在怀里同时容纳两股相互抵抗超因果力的生物。

我必须把我的记忆传承到另一人身上。”

——摘自《纪念之书，由肌腱和怨恨编织成血肉的故事，阴谋之母复活与回归的记录》

14194600.name: Edge of Intent
14194600.flavor: An echo of an ancient weapon, forged from a memory of cunning.
14194600.lore:
The Witch, Insidious, was killed upon the rock cliff as a wretched sacrifice. With life drawn from the Sky, she was reborn: the Witch, Radiant.

The mangled creature, a Ghost, that bestowed the Sky's life, spoke to her, to restore her unmarked mind. 

It said:

You are a god of the chosen krill, the Hive.

You are the mother of cunning and lies.

You are the first of your kind gifted with Light, which is a paracausal force of the Sky.

The Queen of Lies listened quietly to these reminders. Even in her rebirth, with a mind emptied of memory, her cunning shone brightly, and she stitched together her new truth. 

She asked her new companion where she must go next, and it was then that her most trusted witch arrived to guide her to her Lure. 

—An excerpt from "The Books of Rememoration, A Story Sewn into Flesh with Sinew and Malice, A Record of the Scheme-Mother's Resurrection and Return"
14194600.lore_zh:
作为可怜祭品的阴险女巫死在了悬崖上。她从天空中汲取生命，重生成为了光辉女巫。

机灵，这个赋予了天空生命、严重损坏的生物，和她说话，恢复她那没有标志的心灵。 

它说：

“你是天选克里尔邪魔族之神。

你是狡诈和谎言之母。

你是你们同类中第一个拥有光能之人，它是天空的一种超因果力量。”

谎言女王静静地听着这些提醒，即使重生时她头脑里的记忆清空之后，她的眼睛里仍闪耀着狡猾的光芒，并且仍能够把新的真相拼凑起来。 

她问她的新同伴接下来她该去哪里，就在这时，她最信任的女巫来了，带她找到了诱饵。 

——摘自《纪念之书，由肌腱和怨恨编织成血肉的故事，阴谋之母复活与回归的记录》

46524085.name: Osteo Striga
46524085.flavor: "Victory is not in the unmaking of an enemy, but in the re-making of an enemy into your blade." —9th Understanding, 7th Revision of Sorrow
46524085.source_zh: 来源：“暗屋之声”异域任务
46524085.lore:
Ah, pardon us. It just seems like he's always hungry. When I first became a mother, I didn't realize how much time would just be spent feeding him. Do you mind? Thank you.

No, he doesn't look much like me, I know. There are a lot of orphans these days. I heard him crying from… oh my, it seems like half a world away. It was chance, honestly. I never thought of myself as a parent, but caring for another little life… it's taught me so much.

May I?

Sorry, I don't know why I'm sharing so much with you like this. You just seem easy to talk to. And becoming a mom has really given me a lot more insight into the little connections between people. I used to focus so much on my work. I actually lost a few friends over it.

Oh! Shh, shh, shh… there we go. That's right. Growing babies need their calcium.

Now I can see what matters. The beauty in small things and quiet moments. In watching others light up when they see him. In the way meeting new people broadens him.

I had another child, you know. That was… before. I didn't keep him safe. It's for the best. He's… safe now.

Besides, it means I can appreciate this little one so much more. Just the two of us. 

I love my little Striga.

And he's always… so… hungry.

//CASE 620102; SUSPECT IDENT JANA-14; STATUS: AT LARGE
//EVIDENCE IDENT #303, AUDIO DEVICE; RECOVERED ADJACENT TO DISMEMBERED BODY, RIBS EXCISED
46524085.lore_zh:
啊，抱歉。只是他总是看起来很饿。我第一次成为母亲时，我并没有意识到光是喂养他要花多少时间。能帮个忙吗？谢谢你。

不是的，我知道他长得不太像我。现在这个世道孤儿随处可见，那时候我听到他的哭声…哦我的天，那哭声好像离我有半个世界远。老实说，这纯属偶然。我从没想过自己也会为人父母，但照顾另一个小生命…教会了我很多。

介意吗？

对不起，我不知道我为什么会这样和你分享这么多，可能因为你看起来很平易近人。成为母亲后，我对人与人之间的细微联系有了更深入的了解。我曾经只专注于工作，还因此失去了几个朋友。

哦！嘘嘘嘘…乖乖的哦。没错，成长中的婴儿需要些钙质。

我现在才知道什么是最重要的——小事和宁静时刻的美、别人见到他时脸上的笑容，还有拓宽他的视野所结识的新朋友。

我其实…曾经还有另一个孩子，那是…很久以前了。我没能保证他的安全。也许这才是最好的安排，他现在安全了。

况且，这意味着我可以更加珍惜这个小家伙，就我们两个人。 

我爱惨了我的小金属。

而且他总是…非常…饥饿。

3505113722.name: Collective Obligation
3505113722.flavor: "What The Witness gave me, I give to you. May it serve you in death, or in finality. It cannot be both." —Rhulk, disciple of the Witness
3505113722.lore:
Heard while scavenging a pile of dead Ghosts within the Throne World Pyramid:

"Oh insatiable you—how many beats on the snare of self-righteousness will it take before you acknowledge all the avenues from which you stall the flow of things as they should be?

"You do not see the collective obligation before you, the duteous burden that has rested on all sentient beings since time's origination—to ferry existence toward inevitable consequence: the final shape.

"Why do you unendingly insist on waylaying the machinations of every being with a worldview differentiated from your own? You lack respect. You lack direction. You seek only what you are guided to seek, and for that, you remain little more than an unrelenting nuisance.

"I was like you once. Wayward. Driven to misguided perfection by the bubble society painted around me. But when I look back, none but one had the answers. None but one shed all the airs of any pretense of what the universe was supposed to be in the eyes of the infinitesimal individual—my Witness.

"Through it, I found incentive. Clarity. Purpose. I sought to shed from myself the layer of barbarism that had pervaded my being for so long. I turned instead to the sophistication of infecting others with self-actualized corruption.

"You see, total eradication may be efficient, but the goal is not to be the last one standing. Rather, it is to remove the obstacles that encumber you and those who remain from reaching your destination.

"Annihilation of your kind was never the goal. But filling you with the right kind of ideological purpose, the kind that serves the finality of shape—well, that's the point of corrupting a beating heart, is it not?"
3505113722.lore_zh:
在王座世界金字塔内扫荡一堆死去的机灵时听到的一些话：

“哦，你可真贪得无厌，在你承认自己采取一切手段阻碍事情发展之前，得要先敲几下伪善的响弦？”

“你没有看到你们面前的集体义务，那是自时间起源以来，所有有情众生所承担的责任——将存在引向不可避免的后果：终焉之形。”

“为什么你总是坚持用一种不同于你自己的世界观来阻挠每一个人的阴谋？你缺乏尊重、缺乏方向。你只是寻找别人引导你去寻找的东西，因此，你只不过是个不屈不挠的麻烦。”

“我曾经如你一般刚愎任性，被周围所描绘的社会气泡框住追求误导的完美。但当我回首，只有一人知道答案。也只有一人摆脱了渺小个体眼中的宇宙应该是什么样子的假象，那人就是我的见证者。”

“通过它，我找到了动力、启迪，还有目标。我试图摆脱我们这一族人身上那层长久到渗透进血液的野蛮，相反地，我转向了用自我实现的腐败感染他人的老练做法。”

“听着，彻底根除虽然可能有效，但我们的目标不是成为最后一个存活者，而是清除阻碍你和其他人到达目的地的障碍。”

“完全消灭你们从来都不是我们的目标，而是给你灌输正确的意识形态目的，那种为最终形态效力的目的。毕竟这才是腐蚀跳动心脏的目的，不是吗？”

2812324401.name: Dead Messenger
2812324401.flavor: A gift for the empress who has everything.
2812324401.source_zh: 来源：“暗屋之声”异域任务
2812324401.lore:
Caiatl and Zavala stood side by side, watching a live feed of the Guardian's assault on the Psion transmission facility, as broadcast by Amanda Holliday's circling aircraft.

The Guardian ducked behind cover and pulled out a sleek grenade launcher, recovered during their last assault of the base. They fired into a pack of onrushing war beasts, sending shrapnel hurling through the air. 

The Cabal empress emitted a low rumble as she admired the weapon. Zavala looked up at the enormous ruler with raised eyebrows. Her gaze was fixed on the firefight, her eyes twinkling with violent ardor.

The Vanguard commander shut off the open comms and cleared his throat. "Would you like me to send you one of those grenade launchers? I can have Banshee create a Cabal-sized version for you."

Caiatl looked down at the Awoken leader, suddenly aware that her avarice had been on display. She lowered her tusks, which the commander interpreted as equivalent to a blush.

"That would be most welcome, Commander," Caiatl replied. "I'd like to fire it into Xivu Arath's belly and bathe in her soulfire."

Zavala turned back to the screen. "You have a… passionate spirit, Empress." 

He did not see it, but beneath her mask, Empress Caiatl smiled. 

It was terrifying.
2812324401.lore_zh:
查厄托和萨瓦拉并肩而立，看着面前由阿曼达·霍利迪操控的环绕飞行器所带来的，守护者进攻灵能士兵传输设施的实况直播。

守护者躲在掩体后面，掏出一个榴弹发射器，这个东西是上次他们进攻基地时夺来的。一发打入一群战兽之中，弹药碎片四处飞溅。 

卡巴尔女帝对这个武器发出了一阵低沉的青睐的咕哝。萨瓦拉抬头看着这体型庞大的统治者，眉毛略微扬起。她的眼睛紧盯着战场，闪烁着强烈的热情。

先锋指挥官关闭了通讯，清了清嗓子说道：“你想让我给你一把那种榴弹么？我可以让班西制作一把卡巴尔型号大小的版本给你。”

查厄托看向他，突然察觉出她的贪婪有些过于明显。她的尖牙微微下沉，这个动作在指挥官看来代表她脸红了。

“那就多谢了，指挥官。”查厄托回应道，“我想拿这把武器一发打入希乌·阿拉斯的腹部，然后沐浴她的灵魂火焰。”

萨瓦拉重新看向屏幕：“你有…一个热情的灵魂，女帝。” 

他没有看到，在面具之下，女帝查厄托笑了。 

那可吓人了。

2812324400.lore:
Guardian.

Transparency is not a strong suit of mine. Undoubtedly, this comes as no surprise. However, our… misadventures, let's call them, with the parasite have left me with a recurring ambivalence in regard to said transparency; as a result, I feel as though you are deserving of a more appropriate level of access to my thoughts surrounding recent events.

In my previously mentioned vision was the Witness's one truth: an eternity of Darkness in which I serve as a Disciple. It brought me an overwhelming feeling I previously relayed to you as fear—but in actuality, it was fear born of what I felt most within this vision—gratitude.

Gratitude! As if my place alongside the Witness was meant to be a reward for all I have ever done and ever will do. And if the Witness is to be believed, "all I ever will do" is unbecoming, to say the least.

It is moments like these wherein I wonder if I myself should be put to rest to avoid perpetuating these dark truths. But I have never before wavered from righteousness, and I don't intend to begin now.

With that, you should know that while our revealed truths about Savathûn and the Collapse appeared minimal, I have already used them to begin tracing a trail of evidence that may provide us with the power of preservation in the oncoming storm. When the time is right, we will have further parts to play together.

In the meantime, keep the parasite near, and listen close. It's bound to open its mouth again sooner or later.

—Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken
2812324400.lore_zh:
守护者。

公开透明不是我的强项。毫无疑问，这并不令人意外。然而，我们与寄生虫的…不幸遭遇，让我对上述公开透明反复产生矛盾的情绪；因此，我认为你有资格更加了解我对最近事件的看法。

在我之前所提到的幻觉中，见证者的唯一真理是：我将在永恒的暗影中身为门徒效力。这给我带来了恐惧，一种我之前传达给你的强烈感觉，但实际上，我在幻象中最强烈感受到的是感恩，而因此产生了恐惧。

竟然是感恩！这就好像我能够站在见证者身旁，是对我所做的和将来所做的一切的奖赏。而且如果见证者可信，“将来所做的一切”至少可能不太合适。

正是这样的时刻，让我不禁想到我自己是否应该安息，以避免这些黑暗真理永存。但我对公平正义的信仰从以前就没有动摇过，以前不会现在也不会。

说了这么多，你现在应该知道，虽然我们所揭示的关于萨瓦图恩和大崩溃的真相似乎微乎其微，但我已经开始用这些真相来追踪证据的踪迹，这可能可以在即将到来的风暴中赐予我们保护自己的力量。

在此期间，时刻留意寄生虫的动向，听仔细了。它迟早会再次张开嘴的。

——觉醒者女王，玛拉·索维

1763584999.name: Grand Overture
1763584999.flavor: It's not over until the vast red artificial intelligence sings.
1763584999.lore:
"So. You're the new guy." Ana Bray cracks a half smile. "Can't be worse than the last Psions that Red and I dealt with." She impatiently taps her heel on her workshop bench as the Psion hurriedly checks linkages and nodes on the neural coupling device around her head. 

Words and images skip across Ana's mind like stones. "Remain calm. Even though you are defenseless, I do not possess a starship." A sound resembling laughter follows.

"Funny." Ana chuckles impatiently. "Okay! I've been setting this up for months. Are you done with the safety checks?"

Jinju flies by Ana and runs a scan over the engram. "Be nice."

A digital timepiece drains toward zero while the Psion inundates her mind with questions.

"My Light, Splicer tech, brain tubes. Yeah, I got it," Ana says. "Plug my brain into Red already and let's do this." Her voice quickens with excitement. The Psion finishes linking cables to a Splicer-tech receptacle housing Rasputin's engram and gives Ana an awkward thumb pointing up.

The Psion forms an interlocking image in her mind: a tangle of wires. Slowly, her perspective sifts through them and stops at a radiant center. She hears the words, 'Forgotten vestige, made remembered.'

"That's the plan, Pstan!" Ana exclaims. "Drop me in; I can already hear the Tchaikovsky." She stares down the ticking timer: 3… 2… 1…

Ana blinks. She stands in a vast thicket of thorn and rot. A warmth radiates from deep within the thicket. 

Ana blinks. She presses through bramble as barbs draw blood. Her sense of self wavers. She finds her grip on a searing-hot spike, shifting her senses red like an adrenal rush. 

Ana blinks. She kneels at the spike and rips it from the ground. A Valkyrie javelin is in her grasp.

Ana blinks. The thorned vines around her recoil and wither in the heat. She feels something within the javelin, faint and weak, but alive.
1763584999.lore_zh:
“啊，你是新来的家伙。”阿娜·布瑞露出一点微笑，“不可能比我上次面对的灵能士兵更糟了吧。”在灵能士兵慌忙检查其头部周围连接和节点时，她有些不耐烦地用鞋跟轻踏她的工作台。 

文字和图像像石头一样掠过阿娜的脑海。“保持冷静。即使你毫无防御能力，我也没有星际飞船。”一个类似笑声的声音随之而来。

“你真幽默。”阿娜有些不耐烦地轻笑道，“好了吧！我已经摆弄这些装备好几个月了。你的安全检查完事儿了吗？”

金桔飞到阿娜身侧，扫描了一下记忆水晶后说道：“友善点儿。”

当灵能士兵用问题淹没她的头脑时，一个数字计时器逐渐被清空。

“我的光能，熔岩军团的技术，大脑通管。是的，我知道了。”阿娜说道，“让我和红老大思维连接吧，快点儿。”她的声音满含兴奋。灵能士兵将电缆连接到装载着拉斯普廷记忆水晶的熔岩军团科技接收端，然后向阿娜比了一个别扭的大拇指。

灵能士兵在她的头脑中形成了一个连锁的画面：一团混乱的电线。慢慢地，她的视角穿过它们来到闪亮一个的中心。她听到了这句话：“被遗忘的痕迹，被记起了。”

“就是这样！”阿娜说道，“让我进来，我已经可以听见柴可夫斯基了。”她盯着计时器…3…2…1…

阿娜眨了眨眼。她站在一大片荆棘丛生的灌木丛中。一股暖意从丛林深处散发出来。 

阿娜眨了眨眼。她穿过荆棘，刺得她流血。她的自我意识动摇了。她发现自己抓住了一个灼热的尖刺，使她的感官爆发，就像肾上腺素激增的效果一样。 

阿娜眨了眨眼。她跪下来，将尖刺从地面拔出。一把瓦尔基里标枪出现在她的手中。

阿娜眨了眨眼。她周围的带刺的藤蔓在炎热中退缩并枯萎。她在标枪中感觉到了什么，虚弱萎靡，但是还有生命的气息。

2489136103.name: Eidolon Pursuant Handguards
2489136103.lore:
Eris Morn chalks the floor in the H.E.L.M. wing previously inhabited by the Servitor of the Eliksni Splicers. A liberated Tomb Ship drones beside her. Through the open, shielded, hangar, the Leviathan is visible as a malformed knot, its shape bulging from the shadowed outline of the Moon.

Ikora descends the stairs. An ornately dressed Warlock thanatonaut follows, their robes trimmed in bone and elaborately stitched symbols.

"Did you commandeer this from Mars?" Ikora asks with a smile, looking over the Hive vessel.

Eris stands. "It provided ample shielding for transporting the Crown from its vault."

"It's here, now?" the thanatonaut asks, breaking his stride at the bottom of the stairs.

"Worry not. The H.E.L.M. will disembark from the City to ensure the Crown is contained," Eris answers.

"Keep that Tomb Ship docked here in case we need to jettison the Crown. Last thing I need is a rookie shooting you down in it." Ikora steps past the thanatonaut with a reassuring nod. "Tell us what you're thinking next, Eris."

Eris gestures toward the open bay door. "The Leviathan is at our doorstep. Even if we unravel Calus's plan, the ship itself still poses a threat simply by its size. Calus does not require paracausal power to cause an extinction-level event."

"Calus's interest appears to be focused solely on the Pyramid," Ikora interjects. "Should that change, Zavala assures me that Caiatl's fleet will provide ample dissuasive firepower."

Eris nods in rhythm with Ikora's well-reasoned words. "I trust that to be true—however, whatever connection Calus has established is drawing Nightmares and phantoms alike to the Leviathan. He is able to exert influence over them. But I believe we can disrupt this connection."

She points to the thanatonaut. "You," she says and motions toward three chalked spots on the floor. "Here, here, and here. We will require death anchors to tether the ritual. Hold your mind on the brink for as long as you can, and I will craft the sigils required to contain the Crown. Then, we will need volunteers…"
2489136103.lore_zh:
埃里斯·摩恩在应急后勤行动中心侧翼的地板上用粉笔做着记号，这里以前曾住着埃里克斯尼族熔岩军团的魔眼。一艘自由的棺舰在她身旁嗡嗡作响。透过空旷隐蔽的机库，可以看到利维坦像一个畸形的硬结，它的形状在月球的阴影轮廓中更显凸出。

艾可拉走下楼梯。一位衣着华丽的术士探灵人紧随其后，他们的长袍用骨头装饰，精心缝有各种符号。

“这是你从火星上征用的吗？”艾可拉微笑着问道，看着邪魔族舰船。

埃里斯站起身来。“它为从保险库运输王冠提供了充足的防护。”

“它在这儿，现在？”探灵人问道，在楼梯底部停下了脚步。

“别担心。应急后勤行动中心会离开圣城，确保王冠得到遏制，”埃里斯答道。

“把那艘棺舰停靠在这里，以防我们需要除掉王冠。我可不希望当你在里面的时候，某个菜鸟把它打下来。”艾可拉走过探灵人，点头示意他安心。“告诉我们你下一步的计划，埃里斯。”

埃里斯向敞开的舱门示意。“利维坦就在我们的家门口。即使我们弄清了卡鲁斯的计划，这艘飞船光凭本身的大小也依然是个威胁。卡鲁斯不需要超因果力量就可以造成灭绝级的事件。”

“卡鲁斯的兴趣似乎只集中在金字塔上，”艾可拉插话道。“如果情况有变，萨瓦拉向我保证，查厄托的舰队会提供足够的劝阻火力。”

埃里斯点头附和艾可拉的理性话语。“我相信这一点是真的——不过，无论卡鲁斯建立的是什么样的联系，它都在把梦魇和鬼灵吸引到利维坦上。他能够对它们施加影响。但我相信我们可以破坏这种联系。”

她指了指探灵人。“你，”她说着，朝地板上的三个粉笔记号点指去。“这儿，这儿，还有这儿。我们需要死亡船锚来束缚仪式。把守住你的心灵防线，越久越好，而我会制作遏制王冠所需的印记。然后，我们会需要志愿者…”

29154321.name: Eidolon Pursuant Tunic
29154321.lore:
"You've had this for years and never thought to mention it?" Eris runs her fingers over the grime-clouded containment glass housing a large growth of egregore within the Drifter's Derelict.

"Wasn't hidin' it." Drifter rolls Eris's Ahamkara bone over his knuckles. "Ain't nobody ever asked. Hell, you've walked by it before, Moondust."

"What wonders you must have buried in this heap," Eris muses. The emerald shine of her eyes dart back and forth behind thin cloth.
"I could…" Drifter saunters up beside her, "give you the tour?"

"We haven't the time. Tell me, what have you learned from this egregore sample?"

Drifter wrinkles his face and looks up to the massive, contained growth. "Uhh…"

Eris massages annoyance from her brow. She sees the playful coyness in his eyes. The hidden information he holds as bargain for some trade. "Do you at least remember where you found it?"

"Sister, you don't wanna know." Eris locks her eyes on the Drifter's face. He staggers back awkwardly and shrugs. "Icy little nothing in the middle of nowhere. Doesn't have a name, and you don't want to go there alone."

"But you could take me?" Eris tests his defenses.

Drifter brushes off the mottled fur of his shoulder guards and leans against a poorly fastened railing. "Only if we take your jumpship. And I drive."

Eris sighs and pushes through him. "No."

Drifter springs after her. "So that's it? You're leaving?"

"You're being evasive, Rat." Eris plucks her Ahamkara bone from his hand and stows it beneath her cloak. "Contact me when you're willing to speak plainly."

Drifter calls after her, hands outstretched, "You don't want to stay for dinner?"

Eris halts, considering what disgusting amalgamation of refuse would constitute a meal here. She glances over her shoulder. One last attempt to extract information…

"It is strange. When Savathûn drew Mars back into our space, it was free of the egregore. But the Glykon and Leviathan both returned rampant with fungal growth. Why?" she asks.

He gives in. "You know… it sings if you burn it just right." Drifter thumbs behind him. "Sub-sonic, resonates in a funny way with Pyramid tech."

"Is that so?"

"You don't trust me?"
29154321.lore_zh:
“你有了这东西这么多年竟然没想过要提起它？”埃里斯用手指摸了摸浪客的遗落飞船里那布满污尘的玻璃罩，里头装有一大株的守望者。

“不是故意藏起来的。”浪客在他的指关节上滚着埃里斯的阿罕卡拉遗骨。“从来没有人问过。见鬼，你以前还从这里走过的，小月月。”

“你在这堆东西里一定藏了些什么奇观，”埃里斯沉思道。她那双眼睛的翠绿光泽在薄布后面来回闪动。
“我可以…”浪客在她身边踱来踱去，“带你参观一下？”

“我们没有时间。告诉我，你从这个守望者样本上了解到了什么？”

浪客皱起了脸，仰望着这株受到遏制的巨大生长物。“呃…”

埃里斯头疼地揉搓着眉毛。她从他的眼里看到了顽皮的羞怯。他所掌握的隐藏信息是某种交易的筹码。“你至少还记得是在哪里找到的吧？”

“妹子，你不会想知道的。”埃里斯直勾勾地盯着浪客的脸。他笨拙地踉跄后退，耸了耸肩。“在人烟稀少、荒凉空洞的不毛之地。那地方没有名字，你也不会想要一个人去那里的。”

“但你可以带我去？”埃里斯试探着他的防线。

浪客拂去护肩上斑驳的皮毛，倚在不甚牢靠的栏杆上。“用你的跃迁飞船才行。而且得我开。”

埃里斯叹了口气，推开了他。“不。”

浪客紧跟在她身后。“就这样？你要走了？”

“你在避实就虚，老鼠。”埃里斯从他手中抢过她的阿罕卡拉遗骨，藏在她的斗篷下。“等你愿意直说了再联系我吧。”

浪客摊开双手在她身后叫道，“你不想留下来吃晚饭吗？”

埃里斯停了下来，想着什么恶心的废料混合物能在这儿当作一顿饭。她回头瞥了一眼。最后一次试图获取信息…

“这很奇怪。当萨瓦图恩把火星带回我们的太空时，上头可没有守望者。但格利康和利维坦归来时却满是猖獗滋生的真菌。为什么？”她问道。

他屈服了。“那个…要是你把它烧得恰到好处，它就会唱歌。”浪客在身后竖起大拇指。“亚音速，以一种有趣的方式与金字塔科技产生共鸣。”

“是吗？”

“你不相信我？”

1285042454.name: Eidolon Pursuant Mask
1285042454.lore:
Savathûn is rigid and lifeless beneath the edge of Eris's scalpel as it begins a Y-incision. With each careful removal of a chitin plate, she expects the Witch Queen's muscles to shudder, her eyes to roll open, her claws to cleave Eris in twain as retaliation. 

Rigid. Lifeless. Nothing to fear.

Below the skull, protected by plated scale and fraying Hive enchantment, Eris sees the symbol of the Witch Queen. She peels back muscle and shaves away surrounding tissue for a clearer view of the fading mark etched into Savathûn's encephalon organ with soulfire script. Only then does she see the embellishments adorning the mark; they bring to mind the runic symbols carved into the Crown of Sorrow. She catalogues the embellishments on a data-pad, noting the similarities before continuing her examination, confident in her initial findings regarding a link to the Crown.

A link to the Crown. A lock many have tried to pick. Now Eris holds the key, from the mind of Savathûn herself.
1285042454.lore_zh:
埃里斯的手术刀开始划动Y形切口，而萨瓦图恩在刀口下则显得身体僵硬，毫无生气。每次小心翼翼地取出一块壳质鳞甲，她都担心着巫妖女王会突然肌肉颤抖，双眼睁开，用利爪把埃里斯劈作两半作为报复。 

身体僵硬。毫无生气。没什么好怕的。

在头骨下方，在装甲鳞片和磨损的邪魔族魔法的保护下，埃里斯看到了巫妖女王的象征。她剥去背部的肌肉，刮去周围的组织，以便更清晰地看到用灵火字迹刻在萨瓦图恩大脑器官上的褪色印记。她终于看到了修饰着印记的这些装饰；它们让人想起刻在忧愁王冠上的符文符号。她在数据板上对这些装饰进行了分类，标注出它们之间的相似之处，然后继续检查，对自己与王冠联系有关的初步发现信心十足。

与王冠的联系。一把许多人试图撬动的锁。如今埃里斯掌握了钥匙，来自萨瓦图恩自己的头脑。

1241941801.name: Eidolon Pursuant Legguards
1241941801.lore:
Elsie is not at camp in Beyond; perhaps another time—but Eris emerges from transmat to see the Drifter alone, interrogating Elsie's strange, floating companion.

"Well? What are you?" Drifter points at the thing with distrust.

"Leave it be. The Ziggurat awaits our experiment," Eris says, saddling a mostly materialized Sparrow and blasting off into the snow across the frozen Europan flats.

"…And don't touch my stuff!" She hears Drifter shout at the thing as he follows after her.

Frigid sleet stings Eris's face red atop the Ziggurat. It is a welcome sensation compared to the prickling numbness that sticks her fingers; she grips a harvested stalk of the egregore fungus tightly in one gloved hand. In the other, a hot flare disgorges plumes of jade smoke.

She lights the stalk at both ends, according to the Drifter's instruction. Ashing spores furl into dense clouds that envelop her body, obscuring her sight in soot-black shroud until it blocks out all else.

Faint whispers.

A choral swell through turbulent winds.

Tone that forms words across the surface of her mind.

"You hear it?" Drifter asks, his voice a whisper outside her awareness.

The Ziggurat resonates like a tuning fork. The vibrations themselves take shape within the smoke, and Eris is drawn toward somewhere distant and empty. She follows, and the smoke swirls with points of color like stars, separated by lonely rifts of black expanse. Echoes radiate from the black deep like graviton ripples through space. They wash distortion over the stars until breaking against four other points—two greater, two weaker—ghostly strands of incorporeal egregore between them.

She then sees the Pyramids of Europa, Luna, and Savathûn's throne world—as one, their structures melded and overlapping. The connections cauterize in her mind like a vivid memory.

Eris blinks, and the sensation is gone. The stalk is ash in her hand.
1241941801.lore_zh:
艾尔西不在超越层营地；也许下次再来吧——但埃里斯传送现身时，正好看到浪客独自审问艾尔西奇特的浮空同伴。

“说吧？你是什么？”浪客怀疑地指着那东西。

“别管它了。通灵塔还在等着我们的实验，”埃里斯说道。她备好一辆快要显形的快雀，冲入雪中，穿越冰封的木卫二平原。

“…别碰我的东西！”她听到浪客对那东西大喊大叫，然后跟了上来。

在通灵塔顶上，寒冷的雨夹雪把埃里斯的脸冻得发红，但这跟刺痛手指的针扎麻木感相比要好受多了；她用一只戴着手套的手紧紧地握住割下的守望者菌柄。另一只手中，一道炽热的耀光喷出团团玉烟。

根据浪客的指示，她点燃了菌柄的两端。灰化的孢子卷成浓密的云雾，包裹着她的身体，在煤黑的烟雾中笼罩着她的视线，直至遮蔽一切。

微弱的低语。

狂风中传来逐渐响亮的合唱声。

那些音调穿过她的脑海表面形成话语。

“你听到了吗？”浪客问道，他的声音犹如她意识之外的低语。

通灵塔像音叉一样发出共振。共鸣在烟雾中自行成形，埃里斯被拉向某个遥远而空虚的地方。色彩斑斓的烟雾缭绕着，犹如繁星点点，被黑暗广阔的孤寂裂谷隔绝开来。回响从黑暗的深处向四周伸展，就像引力波穿越太空一样。它们在群星上方冲刷着失真，直到撞上另外四个点位——两个较强、两个较弱——在它们之间是无形守望者的虚灵线束。

然后她看到了木卫二金字塔、月球金字塔和萨瓦图恩的王座世界——就像一个整体，它们的构造互相融合重叠。这些联系就像栩栩如生的记忆一般烙印在她脑海。

埃里斯眨了眨眼，那感觉消失了。菌柄在她手里成了灰烬。

2224584236.name: Eidolon Pursuant Cloak
2224584236.lore:
"You want to go where?" Drifter's jumpship idles roughly behind him, the engine misfiring and clattering loudly as if ready to explode. Eris's ship purrs next to it in contrast.

"There is a connection between the points of Darkness. Signals passing back and forth to something beyond." Eris steps closer so her voice carries over the engine noise. "The other Pyramids may provide more context."

The Drifter clicks his tongue and raises and eyebrow. "Sounds a mite dangerous with big daddy Calus parking right over the Moon? Seems off limits."

"Yes, but the Guardian leads raiding parties into Rhulk's Pyramid in Savathûn's throne world. We will use that distraction."

And with that, Eris shoulders through him and trudges to her ship. "Come, Rat."

"…Can we eat first?"

*** 

Explosions thunder within the throne world's Pyramid as Eris and Drifter establish a camp in the sunken bog where Miasma meets the Pyramid's approach. The massive ship eclipses them, towering in fog, the extent of its edges unknown to their eyes.

Drifter's face is stern, clenched with a tension Eris has seldom seen: Trust in one hand, fist full of Stasis in the other.

Eris sets a cloth-wrapped stalk of egregore upon a pyramid-shard jutting from the stinking swamp. She unwraps and neatly spreads the corners of the cloth before noticing the Drifter's footsteps behind her.

"Somethin's watchin' us," Drifter mutters. He turns to his altered Ghost and whispers softly enough to convince himself that Eris cannot hear him, "Keep your eye on her, eh?" Then louder, "I'm gonna look around, make sure that hotshot hero didn't miss any Screebs."

The Drifter's altered Ghost emits a single elongated tone in acknowledgement and then focuses on Eris.

"Germaine."

He stops. Eris knows his concern belies a nobility that he often attempts to suppress in favor of the persona of the Drifter. It is a ruddy shield, but she has seen the true him hidden under that that layer of grime.

"May I… have a light?"

"You got it." He discharges a Solar round from his Trust that sparks on the Pyramid floor and ignites the egregore stalk. "Back in a flash."

Eris watches him disappear into the swamp, then focuses on the pluming egregore.

***

Eris sits, exhausted, on a warm cushion in the dirt. The Drifter stands over a hazardously large fire, scooping some sweet-smelling funk of a stew from a cauldron-like vessel of Hive design. Her face scrunches as he places a chunky bowl of thick greyish-brown potage in her hands.

"What'd you find?" Drifter asks, slurping from his bowl.

Eris tests the temperature and flavor of this "food" against her lips. It is something like the stinking brined cheeses Ikora had given her on her last visit to the City, but with earthy depth beneath. Her face curls and she opts instead for conversation. "I was right; they are connected. But now, I only have more questions."

"You ask me, that's how these things go. Better leave well enough alone and head home," Drifter says, slurping another mouthful.

"The egregore connects points of Darkness, resonates with Pyramid constructs, but I cannot decipher their communications. Still… the Lunar Pyramid, the Europan Pyramid, and both Glykon and Leviathan all converse with the same distant point. What Rhulk spoke to, so does Calus. It is… gravely concerning."

"Wild," Drifter says with a whistle. He shakes his head and looks at her full bowl. "You gonna eat that?"

"I…" Eris wonders if he heard her correctly but knows repeating herself is an exercise in futility. "…What is this? Exactly?"

"Pretty damn tasty is what it is. First time I got it right. Thought you'd appreciate someone cooking for you since you, uh… well, you're awful at it."

"Rat, what are you feeding me?" She remembers his hunt earlier in the day, and her stomach turns. Eris stares at the Drifter, mouth agape in a half-heaved gag—her thoughts racing over the things he's claimed to have consumed. "You cooked me rotted Screebs."

"What?!" Drifter chokes on the stew and coughs. "I wouldn't feed you that crap, Moondust." He laughs. "You never had crawdad stew?" He holds his bowl to his lips. "Or a close cousin to it…" he adds under his breath. "Little swamp shrimps, you dig? It's a delicacy!"

Eris reels her imagination in, takes a breath, and sips the broth without taking her eyes from the Drifter. The liquid fills her crumpled stomach with hearty warmth. She feels her stress melt away. The stew's flavor is far more pleasing than its smell. She smiles and drinks again.

"Thank you. It is… good."
2224584236.lore_zh:
“你想去哪里？”浪客的跃迁飞船在他身后粗暴地空转着，引擎熄着火，发出咔嗒咔的响声，好像要爆炸似的。埃里斯的飞船在旁边呜呜作响，形成了鲜明的对比。

“暗影的点位之间存在着某种联系。信号来回传递，通向远处。”埃里斯走近一些，让她的声音盖过引擎的噪音。“其他金字塔也许能提供更多信息。”

浪客咂咂舌头，扬起眉毛。“大佬卡鲁斯还停在月球上，听起来有点危险？似乎是禁区。”

“没错，但守护者带领突袭队伍进入了萨瓦图恩王座世界中的胡克金字塔。我们可以抓住这次干扰带来的机会。”

埃里斯说着，从他身边挤过，沉重地走向她的飞船。“来吧，老鼠。”

“…我们能先吃东西吗？”

*** 

埃里斯和浪客在瘴气区与金字塔的通道交界处的下沉沼泽中搭建营地时，爆炸声雷鸣般响彻王座世界的金字塔。高耸入云的巨型飞船遮住了他们的光，一眼望去看不到它的边际。

浪客的脸色很严肃，紧绷着一种埃里斯很少见到的紧张情绪：一只手握着信任手炮，另一只手则攥紧充满冰影的拳头。

埃里斯将一根用布包裹着的守望者菌柄放在一块从恶臭的沼泽地里伸出来的金字塔碎片上。她解开包裹整齐地铺展开布角，注意到了身后浪客的脚步声。

“有人在监视我们，”浪客咕哝道。他转过身来，对着他的改装机灵轻声低语，声音小到足以确信埃里斯听不到他说的话：“盯紧她，好吗？”然后大声说道，“我要四处看看，确保那个盖世英雄没有漏下任何变异体。”

浪客的改装机灵发出一声细长的音调示意明白，然后盯着埃里斯看。

“杰曼。”

他停了下来。埃里斯知道，他的担忧下潜藏着他为了树立浪客的人设而时常试图压制的高贵气质。那是一面该死的盾牌，但她看到了真实的他，藏在那层污垢之下。

“我可以…借个火吗？”

“好。”他从他的信任手炮里射出一枚烈日弹药，在金字塔地板上产生火花，点燃了守望者菌柄。“马上回来。”

埃里斯看着他消失在沼泽地里，然后把注意力集中在袅袅的守望者上。

***

埃里斯筋疲力尽地坐在泥土里一个温暖的垫子上。浪客站在危险的大火堆旁，从邪魔族式样的大锅状容器中舀出一些散发着芬芳怪味的炖汤。当他把一大碗浓稠的灰棕色肉汤放到她的手中时，她的脸皱缩了起来。

“你发现了什么？”浪客一边咂着嘴从碗里喝汤，一边问道。

埃里斯用嘴唇测试着这种“食物”的温度和味道。这有点像艾可拉上次来圣城时带给她的臭盐水奶酪，只不过底下带有浓重的土味。她的脸色凝重，转而选择了谈话。“我想得没错，它们相互联系。但现在，我却有了更多的疑问。”

“要我说，我们根本无能为力。最好别管这事了，回家吧，”浪客说着，又咂了一口。

“守望者连接着暗影的各个点位，与各个金字塔构造产生共鸣，但我无法解读它们之间的联系。不过…月球金字塔、木卫二金字塔，还有格利康和利维坦都在与同一个遥远的点位交谈。胡克所说的话，卡鲁斯也说了。这…太让人担忧了。”

“真奇怪，”浪客吹着口哨说。他摇摇头，看着她满满的碗。“你要吃吗？”

“我…”埃里斯怀疑他没有听清自己说的话，但她知道重复一遍也是徒劳的。“…这到底是什么？”

“好吃的东西。我第一次把它弄对。还以为你会感激有人为你做饭呢，毕竟你…那个，不太擅长。”

“老鼠，你给我吃了什么？”她记得那天早些时候他的狩猎，她的胃开始翻江倒海。埃里斯盯着浪客，张着嘴半呕着。她突然想起了他声称吃过的那种东西。“你给我做了腐烂的变异体。”

“什么？！”浪客被炖汤呛到，咳嗽了起来。“我不会给你吃那些垃圾的，小月月。”他笑道。“你从来没有吃过蝲蛄炖肉？”他把碗举到嘴边。“或者它的近亲…”他低声补充道。“小沼泽虾，你懂吗？很美味的！”

埃里斯收回了想象，深吸一口气，抿了一口肉汤，眼睛却没有从浪客身上离开。这种液体让她皱巴巴的肚子充满了温暖。她发觉自己的压力消失不见了。炖肉的味道远比气味更让人喜欢。她笑了笑，又喝了起来。

“谢谢。它…很好喝。”

3821828136.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
3821828136.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

4236667838.name: Atavistic Idol Grips
4236667838.flavor: "We believe she's also responsible for the dead Guardian and Eliksni we found on Venus. We haven't identified which dead Ghost belongs to the Guardian." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
4236667838.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
4236667838.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

2355943840.name: Atavistic Idol Vest
2355943840.flavor: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2355943840.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
2355943840.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

A Fallen Vandal collapses to the ground, Ether vapor rising from a glowing hole where his face once was. Dark-blue blood sizzles around the wound.

"Clear," Reed-7 calls out from the top of a flight of metal stairs, the barrel of his fusion rifle still crackling with energy from the last bolt it fired. As he descends, Aisha follows and shoulders her scout rifle.

"Looks like they were pulling the wiring out of the walls," she observes, lifting up her hand and alighting her Ghost, Dunya, into the air. "Check the systems here; make sure they weren't doing anything else."

"Affirmative," Dunya chirps, zipping off through the air toward a computer terminal.

Aisha notices that Reed's glowing eyes are fixed on the Ether wafting from the Vandal's body. She spares a glance at Dunya before crossing the floor to Reed's side. "Hey," she says with a hand on his arm, jostling him from his thoughts.

"I'm good," he lies, gingerly pulling away. "Just—thinking."

Aisha looks down at the corpse, then back up to Reed. "This isn't like what Shay did on Venus." She tries to be reassuring, but it comes off as dismissive.

"How's it any different?" He asks with a dagger's sharpness in his voice. "These—they were stripping wires from the walls, Aisha. They weren't trying to hurt anyone!"

"They opened fire on us first."

"We didn't even try to talk to them!" Reed yells.

"Aisha?" Dunya chirps, across the room. Neither Guardian hears the Ghost.

"I'm sorry," Aisha says as she throws her arms up. "Was I supposed to do that before or after they threw a grenade at me?"

"Aisha?" Dunya says again, more alarm in his voice.

"We could have tried something! Anything!" Reed screams, getting in Aisha's face. "We could have—"

"AISHA!"
2355943840.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

一名堕落者暴徒倒在地上，乙太烟雾从曾是他脸部的发光洞里冒出来。深蓝色的血液在伤口周围发出嘶嘶声。

“安全了。”里德-7从一段金属楼梯顶上发出了一声呼喊，他的融合步枪枪管伴着射出的最后一颗子弹的能量还在噼啪作响。他走下楼来，艾莎扛着斥候步枪跟着。

“看起来他们在把接线从墙上拔出来，”她评述道，她抬起手，让她的机灵杜妮亚落到空中。“检查这里的系统，确保他们没有做任何其他事情。”

“收到。”杜妮亚说道，掠过空中朝电脑终端移动。

艾莎注意到里德炽热的眼睛盯着暴徒尸体身上飘出的乙太。她瞥了一眼杜妮亚，然后走过地面来到里德身边。“嘿，”她说着，一只手搭在他的胳膊上，把他从思绪中唤醒。

“我很好，”他撒谎道，轻轻地拉开了距离。“只是…在思考。”

艾莎低头看着尸体，然后回头看着里德。“这与沙在金星上干的不同。”她试着安抚，但听起来却很不屑一顾。

“有什么不同？”他问道，声音像匕首一样尖锐。“它——他们只是在扯墙上的接线，艾莎。他们并不想伤害任何人！”

“是他们先向我们开火的。”

“我们甚至没有试着和他们交谈！”里德喊道。

“艾莎？”房间对面的杜妮亚说道。两位守护者都没听到机灵的声音。

“对不起，”艾莎边说边举起胳膊，“我是应该在他们向我扔手雷之前还是之后那样做呢？"

“艾莎？”杜妮亚又说了一遍，声音里多了一些惊慌。

“我们本可以尝试些什么的！什么都行！”里德冲着艾莎的脸尖叫道。“我们本可以——”

“艾莎！”

868732497.name: Atavistic Idol Mask
868732497.flavor: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
868732497.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
868732497.lore:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

The Warlock Shayura kneels on a pillow, eyes closed and head bowed, hands folded in her lap. The soundscape of city noise punctuated by the melody of birds and the whistling wind surrounds her. But there is no grass beneath her pillow, only cold concrete. Four holographic screens encircle Shayura, providing a semi-realistic depiction of the gardens at the center of the Last City; a place of calm serenity situated in the shadow of the Traveler.

"I exalt our forebearers," Shayura says softly.

"I exalt my fireteam."

"I exalt my truth."

"I exalt my heart."

"I exalt humanity's capacity for love."

"This above all else, I hold true."

The words feel like thick syrup in her mouth. Guilt makes it taste bitter. Her jaw trembles and throat tightens, her mouth too dry to swallow.

"I exalt our forebearers."

Her voice wavers, just a little.

"I exalt my fireteam."

Her jaw trembles.

"I exalt my truth."

She can feel the warmth of tears on her cheeks.

"I exalt my heart."

Her voice cracks.

"I exalt h-hu-human—" She breaks. Recitations turn into sobs, and Shayura slides from pillow to floor. Her shoulders heave, and she pulls her knees to her chest, crying against her legs. Dead Guardians stare with hollow eye sockets when she closes her eyes.

They beg for their lives.

She trains a gun on them.

And exalts her truth.
868732497.lore_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

术士沙玉拉跪在枕头上，闭着眼睛，低着头，双手双手叠放在腿上。城市的音景，不时夹杂着鸟儿的鸣唱和呼啸的风声在她耳边环绕。但是她跪着的枕头底下没有草地，只有冰冷的混凝土。四块全息屏幕环绕着沙玉拉，提供了一幅圣城中心的花园的半写实景象；坐落于旅行者阴影之中的一个平静祥和的地方。

“我赞美我们的祖先，”沙玉拉轻声说道。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

“我赞美我的真理。”

“我赞美我的内心。”

“我赞美人类爱的能力。”

“这是我最深信不疑的一点。”

这些话在她嘴里感觉像浓稠的糖浆。内疚让它变得苦涩。她的下巴在颤抖，喉咙开始发紧，她的嘴太干了无法吞咽。

“我赞美我们的祖先。”

她的声音有一点点颤抖。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

她的下巴颤抖着。

“我赞美我的真理。”

她能感觉到脸颊上泪水的温热。

“我赞美我的内心。”

她的声音沙哑了。

“我赞美人…人类…”她开始崩溃。诵读变成了抽泣，沙玉拉从枕头滑到地板上。她耸动着肩膀，把自己缩成一团，靠着腿哭了起来。当她闭上双眼，死去的守护者就用空洞的眼窝望着她。

他们乞求着活命。

她用枪对准他们。

并赞美她的真理。
