162269058.name: Atavistic Idol Strides
162269058.flavor: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
162269058.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
162269058.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
162269058.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

艾莎和里德听到杜妮亚示警的声音，转过身来拔出了枪。但是当他们瞄准面前闪烁的长袍梦魇时，谁也下不了手。艾莎看到这一幕，率先发出了震惊的低声咒骂。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

891829968.name: Atavistic Idol Strides
891829968.flavor: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
891829968.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
891829968.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

1283202269.flavor: "With the Consensus disbanded, there's no telling how long this could take to go to trial. Given the current… situation? We might all be dead before that happens."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1283202269.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
1283202269.lore:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

"The first steps to healing are learning to forgive yourself. That's a hard one, I know."

Doctor Syeda Uzair sets her datapad aside, then sits forward in her chair. She folds her hands in front of herself. A tiny, beaded chain is wrapped around one hand, and a small bone charm of the Traveler is pressed into her right palm. "Shayura, whether or not a court of law finds you guilty of your actions in any measure, you are still held accountable to the court of your own conscience."

Across from Doctor Uzair, Shayura is slouched in her chair. She stares past her doctor, out the narrow windows, and looks to the looming figure of the Traveler hanging in the sky. It seems so much bigger compared to the projections she chooses to display in her cell.

"Who judges them?" Shayura asks, motioning to the window with her chin. To the Traveler.

Doctor Uzair turns, glancing over her shoulder at the Traveler. Her grip on the charm tightens. "I don't know," is her immediate answer, but the question will burrow its way through her mind, surfacing again when she lies down in bed tonight. "I understand the Human condition far better than a god's."

"Maybe the Traveler abandoned us because it's ashamed of us. Of what we've done in its name." Shayura's voice is small, weary. An alert flickers on Dr. Uzair's datapad, momentarily drawing her attention away. Shayura fills the silence with a sigh. 

"Maybe," Doctor Uzair says, though she doesn't believe it. "But, maybe we're all just short on hope these days. I'd like to extend our session a little longer, if you're willing. Would you mind if we did so with some guests?"

Concern flashes across Shayura's face; defensiveness, shame. She sits up slightly in her seat. Doctor Uzair can see the tension.

"When we speak of forgiveness, sometimes it helps to first be forgiven," Doctor Uzair says with a tempered smile. Shayura glances to the datapad, then back to her doctor.

"Reed-7 and Aisha would like to see you."

Tears well in Shayura's eyes. Her voice of dissent evaporates.

Shayura realizes there is one thing she can still have faith in: her family.
1283202269.lore_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

“疗伤的第一步就是学会原谅自己。我知道这很难。”

医生西达·乌泽尔把她的数据板放在一边，然后坐在椅子上。她双手交叉放在身前。她的一只手上缠着一条小小的串珠链，右手掌里压着一个旅行者的骨质小护符。“沙玉拉，不管法庭是否判定你的行为有罪，你都会被自己良心的法庭追究责任。”

在乌泽尔医生的对面，沙玉拉无精打采地耷拉在椅子上。她的目光越过她的医生，从狭小的窗户望出去，看到了悬挂在天空中若隐若现的旅行者的身影。它看起来比她选择在牢房里显示的投影要大得多。

“谁来审判那家伙？”沙玉拉问道，用她的下巴示意着窗口。指向旅行者。

乌泽尔医生转过身，回头瞥了一眼旅行者。她把护符抓得更紧了。“我不知道，”她立即答道，但这个问题还会在她的脑海里钻来钻去，等她今晚躺在床上的时候再次浮现。“比起神灵，我更了解人类的处境。”

“也许旅行者抛弃我们是因为它为我们感到羞耻。为我们以它的名义所做的一切感到羞耻。”沙玉拉的声音微弱而疲惫。乌泽尔医生的数据板上闪烁着一则警示，暂时转移了她的注意力。沙玉拉以一声叹息填补了沉默。 

“也许吧，”乌泽尔医生说道，尽管她并不相信。“但也许我们只不过是近来都缺少希望。如果你愿意，我想把我们的谈话再延长一点。你介意我们邀请两位客人吗？”

忧虑掠过沙玉拉的脸庞；自我防备，羞愧难当。她从座位上微微起身。乌泽尔医生能看出这种紧张。

“当我们谈及宽恕时，有时先被宽恕会有所帮助。”乌泽尔医生带着温和的微笑说。沙玉拉瞥了一眼数据板，然后又看向她的医生。

"里德-7和艾莎想见你。"

沙玉拉的眼里噙满了泪水。她不服从的想法消失了。

沙玉拉意识到有一件事她依然可以相信：她的家人。

3453042252.name: Caliban's Hand
3453042252.flavor: Always keep one up your sleeve.
3453042252.lore:
Caliban-8 had the singular misfortune of "winning" the position of Hunter Vanguard in a card game he didn't even play. All he'd done was deal the hand that lost Tallulah Fairwind's bet—and her life—to an Ahamkara.

Not a day went by where he didn't wish he'd cheated. At least then, the wish-dragon might have killed him as well.

Now he sat as the second Hunter Vanguard in the City's history, chained to a desk in the Tower. Responsible for a breed of Guardians notorious for their unwillingness to answer communications or follow directions. Lulah knew how to inspire a sense of camaraderie in them. But Caliban?

He was just a guy who dealt the wrong hand.

Leaning back in his chair, he flipped a Light-heated knife between his fingers and tossed it up into the ceiling. Its molten edge slid into the steel and instantly cooled, stuck alongside the other half dozen blades he'd previously used to deface his office. 

It had been a slow afternoon.

A light knock on his door caught his attention. An unassuming figure, robed and masked in white, stood at the entrance to the room.

"Hard at work, I see," remarked the Speaker.

Caliban scoffed as he got to his feet. "Not sure what you expect me to do from behind a desk. You know how Hunters are."

The Speaker nodded, then looked up to the ceiling. "How many knives do you have up your sleeve, Caliban?"

"About that many," he joked, pointing upward.

"Then it seems you must get up and collect them," the Speaker mused. "Much like your Hunters."

Caliban began to reply, but for once, he didn't know what to say. The Speaker turned from the doorway and called out over his shoulder. 

"Take your time, Caliban. The desk will be here still when you return."
3453042252.lore_zh:
卡利班-8非常不幸地在一场他甚至没有玩的纸牌游戏里“赢得”了猎人先锋的位置。他所做的只是打出了将塔鲁·和风的赌注——还有她的性命——输给阿罕卡拉的一手牌。

他无时无刻都希望自己当时做了老千。至少那样，神龙就会把他也杀了。

如今他坐在圣城历史第二个猎人先锋的位子上，被锁在高塔里的一张桌子上。负责一批因不愿回应通讯或听从指示而臭名远扬的守护者。鲁拉知道如何激发他们的同志情谊。但是卡利班呢？

他只是一个打错了牌的家伙。

他向后靠在椅子上，用手指翻起一把光能加热的飞刀，朝天花板扔去。它灼热的刀刃滑入钢中瞬间冷却，插在他之前用来毁坏他办公室的其他半打刀片的旁边。 

这真是个漫长的下午。

轻轻的敲门声引起了他的注意。一个穿着白袍，戴着白色面具的谦逊人物站在房间的入口处。

“看得出来，你工作得很卖力，”先知评论道。

卡利班站起身来嘲笑道。“我不知道你想让我在一张办公桌后面做什么。你知道猎人是什么样的。”

先知点点头，然后抬头看着天花板。“你袖子里有多少把飞刀，卡利班？”

“大概这么多，”他开玩笑地朝上指了指。

“那看来你必须站起身去取回它们，”先知沉思道。“就像你其他的猎人同伴一样。”

卡利班想开口回答，但这一次，他不知道要说什么。先知从门口转过身来，回过头喊道。 

“慢慢来，卡利班。等你回来的时候，桌子还会在这。”

1535334771.name: Candescent Grips
1535334771.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
1535334771.lore:
Namrask moves his four hands near the Loom, though he dares not touch it. He fears that one with skills as paltry as his would sully its mechanisms. He can still scarcely believe that he is allowed to be this close to it at all.

"Well?" asks a digital voice from over his shoulder. "What do you think?"

He shuffles to the side, making eye contact with Ada-1, the Exo who invited him to view the Loom. "An impressive machine. Difficult to master, I think."

"Synthweave can be… finicky," Ada admits. She crosses the small room to look upon the Loom herself. "But the results are well worth the effort."

"Why…" Namrask begins, mustering his nerve, "Why did you invite me here?"

"It was thanks to your people that the Loom exists at all," she replies. "And Eido tells me you are a weaver."

That surprises Namrask. Eido makes a habit of avoiding him, and he had always thought she disliked him. Not that he could blame her if she did.

"I am," he says. And then, almost inaudibly, "Now."

He bows his head in silence and shame.

Ada says nothing for a moment, then turns to glance wistfully at the Loom. "When the Black Armory's forges were lost, I felt that I no longer knew who I was. And so, I had to… reinvent myself."

She leaves his side, opening a drawer in her desk and taking from it an object wrapped in cloth.

"Here," she says as she hands it to him. "For you to practice."

Namrask unwraps the parcel, staring wide-eyed at the Synthweave bolt in his hands.

"From one weaver to another," Ada says kindly.
1535334771.lore_zh:
拿姆拉斯克挪动着四只爪子靠近纺织机，尽管他并不敢触碰它。他担心，像他这样技艺拙劣的家伙会玷污它的机械装置。他仍然不敢相信自己竟然能如此接近它。

“怎么样？”一个数码语音从他身后传来。“你觉得如何？”

他挪到一边，跟邀请他来参观纺织机的Exo艾达-1交流了一下眼神。“这机器令人惊艳。我觉得操控起来应该很难。”

“合成纤维有时候确实…需要认真对待，”艾达承认道。她穿过小房间，亲自去看纺织机。“但其成果是值得付出努力的。”

“为什么…”拿姆拉斯克鼓起勇气问道，“你为什么邀请我来这里？”

“多亏了你们的族人，纺织机才得以存在，”她答道。“而且艾多告诉我你是个织布工。”

这让拿姆拉斯克很吃惊。艾多总是避开他，他一直以为她不喜欢他。就算她真不喜欢，他也不能怪她。

“确实，”他说道。接着又说了一句，几乎没法听清。“我现在是了。”

他在沉默和羞愧中低下头来。

艾达沉默了一会儿，然后若有所思地瞥了一眼纺织机。“当黑色军械库的锻炉消失时，我觉得我都不认得自己了。所以，我必须…重塑自己。”

她离开他身旁，打开书桌上的一个抽屉，从里面拿出一个用布包裹的东西。

“给，”她说着把它递给了他。“拿去练习吧。”

拿姆拉斯克打开包裹，睁大眼睛盯着手中的合成纤维。

“织布工给织布工的礼物，”艾达和蔼地说道。

3876588445.name: Candescent Vest
3876588445.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
3876588445.lore:
A bonfire crackles to those around it—friends gathering in need.

It trades for warmth what they cast out,

And grows to sooth with a brilliant hue.

A bonfire roars to those around it—friends cheering the flames higher.

It burns away shadows and brightens the night.

A refuge: from which to look to the horizon.

A bonfire whispers to those around it—friends bonded by revelries now past. 

Morning ignites the horizon, and dawn makes clear the road. 

Friends now ride, Sparrows astride, no longer a shadow behind… 

They vanish into the sun.
3876588445.lore_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，朋友围火而坐，相聚取暖。

他们投之以木，火焰报之以暖，

带着明亮的色调，渐渐变得舒适。

篝火肆意咆哮，火苗越窜越高，朋友为之欢呼雀跃。

它驱散阴影，照亮黑夜。

它是一个避难所，从那里能望向地平线。

篝火窃窃私语，朋友彼此联结的狂欢落幕。 

清晨点燃了地平线，黎明扫清了道路。 

朋友们骑乘着快雀，身后不再留下阴影… 

他们消失在了烈日之中。

1529773610.name: Candescent Mask
1529773610.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
1529773610.lore:
Shaxx shakes his head as he watches the Crucible match play out onscreen. Bravo Team's Warlock has been revived by their Ghost three times in 30 seconds, and by the look of things, they're well on their way to a fourth. It's a shameful display, and the rest of Bravo seems to be getting fed up with it.

"Tough match, huh?"

Shaxx turns to see Ikora Rey, her eyes fixed on the screen as well. 

"Tough for that Warlock's team," Shaxx sighs. "They've eaten a full shotgun blast to the chest, a Hunter's knife to the face, and even got disintegrated by their own grenade."

"Mhm," Ikora replies absently. "Bet you 500 Glimmer that they rally."

Shaxx tilts his head at her. "Are you serious?"

 "I'm always serious," she replies with an arched brow.

After a moment, Shaxx nods. "All right. I'll take that bet."

They turn their attention back to the match. The Warlock is caught in an explosion. Revived. Impaled on a glaive. Revived. Falls off the edge of the arena. Revived.

And then… they land a headshot. And another. Then another. They stick close to a member of Bravo, drawing fire so that their teammate can release a fusion rifle burst into their opponent. Shaxx watches in awe as the Warlock shapes their Light into a flaming sword and takes to the sky, raining fire down on Alpha team.

When the smoke clears, Bravo ekes out a narrow victory.

"How did you know?" Shaxx asks as he hands the Glimmer to Ikora.

"That Warlock stayed in the match," she replies. "Never bet against someone who won't quit."
1529773610.lore_zh:
沙克斯摇摇头，看着屏幕上进行着的熔炉竞技场比赛。Bravo队伍的术士在30秒内被其机灵复活了三次，从目前的情况来看，他们即将迎来第四次复活。这表现太可耻了，Bravo的其他队员似乎已经受够了。

“艰难的比赛哈？”

沙克斯转身看向艾可拉·蕾伊，她的双眼也盯着屏幕。 

“对那个术士的队伍来说很艰难，”沙克斯叹息道。“胸口扛了一整发霰弹枪，脸上挨了猎人一刀，甚至被自己人的手雷炸得七零八碎。”

“嗯，”艾可拉心不在焉地答道。“我赌500微光，他们会重振旗鼓。”

沙克斯朝她歪了歪脑袋。“你是认真的？”

 “我一向不开玩笑。”她挑起眉毛答道。

过了一会儿，沙克斯点了点头。“好吧。我跟你打赌。”

他们把注意力转回到比赛上。术士遭遇爆炸。复活过来。被偃月刺穿。再次复活。从竞技场边缘掉下去。继续复活。

紧接着…术士打中了一发爆头射击。又一发。再来一发。贴紧Bravo队员，吸引火力，好让队友能发射融合步枪攻击对手。沙克斯敬畏地看着术士将自己的光能变成燃烧的利刃，一飞冲天，向Alpha队伍撒下火焰之雨。

硝烟散尽时，Bravo竭尽所能获得了险胜。

“你是怎么知道的？”沙克斯一边问，一边把微光递给艾可拉。

“那术士没有放弃比赛，”她回答道。“不肯放弃的人绝不会输。”

1270288709.name: Candescent Strides
1270288709.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
1270288709.lore:
Amanda Holliday's Solstice Round-Up! See what the defenders of the Last City think about the new festivities!

Vanguard Commander Zavala
"Each of us has faced and overcome so much. Sometimes that can feel like a sacrifice, or a price… but it's a lesson to remember and learn. I'd like Guardians to keep that in mind as we celebrate Solstice. What we come to do is only possible because of what we've done. Both the good, and the bad."

Vanguard Ikora Rey
"Meditation is an important part of understanding not just the Light, but ourselves. We rise in a void, and seek meaning. The Bonfire is a wonderful metaphor for that process; Amanda outdid herself helping with Solstice. Even I don't know how she managed all of this."

Saint-14
"A big pyre to lay to rest everything we hold in our hearts. Yes. I could use this now. Celebration. Explosions. Revelry… isn't it wonderful? I might cry." 

Mithrax, Kell of House Light
"Guardian celebrations perplex and mystify, but new beginnings are worthy of what the Saint calls 'partying.' House Light is grateful for inclusion in this occasion, and offers forth many combustible baubles to the sacrificial flame."

Lord Saladin, Valus to Empress Caiatl
"Once I can see this Bonfire from Caiatl's flagship, I'll be happy."  

Empress Caiatl of the Cabal Empire
"What is the ordnance limitation on these Bonfire contributions? Perhaps the Cabal can assist in creating a larger fire."

Ana Bray
"I'll support anything Amanda does. Quite a show. I'm always a fan of something fancy with a little attitude."

Lord Shaxx
"I like to imagine the ignition cores are grenades… that does put a smile on my face."

Eris Morn 
"…The what?"
1270288709.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪的至日汇总！看看圣城的捍卫者们觉得新的庆祝活动怎么样！

先锋指挥官萨瓦拉
“我们每个人都面对和克服了太多事情。有时这感觉像是一种牺牲或者代价…但其实它是值得铭记和学习的教训。我希望守护者们在庆祝至日时能将这一点牢记在心。我们未来能做成什么，正是因为我们已经付出的努力。无论好坏。”

先锋艾可拉·蕾伊
“冥想不仅是理解光能，也是理解我们自身的重要一环。我们在虚空中崛起，寻求着意义。篝火很好地隐喻了这一过程；阿曼达竭尽全力协助着至日活动。连我都不知道她是怎么做到的。”

圣人14号
“一个大火堆安放我们心中保留的一切。没错。我现在很需要这个。庆祝。爆炸。狂欢…这不是很棒吗？我会哭出来的。” 

光能氏族的凯尔，米瑟拉克斯
“守护者的庆祝活动神秘而复杂，但新的开端值得来一场圣人所说的‘派对'。光能氏族对能融入这一场合心存感激，还为祭祀火焰提供了许多助燃的小玩意儿。"

领主萨拉丁，女帝查厄托军政官
“只要我能在查厄托的旗舰上看到篝火，我就心满意足了。”  

卡巴尔帝国女帝查厄托
“这些篝火捐献有军械限制吗？也许卡巴尔能帮忙生一堆更大更猛的火。”

阿娜·布瑞
“阿曼达做的事我无条件支持。这是场相当精彩的表演。我向来喜欢花哨而有点态度的东西。”

领主沙克斯
"我喜欢把引燃核心想象成手雷…这确实能逗我发笑。"

埃里斯·摩恩 
“…什么日？”

1043609040.name: Candescent Cloak
1043609040.lore:
Saint-14 stands in place of the Sergeant at Arms amid a host of New Lights; most had been resurrected near the City walls. He needed the distraction, the work, but most of all he needed to be somewhere he could help. 

Whispers fly between them regarding the legend that addresses them, and the strange chicken that struts figure eights around his legs.

"This area is reserved for Lights without combat training who wish to take part in Solstice. Let's get you to speed." He picks up an old-looking weapon. "This is standard Khvostov rifle. Some of you are familiar with this weapon," Saint says. "For those who aren't familiar, it's very simple."

He quickly runs through a few exercises. How to reload quickly, adjust the sights, clear a jam. At the range targets, he demonstrates how to weave Light between bursts of gunfire. Each time, a metallic ping rings out as he strikes a target; and each time, a chicken-cluck response echoes beside him.

"Calm and discipline is key. Steady support of your rifle will keep it under control. Steady pressure on the trigger will keep you from pulling off-target. Breathe, squeeze, and shoot."

"Bawk."

"Yes, yes. Now it is your turn, New Lights!"

The group steps forward and focuses on their targets. Several of the trainees' shots miss, but a Guardian in green lands each bullet and cheers.

"Bawk."

The New Light looks at the chicken now standing beside them, then to Saint-14, who also is focused on the chicken. There is a moment of hesitation before Saint says, "Hm. Good. Run it again."

"I did it perfectly," the New Light complains flaccidly.

Saint steps forward and puts a hand on their shoulder. "Perfection doesn't guarantee success. Perfection is subjective, New Light. That's why we train."

"But I hit every one!"

"Bawk… Awk!"

Saint-14 nods to the chicken, who stands tall and mighty—feathers sharp and puffed against the waning morning light.

"Colonel, the Pigeon Lord, says do it again. I wouldn't argue."
1043609040.lore_zh:
圣人14号代替武装中士站在众多新兵中间；他们大多数都是在圣城城墙附近复活的。他需要转移注意力，需要工作，但最重要的是，他需要一个他能帮上忙的岗位。 

新兵在底下窃窃私语，讨论着向他们讲话的这位传奇人物，还有那只绕着他的腿昂首阔步画着8的奇怪的鸡。

“这块区域是预留给希望参加至日、但尚未接受战斗训练的新兵们。我们来尽快熟悉一下吧。”他拿起一把看起来很旧的武器。“这是标准的赫沃斯托夫步枪。你们中有些人对这把武器很熟悉，”圣人说道。“不熟悉的话也别担心，它很简单。”

他快速进行了一番演练。如何快速填装，调整瞄准器，清理卡壳。在靶场上，他演示了如何冒着枪林弹雨编织光能。每一次，他击中目标都会响起金属的枪击声；而每一次，他身旁都会回荡着鸡叫的回应声。

“冷静和纪律是关键所在。稳定的支撑能帮你控制步枪。对扳机施加稳定压力就不会偏离目标。深呼吸，扣下扳机，然后发射。”

“咕咕。”

“是的，没错。现在轮到你们了，新兵们！”

这群新兵迈步向前，专注于他们的目标。有几个受训新兵的射击没有命中，但有位身穿绿衣的守护者每一发子弹都打中了，并欢呼了起来。

“咕咕。”

这名新兵看了看站在旁边的鸡，然后看向圣人14号，他也在关注着这只鸡。圣人犹豫了片刻，然后说道，“嗯。不错。再来一次。”

“我做得很完美，”新兵弱弱地抱怨道。

圣人走上前，把手放在其肩上。“完美并不能保证成功。完美是主观的，新兵。这就是我们训练的原因。”

“但我每枪都打中了！”

“咕…咕咕！”

圣人14号朝鸡点点头，它高大威猛地站着，羽毛在渐弱晨光的映衬下尖锐而蓬松。

“鸽王上校说再做一次。我可没意见。”

2535002841.name: Candescent Grips (Unkindled)
2535002841.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
2535002841.lore:
Namrask moves his four hands near the Loom, though he dares not touch it. He fears that one with skills as paltry as his would sully its mechanisms. He can still scarcely believe that he is allowed to be this close to it at all.

"Well?" asks a digital voice from over his shoulder. "What do you think?"

He shuffles to the side, making eye contact with Ada-1, the Exo who invited him to view the Loom. "An impressive machine. Difficult to master, I think."

"Synthweave can be… finicky," Ada admits. She crosses the small room to look upon the Loom herself. "But the results are well worth the effort."

"Why…" Namrask begins, mustering his nerve, "Why did you invite me here?"

"It was thanks to your people that the Loom exists at all," she replies. "And Eido tells me you are a weaver."

That surprises Namrask. Eido makes a habit of avoiding him, and he had always thought she disliked him. Not that he could blame her if she did.

"I am," he says. And then, almost inaudibly, "Now."

He bows his head in silence and shame.

Ada says nothing for a moment, then turns to glance wistfully at the Loom. "When the Black Armory's forges were lost, I felt that I no longer knew who I was. And so, I had to… reinvent myself."

She leaves his side, opening a drawer in her desk and taking from it an object wrapped in cloth.

"Here," she says as she hands it to him. "For you to practice."

Namrask unwraps the parcel, staring wide-eyed at the Synthweave bolt in his hands.

"From one weaver to another," Ada says kindly.
2535002841.lore_zh:
拿姆拉斯克挪动着四只爪子靠近纺织机，尽管他并不敢触碰它。他担心，像他这样技艺拙劣的家伙会玷污它的机械装置。他仍然不敢相信自己竟然能如此接近它。

“怎么样？”一个数码语音从他身后传来。“你觉得如何？”

他挪到一边，跟邀请他来参观纺织机的Exo艾达-1交流了一下眼神。“这机器令人惊艳。我觉得操控起来应该很难。”

“合成纤维有时候确实…需要认真对待，”艾达承认道。她穿过小房间，亲自去看纺织机。“但其成果是值得付出努力的。”

“为什么…”拿姆拉斯克鼓起勇气问道，“你为什么邀请我来这里？”

“多亏了你们的族人，纺织机才得以存在，”她答道。“而且艾多告诉我你是个织布工。”

这让拿姆拉斯克很吃惊。艾多总是避开他，他一直以为她不喜欢他。就算她真不喜欢，他也不能怪她。

“确实，”他说道。接着又说了一句，几乎没法听清。“我现在是了。”

他在沉默和羞愧中低下头来。

艾达沉默了一会儿，然后若有所思地瞥了一眼纺织机。“当黑色军械库的锻炉消失时，我觉得我都不认得自己了。所以，我必须…重塑自己。”

她离开他身旁，打开书桌上的一个抽屉，从里面拿出一个用布包裹的东西。

“给，”她说着把它递给了他。“拿去练习吧。”

拿姆拉斯克打开包裹，睁大眼睛盯着手中的合成纤维。

“织布工给织布工的礼物，”艾达和蔼地说道。

177463495.name: Candescent Vest (Unkindled)
177463495.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
177463495.lore:
A bonfire crackles to those around it—friends gathering in need.

It trades for warmth what they cast out,

And grows to sooth with a brilliant hue.

A bonfire roars to those around it—friends cheering the flames higher.

It burns away shadows and brightens the night.

A refuge: from which to look to the horizon.

A bonfire whispers to those around it—friends bonded by revelries now past. 

Morning ignites the horizon, and dawn makes clear the road. 

Friends now ride, Sparrows astride, no longer a shadow behind… 

They vanish into the sun.
177463495.lore_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，朋友围火而坐，相聚取暖。

他们投之以木，火焰报之以暖，

带着明亮的色调，渐渐变得舒适。

篝火肆意咆哮，火苗越窜越高，朋友为之欢呼雀跃。

它驱散阴影，照亮黑夜。

它是一个避难所，从那里能望向地平线。

篝火窃窃私语，朋友彼此联结的狂欢落幕。 

清晨点燃了地平线，黎明扫清了道路。 

朋友们骑乘着快雀，身后不再留下阴影… 

他们消失在了烈日之中。

“这些篝火捐献有军械限制吗？也许卡巴尔能帮忙生一堆更大更猛的火。”

阿娜·布瑞
“阿曼达做的事我无条件支持。这是场相当精彩的表演。我向来喜欢花哨而有点态度的东西。”

领主沙克斯
"我喜欢把引燃核心想象成手雷…这确实能逗我发笑。"

埃里斯·摩恩 
“…什么日？”

2160858284.name: Candescent Strides (Unkindled)
2160858284.lore:
Saint-14 stands in place of the Sergeant at Arms amid a host of New Lights; most had been resurrected near the City walls. He needed the distraction, the work, but most of all he needed to be somewhere he could help. 

Whispers fly between them regarding the legend that addresses them, and the strange chicken that struts figure eights around his legs.

"This area is reserved for Lights without combat training who wish to take part in Solstice. Let's get you to speed." He picks up an old-looking weapon. "This is standard Khvostov rifle. Some of you are familiar with this weapon," Saint says. "For those who aren't familiar, it's very simple."

He quickly runs through a few exercises. How to reload quickly, adjust the sights, clear a jam. At the range targets, he demonstrates how to weave Light between bursts of gunfire. Each time, a metallic ping rings out as he strikes a target; and each time, a chicken-cluck response echoes beside him.

"Calm and discipline is key. Steady support of your rifle will keep it under control. Steady pressure on the trigger will keep you from pulling off-target. Breathe, squeeze, and shoot."

"Bawk."

"Yes, yes. Now it is your turn, New Lights!"

The group steps forward and focuses on their targets. Several of the trainees' shots miss, but a Guardian in green lands each bullet and cheers.

"Bawk."

The New Light looks at the chicken now standing beside them, then to Saint-14, who also is focused on the chicken. There is a moment of hesitation before Saint says, "Hm. Good. Run it again."

"I did it perfectly," the New Light complains flaccidly.

Saint steps forward and puts a hand on their shoulder. "Perfection doesn't guarantee success. Perfection is subjective, New Light. That's why we train."

"But I hit every one!"

"Bawk… Awk!"

Saint-14 nods to the chicken, who stands tall and mighty—feathers sharp and puffed against the waning morning light.

"Colonel, the Pigeon Lord, says do it again. I wouldn't argue."
2160858284.lore_zh:
圣人14号代替武装中士站在众多新兵中间；他们大多数都是在圣城城墙附近复活的。他需要转移注意力，需要工作，但最重要的是，他需要一个他能帮上忙的岗位。 

新兵在底下窃窃私语，讨论着向他们讲话的这位传奇人物，还有那只绕着他的腿昂首阔步画着8的奇怪的鸡。

“这块区域是预留给希望参加至日、但尚未接受战斗训练的新兵们。我们来尽快熟悉一下吧。”他拿起一把看起来很旧的武器。“这是标准的赫沃斯托夫步枪。你们中有些人对这把武器很熟悉，”圣人说道。“不熟悉的话也别担心，它很简单。”

他快速进行了一番演练。如何快速填装，调整瞄准器，清理卡壳。在靶场上，他演示了如何冒着枪林弹雨编织光能。每一次，他击中目标都会响起金属的枪击声；而每一次，他身旁都会回荡着鸡叫的回应声。

“冷静和纪律是关键所在。稳定的支撑能帮你控制步枪。对扳机施加稳定压力就不会偏离目标。深呼吸，扣下扳机，然后发射。”

“咕咕。”

“是的，没错。现在轮到你们了，新兵们！”

这群新兵迈步向前，专注于他们的目标。有几个受训新兵的射击没有命中，但有位身穿绿衣的守护者每一发子弹都打中了，并欢呼了起来。

“咕咕。”

这名新兵看了看站在旁边的鸡，然后看向圣人14号，他也在关注着这只鸡。圣人犹豫了片刻，然后说道，“嗯。不错。再来一次。”

“我做得很完美，”新兵弱弱地抱怨道。

圣人走上前，把手放在其肩上。“完美并不能保证成功。完美是主观的，新兵。这就是我们训练的原因。”

“但我每枪都打中了！”

“咕…咕咕！”

圣人14号朝鸡点点头，它高大威猛地站着，羽毛在渐弱晨光的映衬下尖锐而蓬松。

“鸽王上校说再做一次。我可没意见。”

1443166262.name: Second Chance
1443166262.lore:
A high-pitched whistle echoed off the walls of Bannerfall as the shield soared through the air. It ricocheted off one broken pillar, then another, before Shaxx caught it in midair. He held it firm, its Void Light illuminating his armor.

"So, how is he?" asked the Crucible handler. He threw the shield back the way it came, bouncing it off a tree and then a crate until it landed in Saint-14's deft hands.

"No change," Saint answered with a frustrated sigh. He hurled the shield forward, watching it rebound back to Shaxx, who caught and held it again. "Sometimes, I…"

Saint's voice trembled as he trailed off, and Shaxx lowered the shield to his side. "Yes?"

"Sometimes I wonder if I deserve this," Saint continued. "I keep thinking back to the Eliksni who cowered from me in fear. The monstrous things I did to their people. What if Osiris is being made to pay my debts?"

Slowly, Shaxx lowered the edge of the shield to rest on the ground. "When I was a Warlord," he said, his voice unusually quiet, "I inflicted immeasurable pain and suffering on both Humans and Eliksni. Now I train Guardians for battle—some might even call me a role model."

It was Shaxx's turn to sigh. "But they'd be wrong." He lifted the shield and gave it another toss.

Saint caught the shield one-handed, then let its Light fizzle out. "Are you telling me not to blame myself?"

Shaxx shook his head. "I'm telling you that people don't always get what they deserve in life. Us included."

He formed his Light into a new shield and sent it flying through the air.
1443166262.lore_zh:
当护盾在空中飞掠而过时，一声尖锐的哨声在秋天旗帜的城墙上回响。它从一根断裂的柱子上反弹了下来，然后又弹到另一根柱子上，直到沙克斯在半空中接住了它。他紧紧地握着它，它的虚空光能照亮了他的盔甲。

“那么，他怎么样了？”熔炉竞技场顾问问道。他把护盾原路扔了回去，从一棵树上弹开，然后又弹到一个板条箱上，最后落在了圣人14号灵巧的手中。

“没有变化，”圣人沮丧地叹了口气。他把护盾向前猛掷，看着它反弹回沙克斯手中，沙克斯再次接住了它。“有时候，我…”

圣人的声音颤抖着，逐渐弱了下来。沙克斯放下护盾到身旁。“怎么了？”

“有时我在想这是不是我应得的报应，”圣人继续说道。“我不断地回想起那个因为害怕而躲着我的埃里克斯尼族。回想起我对他们的族人所做的那些可怕的事情。要是奥斯里斯不得不偿还我欠下的债怎么办？”

沙克斯缓缓地将护盾边缘放下，靠在地上。“我还是个战争领主的时候，”他说道，声音异常地平静，“给人类和埃里克斯尼族制造了大量的苦痛和折磨。如今我训练守护者参加战斗——有些人甚至称我为楷模。”

这回轮到沙克斯叹气了。“但他们错了。”他举起护盾，又扔了起来。

圣人单手抓住了护盾，然后让它的光能渐渐消散。“你是在告诉我不要自责吗？”

沙克斯摇了摇头。“我是在告诉你，人们在生活中并不总是能得到他们应得的。我们也不例外。”

他用自己的光能做成一个新的护盾，抛向空中让它飞起来。

2388383505.name: Eidolon Pursuant Gauntlets
2388383505.lore:
Eris Morn chalks the floor in the H.E.L.M. wing previously inhabited by the Servitor of the Eliksni Splicers. A liberated Tomb Ship drones beside her. Through the open, shielded, hangar, the Leviathan is visible as a malformed knot, its shape bulging from the shadowed outline of the Moon.

Ikora descends the stairs. An ornately dressed Warlock thanatonaut follows, their robes trimmed in bone and elaborately stitched symbols.

"Did you commandeer this from Mars?" Ikora asks with a smile, looking over the Hive vessel.

Eris stands. "It provided ample shielding for transporting the Crown from its vault."

"It's here, now?" the thanatonaut asks, breaking his stride at the bottom of the stairs.

"Worry not. The H.E.L.M. will disembark from the City to ensure the Crown is contained," Eris answers.

"Keep that Tomb Ship docked here in case we need to jettison the Crown. Last thing I need is a rookie shooting you down in it." Ikora steps past the thanatonaut with a reassuring nod. "Tell us what you're thinking next, Eris."

Eris gestures toward the open bay door. "The Leviathan is at our doorstep. Even if we unravel Calus's plan, the ship itself still poses a threat simply by its size. Calus does not require paracausal power to cause an extinction-level event."

"Calus's interest appears to be focused solely on the Pyramid," Ikora interjects. "Should that change, Zavala assures me that Caiatl's fleet will provide ample dissuasive firepower."

Eris nods in rhythm with Ikora's well-reasoned words. "I trust that to be true—however, whatever connection Calus has established is drawing Nightmares and phantoms alike to the Leviathan. He is able to exert influence over them. But I believe we can disrupt this connection."

She points to the thanatonaut. "You," she says and motions toward three chalked spots on the floor. "Here, here, and here. We will require death anchors to tether the ritual. Hold your mind on the brink for as long as you can, and I will craft the sigils required to contain the Crown. Then, we will need volunteers…"
2388383505.lore_zh:
埃里斯·摩恩在应急后勤行动中心侧翼的地板上用粉笔做着记号，这里以前曾住着埃里克斯尼族熔岩军团的魔眼。一艘自由的棺舰在她身旁嗡嗡作响。透过空旷隐蔽的机库，可以看到利维坦像一个畸形的硬结，它的形状在月球的阴影轮廓中更显凸出。

艾可拉走下楼梯。一位衣着华丽的术士探灵人紧随其后，他们的长袍用骨头装饰，精心缝有各种符号。

“这是你从火星上征用的吗？”艾可拉微笑着问道，看着邪魔族舰船。

埃里斯站起身来。“它为从保险库运输王冠提供了充足的防护。”

“它在这儿，现在？”探灵人问道，在楼梯底部停下了脚步。

“别担心。应急后勤行动中心会离开圣城，确保王冠得到遏制，”埃里斯答道。

“把那艘棺舰停靠在这里，以防我们需要除掉王冠。我可不希望当你在里面的时候，某个菜鸟把它打下来。”艾可拉走过探灵人，点头示意他安心。“告诉我们你下一步的计划，埃里斯。”

埃里斯向敞开的舱门示意。“利维坦就在我们的家门口。即使我们弄清了卡鲁斯的计划，这艘飞船光凭本身的大小也依然是个威胁。卡鲁斯不需要超因果力量就可以造成灭绝级的事件。”

“卡鲁斯的兴趣似乎只集中在金字塔上，”艾可拉插话道。“如果情况有变，萨瓦拉向我保证，查厄托的舰队会提供足够的劝阻火力。”

埃里斯点头附和艾可拉的理性话语。“我相信这一点是真的——不过，无论卡鲁斯建立的是什么样的联系，它都在把梦魇和鬼灵吸引到利维坦上。他能够对它们施加影响。但我相信我们可以破坏这种联系。”

她指了指探灵人。“你，”她说着，朝地板上的三个粉笔记号点指去。“这儿，这儿，还有这儿。我们需要死亡船锚来束缚仪式。把守住你的心灵防线，越久越好，而我会制作遏制王冠所需的印记。然后，我们会需要志愿者…”

2288543943.name: Eidolon Pursuant Plate
2288543943.lore:
"You've had this for years and never thought to mention it?" Eris runs her fingers over the grime-clouded containment glass housing a large growth of egregore within the Drifter's Derelict.

"Wasn't hidin' it." Drifter rolls Eris's Ahamkara bone over his knuckles. "Ain't nobody ever asked. Hell, you've walked by it before, Moondust."

"What wonders you must have buried in this heap," Eris muses. The emerald shine of her eyes dart back and forth behind thin cloth.
"I could…" Drifter saunters up beside her, "give you the tour?"

"We haven't the time. Tell me, what have you learned from this egregore sample?"

Drifter wrinkles his face and looks up to the massive, contained growth. "Uhh…"

Eris massages annoyance from her brow. She sees the playful coyness in his eyes. The hidden information he holds as bargain for some trade. "Do you at least remember where you found it?"

"Sister, you don't wanna know." Eris locks her eyes on the Drifter's face. He staggers back awkwardly and shrugs. "Icy little nothing in the middle of nowhere. Doesn't have a name, and you don't want to go there alone."

"But you could take me?" Eris tests his defenses.

Drifter brushes off the mottled fur of his shoulder guards and leans against a poorly fastened railing. "Only if we take your jumpship. And I drive."

Eris sighs and pushes through him. "No."

Drifter springs after her. "So that's it? You're leaving?"

"You're being evasive, Rat." Eris plucks her Ahamkara bone from his hand and stows it beneath her cloak. "Contact me when you're willing to speak plainly."

Drifter calls after her, hands outstretched, "You don't want to stay for dinner?"

Eris halts, considering what disgusting amalgamation of refuse would constitute a meal here. She glances over her shoulder. One last attempt to extract information…

"It is strange. When Savathûn drew Mars back into our space, it was free of the egregore. But the Glykon and Leviathan both returned rampant with fungal growth. Why?" she asks.

He gives in. "You know… it sings if you burn it just right." Drifter thumbs behind him. "Sub-sonic, resonates in a funny way with Pyramid tech."

"Is that so?"

"You don't trust me?"
2288543943.lore_zh:
“你有了这东西这么多年竟然没想过要提起它？”埃里斯用手指摸了摸浪客的遗落飞船里那布满污尘的玻璃罩，里头装有一大株的守望者。

“不是故意藏起来的。”浪客在他的指关节上滚着埃里斯的阿罕卡拉遗骨。“从来没有人问过。见鬼，你以前还从这里走过的，小月月。”

“你在这堆东西里一定藏了些什么奇观，”埃里斯沉思道。她那双眼睛的翠绿光泽在薄布后面来回闪动。
“我可以…”浪客在她身边踱来踱去，“带你参观一下？”

“我们没有时间。告诉我，你从这个守望者样本上了解到了什么？”

浪客皱起了脸，仰望着这株受到遏制的巨大生长物。“呃…”

埃里斯头疼地揉搓着眉毛。她从他的眼里看到了顽皮的羞怯。他所掌握的隐藏信息是某种交易的筹码。“你至少还记得是在哪里找到的吧？”

“妹子，你不会想知道的。”埃里斯直勾勾地盯着浪客的脸。他笨拙地踉跄后退，耸了耸肩。“在人烟稀少、荒凉空洞的不毛之地。那地方没有名字，你也不会想要一个人去那里的。”

“但你可以带我去？”埃里斯试探着他的防线。

浪客拂去护肩上斑驳的皮毛，倚在不甚牢靠的栏杆上。“用你的跃迁飞船才行。而且得我开。”

埃里斯叹了口气，推开了他。“不。”

浪客紧跟在她身后。“就这样？你要走了？”

“你在避实就虚，老鼠。”埃里斯从他手中抢过她的阿罕卡拉遗骨，藏在她的斗篷下。“等你愿意直说了再联系我吧。”

浪客摊开双手在她身后叫道，“你不想留下来吃晚饭吗？”

埃里斯停了下来，想着什么恶心的废料混合物能在这儿当作一顿饭。她回头瞥了一眼。最后一次试图获取信息…

“这很奇怪。当萨瓦图恩把火星带回我们的太空时，上头可没有守望者。但格利康和利维坦归来时却满是猖獗滋生的真菌。为什么？”她问道。

他屈服了。“那个…要是你把它烧得恰到好处，它就会唱歌。”浪客在身后竖起大拇指。“亚音速，以一种有趣的方式与金字塔科技产生共鸣。”

“是吗？”

“你不相信我？”

527342912.name: Eidolon Pursuant Helm
527342912.lore:
Savathûn is rigid and lifeless beneath the edge of Eris's scalpel as it begins a Y-incision. With each careful removal of a chitin plate, she expects the Witch Queen's muscles to shudder, her eyes to roll open, her claws to cleave Eris in twain as retaliation. 

Rigid. Lifeless. Nothing to fear.

Below the skull, protected by plated scale and fraying Hive enchantment, Eris sees the symbol of the Witch Queen. She peels back muscle and shaves away surrounding tissue for a clearer view of the fading mark etched into Savathûn's encephalon organ with soulfire script. Only then does she see the embellishments adorning the mark; they bring to mind the runic symbols carved into the Crown of Sorrow. She catalogues the embellishments on a data-pad, noting the similarities before continuing her examination, confident in her initial findings regarding a link to the Crown.

A link to the Crown. A lock many have tried to pick. Now Eris holds the key, from the mind of Savathûn herself.
527342912.lore_zh:
埃里斯的手术刀开始划动Y形切口，而萨瓦图恩在刀口下则显得身体僵硬，毫无生气。每次小心翼翼地取出一块壳质鳞甲，她都担心着巫妖女王会突然肌肉颤抖，双眼睁开，用利爪把埃里斯劈作两半作为报复。 

身体僵硬。毫无生气。没什么好怕的。

在头骨下方，在装甲鳞片和磨损的邪魔族魔法的保护下，埃里斯看到了巫妖女王的象征。她剥去背部的肌肉，刮去周围的组织，以便更清晰地看到用灵火字迹刻在萨瓦图恩大脑器官上的褪色印记。她终于看到了修饰着印记的这些装饰；它们让人想起刻在忧愁王冠上的符文符号。她在数据板上对这些装饰进行了分类，标注出它们之间的相似之处，然后继续检查，对自己与王冠联系有关的初步发现信心十足。

与王冠的联系。一把许多人试图撬动的锁。如今埃里斯掌握了钥匙，来自萨瓦图恩自己的头脑。

1795075811.name: Eidolon Pursuant Greaves
1795075811.lore:
Elsie is not at camp in Beyond; perhaps another time—but Eris emerges from transmat to see the Drifter alone, interrogating Elsie's strange, floating companion.

"Well? What are you?" Drifter points at the thing with distrust.

"Leave it be. The Ziggurat awaits our experiment," Eris says, saddling a mostly materialized Sparrow and blasting off into the snow across the frozen Europan flats.

"…And don't touch my stuff!" She hears Drifter shout at the thing as he follows after her.

Frigid sleet stings Eris's face red atop the Ziggurat. It is a welcome sensation compared to the prickling numbness that sticks her fingers; she grips a harvested stalk of the egregore fungus tightly in one gloved hand. In the other, a hot flare disgorges plumes of jade smoke.

She lights the stalk at both ends, according to the Drifter's instruction. Ashing spores furl into dense clouds that envelop her body, obscuring her sight in soot-black shroud until it blocks out all else.

Faint whispers.

A choral swell through turbulent winds.

Tone that forms words across the surface of her mind.

"You hear it?" Drifter asks, his voice a whisper outside her awareness.

The Ziggurat resonates like a tuning fork. The vibrations themselves take shape within the smoke, and Eris is drawn toward somewhere distant and empty. She follows, and the smoke swirls with points of color like stars, separated by lonely rifts of black expanse. Echoes radiate from the black deep like graviton ripples through space. They wash distortion over the stars until breaking against four other points—two greater, two weaker—ghostly strands of incorporeal egregore between them.

She then sees the Pyramids of Europa, Luna, and Savathûn's throne world—as one, their structures melded and overlapping. The connections cauterize in her mind like a vivid memory.

Eris blinks, and the sensation is gone. The stalk is ash in her hand.
1795075811.lore_zh:
艾尔西不在超越层营地；也许下次再来吧——但埃里斯传送现身时，正好看到浪客独自审问艾尔西奇特的浮空同伴。

“说吧？你是什么？”浪客怀疑地指着那东西。

“别管它了。通灵塔还在等着我们的实验，”埃里斯说道。她备好一辆快要显形的快雀，冲入雪中，穿越冰封的木卫二平原。

“…别碰我的东西！”她听到浪客对那东西大喊大叫，然后跟了上来。

在通灵塔顶上，寒冷的雨夹雪把埃里斯的脸冻得发红，但这跟刺痛手指的针扎麻木感相比要好受多了；她用一只戴着手套的手紧紧地握住割下的守望者菌柄。另一只手中，一道炽热的耀光喷出团团玉烟。

根据浪客的指示，她点燃了菌柄的两端。灰化的孢子卷成浓密的云雾，包裹着她的身体，在煤黑的烟雾中笼罩着她的视线，直至遮蔽一切。

微弱的低语。

狂风中传来逐渐响亮的合唱声。

那些音调穿过她的脑海表面形成话语。

“你听到了吗？”浪客问道，他的声音犹如她意识之外的低语。

通灵塔像音叉一样发出共振。共鸣在烟雾中自行成形，埃里斯被拉向某个遥远而空虚的地方。色彩斑斓的烟雾缭绕着，犹如繁星点点，被黑暗广阔的孤寂裂谷隔绝开来。回响从黑暗的深处向四周伸展，就像引力波穿越太空一样。它们在群星上方冲刷着失真，直到撞上另外四个点位——两个较强、两个较弱——在它们之间是无形守望者的虚灵线束。

然后她看到了木卫二金字塔、月球金字塔和萨瓦图恩的王座世界——就像一个整体，它们的构造互相融合重叠。这些联系就像栩栩如生的记忆一般烙印在她脑海。

埃里斯眨了眨眼，那感觉消失了。菌柄在她手里成了灰烬。

3004041686.name: Eidolon Pursuant Mark
3004041686.lore:
"You want to go where?" Drifter's jumpship idles roughly behind him, the engine misfiring and clattering loudly as if ready to explode. Eris's ship purrs next to it in contrast.

"There is a connection between the points of Darkness. Signals passing back and forth to something beyond." Eris steps closer so her voice carries over the engine noise. "The other Pyramids may provide more context."

The Drifter clicks his tongue and raises and eyebrow. "Sounds a mite dangerous with big daddy Calus parking right over the Moon? Seems off limits."

"Yes, but the Guardian leads raiding parties into Rhulk's Pyramid in Savathûn's throne world. We will use that distraction."

And with that, Eris shoulders through him and trudges to her ship. "Come, Rat."

"…Can we eat first?"

*** 

Explosions thunder within the throne world's Pyramid as Eris and Drifter establish a camp in the sunken bog where Miasma meets the Pyramid's approach. The massive ship eclipses them, towering in fog, the extent of its edges unknown to their eyes.

Drifter's face is stern, clenched with a tension Eris has seldom seen: Trust in one hand, fist full of Stasis in the other.

Eris sets a cloth-wrapped stalk of egregore upon a pyramid-shard jutting from the stinking swamp. She unwraps and neatly spreads the corners of the cloth before noticing the Drifter's footsteps behind her.

"Somethin's watchin' us," Drifter mutters. He turns to his altered Ghost and whispers softly enough to convince himself that Eris cannot hear him, "Keep your eye on her, eh?" Then louder, "I'm gonna look around, make sure that hotshot hero didn't miss any Screebs."

The Drifter's altered Ghost emits a single elongated tone in acknowledgement and then focuses on Eris.

"Germaine."

He stops. Eris knows his concern belies a nobility that he often attempts to suppress in favor of the persona of the Drifter. It is a ruddy shield, but she has seen the true him hidden under that that layer of grime.

"May I… have a light?"

"You got it." He discharges a Solar round from his Trust that sparks on the Pyramid floor and ignites the egregore stalk. "Back in a flash."

Eris watches him disappear into the swamp, then focuses on the pluming egregore.

***

Eris sits, exhausted, on a warm cushion in the dirt. The Drifter stands over a hazardously large fire, scooping some sweet-smelling funk of a stew from a cauldron-like vessel of Hive design. Her face scrunches as he places a chunky bowl of thick greyish-brown potage in her hands.

"What'd you find?" Drifter asks, slurping from his bowl.

Eris tests the temperature and flavor of this "food" against her lips. It is something like the stinking brined cheeses Ikora had given her on her last visit to the City, but with earthy depth beneath. Her face curls and she opts instead for conversation. "I was right; they are connected. But now, I only have more questions."

"You ask me, that's how these things go. Better leave well enough alone and head home," Drifter says, slurping another mouthful.

"The egregore connects points of Darkness, resonates with Pyramid constructs, but I cannot decipher their communications. Still… the Lunar Pyramid, the Europan Pyramid, and both Glykon and Leviathan all converse with the same distant point. What Rhulk spoke to, so does Calus. It is… gravely concerning."

"Wild," Drifter says with a whistle. He shakes his head and looks at her full bowl. "You gonna eat that?"

"I…" Eris wonders if he heard her correctly but knows repeating herself is an exercise in futility. "…What is this? Exactly?"

"Pretty damn tasty is what it is. First time I got it right. Thought you'd appreciate someone cooking for you since you, uh… well, you're awful at it."

"Rat, what are you feeding me?" She remembers his hunt earlier in the day, and her stomach turns. Eris stares at the Drifter, mouth agape in a half-heaved gag—her thoughts racing over the things he's claimed to have consumed. "You cooked me rotted Screebs."

"What?!" Drifter chokes on the stew and coughs. "I wouldn't feed you that crap, Moondust." He laughs. "You never had crawdad stew?" He holds his bowl to his lips. "Or a close cousin to it…" he adds under his breath. "Little swamp shrimps, you dig? It's a delicacy!"

Eris reels her imagination in, takes a breath, and sips the broth without taking her eyes from the Drifter. The liquid fills her crumpled stomach with hearty warmth. She feels her stress melt away. The stew's flavor is far more pleasing than its smell. She smiles and drinks again.

"Thank you. It is… good."
3004041686.lore_zh:
“你想去哪里？”浪客的跃迁飞船在他身后粗暴地空转着，引擎熄着火，发出咔嗒咔的响声，好像要爆炸似的。埃里斯的飞船在旁边呜呜作响，形成了鲜明的对比。

“暗影的点位之间存在着某种联系。信号来回传递，通向远处。”埃里斯走近一些，让她的声音盖过引擎的噪音。“其他金字塔也许能提供更多信息。”

浪客咂咂舌头，扬起眉毛。“大佬卡鲁斯还停在月球上，听起来有点危险？似乎是禁区。”

“没错，但守护者带领突袭队伍进入了萨瓦图恩王座世界中的胡克金字塔。我们可以抓住这次干扰带来的机会。”

埃里斯说着，从他身边挤过，沉重地走向她的飞船。“来吧，老鼠。”

“…我们能先吃东西吗？”

*** 

埃里斯和浪客在瘴气区与金字塔的通道交界处的下沉沼泽中搭建营地时，爆炸声雷鸣般响彻王座世界的金字塔。高耸入云的巨型飞船遮住了他们的光，一眼望去看不到它的边际。

浪客的脸色很严肃，紧绷着一种埃里斯很少见到的紧张情绪：一只手握着信任手炮，另一只手则攥紧充满冰影的拳头。

埃里斯将一根用布包裹着的守望者菌柄放在一块从恶臭的沼泽地里伸出来的金字塔碎片上。她解开包裹整齐地铺展开布角，注意到了身后浪客的脚步声。

“有人在监视我们，”浪客咕哝道。他转过身来，对着他的改装机灵轻声低语，声音小到足以确信埃里斯听不到他说的话：“盯紧她，好吗？”然后大声说道，“我要四处看看，确保那个盖世英雄没有漏下任何变异体。”

浪客的改装机灵发出一声细长的音调示意明白，然后盯着埃里斯看。

“杰曼。”

他停了下来。埃里斯知道，他的担忧下潜藏着他为了树立浪客的人设而时常试图压制的高贵气质。那是一面该死的盾牌，但她看到了真实的他，藏在那层污垢之下。

“我可以…借个火吗？”

“好。”他从他的信任手炮里射出一枚烈日弹药，在金字塔地板上产生火花，点燃了守望者菌柄。“马上回来。”

埃里斯看着他消失在沼泽地里，然后把注意力集中在袅袅的守望者上。

***

埃里斯筋疲力尽地坐在泥土里一个温暖的垫子上。浪客站在危险的大火堆旁，从邪魔族式样的大锅状容器中舀出一些散发着芬芳怪味的炖汤。当他把一大碗浓稠的灰棕色肉汤放到她的手中时，她的脸皱缩了起来。

“你发现了什么？”浪客一边咂着嘴从碗里喝汤，一边问道。

埃里斯用嘴唇测试着这种“食物”的温度和味道。这有点像艾可拉上次来圣城时带给她的臭盐水奶酪，只不过底下带有浓重的土味。她的脸色凝重，转而选择了谈话。“我想得没错，它们相互联系。但现在，我却有了更多的疑问。”

“要我说，我们根本无能为力。最好别管这事了，回家吧，”浪客说着，又咂了一口。

“守望者连接着暗影的各个点位，与各个金字塔构造产生共鸣，但我无法解读它们之间的联系。不过…月球金字塔、木卫二金字塔，还有格利康和利维坦都在与同一个遥远的点位交谈。胡克所说的话，卡鲁斯也说了。这…太让人担忧了。”

“真奇怪，”浪客吹着口哨说。他摇摇头，看着她满满的碗。“你要吃吗？”

“我…”埃里斯怀疑他没有听清自己说的话，但她知道重复一遍也是徒劳的。“…这到底是什么？”

“好吃的东西。我第一次把它弄对。还以为你会感激有人为你做饭呢，毕竟你…那个，不太擅长。”

“老鼠，你给我吃了什么？”她记得那天早些时候他的狩猎，她的胃开始翻江倒海。埃里斯盯着浪客，张着嘴半呕着。她突然想起了他声称吃过的那种东西。“你给我做了腐烂的变异体。”

“什么？！”浪客被炖汤呛到，咳嗽了起来。“我不会给你吃那些垃圾的，小月月。”他笑道。“你从来没有吃过蝲蛄炖肉？”他把碗举到嘴边。“或者它的近亲…”他低声补充道。“小沼泽虾，你懂吗？很美味的！”

埃里斯收回了想象，深吸一口气，抿了一口肉汤，眼睛却没有从浪客身上离开。这种液体让她皱巴巴的肚子充满了温暖。她发觉自己的压力消失不见了。炖肉的味道远比气味更让人喜欢。她笑了笑，又喝了起来。

“谢谢。它…很好喝。”

1987616650.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
1987616650.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // ANCHOR OF LIGHT //

"The Vanguard won't hold a military tribunal in the middle of a war."

Reed-7 is a voice of reason. He stands in the doorway of the derelict moonbase, fusion rifle held in a relaxed grip. The still-smoldering bodies of Hive Thrall are scattered around the room.

"That's not comforting," the woman at Reed's back says. Aisha shoulders past him, leading with the barrel of her scout rifle, sweeping the area for any remaining targets. "The last thing I want is Shay languishing in some—some kind of Vanguard prison cell for however long this goes on for, or until we're all…"

"Dead?" Reed-7 finishes. Aisha says nothing. "This isn't the end of the world, Aisha. But we have to reach the bottom before we can climb to the top again."

"This isn't the bottom?" Aisha asks, tilting her head to the side mockingly. She steps over to one of the blown-out windows and gestures to the massive silhouette of the Leviathan hanging over the Moon, a crimson stream of Nightmares spiraling up into its open maw. "Because it sure as hell looks like it is. And, what, the Vanguard has us out here doing… doing New Light patrols?!"

"They can't afford to give us leave, no matter how much we need it," Reed pleads. "We have to stay active, contribute. We lost too many new Guardians already with the Lucent Hive assault on the Cosmodrome. We can't…" He sighs. "We can't afford to lose anyone else. We have to do everything we can."

Aisha leans one arm against the broken window frame, head hung low. "Yeah," she whispers. "Yeah."
1987616650.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//光能之锚//

“先锋不会在战争中途举行军事法庭。”

里德-7是理性的发声者。他站在废弃的月球基地门口，放松地握着融合步枪。房间里散落着仍在闷烧的邪魔族怨魂的尸体。

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

“这么说并没让人更好受，”里德背后的女人说道。艾莎肩扛着她的斥候步枪从他身边走过，在区域里搜寻着任何剩余的目标。“我最不想看到的就是沙在某种——某种先锋监狱里受尽折磨，不管这一切持续多久，或者直到我们都…”

“死了？”里德-7补完这句话，艾莎一言不发。“这不是世界末日，艾莎。但我们必须先抵达低谷，才能再攀高峰。”

“这还不叫低谷？”艾莎问道，嘲弄地侧过头。她走向一扇被吹开的窗户，向悬挂在月球上方巨大的利维坦轮廓做了个手势，一串串绯红的梦魇盘旋上升进它张开的血盆大口。“因为那看起来不能更糟了。而先锋却派我们在这里做…做新曙光巡逻？！”

“无论我们有多需要，他们都没法给我们放假。”里德申辩道。“我们必须坚持在岗，做出贡献。在光明邪魔族对发射基地的攻击下，我们已经失去了太多的新兵守护者。我们不能…”他叹了口气。“我们不能再失去任何人了。我们必须竭尽所能。”

艾莎把一只胳膊靠在破碎的窗框上，低垂着头。“是啊，”她低声说道。“是啊。”

2627533758.name: Atavistic Idol Plate
2627533758.flavor: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2627533758.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
2627533758.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

A Fallen Vandal collapses to the ground, Ether vapor rising from a glowing hole where his face once was. Dark-blue blood sizzles around the wound.

"Clear," Reed-7 calls out from the top of a flight of metal stairs, the barrel of his fusion rifle still crackling with energy from the last bolt it fired. As he descends, Aisha follows and shoulders her scout rifle.

"Looks like they were pulling the wiring out of the walls," she observes, lifting up her hand and alighting her Ghost, Dunya, into the air. "Check the systems here; make sure they weren't doing anything else."

"Affirmative," Dunya chirps, zipping off through the air toward a computer terminal.

Aisha notices that Reed's glowing eyes are fixed on the Ether wafting from the Vandal's body. She spares a glance at Dunya before crossing the floor to Reed's side. "Hey," she says with a hand on his arm, jostling him from his thoughts.

"I'm good," he lies, gingerly pulling away. "Just—thinking."

Aisha looks down at the corpse, then back up to Reed. "This isn't like what Shay did on Venus." She tries to be reassuring, but it comes off as dismissive.

"How's it any different?" He asks with a dagger's sharpness in his voice. "These—they were stripping wires from the walls, Aisha. They weren't trying to hurt anyone!"

"They opened fire on us first."

"We didn't even try to talk to them!" Reed yells.

"Aisha?" Dunya chirps, across the room. Neither Guardian hears the Ghost.

"I'm sorry," Aisha says as she throws her arms up. "Was I supposed to do that before or after they threw a grenade at me?"

"Aisha?" Dunya says again, more alarm in his voice.

"We could have tried something! Anything!" Reed screams, getting in Aisha's face. "We could have—"

"AISHA!"
2627533758.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

一名堕落者暴徒倒在地上，乙太烟雾从曾是他脸部的发光洞里冒出来。深蓝色的血液在伤口周围发出嘶嘶声。

“安全了。”里德-7从一段金属楼梯顶上发出了一声呼喊，他的融合步枪枪管伴着射出的最后一颗子弹的能量还在噼啪作响。他走下楼来，艾莎扛着斥候步枪跟着。

“看起来他们在把接线从墙上拔出来，”她评述道，她抬起手，让她的机灵杜妮亚落到空中。“检查这里的系统，确保他们没有做任何其他事情。”

“收到。”杜妮亚说道，掠过空中朝电脑终端移动。

艾莎注意到里德炽热的眼睛盯着暴徒尸体身上飘出的乙太。她瞥了一眼杜妮亚，然后走过地面来到里德身边。“嘿，”她说着，一只手搭在他的胳膊上，把他从思绪中唤醒。

“我很好，”他撒谎道，轻轻地拉开了距离。“只是…在思考。”

艾莎低头看着尸体，然后回头看着里德。“这与沙在金星上干的不同。”她试着安抚，但听起来却很不屑一顾。

“有什么不同？”他问道，声音像匕首一样尖锐。“它——他们只是在扯墙上的接线，艾莎。他们并不想伤害任何人！”

“是他们先向我们开火的。”

“我们甚至没有试着和他们交谈！”里德喊道。

“艾莎？”房间对面的杜妮亚说道。两位守护者都没听到机灵的声音。

“对不起，”艾莎边说边举起胳膊，“我是应该在他们向我扔手雷之前还是之后那样做呢？"

“艾莎？”杜妮亚又说了一遍，声音里多了一些惊慌。

“我们本可以尝试些什么的！什么都行！”里德冲着艾莎的脸尖叫道。“我们本可以——”

“艾莎！”

486861531.name: Atavistic Idol Helmet
486861531.flavor: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
486861531.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
486861531.lore:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

The Warlock Shayura kneels on a pillow, eyes closed and head bowed, hands folded in her lap. The soundscape of city noise punctuated by the melody of birds and the whistling wind surrounds her. But there is no grass beneath her pillow, only cold concrete. Four holographic screens encircle Shayura, providing a semi-realistic depiction of the gardens at the center of the Last City; a place of calm serenity situated in the shadow of the Traveler.

"I exalt our forebearers," Shayura says softly.

"I exalt my fireteam."

"I exalt my truth."

"I exalt my heart."

"I exalt humanity's capacity for love."

"This above all else, I hold true."

The words feel like thick syrup in her mouth. Guilt makes it taste bitter. Her jaw trembles and throat tightens, her mouth too dry to swallow.

"I exalt our forebearers."

Her voice wavers, just a little.

"I exalt my fireteam."

Her jaw trembles.

"I exalt my truth."

She can feel the warmth of tears on her cheeks.

"I exalt my heart."

Her voice cracks.

"I exalt h-hu-human—" She breaks. Recitations turn into sobs, and Shayura slides from pillow to floor. Her shoulders heave, and she pulls her knees to her chest, crying against her legs. Dead Guardians stare with hollow eye sockets when she closes her eyes.

They beg for their lives.

She trains a gun on them.

And exalts her truth.
486861531.lore_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

术士沙玉拉跪在枕头上，闭着眼睛，低着头，双手叠放在腿上。城市的音景，不时夹杂着鸟儿的鸣唱和呼啸的风声在她耳边环绕。但是她跪着的枕头底下没有草地，只有冰冷的混凝土。四块全息屏幕环绕着沙玉拉，提供了一幅圣城中心的花园的半写实景象；坐落于旅行者阴影之中的一个平静祥和的地方。

“我赞美我们的祖先，”沙玉拉轻声说道。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

“我赞美我的真理。”

“我赞美我的内心。”

“我赞美人类爱的能力。”

“这是我最深信不疑的一点。”

这些话在她嘴里感觉像浓稠的糖浆。内疚让它变得苦涩。她的下巴在颤抖，喉咙开始发紧，她的嘴太干了无法吞咽。

“我赞美我们的祖先。”

她的声音有一点点颤抖。

“我赞美我的火力战队。”

她的下巴颤抖着。

“我赞美我的真理。”

她能感觉到脸颊上泪水的温热。

“我赞美我的内心。”

她的声音沙哑了。

“我赞美人…人类…”她开始崩溃。诵读变成了抽泣，沙玉拉从枕头滑到地板上。她耸动着肩膀，把自己缩成一团，靠着腿哭了起来。当她闭上双眼，死去的守护者就用空洞的眼窝望着她。

他们乞求着活命。

她用枪对准他们。

并赞美她的真理。

1026828708.name: Atavistic Idol Greaves
1026828708.flavor: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
1026828708.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
1026828708.lore:
MOON // OCEAN OF STORMS // K1 COMMUNION //

Red light floods over Dunya's black-and-gold shell. The tiny Ghost's monocular blue eye bobs up and down as he tracks backwards through the air, taking in the presence of an ethereal figure hovering above.

Aisha and Reed turn at Dunya's chirp of alarm, guns drawn. But as they train their sights on the robed Nightmare shimmering in front of them, neither one can fully commit their aim. Aisha is the first to whisper an expletive in shock at the sight.

"Arguing about which of you is as terrible as I am?" The Nightmare of Shayura asks, turning her crimson stare away from Dunya's retreating form. "Heaven forbid you be as awful as your murderous friend."

Aisha is frozen in confusion, hands trembling on the grip of her scout rifle. "Shay." The word comes out of her mouth as little more than a hoarse whisper. 

The Nightmare of Shayura floats slowly through the air toward Aisha and Reed, smiling when Dunya hides behind his Guardian and transmats away.

"First comes the guilt," the Nightmare croons, "then the shame, then the denial. I know the patterns well." She wags a finger back and forth, chidingly. "How soon before you forget me? Find a new Warlock to bask in their well? Pretend that I never existed?"

"S-Shay—Shay wh—" Aisha can't even string her words together. Not until she feels Reed's metal hand clamp down on her shoulder. When she looks at him, his expression is one of resolve, not fear. It's then that she remembers the instructions Eris had given, about how to survive on the Moon if ever the Nightmares came for them with familiar faces, familiar voices.

Aisha looks back at the Nightmare of Shayura and whispers: "I'm sorry."
1026828708.lore_zh:
月球//风暴海洋//K1通讯区//

红光淹没了杜妮亚的黑金色机壳。小机灵在空中向后退却，他的单目蓝眼睛上下跳动，看到了一个空灵的身影在上方盘旋。

艾莎和里德听到杜妮亚示警的声音，转过身来拔出了枪。但是当他们瞄准面前闪烁的长袍梦魇时，谁也下不了手。艾莎看到这一幕，率先发出了震惊的低声咒骂。

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

“争论你们俩中谁和我一样恶劣？”沙玉拉的梦魇问道，她把绯红的目光从杜妮亚退下的身影上移开。“但愿你们不会像你们那杀人不眨眼的朋友那样恶劣。”

艾莎不知所措，双手握着斥候步枪，颤抖着。“沙。”从她的嘴里发出来的话语就像嘶哑的耳语。 

沙玉拉的梦魇在空中慢慢飘向艾莎和里德，并在杜妮亚躲在他的守护者身后传送离开时笑了。

“先是内疚，”梦魇低声说道，“然后是羞愧，再然后是否认。我很了解这一套。”她来回摇晃着手指，责备道。“你们还有多久就会忘记我？找个新术士沉浸在其美好中？假装我从未存在过？”

“沙…沙…沙，你…”艾莎甚至连话都说不清楚。直到她感觉到里德的金属手紧紧抓住她的肩膀。她看着他时，他的表情是一种坚定，而不是恐惧。就在那时，她记起了埃里斯给的指示，假如梦魇以熟悉的面孔，熟悉的声音向他们袭来，如何在月球上存活下来。

艾莎回头看着沙玉拉的梦魇，低声说：“对不起。”

2381515079.name: Atavistic Idol Mark
2381515079.flavor: "With the Consensus disbanded, there's no telling how long this could take to go to trial. Given the current… situation? We might all be dead before that happens."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
2381515079.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
2381515079.lore:
EARTH // LAST CITY // DETENTION FACILITY //

"The first steps to healing are learning to forgive yourself. That's a hard one, I know."

Doctor Syeda Uzair sets her datapad aside, then sits forward in her chair. She folds her hands in front of herself. A tiny, beaded chain is wrapped around one hand, and a small bone charm of the Traveler is pressed into her right palm. "Shayura, whether or not a court of law finds you guilty of your actions in any measure, you are still held accountable to the court of your own conscience."

Across from Doctor Uzair, Shayura is slouched in her chair. She stares past her doctor, out the narrow windows, and looks to the looming figure of the Traveler hanging in the sky. It seems so much bigger compared to the projections she chooses to display in her cell.

"Who judges them?" Shayura asks, motioning to the window with her chin. To the Traveler.

Doctor Uzair turns, glancing over her shoulder at the Traveler. Her grip on the charm tightens. "I don't know," is her immediate answer, but the question will burrow its way through her mind, surfacing again when she lies down in bed tonight. "I understand the Human condition far better than a god's."

"Maybe the Traveler abandoned us because it's ashamed of us. Of what we've done in its name." Shayura's voice is small, weary. An alert flickers on Dr. Uzair's datapad, momentarily drawing her attention away. Shayura fills the silence with a sigh. 

"Maybe," Doctor Uzair says, though she doesn't believe it. "But, maybe we're all just short on hope these days. I'd like to extend our session a little longer, if you're willing. Would you mind if we did so with some guests?"

Concern flashes across Shayura's face; defensiveness, shame. She sits up slightly in her seat. Doctor Uzair can see the tension.

"When we speak of forgiveness, sometimes it helps to first be forgiven," Doctor Uzair says with a tempered smile. Shayura glances to the datapad, then back to her doctor.

"Reed-7 and Aisha would like to see you."

Tears well in Shayura's eyes. Her voice of dissent evaporates.

Shayura realizes there is one thing she can still have faith in: her family.
2381515079.lore_zh:
地球//圣城//拘留所//

“疗伤的第一步就是学会原谅自己。我知道这很难。”

医生西达·乌泽尔把她的数据板放在一边，然后坐在椅子上。她双手交叉放在身前。她的一只手上缠着一条小小的串珠链，右手掌里压着一个旅行者的骨质小护符。“沙玉拉，不管法庭是否判定你的行为有罪，你都会被自己良心的法庭追究责任。”

在乌泽尔医生的对面，沙玉拉无精打采地耷拉在椅子上。她的目光越过她的医生，从狭小的窗户望出去，看到了悬挂在天空中若隐若现的旅行者的身影。它看起来比她选择在牢房里显示的投影要大得多。

“谁来审判那家伙？”沙玉拉问道，用她的下巴示意着窗口。指向旅行者。

乌泽尔医生转过身，回头瞥了一眼旅行者。她把护符抓得更紧了。“我不知道，”她立即答道，但这个问题还会在她的脑海里钻来钻去，等她今晚躺在床上的时候再次浮现。“比起神灵，我更了解人类的处境。”

“也许旅行者抛弃我们是因为它为我们感到羞耻。为我们以它的名义所做的一切感到羞耻。”沙玉拉的声音微弱而疲惫。乌泽尔医生的数据板上闪烁着一则警示，暂时转移了她的注意力。沙玉拉以一声叹息填补了沉默。 

“也许吧，”乌泽尔医生说道，尽管她并不相信。“但也许我们只不过是近来都缺少希望。如果你愿意，我想把我们的谈话再延长一点。你介意我们邀请两位客人吗？”

忧虑掠过沙玉拉的脸庞；自我防备，羞愧难当。她从座位上微微起身。乌泽尔医生能看出这种紧张。

“当我们谈及宽恕时，有时先被宽恕会有所帮助。”乌泽尔医生带着温和的微笑说。沙玉拉瞥了一眼数据板，然后又看向她的医生。

"里德-7和艾莎想见你。"

沙玉拉的眼里噙满了泪水。她不服从的想法消失了。

沙玉拉意识到有一件事她依然可以相信：她的家人。

1068450901.name: Candescent Gauntlets
1068450901.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
1068450901.lore:
Namrask moves his four hands near the Loom, though he dares not touch it. He fears that one with skills as paltry as his would sully its mechanisms. He can still scarcely believe that he is allowed to be this close to it at all.

"Well?" asks a digital voice from over his shoulder. "What do you think?"

He shuffles to the side, making eye contact with Ada-1, the Exo who invited him to view the Loom. "An impressive machine. Difficult to master, I think."

"Synthweave can be… finicky," Ada admits. She crosses the small room to look upon the Loom herself. "But the results are well worth the effort."

"Why…" Namrask begins, mustering his nerve, "Why did you invite me here?"

"It was thanks to your people that the Loom exists at all," she replies. "And Eido tells me you are a weaver."

That surprises Namrask. Eido makes a habit of avoiding him, and he had always thought she disliked him. Not that he could blame her if she did.

"I am," he says. And then, almost inaudibly, "Now."

He bows his head in silence and shame.

Ada says nothing for a moment, then turns to glance wistfully at the Loom. "When the Black Armory's forges were lost, I felt that I no longer knew who I was. And so, I had to… reinvent myself."

She leaves his side, opening a drawer in her desk and taking from it an object wrapped in cloth.

"Here," she says as she hands it to him. "For you to practice."

Namrask unwraps the parcel, staring wide-eyed at the Synthweave bolt in his hands.

"From one weaver to another," Ada says kindly.
1068450901.lore_zh:
拿姆拉斯克挪动着四只爪子靠近纺织机，尽管他并不敢触碰它。他担心，像他这样技艺拙劣的家伙会玷污它的机械装置。他仍然不敢相信自己竟然能如此接近它。

“怎么样？”一个数码语音从他身后传来。“你觉得如何？”

他挪到一边，跟邀请他来参观纺织机的Exo艾达-1交流了一下眼神。“这机器令人惊艳。我觉得操控起来应该很难。”

“合成纤维有时候确实…需要认真对待，”艾达承认道。她穿过小房间，亲自去看纺织机。“但其成果是值得付出努力的。”

“为什么…”拿姆拉斯克鼓起勇气问道，“你为什么邀请我来这里？”

“多亏了你们的族人，纺织机才得以存在，”她答道。“而且艾多告诉我你是个织布工。”

这让拿姆拉斯克很吃惊。艾多总是避开他，他一直以为她不喜欢他。就算她真不喜欢，他也不能怪她。

“确实，”他说道。接着又说了一句，几乎没法听清。“我现在是了。”

他在沉默和羞愧中低下头来。

艾达沉默了一会儿，然后若有所思地瞥了一眼纺织机。“当黑色军械库的锻炉消失时，我觉得我都不认得自己了。所以，我必须…重塑自己。”

她离开他身旁，打开书桌上的一个抽屉，从里面拿出一个用布包裹的东西。

“给，”她说着把它递给了他。“拿去练习吧。”

拿姆拉斯克打开包裹，睁大眼睛盯着手中的合成纤维。

“织布工给织布工的礼物，”艾达和蔼地说道。

58945355.name: Candescent Plate
58945355.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
58945355.lore:
A bonfire crackles to those around it—friends gathering in need.

It trades for warmth what they cast out,

And grows to sooth with a brilliant hue.

A bonfire roars to those around it—friends cheering the flames higher.

It burns away shadows and brightens the night.

A refuge: from which to look to the horizon.

A bonfire whispers to those around it—friends bonded by revelries now past. 

Morning ignites the horizon, and dawn makes clear the road. 

Friends now ride, Sparrows astride, no longer a shadow behind… 

They vanish into the sun.
58945355.lore_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，朋友围火而坐，相聚取暖。

他们投之以木，火焰报之以暖，

带着明亮的色调，渐渐变得舒适。

篝火肆意咆哮，火苗越窜越高，朋友为之欢呼雀跃。

它驱散阴影，照亮黑夜。

它是一个避难所，从那里能望向地平线。

篝火窃窃私语，朋友彼此联结的狂欢落幕。 

清晨点燃了地平线，黎明扫清了道路。 

朋友们骑乘着快雀，身后不再留下阴影… 

他们消失在了烈日之中。

3967067356.name: Candescent Helm
3967067356.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
3967067356.lore:
Shaxx shakes his head as he watches the Crucible match play out onscreen. Bravo Team's Warlock has been revived by their Ghost three times in 30 seconds, and by the look of things, they're well on their way to a fourth. It's a shameful display, and the rest of Bravo seems to be getting fed up with it.

"Tough match, huh?"

Shaxx turns to see Ikora Rey, her eyes fixed on the screen as well. 

"Tough for that Warlock's team," Shaxx sighs. "They've eaten a full shotgun blast to the chest, a Hunter's knife to the face, and even got disintegrated by their own grenade."

"Mhm," Ikora replies absently. "Bet you 500 Glimmer that they rally."

Shaxx tilts his head at her. "Are you serious?"

 "I'm always serious," she replies with an arched brow.

After a moment, Shaxx nods. "All right. I'll take that bet."

They turn their attention back to the match. The Warlock is caught in an explosion. Revived. Impaled on a glaive. Revived. Falls off the edge of the arena. Revived.

And then… they land a headshot. And another. Then another. They stick close to a member of Bravo, drawing fire so that their teammate can release a fusion rifle burst into their opponent. Shaxx watches in awe as the Warlock shapes their Light into a flaming sword and takes to the sky, raining fire down on Alpha team.

When the smoke clears, Bravo ekes out a narrow victory.

"How did you know?" Shaxx asks as he hands the Glimmer to Ikora.

"That Warlock stayed in the match," she replies. "Never bet against someone who won't quit."
3967067356.lore_zh:
沙克斯摇摇头，看着屏幕上进行着的熔炉竞技场比赛。Bravo队伍的术士在30秒内被其机灵复活了三次，从目前的情况来看，他们即将迎来第四次复活。这表现太可耻了，Bravo的其他队员似乎已经受够了。

“艰难的比赛哈？”

沙克斯转身看向艾可拉·蕾伊，她的双眼也盯着屏幕。 

“对那个术士的队伍来说很艰难，”沙克斯叹息道。“胸口扛了一整发霰弹枪，脸上挨了猎人一刀，甚至被自己人的手雷炸得七零八碎。”

“嗯，”艾可拉心不在焉地答道。“我赌500微光，他们会重振旗鼓。”

沙克斯朝她歪了歪脑袋。“你是认真的？”

 “我一向不开玩笑。”她挑起眉毛答道。

过了一会儿，沙克斯点了点头。“好吧。我跟你打赌。”

他们把注意力转回到比赛上。术士遭遇爆炸。复活过来。被偃月刺穿。再次复活。从竞技场边缘掉下去。继续复活。

紧接着…术士打中了一发爆头射击。又一发。再来一发。贴紧Bravo队员，吸引火力，好让队友能发射融合步枪攻击对手。沙克斯敬畏地看着术士将自己的光能变成燃烧的利刃，一飞冲天，向Alpha队伍撒下火焰之雨。

硝烟散尽时，Bravo竭尽所能获得了险胜。

“你是怎么知道的？”沙克斯一边问，一边把微光递给艾可拉。

“那术士没有放弃比赛，”她回答道。“不肯放弃的人绝不会输。”

2644573111.name: Candescent Greaves
2644573111.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
2644573111.lore:
Amanda Holliday's Solstice Round-Up! See what the defenders of the Last City think about the new festivities!

Vanguard Commander Zavala
"Each of us has faced and overcome so much. Sometimes that can feel like a sacrifice, or a price… but it's a lesson to remember and learn. I'd like Guardians to keep that in mind as we celebrate Solstice. What we come to do is only possible because of what we've done. Both the good, and the bad."

Vanguard Ikora Rey
"Meditation is an important part of understanding not just the Light, but ourselves. We rise in a void, and seek meaning. The Bonfire is a wonderful metaphor for that process; Amanda outdid herself helping with Solstice. Even I don't know how she managed all of this."

Saint-14
"A big pyre to lay to rest everything we hold in our hearts. Yes. I could use this now. Celebration. Explosions. Revelry… isn't it wonderful? I might cry." 

Mithrax, Kell of House Light
"Guardian celebrations perplex and mystify, but new beginnings are worthy of what the Saint calls 'partying.' House Light is grateful for inclusion in this occasion, and offers forth many combustible baubles to the sacrificial flame."

Lord Saladin, Valus to Empress Caiatl
"Once I can see this Bonfire from Caiatl's flagship, I'll be happy."  

Empress Caiatl of the Cabal Empire
"What is the ordnance limitation on these Bonfire contributions? Perhaps the Cabal can assist in creating a larger fire."

Ana Bray
"I'll support anything Amanda does. Quite a show. I'm always a fan of something fancy with a little attitude."

Lord Shaxx
"I like to imagine the ignition cores are grenades… that does put a smile on my face."

Eris Morn 
"…The what?"
2644573111.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪的至日汇总！看看圣城的捍卫者们觉得新的庆祝活动怎么样！

先锋指挥官萨瓦拉
“我们每个人都面对和克服了太多事情。有时这感觉像是一种牺牲或者代价…但其实它是值得铭记和学习的教训。我希望守护者们在庆祝至日时能将这一点牢记在心。我们未来能做成什么，正是因为我们已经付出的努力。无论好坏。”

先锋艾可拉·蕾伊
“冥想不仅是理解光能，也是理解我们自身的重要一环。我们在虚空中崛起，寻求着意义。篝火很好地隐喻了这一过程；阿曼达竭尽全力协助着至日活动。连我都不知道她是怎么做到的。”

圣人14号
“一个大火堆安放我们心中保留的一切。没错。我现在很需要这个。庆祝。爆炸。狂欢…这不是很棒吗？我会哭出来的。” 

光能氏族的凯尔，米瑟拉克斯
“守护者的庆祝活动神秘而复杂，但新的开端值得来一场圣人所说的‘派对'。光能氏族对能融入这一场合心存感激，还为祭祀火焰提供了许多助燃的小玩意儿。"

领主萨拉丁，女帝查厄托军政官
“只要我能在查厄托的旗舰上看到篝火，我就心满意足了。”  

卡巴尔帝国女帝查厄托
“这些篝火捐献有军械限制吗？也许卡巴尔能帮忙生一堆更大更猛的火。”

阿娜·布瑞
“阿曼达做的事我无条件支持。这是场相当精彩的表演。我向来喜欢花哨而有点态度的东西。”

领主沙克斯
"我喜欢把引燃核心想象成手雷…这确实能逗我发笑。"

埃里斯·摩恩 
“…什么日？”

2710628962.name: Candescent Mark
2710628962.lore:
Saint-14 stands in place of the Sergeant at Arms amid a host of New Lights; most had been resurrected near the City walls. He needed the distraction, the work, but most of all he needed to be somewhere he could help. 

Whispers fly between them regarding the legend that addresses them, and the strange chicken that struts figure eights around his legs.

"This area is reserved for Lights without combat training who wish to take part in Solstice. Let's get you to speed." He picks up an old-looking weapon. "This is standard Khvostov rifle. Some of you are familiar with this weapon," Saint says. "For those who aren't familiar, it's very simple."

He quickly runs through a few exercises. How to reload quickly, adjust the sights, clear a jam. At the range targets, he demonstrates how to weave Light between bursts of gunfire. Each time, a metallic ping rings out as he strikes a target; and each time, a chicken-cluck response echoes beside him.

"Calm and discipline is key. Steady support of your rifle will keep it under control. Steady pressure on the trigger will keep you from pulling off-target. Breathe, squeeze, and shoot."

"Bawk."

"Yes, yes. Now it is your turn, New Lights!"

The group steps forward and focuses on their targets. Several of the trainees' shots miss, but a Guardian in green lands each bullet and cheers.

"Bawk."

The New Light looks at the chicken now standing beside them, then to Saint-14, who also is focused on the chicken. There is a moment of hesitation before Saint says, "Hm. Good. Run it again."

"I did it perfectly," the New Light complains flaccidly.

Saint steps forward and puts a hand on their shoulder. "Perfection doesn't guarantee success. Perfection is subjective, New Light. That's why we train."

"But I hit every one!"

"Bawk… Awk!"

Saint-14 nods to the chicken, who stands tall and mighty—feathers sharp and puffed against the waning morning light.

"Colonel, the Pigeon Lord, says do it again. I wouldn't argue."
2710628962.lore_zh:
圣人14号代替武装中士站在众多新兵中间；他们大多数都是在圣城城墙附近复活的。他需要转移注意力，需要工作，但最重要的是，他需要一个他能帮上忙的岗位。 

新兵在底下窃窃私语，讨论着向他们讲话的这位传奇人物，还有那只绕着他的腿昂首阔步画着8的奇怪的鸡。

“这块区域是预留给希望参加至日、但尚未接受战斗训练的新兵们。我们来尽快熟悉一下吧。”他拿起一把看起来很旧的武器。“这是标准的赫沃斯托夫步枪。你们中有些人对这把武器很熟悉，”圣人说道。“不熟悉的话也别担心，它很简单。”

他快速进行了一番演练。如何快速填装，调整瞄准器，清理卡壳。在靶场上，他演示了如何冒着枪林弹雨编织光能。每一次，他击中目标都会响起金属的枪击声；而每一次，他身旁都会回荡着鸡叫的回应声。

“冷静和纪律是关键所在。稳定的支撑能帮你控制步枪。对扳机施加稳定压力就不会偏离目标。深呼吸，扣下扳机，然后发射。”

“咕咕。”

“是的，没错。现在轮到你们了，新兵们！”

这群新兵迈步向前，专注于他们的目标。有几个受训新兵的射击没有命中，但有位身穿绿衣的守护者每一发子弹都打中了，并欢呼了起来。

“咕咕。”

这名新兵看了看站在旁边的鸡，然后看向圣人14号，他也在关注着这只鸡。圣人犹豫了片刻，然后说道，“嗯。不错。再来一次。”

“我做得很完美，”新兵弱弱地抱怨道。

圣人走上前，把手放在其肩上。“完美并不能保证成功。完美是主观的，新兵。这就是我们训练的原因。”

“但我每枪都打中了！”

“咕…咕咕！”

圣人14号朝鸡点点头，它高大威猛地站着，羽毛在渐弱晨光的映衬下尖锐而蓬松。

“鸽王上校说再做一次。我可没意见。”

2916149327.name: Candescent Gauntlets (Unkindled)
2916149327.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
2916149327.lore:
Namrask moves his four hands near the Loom, though he dares not touch it. He fears that one with skills as paltry as his would sully its mechanisms. He can still scarcely believe that he is allowed to be this close to it at all.

"Well?" asks a digital voice from over his shoulder. "What do you think?"

He shuffles to the side, making eye contact with Ada-1, the Exo who invited him to view the Loom. "An impressive machine. Difficult to master, I think."

"Synthweave can be… finicky," Ada admits. She crosses the small room to look upon the Loom herself. "But the results are well worth the effort."

"Why…" Namrask begins, mustering his nerve, "Why did you invite me here?"

"It was thanks to your people that the Loom exists at all," she replies. "And Eido tells me you are a weaver."

That surprises Namrask. Eido makes a habit of avoiding him, and he had always thought she disliked him. Not that he could blame her if she did.

"I am," he says. And then, almost inaudibly, "Now."

He bows his head in silence and shame.

Ada says nothing for a moment, then turns to glance wistfully at the Loom. "When the Black Armory's forges were lost, I felt that I no longer knew who I was. And so, I had to… reinvent myself."

She leaves his side, opening a drawer in her desk and taking from it an object wrapped in cloth.

"Here," she says as she hands it to him. "For you to practice."

Namrask unwraps the parcel, staring wide-eyed at the Synthweave bolt in his hands.

"From one weaver to another," Ada says kindly.
2916149327.lore_zh:
拿姆拉斯克挪动着四只爪子靠近纺织机，尽管他并不敢触碰它。他担心，像他这样技艺拙劣的家伙会玷污它的机械装置。他仍然不敢相信自己竟然能如此接近它。

“怎么样？”一个数码语音从他身后传来。“你觉得如何？”

他挪到一边，跟邀请他来参观纺织机的Exo艾达-1交流了一下眼神。“这机器令人惊艳。我觉得操控起来应该很难。”

“合成纤维有时候确实…需要认真对待，”艾达承认道。她穿过小房间，亲自去看纺织机。“但其成果是值得付出努力的。”

“为什么…”拿姆拉斯克鼓起勇气问道，“你为什么邀请我来这里？”

“多亏了你们的族人，纺织机才得以存在，”她答道。“而且艾多告诉我你是个织布工。”

这让拿姆拉斯克很吃惊。艾多总是避开他，他一直以为她不喜欢他。就算她真不喜欢，他也不能怪她。

“确实，”他说道。接着又说了一句，几乎没法听清。“我现在是了。”

他在沉默和羞愧中低下头来。

艾达沉默了一会儿，然后若有所思地瞥了一眼纺织机。“当黑色军械库的锻炉消失时，我觉得我都不认得自己了。所以，我必须…重塑自己。”

她离开他身旁，打开书桌上的一个抽屉，从里面拿出一个用布包裹的东西。

“给，”她说着把它递给了他。“拿去练习吧。”

拿姆拉斯克打开包裹，睁大眼睛盯着手中的合成纤维。

“织布工给织布工的礼物，”艾达和蔼地说道。

1947358241.name: Candescent Plate (Unkindled)
1947358241.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
1947358241.lore:
A bonfire crackles to those around it—friends gathering in need.

It trades for warmth what they cast out,

And grows to sooth with a brilliant hue.

A bonfire roars to those around it—friends cheering the flames higher.

It burns away shadows and brightens the night.

A refuge: from which to look to the horizon.

A bonfire whispers to those around it—friends bonded by revelries now past. 

Morning ignites the horizon, and dawn makes clear the road. 

Friends now ride, Sparrows astride, no longer a shadow behind… 

They vanish into the sun.
1947358241.lore_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，朋友围火而坐，相聚取暖。

他们投之以木，火焰报之以暖，

带着明亮的色调，渐渐变得舒适。

篝火肆意咆哮，火苗越窜越高，朋友为之欢呼雀跃。

它驱散阴影，照亮黑夜。

它是一个避难所，从那里能望向地平线。

篝火窃窃私语，朋友彼此联结的狂欢落幕。 

清晨点燃了地平线，黎明扫清了道路。 

朋友们骑乘着快雀，身后不再留下阴影… 

他们消失在了烈日之中。

3526595120.name: Candescent Mark (Unkindled)
3526595120.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
3526595120.lore:
Shaxx shakes his head as he watches the Crucible match play out onscreen. Bravo Team's Warlock has been revived by their Ghost three times in 30 seconds, and by the look of things, they're well on their way to a fourth. It's a shameful display, and the rest of Bravo seems to be getting fed up with it.

"Tough match, huh?"

Shaxx turns to see Ikora Rey, her eyes fixed on the screen as well. 

"Tough for that Warlock's team," Shaxx sighs. "They've eaten a full shotgun blast to the chest, a Hunter's knife to the face, and even got disintegrated by their own grenade."

"Mhm," Ikora replies absently. "Bet you 500 Glimmer that they rally."

Shaxx tilts his head at her. "Are you serious?"

 "I'm always serious," she replies with an arched brow.

After a moment, Shaxx nods. "All right. I'll take that bet."

They turn their attention back to the match. The Warlock is caught in an explosion. Revived. Impaled on a glaive. Revived. Falls off the edge of the arena. Revived.

And then… they land a headshot. And another. Then another. They stick close to a member of Bravo, drawing fire so that their teammate can release a fusion rifle burst into their opponent. Shaxx watches in awe as the Warlock shapes their Light into a flaming sword and takes to the sky, raining fire down on Alpha team.

When the smoke clears, Bravo ekes out a narrow victory.

"How did you know?" Shaxx asks as he hands the Glimmer to Ikora.

"That Warlock stayed in the match," she replies. "Never bet against someone who won't quit."
3526595120.lore_zh:
沙克斯摇摇头，看着屏幕上进行着的熔炉竞技场比赛。Bravo队伍的术士在30秒内被其机灵复活了三次，从目前的情况来看，他们即将迎来第四次复活。这表现太可耻了，Bravo的其他队员似乎已经受够了。

“艰难的比赛哈？”

沙克斯转身看向艾可拉·蕾伊，她的双眼也盯着屏幕。 

“对那个术士的队伍来说很艰难，”沙克斯叹息道。“胸口扛了一整发霰弹枪，脸上挨了猎人一刀，甚至被自己人的手雷炸得七零八碎。”

“嗯，”艾可拉心不在焉地答道。“我赌500微光，他们会重振旗鼓。”

沙克斯朝她歪了歪脑袋。“你是认真的？”

 “我一向不开玩笑。”她挑起眉毛答道。

过了一会儿，沙克斯点了点头。“好吧。我跟你打赌。”

他们把注意力转回到比赛上。术士遭遇爆炸。复活过来。被偃月刺穿。再次复活。从竞技场边缘掉下去。继续复活。

紧接着…术士打中了一发爆头射击。又一发。再来一发。贴紧Bravo队员，吸引火力，好让队友能发射融合步枪攻击对手。沙克斯敬畏地看着术士将自己的光能变成燃烧的利刃，一飞冲天，向Alpha队伍撒下火焰之雨。

硝烟散尽时，Bravo竭尽所能获得了险胜。

“你是怎么知道的？”沙克斯一边问，一边把微光递给艾可拉。

“那术士没有放弃比赛，”她回答道。“不肯放弃的人绝不会输。”

2056606165.name: Candescent Helm (Unkindled)
2056606165.flavor: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
2056606165.lore:
Amanda Holliday's Solstice Round-Up! See what the defenders of the Last City think about the new festivities!

Vanguard Commander Zavala
"Each of us has faced and overcome so much. Sometimes that can feel like a sacrifice, or a price… but it's a lesson to remember and learn. I'd like Guardians to keep that in mind as we celebrate Solstice. What we come to do is only possible because of what we've done. Both the good, and the bad."

Vanguard Ikora Rey
"Meditation is an important part of understanding not just the Light, but ourselves. We rise in a void, and seek meaning. The Bonfire is a wonderful metaphor for that process; Amanda outdid herself helping with Solstice. Even I don't know how she managed all of this."

Saint-14
"A big pyre to lay to rest everything we hold in our hearts. Yes. I could use this now. Celebration. Explosions. Revelry… isn't it wonderful? I might cry." 

Mithrax, Kell of House Light
"Guardian celebrations perplex and mystify, but new beginnings are worthy of what the Saint calls 'partying.' House Light is grateful for inclusion in this occasion, and offers forth many combustible baubles to the sacrificial flame."

Lord Saladin, Valus to Empress Caiatl
"Once I can see this Bonfire from Caiatl's flagship, I'll be happy."  

Empress Caiatl of the Cabal Empire
"What is the ordnance limitation on these Bonfire contributions? Perhaps the Cabal can assist in creating a larger fire."

Ana Bray
"I'll support anything Amanda does. Quite a show. I'm always a fan of something fancy with a little attitude."

Lord Shaxx
"I like to imagine the ignition cores are grenades… that does put a smile on my face."

Eris Morn 
"…The what?"
2056606165.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪的至日汇总！看看圣城的捍卫者们觉得新的庆祝活动怎么样！

先锋指挥官萨瓦拉
“我们每个人都面对和克服了太多事情。有时这感觉像是一种牺牲或者代价…但其实它是值得铭记和学习的教训。我希望守护者们在庆祝至日时能将这一点牢记在心。我们未来能做成什么，正是因为我们已经付出的努力。无论好坏。”

先锋艾可拉·蕾伊
“冥想不仅是理解光能，也是理解我们自身的重要一环。我们在虚空中崛起，寻求着意义。篝火很好地隐喻了这一过程；阿曼达竭尽全力协助着至日活动。连我都不知道她是怎么做到的。”

圣人14号
“一个大火堆安放我们心中保留的一切。没错。我现在很需要这个。庆祝。爆炸。狂欢…这不是很棒吗？我会哭出来的。” 

光能氏族的凯尔，米瑟拉克斯
“守护者的庆祝活动神秘而复杂，但新的开端值得来一场圣人所说的‘派对'。光能氏族对能融入这一场合心存感激，还为祭祀火焰提供了许多助燃的小玩意儿。"

领主萨拉丁，女帝查厄托军政官
“只要我能在查厄托的旗舰上看到篝火，我就心满意足了。”  

卡巴尔帝国女帝查厄托
“这些篝火捐献有军械限制吗？也许卡巴尔能帮忙生一堆更大更猛的火。”

阿娜·布瑞
“阿曼达做的事我无条件支持。这是场相当精彩的表演。我向来喜欢花哨而有点态度的东西。”

领主沙克斯
"我喜欢把引燃核心想象成手雷…这确实能逗我发笑。"

埃里斯·摩恩 
“…什么日？”
