213264394.name: Buzzard
213264394.lore:
"This is foolish," Mithrax says, empty hands spread.

The Trostland forest had been quiet until three Eliksni jumped from their hiding places with weapons sparking with Arc energy. Two Dregs and a Vandal. They bear House Salvation's sigil.

"Misraaks, the Forsaken," one Dreg clicks, brandishing a spear. "Come to kill us?"

"No," he says, staring them down. "I will not harm you."

"You lie like a Human."

Mithrax sees the shift of the spear in the Dreg's hands the moment before he lunges. The Kell avoids its thrust and grips the Dreg by his head, slamming it into the ground with a hard crack. The Vandal draws a sidearm. Mithrax rushes him, grabs him by the wrist, and wrenches the gun upward. The Vandal's lower hand jabs a knife in the soft flesh between Mithrax's carapace. He barely feels it—the Kell of Light puts a hand around his attacker's throat and squeezes the life from him.

The third flees. Mithrax lets him.

The Kell pulls the knife from his side and drops it among the pine needles, pressing a hand to his wound.

Perhaps, when all the violence was done, the future he could give the Eliksni would be worth it. Would justify everything he had done. Every death, every act of cruelty… or kindness. Or love.

He knows that Eramis hoped for the same.

For now, Mithrax can only leave the two Eliksni where they lie. He will come back later for their funeral rites.
213264394.lore_zh:
“这太蠢了，”米瑟拉克斯说道，摊开空空的双手。

慰藉之地森林一片寂静，直到三个埃里克斯尼族从藏身处跳了出来，手里拿着闪动着电弧能量的武器。两个堕落者士兵和一个暴徒。他们身上有着救赎氏族的印记。

“遗落之族的米斯拉阿克斯，”一个堕落者士兵尖声说道，挥舞着长矛。“要来杀我们？”

“不，”他凝视着他们说。“我不会伤害你们。”

“你撒起谎来就像人类一样。”

就在堕落者士兵刺过去的那一刻，米瑟拉克斯看到了他手中长矛的移动。凯尔避开了它的突刺，夹住堕落者士兵的头，砰的一声重重地将其摔在地上。暴徒拔出了一支手枪。米瑟拉克斯冲向他，抓住他的手腕，把枪往上扳。暴徒下方的手将一把刀刺进了米瑟拉克斯外壳之间柔软的血肉。光能凯尔掐住袭击者的喉咙，剥夺了他的生命。

第三个对手逃跑了。米瑟拉克斯没有去追。

凯尔从身侧拔出刀来，让它落在松针之间，一只手按着他的伤口。

也许，当所有暴行都结束后，他带给埃里克斯尼族的未来会是值得的。会证明他所做的一切都是正确的。每一次死亡，每一次残忍…善良或爱意之举。

他知道伊拉莫斯也有过同样的期望。

米瑟拉克斯只得把两个埃里克斯尼族暂时留在原地。他稍后会回来完成他们的葬礼。

2759590322.name: THE SWARM
2759590322.flavor: Hunger is the all of it, and it is all of hunger.
2759590322.lore:
The Cosmodrome quakes under a killing wind: fire sent roaring from entrenched Cabal gunlines across the Mothyards. A Cabal advance threatens to encircle a defensive line held by crimson frames and one lone Light.

Shaw Han dips his head beneath a swivel of Machine Gun rounds and dives for the trench line. He slams his back against an earthen wall next to a few shot-to-pieces Redjacks. His eyes focus on the gaping bullet holes perforating their thin plating as he runs a shaky hand over his own chest. At least they were just frames. He had bled out from open wounds before and was in no rush to relive the experience. Shaw peers down to the end of his trench where a detachment of Gladiators crash through their flanks. "Just a little farther…"

A Solar explosion vaporizes the leading Gladiator and scatters their charge. A surviving Cabal recoils from the explosion in confusion. He stumbles backward into another of Shaw's trip mines and obliterates the rest of his comrades in a chain of explosions. Shaw exhales the tension in his chest and makes a mental note of the frames lost in the blast. He could take a verbal lashing from Shaxx if it meant no more blood on his hands.

He glances back to the flank. Through the settling dust of a crisis averted, Shaw sees faint silhouettes of a second Cabal charge incoming.

"Damn it!" Commander Zavala had tasked him with holding this sector. Had called him by name directly, imbued Shaw with his trust. He couldn't go back having lost a fertile ground for new Lights. Old Russia was his to protect, and no Cabal conqueror would claim it while he still drew breath.

 Slugs slap hard into the earthen trench wall at his back, sending reverberations through his ribs. He shifts to plot a safe path to defend the flank. Shaw readies to move as a heavy metal boot slams out of transmat in front of him, followed by a solid Light barricade erected to deflect the incoming metallurgic hail.

"Get up, Han. That ditch isn't going to save you." Machine Gun fire thunders off the barricade as Lord Saladin grabs him and raises Shaw to his feet. "That's for your Light to do."

"Saladin?" Shaw closes his mouth and tries again. "Lord Saladin."

"Zavala forwarded your support request." Saladin ignores Shaw's surprised expression and eyes the Cabal fortifications. "You're with me now."

"Sir." Shaw nods with a steady confidence. "What's the plan?"

Saladin peers through the cracking barricade, slugs crashing finger-lengths from his face. "Holliday is en route to deploy our heavy ordnance, but she needs their attention off the skies." Saladin looks at him for the first time and smiles. "Take out their flak guns, and give them no choice but to focus those Machine Gun nests on us."

"Oh…" Shaw wasn't sure if he'd call this a plan—maybe a Titan plan.

"You're fast on your feet, son. You'll be fine." Saladin motions the advance; "JACKS, SUPPRESSING FIRE!"

Lord Saladin strides into the no-man's-land surrounded by advancing Redjacks and a billowing aura of searing refraction. He hurls a fusion grenade across the expanse without breaking pace and demolishes one of the dozens of machinegun nests outright. Shaw moves behind him. Flame licks down the Ahamkara spine lashed to his arm until it meets the hammer of his weapon and ignites his Golden Gun. He singles out several enemy flak cannons and skewers them with Solar points, incinerating nearby Cabal.

Hot barrels realign on the Guardians as a magnificent flare emblazons Lord Saladin's armor in Solar Light. From his palms erupts a mighty maul that clinks into his gauntlets. Heavy slugs clang as they shrug off his immolated plate. He does not flinch or falter. Saladin charges the line, heat intensifying and melting slugs into slag droplets that ping and sizzle against him. He slams his maul into the dirt, driving a sweeping inferno toward the Cabal gunline. It hits like a bursting artillery shell, catching oil alight and spreading hot panic through the Cabal ranks.

Shaw dodges around incoming fire and reloads his weapon. He snaps off two more golden rays into the remaining enemy flak cannons. Frames push forward alongside them, absorbing slugs for the Guardians and keeping pressure on the gunline. Shaw spots several Gladiator detachments redirecting to confront them. He pushes the bulk of his Light into his weapon, spreads its influence to reach the nearby Redjacks, and reignites his gun before touching the barrel to the ground and firing. The ground bubbles with hot magmatic Light; a warmth envelops the Redjacks as Solar flame imbues and empowers their rifles with golden power. Shaw directs the firestorm of golden Redjack rifles to incinerate every last charging foe.

Saladin bears down on the Cabal, almost in their ranks now. He is a wildfire of Light and death. Legionaries flee their nests rather than challenge him. Frantic Cabal radio transmissions crackle across the battleground. All remaining guns turn to stop the Iron Lord's advance, but only succeed in slowing it. Saladin's voice bellows above the gunline.

"Now, Siegfried!" A Vanguard vulture-class battle carrier shrieks through the sky above, just long enough for a lone Guardian to drop from the clouds, a meteor wreathed in lightning, bringing down havoc from the skies.
2759590322.lore_zh:
发射基地在杀气腾腾的风中震颤：火力从飞蛾庭院盘踞的卡巴尔炮轴线上发出咆哮。一个卡巴尔先锋威胁着包围深红仆从和一个孤独光能的防线。

韩潇在机枪子弹的旋转下低下头，潜入战壕线。他背靠着土墙，旁边是几个中枪的红桃杰克。他的目光集中在穿透他们薄薄铠甲的弹孔上，用颤抖的手抚摸着自己的胸口。至少它们只是机械仆从。他以前也曾因撕裂伤口流血殆尽，并不急于重温这段经历。韩潇向他的战壕尽头望去，那里有一支角斗士分队从他们的侧翼冲来。“再远一点……”

一个烈日爆炸将领头的角斗士蒸发，打散了他们的冲锋。一个幸存的卡巴尔在混乱中，从爆炸中退回去。他跌跌撞撞地后退到韩潇的另一个绊雷中，在一连串的爆炸中消灭了其余的战友。韩潇呼出胸中的紧张情绪，在心里记下了在爆炸中失去的机械仆从。他可以接受沙克斯的口头怒斥，只要那样意味着他的手上不再沾血。

他回头看了一眼侧翼。透过避开危机的落下尘埃，韩潇看到了卡巴尔第二次冲锋而来的模糊身影。

“该死！”指挥官萨瓦拉给他的任务就是守住这个区域。曾经直接称呼他的名字，赋予韩潇信任。他不能就这样，失去了新的光能沃土后回去。旧俄罗斯是他要保护的，没有一个卡巴尔征服者能在他活着的时候夺走。

 炮弹狠狠拍在他后背的战壕壁上，在他的肋骨上发出回响。他开始谋划一条安全的道路，来保卫侧翼。韩潇准备动身时，一只沉重的金属靴从他面前的传送器中摔出。随后，一道坚固的光能屏障竖起，挡住了袭来的金属风暴。

“站起来，韩潇。那个壕沟可救不了你。”机枪的火力从屏障上方呼啸而过，领主萨拉丁抓住他，把韩潇拉了起来。“这才是你该用光能做的事。”

“萨拉丁？”韩潇闭上嘴，再次试了试。“领主萨拉丁。”

“萨瓦拉转达了你的支援请求。”萨拉丁没有理会韩潇的惊讶表情，眼睛盯着卡巴尔的防御工事。“你现在跟我一起。”

“长官。”韩潇点点头，信心十足。“计划是什么？”

萨拉丁从裂开的屏障中窥视出去，弹头距离他的脸咫尺之遥。“霍利迪正在部署重型武器的路上，但她需要敌人的注意力从天上转移开。”萨拉丁第一次看了看他，然后笑了。“干掉他们的高射炮，让他们别无选择，只能把机枪火力集中在我们身上。”

“哦……”韩潇不确定这能不能称之为一份计划——或者这是泰坦计划。

“你跑得很快，孩子。你会没事的。”萨拉丁动身前进，“红桃杰克，压制火力！”

领主萨拉丁大步走进无人区，周围是正在前进的红桃杰克，和汹涌的灼热光环。他不紧不慢的在宽阔的战场上扔出一颗融合手雷，直接将几十个机枪工事中的一个拆掉。韩潇跟在他的后面。烈焰顺着拴在他手臂上的阿罕卡拉之脊舔舐，直到碰到他武器的击锤，点燃了他的黄金枪。他挑出几门敌方高射炮，用烈日点将它们串起来，焚烧了附近的卡巴尔。

炽热的枪管在守护者身上重新排列，一束华丽的信号弹将领主萨拉丁的护甲点缀在烈日光能中。从他的手掌中，喷出一把巨大的大锤，铿锵作响，落入他的手中。沉重的弹头从他的献祭盔甲时，发出哐当一声。他没有退缩，也没有动摇。萨拉丁向战线发起冲锋，热度加强，将蛋壳融化成熔渣，叮叮当当地砸在他身上。他将大锤砸进土里，向着卡巴尔的战线打出一记横扫的地狱。就像一发爆裂的炮弹一样，将油点燃，在卡巴尔的队伍中蔓延着炙热的恐慌。

韩潇躲避着周围来袭的活力，给自己的武器换弹。他又向敌人剩余的高射炮打出两道黄金射线。机械仆从在旁边推进，为守护者吸收活力，保持对阵线的压力。韩潇发现几支角斗士队伍改变方向，朝他们迎面而来。他将大量光能推入武器中，将其扩散到附近的红桃杰克身上，重新点燃枪身，然后将枪管碰在地上，开枪射击。地面冒出炙热的岩浆光能；一股暖意笼罩着红桃杰克，烈日火焰为他们的步枪注入黄金的力量。韩潇指挥着黄金红桃杰克步枪的火力风暴，焚烧冲锋的每一个敌人。

萨拉丁逼近卡巴尔，现在几乎杀进他们的队伍之中。他是光能和死亡的野火。军团士兵们逃离他们的阵地，也不愿挑战他。卡巴尔狂乱的无线电通信，在战场上噼啪作响。剩下的所有枪口都转而阻止钢铁领主的前进，但却只能减缓他的速度。萨拉丁的声音在阵地上方回响。

“齐格菲，就是现在！”一艘先锋军秃鹫级战斗航母，尖啸着飞越上空，正好让一名守护者从云层中落下，一颗被闪电包裹的流星，从天空中带来了浩劫。

566740455.lore:
The Cosmodrome quakes under a killing wind: fire sent roaring from entrenched Cabal gunlines across the Mothyards. A Cabal advance threatens to encircle a defensive line held by crimson frames and one lone Light.

Shaw Han dips his head beneath a swivel of Machine Gun rounds and dives for the trench line. He slams his back against an earthen wall next to a few shot-to-pieces Redjacks. His eyes focus on the gaping bullet holes perforating their thin plating as he runs a shaky hand over his own chest. At least they were just frames. He had bled out from open wounds before and was in no rush to relive the experience. Shaw peers down to the end of his trench where a detachment of Gladiators crash through their flanks. "Just a little farther…"

A Solar explosion vaporizes the leading Gladiator and scatters their charge. A surviving Cabal recoils from the explosion in confusion. He stumbles backward into another of Shaw's trip mines and obliterates the rest of his comrades in a chain of explosions. Shaw exhales the tension in his chest and makes a mental note of the frames lost in the blast. He could take a verbal lashing from Shaxx if it meant no more blood on his hands.

He glances back to the flank. Through the settling dust of a crisis averted, Shaw sees faint silhouettes of a second Cabal charge incoming.

"Damn it!" Commander Zavala had tasked him with holding this sector. Had called him by name directly, imbued Shaw with his trust. He couldn't go back having lost a fertile ground for new Lights. Old Russia was his to protect, and no Cabal conqueror would claim it while he still drew breath.

 Slugs slap hard into the earthen trench wall at his back, sending reverberations through his ribs. He shifts to plot a safe path to defend the flank. Shaw readies to move as a heavy metal boot slams out of transmat in front of him, followed by a solid Light barricade erected to deflect the incoming metallurgic hail.

"Get up, Han. That ditch isn't going to save you." Machine Gun fire thunders off the barricade as Lord Saladin grabs him and raises Shaw to his feet. "That's for your Light to do."

"Saladin?" Shaw closes his mouth and tries again. "Lord Saladin."

"Zavala forwarded your support request." Saladin ignores Shaw's surprised expression and eyes the Cabal fortifications. "You're with me now."

"Sir." Shaw nods with a steady confidence. "What's the plan?"

Saladin peers through the cracking barricade, slugs crashing finger-lengths from his face. "Holliday is en route to deploy our heavy ordnance, but she needs their attention off the skies." Saladin looks at him for the first time and smiles. "Take out their flak guns, and give them no choice but to focus those Machine Gun nests on us."

"Oh…" Shaw wasn't sure if he'd call this a plan—maybe a Titan plan.

"You're fast on your feet, son. You'll be fine." Saladin motions the advance; "JACKS, SUPPRESSING FIRE!"

Lord Saladin strides into the no-man's-land surrounded by advancing Redjacks and a billowing aura of searing refraction. He hurls a fusion grenade across the expanse without breaking pace and demolishes one of the dozens of machinegun nests outright. Shaw moves behind him. Flame licks down the Ahamkara spine lashed to his arm until it meets the hammer of his weapon and ignites his Golden Gun. He singles out several enemy flak cannons and skewers them with Solar points, incinerating nearby Cabal.

Hot barrels realign on the Guardians as a magnificent flare emblazons Lord Saladin's armor in Solar Light. From his palms erupts a mighty maul that clinks into his gauntlets. Heavy slugs clang as they shrug off his immolated plate. He does not flinch or falter. Saladin charges the line, heat intensifying and melting slugs into slag droplets that ping and sizzle against him. He slams his maul into the dirt, driving a sweeping inferno toward the Cabal gunline. It hits like a bursting artillery shell, catching oil alight and spreading hot panic through the Cabal ranks.

Shaw dodges around incoming fire and reloads his weapon. He snaps off two more golden rays into the remaining enemy flak cannons. Frames push forward alongside them, absorbing slugs for the Guardians and keeping pressure on the gunline. Shaw spots several Gladiator detachments redirecting to confront them. He pushes the bulk of his Light into his weapon, spreads its influence to reach the nearby Redjacks, and reignites his gun before touching the barrel to the ground and firing. The ground bubbles with hot magmatic Light; a warmth envelops the Redjacks as Solar flame imbues and empowers their rifles with golden power. Shaw directs the firestorm of golden Redjack rifles to incinerate every last charging foe.

Saladin bears down on the Cabal, almost in their ranks now. He is a wildfire of Light and death. Legionaries flee their nests rather than challenge him. Frantic Cabal radio transmissions crackle across the battleground. All remaining guns turn to stop the Iron Lord's advance, but only succeed in slowing it. Saladin's voice bellows above the gunline.

"Now, Siegfried!" A Vanguard vulture-class battle carrier shrieks through the sky above, just long enough for a lone Guardian to drop from the clouds, a meteor wreathed in lightning, bringing down havoc from the skies.

一个烈日爆炸将领头的角斗士蒸发，打散了他们的冲锋。一个幸存的卡巴尔在混乱中，从爆炸中退回去。他跌跌撞撞地后退到韩潇的另一个绊雷中，在一连串的爆炸中消灭了其余的战友。韩潇呼出胸中的紧张情绪，在心里记下了在爆炸中失去的机械仆从。他可以接受沙克斯的口头怒斥，只要那样意味着他的手上不再沾血。

他回头看了一眼侧翼。透过避开危机的落下尘埃，韩潇看到了卡巴尔第二次冲锋而来的模糊身影。

“该死！”指挥官萨瓦拉给他的任务就是守住这个区域。曾经直接称呼他的名字，赋予韩潇信任。他不能就这样，失去了新的光能沃土后回去。旧俄罗斯是他要保护的，没有一个卡巴尔征服者能在他活着的时候夺走。

 炮弹狠狠拍在他后背的战壕壁上，在他的肋骨上发出回响。他开始谋划一条安全的道路，来保卫侧翼。韩潇准备动身时，一只沉重的金属靴从他面前的传送器中摔出。随后，一道坚固的光能屏障竖起，挡住了袭来的金属风暴。

“站起来，韩潇。那个壕沟可救不了你。”机枪的火力从屏障上方呼啸而过，领主萨拉丁抓住他，把韩潇拉了起来。“这才是你该用光能做的事。”

“萨拉丁？”韩潇闭上嘴，再次试了试。“领主萨拉丁。”

“萨瓦拉转达了你的支援请求。”萨拉丁没有理会韩潇的惊讶表情，眼睛盯着卡巴尔的防御工事。“你现在跟我一起。”

“长官。”韩潇点点头，信心十足。“计划是什么？”

萨拉丁从裂开的屏障中窥视出去，弹头距离他的脸咫尺之遥。“霍利迪正在部署重型武器的路上，但她需要敌人的注意力从天上转移开。”萨拉丁第一次看了看他，然后笑了。“干掉他们的高射炮，让他们别无选择，只能把机枪火力集中在我们身上。”

“哦……”韩潇不确定这能不能称之为一份计划——或者这是泰坦计划。

“你跑得很快，孩子。你会没事的。”萨拉丁动身前进，“红桃杰克，压制火力！”

领主萨拉丁大步走进无人区，周围是正在前进的红桃杰克，和汹涌的灼热光环。他不紧不慢的在宽阔的战场上扔出一颗融合手雷，直接将几十个机枪工事中的一个拆掉。韩潇跟在他的后面。烈焰顺着拴在他手臂上的阿罕卡拉之脊舔舐，直到碰到他武器的击锤，点燃了他的黄金枪。他挑出几门敌方高射炮，用烈日点将它们串起来，焚烧了附近的卡巴尔。

炽热的枪管在守护者身上重新排列，一束华丽的信号弹将领主萨拉丁的护甲点缀在烈日光能中。从他的手掌中，喷出一把巨大的大锤，铿锵作响，落入他的手中。沉重的弹头从他的献祭盔甲时，发出哐当一声。他没有退缩，也没有动摇。萨拉丁向战线发起冲锋，热度加强，将蛋壳融化成熔渣，叮叮当当地砸在他身上。他将大锤砸进土里，向着卡巴尔的战线打出一记横扫的地狱。就像一发爆裂的炮弹一样，将油点燃，在卡巴尔的队伍中蔓延着炙热的恐慌。

韩潇躲避着周围来袭的活力，给自己的武器换弹。他又向敌人剩余的高射炮打出两道黄金射线。机械仆从在旁边推进，为守护者吸收活力，保持对阵线的压力。韩潇发现几支角斗士队伍改变方向，朝他们迎面而来。他将大量光能推入武器中，将其扩散到附近的红桃杰克身上，重新点燃枪身，然后将枪管碰在地上，开枪射击。地面冒出炙热的岩浆光能；一股暖意笼罩着红桃杰克，烈日火焰为他们的步枪注入黄金的力量。韩潇指挥着黄金红桃杰克步枪的火力风暴，焚烧冲锋的每一个敌人。

萨拉丁逼近卡巴尔，现在几乎杀进他们的队伍之中。他是光能和死亡的野火。军团士兵们逃离他们的阵地，也不愿挑战他。卡巴尔狂乱的无线电通信，在战场上噼啪作响。剩下的所有枪口都转而阻止钢铁领主的前进，但却只能减缓他的速度。萨拉丁的声音在阵地上方回响。

“齐格菲，就是现在！”一艘先锋军秃鹫级战斗航母，尖啸着飞越上空，正好让一名守护者从云层中落下，一颗被闪电包裹的流星，从天空中带来了浩劫。

52790208.name: THE SWARM
52790208.flavor: Hunger is the all of it, and it is all of hunger.
52790208.lore:
The Cosmodrome quakes under a killing wind: fire sent roaring from entrenched Cabal gunlines across the Mothyards. A Cabal advance threatens to encircle a defensive line held by crimson frames and one lone Light.

Shaw Han dips his head beneath a swivel of Machine Gun rounds and dives for the trench line. He slams his back against an earthen wall next to a few shot-to-pieces Redjacks. His eyes focus on the gaping bullet holes perforating their thin plating as he runs a shaky hand over his own chest. At least they were just frames. He had bled out from open wounds before and was in no rush to relive the experience. Shaw peers down to the end of his trench where a detachment of Gladiators crash through their flanks. "Just a little farther…"

A Solar explosion vaporizes the leading Gladiator and scatters their charge. A surviving Cabal recoils from the explosion in confusion. He stumbles backward into another of Shaw's trip mines and obliterates the rest of his comrades in a chain of explosions. Shaw exhales the tension in his chest and makes a mental note of the frames lost in the blast. He could take a verbal lashing from Shaxx if it meant no more blood on his hands.

He glances back to the flank. Through the settling dust of a crisis averted, Shaw sees faint silhouettes of a second Cabal charge incoming.

"Damn it!" Commander Zavala had tasked him with holding this sector. Had called him by name directly, imbued Shaw with his trust. He couldn't go back having lost a fertile ground for new Lights. Old Russia was his to protect, and no Cabal conqueror would claim it while he still drew breath.

 Slugs slap hard into the earthen trench wall at his back, sending reverberations through his ribs. He shifts to plot a safe path to defend the flank. Shaw readies to move as a heavy metal boot slams out of transmat in front of him, followed by a solid Light barricade erected to deflect the incoming metallurgic hail.

"Get up, Han. That ditch isn't going to save you." Machine Gun fire thunders off the barricade as Lord Saladin grabs him and raises Shaw to his feet. "That's for your Light to do."

"Saladin?" Shaw closes his mouth and tries again. "Lord Saladin."

"Zavala forwarded your support request." Saladin ignores Shaw's surprised expression and eyes the Cabal fortifications. "You're with me now."

"Sir." Shaw nods with a steady confidence. "What's the plan?"

Saladin peers through the cracking barricade, slugs crashing finger-lengths from his face. "Holliday is en route to deploy our heavy ordnance, but she needs their attention off the skies." Saladin looks at him for the first time and smiles. "Take out their flak guns, and give them no choice but to focus those Machine Gun nests on us."

"Oh…" Shaw wasn't sure if he'd call this a plan—maybe a Titan plan.

"You're fast on your feet, son. You'll be fine." Saladin motions the advance; "JACKS, SUPPRESSING FIRE!"

Lord Saladin strides into the no-man's-land surrounded by advancing Redjacks and a billowing aura of searing refraction. He hurls a fusion grenade across the expanse without breaking pace and demolishes one of the dozens of machinegun nests outright. Shaw moves behind him. Flame licks down the Ahamkara spine lashed to his arm until it meets the hammer of his weapon and ignites his Golden Gun. He singles out several enemy flak cannons and skewers them with Solar points, incinerating nearby Cabal.

Hot barrels realign on the Guardians as a magnificent flare emblazons Lord Saladin's armor in Solar Light. From his palms erupts a mighty maul that clinks into his gauntlets. Heavy slugs clang as they shrug off his immolated plate. He does not flinch or falter. Saladin charges the line, heat intensifying and melting slugs into slag droplets that ping and sizzle against him. He slams his maul into the dirt, driving a sweeping inferno toward the Cabal gunline. It hits like a bursting artillery shell, catching oil alight and spreading hot panic through the Cabal ranks.

Shaw dodges around incoming fire and reloads his weapon. He snaps off two more golden rays into the remaining enemy flak cannons. Frames push forward alongside them, absorbing slugs for the Guardians and keeping pressure on the gunline. Shaw spots several Gladiator detachments redirecting to confront them. He pushes the bulk of his Light into his weapon, spreads its influence to reach the nearby Redjacks, and reignites his gun before touching the barrel to the ground and firing. The ground bubbles with hot magmatic Light; a warmth envelops the Redjacks as Solar flame imbues and empowers their rifles with golden power. Shaw directs the firestorm of golden Redjack rifles to incinerate every last charging foe.

Saladin bears down on the Cabal, almost in their ranks now. He is a wildfire of Light and death. Legionaries flee their nests rather than challenge him. Frantic Cabal radio transmissions crackle across the battleground. All remaining guns turn to stop the Iron Lord's advance, but only succeed in slowing it. Saladin's voice bellows above the gunline.

"Now, Siegfried!" A Vanguard vulture-class battle carrier shrieks through the sky above, just long enough for a lone Guardian to drop from the clouds, a meteor wreathed in lightning, bringing down havoc from the skies.

2653171213.lore:
Sadhij opened comms first. "I'm flanking. They're not going to know what hit them."

"Don't over-extend, Sadhij. Trestin and I are pushing A-side. Those damn wheels block our firing lines." The words flew from Yara's lips with concerned purpose.

Trestin chimed in, "Crimiq's on their fireteam. He laid me out in Crucible a few weeks back—just so you know."

"Can't stop the lightning, Yara. I just ride it where it takes me." Sadhij's smile was almost audible.

"You're a goober."

"You're going to be a dead goober." Trestin added.

"If you die, die with honor, Guardian!" Yara's tone struck a chord in his heart, and Sadhij quickened his pace.

He locked eyes with a Guardian down-lane and charged, Shotgun in hand, whipping a lightning grenade toward Pillar to cover his side. Sadhij heard the distinctive revving of a fusion weapon building power and leapt into the air.

"I hope you're watching…"

Sadhij felt the current surge through him and arc through the air, connecting him to his target. As his opponent's Fusion Rifle let loose, Sadhij surrendered himself to the Light. His muscles convulsed as droves of Arc energy pulsed through his nervous system and overtook him. He was a bolt, screaming across the Burning Shrine and painting the arena in the glow of static glory.

A saintly voice confirmed his strike. A smile split across his face. A rifle fired in the distance. A grounded thud heard by none.
2653171213.lore_zh:
萨迪先打开了通讯。“我在侧翼进攻。他们不会知道被谁攻击的。”

“不要过度前突，萨迪。特雷斯廷和我正在推A侧。那些该死的轮子挡住了我们的射击视野。”这些话从雅拉的口中说出，带有坚定的目标。

特雷斯廷加入进来，“克里米克在他们的火力战队。几周前他在熔炉竞技场里把我放倒了——和你们说一声。”

“没办法阻止闪电，雅拉。我只能随波逐流。”萨迪的微笑几乎自带声音。

“你是个傻瓜。”

“你马上要是个死傻瓜了。”特雷斯廷补充道。

“如果你死了，也要带着荣耀而死，守护者！”雅拉的语调打动了他的心弦，萨迪加快了脚步。

他盯紧了守护者的下路，手中握着霰弹枪，向柱子扔了一枚手雷，掩护他的侧边。萨迪听到融合武器集聚能量的特有声音，然后跳到空中。

“我希望你在看着……”

萨迪感觉到电流穿过他，电弧穿过空中，见他和目标连接在一起。当他对手的融合步枪松开时，萨吉马上把自己交给了光能。当成群的电弧能量通过他的神经系统并占据他的身体时，他的肌肉抽搐不已。他成了一支箭，在燃烧祭坛面前呼啸而过，在静态荣耀的光芒下涂抹着竞技场。

一个神圣的声音确认了他的攻击。一个微笑在他脸上荡漾开。一支步枪在远处开枪。一个接地的轰鸣却无人听到。

854379020.name: Astral Horizon (Adept)
854379020.flavor: Even the brightest stars eventually set.
854379020.source: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
854379020.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱
854379020.lore:
Sadhij opened comms first. "I'm flanking. They're not going to know what hit them."

"Don't over-extend, Sadhij. Trestin and I are pushing A-side. Those damn wheels block our firing lines." The words flew from Yara's lips with concerned purpose.

Trestin chimed in, "Crimiq's on their fireteam. He laid me out in Crucible a few weeks back—just so you know."

"Can't stop the lightning, Yara. I just ride it where it takes me." Sadhij's smile was almost audible.

"You're a goober."

"You're going to be a dead goober." Trestin added.

"If you die, die with honor, Guardian!" Yara's tone struck a chord in his heart, and Sadhij quickened his pace.

He locked eyes with a Guardian down-lane and charged, Shotgun in hand, whipping a lightning grenade toward Pillar to cover his side. Sadhij heard the distinctive revving of a fusion weapon building power and leapt into the air.

"I hope you're watching…"

Sadhij felt the current surge through him and arc through the air, connecting him to his target. As his opponent's Fusion Rifle let loose, Sadhij surrendered himself to the Light. His muscles convulsed as droves of Arc energy pulsed through his nervous system and overtook him. He was a bolt, screaming across the Burning Shrine and painting the arena in the glow of static glory.

A saintly voice confirmed his strike. A smile split across his face. A rifle fired in the distance. A grounded thud heard by none.

3659414143.flavor: A volley of solutions to any disruption.
3659414143.lore:
I crouch, my knees in the dirt. My world has become pain, heat, erratic movement, ugly noise. I shield my eyes from the shrapnel, press my ear to my shoulder to quiet the baying of my foes. 

There is too much—it is all too much. My shaking fingers fumble for an arrow. I nock one, trailing blue, and close myself off from the world.

I take a sharp breath and stand. 

If the bullets hit me, I do not feel them. I pull the drawstring until it is taut across my body, and, for a moment…

I create peace. 

My fingers, my arm, the limbs of the bow, the string—all locked in unity. Equal parts forming a perfect whole. 

Stillness. 

The illusion shatters as I release.

My fingers fly open. My arm shudders. The bow limbs flex wildly, the string twangs, the arrows fly. Everything in motion, surging with chaotic momentum.

And on the battlefield, there is only stillness—beautiful, tranquil stillness—where my enemies once stood.
3659414143.lore_zh:
我蹲伏着，双膝埋进土里。我的世界充斥着痛苦、燥热、飘忽不定的移动、刺耳的噪音。我掩住眼睛，不让它被弹片击中，用肩膀抵住耳朵，让敌人的咆哮声安静下来。 

太多了，这一切都太难承受了。我颤抖的手指摸索着找箭。我把一支拖着蓝尾的箭搭在弦上，随后便让自己与世界隔绝。

我深吸一口气，站了起来。 

就算子弹击中我，我也感觉不到。我拉着弓弦，直到它在我身上绷得紧紧的，接着，有那么一瞬间...

我缔造了安宁。 

我的手指，我的手臂，弓臂，弓弦——全都统一地固定在一起，形成一个完美的整体。 

寂静。 

我松了手，幻象随之粉碎。

我的手指张开着。我的手臂在发抖。弓臂疯狂地弯曲，弦发出响声，箭飞了起来。一切都在运动，涌动着混乱的冲力。

而在战场上，我的敌人曾经站过的地方，唯有寂静——美妙、安宁的寂静。

3118061004.lore:
NEOMUNA HISTORICAL ARCHIVE

ARTIFACT REF X0003; EXO-IND4b0082.log 090260163

TYPE: bridge audio recorder

PARTIES: M. Sundaresh [IC-3612], C. Esi [IC-3977], L. Tse [IC-6055], C. Sanchez [IC-5438], A. Murib (IC-xxxx)

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS…//

ESI: What was that?

MURIB: We got hit. Engine 7 is down.

SUNDARESH: We can't take another one of those! This is a colony ship!

ESI: Hard aport. Put Hyperion between us and that—

MURIB: Sir, the r—

ESI: And flood the EM spectrum with—

MURIB: CHIOMA! The round—the one that hit us—it's moving!

ESI: What?

SYSTEM WARNING//STRUCTURAL IMPACT

SUNDARESH: He's right. I'm reading… arms and legs? It's attacking engine 6.

SANCHEZ: I'll scramble a squad of Cloud Walkers. They can suit up and—

MURIB: The maneuvers I'm pulling'll fling them into space, even with mag boots.

TSE: Bringing point-defense cannons about. 

ESI: It's only three meters across. Sure you can hit that without peeling us open?

SYSTEM WARNING//STRUCTURAL IMPACT

TSE: Kinda have to, Cap'n. Firing.

MURIB: Buset! That thing just took a fifteen-millimeter burst to the chest!

ESI: Again.

TSE: Firing. It's clear!

MURIB: Mostly. Looks like it left a… is that a spear through our bulkhead?

SUNDARESH: Not sure. It's some kind of exotic matter, spitting all my sensor pings back at me, amplified, like a…

ESI: We can figure it out later, dear. Sanchez, how's the ECM?

SANCHEZ: Not great. Whatever they're using to coordinate, it's not electromagnetic. Getting something weird, though.

MURIB: Weirder than the three-meter hitchhiker knocking on the hull?

SANCHEZ: Maybe. You remember those Vex signals you discovered?

SUNDARESH: On occasion, Carlo.

SANCHEZ: There's a big one! Recurring. Coming from the outer system. Think it's a distress signal.

ESI: Ignore it and get me—

SUNDARESH: No! Bring us back around into the moon's shadow!

ESI: Maya!

SUNDARESH: We need to break line of sight. I can feed that Vex signal into that thing skewering us—use it like an amplifier. It might trick these attackers into thinking we're a Vex ship.

MURIB: It's a tightbeam transmission. We'll have to ride it back to the source to keep that up. You sure you want to meet whatever makes a Vex cry for help?

ESI: Enemy of my enemy, Arief. We might just find a safe port in this storm.
3118061004.lore_zh:
内欧姆那历史档案

神器REF X0003；EXO-IND4b0082.记录 090260163

类型：桥式音频录音机

参与方：M. 桑戴尔什[IC-3612]，C. 艾西[IC-3977]，L.谢[IC-6055]，C. 桑切斯[IC-5438]，A. 穆里布(IC-xxxx)

//转录如下…//

艾西：什么情况？

穆里布：我们被击中了。7号引擎已损坏。

桑戴尔什：我们可不能再挨一下了！这是一艘移民飞船！

艾西：左满舵。朝着许珀里翁进发然后——

穆里布：长官，那发——

艾西：然后电磁频谱上满——

穆里布：希欧玛！那发弹药——击中我们的那发——它在移动！

艾西：什么？

系统警告//结构撞击

桑戴尔什：他说得对。我正在读取…居然有四肢？它正在攻击6号引擎。

桑切斯：我去召集一队云端行者。他们可以带上装备——

穆里布：就算他们穿着磁力靴，我进行的飞行动作也会把他们都甩到太空里去。

谢：调用点防御大炮。 

艾西：它只有三米宽。你确定你能在不把我们撕成碎片的情况下击中它？

系统警告//结构撞击

谢：看来必须这样了，船长。开火。

穆里布：正中靶心！那东西刚被十五毫米的点射击中胸口！

艾西：再来。

谢：开火。除掉它了！

穆里布：大部分吧。看来它留下了…刺穿我们舱壁的是一支矛吗？

桑戴尔什：不太确定。它是某种异域物质，把我所有的传感器信号都吐还回来，进行了增幅，就像…

艾西：这个我们以后再研究，亲爱的。桑切斯，电子反制怎么样了？

桑切斯：不太好。不管他们是用什么东西来协调，反正都不是电磁。不过，发现了一些奇怪的东西。

穆里布：比三米宽的搭车人敲打船身还奇怪？

桑切斯：有可能。还记得你发现的那些Vex信号吗？

桑戴尔什：时不时吧，卡洛。

桑切斯：这有个大的！反复出现。来自外部星系。我想这是一个求救信号。

艾西：别管它，带我——

桑戴尔什：不！带我们回到月球阴影里！

艾西：玛雅！

桑戴尔什：我们得躲开敌人的视线。我可以把那个Vex信号输入那个刺穿我们的东西——把它当成增幅器。这也许能骗过那些攻击者，让他们以为我们是Vex飞船。

穆里布：这是个紧束式信号。我们必须沿着它回到源头。你确定要去见让Vex大声求救的东西？

艾西：敌人的敌人是朋友，阿利夫。我们也许能在这场风暴中找到个安全港。

449318888.name: Deterministic Chaos
449318888.flavor: "So all being is a one and only being; and that it continues to be when someone dies, tells you, that he did not cease to be." —Schrodinger's epitaph
449318888.source_zh: 来源：“遗留之物”异域任务
449318888.lore:
He is fleeing the Vex across a verdant cliff He is standing guard on the CloudArk-Nexus border on Tramontane's orders He is sitting next to Nimbus on the watchtower ledge He is

[In the Garden, of the Garden: both descriptions are approximately correct but technically inaccurate, in the same way you can say Schrodinger's cat is at once dead and alive. You and I are both and neither, in and of, extinct and perpetual. So, there isn't much point in] 

trying to find a way out of this daedal maze He is trying to make sense of what he's looking at He is trying to place the familiar voice echoing across the network 

[wondering what might have been if we had stayed in our familiar prism-prison or kept tightrope-walking across the quantum wilds. Instead, ask yourself]

"Would you like to dance?"

[is disincorporated immortality really so bad compared to the others' ends? Would you have preferred an attack by vitreous helicoprion or stumbling over the edge of unreality? Imagine]

His foot crosses the quantum threshold before he's aware of it His grip slackens and his gun falls into a bed of red flowers His stomach churns with fear regret sudden doubt as to what

[if we didn't have each other; at least we're not cut off, like the Sol Divisive are from the rest of the Vex. Nor are we beholden to another's purpose. They chose that lonelier path all for a chance to create not simulate, not remake in their image—something truly paracausal.]

he is witnessing: the birth of a god a false idol a reproduction that is both like the Veil and not at all built up by the same Vex who bowed down to it

[Well, they tried to anyway. Either the blueprint was imperfect or the task impossible or both or neither, but their efforts fell short, so now they're stuck waiting for a resurrection]

He is racing for the door that is at once opening and closing He is coming around to the city council's decision to ignore the unknown threat He is reaching for an answer to Nimbus's question 

[they know will never come.]

"Do you think you'll have any regrets?"

[I could be wrong. Is it possible the Black Heart will beat again?]

He stares into the white-hot glow of a conflux, speculating on the secrets that lie within He squints down the barrel of his gun at a row of glowing red eyes advancing on his city He looks away from Nimbus's keen curious expression to reckon with his uncertain certainty before he says 

[Of course. The same as everything else, everything that has been and is and will be. And what will become of us then?]

"I don't know."
449318888.lore_zh:
他正穿过翠绿的悬崖逃离Vex，他正奉特拉蒙特之命，站着守卫云端方舟-纳克斯枢纽边界，他正坐在宁博思身边的瞭望塔窗台上，他

[身处花园，身属花园：两种描述大抵上都正确，但严格地讲并不够准确，就像你可以说薛定谔的猫既是死的又是活的。你和我本质上，都是，也都不是，消亡和永恒的。所以，也没有什么意义去] 

试图逃出这一错综复杂的迷宫。他正试图弄懂他所看到的东西，他正试图认出在网络中回响的熟悉声音 

[好奇着如果我们呆在熟悉的棱镜囚狱里，或者继续在量子的荒野中钢丝行走，会发生什么。倒不如，问问自己]

“你想跳支舞吗？”

[与其他人的结局相比，解体的不朽真有那么糟糕吗？你会喜欢遭到玻璃旋齿鲨的袭击，还是在非现实的悬崖边缘跌撞前行？想象一下]

他还没意识到，他的脚就跨过了量子门槛。他的手松开了，他的枪掉在了一床红花上。他的胃翻腾着恐惧、悔恨与突如其来的疑虑，只因他

[要是我们没有了彼此会怎样；至少我们没有像太阳系分支那样与其余的Vex隔绝开来。我们也不受制于他人的目的。他们选择了这条更孤独的道路，都是为了有机会去创造——不是模拟，也不是按照他们的形象重塑——一些真正的超因果关系。]

正在见证的：一个虚假偶像，伪神的诞生，这个复制品既像面纱，又完全不像，由向它俯首称臣的同一个Vex塑造而成。

[不管怎样，他们尽力了。要么是蓝图不完美，要么是任务不可能完成，或者两者皆是，抑或都不是，但他们的努力白费了，所以他们现在只能等待着死而复生]

他正向那扇同时打开和关闭的门跑去，他正转而接受城市议会的无视未知威胁的决定，他正在寻找宁博思问题的答案 

[他们知道永远不会有答案。]

“你觉得你会后悔吗？”

[或许是我错了。黑暗之心有可能再次跳动吗？]

他凝视着汇流炽热的光芒，揣摩着隐藏在其中的秘密。他斜睨着枪管，看着一排朝着他的城市前进的发光红眼。他避开了宁博思敏锐而又好奇的表情，然后说 

[“当然”之前先思忖他不确定的确定性。和其他所有事情一样，所有曾经是，现在是，将来也会是的事情。那我们到时又会怎么样呢？]

“我不知道。”

3371017761.name: Conditional Finality
3371017761.flavor: You will dream of me… I will never leave you…
3371017761.lore:
The sound that escaped me resembled a roar.

A psychic echo.

It soared through the air and pierced every corner of my ship.

Anger coursed through me as I toppled the ground in a heap.

I wheezed with each breath and clutched at my chest.

I watched that witch saunter out…

Like she'd won.

My ship rumbled as she wrested her primordial prize from it.

I felt hatred—

Deep, unchallenged hatred.

My claws punctured the floor, etched new patterns into it. 

I dragged myself forward. 

Whispers danced around me, trillions of voices melded together in my favorite symphony.

I had always welcomed death, and this time would be no different.

An agonizing sensation shot through me. 

It was as if an arrow had bored its way through my chest.

It burned, and I collapsed among the rubble. 

A green hue enveloped me.

I was unfamiliar with this—her magic festering within me. Shackling me.

My body twisted.

My breaths grew thin.

My limbs became heavy. 

Torturous.

No… she could not hold me. I would not allow it.

This would not be my end.

"My Witness," I whispered as the void I once commanded claimed me.
3371017761.lore_zh:
我发出的那声音就像是咆哮一样。

心灵的回声。

它在空中飞翔，穿透了我飞船的每一个角落。

我把地面掀翻成一堆，愤怒贯穿了我的全身。

我大喘着每一口气，攥紧了胸口。

我看着那个女巫大摇大摆地离开…

就像她赢了一样。

她从我的飞船上夺走她的原始战利品时，它发出了轰鸣声。

我感到了仇恨——

深重无比，无可辩驳的仇恨。

我的爪子刺破了地板，在上面蚀刻了新的图案。 

我拖着身子向前。 

低语声在我四周此起彼伏，数万亿个声音在我最喜欢的交响乐中融为一体。

我一向欢迎死亡，这一次也不例外。

一种痛苦的感觉击穿了我。 

就像是一支箭穿过了我的胸膛。

那感觉灼热难耐，我瘫倒在瓦砾中。 

一片绿色笼罩着我。

我对此并不熟悉——她的魔力在我体内郁积。桎梏着我。

我的身体扭曲了。

我的呼吸变得稀薄。

我的四肢变得沉重。 

痛苦无比。

不…她不能控制我。我不会允许的。

这不是我的终点。

“我的见证者，”我低声说道，屈服于曾被我统御的虚空。

3121540812.name: Final Warning
3121540812.flavor: The flit of tiny wings; the pull of a trigger.
3121540812.source_zh: 来源：“最后的缚丝”异域任务
3121540812.lore:
My Esteemed Colleagues,

While enjoying my afternoon cup of Psamathe Silver Tip (a gift from Dr. Dewan after his sabbatical—thank you again, dear friend) and ruminating on our planet's orbital corrections and the orbital corrections we ourselves make throughout our own lives, a completely unrelated revelation came to me. 

I realized, often in times of rest, how my mind wanders its own furthermost reaches, and how the answers to my most vexing questions present themselves at that time with absolutely no fanfare. (This phenomenon is worth studying in its own right by people much smarter than I, but I digress.) My most recent revelation comes in regard to our current pursuits with Atmospheric Spectrometer #003a, a.k.a. Final Warning, as I have heard it being called around the lab. 

The odd capabilities this "Final Warning" harbors have long been suspected by Dr. Sundaresh to be a byproduct of the Veil, replicating energy signatures we most often observe in fluid dynamics. With that in mind, I propose we begin testing the ability to engage that energy using both the Magnus and gyroscopic effects. We attempt to create a "paracausal skipping stone," if you will. 

How we accomplish this remains to be seen, but I encourage you to not spend the next few days thinking about it, as we will discuss it at the next staff meeting. 

Enjoy your weekends,

Dr. Esi
3121540812.lore_zh:
尊敬的各位同事，

我在享受海卫十的银针下午茶（德万博士休假后送的礼物——再次感谢你，亲爱的朋友），沉思着我们的星球轨道修正和我们自己在一生中所做的轨道修正时，一个完全无关的启示出现在了我的脑海中。 

我经常意识到在休息的时候，我的思维如何游荡到最远处，我最烦恼的问题的答案会在那时如何毫无声息地呈现出来。（这种现象本身就值得比我聪明得多的人去研究，但我有点跑题了。）我最近的启示是关于我们目前对#003a大气光谱仪的研究，我在实验室听到它被称为最终警告。 

桑戴尔什博士长期以来一直怀疑这个“最终警告”所具有的奇怪能力是面纱的副产品，能够复制我们在流体动力学中最常观察到的能量特征。考虑到这一点，我建议我们开始测试同时使用马格努斯效应和陀螺仪效应与那种能量相结合的能力。你们可以理解为我们在尝试打造一种“超因果水漂石”。 

我们如何实现这一目标尚未确定，但是我建议你们不要在接下来的几天里费心考虑这个问题，我们将在下次员工会议上进行讨论。 

祝你们周末愉快，

艾西博士

996109059.name: Nameless Midnight
996109059.flavor: Strange things wake at the stroke of twelve.
996109059.source: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
996109059.source_zh: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。
996109059.lore:
"This is incredible work. I've barely had to make any adjustments." The Warlock flexes her gloved fingers, staring intently at her hand. 

Standing silently by the Loom, Namrask wonders what it is the Machine-spawn sees. He wonders if he is making another mistake. 

The Humans are on the cusp of a second Whirlwind. It may be that the Guardians he armors today are only tomorrow's Ketchkillers. Light-starved, desperate… powerful.
Will it be Namrask's turn to be abandoned alongside the hatchlings, the sick, and the frail?

Beside him, Ada-1 nods placidly at the Guardian. "An interesting commission." 

The Warlock grins at Ada, baring her blunt teeth. "Couple of heat sinks in here and I can rig up a stealth generator. Nothing fancy, but it'll be easier to keep the civvies safe if I can get in close without the Legion spotting me." 

Namrask stares and does not realize it until the Guardian looks up at him. Anxiety locks his breath in his chest. 

"Hey, uh, what's that word, again?" The Warlock seems uncomfortable. It takes a moment for him to realize she is embarrassed. "Velask?" 

He nods, mutely. 

"Couple of Eliksni on the last run. They seemed a little rattled, and I thought… you know, maybe if I say—" 

"You will… bring them back?"
 
"Of course." The Warlock nods at Ada-1, at Namrask. "Thanks again."

"Wait," Namrask says. He turns and moves toward the materials stored in orderly piles by his workstation. Digs through a month's worth of excess fabric and small woven experiments. Clothing, not armor. Cloaks and shawls. For Eliksni, for Humans.

He presses these into the Warlock's hands. 
"For… those you find."
996109059.lore_zh:
“技艺真是精湛。我几乎不需要做任何调整。”术士凝视着她的手，活动了一下戴着手套的手指。 

拿姆拉斯克静静地站在纺织机旁，好奇机械种看到了什么。他不知自己是否又犯了一个错误。 

人类正处于第二次旋风的风口浪尖。也许他今天提供护甲的守护者不过是明天的双桅船杀手。渴求着光能，绝望而…强大。
该轮到拿姆拉斯克被遗弃在老弱病残的身旁了吗？

在他身边，艾达-1平静地向守护者点点头。“真有趣。” 

术士对艾达咧嘴一笑，露出了她钝钝的牙齿。“这里有几块散热片，我可以组装一个隐形生成器。没什么特别的，但要是我能在不被军团发现的情况下靠近，保护平民安全就更容易了。” 

拿姆拉斯克凝视着，直到守护者抬头看向他，才意识到了这一点。焦虑让他喘不过气来。 

“嘿，呃，那个词是什么来着？”术士似乎不太自在。过了一会儿，他才意识到她很尴尬。“维拉斯克？” 

他默默地点了点头。 

“上一趟遇到了几个埃里克斯尼族。他们好像有点惊慌，我想…你懂的，也许我说——” 

“你愿意…把他们带回来吗？”
 
“当然。”术士对着艾达-1和拿姆拉斯克点点头。“再次感谢。”

“等等，”拿姆拉斯克说道。他转过身，走向他的工作台旁边整齐堆放的材料。在一堆能用上一个月的多余面料和小试验织品里翻找。衣服，不是护甲。披风和披肩。是给埃里克斯尼族和人类的。

他把这些东西塞到术士的手里。 
“你找到后…就给他们。”

“当然。”术士对着艾达-1和拿姆拉斯克点点头。“再次感谢。”

“等等，”拿姆拉斯克说道。他转过身，走向他的工作台旁边整齐堆放的材料。在一堆能用上一个月的多余面料和小试验织品里翻找。衣服，不是护甲。披风和披肩。是给埃里克斯尼族和人类的。

他把这些东西塞到术士的手里。 
“你找到后…就给他们。”

3727588804.description:
Weapon-focused tiered rewards.

Weapons decode up to Tier 4 based on your Power.
3727588804.description_zh:
围绕武器的分级奖励。

根据你的能量等级，可解码最高4阶武器。

3218214121.name: Trials of Osiris
3218214121.description:
• Purchase a Trials Passage to start competing in Trials of Osiris and track rounds or matches won.

• Complete Trials rounds and matches to earn Trials Ranks based on the number of round wins on your ticket and in the current match.

• Complete a Lighthouse Passage to open the Lighthouse and get a piece of Trials armor, plus a chance at the weekly Adept Trials weapon and unique cosmetic items.

• Complete Ranks to earn Trials Engrams.

• Trials armor always drops with high-stat packages, as well as glows if you have gone flawless.
3218214121.description_zh:
• 购买试炼入场券来开始参加奥斯里斯试炼并追踪取胜的回合或比赛。

• 完成试炼回合与比赛以获得试炼等级。该等级取决于入场券上的胜利数和当前比赛中的胜利数。

• 完成灯塔入场券来开启灯塔并获得一件试炼护甲，并有几率获得每周专家试炼武器以及独特装饰物品。

• 完成试炼等级以获得试炼记忆水晶。

• 试炼护甲总是掉落高属性版本，若是无瑕完成，还会带炫彩。

2530045086.name: Focused Decoding
2530045086.description: Rahool offers three levels of decryption: Daily, allowing random focusing across a specific gear slot, Advanced, allowing focusing of previously earned gear from a given expansion, Precision, allowing for focusing specific pieces of previously acquired gear, and Novel, allowing focusing of gear you have not yet acquired.
2530045086.description_zh: 拉乎尔提供三个等级的解码：每日，允许针对特定装备插槽进行随机聚焦；高级，允许聚焦来自特定扩展的已获取装备；精准，允许聚焦特定的已获取装备；以及新奇，允许聚焦尚未获取的装备。

1035468760.name: Focused Decoding
1035468760.description:
Gather Fated Ciphers and materials to focus into Kepler gear.

Fated Ciphers are earned from many activities on Kepler. The Sieve and Time Latch missions playlist are the best sources of Fated Ciphers.

Focusing requires materials from the current daily region.

Each day, a limited number of direct-purchase items are available, using Quantum Substances.
1035468760.description_zh:
收集宿命暗码和其它材料来聚焦开普勒装备。

宿命暗码可在开普勒的多种活动获得，其中滤网和时间锁扣任务游戏列表是获得宿命暗码的最佳途径。

聚焦需要当前每日地区收集的材料。

每天可使用量子物质直接购买限定数量的物品。

3472233982.name: Focused Decoding
3472233982.description:
Gather Fated Ciphers and materials to focus into Kepler gear.

Fated Ciphers are earned from many activities on Kepler. The Sieve and Time Latch missions playlist are the best sources of Fated Ciphers.

Focusing requires materials from the current daily region.

Each day, a limited number of direct-purchase items are available, using Quantum Substances.

479917491.flavor: "Perun and Gheleon are so serious. Never yet seen a target I couldn't hit. What've I to worry about? " —Efrideet, before the Ironsbane

1496224967.name: Iron Truage Casque
1496224967.flavor: When the Last City was just a patchwork of campfires, the Iron Lords stood guard.

1526005320.name: Iron Truage Boots
1526005320.flavor: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.

4224076198.name: Frumious Grips
4224076198.flavor: It makes perfect sense to you. And that's all that matters.

385045066.name: Frumious Vest
385045066.flavor: When have you ever known Hunters to do as they were told?

555828571.name: Frumious Cloak
555828571.lore:
"I used to ride the Light all around the system, doing my best to stay busy and stay away. Well I can tell you, contrary to popular opinion—and from personal experience—shacking up in the City's got its perks. And without the others looking out for us, we'd be running around tinkering with pea shooters and trying to fly those clunkers from the Cosmodrome, looking like a bunch a' dummies. 

"Look— the City needs you; you need it. I mean, have you seen the goods they're peddling these days? The ships Holliday's been putting up in the air? They got your back here.

"I'm hungry. Let's get some ramen." 

—Cayde-6
555828571.lore_zh:
“我曾经在整个太阳系中驾驭光能，尽全力保持繁忙和远离那里。我可以告诉你，虽然违背主流观点——但从个人经验来看——圣城的居住量已经达到顶峰。没有人寻找我们，我们就带着豌豆射手四处转转，修修补补，希望能让那些老机器飞出发射基地。看起来是群蠢蛋吧。

”听着——圣城需要你们，你们也需要它。我是说，你看到他们这些天叫卖的货物了吗？那些天上飘着的霍利迪的飞船？它们都是你回来的原因。”

“我好饿，要不要吃面？”

——凯德6号

3741528736.name: Frumious Strides
3741528736.flavor: Mostly the hero—but with a healthy dash of the monster, too. That's what it means to be a Hunter.

1960303677.name: Grips of the Ace-Defiant
1960303677.flavor: “The Sindu fly like surgeons operate. And the Ace-Defiants are the best among them. Only one Shadowed me.” —Emperor Calus
1960303677.lore:
With a flourish, Emperor Calus lifted a hand. "My Star, a gift for you." The theater had begun. 

The hangar door opened slowly, and behind it a row of purple banners dropped, one after another. As each banner snapped into place, a Psion fell to hands and knees, head bowed low. 

Jarus's shoulder disappeared in the emperor's hand. "Come, let us open your gift." The two walked past the kneeling warriors. "I have named it for you," Calus crooned. "I call it God's Will." 

Jarus's chest fluttered. The ship was beautiful. A drum sounded. A Cabal emerged, delicately carrying armor, holding it as if it would break. Piece by piece it was placed on the floor in front of Jarus. 

The weight on his shoulder lifted. "This is yours. When you take it, you are mine." Calus left. His procession followed. Only God's Will and Jarus remained.
1960303677.lore_zh:
卡鲁斯大帝夸张地抬起一只手。“我的明星，这是你的礼物。”戏剧开始。

机库门缓缓打开，门后一排紫色战旗接二连三地落下。每一面旗帜插到地面的瞬间，都有一名辅助士兵应声下跪朝拜。

大帝的手搭在了贾鲁斯的肩膀上。“来吧，打开你的礼物吧。”两人穿过下跪的武士。“我帮你为它起了个名字，”卡鲁斯低声说。“我叫它神的意志。”

贾鲁斯的呼吸变得急促起来。这架飞船漂亮极了。鼓声响起。一个卡巴尔走了出来，小心翼翼地捧着一套护甲，仿佛它是如此的脆弱。护甲一件件地被摆到了贾鲁斯面前的地板上。

他肩膀上的手抬了起来。“这些都是你的了。收下它们，你就是我的了。”卡鲁斯转身离开。他的仪仗队紧随其后。只留下贾鲁斯和神的意志。

1960303676.name: Gloves of the Emperor's Agent
1960303676.flavor: You left me with nothing, but now I have everything.
1960303676.lore:
When you left me on the Leviathan, you left me with nothing. I hope you understand things are different now. I've been tested, and I have emerged from the other side. 

You always spoke of how adversity shaped the person you are, how it made you stronger. I see the truth of that now in a way that before I never could. I want you to see what I have learned. I want you to see what adversity has allowed me to become.
1960303676.lore_zh:
当你将我留在利维坦上时，你没有给我留下任何东西。我希望你明白如今已时过境迁。我经受住了考验，我已超出生死界限。

你总是说着逆境如何塑造了你，如何使你变得更强。我现在能以从未有过的角度理解了其中的道理。我想让你知道我学到了什么。我想让你看到逆境如何锻造了我。

407863747.name: Vest of the Ace-Defiant
407863747.flavor: “The Ace-Defiant burned his mind to fly my golden ship. Being a Loyalist costs you. Being a Shadow costs dearly.” —Emperor Calus
407863747.lore:
Shayotet's ship lay smashed and burning on the ground. A few meters away, Shayotet himself crawled from a pod. Jarus jumped lightly from his own ship, sent it rocketing back into low orbit with a tap to his nav-gauntlet. God's Will had done its part. Now Jarus must finish him. 

Jarus raised a pistol, another of Calus's gifts, and emptied its clip. Shayotet heaved and jerked as black pressure gel spouted from his armor, but he did not fall. He roared—blood and saliva spattered the ground—and charged. Jarus holstered the pistols. 

He waited until Shayotet was nearly on top of him before activating the energy blade. A gargling roar, a spray of pressure gel, and it was over. 

Jarus' fingers trembled as he summoned God's Will again. In the cockpit, Calus' face appeared. "My heart swells with pride. This drink is in your honor."
407863747.lore_zh:
薛欧特的飞船被撞得稀巴烂，在地面燃烧着。不远处，薛欧特从救生舱里爬了出来。贾鲁斯从自己的飞船里轻巧地跳了出来，按下导航臂铠上的按钮，飞船腾空而起又飞回了低空轨道。‘神的意志'已经完成了任务。现在贾鲁斯也必须完成他的使命。

贾鲁斯举起手枪，这是卡鲁斯大帝送给他的另一件礼物，然后他卸掉了弹匣。薛欧特上气不接下气地站了起来，护甲中不断有黑色的压力胶喷出，但他没有倒下。他长啸一声——鲜血和口水喷了一地——然后猛地向前冲了过去。贾鲁斯把手枪收回枪套。

他等到薛欧特在他面前跳起的一刻才激活了能量利刃。随着一声咕哝，压力胶喷溅得满地都是，就这么结束了。

贾鲁斯重新召唤‘神的意志'时手还在颤抖着。刚进入驾驶舱，卡鲁斯的脸就出现在了屏幕上。“我的心充满了自豪。为你的荣耀干杯。”

407863746.name: Vest of the Emperor's Agent
407863746.flavor: You don't realize that I'm all around you.
407863746.lore:
I know that you have gone to the Sol system. I'm writing because I will be there soon as well. Perhaps a reunion is in order? 

My agents have left ahead of me to prepare for my arrival.  I like to establish good relationships with the locals. I know it may surprise you, but one of the ways in which I have grown is my attitude towards the lesser species. I've come to believe that there is a place for all creatures in my empire. The end will be so much more interesting if we face it together.
407863746.lore_zh:
我知道你去太阳系了。我现在给你写信，因为我马上也会过去的。也许该按规矩办个聚会？

为了迎接我的到来，我的密探先我一步离开了。我喜欢和当地人建立良好的关系。我知道这也许会让你很惊讶，但我养成的品性之一便是善待少数物种。我开始相信，在我的帝国中，所有物种都能够找到其安身之所。如果我们能共同面对末日，那一定会很有趣。

3984534842.name: Shadow's Cloak
3984534842.flavor: “With the death of the Ace-Defiant, the Leviathan is without a master helmsman. If I must wait another millennium for a replacement, I shall.” —Emperor Calus
3984534842.lore:
Jarus left God's Will behind for his final mission. He needed a ship big enough to carry his fellow Shadows to Ghaul, and with enough internal shielding and anti-impact padding to ensure the plan they had developed would succeed. 

Under Jarus's control, the ship dodged, weaved, and carved a path through the Red Legion. His fingers flipped switches, rapidly changing the displays on the monitors surrounding the cockpit. In the hold, the Shadows waited. Jarus aligned the ship's trajectory toward the Dominus' ship. The plan was simple. 

"My dear Jarus," the emperor had said. "We must deliver the Shadows to the Dominus at any cost." Jarus knew what this meant. For him, the trip was one-way. But that was all right, so long as Ghaul's was, too.
3984534842.lore_zh:
贾鲁斯没有用‘神的意志'来参加最后的任务。他需要一艘足够大的船来带着他的暗影部下去找盖欧，还要有足够的内部护盾和抗撞击护垫来确保他的计划能够成功。

在贾鲁斯的控制下，飞船不断闪避，摇摇晃晃地在猩红军团中杀出一条血路。他不断拨动开关，快速变更着驾驶舱里四面八方显示器上的内容。而在机舱里，暗影耐心地等待着。贾鲁斯将飞船的目标指向了尊主的舰船。计划很简单。

“亲爱的贾鲁斯，”大帝说道。“我们必须不惜一切代价将暗影带到尊主那里。”贾鲁斯知道这是什么意思。对于他来说，这是条不归路。但没有关系，只要有盖欧的陪伴就够了。

3984534843.name: Cloak of the Emperor's Agent
3984534843.flavor: My gift to the Hunter with Ghaul's cunning.
3984534843.lore:
Ghaul was a masterful conspirator. He spent his whole life dedicated to a higher purpose. Few survive the gladiator pits. Even fewer rise to the rank of Primus. It is remarkable that a discarded runt managed to do both, all the while living a double life. 

It was only at the very end that I even began to suspect him. He possessed an absolute, single-minded dedication to his life of deceit. I see the same cunning in you, my dear Hunter.
3984534843.lore_zh:
盖欧曾是一个老练的阴谋家。他穷极一生为了达成更高的目标。鲜有人能在角斗场中活下来，晋升军团长的人更是少之又少。然而值得称道的是，一个被遗弃的弱者做到了两者，并且一直过着这种双重人生。

甚至到最后关头，我才开始怀疑他。他坚定不移地演绎着自己的狡黠人生。我亲爱的猎人，我在你身上也看到了同样的狡黠。

2013109092.name: Helm of the Ace-Defiant
2013109092.flavor: “The Sindu inhabited gas giants in the spinward marches. They refused my invitation at first. As with all things, they came to see things my way.” —Emperor Calus
2013109092.lore:
When his eyes finally opened, Jarus was staring at a fuzzy silhouette of something giant. The giant spoke. "Welcome home," it rumbled. Jarus blinked rapidly. The room began to come into focus, shining like a temple. The giant spoke again.  

"My child, there is nothing to fear. I have rescued you. Welcome to my empire." The feeling returned to Jarus' limbs. He was restrained. And this creature now towered over him. He was staring into the face of death. "Fear not, my warrior-to-be."  

Jarus blinked slowly. What about the other pilots? His battalion? Did they escape?  

"You, the last star-pilot of the Sindû, will be my Ace-Defiant." 

It was not a choice.
2013109092.lore_zh:
当贾鲁斯终于睁开眼睛，眼前是一个巨人的模糊身影。巨人突然开了口。“欢迎回家，”它用低沉的声音说道。贾鲁斯很快地眨了眨眼睛。他逐渐看清了房间中的一切，闪耀的像一座神庙。巨人又开口了。

“我的孩子，你不需要恐惧。是我救了你。欢迎来到我的帝国。”贾鲁斯的四肢终于恢复了知觉。他被束缚住了。这个生物高高在上，他似乎看到了死神的面容。“不用害怕，未来的战士。”

贾鲁斯缓慢地眨了眨眼睛。其他飞行员呢？他的部队呢？他们逃走了吗？

“你，信德的最后一个星级飞行员，将成为我的王牌猎手。”

他别无选择。

2013109093.name: Mask of the Emperor's Agent
2013109093.lore:
I often think of what it would be like to see you again—how you might look and what you might say. I imagine different scenarios where you walk around a corner and there I am, magnificent and in control. I don't see you at first, and you hesitate. Is this a confrontation you want to have? 

Of course, your curiosity gets the better of you. Our eyes meet. Neither of us say anything, because we both know what's at stake. This could be the end of an empire.
2013109093.lore_zh:
我常常想着再次见到你时会是什么样——你会是什么样，你会说些什么。我想象了无数你走过转角，遇见位高权重的我时的情景。我并没有看到你，而你也犹豫不敢上前……这是你期待的见面方式吗？

当然，你的好奇心占了上风。眼神相会，却无言。因为我们都知道现在是生死存亡的关头，这可能是帝国的末日。

30962015.name: Boots of the Ace-Defiant
30962015.flavor: “We armed the Sindu with a fleet of golden ships. Their interceptors are a shield for the Leviathan, as the Shadows are my sword.” —Emperor Calus
30962015.lore:
"Jarus, you simply are wrong." 
"We will agree to disagree, my lord." 
"Your palate simply lacks the sophistication to detect the notes in your world's drink!" 
"I am Sindû. It was crafted for my palate, my lord." 
"But you simply do not taste all of this. It's impossible." 
"I do not currently taste anything, my lord." 
"Well, we must fix that." 

In the silence of space, a nearby explosion rocked God's Will. Jarus narrowed his eyes. "My lord, I have an issue to tend to." 

"I shall save your drink for you." The cockpit monitor flickered from Calus's face to a radar.  Small red triangles blinked onscreen as an alarm took up its shrill cry. Jarus pulled a visor down in front of him and fired the ship's thrusters.
30962015.lore_zh:
“贾鲁斯，你就是单纯的错了。”
“我们各自保留意见吧，主人”
“你缺乏品尝世界中美酒的精妙味觉！”
“我是信德。它就是为了我的味觉而造的，主人。”
“但你都还没有尝遍这些。这不可能。”
“我现在什么都尝不出来，主人。”
“如果是这样的话，我们必须治好这一点。”

在太空无尽的寂静之中，附近的一场爆炸使‘神的意志'震荡不已。贾鲁斯眯起了眼睛。“主人，我有件事需要处理。”

“我会把你的酒留给你的。”卡鲁斯的脸从驾驶舱的显示器上消失，转变成雷达画面。细小的红色三角形在屏幕上闪烁，刺耳的警报声不断传来。贾鲁斯拉下面甲，发动了飞船推进器。

30962014.name: Boots of the Emperor's Agent
30962014.flavor: You're a difficult one to find.
30962014.lore:
You've gone to great lengths to hide your movements. I know, because I've been tracking you, not out of any kind of obsession; I just need to know what you're doing. It might affect my plans. 

But I'm curious to know—are you hiding because of me? Is there some reason you don't want me to see you? I'm not upset about it, but you should know—I'm not hiding from you. If you want to understand what I'm doing, you need but look.
30962014.lore_zh:
你尽力掩饰自己的行动。我知道，因为我一直在追踪你。并不是出于任何迷恋，我只想知道你在干什么。这或许会影响到我的计划。

但我更想知道的是——你是在躲我吗？是不是有某种原因使你不希望我见到你？我并没有因此生气，但你需要知道的是——我没有躲着你。如果你想理解我正在做的一切，你需要亲自看一看。

1729074423.flavor: "Gensym Armor. Let's hope it does you more good than it did me." —Asher Mir

1085797441.name: Gensym Knight Cuirass
1085797441.flavor: "Have you ever considered that the Traveler might be just as chaotic and arbitrary as everything else?" —Asher Mir

1868302492.name: Gensym Knight Cloak
1868302492.flavor: "Remember, the universe is a chaotic system. This frippery won't protect you from the continuum." —Asher Mir
1868302492.lore:
Eris, 
I have scoured my library but found nothing on this "Nokris" of which you speak. I am sorry both for the delay and that I could not be of more help. Do you ever feel any affection for the creatures that changed you? I confess this weakness myself. In the shadow of the Pyramidion, I have sometimes felt a kind of craven admiration for the illimitable superior beings that suffuse my body. I can feel them move through my veins with purpose, magnetized to the intent of the Minds that have come to machinoform Echo Mesa. I have a sense of their desires. They have changed since I fell. And so, I am—if nothing else—a new variable in whatever grand equation compels them. 

My arm grows worse. This morning, I cut my finger and bled radiolaria. I will redouble my efforts. 

Truth in action, 
Asher Mir
1868302492.lore_zh:
埃里斯，
我已经翻遍了我的图书馆，但在你所说的那个“诺克里斯”影儿都没有。很抱歉回信儿晚了，而且我也帮不上忙。你有没有一点点的喜爱那些改变了你的生物？我承认自己有这个弱点。在金字塔的阴影下，我有时会对那些萦绕在我身边毫无生气的卓越优势存在心生艳羡。我可以感觉到它们有目的地在我的血管中移动，被厄科台地模块控制区的思维有意地磁化着。我能感觉到它们的目的。它们已经变了，我能感觉到。所以，我是——如果没有别的——它们这宏大的方程式中一个新的变量。

我的胳膊情况越来越糟了。今天早上，我切下了手指鲜血四溅。我会加倍努力的。

事实中的真理，
阿什·米尔

2715114534.name: Gensym Knight Casque
2715114534.flavor: "I have no use for mawkish sentimentality. What I do need is an assistant who stays alive. As often as possible." —Asher Mir

3537609113.name: Gensym Knight Strides
3537609113.flavor: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir

3907226374.name: Wildwood Grips
3907226374.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

2729740202.name: Wildwood Vest
2729740202.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

3366557883.name: Wildwood Cloak
3366557883.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
3366557883.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
3366557883.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

3973359167.name: Wildwood Mask
3973359167.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

3466255616.name: Wildwood Strides
3466255616.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

479417869.name: Lost Pacific Grips
479417869.flavor: "Send a deep-space probe toward the anomaly. I want to know what it is." —Dr. Shanice Pell

2380978355.name: Lost Pacific Vest
2380978355.flavor: "The probe's initial data makes no sense. And then the signal died. What have we found?" —Dr. Shanice Pell

291437034.name: Lost Pacific Cape
291437034.flavor: Sloane had these Golden Age space suits repurposed for Guardian armor.
291437034.lore:
From the Diaries of Dr. Shanice Pell 
Darling, the installation is nearly complete. Between Ishtar's endless audits and Clovis Bray's network protocols, I thought we would never make it. Secret the initial blueprints in hand-to-hand relays, recruit personnel brave enough to challenge the Traveler at its own game, secure mining rights in the Belt for materials… I remember when it was just a dream in our heads. At last, the freedom and silence to pierce interstellar space for our own answers! Tomorrow, I'm bringing the girls to see the navigation probe launch. They still ask about you from time to time. I just tell them, that's why we're out here, to find you.
291437034.lore_zh:
沙尼斯·佩尔博士的日志
亲爱的，安装就要完成了。在伊什塔不间断的审计和克洛维斯·布瑞网络数据协议之间，我想我们可能永远都成功不了。将手把手的秘密传递着这份初始蓝本，新人用自己的游戏方式勇敢地挑战旅行者，保护着贝尔特地区材料的采矿权..……我记得当时这只是我们头脑中的一个梦想。最后，自由和刺穿星际空间的沉默成为了我们的答案！明天，我会带姑娘们去看导航探测器发射。她们还一直在问你。我告诉她们，我们来到这里的原因，就是找到你。

1607012852.name: Lost Pacific Mask
1607012852.flavor: "I need more data. And… put the lab on yellow alert."  —Dr. Shanice Pell

1150216911.name: Lost Pacific Strides
1150216911.flavor: "This research has to get out. Even if I don't. People have to know what this 'anomaly' is." —Last Recording of Dr. Shanice Pell

2423003287.name: Exodus Down Grips
2423003287.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what the Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

2462524641.name: Exodus Down Vest
2462524641.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

3669590332.name: Exodus Down Cloak
3669590332.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
3669590332.lore:
Captain's Logbook. Ship, if we ever figure out the date, would you backfill it here? Thanks. 
We are stranded on an outbound Centaur. With every word I speak, we fall further from our sun. 7066 Nessus shouldn't be here, but there was no way to anticipate the way it pulled us in. Ship's guess is that our orbital momentum—what we'd call a four-vector, for the dimensions of space and time—was somehow folded away into six extra dimensions. Leaving us on a crash orbit towards Nessus… 

We have lost all sense of time. Past and future are like up and down, and we would walk them if we could, back to a place before Nessus, but we will always be on Nessus, too. I don't know. I don't know. They are trying to understand us. They must think like rivers. We are now receiving our own distress calls. I sound calmer than I feel.
3669590332.lore_zh:
船长日志。飞船，如果我们弄清楚日期，你能回填吗？谢谢。
我们被困于半人马座外轨。我每讲一个字，我们就离太阳更远一步。7066涅索斯不应该在这里，但我们也无法预见它将我们拖引过来的方法。飞船猜测是我们的轨道动量——我们在空间和时间维度上称之为四向量——以某种方式折叠成了六个额外的维度。将我们拖进了涅索斯的碰撞轨道……

我们已经失去了所有的时间感。过去和未来像方向一样，如果我们可以在时间上走动，或许我们可以回到涅索斯之前的地方，但我们也将永远留在涅索斯。我不知道，我不知道。他们在试图理解我们。他们必须像河流一样思考。我们现在收到了自己的遇险信号。我看起来比想象的要镇定一些。

3026265798.name: Exodus Down Mask
3026265798.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

3807183801.name: Exodus Down Strides
3807183801.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

3646674533.name: Icarus Drifter Grips
3646674533.flavor: "Bet I can get to 15-6-6 Icarus before you can!" —Tallu Fairwind

3066593211.name: Icarus Drifter Vest
3066593211.flavor: "You wouldn't believe the solar flare I caught the other day. Rode it halfway to Venus." —Blue Boaz

1847870034.name: Icarus Drifter Cape
1847870034.flavor:
"Don't forget who has the best Icarus–Daedalus time."

"You did it at closest approach! Doesn't count." "Does too!"

155832748.name: Icarus Drifter Mask
155832748.flavor: "That last flare burned my engines out. Holliday's mad at me." —Ariadne Gris

3569443559.name: Icarus Drifter Legs
3569443559.flavor: "Just remember, post-crash Ghost rez in a vacuum can be, ah… complicated. So try not to die."  —Shun Endo

1504041928.name: Airhead Hood
1504041928.flavor: "If you can hear yourself think, you're not flying fast enough." —Marcus Ren

124410141.name: Shadow Specter
124410141.flavor: Cling to this world, oh departed friend, that its wonders will never slip your grasp.

3035240099.name: Shadow Specter
3035240099.flavor: Haunt the paths yet tread, that your wake may guide those brave enough to follow.

2317046938.name: Shadow Specter
2317046938.flavor: Light as the breeze that carries the day.

177215556.name: Shadow Specter
177215556.flavor: Look now, with sullen eyes, to those long lost worlds no one has ever walked.

2065578431.name: Shadow Specter
2065578431.flavor: The other side of death is simply a new frontier. Tame it.

3922069396.name: The Outlander's Heart
3922069396.flavor: …beats with each new step into the beyond.

795389673.name: The Outlander's Cloak
795389673.flavor: …hides the sins of days forgotten and those yet to come.

1479532637.name: The Outlander's Cover
1479532637.flavor: …laughs at the horizon—ever changing, ever new.

1998314509.name: Dead End Cure 2.1
1998314509.flavor: "The path don't end. You do." —D.E.C. slogan

316000947.name: Dead End Cure 2.1
316000947.flavor: "There's no dead ends, fella." —D.E.C., 1st Sister to Unknown

2521426922.name: Far Gone Hood
2521426922.flavor: Worn by 1st Brothers and Sisters of the Dead End Cure, a notorious posse of itinerant Hunters.

3125909492.name: Dead End Cure 2.1
3125909492.flavor: "D.E.C. means you don't have to travel alone. Unless you want to." —D.E.C., 1st Brother to Unknown

922218300.name: Road Complex AA1
922218300.flavor: "An adventurer's spirit is a tool so few possess. Own it. Enjoy it." —The Speaker

1415533220.name: Road Complex AA1
1415533220.flavor: "Travel far and travel wide, and know that you are always welcome home." —The Speaker

2159363321.name: Be Thy Guide
2159363321.flavor: An honored gift, given to those who seek the farthest edges of maps yet written.

269552461.name: Road Complex AA1
269552461.flavor: "Be mindful of the countless miles ahead. They will test even the bravest among us." —The Speaker

308026950.name: Road Complex AA1
308026950.flavor: "The many roads traveled have led to here… to now. Do not stop." —The Speaker

493299171.name: Errant Knight 1.0
493299171.flavor: Take the lost by the hand and lead them ever here, ever home.

1024867629.name: Errant Knight 1.0
1024867629.flavor: The quickening beat is in step with your wanderer's stride.

3433746208.name: A Cloak Called Home
3433746208.flavor: No matter how far you travel, home is closer than you think.

2550994842.name: Errant Knight 1.0
2550994842.flavor: Remember this place when new horizons call.

2414278933.name: Errant Knight 1.0
2414278933.flavor: Walk on, noble hero… all roads lead home.

4284305242.name: Young Ahamkara's Spine
4284305242.flavor: Give me your arm, oh bearer mine. Let me help you fill the world with teeth.
4284305242.lore:
Bones! Let's wear some bones! 

Oh, it's a taste many Guardians develop. I think because they feel a wee bit spectral. All this transmatting leaves one saying "Am I still here? Am I flesh or am I mist?" So, you strap some old bones to your arm, bones that've been unbreakable for an eon, and you feel solid again. More yourself. 

Bearers of a particular species of bone do claim—and mind that I'm not recommending these bones—that the fossils grant them unusual powers. Nothing too wild. A little more of this and that. 

My own research suggests these special bones come from a species of draconic post-Traveler neolife called 'ahamkara'. They apparently talked—loved the phrase 'o seeker mine'—and troubled us enough to be hunted to extinction. If you wanted some more of these bones for your friends, I might know a source…
4284305242.lore_zh:
骸骨！我们带些骸骨吧！

哎，守护者就喜欢这种感觉。可能因为他们觉得这样有点点怪诞吧，给人感觉“我在哪儿？这是梦境还是现实？”所以你将这些坚不可摧的远古骸骨附在手上，让自己更坚固。超越自我。

这些特殊骸骨的佩戴者声称——我可不是在推销这些骸骨啊——这些化石赋予了他们非同寻常的力量。没什么太狂野的。只是难免有些这样或那样的怪异。

我亲自研究过了，这些特殊的骨骼来自一个叫做“阿罕卡拉”的新生龙族旅行者。他们显然说过——喜欢“来追寻我的骨骼”这个词——这让我们很困惑，他们不怕被追杀灭绝吗？如果你想给你的朋友捎些骸骨，我有货源……

4284305243.name: Mechaneer's Tricksleeves
4284305243.flavor: "This won't end well for one of us. And darling, it won't be me." —Self-styled "Lady" Olu Alderdice
4284305243.lore:
Attention, esteemed patrons of the Seven Stars! We are a semi-respectable business here. Until now, we've only had three or four rules, barring any newly invented misdeeds of which we are yet to be made aware. Unfortunately, we are forced to increase our rules by two. 

Four (or five): Olu Alderdice is heretofore banned from our establishment. 
Five (or six, who's counting): Alderdice's inventions are also forbidden. Anyone found to be in possession of devices such as, but not limited to, spring-razor petticoats, electrified fascinators, sidearm tricksleeves, or arsenic lipstick will be introduced to our bouncer. Who is a Titan. A very big one. Named Karl. 

Thank you for your understanding, and please enjoy your stay. Unless you're Olu Alderdice. Go away, Olu.
4284305243.lore_zh:
尊敬的七星金主们请注意！我们是一家声誉一般的商业公司。到现在为止，我们也只有三四条规则，且容忍我们意识到的新出现的任何错误。然而，我们被迫要求再加两条规则。

第四（或是第五）：欧卢·奥德黛丝在我们建立之前已经被加入黑名单了。
第五（或是第六，谁还数这个）：奥德黛丝的发明也被禁止。任何拥有以下，且不仅限于以下的装置，请交给我们的保安：弹簧刀片女士裙、电气化头巾、藏有手枪的怪异袖子、砒霜唇膏等。我们的保安叫做卡尔，是一位高大的泰坦。

谢谢您的理解，并祝您购物愉快。除了欧卢·奥德黛丝。欧卢，一边儿去！

419976110.name: Raiden Flux
419976110.flavor: Interfaces with synapses (or nearest equivalent) to draw electric power directly from the wearer's body.
419976110.lore:
"It's hard, in this age, for any warrior to find their inner peace. Our constant state of struggle breeds chaos, in the world and in our hearts. The Raiden Flux channels that chaos, regulates it by mapping and defining the wearer's true spiritual center. It is science merged with belief and the healing power of one's own natural energies. But there is more. The Raiden Flux is an amplifier of those energies. It seeks the spark in you and bolsters its charge, redirecting your innermost power that it may serve as an extension of your will. The staff then acts as a conduit through which one may forcibly deliver peace when such action is required. This seems a contradiction, to be sure. It is not. Because at its heart, peace defines war and peace is war's end." 

– Gao Sinyada, forger of the Raiden Flux
419976110.lore_zh:
“在这个年代，战士们要找到内心的平静很难。在世界及我们的内心，战斗和混乱永不休止。雷电通流引导混沌，通过映射和定义穿着者的真实精神中心进行调节。它是一种融合了信仰和自身治愈力量的科技。实际上还要更多。雷电通流将这些力量放大，发掘并强化你的闪光之处，重定向你内在的力量，这些力量可能就是意志的延伸。当进行此行为时，人们将作为媒介，实现强制和平。看起来有些矛盾，但实际上并不。因为其核心是，和平界定战争，和平是战争的终点。”

——雷电通流制造者，高信雅达

419976111.name: Lucky Raspberry
419976111.flavor:
> No one has ever died wearing me.
# It's true. She leaves the unworthy before they fall.
419976111.lore:
"I dunno. Hunter just came in one day with this odd Arc-reacting circuit, asking what it might be good for. All she could tell me was she scored it off some derelict satellite that crashed in the EDZ. So I ran diagnostics on them and it ebbed and flowed with massive Arc fluctuations. No pattern, no match to known solar or extra-solar events. Just random-like. So I hooked one into an old Malina vest we had lying around, and wished her luck. Word's got out, I guess." 

—Overheard in the Tower
419976111.lore_zh:
“我不知道。一天，猎人带着这个古怪的电弧反应电路过来，问这个可能有什么用。她只说是她在欧洲无人区坠毁的一些遗弃的卫星上取下来的。然后我诊断发现上面有大量的电弧波动流下，和已知的灼烧或超灼烧事件模式方法都不一样，都是随机的。所以我随意找了件老玛丽娜胸甲把它挂在里面，并祝她好运。反正话说出去了。”

——高塔里偷听到的

419976108.name: The Dragon's Shadow
419976108.flavor: "It is my honor." —Chalco Yong to Ikora Rey
419976108.lore:
"Find thy self." —first dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Know thy self." —second dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Destroy thy self." —third dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Shed thy self." —fourth dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Embrace a new skin." —fifth dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Become the many." —sixth dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"We are as unseen. We are as death." —final dictate, first calling, The Hidden
419976108.lore_zh:
“找回自我。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第一命令
“认知自我。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第二命令
“毁灭自我。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第三命令
“粉碎自我。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第四命令
“拥抱新肤。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第五命令
“化身为众。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，第六命令
“吾等皆盲。吾等皆亡。”——隐秘者，第一召唤，最终命令

1667080811.name: Knucklehead Radar
1667080811.flavor: You can see the point, right? Who wants to team up with one?
1667080811.lore:
"If you were rich, what would you do with all your money?" 
"Uh… I dunno. Maybe start my own business. Be some kinda bounty hunter." 
"What you mean, bounty hunter? We got thousands of Guardians running around, bounty-hunting anything that moves!" 
"Nuh-uh! That's all just sport. Them Awoken out in the Reef, I figure they might pay me to hunt folks down. And I got a secret. It's gonna gimme a real leg up on all them Guardians who come to copycat me when they see what a good idea I got." 
"Yeah? What is it?" 
"This Hunter, she sold me a visor that lets you find all the stupid enemies in a crowd. Called it 'knucklehead radar' or something like that." 
"Huh. How's it work?" 
"Couldn't tell ya."
1667080811.lore_zh:
“你要是有钱了，会怎么花？”
“呃……我不知道。可能先创业吧，做个悬赏猎人什么的。”
“悬赏猎人是指什么？我们成千上万的守护者每天跑来跑去就是在狩猎悬赏！”
“不是啦！那只是休闲运动。那些暗礁之外的觉醒者们，我觉得他们才是会花大量跑腿费雇我狩猎的人。我有个秘密，要是让外面那些守护者知道了，肯定都堵在我家门前想要抄袭我的好主意。”
“嗯？是什么？”
“有个猎人，她卖给我了一个视觉装置，可以显示人群中所有的白痴敌人。她叫它‘傻瓜雷达'还是什么的。”
“嗯，管用吗？”
“不告诉你。”

1667080810.name: Celestial Nighthawk
1667080810.flavor: Starlight is your guide. No vacuum will contain you.
1667080810.lore:
I'm on the ground, half inside Mav's Ward. Lucky for me, it's my head that's half in. The stars over my head are going out one at a time, but that could just be Taken goo blocking my sight. 

This giant one-eyed nightmare we woke up is real unhappy to see us. This wasn't the plan—we just came here to rob him. 

Luna's dry. The 'horn's dull. Mav's either laughing, or screaming for her life spraying lead everywhere. She's floating past Psions that won't stop splitting. STOP SPLITTING. 

We're almost out of time. We have one shot. 
So I pull out the bird and give this sucker the finger. 
One red-hot glowing finger.
1667080810.lore_zh:
我躺在地上，一半身子在马福的护盾中。幸运的是，头的那半在里面。我头顶的星星一颗接着一颗消失，但可能只是因为傀儡军团阻挡了我的视线。

我们吵醒的这个巨型独眼梦靥看到我们很不开心。这在计划外——我们只是来抢劫他的。

月球好干，角都钝了。马福不知道是在大笑，还是因为四处扫射而尖叫。她飘过不停分裂的方阵士兵。不要再分裂了。

我们快没有时间了，只剩最后一次机会了。
所以我冲着这家伙竖起了大大的中指。
红彤彤的大中指。

1667080809.name: Foetracer
1667080809.lore: I thought I was dead. Held my own for bit, but I could hear the Wizard wasn't alone and she'd be coming for whoever took out her spawn. It was just lying there, honestly. Looked like a standard old Outrider kit, but it had this rig, enough small diamond conduits to make me think it was something pulled out of those old Bray labs in the MNP. I don't just go putting things on my head, but I was desperate. Not sure what activated the thing, but sure enough there she was. I already had a lock on her, and once I engaged, there was nowhere she could hide.
1667080809.lore_zh: 我以为我快死了。我硬撑了一阵子，但我听到巫师不止一个，她想来向杀死她孩子的人报仇。老实说，它就在那里。看起来像是一件老旧的标准护卫装备，但是上面有一个装置像小钻石导管一样，让我觉得它是从那些MNP的旧布雷实验室里弄出来的东西。我一般不会胡思乱想，但当时我已经绝望了。不知道光能是不是能激活它，但她就在面前。我已经锁定了她，只要进入战斗，她就无处可藏了。

1245809813.name: Orpheus Rig
1245809813.lore:
Quantis Rhee has almost forgotten what colors are. For months, she has prowled the deep, shadowed catacombs of Nessus—the places where the inexorable Vex burrowed into the rogue planet and replaced natural life with a cold, inhuman labyrinth. 

Light is scarce in this place. But Quantis knows how to find it—how to feel for the un-ripples of the Void, to draw Light from the infinities between spaces. She knows how to roll black holes between her fingertips, and how to nock her bow with the inescapable gravities of the universe. 

Soon Quantis will leave this place, return to the City, report her findings. See colors again. But that won't last long. She is a Nightstalker. Out here—balanced upon the infinitesimal knife's edge—is where she truly belongs.
1245809813.lore_zh:
奎提斯·李几乎已经忘记颜色是什么。几个月里，她都在涅索斯地下阴暗的墓穴内徘徊——Vex惊人地在这个游离星球上挖掘藏身之地，用冰冷非人的迷宫取代自然的生活。

这个地方的光线很稀少。但是奎提斯知道如何找到它——如何感知虚空涟漪，在空间的极限中吸引光能。她知道如何在她的指尖之间翻转黑洞，并用宇宙中无处不在的重力拉开她的弓弦。

奎提斯将离开这个地方，回到圣城，并报告她的发现。又可以重见色彩了。不过不会持续很久。她是一名夜潜。在这之外，在极微的刀尖上穿梭，是她真正的归属。

1245809814.name: St0mp-EE5
1245809814.flavor: "I call them the Stompies! For when your legs need that extra kick." —Marcus Ren
1245809814.lore:
"Marcus, what—" 
"You're here! Finally! Get over here and hold this gun—" 
"Right down to business, huh?" 
"I will put these legs on—" 
"What are these? Frosties 2.0?" 
"No! They're completely different."  
"Uh-huh." 
"OK, they share some similarities. But these are the Stompies. I'm going to do a test-drive, and if they rip my legs off—" 
"Is that likely?" 
"You disintegrate me quick before the rogue mechasynapses spread—" 
"WHAT—" 
"Boaz, please. I thought you wanted to help?" 
"But shooting you? And I don't even get Crucible glory for it?" 
"I'll let you win the next race." 
"Cute." 
"C'mon. If you won't do it, I'll ask Ariadne. She'd love to shoot me."  
"Fine. Gimme the gun." 
"Thank you! Stompies Field Test One is go." 
"I might actually enjoy this." 
"That's the spirit."
1245809814.lore_zh:
“马库斯，什么——”
“你终于来了！快过来，拿上这把枪——”
“开始干活儿了，哈？”
“我要把这些腿甲装上——”
“这些是什么型号？冰冻2.0吗？”
“不！完全不一样。”
“呃啊。”
“好吧，还是有相似之处的。这些是小踩踩。我准备要试试它们了，要是它们把我的腿扯下来——”
“还有这种可能？”
“在异常机甲突触扩散之前把我拆掉——”
“什么——”
“波资，拜托。我以为你愿意帮我呢。”
“但要射你？这样我又拿不到熔炉竞技场荣耀。”
“下次比赛让你赢。”
“好哒。”
“快，你要不帮我，我就去找阿里阿德涅了。她可愿意射我了。”
“……好吧。把枪给我。”
“谢谢！小踩踩实地测试一，开始。”
“我会享受这过程的。”
“这才对嘛。”

3313736739.lore:
What's the Crucible? Before the days of the City and the Iron Lords, it was a place to pursue vendettas. To battle for territory, and pettier reasons. The whole world was a Crucible arena. The Crucible today? To Cayde-6, it's a gambler's paradise. To Zavala, it's a resource sink where equipment goes to die. To Ikora, it's home—though she would never admit it. 

Partial answers. The tactics and techniques that will save us in wars to come are birthed in the Crucible, during live-fire training. The Vanguard are so preoccupied with their own agendas they're missing the Vanguard of tomorrow rising right before their eyes. 

Ghosts find Guardians. The Crucible forges them. 
– Lord Shaxx
3313736739.lore_zh:
熔炉竞技场是什么？在圣城与钢铁领主之前，那是个仇杀之地。更贴切地说，为了争夺领土。整个世界就是个熔炉竞技场。而今天的熔炉竞技场呢？对凯德6号来说，那是赌徒的天堂。对萨瓦拉来说，那是装备逝去的资源库。对艾可拉而言，那是家——虽然她永远不会承认这一点。

这只是答案的一部分。在战争中让我们活下来的战术和技术都源自熔炉竞技场，都于战火训练中习得。先锋总是忙于眼前的日程而不顾及明天他们就要面对的问题。

机灵寻找守护者。熔炉竞技场塑造了他们。
——领主沙克斯

3281314016.lore:
The bar's still missing its roof, and the air smells like rain. 

Cayde-6 sits in the bar with his chair tipped, holding a shot of something acid green. He looks at you, counts the beads of sweat on Zavala's mug, and sighs. "Are we doing this, or what? C'mon, I'm rusting." 

Zavala straightens and clears his throat. "The Vanguard will continue until we are no longer needed, but I can foresee the day when you will…" He pauses, searching your face. 

The moment drags. Cayde juts his chin forward. Ikora hides a smile, then lifts her glass to you. "When you will surpass us." 

"Wait, what?" Cayde's chair drops heavily. He leans forward. "'Surpass' us? I didn't agree to that! This is a 'great job being a hero' party, not a 'Cayde is second-best' party." 

Ikora winks at you. "It's always been a 'Cayde is second-best' party."
3281314016.lore_zh:
酒吧的屋顶一直没有找到，空气闻起来很潮湿。

凯德6号斜着椅子坐在酒吧里，拿着酸绿的酒。他看向你，数着萨瓦拉脸上的汗珠，叹息道，“我们真要这么做吗，还有没有别的办法？快点儿，我都要生锈了。”

萨瓦拉坐直，清了清嗓。“只要我们被需要，先锋就会一直继续。但我能预见到你……”他停了下来，想看看你的表情。

时间仿佛停滞。凯德探出脸来，艾可拉忍住笑，对你举起杯。“你超过我们的那天。”

“等等，你说什么？”凯德的椅子重重地摔到了地上。他向前一倾。“‘超过'我们？这么说不对！这是个‘时势造英雄'的团体，不是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

艾可拉冲你眨眨眼。“这一直都是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

1056171153.lore:
OK, here's where I give you this big pep talk about "what it means to be a Hunter" and "follow these rules" and blah blah blah. 

So. Here's the one rule to being a Hunter: can you see me? I'm—I'm shrugging. It's—hard to convey in a written— 

Anyway. It's a shrug. Get it? There's no one way to be a Hunter. Just—figure it out as you go along. I know you can. Otherwise you wouldn't be a Hunter. OK?  

So what are you waiting for? Get out of here. Wait, wait—that'll be 1000 Glimmer. I'm kidding! Now go make me proud. Or don't. Just make you proud, okay? 

Wow. Sometimes I inspire even myself.
1056171153.lore_zh:
好的，我来和你好好谈谈“成为猎人意味着什么”和“要遵守的规则”等等等等。

是这样的。成为猎人有一个规则：看见没？我——我在耸肩。很难——用书面语表达清楚——

不管怎么说。就是耸耸肩。明白了吗？成为猎人没什么规则。但——你自己会慢慢领悟的。我相信你。否则你就不是猎人。好吧？

那你还在等什么呢？出去吧。等等，等等——那可是1000微光啊。我开玩笑的！别让我失望啊。不是不是。是别让自己失望，好吧？

哇，有时候我都佩服我自己。
