1490387264.flavor: So long as one Titan stands, so too stands the Wall.

89175653.name: Noble Constant Mark
89175653.flavor: Where you stand, they will fall.
89175653.lore:
"We are history. We hold something that the Traveler wanted us to keep. Our charge is simple: Protect the Light. 

Be the candle in the darkness of these days. Be the light the world sees. Be the wall against which evil breaks. Be the defenders the people of this City need. Bring hope, bring protection, bring victory.  

We are Titans. A choice was made to bring us here to fight together, and now that choice asks a new question: how will the history we are shape us into the legends we must become?" 

—Zavala, Titan Vanguard
89175653.lore_zh:
“我们是历史。我们保存了旅行者需要我们传承的过去。我们的指令很简单：守护光能。

成为黑暗笼罩下的烛光。成为世界可见的光芒。成为抵抗邪恶破坏者的高墙。成为圣城人们的守护者。带来希望，带来保护，带来胜利。

我们是泰坦。我们选择在这里并肩作战，现在这个选择带来新的问题：历史将如何塑造我们必须为之奋斗的传奇？”

——泰坦先锋，萨瓦拉

185326970.name: Noble Constant Type 2
185326970.flavor: Our sweat, our sacrifice, our responsibility.

1879942843.name: Gauntlets of Rull
1879942843.flavor: “Calus had won. But he took nothing from us. Instead he gave us everything we needed to end our perpetual war.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
1879942843.lore:
The greatest warriors of the Clipse lay dead. They formed a bloody trail through the Leviathan. Only Rull had lived to see the throne room. 

Calus calmly sipped his wine and considered Rull from the height of his golden seat. 

"Are you hungry?" 

Rull stared dumbfounded, bleeding and exhausted. He didn't know what to make of a creature that would casually offer sustenance and slaughter in equal measure. 

"I offer you a warrior's paradise, Rull of the Clipse. Join me, and be counted among the lucky few that might see the end of this world." 

What could Rull do but accept?
1879942843.lore_zh:
克里普斯最棒的战士倒下了。他们在利维坦留下了一道长长的血迹。只有鲁尔活着见到了王座大厅。

卡鲁斯冷静地品着酒，在他那高高在上的金色王座上看着鲁尔。

“你是否饥饿？”

鲁尔目光呆滞，他的身体在流血，精疲力竭。他不知道是什么能让一个生物可以同时操纵着生命和屠杀。

“克里普斯的鲁尔，我为你提供一个勇者的天堂。和我一起，成为可以看到这个世界尽头的少数幸运人吧。”

鲁尔除了接受，别无他选。

1879942842.name: Gauntlets of the Emperor's Champion
1879942842.flavor: I will be the last light to go out at the party.
1879942842.lore:
When you imagine the last moments of all life in this universe, what do you see? Is it struggle, war, and death? Are you fighting to the last breath? Are you suffering? 

I am not. In those last moments, I am surrounded by joy, pleasure, and good company. I am the last thing that they see. They give to me the greatest gift—the last of the living acknowledge that I, above all other beings, was real.
1879942842.lore_zh:
想象一下这个宇宙中所有生命的最后一刻，你看到了什么？挣扎、战争还有死亡？你是否战斗到了最后一刻？你是否饱受苦痛？

我没有。在最后的时刻，环绕着我的，是快乐、愉悦和幸福的陪伴。我是他们最后看到的人。他们给予我最好的礼物是——承认我是真实的，超越其他所有的存在。

1876645653.name: Chassis of Rull
1876645653.flavor: “Calus invited the Clipse to join his Loyalists. We refused, at first. So he sent a Shadow.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
1876645653.lore:
Rull gathered his cloak around him tightly as he pushed his way through the teeming marketplace. All around him, Cabal stumbled and pushed their way towards the celebration. No one seemed to question his identity as a foreign merchant, but his heart still raced. 

Rull thought about the mission that Emperor Calus had given him. 

"I'm sending you to the Cabal homeworld, Rull. There's a celebration, and you are to be a bearer of my gifts—the finest wines and spirits the universe has to offer." 

Rull was disappointed. He wanted to bring down great beasts, not assassinate old Cabal aristocrats. 

"Oh, Rull. Don't fret. I promised you a warrior's paradise and you shall have it. The gifts will buy you access to some of my former friends. I haven't spoken to them in some time, and well, I'd like them to know I haven't forgotten."
1876645653.lore_zh:
鲁尔用披风紧紧的裹着自己，穿过拥挤的市场。在他四周，卡巴尔跌跌撞撞地向庆典涌去。没有人怀疑他外国商人的身份，但他也没有放松。

鲁尔在思考卡鲁斯大帝交代的任务。

“我要把你送到卡巴尔的家园去，鲁尔。这个庆典上，你将受赠我的礼物——最佳酒酿以及宇宙间最伟大的勇气。”

鲁尔很失望。他想要击败猛兽，而不是刺杀卡巴尔贵族。

“哦，鲁尔。别苦恼。我承诺给你勇士的天堂，你会得到的。这些礼物会让你能接触到我们的一些老朋友。我不常和他们聊天的，好吧，我会告诉他们我没有忘记他们的。”

1876645652.name: Cuirass of the Emperor's Champion
1876645652.flavor: What will we be to each other in the next life?
1876645652.lore:
I've known you through many lives now: gladiator, Primus, usurper. With each new incarnation, I think we learn a little more about each other. How many more lives before our relationship becomes complete? 

But this life is my last, because there is no further that I can go. When next we meet, you will face one who has transcended even the gods. What will you be?
1876645652.lore_zh:
到目前为止，我已经通过许多次轮回认识了不同的你：角斗士、军团长、篡位者。通过每个全新的化身，我觉得我们越来越了解彼此。在我们成为完整的彼此之前还要经历多少轮回呢？

可是，这是我最后一次轮回，因为我已达极限。下次相见时，你会面对一个超越诸神的存在。而你又会是什么模样呢？

574137192.name: Shadow's Mark
574137192.flavor: “Calus could not heal our air. My planet is still dying. But as long as I serve, I have hope.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
574137192.lore:
Rull activated his staff's secondary configuration and fired a harpoon into Moli's exposed flank. The barbs pierced deep, and the giant beast of a Cabal let out a monstrous howl. Blind with pain, he began to run, dragging Rull behind like a harpooned whale dragging a ship. 

The honored Celebrant Moli ran through the streets of the Cabal homeworld on celebration day, howling in agony and dragging Rull behind. It was such a spectacle that no one was sure what exactly was happening or what to do about it. 

Moli ran all the way to Dominus Ghaul's ceremony and right up the steps before collapsing at his lord's feet. Rull realized that he now faced a choice—try to escape, or finish the job. 

Rull yanked out the harpoon before shoving it through Moli's neck. He had just enough time to pull off his helmet and smile in Ghaul's face before he was killed. 

Truly, Emperor Calus had delivered a warrior's paradise.
574137192.lore_zh:
鲁尔启动了他的法杖的第二功能，向莫利暴露的侧翼投掷了一把鱼叉。倒钩深深地刺了进去，这个卡巴尔巨兽发出了一阵怪异的嚎叫。疼痛令他失去了辨别能力，没头没尾地逃，像鲸鱼拖着渔船一样拖着鲁尔。

这名荣耀司仪莫利拖着鲁尔，在卡巴尔家园的大街上四处乱窜，痛苦地嚎叫。看到这个场景，人们根本不知道发生了什么，要去做什么。

莫利向着尊主盖欧的典礼一路奔去，在他的主人脚步踏出之前，一路爬上了台阶。鲁尔意识到他需要作出一个抉择——逃走，或是结束这一切。

鲁尔抽出鱼叉，将它扎进莫利的颈窝。在被杀死之前，他从容地摘下头盔，笑着面对盖欧的脸。

终究，卡鲁斯大帝将他送入了勇士的天堂。

574137193.name: Mark of the Emperor's Champion
574137193.flavor: A gift for the Titan with Ghaul's strength.
574137193.lore:
Did you know Ghaul once fought as a gladiator? He was so striking and different… yes, because of his strange color and markings, but also his movement. He weaved through his opponents, tying together the thread of a grand design only he could see. 

There was no opponent too large or powerful for Ghaul; his determination was everything. I see that strength in you, my dear Titan.
574137193.lore_zh:
你是否知道盖欧曾是一名角斗士？他是如此与众不同……是的，因为他那奇怪的肤色和印记，但还有他的动作。他穿行于对手之间，将命运丝线结成只有他自己才能看见的壮丽图案。

在盖欧眼中，没有什么对手是特别巨大或强悍的；他的决心便是一切。我亲爱的泰坦，我在你身上也看到了同样的力量。

1413589586.name: Mask of Rull
1413589586.flavor: “My planet was dead. The sky poisoned by war with an extrasolar enemy in a war that continued to rage. Then Calus came.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse
1413589586.lore:
The Clipse had only celebrated their first century of global peace when the cataclysm struck. A flash of interstellar gamma radiation killed every living thing in their western hemisphere, poisoned the atmosphere, and destroyed all technological civilization. 

As the surviving Clipse clawed back to subsistence cave farming, they met a new horror. The radiation had burnt a mysterious signal into the comets and asteroids of their system, and as this debris rained down on their world, it seeded hideous alien life. 

Millennia later, they had become a civilization that knew only war—a culture that revered the gun, batteries of planetary defense weapons holding back an endless poison sky-fall. The moon Kaga-Clipse bristled with interceptors, ready to fend off any threat. They were no match for the Leviathan.
1413589586.lore_zh:
当大灾变爆发时，克里普斯还在庆祝他们第一个全球和平的世纪。一场星际伽马辐射杀死了西半球的所有生物，大气层充满毒气，摧毁了所有的技术文明。

幸存的克里普斯人回到了居住洞穴的农耕时代，他们面临着一个新的恐惧。辐射向他们所在星系的彗星和小行星发出了神秘的信号，随着这个碎片降落到了他们的世界，它孕育出了可怕的外星生命。

千年之后，他们形成了一个只知道战争的文明——一支崇拜枪支，崇拜在无尽的毒气大气中使用武器实施暴力行为的文明。卫星卡佳-克里普斯人抗击拦截者，时刻准备着抵御任何威胁。但他们不是利维坦的对手。

1413589587.name: Helm of the Emperor's Champion
1413589587.flavor: Looking for a quiet place to watch the end of the world.
1413589587.lore:
The light of this universe will soon dim. You cannot see it yet, but I assure you, there will be no denying it when it comes. There will be no safety, and no defense. The only question you should ask yourself is, "Where do I want to be at the end?" 

From my vantage, I have cause to ask myself this question with some urgency. I will move soon, and I mean to choose the place from which I will watch all become darkness. I find it poetic and satisfying that you will be near.
1413589587.lore_zh:
这个宇宙的光辉将很快熄灭。你还对此毫无头绪，但我向你保证，当末日来临时，你无法抵抗。安身之所不再，防御之策不再。你应问自己的唯一问题是，“我想在哪里迎接末日来临？”

就我而言，我有理由现在问自己这个问题。我很快便会动身，我会刻意选择一个地方，从那里我将目睹一切堕入黑暗。而你就在不远处，我觉得这实在是颇有诗意，让人满足。

288406317.name: Greaves of Rull
288406317.flavor: “Valus Nohr marched on our capital with a few thousand. For weeks we battered them. But the Valus. She broke us.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
288406317.lore:
He arrived at the estate of Iska'al, former friend and confidante of the exiled Emperor Calus. It took surprisingly little to convince the guards to grant him entrance. The Cabal must truly be crazy for the wine he offered up as a gift. It was a day of celebration, after all. Who knows how deep into their cups these guards were? 

Once inside, he spotted his mark. Rull wasted no time. He removed the sheath from the end of his staff to reveal a spear-tip. Iska'al fell backwards and attempted to crawl away as his guards were skewered. Rull grabbed a cask of wine and pounced on the terrified old creature, pouring the wine down his throat. Iska'al choked and sputtered and flailed helplessly. Rull delivered his message as promised. 

"Emperor Calus has not forgotten you." 

Rull didn't stop pouring until he felt Iska'al go limp. 

Rull was covered in the sticky black and violet of Cabal blood and wine. He dropped Iska'al's body to the floor with a soft thud. Just then, Moli the Celebrant entered the courtyard.  When Rull realized that his second target had carelessly walked alone into a secluded space in the midst of a massive celebration on the Cabal homeworld, he thought, "Perhaps this is the warrior's paradise that Emperor Calus promised."
288406317.lore_zh:
他来到了伊斯卡拉的居所，其曾是流亡卡鲁斯大帝的朋友和知己。要说服守卫让他进去确实费了些力气。卡巴尔对他贿赂上的美酒近乎疯狂。毕竟那天也是个庆祝的日子。天知道那些守卫干了多少杯？

进去之后，他盖住了他的印记。一分一秒都不能浪费。他摘掉了法杖一头的护套，露出矛头。伊斯卡拉向后倒下，他的守卫都被串起来了，他试图爬走。鲁尔抓起一桶酒，向那个害怕的老东西猛冲过去，将酒灌进他的喉咙。伊斯卡拉呛着酒，无助地挣扎。鲁尔如约传达了他的消息。

“卡鲁斯大帝从未忘记你。”

直到伊斯卡拉不再动弹，鲁尔都没有停止灌酒。

黑色卡巴尔血液和紫色琼浆的粘稠混合物覆盖了鲁尔的全身。他将伊斯卡拉的尸体扔在地板上，发出了一下轻声的闷响。紧接着，司仪莫利走进了庭院。鲁尔发现他的第二个目标从卡巴尔家园举行的大型庆典中，不小心独自走进了这个僻静的空间，他感悟到：“也许这就是卡鲁斯大帝承诺的勇士的天堂。”

288406316.name: Greaves of the Emperor's Champion
288406316.flavor: The chorus of regret must be deafening.
288406316.lore:
What sad turns has your life taken since my exile? When you look upon the dour face of the Consul, do you feel the nauseous twinge of regret? Do you find solace in a meditative state—a lonely island in a sea of incessant blathering? 

I wonder what portion of your life is spent pondering how else it might have been. All of those possibilities must pile up behind you like a chorus of furies, each whispering doubts in your ear. When next we meet, the volume of that chorus will become deafening, and you will finally understand the totality of your mistake.
288406316.lore_zh:
自从我被流放以来，你的人生经历了怎样的苦楚转折呢？当抬头望向执政官的严厉面容时，你是否感受到令人作呕的悔恨之痛呢？你是否通过冥想——在这喋喋不休汪洋中的孤岛上——找到了安宁？

我想知道你用了多少时光思索另一番人生的景象。所有这些可能性必定堆积在你身后，仿佛狂怒的合唱，无一不在向你耳语着疑惑的旋律。我们再次相遇时，那首合唱将震耳欲聋，而你终会认识到自己全盘皆错。

the edge of a system frays like string

W E H A D B E E N V I E W E D B E F O R E

3624606677.lore_zh:

我，们，曾，被，盯，着，看，过

4071576013.name: Gensym Knight Gauntlets
4071576013.flavor: "Gensym Armor. Let's hope it does you more good than it did me." —Asher Mir

2523633779.name: Gensym Knight Plate
2523633779.flavor: "Have you ever considered that the Traveler might be just as chaotic and arbitrary as everything else?" —Asher Mir

434092458.name: Gensym Knight Mark
434092458.flavor: "Remember, the universe is a chaotic system. This frippery won't protect you from the continuum." —Asher Mir
434092458.lore:
Eris, 
I have scoured my library but found nothing on this "Nokris" of which you speak. I am sorry both for the delay and that I could not be of more help. Do you ever feel any affection for the creatures that changed you? I confess this weakness myself. In the shadow of the Pyramidion, I have sometimes felt a kind of craven admiration for the illimitable superior beings that suffuse my body. I can feel them move through my veins with purpose, magnetized to the intent of the Minds that have come to machinoform Echo Mesa. I have a sense of their desires. They have changed since I fell. And so, I am—if nothing else—a new variable in whatever grand equation compels them. 

My arm grows worse. This morning, I cut my finger and bled radiolaria. I will redouble my efforts. 

Truth in action, 
Asher Mir
434092458.lore_zh:
埃里斯，
我已经翻遍了我的图书馆，但在你所说的那个“诺克里斯”影儿都没有。很抱歉回信儿晚了，而且我也帮不上忙。你有没有一点点的喜爱那些改变了你的生物？我承认自己有这个弱点。在金字塔的阴影下，我有时会对那些萦绕在我身边毫无生气的卓越优势存在心生艳羡。我可以感觉到它们有目的地在我的血管中移动，被厄科台地模块控制区的思维有意地磁化着。我能感觉到它们的目的。它们已经变了，我能感觉到。所以，我是——如果没有别的——它们这宏大的方程式中一个新的变量。

我的胳膊情况越来越糟了。今天早上，我切下了手指鲜血四溅。我会加倍努力的。

事实中的真理，
阿什·米尔

1370341044.name: Gensym Knight Helm
1370341044.flavor: "I have no use for mawkish sentimentality. What I do need is an assistant who stays alive as often as possible." —Asher Mir

447407759.name: Gensym Knight Greaves
447407759.flavor: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir

872284448.name: Wildwood Gauntlets
872284448.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

10307688.name: Wildwood Plate
10307688.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

1712405061.name: Wildwood Mark
1712405061.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
1712405061.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
1712405061.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

3080875433.name: Wildwood Helm
3080875433.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

3862191322.name: Wildwood Greaves
3862191322.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

3955340735.name: Lost Pacific Gauntlets
3955340735.flavor: "Send a deep-space probe toward the anomaly. I want to know what it is." —Dr. Shanice Pell

1847610489.name: Lost Pacific Plate
1847610489.flavor: "The probe's initial data makes no sense. And then the signal died. What have we found?" —Dr. Shanice Pell

3586337076.name: Lost Pacific Mark
3586337076.flavor: Sloane had these Golden Age space suits repurposed for Guardian armor.
3586337076.lore:
From the Diaries of Dr. Shanice Pell 
Darling, the installation is nearly complete. Between Ishtar's endless audits and Clovis Bray's network protocols, I thought we would never make it. Secret the initial blueprints in hand-to-hand relays, recruit personnel brave enough to challenge the Traveler at its own game, secure mining rights in the Belt for materials… I remember when it was just a dream in our heads. At last, the freedom and silence to pierce interstellar space for our own answers! Tomorrow, I'm bringing the girls to see the navigation probe launch. They still ask about you from time to time. I just tell them, that's why we're out here, to find you.
3586337076.lore_zh:
沙尼斯·佩尔博士的日志
亲爱的，安装就要完成了。在伊什塔不间断的审计和克洛维斯·布瑞网络数据协议之间，我想我们可能永远都成功不了。将手把手的秘密传递着这份初始蓝本，新人用自己的游戏方式勇敢地挑战旅行者，保护着贝尔特地区材料的采矿权..……我记得当时这只是我们头脑中的一个梦想。最后，自由和刺穿星际空间的沉默成为了我们的答案！明天，我会带姑娘们去看导航探测器发射。她们还一直在问你。我告诉她们，我们来到这里的原因，就是找到你。

2930137294.name: Lost Pacific Helm
2930137294.flavor: "I need more data. And… put the lab on yellow alert."  —Dr. Shanice Pell

2876590849.name: Lost Pacific Greaves
2876590849.flavor: "This research has to get out. Even if I don't. People have to know what this 'anomaly' is." —Last Recording of Dr. Shanice Pell

957928253.name: Exodus Down Gauntlets
957928253.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

177493699.name: Exodus Down Plate
177493699.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

3754164794.name: Exodus Down Mark
3754164794.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
3754164794.lore:
Captain's Logbook. Ship, if we ever figure out the date, would you backfill it here? Thanks. 
We are stranded on an outbound Centaur. With every word I speak, we fall further from our sun. 7066 Nessus shouldn't be here, but there was no way to anticipate the way it pulled us in. Ship's guess is that our orbital momentum—what we'd call a four-vector, for the dimensions of space and time—was somehow folded away into six extra dimensions. Leaving us on a crash orbit towards Nessus… 

We have lost all sense of time. Past and future are like up and down, and we would walk them if we could, back to a place before Nessus, but we will always be on Nessus, too. I don't know. I don't know. They are trying to understand us. They must think like rivers. We are now receiving our own distress calls. I sound calmer than I feel.
3754164794.lore_zh:
船长日志。飞船，如果我们弄清楚日期，你能回填吗？谢谢。
我们被困于半人马座外轨。我每讲一个字，我们就离太阳更远一步。7066涅索斯不应该在这里，但我们也无法预见它将我们拖引过来的方法。飞船猜测是我们的轨道动量——我们在空间和时间维度上称之为四向量——以某种方式折叠成了六个额外的维度。将我们拖进了涅索斯的碰撞轨道……

我们已经失去了所有的时间感。过去和未来像方向一样，如果我们可以在时间上走动，或许我们可以回到涅索斯之前的地方，但我们也将永远留在涅索斯。我不知道，我不知道。他们在试图理解我们。他们必须像河流一样思考。我们现在收到了自己的遇险信号。我看起来比想象的要镇定一些。

1010733668.name: Exodus Down Helm
1010733668.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

3323553887.name: Exodus Down Greaves
3323553887.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

3999262583.name: Terra Concord Fists
3999262583.flavor: "Use your surroundings, they said. Don't think they meant 'build armor out of a crashed space base,' but here we are."

3291075521.name: Terra Concord Plate
3291075521.flavor: "Peace is achievable. How do I know? We have achieved it before."

4073580572.name: Terra Concord Mark
4073580572.flavor: The orbital city of Caer Lerion was one of Earth's crowning achievements in the Golden Age.

690335398.name: Terra Concord Helm
690335398.flavor: "The shining halls of peace have been torn down and turned into the battered plate of war."

1512829977.name: Terra Concord Greaves
1512829977.flavor:
"Earth's destiny is to move beyond the Earth."

"It was. Now we turn space stations into battle armor."

1809381923.name: Mark of the Colliders
1809381923.flavor: "All is conflict. Stand your ground." —Oath of the Collision Order

1809381922.name: Ere the End
1809381922.flavor: "The Titans shall say their piece, ere the end." —Lady Bretomart

739196403.name: RPC Valiant
739196403.flavor: The tragedy of the Prime Guard will be replaced by honored deeds yet done.” —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"

3007889693.name: RPC Valiant
3007889693.flavor: "They were the first line, and the last." —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"

174910288.name: Mark of Inquisition
174910288.flavor: "Stand before us, that you may be judged." —Unknown

733635242.name: RPC Valiant
733635242.flavor: Noble stand-ins for hope, when hope itself was long since gone." —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"

474150341.name: RPC Valiant
474150341.flavor: As that forgotten Age lost its golden sheen, they stood defiant against the coming end. —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"

280187206.name: Hardcase Battleplate
280187206.flavor: “At this point, it's a given… There will be pain.” —Unknown Titan

598178607.name: Mark of Confrontation
598178607.flavor: "'Unknown Titan'? More like 'All Titans. Every single one.'" —Unknown Titan

1933944659.name: Hardcase Helm
1933944659.flavor:
“No hard feelings?” —Unknown party

“What are feelings?” —Unknown Titan

2530905971.name: Retro-Grade TG2
2530905971.flavor: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "Knuckle up."

1364856221.name: Retro-Grade TG2
1364856221.flavor: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "Breathe easy, this should work."

2826844112.name: Retro-Grade Mark
2826844112.flavor: The dark decades after the Collapse were a time of confusion, desperation, and… interesting engineering choices.

2525344810.name: Retro-Grade TG2
2525344810.flavor: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "It'll think for ya."

2265859909.name: Retro-Grade TG2
2265859909.flavor: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "Who's up for a moonwalk?"

1260134370.name: Devastation Complex
1260134370.flavor: "Hold tight to all that remains. It is fleeting, but doesn't have to be." —The Speaker

2932121030.name: Devastation Complex
2932121030.flavor: "All you accomplish will inspire. And in that inspiration you will find strength." —The Speaker

3250112431.name: Be Thy Champion
3250112431.flavor: An honored gift, given to those who stand as pillars of hope.

3725654227.name: Devastation Complex
3725654227.flavor: "Be that which causes ruin to all who oppose the light." —The Speaker

3304280092.name: Devastation Complex
3304280092.flavor: "Hope shall follow in the wake of your greatest deeds." —The Speaker

107582877.name: Kerak Type 2
107582877.flavor: You are a problem solver, hero. Keep punching.

2696303651.name: Kerak Type 2
2696303651.flavor: These worlds have need for your might. Stand strong.

1978110490.name: Mark of the Unassailable
1978110490.flavor: All are welcome. None shall pass.

160388292.name: Kerak Type 2
160388292.flavor: They look to you for inspiration. Be brave.

2048751167.name: Kerak Type 2
2048751167.flavor: Being a Titan means always having the high ground.

1035680664.name: ACD/0 Feedback Fence
1035680664.flavor: The Active Contact Defense system uses warsat hull materials to store a retaliatory charge.
1035680664.lore:
In order to explain this, I need to explain Kessler Syndrome. As an Exo, I feel a duty to the machine to convey its original purpose. But first: ACD stands for Active Contact Defense. It is not an AC-DC Feedback Fence and it is not named for any work of pre-classical music. I am not winking. That is a malfunction. 

Kessler Syndrome occurs when a planet's orbitals fill up with fast-moving debris, which strikes other debris and shatters it in a chain reaction. Soon you can't put up a satellite without it being shredded by a swarm of junk. To protect against debris, Golden Age warsats are shielded by a kinetic superconductor that transforms a punch into a charge. 

Thanks to enemy action, we have a lot of downed warsats. With some tweaking, we can peel out the superconductor and produce a personal defense system. Like so.
1035680664.lore_zh:
解释这个前，我必须先讲一下什么是凯斯勒现象。作为一名Exo，我觉得我有责任传达机械的原始意图。但首先：ACD表示主动接触防御。不是AC-DC反馈栅，也不是前古典音乐作品的名字。我没眨眼，这是个故障。

凯斯勒现象在行星轨道充满快速移动的碎片时出现，碎片相互撞击并在连锁反应中破碎。不久之后你的卫星不被这一大群垃圾粉碎都不算你发射卫星了。为了防止这些碎片的出现，黄金时代的战争卫星有一个动量超导体的防护罩，可将冲击转化为电荷。

由于敌人的行动，我们找到了很多掉下来的战争卫星。通过一些调整，我们可以剥离超导体，并制造个人防御系统，就像这样。

1035680665.name: Doom Fang Pauldron
1035680665.lore:
"It was a Warlock who first worked out that the fangs could be used as some kind of conductive amplifier when specific light frequencies were run through 'em. I don't know the science. That's not for me. I just know they work. And in battle what works is what's best. 

"Is it weird? Yeah. Maybe. Science fangs and space magic. But I've seen enough strange out there to understand normal ain't the norm. Anyway, the Warlock called 'em 'Bio-Conductive Trouble Breakers'. I call 'em 'Doom Fangs' 'cause of the fang, which is obvious, and then there's the doom we tend to inflict on a situation. 

"Plus it just sounds cooler." 

– Unknown Titan
1035680665.lore_zh:
“最初是一个术士发现利齿可以在经过特定频率的光线照射后用作一种导体增幅器。我不懂什么科学。那不是我的菜。我只知道那玩意儿有用。而在战斗中，有用的就是最好的。”

“这很奇怪吗？是的。也许是吧。科学利齿和空间魔法。但是我已经见识得够多的了，能理解什么是正常而什么不是，你懂吗？总之，术士叫它们‘生物传导麻烦解决器'。我叫它们‘毁灭之牙'，当然是因为它就是利齿……呃，你懂的，我们是用它在某种情况下毁灭东西的。”

“再说，这名字酷多了。”

——无名泰坦

1035680666.name: Synthoceps
1035680666.flavor: Caution: the organism has been known to develop consciousness. In these cases, immediate termination is recommended.
1035680666.lore:
"Discovered amid the outer-reef scrap fields, the bio-matter is a novel sentience dependent upon neural-symbiosis with a host organism. It seeks to link to the synaptic patterns of the closest organism, living or synthetic, to form an unbreakable bond. We theorize that this bond is a form of primordial 'love'—an emotional connection meant to compel the bio-matter to view its host as 'family.' The host comes to regard the bio-matter as an indispensable tool. 

The science is inexact, but what is known is that the bio-matter becomes aggressively protective once linked to a worthy host, forming an organic shell that can amplify the host's own strength when immediate threats are detected. 

—Self-authored report broadcast on covert frequencies
1035680666.lore_zh:
“在暗礁外的碎屑场中发现的，一种需要依赖有机宿主神经共生元的感知生物物质。它寻找与它最接近的组织、生物或合成物，用突触连接它们，制成最坚固的纽带。理论上来讲，这个纽带是一种最原始的‘爱'——一种迫使生物物质将其宿主视为”家“的情感连接。宿主将生物物质视为必要工具。

研究上并不确定，但就目前所知，这种生物物质在连接到合适的宿主后会变得极具保护欲——在发现威胁时形成一种有机外壳来增强宿主自身的力量。

——转换频道时收到的自研究报告广播

458095280.name: Crest of Alpha Lupi
458095280.flavor: Whoever survives our passing does so only by our consent.
458095280.lore:
Near-gods must believe in greater gods. But every power is finite, every life shorter than it wishes. 

Only an astonishing mind can truly appreciate just how tiny it is when set against the known universe; and how insignificant the known becomes when it is devoured by what isn't seen and can't be comprehended. 

As darkness begins to claim their ragged souls, you look ahead to find a great power pouring out of you—a face of fire and golden light. 

That blazing wonder, a gift from the great-eyed god, is their salvation. Or are you? 
Perhaps you are the greater god now.
458095280.lore_zh:
半神必须相信更伟大的神。但每种力量都是有限的，每一个生命都比你想象的要短。

只有惊人的头脑才能真正体会到与已知宇宙相抗的微小之处；而当无法被人看到与理解的时候，已知事物也变得如此微不足道。

暗影开始拾取他们破烂的灵魂，你会发现你体内涌出的强大力量——充满金与火之光的脸。

这令人兴奋的奇迹，伟大的神的礼物，是他们的恩赐。还是你的？
那你可能就是更伟大的神了。

458095281.name: Actium War Rig
458095281.flavor: Conflict Resolution Solution #3479: Leave them to rest wherever they may fall.
458095281.lore:
"Keep it clean. Your body. Your mind. Your armor. Weapons. Gear. Ammo. CRS #1: Keep it clean. Clean equals function. Clean equals focus. That's where it all starts. Skill matters. Training, practice, experience. All key ingredients. All valued assets as you balance death and glory on the battlefield. But once you're trained and ready for war. And once your gear is up to the standards of a proper, respected, walking, talking war machine. What comes next?" 
"1177!" 
"That's right. CRS #1177: Ammunition is your best friend. So what do you do?" 
"Load up." 
"Load. Up. Get yourself a weapon that spits unending fire and stock up on ammo until your shoulders slump and your back aches. Because each round is a war all its own." 

 —Lord Shaxx educating a gathering of Titans
458095281.lore_zh:
“请保持洁净。你的身体。你的思维。你的护甲。武器。装备弹药。CRS#1：请保持洁净。洁净就是能力。洁净就是专注。它是所有的起源。技能至上。训练，练习，实践。所有的关键组合在一起。所有的至要左右着你在战场的生死与荣耀。但是一旦你训练完毕并准备出战；一旦你的装备与那装配完备、受人尊敬与能言善行的战争机器丝毫不差。接下来是哪个？”
“1177！”
“对的。CRS#1177：弹药才是你最好的朋友。那么你会怎么做？”
“填装弹药”
“填装。弹药。拿起喷着无穷怒火的武器，备好弹药直到它们压垮你的肩，压弯你的背。因为每一次战斗本身就是一场战争。”

——领主沙克斯教授于泰坦动员会

458095282.name: Hallowfire Heart
458095282.flavor: "You who seek the Forge: your journey will be long, but your destination is closer than you think." —Ouros
458095282.lore:
"Commander, as best we can tell, they're all gone. Somehow the Legion found their outpost, and the Hunters say Centurions still hold the ruins. This was the last text transmission we got before the signal died." 
—Sloane 

"The fire burned within us. Not by choice, not because we sought the flame. But because there was no other way. 

"When you stood before the Forge, there was no doubt. No fear. Not even anger. 

"My order stood for generations. We held against the shadow, bearing a weapon that seared flesh and melted bone. 

"And now we stand at the end. May history remember the Forge. Remember the Hammer. Remember the Sunbreakers." 

—Ouros, Third and Final Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
458095282.lore_zh:
“指挥官，根据我们所知，他们都走了。不知为何，军团找到了他们的前哨站，猎人说百夫长仍然占据着废墟。这是信号消失之前我们得到的最后一段文字。”
——斯隆

“我们燃起了一团火。我们并未选择如此，也并未因为我们在寻求火焰，而是因为没有办法。

“当你站在烈焰之前，就不会有疑问，不会有惧怕，甚至不会有愤怒。

“我们的秩序世代传承。我们带着灼肉熔骨武器反对暗影。

“现在我们站在了胜利一端。愿历史铭记烈焰。铭记战锤。铭记炎阳。”

——奥罗斯，三级及终极炎阳天空法官

197761153.name: An Insurmountable Skullfort
197761153.lore:
Hello. We understand you require Real-Time Combat Instructives. 

This is a BRAINVAULT Sigma-ACTIUM-X Cranial Dreadnought (Invictus Type). It is a fortress for your skull. Your skull is now a mighty bastion. You can break anything with your skull. The only limit is your spine. Relax. The lights will speak for you. Your hands are your eyes now. Look around. You find hand-to-hand combat relaxing. The lights will attract the enemy. Help them to relax as well. You will feel the effect of a CAREGRAVER Gamma-LYSANDER-IV Health Enforcer (Frontline Variant). Your enemies do not have a skull fortress. Their skulls are like meadows. Play in the meadows. Gather the flowers from the meadows. Gather them with electrokinetic trauma. Smell the flowers. Isn't that nice? 

You are safe in your skullfort.
197761153.lore_zh:
你好。我们知道你需要实时战斗指南。

这是大脑保险库 西格玛-亚克兴-IX颅骨无畏战舰（隐身型）。你的头骨堡垒。你的头骨现在是一个强大的堡垒。你的头骨现在无坚不摧。唯一的弱点就是对脊柱有限制。放松。光能会指引你。你的双手就是双眼。观察四周。你会发现手对手搏斗让人惬意。光能将引诱敌人。让他们也一样惬意。你会感觉到和关怀切割者 伽马-吕山德-IV生命强健者（前线改装型）一样的效果。你的敌人并没有头骨堡垒。他们的头骨就像块草地。在草地上玩耍。在草地上采花。用电动重创枪来采。闻闻花香。是不是很棒？

你在头骨堡垒里很安全。

197761152.name: Mask of the Quiet One
197761152.lore:
"Must you all be so dark? You're too focused on the horns. Look, I have died hundreds of times hunting the shadowed killers in Murder Row. I spent years mulling over Toland's and Osiris's discourse on thanatonautics. I have dabbled a bit myself and saw what lingers immediately upon all death. What I have done is found a way to channel the Void to draw that essence in before it is lost to the ether, to return it to Light so it can be properly bestowed back on our enemies. Death does not need to be final; it can, in fact, be recycled. What's so dark about that?" 

—Satomi, Architect of the Mask
197761152.lore_zh:
“你们一定要这么悲观吗？你们都对角盔太过执着。听着，我为了追杀死囚榜上的暗影杀手，都死了几百次了。我花了多年时间研究托兰德和奥斯里斯有关渡灵学的谈话。我自己小试过一番，看到了死亡后瞬间残留的事物。我是这么做的：引导虚空，在消散于乙太之前吸收其精华，将精华注入光能，这样这股力量也能够再度运用在敌人身上。死亡不是终点；事实上它是可以被循环的。为什么对死亡如此悲观？”

——面具工匠，里美

3790373074.name: Lion Rampant
3790373074.flavor: All expect that you should rouse yourself, as did the former lions of your blood.
3790373074.lore:
"O, lion! Stretch your wicked claws toward the stars and rend a hole in the sky itself! Let the stars cascade down around you. Leap high and tear again at the night! Rip every fearful comet and burning meteor out of the cosmos and swim in that ocean of light! Drink deep of it. Grow powerful. Carve pathways through the unknown, o defender! O enforcer from on-high!" 

—Traditional Titan meditation
3790373074.lore_zh:
“哦，狮子！将你的邪恶利爪伸向星空，在天空中撕裂出一个洞！让星星纷纷倾倒在你周围。然后高高跃起，再次撕裂黑夜！将每一颗受惊的彗星和冲出宇宙的燃烧流星撕碎，徜徉在那片光的海洋中！深饮一口那光芒，感受能量的增长。穿过未知披荆斩棘，哦，捍卫者！哦，高高上的执行者！”

——传统泰坦的冥思

3790373075.name: Peacekeepers
3790373075.flavor: Designed for the seamless delivery of justice in an unjust world.
3790373075.lore:
Peacekeepers once patrolled the City before the Red Legion's attack. They were Guardians, but their interest was in protecting our core, our home. Most understood the value in exploration, but the peacekeepers were old guard, born in the aftermath of the Iron Lords. They lived through the Faction Wars; bore witness to what damage internal strife could bring to a fragile society. They vowed to keep the factions in check and stood at the gates as our walls expanded and our city became a home. 

Now, nothing remains of the order. Yet their legacy delivers a harsh truth: the Last Safe City was never truly safe.
3790373075.lore_zh:
是曾经抵抗猩红军团入侵圣城的和平守护者们。他们是守护者，但是他们的利益在于保护我们的核心——家园。大多数人都懂得探索的意义，但和平守护者们是古老的守卫，钢铁领主的后人。他们经历过阵营战争；目睹过内部冲突对脆弱社会带来的后果。他们发誓要稳定阵营，站在延展的高墙和圣城家园的门口。

现在，秩序不再。他们的遗迹证明了一个残酷的事实：最后的避难所从未真正安全。

3790373072.name: Dunemarchers
3790373072.flavor: Whether on solid rock or shifting sand dune, the inexorable Sand Eaters never slow their pace.
3790373072.lore:
Ikora, I've done the best I can. Their language is moronic; I've had more interesting conversations with Titan recruits. Still, if true this is… enlightening. —Asher 

File Fragment 783737902-1, recovered from Cabal Centurion corpse at Firebase Delphi 

1: Deployment as planned. Still carry the honor silk from the dispatch ceremony. Proud to serve the emperor. 

2: Word has reached us of the [untranslateable] Ghaul's assault on the Trappist system. Death to warlords! 

3: The traitor [untranslateable] Calus has claimed another Primus. The Siege Dancers will not forget! 

4: Skyburners in ruins. Dark King ascendant. We must hold this world for the emperor! 

5: The Primus has given the order. We are to stand as long as we can against the [untranslateable] Ghaul. Glory to the one true emperor. 

End of file.
3790373072.lore_zh:
艾可拉，我尽力了啊。他们的语言挺蠢的；我和泰坦新兵进行了许多有趣的对话。不过，如果这是真的……那可真具有启发性的。——阿什

文件片段783737902-1，于德尔斐火力基地的卡巴尔百夫长尸体上找到

1：按计划部署。还要把派遣仪式中的荣耀丝绸拿走。很荣幸为大帝效劳。

2：我们已经获得了[无法翻译]盖欧对特拉普系统攻击的消息。去死吧战争狂！

3：叛徒[无法翻译]卡鲁斯公布了另一个军团长。攻坚舞者不会忘记的！

4：废墟中的焚天者。暗黑邪神的上维国度。我们必须为了大帝守护世界！

5：军团长已经下令。只要我们还能战斗，就会坚持与[无法翻译]盖欧抗争。这属于真正帝王的荣誉。

文件结束。

849529384.name: Phoenix Strife Type 0
849529384.flavor: "Mercy has no place in the Crucible. Going easy does no one any favors." —Lord Shaxx

1742680797.name: Binary Phoenix Mark
1742680797.flavor: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
1742680797.lore:
What's the Crucible? Before the days of the City and the Iron Lords, it was a place to pursue vendettas. To battle for territory, and pettier reasons. The whole world was a Crucible arena. The Crucible today? To Cayde-6, it's a gambler's paradise. To Zavala, it's a resource sink where equipment goes to die. To Ikora, it's home—though she would never admit it. 

Partial answers. The tactics and techniques that will save us in wars to come are birthed in the Crucible, during live-fire training. The Vanguard are so preoccupied with their own agendas they're missing the Vanguard of tomorrow rising right before their eyes. 

Ghosts find Guardians. The Crucible forges them. 
– Lord Shaxx
1742680797.lore_zh:
熔炉竞技场是什么？在圣城与钢铁领主之前，那是个仇杀之地。更贴切地说，为了争夺领土。整个世界就是个熔炉竞技场。而今天的熔炉竞技场呢？对凯德6号来说，那是赌徒的天堂。对萨瓦拉来说，那是装备逝去的资源库。对艾可拉而言，那是家——虽然她永远不会承认这一点。

这只是答案的一部分。在战争中让我们活下来的战术和技术都源自熔炉竞技场，都于战火训练中习得。先锋总是忙于眼前的日程而不顾及明天他们就要面对的问题。

机灵寻找守护者。熔炉竞技场塑造了他们。
——领主沙克斯

2191401041.name: Phoenix Strife Type 0
2191401041.flavor: "The greatest compliment you can pay in the Crucible is to fight with everything you've got." —Lord Shaxx

1484937602.name: Phoenix Strife Type 0
1484937602.flavor: "Fight harder! Any less than your best is an insult to the very core of being a Guardian!" —Lord Shaxx

4065136800.name: Anti-Extinction Gauntlets
4065136800.flavor: "The instinct to migrate comes to many at once, without warning. Unlike birds, we must make preparations—we must make our own wings." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII

387100392.name: Anti-Extinction Plate
387100392.flavor: "To be selected as an Arach, one must have a clear vision of the future and its horrors." —The Book of Departures, Canto I

2089197765.name: Stella Incognita Mark
2089197765.flavor: "In choosing the site of a new home, consider not only natural resources and environmental dangers, but also the fuel levels of your ships." —The Book of Departures, Canto II

1978760489.name: Anti-Extinction Helm
1978760489.flavor: "Friends and families must be cast aside if they do not perceive the truth. Such ties bind us more tightly than gravity." —The Book of Departures, Canto III

2760076378.name: Anti-Extinction Greaves
2760076378.flavor: "Even for the faithless Arach, there is hope. While there is space on the ships, none shall be turned away." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII

1162875302.name: Simulator Gauntlets
1162875302.flavor: "As in the other timelines we examined, where the simulation includes our intervention, the City survives. Where it does not, well..." —RECORD 116-CHASM-0064

3671665226.name: Simulator Plate
3671665226.flavor: "In this vision we are victorious. In this vision also. And this one. And this." —RECORD 115-CHASM-8991

3842448731.name: Entanglement Mark
3842448731.flavor: "A hand, lying on the grass, in one future. A head in another. Components scattered across six visions. All identifiable. I agree. We cannot tell her. Take this off the—" —RECORD 784-CHASM-1016

1187431263.name: Simulator Helm
1187431263.flavor: "The face of war continues to change. In this timeline, Cabal. In another, Vex. And in this other one—we have no name for what we saw." —RECORD 614-CHASM-8299

680327840.name: Simulator Greaves
680327840.flavor: "I see the City, ruined and abandoned. I see no Traveler in the sky. The war is elsewhere. Let us find it." —RECORD 615-CHASM-2110

1890693805.name: Sovereign Gauntlets
1890693805.flavor: "Executors shall uphold the rights of others with all their strength until a greater leader arises to take that burden." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6

2154427219.name: Sovereign Plate
2154427219.flavor: "Opportunities will arise to profit from our mission, to accrue personal power and wealth. Decline them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 12

106359434.name: Coronation Mark
106359434.flavor: "The greatest merits are found within. But even these are better displayed by sumptuous dress and a sense of style." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 1

3059968532.name: Sovereign Helm
3059968532.flavor: "To serve as an Executor is to stand as a pillar of the City. Hold your head high." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 2

2603069551.name: Sovereign Greaves
2603069551.flavor: "In your long search, remember that true leaders inspire others to follow. Tyrants may exercise petty power, but they will be abandoned before long." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13

3027732901.name: The Shelter in Place
3027732901.flavor: Some armor doesn't protect you so much as it just makes the dying slower.

1667528443.name: The Shelter in Place
1667528443.flavor: This armor won't stop a Cabal round, but it'll buy you some time before you die.

24244626.name: Mark of Shelter
24244626.flavor: Titans are both the shelter and the storm.
24244626.lore:
The bar's still missing its roof, and the air smells like rain. 

Cayde-6 sits in the bar with his chair tipped, holding a shot of something acid green. He looks at you, counts the beads of sweat on Zavala's mug, and sighs. "Are we doing this, or what? C'mon, I'm rusting." 

Zavala straightens and clears his throat. "The Vanguard will continue until we are no longer needed, but I can foresee the day when you will…" He pauses, searching your face. 

The moment drags. Cayde juts his chin forward. Ikora hides a smile, then lifts her glass to you. "When you will surpass us." 

"Wait, what?" Cayde's chair drops heavily. He leans forward. "'Surpass' us? I didn't agree to that! This is a 'great job being a hero' party, not a 'Cayde is second-best' party." 

Ikora winks at you. "It's always been a 'Cayde is second-best' party."
24244626.lore_zh:
酒吧的屋顶一直没有找到，空气闻起来很潮湿。

凯德6号斜着椅子坐在酒吧里，拿着酸绿的酒。他看向你，数着萨瓦拉脸上的汗珠，叹息道，“我们真要这么做吗，还有没有别的办法？快点儿，我都要生锈了。”

萨瓦拉坐直，清了清嗓。“只要我们被需要，先锋就会一直继续。但我能预见到你……”他停了下来，想看看你的表情。

时间仿佛停滞。凯德探出脸来，艾可拉忍住笑，对你举起杯。“你超过我们的那天。”

“等等，你说什么？”凯德的椅子重重地摔到了地上。他向前一倾。“‘超过'我们？这么说不对！这是个‘时势造英雄'的团体，不是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

艾可拉冲你眨眨眼。“这一直都是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

3873435116.name: The Shelter in Place
3873435116.flavor: "Where is your home? That is where you will fight the hardest." —Zavala

3375062567.name: The Shelter in Place
3375062567.flavor: "That each of us have many lives to give for the City is the Traveler's greatest gift." —Zavala

722380134.name: Brave Titan Plate
722380134.flavor: Commander Zavala teaches the City's Titans to be the wall against the City's enemies.

1040474575.name: Brave Titan's Mark
1040474575.flavor: A Mark meant to honor the stalwart defenders of the Last City.
1040474575.lore:
Do you see the walls that surround the Last City? Picture them in your mind. They don't just protect our people. They also serve as a reminder— a reminder of what you are. 

You are a Titan. The wall against which evil breaks. The candle in the darkest of these days. The protector of the Traveler's last gifts. 

This City is your home. Its people are your blood. And its walls are your shields, your weapons, your temple. 

Take your place, Titan, and know this: when you fight for the Last City, you will never suffer defeat. 

– Zavala, Titan Vanguard
1040474575.lore_zh:
你看到环绕最后的城市的高墙了吗？记住这个画面。它们不仅仅保护了我们的人民，也时刻提醒着——提醒着你是谁。

你是一名泰坦，是抵抗邪恶破坏者的高墙，是黑暗时代中的烛光，是旅行者最后馈赠的保护者。

圣城是你的家。人民是你的血液。高墙是你的护盾，你的武器，你的神殿。

泰坦，认清你的位置，听着：当你为最后的城市战斗时，你将永远不会失败。

——泰坦先锋，萨瓦拉

660037107.name: Brave Titan Helm
660037107.flavor: When in doubt, you use your head. Your headbutts are renowned.

238766140.name: Brave Titan Greaves
238766140.flavor: A Titan's march is long and unwavering.

3878952908.name: Wrecked Titan Gauntlets
3878952908.flavor: Titans are taught to repair their armor after every battle. These gauntlets are a lost cause.

2134070164.name: Wrecked Titan Plate
2134070164.flavor: Not in a million years could you buff out all the dints in this breastplate.

3302357737.name: Tattered Titan Mark
3302357737.flavor: It is customary to shed a mark after victory or loss—to remind its finder of the history that came before.
3302357737.lore:

– Zavala, Titan Vanguard

697099357.name: Wrecked Titan Helm
697099357.flavor: Every aspect of this helm has been compromised.

229821046.name: Wrecked Titan Greaves
229821046.flavor: These boots are unaccustomed to retreat.

1378545975.name: Refugee Helm
1378545975.flavor: Keep your head up. You're still a Titan, after all.

59990642.name: Refugee Plate
59990642.flavor: Titans honor their armor, no matter its strength.

452060094.name: Refugee Gloves
452060094.flavor: These hands could once turn diamonds into dust.

696808195.name: Refugee Mark
696808195.flavor: Even without the Light, a Titan is a beacon of hope for any refugee.

871442456.name: Refugee Boots
871442456.flavor: When traveling far from the City, one must be prepared for all conditions and enemies.

868799838.name: Renegade Helm
868799838.flavor: The true test of a Titan's worth is how she endures defeat.

2886651369.name: Renegade Plate
2886651369.flavor: Titans once challenged themselves to patrol the frontier with armor this weak.

3967705743.name: Renegade Gauntlets
3967705743.flavor: Those who founded the City braved the wilds of Earth with much less.

4200817316.name: Mark of the Renegade
4200817316.flavor: Protect those who seek protection. Give them a home.

288815409.name: Renegade Greaves
288815409.flavor: The road to victory is long. May your legs never tire.

203317967.name: Fieldplate Type 10
203317967.flavor: When the Light was taken away, Vijaya Jain started crafting fieldplate. Lots of fieldplate.

846463017.name: Fieldplate Type 10
846463017.flavor: It'll take more than this to kill us.

2626766308.name: Mark of the Longest Line
2626766308.flavor: Titan orders mark time in ages of battle. This was the twelfth—until the Cabal came.

933345182.name: Fieldplate Type 10
933345182.flavor: Fancy armor incorporates shock-absorbent padding. This ramshackle plate sure isn't fancy.

777818225.name: Fieldplate Type 10
777818225.flavor: "Is it great armor? No. But at least there's plenty to go around." —Vijaya Jain

516502270.name: Firebreak Field
516502270.flavor: To their shame, most of the wide-scattered Firebreak Order survived the City's fall.

3523134386.name: Firebreak Field
3523134386.flavor: We should never have let ourselves be cornered. We could have dispersed centuries ago.

3693917763.name: Mark of the Fire
3693917763.flavor: Callisto Yin carried the Fire Victorious out of the City on her burning mark.

1443091319.name: Firebreak Field
1443091319.flavor: Firebreak Titans once fought to draw the battle away from home. Now home IS the battle.

1360445272.name: Firebreak Field
1360445272.flavor: Walls were never enough to guard us. We needed to strike first.

627055961.name: Fortress Field
627055961.flavor: "I see the first thing Titans rediscovered was the construction of huge shoulder plates." —A jealous Warlock, probably

226227391.name: Fortress Field
226227391.flavor: The Stoneborn, protectors of the City's walls, fell with the City. In memory this armor was made.

1473385934.name: Mark of the Golden Citadel
1473385934.flavor: "Titans are trained to be a wall. But perhaps we must train ourselves to be something more." —Callisto Yin

1279721672.name: Fortress Field
1279721672.flavor: The Jaisalmer pattern in this helmet carries redundant transmitters, in case of cranial dislocation.

3519241547.name: Fortress Field
3519241547.flavor: I remember saying I was bored of the view from the Tower. I wish I'd shut my mouth.

3650925928.name: Atgeir 2T1
3650925928.flavor: If flexed at full strength, this gauntlet would tear itself asunder.

703683040.name: Atgeir 2T1
703683040.flavor: The plate's surface snaps into alignment when battle is near.

13719069.name: Atgeir Mark
13719069.flavor: In wars of ancient myth, the fire of great birds guarded the warriors below.

739406993.name: Atgeir 2T1
739406993.flavor: Vengeance may lead a good Titan from law down into fire.

457297858.name: Atgeir 2T1
457297858.flavor: The legendary Njall let himself be burned rather than abandon his home.

2486041713.name: Songbreaker Gauntlets
2486041713.flavor: "They're powered by that Hive rock you got me! Sloane gave me permission once I explained the voltmeter readings." —Amanda Holliday

2486041712.name: Gearhead Gauntlets
2486041712.flavor: "I dunno what's more fun: Stealing enemy vehicles, or blowing them up." —Hawthorne

2426340790.name: Dreamer's Mark
2426340790.flavor: "Without Light to sustain it, this body of mine cannot make the pilgrimage to the Shard. But you can." —Tyra Karn

2426340791.name: Unethical Experiments Mark
2426340791.flavor: "I've seen experiments like this before. My crew.... I don't want to talk about it." —Failsafe

2426340788.name: Orobas Vectura Mark
2426340788.flavor: "You made the right choice. I think. Either way, I'm on your side." —Ghost

2317191363.name: Mindbreaker Boots
2317191363.flavor: "Your work today was more than acceptable. It was adequate." —Asher Mir

2253044470.name: Legion-Bane
2253044470.flavor: Firm orders compel Legionaries to fight to the end—hoping for a lucky shot.

3656549306.name: Legion-Bane
3656549306.flavor: Titans brainstormed this high-end pattern for field make. We're not all punch-crazed lunks.

2880545163.name: Black Shield Mark
2880545163.flavor: Strike down the Centurion. Leave the Legionaries to contemplate your indifference.

3968319087.name: Legion-Bane
3968319087.flavor: The Psions who spied on Crucible training at Thuria were bemused by all the complaining.

3465323600.name: Legion-Bane
3465323600.flavor: A Legionary packs thousands of slug rounds. A nimble Titan can survive every last one.

1665016007.name: Primal Siege Type 1
1665016007.flavor: It's possible for an Exo to confuse their armor as part of their body: but then, y'see, they'll feel naked.

3163241201.name: Primal Siege Type 1
3163241201.flavor: Regardless of what we were, we inherently know what we must become.

1022126988.name: Baseline Mark
1022126988.flavor: There comes a whisper in an ancient tongue: "You are worthy. Remember us."

461025654.name: Primal Siege Type 1
461025654.flavor: Few Titans master all the disciplines of their Light. Those who do can switch in an instant.

417821705.name: Primal Siege Type 1
417821705.flavor: A Titan without a discipline is like a computer without programs.

3794819064.name: Arms of Optimacy
3794819064.flavor: You hold the means to control worlds.

199852048.name: Robes of Optimacy
199852048.flavor: Your true worth has at last manifested.

3421974605.name: Bond of Optimacy
3421974605.flavor: Has this wealth found you or have you found it?

2956899553.name: Hood of Optimacy
2956899553.flavor: From high atop humanity we watch.

1830086706.name: Legs of Optimacy
1830086706.flavor: All that tread below will learn that we, the Optimacy, dwell above.

287471683.name: Iron Truage Gloves
287471683.flavor: The Iron Banner tournament keeps alive the heroes of humanity's dark past.

124696333.name: Iron Truage Vestments
124696333.flavor: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.

2999505920.name: Timur's Iron Bond
2999505920.flavor: "Think of all the old mysteries that are now ours to solve anew!" —Timur, learning of SIVA

2811201658.name: Iron Truage Hood
2811201658.flavor: When the Last City was just a patchwork of campfires, the Iron Lords stood guard.

2674485749.name: Iron Truage Legs
2674485749.flavor: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.

3081969019.name: Ego Talon IV
3081969019.flavor: "A nimble mind makes a nimble trigger finger." —Ikora Rey

868792277.name: Ego Talon IV
868792277.flavor: "To know the universe, you must first know yourself." —Ikora Rey

4285708584.name: Ego Talon Bond
4285708584.flavor: "You will find the nightmares grow worse. Thankfully, you no longer have need of sleep." —Gallida Tuyet
4285708584.lore:
I live what I teach. Every time I fire my shotgun, I reflect on our enemies. Every shell I leave in my wake is evidence of my meditations. 

I know the forces that move against us. I have studied endlessly. I have transcended our libraries.  

I listen to the whispers of my Hidden and I grow wiser every day. 

I live what I teach, but I could not predict Ghaul. This is my failing, and I must answer for it.

—Ikora Rey, Warlock Vanguard
4285708584.lore_zh:
我教导，我生存。我每发射一颗子弹，都有一名敌人应声倒地。我留着的每个弹壳，都是我冥想的证据。

我了解与我们抗衡的力量。我一直在无尽地学习。我的学识已超越图书馆。

我听从隐秘者的低语，每天都越加机敏。

我教导，我生存，但我无法预测盖欧。这是我的失败之处，我必须给出一个答案。

——术士先锋，艾可拉·蕾伊

1532009197.name: Ego Talon IV
1532009197.flavor: "Knowledge is its own end." —Toland, the Shattered

2676042150.name: Wraps of the Fulminator
2676042150.flavor: “Before my Councilors and I could finalize her containment armor, the very presence of the Fulminator assaulted the senses. She was breathtaking.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2676042150.lore:
Statesman Tha'uul ran, and the Fulminator followed him. He was a minor diplomat who had played a part in the coup against the emperor. She wasn't certain of the details. The social dynamics of organics were difficult to grasp and she found them consistently irrelevant. 

He had no idea she was still there. He thought he had outrun her, but the Arkborn knew that bipeds rarely look up. 

She hovered far above her target, specific limiters on her armor disabled so that Arc could flow freely and lift her to the heavens. 

Below, the statesman had chosen a brightly lit street that led to a dead end on the left turn in front of him. She descended.
2676042150.lore_zh:
政治家陶路尔跑了，轰鸣者跟着他。他曾是一名微不足道的外交官，他在皇帝的政变中起了些作用。具体做了什么她就不清楚了。有机物的社会动态很难掌握，她发现那些动态经常没有联系。

他不知道她还在那里。他认为自己已经甩开她了，但是方舟之子知道这个两足动物很少会抬头看。

她徘徊在她的目标之上，关闭了护甲上的特定限制器，让电弧自由流动，把她升得快能触碰到天堂。

在下面，政治家选择了一条灯火通明的街道，前方左转是个死胡同。她降了下来。

2676042151.name: Wraps of the Emperor's Minister
2676042151.flavor: There is nothing I cannot forgive.
2676042151.lore:
I think perhaps I am finally ready to forgive you. There's no point in carrying around this hate forever. I think about who you were, and who I was, and the end seems inevitable. How can I blame you for the poisonous ambition that the Consul poured into your ear? You were merely his instrument. 

In the end, it has all been for the better, has it not? Your betrayal is the first chapter in the story of my ascension.
2676042151.lore_zh:
我想也许我终于准备好宽恕你了。将这种仇恨永远宿于心中毫无意义。我思考了你是谁，我又是谁，而那种结果似乎是不可避免的。我怎能因执政官向你灌输的歹毒野心而责怪你呢？你只是他的棋子。

到头来，一切都变得更好，不是吗？你的背叛是我重生的首章。

3592548938.name: Robes of the Fulminator
3592548938.flavor: “The Councilors devised a way for the Fulminator to escape her interstellar ark, to the outrage of her people.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3592548938.lore:
The charred husk that was Statesman Tha'uul had revealed several things before he expired. He had mistaken her for a "warrior of the Light," one of their "storm bringers" who apparently bore a resemblance to the Fulminator. She wished to see one of them. No biped was ever anything like her. She felt something like regret when Tha'uul said his people were mobilizing to annihilate them. 

She made other reports to Calus, pertaining to the locations of Red Legion armories and fleet movements. He only cared about one. Now that the military was in power, in Calus's absence, military parades on Cabal worlds were commonplace. Ghaul's flagship would take part in one such celebration, on Resignation Day, in the fringes of the Sol system, in honor of a mythic Praetor. 

That was where the Shadows would kill the Dominus.
3592548938.lore_zh:
政治家陶路尔烧焦的外壳透露出了他死前的几件事。他把她当作了一个“光能战士”，是与轰鸣者特别相似的“风暴使者”之一。她想亲眼见见他们其中的谁。因为还没有哪个两足动物和她一样。当陶路尔说他们的人民正打算动员消灭他们时，她感到了某种像是后悔的情绪。

她向卡鲁斯呈上了关于猩红军团军械库和舰队移动的其他报告。他只关心一件事。军方掌权了，在卡鲁斯不在的情况下，卡巴尔世界的军事游行司空见惯。盖欧的旗舰也将出现在这场退位日的庆祝活动中，在太阳系的边界，纪念一位传说中的执政官。

也是暗影军团刺杀尊主的地方。

3592548939.name: Robes of the Emperor's Minister
3592548939.lore:
I think it is only fair to warn you—I mean to reincorporate the Red Legion. I am their rightful emperor, and I shall offer them forgiveness. All they must do is repent and submit to their reeducation. 

I feel like it's only fair to make you the same offer. How does "Primus of the Red Legion" sound?
3592548939.lore_zh:
我觉得要警告你一下才是——我有意重组猩红军团。我才是他们当之无愧的皇帝，我会赦免他们。他们需要做的是必须悔改，服从改造。

我觉得施予你相同的待遇才算公平。“猩红军团军团长”听上去如何？

3763332443.name: Shadow's Bond
3763332443.flavor: “The Fulminator could directly afflict the nervous system of the organics around her. She was pain in all its shades. I will miss her.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
3763332443.lore:
Jarus's fighter soared like a blade into the throat of the Dominus's command ship. They hoped it wouldn't matter. Jarus died on impact. The Shadows burst forth from his shattered vessel, the Fulminator leading the charge. 

Every limiter on her armor was undone. The unrelenting fury of her being loosed onto the bridge would permanently disable her. She would still exist, but couldn't anchor herself or manipulate anything around her. She would scatter to the winds. 

Navigation displays exploded in a shower of sparks as she passed. The storm she had become reached an apex of intensity, and she reached out to scores of Cabal and swallowed them and she felt them die. She wrapped Ghaul in her light, enervated him in bursts of flaring Arc. She was fading. He would die. Wouldn't he?
3763332443.lore_zh:
贾鲁斯的战斗机呼啸而过，犹如一把利剑插入尊主指挥舰的咽喉。他们觉得没关系。贾鲁斯由于撞击当场身亡。暗影从他遭到破坏的船中喷涌而出，轰鸣者是这次行动的指挥者。

她护甲上的每个限制器都被关闭了。流淌在舰桥上的愤怒无法平息，使她永不可再战。她仍然活着，但无法站稳或操纵她周围的任何东西。她只能随风飘零。

当她消逝的过程中，导航显示器在阵阵火花中爆炸。她化身成无比强大的风暴，伸向众多的卡巴尔，吞噬他们，感受他们的死亡。她将盖欧囚禁在她的光能之中，闪耀的电弧能量使他愈近虚弱。她消逝了。他也会死去。不是吗？

3763332442.name: Bond of the Emperor's Minister
3763332442.flavor: For the Warlock possessed of Ghaul's wisdom.
3763332442.lore:
Ghaul once served at my right hand. His even temper and disciplined mind proved a useful foil to my passion and force of will. And so, I leaned on him for all of my important decisions. It always felt good to talk through my ideas. He had a way of reflecting them back to me sharper and clearer. 

I see the same wisdom in you, my dear Warlock. Perhaps—when the time is right—we might discuss my ideas.
3763332442.lore_zh:
盖欧曾是我的左膀右臂。与我的热忱和意志力量相对，事实证明他那平和的脾性和自律的思维对我大有助益。因此，我将所有的重要决策都托付于他。与他人深入探讨自己的想法总能让人感觉良好。他会反馈回来更尖锐更透彻的想法。

我在你身上看到了同样的睿智，我亲爱的术士。也许——时机到来时——我们可以探讨一下我的想法。

2700598111.name: Mask of the Fulminator
2700598111.flavor: “How does one convince a creature of pure, sentient energy to pledge her loyalty? The agency to leave home is intoxicating for anyone.” — Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2700598111.lore:
Calus gestured towards the crackling Arc storm before him. The energy mass shivered, tethered to a golden spindle in the center of the chamber. 

"You are marvelous," he said to the Arkborn. His eyes drank in the flickering light, reflecting nothing. "You will cast a glorious Shadow." 

A panel on the wall lit up in Cabal: THIS SHIP IS TINY. 

The emperor threw his head back and guffawed. "Compared to the interstellar conduits of your people anything would seem small. The Leviathan is formidable in its own right, I assure you."  

LEAVE MY PEOPLE BE. I WILL SERVE. 

"Of course. You are all I need. Your very presence eviscerates flesh." He gestured, and a metallic shell lowered from the darkness above. Now the Fulminator was free to walk the decks of her new flagship.
2700598111.lore_zh:
卡鲁斯指着他面前劈啪作响的电弧风暴。能量体不断颤动，与大厅中心的金色转轴纠缠不清。

“你真是不可思议，”他对方舟之子说。他的眼睛沉浸在这闪烁的光线里，眼中没有任何反射。“你会投下美丽的暗影。”

墙上的一块面板亮起，上面用卡巴尔语写着：这艘船真小。

大帝仰天大笑。“比起你们的星际通道，什么看起来都很小。利维坦本身是非常庞大的，我可以保证。

放过我的子民，我会为你效忠。

“当然，我有你就够了。你的存在比千万血肉之躯都要重要。”他做了个手势，一个金属甲壳从黑暗中降下来。现在轰鸣者可以自由行走在她的新旗舰甲板上了。

2700598110.name: Headpiece of the Emperor's Minister
2700598110.flavor: Are you just a phantom in a mirror?
2700598110.lore:
Sometimes I stare into the abyss of space, plagued by a terrible fear. In this waking nightmare, everything you said to me and everything you felt for me was a lie. 

But what was the nature of these lies? Were they manipulations wrought by ambition? Were they hateful machinations of vengeance? Or, worst of all, were they self-delusions? Did I merely ascribe to you words and feelings that were, in fact, my own?
2700598110.lore_zh:
有时我凝望着遍布恐惧的太空深处。在这场清醒的噩梦之中，你对我所说的一切，以及你对我的所有感情都只是谎言。

但这些谎言的本质又是什么呢？它们是野心造就的肆意操纵？它们是可憎的复仇阴谋？或者最糟的情况，它们是自我欺骗？我是否仅仅将事实上属于我自己的言语与感情归因于你？

2193494688.name: Boots of the Fulminator
2193494688.flavor: “What was she? A creature of the Light? Or the other end of the spectrum? The Councilors never finished their analysis.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2193494688.lore:
The Fulminator noticed a difference in her fellow Shadows as they prepared for war. 
The usual bickering, fostered by the multispecies makeup of Calus's enforcer group, vanished overnight as they faced the task they had gathered to complete: kill Dominus Ghaul. 

Calus had recruited them through bribery or promises of wealth and resources for their homeworlds. None of them expected to survive their mission. The might of the Red Legion had grown vast. This acceptance brought them together. 

The Fulminator didn't understand, or care. As long as Calus left the Arkborn to their interstellar conduits, she would do what she had done since the day she came aboard the Leviathan: destroy the enemies of the emperor.
2193494688.lore_zh:
当他们备战时，轰鸣者注意到她的暗影有些不同。
鱼目混杂的卡鲁斯执行官组织平日里的争吵在一夜之间消失，因为他们面临着一个共同的任务：杀死尊主盖欧。

卡鲁斯通过贿赂或给他们家园财富和资源的承诺招募了他们。他们都没有想着能活着完成任务。猩红军团的力量已经变愈加强大。视死如归让他们众志成城。

轰鸣者无法理解，也不在乎。只要卡鲁斯将这个方舟上出生的战士放到他们的星际通道中，她会做她登上利维坦的那天就开始做的事：消灭大帝的敌人。

2193494689.name: Boots of the Emperor's Minister
2193494689.flavor: It's all for the sake of appearances.
2193494689.lore:
Your reassimiliation into the empires is likely to be cause for concern. You'll understand that it will come with some preconditions. After all, we can't have it appear that I've played favorites. But there's no cause for alarm; your reeducation is merely a formality. 

While I may forgive you, the rest of the empire will need some time. It's important to show the people how you have changed. It won't be forever, just however long it takes to earn your place at my side once more.
2193494689.lore_zh:
你重新被帝国同化很可能是被关注的原因。你也要理解这需要一些先决条件。毕竟，我们不能让它看上去像是我的袒护所为。但不必惊慌；你的改造仅仅是一种形式。

我会宽恕你，但帝国里的其他人需要些时间。让人们看到你的转变十分重要。再次获得伴我左右资格的时间虽不会是永远，但也要花点儿时间。

530515217.name: Channeling Wraps
530515217.flavor: "For the Light who seeks to kill with a gesture." —Emissary of the Nine

530515216.name: Focusing Wraps
530515216.flavor: "For those to whom a strike is simply a revelation of Light." —Emissary of the Nine

891933383.flavor: "For one who seeks centered moments in war." —Emissary of the Nine

1607431126.name: Judgement's Wrap
1607431126.flavor: "For one who analyzes battle as the philosopher questions the universe." —Emissary of the Nine
1607431126.lore:
The overturned stone reveals the ants beneath. 
THEY WERE CURIOUS. SO THEY LOOKED. 
why fault the curiosity which stems from loss 
WHY FAULT THE YOUNG AND SMALL 
W H Y N O T
1607431126.lore_zh:
掀开石头，下面的蚂蚁纷纷爬出。
它们好奇。所以它们探索。
为什么要将损失怪罪于好奇
为什么要怪罪于年幼与弱小
为什么不呢

1607431127.name: Bond Relentless
1607431127.flavor: "For you as much as for them. They are observing your thoughts." —Emissary of the Nine
1607431127.source: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
1607431127.source_zh: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。
1607431127.lore:
The overturned stone reveals the ants beneath.
THEY WERE CURIOUS. SO THEY LOOKED.
why fault the curiosity which stems from loss
WHY FAULT THE YOUNG AND SMALL
W H Y N O T
1607431127.lore_zh:
被翻开的石头暴露出了下面的蚂蚁。
它们的好奇心使他们四处探寻。
为何要归罪源自失去的好奇心
为何要归罪年轻和幼小的人
为什么不呢

2964441920.name: Channeling Cowl
2964441920.flavor: "For those who seek not cunning, but the idea of it." —Emissary of the Nine

2964441921.name: Focusing Cowl
2964441921.flavor: "For the Light who seeks enlightenment as a means to lethality." —Emissary of the Nine

4232174819.flavor: "For those who seek to be elsewhere." —Emissary of the Nine

4232174818.flavor: "For one who seek to be everywhere at once." —Emissary of the Nine
