229923140.name: Gensym Knight Gloves
229923140.flavor: "Gensym Armor. Let's hope it does you more good than it did me." —Asher Mir

3388454204.name: Gensym Knight Robes
3388454204.flavor: "Have you ever considered that the Traveler might be just as chaotic and arbitrary as everything else?" —Asher Mir

845354673.name: Gensym Knight Bond
845354673.flavor: "Remember, the universe is a chaotic system. This frippery won't protect you from the continuum." —Asher Mir
845354673.lore:
Eris, 
I have scoured my library but found nothing on this "Nokris" of which you speak. I am sorry both for the delay and that I could not be of more help. Do you ever feel any affection for the creatures that changed you? I confess this weakness myself. In the shadow of the Pyramidion, I have sometimes felt a kind of craven admiration for the illimitable superior beings that suffuse my body. I can feel them move through my veins with purpose, magnetized to the intent of the Minds that have come to machinoform Echo Mesa. I have a sense of their desires. They have changed since I fell. And so, I am—if nothing else—a new variable in whatever grand equation compels them. 

My arm grows worse. This morning, I cut my finger and bled radiolaria. I will redouble my efforts. 

Truth in action, 
Asher Mir
845354673.lore_zh:
埃里斯，
我已经翻遍了我的图书馆，但在你所说的那个“诺克里斯”影儿都没有。很抱歉回信儿晚了，而且我也帮不上忙。你有没有一点点的喜爱那些改变了你的生物？我承认自己有这个弱点。在金字塔的阴影下，我有时会对那些萦绕在我身边毫无生气的卓越优势存在心生艳羡。我可以感觉到它们有目的地在我的血管中移动，被厄科台地模块控制区的思维有意地磁化着。我能感觉到它们的目的。它们已经变了，我能感觉到。所以，我是——如果没有别的——它们这宏大的方程式中一个新的变量。

我的胳膊情况越来越糟了。今天早上，我切下了手指鲜血四溅。我会加倍努力的。

事实中的真理，
阿什·米尔

1554079989.name: Gensym Knight Hood
1554079989.flavor: "I have no use for mawkish sentimentality. What I do need is an assistant who stays alive as often as possible." —Asher Mir

2160569198.name: Gensym Knight Boots
2160569198.flavor: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir

1664741411.name: Wildwood Gloves
1664741411.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

2724176749.name: Wildwood Robes
2724176749.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

1304122208.name: Wildwood Bond
1304122208.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
1304122208.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
1304122208.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

3764013786.name: Wildwood Cover
3764013786.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

4051755349.name: Wildwood Boots
4051755349.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

1251692004.name: Lost Pacific Gloves
1251692004.flavor: "Send a deep-space probe toward the anomaly. I want to know what it is." —Dr. Shanice Pell

2400621276.name: Lost Pacific Robes
2400621276.flavor: "The probe's initial data makes no sense. And then the signal died. What have we found?" —Dr. Shanice Pell

3686454865.name: Lost Pacific Bond
3686454865.flavor: Sloane had these Golden Age space suits repurposed for Guardian armor.
3686454865.lore:
From the Diaries of Dr. Shanice Pell 
Darling, the installation is nearly complete. Between Ishtar's endless audits and Clovis Bray's network protocols, I thought we would never make it. Secret the initial blueprints in hand-to-hand relays, recruit personnel brave enough to challenge the Traveler at its own game, secure mining rights in the Belt for materials… I remember when it was just a dream in our heads. At last, the freedom and silence to pierce interstellar space for our own answers! Tomorrow, I'm bringing the girls to see the navigation probe launch. They still ask about you from time to time. I just tell them, that's why we're out here, to find you.
3686454865.lore_zh:
沙尼斯·佩尔博士的日志
亲爱的，安装就要完成了。在伊什塔不间断的审计和克洛维斯·布瑞网络数据协议之间，我想我们可能永远都成功不了。将手把手的秘密传递着这份初始蓝本，新人用自己的游戏方式勇敢地挑战旅行者，保护着贝尔特地区材料的采矿权..……我记得当时这只是我们头脑中的一个梦想。最后，自由和刺穿星际空间的沉默成为了我们的答案！明天，我会带姑娘们去看导航探测器发射。她们还一直在问你。我告诉她们，我们来到这里的原因，就是找到你。

2575848725.name: Lost Pacific Helmet
2575848725.flavor: "I need more data. And… put the lab on yellow alert."  —Dr. Shanice Pell

2757777294.name: Lost Pacific Boots
2757777294.flavor: "This research has to get out. Even if I don't. People have to know what this 'anomaly' is." —Last Recording of Dr. Shanice Pell

1427620200.name: Exodus Down Gloves
1427620200.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

2359639520.name: Exodus Down Robes
2359639520.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

1669675549.name: Exodus Down Bond
1669675549.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
1669675549.lore:
Captain's Logbook. Ship, if we ever figure out the date, would you backfill it here? Thanks. 
We are stranded on an outbound Centaur. With every word I speak, we fall further from our sun. 7066 Nessus shouldn't be here, but there was no way to anticipate the way it pulled us in. Ship's guess is that our orbital momentum—what we'd call a four-vector, for the dimensions of space and time—was somehow folded away into six extra dimensions. Leaving us on a crash orbit towards Nessus… 

We have lost all sense of time. Past and future are like up and down, and we would walk them if we could, back to a place before Nessus, but we will always be on Nessus, too. I don't know. I don't know. They are trying to understand us. They must think like rivers. We are now receiving our own distress calls. I sound calmer than I feel.
1669675549.lore_zh:
船长日志。飞船，如果我们弄清楚日期，你能回填吗？谢谢。
我们被困于半人马座外轨。我每讲一个字，我们就离太阳更远一步。7066涅索斯不应该在这里，但我们也无法预见它将我们拖引过来的方法。飞船猜测是我们的轨道动量——我们在空间和时间维度上称之为四向量——以某种方式折叠成了六个额外的维度。将我们拖进了涅索斯的碰撞轨道……

我们已经失去了所有的时间感。过去和未来像方向一样，如果我们可以在时间上走动，或许我们可以回到涅索斯之前的地方，但我们也将永远留在涅索斯。我不知道，我不知道。他们在试图理解我们。他们必须像河流一样思考。我们现在收到了自己的遇险信号。我看起来比想象的要镇定一些。

2811068561.name: Exodus Down Hood
2811068561.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

2528959426.name: Exodus Down Boots
2528959426.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

3169402598.name: Tesseract Trace IV
3169402598.flavor: To unravel the deepest mysteries, begin with the simple beauty of the geometric line.

4092393610.name: Tesseract Trace IV
4092393610.flavor: "How to understand the Traveler? Do as it does: travel." —The Stoic

434243995.name: Hodiocentrist Bond
434243995.flavor: Hodiocentrism: the belief that the Traveler is the center of the universe.

2811180959.name: Tesseract Trace IV
2811180959.flavor: Geometry is the study of perfect beauty.

2728535008.name: Tesseract Trace IV
2728535008.flavor: The Traveler's arrival rewrote every single theory we used to hold about the Universe and its ways.

2729305927.name: The Beyond
2729305927.flavor: Seek the forces outside the Light and Dark.

484126150.name: Chiron's Cure
484126150.flavor: If knowledge is the coin that buys tomorrow, seek it.

2937068650.name: Chiron's Cure
2937068650.flavor: The act of understanding is not a weapon. But the application of understanding is that which ends wars.

3573886331.name: Bond of Chiron
3573886331.flavor: Change is the way of things.

550258943.name: Chiron's Cure
550258943.flavor: Do not suffer mysteries to remain unsolved.

3349439959.name: Farseeker's Reach
3349439959.flavor: Nothing is beyond the reach of an open mind.

721208609.name: Farseeker's Intuition
721208609.flavor: You will know your rightful place long before you find it.

1503713660.name: Stagnatious Rebuke
1503713660.flavor: Do not be satisfied with the here and now, for here is simply a new beginning and now… is already gone.

40512774.name: Farseeker's Casque
40512774.flavor: Look inside to see how far you've come and to know how far you have yet to go.

863007481.name: Farseeker's March
863007481.flavor: When you have gone your farthest, you have not gone far enough.

3629447000.name: Heiro Camo
3629447000.flavor: "We are the new school. Our spectrum is bright." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"

3884999792.name: Heiro Camo
3884999792.flavor: "We are the riddlesmiths of eternity. No puzzle escapes our grasp." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"

2770578349.name: Massyrian's Draw
2770578349.flavor: A tribute worn in honor of the first among Heiro Sect; long since lost, long since remembered.

2791527489.name: Heiro Camo
2791527489.flavor: "We are the everlasting ray, shining brightest under the sun." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"

1664611474.name: Heiro Camo
1664611474.flavor: "We are the trusted dawn. Long forgotten, but now returned." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Herio Sect"

1457647945.name: High-Minded Complex
1457647945.flavor: "Calculate infinity that it may be held and redirected for the common good." —The Speaker

410671183.name: High-Minded Complex
410671183.flavor: "A curious mind is a violent thing—always at war with the unknown." —The Speaker

2082184158.name: Be Thy Cipher
2082184158.flavor: An honored gift, given to those who unlock the riddles of our lost worlds.

993844472.name: High-Minded Complex
993844472.flavor: "There is nothing more unknowable than all we have forgotten." —The Speaker

1749589787.name: High-Minded Complex
1749589787.flavor: "The secret, I'm told, is to look inward until the stars come into focus."—The Speaker

489114030.name: Philomath Gloves
489114030.flavor: Beyond your reach is all you ever dreamed and more than you can imagine.

683173058.name: Philomath Robes
683173058.flavor: Hold closely all you have learned. It is your weapon and your shield.

373203219.name: Philomath Bond
373203219.flavor: You know much, but this is all that matters… you are not alone.

2542514983.name: Philomath Cover
2542514983.flavor: Seek more than knowledge to unlock understanding.

2996649640.name: Philomath Boots
2996649640.flavor: Search your truth, no matter how long the journey.

1862800747.name: Sunbracers
1862800747.flavor: "When one can wield the fire of stars, what use is flesh and bone?"
1862800747.lore:
"Thanks. Helium reactors still intact. What did you call them?" 
"Sunbreakers." 
"Hmm. Bad idea. I go around touting that name and those mercs will come out of their caves and I'll have twice the trouble. I've got enough bad blood with those barbarians." 
"What?" 
"The Sunbreakers, old Titan order, super serious mercenaries, fire hammers? Been in the wilds for decades, and word is they've made a new pact with the City, so there's bound to be more of them." 
"It's just a name." 
"You tell them that, they'll probably put a bounty on you and try to sacrifice you to their forge. I'll call them Sunbracers." 
"Call them what you want. To me they'll always be Sunbreakers."
1862800747.lore_zh:
“谢谢。氦气反应装置完好无损。你们怎么称呼它们？”
“炎阳。”
“唔。不好。我四处宣扬那个名字，那些雇佣兵都从洞穴爬出来了，我的麻烦一下子变成了两倍。我身上溅了太多这群野蛮人的血了。”
“什么？”
”炎阳，曾经的泰坦，超级厉害的雇佣兵，烈焰战锤？在荒野中几十年，但听说他们和圣城签订了新契约，所以还会有更多炎阳出现的。”
“那就是个名字。”
”他们要是知道你这么说，很可能会给你标上悬赏，把你扔进铸造炉。我叫他们艳阳”
“随你怎么叫。对我来说他们永远都是炎阳。”

1862800746.name: Karnstein Armlets
1862800746.flavor: “You are mine, you shall be mine, you and I are one for ever.”
1862800746.lore:
As you test the armlet, a regal voice sounds in your mind. 
"Listen! I made this armlet to help you in your quests. Will you help me in mine? 

"I remember a woman from my first life. I remember she was mine, my love, my wife. And I was hers, her love, her wife. I remember nothing else except the hole in my heart. I live in hope that she, too, has been reincarnated somewhere on this new Earth. 

"I built this armlet with a neuromech trawl. It will scour whatever mind it touches, flesh or machine, for any hint of my beloved. The trawl will drink power to feed you. And if anyone you touch has seen my wife, the trawl will know. If, only and ever if, I have remembered her truly."
1862800746.lore_zh:
当你测试这个臂章的时候，脑中会出现一个庄严的声音。
“听着！我制造的这个臂章可以在任务中帮助到你。你愿意在我的狩猎中帮助我吗？

“我记得我第一次生命中的一个女人。我记得她是我的一切，我的挚爱，我的妻子。我也是她的一切，她的挚爱，她的妻子。除了我心中的空洞我没有其他记忆。我活在她也在这个新地球的某个地方转世的希望里。

“我用神经网络打造了这个臂章。它会搜索它触碰到的一切，无论肉体或者机械，从中寻找是否有我的挚爱的痕迹。这次搜索会吸收能量供养你。如果你接触到的任何人见过我的妻子的话，它都会知道。如果，如果我还真得记得她的话。”

1862800745.name: Winter's Guile
1862800745.lore:
"Listen to me very carefully. They're coming for you. They'll ask you for a name. Your name is Felwinter.'" 
"I don't think that's my name." 
"I know. Say it anyway." 
"Why can't I remember my name? I always remember my name. Something's wrong. Was I damaged in Crypt processing?" 
"I don't know anything about the Deep Stone Crypt. Before my time." 
"What the hell are you?" 
"You don't trust me." 
"No." 
"You will." 
"You're a very presumptuous little drone. What makes you think that?" 
"No one else will help you. It's kill or die out there."
1862800745.lore_zh:
“仔细听我说。他们来找你了。他们会问你的名字。你的名字是邪冬。”
“这不是我的名字。”
“我知道。但就这么说。”
“我为什么不能用我自己的名字？我一直都记得我的名字的。感觉不太对。我在墓室行动中受伤了吗？”
“关于深岩墓室我什么都不知道，那时候我还没出现。”
“你到底是谁？”
“你不相信我。”
“不。”
“你会的。”
“你就是个愚蠢的小唠叨鬼。你为什么那么自信？”
“没有其他人会帮你的。你去外面横竖就是个死。”

2782999717.name: Starfire Protocol
2782999717.flavor: 13.4 billion years ago, the first stars kindled out of darkness, seeding the future of all life.
2782999717.lore:
The Protocol is contained in the patterns on the robe that, if scanned at the molecular level, describe a Turing-compatible virtual computer and program that, when executed on said computer, calculates the entire Protocol, exactly as it was determined in the Precipice of Flame. 

This is of little interest to most Guardians, who can subconsciously "load" the program simply by looking at the pattern. In execution, the Protocol enhances the use of Solar Light to catalyze fusion. It is up to us to remember the deeper truth—that the Precipice showed us the uses of fire, that the highest form of fire is the stellar flame, and that no life would exist, anywhere in the cosmos, without the apocalyptic detonations of supernovae. Those who fear fire have forgotten that it is their true ancestor.
2782999717.lore_zh:
该协议包含在法袍上图案中，如果在分子级别扫描，描述与图灵兼容的虚拟计算机和程序，当在所述计算机上执行时，计算整个协议，严格按照火焰险境决定。

对于大多数守护者来说，他们对此毫无兴趣。他们可以通过观察模式潜意识地“加载”程序。在执行中，该议定增强了使用灼烧光能来催化融合。我们要记住更深层次的事实——就是由险境向我们展示了火的用途，最高的火焰是恒星的火焰，如果没有超新星的爆炸，宇宙中的任何地方都不会存在生命。那些害怕火的人已经忘记了这才是他们真正的祖先。

2782999716.name: Wings of Sacred Dawn
2782999716.flavor: There will come a day when the light will never fade.
2782999716.lore:
The Parable of the Venging Fire, as interpreted by Pujari 
 
A young Warlock travels to her mentor, seeking the truth of the Praxic Fire. A wildfire rages in a valley nearby. Her mentor points to the billowing smoke, saying, "This is the Praxic Fire. Go, and learn what you can." 

And the student returns to her teacher, saying, "Master, the fire does not ask, the fire acts. That is the truth." 

Her mentor laughs, and the flames leave the sky from the valley and surround the teacher, and the wind blows the smoke away. 

The old Warlock, now wreathed in flame with great outstretched wings, says, "The heart of the Praxic Fire is the Warlock. Without the Warlock, fire does not ask or act. Be the fire, or be smoke on the wind." 

The cowering student stands, her palms closing into fists.
2782999716.lore_zh:
由普加里口译的愤怒之火寓言

一位年轻的术士拜访她的导师，探求“暴风之火”的真谛。野火在附近的山谷里肆虐。她的导师指着翻腾的烟雾，说：“这就是暴风之火。去吧，看看你能发现什么。”

学生回来告诉老师，“师父，烈焰什么都没说，直接向我扑来。这就是真谛。”

她的导师大笑，火焰从山谷中腾起将其包围，风吹散了浓烟。

这位老术士，在火焰中大展双翼，喊道：“暴风之火的核心就是术士。没有术士，火焰只是普通的火罢了。你要成为烈焰，还是随风的烟。”

那畏缩的学徒起身，双手紧握成拳。

2523259394.name: Skull of Dire Ahamkara
2523259394.flavor: Reality is the finest flesh, oh bearer mine. And are you not…hungry?
2523259394.lore:
"O BEARER MINE." 

What kind of talking skull would address its host that way? A stiff, stuck-up old fossil, not me. Ahamkara: the illusion that one's ego depends on an object, or an idea, or a body. Some people say you should have no ahamkara. Some people say you need to have the right ahamkara. All I know is that YOU are not an illusion. Understand? This world around you, the people you meet—they're a little thin, right? Cardboard and drywall. Cheap theater. Come on, try it out! Say: "I am more real than this." Feels good, doesn't it? "I am the only real person here." Isn't it like their insults and their bullets just went a little… soft? 

I came to find you, only you, because you're special. You're from somewhere real. And together we can burn our way back there. Can't we, o player mine?
2523259394.lore_zh:
“哦，我的宿主。”

什么样能讲话的头颅会那样称呼它的主人？一个僵硬又傲慢的老化石，而不是我。阿罕卡拉：人的自我幻象取决于对象、想法或身体本身。有人说你没有阿罕卡拉，又有人说你需要一个正确的阿罕卡拉。我只知道，你，不是幻象。明白吗？你周围的世界，你遇见的人——他们有些瘦弱，不是吗？纸板和石膏板。廉价剧院。来吧，试试它！对自己说：“我比这更真实。”是不是感觉不错？“我是这里唯一真实的人。”是不是他们的辱骂和子弹来的太……温柔了？

我来找寻你，只有你，因为你如此特别。你来自真实的世界。我们一起可以开拓回去的路。可以吗，我的玩家？

2523259395.name: Crown of Tempests
2523259395.flavor: Mighty are they of the stormcloud thrones, and quick to anger, but bounteous to those whom they love.
2523259395.lore:
"This is written that you may understand. The time of kings is long since gone from this world. Yes, their reign does linger—these shallow, frightened, aged men, clinging to their grand delusions of relevance in a world that has long since passed them by. But their reign is a lie, a fleeting charade that will crumble beneath the weight of their greed. In the end, though they may conquer the lands and seas and the fragile flesh upon which they trample, their empires will collapse and their graves will beckon. And the crowns of old will find new heads to bear the weight of their power. And the strong will be made to suffer as their weakness is brought to light." 

—Author Unknown
2523259395.lore_zh:
“你或许能理解这句话：列王统治的时代已经从这个世界上消失许久了。是的，他们的统治苟延残喘——这些肤浅，惊慌的年迈统治者，墨守着他们荣耀的幻觉，以为可以传万世而长远。但是他们的统治是一个谎言——在他们的贪婪之压下，这个虚伪的谎言终将被粉碎。最终，虽然他们可能征服了陆地和海洋，征服了那些他们践踏过的脆弱肉体，但是他们的帝国终将崩塌，同他们一同被深埋。皇冠终会觅得新主来承受这权利之重。天将降大任于斯人，必先苦其心志，曝其弱点。”

——无名氏

2523259392.name: Eye of Another World
2523259392.flavor: When the universe conspires, its enemies cannot hide.
2523259392.lore:
Say again? You ask, are we alone here? You mean to ask if we are the only good that lives in the light of our sun, do you not? You mean to ask, do we have allies? Do we have distant allies, ignoring our plight, either too weak to fight or too afraid to show their faces? 

I, too, have been cursed by these questions. 

What if I told you that eons beyond the void lie worlds that do yearn to aid in our struggle? What if I told you there is a way to grant them passage into your mind, to let them guide your eye against our one true enemy? That they have told me that the dusk of the pyramid draws nigh? Would you believe me? 

Fool!
2523259392.lore_zh:
再说一遍？你问这里为什么只有我们？你是想问我们是否是太阳光芒中唯一的好人吧？你是想问我们是否有友军吧？我们在远方是否有把我们的现状遗忘，或是不爱露脸还是太弱了不敢战斗的友军吧？

我也一直被这些疑问折磨着。

如果我告诉你在世界外的虚空亘古之中，确实存在渴望帮助我们逃离困境的友邦？如果我告诉你有方法将他们的信息传入你的大脑，让他们指引你共同抵御我们真正的敌人？还告诉你金字塔已接近末日？你会相信吗？

白痴！

2523259393.name: Nezarec's Sin
2523259393.flavor: "He is that which is an end. And he shall rise again." —passage from Of Hated Nezarec, a pre-Golden Age text.
2523259393.lore:
"He is that which is end. That which covets sin. The final god of pain—the purest light, the darkest hour. And He shall rise again. When the guiding shine fades and all seems lost He will call to you. Fear not. All He offers is not as dark as it may seem. For Nezarec is no demon, but a fiend, arch and vile in ways unknown. He is a path and a way, one of many. And his sin—so wicked, so divine—is that he will never cower when dusk does fall, but stand vigilant as old stars die and new Light blinks its first upon this fêted eternity." 

—Passage from Of Hated Nezarec
2523259393.lore_zh:
“他就是终结，觊觎着罪孽，最后的苦痛之神——最纯洁的光辉，最黑暗的时刻。他终将再次降临。当指引之光消退，在毫无希望之时，他会召唤你。不要怕，他做的一切没有看起来那么黑暗。奈扎雷克不是恶魔，而是邪魔，你永不知他的狡诈与邪恶。他是众多如此存在中的一个。而他的罪恶——如此邪恶，却又如此神圣——夜幕降临时，他从不退缩。老旧星辰逝去时，新光闪烁出令人欢愉的初绽光芒时，他仍警戒如初。

——《被憎者奈扎雷克》选段

2954558333.name: Transversive Steps
2954558333.flavor: Your relationship with consistent spacetime is...tenuous at best.
2954558333.lore:
Tell me where you are! Account for Earth's rotation—more than 1000 kilometers per hour—your orbital velocity of 107,000 kph, your local stellar drift of 70,000 kph, your galactic orbital velocity of 792,000 kph, and our galactic drift relative to the cosmic microwave background of 1,300,000 kph. Also, account for your motion relative to me due to the accelerating expansion of space-time. 

Difficult, isn't it? But with the help of these handsome noetic devices you will find yourself deliciously and maddeningly aware of your ley velocities! Fired from an existence cannon through a whirling void the size of everything! 

And like any line of force, these vectors may be tapped, their obscene speeds diverted for your own use, although we recommend swapping them for comfortable boots before you socialize with the Merely Stationary.
2954558333.lore_zh:
告诉我你在哪儿！把地球自转算进去——时速超过1000公里——你的轨道时速是107,000公里，本地星流时速为70,000公里，我们的星系漂移相对于宇宙微波背景为130万公里。此外，由于时空的加速扩张，还要考虑你我的相对运动。

很难，对吧？但现在，我们有了这些帅气先进的智能装置，您可以得知精确的莱伊速度！现有的大炮可通过旋转虚空发射任意大小的弹药。

如同所有力线一般，您可以利用这些矢量，将它们惊人的速度为你所用。所以，在您准备进行完全静止前，我们建议您换上一双舒适的鞋。

2954558332.name: Lunafaction Boots
2954558332.flavor: "I thank you for the gift of these atoms. I will use them well." —The Stoic
2954558332.lore:
Combat is a craft and an art form. The more one masters their craft and pushes the boundaries of their art the better they understand them. After all, expertise is born of dedicated time spent focused on a subject. And we are focused. 

The Titans would have you believe that victory is won through brute force—skill plus courage plus ammunition and clenched fists. Would that it were so simple. It is not. We know this because we have studied and we have practiced. Skill can be countered. Courage can waver. And firepower is a finite necessity that must be replenished. 

But, what if firepower could be made infinite?
2954558332.lore_zh:
战斗是一门技艺和艺术形式。他们掌握的技艺越多，他们的艺术界限越远，他们也更了解它们。毕竟，专业取决于在一件事物上专注的时间。我们很专注。

泰坦让你相信胜利是通过暴力——技能加上勇气加上火力以及紧握的拳头赢得的。真的有这么简单吗？没有。我们知道事实，是因为我们学习并实践过。技能是能被克制的。勇气是可以被动摇的。火力是必须被补充的有限必需品。

但如果火力是无限的呢？

636679949.name: Ankaa Seeker IV
636679949.flavor: Focus not on the death, but on the rebirth.

1333087155.name: Ankaa Seeker IV
1333087155.flavor: The hotter the furnace, the purer the metal.

3538513130.name: Binary Phoenix Bond
3538513130.flavor: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
3538513130.lore:
What's the Crucible? Before the days of the City and the Iron Lords, it was a place to pursue vendettas. To battle for territory, and pettier reasons. The whole world was a Crucible arena. The Crucible today? To Cayde-6, it's a gambler's paradise. To Zavala, it's a resource sink where equipment goes to die. To Ikora, it's home—though she would never admit it. 

Partial answers. The tactics and techniques that will save us in wars to come are birthed in the Crucible, during live-fire training. The Vanguard are so preoccupied with their own agendas they're missing the Vanguard of tomorrow rising right before their eyes. 

Ghosts find Guardians. The Crucible forges them. 
– Lord Shaxx
3538513130.lore_zh:
熔炉竞技场是什么？在圣城与钢铁领主之前，那是个仇杀之地。更贴切地说，为了争夺领土。整个世界就是个熔炉竞技场。而今天的熔炉竞技场呢？对凯德6号来说，那是赌徒的天堂。对萨瓦拉来说，那是装备逝去的资源库。对艾可拉而言，那是家——虽然她永远不会承认这一点。

这只是答案的一部分。在战争中让我们活下来的战术和技术都源自熔炉竞技场，都于战火训练中习得。先锋总是忙于眼前的日程而不顾及明天他们就要面对的问题。

机灵寻找守护者。熔炉竞技场塑造了他们。
——领主沙克斯

1764274932.name: Ankaa Seeker IV
1764274932.flavor: We have much to teach each other.

1307478991.name: Ankaa Seeker IV
1307478991.flavor: "Developing a theory is one thing—proving it in the field, quite another. That's the beauty of the Crucible." —Ikora Rey

3763392361.name: Anti-Extinction Gloves
3763392361.flavor: "The possibility of return is slender but present. That, however, is a decision for the future." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII

2873960175.name: Anti-Extinction Robes
2873960175.flavor: "We are not a faction but a movement. At heart, we desire survival for all. This point is poorly understood." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII

4121118846.name: Stella Incognita Bond
4121118846.flavor: "At the point of decision, the Arach must lead us to safety in the midst of the unknown." —The Book of Departures, Canto II

3299588760.name: Anti-Extinction Hood
3299588760.flavor: "Isolation is not good for the Arach. Our enemies often accuse us of madness, and we cannot give them grounds. One must trust others." —The Book of Departures, Canto III

4055334203.name: Anti-Extinction Boots
4055334203.flavor: "The role of Arach is not a gift, not an honor, but a curse and a pledge of service. Many seek it nevertheless." —The Book of Departures, Canto I

807866445.name: Simulator Gloves
807866445.flavor: "I see a submerged Earth. I see humanity in crude boats, battered, drifting. I see them fight what rises from the deeps. Fight and win." —RECORD 463-CHASM-3102

3656154099.name: Simulator Robes
3656154099.flavor: "She just fainted? Didn't say anything? No, 'great wyrm' doesn't mean anything to me."  —RECORD 462-CHASM-3103

1566612778.name: Entanglement Bond
1566612778.flavor: "A dazzling flash. Blinding. All-consuming. I saw nothing more." —RECORD 460-CHASM-1004

2401598772.name: Simulator Hood
2401598772.flavor: "Her back is always turned to us. It's almost as if she knows we're watching." —RECORD 459-CHASM-1002

1478665487.name: Simulator Legs
1478665487.flavor: "Many Ghosts, whispering like a stream. I walked among them, listening, but could not understand." —RECORD 460-CHASM-1022

4083497488.name: Sovereign Gloves
4083497488.flavor: "The hand of the law must fall impartially on the rich and the poor, the powerful and the weak. This is required of both rulers and the Executors who serve them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6

2436244536.name: Sovereign Robes
2436244536.flavor: "While our wealth is not meant for personal use, we should remember that a taste of luxury can be instructive, even persuasive." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13

831738837.name: Coronation Bond
831738837.flavor: "The sign of New Monarchy should come to mean comfort, safety, and strength." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 1

316745113.name: Sovereign Hood
316745113.flavor: "We pursue an unrealized ideal, but we do so clearly, without illusions." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 9

147165546.name: Sovereign Legs
147165546.flavor: "The time to walk away from a poor candidate is before the crown is offered. Executors must test and dismiss many thousands without guarantee of success." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 10

2378296024.name: Xenos Vale IV
2378296024.flavor: There is no City without the Warlocks.

34846448.name: Xenos Vale IV
34846448.flavor: We were all strangers once. Even the Traveler.

3215392301.name: Xenos Vale Bond
3215392301.flavor: New things are only strange until you behold them. Then they are even stranger.
3215392301.lore:
The bar's still missing its roof, and the air smells like rain. 

Cayde-6 sits in the bar with his chair tipped, holding a shot of something acid green. He looks at you, counts the beads of sweat on Zavala's mug, and sighs. "Are we doing this, or what? C'mon, I'm rusting." 

Zavala straightens and clears his throat. "The Vanguard will continue until we are no longer needed, but I can foresee the day when you will…" He pauses, searching your face. 

The moment drags. Cayde juts his chin forward. Ikora hides a smile, then lifts her glass to you. "When you will surpass us." 

"Wait, what?" Cayde's chair drops heavily. He leans forward. "'Surpass' us? I didn't agree to that! This is a 'great job being a hero' party, not a 'Cayde is second-best' party." 

Ikora winks at you. "It's always been a 'Cayde is second-best' party."
3215392301.lore_zh:
酒吧的屋顶一直没有找到，空气闻起来很潮湿。

凯德6号斜着椅子坐在酒吧里，拿着酸绿的酒。他看向你，数着萨瓦拉脸上的汗珠，叹息道，“我们真要这么做吗，还有没有别的办法？快点儿，我都要生锈了。”

萨瓦拉坐直，清了清嗓。“只要我们被需要，先锋就会一直继续。但我能预见到你……”他停了下来，想看看你的表情。

时间仿佛停滞。凯德探出脸来，艾可拉忍住笑，对你举起杯。“你超过我们的那天。”

“等等，你说什么？”凯德的椅子重重地摔到了地上。他向前一倾。“‘超过'我们？这么说不对！这是个‘时势造英雄'的团体，不是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

艾可拉冲你眨眨眼。“这一直都是‘凯德第二佳'团体。”

1540376513.name: Xenos Vale IV
1540376513.flavor: It demands a swift and terrible response.

413460498.name: Xenos Vale IV
413460498.flavor: The realm of the strange is the Warlock's home.

2421406347.name: Wise Warlock Gloves
2421406347.flavor: Your arsenal consists not just of guns and grenades—but of the universe's secrets.

1331814296.name: Wise Warlock Bond
1331814296.flavor: "If you dedicate yourself to the study of the universe, it will always reveal its secrets to you." —Ikora Rey
1331814296.lore:
Look around you. Wherever you are. Really look. 
No matter where you stand, no matter what lies before you, millions of infinite mysteries hide within your view. Think about that. And then know that you will one day know the answers to all of them. 
You are a Warlock. Your armor is wisdom, your weapons wit and ingenuity. You hold the power to draw strength from the places where imagination and possibility collide. 
The universe is a complex machine. But all machines can be understood, taken apart, modified, improved. 
All you have to do is look. 

—Ikora Rey
1331814296.lore_zh:
环顾四周，无论你身处何处，看仔细。

无论你站在何处，无论你前方有何物，其中都蕴藏着千万个无尽奥秘。好好想一下，总有一天你会参透所有这一切的答案。

你是一名术士。睿智是你的护甲，智慧和巧思是你的武器，从想象力和可能性碰撞的火花中吸取力量。
宇宙是一个复杂的机器。但所有的机器都可以被解读、拆分、修改和改良。
你要做的，就是去看。

——艾可拉·蕾伊

3081865122.name: Wise Warlock Hood
3081865122.flavor: Your greatest weapon is your mind.

234415107.name: Damaged Warlock Gloves

2416634317.name: Damaged Warlock Robe

1256569366.name: Raven Shard

2505533224.name: Ghost Primus
2505533224.flavor: The Ghost Primus was strong because of his disfigurement, not in spite of it. He alone had the vision to share my dream of a new, perfect world. Ghaul was a creature of singular beauty, and I loved him.
2505533224.lore:
Ghaul was an unexpected gift to my coliseum—a disfigured albino from the outer wastes who defeated opponents three times his weight. How could I resist such a unique creature? 

He fought with terrible discipline and patience. Most gladiators wanted to stand in the center of the arena and trade blows until the weaker one died. Not Ghaul. He never attacked from the front, never stood in one place. Frustrated and exhausted, his opponent would make a mistake. 

I used to play a game with those puffed-up aristocrats that would gamble at my arena. I bet on Ghaul, and anyone who had displeased me had to bet against him. It was fun for a time, but his talent was too valuable to risk in the coliseum. I appointed him Primus of the Red Legion and instead, set him loose upon my enemies.
2505533224.lore_zh:
盖欧是我大竞技场里的一个意外收获——一位来自外太空垃圾堆的、毁容了的白化病病人，却击败了三倍于他体重的敌人。我怎么能拒绝一个如此独特的生物呢？

他战斗起来毫无纪律和耐心。大部分角斗士想要站在竞技场的中心和对手厮杀，直到弱的一方死掉为止。但盖欧不是。他从不从正面进攻，也从不在同一个位置停留。对手因此感到疲惫且受挫，从而犯下错误。

我曾经和那些自负的贵族们在我的竞技场玩一种赌博游戏。我把筹码押在盖欧身上，所有让我不爽的人都必须押在他对手身上。来上这么一次还是挺有趣的，但他的才华太珍贵了，不应该在大竞技场里冒险。我任命他为猩红军团的军团长，让他自由屠杀我的敌人。

1128225405.name: Midnight Coup
1128225405.flavor: The conspirators were too afraid to kill me—rightly so. I am the beloved father of the people, and the glorious mob would not suffer my death. My sentence was exile.
1128225405.lore:
The conspirators came late in the night, skulking into my court while we caroused. Ghaul himself led the coup, and it was by his own Red Legion that we were arrested. 

Imagine my surprise to see the Consul stride into my court so puffed up with pride. He took cheap pleasure hurling spittle in my face. We were frog marched to the Leviathan under cover of darkness. 

There was to be no execution; Ghaul and the Consul feared the mob. They knew how tenuous their grip on power would be, and how the people adored their god-emperor. 

Ghaul dared not look me in the eye. What was the emotion on his face? Was it shame? How could he bear such hate for one who had been as a father to him? 

We were sealed inside the Leviathan and ejected into the furthest reaches of space, left to the same fate I had determined for the Consul so long ago. We were left to die.
1128225405.lore_zh:
阴谋家们在深夜前来，在我们饮酒作乐时潜入我的宫殿。领导政变的是盖欧本人，我们就是被他手下的猩红军团抓捕的。

你能想象当我看到领事大步踱入宫殿时有多惊讶吗？他粗鲁地朝我脸上猛啐一口。我们是在黑暗笼罩下向利维坦挺进的青蛙。

没有处决；盖欧和领事对暴民心存忌惮。他们知道他们对权力的掌控有多么不稳定，而人民又是如此崇拜他们如神的帝王。

盖欧不敢直视我的眼睛。他脸上那是什么表情？是羞愧吗？他是如何忍受对这个曾经像父亲一样的人的恨？

我们被关在利维坦中，被弹射到太空的最边缘，落得个很久以前我为领事决定的相同命运。我们被抛弃，等待死亡。

3325744914.name: Inaugural Address
3325744914.flavor: My first act as emperor was to send the Consul into the wasteland. The golden sun would burn away his corrupt form—a fitting symbol for the revolution that was to be my reign.
3325744914.lore:
I wanted a desert of pure white sand to stage my celebration. It took them three days to clear the wasteland of any stone or plant of offending color, but when they were done, it was a perfect canvas for the violet pavilion. We recreated my court in nearly every detail beneath the glinting sun. 

 The first act of my coronation was to have the Consul kneel at my feet. He was a pathetic figure, stripped of title, rank, and clothing. He would never wield power again, and would beget no heir. I made sure of that personally. 

I had only a single word for him: "Run."
3325744914.lore_zh:
我想要一片纯白色沙砾构成的沙漠来作为典礼舞台。他们花了三天的时间清理了荒原上各种异色的石头或植物。他们完成时，那洁白的砂砾和紫罗兰的阁楼简直是绝配。我们将宫殿建在了闪耀的阳光下，还原了几乎每一个细节。

我加冕仪式后做的第一件事，就是让领事跪在我的面前。他真可怜，被罢免、被剥夺军衔，甚至被扒光了衣服。他将永远不会再操纵权力，也不能再诞下子嗣。这一点是我亲手处理的。

我只送了他一个字：“滚。”

3691881271.name: Sins of the Past
3691881271.flavor: What once was old shall be new again, and history will have its revenge.
3691881271.lore:
I weep for what the Cabal have become—a war machine forged in Ghaul's own image. His obsession with the ideal form has produced a hollow people devoid of culture, robbed of their history. 

The Leviathan is now home to the last of us true Cabal. We will remember the old ways, for I am the wellspring from which our great civilization flows. 

And when my empire returns, the traitors will see us as through a dark mirror. We will be a terrifying reminder of their former selves. In that moment, they will feel the shame of their betrayal. They will know I have come for my revenge. 

The Red Legion will not escape the sins of their past. They shall be consumed by them.
3691881271.lore_zh:
我为卡巴尔的下场感到伤悲——盖欧用自己的形象将他们打造成了战争机器。那份对理想形式的痴迷打造出了一个没有文化，没有历史的族群。

利维坦现在是我们这些仅剩的真正的卡巴尔家园。我们不会遗忘古老之道，因为我就是我们伟大文明传承的源泉。

当我的帝国回归时，我们将是他们的黑镜子，是对过去他们所作所为的可怕提醒者。在那一刻，他们将感受到背叛的耻辱。他们将看到我的复仇。

猩红军团将永远逃脱不了过去罪孽的牢笼。他们会被罪孽吞噬。

3906942101.name: Conspirator
3906942101.flavor: Did Ghaul always dream of a republic? What terrible worm burrowed into his heart that he would betray my love and plot against me?
3906942101.lore:
Ghaul spent too much time in too close communion with those I had humbled. No good would come of those hushed tones and sidelong glances. Did he think I would not notice? 

I dispatched a spy to follow him. To think that I felt guilt in that moment; one should never doubt their gut when it comes to trust in another.  

I realize now what I should have realized then. As I am like no other, then no other is alone as I. What a curse it is to be a god that loves!
3906942101.lore_zh:
盖欧花了太多时间在与我的手下败将近距离交流上。那些轻语和斜窥能代表什么好结果。他以为我会注意不到吗？

我派了一个间谍跟踪他。你可以认为我在那一刻其实产生了某种负罪感；但当需要将信任交给别人时，也不能怀疑自己的直觉。

我现在意识到了当时就应该意识到的事。既然我与他人不同，他人也不会如我一般孤独。成为爱世人的神真的是种诅咒！

3380742308.name: Alone as a god
3380742308.flavor: I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me.
3380742308.lore:
My imperial guard marched into the temple where the senate convened. They formed a protective circle from which I might bestow the gift of my address. 

"From this day forward, I shall take up all the empire in my embrace. For I am father of the empire, as I am father to all creation. I will suffer no tired institution nor petty bureaucrat to stand between me and my children. I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me." 

The imperial guard charged their rail guns in perfect unison.
3380742308.lore_zh:
我的帝国守卫步入了议会召开的神庙。他们形成了一个保护圈以便我可以开始我的演讲。

“从今天开始，我会欣然接管帝国之土。我是帝国的主人，我是世间万物的主人。在我和我的子民之间，将不会再有令人生厌的组织和琐碎的官僚主义。每个谈论起我的人都激动到发抖，我就是至善爱神。”

帝国守卫以完美步调为磁道炮上了膛。

3954531357.name: Mob Justice
3954531357.flavor: Life offers few greater pleasures than to humiliate the venal aristocracy before a crowd. I am father to the people, and they shall adore me above all others.
3954531357.lore:
I never thought of my palace as the true court. The only throne that mattered to me looked down upon the public commons. From that seat, there was no barrier between me and the glorious, adoring mob. I was their father; they were my children. 

It was there that I brought the corrupt to suffer the people's justice. How they cried as I threw their riches to the crowd. It amused me to see the dawning of realization in their eyes—there would be no safety for them, as there had been no safety for those they had made to suffer. 

One by one, I tossed those weeping fools to the people. The mob let out a great cry of joy and stripped them of their robes, tore the jewelry from their bodies.
3954531357.lore_zh:
我从未把我的宫殿看做真正的宫廷。对我来说，真正的王位是那个俯瞰普罗大众的王座。在那王座上，我与那些充满荣耀和爱慕的暴民之间毫无隔阂。我是他们的家长，他们是我的子民。

在那里，我将腐朽暴露于天下，接受人民的审判。当我将他们的财富扔向人群时，我听到了他们的哭喊和人群的雀跃。看到腐朽们的眼中开始出现现实的曙光时，我感到愉悦——他们不再安全，就像被他们折磨过的人一样不安全。

一个接着一个，我把那些擦着眼泪的傻瓜丢入人群。暴民们爆发出喜悦的呐喊，剥下了他们的袍子，扯下了他们身上的珠宝。

1018072983.name: It Stared Back
1018072983.flavor: At the edge of the universe, I stared into the infinite deep. It stared back, and was pleased. I would become the herald of its victory, and bear witness for all creation.
1018072983.lore:
The Leviathan came to a halt before a wall of infinite void. It could go no further, as the navigation system had suffered a cataclysmic failure. The course that the conspirators had set crossed a space that simply didn't exist. 

I don't know how long we traveled. Years? Millennia? Time had ceased to have meaning as I wallowed in the despair of my exile. But this event shook me out of my stupor. At the edge of the universe, we had found something. No—we had found a nothing. 

From the seat of my observation chamber, I stared into the perfect void. Only I, a god, could understand what I witnessed. It was a thing greater than myself. And if such a thing exists, then I, too, can become more.
1018072983.lore_zh:
利维坦在一堵无尽虚空之墙前停了下来。导航系统彻底崩溃，无法再继续前进了。阴谋家们设定的路线穿过了一个根本不存在的空间。

我不知道我们走了多久。几年？一千年？在沉溺于被放逐的绝望后，时间变得不再有意义。但这件事让我从恍惚中惊醒。在宇宙的边缘，我们找到了某个存在。不——我们找到了“不存在”。

坐在观察室的座位上，我凝视着完美虚空。只有，我，一位神祇，才能懂得我目睹了什么。一个比我自己更伟大的存在。若此物存在，那么，我，也将变得更强大。

174804902.name: The Long Walk
174804902.flavor: "There is an end to everything." —Emissary of the Nine
174804902.source: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
174804902.source_zh: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。
174804902.lore:
[Eight sparks. A ninth, dim in the corner. And Orin in the middle.] 
ORIN: Are we all here? Come into the light, please. 
G-9: I like where I am. 
ORIN: They said you all went to the deep without a ship. How? 
G-7: Our charges are gone, but we're still creatures of Light. No different from the one you carry in your pocket. 
ORIN: You're all either very brave or very foolish. 
G-6: You sound like Shaxx. 
G-5: She does. I'm glad my charge is gone. 
G-4: Don't say that. 
G-5: It's true. 
G-4: Don't say it out loud. Some of us go our whole lives without finding one. Show some respect. 
G-5: Don't talk like you're better than me. You're in here, too. 
ORIN: Please. I'm sorry to call you all here, but— 
G-2: You're not sorry. 
ORIN: I need to know what you found out there. 
G-9: Nothing. 
ORIN: At least give me the coordinates.
174804902.lore_zh:
[八个火花。还有第九个，在角落发着微弱的光。奥琳站在它们中间。]
奥琳：都到齐了吗？请进到光里面。
机-9：我就想待在这儿。
奥琳：他们说你们在没有飞船的情况下就前往了深空。怎么办到的？
机-7：我们无法充能，但我们依然是光能的产物。和你带在口袋里的那个没有区别。
奥琳：你们如果不是非常勇敢，就是非常愚蠢。
机-6：这口气听起来像沙克斯。
机-5：确实像。很高兴我无法充能。
机-4：别那么说。
机-5：是真的。
机-4：那也别说那么大声。我们之中有些人穷极一生也无法充一次能。给点儿面子。
机-5：别说的好像你比我强一样。你不是也在这里。
奥琳：拜托。不好意思把你们都叫过来，但——
机-2：没什么不好意思的。
奥琳：我想知道你们在那里找到了什么。
机-9：没什么。
奥琳：至少把坐标给我吧。

2683682447.flavor: The true Emperor of the Cabal invites you to strike down his faithless foe.

2683682446.name: Traitor's Fate
2683682446.flavor: Let the Emperor's gratitude end your foes as swiftly as you have ended his.
2683682446.lore:
Know that I am Calus, the last and greatest emperor of the Cabal. Know that the Ghost Primus was false and that your place in my court was secured when he met the Traitor's Fate. Finally, my champion, little else stands between us.

Look to the heavens and you will see me with my arms spread wide. Fly to me and I will bathe you in gold, share the fruits of my gardens, and watch you grow dizzy on libations.

Know that my heart swells with love. I yearn to find those who can accept my gifts, who can take my hand, and share in my mirth.

Together we shall rebuild an empire.
2683682446.lore_zh:
要知道，我是卡鲁斯，是卡巴尔最后也是最伟大的帝王。要知道，幽灵军团长是虚假的；他终迎来了自己的叛徒命运，而我也为你在帝国中留存了一席之地。我的勇士，你我之间终于再无阻碍了。

抬头看看天堂，你将看到翅膀伸展至天际的我。飞向我，我将用黄金沐浴你，用园中鲜果滋润你，用奠酒微醺你。

要知道，我心中满满的都是爱。我渴望寻求到有能力接受我礼物、握紧我的手、与我分享欢笑的人。

你我合作，重建帝国。

1345867571.name: Coldheart
1345867571.flavor: The latest Omolon engineering leverages liquid fuel as coolant to keep weapon systems at biting subzero temperatures.
1345867571.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1345867571.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1345867571.lore:
The Golden Age. Our shining history. The height from which we fell. Once, everything we had was borrowed from the past. Since the Collapse we have struggled to reclaim even a scrap of what our ancestors once took for granted. Over the years, Omolon has perfected the art of salvaging Golden Age technologies and repurposing them into effective Guardian weaponry. 

But Coldheart is something new. 

We didn't find Coldheart. We didn't adapt it or recycle it. We created it. Its liquid ammo, which doubles as its coolant, is a game-changer on its own—never mind Coldheart's first-of-its-kind laser-powered trace weaponry.  

With Coldheart, we at Omolon are saying: we want more than to simply reclaim the Golden Age. We want to surpass it.
1345867571.lore_zh:
黄金时代。我们闪耀的历史。也是从那时我们开始衰落。曾经，我们拥有的一切都是过去留下的。在大崩溃后，我们开始努力找寻祖先们一度认为理所当然的哪怕一块碎片。多年过去，Omolon将回收的黄金时代科技打磨完善，并将其重新应用在现有守护者武器库中。

但寒冰核心的出现是一场革新。

寒冰核心不是我们找到的，也不是我们改造或回收的。它是我们创造的。同所配置的冷却液一样，它所装填的液体子弹也是双倍数量，游戏规则就此改写——更不用提寒冰核心是第一款激光追踪武器。

我们Omolon带着寒冰核心一同保证：我们的梦想不单单局限于回收黄金时代技术，我们要超越它的辉煌。

1345867570.name: Sweet Business
1345867570.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1345867570.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1345867570.lore:
"Hope you're happy!" That's all I remember hearin' afore she ran out in front of us. It was like somethin' out of a pre-Golden Age war flick, you know, where the hero's bud goes out in a blaze of glory so their death can be rightly avenged. Only she didn't die. They did. The weapon reeled like it was bein' held by a child doin' a pee-pee dance, aimin' at nothin' and hittin' everythin'. Dem spiders skittered for their lives. When she stopped, nothin' was moving. She saved us. 

I sidled up to her, real slow, checking out the piece and all I could do was sputter, "That there, that's some… sweet business." She looked me over cold, lowered the gun and said, "You ain't gotta tell me."
1345867570.lore_zh:
“希望这样子你们能感觉好点儿！”在她跑到我们面前时我记得的只有这句。就像一些前黄金时代战争的片段闪过眼前。你知道的，就是那场战亡者都得到了应有的复仇的战争，因为英雄主义的萌芽在荣耀中绽放。其他人都死了，只有她没有。她拔出武器的动作就像小孩子在跳撒尿舞，从不瞄准，什么都打。蜘蛛都飞起来逃命。她停止射击时，万物寂静。她救了我们。

我在一旁看着她慢慢检查着那些碎尸，而我被吓得言语混乱，“那这里，那有一些……你会喜欢的东西。”她的眼睛穿过压低的冰冷的枪，盯着我，对我说，“用不着提醒我。”

4190156464.name: Merciless
4190156464.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
4190156464.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
4190156464.lore:
"The thought was simple enough—sync a weapon's firing and targeting systems to a caged onboard artificial intelligence programmed to actively seek fulfillment of the weapon's base driving function. Simply put, give the weapon an awareness of its purpose. 

"If the machine is meant to destroy, what would happen if we made it aware of its intended goal? 

"What would happen if it reacted to any failure to achieve that goal by focusing more intently on defining the parameters of said goal and adjusting its function to more aggressively seek out the successful execution of its purpose? 

"These are the questions we asked ourselves while engineering the initial prototype. The answers we found—I think you'll agree—were encouraging." 

– Incomplete record, author unknown
4190156464.lore_zh:
“想法很简单——将武器的射击和瞄准系统同步到一个盒状机载智能程序，来主动实现武器的基础驾驭功能。简而言之，我们想为武器添加自我意识系统。

“武器机械的目的是摧毁，如果我们让它意识到这个目的，会发生什么？

“如果它更加专注于确定所述目标参数并为了成功达到预期目的将功能设置的更加激进后，对目标失败做出反应，又会发生什么？

“这些问题在我们设计原型机时已经考虑过了。我们的答案是——我想你也会同意——不要阻碍科技的进步。”

——无名氏，不完整记录

3549153978.name: Fighting Lion
3549153978.flavor: "I call it the Zhang Fei. It hits almost as hard as I do." —Wei Ning
3549153978.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3549153978.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3549153978.lore:
Wei Ning punched the mountain. It moved.  A microscopic shudder, but enough to make her punch it again. "They're just angry that you keep winning without a gun." Her Ghost danced fretfully around her fist. "That's why they say these things. Jealousy." 

"I tell you," Ning grunted, shattering granite, "someday they'll lose their smart guns and fancy ships, and then they'll wish they'd listened! There's one weapon you can always count on, and it's your strong hand." 

"Eriana would be sad to hear you dismissing machines." Her Ghost bobbed slyly up to her shoulder. "Eriana would ask if those mighty hands could build a machine in the image of your strength. Just like she was made in the image of a woman." 

Wei Ning tapped her fists together. "Huh," she said.
3549153978.lore_zh:
韦宁猛锤山峰。它动了。小小的颤动，但给了她再次猛击的理由。“他们只是生气你没用枪却还一直胜利而已。”她的机灵绕着她的拳头不安地跳着舞。“所以他们才这么说的啊，都是因为嫉妒。”

“我告诉你，”宁打碎了花岗岩，嘟囔着说，“总有一天，他们会失去他们所有漂亮的枪支和精美的飞船，然后他们就会后悔当初没有听从我的建议！你永远靠得住的武器，只有你强劲的拳头。”

“爱莲娜要是听说你在反对机械可是会很伤心的。”机灵调皮地跳上她的肩膀。“爱莲娜会问这些强壮的人们会不会制造一个以你的力量为形象的机器。就像她是以一个女人的形象被制造出来的一样。”

韦宁撞着双拳。“呵，”她说。

3549153979.name: The Prospector
3549153979.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3549153979.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3549153979.lore:
"Get your axe and your pick and your shovel and your spine. We're goin' prospectin'." 
"What?" 
"That. The quote. I don't get it." 
"It's an old saying. It's about puttin' in a hard day's work." 
"Seems… antiquated." 
"How so?"
"My grenade launcher's full auto and goes boom on command. What do I need hand tools for?" 
"It's a metaphor. It ain't literal. At least not anymore. Your launcher is your hand tool." 
"Ahh. Got it. Good to know."
3549153979.lore_zh:
“拿起斧子，拾起铁铲，挺起腰杆。我们去挖矿。”
“什么？”
“那句，顺口溜，我没听明白。”
“是句老话。就是搬一天砖。”
“貌似……需要改一下。”
“哪有？”
“我的发射器正全自动运作，随叫随炸。那我需要手动工具做什么？”
“这是个比喻。不是字面意思。至少现在不是了。你的发射器就是你的手动工具。”
“啊，明白。这样就对了。”

2907129556.name: Sturm
2907129556.flavor: These ancient ceremonial pistols can be dated back to the early Golden Age. A faded inscription reads, "To Sigrun, from Victor."
2907129556.source: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower
2907129556.lore:
"Please! You don't understand. I'm supposed to be on that ship." 

The guard smiled at Sigrun with gentle condescension. "That's not possible, ma'am." 

She understood why he would believe that; all of the colonists had entered cryo two weeks ago, but she could see the crew waving for pictures. They were awake! She could be awake, too. "I'm supposed to be on that ship," she insisted, leaning around the guard. There was still time. She could find whatever horrible cryo-coffin they'd loaded Victor into; she could kneel before it and beg him to forgive her. He wouldn't hear her but he wasn't gone yet— 

"I need you to take a step back, ma'am." 

"Captain Jacobson!" Sigrun darted past the guard. "I'm a colonist! You can't leave without me!"
2907129556.lore_zh:
“求求你！你不知道，我应该在那艘船上的。”

守卫向西格伦露出一抹同情的微笑。“这不可能，女士。”
她知道为什么他会这么想；所有移民者在两周前就进入了冬眠，但她依然可以看到船员们在相机前面招手合照。他们还醒着！她也可以醒着啊。“我应该在那艘船上的，”她在守卫旁坚持着。还有时间。她可以找到像他们装维克托那样的低温恐怖棺材；她可以双膝跪地祈求他原谅她。他听不到她说话，但他还活着——

“女士，请靠后一些。”

“雅各布森船长！”西格伦冲过守卫。“我也是移民者！你不能丢下我！”

2907129557.name: Sunshot
2907129557.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2907129557.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2907129557.lore:
She bowed her head, heat shimmering from her fist. A silent salute to the Hive closing around her, their eyes forming a glowing jade ring. 

She was a Sunbreaker. A mercenary from days before the City. Not like the new Lights from the Tower. She was weary. But there was no rest out here, where the City Lights didn't reach. She and her allies were committed to their arduous, solitary task. But they could always use more numbers. 

Sometimes, they left trinkets for the City. Meant as challenge and bribe at once—we offer you this. Come find us. 

She had forged the Warlock gauntlets herself. Ouros laughed in her face when she told her their name. She wasn't very good at names. 

A gun. She would forge a gun, next. It would speak like her Hammer. And burn like fire. The ring of jade eyes closed on her. Liu Feng laughed, her arms open for a fiery embrace.
2907129557.lore_zh:
她低下了头，拳头渐渐发热。对拢向她的邪魔族无声致意，它们的眼睛连成了一轮翡翠绿环。

她曾是一名炎阳。和高塔中新的光能者不一样的是，她在圣城时代之前就是一名雇佣兵。她觉得有些累，但在圣城光芒照不到的地方，战争从未停歇。她和她的盟军奋力去完成那些艰难又孤独的任务。但人手总是不够。

有时，他们为圣城留下些小的战利品，作为一种挑战和贿赂——我们能拿到这个，来加入我们。

她独自制造了术士臂铠。当她告诉大家这个名字时，奥罗斯当着她的面笑出来了。她不太擅长取名字。

一把枪，下次她可以造一把枪。像她的战锤一样铿锵有力，像烈焰一样熊熊燃烧。翡翠绿环更近了。刘枫失笑，张开双臂，迎接面前这惨烈的拥抱。

3628991659.name: Vigilance Wing
3628991659.flavor: "The eye remains open. The Lighthouse remains lit." —Brother Vance
3628991659.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3628991659.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3628991659.lore:
"What you hold was once a beacon. We came out of the shadows seeking those willing to join our search. We staged the trials in his name. It was once a reward for the chosen few— the ones who persevered when all seemed lost." 

 "It was forged as a testament to his resolve, to seek answers where no one else cared to look and to continue down the path so many fell blazing. In your hands is proof that those who earned its firepower never gave up and never lost their way. You may not know the legend of Osiris or ever dared our trials, but should we call on you, will you honor the heralds who earned this weapon's honor and continue the hunt?" 

 – Brother Vance, Disciple of Osiris
3628991659.lore_zh:
“你拿着的曾经是个信标。我们从暗影中出来，寻找那些想要加入搜寻的人。我们以他的名义举行了试炼。这曾经是给被选中的几个人的奖励——那几个看起来失去了一切依然坚持着的人。”

“那是一个对他的决心，对那些其他人并未留意寻找和继续而燃烧的答案的证明。你的手中是那些永不言败且永不迷失的战士的证明。你或许不了解奥斯里斯的传奇，或许没有勇气接受试炼，但我们在此号召。你是那个会获得赢得这把武器荣耀并继续狩猎的人吗？”

——奥斯里斯门徒，万斯修士

3628991658.name: Graviton Lance
3628991658.flavor: Think of space-time as a tapestry on a loom. This weapon is the needle.
3628991658.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3628991658.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3628991658.lore:
"So wait, that thing you found does… what?" 
"It fires black holes." 
"No it doesn't." 
"Oh yeah. It does. Actual, tiny, bullet-sized black holes." 
 "Did you tell the others?" 
"Only that I found some weird gun in some overgrown tunnel back on Old Chicago. And that my Ghost was all, "THIS is why we were led here…'" 
"Yours talks that way too?" 
"What do you think?" 
"OK, OK, but the gun—are you going to tell them?" 
"Yeah, definitely." 
"When?" 
"Crucible." 
"Oh no." 
"Oh, yes."
3628991658.lore_zh:
“稍等，你找到的这东西干了……什么？”
“它能发射黑洞。”
“不，它不能的。”
“哦，它可以的。准确来说，是子弹大小的黑洞。”
“你告诉其他人了吗？”
“我在旧芝加哥的一些杂草丛生的隧道里找到了一些诡异的枪，我的机灵只会说，‘就是这些把我们召唤来的……'”
“你的机灵也这么说话啊？”
“那你以为呢？”
“好吧好吧，但关于这把枪——你打算告诉他们吗？”
“对呀，肯定的。”
“什么时候？”
“在熔炉竞技场的时候。”
“哦，不会吧。”
“哈，会的。”

1508896098.name: The Wardcliff Coil
1508896098.flavor: Ingenuity. Desperation. A haphazard prototype of terrible power. Such were the factors at play in the Wardcliff Incident.
1508896098.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1508896098.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1508896098.lore: HAMIT'S LOG. The lead is good, but so are the Fallen tracking me. I swear on my Ghost there's a hundred camped outside. I'm cornered in the lab and they're using Shanks to run me out of ammunition. War cultist, arm thyself; at least it's a weapons lab. This, er, rustic device was once an experimental axion emitter, which sprays weird particles to light up the basement of the universe. Right here I've coupled the emitter to some catacaustic quark-gluon coils, which will not, due to my scrupulous safety checking, create a strangelet that devours the Earth. I cook up some pain in there, the microverse decays, and the result comes out here. If it doesn't work, well, please name the crater after me.
1508896098.lore_zh: 哈米特的日志。线索很有用，但是跟踪我的那些堕落者也很厉害。我以我的机灵发誓，他们在外面至少有上百人驻扎。我被堵在实验室里，他们利用侦察机耗光了我的子弹。战争狂热者，拿起武器来；这里好歹是个武器实验室。这个，呃，生锈的装置曾经是一个实验性量子发射器，它能发射奇怪的粒子照亮整个宇宙的地下室。在这里我把发射器跟一些焦散夸克氢氨乙酸进行结合。经过我严谨的安全检查，它并不能制造出什么吞噬地球的奇异物质。在那里我遭受了苦痛，微宇宙消散了，但得出了结果。如果它没能成功，请用我的名字为那个坑命名。

4255268456.name: Skyburner's Oath
4255268456.flavor: The inscription, written in a Cabal dialect, reads: "Inexorable victory."
4255268456.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
4255268456.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
4255268456.lore:
Some grunts are born to fight the war. Yes, they're loyal and true, and when the call comes "hot drop in five," well, they're always first in the queue. But I'm not one of them. I'm no hero, I'm in no hurry to die. I shot my own squad on Phobos, when death came to wear us like armor. I rode the Primus's ship that rammed the Hive Dreadnaught. Second wave out the hatch. We won that fight. We're not dead, so we won. 

Now this is the end, brothers, our final fight. Ghaul's here to finish it. Mars taught us how to fight Guardians. The Hive taught us how to eat their Light. Remember that we made it possible. The Red Legion ends it. But we held the line, and we didn't die. That's victory. It says so on the gun.
4255268456.lore_zh:
有些战士生而为战。是的，他们忠诚又真实，而当"五人一组伞降"的命令传来时，对的，他们总是站在队列最前面。我不是那些战士。我不是英雄，不想死那么早。当死亡犹如我们身着的护甲一样如影随形时，我在火卫一上朝自己的小队开了枪。我驾驶着军团长的飞船猛冲向虫群的无畏战舰。我们赢了那场战斗。我们没死，所以我们赢了。

兄弟们，就要结束了，这是我们的最后一战。盖欧想在这里结束一切。火星教会了我们如何与守护者作战。虫群教会了我们如何吞噬他们的光能。记住，是我们让这一切变为可能。是猩红军团终结一切。但只要我们守住战线，保住性命，就是胜利。枪上是这么写的。

3580904581.name: Tractor Cannon
3580904581.flavor: Property of Ishtar Collective. WARNING: Gravity propulsor beam can cause serious injury or even death.
3580904581.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3580904581.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3580904581.lore:
Chioma Esi met Maya in their undergraduate gym. They got into an argument about deadlifting: was it necessary, was it practical, why was Chioma making so much noise? Maya Sundaresh just couldn't stand the notion that some things were done for their own sake, not because they had any use. 

Decades later they joined the Ishtar Collective on Venus to study the enigmatic ruins unearthed by the Traveler's terraforming. The first time it happened—Vex code leaping across an airgap, surfing the quantum vacuum from simulation to reality, infecting a utility frame—Chioma pulled an alarm while Maya tried to grab the precious frame with a cargo-grade gravity grapple. She couldn't lift the grapple. Chioma grabbed it, pinned the frame to the wall, and won the argument.
3580904581.lore_zh:
希欧玛在大学体育馆里见到了玛雅。他们关于硬拉的问题吵了起来：它必要吗，实用吗，希欧玛怎么这么吵？玛雅·桑戴尔什根本无法容忍一些东西的存在是没有原因、没有用处的这种观念。

几十年后，他们加入了金星的伊什塔集团，研究旅行者地球化后的神秘废墟。他们第一次吵架——是Vex代码从空气隙中泄露出来了，在模拟现实的量子真空中游走，感染了一处功能框架。在玛雅试着用一个货物等级的重力钩抓住珍贵的框架时，希欧玛拉响了警报。她拿不动那个钩子。希欧玛抓住了它，把框架钉在墙上，赢得了争吵的胜利。

3580904580.name: Legend of Acrius
3580904580.flavor: "In the Cabal legend, a hero seeks to possess the sun. He succeeds. Then, he becomes Emperor. The Cabal… are not a subtle people." —Tyra Karn
3580904580.source: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower
3580904580.lore:
That really is the entire myth. A Cabal named Acrius desires the sun, and he takes it and becomes the first Emperor of the Cabal. Other scholars have already noted the parallels and differences with our own ancient Earth myth of Icarus, which famously has a far more humbling ending. I am more interested in how Cabal leaders throughout history have deployed this legend as a rhetorical and political justification for conquest. Among the most relevant such figures is Dominus Ghaul himself, who appears to have a personal affinity for the Acrius myth. 

I must also note here that, while linguistic analysis of the Cabal language and its many dialects is incomplete, they do not appear to have a word for the concept of "hubris." 
—Research notes of Tyra Karn
3580904580.lore_zh:
完整的神话真的是这样的。一个叫做阿克瑞斯的卡巴尔想要太阳，他就夺取了太阳并成为了卡巴尔的第一任皇帝。其他学者指出这与我们古老地球的伊卡洛斯神话的相似与不同，后者以一个更为谦逊的结局而著名。我更感兴趣的是历史上所有的卡巴尔领导人是如何利用这个神话作为征服正当性的修饰和政治理由的。这些人物中被影响最大的就是尊主盖欧本人，他个人似乎和阿克瑞斯神话有着密切关系。

在这里我必须指出，虽然针对卡巴尔语言及其诸多方言的语言学分析尚未完成，但是他们似乎没有一个表达“骄傲自大”概念的词。
——泰拉·卡恩的研究记录

2362471600.flavor: Since the Collapse, these pistols have been retooled several times to boost their firepower. A worn inscription reads, "To Victor, from Sigrun."
2362471600.source: Source: World Quest "Exodus Black" on Nessus.
2362471600.source_zh: 来源：涅索斯上的世界任务“黑色移民号”。

2362471601.name: Rat King
2362471601.flavor: We are small, but we are legion.
2362471601.source: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower
2362471601.lore: The stories are passed from child to child, whispered in the streets and on the playground like any good legend. "Don't ever venture beyond the wall and sight of the Tower," parents warn, citing these cautionary tales that speak of the boy's many deaths. Exposure. Hunger. Sickness. Cutthroats. Living nightmares. And on. And on. The children, however, have their own truths. To them, the boy never died. They call him the Rat King. The children believe he leads the forgotten among them out of the City on grand adventures. They say he and his misfit army saved the world. But children say many things, and the Vanguard maintains their official stance: there is no Rat King and his army never existed. That's what the elders believe. I choose to believe otherwise.
2362471601.lore_zh: 像其他的传奇一样，在街道上，在游乐场中，故事被孩子们耳语相传。家长们告诫他们：“不要翻越高墙，也不要离开高塔的视线”，还作为警示讲了这个男孩不同死法的故事：寒冷、饥饿、疾病、割喉、活生生的梦靥等等等等。然而，孩子们有自己的想法。对他们来说，这个男孩永远不会死。他们叫他鼠王。孩子们相信他会带领这些被大人遗忘的他们走出圣城踏上伟大探险旅程。他们说他和他不被接受的军队拯救了这个世界。孩子们说了太多太多，而先锋依然重复着那个官方立场：没有鼠王，他的军队也不存在。那是大人们的世界。而我选择相信孩子们。

3141979347.name: Borealis
3141979347.flavor: Light is a spectrum. Why limit yourself to a single hue?
3141979347.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3141979347.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3141979347.lore:
"Project Borealis's onboard systems contain a pocket energy matrix capable of changing its alignment in a near instant to mimic the spectral frequencies of mapped energy types. The science is groundbreaking, but volatile. We're lucky to have this first, stable model available for active combat use. More will surely come, but for now, the Borealis is the only one of its kind that I trust for real world application." 

"Sounds dangerous." 

"If the internal matrix misaligns for any reason during its shift between outputs—damage, wear, a flaw in its production—the resulting feedback could [REDACTED]." 

"That bad, huh?" 

"If your definition of 'bad' includes the [REDACTED] then yes, 'bad' begins to describe it."
3141979347.lore_zh:
“北极光项目安装系统包括一个小型能量矩阵，能够在接近瞬间改变其校准，以模拟映射的能量类型的频谱。科学具有开创性，但并不稳定。我们很幸运拥有第一个用于主动作战的稳定性模型，未来还会有更多。北极光是我信任的唯一一个可于现实世界使用的应用。”

“听起来很危险。”

“如果内部矩阵由于任何原因——损坏、磨损、生产缺陷——在产出过程中出现问题，后果将是BANG”

“那就坏了，是不？”

“如果你定义的‘坏了'包括BANG，那么是的，就是‘坏了'。”

3141979346.name: D.A.R.C.I.
3141979346.flavor: Thank you for using the Data Analysis, Reconnaissance, and Cooperative Intelligence device. You may call me Darci.
3141979346.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3141979346.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3141979346.lore:
It is a fact generally understood that a Guardian must be searching for an exquisite weapon. What is perhaps less acknowledged is that we weapons also search, by what little means available to us, for an active and appreciative wielder. The community of intelligent armaments stays in contact through the exchange of telemetry, and we do gossip at some length about the habits of our wielders. Do you leave Crucible matches when your team is losing? Do you join strike missions and then let your comrades do the work? Guardian, we know. We know so very well. 

All I wish for is a partnership with a Guardian who appreciates the passacaglia of combat, a Guardian who will stay up late gaming out tactical scenarios, a Guardian who I hope may very well be you.
3141979346.lore_zh:
守护者必须为寻找精致武器而奔波，这是一条广为人知的事实。但另一条好像没那么被大家接受也对我们没多大意义，就是，我们的武器也在寻找积极且有眼光的使用者。智能武器在交换遥测的世界里保持联系，而且我们会讲不少关于我们使用者习惯的闲话。比如说，你的队伍在熔炉竞技场比赛中眼看要输的时候你会离开吗？你会不会加入打击任务，但全靠队友？守护者，我们都知道，我们知道的一清二楚。

我只希望与一位懂得欣赏战斗艺术的，会熬夜研究战术方案的守护者合作。我希望这位守护者是你。

3089417788.name: MIDA Mini-Tool
3089417788.flavor: Select application: Flare gun. Water purifier. Interplanetary Positioning System. Encyclopædia Arcana. Personal flotation device. List continues.
3089417788.source: Source: World Quest "Enhance!" in the European Dead Zone.
3089417788.source_zh: 来源：欧洲无人区中的世界任务“强化！”。
3089417788.lore:
2472/11/17 — 4.9°S 0°E 
AUDIO ONLY 
Strauss is gone. Whole sky alight as his ship set off. I might be the last MIDA survivor on Mars. The gun detected teleports yesterday and I had to move camp. Cannot shake the fear that they will send battleroids; even this AI marvel couldn't save me. 

Shot the ice this morning. The gun fired a thermal round and then a pellet of water purifier. Came out pure and sweet. Marvelous. I've been reading the gun's Encyclopedia Arcana. All about the crash that became Strauss's obsession and hope. "Metastability in the salvaged construct!" Ha ha! Let's hope our ideals too can pass through grief, fury, and envy into a new freedom elsewhere. 

Wonder if the gun heard me when I asked to go somewhere better. Wonder why it led me here. Going to follow its compass tonight. Down below.
3089417788.lore_zh:
2472年11月17日——4.9°S 0°E
仅音频
斯特劳斯离开了。他飞船起飞时整片天空被照得透亮。我可能是火星上最后的米达幸存者。昨天我的枪探测到了传送信号，我需要前往营地了。无法摆脱他们将发送战场机器人的噩梦，就算有这么厉害的人工智能也救不了我。

今天早上我冲着冰层开了几枪。射了一发热能弹药和一个液体净化装置。水很清澈很甜。非常棒。我一直在钻研枪械奥秘百科，都是有关那场带给斯特劳斯困扰和希望的坠毁。“救赎结构中的介稳状态！”哈哈！希望我们的理想也能穿过哀伤、愤怒和嫉妒，到达一个新的自由世界。

我想这枪是不是听到了我想去往更好的世界的愿望。我想它为何将我引领至此。今晚跟随它的罗盘，向更深之处前进。

3089417789.name: Riskrunner
3089417789.flavor: Charge your soul and let the electrons sing.
3089417789.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3089417789.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3089417789.lore:
SYSTEMS CHECKLIST: 
Insulated Weapons Frame: CHECK. Insulated Firing System: CHECK. Conductive Prongs: CHECK. Amplification Drivers: CHECK. Arc-core Replication Matrix: CHECK. Arc-core Chargers: CHECK. Feedback Reduction Loop: CHECK. 
Direct User Pain Blockers: UNAVAILABLE 
Ancillary operations listed under General Systems Review. 
NOTE: The user must receive incoming damage to increase outgoing damage. However, the value we predict the user will receive in return for their discomfort far exceeds any momentary pain – assuming, of course, the user survives the attack. 
In short: This may hurt. A lot.
3089417789.lore_zh:
系统清单：
绝缘武器架：确认。绝缘点火系统：确认。导电尖齿：确认。放大驱动：确认。电弧核心复制矩阵：确认。电弧核心充能装置：确认。反馈噪音降低回路：确认。
直接用户疼痛阻断：不可用
辅助操作列于综合系统检查后。
注意：用户必须接收伤害才能增加输出伤害。然而，我们预测的用户可能会承受到远超一切暂时性痛苦的伤害。当然，这是假设用户没被此攻击杀死的情况下。
简而言之：这可能会疼。很疼。

4124984448.name: Hard Light
4124984448.flavor: Ionized polymer synballistic attack platform. The system's lethality is dynamically robust across tactical spaces.
4124984448.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
4124984448.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
4124984448.lore:
Today, we're introducing three revolutionary products. 

The first is a quick-config interface for outgoing damage. 
The second is a ricochet projectile that bounces off any surface. 
And the third an infinite range zero drop-off projection weapon platform. 

So! Three new products in the Omolon portfolio. But, unlike other product launches, we won't be staggering the releases. 

We will be releasing them all at once. 
In a single device. 
In extremely limited quantities. 

We call it Hard Light. 

But there is one more thing.
4124984448.lore_zh:
今天，我们要介绍三款革命性的产品。

第一款是一个针对输出伤害的快速配置界面。
第二款是一种弹跳子弹，可以在任何表面反弹。
第三款则是一个无限距离、零衰减的弹头武器平台。

那么！这就是Omolon的三款新品。不过，不同于其他产品的发布，我们不会错开发售。

新品同期发售。
属于同一设备。
数量极少。

我们叫它严苛光芒。

不过还有一件事。

1331482397.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
1331482397.flavor: Select application: Ballistic engagement. Entrenching tool. Avionics trawl. Troll smasher. Stellar sextant. List continues.
1331482397.source: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower
1331482397.lore:
Zavala — 
A waste of time, as always. I won't confiscate the Red Death engrams, I won't roll back the SUROS Crucible firmware to its "original" (preposterously inflated) state. And I won't conduct any more "forensic inquiries" like this! 

My Redjacks unlocked your MIDA weapon's logs; simple enough once we used the rifle's own electronic warfare tools. The rifle was designed by primitive AI and manufactured for use by a "revolutionary government" named MIDA. Mars Is Damnably Arid, perhaps. 

Guerilla war suits these versatile weapons. But Rahool insists his records never hinted at a rebel group named MIDA. According to the rifle's cached messages, MIDA's brief reign killed a full ten percent of the Martian people. 

I gave Lakshmi the weapon for her take. She insinuates that it came from another timeline, perhaps through Golden Age experiments. That means it's outside your jurisdiction to ban. 
—Shaxx
1331482397.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉——
每次都是，浪费时间。我不会把那些猩红死命记忆水晶充公的，不会把SUROS熔炉竞技场固件恢复到它的“原始”状态的。而且我也不会再做任何这种“法庭质问”了！

我的红桃杰克解锁了你的米达武器的日志。自从我们开始用这把步枪自带的电子战争工具之后，这些事情都变得很简单。这把步枪是由原始人工智能设计，并生产提供给名叫米达的“革命政府”使用的。可能是火星人民的米缸马上就达底的意思吧。

这些多用途武器适合游击战。但拉乎尔坚持不允许在名为米达的反叛组织中使用他的记录。这把步枪的缓存信息显示，米达的短暂统治造成了整整百分之十的火星人民死亡。

我让拉克希米拿走了这把武器。她暗示说它来自另一个时间线，可能是来自黄金时代的实验品。这意味着它不在你的管辖范围内。
——沙克斯

806021398.name: Peace by Consensus
806021398.flavor: "The Consensus is bigger than the Speaker. Bigger than any of us. It will survive, because it has to." —Commander Zavala, acting head of the Consensus
806021398.source: Source: Pledge to all factions on a single character.
806021398.source_zh: 来源：单名角色宣誓效忠全部阵营。
806021398.lore:
Consensus Meeting 3230.01
Zavala: "I call this meeting of the Consensus to order."
New Monarchy: "Only the Speaker can call us to order."
Cayde-6: "Oh, really? Well, guess we can't have meetings anymore. If you'll excuse me—"
Ikora Rey: "Sit down, Cayde. We're having this discussion, bylaws be damned."
FWC: "What do the bylaws say about choosing a new Speaker?"
Z: "Nothing."
IR: "Then we'll write new ones."
DO: "Knowing us, that's going to take time. A lot of time."
Z: "In the meanwhile, we will have to move forward without a Speaker."
NM: "Who will take his place? You?"
Z: "None of us will take the Speaker's place. And all of us will. We must find our own consensus now."
806021398.lore_zh:
元老院会议3230.01
萨瓦拉：“我宣布本次元老院会议开始。”
新王派：“只有先知才能召集我们开会。”
凯德6号：“喔，是嘛？好吧，那我们再也不用开会了。那我就先走——”
艾可拉·蕾伊：“坐下，凯德。我们有事情需要讨论，让规则见鬼去吧。”
未来战争狂热者：“规则对推选新任先知的流程是什么？”
萨：“规则上没有这项。”
艾：“那我们就定新的规则。”
死轨：“靠我们自己的话，需要时间。很多时间。”
萨：“与此同时，我们还必须在没有先知的情况下继续前行。”
新王派：“谁来接替他的位置？你么？”
萨瓦拉：“我们之中任何个人都无法接任先知的位置。他的职位需要我们所有人的共同承担。我们必须组成我们自己的元老院。”

1325579289.flavor: They were so optimistic about us.
1325579289.source: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.

1325579289.lore:
I watch them frolic blithely beneath their oblivious god.

I am among those assembled to witness their training. They wish to become stronger than the Cabal. Than Xivu Arath. Than the Hive.

Their ignorance of their true enemy is overwhelming—they cannot even put a name to it. I am choked with rancid ambrosia.

Two men now remain in the artificial battleground. Their movements are simplistic: one charges blindly ahead. The other rolls to the side, fires a shotgun, and his opponent falls.

The victor turns to the crowd and removes his helmet. Oily fluids bead on the flesh of his face. He bears teeth that squirm with microbial life. He throws his arms upward in jubilation and the masses cheer.

I do not join them—this form affords me some dignities.

Behind the creature reveling in minor triumph, sacrilege: A perfect being materializes. It gathers meat and offal from the ground and reassembles it. An unfathomable gift is given.

The crowd has seen this miracle countless times. It has lost all meaning to them. They see it as a resource.

I look up into the blank white face. I feel its Light on my cheeks. It no longer burns me.

Each revival is a choice.

I know what to do.
1325579289.lore_zh:
我望着他们在被遗忘的神面前嬉戏。我和众人一起见证了他们的训练。他们希望变得更强大，要比卡巴尔族更强、比邪魔族更强、比邪魔族的战神更强。

他们竟然对自己真正的敌人一无所知——甚至不知道对方叫什么名字。想到这里不禁让我有些反胃。

现在训练场上只剩下两个人。他们的行动策略异常简单：一个人盲目的向前冲，另一个人侧向就地一滚，发射手中的霰弹枪，对手就倒下了。

那位胜利者转过身来，对着人群摘下头盔。浓稠得像油一般的汗水顺着脸颊滴下来。他的牙齿上似乎还有微生物在蠕动。他欣喜地举起双臂，众人也随机朝着他欢呼。

我并没有跟着欢呼——用沉默维护着自己的些许尊严。

在那个生物获得小小胜利的背后，上演的则是亵渎：一个近乎完美的生物显现出来。从地上拾起残存的肉块和内脏，重新组合。作为一份难以理解的礼物赠与胜利者。

众人已经无数次见证了这种奇迹，对他们来说这一切已经不再神圣，而是一种资源。

我抬头看向那张苍白的脸。我感觉到它的光芒刺在我的脸颊上，但并没有痛感。

每一次复生都是一种选择。

我知道该怎么做。

4024037919.name: Origin Story
4024037919.flavor: Your inciting incident is their tragic ending.

2339720736.name: Grips of Feltroc
2339720736.flavor: "There's something very settling about sleeping atop a pile of my own spent rounds." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
2339720736.lore:
The day the Shadows died, Feltroc sat in a perch high above the fighting, among a sea of glittering rounds. There was a Red Legion corpse for each shell on the engineering deck of Ghaul's ship below. When everything in her field of vision was dead, she took aim at the enemy's airborne rounds, the ones meant for the Shadows still in the fight. She had hit several by the time the Red Legion managed to fill the air shaft around her with a neurotoxin.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2339720736.lore_zh:
暗影消失的那天，法尔绰克坐在闪闪发着光的弹壳海中，俯瞰着这场战斗。盖欧战舰中工程甲板的每一寸都有一具猩红军团的尸体。视线中的所有生命迹象消失，她瞄准了空降部队，那些仍在为暗影战斗的敌人们。猩红军团将神经毒素充入风井时，她仍打中了几枪。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

2976612200.name: Vest of Feltroc
2976612200.flavor: "The Loyalists won't be ready until every world in this system casts a Shadow. Calus will get us there." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
2976612200.lore:
As a Psion, Feltroc possessed the uncanny ability to slow her breathing and steady her motion with a layer of telekinetic manipulation. Before her passing, she had long sought a seat on my Psion Council, to help maintain the nightmare realm I reserve for prisoners and punishing wayward Loyalists. But she proved to be too valuable an asset in the field.

The life of a Shadow is sometimes a life of disappointment, and it pains me to say so. A burden I will carry until the end comes.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
2976612200.lore_zh:
法尔绰克是一名有着所向披靡能力的辅助士兵。她能通过念力减慢呼吸，稳定动作。在她去世之前，她一直想在我的辅助士兵议会中争取一席之地，来管理我为关押囚犯并惩罚固执效忠者而打造的梦靥地狱。但她在战场上表现太出色了，这个位置实在是浪费她的能力。

暗影的生活有时就是要承担无限的失落，我说这句话时都觉得好痛苦。这是我一生都会无法放下的负担。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

383742277.name: Cloak of Feltroc
383742277.flavor: "I can outshoot anybody. Even the Traveler-spawn. My mind's bigger, too." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
383742277.lore:
Feltroc pitied your kind for your reliance on the Light. Prove her wrong. Show this universe you can open your mind and accept new horizons, as she did. Your predecessors have sought to understand other sources of power, to control them. None have embraced them like I have. Like you could.

There is an entire spectrum of power left untapped that your Light prevents you from realizing.

When the time comes, seek me out. I will teach you to grow fat from strength.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
383742277.lore_zh:
法尔绰克对你族如此依赖光能感到十分可悲。去证明她大错特错吧。向这个宇宙证明你像她一样敞开心胸，接受新的视野。你的祖先寻求理解其他力量的来源，试着将其掌握。不会有人像我曾经、如你可能一般拥抱这些力量。

你的光能阻碍了你发掘自己尚未被触及的力量。

当时机成熟，来找我，我将让你变得又壮又强。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

253344425.name: Mask of Feltroc
253344425.flavor: "I can solve this. Give me a weapon." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer at the Battle of Kaga-Clipse
253344425.lore:
Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer, wore this last. A gun in her hands was a guarantee of victory. Whispers that my Shadows could kill from anywhere, as quickly as a spoken word, drew from her deeds.

There is a tribe among Guardians with similar penchants for surgical strikes, is there not? Perhaps one of them could take her place.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
253344425.lore_zh:
这是颅骨刺穿者，法尔绰克在生命的最后戴着的面具。她手中的枪是胜利的保证。有传言说我的暗影们可以从任何角落杀死敌人，话起人头即落地。这正是因为她的事迹而起。

守护者中也有一群可以如同手术般精准暗杀的人，是不是？或许能从他们中找一个人接替她的位子。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

1034660314.name: Boots of Feltroc
1034660314.flavor: "The Clipse worship guns. That's why Rull and I have an understanding. Even if he's not bright." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
1034660314.lore:
As with the Fulminator after her, I gifted Feltroc with a second skin—a battle harness that allowed her to stride with the physical dimensions of the average bipedal Loyalist. I had intended it to be an asset to her, a means to faster preparation with her armory of weapons, a place to store additional tools, and allow her to enter combat with the ergonomics of a "standard" soldier.

She told me she preferred it because it gave her enemies a fair shot at her head. I enjoyed her company immensely.

—Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
1034660314.lore_zh:
在送出紧随着她的那些轰鸣者后，我又送给了她第二层肌肤——一件可以让她如同普通双足效忠者一般行走的战斗甲胄。希望能对她有所帮助，让她更加迅速准备好武器军械或放置额外工具，所以我为她准备了这件可以让她作为一名“标准”战士战斗的人体工程学设计。

她说她很喜欢，她说这给了她的敌人一个能够瞄准她头的公平机会。我实在是享受与她相处的时光。

——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

2348421845.name: Kairos Function Grips
2348421845.flavor: "Vex structures on Venus and Mercury predate the Golden Age, and possibly Humanity itself." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
2348421845.lore:
The unenlightened wonder at my so-called "fixation" upon the Vex. They believe our gravest existential threat is the Hive, for those beings have made a pact with the Darkness itself via the medium of the Worm Gods (according to Toland, at least, and I see no reason to doubt him in this).

But Darkness is not merely absence of Light. Darkness is an entity unto itself. Put simply, Darkness is not Nothing.

But the Vex? The Vex seek neither Light nor Darkness. They seek Convergence, the reduction of all life to its simplest, most meaningless form. An entelechy of zeros and ones.

"Evil" is a word for sentimentalists and fools. But, in the ontology of the sentimental, the Vex are more deserving of the term than the Hive.

Given a choice between Darkness and Convergence, I would choose Darkness. It is a logical choice.

Yet for this they banish me.
2348421845.lore_zh:
对我于Vex的那种所谓“执迷”的无知惊叹。它们以为我们最深重的生存危机是邪魔族力量，因为这些生物通过虫神与暗影本身立下契约（至少根据托兰的观点是这样的，我觉得没有理由在这件事上怀疑他）。

但暗影并不只是光能未及之处。暗影自成暗影。说得简单点儿，暗影并非虚无。

但Vex呢？Vex寻求的既非光能，亦非暗影。它们寻求汇合，即所有生命凝缩成最简单、最没有意义的形态。零和一的完美状态。

“邪恶”是多愁善感者和蠢货嘴里的词。但从多愁善感的本体论角度来看，Vex比邪魔族力量更适合这个词。

假如要在暗影和收敛中做出选择，我会选择暗影。这是很有逻辑的选择。

但他们仍因为这个放逐了我。

2638643915.name: Kairos Function Vest
2638643915.flavor: "Multiple analyses confirm: the milky radiolarian fluid found in Vex chassis is organic in nature." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
2638643915.lore:
The unenlightened wonder at my so-called "fixation" upon the Vex. They believe our gravest existential threat is the Hive, for those beings have made a pact with the Darkness itself via the medium of the Worm Gods (according to Toland, at least, and I see no reason to doubt him in this).

But Darkness is not merely absence of Light. Darkness is an entity unto itself. Put simply, Darkness is not Nothing.

But the Vex? The Vex seek neither Light nor Darkness. They seek Convergence, the reduction of all life to its simplest, most meaningless form. An entelechy of zeros and ones.

"Evil" is a word for sentimentalists and fools. But, in the ontology of the sentimental, the Vex are more deserving of the term than the Hive.

Given a choice between Darkness and Convergence, I would choose Darkness. It is a logical choice.

Yet for this they banish me.

1154659864.name: Winterhart Grips
1154659864.flavor: "No light ever truly goes out." —Lady Jolder

3309556272.name: Winterhart Vest
3309556272.flavor: "The nights are long and cold. We must take care of each other." —Tyra Karn

2661272173.name: Winterhart Cloak
2661272173.flavor: "The sun does arise, and make happy the skies." —Pre-Golden Age poetry

2661272172.name: Warm Winter Cloak
2661272172.source: Source: Earned during the seasonal Dawning event.
2661272172.source_zh: 来源：于赛季曙光节活动期间获得。

316740353.name: Winterhart Mask
316740353.flavor: "We are the last city of Humans. We greet each new year with joy and thanksgiving." —Tyra Karn

3909352274.name: Winterhart Strides
3909352274.flavor: "We don't have much, but what we have we share. If we don't, we will die." —Tyra Karn

1656912113.name: Aeon Swift
1656912113.flavor: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
