1664757090.name: Gauntlets of the Taken King
1664757090.flavor: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
1664757090.lore:
A compact submersible of Eliksni design finishes its descent through the hazy depths of Titan's methane ocean. The craft's seafloor landing kicks up a cloud of dark silt and microbial life shimmering like stars. The submersible's dorsal airlock cracks open with a rush of bubbles, then slowly folds down into a ramp, allowing a trio of figures armored in deep diving gear to emerge. The submersible's single floodlight sweeps across the ocean floor, revealing the alien landscape of twisting coral. 

Fenchurch approaches one of the coral growths, running a gloved hand over its surface. "These polyps…" he mutters. "Is this—" He stops suddenly at the sound of a mechanical snap and turns to see Chalco and Lisbon-13 plant a large, mechanical spire in the ground. Internal lights flicker on as the spire whirrs to life, creating a regulated field of water pressure around the submersible. 

Fenchurch steps away from the coral, rubbing his fingers together. He looks to the spire as its sides open like a flower and release several drones, each outfitted with floodlights. The drones swim out ahead, revealing the disorienting flicker of what looks like the water's surface but at an impossibly vertical angle. 

"This way," Chalco directs as she turns to follow the drones. Fenchurch and Lisbon look at one another, steady themselves, and fall in line behind their fireteam leader. 

"Stop me if you've heard this one before," Fenchurch says, anxiously checking the talisman clipped to his armor. "Two Hunters and a Warlock walk into the deep…"
1664757090.lore_zh:
在土卫六甲烷海的模糊深度，一艘埃里克斯尼族设计的小型潜水器完成了下潜。潜水器在海底着陆时掀起一片黑色淤沙云，微生物生命像群星一样闪闪发光。潜水器的背部气闸随着气泡的喷涌而打开，然后慢慢折叠成一个斜坡，让穿着深潜装备的三个身影走了出来。潜水器唯一的泛光灯扫过海底，展现出缠绕珊瑚的奇异景观。 

芬丘奇走近其中一处珊瑚生长物，用戴着手套的手抚摸着它的表面。“这些珊瑚虫…”他嘟囔道。“这是——”他突然在一声机械咔嚓声中停了下来，转身看到卡尔科和里斯本-13在地上放置了一个巨大的机械尖塔。随着尖塔的旋转，内部的灯光闪烁着，在潜水器周围形成了一个受控的水压场。 

芬丘奇离开珊瑚，搓着手指。他看着尖塔，它的两侧像花瓣一样打开，几架无人机被放了出来，每架无人机都配备了泛光灯。无人机游到前方，闪着令人迷惑的光芒，看起来像是在水面，但角度却异常垂直。 

“这边，”卡尔科一边指挥，一边转身跟随无人机。芬丘奇和里斯本面面相觑，稳定了一下情绪，在火力战队队长身后排成队形。 

“要是你们之前听过这个就叫停我，”芬丘奇说着，焦急地检查着固定在他护甲上的护身符。“两个猎人和一个术士走进深渊…”

638836294.name: Plate of the Taken King
638836294.flavor: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."
638836294.lore:
Chalco Yong disappears behind the shimmering curtain of surface tension. Lisbon-13 follows without hesitation, leaving Fenchurch to stare at the vertigo-inducing, vertical plane of water. He reaches out, hesitantly touching the surface, only for Lisbon to reach back, grab him by the wrist, and yank him through. 

"Everis," Lisbon mutters once he pulls Fenchurch to the other side. The Warlock doesn't even realize he's hyperventilating. "Get it together." He gives Fenchurch a warning look, then nods at Chalco walking ahead across the maddeningly dry ground.  

It takes Fenchurch a moment to realize that he is not underwater anymore. Liquid methane drips off his suit and turns to ice when it hits the compacted silt. The cavernous space is suffocatingly dark. It will be hours yet before the sun rises on this section of Titan, yet the lambent shades of starlight twinkling in the void beyond fill Fenchurch with a lurching sense of dread. 

He wants to ask, 'Where are we?,' but the words fail to get past his lips. Instead, Fenchurch gathers himself and joins Chalco at her side. 

Chalco raises her hand, and three drones come to heel behind her. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to visit this site." She sends the drones up into the air with a wave. "What you are about to see is not to be discussed outside of official reports." 

Fenchurch takes a step forward, squinting against the dark, until the drones sweep the terrain with their floodlights. Then, as the alien landscape comes into sharp focus, one word finally escapes his lips: 

"Oryx."
638836294.lore_zh:
卡尔科·杨消失在表面闪闪发光的帘幕后面。里斯本-13毫不犹豫地跟着，留下芬丘奇盯着让人晕眩的垂直水面。他伸出手，犹豫地触碰表面，不料里斯本回头伸出手，抓住他的手腕，把他拽了过去。 

“艾夫瑞斯，”里斯本在把芬丘奇拉到另一边时喃喃地说道。这位术士甚至没意识到他换气过度了。“振作起来。”他告诫地看了芬丘奇一眼，然后朝正走在干燥地面上的卡尔科点点头。  

芬丘奇过了一会儿才意识到他已经不在水下了。液态甲烷从他的潜水服上滴下来，一碰到夯实的淤沙就化作了冰。空洞的空间黑得令人窒息。距离太阳在土卫六的这片区域升起还有几个小时，远处虚空中摇曳的点点星光却让芬丘奇充满了一种突如其来的恐惧感。 

他想要问，‘我们在哪儿？'，但话没能说出口。相反，芬丘奇平静下来，站到了卡尔科身旁。 

卡尔科举起手，三架无人机转而跟在她身后。“我们是现存唯一造访这个地点的隐秘者小队。”她挥手让无人机飞向空中。“你们即将看到的东西，不能在官方报告以外的地方进行讨论。” 

芬丘奇向前走了一步，在黑暗中眯着眼睛，直到无人机用泛光灯扫视着地形。然后，随着怪异的景观逐渐清晰起来，他的嘴里终于吐出了一个词： 

“欧里克斯。”

4130276947.name: Helm of the Taken King
4130276947.lore:
"Keep this talisman on you at all times." 

Black, glossy, and in the right light, the talisman has a rainbow iridescence. It reminds Fenchurch of hematite pearls from the Bay of Drowned Wishes. He rolls it in his hand, looking up at Chalco to see the creases of worry in her brow. 

Fenchurch clips the talisman to his jacket as the rest of his fireteam has. "What's it do?" 

"If it glows white, stay where you are and call out," Chalco explains, choosing her words carefully all while avoiding Fenchurch's gaze. "If you experience any memory loss or sense of déjà vu, call out." A silence falls over her fireteam. Palpable tension fills the cabin as they feel the craft begin to descend. 

"If you see anyone at the operation site that you do not recognize, call out." Chalco continues, occasionally steadying herself with a hand on the cabin ceiling as the submersible pitches and yaws in the disruptive currents. "If you experience any out-of-body sensations or missing time, call out." 

"Ma'am?" Lisbon-13 is not afraid to interrupt Chalco. His eyes glow bright from the back of the submersible. "Where are we going?" 

Chalco stares for a moment, squares her shoulders, and continues. "If you hear a voice that you think is your own…"
4130276947.lore_zh:
“把这个护身符一直带在身上。” 

护身符是黑色带有光泽的，而在适当的光线下，会呈现出斑斓的彩虹色。这让芬丘奇想起了溺亡之愿海湾的赤铁矿珍珠。他把它卷起放在手里，抬头望向卡尔科，看到她眉头紧锁。 

芬丘奇和其他火力战队队员一样，把护身符固定在了他的夹克上。“它是干什么用的？” 

“要是它发出白光，就呆在原地，大声呼救，”卡尔科解释道，她一边小心地说着，一遍避开了芬丘奇的目光。“如果你出现任何记忆丧失或既视感，就大声呼救。”她的火力战队陷入一片沉默。当他们感知到潜水器开始下潜时，明显有一种紧张感充满了机舱。 

“如果你在操作现场看到不认识的人，就大声呼救。”卡尔科继续说道，她偶尔会在潜水器遇到扰乱水流发生倾斜和偏航时，把手放在船舱天花板上稳住身体。“如果你遇到任何体外感知或迷失的情况，就大声呼救。” 

“女士？”里斯本-13插嘴打断了卡尔科。他的双眼从潜水器后部发出明亮的光。“我们要去哪里？” 

卡尔科凝视了一会儿，挺起肩膀，继续说道。“如果你听到了一种声音，以为是自己发出来的…”

针对样本与受试者WQS-030遗体的对比分析不匹配。WQS-030不存在有丝分裂迹象。可能是蠕虫分离和光能暴露的复合效应。 

尸检显示TKO-300的遗骸中不存在蠕虫尸体。状态未知。 

长期接触TKO-300会因暴露在傀儡军团和暗影能量中而导致强烈的视听幻觉。ERI-223与目标对象COS-030存在相仿性。 

来自最初接触现场的守护者火力战队的编目回忆表明WGX-003频繁造访遗骸进行哀悼。TKO-300能够吸收知识和事件，但无法对其做出反应。  

我的专业建议是，销毁TKO-300的残骸。它对人类安全的威胁远远超过其潜在的知识价值。 

信息结束

FEN-092的分析附有来自ERI-223的检疫建议，以及我自身对NEV-000对象的分析，以便与TKO-300进行比较。 

我的建议如下：将目标点重新分类为分段查询，将遗骸隔离到场外位置，并限制对框架和机械智能的直接接触。此处存在太多价值，不应直接摒弃。

90009855.name: Arbor Warden
90009855.flavor: Tend the gardens of your heart.
90009855.lore:
Emreth is tangling with the last Hive Acolyte when he sees the canister, wedged between two unidentifiable heaps of machinery. He can only read some of the letters stamped into its surface: H Y D R O P.  

And there it is, barely visible under the glass: a small, leafy plant. Preserved, somehow, and perfectly out of place in the flooded wreckage of the Arcology.  

Emreth has a clean shot if he pushes forward, but when the Acolyte lumbers unwittingly in the plant's direction, it makes the decision for him. He feels a shot impact against his pauldron as he runs, hears hissing as the slug starts eating into the relic iron.  

He gets to the canister first. Emreth summons his Light in the form of a shimmering barrier. The Acolyte reels back, firing blindly. Emreth puts his back to the barrier and brings up his sword. 

It's messy fighting. If he takes a little satisfaction in cleaving the Acolyte's head from its shoulders, he hopes it's beneath the War God's notice.   

Emreth surveys the room: quiet now, save for his breathing.  

Killswitch patches him through to the commander.  

"Transmat site is secure," Emreth says.  

"Acknowledged." 

He bends down to retrieve the canister—heavy, but fragile in his gauntleted hands.  

Emreth holds the tinted glass to the sunlight. "I bet you're good luck."
90009855.lore_zh:
与最后一个邪魔族仆从缠斗时，埃姆瑞斯看到了被卡在两堆无法辨认的机械之间的罐子。他只能读出印在它表面上的一些字母：H Y D R O P。  

它就在那里，玻璃底下几乎看不见：一种小型的多叶植物。不知怎的保存了下来，并出现在生态园区的浸没残骸中，显得有些违和。  

要是向前推进，埃姆瑞斯就可以干净利落地开枪，但当仆从不经意间朝植物的方向挪动时，情况替他做出了抉择。他奔跑起来，感到子弹击中了他的肩甲，听到了重弹开始侵蚀圣物金属的嘶嘶声。  

他率先抵达了罐子处。埃姆瑞斯以闪光屏障的形式召唤他的光能。仆从踉跄着后退，一顿乱射。埃姆瑞斯背对着屏障，拿出他的刀剑。 

这是一场混战。他可能从砍下仆从肩上的头中得到了一丝满足感，但愿这不会引起战神的注意。   

埃姆瑞斯扫视了一下房间：这下安静了，只剩他的呼吸声。  

杀戮开关帮他接通了指挥官。  

“传送站点安全了，”埃姆瑞斯说道。  

“了解。” 

他弯下腰去收回罐子——很重，但在他戴着臂铠的手里却十分脆弱。  

埃姆瑞斯在阳光下欣赏着它的有色玻璃。“你肯定会带来好运的。”

1125217994.name: New Pacific Epitaph
1125217994.flavor: "This isn't happening. This isn't happening. This isn't happening."
1125217994.lore:
Beyond the dappled sea spray on the bedroom window, escape craft and their blue contrails sweep past the Arcology as beams of orange light punctuate the sky. They cut through contrails with certainty, and before long, each craft erupts in blossoms of fire and brilliant warmth.  

No one is leaving Titan. 

Nadia Jahandar is not leaving. She has a cup of tea cooling on the windowsill, a collection of her late brother's poetry on her tablet, and the recording of her last piano recital playing on her headphones. The roar of the apocalypse accompanies her. She looks away from the window. 

I stepped into the stars 
Because the seas were explored 
No dragons on our maps 
Islanded in a sea of night 
Though it could never be home 
No hearths in the gulf 

Nadia reaches for her tea, glancing out the window to watch the sea rise up in a kilometers-high wall. It casts a shadow so long, it throws the Arcology into darkness.  

She will tell her brother that this poem is her favorite.
1125217994.lore_zh:
在卧室窗户上斑驳的浪沫外，逃生艇以及它们蓝色的尾迹扫过生态园区，橙色的光束点缀着天空。它们无一例外地穿过尾迹，不久后，每艘飞艇都迸发出花束般的火焰和绚烂的暖意。  

没人能离开土卫六。 

娜迪娅·贾汉达没打算离开。她把一杯茶放在窗台上冷却，平板电脑上是她已故兄弟的诗集，耳机里播放着她最后一次钢琴独奏会的录音。大灾难的轰鸣声伴随着她。她把目光从窗边移开。 

我踏入群星 
因为海洋已被探寻 
我们的地图上没有巨龙 
孤立在夜色的海洋中 
虽然它永远无法成为家园 
海湾里没有壁炉 

娜迪娅伸手去拿茶，瞥了眼窗外，看到海水涨成好几千米高的墙。它投下了长长的阴影，让生态园区笼罩进黑暗之中。  

她会告诉她兄弟，这首诗是她最喜欢的。

839786290.name: Cold Comfort
839786290.lore:
The submersible hits the water at an odd angle, throwing the passengers against the bulkhead. No one was buckled in before it dropped. Confusion erupts from the team of scientists as they begin their descent: the currents shouldn't be as strong as they are. Titan's atmosphere doesn't allow for that.  

But they are swept away. 

The pilot struggles to orient the craft, and for a moment, they are vertical, able to see blooms of fire expanding above the surface of the ocean. The submersible pitches in another direction, sinking rapidly.  

They have nowhere to go but down. Hide under the ice shelf, wait the chaos out. Hope for rescue. 

One of the scientists leans out of her seat, pressing her face up against the port window. A shape moves in the dark, too massive to be another craft, too sinuous to be mechanical. The scientist reaches back, blindly grasping for the hand of the person seated next to her. 

The shape in the sea doubles back, following the speed and telemetry of the current-swept submersible. Everyone sees it now, blocking out what little light is left as they sink past the ice shelf. It dives with them. Not after, but with. 

She will not let them die alone.
839786290.lore_zh:
潜水器以某种奇怪的角度撞击水面，将乘客抛向舱壁。没人来得及在它落下前扣上安全带。当他们开始下降时，科学家团队突然感到困惑不解：洋流不可能像现在这么强。土卫六的大气提供不了这种条件。  

但他们被冲走了。 

领航员努力调整潜水器的航向，有一瞬间，他们是垂直的，能够看到花束般的火焰在海面上蔓延。潜水器转向另一个方向，迅速下沉。  

他们无处可去，只能往下。躲在冰架底，等待混乱过去。希望能够获救。 

其中一位科学家从座位上探出身子，把她的脸贴在左舷窗上。有个形状在黑暗中移动着，庞大异常，应该不是潜水器，又很蜿蜒，应该不是机械制品。科学家的手向后伸，盲目地抓住坐在她身旁的人的手。 

海水中的形状随着洋流裹卷潜水器的速度和遥测信号折回。现在每个人都能看到它，当他们沉到冰架下时，它挡住了仅存的一点光线。它和他们一起下潜。不是跟着他们，而是拽着他们。 

她不会让他们孤独地死去。

3262192268.name: No Survivors
3262192268.lore:
Klaxons blare across the hangar. Seven terrified people huddle by the escape craft's open hatch, bracing against the wind cutting through the open hangar bay doors. 

"You're not leaving me behind!" an engineer shouts. He holds a young man hostage, arm like a vice around his neck. Pistol wavering. 

The last security officer looks down at his counterpart, long dead and bleeding out on the floor. He isn't sure how many rounds are left in his gun. His hands are shaking from the cold. From the reverberations of explosions shuddering through the superstructure. 

"Let me on! Make room for me! Move!" the engineer demands, motioning to the side with his gun. The security officer takes the opportunity and fires. He's not steady, hits the engineer and his hostage. Both crumple to the ground. The crowd behind him is screaming. 

The security officer curses, hurrying over to save the hostage. He hears a hatch door close behind him, turns to see the escape craft take off. He screams something, but it's cut short—the engineer was still alive. He doesn't even feel the bullet enter his spine before he hits the ground. 

From where he lies on the freezing cold floor, he can see the escape craft outside the hangar bay. Tears well up in his eyes. The last thing he sees is a beam of fire descending from the sky. 

His chest stills as the escape craft disintegrates, shot down by a Warsat.
3262192268.lore_zh:
警笛声响彻机库。七名吓坏了的人挤在逃生艇敞开的舱口旁，顶着穿过敞开的机库大门的狂风。 

“你们不能丢下我！”一位工程师喊道。他挟持一名年轻人作为人质，胳膊像虎钳一样用手缠住他的脖子。手枪摇摆不定。 

最后一名安保人员低头看着他的同事，那人早就死了，倒在地上流血不止。他不确定枪里还有多少子弹。他的手冷得直发抖。上层构造因爆炸的回响而震动着。 

“让我上去！给我腾点地方！快！”工程师用枪指着侧边要求道。安保人员抓住机会开了枪。他没打准，子弹击中了工程师和人质。两人都瘫倒在地。他身后的人群在尖叫。 

安保人员咒骂着，急忙赶过去救人质。他听到身后舱门关闭的声音，转身看到逃生艇起飞。他喊了些什么，但被打断了——工程师还活着。他甚至没觉察到子弹进入自己的脊柱，就倒在了地上。 

躺在冰冷地板上，他可以看到机库外的那逃生艇。泪水在他的眼中涌动。他看到的最后一幕是一束火焰从天而降。 

逃生艇被战争卫星击落然后解体，他的胸膛也随之停止了起伏。

542573208.lore:
Caiatl and Saladin sit alone in the council chamber. Two metal bowls bearing the inscription, Perun, sit between them. Each holds a pile of small smooth stones that rattle along with the hum of the Eligos Lex V's engine. 

Saladin rolls a stone in his fingers. He leans forward and places it on an intersection of lines seared into a thick leather mat. He taps the table beneath it. "These stones are like legions raising your banner. Each one placed is a claim." 

He leans back in his seat and gestures to her. "Turn." 

Caiatl's eyes remain on the spot where Saladin placed his stone. She flicks an azure stone from her bowl onto the mat, then nudges the stone adjacent to Saladin's last placement. 

"Aggressive. But the object isn't to kill. Establish borders. Hold territory." Saladin's words are measured as he places a counter-stone. 

Caiatl considers a flanking maneuver, then a defensive line, or— 

"Speaking of… borders…" Caiatl flanks. "You place too many between yourself and your Legionaries." 

Saladin looks up, then back to the board. 

Caiatl continues. "It is how Tarnth chooses to die. Rather than ossify into an immobile monument of bone, drawn on a cart that the young may hear their wisdom." 

Saladin shoots her a look, then connects a line of stones in defense. "I'm not an executioner." 

"You carry a large axe," she spars, placing another stone by his. 

He groans and places a stone away from the clash. 

"Tarnth respects your command, she bears your Iron Banner." Caiatl continues, "Death by your hand would be an honor." 

Saladin sighs. "That's not how I see it." 

"Because it is not YOUR custom. In the Age of Conquest, warriors nearing death were gathered into legions and deployed at the tip of the spear. A final, glorious death charge. Seen by all." 

Caiatl considers her next move. 

"Calus did away with the practice. Denied our greatest their glorious deaths. He surrounded himself with a host of petrified elders, soaking in their council. Those who resisted were shown the fighting pits, to reclaim lost honor. Most soldiers were called home to Torobatl to live out their lives in the empire, paid as citizens. But many still chose to die on distant battlefronts when the opportunity presented itself." 

"This is comfort for her." Caiatl captures her first of Saladin's stones. 

"Fine. But this is my last rite of proving." 

"Very well. She wishes you display her bleached skull in the barracks." 

Saladin glares up at her and moves to secure a corner of the board. "You're joking." 

"Yes," she snorts, "It goes to her family."
542573208.lore_zh:
查厄托和萨拉丁单独坐在议事厅里。两个刻有“佩纶”字样的金属碗放在他们之间。每个碗里都放着一堆光滑的小石头，伴着伊犁苟斯·莱克斯五号引擎的嗡鸣而咯咯作响。 

萨拉丁用手指滚动着石头。他身体前倾，把石头放在一张厚皮垫子烧焦线条的交叉点上。他敲了敲垫子下的桌子。“这些石头就像是高举你旗帜的军团。放置的每一个，都是一次占领。” 

他向后靠在座位上，向她示意着。“到你了”。 

查厄托的眼睛依然停留在萨拉丁放置石头的地方。她把碗里的一块天蓝色石头弹到垫子上，然后把它推到了萨拉丁最后一次落子的相邻位置。 

“咄咄逼人。但目的并非杀戮。而是建立边界。守住领土。”萨拉丁放置了一块反制的石头，话语把握有度。 

查厄托思考进行侧攻，然后建立防线，或者—— 

“说到…边界…”查厄托选择了侧攻。“你在自己和你的军团士兵之间放置了太多。” 

萨拉丁抬头看了一眼，然后把视线转回到棋盘上。 

查厄托继续说道。“塔恩斯选择了那样的死法。宁可那样，而不是僵化成一座动弹不得的骨头纪念碑，被拉上一辆马车，让年轻人能听到其智慧。” 

萨拉丁看了她一眼，然后用一排石头进行防御。“我不是刽子手。” 

“可你拿着一把大斧头，”她反驳道，在他的石头旁放置了另一块。 

他咕哝着，把一块石头放在远离交锋的地方。 

“塔恩斯尊重你的命令，她肩抗着你的铁旗。”查厄托继续说道，“死在你手上是一种荣誉。” 

萨拉丁叹了口气。“我不这么看。” 

“因为这不是你的习俗。在征服时代，濒死的战士集结成军团，被部署成矛尖。最后一次光荣的死亡冲锋。让世人有目共睹。” 

查厄托思忖着下一着棋。 

“卡鲁斯废除了这种做法。否认了我们最伟大的光荣死亡。他身边围着一群僵化的长老，沉浸在他们的议会中。那些反抗的人被带到角斗场，以夺回失去的荣誉。大多数士兵都被召回图罗巴特尔，在帝国中度过余生，以公民的身份获得报酬。但一有机会，许多人还是会选择死在遥远的战场上。” 

“这对她来说是种慰藉。”查厄托拿下了她第一块萨拉丁的石头。 

“好吧。但这是我最后的证明仪式。” 

“很好。她希望你在军营里展示她漂白的头骨。” 

萨拉丁抬头瞪着她，下出守住棋盘一角的一步棋。“你在开玩笑吧。” 

“是的，”她哼了一声，“那个要给她的家人。”

424291879.name: Age-Old Bond
424291879.flavor: Symbiosis. Not predation. Never predation, o wary one mine.
424291879.lore:
The driving bass line of a classic song from Old Earth drove their prey before them. No less than a half-dozen wyverns snarled and clawed at the trio as they stabbed and blasted their way through the wilds of Mars.

Praedyth wished hard. Wished it would never end.

Alongside him, Kabr was a towering giant. An Awoken-made weapon roared in his hands and in his head.

Pahanin was a force, a living embodiment of the Void. Where he pointed, Ahamkhara died.

In the middle, between them, Praedyth smiled. A winged and scaled lion with a boar's tusks leapt at him, and he could swear he saw the thing wink at him as he tore it apart.

Beneath the song, Praedyth heard static, like a comm signal. Best not to think about it.

Praedyth wished again, and the hunt went on.
424291879.lore_zh:
来自旧时代地球经典歌曲的强劲低音，把他们的猎物驱赶到他们面前。当三人在火星的野外披荆斩棘时，至少有五六只双足飞龙咆哮着向他们扑过来。

普莱蒂斯许愿，希望这一切永远不会结束。

在他身边的卡布尔，是个铁塔般的巨人。他拿着的觉醒者武器在手中和脑海不断怒吼着。

帕哈宁是一种力量，是虚空活生生的化身。他所指之处，阿罕卡拉就会死去。

身在两者中间的普莱蒂斯微微一笑。一只满身鳞片，长着野猪獠牙和双翼的狮子扑向他。他敢肯定在把这东西撕碎的时候，看到它对自己眨了眨眼。

在歌声之下，普莱蒂斯听到静电的声音，似乎是通讯信号。最好先放一放。

普莱蒂斯又许了个愿，狩猎继续进行。

1605117129.name: Age-Old Bond
1605117129.flavor: Symbiosis. Not predation. Never predation, o wary one mine.

3388655311.name: Tyranny of Heaven
3388655311.flavor: It was She that inspired me to imagine your destruction, o jailer mine.
3388655311.lore:
Tallulah Fairwind smoothed the felt of the table with one hand, idly playing with her chips with the other. Across the table, Caliban-8 wore a green dealer's cap and looked stricken.

The Ahamkara looked like somebody's kindly old grandpa just now. And it could play a mean hand of cards. "Twenty," it crooned as it raised the stakes. She saw Caliban's eye sensors dilate.

The game had started so well. And it seemed like a great story they could have told back at the Tower. How was she supposed to have known? "Call," said Caliban, tension in his voice.

She looked down at her hand. "All in."

The Ahamkara's grin grew larger. Caliban shook his head.

"Don't you do this, Lulah. Don't you leave me here! I can't do it!"

The cards went down.

She'd lost.

The Hunter Vanguard tossed her bow to the Exo as the Ahamkara came around the table to collect his winnings. "A dare's a dare, man. Good luck."

She didn't scream. Wouldn't have been dignified.
3388655311.lore_zh:
塔鲁·和风一手抚平桌上的毛毡，另一手随意地摆弄着筹码。桌子的另一边，卡利班-8带着一个绿色的商人帽，看起来病恹恹的。

阿罕卡拉现在则看起来像是位慈祥的老爷爷，这样它就可以认真玩一把牌了。“二十”，它轻哼了一声，提高了赌注。她看到卡利班的眼睛传感器瞳孔变大了。

开局非常好。这似乎是个可以回高塔里讲的精彩故事。她怎么会知道的？“我跟”，卡利班说道，声音很紧张。

她低头看着她的手。“全押。”

阿罕卡拉的笑意愈浓。卡利班摇了摇头。

“不要这样，鲁拉。别把我留在这里！我做不到！”

牌见光。

她输了。

当阿罕卡拉绕过桌子拿赢的筹码时，猎人先锋把弓扔向了Exo。“敢作敢当，伙计。祝你好运。”

她没有惊呼，那样太没尊严。

543990593.name: Tyranny of Heaven
543990593.flavor: It was She that inspired me to imagine your destruction, o jailer mine.

3591141932.name: Techeun Force
3591141932.flavor: Sworn into faithful service to the Queen, the Techeuns of the Reef have long protected the secrets of the Awoken.
3591141932.lore:
Mara knew she had been a fool to pretend to be a peer to the others. What was true of her brother was true of all Awoken. They needed secrets to marvel at, secrets that rhymed with the deep enigma of their souls. They could not follow what they fully understood.

There would be a formal coronation later, in a place not yet built. Out of respect for that unhappened coronation, Mara did not at first wear a crown; and later she claimed as her diadem the ring of event horizon that surrounds the observable universe.

"My Techeuns," she said, gathering Kelda Wadj and the other eutechs who'd remained, "will be given absolute authority to explore our new power, the Traveler's relics, and all associated domains. We are no longer in the realm of pure science. We require an order of mysteries and witches to tend to them."
3591141932.lore_zh:
玛拉知道，她一直假装与其他人是同类的这种行为很傻。她真正的兄弟是觉醒者。他们需要可以惊叹的秘密，需要一些能与他们灵魂深奥之谜相呼应的秘密。他们无法跟从他们完全理解的事物。

稍后在一个尚未完全建成的地方，会有正式的加冕仪式。出于对这次尚未举行的加冕仪式的尊重，玛拉一开始并没有戴冠；后来她宣称，她那事件视界的小王冠环绕着这个会被发现的宇宙。

“我的灵巫们”，她召集了凯尔妲·瓦杰和其他留下来的技徒，说道：“将会获得绝对的权力，去探索新的力量、旅行者遗迹，以及所有相关的领域。我们不再局限于纯科学的国度。我们需要奥秘与巫师可遵循的秩序。”

2683864852.name: Techeun Force
2683864852.flavor: Sworn into faithful service to the Queen, the Techeuns of the Reef have long protected the secrets of the Awoken.

70083888.name: Nation of Beasts
70083888.flavor: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.
70083888.lore:
She held the handgun pressed against Liu Feng's head. Ouros blinked through the sweat.

Liu Feng held the handgun against Ouros's head. She shivered.

Across the river, as if in a mirror, another Liu Feng and another Ouros looked back at them.

Two Liu Fengs.

Two Ouroses.

Four handguns.

The Liu Feng that was cold opened her mouth. "I wish…"

When the shooting stopped, only the Guardians still lived. They stared at each other from across the river.

"How did you know?" Liu Feng asked.

"I could feel the heat of the Forge on my skin." Ouros shook her head. "You could not?"

Liu Feng shook her head also.

"Forget these tricksters. They can teach us nothing. And you have so much left to learn."
70083888.lore_zh:
她拿着手枪顶着刘枫的脑袋。奥罗斯在汗水滴落中眨了下眼睛。

刘枫拿着手枪对着奥罗斯的脑袋。她浑身颤抖。

河的对岸，似乎像照镜子一样，另一个刘枫和另一个奥罗斯转头看向他们。

两个刘枫。

两个奥罗斯。

四把手枪。

刘枫冷冷开腔，“我希望……”

当交火停止时，只有守护者还活着。她们隔河相视。

“你怎么知道的？”刘枫问。

“我的皮肤感觉到了熔炉热度。”奥洛斯摇了摇头。“你感觉不到吗？”

刘枫也摇了摇头。

“忘了这些骗子吧，他们什么也教不了我们。而你要学的东西还有很多。”

688331960.name: Nation of Beasts
688331960.flavor: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.

501329015.name: Chattering Bone
501329015.flavor: We have so much to discuss, o seeker mine.
501329015.lore:
Nadiya sipped her tea, calm and collected. Shinobu sat back, looking perplexed. "Really, the entire summer?"

The serpent that claimed to look like her mother sat across from the two of them, smiling broadly. "Why would I lie? I'm telling you, the whole summer you wore that dress. We had to tackle you to get the thing off of you, get you to bathe."

The serpent plucked the dainty cup from the white saucer and set it to her lips before continuing. "Your brother called you stinkbug for years. Until… you know."

Nadiya reached over and took the other Hunter's hand in her own. "It would lie because it's fulfilling your wish, Nobu."

Shinobu searched the serpent's face. Her mother just smiled again, all teeth and secrets. Shinobu felt tears at the corners of her eyes. Her voice was barely a whisper. "Okay. Now."

The burst from the pulse rifle was loud, and Nadiya pulled the trigger again and again and again.
501329015.lore_zh:
纳迪亚小口喝着茶，冷静又集中。忍野向后坐了回去，满脸困惑。“真的吗，整个夏天？”

声称看起来像她母亲的毒蛇坐在他们两人对面，大笑道：“我为什么要撒谎？我告诉你，整个夏天你都穿着那件衣服。我们不得不把你绊倒才能把那东西脱下来，让你洗个澡。

毒蛇从白色茶托上拿起精致的杯子，将杯子递到嘴边才继续说。“你的哥哥多年来一直叫你臭虫。直到……你知道的。”

纳迪亚伸出手，抓住另一名猎人的手。“它为了满足了你的愿望是会说谎的，野。”

忍野摸索着毒蛇的脸。她的母亲又笑了笑，吐露出所有的牙齿和秘密。忍野触碰到了她眼角流出的泪。她的声音几乎是在喃喃自语。“好了，够了。”

脉冲步枪的枪声响亮，纳迪亚不停地，不停地扣动着扳机。

3767125177.name: Chattering Bone
3767125177.flavor: We have so much to discuss, o seeker mine.

1851777734.name: Apex Predator
1851777734.flavor: Is it you or I that tops the food chain, o challenger mine?
1851777734.lore:
The massive Vex construct that was the Ahamkhara towered over them, and Taeko-3 tried not to be bored. Being bored might lead to idle wishes, and that would be bad right now. She thought again about the name she'd squinted at on the porcelain chit when she'd drawn lots back at the Tower. Two-name Guardians always struck her as a little pretentious.

"Gallida?" The Warlock didn't look up from the drawing she was making; she just held up a finger. "The rear ventral plate, please?" Graciously, the construct shifted its superstructure and allowed the researcher a detailed look at the thing's internal workings. "And… there." The Warlock turned toward Taeko. "You may proceed."

"Finally." As Gallida ran clear, and the beast warbled a Vex war cry, Taeko hefted the massive launcher up over her shoulder and sighted down the line. "Girl's gotta eat!"
1851777734.lore_zh:
阿罕卡拉耸立成巨大的Vex建筑，而妙子3号努力在找乐子。无聊可能导致随意的愿望，对现在来说情况不妙。当她回忆高塔时，又想到了她在瓷器上瞥到的名字。两个名字的守护者总是让她觉得有点儿自命不凡。

“加里达？”术士正在画图，头都没抬；她只举起一根手指。“后面的腹板？”建筑优雅地移动了它的上层结构，让研究人员得以详细了解内部运作。“还有……那里。”术士转身看向妙子：“你可以继续了。”

“终于。”当加里达清醒过来，野兽发出一声Vex战吼，妙子将巨大的发射器架在肩膀上，瞄准。“姑娘家的必须吃饱饭！”

1308286454.name: Apex Predator
1308286454.flavor: Is it you or I that tops the food chain, o challenger mine?

3885259140.name: Transfiguration
3885259140.flavor: Desire becomes reality, o wishbringer mine.
3885259140.lore:
"You're sure you want to keep on with the axe?" Efrideet asked, reloading her rifle. The voice in her comms was barely winded, even as the Iron Lord leapt to avoid a plume of white-hot fire.

"That's why she gave it to me, I'm one of the only…" A globule of flame licked past Efrideet's helmet, and she tugged at her clasp, shrugging free the now-burning cloak. "Why in the Traveler's crack did you wish to fight an actual DRAGON, old man?"

Saladin Forge grinned inside his helmet. The enormous wyrm towered above them, bleeding wounds covering its gleaming scales as it reared up for another breath. The massive axe in his hands was dented, scarred, and melted at the tip. But it still held an edge. "We are knights, Lady Efrideet. Do you not want to be a dragon slayer?"

He charged, and his words could barely be heard over the creature's cry. "We are what we survive!"
3885259140.lore_zh:
“你确定还要继续用斧头？”艾弗里迪特一边给步枪装弹，一边问道。即使当钢铁领主跳着逃开一缕白热的火焰，她通讯中的声音也几乎连喘息都没有。

“这就是为什么她把它给了我，我是唯一……”火焰舔过艾弗里迪特的头盔，她使劲儿拽下了扣子，耸肩甩开了正在燃烧的斗篷。“为什么在旅行者的裂缝中，你想和一只真正的巨龙战斗，老家伙？”

萨拉丁·弗吉在头盔里咧嘴一笑。巨龙在上方耸立，当它再次跳起来吐息时，覆盖着闪光鳞片的伤口喷出鲜血。他手中的巨大斧头充满坑洼和疤痕，斧尖也融化了，但仍然锋利。“我们是骑士，艾弗里迪特夫人。你不想成为一名屠龙者吗？”

他猛冲过去，在巨龙的吼叫声里，几乎难以听清他的话。“这是我们生存下去的方式！”

268816284.name: Transfiguration
268816284.flavor: Desire becomes reality, o wishbringer mine.

2884596447.name: The Supremacy
2884596447.flavor: "He didn't recognize me, at the end." —Jolyon Till the Rachis
2884596447.lore:
"Here's the thing," he says. "No."

Petra is trying to hide the hurt in her expression. Watching her is exhausting, so Jolyon keeps his eye pressed to his sniper scope.

"I thought you would want to see it."

"Why? He's dead. He died a long time before you shot him. Or if you didn't," Jolyon says, as if Petra flinched, "you helped that Guardian do it."

"Jolyon," Petra starts.

He holds up a hand. "I'm not interested in your secrets." Then, quieter, "Please."

Silence falls over them as they lie side-by-side in a sniper's nest overlooking Rheasilvia. Both belly-down in the sand, clutching well-worn Supremacy rifles beneath their armpits. Petra takes a shot. A Taken Hive Knight seethes into nothingness.

Finally, she gets up to go. Jolyon rolls onto his side, pushes himself half-up and calls after her. "I still dream about the Garden."

She looks back. "I've dreamed about it, too," she says carefully.

"Not like I have." Jolyon licks his lips, trying to figure out if he has anything else to say. He finally decides that he doesn't, so he rolls back onto his belly to settle his cheek against the Supremacy once more.

"That's all. I just wanted someone to know."
2884596447.lore_zh:
“就是这样，”他说道。“不。”

佩特拉试图隐藏受伤的表情。光是看着她就感到筋疲力竭，所以乔里恩一直盯着他的狙击镜。

“我以为你会想看看。”

“为什么？他已经死了。他在你开枪之前很久就已经死了。也许你没开枪。”乔里恩说道，佩特拉似乎畏缩了一下，“但是是你协助那个守护者做到的。”

“乔里恩”，佩特拉开口。

他举起一只手，“我对你的秘密不感兴趣。”气氛更安静了。“拜托。”

他们并肩靠在一个俯瞰雷亚希尔维亚的狙击手巢穴中。两人都趴在沙中，紧紧抓着夹在腋下那个破旧不堪的霸权步枪。佩特拉开了一枪。一个傀儡邪魔族骑士燃成虚无。

终于，她起身要走。乔里恩滚到他身边，撑起半个身子叫她。“我还是会梦见花园。”

她回头看了一眼：“我也梦见过，”她小心翼翼地说道。

“和我的不一样。”乔里恩舔了舔嘴唇，在想着他是不是还有别的话要说。他最终决定算了，就又滚了回去，再次将颧骨抵在霸权上。

“这样就好。我只想让某人知道。”

2177480113.name: The Supremacy
2177480113.flavor: "He didn't recognize me, at the end." —Jolyon Till the Rachis

3890055324.name: Targeted Redaction
3890055324.lore:
The neon-saturated skyline of Neomuna pops bright against the starry night sky. On a rooftop overlooking an empty, tree-lined plaza, Saint and Osiris sit in contemplative silence. They are making time for one another in the margins of their lives, pushing responsibilities aside as much as they can. 

"So, is she doing any better?" Osiris asks, breaking several minutes of peaceful silence. "Sloane," he clarifies. 

"Every day is small progress," Saint explains. "And even small progress is something to be proud of." 

Osiris nods, watching the glittering lights in the distance. "It's nothing short of a miracle that she survived all that time on Titan. A portion of Asher Mir also seems to have survived his dive into the Pyramidion. Don't lose hope in the darkness," he says, joining his hand with Saint's. 

"Yes. Perhaps there is even hope for Brother Vance." Saint offers. 

Osiris stares at him in prolonged silence. 

"Who?" 

Saint coughs and politely changes the topic.
3890055324.lore_zh:
浸满霓虹灯的内欧姆那天际线在繁星漫天的夜空映衬下格外耀眼。屋顶上，圣人和奥斯里斯在沉默中静静地坐着，俯瞰着一个空无一人、绿树成荫的广场。他们在生活的边缘为彼此腾出时间，尽可能地把职责搁置一旁。 

“所以，她有好转吗？”奥斯里斯问道，打破了持续数分钟的宁静。“斯隆，”他指明道。 

“每天都有小进步，”圣人解释道。“即使是微小的进步也值得骄傲。” 

奥斯里斯点点头，看着远处璀璨的灯火。“她在土卫六上活了那么长时间，简直是个奇迹。阿什·米尔的一部分似乎也在他潜入金字塔时活了下来。不要在黑暗中失去希望，”他说着，握着圣人的手。 

“是的。也许万斯修士还有希望。”圣人说道。 

奥斯里斯久久沉默地凝视着他。 

“谁？” 

圣人咳嗽了一声，礼貌地岔开了话题。

3016891299.name: Different Times
3016891299.lore:
At the base of the mesa, Lord Shaxx stands triumphant. Blood seeps into the grass at his feet as the Warlord before him, legs shattered, makes a feeble attempt to drag himself away.

"It's over," Shaxx decrees. "Bring out your Ghost."

The Warlord shakes his head, hands trembling even as he claws at the hard-packed earth. In the distance, atop the mesa, the setting sun kisses the parapets of Shaxx's castle, untouched by the violence in its shadow. Behind its walls, tendrils of smoke gently waft into the sky as the Ghostless under Shaxx's protection begin preparing the fires for their meals.

Six Warlords arrived to conquer his stronghold. Five met their final death. 

"Your Ghost," Shaxx repeats. He steps forward and crushes the Warlord's hand with his boot.

The Warlord cries out in pain, and all at once, the defiance leaves him like the breath in his lungs. His Ghost materializes, their eye fixated on Shaxx in fear.

Lord Shaxx shapes his Solar Light into a burning hammer, and in a single swing—

A clang of molten metal shakes him back to the present.

On the screen in front of him, a Guardian tosses her Hammer of Sol into the opposing team. Five erupt in flames as the lone survivor retreats.  The Guardian pursues.

Shaxx, without missing a beat, refocuses his attention on the Crucible match.

"Look at them fall!" he shouts over the comms. 

A moment later, the Sunbreaker catches up to the last opponent and incinerates them. 

Shaxx cheers her on as the smoke swallows his memories of a different time.
3016891299.lore_zh:
在台地的底部，领主沙克斯得意洋洋地站立着。鲜血渗进他脚边的草地，而他面前的战争领主，双腿粉碎，无力地试图挪走。

“结束了，”沙克斯裁定道。“把你的机灵叫出来。”

战争领主摇了摇头，抓着坚硬泥土的双手颤抖着。远处的台地之上，落日亲吻着沙克斯城堡的护墙，丝毫未受其阴影下暴力的影响。在它的高墙后，沙克斯保护下的没有机灵的百姓开始为他们的饭菜准备炉火，卷须般的烟雾轻轻地飘向天空。

六个战争领主前来征服他的据点。有五个已经永远地死去。 

“你的机灵，”沙克斯重复道。他走上前去，用靴子踩碎了战争领主的手。

战争领主痛苦地呼喊着，突然，反抗就像他肺里的呼吸一样消失了。他的机灵显形，眼睛恐惧地盯着沙克斯。

领主沙克斯把他的烈日光能塑造成一把燃烧的战锤，一挥而就——

熔融金属的铿锵声把他带回了现实。

他面前的屏幕上，一名守护者把她的烈焰战锤投到了敌方队伍中。五个身躯在熊熊燃烧，而唯一的幸存者撤退了。那名守护者穷追不舍。

沙克斯毫不迟疑地把注意力重新集中在了熔炉竞技场比赛上。

“看着他们倒下！”他在通讯频道上喊道。 

片刻之后，炎阳追上最后一个对手并将其烧成了灰烬。 

沙克斯为她欢呼，烟雾吞噬了他不同时代的记忆。

2883484461.name: Until Its Return
2883484461.source: Source: Season of the Deep Activities
2883484461.lore:
Whatever their odds of success, the plan was sound. They each had their assignments. Sloane turned away to examine a projection of the lower sections of the Arcology. Zavala glanced over the first of the scouting reports.  

Working alongside Deputy Commander Sloane felt perfectly natural, as if the years that parted them had been restored alongside Titan. Zavala had expected the silence that followed to be equally familiar, even companionable.  

The truth was apparent in the abrasive passage of each minute. The faint sense memory of ozone in his nostrils. The gulf between them had merely shifted in quality: deep, not wide.  

Zavala set the datapad aside. "Sloane. There's one more item of business."  

She turned to face him, ever dutiful. "Sir?" 

"It's been a day for reunions, hasn't it?" He nodded to Targe.  

A parcel materialized into Zavala's hands in a burst of Light and transmat energy. It was heavy, wrapped carefully in cloth and secured with buckled straps that Zavala made short work of. 

Sloane stared. "Thought it'd be collecting dust on somebody's wall by now."  

"A mutual friend felt very strongly that it belonged in your hands."  

Sloane hesitated. Her expression hardened; she reached out to grip the handle of the blade, and hefted Crown-Splitter aloft with ease.  

Sloane smiled.  

"Feels like it never left."
2883484461.lore_zh:
不管他们成功的几率有多大，这个计划都是合理的。他们有各自的任务。斯隆转过身去查看生态园区下方区域的投影。萨瓦拉浏览着第一份侦察报告。  

和副指挥官斯隆一起工作的感觉非常自然，就好像他们分离的岁月已经和土卫六一起恢复如初。萨瓦拉原以为接下来的沉默也会同样熟悉，同样友善。  

真相在每一分钟刺耳的流逝中都显而易见。他的鼻孔里隐约有着对臭氧的感知记忆。他们之间的鸿沟只是在性质上发生了变化：更深，而非更宽。  

萨瓦拉放下了数据板。“斯隆。还有一件事。”  

她转身面向他，还是那样地恪尽职守。“什么事，长官？” 

“今天是团圆的日子，不是吗？”他向塔格点点头。  

在一束光能和传送能量中，一个包裹出现在萨瓦拉的手中。它很重，小心翼翼地包在布里，用萨瓦拉很快做好的扣带固定着。 

斯隆凝视着。“我还以为它现在已经在谁的墙上积灰了呢。”  

“我们一位共同的朋友非常强烈地感觉到它属于你。”  

斯隆迟疑了。她的表情变得严肃起来；她伸手抓住刀柄，轻松地把裂冠者举到空中。  

斯隆笑了。  

“感觉它从没离开过。”

1769847435.name: A Distant Pull
1769847435.flavor: From distant hollows, a call demands attention.
1769847435.lore:
Titan fell into darkness only moments before the first Tomb-craft arrived. They bore the burning sigils of War, dripping soulfire from their branded hulls as if it gushed from an open wound.  

Beneath the churning sea, a Guardian Light wrapped in metal, yet to be coiled in promise, watched the skies turn to ink, and Hive fiends disembark the invading craft. 

Proclamations scattered across the methane ocean, eager words searing each wave's crest with jade flame. The Hive's intent was clear: tear asunder the claims of the Witch Sister. Raise the banners of War. 

Led by a massive Knight, Acolytes descended to depths once infested by denizens of the lie, down to where the song of trickery echoed from long-dead shrieks. They marched in adorant procession, surrounded by a host of Thralls that defaced the remnant traces of Savathûn's holdings with hungering delight. 

Held aloft in the claws of a central Acolyte was a Wizard's skull, recovered from the flame-licked wash before Titan's capture. The Acolyte delicately placed the skull upon a ragged sheet of conquered foe-flesh while others carved a circle of runes around it. 

The Acolytes took position over the runes. They threw their heads back and howled a discordant melody that ignited the rune-circle, consuming each of them in soulfire conflagration. 

The melody took hold, flooding the flesh of the accompanying Thralls with frenzy. They surged forward, kicked and clawed their kin in a mad scramble to reach the skull first. To claim it. 

Each time the melody thrummed, an Acolyte turned to ash. Each time the melody thrummed, spilled Thrall viscera twisted into fetid swirls around the skull. 

Blood and ash was offered until none remained; the Knight stepped forward, brandishing a blade of deathly menace. 

"I call Xivu Arath. I invoke War's presence. Take this dreg, cast out by your sister. Take her claims as your own." 

The churning soulflame was drawn into the Knight's deathly blade, then plunged into the Wizard's skull. The runic circle projected an ancient realm, and the Knight felt watchful eyes leering from atop a distant Black Terrace perched above that projected realm. The thunderous response pressed him to his knees. 

KELGORATH, I ACCEPT THINE OFFERINGS 

THROUGH WILL, LIES ARE UNEARTHED 

THROUGH WILL, LIES ARE MADE TRUTH 

THROUGH WILL, LIES FALL TO CONQUEST 

 KUDAZAD, BOUND, YOU ARE NAMED IN SERVICE
1769847435.lore_zh:
当第一艘棺艇抵达时，土卫六刚陷入黑暗不久。它们身上带着燃烧的战争印记，灵魂之火从烙印的船体上滴落下来，就像从一个裸露的伤口里喷涌而出。  

翻腾的大海之下，一个被金属包裹、尚未被承诺缠绕的守护者光能，看着苍穹化为黑墨，邪魔族恶魔走下了入侵的飞船。 

宣言散布在甲烷海中，热切的话语用翡翠色的火焰灼烧着每一个浪尖。邪魔族的意图很明确：撕碎女巫姐妹的要求。高举战争的旗帜。 

在一位高大骑士的带领下，仆从们下潜到谎言居民曾经出没的深处，直至诡计之歌在早已死亡的尖叫声中回荡的地方。他们列队前进，一群怨魂环绕周围，如狼似虎般地毁坏萨瓦图恩的残存痕迹。 

中央仆从的爪子高举着一个巫师的头骨，那是在土卫六被占领之前从火焰舔舐的浪花中找到的。这名仆从把头骨轻轻地放在一块被征服的敌人烂肉上，其他仆从则在它周围刻了一圈符文。 

仆从们在符文四周站定位置。他们仰起头，嚎叫着一段不怎么悦耳的旋律，点燃了符文圈，灵魂之火在烈焰中吞噬了他们每个人。 

旋律席卷而来，疯狂地淹没了一旁怨魂的肉体。它们冲上前去，在疯狂的争夺中对同类又踢又抓，想要率先拿到头骨。夺取它。 

每当旋律弹起，一个仆从就会化为灰烬。每当旋律弹起，四溅的怨魂内脏就会在头骨周围扭曲成恶臭的漩涡。 

鲜血和灰烬轮番奉上，直到一个也不剩；骑士走上前去，挥舞着死亡威胁之刃。 

“我呼唤希乌阿拉斯。我号召战争的降临。拿走这些被你的姐妹扔出去的渣滓。将她的主张据为己有。” 

翻腾的灵魂之火被吸入骑士的死亡之刃，然后插入了巫师的头骨。符文圈投射出一块古老领地，骑士感到远处的黑色平台上有一双警惕的眼睛在斜视着。雷鸣般的应答促使他跪了下来。 

克尔格拉斯，我接受你的贡品 

经由意志，谎言会被揭穿 

经由意志，谎言成为真相 

经由意志，谎言会被征服 

 附庸库达萨德，你已被任命

1081724548.name: Rapacious Appetite
1081724548.lore:
To: Vanguard High Command 
Incident Report Source: Scout Patrol 919 
Report: Kraken Mare, Exterior Shelf Shallows—High Priority-0174 
Target: J4W-S, Aberrant Houseless Servitor, Wrathborn 
Threat Type: Ambusher, supported by hostile Warband(s), Engage with Extreme Caution 
Noted Casualties: 8, not all incidents recorded. 
Known Armaments: Servitor Eye Projector, Material Denial Shield, Displacement Thresher, Kinetic Impact. 

Incident Report-309: Servitor J4W-S was spotted in the southern ridge of Kraken Mare. Dive Tactical was notified, and fireteams were pulled from the area. Upon retreat, one fireteam was ambushed by a Hive warband. J4W-S then dove from above, and crashed into the fireteam, using its body as a kinetic driver. One fireteam member was killed on impact, and their Ghost was captured. Both remaining Guardians were able to escape after a prolonged exchange of fire. 

          RE: Recovery teams dispatched. 

Recovery Incident Report-317: Dive Tactical and accompanying fireteams prepared an ambush and engaged J4W-S outside of Delta Sector. When caught in the crossfire, J4W-S initially fled the battle under the cover of Taken forces, only to harry the fireteams with guerrilla attacks from the surrounding methane sea. Note this Wrathborn Servitor retains the use of their displacement thresher and has begun using it to pick up and drop fireteam members into the methane sea's open depths, outside the safety of the coral shelves. The thin density of the liquid makes survival without independent propulsion unlikely and recovering remains for Ghost resurrection difficult. Dive Tactical is advised not to engage J4W-S near shelf drops or cliff faces in the future. 

          RE: J4W-S has been confirmed to have been converted to a Wrathborn Servitor. This would explain its aggression and predatory behaviors. Following notable operator losses, Dive Tactical has erected radar buoys to detect ambushes in what have come to be known as the Servitor's hunting grounds.
1081724548.lore_zh:
接收方：先锋最高指挥部 
事件报告来源：斥候巡逻919 
报告：克拉肯海，外大陆架浅海—高优先级-0174 
目标：J4W-S，异常无氏族魔眼，暴怒之子 
威胁类型：伏击者，受敌对战团支援，作战须极度谨慎 
伤亡记录：8人，并未记录所有事件。 
已知武器：魔眼之眼投射器，物质拒止护盾，位移长尾鲨，动能冲击。 

事件报告-309：克拉肯海南部山脊发现J4W-S魔眼行迹。已通知潜水战术指挥，各火力战队也已从现场撤离。撤退时，一支火力战队遭到了邪魔族战团的伏击。J4W-S随后从上方俯冲，利用身体作为动能驱动器撞向火力战队。一名火力战队成员在撞击中被杀，其机灵被俘获。剩下两名守护者在长时间交火后逃脱了。 

          回复：已派出回收小队。 

回收事件报告-317：潜水战术指挥和随行的火力战队准备了伏击，并在三角洲区外与J4W-S交战。陷入交火时，J4W-S最初在傀儡军团部队的掩护下逃离战斗，随后用来自周围甲烷海的游击攻击骚扰火力战队。请注意，这一暴怒之子魔眼仍能使用其位移长尾鲨，并已开始利用它来抓取火力战队成员，并将其投掷到珊瑚陆架安全地带之外的甲烷海开放深处。稀薄的液体密度使得在缺少独立推进系统的情况下不太可能生存，而回收遗骸供机灵复活也愈发困难。下潜战术指挥建议在未来不要与J4W-S在陆架下降地带或悬崖附近交战。 

          回复：J4W-S已确认转化为暴怒之子魔眼。这就可以解释其好斗与掠食行为。在损失了相当数量的操作员后，潜水战术指挥已部署雷达浮标，以探测魔眼狩猎场的伏击。

4066778670.name: Thin Precipice
4066778670.flavor: Sharpened, from tip to hilt, drawing from all who partake in the ritual of war.
4066778670.lore:
Kelgorath kneels before a feeble altar in an empty court. A dead Knight's realm. A shriveled, fleshless rind. A cautionary tale. 

A Wizard floats over the altar. "The High Celebrant's domain was once a grand place of adoration. It holds a mighty tribute." The Wizard, Rakthrin, War-Council, whispers Xivu Arath's bait to the Knight. 

Kelgorath remembers how Savathûn sought the Sky and became its puppet, all so she could usurp sword logic. "Favor wanes. It can be rekindled." 

"You were disarmed. Shamed. Beaten so many times by a Light-wielder." 

Kelgorath stands, spinning to face Rakthrin. He thrusts a claw forward at the Wizard's throat, but she swoops back from his reach.  

Kelgorath sneers. "I need no blade; I am wielded. The plates upon my body are razors." 

"Should you have remained with Savathûn and prayed to her to give you the Light… perhaps you would have found greatness then. You wither without her favor." 

"I spit on the Witch Sister! I am an instrument of War!" 

"Not yet. Not truly." 

Rakthrin conjures a dark bolt of lightning that saps the room's dim lighting and casts it into the altar. The altar splits apart with a timbered snap, revealing an emerald sliver of a blade, bleeding shade and whispering rapture. "A shard of the Taken King's blade. Conquered out of love. Stolen away from Saturn's shadow." 

Kelgorath fixates upon the blade shard. The Wizard gestures to it with a lipless smile, and the Knight steps forward.

"I will take it. To be an instrument of her will. To cleanse the hate of weakness with loving violence." Kelgorath genuflects and encloses his claws around the emerald sliver, wisps of shadow spilling between the gaps in his claws. "I offer myself to this union." 

The barrier of his flesh melts away. A will not his own enraptures him.  

Kelgorath, Risen from Bones, Taken by War.
4066778670.lore_zh:
克尔格拉斯跪在空荡庭院里一个光线微弱的祭坛前。死去骑士的领地。干瘪无肉的外壳。警诫的故事。 

一名巫师漂浮在圣坛上。“高阶颂扬者的领地曾经是一处宏大的崇拜之地。它承载着强大的贡品。”战争议会巫师拉克瑟林，对骑士低语着希乌阿拉斯的诱饵之言。 

克尔格拉斯记得萨瓦图恩如何寻求苍穹并成为它的傀儡，这一切都是为了侵占邪剑守则。“偏爱消逝。可以重新点燃它。” 

“你被一个负光者缴械、羞辱和击败了那么多次。” 

克尔格拉斯站了起来，转身面对着拉克瑟林。他把一只爪子伸向巫师的喉咙，但她退到了他够不着的地方。  

克尔格拉斯冷笑道。“我不需要刀刃；我即是兵器。我身上的鳞片就是剃刀。” 

“如果你有留在萨瓦图恩身边，祈祷她给你光能…也许你会成就伟大。没了她的宠爱，你就会枯萎。” 

“我唾弃女巫姐妹！我是战争的工具！” 

“还不是，还算不上。” 

拉克瑟林召唤了一道黑暗的闪电，侵蚀着房间昏暗的灯光，把它投入了祭坛。祭坛随着一声木质撕裂声分崩离析，露出一片翡翠般的刀刃，流着阴影之血和窃窃私语的狂喜。“邪神之刃的碎片。因爱而被征服。从土星的阴影中被窃取。” 

克尔格拉斯盯着刀刃碎片。巫师带着无唇的微笑朝它示意，骑士走上前去。

“我会拿走它。成为她意志的工具。用爱的暴力来净化对软弱的仇恨。”克尔格拉斯跪下来，用爪子抓住了翡翠银片，一缕缕影子从爪子的缝隙中溢出来。“我把自已奉献给这样的结合。” 

他肉体的屏障消失了。一个不属于他的意志令他着迷。  

他成为了战争傀儡，白骨复生者，克尔格拉斯。

3125454907.name: Loaded Question
3125454907.flavor: "Hey. You see Cayde around, tell him his gun's ready." —Banshee-44
3125454907.lore:
Banshee stares at the paper, then turns it upside down.

"I never said I was an artist," Cayde says over Banshee's shoulder. "This gets at the spirit of it."

Banshee turns the paper around again. "So that's…"

"The laser tracker, yeah."

"Huh." Banshee tilts his head. "And those…"

"Racing stripes."

"…On a fusion rifle."

"We're just—" Cayde throws his arms up. "We're just tossin' out ideas here, pal! Don't shut anything down until you get the whole picture."

"Seems like the picture's the problem."

"OK. Listen—the details aren't important. I just want a good gun that you take out and the fight's already over." He shoots at invisible opponents. "Tsuu-tsuu-tsuu! The end."

Banshee relaxes. He knows good guns.

Cayde clasps Banshee's shoulder. "So is that a yes?"

"Uh-huh."

"Great!" Cayde claps his hands. "Not to rush your genius, but chop-chop, all right? I maybe made a bet with a certain Crucible handler, and I maybe don't have the Glimmer to back it up, so… By the way, you'll do this on an IOU, right?"

 Banshee points to the paper one more time. "Is that…?"

"A bottle opener, yes."
3125454907.lore_zh:
班西盯着纸，将它上下颠倒。

“我从没说我画画好”，凯德在班西身后说。“只是有个神韵。”

班西又把纸转了回来。“那这……”

“是的，激光追踪器。”

“啊。”班西歪着头。“那这些……”

“竞赛条纹。”

“…… 融合步枪上的。”

“我们只——”凯德举着双臂。“我们不过是在想新点子嘛，兄弟！看完整体再下定论嘛。”

“这整体看上去就很成问题。”

“好吧，你看——细节没那么重要。我只是想让你造出把好枪，仗就会结束得快点儿嘛。”他对着不存在的敌人“唰唰唰，结束！”

班西叹了口气，他还是知道几把好枪的。

凯德拍了拍班西的肩膀，“这么说你同意啦？”

“嗯哼。”

“太棒了！”凯德鼓掌。“不是在催促你啊，但尽量快，好吗？好像我跟熔炉竞技场的某个顾问下了个注，好像我没那么多微光，所以……对了，可以打白条，对吧？”

班西再次指着纸上画的东西。“这是……？”

“是的，开瓶器啊。”

"OK. Listen—the details aren't important. I just want a good gun that you take out and the fight's already over." He shoots at invisible opponents. "Tsuu-tsuu-tsuu! The end."

Banshee relaxes. He knows good guns.

Cayde clasps Banshee's shoulder. "So is that a yes?"

"Uh-huh."

"Great!" Cayde claps his hands. "Not to rush your genius, but chop-chop, all right? I maybe made a bet with a certain Crucible handler, and I maybe don't have the Glimmer to back it up, so… By the way, you'll do this on an IOU, right?"

 Banshee points to the paper one more time. "Is that…?"

"A bottle opener, yes."
1515561791.lore_zh:
班西盯着纸，将它上下颠倒。

“我从没说我画画好”，凯德在班西身后说。“只是有个神韵。”

班西又把纸转了回来。“那这……”

“是的，激光追踪器。”

“啊。”班西歪着头。“那这些……”

“竞赛条纹。”

“…… 融合步枪上的。”

“我们只——”凯德举着双臂。“我们不过是在想新点子嘛，兄弟！看完整体再下定论嘛。”

“这整体看上去就很成问题。”

“好吧，你看——细节没那么重要。我只是想让你造出把好枪，仗就会结束得快点儿嘛。”他对着不存在的敌人“唰唰唰，结束！”

班西叹了口气，他还是知道几把好枪的。

凯德拍了拍班西的肩膀，“这么说你同意啦？”

“嗯哼。”

“太棒了！”凯德鼓掌。“不是在催促你啊，但尽量快，好吗？好像我跟熔炉竞技场的某个顾问下了个注，好像我没那么多微光，所以……对了，可以打白条，对吧？”

班西再次指着纸上画的东西。“这是……？”

“是的，开瓶器啊。”

3667553455.name: BrayTech Osprey
3667553455.lore:
"Did you find anything strange about the latest Warmind hashes?"
"Not really. What's the issue?"
"Something just seems off. What kind of enemy is this intended for?"
"Isn't that the whole point of the Warmind? It knows better than we do. We just do what it tells us to do."
"And you're okay with that?"
"Heck yeah! My job's never been easier. I have more time for the kids."
"Take this seriously. We're building weapons here, not toys."
"You worry too much."
3667553455.lore_zh:
“你发现最近的战争思维哈希值有什么不对劲的地方吗？”
“没有，有问题吗？”
“有地方不对劲，这到底是为什么样的敌人准备的？”
“这不就是战争思维存在的意义吗？它比我们理解得更多，我们只是按照它的指示行事。”
“而你没有其他想法？”
“当然没有，我的工作从来就不轻松，我倒是肯多花点时间在孩子身上。”
“别开玩笑，我们是在这里建造武器，不是制作玩具。”
“你担心过头了。”

4005780578.name: Unexpected Resurgence
4005780578.flavor: "Stasis was the thesis. Strand is his dissertation." —Sister Faora
4005780578.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
4005780578.lore:
Shayura kneels in front of a gilded copper pot and the young bonsai rising from inside it. Tucked away in the soil are the vertically sliced fragments of a Ghost. The tree grows up around them, and where root and dirt meet, Shayura places a stick of lit incense. 

The Bazaar is quiet as she lifts the freshly potted tree and places it on a low table, overlooking the City the Traveler once protected. "You are missed," Shayura whispers, brushing her fingertips against the soft branches.  

The remains of Reed-7's Ghost stare up at her.  

For a moment, she remembers seeing the cockpit of her jumpship littered with the Ghosts of her victims. Yet her Ghost was spared the Witness's wrath. Aisha's too, but this pain isn't about her. It is selfish. Shayura's heart lurches, and she tries to center herself. 

"I exalt my fireteam."  

"Is that a prayer?" A woman asks behind her. Shayura quickly turns and spots a stranger approaching between stalls. She carries a glaive like a walking staff. Its design matches the ornate pattern of her robes. Familiar. Osirian. 

"…Of sorts," Shayura answers belatedly.  

The robed woman bows, apologetic. "I ask for a moment of your time, Shayura."  

Hearing her name from the mouth of a stranger sets Shayura on edge. She glances at the memorial, then stands.  

"Please, leave me be." 

"My name is Sister Faora," the robed woman continues. "Devotee of Osiris, Seeker of Truth. Outcast." The last title earns a squint from Shayura. 

"What do you want, Outcast Faora?" 

Sister Faora gestures to herself with one hand. "Only to offer you something that few others would, given your history." 

Shayura raises a brow in challenge. Faora boldly meets it. 

"Friendship."
4005780578.lore_zh:
沙玉拉跪在一个镀金的铜壶前，幼小的盆栽从壶内长出来。埋在土里的是被垂直切割的机灵碎片。树苗在它们周围生长着，而在树根和泥土相遇的位置，沙玉拉放上了一根点燃的香。 

集市寂静无声，她举起刚栽下的树，放在一张矮桌上，俯瞰着旅行者曾经保护过的圣城。“我们想念你，”沙玉拉低声说道，用指尖抚摸着柔软的树枝。  

里德-7机灵的残骸凝视着她。  

有那么一瞬间，她忆起了跃迁飞船的驾驶舱里到处都是受害者机灵的画面。但她的机灵躲过了见证者的怒火。艾莎的也是，但这痛苦与她无关。太自私了。沙玉拉的心猛地一跳，她试图集中注意力。 

“我赞美我的火力战队。”  

“是在祈祷吗？”一个女人在她身后问道。沙玉拉迅速转身，发现一名陌生人正在走近。她像拐杖一样拿着偃月。它的设计与她长袍的华丽图案相匹配。看起来很熟悉。奥斯里斯的风格。 

“…算是吧，”沙玉拉半晌才回答。  

穿长袍的女人带着歉意鞠了个躬。“我想占用你一点时间，沙玉拉。”  

从陌生人的口中听到她的名字让沙玉拉紧张不安。她望了一眼纪念碑，然后站了起来。  

“请不要打扰我。” 

“我是菲奥拉修女，”穿长袍的女人继续说。“奥斯里斯的信徒，真理追寻者。放逐者。”听到最后那个称号，沙玉拉瞥了她一眼。 

“你想做什么，放逐者菲奥拉？” 

菲奥拉修女用一只手对自己做了个手势。“鉴于你的过去，我只是想给你一样很少有人愿意提供的东西。” 

沙玉拉挑衅地扬起了眉毛。菲奥拉大方相迎。 

“友谊。”

3796795102.name: The Messenger
3796795102.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战
3796795102.lore:
Aunor was in a sour mood when she transmatted into Ikora's personal library. She hated visiting the Tower. Even in a room without doors, well away from the dank Annex basement, she could still smell the Drifter's sulfuric odor. How the others could stand it, she had no idea. 

Her irritation was softened slightly, when Ikora looked up from her writing with a smile. "I'm glad to see you," she said. 

"Interesting choice of words. I thought I was being summoned for a 'matter of grave importance. '" 

"'Relieved' may be the better word. There aren't many I can trust with an assignment like this." Ikora gestured towards a seat. Aunor shook her head.

"Is that so?" 

"I mean that as a compliment to you. Not a condemnation of anyone else." 

 "You don't need to butter me up before a bad job, Ikora." 

Ikora sighed, then tapped her datapad. "We've received word of another tainted Guardian in our ranks." 

Within her cloak, Aunor's pad dinged. She took it out, reading as she scrolled. "Disobeying orders, trading Vanguard secrets… Pretty standard. Prolonged and intentional torture?" She looked up questioningly. 

"Fallen civilians fleeing the House of Salvation," Ikora supplied, her voice grave. "According to her fireteam, she wanted to know how Eramis accessed the Darkness. "When they tried to intervene…" she trailed off. 

Aunor looked up sharply. "She tortured her own teammates too?" 

Ikora nodded. Aunor stowed her datapad back in her cloak. "Where's she headed now?" 

"We believe she's still on Europa, trying to access the Darkness on her own." 

"Makes sense. Now that the Vanguard's lifted the ban, she has plausible deniability. As does anyone else who's tempted by that power," she added pointedly.

阿诺尔在传送到艾可拉的私人图书馆时，心情十分低落。她讨厌去高塔，哪怕是在那些没有门的、敞亮的大厅，那些寻不见阴暗地下室的地方，她依然感觉自己能闻到Drifter身上那股硫磺味。她不敢想像其他人到底是怎么忍受过来的。

当艾可拉停下笔，把头抬起来冲她微笑的时候，她的怒气稍稍消减了一些。“很高兴见到你”，艾可拉说道。

“这话说得真有意思，我听说是因为有‘极其重要的事'才把我叫到这里来的。”

“大概‘排忧解难'这个词会更准确一些吧。这样的任务，我信得过的人不多。”艾可拉示意她坐下，而阿诺尔则摇了摇头。

“你确定？”

“这是对你的赞美，而不是对其他人的贬斥。”

 “艾可拉，让我去干脏活的时候不用刻意奉承我。”

艾可拉叹了口气，点了点自己的数据板：“我收到消息，我们的队伍中又多了一个被污染的守护者。”

阿诺尔的数据板在她的斗篷下叮叮当当响了起来。她顺手拿了出来，边看边读出了声：“违抗命令、出卖先锋军机密信息...很标准背叛行为。嗯？长期故意折磨？”她疑惑地抬起头。

“是那些逃离救赎之家的堕落者平民”，艾可拉补充道，声音十分严肃：“根据火力战队的回报，她想知道伊拉莫斯是怎么跟黑暗建立联系的。”当他们试图干预的时候...她就销声匿迹了。

阿诺尔猛地抬起头：“她连队友也折磨？”

艾可拉点了点头。阿诺尔把数据板收了起来，问到：“她往哪里逃了？”

“我们相信她还在木卫二上，想要独立于黑暗建立联系。”

“这也说得通。现在先锋军解除了禁令，她就有否认依据。那些受到权力诱惑的人都是这样，”她一针见血的说道。

“请不要让我再重复这些内容，先锋军——”

“先锋允许黑暗进入高塔区域。只要在浪客的监视之下，你也允许守护者去接触这些。否则，你就会派我去追杀他们作为惩罚。”

“不是惩罚”，艾可拉纠正她到：“是救赎。你要先给他们一个就范的机会，让他们有机会弥补自己犯下的过错，重新回到正轨上来。”

“到目前为止，没有人接受这个提议。”

“这不代表他们所有人都不会接受。”

“那么这个特雷斯廷呢？你觉得你运气这么好，她就一定会接受你的提议吗？到目前为止已经有多少个了？在这种情况下我不率先出手，就等于给他们机会先杀了我。”

“够了”。艾可拉眼神有些闪烁：“我也不会假装对这个任务结果保持乐观，下次也不会。但是谁也不能保证这些被污染的人就彻底变坏了，一点拯救的可能性都没有。在你不能证明这些之前，我的命令不会更改。听清楚了没有？”

阿诺尔盯着她，狠狠咬着牙：“还有下次？”说罢便摇了摇头：“罢了，下次等这些人在某个地方大肆破坏的时候，我相信你会松口的。”

“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

阿诺尔将这些顾虑一扫而空。“我会信守承诺”，她回答。然后一道蓝色的光闪过，她便消失在空气中。

 "You don't need to butter me up before a bad job, Ikora." 

Ikora sighed, then tapped her datapad. "We've received word of another tainted Guardian in our ranks." 

Within her cloak, Aunor's pad dinged. She took it out, reading as she scrolled. "Disobeying orders, trading Vanguard secrets… Pretty standard. Prolonged and intentional torture?" She looked up questioningly. 

"Fallen civilians fleeing the House of Salvation," Ikora supplied, her voice grave. "According to her fireteam, she wanted to know how Eramis accessed the Darkness. "When they tried to intervene…" she trailed off. 

Aunor looked up sharply. "She tortured her own teammates too?" 

Ikora nodded. Aunor stowed her datapad back in her cloak. "Where's she headed now?"

"And this Trestin? You think she'll be lucky number…  how many are we up to now? At this point, the only chance I'm giving them is the chance to kill me first."

"You don't have to do this, if you don't want to. I'd understand." 

Aunor swatted the concern away. "I stand by my promise," she said.  Then, in a flash of blue, she was gone.

阿诺尔的数据板在她的斗篷下叮叮当当响了起来。她顺手拿了出来，边看边读出了声：“违抗命令、出卖先锋军机密信息...很标准背叛行为。嗯？长期故意折磨？”她疑惑地抬起头。

“是那些逃离救赎之家的堕落者平民”，艾可拉补充道，声音十分严肃：“根据火力战队的回报，她想知道伊拉莫斯是怎么跟黑暗建立联系的。”当他们试图干预的时候...她就销声匿迹了。

阿诺尔猛地抬起头：“她连队友也折磨？”

艾可拉点了点头。阿诺尔把数据板收了起来，问到：“她往哪里逃了？”

“我们相信她还在木卫二上，想要独立于黑暗建立联系。”

“这也说得通。现在先锋军解除了禁令，她就有否认依据。那些受到权力诱惑的人都是这样，”她一针见血的说道。

“请不要让我再重复这些内容，先锋军——”

“先锋允许黑暗进入高塔区域。只要在浪客的监视之下，你也允许守护者去接触这些。否则，你就会派我去追杀他们作为惩罚。”

“不是惩罚”，艾可拉纠正她到：“是救赎。你要先给他们一个就范的机会，让他们有机会弥补自己犯下的过错，重新回到正轨上来。”

“到目前为止，没有人接受这个提议。”

“这不代表他们所有人都不会接受。”

“那么这个特雷斯廷呢？你觉得你运气这么好，她就一定会接受你的提议吗？到目前为止已经有多少个了？在这种情况下我不率先出手，就等于给他们机会先杀了我。”

“够了”。艾可拉眼神有些闪烁：“我也不会假装对这个任务结果保持乐观，下次也不会。但是谁也不能保证这些被污染的人就彻底变坏了，一点拯救的可能性都没有。在你不能证明这些之前，我的命令不会更改。听清楚了没有？”

阿诺尔盯着她，狠狠咬着牙：“还有下次？”说罢便摇了摇头：“罢了，下次等这些人在某个地方大肆破坏的时候，我相信你会松口的。”

“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

阿诺尔将这些顾虑一扫而空。“我会信守承诺”，她回答。然后一道蓝色的光闪过，她便消失在空气中。

1123421440.name: Epochal Integration
1123421440.flavor: "It is a wonder that we are still here. Keep it that way." —Osiris
1123421440.lore:
The Ishtar Collective's researchers knew no bounds: amidst a sea of their data, I found schematics for a weapon using the Veil's paracausal field as supplemental power. However, it appears the weapon project was abandoned early. I hoped I could finish what they started, and so I share the fruits of my labor with you, Guardian. 

Fusing Golden Age designs with modern necessity involved considerable guesswork, made worse by the lack of an extant prototype. I took liberties with the original schematic, choosing what to preserve, what to discard, and how to harmonize elements separated by centuries.  

The first fabricated pieces clicked into place, and abstraction became reality. But it was not what I envisioned. Too cold, impersonal, and utilitarian.  

I confess, I was sorely tempted to discard everything and start over. Yet I knew if I gave in to that familiar impulse, the hours would slip into days, and the days into months, while I strained for the vanishing limit of perfection in vain. 

In the end, I asked Saint if he could suggest the finishing touches. Engraving a pattern into the steel was his idea. I took his word for it; aesthetic flourishes are not a strength of mine. 

The result is this weapon: a synthesis of disparate elements into an unexpected shape. I am eager to see what you add to it, Guardian. 

—Osiris
1123421440.lore_zh:
伊什塔集团的研究者们可谓旷古绝今：在他们几乎无尽的数据之中，我找到了一种使用面纱的超因果力场作为额外能源的武器图纸。然而，这种武器的研发似乎提前终止了。我希望我能实现他们的愿景，所以我将把自己的劳动成果与你分享，守护者。 

将黄金时代的设计与现代的需要融合在一起涉及到相当多的揣测，由于缺乏现存的原型，这个步骤会更加艰难。我对原始图纸进行了一些修改：我留了些东西，也丢了些东西。我还思考了如何协调相隔几个世纪的设计元素。  

第一批零件新鲜出炉，完美地嵌进了武器主体。梦想成为了现实，但它与我的期待不相符。它太过冷酷、没有人情味，而且过于功利。  

我承认，我很想抛弃一切，重新开始。但我知道，如果我屈服于这种熟悉的冲动，那么任凭时光流逝，岁月蹉跎，只会余我徒劳地追求完美的极限。 

到最后，我问圣人对完成这把枪有何建议。他的主意是在金属部分雕刻图案。我听从了：美学上的修饰并不是我的强项。 

这件武器便是成果：一把由不同的元素糅合而成的、形态瑰异的武器。我等不及想看看你会为它添上什么了，守护者。 

——奥斯里斯

3256453690.name: Crowning Duologue
3256453690.lore:
It took a full seven minutes before Lord Shaxx stopped pretending that the screen in front of him was transmitting a live Crucible match and not a looped recording. He finally let out an aggrieved sigh and folded his arms across his chest.  

"Forge." 

"If you can spare a few moments," Lord Saladin said, with grim humor, "I wanted to talk."  

Shaxx leveled his helmet in Saladin's direction.  

Saladin returned his stare. "Fine. It isn't a matter of wanting. We need to talk." Saladin braced himself. "About Twilight Gap."  

Shaxx turned to face Saladin, arms sliding down to his sides. His chest expanded as he filled the great bellows of his lungs.  

"You made the right call," Saladin said, quickly.  

There was a muffled, choked sound from beneath Shaxx's helmet.  

"We've always known that much." Saladin's mouth twisted unhappily. He turned his gaze to the City's horizon, feigning interest in a flooded crater near the outskirts. "Even if I refused to admit it." 

"You saw hope where I couldn't. I told myself your defiance was grandstanding." Saladin laughed ruefully. "I'd given up. But you—you and your fireteam bought us time. Enough time for all of us to change." 

Shaxx stood unmoving. They both waited in protracted silence.  

At last, Saladin sighed. "After all these years, after everything… I trust your judgment. I just wanted you to know that."  

Shaxx's helmet shifted, just slightly. "Before the end?"  

"Before whatever comes next."  

Shaxx nodded slowly.  

"You know, I had a host of incredibly scathing comments prepared for this moment."  

Saladin smiled. "I bet you did."
3256453690.lore_zh:
足足过了七分钟，领主沙克斯才终于承认，他面前屏幕上的循环录像并不是熔炉竞技场比赛直播。他终于愤愤不平地叹了一口气，双臂交叉在胸前。  

“弗吉。” 

“有时间的话，”领主萨拉丁带着冷酷的幽默说，“我想和你谈谈。”  

沙克斯把头盔移向了萨拉丁的方向。  

萨拉丁回瞪着他。“好吧。这不是想不想的问题。我们需要谈谈。”萨拉丁打起精神。“关于暮光峡谷。”  

沙克斯转身面对萨拉丁，双臂滑落到身体两侧。他深吸了一大口气，胸膛随之扩张起来。  

“你做了正确的决定，”萨拉丁赶紧说道。  

沙克斯的头盔下面传来了低沉的哽咽声。  

“我们一直都心知肚明。”萨拉丁不高兴地撇了撇嘴。他把目光转向圣城的地平线，假装对郊区附近被水淹没的一处坑穴感兴趣。“虽然我拒绝承认。” 

“你看到了我无法看到的希望。我告诉自己，你的反抗不过是哗众取宠。”萨拉丁苦笑起来。“我放弃了。但你——你和你的火力战队为我们争取了时间，足以让我们所有人去做出改变。” 

沙克斯一动不动地站着。他俩都在漫长的沉默中等待着。  

最后，萨拉丁叹了口气。“对不起，沙克斯。这么多年过去了，发生了那么多事…我相信你的判断。我只是想让你知道这一点。”  

沙克斯的头盔微微晃动了一下。“在结束之前？”  

“在接下来发生的事之前。”  

沙克斯缓缓点了下头。  

“你知道么，为这一刻，我准备了一大堆苛责的话。”  

萨拉丁笑了。“早料到了。”

1912669214.name: Centrifuse
1912669214.lore:
Excerpts from a pre-Collapse report, logged by Dr. Khatun-Rowe, a researcher in the Engineering Division of the New Pacific Arcology, Titan: 

Since Dr. Pell's breakthrough on methods of magnetic containment last year, we've successfully stabilized multiple ionic reactors. They have allowed us to expand our division's plasma technology work beyond research into development…  
 
[Because] the Arcology's turbines have been generating more energy than the facility consumes, leadership has decided, over the objections of D.M. Korosec, to focus initial trials on force-multiplying technology. Ostensibly, leadership's hope is to supplement invasive and costly gene-splicing technology with power suits that could greatly extend our divers' uptime… 

While the power suit initiative seems benign, [Arcology leadership's] insistence on controlled ionic emissions research is clearly geared toward weapon development. 

Though I will, of course, give my full focus to our new directive, I pray these weapons remain prototypes, discarded and forgotten in the back room of history…
1912669214.lore_zh:
土卫六新太平洋生态园区工程区研究员哈顿-罗维博士记录的一份大崩溃前报告，摘录如下： 

“自从佩尔博士去年在磁遏制方法上取得突破以来，我们已成功稳定多个离子反应堆。有了这些进展，我们部门的等离子技术工作就可以从研究扩展到开发…”  
 
[因为]生态园区涡轮机产生的能量已超过设施消耗量，领导层不顾大卫·米格尔·科洛赛克的反对，决定将初步试验的重点放在力量倍增技术上。表面上，领导层是希望用动力服来补充有侵害和昂贵的基因拼接技术，说是可以大大延长潜水员的正常工作时间… 

虽然动力服计划似乎是无害的，但[生态园区领导层]坚持进行可控离子发射研究，显然是为了发展武器。 

尽管我当然会把全部精力放在我们的新指令上，但我希望这些武器一直是原型就好，在历史的密室里被遗忘，被丢弃…

1441805468.name: The Navigator
1441805468.lore:
My brother — 

Uttered by Xivu Arath — 

God of War — 

A GIFT. My true death was from necessity. The others were from love. The Ecumene had cornered us, made us act with sickness. With my power, Auryx murdered our sister. And with our power, Auryx descended into the Deep. And with our power, Oryx's wings spread wide, and he blotted out the Ecumene's sky.  

MY COURT. With his memory and his acts of war he brought me back with all the splendor of a love that sharpens and kills. 

A GRAVE. I will find his corpse, where he rots. He deserved to die. We do not dig graves. 

THE SPIRE. I will take what is true and break it until it can no longer be broken. I will find my sister's secrets and break them as well. 

VOYAGE. My love spills out. My love engulfs. I will go out into the universe as my brother did. I will do so with my memory of him.
1441805468.lore_zh:
我的兄弟—— 

出自希乌阿拉斯—— 

战神—— 

馈赠。我真正的死亡是出于迫不得已。其他的死亡都是出于爱。家园让我们走投无路，逼得我们携病而行。凭借我的力量，欧里克斯杀了我们的姐妹。凭借我们的力量，欧里克斯坠入了深渊。同样凭借我们的力量，欧里克斯大展双翼，他遮住了家园的苍穹。  

我的审判庭。凭借他的记忆和战争行为，他把我带回，伴着尖锐而致命的爱之光辉。 

一座坟墓。我会找到他腐烂不堪的尸体。他理应死去。我们不会挖掘坟墓。 

尖塔。我要夺取真相打碎它，直到再也无法打碎。我会找到我姐妹的秘密，把它们也打碎。 

航行。我的爱喷涌而出。我的爱吞噬蚕食。我要像我兄弟一样到宇宙中去。我会带着对他的记忆如此而行。

3832002135.name: Veiled Tithes Grips
3832002135.lore:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
3832002135.lore_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

4067720865.name: Veiled Tithes Vest
4067720865.flavor: Feeling the fury in your chest.
4067720865.lore:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
4067720865.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什…米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

555258620.name: Veiled Tithes Cloak
555258620.lore:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
555258620.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

523074950.name: Veiled Tithes Mask
523074950.flavor: Toiling in the dead of night.
523074950.lore:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
523074950.lore_zh:
埃里斯把邪魔族骑士剥光的股骨削成了一个轴，并用锇钉把它深深钉住。她用丝绒线把它包起来，附上她的印记。当她在手中转动它时，它发出了响声。

“对，弄得漂亮点，”伊马鲁翻着白眼说。“那会有帮助的。真的有用。”

“我在用我的力量附着权杖，”她调皮地说道。“你又有何‘用'？”

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

1345569657.name: Veiled Tithes Strides
1345569657.flavor: Dancing at the edge of the Light.
1345569657.lore:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
1345569657.lore_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

3534173884.name: Mothkeeper's Wraps
3534173884.lore:
She had tracked the infested Ogre across the Throne World, led by its trailing effluvium. Now it lay collapsed against a cracked jade pillar, its wheezing form obscured by a thick blanket of moths. 

As she approached, ripples of startling color shimmered over the Ogre as the moths flashed their vibrant underwings in warning. She pulled her hood tight against her exposed face. She would have to work quickly.

The moths on the ground shivered as she stepped carefully over them. She took a breath of the powdery air and reached into the rustling mass, shoulder deep, as quivering wings beat against her neck. She groped blindly until her fingers finally grazed against the withered Ogre, its hide yielding as old leather.

Her knife was swift and sure. The Ogre shuddered once, and it was over. As she withdrew her blade, the moths took flight with the muffled rush of a thousand zephyr-borne petals.

Then they were upon her, covering her cloak, her shoulders, landing in her hair. They smothered her with their dusty bodies, brushing against her lips as she whispered the incantation she stole from the Witch Queen's Spire. She traced the outline of a Hive rune in the air with her knife, then touched the tip of the blade to the back of her hand.

The moths fell still, hushed, bipectinate antennae quivering as they considered the offer:

Not a host, but a home.
3534173884.lore_zh:
她在王座世界里追踪那个受到感染的虫瘤，寻找它身后的恶臭。现在它瘫倒在一根裂开的玉柱上，大口喘息的身影被一层厚厚的飞蛾遮住。 

她走近过去，虫瘤的头顶上闪烁着不寻常的色彩涟漪，那是飞蛾在扑闪着它们充满活力的翅膀以示警告。她把兜帽拉向露在外面的脸庞前，贴得紧紧的。她必须动作快点。

地面上的飞蛾在她小心翼翼地跨过时害怕地颤抖着。她吸了一口满是蛾粉的空气，把手伸到齐肩深、沙沙作响的蛾群中，颤动的翅膀拍打着她的脖子。她盲目地摸索着，直到触及了那个衰弱虫瘤。它的表皮就像旧皮革一样柔软。

她的刀又快又准。虫瘤颤抖了一下，一切就结束了。她拔出刀刃，蛾群带着万千和风花瓣的闷响飞了起来。

然后它们飞到她身上，遮盖她的披风，她的肩膀，落在她的头发上。它们用满是蛾粉的身体让她窒息，在她低声念着从巫妖女王的尖塔上偷来的咒语时拂过她的嘴唇。她用刀刃在空中勾勒出邪魔族符文的轮廓，然后用刀尖碰了碰手背。

飞蛾们安静缄默地落下，双栉形的触须颤抖着，思忖着这个提议：

不是宿主，而是家园。
