1322406401.name: Veiled Tithes Gauntlets
1322406401.lore:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
1322406401.lore_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

2953343703.name: Veiled Tithes Plate
2953343703.flavor: Hope and hate share the same heart.
2953343703.lore:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
2953343703.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什·米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

786695846.name: Veiled Tithes Mark
786695846.lore:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
786695846.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

1524622768.name: Veiled Tithes Helm
1524622768.flavor: Responsibility, taken in secret, proudly upheld.
1524622768.lore:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
1524622768.lore_zh:
埃里斯把邪魔族骑士剥光的股骨削成了一个轴，并用锇钉把它深深钉住。她用丝绒线把它包起来，附上她的印记。当她在手中转动它时，它发出了响声。

“对，弄得漂亮点，”伊马鲁翻着白眼说。“那会有帮助的。真的有用。”

“我在用我的力量附着权杖，”她调皮地说道。“你又有何‘用'？”

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

2817251955.name: Veiled Tithes Greaves
2817251955.flavor: Feet steady in the midst of the madness.
2817251955.lore:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
2817251955.lore_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用其光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

2066430310.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
2066430310.lore:
Lord Shaxx watched a Crucible match play out below his announcer's perch, but his mind was elsewhere.  

Since the Witness's assault on the Traveler, he'd become uncharacteristically anxious. He had tried to throw himself into the Crucible with renewed vigor, but his preoccupation had proven too difficult to shake. 

A sudden flash of Solar Light disrupted his fretting. He sat up and focused on a Titan who was wearing a new piece of kit: some kind of gauntlets Shaxx had never seen before.  

Shaxx leaned into the microphone. "Fought like a Titan of the First Pillar!" he boomed. "One minute left. The enemy is out of second chances!" 

While his teammates concentrated their rifle fire from under cover, the Titan instead charged directly at the oncoming team.  

Shaxx chuckled to himself. "Titans… always thinking with their fists." He waited eagerly to see how the Guardian's gambit would unfold. 

As the Titan reached the oncoming fireteam, he leapt into the air, unleashing a halo of Solar flame. When he landed, a furious wave of fire surged forward, immolating the opposing Guardians where they stood. 

Shaxx jumped up from his seat. "Look what one Guardian can do with nothing but their Ghost, their weapon, and their Light!" he thundered.  

It was the type of triumphant moment that he'd envisioned when he founded the Crucible, and the perfect diversion to take his mind off the Witness, at least for a while.
2066430310.lore_zh:
领主沙克斯心不在焉地望着他的解说员看台下的一场熔炉竞技场比赛。  

自从见证者对旅行者发动袭击以来，他变得异常焦虑。他试图振作起来，投入到熔炉竞技场之中，但他仍然难以摆脱心事。 

一道突如其来的烈日闪光打断了他的苦恼。他端坐起来，望向一名泰坦。他穿着沙克斯从没见过的新臂铠。  

沙克斯靠向麦克风。“你战斗起来像是第一中坚的泰坦！”他低沉有力地说道。“还剩一分钟。敌人不能再复活了！” 

趁队友在掩体下步枪集火之际，那泰坦径直朝迎面而来的队伍冲了过去。  

沙克斯轻声笑道。“泰坦…总是用拳头思考问题。”他急切地等着看这位守护者要玩什么花招。 

就在泰坦碰到迎面而来的火力战队时，他跃入空中，释放出烈日火焰的光环。当他落地时，一股猛烈的火浪涌向前方，将敌方守护者原地活活烧死。 

沙克斯从他的座位上跳了起来。“守护者只靠机灵、武器和光能，就有如此威力！”他大声喊道。  

他创立熔炉竞技场时就是想出现这样的胜利时刻，这也让他分散注意力，暂时不去想见证者的事。

2593354668.lore:
BEHOLD, MY BROOD 
HOW YOUR ENEMIES LAY ROTTING IN THE FIELD! 
 
THE CHROMA-ADMIRAL RAFRIT ENGULFED BY WAVES OF DEATH, 
DRAGGED BACK INTO THE ATMOSPHERE BY A MILLION HIVE CORPSES.
THE AMMONITES KEENING BELOW 
AS THEIR WARRIOR OF THE SKY FELL  
INTO THE DEEP. 
 
AND THERE, IN CONCERT WITH YOUR GODS, 
HIS ARMOR WAS PULLED SLOWLY FROM HIS BODY 
UNTIL THE SINEW OF HIS ADDUCTORS TORE,   
ANNOINTING OUR GODS WITH HIS SPURTING PLASM. 

HOW HE CRIED AS HIS RUINED FLESH WAS IMPALED— 
HIS WAILING, A CALL TO WORSHIP 
IN THE TEMPLE OF HIS DYING BODY! 

THEN WAS THE AMMONITES' LEVIATHAN ALONE. 

SO I DID COMMAND MY SERVANT, 
IR UULXAL, 
TO TASTE OF THE LEVIATHAN'S FLESH, 
TO TEAR IT FROM THE SKY IN A FEAST OF AGONY. 

AND SO HE DID. 

THE LEVIATHAN'S VISCERA OPENED TO THE SKY 
AND RAINED DOWN UPON THE AMMONITES, 
BATHING THEM IN THE BOWELS OF THEIR GOD. 
SO MY BROOD DID TASTE OF HIS ENTRAILS 
AND REJOICE! 

FROM THIS VICTORY FORWARD,  
UNTIL THE SKY FALLS AND THE DEEP SUBSUMES ALL,  
IR UULXAL SHALL BE KNOWN AS 
THE LEVIATHAN-EATER, 
BANE OF THE AMMONITES, 
AND FAVORED HARBINGER OF XIVU ARATH!
2593354668.lore_zh:
看哪，我的虫群 
你们的敌人是如何倒在战场上腐烂的！ 
 
幻彩将军拉弗里特被死亡之浪席卷， 
被数百万邪魔族尸体拖回大气层中。
鹦鹉螺族在底下哀号， 
看着他们的苍穹战士  
堕入深渊。 
 
在那里与你们的众神遥相呼应， 
他的护甲被慢慢地从身上扯下， 
直到他的内收肌腱被撕裂开来，   
以喷涌的血液祭祀我们的众神。 

残缺肉身被刺穿时他哭天喊地—— 
他的哀嚎呼唤着 
在他垂死之躯的神庙里膜拜！ 

然后就只剩鹦鹉螺族的利维坦。 

故我指挥我的仆从， 
伊尔·乌尔萨尔， 
品尝利维坦的血肉， 
在痛苦盛宴中将其从苍穹撕下。 

他照做了。 

利维坦的五脏六腑向苍穹敞开， 
在鹦鹉螺族身上如雨点般落下， 
让他们沐浴在其神的脏腑之中。 
于是我的虫群尝到了他的内脏 
并且欢欣鼓舞！ 

自这场胜利起，  
直至苍穹陨落，深渊吞噬一切，  
伊尔·乌尔萨尔将成为 
利维坦吞噬者， 
鹦鹉螺族克星， 
希乌阿拉斯宠爱的使者！

260708852.name: Veiled Tithes Robes
260708852.flavor: Calm and centered through the tumult.
260708852.lore:
Mithrax had come to Ikora's office with a gift and a question. 

The gift was a large glass jar of preserved leechlike creatures, oily and glistening. They were perhaps the most delicious thing Ikora had tasted in the last 20 years. And while the two of them worked their way through the jar, Mithrax uncomfortably stumbled his way to his question.

"Eris Morn has changed," he said carefully, and Ikora nodded. "She chose to change, and she acted out of… is there a Human word for 'love-bravery'?"

Ikora smiled. "Love," she said.

"Love, then," Mithrax nodded. "If she were to change forever, if she cannot return to herself, will she be remembered well? Since her first choice was made from love?"

Ikora responded as though she had not struggled with the thought a thousand times already. "Eris will always be Eris, no matter what form she takes," she said.

Mithrax harrumphed in satisfaction and leaned forward to take another leech. "Yes. I am always impressed with the resilience of the Guardians, with or without their Light. Saint tells me the Titan Sloane embraced the Taken, and she is doing well."

"Yes, and for that, I am grateful," Ikora said. "But… they don't always come back, Mithrax. An old friend of mine was corrupted by the Vex in a similar way. He stayed behind when the Pyramids attacked, just like Sloane. But I believe we lost him."

"I am sorry about your friend," Mithrax said somberly. "I hope he is remembered as a hero."

Ikora raised her eyebrows but said nothing.

"I, too, encountered a great mind consumed by the Vex," Mithrax continued. "The Guardian and I attempted a rescue, but it went deeper into the network as it gained the access it sought. It taught me that the pursuit of truth is worth any price—even one's own sense of self."

Ikora smiled. "Asher would have agreed with every word of that."

Mithrax leaned forward in amazement, a leech dangling limply from his claws. "You knew Ashermere?"

Ikora cocked her head. "Yes, Asher Mir. How on earth did you know him?"

"Asher… Mir," Mithrax said slowly to himself, mimicking Ikora. "That is why I have been unable to locate any records."

"Ikora," he said, straightening himself in his seat, "I must tell you a story about our friend, Asher Mir, the hero."
260708852.lore_zh:
米瑟拉克斯带着一份礼物和一个问题来到了艾可拉的办公室。 

礼物是一个大玻璃罐，里面装着保存完好的水蛭状生物，油光锃亮。它们可能是艾可拉在过去20年里尝过的最美味的东西。就在他们俩品尝罐子里的食物时，米瑟拉克斯吞吞吐吐地提出了他的问题。

“埃里斯·摩恩变了，”他小心翼翼地说，艾可拉点点头。“她选择改变，是出于…人类有没有一个词可以形容‘因爱而勇敢'？”

艾可拉笑了。“就是爱”，她说道。

“那就爱吧，”米瑟拉克斯点点头。“如果她永远地改变了，如果她不能变回原来的自己，大家还会记得她吗？毕竟她的第一选择是出于爱？”

艾可拉表现得好像她没有为这个想法挣扎过无数回似的。“埃里斯永远都是埃里斯，不管她是什么样子，”她说。

米瑟拉克斯满意地哼了一声，身子向前拿了条水蛭。“是的。我总是很钦佩守护者的韧性，不管他们有没有光能。圣人告诉我，泰坦斯隆将傀儡接受进自己的身体，情况还不错。”

“是的，为此我很庆幸，”艾可拉说。“但…他们并不是总能回来，米瑟拉克斯。我的一个老朋友也以类似的方式被Vex腐化了。金字塔发起攻击时，他像斯隆一样留下了。但我们应该是失去他了。”

“我为你朋友的事感到遗憾，”米瑟拉克斯忧郁地说道。“他是个英雄，值得我们永远铭记。”

艾可拉扬起眉毛，但什么也没说。

“我也遇到过一个被Vex吞噬的英雄，”米瑟拉克斯继续说道。“守护者和我试图展开营救，但当它获得了它所寻求的访问权时，它就深入到网络中去了。这让我明白了，对真理的追求值得付出任何代价——哪怕是个体的自我意识。”

艾可拉笑了。“阿什肯定会同意你说的每一个字。”

米瑟拉克斯惊讶地探出身子，一只水蛭在他的爪子里软绵绵地摇来晃去。“你认识阿什米尔？”

艾可拉歪着头。“是的，阿什·米尔。你又是怎么认识他的？”

“阿什·米尔，”米瑟拉克斯模仿着艾可拉，慢慢自语道。“难怪我一直没能找到任何记录。”

“艾可拉，”他说着，从座位上直起身子，“我必须给你讲一个关于我们的朋友，英雄阿什·米尔的故事。”

1004538825.name: Veiled Tithes Bond
1004538825.lore:
Zavala locked his office door. The furtive gesture made him uneasy, but he couldn't risk anyone coming in. The feed he was about to watch could easily be misconstrued.  

As it was, the City smoldered with rumors from citizens and Guardians alike. The persistent, undulating hole in the Traveler's side put everyone on edge. Hearing that Vanguard leadership was using Hive magic to fulfil a bargain put forth by the Witch Queen would undoubtedly stoke the flames of panic. 

Zavala leaned grimly over his desk to watch the Guardian's latest tithes to Eris Morn.  

It used to be simple, he lamented. We exterminated the Hive wherever we found them, and we felt good about it. Justified. But in recent years, morally ambiguous situations like these had become more common, and separating friend from foe was increasingly difficult. 

Over the feed, Eris Morn's face lit up with fierce elation as the Guardian's tithes flowed through her. Her Hive form seemed to swell with power. Zavala knew that Eris undertook the rituals with temperance, at least for now, but he wondered how long her clarity would last. Elsie Bray's warnings had been too vivid to dismiss entirely, even after Ikora's reassurances. 

Zavala turned away from the feed to gaze out the window at the Traveler. The trauma puncturing its side reminded him of the stakes. The reasons they were taking such risks. 

He sighed, wondering how many more compromises they would have to make before the end.
1004538825.lore_zh:
萨瓦拉锁上了办公室的门。这个鬼祟的姿态让他感到不安，但他不能冒险让任何人进来。他要看的资料很可能被误解。  

事实上，圣城里弥漫着来自市民和守护者的谣言。旅行者侧面波状的洞让大家都紧张不安。听到先锋领导层同意用邪魔族魔法来履行巫妖女王提出的交易，无疑会激起恐慌的火焰。 

萨瓦拉严肃地前倾到桌子上，看着守护者对埃里斯·摩恩的最新进贡。  

这事放在过去很简单，他哀叹着。我们一发现邪魔族就消灭他们，还感觉良好，觉得是在替天行道。但是近年来，随着越来越难以区分敌友，这种道德上模棱两可的情况变得越来越普遍。 

在画面中，当守护者的贡品从埃里斯·摩恩身上流过时，她脸上露出一阵狂喜。她的邪魔族形态似乎充满了力量。萨瓦拉知道，至少目前埃里斯在进行仪式时是竭力保持克制的，但他不知道她的清醒能持续多久。艾尔西·布瑞的警告太真实了，即使在艾可拉保证过后，也很难无视它。 

萨瓦拉把视线从画面上移开，凝视着窗外的旅行者。它侧面的伤口在提醒他情况有多危急，以及他们为什么要冒这样大风险。 

他叹了口气，不知道在这一切结束之前，还要做出多少妥协。

4130822717.name: Veiled Tithes Hood
4130822717.flavor: Rational and ritual in gnashing dissonance.
4130822717.lore:
Eris had whittled the Hive Knight's denuded femur into a shaft and driven it deep with osmium nails. She'd wrapped it in velvet string, attached her sigil to it. Now it chimed as she turned it in her hands.

"Yeah, make it pretty," Immaru said, rolling his eye. "That'll help. Real useful."

"I am binding the staff with my power," she said archly. "What 'use' have you been?"

"I told you what to do!"

"I gathered the materials. I crafted the staff. I infused it with Light and soulfire. Do not presume your ideas were essential to this process."

"You think you're such an expert in Hive magic," Immaru scoffed, "but you know what? You're just doing parlor tricks. Without me, that staff would be nothin' more than a fancy piece of bone."

Eris gripped the staff and held it out to test its heft. It was unbalanced. She returned it to the worktable.

"Do not make yourself intolerable."

Immaru moved so he could look Eris in the face. She raised her eyes, staring him down. He came close; she did not step back.

"Or what? You might scare everyone else, but you don't scare me. There's nothin' you can do except put up with me."

Eris returned to her work, raising a hand and pushing him out of the way. He huffed, watching her as she resumed sharpening the points of the staff's base.

"With this, the Guardian may devise rituals of their own. It will empower their Light and channel the Hive's vile power."

"You're welcome," Immaru said smugly.

Eris ignored him and examined the staff she had crafted. It represented hours spent sliding a blade's edge over layers of dead, porous Hive chitin, carving it with spells and imbuing it with magic. At its head was soulfire ichor, encased in vitreous Light. A gleaming vessel.

"One last reagent."

She turned back to her worktable. The worm squirmed and squealed under her knife.
4130822717.lore_zh:
埃里斯把邪魔族骑士剥光的股骨削成了一个轴，并用锇钉把它深深钉住。她用丝绒线把它包起来，附上她的印记。当她在手中转动它时，它发出了响声。

“对，弄得漂亮点，”伊马鲁翻着白眼说。“那会有帮助的。真的有用。”

“我在用我的力量附着权杖，”她调皮地说道。“你又有何‘用'？”

“我告诉过你该做什么！”

“是我收集的材料。是我打造的权杖。是我给它注入的光能和灵魂之火。别以为在这个过程中你的想法有多重要。”

“你自认为是邪魔族魔法的专家，”伊马鲁嘲笑道，“但你知道吗？你只是在耍把戏罢了。没有我，那根权杖充其量就只是一根漂亮的骨头。”

埃里斯抓住权杖，把它举起来测试它的重量。不太平衡。她把它放回工作台上。

“别考验我对你的忍耐。”

伊马鲁挪动身子来直视埃里斯的脸。她抬起眼睛来瞪着他。他靠得更近了些；她没有后退。

“否则呢？你也许能吓唬别人，可你吓不倒我。除了忍受，你不能拿我怎么样。”

埃里斯举起一只手把他推开，回到了工作上。他气鼓鼓地看着她继续削尖权杖的底部。

“有了这个，守护者就能使用他们自己的仪式。这可以增强他们的光能，引导邪魔族的邪恶力量。”

“不客气，”伊马鲁自鸣得意地说道。

埃里斯没有理睬他，打量着自己制作的权杖。她花了好久，用刀锋在一层层耗尽生命、多孔稀松的邪魔族壳质上铭刻咒语，注入魔法。它的头部是灵魂之火灵液，被玻璃似的光能禁锢。一个闪光的器皿。

“最后一样试剂。”

她转身返回她的工作台。蠕虫在她的刀刃下扭动尖叫。

3663544278.name: Veiled Tithes Boots
3663544278.flavor: Lithe came the footfalls of the dead.
3663544278.lore:
Immaru focused his digital iris, zooming in on the Guardian. They were about to initiate a new ritual, and the Hive Ghost was keen to see their response. 

When the Screebs started pouring in, Immaru couldn't help himself. "Oops! This one's all Screebs," he chortled. "Have fun." 

He expected the ritual to end promptly in a shower of Dark Ether. Instead, the Guardian surged through the air, dodging explosion after explosion. Their Light seared through the Scorn, burning them alive.  

It wasn't long before the smoke cleared and the Guardian stood alone, their Light thrumming with tithes. Immaru grumbled to himself.  

For as long as he'd been a Ghost, he'd resented how the Guardians referred to the Light. It was never "my Ghost's Light" or "the Traveler's Light." No—it was always "MY Light." They talked about it like they owned it. Like they were entitled to it. Like they earned it. 

But looking down at the smoldering battlefield, Immaru had to admit that the Guardians' arrogance served them well. It gave them the confidence to mold their Light in the fashion that suited them best. They treated it like a tool—something to be used. That gave them an advantage over the Lucent Brood, whose manipulation of the Light was inhibited by reverence. 

Immaru turned away from the ritual circle in disgust. He hated to admit it, but the Lucent Brood had a lot to learn about the Light from the Guardians.  

And once they did, the Humans would pay for their lack of respect.
3663544278.lore_zh:
伊马鲁聚焦他的数码虹膜，朝着守护者放大。他们正准备启动一场新仪式，而这名邪魔族机灵很想看看他们的反应。 

当变异体开始涌入时，伊马鲁难以自抑。“哎呀！这回全是变异体，”他咯咯笑道。“玩得开心。” 

他以为仪式会在一阵黑暗乙太的洗礼中迅速告终。但守护者灵巧地在空中左避右闪，躲过了一次又一次的爆炸，用其光能烤灼嗤魅，将他们活活烧死。  

没过多久，烟雾消散，只留下守护者一人站着，其光能伴着贡品嗡嗡作响。伊马鲁暗自嘟囔着。  

自他作为机灵诞生以来，就一直很憎恨守护者们提到光能的方式。从来都不是“我机灵的光能”或是“旅行者的光能”。不，一直都是“我的光能”。就好像光能是属于他们的。就好像他们有权享有它。就好像它是他们应得的。 

但俯视着这片阴燃闷烧的战场，伊马鲁不得不承认，守护者们的傲慢对他们很有帮助。它给了他们信心，以最适合的方式来塑造光能。他们把它当作一件可以利用的工具。这使他们比光明虫群更有优势，因为虫群对光能的操纵受到了敬畏的抑制。 

伊马鲁厌恶地转身离开了仪式环。尽管他不愿意承认，但关于光能，光明虫群还有很多东西需要向守护者学习。  

等他们做到了，人类就会为他们的肆无忌惮付出代价。

3234692237.name: Briarbinds
3234692237.flavor: New growth rises from the old.
3234692237.lore:
The vines coiled and twisted up her arm, blooming their deep purple as they settled over her glove. She flexed her fingers and felt the thorns at her wrist. 

The Thralls ran towards her, their claws outstretched. Her Void Soul shimmered into being as she stood her ground. She fired her weapon and the Void Soul fluttered towards them, reaching out with its dark web of Light as it weakened and drained the life from the Thralls. They fell one after another—then the Acolytes advanced. 

She sprinted towards the Void Soul. The delicate tendrils on her glove unfurled. She could feel the faint call, the scent, the color that drew the eye. The Void Soul was drawn to her as she to it. 

She raised her weapon and fired again.
3234692237.lore_zh:
藤蔓在她的手臂上扭动盘绕，缠在她的手套上，绽放出深紫色的花朵。她弯曲手指，感受荆刺触碰她的手腕。 

怨魂们朝她跑来，伸出了爪子。她站在原地，她的虚空灵魂闪烁现身。她用武器射击；虚空灵魂飘向他们，伸出它黑暗的光能之网，削弱并吸尽这些怨魂的生命。他们接连倒下——然后仆从们开始了行动。 

她冲向虚空灵魂，手套上精巧的卷须随之展开。她可以感觉到那微弱的呼唤，那气味，那吸引她目光的颜色。虚空灵魂被她所吸引，就像她被它所吸引一样。 

她举起武器，再次开始射击。

3337727085.lore:
"I understand that getting through the portal is important—" Crow began. 

"It's more than important," Osiris interrupted. "It's our best chance to prevent the final shape, however the Witness conceives of it. Beyond that, it's a chance to study paracausality at a level we've never had access to before." 

"I get it, I get it," Crow interjected.  

The Hunter was overseeing the unloading of Spider's ship in the Eliksni Quarter. House of Light workers ferried crates into warehouses on ingenious Eliksni-made trollies. Normally, such a task would be outside of Crow's purview, but Spider couldn't be trusted to stick to his manifests, so here he was. Osiris stood back and watched the bustle with detachment. 

"I've heard all the reasons," Crow continued. "And they all make sense. It's just…" He paused, trying to find a delicate way of broaching the subject. 

"Savathûn," Osiris provided, his voice tinged with foreboding.  

"Yeah," Crow replied. He shook his head in dismay. "We worked so hard to put her away. And after everything we went through—what YOU went through—we're just going to… bring her back?"  

Under his mask, Osiris's lips pressed into a thin, tense line. In truth, the situation pained him greatly, but he would not allow his gnawing doubt to infect the young Hunter.  

When he spoke, his voice came out as smooth and measured as always. "Guardians sacrifice more than their lives in defense of humanity. More than their friends. Or their Ghosts."  

"We sacrifice our peace of mind. In many ways, it's our greatest loss," Osiris said, imagining Saint's concern. "But it's the price we pay for the knowledge we bear. For the power we wield." 

"I know," Crow sighed, recalling Amanda's empty spot in the Hangar. "I know."
3337727085.lore_zh:
“我知道通过传送门很重要——”乌鸦开口说。 

“不止是重要，”奥斯里斯打断道。“不管见证者如何构想终焉之形，这是我们阻止它的最好机会。其次，这也是我们难得能深度研究超因果的机会。” 

“我懂的，我懂的，”乌鸦插嘴道。  

这名猎人正在埃里克斯尼居住区监督蛛王的飞船卸货。光能氏族的工人们会用埃里克斯尼族制造的精巧手推车将板条箱运送到仓库。通常这样的任务不属于乌鸦的职责范围，但蛛王可能会对载货清单动些手脚，所以他来了。奥斯里斯站在后面冷眼旁观着这片喧闹。 

“我听过各种理由，”乌鸦继续说。“它们都说得通。只是…”他停顿了一下，试图找到一种巧妙的方式来谈论这话题。 

“萨瓦图恩，”奥斯里斯接上了他的话，声音中带着不祥的预感。  

“是的，”乌鸦答道。他沮丧地摇摇头。“我们好不容易才除掉她。但在我们经历了那些事…在你经历了那些事之后…我们还要再复活她？”  

在他的面具之下，奥斯里斯的嘴唇抿成了一条紧绷的细线。事实上，这种情况让他非常痛苦，但他不会容许自己的疑虑影响到这位年轻的猎人。  

他开口说话时，声音像往常一样流畅而慎重。“守护者为捍卫人类而牺牲的不仅仅是生命。不仅仅是朋友。或是机灵。”  

“我们牺牲了内心的安宁。从许多方面来讲，这都是我们最大的损失。”奥斯里斯说道，想象着圣人的担忧。“但为了我们获得知识、掌握力量，这是必须付出的代价。” 

“我知道，”乌鸦叹了口气，回想起阿曼达在机库里留下的空位。“我知道。”

1875512595.name: Kept Confidence
1875512595.flavor: "One way or the other, I'll be there." —Drifter
1875512595.lore:
Drifter wiped the sweat off his brow and the grin off his face. His shoulders slumped as he stepped down from the platform in the Derelict. The Gambit match had ended in a hard-earned win. The next match would be in a few minutes. That's all he had.

He cleared his throat. His voice was hoarse.

Drifter looked up at the swirling mass of egregore and his thoughts shifted back to Eris Morn. They'd found a little comfort with each other. A little understanding. But what did it look like, he wondered, when all that chitin burst out of her? What did it feel like to eat up all those tithes the Guardians were taking for her in the field? In the Crucible? In Gambit?

He'd read the reports. He saw the theories on VanNet. He didn't trust them. He trusted her.

Drifter nodded to himself and took a breath as he heard the Guardians assemble behind him. He stepped up on the platform, flicking his jade coin. It spun in the air, catching the light, before falling back into the Drifter's waiting palm.

"You ever eat Hive eyes?" he asked with a smile, twisting his wrist around and slipping the coin back into his sleeve.

"Real juicy. They go pop in your mouth, and a shiver runs all the way through… Heh. I'll tell you when you're older."

He winked. The assembled Guardians watched him in silence. 

"Transmat firing!" he called out, and they disappeared in a burst of light.
1875512595.lore_zh:
浪客拭去额头上的汗水，褪去脸上的笑容。他从遗落飞船的平台上走下来，耷拉着肩膀。智谋比赛以一场来之不易的胜利告终。下一场比赛将在几分钟后进行。这就是他所拥有的一切。

他清了清嗓子。声音很嘶哑。

浪客抬头看了看那一团旋转的守望者，思绪又回到了埃里斯·摩恩身上。他们在彼此身上找到了一丝安慰。一点理解。但他不禁好奇，当她体内所有的壳质迸发出来时会是什么样子？把守护者在战场上为她收取的贡品全部吸收是什么感觉？在熔炉竞技场里呢？在智谋里呢？

他读过报告，也在VanNet上看过各种猜测，但这些他都不相信。只相信她。

听到守护者们在他身后集合，浪客暗自点点头，吸了一口气。他走上平台，轻弹起他的玉币。它在空中旋转，反射光线，然后又落回到浪客等待着的手掌里。

“你们吃过邪魔族的眼睛吗？”他笑着问，扭动手腕，把硬币塞回袖子里。

“非常多汁。它们会在嘴里爆开，然后一阵寒颤贯穿全身…呵呵。等你们长大点再告诉你们。”

他挤了下眼。集合在一起的守护者们默默地看着他。 

“开始传送！”他喊道，接着他们便在一阵亮光中消失了。

4132072834.name: Locus Locutus
4132072834.flavor: Speak to remember, speak to forget.
4132072834.lore:
"The cards cannot truly predict the future. They only offer perspective," Eris said. She stood with Eido at the Lectern of Divination, laying each card with purpose. "Your thoughts on their meanings will be appreciated."

Eido didn't reply; she was looking over her shoulder and towards the ritual circle at the center of the Athenaeum. Eris continued.

"Your insight into Xivu Arath's motivations avoided disaster," Eris said, trying to catch her attention. "We were able to warn Queen Mara and convince Rasputin of his error."

Eido nodded, looking down at the table. With the tip of one claw, she aligned the edge of The Adherent card with the edge of its neighbor.

"You want to ask me something," Eris said after a long pause. She had never known Eido to refrain from asking any question that came to mind, and the Scribe's new hesitance was surprising.

"Yes," Eido said, then paused. When she spoke again, it was in a whisper. "This is where it… happens? Your… transformations."

Her voice strained at the last word.

"Yes. Where the runes are most powerful," Eris answered coolly. "Here, and in the Witch Queen's oubliette."

Eido nodded.

"That word is from an old Human language," Eido said, her voice regaining a little of the cheer that Eris recognized. "Its root means 'to forget,' I believe."

"Yes, you are correct."
 
"And, ah…" Eido paused again, the question tangling in her throat. "Do you… forget? Who you are?"

Eris took a breath. In their research together, Eido had learned to be blunt.

"No," Eris said. "I am myself. Always."

Eido's eyes widened. There was silence. No questions, no curiosity. Only the unblinking stare of someone too afraid to speak.

"There is nothing to fear," Eris said, and she did not know if that was comforting. Eido nodded and looked away.

"Of course not," the Scribe answered. "I didn't think there would be."

Eris wondered if others had lied more convincingly.
4132072834.lore_zh:
“这些卡牌不能真正预测未来。它们只能提供一些线索，”埃里斯说。她和艾多站在占卜台前，意味深长地铺上每张卡牌。“说一说你对其中含义的看法吧。”

艾多没有回答。她一直回头盯着雅典娜神庙中心的仪式环。

“你对希乌阿拉斯动机的见解避免了灾难的发生，”埃里斯继续说道，试图吸引艾多的注意力。“我们得以警告玛拉女王，并说服拉斯普廷认识到自己的错误。”

艾多点了点头，看向台上的卡牌。她用爪尖将“拥护者”卡牌的边缘与其相邻卡牌的边缘对齐。

“你想要问我些事，”埃里斯停顿了很久后说道。她所认识的艾多不会克制自己询问任何想到的问题；这名文士的犹豫让她很吃惊。

“是的，”艾多说道，然后停顿了一下。当她再次开口时，声音变得非常小。“这里就是…那里了吧？就是你…转化的地方。”

她说到后面时声音有些紧张。

“是的。这里是符文最强大的地方，”埃里斯冷淡地答道。“在这里，还有巫妖女王的地下密牢里。”

艾多点了点头。

“这个词来自一种古老的人类语言，”艾多说道，声音又恢复了一丝埃里斯所熟悉的欢快。“如果我没弄错，它的词根是‘忘记'的意思。”

“是的，你说得对。”
 
“那么，呃…”艾多又停顿了一下。这问题在她的喉中有些纠结。“你会…忘记吗？自己是谁？”

埃里斯吸了一口气。在她们共同研究的过程中，艾多学会了直言不讳。

“不，”埃里斯说道。“我是我自己。永远都是。”

艾多睁大了眼睛。随后是一阵沉默。没有问题，没有好奇。只是目不转睛地看着她，不敢开口。

“没什么好害怕的，”埃里斯说，她不知道这是不是一种安慰。艾多点点头，移开了目光。

“当然没有，”文士回答道。“我觉得没什么好害怕的。”

埃里斯心想，恐怕没人撒谎时还这么笃定吧。

105306149.name: Eleatic Principle
105306149.lore:
SENDER: IKO-006
DECRYPTION KEY: SE7SYZP17A$IKO-006
SUBJ: Understanding

Savathûn didn't construct her Spire for Light and logic alone. There is more to this than meets the eye. That's the crux of it.

What is imbaru? Asking the question yields an ounce of tribute by itself; failing to answer it yields more. It's impossible to engage with the concept without falling into the web of cunning devised by the Witch Queen, even after her death.

It's elegant. And irritating.

We are familiar with the sword logic: the need to endure and force the universe to endure you. It's a contest. When there is nothing left standing but you, then you've won. Your prize is existence.

But imbaru is tribute from the failure to understand. When Savathûn ensnared us with her cunning, she fed her worm. Every false step or mistake in our attempts to unravel Savathûn's plans gave her exactly what she wanted. Whenever someone believed a lie or doubted a truth, she became that much more powerful.

We might think we know what we're doing here, but in many ways, I doubt we do. There will be ripples from Eris's actions. We can't predict what waves she'll make.

MESSAGE ENDS
105306149.lore_zh:
发送者：IKO-006
解码密钥：SE7SYZP17A$IKO-006
主题：理解

萨瓦图恩建造她的尖塔并不仅仅是为了光能和守则。事情远不止我们所看到的，这就是一切的症结所在。

什么是薄雾？提出这个问题本身就是在进贡。如果回答不了，进贡得就更多了。若不能陷入巫妖女王所设计的狡诈之网，就根本不可能理解这个概念。即使是在她死后。

这招很妙，令人头疼。

我们都熟悉邪剑守则：对忍受的需求，以及迫使宇宙忍受你。这是一场比赛。活到最后，你就赢了。你的奖品是生存。

但薄雾是来自理解失败的贡品。当萨瓦图恩用她的狡诈捕获我们时，她喂养了她的蠕虫。我们试图揭示萨瓦图恩计划时的每一步失误都正中其下怀。每当有人相信了一个谎言或对某一真相产生怀疑时，她就会变得更加强大。

我们也许认为自己知道在做什么，但在很多方面，我都深表怀疑。埃里斯的举动会激起浪花。我们无法预测她会掀起什么样的波涛。

信息结束

2922749929.name: Semiotician
2922749929.lore:
Eido of the House of Light, Scribe log Epsilon-2-12A

I have received a gift from Eris Morn! It is a collection of Hive tomes on the nature of their runes and the rituals that they compose.

I delved into the tomes immediately. They were very useful once I was able to decipher her notes, neaten the pages, and remove her blank bookmarks—which I hope were not placed there for some purpose. I could not find a pattern to their insertion, even when they had arrows pointing to underlined passages.

At this point in my studies, I believe I have some insight into the way that these runes affect their magic. As Eris has explained to me, each rune is a logogram that encompasses many, and at times, contradictory meanings.  Curiously, some denote the particular Light energies used by Guardians and predate the acquisition of the Light by Savathûn's brood.

The style employed in inscribing the runes is unique to their practitioner. For instance, the runes that Eris writes follow concentric circles, while Savathûn composes long, tangential strings of runes. Runes also adorn many Hive weapons in long columns.

I understand that Eris is now devising a ritual that requires the composition and empowerment of many Hive runes. I must remember to wish her luck.
2922749929.lore_zh:
光能氏族的艾多，文士日志E-2-12A

我收到了埃里斯·摩恩的礼物。这是一套邪魔族藏书，里面描述了他们的符文性质和相关仪式。

我马上开始研究这些藏书。等我破译完她的笔记，整理好书页，移掉她的空白书签（希望不是故意放在那里的）之后，它们变得非常实用。我找不到那些书签的摆放规律，即使它们有箭头指向划线的段落。

我相信在当前的研究阶段，我已对这些符文影响其魔法的方式有了一些了解。正如埃里斯向我解释的那样，每个符文都是一个词符，包含了许多有时相互矛盾的含义。有趣的是，一些符文表示了守护者所使用的特定光能能量，且早于萨瓦图恩的虫群获得光能的时间。

这些符文的施法者有着独特的书写风格。例如，埃里斯的符文是沿着同心圆写的，而萨瓦图恩的则是长而相切的符文串。符文呈长柱状，装饰在许多邪魔族武器上。

我知道埃里斯现在正在设计一个仪式，需要许多邪魔族符文的成分和赋能。我一定要记得去祝她好运。

2779821308.lore:
"What was Brya like?"

The assembled Ghosts—Targe, Peach, and Ophiuchus—ceased their gossip. They turned to Glint, who bobbed back a half-step.

"I never met her," Glint admitted.

"But you know what happened to her, right?" Peach asked. Glint nodded.

"She was…" Peach thought for a moment, searching for the word. "Cheerful."

Glint contracted his shell in confusion. "That's a little hard to imagine."

"It's true!" Peach chimed.

"You saying that makes it even harder to imagine," Glint replied, but Targe and Ophiuchus bobbed in affirmation.

"I mean, Eris was never cheerful," Peach continued. "But Brya could bring out a different side of her. It was impressive. I was impressed."

"She used to make up rhymes with Eris," Targe added.

"It was… endearing," Ophiuchus said.

"Huh," Glint mused. "It sounds like she was pretty special."

"She was," Targe said. They fell into a moment's silence until Peach spoke again.

"What she did in the Hellmouth… it wasn't for nothing. Eris made it out."

The assembled Ghosts nodded.

"I think I'd do the same, if Crow was in danger," Glint said softly. "If that was the only way to keep him safe. But Crow would be very sad. Very, very sad."

"Eris is 'very, very sad' too. It wasn't just losing the Light or her friends," Targe replied.

"We know our Guardians better than anyone," Ophiuchus said. "We see them at their lowest moments."

Targe glanced away, lost in thought.

Peach hummed. "I wonder what she'd think about Eris's plan?"

Her question hung in the air for a moment. Glint bobbed in consideration.

"I think she'd be proud," he said, and the others agreed.
2779821308.lore_zh:
“布瑞亚是什么样的？”

聚集在一起的机灵们——塔格、桃子和蛇夫座——停下了闲聊。他们投来的目光让格林特不禁向后退去。

“我从没见过她，”格林特承认道。

“但你知道她发生了什么事，对吧？”桃子问道。格林特点了点头。

“她很…”桃子想了一会儿，寻找合适的措辞。“欢快。”

格林特迷惑地缩紧了他的机壳。“有点难以想象。”

“是真的！”桃子鸣叫道。

“你这么说，就更难想象了，”格林特答道，但塔格和蛇夫座都上下摆动，表示肯定。

“我的意思是，埃里斯从来都不欢快，”桃子继续说道。“但布瑞亚可以让她展现出不同的一面。很神奇。我印象很深。”

“她过去曾和埃里斯一起编写歌谣，”塔格补充道。

“真…可爱，”蛇夫座说道。

“哈，”格林特思忖道。“听起来她很特别。”

“她是很特别，”塔格说。他们陷入了一阵沉默，然后桃子重新开口。

“她在地狱深渊里所做的一切…不是没有意义的。埃里斯逃了出来。”

机灵们点了点头。

“如果乌鸦有危险，我想我也会这么做的，”格林特轻声说道。“如果那是保证他安全的唯一办法。但乌鸦会很难过。非常，非常难过。”

“埃里斯也‘非常，非常难过'。她不只是失去了光能和她的朋友。”塔格答道。

“我们比任何人都更了解我们的守护者，”蛇夫座说道。“我们是在他们最落魄的时刻遇到他们的。”

塔格把目光移开，陷入了沉思。

桃子嗡鸣着。“她会怎么看待埃里斯的计划呢？”

她的问题让大家陷入了沉思。格林特若有所思地上下摆动起来。

“我想她会感到骄傲的，”他说道，其他机灵也表示同意。

3347946548.lore:
My Queen,

Undoubtedly you have read the reports. I make no apology for the ritual I have performed, or what I become when under its effects. You too have done many things in your own life that revealed who you are.

The Guardians see me unrestrained. I do not control my emotions when I enter the oubliette and embrace my transformation. I warned you of this many years ago, when I was afraid of what I might do. But I am no longer afraid. The time for warnings has passed. We have the knowledge we need.

Long ago I warned you of the threat Oryx posed and the imminence of his arrival. I spoke of his sword logic and his throne world, of his insatiable worm and the power of his Dreadnaught.

With this insight, you did something marvelous. Your throne world, your Eleusinia, is a testament to your will, to your Techeuns' skills, and to Riven's delight. Sadly, its desecration is, to our knowledge, irreparable. I am certain it was once beautiful.

But I believe it was also the sole exception in a process of creation that is uniquely Hive. If only the slaying of a powerful being was required, then every Guardian would be reveling in their own creation.

Recall that it was only with Hive magic that the Scorned Baron Hiraks—the Mindbender, as he wished to be styled—created a throne through Cayde-6's murder. So, too, did Crota affect his own throne in the same way.

Of course, Oryx and Savathûn's thrones are well-known to us. A worm-husk of bone; a lush garden of Light. Others have seen brief and terrible glimpses of Xivu Arath's throne. It gapes like a maw, following her wherever there is war.

Theirs were inadvertent. Upon their first true deaths, they did not know what they had made. With their strength and the power of their worms, they created something dire, and found themselves there upon their deaths. Imagine the Hive gods' first glimpses of their realms. To retreat to one's throne is to retreat into the variances of one's mind. It is a stark confrontation.

You were well prepared for yours. Such was the consequence of my warning. I could well imagine my surprise at the variances of my own, as my own emotions surprise me now. But Imagining must be enough for me.

Eris Morn
3347946548.lore_zh:
我的女王，

你一定已经看过报告了。我进行了仪式，而且受其影响我发生了很大的转变，但我对此并不感到抱歉。你在人生中也做过很多事，让你明白自己是谁。

守护者们认为我无法控制。我进入地下密牢接受转化时，我不会控制自己的情绪。多年前我就警告过你此事，那时我害怕自己会做出什么事来。但我不再害怕了。警报已经解除，我们所需要的已经知晓。

很久之前，我曾警告过你，欧里克斯会造成很大威胁，而且他即将到来。我提到他的邪剑守则、王座世界，还有他那贪得无厌的蠕虫以及无畏战舰的力量。

知道了这些，你建立了千秋伟业。你的王座世界，你的厄琉息斯，就是你的意志、灵巫技能和魅痕的证明。可悲的是，据我们所知，它遭到了可无法挽回的亵渎。它曾经一定很美丽吧。

但我相信除它以外，这种创造过程是邪魔族独有的。如果所需要的只是杀死一个强大的生物，那么每个守护者都会陶醉在自己的造物之中。

回想一下，只有依靠邪魔族魔法，嗤魅公爵赫拉克斯——他更希望被称为心灵操纵者——才通过谋杀凯德6号创造了一个王座。克洛塔也是如此去影响他自己的王座的。

当然，欧里克斯和萨瓦图恩的王座，我们都很了解。骨质的蠕虫外壳，繁茂的光能花园。其他人则短暂地瞥见了希乌阿拉斯的可怕王座。它张开血盆大口，哪里有战争，它就跟随她前去。

他们在无意中建造了王座。当他们初尝死亡时，并不知道自己造了什么。他们用自己和蠕虫的力量创造了一件可怕的东西，而死后发现自己竟然身处那里。想象一下，邪魔族诸神第一次看到自己领域的情景。退至自己的王座，就是退至自己变化的心灵当中。这是一种严酷的对峙。

你为面对你的王座世界做了充分的准备。这就是我的警告带来的结果。我能想象面对那些变化时我会多么惊讶，就像我现在对自己的情感也很惊讶一样。光是想象一下就够了。

埃里斯·摩恩

1973107014.lore:
"You don't have to do this, if you don't want to," Ikora said. "I'd understand." 

From the other side of the library, Aunor scowled. She was perhaps the most diligent of the Hidden, having dedicated herself to the unpleasant task of hunting down tainted Guardians. But that was precisely what worried Ikora. Each time they met, she seemed a little gaunter than before. A little testier. Was this crusade beginning to take a toll? Was it a mistake to give her another assignment instead of a vacation? 

"I stand by my promise," Aunor snapped before transmatting out. 

That had not alleviated Ikora's concerns one iota . She let out a sigh and rubbed her temples. 

She couldn't dwell on it for long, however. The air crackled again. When Ikora opened her eyes, Saint was standing exactly where Aunor had been, moments ago. "Ikora Rey, I am sorry to come unannou—"

"How did you get in here?" she blurted. No one but the Hidden knew where her private library was. Or so she had thought. 

The Exo stared at her, confused. "I—I transmatted," he said simply. He tried again. "I am sorry, but I must speak with you." 

"No, I'm the one who should apologize. Please, sit." She hurried to clear the books piled around a pair of armchairs. "I got your message. It's unfortunate this has happened a second time." 

Saint sat, his massive frame dwarfing  the chair. "Unfortunate, yes. Disturbing too. I fear…" He paused, looking away. Out the window, the afternoon sun had turned golden and begun sinking in the sky. "In battle, I know what to do. There are no doubts. The Trials was the same. But now, I do not know." 

"I understand. Sometimes, it feels like these incidents are designed to make us doubt everything, even our own abilities." Ikora sat beside him. "But there's no one I'd trust more to helm the Trials at a time like this." 

"Not even the man they are named for?" Saint let out a sad laugh. "He does not wish to, in any case. I ask and right away, he says he is too busy to care. Told me to shut them down, if I was so tired." 

"Well, he is busy. He's almost acting as a third Vanguard with this whole Cabal conflict.  Perhaps after we come to terms  with Caiatl…"

"You misunderstand. I am glad he is busy. Busy is good. It distracts him from his loss. But he is still…"

"Different?" 

"No. Yes, but more than that." He shook his head in frustration. "When I told him about the incident, I thought he would worry, like me. Instead, he tells me to take notes next time. Said the data would be useful," he spat in disgust. 

Ikora looked at Saint, expecting him to say more. When he didn't, she sat back in her seat, thinking. She wasn't exactly surprised. Osiris was an experimentalist , after all, and not a particularly sensitive one. And though this comment was certainly more callous than usual, she didn't understand Saint's concern. He seemed agitated, almost like he was angry at Osiris…

"That must've been upsetting to hear, after what you went through," she began slowly. Saint looked away, confirming her theory. "But I think his heart's in the right place. We know so little about the Darkness. More data would indeed be very useful." 

Saint said nothing. The light through the window splashed orange across his helm. 

"But," she pressed on, "We shouldn't endanger Guardians to get it. However Osiris feels about them now, the Trials started as a way to train fireteams, and they're going to stay that way." She stood, placing a hand on the Exo's shoulder. "I swear to you." 

He nodded, eyes still fixed on the horizon. "Good."
1973107014.lore_zh:
艾可拉“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

在图书馆的另一头，阿诺尔在低头沉吟着什么。她也许是隐秘者中最勤奋的一员，无私地投身于猎杀那些被污染的守护者。但这也恰恰是艾可拉担心的地方。每次他们碰面的时候，她都会显得更加憔悴，也更加凶狠。是这样的战斗开始对她造成伤害了吗？是不是该给她放个假，而不是再次让她出任务呢？

“我会坚守我的承诺”，阿诺尔在传送出去之前斩钉截铁地说道。

艾可拉对她的担忧并没有一丝一毫的减少，只轻轻叹了一口，闭上眼，用手揉了揉太阳穴。

对她来说，没有多少时间可以用来纠结。空气中再次噼啪作响，等艾可拉睁开眼，圣人就站在刚刚阿诺尔消失的位置。“艾可拉·蕾伊，抱歉没有提前知会你...”

她大声喊到：“你是怎么进来的”？除了隐秘者，没人知道她的死人图书馆的位置。至少她一直是这么认为的。

那个Exo略显疑惑地盯着她看。“我，我是传送来的”，他直接了当的说到：“我很抱歉，不过我现在必须跟你谈谈。”

“不，是我要向你道歉，真是失礼了。请坐吧。”她赶紧清理座位周围堆放的书籍。“我收到你的消息了，再次发生这样的事情我很遗憾。”

圣人坐了下去，他庞大的身躯让椅子显得有些可怜。“确实有些不幸，恐怕也让人有些不安...”他话说到一半停了下来，脸却转向另外一侧。窗外，午后的太阳已经变成了金色，开始向天边缓缓下沉。“无论是在战斗中还是在试炼里，我都知道自己应该做什么，也不会有任何犹豫。但是现在，我不知道了。”

“我懂这种感觉。有时候，就感觉这一切都是设计好的，让我们去怀疑一切，甚至怀疑自己的能力。”艾可拉走上前去，坐在他的身边。“但是对于试炼的主持者，没人比你更值得信任了。”

“那位让试炼冠上自己名字的人呢？”圣人笑了起来，笑声中充满了苦涩。“他不愿意的，只要我问，他就会说自己太忙顾不上。然后跟我说如果自己觉得折腾就把试炼彻底取消掉。”

“是啊，他是很忙。他现在简直就像是跟卡巴尔族交火的第三先锋军。也许我们跟查厄托达成协议之后...”

“我不是这个意思。他能忙一些我也很欣慰，有事做总是好的，能分散他的注意力，让他不那么痛苦。但是他还是...”

“这有什么区别？”

“没有。不过比这更重要的是。”他沮丧的摇摇头，说：“当我告诉他这件事的时候，我以为他会跟我一样有些担心。没想到他根本没有，还让我下次一定要做好记录，说什么这些数据以后会有用。”他略显厌恶地吐槽道。

艾可拉看着圣人，等待他继续说下去，但是他却彻底沉默了下来。见状，她便靠在自己的椅背上，思索起来。她倒是对此不太惊讶。奥斯里斯毕竟是个搞实验的，而且不是个多愁善感的人。在这种背景下，说出这样冷酷的话语固然比平时更无情，但圣人的担忧让她有些摸不着头脑。他似乎很激动，在生奥斯里斯的气...

“我明白，在你经历过那些之后，听到些话确实有些难受”，她耐心地说道。圣人移开目光，这也证实了她的猜想，随即补充到：“不过我相信他心里是怀着好意的。我们对黑暗的了解并不深，多采集一些数据确实很有用。”

圣人一言不发，窗外的阳光照射在他的头盔上，反射出橙色的光。

“但是”，她接着说：“我们不能因为要数据就伤害那些守护者。不管奥斯里斯对他们怀着怎样的态度，试炼的目的是为了选拔火力战队，我们必须保持纯粹。”她站了起来，用一只手搭在Exo的肩膀上说到：“这点我向你保证。”

他点了点头，依然远眺着地平线。“那就好。”

2314610827.lore_zh:
“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

在图书馆的另一头，阿诺尔在低头沉吟着什么。她也许是隐秘者中最勤奋的一员，无私地投身于猎杀那些被污染的守护者。但这也恰恰是艾可拉担心的地方。每次他们碰面的时候，她都会显得更加憔悴，也更加凶狠。是这样的战斗开始对她造成伤害了吗？是不是该给她放个假，而不是再次让她出任务呢？

“我会坚守我的承诺”，阿诺尔在传送出去之前斩钉截铁地说道。

艾可拉对她的担忧并没有一丝一毫的减少，只轻轻叹了一口，闭上眼，用手揉了揉太阳穴。

对她来说，没有多少时间可以用来纠结。空气中再次噼啪作响，等艾可拉睁开眼，圣人就站在刚刚阿诺尔消失的位置。“艾可拉·蕾伊，抱歉没有提前知会你...”

她大声喊到：“你是怎么进来的”？除了隐秘者，没人知道她的死人图书馆的位置。至少她一直是这么认为的。

那个Exo略显疑惑地盯着她看。“我，我是传送来的”，他直接了当的说到：“我很抱歉，不过我现在必须跟你谈谈。”

“不，是我要向你道歉，真是失礼了。请坐吧。”她赶紧清理座位周围堆放的书籍。“我收到你的消息了，再次发生这样的事情我很遗憾。”

圣人坐了下去，他庞大的身躯让椅子显得有些可怜。“确实有些不幸，恐怕也让人有些不安...”他话说到一半停了下来，脸却转向另外一侧。窗外，午后的太阳已经变成了金色，开始向天边缓缓下沉。“无论是在战斗中还是在试炼里，我都知道自己应该做什么，也不会有任何犹豫。但是现在，我不知道了。”

“我懂这种感觉。有时候，就感觉这一切都是设计好的，让我们去怀疑一切，甚至怀疑自己的能力。”艾可拉走上前去，坐在他的身边。“但是对于试炼的主持者，没人比你更值得信任了。”

“那位让试炼冠上自己名字的人呢？”圣人笑了起来，笑声中充满了苦涩。“他不愿意的，只要我问，他就会说自己太忙顾不上。然后跟我说如果自己觉得折腾就把试炼彻底取消掉。”

“是啊，他是很忙。他现在简直就像是跟卡巴尔族交火的第三先锋军。也许我们跟查厄托达成协议之后...”

“我不是这个意思。他能忙一些我也很欣慰，有事做总是好的，能分散他的注意力，让他不那么痛苦。但是他还是...”

“这有什么区别？”

“没有。不过比这更重要的是。”他沮丧的摇摇头，说：“当我告诉他这件事的时候，我以为他会跟我一样有些担心。没想到他根本没有，还让我下次一定要做好记录，说什么这些数据以后会有用。”他的言语中充满了厌恶。

艾可拉看着圣人，等待他继续说下去，但是他却彻底沉默了下来。见状，她便靠在自己的椅背上，思索起来。她倒是对此不太惊讶。奥斯里斯毕竟是个搞实验的，而且不是个多愁善感的人。在这种背景下，说出这样冷酷的话语固然比平时更无情，但圣人的担忧让她有些摸不着头脑。他似乎很激动，在生奥斯里斯的气...

“我明白，在你经历过那些之后，听到些话确实有些难受”，她耐心地说道。圣人移开目光，这也证实了她的猜想，随即补充到：“不过我相信他心里是怀着好意的。我们对黑暗的了解并不深，多采集一些数据确实很有用。”

圣人一言不发，窗外的阳光照射在他的头盔上，反射出橙色的光。

“但是”，她接着说：“我们不能因为要数据就伤害那些守护者。不管奥斯里斯对他们怀着怎样的态度，试炼的目的是为了选拔火力战队，我们必须保持纯粹。”她站了起来，用一只手搭在Exo的肩膀上说到：“这点我向你保证。”

他点了点头，依然远眺着地平线。“那就好。”

413901114.name: Acosmic
413901114.flavor: How may we endure the desolation of the absolute?
413901114.lore:
The noise of the Bazaar was a background hum, the seemingly electric energy pulsating all around Sloane as she wandered among the Festival of the Lost vendors. A Human sold delicate pottery beside Eliksni weavers showcasing their intricate fabrics. There were platters of stuffed figs and mugs of Ether Fizz. A Bracus tended a flame below a spit. The charring meat sizzled with each turn, and war beasts lapped at the fat that trickled to the ground. Two Awoken Corsairs shared a roasted artichoke, both warming their fingers on the coal-blistered petals. Human and Eliksni children darted past, their laughter and chittering carried on the wind.

Everything here struck Sloane's senses as ruefully foreign and strangely dissonant. She'd missed so much. Her grief caught in her throat as the spiny shell of a Hive Ghost glided into view, and Sloane felt her jaw drop. She mentally noted even more questions for Zavala.

Rehnpeir's Drunken Noodle caught her eye up ahead, the sign blissfully familiar, and she sighed with relief for a moment.

Aisha and Shayura waved her over to a table. "You made it," Shayura said, affection laced into the edge of her voice.

"I'm glad you're here too," Sloane said. "Both of you." Aisha handed a steaming bowl to Sloane and put another in front of an empty chair.

Aisha's gaze followed Sloane's. "Reed will always have a seat at our table," Aisha said. Shayura nodded and offered a supportive but strained smile, and Aisha gave her hand a reassuring squeeze.

Sloane looked down again at the bowl in front of her. Swirls of noodles and slices of meat soaked in the creamy broth, and the egg's golden yolk pooled around the bok choy nestled beside it. She stared at her meal, as if to commit every noodle to memory.

"Are you planning on eating it or painting it?" a voice teased from behind.

Sloane turned to see Zavala standing beside her. A small laugh escaped from her lips. "I just… I've been waiting—wanting—for this for so long. Now that I have it, I… I almost don't want this moment to end."

"We know how you feel," Aisha said. 

"However, there's good news," Zavala quipped.

"What's that?"

"You can savor the next bowl too."

Sloane grinned and lifted the first noodles to her lips. She savored the umami flavors, surprised by the complexity. 

"How is it?" he asked.

"It's different. But… still good."

A look of understanding passed between them, and Zavala gave her a reassuring smile.
413901114.lore_zh:
集市的噪音犹如嗡鸣的背景声，斯隆漫步在英灵日的商人之中，她的四周似乎跳动着电能。一名人类在展示复杂织物的埃里克斯尼族织工身旁贩卖着精致的陶器。包括一些放着含馅无花果的盘子和几杯乙太气泡酒。一名十夫长照看着烤架下的炉火。烧焦的肉伴着每一次翻转咝咝作响，战兽们舔着滴落在地上的肉脂。两个觉醒者海盗军分享着一个烤洋蓟，在炭烧过的瓣片上暖着手指头。人类和埃里克斯尼族的孩童们飞奔而过，欢笑和嬉闹声随风而去。

这里的一切让斯隆生出一种悲伤的陌生感，异常不和谐。她错过了太多。一名邪魔族机灵的多刺机壳飞入视野，她的悲痛仿佛因惊愕而卡在了喉咙里。她在脑海中记下了更多需要向萨瓦拉提出的问题。

前方的瑞恩佩尔醉面餐馆吸引了她的目光，这个招牌熟悉得令人欣喜，她顿时松了一口气。

艾莎和沙玉拉挥手让她坐到桌子旁。“你来了，”沙玉拉说道，声音中含着温情。

“我很高兴你们也在这儿，”斯隆说道。“你们俩都是。”艾莎把一只热气腾腾的碗递给斯隆，又把另一只碗放在一把空椅子前面。

艾莎注意到了斯隆的目光。“我们这桌永远会为里德留一个位置，”艾莎说道。沙玉拉点点头，给了一个支持但略显拘谨的微笑，而艾莎则安慰地握紧了她的手。

斯隆再次低头看向她面前的碗。漩涡状的面条和肉片浸泡在奶油肉汤里，鸡蛋的金黄色蛋黄积聚在白菜四周。她凝视着她的食物，好像是要将每一根面条都印在脑海中。

“你是打算吃它，还是画它？”一个调侃的声音从身后传来。

斯隆回过头看见萨瓦拉站在她身边，嘴角不禁露出一丝微笑。“我只是…我已经等待——也期待——这一刻很久了。现在我如愿以偿，我…都有点不想让这一刻结束了。”

“我们明白你的感受，”艾莎说道。 

“不过，我有好消息，”萨瓦拉打趣道。

“是什么？”

“另一碗也归你了。”

斯隆咧嘴一笑，把第一口面举到唇边。她品尝着鲜味，口感丰富，让她十分惊讶。 

“怎么样？”他问道。

“不一样。但…还是很好吃。”

他们四目相对，彼此心领神会。萨瓦拉给了她一个安慰的微笑。

3103255595.name: Jurassic Green
3103255595.flavor: "'Monster' is a relative term. Just look at the Drifter."  —Glint
3103255595.lore:
Foreword to "The Book of the Forgotten"

Sol is filled with monsters. More than I imagined could possibly exist in one system. So far, the list includes:

Alien robots that bend time, blot out the sun, and drive people crazy.

Floating witches that birth squirming hordes of cannibals, all driven to murder by parasitic worms.

Armored walrus people who conquer planets and subjugate whole races.

Undead mobs of rotting alien corpses, animated by Dark Ether.

Clans of interstellar insects trying to steal a small planetoid for its energy signature.

And most recently, ominous triangular ships of unknown origin that send spooky telepathic messages.

But in my opinion, the most bizarre monsters in all of Sol are a gang of heavily armed zombies, made eternal by pint-sized cybernetic constructs (some of whom are lovers of folk tales).

Sol may be a strange and crowded place, but the next time someone tells you of a bizarre new monster (like a shadowy clique of pumpkin-headed phantoms), think twice before you dismiss them. That monster may be your new neighbor.

Happy Festival of the Lost!

—Glint, the smallest monster
3103255595.lore_zh:
《遗忘之书》前言

太阳系到处都是怪物。远远超出了我想象中一个星系里能够存在的数量。到目前为止，这份怪物清单包括：

能扭曲时空、遮天蔽日，让人意乱神迷的外星机器人。

产下成群蠕动的食人族，受寄生蠕虫驱使嗜血杀戮的浮空女巫。

攻占星球并征服整个种族的披甲海象人。

被黑暗乙太驱动，拖着腐烂外星尸体躯壳的不死暴民。

为了能量信号，试图窃取一颗小行星的星际虫群。

最近，还有会发送恐怖心灵感应消息，来历不明的不详三角飞船。

但在我看来，整个太阳系中最奇异的怪物还要数那群全副武装，凭借微型的电子结构体而长生不死的僵尸（他们中有些还是民间传说的爱好者）。

太阳系算得上是个奇怪又拥挤的地方，不过下次要是有人告诉你某种奇异的新怪物（比如一群神秘的南瓜脑袋幽灵），置之不理之前可要三思。那怪物没准就住在你的隔壁。

英灵日快乐！

——格林特，最小只的怪物

3871226707.name: Mechabre
3871226707.lore:
"It's not complicated. I just want to stomp my enemies using a giant mech suit," the Titan mused.

"Seems a little redundant," replied his Hunter teammate. 

The pair were stationed at the rim of a canyon, watching their Warlock teammate take readings from a Vex conflux down below. The Titan surveyed the canyon through the scope of his elaborate sniper rifle, while the Hunter scanned his radar for any hint of incoming hostiles.

"I mean, no offense," the Hunter continued, "but you're already an Exo."

The Titan took his eye off the scope and scowled at his teammate. "What the hell do you mean by that?"

"C'mon, man. You know what I mean," the Hunter replied, rolling his eyes.

"What, just because I'm an Exo, I'm an empty mechanized shell or something?" the Titan growled, piqued.

"I didn't say that. It's just… you've already got a machine body. And superpowers. What the hell is a mech suit gonna add?"

"Oh, so just because I'm an Exo, I don't deserve a mech suit?" The Titan began to raise his voice.

"Dude. First of all, mech suits don't exist. Second—" 

"Tell that to giant Clovis Bray." 

"SECOND," the Hunter continued, "there's nothing a mech suit could do that you can't already. I mean, the Vex actually need theirs to—"

"So NOW I'm a VEX?!" the Titan hollered, throwing his hands up.

"I DIDN'T SAY THAT!" 

"GUESS I'M JUST A METAL SHELL FILLED WITH GROSS ELECTRIC MILK—" 

A thunderous CRUNCH interrupted the Titan's rant. The pair peered into the valley below, where an enormous Vex Minotaur was lifting its giant metal hoof from the flattened body of their Warlock teammate. 

The Guardians winced. There was an awkward silence.

"…All right, I admit it," the Hunter finally spoke up. "That did look like fun."
3871226707.lore_zh:
“这并不复杂。我只是想用巨大的机甲套装践踏我的敌人，”泰坦沉思道。

“好像有点多余，”他的猎人队友回答道。 

这两人站在峡谷边缘，看着他们的术士队友从下方的Vex汇流处读取数据。泰坦通过他精致的狙击步枪瞄准镜观察着峡谷，而猎人则扫描他的雷达找寻任何敌人来袭的迹象。

“我的意思是，无意冒犯，”猎人继续说道，“但你已经是Exo了。”

泰坦将目光从瞄准镜上移开，怒视他的队友。“你这话是什么意思？”

“拜托，兄弟。你知道我的意思，”猎人翻着白眼答道。

“怎么，因为我是Exo，所以我是个机械空壳什么的？”泰坦愤怒地咆哮着。

“我没那么说。只是…你已经有了一具机械躯壳。还有超能。机甲套装又能有多大作用？”

“哦，这么说因为我是Exo，所以我不配得到机甲套装了？”泰坦开始提高嗓音。

“老兄。首先，机甲套装根本不存在。其次——” 

“这话你跟巨人克洛维斯·布瑞说去。” 

“其次，”猎人继续说道，“机甲套装能做到的事，你已经做到了。我是说，Vex其实是需要他们的机甲套装来——”

“现在我又成Vex了？！”泰坦大叫道，举起了双手。

“我没那么说！” 

“看来我只是个金属壳，里头装满了恶心的电乳液——” 

雷鸣般的碾压声打断了泰坦的咆哮。两人往下方的山谷张望，一个庞大的Vex米诺陶正抬起它那巨大的金属蹄足，而他们的术士队友身体已被踏平。 

守护者们不禁皱眉蹙额，陷入了一阵尴尬的沉默。

“…好吧，我承认，”猎人终于开口了。“那看起来确实很有趣。”

1735710919.name: Mechabre
1735710919.lore:
"It's not complicated. I just want to stomp my enemies using a giant mech suit," the Titan mused.

"Seems a little redundant," replied his Hunter teammate. 

The pair were stationed at the rim of a canyon, watching their Warlock teammate take readings from a Vex conflux down below. The Titan surveyed the canyon through the scope of his elaborate sniper rifle, while the Hunter scanned his radar for any hint of incoming hostiles.

"I mean, no offense," the Hunter continued, "but you're already an Exo."

The Titan took his eye off the scope and scowled at his teammate. "What the hell do you mean by that?"

"C'mon, man. You know what I mean," the Hunter replied, rolling his eyes.

"What, just because I'm an Exo, I'm an empty mechanized shell or something?" the Titan growled, piqued.

"I didn't say that. It's just… you've already got a machine body. And superpowers. What the hell is a mech suit gonna add?"

"Oh, so just because I'm an Exo, I don't deserve a mech suit?" The Titan began to raise his voice.

"Dude. First of all, mech suits don't exist. Second—" 

"Tell that to giant Clovis Bray." 

"SECOND," the Hunter continued, "there's nothing a mech suit could do that you can't already. I mean, the Vex actually need theirs to—"

"So NOW I'm a VEX?!" the Titan hollered, throwing his hands up.

"I DIDN'T SAY THAT!" 

"GUESS I'M JUST A METAL SHELL FILLED WITH GROSS ELECTRIC MILK—" 

A thunderous CRUNCH interrupted the Titan's rant. The pair peered into the valley below, where an enormous Vex Minotaur was lifting its giant metal hoof from the flattened body of their Warlock teammate. 

The Guardians winced. There was an awkward silence.

"…All right, I admit it," the Hunter finally spoke up. "That did look like fun."

3561203890.name: Tessellation
3561203890.flavor: The monolith is hewn; the monument is built.
3561203890.lore:
Once, nothing became something.

There was a game of possibilities. Patterns emerged that could—would—flourish or fail, wax or wane. And in the gaps between, there was nothing.
 
But nothing is an absence, defined by all the things that might one day be and yet never find fruition. It is an entropy of existence. For nothing to become something is as simple as a flipped bit, a chance mutation, a fallen leaf. Once it has become, it has always become, for castles are less fragile when built by something than nothing.

Something grows; and grown, it is seen.

Once, something became something else.

There were a people of potential and promise, of galvanizing growth. By their tools, their grand intention, the happenstance alignment of infinite years and atoms were as sculptor's clay, that which becomes the finest of statuary. Purpose carved from meaninglessness; the chance generation of the universe crafted into beauty, intentionality. That which served no reason ceased, randomness elided by the sculptor's art.

Something changes; and changed, it continues.

Once, something will become nothing.

There are beings who plant their intention and say, so far, no further. The bulwarks and the bastions, the stubborn flower that will defy even stone. In these hands, possibility is a single-minded tool. Resolution, pursuit, obliteration. What potential lies in empty space?

All that dies is only ever transformed, abscised and swallowed by wilderness, returned to infinite metamorphosis. To excise from that rich loam of transformation requires no less than perfect certainty.
 
Here is the secret: a ploughshare and a sword have never truly differed.
3561203890.lore_zh:
曾经，“无”化为了“有”。

过去有一种概率游戏。出现的图案可能会决定某件事的成败。而在其间的空隙里，什么都没有，即“无”。
 
但“无”是种缺失，它的定义是可能有天会出现但却永远不会出现的所有东西。它是一种存在的熵。化“无”为“有”，就像一次位翻转、一次偶然的突变、一片落叶一样简单。一旦出现，它便会一直存在，因为“有”所筑成的堡垒比由“无”更牢固。

这个“有”会成长；长成后即会被看见。

曾经，“有”发生了变化。

他们曾是一个具有潜力和希望的民族，一个不断成长的民族。通过他们的工具和宏图伟业，还有无限的岁月和原子的偶然排列，他们就像雕塑家手中的泥土，被塑造成了最精美的雕像。存在目的是从无意义中雕刻出来的；宇宙的偶然生成之物被加工成了刻意的美。那些没有理由的东西消失了，随机性被雕塑家的艺术所掩盖。

“有”改变了；改变之后的它，继续存在着。

曾经，“有”归于“无”。

有生命种下了他们的意图，并说，到此为止。他们是坚固的壁垒，是能在坚石上生根的顽强花朵。在这些生命手中，可能性是一种单一的工具。决断、追求、抹去。空旷之处会蕴含着什么潜力？

所有死亡的东西都只是被转化、切除并被荒野所吞噬，回到了无限的蜕变中。而要从那片蜕变的沃土中离开，需要的正是完美的确定性。
 
告诉你一个秘密：犁铧与刀剑其实并没有不同。

3821409356.name: Ex Diris
3821409356.flavor: "I have heralded disaster so often that my mere presence is an omen. So be it." —Eris Morn
3821409356.lore:
The cards gleamed in Eris Morn's hands, each one a taut web of meanings pinned down in place so that its signifier, in all its instability, could be held and comprehended.

She lay the first card on the table. Blades. Of course, she thought. The Hive's childish logic. But, like all childish things, it was persistent. They were all ensnared in its thesis. For now, it was their purpose as much as the Hive's.

The second card over the first. The Adherent. Xivu Arath. The greatest and most committed proponent of her brother's grand theory. Xivu Arath guarded the Blades card with her life. It held her with all the great lies she told herself.

Eris placed the third card below the others. The Sisters. Aurash, Sathona, Xi Ro. The Hive Gods' first names and first selves.

But the fourth card made her hesitate. She looked at it, and it stared back. The Harbinger. It could be no one but herself. She placed it to the left of the others. Perhaps now she counted among those sisters. Savathûn, Xivu Arath, and Eris Morn. A game between siblings. A love that sharpens.

Another card to the right of the first two. The Lie. Eris furrowed her brow. The cards had manifested through Hive magic; perhaps it denoted how the Hive see the Guardians. Liars denying the all-edged truth of the sword logic. Or was it the lie of that logic itself? The lie of the Deep, the lie of worms?

Three cards above the rest, one beside the other. Liminal. Ascension. Lacuna. All the aspects of a Guardian's Light. She had not held it for centuries. The Hive sisters below beckoned more loudly than the Light did.

Eris made a column of the remaining cards. At the bottom, The Witch. Above that, The Truth. Then Lament. Then The Wish.

Who was the Witch? Savathûn, or herself? The thought gave her pause. From whom did the Truth flow? There were too many truths for any one to triumph. But Lament, she knew: the slaying of Oryx, Xivu Arath's greatest loss.

Would the truth lead to another Hive sibling's death?

Eris looked to the last card. The Wish puzzled her. A wish is desire, the greatest power in this universe. Eris had wished before. It had led her here. Would she be asked to wish again? What else would her desire wrought?

Turning away, Eris left the cards on the table and took her questions with her.
3821409356.lore_zh:
卡牌在埃里斯·摩恩的手中闪闪发光，每张都是一个绷紧的意义之网，固定到位使其所指的不稳定性可以被掌握和理解。

埃里斯把第一张卡牌放在桌上。利刃。不出所料，她想。邪魔族幼稚的守则。但正如其他幼稚的东西，它会一直续存下去。他们都身陷于其理论。现在，这不仅是邪魔族的使命，也是他们的使命。

第二张卡牌盖过第一张。拥护者。希乌阿拉斯。她是她兄弟伟大理论最强大和最坚定的拥趸。希乌阿拉斯用她的生命守护着利刃卡牌。它用她对自己说的所有弥天大谎控制她。

埃里斯把第三张卡牌放在其他几张卡牌的下面。姐妹。奥拉什、萨托娜、希罗。邪魔族众神的本名与本我。

但第四张卡牌让她犹豫了。她看着它，它也盯着她。先知。那只能是她自己。她把它放在其他卡牌的左侧。也许现在她也算是那些姐妹中的一员了。萨瓦图恩、希乌阿拉斯，还有埃里斯·摩恩。一场同胞间的游戏。一场磨砺的爱恋。

前两张卡牌右边的另一张卡牌。谎言。埃里斯皱起眉头。这些卡牌是由邪魔族的魔法生成的；也许这就是邪魔族看待守护者的方式。否认邪剑守则剑刃真相的说谎者。还是说，守则本身才是谎言？深渊的谎言，蠕虫的谎言？

有三张卡牌在其他卡牌的上面，一张挨着一张。阈限、飞升、缺漏。守护者光能的所有星相。她已经好几个世纪没有持有它了。底下的邪魔族姐妹召唤的声音比光能更加响亮。

埃里斯把剩下的卡牌排成一列。最下面的是女巫。在那之上，是真相。然后是挽歌。接着是心愿。

女巫指的是谁？萨瓦图恩，还是她自己？这个想法让她迟疑了。真相来自于谁？真相太多，以至于任何人都无法知晓所有。不过她知道挽歌是什么：欧里克斯的死。希乌阿拉斯最大的丧失。

真相会使邪魔族兄弟姐妹中又出现一名死者吗？

埃里斯看向最后一张卡牌。“心愿”使她困惑。心愿是欲望，是这个宇宙中最伟大的力量。埃里斯曾经许过愿。它把她带到了这里。她会被要求再许一个愿吗？她的愿望还会带来什么？

埃里斯把卡牌留在桌子上，带着疑问转身离开了。

1034055198.name: Necrochasm
1034055198.flavor: Is your Light bright enough to stand in full gaze of the Hive's abyss?
1034055198.source_zh: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭
1034055198.lore:
Arise for Crota, Son of Oryx, the Hope-Eater! 

He who has seized the Sky lair above Ceres, 
which peers into other planes, 
now vassal to the might of the Worldbreaker! 

Within these keyholes  
our brood communes with unheard voices. 
They who whisper that the 
curse of our Thralls 
is a blessing granted by the Deep. 

Now, in honor of the God-Knight,  
we fashion these gluttonous whispers into death. 
His Hellmouth becomes home to the profane: 
the corpse of the Sky, reborn in the abyss. 

— Enkaar, the Anointed
1034055198.lore_zh:
为了欧里克斯之子和希望吞噬者克洛塔而崛起吧！ 

他曾夺取谷神星上的苍穹巢穴， 
它窥视其他位面， 
如今依附于世界破坏者的力量！ 

在这些锁眼中，  
我们的虫群与从未听过的声音交流。 
它们低声地说， 
我们怨魂的诅咒 
是深渊赐予的祝福。 

现在，为了向神骑士致敬，  
我们将这些贪婪低语变为死亡。 
其地狱深渊成了亵渎之家： 
苍穹之尸，自深渊中重生。 

——被指定的恩卡尔

3289270298.flavor: What you asked for or your money back!
3289270298.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3289270298.lore:
Patrolling with pickup fireteams isn't the greatest work, but, as Shaw likes to say, you can't let life get you down when you've got so much of it. 

He picks up a mission to clear out Vex on Io. Down in caves so deep they don't even notice the Pyramid ships overhead. They barely escape in time to watch Io get swallowed by nothingness. Just gone. 

All right, lesson learned. No more caves. 

The next gig's on Europa, and Shaw's fireteam bails on him. They don't even try to break him out of the crystal when he gets got by Fallen playing with Stasis. It takes the whole flight home to feel warm again. 

All right, lesson learned. Time to settle down. Go steady with a real team. People he can trust. 

Shaw feels better as soon as he drafts the message. And while he waits for replies, the City's waiting for him, full of Light and life and everything else you can think of. Antique House of Wolves cloaks, guaranteed genuine. Vex-metal woks. Fresh baklava. And his pockets are finally full of Glimmer. 

As he walks, a vendor calls out, "Bones! Let's wear some bones!" 

A lizard skull stares out at Shaw from the shoulder of a gauntlet-and-pauldron set. Spikes along one forearm: real stylish. And on sale. Might be a tight fit for Shaw's guns, though. 

The vendor doesn't even blink as Shaw tests his mobility right there in the stall. 

Shaw thinks to himself: it's no way to live, constantly hunting down gigs. Falling into swamps or methane snowdrifts without a friend to pull him out. Always burning his pay on gear to keep up with the arms race. It'd be nice to have a steady gig. A real team. Someplace he won't get his atoms scattered weekly by the latest alien in the system with a chip on their shoulder. 

He swings his arm. 

Pauldron feels good. Not too tight at all. Perfect, really. Funny he ever thought otherwise. 

Shaw heads back to the Tower with a spring in his step and a skull on his arm. His Ghost routes a message his way from the Vanguard network:  

[CASTER-3] I saw your post looking for a steady fireteam. I think I had a dream about you? We should meet. 

Yeah. Shaw's got a good feeling about this one.
3289270298.lore_zh:
与临时拼凑的火力战队一起巡逻，这个体验不怎么样。但正如韩潇所说，生活中的苦难越多，就越应该直面一切。 

他接到了前往木卫一剿灭Vex的任务。在深邃的洞穴中，一行人甚至没注意到头顶上的金字塔飞船。他们几乎来不及逃走，只能眼睁睁地看着木卫一被虚无吞没。这个星球就这样消失了。 

好吧，吸取教训。再也不钻洞了。 

下一个是在木卫二上，而韩潇的火力战队直接抛下了他。他们甚至没尝试把他从冰影堕落者的水晶里救出来。直到飞回家里，他的身体才重新温暖了起来。 

好吧，吸取教训。是时候找几个固定的伙伴组成队伍了。找些可以信任的人当伙伴。 

韩潇在起草讯息后感觉好多了。在他等待回信的同时，这座城市也在等着他，这里充满了光明和生机，还有你能想到的一切。恶狼氏族的古董斗篷，保证货真价实。Vex金属锅，新鲜的巴拉瓦饼。他的口袋里终于装满了微光。 

走着走着，一个小贩喊道：“骨头！现在正流行骨头饰品！” 

一套带臂铠护肩上的蜥蜴颅骨瞪着韩潇。一边的前臂上还饰有尖刺，真时髦。不过对于韩潇的枪可能不大合适。 

韩潇就在店前测试这套装备的敏捷度，而这商贩连眼睛也没眨一下。 

韩潇心想：不停地寻找散活不是办法。掉进沼泽或甲烷雪堆，都没有朋友拉他一把。为了跟上军备竞赛的步伐，他总是把收入花在装备上。如果能有个稳定的工作，一个真正的团队就好了。这样，他就不会每周都被来势汹汹的新外星人打回原子态了。 

他挥了挥手臂。 

护肩感觉很好。一点也不紧。真的很完美。完全出乎他的意料。 

韩潇肩抗着颅骨，步伐轻盈地回到了高塔。他的机灵向他传送了一条来自先锋网络的信息：  

[卡斯特-3]我看到了你寻找稳定火力战队的帖子。我好像梦见过你？我们应该见个面。 

是的。韩潇对此感觉不错。

3013248110.name: Wyrmguard Tunic
3013248110.flavor: "It's never a fair fight. Win anyway." —Lord Shaxx
3013248110.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3013248110.lore:
Arcite 99-40 holds the cable taut while Lord Shaxx fastens the final anchor with a few swings of a fiery hammer. When Shaxx gives the nod, Arcite tests the give, then releases the cable.  

They look up at the massive, tusked skull that now looms majestically over the Crucible staging area.  

The occasion has attracted a small crowd of observers: a mixed group of citizens and Guardians who murmur among themselves or simply stare, be it in awe or disapproval. Shaxx ignores them, crossing his arms and gazing up at his trophy. 

"The Speaker would not approve of this," Arcite observes. 

Shaxx ignores this too. 

"This is a lesson, Arcite. I want these newbies to look at this and know that there's always something worse out there. Something meaner, and more powerful."  

"Something like the Red Legion," Arcite supplies. A foe to catch them all unawares. 

"Temptation," Shaxx corrects. "Self-destruction."  

Arcite looks up again at the skull and scans it for energy signals. "And it can be killed."  

Shaxx nods, satisfied. "Something always remains. But it can be killed." 

Arcite picks up a faint whisper, an audio signal too faint and garbled to process into intelligible language. When he scans for it again, it's gone.
3013248110.lore_zh:
在阿赛特99-40紧紧拽住缆绳的同时，领主沙克斯用炽热的铁锤固定住了最后的锚。沙克斯点头后，阿赛特试探着松开了缆绳。  

他们抬起头，望着熔炉竞技场上方那颗巨大的、长着獠牙的颅骨。它现在被威严地挂在了准备区域的上方。  

这个变化引来了一小群旁观者：市民和守护者混杂在一起，他们或喃喃自语，或瞠目结舌，或惊叹不已。沙克斯没有理会他们，双手交叉，仰望着自己的战利品。 

“先知不会认可的，”阿赛特说。 

沙克斯也没有理会他。 

“这是一堂课，阿赛特。我想让这些新手看看这个东西，让他们知道宇宙中总有更可怕的东西。更凶残，更强大的东西。”  

“猩红军团那样的东西，”阿赛特补充道。一个让他们所有人措手不及的敌人。 

“诱惑，”沙克斯纠正他。“自我毁灭。”  

阿赛特再次抬头看了看颅骨，扫描了一下它的能量信号。“而它是可以被杀死的。”  

沙克斯满意地点了点头。“有些东西总会留存下来。但它可以被杀死。” 

阿赛特捕捉到一个微弱的低语，这个音频信号太微弱、太杂乱，无法处理成可理解的语言。当他再次扫描时，信号已经消失了。

3755696951.name: Wyrmguard Cloak
3755696951.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3755696951.lore:
The Bazaar, atop a balcony:  

Tyche-4 sips hot broth from a takeout container. 

"I wish I could win just one match," Baro says to her, sagging morosely against the railing.  

Tyche-4 elbows him gently. "Killing other Guardians all day isn't the only way to help the City, you know."  

"Easy for you to say. You're not the one who's been hiding from Shaxx for weeks—hey, don't laugh!" 

 

The Annex, beneath the stairs: 

"The look on their faces," Nakato says, laughing breathlessly. "Can't believe he staked that Sparrow of his. Guardians really do think they can't lose."  

Her Eliksni companion makes a chuffing noise and rattles off an incomprehensible stream of words. Nakato catches "skilled" and "cheat" though, and smiles. Even the most backhanded of compliments are better than none. 

"You know, you're a quick hand at cards. And everyone's throwing around Glimmer like there's no tomorrow. If you wanted to stick together a while…"  

The Eliksni blinks at her, mulling it over, then nods. 

Nakato grins and claps her new friend on the back. "That's the spirit. Wish I'd met you years ago."  

 

The Hangar, within a maintenance closet: 

Velibor sits hidden in the dark, wracked by helpless convulsions of grief.  

"I wish they were still here." He gulps for air. "I can't do this without them."  

Augur settles at her Guardian's shoulder. "You need to talk to someone, Vel—"  

"I should have been there. I could have saved them. I wish I'd never let them go."  

 

Outside the Tower offices: 

A stray cat regards Dimas disdainfully from a windowsill, then resumes washing its paws. 

"I wish I had a cat," Dimas exclaims. "Here, cat!"  

Dimas inches closer to the indifferent feline. "It must be a good life, sitting around the Tower without worrying about Light and Dark, or much of anything at all."  

The cat does not look up. 

Dimas thinks for a moment. 

"I wish I was a cat," he says. 

 

A Tower sub-basement, between the stacks: 

"I think that's it," Serge says. "Once we've sealed up this last one, we're done for the day."  

"Not bad for an honest day's work," the frame says. It speaks in the same amiable tone of voice it applies to every statement, but Serge still finds himself smiling.  

"You said it, buddy."  

Serge looks on as the frame effortlessly fits the final plate of ion shielding into place. It hums as it works—a little tune Serge taught it on his second day on the job. 

"The day goes by a lot faster with someone to talk to," Serge says. "Just wish you could understand me. Really understand, I mean."  

"Yes," says the frame. "I wish that also."
3755696951.lore_zh:
在集市旁的一个阳台上：  

泰谢-4从外卖容器中啜饮着热汤。 

“我希望我能赢一场比赛。”巴罗垂头丧气地靠在栏杆上，对她说道。  

泰谢-4用手肘轻轻地碰了碰他。“整天和其他守护者打打杀杀，根本帮不了圣城，你知道吧。”  

“说得倒是容易。你这几周又没在躲着沙克斯——嘿，别笑！” 

 

楼梯下的附属建筑： 

“他们的表情太逗了，”纳卡托笑得喘不过气来。“真不敢相信，他竟然堵上了他的快雀。守护者真的以为自己不会输啊。”  

她的埃里克斯尼族同伴发出“唧唧”的声音，滔滔不绝地说了一大堆听不懂的话。但纳卡托还是听出了“熟练”和“作弊”，也看见了他的微笑。即使是最挖苦的赞美也比没有强。 

“你知道，你打牌的技术挺不错。而所有人都在大手大脚地撒微光。如果你想合作一段时间的话…”  

埃里克斯尼族朝她眨了眨眼，琢磨了一下，然后点了点头。 

纳卡托咧嘴一笑，拍了拍新朋友的后背。“要的就是这种精神。要是早几年遇到你就好啦。”  

 

机库的某个维修间内： 

维利博躲在黑暗中，无助地被悲痛折磨着。  

“我希望他们还在这里。”他大口喘着气。“没有他们，我做不到。”  

奥古靠在这位守护者的肩膀上。“你得找人谈谈，维利…”  

“我本应该在那里，本可以救出他们的。真希望我没让他们走。”  

 

高塔办公室外： 

一只流浪猫在窗台上不屑地看了看迪马斯，然后又继续舔它的爪子。 

“我要是养了只猫就好了，”迪马斯感叹道。“过来，猫咪！”  

迪马斯慢慢地靠近了这只冷漠的猫科动物。“在高塔附近度日，不用担心光明与黑暗，也不用担心任何其他事情，这样的生活一定很美好吧。”  

猫咪没有抬头。 

迪马斯思考了片刻。 

“我要是一只猫就好了，”他说。 

 

高塔下，资料库之间的某个地下室： 

“我想差不多了，”塞吉说。“我们把最后一个封起来，今天的任务就完成了。”  

“一天干完这么多还算不错，”框架说。虽然它的每句话都是那样的随和，塞吉还是笑了出来。  

“你说得对，伙计。”  

塞吉看着框架毫不费力地将最后一块离子屏蔽板安装到位。它一边工作一边发出嗡嗡声——这是塞吉在工作第二天教给它的小调。 

“有个人说话，一天就过得快多了，”赛吉说。“要是你能理解我就好了。我是说，真正地理解我。”  

“是啊，”框架说。“我也希望。”

713622571.name: Wyrmguard Mask
713622571.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
713622571.lore:
Descending the grassy sands of the Strand, Petra Venj hears the familiar roar of the Dreaming City, caught in another predictable brawl. She notes streaks of glass and scorch along the sand where dead Scorn line the beach and continues moving.  

Chitin ashes away as she strides through the Gardens of Esila. She moves unhindered; travel is never easier than in the wake of a Guardian. She smiles—maybe she would meet them there. 

Her spirits fade when she reaches Amrita's cave and sees no Guardian waiting. It seems they crashed through the city and left. Their attention drawn by some greater battle raging elsewhere. 

Petra minds her footing as she clambers down the slick cave rock and kneels beside the Corsair. "Something for the pain?" 

Corsair Amrita tries to stand, winces, and slouches back against the stone wall. "Oh, you got my distress signal?" 

"I just assumed you were in distress." Petra smiles and removes a small pouch labeled "Amrita," as well as a finely carved wooden applicator. Several other named pouches dangle from her belt. 

 "Safe bet…" Amrita chuckles, voice trailing in soft, tense coughs, and unsteady breathing. 

"Stop trying to get up." Petra whisks the contents of the pouch with the applicator, stirring an aroma of mint, aloe, and musk into the air. Amrita watches her work the mixture over. Too forceful, and the salve would separate. Too soft, and it wouldn't properly adhere or harden in the air. It was a test of consistency, attention, and discipline. 

"I think… I'd just like to go now. Wake up from the beginning." Amrita doesn't look up from Petra's hands until they stop. 

"Let me apply the salve." Petra reaches toward Amrita's stomach, a Hive Splinter spike still hot in her gut. 

Amrita grips Petra's arm as a spasm twists her gut, voice almost a whisper. "I don't want to do this anymore, Petra." The words were stark with grit. 

"I don't want you to, either," Petra says, her eyes meeting Amrita's. "But you don't have to suffer needlessly." 

Petra nods to her arm. 

Amrita lets go and shifts her armor off the wound. "Thank you…" 

Petra smears a thick coating of salve over the burnt, cauterized flesh, which douses the spike and sooths the inflammation. 

Amrita exhales and leans forward. "Go, you've spent enough time with me." 

"I'll be back, sister."  Petra grabs Amrita's hand and squeezes it. "We'll find a way out. Just not today."
713622571.lore_zh:
从滨岸的草地上落下，佩特拉·万吉听到了幽梦之城熟悉的咆哮声。它又陷入了一场预料中的争斗。她注意到遍布嗤魅尸体的沙滩上有玻璃和烧灼的痕迹。她继续前进。  

穿过艾希拉花园时，她发现四处都是甲壳素的灰烬。她一路畅通无阻；在守护者身后旅行是如此轻松。她微笑着，也许她会在那里遇到他们。 

当她抵达阿姆丽塔的洞穴，却没有看见守护者时，她的心情变得沮丧起来。看来他们穿城后便离开了。他们的注意力被其他地方更激烈的战斗所吸引了。 

佩特拉小心翼翼地爬下光滑的洞穴岩石，跪在一名海盗军身旁。“要点止痛的东西吗？” 

海盗军阿姆丽塔试着站起来，但却打了个趔趄，无力地靠在石壁上。“啊，你收到我的求救信号了吗？” 

“我只是猜到你遇上麻烦了。”佩特拉笑着，拿出一个标着“阿姆丽塔”的小袋子，以及一个精美的木制涂抹器。她的腰带上还挂着其他几个小袋子。 

 “安全起见吗…”阿姆丽塔笑了笑，声音中夹杂着轻微、短促的咳嗽和不稳定的呼吸。 

“别起来了。”佩特拉用涂抹器拂拭着小袋里的东西，将薄荷、芦荟和麝香的香气拌到了空气中。阿姆丽塔看着她涂抹着这种混合物。若太用力，药膏就会分离。若不够用力，药膏就不能很好地附着，或在空气中变硬。这是对毅力、注意力和纪律的考验。 

“我想…现在死去。从头醒过来。”直到佩特拉的手停下，阿姆丽塔才抬起头来。 

“等我涂完药膏。”佩特拉把手伸向阿姆丽塔的腹部。邪魔族的炽热尖刺依然陷在她的内脏之中。 

阿姆丽塔紧紧抓住佩特拉的手臂，肠胃一阵痉挛，几乎说不出话来。“我不想再这样了，佩特拉。”这番话语中充满了刻骨的痛楚。 

“我也不想让你再经历这些，”佩特拉看着阿姆丽塔的眼睛说。“但你不必承受不必要的痛苦。” 

佩特拉对着她的手臂点了点头。 

阿姆丽塔松开手，把护甲从伤口上挪开。“谢谢你…” 

佩特拉在烧焦的皮肉上涂抹了一层厚厚的药膏，冷却了尖刺，舒缓了她的灼烧感。 

阿姆丽塔喘了一口气，然后向前靠了靠。“快走吧，你陪我够久了。” 

“我会回来的，姐妹。”佩特拉紧紧抓住阿姆丽塔的手，说道。“总有一天，我们会找到出路的。”

716705876.name: Wyrmguard Strides
716705876.flavor: For all evils, there are two remedies.
716705876.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
716705876.lore:
[Report by VanNet encrypted router.] 

[E-Morn//Link: NM-O01] 

[Msg-Archive//00192410] 

E-Morn: Your findings are consistent with mine. The egregore festers where the Veil touches, as if it projects a field across Sol. I could feel it when I took my tithing. Do you mean to map it? 

NM-O01: I could, but the egregore only shows us where the Veil's influence has marked our plane in that past. The areas where the Veil's influence currently holds sway are not so easily identified. This does progress some working theories, however. 

[Brief pause] 

NM-O01: …I wish I had been there, to face Savathûn and Xivu Arath with you. 

E-Morn: I would not expect you to endanger yourself. 

NM-O01: Is that so?  

NM-O01: How did it feel to face her? 

E-Morn: Like judgment, long overdue… for a moment.  

NM-O01: I was incensed to hear she was allowed to live. 

E-Morn: I was not pleased either. But, if it is vengeance you crave, know that it has been exacted. I tore from Xivu Arath what she tore from you. 

NM-O01: Good. 

E-Morn: And Savathûn… she knows our true enemy. There will come a day when she meets your retribution as well. 

NM-O01: Yes… for now, victory over vengeance. 

E-Morn: It is inevitable, Osiris. She will turn on us again. And we will strike her down.
716705876.lore_zh:
[报告来自VanNet加密路由器。] 

[E-摩恩//连接: NM-O01] 

[信息存档//00192410] 

E-摩恩：你的发现与我的一致。守望者会在面纱触及的地方滋生，像是在太阳系里投射出了一块滋生地。我在获得供奉的时候就感受到了。你是想绘制它的地图吗？ 

NM-O01：我可以这么做，但守望者只能反映出过去面纱在我们的位面中触及过的地方。目前受面纱影响的区域不是那么容易确定。不过，这倒是让我们的理论有了一些进展。 

[短暂停顿] 

NM-O01：…我希望我当时也在那里，与你一起面对萨瓦图恩和希乌阿拉斯。 

E-摩恩：我不想让你将自己置于危险之中。 

NM-O01：是吗？  

NM-O01：面对她是怎样一种感觉？ 

E-摩恩：一开始，像是…一场早该开始的审判。  

NM-O01：听说她被允许活下去，我感到非常气愤。 

E-摩恩：我也很不满。但如果你想要的是复仇，那个目的已经实现了。希乌阿拉斯从你那夺走的东西，我已经夺回来了。 

NM-O01：很好。 

E-摩恩：至于萨瓦图恩…她了解我们真正的敌人。总有一天，你会找她复仇。 

NM-O01：没错…现在，胜利比复仇重要。 

E-摩恩：那是不可避免的，奥斯里斯。她会再次背叛我们。而我们会击倒她。
