3837409374.flavor: What you asked for or your money back!
3837409374.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3837409374.lore:
Patrolling with pickup fireteams isn't the greatest work, but, as Shaw likes to say, you can't let life get you down when you've got so much of it. 

He picks up a mission to clear out Vex on Io. Down in caves so deep they don't even notice the Pyramid ships overhead. They barely escape in time to watch Io get swallowed by nothingness. Just gone. 

All right, lesson learned. No more caves. 

The next gig's on Europa, and Shaw's fireteam bails on him. They don't even try to break him out of the crystal when he gets got by Fallen playing with Stasis. It takes the whole flight home to feel warm again. 

All right, lesson learned. Time to settle down. Go steady with a real team. People he can trust. 

Shaw feels better as soon as he drafts the message. And while he waits for replies, the City's waiting for him, full of Light and life and everything else you can think of. Antique House of Wolves cloaks, guaranteed genuine. Vex-metal woks. Fresh baklava. And his pockets are finally full of Glimmer. 

As he walks, a vendor calls out, "Bones! Let's wear some bones!" 

A lizard skull stares out at Shaw from the shoulder of a gauntlet-and-pauldron set. Spikes along one forearm: real stylish. And on sale. Might be a tight fit for Shaw's guns, though. 

The vendor doesn't even blink as Shaw tests his mobility right there in the stall. 

Shaw thinks to himself: it's no way to live, constantly hunting down gigs. Falling into swamps or methane snowdrifts without a friend to pull him out. Always burning his pay on gear to keep up with the arms race. It'd be nice to have a steady gig. A real team. Someplace he won't get his atoms scattered weekly by the latest alien in the system with a chip on their shoulder. 

He swings his arm. 

Pauldron feels good. Not too tight at all. Perfect, really. Funny he ever thought otherwise. 

Shaw heads back to the Tower with a spring in his step and a skull on his arm. His Ghost routes a message his way from the Vanguard network:  

[CASTER-3] I saw your post looking for a steady fireteam. I think I had a dream about you? We should meet. 

Yeah. Shaw's got a good feeling about this one.
3837409374.lore_zh:
与临时拼凑的火力战队一起巡逻并不是最棒的体验。但正如韩潇所说，生活中的苦难越多，就越应该直面一切。 

他接下了一个前往木卫一剿灭Vex的任务。在深邃的洞穴中，一行人甚至没注意到头顶上的金字塔飞船。他们几乎来不及逃走，只能眼睁睁地看着木卫一被虚无吞没。这个星球就这样消失了。 

好吧，吸取教训。再也不钻洞了。 

下一个活在木卫二上，而韩潇的火力战队直接抛下了他。他们甚至没尝试把他从冰影堕落者的水晶里救出来。在回家的路上他才暖到了身子。 

好吧，吸取教训。是时候找几个固定的伙伴组成队伍了。找些可以信任的人当伙伴。 

韩潇在起草讯息后感觉好多了。在他等待回信的同时，这座城市也在等着他，这里充满了光明和生机，还有你能想到的一切。恶狼氏族的古董斗篷，保证货真价实。Vex金属锅，新鲜的巴拉瓦饼。他的口袋里终于装满了微光。 

走着走着，一个小贩喊道：“骨头！现在正流行骨头饰品！” 

一套带臂铠护肩上的蜥蜴颅骨瞪着韩潇。一边的前臂上还饰有尖刺，真时髦。不过对于韩潇的枪可能不大合适。 

韩潇就在店前测试这套装备的敏捷度，而这商贩连眼睛也没眨一下。 

韩潇心想：不停地寻找散活不是办法。掉进沼泽或甲烷雪堆，都没有朋友拉他一把。为了跟上军备竞赛的步伐，他总是把收入花在装备上。如果能有个稳定的工作，一个真正的团队就好了。这样，他就不会每周都被来势汹汹的新外星人打回原子态了。 

他挥了挥手臂。 

护肩感觉很好。一点也不紧。真的很完美。完全出乎他的意料。 

韩潇肩抗着颅骨，步伐轻盈地回到了高塔。他的机灵向他传送了一条来自先锋网络的信息：  

[卡斯特-3]我看到了你寻找稳定火力战队的帖子。我好像梦见过你？我们应该见个面。 

是的。韩潇对此感觉不错。

3005056146.name: Wyrmguard Chestplate
3005056146.flavor: "It's never a fair fight. Win anyway." —Lord Shaxx
3005056146.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3005056146.lore:
Arcite 99-40 holds the cable taut while Lord Shaxx fastens the final anchor with a few swings of a fiery hammer. When Shaxx gives the nod, Arcite tests the give, then releases the cable.  

They look up at the massive, tusked skull that now looms majestically over the Crucible staging area.  

The occasion has attracted a small crowd of observers: a mixed group of citizens and Guardians who murmur among themselves or simply stare, be it in awe or disapproval. Shaxx ignores them, crossing his arms and gazing up at his trophy. 

"The Speaker would not approve of this," Arcite observes. 

Shaxx ignores this too. 

"This is a lesson, Arcite. I want these newbies to look at this and know that there's always something worse out there. Something meaner, and more powerful."  

"Something like the Red Legion," Arcite supplies. A foe to catch them all unawares. 

"Temptation," Shaxx corrects. "Self-destruction."  

Arcite looks up again at the skull and scans it for energy signals. "And it can be killed."  

Shaxx nods, satisfied. "Something always remains. But it can be killed." 

Arcite picks up a faint whisper, an audio signal too faint and garbled to process into intelligible language. When he scans for it again, it's gone.
3005056146.lore_zh:
在阿赛特99-40紧紧拽住缆绳的同时，领主沙克斯用炽热的铁锤固定住了最后的锚。沙克斯点头后，阿赛特试探着松开了缆绳。  

他们抬起头，望着熔炉竞技场上方那颗巨大的、长着獠牙的颅骨。它现在被威严地挂在了准备区域的上方。  

这个变化引来了一小群旁观者：市民和守护者混杂在一起，他们或喃喃自语，或瞠目结舌，或惊叹不已。沙克斯没有理会他们，双手交叉，仰望着自己的战利品。 

“先知不会认可的，”阿赛特说。 

沙克斯也没有理会他。 

“这是一堂课，阿赛特。我想让这些新手看看这个东西，让他们知道宇宙中总有更可怕的东西。更凶残，更强大的东西。”  

“猩红军团那样的东西，”阿赛特补充道。一个让他们所有人措手不及的敌人。 

“诱惑，”沙克斯纠正他。“自我毁灭。”  

阿赛特再次抬头看了看颅骨，扫描了一下它的能量信号。“而它可以被杀死。”  

沙克斯满意地点了点头。“有些东西总会留存下来。但它可以被杀死。” 

阿赛特捕捉到一个微弱的低语，这个音频信号太微弱、太杂乱，无法处理成可理解的语言。当他再次扫描时，信号已经消失了。

3600297123.name: Wyrmguard Mark
3600297123.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3600297123.lore:
The Bazaar, atop a balcony:  

Tyche-4 sips hot broth from a takeout container. 

"I wish I could win just one match," Baro says to her, sagging morosely against the railing.  

Tyche-4 elbows him gently. "Killing other Guardians all day isn't the only way to help the City, you know."  

"Easy for you to say. You're not the one who's been hiding from Shaxx for weeks—hey, don't laugh!" 

 

The Annex, beneath the stairs: 

"The look on their faces," Nakato says, laughing breathlessly. "Can't believe he staked that Sparrow of his. Guardians really do think they can't lose."  

Her Eliksni companion makes a chuffing noise and rattles off an incomprehensible stream of words. Nakato catches "skilled" and "cheat" though, and smiles. Even the most backhanded of compliments are better than none. 

"You know, you're a quick hand at cards. And everyone's throwing around Glimmer like there's no tomorrow. If you wanted to stick together a while…"  

The Eliksni blinks at her, mulling it over, then nods. 

Nakato grins and claps her new friend on the back. "That's the spirit. Wish I'd met you years ago."  

 

The Hangar, within a maintenance closet: 

Velibor sits hidden in the dark, wracked by helpless convulsions of grief.  

"I wish they were still here." He gulps for air. "I can't do this without them."  

Augur settles at her Guardian's shoulder. "You need to talk to someone, Vel—"  

"I should have been there. I could have saved them. I wish I'd never let them go."  

 

Outside the Tower offices: 

A stray cat regards Dimas disdainfully from a windowsill, then resumes washing its paws. 

"I wish I had a cat," Dimas exclaims. "Here, cat!"  

Dimas inches closer to the indifferent feline. "It must be a good life, sitting around the Tower without worrying about Light and Dark, or much of anything at all."  

The cat does not look up. 

Dimas thinks for a moment. 

"I wish I was a cat," he says. 

 

A Tower sub-basement, between the stacks: 

"I think that's it," Serge says. "Once we've sealed up this last one, we're done for the day."  

"Not bad for an honest day's work," the frame says. It speaks in the same amiable tone of voice it applies to every statement, but Serge still finds himself smiling.  

"You said it, buddy."  

Serge looks on as the frame effortlessly fits the final plate of ion shielding into place. It hums as it works—a little tune Serge taught it on his second day on the job. 

"The day goes by a lot faster with someone to talk to," Serge says. "Just wish you could understand me. Really understand, I mean."  

"Yes," says the frame. "I wish that also."
3600297123.lore_zh:
在集市旁的一个阳台上：  

泰谢-4从外卖容器中啜饮着热汤。 

"我希望我能赢一场比赛。"巴罗垂头丧气地靠在栏杆上，对她说道。  

泰谢-4用手肘轻轻地碰了碰他。“整天打其他守护者并不是帮助圣城的唯一方式，你知道吗？”  

“说得倒是容易。你这几周又没在躲着沙克斯——嘿，别笑！” 

 

楼梯下的附属建筑： 

“他们的表情太逗了，”纳卡托笑得喘不过气来。“真不敢相信，他竟然堵上了他的快雀。守护者真的以为自己不会输啊。”  

她的埃里克斯尼族同伴发出“唧唧”的声音，滔滔不绝地说了一大堆听不懂的话。但纳卡托还是听出了“熟练”和“作弊”，也看见了他的微笑。即使是最挖苦的赞美也比没有强。 

“你知道，你打牌的技术挺不错。而所有人都在大手大脚地撒微光。如果你想合作一段时间的话…”  

埃里克斯尼族朝她眨了眨眼，琢磨了一下，然后点了点头。 

纳卡托咧嘴一笑，拍了拍新朋友的后背。“要的就是这种精神。要是早几年遇到你就好啦。”  

 

机库的某个维修间内： 

维利博躲在黑暗中，无助地被悲痛折磨着。  

“我希望他们还在这里。”他大口喘着气。“没有他们，我做不到。”  

奥古靠在这位守护者的肩膀上。“你得找人谈谈，维利——”  

“我本该在那里的。我本可以救出他们。我真希望我没让他们走。”  

 

高塔办公室外： 

一只流浪猫在窗台上不屑地看了看迪马斯，然后又继续洗它的爪子。 

“我要是养了只猫就好了，”迪马斯感叹道。“过来，猫咪！”  

迪马斯慢慢地靠近了这只冷漠的猫科动物。“在高塔附近度日，不用担心光明与黑暗，也不用担心任何其他事情，这样的生活一定很美好吧。”  

猫咪没有抬头。 

迪马斯思考了片刻。 

“我要是一只猫就好了，”他说。 

 

高塔下，资料库之间的某个地下室： 

“我想差不多了，”塞吉说。“我们把最后一个封起来，今天的任务就完成了。”  

“一天干完这么多还算不错，”框架说。虽然它的每句话都带着同样的随和，塞吉还是笑了出来。  

“你说得对，伙计。”  

塞吉看着框架毫不费力地将最后一块离子屏蔽板安装到位。它一边工作一边发出嗡嗡声——这是塞吉在工作第二天教给它的小调。 

“有个人说话，一天就过得快多了，”赛吉说。“要是你能理解我就好了。我是说，真正地理解我。”  

“是啊，”框架说。“我也希望。”

469031127.name: Wyrmguard Helm
469031127.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
469031127.lore:
Descending the grassy sands of the Strand, Petra Venj hears the familiar roar of the Dreaming City, caught in another predictable brawl. She notes streaks of glass and scorch along the sand where dead Scorn line the beach and continues moving.  

Chitin ashes away as she strides through the Gardens of Esila. She moves unhindered; travel is never easier than in the wake of a Guardian. She smiles—maybe she would meet them there. 

Her spirits fade when she reaches Amrita's cave and sees no Guardian waiting. It seems they crashed through the city and left. Their attention drawn by some greater battle raging elsewhere. 

Petra minds her footing as she clambers down the slick cave rock and kneels beside the Corsair. "Something for the pain?" 

Corsair Amrita tries to stand, winces, and slouches back against the stone wall. "Oh, you got my distress signal?" 

"I just assumed you were in distress." Petra smiles and removes a small pouch labeled "Amrita," as well as a finely carved wooden applicator. Several other named pouches dangle from her belt. 

 "Safe bet…" Amrita chuckles, voice trailing in soft, tense coughs, and unsteady breathing. 

"Stop trying to get up." Petra whisks the contents of the pouch with the applicator, stirring an aroma of mint, aloe, and musk into the air. Amrita watches her work the mixture over. Too forceful, and the salve would separate. Too soft, and it wouldn't properly adhere or harden in the air. It was a test of consistency, attention, and discipline. 

"I think… I'd just like to go now. Wake up from the beginning." Amrita doesn't look up from Petra's hands until they stop. 

"Let me apply the salve." Petra reaches toward Amrita's stomach, a Hive Splinter spike still hot in her gut. 

Amrita grips Petra's arm as a spasm twists her gut, voice almost a whisper. "I don't want to do this anymore, Petra." The words were stark with grit. 

"I don't want you to, either," Petra says, her eyes meeting Amrita's. "But you don't have to suffer needlessly." 

Petra nods to her arm. 

Amrita lets go and shifts her armor off the wound. "Thank you…" 

Petra smears a thick coating of salve over the burnt, cauterized flesh, which douses the spike and sooths the inflammation. 

Amrita exhales and leans forward. "Go, you've spent enough time with me." 

"I'll be back, sister."  Petra grabs Amrita's hand and squeezes it. "We'll find a way out. Just not today."
469031127.lore_zh:
从滨岸的草地上落下，佩特拉·万吉听到了幽梦之城熟悉的咆哮声。它又陷入了一场预料中的争斗。她注意到遍布嗤魅尸体的沙滩上有玻璃和烧灼的痕迹。她继续前进。  

穿过艾希拉花园时，她发现四处都是甲壳素的灰烬。她一路畅通无阻；在守护者身后旅行是如此轻松。她微笑着，也许她会在那里遇到他们。 

当她抵达阿姆丽塔的洞穴，却没有看见守护者时，她的心情变得沮丧起来。看来他们穿城后便离开了。他们的注意力被其他地方更激烈的战斗所吸引了。 

佩特拉小心翼翼地爬下光滑的洞穴岩石，跪在一名海盗军身旁。“要点止痛的东西吗？” 

海盗军阿姆丽塔试着站起来，但却打了个趔趄，无力地靠在石壁上。“啊，你收到我的求救信号了吗？” 

“我只是猜到你遇上麻烦了。”佩特拉笑着，拿出一个标着“阿姆丽塔”的小袋子，以及一个精美的木制涂抹器。她的腰带上还挂着其他几个小袋子。 

 “安全起见吗…”阿姆丽塔笑了笑，声音中夹杂着轻微、短促的咳嗽和不稳定的呼吸。 

“别起来了。”佩特拉用涂抹器拂拭着小袋里的东西，将薄荷、芦荟和麝香的香气拌到了空气中。阿姆丽塔看着她涂抹着这种混合物。太用力，药膏就会分离。不够用力，药膏就不能很好地附着，或在空气中变硬。这是对毅力、注意力和纪律的考验。 

“我想…现在死去。从头醒过来。”直到佩特拉的手停下，阿姆丽塔才抬起头来。 

“等我涂完药膏。”佩特拉把手伸向阿姆丽塔的腹部。邪魔族的炽热尖刺依然陷在她的内脏之中。 

阿姆丽塔紧紧抓住佩特拉的手臂，肠胃一阵痉挛，几乎说不出话来。“我不想再这样了，佩特拉。”这番话语中充满了刻骨的痛楚。 

“我也不想让你再经历这些，”佩特拉看着阿姆丽塔的眼睛说。“但你不必承受不必要的痛苦。” 

佩特拉对着她的手臂点了点头。 

阿姆丽塔松开手，把护甲从伤口上挪开。“谢谢你…” 

佩特拉在烧焦的皮肉上涂抹了一层厚厚的药膏，冷却了尖刺，舒缓了她的灼烧感。 

阿姆丽塔喘了一口气，然后向前靠了靠。“快走吧，你陪我够久了。” 

“我会回来的，姐妹。”佩特拉紧紧抓住阿姆丽塔的手，说道。“我们会找到出路的。总有一天。”

386385208.name: Wyrmguard Greaves
386385208.flavor: For all evils, there are two remedies.
386385208.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
386385208.lore:
[Report by VanNet encrypted router.] 

[E-Morn//Link: NM-O01] 

[Msg-Archive//00192410] 

E-Morn: Your findings are consistent with mine. The egregore festers where the Veil touches, as if it projects a field across Sol. I could feel it when I took my tithing. Do you mean to map it? 

NM-O01: I could, but the egregore only shows us where the Veil's influence has marked our plane in that past. The areas where the Veil's influence currently holds sway are not so easily identified. This does progress some working theories, however. 

[Brief pause] 

NM-O01: …I wish I had been there, to face Savathûn and Xivu Arath with you. 

E-Morn: I would not expect you to endanger yourself. 

NM-O01: Is that so?  

NM-O01: How did it feel to face her? 

E-Morn: Like judgment, long overdue… for a moment.  

NM-O01: I was incensed to hear she was allowed to live. 

E-Morn: I was not pleased either. But, if it is vengeance you crave, know that it has been exacted. I tore from Xivu Arath what she tore from you. 

NM-O01: Good. 

E-Morn: And Savathûn… she knows our true enemy. There will come a day when she meets your retribution as well. 

NM-O01: Yes… for now, victory over vengeance. 

E-Morn: It is inevitable, Osiris. She will turn on us again. And we will strike her down.
386385208.lore_zh:
[报告来自VanNet加密路由器。] 

[E-摩恩//连接: NM-O01] 

[信息存档//00192410] 

E-摩恩：你的发现与我的一致。守望者会在面纱触及的地方滋生，像是在太阳系里投射出了一块滋生地。我在获得供奉的时候就感受到了。你是想绘制它的地图吗？ 

NM-O01：我可以这么做，但守望者只能反映出过去面纱在我们的位面中触及过的地方。目前受面纱影响的区域不是那么容易确定。不过，这倒是让我们的理论有了一些进展。 

[短暂停顿] 

NM-O01:…我希望我当时也在那里，与你一起面对萨瓦图恩和希乌阿拉斯。 

E-摩恩：我不期望你将自己置于危险之中。 

NM-O01:是吗？  

NM-O01:面对她是怎样一种感觉？ 

E-摩恩：一开始，像是…一场早该开始的审判。  

NM-O01：听说她被允许活下去，我感到非常气愤。 

E-摩恩：我也很不满。但如果你想要的是复仇，那个目的已经实现了。我从希乌阿拉斯身上夺走了她从你那夺走的东西。 

NM-O01：很好。 

E-摩恩：至于萨瓦图恩…她了解我们真正的敌人。总有一天，你的复仇会找上她。 

NM-O01：没错…现在，胜利比复仇重要。 

E-摩恩：那是不可避免的，奥斯里斯。她会再次背叛我们。而我们会击倒她。

927140159.lore:
Patrolling with pickup fireteams isn't the greatest work, but, as Shaw likes to say, you can't let life get you down when you've got so much of it. 

He picks up a mission to clear out Vex on Io. Down in caves so deep they don't even notice the Pyramid ships overhead. They barely escape in time to watch Io get swallowed by nothingness. Just gone. 

All right, lesson learned. No more caves. 

The next gig's on Europa, and Shaw's fireteam bails on him. They don't even try to break him out of the crystal when he gets got by Fallen playing with Stasis. It takes the whole flight home to feel warm again. 

All right, lesson learned. Time to settle down. Go steady with a real team. People he can trust. 

Shaw feels better as soon as he drafts the message. And while he waits for replies, the City's waiting for him, full of Light and life and everything else you can think of. Antique House of Wolves cloaks, guaranteed genuine. Vex-metal woks. Fresh baklava. And his pockets are finally full of Glimmer. 

As he walks, a vendor calls out, "Bones! Let's wear some bones!" 

A lizard skull stares out at Shaw from the shoulder of a gauntlet-and-pauldron set. Spikes along one forearm: real stylish. And on sale. Might be a tight fit for Shaw's guns, though. 

The vendor doesn't even blink as Shaw tests his mobility right there in the stall. 

Shaw thinks to himself: it's no way to live, constantly hunting down gigs. Falling into swamps or methane snowdrifts without a friend to pull him out. Always burning his pay on gear to keep up with the arms race. It'd be nice to have a steady gig. A real team. Someplace he won't get his atoms scattered weekly by the latest alien in the system with a chip on their shoulder. 

He swings his arm. 

Pauldron feels good. Not too tight at all. Perfect, really. Funny he ever thought otherwise. 

Shaw heads back to the Tower with a spring in his step and a skull on his arm. His Ghost routes a message his way from the Vanguard network:  

[CASTER-3] I saw your post looking for a steady fireteam. I think I had a dream about you? We should meet. 

Yeah. Shaw's got a good feeling about this one.
927140159.lore_zh:
与临时拼凑的火力战队一起巡逻并不是最棒的体验。但正如韩潇所说，生活中的苦难越多，就越应该直面一切。 

他接下了一个前往木卫一剿灭Vex的任务。在深邃的洞穴中，一行人甚至没注意到头顶上的金字塔飞船。他们几乎来不及逃走，只能眼睁睁地看着木卫一被虚无吞没。这个星球就这样消失了。 

好吧，吸取教训。再也不钻洞了。 

下一个活在木卫二上，而韩潇的火力战队直接抛下了他。他们甚至没尝试把他从冰影堕落者的水晶里救出来。在回家的路上他才暖到了身子。 

好吧，吸取教训。是时候找几个固定的伙伴组成队伍了。找些可以信任的人当伙伴。 

韩潇在起草讯息后感觉好多了。在他等待回信的同时，这座城市也在等着他，这里充满了光明和生机，还有你能想到的一切。恶狼氏族的古董斗篷，保证货真价实。Vex金属锅，新鲜的巴拉瓦饼。他的口袋里终于装满了微光。 

走着走着，一个小贩喊道：“骨头！现在正流行骨头饰品！” 

一套带臂铠护肩上的蜥蜴颅骨瞪着韩潇。一边的前臂上还饰有尖刺，真时髦。不过对于韩潇的枪可能不大合适。 

韩潇就在店前测试这套装备的敏捷度，而这商贩连眼睛也没眨一下。 

韩潇心想：不停地寻找散活不是办法。掉进沼泽或甲烷雪堆，都没有朋友拉他一把。为了跟上军备竞赛的步伐，他总是把收入花在装备上。如果能有个稳定的工作，一个真正的团队就好了。这样，他就不会每周都被来势汹汹的新外星人打回原子态了。 

他挥了挥手臂。 

护肩感觉很好。一点也不紧。真的很完美。完全出乎他的意料。 

韩潇肩抗着颅骨，步伐轻盈地回到了高塔。他的机灵向他传送了一条来自先锋网络的信息：  

[卡斯特-3]我看到了你寻找稳定火力战队的帖子。我好像梦见过你？我们应该见个面。 

是的。韩潇对此感觉不错。

3400974073.name: Wyrmguard Robe
3400974073.flavor: "It's never a fair fight. Win anyway." —Lord Shaxx
3400974073.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
3400974073.lore:
Arcite 99-40 holds the cable taut while Lord Shaxx fastens the final anchor with a few swings of a fiery hammer. When Shaxx gives the nod, Arcite tests the give, then releases the cable.  

They look up at the massive, tusked skull that now looms majestically over the Crucible staging area.  

The occasion has attracted a small crowd of observers: a mixed group of citizens and Guardians who murmur among themselves or simply stare, be it in awe or disapproval. Shaxx ignores them, crossing his arms and gazing up at his trophy. 

"The Speaker would not approve of this," Arcite observes. 

Shaxx ignores this too. 

"This is a lesson, Arcite. I want these newbies to look at this and know that there's always something worse out there. Something meaner, and more powerful."  

"Something like the Red Legion," Arcite supplies. A foe to catch them all unawares. 

"Temptation," Shaxx corrects. "Self-destruction."  

Arcite looks up again at the skull and scans it for energy signals. "And it can be killed."  

Shaxx nods, satisfied. "Something always remains. But it can be killed." 

Arcite picks up a faint whisper, an audio signal too faint and garbled to process into intelligible language. When he scans for it again, it's gone.
3400974073.lore_zh:
在阿赛特99-40紧紧拽住缆绳的同时，领主沙克斯用炽热的铁锤固定住了最后的锚。沙克斯点头后，阿赛特试探着松开了缆绳。  

他们抬起头，望着熔炉竞技场上方那颗巨大的、长着獠牙的颅骨。它现在被威严地挂在了准备区域的上方。  

这个变化引来了一小群旁观者：市民和守护者混杂在一起，他们或喃喃自语，或瞠目结舌，或惊叹不已。沙克斯没有理会他们，双手交叉，仰望着自己的战利品。 

“先知不会认可的，”阿赛特说。 

沙克斯也没有理会他。 

“这是一堂课，阿赛特。我想让这些新手看看这个东西，让他们知道宇宙中总有更可怕的东西。更凶残，更强大的东西。”  

“猩红军团那样的东西，”阿赛特补充道。一个让他们所有人措手不及的敌人。 

“诱惑，”沙克斯纠正他。“自我毁灭。”  

阿赛特再次抬头看了看颅骨，扫描了一下它的能量信号。“而它可以被杀死。”  

沙克斯满意地点了点头。“有些东西总会留存下来。但它可以被杀死。” 

阿赛特捕捉到一个微弱的低语，这个音频信号太微弱、太杂乱，无法处理成可理解的语言。当他再次扫描时，信号已经消失了。

844733364.name: Wyrmguard Bond
844733364.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
844733364.lore:
The Bazaar, atop a balcony:  

Tyche-4 sips hot broth from a takeout container. 

"I wish I could win just one match," Baro says to her, sagging morosely against the railing.  

Tyche-4 elbows him gently. "Killing other Guardians all day isn't the only way to help the City, you know."  

"Easy for you to say. You're not the one who's been hiding from Shaxx for weeks—hey, don't laugh!" 

 

The Annex, beneath the stairs: 

"The look on their faces," Nakato says, laughing breathlessly. "Can't believe he staked that Sparrow of his. Guardians really do think they can't lose."  

Her Eliksni companion makes a chuffing noise and rattles off an incomprehensible stream of words. Nakato catches "skilled" and "cheat" though, and smiles. Even the most backhanded of compliments are better than none. 

"You know, you're a quick hand at cards. And everyone's throwing around Glimmer like there's no tomorrow. If you wanted to stick together a while…"  

The Eliksni blinks at her, mulling it over, then nods. 

Nakato grins and claps her new friend on the back. "That's the spirit. Wish I'd met you years ago."  

 

The Hangar, within a maintenance closet: 

Velibor sits hidden in the dark, wracked by helpless convulsions of grief.  

"I wish they were still here." He gulps for air. "I can't do this without them."  

Augur settles at her Guardian's shoulder. "You need to talk to someone, Vel—"  

"I should have been there. I could have saved them. I wish I'd never let them go."  

 

Outside the Tower offices: 

A stray cat regards Dimas disdainfully from a windowsill, then resumes washing its paws. 

"I wish I had a cat," Dimas exclaims. "Here, cat!"  

Dimas inches closer to the indifferent feline. "It must be a good life, sitting around the Tower without worrying about Light and Dark, or much of anything at all."  

The cat does not look up. 

Dimas thinks for a moment. 

"I wish I was a cat," he says. 

 

A Tower sub-basement, between the stacks: 

"I think that's it," Serge says. "Once we've sealed up this last one, we're done for the day."  

"Not bad for an honest day's work," the frame says. It speaks in the same amiable tone of voice it applies to every statement, but Serge still finds himself smiling.  

"You said it, buddy."  

Serge looks on as the frame effortlessly fits the final plate of ion shielding into place. It hums as it works—a little tune Serge taught it on his second day on the job. 

"The day goes by a lot faster with someone to talk to," Serge says. "Just wish you could understand me. Really understand, I mean."  

"Yes," says the frame. "I wish that also."
844733364.lore_zh:
在集市旁的一个阳台上：  

泰谢-4从外卖容器中啜饮着热汤。 

"我希望我能赢一场比赛。"巴罗垂头丧气地靠在栏杆上，对她说道。  

泰谢-4用手肘轻轻地碰了碰他。“整天打其他守护者并不是帮助圣城的唯一方式，你知道吗？”  

“说得倒是容易。你这几周又没在躲着沙克斯——嘿，别笑！” 

 

楼梯下的附属建筑： 

“他们的表情太逗了，”纳卡托笑得喘不过气来。“真不敢相信，他竟然堵上了他的快雀。守护者真的以为自己不会输啊。”  

她的埃里克斯尼族同伴发出“唧唧”的声音，滔滔不绝地说了一大堆听不懂的话。但纳卡托还是听出了“熟练”和“作弊”，也看见了他的微笑。即使是最挖苦的赞美也比没有强。 

“你知道，你打牌的技术挺不错。而所有人都在大手大脚地撒微光。如果你想合作一段时间的话…”  

埃里克斯尼族朝她眨了眨眼，琢磨了一下，然后点了点头。 

纳卡托咧嘴一笑，拍了拍新朋友的后背。“要的就是这种精神。要是早几年遇到你就好啦。”  

 

机库的某个维修间内： 

维利博躲在黑暗中，无助地被悲痛折磨着。  

“我希望他们还在这里。”他大口喘着气。“没有他们，我做不到。”  

奥古靠在这位守护者的肩膀上。“你得找人谈谈，维利——”  

“我本该在那里的。我本可以救出他们。我真希望我没让他们走。”  

 

高塔办公室外： 

一只流浪猫在窗台上不屑地看了看迪马斯，然后又继续洗它的爪子。 

“我要是养了只猫就好了，”迪马斯感叹道。“过来，猫咪！”  

迪马斯慢慢地靠近了这只冷漠的猫科动物。“在高塔附近度日，不用担心光明与黑暗，也不用担心任何其他事情，这样的生活一定很美好吧。”  

猫咪没有抬头。 

迪马斯思考了片刻。 

“我要是一只猫就好了，”他说。 

 

高塔下，资料库之间的某个地下室： 

“我想差不多了，”塞吉说。“我们把最后一个封起来，今天的任务就完成了。”  

“一天干完这么多还算不错，”框架说。虽然它的每句话都带着同样的随和，塞吉还是笑了出来。  

“你说得对，伙计。”  

塞吉看着框架毫不费力地将最后一块离子屏蔽板安装到位。它一边工作一边发出嗡嗡声——这是塞吉在工作第二天教给它的小调。 

“有个人说话，一天就过得快多了，”赛吉说。“要是你能理解我就好了。我是说，真正地理解我。”  

“是啊，”框架说。“我也希望。”

4196904014.name: Wyrmguard Hood
4196904014.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
4196904014.lore:
Descending the grassy sands of the Strand, Petra Venj hears the familiar roar of the Dreaming City, caught in another predictable brawl. She notes streaks of glass and scorch along the sand where dead Scorn line the beach and continues moving.  

Chitin ashes away as she strides through the Gardens of Esila. She moves unhindered; travel is never easier than in the wake of a Guardian. She smiles—maybe she would meet them there. 

Her spirits fade when she reaches Amrita's cave and sees no Guardian waiting. It seems they crashed through the city and left. Their attention drawn by some greater battle raging elsewhere. 

Petra minds her footing as she clambers down the slick cave rock and kneels beside the Corsair. "Something for the pain?" 

Corsair Amrita tries to stand, winces, and slouches back against the stone wall. "Oh, you got my distress signal?" 

"I just assumed you were in distress." Petra smiles and removes a small pouch labeled "Amrita," as well as a finely carved wooden applicator. Several other named pouches dangle from her belt. 

 "Safe bet…" Amrita chuckles, voice trailing in soft, tense coughs, and unsteady breathing. 

"Stop trying to get up." Petra whisks the contents of the pouch with the applicator, stirring an aroma of mint, aloe, and musk into the air. Amrita watches her work the mixture over. Too forceful, and the salve would separate. Too soft, and it wouldn't properly adhere or harden in the air. It was a test of consistency, attention, and discipline. 

"I think… I'd just like to go now. Wake up from the beginning." Amrita doesn't look up from Petra's hands until they stop. 

"Let me apply the salve." Petra reaches toward Amrita's stomach, a Hive Splinter spike still hot in her gut. 

Amrita grips Petra's arm as a spasm twists her gut, voice almost a whisper. "I don't want to do this anymore, Petra." The words were stark with grit. 

"I don't want you to, either," Petra says, her eyes meeting Amrita's. "But you don't have to suffer needlessly." 

Petra nods to her arm. 

Amrita lets go and shifts her armor off the wound. "Thank you…" 

Petra smears a thick coating of salve over the burnt, cauterized flesh, which douses the spike and sooths the inflammation. 

Amrita exhales and leans forward. "Go, you've spent enough time with me." 

"I'll be back, sister."  Petra grabs Amrita's hand and squeezes it. "We'll find a way out. Just not today."
4196904014.lore_zh:
从滨岸的草地上落下，佩特拉·万吉听到了幽梦之城熟悉的咆哮声。它又陷入了一场预料中的争斗。她注意到遍布嗤魅尸体的沙滩上有玻璃和烧灼的痕迹。她继续前进。  

穿过艾希拉花园时，她发现四处都是甲壳素的灰烬。她一路畅通无阻；在守护者身后旅行是如此轻松。她微笑着，也许她会在那里遇到他们。 

当她抵达阿姆丽塔的洞穴，却没有看见守护者时，她的心情变得沮丧起来。看来他们穿城后便离开了。他们的注意力被其他地方更激烈的战斗所吸引了。 

佩特拉小心翼翼地爬下光滑的洞穴岩石，跪在一名海盗军身旁。“要点止痛的东西吗？” 

海盗军阿姆丽塔试着站起来，但却打了个趔趄，无力地靠在石壁上。“啊，你收到我的求救信号了吗？” 

“我只是猜到你遇上麻烦了。”佩特拉笑着，拿出一个标着“阿姆丽塔”的小袋子，以及一个精美的木制涂抹器。她的腰带上还挂着其他几个小袋子。 

 “安全起见吗…”阿姆丽塔笑了笑，声音中夹杂着轻微、短促的咳嗽和不稳定的呼吸。 

“别起来了。”佩特拉用涂抹器拂拭着小袋里的东西，将薄荷、芦荟和麝香的香气拌到了空气中。阿姆丽塔看着她涂抹着这种混合物。太用力，药膏就会分离。不够用力，药膏就不能很好地附着，或在空气中变硬。这是对毅力、注意力和纪律的考验。 

“我想…现在死去。从头醒过来。”直到佩特拉的手停下，阿姆丽塔才抬起头来。 

“等我涂完药膏。”佩特拉把手伸向阿姆丽塔的腹部。邪魔族的炽热尖刺依然陷在她的内脏之中。 

阿姆丽塔紧紧抓住佩特拉的手臂，肠胃一阵痉挛，几乎说不出话来。“我不想再这样了，佩特拉。”这番话语中充满了刻骨的痛楚。 

“我也不想让你再经历这些，”佩特拉看着阿姆丽塔的眼睛说。“但你不必承受不必要的痛苦。” 

佩特拉对着她的手臂点了点头。 

阿姆丽塔松开手，把护甲从伤口上挪开。“谢谢你…” 

佩特拉在烧焦的皮肉上涂抹了一层厚厚的药膏，冷却了尖刺，舒缓了她的灼烧感。 

阿姆丽塔喘了一口气，然后向前靠了靠。“快走吧，你陪我够久了。” 

“我会回来的，姐妹。”佩特拉紧紧抓住阿姆丽塔的手，说道。“我们会找到出路的。总有一天。”

4143357569.name: Wyrmguard Boots
4143357569.flavor: For all evils, there are two remedies.
4143357569.source: Source: Season of the Wish Activities
4143357569.lore:
[Report by VanNet encrypted router.] 

[E-Morn//Link: NM-O01] 

[Msg-Archive//00192410] 

E-Morn: Your findings are consistent with mine. The egregore festers where the Veil touches, as if it projects a field across Sol. I could feel it when I took my tithing. Do you mean to map it? 

NM-O01: I could, but the egregore only shows us where the Veil's influence has marked our plane in that past. The areas where the Veil's influence currently holds sway are not so easily identified. This does progress some working theories, however. 

[Brief pause] 

NM-O01: …I wish I had been there, to face Savathûn and Xivu Arath with you. 

E-Morn: I would not expect you to endanger yourself. 

NM-O01: Is that so?  

NM-O01: How did it feel to face her? 

E-Morn: Like judgment, long overdue… for a moment.  

NM-O01: I was incensed to hear she was allowed to live. 

E-Morn: I was not pleased either. But, if it is vengeance you crave, know that it has been exacted. I tore from Xivu Arath what she tore from you. 

NM-O01: Good. 

E-Morn: And Savathûn… she knows our true enemy. There will come a day when she meets your retribution as well. 

NM-O01: Yes… for now, victory over vengeance. 

E-Morn: It is inevitable, Osiris. She will turn on us again. And we will strike her down.
4143357569.lore_zh:
[报告来自VanNet加密路由器。] 

[E-摩恩//连接: NM-O01] 

[信息存档//00192410] 

E-摩恩：你的发现与我的一致。守望者会在面纱触及的地方滋生，像是在太阳系里投射出了一块滋生地。我在获得供奉的时候就感受到了。你是想绘制它的地图吗？ 

NM-O01：我可以这么做，但守望者只能反映出过去面纱在我们的位面中触及过的地方。目前受面纱影响的区域不是那么容易确定。不过，这倒是让我们的理论有了一些进展。 

[短暂停顿] 

NM-O01:…我希望我当时也在那里，与你一起面对萨瓦图恩和希乌阿拉斯。 

E-摩恩：我不期望你将自己置于危险之中。 

NM-O01:是吗？  

NM-O01:面对她是怎样一种感觉？ 

E-摩恩：一开始，像是…一场早该开始的审判。  

NM-O01：听说她被允许活下去，我感到非常气愤。 

E-摩恩：我也很不满。但如果你想要的是复仇，那个目的已经实现了。我从希乌阿拉斯身上夺走了她从你那夺走的东西。 

NM-O01：很好。 

E-摩恩：至于萨瓦图恩…她了解我们真正的敌人。总有一天，你的复仇会找上她。 

NM-O01：没错…现在，胜利比复仇重要。 

E-摩恩：那是不可避免的，奥斯里斯。她会再次背叛我们。而我们会击倒她。

3438139008.lore:
"It should be elegant," says Zavala, striking his breastplate with a fist. The sound echoes through the room. "The Vanguard's representatives are as suited to diplomacy as they are combat. That is our strength, when our allies range from an Ahamkara to the Cabal."
 
Shaxx's firm gesture of denial drives the side of his hand into a shelf. An Omolon-branded canister falls off and rolls across the floor. "It must be an unstoppable force in sword form! It should spit fire! Also, it should be red."
 
"No, no," the Drifter says from the doorway. He kicks the rolling canister away without looking down. "I'm a law-abiding citizen. I pay my taxes. You can trust me. It needs to look mean. You want people thinking: 'They're madder, badder, and hungrier than me. I'm not tangling with them.'"
 
Banshee-44 dubiously scratches his jaw with the point of his stylus. He glances up at his clients from his notepad.
 
"That's a lot of elements for one design. Can you cut a couple?"
 
The workshop erupts in impassioned shouts.
3438139008.lore_zh:
“要优雅点，”萨瓦拉用拳头敲了敲自己的胸甲，说道。他的嗓音在房间里回荡。“先锋的代表必须能文能武。我们的盟友从卡巴尔到阿罕卡拉都有，所以这点正是我们的优势所在。”
 
沙克斯使劲敲了敲架子的侧面，做出了否认的手势。一个标着Omolon的罐子掉下来，滚落在地板上。“我们需要的是刀剑的形状，以代表无人能挡的力量！还要喷火！而且必须是红色。”
 
“不对不对，”浪客在门口说道。他头也不低，就一脚踢开了滚到脚下的罐子。“我是守法公民。我交税。你可以信任我。它要显得凶狠。要让人们觉得，‘他们比我更疯狂，更厉害，更饥渴。还是别去惹他们好。'”
 
班西-44疑惑地用触控笔的笔尖挠了挠下巴。他放下笔记本，抬头看了一眼面前的客户。
 
“要加在一起的设计元素太多了。能少一点吗？”
 
工作室里爆发出了慷慨激昂的喊声。

3710082365.lore:
The wish-dragons took to the air one final time, soaring nimbly between the pillars on wings of prismatic light. Sjur Eido watched their pale, sinuous reflections sweep across the surface of the geodes. 

It had been many years since Huginn and Muninn first arrived in the city as a nameless pair, full of the fervor and cunning of their kind. For the greater portion of those years, Sjur considered them friends. They dined delicately on her desire for news of worlds beyond the Reef, spinning truth and lies with the cackling enthusiasm of dedicated storytellers. 

But now the Hunt had been called, and there was only one path into the future. 

Sjur stood waiting at the center of the chamber, her fingers loose around the grip of her bow, her head bowed. 

At last, the Ahamkara landed heavily to either side of her, scenting the air.  

"Are you unhappy?" Huginn asked, surprised. 

"What story was there that never ended?" Muninn said. 

"And can you not tell it again once it is over?" said Huginn.  

"We will be as true and solid as bone, forever." Muninn yawned wide, his curling tusks scraping against one another.  

"Rhetoric," Sjur muttered. 

She would miss them, all the same. Their shining inquisitiveness, their impossible wisdom. The fleeting grace of weapons purposefully sheathed.  

All of it lost in one dismal moment of surrender. Unless— 

Huginn tilted his head. Muninn parted his jaws to brandish a fanged smile.  

Sjur straightened to her full height. At her hip was the fractal knife she had been gifted from the Queen's own armory. In her hands, her great bow.  

"Come, then," she said, plucking an arrow from its quiver. "Give me a fight to remember."
3710082365.lore_zh:
神龙最后一次腾空而起，乘着棱镜般的光翼在柱子之间灵活地翱翔。苏尔·艾多看着他们苍白而蜿蜒的倒影掠过晶石表面。 

距离休津和穆宁这对充满着热情和狡诈的无名组合第一次来到这座城市，已经过去很多年了。在这些年的大部分时间里，苏尔都把他们当做朋友。他们以她对暗礁以外的世界的知识的渴望为食，像专职的说书人一样热情地编织着真相和谎言。 

然而现在狩猎开始了。通向未来的道路只有一条。 

苏尔站在大厅中央等待着，低着头，手指轻轻地搭在弓弦上。 

最后，阿罕卡拉重重地落在了她的两侧，嗅着空气中的味道。  

“你不快乐吗？”休津惊讶地问道。 

“世上存在没有结局的故事吗？”穆宁说。 

“你不能在故事结束之后重新讲一遍吗？”休津说。  

“我们像骨头一样坚固、诚实，直到永远。”穆宁打了个大大的哈欠，弯曲的獠牙互相摩擦着。  

“诡辩，”苏尔嘀咕道。 

她还是会想念他们。他们毫不掩饰的好奇心，几乎不可能的智慧，还有武器故意放进鞘里的短暂优雅。  

所有这些都在投降时化为乌有。除非—— 

休津歪着头。穆宁张开下颌，露出獠牙，微笑起来。  

苏尔挺直了腰板。她腰上的短刀是女王从自己的军械库里取出来赠予她的。她的手中拿着她的大弓。  

“来吧，”她从箭筒中抽出一支箭，说道。“跟我大战一场吧。”

92459755.lore:
"Osiris." 

Strand weaves around Osiris's hands. It dims and brightens, casting green light onto the messy scatter of books and star charts spread across his desk and the surrounding six feet of floor. 

"Osiris!" 

"What?" Osiris lowers his hands. 

Saint-14 is there, a solid wall of Exo in the doorway.  

Saint crosses his arms. "You didn't answer my call." 

"It is crucial that we learn how Ley Lines operate. I believe they share a connection with Strand, if only I can unlock it." 

His handful of Strand extends in loops around him, spiraling towards the ceiling, turning the purple of Saint's ribbons to gray. 

"I am reminded of Nimbus's tale of the river. Strand connects our minds. But what parts of us also touch Ley Lines?" 

"I liked Nimbus in your stories," Saint interjects, mild. "We should visit them." 

In a mood like this, a mild interjection can't stop Osiris. "Queen Mara's Techeuns can affect matter through Ley Lines. Their joined will pulls on threads woven through the Ascendant Plane. Two connected systems, the warp and weft of our universe's fabric—one, a spool of thread for this world, and another perhaps, for the Ascendant Plane?" 

Osiris's Strand grows brighter, until Saint's massive hand engulfs his own. No master of Darkness, Saint takes control with a gleaming Void tether as the glow of Strand slowly fades. 

"How long has it been since you've seen the sun?" Saint asks. 

"I was experimenting with Solar Light just the other day. You know this." 

"Not the same. Come. Stubbornness is unbecoming." Saint tugs gently at Osiris by their joined hands. 

Osiris stops in his tracks and snorts. "If the question between us is that of hard-headedness—" 

Ikora's going to give them a talking-to if Saint's laughter gets through the soundproofing to her office again. So, he persists: "It is late, and I have not seen you since you set your robe on fire. The work will wait." 

Osiris lets himself be led out the door, the connection between them still glowing bright.
92459755.lore_zh:
“奥斯里斯。” 

缚丝缠绕在奥斯里斯的双手上。它时而变暗，时而变亮，将绿光投射到书桌上凌乱散落的书籍和星图上，以及六尺内的地板上。 

“奥斯里斯！” 

“什么？”奥斯里斯垂下了手臂。 

圣人14号，这位Exo就像一堵铁墙站在门廊里。  

圣人叉着手。“你没有接我的电话。” 

“弄懂灵脉的运作方式对我们至关重要。我相信它们与缚丝有某种联系，如果我能弄懂它就好了。” 

他手中的缚丝在周围绕圈延伸，盘旋着飞向天花板，将圣人的紫色缎带变成了灰色。 

“这让我想起了宁博思讲过的河流传说。缚丝连接着我们的思维。但我们中的哪个部分又连着灵脉呢？” 

“我喜欢你老是提起的那个宁博思，”圣人温和地插话道。“也许我们该去拜访这个人。” 

在这样的气氛中，温和的插话打断不了奥斯里斯。“玛拉女王的灵巫可以通过灵脉影响物质。她们的共同意志牵引着上维位面中编织着的丝线。两个相连的系统，我们宇宙结构的经纬线——其中一个是这个世界的线轴，也许另一个是上维位面的线轴？” 

奥斯里斯的缚丝越来越明亮，直到手被圣人的巨大手掌握住。圣人并非暗影的大师，他用一条发光的虚空系链控制住了局面。缚丝的光明慢慢褪去。 

“你有多久没见到太阳了？”圣人问道。 

“我几天前才用烈日的光能做过实验。你知道的。” 

“不是一回事。来吧。固执可不好。”圣人轻轻地拉了拉奥斯里斯的手。 

奥斯里斯停下动作，颇为不屑，“如果说我们中有谁固执——” 

如果圣人的笑声再次传进艾可拉的隔音办公室，那他肯定会被她好好说教一番。所以，他坚持道：“现在已经很晚了，而且我上次见你还是你长袍着火那次。工作的事可以等等。” 

奥斯里斯放任自己被带出门外，他们两人的联结仍在散发光亮。

2563668388.name: Scalar Potential
2563668388.lore:
// VANNET // EUROPA WIDEBAND // AudCHNL-2113-C // ENCRYPTION ENABLED 
// CRYPTARCHY ARCHIVE DELTA-4F // ANNOTATED // CLASSIFIED 

… 

EB: Is that everything, Commander? 

CZ: Well, no. There's one more thing. I wanted to ask you about Stasis. What it means for you to… wield the Darkness.  

EB: I was wondering if you might ask me that. For me, Stasis is intimately tied to perception. And to time. 

CZ: Time? 

EB: Yes. Stasis has the power to slow molecular activity. A process that we normally associate with gravity. Relativity, and all that. 

CZ: You're talking about time dilation.  

EB: Exactly. We think of time as… steady. But that's only because we experience it from a fixed perspective. When I "freeze" something with Stasis, I'm changing its timeframe relative to myself and the world around me. 

CZ: Stasis relies in part on one's perception of reality. Is that why Osiris always emphasizes self-control in using the Darkness? 

EB: That's his way of framing things. He views Stasis as exerting authority over oneself and others. 

CZ: And you don't? 

EB: In my view, the goal of Stasis is not to control the object, or even my own mind. It's to change my perspective. To see the object moving at the speed of my thoughts, not the speed of matter. 

CZ: And just… seeing it differently is enough? 

EB: Is that so hard to imagine? It's very similar to how you use Void Light—manipulating spacetime and gravitational fields. In fact, I would argue that Void has more in common with Stasis than it does with Solar or Arc. Perhaps they're reverse sides of the same coin. 

CZ: And using Stasis doesn't… worry you? Even after everything you've seen? 

EB: It did. For a long time, I feared that using Stasis would corrupt me, as I'd seen others corrupted. But after what seemed like a thousand years trapped in that interminable loop, it gradually dawned on me: the fear was the corruption. As long as fear gripped me, Light or Darkness made no matter. Once I accepted that, the Darkness ceased to be frightening. It was another matter of perspective. 

CZ: Hmm. Thank you, Elsie. You've given me a lot to think about. For some reason, your explanation makes me more… comfortable… with the idea. 

EB: Any time, Commander. It's all a matter of perspective. 

TRANSCRIPTION ENDS
2563668388.lore_zh:
// 先锋网 // 木卫二宽带 // 音频-2113-C // 已加密 
// 解密大师档案D-4F // 注释 // 机密 

… 

EB：就这样吗，指挥官？ 

CZ：不。还有一件事。我想问问你关于冰影的事。对你来说…操纵暗影之力是什么。  

EB：我也在想你会不会问我这个问题。对我来说，冰影与感知和时间都有紧密的关系。 

CZ：时间？ 

EB：是的。冰影会减缓分子活动。我们通常将这一过程与重力联系在一起。相对论等等。 

CZ：你是在说时间膨胀。  

EB：没错。我们认为时间是…稳定的。但这只是因为我们从一个固定的角度来体验它。当我用冰影“冻结”某个东西时，就在改变它相对于我自己和周围世界的时间框架。 

CZ：冰影依赖于一个人对现实的感知。这就是为什么奥斯里斯在使用暗影之力时总是强调自我控制吗？ 

EB：他就是这样看待冰影的。他认为冰影是对自己和他人行使权力的手段。 

CZ：你不这么认为吗？ 

EB：在我看来，冰影的目的不是控制对象，甚至不是控制我自己的思想。是改变我的视角。以我的思维的速度，而不是物质的速度来看待物体。 

CZ：只用…改变视角就足够了？ 

EB：很难想象吗？这与你如何使用虚空光能——操纵失控和引力场——非常相似。事实上，我认为虚空与冰影之间的相似度高于烈日和电弧。也许它们是一枚硬币的正反面吧。 

CZ：你看过了这么多事的发生，难道就不会担心…冰影的使用吗？ 

EB：我确实担心过很长一段时间。我曾担心使用冰影会使我堕落，就像其它人那样。但被困在那个无休止的循环中，过了像是一千年之后，我逐渐明白了：恐惧才是堕落。只要恐惧笼罩着我，光能或是暗影都一样。一旦我接受了这一点，暗影就不再可怕了。这又是另一个视角问题。 

CZ：嗯。谢谢你，艾尔西。你让我感触很多。不知为何，你的解释让我…更能接受这种力量了。 

EB：别客气，指挥官。这只是视角问题罢了。 

转录结束

4153087276.name: Appetence
4153087276.flavor: There is the sea. Who can drain it dry?
4153087276.lore:
// VANNET // TOWER WIDEBAND // AudCHNL-623F // ENCRYPTION ENABLED 
// CRYPTARCHY ARCHIVE GAMMA-2-7D // ANNOTATED // CLASSIFIED 

IR: And every time I look up at that portal, this gnawing doubt in my mind grows bigger. 

MK: Doubt is the shadow cast by wisdom. It is only by questioning that we uncover profound truths. What troubles you? 

IR: I've spent centuries studying the Light. Mastering it. I thought I knew… something. Enough. But watching the Witness carve through the side of the Traveler made me feel… ignorant. I realized how little I actually know.   

MK: The secrecy of the Great Machine has troubled many Eliksni. Eido has these same fears. 

IR: But not you? 

MK: I am reminded of the sea hunting ritual many Guardians enjoy. 

IR: Mmmm. Fishing. 

MK: The Guardians throw their hunting-lure into the sea in faith that many creatures live there, though they cannot see beneath its surface. And standing silently on shore, they might feel… helpless. For they cannot affect the sea. It is too vast, and too powerful. 

IR: I knew I disliked fishing for a reason. 

MK: In the face of such power, we must act with patience and humility. A fish hunter should not dwell on the invisible depths of the sea. This is only a distraction. Instead, they must focus on the fish hunting itself: the feel of the line and the ebb of the tides.  

IR: And that works? 

MK: I am happy to stand on the shore, appreciating the beauty and power of the sea without understanding it. Without controlling it. I have faith that, in time, the sea will reward my reverence with its abundance. 

IR: …The sea provides? 

MK: It does, Ikorakel. It does. 

TRANSCRIPTION ENDS
4153087276.lore_zh:
// 先锋网络 // 高塔宽带 // 音频-623F // 已启用加密 
// 解密大师档案G-2-7D // 注释 // 机密 

IR：每当我抬头看到那传送门时，我心中的疑虑就越发强烈。 

MK：怀疑是智慧投下的阴影。只有通过质疑，我们才能发现深刻的真理。你在烦恼什么？ 

IR：我花了几个世纪研究光能。熟练掌握光能。我以为我…很了解它。足够了解它。看着见证者切开旅行者的外壳，我觉得自己…很无知。我意识到了我的知识是多么浅薄。   

MK：大机器的秘密困扰着许多埃里克斯尼族。艾多也有同样的恐惧。 

IR：你没有吗？ 

MK：它让我想起了许多守护者喜欢的海上狩猎仪式。 

IR：嗯。钓鱼。 

MK：守护者们把猎物铒食扔进海里，因为他们相信那里生活着许多生物，尽管他们看不到海面之下。静静地站在岸上，他们可能会感到…无助吧。因为他们无法影响大海。它太广阔，太强大了。 

IR：我就知道我不喜欢钓鱼是有原因的。 

MK：面对如此强大的力量，我们必须保持耐心和谦逊。猎鱼者不应沉溺于看不见的海洋深处。这只会分散自身的注意力。相反，他们必须专注于捕鱼本身：鱼线的感觉和潮汐的起伏。  

IR：这样有用么？ 

MK：我很乐意站在岸边，欣赏大海的美丽和力量，即使我不了解它，也不能控制它。我相信，假以时日，大海会用它的丰饶回报我的敬畏。 

IR：…大海会赐予我们所需？ 

MK：它会的，艾可拉凯尔。它会的。 

转录结束

1401300690.name: Eye of Sol
1401300690.flavor: "The sun took my sight; thus, the sun became my eyes." —Parables of the Allspring
1401300690.lore:
It was Crimiq-5's honor to hold the flank. Sun at his back, there was no better position to provide overwatch in the Burning Shrine. He was the watchtower, and none would escape his vigil. Curt radio chatter signaled his fireteam's advance as he called out enemy maneuvers. Crimiq-5 watched tense bursts of movement and exchanges of fire as his team jockeyed for position.

Sola had ripped through their previous opponents with off-putting ferocity, and Crimiq was ready for this to be their last match of the day. He looked over her through his scope. Sola's silhouette marinated in an eerie shimmer that distorted the air as she moved. He stilled his body and sent a shot over her head to force an opponent back into cover.

"Aiming a little close." Sola sent a glare over her shoulder into the sun.

Crimiq-5 moved his scope off her. "Duck."

His earpiece crackled. Katake's voice drilled into his head. "THUNDERCRASH… Help!"

Katake's voice screeched out of existence as the lightning overtook him and Saint bellowed. Crimiq saw a bright flash burst from the hallway leading toward C-point.

"Be advised, I'm leaving the perch. Moving to trade for Katake."

He slid into position and snapped his trusted long rifle down lane. His sights found an unlucky Titan, lightning still crackling from their armor.

"Fate Cries Foul for you, brother." The shot hit squarely, and the Titan dropped. "Sorry I couldn't save you Katake. Next time."
1401300690.lore_zh:
守住侧翼是克里米克5号的荣耀。太阳在身后，在燃烧祭坛中没有更好的监视位置了。他就是瞭望塔，没人能逃脱他警觉的目光。当他喊出敌人的机动时，简要电台通讯声发出信号，指挥着他的火力战队前进。克里米克5号观察着紧张的移动和交火，他的团队在奋力争夺位置。

索拉用令人生厌的方式残忍击败了先前的对手，克里米克已准备好将其作为当天的最后一场比赛。他通过枪镜看着她。索拉的身影在出现令人毛骨悚然的微光中，移动时扭曲了空气。他稳住自己的身体，越过她的头顶开了一枪，迫使对手回身掩护。

“瞄准近点。”索拉向身后的太阳瞥了一眼。

克里米克5号的准镜离开了她。“闪避。”

他的耳机劈啪作响。卡塔克的声音钻进他的脑袋里。“雷霆冲击…帮忙！”

卡塔克声音从雷声中消失了，闪电占据了他，圣人也开始吼叫。克里米克看到一道明亮的闪光从伸向C点的廊道中爆发出来。

“小心，我要离开高点了。前去帮卡塔克换掉对手。”

他滑进位置，然后将他信赖的长枪瞄准下路。他的视野中发现一个不走运的泰坦，他的护甲中仍然不断有闪电爆裂。

“屈枉天命，兄弟。”射击正中目标，那位泰坦倒下。“抱歉我救不到你，卡特克。下次吧。”

2059255495.flavor: "The sun took my sight; thus, the sun became my eyes." —Parables of the Allspring
2059255495.lore:
It was Crimiq-5's honor to hold the flank. Sun at his back, there was no better position to provide overwatch in the Burning Shrine. He was the watchtower, and none would escape his vigil. Curt radio chatter signaled his fireteam's advance as he called out enemy maneuvers. Crimiq-5 watched tense bursts of movement and exchanges of fire as his team jockeyed for position.

Sola had ripped through their previous opponents with off-putting ferocity, and Crimiq was ready for this to be their last match of the day. He looked over her through his scope. Sola's silhouette marinated in an eerie shimmer that distorted the air as she moved. He stilled his body and sent a shot over her head to force an opponent back into cover.

"Aiming a little close." Sola sent a glare over her shoulder into the sun.

Crimiq-5 moved his scope off her. "Duck."

His earpiece crackled. Katake's voice drilled into his head. "THUNDERCRASH… Help!"

Katake's voice screeched out of existence as the lightning overtook him and Saint bellowed. Crimiq saw a bright flash burst from the hallway leading toward C-point.

"Be advised, I'm leaving the perch. Moving to trade for Katake."

He slid into position and snapped his trusted long rifle down lane. His sights found an unlucky Titan, lightning still crackling from their armor.

"Fate Cries Foul for you, brother." The shot hit squarely, and the Titan dropped. "Sorry I couldn't save you Katake. Next time."
2059255495.lore_zh:
守住侧翼是克里米克5号的荣耀。太阳在身后，在燃烧祭坛中没有更好的监视位置了。他就是瞭望塔，没人能逃脱他警觉的目光。当他喊出敌人的机动时，简要电台通讯声发出信号，指挥着他的火力战队前进。克里米克5号观察着紧张的移动和交火，他的团队在奋力争夺位置。

索拉用令人生厌的方式残忍击败了先前的对手，克里米克已准备好将其作为当天的最后一场比赛。他通过枪镜看着她。索拉的身影在出现令人毛骨悚然的微光中，移动时扭曲了空气。他稳住自己的身体，越过她的头顶开了一枪，迫使对手回身掩护。

“瞄准近点。”索拉向身后的太阳瞥了一眼。

克里米克5号的准镜离开了她。“闪避。”

他的耳机劈啪作响。卡塔克的声音钻进他的脑袋里。“雷霆冲击…帮忙！”

卡塔克声音从雷声中消失了，闪电占据了他，圣人也开始吼叫。克里米克看到一道明亮的闪光从伸向C点的廊道中爆发出来。

“小心，我要离开高点了。前去帮卡塔克换掉对手。”

他滑进位置，然后将他信赖的长枪瞄准下路。他的视野中发现一个不走运的泰坦，他的护甲中仍然不断有闪电爆裂。

“屈枉天命，兄弟。”射击正中目标，那位泰坦倒下。“抱歉我救不到你，卡特克。下次吧。”

2465372924.name: Tigerspite
2465372924.flavor: "What else can we do but take up arms?" —Corsair Amrita Vae
2465372924.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
2465372924.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
2465372924.lore:
Kazia watches as Amrita tears through their little cobbled-together home. She's ripping it apart, trying to put it into a backpack.

"Hurry," she's saying. "It's finally happening."

Kazia watches, but all she sees are the walls they built with their own hands. The tiny garden they coaxed out of the parched earth. The mountains on the horizon, so unlike any in the Reef. The salvage they transformed from left-behind scraps into beloved possessions. She watches, but all she thinks of is the before and the after. She's starting to realize that she stopped longing for the "before" years ago.

It's clear now that Amrita has been dreaming of it every day.

When Kazia speaks, it takes all her courage. "What about our life here?"

Amrita reels. "What life?" she says, thoughtless. "This isn't a life, Kazia. This is waiting. Hiding. This is… purgatory. The Queen's alive. Petra needs us. We have to fight."

Of those who go and those who stay, Amrita goes and Kazia stays. Alone.
2465372924.lore_zh:
卡兹亚看着阿姆丽塔在他们的小鹅卵石建成的家中流泪。她将它拆除，试图想放进背包里一同带走。

“快点”，她说道。“终于还是发生了。”

卡兹亚看着一切，但看到的只是他们用自己双手建造的墙壁。他们在烧焦的土地中想方设法造出的小花园。地平线上的山脉，和暗礁中的任何山脉都不同。他们将这些残骸从被抛弃的废料改造成为心爱的家园。她看着这一切，但想到的只是前后的变化。她开始意识到，自己早已在几年前就停止对“之前”的渴望了。

显然，现在的阿姆丽塔每天都在梦想着这一切。

卡兹亚张口说话，耗尽了她所有的勇气。“我们这里的生活怎么样？”

阿姆丽塔缩成一团。“什么生活？”她说，脑子空空的。“这不是生活，卡兹亚。这是等待、隐藏，这是……炼狱。女王还活着，佩特拉需要我们。我们必须战斗。”

那些走的人和留下来的人中，阿姆丽塔要走，卡兹亚要留，一个人。

3723679465.name: Waking Vigil
3723679465.flavor: "We have a duty to this solar system that goes deeper than blood, deeper than oaths." —Paladin Devi Cassl
3723679465.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
3723679465.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
3723679465.lore:
Pranav sucks his cheeks between his molars as he considers his options.

"Stop that," Devi says, swatting playfully at his hand. "It makes you look stupid."

"Ashamed of your stupid brother?" he teases, vacuuming his cheeks even further into his mouth.

"Never," Devi says fiercely, forgetting the joke. They fall quiet. Eventually, she reaches for her hand cannon and rises to leave. "Anyway, I… I understand why you left. You've done so much good here." She looks out over the valley that Pranav has protected for the centuries since he left the Reef. "I just wanted to say that, in case…"

Pranav is quiet. Then he stands, fetches his rifle. "And I understand why you stayed. I'm coming with you. Assuming Petra welcomes me back."

Relief and delight takes Devi's breath away. She throws her arms around him. "She will! She's just a baby, but she's practical, Pranav, you'll see. And anyway, we… There aren't enough of us now to turn away you Earth-lovers. We need all the help we can get."
3723679465.lore_zh:
普拉纳唑着脸噘着嘴，在考虑他的选择。

“别这样”，戴维说，嬉戏地打了打他的手。“你这样看起来很蠢。”

“为你愚蠢的大哥感到羞耻？”他笑着着，将自己的脸颊进一步向里吸。

“永远不会”，戴维狠狠地说道，全然忘记这只是个笑话。他们安静下来。最后，她伸出手拿起手炮然后起身离开。“无论如何，我……我明白你为什么会离开。你在这里做得很好。”自从他离开暗礁之后，她一直在向外看着这个普拉纳保护着的山谷，已有几个世纪。“我只是想说，万一……”

普拉纳安安静静地站起来，拿起他的步枪。“我也明白你为什么会留下来。我会和你一起去，如果佩特拉欢迎我回来的话。”

解脱和快乐让戴维简直喜不自胜，她搂着他说道：“她会的！她只是个孩子，但她很实际，普拉纳，你会了解的。无论如何，我们……现在我们还无法拒绝像你这样的地球爱好者。我们需要能得到的所有帮助。”

2140635451.name: Sleepless
2140635451.flavor: "I see our path ahead, full of despair and hardship, and I will walk it with joy in my heart." —Sjur Eido
2140635451.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
2140635451.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
2140635451.lore:
Sjur snorts and coughs as she wakes herself up from a sound sleep.

"You were drooling," Mara says. She's perched in a divan nearby. There are books open all around her. She has dog-eared dozens of pages.

"I was dreaming," Sjur says, wiping her mouth off with the back of her hand. "I saw you on a great black triangle. You split it in two with your bare hands."

"Mm."

"And I was dead, I think." She cracks her neck with a deliciously loud pop. "Or… trapped? Like in a maze. But pretty close to figuring my way out."

"Mhm."

Sjur stands up to stretch. She does not mind that Mara is not listening. Let her read. "And there was another woman with you."

"On the triangle," Mara murmurs.

"Mm. Yeah. She was helping. Then your brother showed up, and…" She shakes out her arms, frowning thoughtfully. The dream is already fading. "He said, 'Tropaea.' Or maybe it was, uh, 'Tropical.' Anyway."
2140635451.lore_zh:
当苏尔从美美的一觉中醒来时，哼了一声，又咳了几下。

“你流口水来着”，玛拉说。她坐在附近的沙发里，周围全是书。她折了十几页的书。

“我刚才做梦”，苏尔说，用手背擦了擦嘴。“我梦到你在一个很棒的黑色三角形上，还徒手将它分成两半。”

“嗯。”

“而我好像是死了。”她扭了扭脖子，发出咔咔的声响。“或者……被困住了？就像在迷宫中一样。但非常接近出口。”

“嗯。”

苏尔站起来伸了伸懒腰。她不介意玛拉没在听她说话。就让她继续看书吧。“还有另一个女人和你在一起。”

“在三角形上”，玛拉低声说道。

“嗯。是的，她在帮忙，然后你的弟弟出现了……”她摇了摇胳膊，若有所思地皱着眉头。梦渐渐不清晰了。“他说到，‘热态'。或者也许是，‘热带'，都差不多。”

355922321.name: Vouchsafe
355922321.flavor: "We knew it would not be easy." —Paladin Hallam Fen
355922321.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
355922321.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
355922321.lore:
"You were right," Hallam says. He leans close to the screen, earnest, entreating. "You were right all along. I'm sorry I didn't believe you."

"That doesn't matter now," Petra says. He can make out the spires of the Keep of Voices behind her, but not the nuance of her expression. The connection is bad.

"It does! Listen. No one thought you were right for that job. We thought…" He flattens his mouth. "Well, we thought Mara was favoring you for the wrong reasons. You're young; you were still green. You certainly weren't Sjur. When Mara died, and suddenly you were Regent instead of me or Devi or whoever…"

It's hard to confess such ugly things.

He shakes his head, pushing his computer away at arm's-length. "When everything is going wrong, but you aren't in charge, it's easy to imagine you could do a better job. But I was wrong. I didn't understand that the job was to keep the faith. None of us could have done that except you."
355922321.lore_zh:
“你是对的，”霍拉姆说道，他凑近屏幕，非常认真。“你一直都是对的。我很抱歉我没相信你。”

“现在无所谓了”，佩特拉说。他可以看到她身后语声要塞的尖塔，但看不清她脸上的微表情。连接不太好。

“有所谓！听着，之前没有人认为你是对的。我们以为……”他的嘴巴扁了扁，“好吧，我们觉得玛拉因为一些错误的原因偏袒你。你还年轻；你是个新手。你当然不是苏尔。当玛拉去世的时候，突然间你成了掌权者，不是我也不是戴维或者其他人……”

很难将难堪的事情说出口。

他摇了摇头，把电脑推开。“当一切都出错，但你不是负责人时，很容易会有错觉认为你能做得更好。但我错了。我不明白这份职责是为了保持信念。除了你，没有人能做得到。”

871900124.flavor: "It's what gets left out, what gets reemphasized that you have to pay attention to." —Esila, daughter of Sila

1874424704.name: Twilight Oath
1874424704.flavor: Engraved in illuminated letters on the weapon's chassis: THE AWOKEN MADE ME.
1874424704.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
1874424704.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
1874424704.lore:
Guardian comms are ablaze with gossip.

Yevik crouches over a battered radio that they've juryrigged to bypass Vanguard security overrides. He listens closely while the rest of his scouting party watches and waits. None of them speak the Human tongues, so it falls on him to translate the news.

He's rusty, but he can make out the main beats. Queen Mara Sov is alive. Prince Uldren Sov is dead. The Awoken are calling for aid.

His blood quickens. He was once a Wolf who bowed to Mara Sov in good faith. He kept that faith when so many of his cousins defected to Meridian Bay, and abandoned it only when it seemed she was truly dead.

But now, somehow, the tiny Kell is alive?

"Well?" his Captain asks.

"It's nothing," he demures. "The two-soul prince is dead. The Lightmongers, they are surprised. They wonder what this does to their Houses."

The group rumbles with vicious satisfaction. As they talk, Yevik begins planning his return. He cannot serve the House of Dusk while his Kell still lives.
1874424704.lore_zh:
守护者的通讯中谣传满天飞。

耶维克蹲伏在一个受损严重的电台上，他们绕过了先锋的安全覆盖。当侦察小分队的其他人静静观察等待时，他在仔细倾听。他们没有说人类的语言，所以由他负责翻译。

他技艺生疏，但能说出大致的内容。玛拉·索维女王还活着。欧顿·索维王子已经死了。觉醒者正在求助。

他的血液加速了。他曾经是真诚地向玛拉·索维效忠的狼。当他许多表兄弟叛逃到子午线海湾时，他还保留着这种信仰，似乎只有当她真的死了时才会放弃。

但是现在不知为何，小凯尔还活着？

“然后呢？”他的队长问道。

“没什么，”他温婉一笑。“双灵魂的王子已经死了。光能使者们很惊讶。他们想知道这对他们的氏族有什么影响。”

小队的人发出欢呼。在他们谈话时，耶维克开始筹划他的回归。既然他的凯尔还活着，他就无法为黄昏氏族效忠。

250721843.name: Abide the Return
250721843.flavor: "It is what she asks of us." —Paladin Kamala Rior
250721843.source: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
250721843.source_zh: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。
250721843.lore:
Kamala Rior climbs onto a railing at the top of the Tower in the Last City. "Guardians of the Tower!" she calls out.

A few look her way. One begins dancing at her feet. Others fool around with a purple ball.

Kamala can feel Zavala watching. Tess and Rahool, too, though both pretend otherwise. She goes on, "The Awoken are Humanity's shield. We entered the Reef Wars to prevent a Fallen coup here on Earth. We met Oryx head-on and endured immeasurable sacrifice, all in the name of a shared future."

The dancing Guardian falls still. The purple ball is forgotten.

"We ask you now for your aid. One of our sacred cities is at risk. There are so few of us left; we cannot defend it alone. We do not ask this for free: We will open our armories; we will share our wisdom; we will teach you what we can. Please. Come to the Dreaming City. Fight with us."

"The Vanguard stands with the Reef," Zavala calls, strong and true. Kamala turns to look at him, shocked, and he smiles: apologetic, genuine, honorable.
250721843.lore_zh:
卡马拉·雷奥爬上最后的城市高塔的栏杆。“高塔的守护者们！”她喊道。

少数几个人看向她。一个人她的脚下跳舞，其他人则玩弄着一颗紫色的球。

卡马拉可以感受到萨瓦拉正在看着她。泰斯和拉乎尔也在看着她，但他们都假装没有。她接着说：“觉醒者是人类的护盾。我们进入了暗礁战争是为了防止地球上的傀儡发动政变。我们正面对抗欧里克斯，忍受着无法估量的牺牲，所有这些都是以共同未来的名义。”

跳舞的守护者停了下来。紫球也被遗忘在一边。

“我们现在要请你们伸出援手。我们的一个神圣城市危在旦夕。我们剩下的人手太少；只靠我们自己是无法独自保护它的。我们不会要你们无偿帮助：我们将打开军械库；我们将分享我们的智慧；我们将把自己会的一切教给你们。请来到幽梦之城。与我们一起战斗。”

“先锋与暗礁并肩而战。”萨瓦拉呼喊着，声音坚定而真诚。卡玛拉转身看着他，先是震惊，而他带着微笑：其中有着歉意、真诚以及敬意。

2910326942.name: Wish-Keeper
2910326942.lore:
You will not hear our bones sing in dreams. 

You will not shelter under our wings. 

You will have to remember for yourselves. 

Your sire was Riven of a Thousand Voices, she who contracted with royalty, she who built the Dreaming City and brought it to its knees. 

Your dam was Taranis, he who made the Black Garden his own, he who strangled his life for yours, he whose wish tricked even Riven. 

Remember! 

I will not bargain with my children. Our lives are our gifts to you: glut yourselves on them. Learn who you are. 

The clutch of your sire. The strongest, the wiliest, the sharpest-clawed arbiters of reality. 

The clutch of your fool of a dam. Never Taken by another's will. Never ruled by hunger without choice. 

Sing your own songs.  

Find those whom your wings would stretch out to shelter. 

O whims of my blighted heart, born of our eyes and teeth and will to power, live as yourselves. 

Never less than that.
2910326942.lore_zh:
你们听不到我们的骨骸在梦境里吟唱。 

你们无法在我们的羽翼之下接受庇护。 

你们必须为自己铭记。 

你们的父亲是千语魅痕，她曾与皇室缔约，建造了幽梦之城并几乎将其摧毁。 

你们的母亲是塔拉尼斯，他占据了黑暗花园，为你们牺牲了自己的性命，他的愿望甚至骗过了魅痕。 

铭记吧！ 

我不会和我的孩子们做交易。我们的生命是赠给你们的礼物：尽情享用吧。了解真实的自己。 

你们父亲的蛋啊。她是最强大、最狡诈、利爪最锋锐的现实仲裁者。 

你们愚蠢母亲的蛋啊。他从不受他人意志奴役。绝不被迫屈从于饥饿。 

吟唱属于你们自己的歌。  

找到那些你们愿意张开双翼去庇护的人。 

由我们的眼睛、利齿和权力意志所生，我那凋零之心的孩子啊，活出你们自己的样子。 

至少要做到那样。

3886719505.name: Buried Bloodline
3886719505.flavor: Shallow graves give way to old vendettas and hungry claims.
3886719505.source_zh: 来源：“战争领主的废墟”地牢
3886719505.lore:
Fikrul stands on the bridge of a seized Ketch. Ravagers keep watch over a handful of Eliksni that remain to pilot the vessel. Five heavily armored Scorn kneel before Fikrul, their heads bowed in reverence. Fikrul steps forward. 

"Dark rumors whisper from the Dreaming City. The Reef hunts us. The Darkness claims us. And our father is not returning. But even without Uldren Sov, new Scorn still rise. Old Scorn still live, unseen." Fikrul waits for silence before looking beyond the five armored Scorn knights to the greater horde that gathers.  

He turns and points his staff at the pilots. "These Eliksni, they speak of Scorn risen on Earth, where dead things will hunt them, or Darkness claims them." 

"We serve only Scorn!" Fikrul raises his staff above his head. "We will bring them home. Open their minds, as I have for you. As I will for all Scorn!" 

The horde gnashes and cheers. 

"Rathil, Malaris, Vrysiks, Nymeks, Sirloks. Ascend!" commands Fikrul over the commotion. 

The five armored Scorn stand. 

"You, loyal-sworn, will be my knights." Scorn move from behind them to present the knights with staves made in the image of their leader's. "Go to Earth. Bring brothers and sisters home, before Darkness claims them." 

The knights bow. 

"Rathil." Fikrul places a hand on the center knight. "You, will lead." 

***** 

Rathil enters the quarters of the Ketch's dead captain to see Fikrul gazing at walls of bound tomes filled with Eliksni scrawl. Rathil could not understand the contents of these books, but his father had learned much from them. With time, he would learn to unravel their secrets as well. 

"Father… You called me? We prepare to leave." 

Fikrul turns, a polished steel case in his lower arms. "I have one last gift for you." Fikrul opens the case to display a clean-looking weapon—a sleek bolt-caster. Rathil could see its original Eliksni design, twisted, broken, and refashioned into something stronger, as he was. 

"Claimed from Kings by Wolves… Modified. Scorn, now. Like us." 

"I am honored," Rathil says, gently lifting the weapon from its case and bowing. 

Fikrul looks upon his son with pride. "I send you to claim Kings, as we once did as Wolves. Carry our history with you. Claim it. Bring it home."
3886719505.lore_zh:
费克鲁站在抢来的双桅船舰桥里。掠夺者们监视着几个留下来操纵船只的埃里克斯尼族。五名身披重甲的嗤魅跪在费克鲁面前，恭敬地低着头。费克鲁向前迈了一步。 

“幽梦之城传来了黑暗的流言。暗礁正在追猎我们。暗影想吞噬我们。而我们的父亲也不会回来了。但即使没有欧顿·索维，新的嗤魅依然会崛起。以前的嗤魅仍然在暗中活动。”费克鲁等待着静默。他的目光越过五名披甲的嗤魅骑士，望向逐渐聚集在一起的嗤魅大军。  

他转过身，用法杖指着飞行员说：“这些埃里克斯尼族说，嗤魅曾在地球上崛起，它们或是被已死之物杀死，或是被暗影吞噬。” 

“我们为嗤魅而战！”费克鲁将法杖举过头顶。“我们会把他们带回家。启迪他们的心智，就像我启迪你们那样。我会解放所有嗤魅！” 

嗤魅大军咬牙切齿，欢呼雀跃。 

“拉席尔，马拉瑞斯，弗里斯克斯，尼梅克斯，西尔洛克斯，起立！”费克鲁在一片嘈杂中命令道。 

五位披甲的嗤魅站了起来。 

“忠诚的勇士们，你们将成为我的骑士。”嗤魅从身后走来，向五名骑士送上以其首领的法杖为原型制作的法杖。“去地球吧。在暗影吞噬兄弟姐妹之前，带他们回家。” 

骑士们屈身鞠躬。 

“拉席尔。”费克鲁将一只手放在中间骑士的身上。“你来领队。” 

***** 

拉席尔走进这艘双桅船已故船长的房间，看到费克鲁正凝视着满墙的埃里克斯尼族古籍。拉席尔不明白这些古籍中的内容，但他的父亲从中学到了许多。假以时日，他也将学着揭开这些书的秘密。 

“父亲…您叫我吗？我们正准备动身。” 

费克鲁转过身，手里拿着一个锃亮的铁箱子。“我有最后一件礼物给你。”费克鲁打开箱子，里面装着一把造型简洁的武器——一把线条流畅的弩。拉席尔看出了这是埃里克斯尼族的造物：它在被扭曲、折断后，经过不断改良，变得更加坚固。就像他自己一样。 

“恶狼氏族从王族氏族那里夺来的武器…经过了改装。现在像我们一样，也是嗤魅。” 

“这是我的荣幸，”拉席尔说着，毕恭毕敬地将武器从盒子里拿出。 

费克鲁骄傲地看着自己的儿子。“我派你前去夺取王族，就像我们作为恶狼氏族时那样。带着我们的历史。夺下它。把它带回来。”

17096506.name: Dragon's Breath
17096506.flavor: Burn the world. Burn it all.
17096506.lore:
"You buying?" asks the bored clerk. 

Ariadne isn't listening. She scowls at the display case. "Look at this thing, Enoch. How is it a dragon? It's barely a shark. Crux should have called it Shark's Breath." 

"Shark's Breath doesn't sound dangerous. Unless you're underwater, I guess," Enoch says. At his side, Marcus studies the case. 

"Exactly! While my dragon has been legally recognized as cool." Ariadne points to the gleaming crimson dragon painted along the side of her Sparrow. "No contest." 

"Could be a contest," Marcus says. He looks to the clerk. "Do you do samples?" 

Ariadne's eyes light up. 

Twenty minutes later at the City's outskirts with waivers signed, Enoch hoists the rocket launcher onto his shoulder. Its shark's face grins at Ariadne. 

"You can do it," says Didi. She and Ghost hover above the group, ready to record. 

"Ari, you get five seconds head start so you'd better gun it," Marcus says. "And… Go!" 

Ariadne's Sparrow screeches away as Enoch counts, fires, and lowers the rocket launcher. 

"You really think this is a race Gris can win?" Enoch asks. The rocket arcs towards her, bright in the sky. 

Marcus leans in and claps his shoulder. 

"Not a chan—" 

A ball of flame rises from the landscape as the rocket impacts the Sparrow. 

"Now that's cinema," Didi says, satisfied.
17096506.lore_zh:
“你要买单吗？”无聊的店员问道。 

阿里阿德涅没有在听。她怒视着陈列柜。“以诺，你看这玩意儿。它怎么会是条龙呢？它都算不上是鲨鱼。核心应该叫它‘鲨鱼之息'。” 

“‘鲨鱼之息'听起来不够危险。除非你在水底下，”以诺说道。马库斯在他的身旁研究着柜子。 

“太对了！法律都认可我的龙很酷。”阿里阿德涅指着画在她快雀一侧那条闪闪发光的猩红巨龙。“毫无可比性。” 

“倒是可以比比，”马库斯说道。他看向店员。“你们这产品可以试用吗？” 

阿里阿德涅的眼睛亮了起来。 

二十分钟后，他们签了免责书，来到圣城郊区。以诺把火箭发射器举到肩上。它的鲨鱼脸对着阿里阿德涅咧嘴而笑。 

“你可以的，”迪迪说道。她和机灵在人群上方盘旋，准备记录。 

“阿里，你有五秒钟的起步优势，所以你最好加速前进，”马库斯说道。“准备…出发！” 

阿里阿德涅的快雀尖啸着驶出，以诺读完秒，开火，然后放下了火箭发射器。 

“你真的认为格里斯能赢下这场比赛？”以诺问道。火箭划着弧线飞向她，在天空中显得格外耀眼。 

马库斯靠过去拍了拍他的肩膀。 

“毫无胜——” 

随着火箭命中快雀，一团火焰从地平线上升起。 

“真是一出好戏，”迪迪满意地说道。

1612781792.name: Retrofuturist
1612781792.flavor: They were so optimistic about us.
1612781792.source: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
1612781792.source_zh: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。
1612781792.lore:
I watch them frolic blithely beneath their oblivious god.

I am among those assembled to witness their training. They wish to become stronger than the Cabal. Than Xivu Arath. Than the Hive.

Their ignorance of their true enemy is overwhelming—they cannot even put a name to it. I am choked with rancid ambrosia.

Two men now remain in the artificial battleground. Their movements are simplistic: one charges blindly ahead. The other rolls to the side, fires a shotgun, and his opponent falls.

The victor turns to the crowd and removes his helmet. Oily fluids bead on the flesh of his face. He bears teeth that squirm with microbial life. He throws his arms upward in jubilation and the masses cheer.

I do not join them—this form affords me some dignities.

Behind the creature reveling in minor triumph, sacrilege: A perfect being materializes. It gathers meat and offal from the ground and reassembles it. An unfathomable gift is given.

The crowd has seen this miracle countless times. It has lost all meaning to them. They see it as a resource.

I look up into the blank white face. I feel its Light on my cheeks. It no longer burns me.

Each revival is a choice.

I know what to do.
1612781792.lore_zh:
我望着他们在被遗忘的神面前嬉戏。我和众人一起见证了他们的训练。他们希望变得更强大，要比卡巴尔族更强、比邪魔族更强、比邪魔族的战神更强。

他们竟然对自己真正的敌人一无所知——甚至不知道对方叫什么名字。想到这里不禁让我有些反胃。

现在训练场上只剩下两个人。他们的行动策略异常简单：一个人盲目的向前冲，另一个人侧向就地一滚，发射手中的霰弹枪，对手就倒下了。

那位胜利者转过身来，对着人群摘下头盔。浓稠得像油一般的汗水顺着脸颊滴下来。他的牙齿上似乎还有微生物在蠕动。他欣喜地举起双臂，众人也随机朝着他欢呼。

我并没有跟着欢呼——用沉默维护着自己的些许尊严。

在那个生物获得小小胜利的背后，上演的则是亵渎：一个近乎完美的生物显现出来。从地上拾起残存的肉块和内脏，重新组合。作为一份难以理解的礼物赠与胜利者。

众人已经无数次见证了这种奇迹，对他们来说这一切已经不再神圣，而是一种资源。

我抬头看向那张苍白的脸。我感觉到它的光芒刺在我的脸颊上，但并没有痛感。

每一次复生都是一种选择。

我知道该怎么做。

2026755633.name: Breakneck
2026755633.flavor: "They don't make Dark Age tech like this anymore. Lucky for you I kept all mine." —The Drifter
2026755633.source: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
2026755633.source_zh: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。
2026755633.lore:
"Y'know," said Cenric, a thick-necked Risen with a bulging vein in his forehead, "I've always thought you were a sneak. But after five drinks on your dime, I'm feeling pretty fond of you, Drifter."

Everyone laughed. Drifter smiled, feet kicked up on the bar. The rifle holstered on his back was heavy with promise.

"You're a real smooth talker," he said. "I wonder… You whisper those same sweet nothings to your pal Lord Rience?"

The bar fell quiet. The vein in Cenric's forehead began to twitch. 

"Listen, no one's rockin' the boat here," Jaak spoke up. "We shut Rience out, just like you said."

"Funny. I seen you in that valley, too. And Otto, and Ayrin, and Thalia…" He looked at them each in turn. "Guess my eyes are playing tricks on me."

Cenric pushed his stool back. "You have something to say, say it plain."

"Well, Cen—my eyes might be shot, but this…" He tapped the side of his nose. "Just fine. And I smell a rat." He sniffed. "A whole mess of 'em, actually."

Cenric stood up. That vein of his looked about ready to pop. Drifter let his feet down as he reached for his rifle, asp-quick. "And you know what we do with rats, don't you, brother."
2026755633.lore_zh:
“你知道吗”，那个额头上血管突出的粗脖子复生者森瑞克说，“我一直以为你这人偷偷摸摸的，但和你在小屋里喝了几杯后，我是相当喜欢你啊，浪客。”

大家哄笑。浪客轻踢着护栏，也笑了。肩上的步枪随之沉重。

“你真的很健谈”，他说。“我猜……你和你的朋友领主瑞恩斯也说过同样的甜言蜜语吧？”

酒吧安静了下来。森瑞克前额的血管开始抽动。

“听着，别在这里惹事”，雅克开口。“就像你说的，别提瑞恩斯了吧。”

“真有趣，我看你也在那个山谷里，还有奥托、艾润和塔利亚……”他的目光扫过每一个人。“看来我的眼睛欺骗了我呢。”

瑞森克推了下他的酒吧椅。“有话直说。”

“这样啊，森——我的眼睛可能出问题了，但这个……”他点了点自己的鼻子。“可是好用的很呢。我的鼻子像老鼠一样灵敏。”他嗅了嗅。“他们真是一团糟。”

瑞森克站起来，他的血管看起来快要炸开了。浪客迅速起身备好了枪。“那你也知道我们遇见老鼠会怎么做吧，朋友。”

1955548646.name: Mataiodoxía
1955548646.flavor: The moment when wings and limbs are held on tenterhooks, and the pin enters the thorax.
1955548646.lore:
The Witness has made an old friend of Darkness. It knows intimately the language of warp and weft, how to weave a spider-silk notion or slip a needle of intrusive thought into the fabric of another's mind. In its hands, the Light should be alien and inelegant, the hammer and chisel so unlike its customary tools. 

But though the Witness has never wielded the Light like this before, parts of it recall a time when they made the Gardener's tools their own. But now that power is not freely given; now every stroke of the chisel is accompanied by a distant wail. A minor annoyance, at most. 

The raw material is mediocre, but a true artist can paint on any canvas. The Witness has far more vision than the feckless sphere it has superseded.  

-|A paean to our final work.|- 

It works in broad strokes first. Cuts away the excess. Peels back the integument and lays bare the shivering, raw meat of it. In it, the Witness sees a glimpse of the sculpture trapped inside, waiting to be freed by its hand. One assistant places the pins; another wipes away the effluvia. 

-|A form to teach our enemy fear. A shadow they will dread.|- 

The rough grows restless. It thrashes, threatening to upset the delicate work done so far. The Witness spares it a sharp, quelling look, and it stills. Nothing may distract the auteur from its work. 

Onward. It refines the form, tearing wings of muscle away from bone, carving down, down, until exposed marrow steams in the cold air. Its tempo increases, its motions grow sharper, until it is slashing wildly at its canvas. Its assistants tremble. They do not see that its expression is frozen in absolute serenity. It is as calm and clear-eyed as it has ever been, discarding yards of still-living tripe to reveal… 

-|Perfection.|-
1955548646.lore_zh:
见证者是暗影的老朋友。它熟知经纬语言，了解如何编织蛛丝般的念头，或将侵入性想法的针尖插入另一个人的思维布料。在它的手中，光能理应是陌生而笨拙的，与它惯用的工具大不相同的锤子和凿子。 

虽然见证者从未像现在这样操控过光能，但它的某些部分还是会不禁回想起自己曾把园丁的工具据为己有的时光。但如今，这种力量不再是慷慨给予的；现在，凿子的每一次敲击都伴随着遥远的哀鸣。这顶多算个小烦恼。 

原材料相当平庸，但真正的艺术家可以在任何画布上作画。见证者的愿景要远胜它所取代的那个软弱球体。  

-|对我们最终作品的赞歌。|- 

它先是猛地一挥。切除多余部分。剥开外皮，露出颤抖的生肉。见证者从中瞥见了困在其中的雕塑，等待着被它的手解放出来。一名助手放置了针脚，另一名助手擦去了污物。 

-|让敌人恐惧的形式。让敌人害怕的阴影。|- 

原材料变得焦躁不安。它扭动着，威胁要破坏迄今为止完成的精细工作。见证者投下锐利的抑制目光，它便安静下来。什么都不能让这名导演分心。 

继续前进。它精雕细琢，将肌肉翅膀从骨头上撕下，不断向下雕刻，直到裸露的骨髓在寒冷空气中蒸腾。它的节奏越来越快，动作愈发犀利，直到疯狂劈砍画布。助手们瑟瑟发抖，没有看到它的表情凝固在绝对的平静之中。它一如既往地镇定自若、目光如炬，丢弃一码码还活着的肚皮，露出了… 

-|完美。|-

3598649636.name: Mataiodoxía
3598649636.flavor: The moment when wings and limbs are held on tenterhooks, and the pin enters the thorax.
3598649636.lore:
The Witness has made an old friend of Darkness. It knows intimately the language of warp and weft, how to weave a spider-silk notion or slip a needle of intrusive thought into the fabric of another's mind. In its hands, the Light should be alien and inelegant, the hammer and chisel so unlike its customary tools. 

But though the Witness has never wielded the Light like this before, parts of it recall a time when they made the Gardener's tools their own. But now that power is not freely given; now every stroke of the chisel is accompanied by a distant wail. A minor annoyance, at most. 

The raw material is mediocre, but a true artist can paint on any canvas. The Witness has far more vision than the feckless sphere it has superseded.  

-|A paean to our final work.|- 

It works in broad strokes first. Cuts away the excess. Peels back the integument and lays bare the shivering, raw meat of it. In it, the Witness sees a glimpse of the sculpture trapped inside, waiting to be freed by its hand. One assistant places the pins; another wipes away the effluvia. 

-|A form to teach our enemy fear. A shadow they will dread.|- 

The rough grows restless. It thrashes, threatening to upset the delicate work done so far. The Witness spares it a sharp, quelling look, and it stills. Nothing may distract the auteur from its work. 

Onward. It refines the form, tearing wings of muscle away from bone, carving down, down, until exposed marrow steams in the cold air. Its tempo increases, its motions grow sharper, until it is slashing wildly at its canvas. Its assistants tremble. They do not see that its expression is frozen in absolute serenity. It is as calm and clear-eyed as it has ever been, discarding yards of still-living tripe to reveal… 

-|Perfection.|-
3598649636.lore_zh:
见证者是暗影的老朋友。它熟知经纬语言，了解如何编织蛛丝般的念头，或将侵入性想法的针尖插入另一个人的思维布料。在它的手中，光能理应是陌生而笨拙的，与它惯用的工具大不相同的锤子和凿子。 

虽然见证者从未像现在这样操控过光能，但它的某些部分还是会不禁回想起自己曾把园丁的工具据为己有的时光。但如今，这种力量不再是慷慨给予的；现在，凿子的每一次敲击都伴随着遥远的哀鸣。这顶多算个小烦恼。

50291571.name: Speaker's Sight
50291571.flavor: To its Speakers, the Traveler gives dreams, and little more.
50291571.lore:
—I dream of a star hung low in the sky: brilliant, refractive, astigmatic. In green twilight, it was clear; in golden sunrise, it was aloof. Through day and night, it keeps me company, and from dream to dream, it is there, no matter the sky, no matter indoors or outdoors. In the heart of a deep subterranean compound, the star twinkles in the ventilation ducts. I always know where I am going. 

—I dream of a weary wolf with kind eyes, a mother with pups behind her. She knows I am no threat, but I keep respectful distance anyway. Manners are not a suggestion. She does not speak. 

—I dream of sunset, over and over. 

—I dream of spears. I trace symbology through archives—boar-hunting and defense, creativity and fire, sacrifice and martyrdom. I do not understand the dreams. They stay with me for a long, long time. 

—I dream of peace. I dream of waking with a rising sun, calm at dawn—waking to birdsong, to the sound of wings. I dream there is no fear and there are no walls, and the only trouble that meets me is I must shade my eyes when I walk out into the world. 

—I dream of dreaming. I wake from one dream into another dream. There was a time when people like me dreamed, and it was a story. Now I dream only omens, cast in the fall of bamboo and the patterns of offal. I dream that I had a dream where I knew, without question, what was being said to me, but in the waking, it is nothing but smoke. 

—I dream of patterns in the stream, fallen leaves drawing pictures for the briefest of moments before being washed down the river. Sorrow crushes me, and I do not understand why. 

—I dream I am a voice caught in a throat, a heart trapped behind ribs—the thundering life of something that can only exist in its cage. I am Light cradled in glass and wire; I am a shield dreaming of being a sky, in love with the clouds. I look back at myself, and I am so, so small. I dream— 

—And I wake, and I remember the dreams I have had before, though I do not understand them. But they  array themselves in orderly fashion, in a long queue of patience. 

I have time to cast the bones and learn their meaning.
50291571.lore_zh:
——我梦见一颗星星，低垂在天：明亮灿烂，折射散光。在绿色的暮光中，它是无阻的；在金色的朝阳中，它是疏远的。无论日夜，无论何种天空，无论室内室外，无论哪个梦，它都与我相伴。那颗星星在某个地下深处核心的通风管道中闪烁着。我总是知道自己要去哪儿。 

——我梦见一匹疲惫的狼，眼神和蔼可亲，它是一匹母狼，身后跟着一群幼崽。她知道我不具威胁，但我还是敬而远之。礼貌是必要的。她一言不发。 

——我梦见日落，一次又一次。 

——我梦见长矛。我通过档案追溯象征——野猪狩猎与防御、创造与火焰、牺牲与殉难。我不理解这些梦。它们会在我心中萦绕很久很久。 

——我梦见安宁。我梦见伴着初升的太阳醒来，平静的黎明——听着鸟语和振翅声醒来。我梦见没有恐惧，没有围墙，唯一的麻烦是我走进外面的世界时必须遮住眼睛。 

——我梦见做梦。我从一个梦中醒来，进入另一个梦。曾几何时，像我这样的人会梦到故事。现在，我只梦见预兆，梦见竹子倒下，梦见内脏的纹路。我梦见我做了一个梦，我非常确定梦里有人对我说了什么，但在梦醒时分，一切都化为乌有。 

——我梦见溪流中的图案，落叶在被河水冲走之前，在那短暂的片刻里作画。悲伤压得我喘不过气来，我不明白为什么会这样。 

——我梦见自己是哽在喉中的声音，困在肋骨后的心脏——只能存在于牢笼中的雷电生命。我是被玻璃和铁丝包裹的光能；我是爱上了云朵，梦想成为苍穹的盾牌。我回望自己，我是那么那么的渺小。我梦见—— 

——随后我醒了，我想起了以前做过的梦，虽然我无法理解它们。但它们都井然有序地自行排列着，组成了一条耐心的长龙。 

我会有时间去投出占卜之骨，了解它们的含义。

2273643087.name: Solipsism
2273643087.flavor: We are thinkers, daring to dream about the universe and its infinite expanse.
2273643087.lore:
I see an abyss. Small and distant shapes. I'm walking in your nascent memories. Flickering motes. I sense… curiosity. You've always pondered, from the very beginning. As did we. 

I see tessellation. The pulsating hum of cosmic structure; a kaleidoscopic symphony of Light and Dark. What was the Veil to you?  

Since I woke, I've always felt like I was still dreaming. I'd like to think that's how you feel as well. Those of us that hunger for a great truth—we dream with you. 

—Unknown Warlock
2273643087.lore_zh:
我看到了深渊。渺小而遥远的形状。我走在你初生的记忆里。闪烁的萤光。我感觉到…好奇。你总是在思索，自打一开始起。和我们一样。 

我看到了细分曲面。宇宙结构的脉动嗡鸣；光明与黑暗的万花筒交响曲。面纱对你来说是什么？  

自我醒来后，我总觉得自己还在做梦。我想这也是你的感受。我们当中这些渴求伟大真理的人——我们和你一起做梦。 

——不知名的术士
