4028298892.name: Psychopomp
4028298892.lore:
It's the Psions who go first, miserable weedy things. Can't take the pressure, one of 'em told Olgurn before the end. The whole ship around them weighing them down, crushing the juice out of their brains. 

The rest of them last a little longer, daughters and sons of Torobatl with their heads made of rock already. Olgurn's grandma in the village wanted to die out in the sands. Let the wind scrape away her ossified features. That's how they did it back home. 

Day he joined up with the Skyburners, their recruiter gave him his obol, and he learned something new. 

"That's your death," she said. "Put it in your pocket and never forget it. The other Skyburners will take it when it's your time."  

"Now pick up your gun. That's your duty. Victory for the empire. For the emperor." 

Olgurn had to do the rites for Big Grusk all by himself. Had to cut his mangled armor open with a torch to get to his obol. Now it's just him, crawling through tunnels with alien chitin bolted to his armor and wormspore smeared wherever he can reach. Smelling like an acolyte. 

Last one alive means he's ranking officer. Means the Dreadnaught's his responsibility. 

So Olgurn puts on his stinking armor and he crawls through tunnels and he plants explosives and he makes sure he's at the minimum safe distance before he hits the trigger. He's a Skyburner. He said the oath. He doesn't get to give up. 

And when the relief shows up, Olgurn's gonna give them his report and his obol.
4028298892.lore_zh:
灵能士兵们是最先逝去的，那些可怜的孱弱东西。在终结前，有个灵能士兵向奥尔根坦言，他们无法承受那股压力。整个飞船仿佛一座巨山，压榨着他们的脑浆。 

其他人则坚持得更久一些，那些图罗巴特尔的子女，他们的头颅本就坚如磐石。奥尔根在村里的奶奶渴望在沙漠中死去，让风沙带走她那骨化的面容。那是他们在家乡的传统。 

他加入焚天者的那天，招募者给了他一枚死币，而他则学到了新的知识。 

“那即是你的死，”她说。“把它放进口袋里，永远不要遗忘。当你的那一刻来临时，其他焚天者会来取走它。”  

“现在拿起枪。履行你的职责。为了帝国，为了皇帝，去夺取胜利。” 

奥尔根不得不独自为大格鲁斯克进行仪式，不得不用割炬切开他破碎的护甲，从中取出死币。如今，他孤身一人，在隧道中爬行，外星甲壳紧紧贴合在他的护甲上，蠕虫孢子被涂抹到他能触及的每一处。他闻起来像是个仆从。 

身为最后一个存活者，他已成为最高级别军官。这意味着他要对无畏战舰负责任。 

于是，奥尔根穿上他那散发着恶臭的护甲，爬过隧道，安置炸药，并确保在按下引爆扳机前，自己处于安全距离之外。他是个焚天者，曾立下誓言。他不能放弃。 

当援军抵达时，奥尔根会呈上他的报告，以及他的死币。

“那即是你的死，”她说。“把它放进口袋里，永远不要遗忘。当你的那一刻来临时，其他焚天者会来取走它。”  

“现在拿起枪。履行你的职责。为了帝国，为了皇帝，去夺取胜利。” 

奥尔根不得不独自为大格鲁斯克进行仪式，不得不用割炬切开他破碎的护甲，从中取出死币。如今，他孤身一人，在隧道中爬行，外星甲壳紧紧贴合在他的护甲上，蠕虫孢子被涂抹到他能触及的每一处。他闻起来像是个仆从。 

身为最后一个存活者，他已成为最高级别军官。这意味着他要对无畏战舰负责任。 

于是，奥尔根穿上他那散发着恶臭的护甲，爬过隧道，安置炸药，并确保在按下引爆扳机前，自己处于安全距离之外。他是个焚天者，曾立下誓言。他不能放弃。 

当援军抵达时，奥尔根会呈上他的报告，以及他的死币。

704410186.name: Psychopomp (Adept)
704410186.lore:
It's the Psions who go first, miserable weedy things. Can't take the pressure, one of 'em told Olgurn before the end. The whole ship around them weighing them down, crushing the juice out of their brains. 

The rest of them last a little longer, daughters and sons of Torobatl with their heads made of rock already. Olgurn's grandma in the village wanted to die out in the sands. Let the wind scrape away her ossified features. That's how they did it back home. 

Day he joined up with the Skyburners, their recruiter gave him his obol, and he learned something new. 

"That's your death," she said. "Put it in your pocket and never forget it. The other Skyburners will take it when it's your time."  

"Now pick up your gun. That's your duty. Victory for the empire. For the emperor." 

Olgurn had to do the rites for Big Grusk all by himself. Had to cut his mangled armor open with a torch to get to his obol. Now it's just him, crawling through tunnels with alien chitin bolted to his armor and wormspore smeared wherever he can reach. Smelling like an acolyte. 

Last one alive means he's ranking officer. Means the Dreadnaught's his responsibility. 

So Olgurn puts on his stinking armor and he crawls through tunnels and he plants explosives and he makes sure he's at the minimum safe distance before he hits the trigger. He's a Skyburner. He said the oath. He doesn't get to give up. 

And when the relief shows up, Olgurn's gonna give them his report and his obol.

727781522.lore:
Article: An Unexpected Light—SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST Advance Preview 

By Ken Yanagi, Arts and Culture Writer at the City Herald 

The Ghost Community Players customarily present their works in the Wei Ning Memorial Theater, an unassuming black box in the heart of the Last City. SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST: A TALE OF CROSSED LINES AND FORBIDDEN LIGHT, the newest work from Ghost playwright (now songwriter) Didi, is the latest to make its home in that same theater. An ambitious performance that falls short in some aspects but shines brightly in others, SATG begins its run this week, with tickets available on a very reasonable pay-what-you-can basis. 

SATG depends on some esoterica of the Ghost-Lightbearer relationship which the average audience member may not find familiar, but the savvy observer will find context clues to enlighten them. The show is staged in the round, with a minimalist but expressive aesthetic. Audiences should not expect expansive sets or practical effects, but the costuming suits the actors perfectly, and the acoustics of the space (and the sound technicians' hard work) ensure that not a moment of script and song is missed. The majority-Ghost cast performs in a larger-than-life fashion, a directorial choice doubtless made to compensate for a lack of recognizable Human body language. 

The result is a bombastic piece that has the feel of epic theatre or morality plays, rather than the tight, intimate drama that the script suggests it wants to be. However, the core of emotional truth in its actors and script alike left barely a dry eye in the theater, especially during Savathûn and Immaru's final star-crossed duet. 

SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST runs for the next two months; regular casting substitutions are expected based on field missions. Four stars out of five—if you're at all interested in experimental theatre, Guardians, or Hive, then make time in your schedule, bring tissues, and turn off your heavier thoughts for the night. 

For ticket sales, please contact Pixie, Ghost of Ariadne Gris, via VanNet for inquiries.
727781522.lore_zh:
文章：意外之光——《萨瓦图恩与机灵》前瞻 

圣城使者艺术与文化专栏撰稿人肯·柳著 

机灵社区剧团通常在韦宁纪念剧院上演他们的剧目。这座位于圣城心脏地带的低调黑匣子剧场，迎来了机灵剧作家（现为歌曲作家）迪迪的最新力作《萨瓦图恩与机灵：交错命运与禁忌之光》。这是一场充满野心的表演，尽管在某些方面稍显稚嫩，但是在其他方面却光芒四射。本周起，该剧以极为亲民的随意付费制面向观众开放。 

《萨瓦图恩与机灵》深植于机灵与负光者复杂关系的深厚土壤，对于普通观众而言或许稍显陌生，但那些敏锐的戏剧爱好者定能发掘出启发思考的背景线索。该剧采用圆形舞台设计，简约而不失表现力。观众或许无法期待宏大的布景或炫目的实物特效，但服饰与角色完美契合，而剧场的声学效果（以及音响团队的辛勤付出）更是确保了每一句台词、每一曲旋律都能清晰传入观众的耳中。以机灵为主的演员们通过夸张的表演方式，弥补了缺乏直观人类肢体语言的遗憾，而这显然是导演的精心安排。 

最终，这部作品更像是一部史诗剧或道德剧，而非剧本所暗示的紧凑而亲密的戏剧。然而，演员们和剧本中的真挚情感，几乎让剧场内的每一位观众都为之动容，尤其是萨瓦图恩与伊马鲁最后那命运交错的动人二重唱，更是令人泪眼婆娑。 

《萨瓦图恩与机灵》将在接下来的两个月里持续上演，根据现场演出的实际情况，预计会有常规的演员轮换。四星推荐（满分五星）——如果您对实验性戏剧、守护者或邪魔族感兴趣，不妨在您的日程中预留出时间，带上纸巾，抛开繁重的思绪，享受一个难忘的夜晚。 

如需购票，请通过VanNet联系阿里阿德涅·格瑞斯的机灵皮可茜进行咨询。

1757177186.name: Watchful Eye
1757177186.flavor: A Guardian is first watchful, that they might know right action.
1757177186.lore:
"Sounds like you're asking me to spy on our own people," Drifter replied. "I'm a lot of things, but I ain't a snitch." 

He leaned back and crossed his arms, eyeing Chalco over the remnants of a now-cold dumpling lunch.

547165496.name: Abyssal Edge
547165496.lore:
The Drifter walks the gloaming halls of the Hive vessel, past the pulsing bioenergetics of multiple living systems.

Over comms, he can hear his best (remaining) friend tearing chitinous bodies to shreds with sheer will. The ship, and its inhabitants, are occupied. 

He stumbles along, past pillars that could be ribs, past something that gibbers and gestates but otherwise ignores him. 

Why did he have the gall to be surprised? 

He should have stayed with the Ghostless. Those were his people. Tomorrow is never guaranteed for them, and he rarely got attached. Leave the gods alone. 

He has broken all his rules. 

His mind moves to the infernal machine he carries as the haul of his ship, thoughts sifting through everything he owns: artifacts of the City that might help, Echoes of the Witness that the Cryptarchs have catalogued, favors of the Nine he could dare to call in. But he knows…  

There's nothing he can do. 

He has lost before, but not like this. 

He walks and he walks and finally reaches what might be the prow. He imagines this might have looked out over Saturn at some point, where the king's body had once drifted. It stares out into the abyss now, no stars, full dark. 

There's a hollowness in him, too, that might be pain or anger. He's not certain. 

He holds onto it because she doesn't even have that anymore.
547165496.lore_zh:
浪客在邪魔族飞船昏暗的走廊中穿行，沿途经过了多个涌动着生物能量的活体系统。

通过通讯器，他能听到自己最好的（也是仅剩的）朋友正凭着顽强的意志在撕裂甲壳生物的身体。飞船及其居民都已被敌人占据。 

他跌跌撞撞地前进，路过可能是肋骨的支柱，以及某种喋喋不休、孕育生命却又无视他的存在。 

他为何会感到惊讶呢？ 

他本该留在没有机灵陪伴的人们的身边。那些是他的同类。他们能否活到明天从来都说不准，因此他很少会感到难以割舍。离那些神灵远点。 

他打破了自己所有的原则。 

他的思绪转向了自己携带的地狱机器，那是他飞船上的货物。他思考着自己所拥有的一切：可能有所帮助的圣城神器，解密大师们编完目的见证者回响，以及他可以冒险索还的玖的人情。但他深知…  

他什么都做不了。 

他也曾经丧失过，但不是像这样。 

他不断前行，终于来到了可能是船首的地方。他想象着这里曾经俯瞰过土星，而邪神的尸体曾在那里漂浮着。现在，它向外凝视着无尽的深渊，没有星光，一片漆黑。 

他的内心里还有一种空虚，那或许是痛苦，或是愤怒。他不确定。 

他紧紧抓住这种感觉，因为她连这个都已不再拥有。

他不断前行，终于来到了可能是船首的地方。他想象着这里曾经俯瞰过土星，而邪神的尸体曾在那里漂浮着。现在，它向外凝视着无尽的深渊，没有星光，一片漆黑。 

他的内心里还有一种空虚，那或许是痛苦，或是愤怒。他不确定。 

他紧紧抓住这种感觉，因为她连这个都已不再拥有。

3054597646.name: Abyssal Edge (Adept)
3054597646.lore:
The Drifter walks the gloaming halls of the Hive vessel, past the pulsing bioenergetics of multiple living systems.

Over comms, he can hear his best (remaining) friend tearing chitinous bodies to shreds with sheer will. The ship, and its inhabitants, are occupied. 

He stumbles along, past pillars that could be ribs, past something that gibbers and gestates but otherwise ignores him. 

Why did he have the gall to be surprised? 

He should have stayed with the Ghostless. Those were his people. Tomorrow is never guaranteed for them, and he rarely got attached. Leave the gods alone. 

He has broken all his rules. 

His mind moves to the infernal machine he carries as the haul of his ship, thoughts sifting through everything he owns: artifacts of the City that might help, Echoes of the Witness that the Cryptarchs have catalogued, favors of the Nine he could dare to call in. But he knows…  

There's nothing he can do. 

He has lost before, but not like this. 

He walks and he walks and finally reaches what might be the prow. He imagines this might have looked out over Saturn at some point, where the king's body had once drifted. It stares out into the abyss now, no stars, full dark. 

There's a hollowness in him, too, that might be pain or anger. He's not certain. 

He holds onto it because she doesn't even have that anymore.
3054597646.lore_zh:
浪客在邪魔族飞船昏暗的走廊中穿行，沿途经过了多个涌动着生物能量的活体系统。

通过通讯器，他能听到自己最好的（也是仅剩的）朋友正凭着顽强的意志在撕裂甲壳生物的身体。飞船及其居民都已被敌人占据。 

他跌跌撞撞地前进，路过可能是肋骨的支柱，以及某种喋喋不休、孕育生命却又无视他的存在。 

他为何会感到惊讶呢？ 

他本该留在没有机灵陪伴的人们的身边。那些是他的同类。他们能否活到明天从来都说不准，因此他很少会感到难以割舍。离那些神灵远点。 

他打破了自己所有的原则。 

他的思绪转向了自己携带的地狱机器，那是他飞船上的货物。他思考着自己所拥有的一切：可能有所帮助的圣城神器，解密大师们编完目的见证者回响，以及他可以冒险索还的玖的人情。但他深知…  

他什么都做不了。 

他也曾经丧失过，但不是像这样。 

他不断前行，终于来到了可能是船首的地方。他想象着这里曾经俯瞰过土星，而邪神的尸体曾在那里漂浮着。现在，它向外凝视着无尽的深渊，没有星光，一片漆黑。 

他的内心里还有一种空虚，那或许是痛苦，或是愤怒。他不确定。 

他紧紧抓住这种感觉，因为她连这个都已不再拥有。

690341468.name: Whispering Slab
690341468.flavor: It sings of sorrows that have not yet come to pass.
690341468.lore:
Eris Morn walks with slow, silent steps toward a haggard Drifter shoving small bags into larger ones. Dim and exhausted Motes lie scattered throughout the Derelict, slowly evaporating. She retrieves a Mote from the floor and shines her burning light over the cracked surface. The light struggles to leave the cracks. She lets the disintegrating Mote drop and shatter into dust against the floor grates. It chimes like resonate glass.

The Drifter whirls around to face the noise, almost losing his footing. He lets his hand slide off his holstered Trust as recognition washes over him. "Ain't anybody ever tell you not to skulk? It's rude."

"Noted. Are you vacating?"

"Road trip. How'd you get in here anyway?"

"The airlock was open."

"Uh huh."

"If I said I were here to run in your rat race, would it change your tune?"

"Uh huh…"

Eris drops her shoulders and approaches the Drifter. "I want your help."

"Uh huh." His brow furrows with suspicion. "Why? Didn't you save the universe yet?" Drifter turns back to shoving bags in bags.

"It seems to be continually in peril. To be honest, I'm not sure I've helped."

Eris hands him a bag. "I need your knowledge."

"You? No."

"I have had some troubling experiences as of late."

"Yeah, it's called life."

"I need to know," she says and hesitates, half-hearted restraint preceding sacrilege. "Tell me how to interpret the Darkness."

"What am I, some crusty woo-woo sage? Beat it, kid. I'm packing."

"Do not ignore me," Eris says. Her voice is calm and piercing. "We've both seen beneath the surface."

Drifter drops the pack in his hand and picks a jade coin off his workbench.

"Asher is entrenched in his thinking," she says and gently places a palm down on the workbench beside them. "Ikora… she tries. She hears, but she doesn't understand. No one is listening."

Drifter pockets the coin and turns to face her. He stares deep. "Experience. Hell of a thing." He looks down the gangway of the Derelict and through the gate that would take him to his Haul. "Favors ain't free. I do this, you owe me."

Eris nods. Drifter swipes the workbench clean and pulls out a retractable seat for himself.

"How long you got?"

The two sit. They speak. They listen. Linkages forged in Light and Dark of traded secrets as the Derelict hangs in orbit around the Earth. Pacts are made. Soon, there is only the silence of knowing left between them.

"Next time you fly over the Moon, dust your boots. Tracking that crap all over my floors."

Eris shakes her head and moves toward the airlock.

Drifter yells after her, "AND CALL NEXT TIME! I could've blown those fancy eyes straight out of your face."

"I'll try to be more mindful of your many eccentricities in the future."
690341468.lore_zh:
埃里斯·摩恩迈着缓慢无声的脚步，走向憔悴的浪客，将小袋子塞进大袋子里。 昏暗而疲惫的萤光散落在遗落飞船中，慢慢地蒸发着。她从地板上取回一个荧光，将燃烧的光能照在裂缝表面。光能挣扎着想要离开裂缝。她让正在解体的M荧光掉落下来，在地板的栅栏上碎成灰尘，像是共鸣的玻璃钟声。

浪客突然转身面对着声音，差点没站稳脚跟。他的手从枪套上滑落下来，因为他突然认了出来。“没人告诉过你不要鬼鬼祟祟吗？很没礼貌。”

“知道了，你是在度假？”

“公路旅行。不过你是怎么到这来的？”

“气闸打开了。”

“嗯哼。”

“如果我说我是来这里参加你的亡命夺宝，你会不会改变想法？”

“嗯哼……”

埃里斯放下肩膀，朝浪客走去。“我需要你的帮助。”

“嗯哼。”他的眉头一皱，满脸狐疑。“怎么？你不是还没拯救宇宙吗？”浪客转身把袋子塞进袋子里。

“看起来情况一直都很危险。老实说，我不知道我是不是帮上了忙。”

埃里斯递给他一包东西。“我需要你的知识。”

“你？不干。”

“目前为止，我倒是有些麻烦的经历。”

“是的，这就叫人生。”

“我想知道。”她犹豫了下，犹疑不决克制着先前的渎圣行为。“告诉我，如何解读暗影。”

“什么鬼，难不成你以为我是什么圣人吗？走开吧，小家伙。我正在打包。”

“不要无视我。”埃里斯的声音平静而具有穿透力。“我们都看到过表象之下的东西。”

浪客放下手中的背包，从工作台上拿起一枚玉币。

“阿什的想法是根深蒂固的。”埃里斯轻轻将手掌放在旁边的工作台上。“艾可拉……她也尝试过。她听到了声音，但并不懂。没有人在听。”

浪客把硬币装进口袋，转身面对着她。他深深凝视着。“经历，是个很复杂的东西。”他低头看着遗落飞船的廊道，穿过那扇门，他就可以回到曳室。“忙可不是免费帮的。我帮你的话，你欠我一次人情。”

埃里斯点点头。浪客把工作台扫干净，然后给自己拉过来一把折叠椅。

“你还有多少时间？”

两人坐了下来，开始交谈，开始倾听。随着遗落飞船在环绕地球轨道上漂浮，光能与阴影交换着秘密的同时，建立起了联系。契约开始订下。很快他们之间只剩下相互了然的沉默。

“下次你从月球上飞过的时候，给你的靴子拍拍灰。破玩意儿弄的我地板上全都是。”

埃里斯摇摇头，然后朝气闸走去。

浪客在她身后喊着，“下次记得提前喊一声！我差点把你那双漂亮的眼睛打瞎了。”

“以后我会尽量注意你的诸多怪癖。”

342027677.name: Hollow Words
342027677.lore:
TYPE: SPLICED FEED, AUDIO

CZ: Rasputin has been neutralized. What that means exactly, time will tell.

FWC-L2: A glorious tragedy. May it rise to fight again.

DO-AJ: I trust you have another plan, Commander? Hopefully a more effective plan.

[silence]

IR: The hostility is unnecessary, Jalaal. We are here to devise a plan.

DO-AJ: We had one. It was rejected. The time for that is long past.

IR: Your plan was to leave the Traveler.

NM-EH: We are unprepared because we waste time debating.

FWC-L2: We were prepared by every conflict that befell the City. This war has been written in the stars. Let it come.

DO-AJ: Mobilize the fleet. We have guns enough. Surely, that option would please Lakshmi.

FWC-L2: Yes.

IR: The fire from your guns would have ricocheted off the Almighty's hull. How do you plan to wound the Pyramid?

CZ: This was settled during the Red War. It has not changed. We will need the fleet in reserve should the situation turn dire.

NM-EH: We will not flee the seat of our Golden Age. Enact war-time powers. A Monarch must be chosen.

IR: [inaudible]

NM-EH: How long has that omen been left buried on the Moon? If the Commander had given us access instead of allowing that mystic to—

IR: Cryptarchs have been attempting to parse the Luna site data feed for months. It is digitized madness.

FWC-L2: Are the Warmind's weapons operational?

CZ: No. They… cannot act independently.

NM-EH: So then there is nothing?

CZ: When Rasputin fell, a Hidden agent was dispatched to investigate the Pyramid's nature and divine its intent. They are supported by Guardian operatives. They will work to contain the Darkness while we evacuate nearby assets and evaluate engagement strategies.

[silence]

CZ: In our haste to act, we were caught flat-footed. When we choose to strike again, we must be sure of its efficacy. We may only get one chance. You have all brought wisdom to this meeting. I have considered your council. Executor, I request the New Monarchy support us as they did so graciously when the Red Legion struck. Organize the movement of our people and coordinate with Suraya Hawthorne's contacts to secure them within the walls. Cousin Jalaal, I request Dead Orbit ships ferry the wayward home and provide transit security. In return, you will both be granted full access to the Vanguard's Luna site resources.

NM-EH: A late invitation, but acceptable.

DO-AJ: For the time being, we will protect caravans and aid in relocation.

CZ: Good. Lakshmi, Project Stronghold will require additional printings. Ada-1 has agreed to lend her equipment and expertise to assist in this endeavor. Is this satisfactory?

FWC-L2: Our forges are ready and eager. We request to assist the Bray in evaluating damage to the Warmind.

CZ: Offer the help. Ana will accept it, I'm sure, so long as you defer to her oversight.

FWC-L2: Her standing is tenuous. We believe it amicable to offer partnership, not support.

CZ: You may suggest as much.

IR: Do we have a consensus?

[many voices pledge in agreement]

IR: Adjourned.

[nondescript shuffling and chatter]

[door closing]

[silence]

IR: You offer too much. They want all the sway and none of the responsibility.

CZ: Let them have both. Now is not the time to tangle ourselves in political conflicts.

CZ: It won't be long before they realize Eris is the agent in question. She should be warned.

IR: I'll reach out to her.
342027677.lore_zh:
类型： 拼接信号，音频

CZ：拉斯普廷已经被消除。这究竟会有什么影响，时间会告诉我们。

FWC-L2：一场荣耀的悲剧。愿它能再次崛起，再次战斗。

DO-AJ：我相信你们还有其他的计划，指挥官？希望会是个更有用的计划。

[沉默]

IR：没必要有敌意，杰拉尔。我们是来制定计划的。

DO-AJ：我们之前有过一个计划，被拒绝了。现在早已经过了那个时间了。

IR：你的计划是离开旅行者。

NM-EH：我们之所以没有准备好，是因为时间都浪费在讨论上。

FWC-L2：每一次城市里降临的冲突，我们都是有备而来的。这场战争已经被书写在星空中。让它来吧。

DO-AJ：让舰队机动起来。我们有足够的火炮。当然，那个方案会让拉克希米高兴。

FWC-L2：是的。

IR：你们发射的火炮都打不到万羿巨舰的外壳。你准备怎样伤到金字塔？

CZ：这在猩红战争期间就决定了。还未改变。如果情况变得糟糕，我们要保留住舰队。

NM-EH：我们不会逃离黄金时代的根据地。启用战争时期的力量。必须选择一位君主。

IR：[听不清]

NM-EH：那个预兆在月球上埋没了多久？如果指挥官给了我们权限，而不是让那个神秘的——

IR：解密大师已经尝试了几个月，试图解析月球上的数据流。那是数字化的疯狂。

FWC-L2：战争思维的武器可以正常使用吗？

CZ：不，它们……无法独立运作。

NM-EH：那什么都没了？

CZ：拉斯普廷陨落的时候，一个秘密特工被派遣去调查金字塔的本质和它神秘的意图。他们获得守护者的支持。在我们疏散附近资产和评估进攻策略的同时，他们会努力控制住暗影。

[沉默]

CZ：在我们匆匆忙忙的行动中，我们陷入了困境。当我们选择再次进攻时，我们必须确保它的功效。我们可能只有一次机会。这次会议，你们都带来了智慧。我考虑了你们的建议。执行者，我请求新王派支持我们，就像曾经猩红军团进攻时那样慷慨地支持我们。组织好我们的人的行动，协调苏拉娅·霍桑的人脉，在城墙内保证他们的安全。杰尔拉表亲，我请求死亡轨道飞船摆渡回家，提供运输安全。作为回报，你们都将获得对先锋月球基地资源的使用权。

NM-EH：一次迟到的邀请，不过可以接受。

DO-AJ：暂时我们会保护撤离队伍并协助搬迁。

CZ：很好，拉克希米，据点计划需要更多印刷品。艾达-1已经同意出借她的设备和技能，协助此次行动。满意了吗？

FWC-L2：我们的锻炉已经做好准备，急不可耐了。我们请求布瑞来评估撤离对战争思维的伤害。

CZ：提供帮助。阿娜会接受的，我确信，只要你服从她的监督就行。

FWC-L2：她的地位脆弱。我们认为，提供合作而不是支持，这样会比较友好。

CZ：你们可以尽可能提出建议。

IR：我们可以达成共识吗？ 

[许多人发生表示同意]

IR：休会。

[嘈杂的对话声]

[关门]

[沉默]

IR：你们提供得太多了。他们只想拿好处，不想担责任。

CZ：两个都给他们。现在不是让我们卷入到政治冲突的时候。

CZ：很快他们就会明白，埃里斯是问题中提到的特工。我们应该警告她。

IR：我会联系她的。

1587953057.name: Temptation's Hook
1587953057.flavor: A finger of death from which to hang.
1587953057.lore:
"You ferried a Lightbearer to the outer system," Aunor says and cocks the hammer on her weapon. "They did not return with you."

"I learned the secret. The one your hounds have hidden away in that quaint little vault." Sola smiles red through split lips. "You're on the losing side."

"Do you think you have nothing to lose, or that I wouldn't take it from you? You're sorely, and soon to be regretfully, mistaken."

Sola spits in Aunor's face. "You have limits. You have masters." A twisted Light shimmers in Sola's hand as she moves to attack. "Enjoy hanging to death in your strings!"

Aunor pulls the trigger unflinchingly. Sola drops. "Disgrace of a Warlock."

Sola's Ghost hangs motionless in the air beside her dead charge. A breeze rustles char from the patches of blackened grass around them. Her iris flicks next to the two Praxic watchdogs: the Warlock who pulled the trigger and the Titan partner who shakes a recent death from his bones.

Aunor turns to her colleague. "Should we have her resurrected and ask again?"

The Titan wipes blood from his chest plate as his Ghost patches his armor. A fresh bullet hole sits above his heart. "No, I think she made herself clear the first time."

Sola's Ghost pipes up, "Who says I would?"

"You have nothing to fear, Little Light. Your Guardian is… touched. We are here to help."

"You mean you're here to put us down."

"Not presently. Give us the coordinates of your heading. Then, you will be escorted to the City in peace."

"You know. If you didn't, you wouldn't be here."

"We've tracked the gravitational disturbances, yes. The Warmind had revealed the anomaly was moving through the outer system. But you know that, and you know how to find it."

The Ghost mimics a "spit" noise. "Run back to your quiet Traveler. I won't be ordered around anymore!"

Aunor's body deflates as she holsters her weapon. "Bahaghari…" she says. A Ghost appears at Aunor's side. "Prepare our tools. This one appears touched as well."

Bahaghari nods and slips away to follow the order.

The Striker Titan approaches and snaps his  fingers. A stunning bolt of lightning pelts Sola's Ghost out of the air into unconsciousness. "It's affecting Ghosts now too. We should bring them back to the City. This makes five."

He picks up the Ghost and shoulders Sola's body before shuffling off to their ship.

Aunor turns to follow. "Five, and counting," she whispers to herself without taking her eyes off Sola's Ghost.
1587953057.lore_zh:
“你把一名负光者送到了外星系。”阿诺尔把锤子扣在她的武器上。“他们没有和你一起回来。”

“我知道了那个秘密。你的猎犬藏在那个古怪宝库里的那个秘密。”索拉的笑容透过分开的嘴唇，红了起来。“你输定了。”

“你觉得你没什么可失去的，还是我不会从你手中夺走？你很可悲，而且很快就会后悔了。”

索拉朝阿诺尔的脸吐了一口吐沫。“你有限制。你有大师。”随着索拉动身发起进攻，手中发出一阵扭曲的光能。“尽情享受被吊死的乐趣吧！”

阿诺尔毫不犹豫扣下扳机。索拉坠落了。“术士的耻辱。”

索拉的机灵就这样静静漂浮在空中，在她的死亡冲锋的旁边。一阵微风吹来，周围漆黑的草丛中，发出沙沙的声音，烧成了灰。她的虹膜在两个英勇教团看门狗之间闪动。扣动扳机的术士，还有那名最近刚从死亡复活的泰坦伙伴。

阿诺尔转身看向同伴。“我们要不要把她复活再问问？”

泰坦从胸甲上抹去血迹，机灵绣布着他的护甲。他的心脏上方一个新鲜的弹孔。“不，我想她第一次的时候就已经说的很清楚了。”

索拉的机灵高声说道，“谁说我会？”

“你没什么好怕的，光能小东西。你的守护者……是被触摸过。 我们来是帮忙的。”

“你是说你们来这里是为了放倒我们。”

“现在还不是。把你们要前往地方的目标给我吗。然后，你们会被安全护送回到城市里。”

“你知道的。如果不这样做，你就。”

“我们追踪了重力扰动，是的。战争思维发现异常点穿过外星系正在移动。但你知道这件事，你也知道怎样找到它。”

机灵模仿了一个“吐口水”的声音。“回去找你那安静的旅行者。我不会再被人随意命令使唤了。”

阿诺尔收起武器，身体开始放气。“巴哈迦里……”她说，一个机灵出现在阿诺尔的身旁。“把我们的工具准备好。这个看起来也被触碰了。”

巴哈迦里点点头，随即滑到一旁接受命令。

强袭泰坦靠近打了个响指。一道炫目的闪电将索拉的机灵击飞到空中，陷入昏迷。“现在也会影响机灵了。”我们应该把他们带回城市里。这下就是5个了。”

他捡起机灵，肩上扛起索拉的身体，然后走向他们的飞船。

阿诺尔转身跟在身后。“5个，还在增加。”她低声自言自语，眼镜没有离开过索拉的机灵。

1390080550.name: False Promises
1390080550.flavor: Gripped in the hands of the desperate many.
1390080550.lore:
The Spider eyes the Drifter, boots to bandana.

"Mm. My favorite…" Spider trails off with a drag of ether to select a title befitting the Drifter, "…nothing."

"You think this'll take?" The Drifter says and nods skyward, kicking an empty ether canister off the side of their floating mote of Reef. Red streaks burn in the star-sea sky beyond the vast cloud of asteroids and dust, drawing the shape of a new constellation as the Warmind launches fresh guns.

"An 'almighty' effort. Splendid." Spider steps off a transit craft, alone. "We could have met in… a more protected place."

"You don't like being seen with me?"

"The Spider is a friend to all, but not all my friends are friends," Spider says and focuses his gaze on the Drifter. "You should have come to me."

"You keep too many bodies around. Bodies can stab you in the back."

"Running shows your back," the Spider's voice shudders, "to everyone."

Drifter pauses a moment and looks around at the desolate scape. Small boulders hang in space. They slowly drift towards each other, make contact, and bounce away on random trajectories. Some stick; incorporated via destructive consummation. He scowls and turns back to Spider. "Stretch your legs. No one here for miles."

The Spider unfurls himself, slurping a heavy vacuumous drag from his rebreather. Fully upright, he dwarfs the Drifter in shadow. "Isolation… is not the same as protection, friend."

"Friendship gonna save us from what's coming?" Drifter asks. He places his fingertips together, the space between his hands resembling a triangle.

"The odds aren't in your favor, but…" a guttural laugh ripples from Spider's belly and sends vibration through the loose-packed dirt underfoot, "I'm the wrong one to come to for comfort."

"I get it. You tried running last time. Didn't work. Now you're trying to hide. Let me give you some advice: that don't work either."

"Hiding? the Spider asks and waits. "The board changes. The board clears. I don't play, I just price the pieces."

"Cold-blooded. World's ending and you want a run at it for all it's got."

"'End' is a matter of perspective. Devastation is oftentimes," he says with a breath, "profitable."

"What if nothing's left? Skin and bones?"

"There's always ivory among the bones."

"Bull."

Spider slings a single breathy, "Ha."

"You remind me of my compatriots." Spider wraps his fingers around a small clod of earth drifting by. "They looked at the Whirlwind, just like you. Scared." He closes his hand, crushing the clod into a dense mound. It fractures into several pieces that waft away as Spider releases his grip. "But here we are, living on anyway."

"Yeah. Fallen."

"Fallen. I hold favor among Witches, and Kells, and whispering agents… of every shade and shape. My web is vast, and I have proven useful. Let the kings bloody each other. I'll direct the runoff."

"You talking about Guardians? Hate to break it to you, but they're a cheap date."

"Cheap is malleable. Cheap becomes… cheaper in desperation."

"Yeah." The Drifter pulls a small and ornate box of Awoken design from his rucksack. "Who you lookin' for with this anyway?"

The Spider steps toward Drifter, smothering his personal space. "Options, my dear rogue; tangled in the web." He takes the box with his dominant arms and plops two stuffed sacks of Ghost shells into the Drifter's hands with his others.

"Went through hell to get that little box. Don't come with no throne," Drifter says, holding his voice steady, jaw tense to stay the trembling.

The Spider chitters as a shiver runs through him. "No. Just a looking-glass window. Good business, friend." The hulking Fallen Don turns to leave. "Remember… remain useful."

"When you find 'em, you sure the past won't come knocking?"

"No one minds the Spider."

"Lucky."
1390080550.lore_zh:
蛛王盯着浪客，从靴子看到方巾。

“唔，我最爱的…”蛛王在以太上拖动，选了一个适合浪客的称号。“…无名。”

“你觉得这个可以吗？”浪客说道，然后向着天空点了点头，一脚将一个空的以太罐从他们的漂浮荧光的暗礁一侧踢开。红色条纹在浩瀚的小行星和尘埃之外的星海星空中燃烧着，在战争思维发射新炮一轮炮击时，画出新的星座的形状。

“一次‘伟大的'尝试。漂亮极了。”蛛王从运输船上走下来，独身一人。“我们原本可以在……一个更安全的地方会面。”

“你不想被人看到和我在一起吗？”

“蛛王是所有人的朋友，但我的朋友并非都是朋友。”蛛王说着，他的目光凝视着浪客。“你应该来找我的。”

“你身边围绕了太多人。太多可能对你背后动刀子的人。”

“逃跑的时候，你会露出你的背，”蛛王的声音颤动着，“所有人都会看到。”

浪客停顿片刻，看着周围荒凉的景象。空中悬浮着小石块。它们缓慢向着对方飘去，进行接触，然后以随机的轨迹弹开。有些粘附在一起，通过破坏性消耗的方式融合在一起。他皱了皱眉，转身朝着蛛王。“伸伸你的腿，这里没人要走大老远的路。”

蛛王舒展开身子，从呼吸器里吐出一口沉重的气。完全站直后，他的影子让浪客的身形见绌。“隔绝……与保护不一样，朋友。”

“友谊能够把我们从要面对的事情中救出来？”浪客问道，他将指尖交叉一起，双手之间的空间像一个三角形。

“你的胜算不大，但……”一阵阴森的笑声从蛛王的肚子里荡起了涟漪，从脚下松散的泥土中传递着震动。“要是找我想寻求安慰，那可是找错人了。”

“明白。上一次你想逃跑，但没成功。现在又想想起来。我来给你点建议吧：逃跑同样没用。”

“藏起来？蛛王等待着，棋盘变了，棋盘被清空。我不玩，我只会在棋子上标价”。

“冷血。整个世界都要终结了，你还想不惜一切代价去逃跑。”

“‘终结'，只是一种看法。毁灭是常有的事，”深吸一口气继续说道，“有利可图。”

“如果什么都没有了？只剩下血肉呢？”

“骨头里总有象牙。”

“胡扯。”

蛛王吐出一口气，“哈。”

“你让我想起了我的同胞。”蛛王手指掠过一小块飘过的冰冷土块。“他们看着飓风，和你一样。惊恐不已。”他合上手，将那块土块碾成一小堆。蛛王松开手的时候，碎裂成几块，飘散开来。“我们就这样，想尽办法继续活着。”

“是的，堕落者。”

“堕落者。我在女巫、凯尔，还有……各种形状的低语特工那里很受欢迎。我的网广阔，我也证明了非常有用。让诸王相互厮杀吧。我来指挥。”

“你说的是守护者？很抱歉要打断你，但他们都是廉价的约会对象。”

“廉价容易塑造。廉价……会在绝望的时候更加廉价。”

“是的。”浪客从背包里掏出一个小盒子，里面装的是觉醒者风格的精美小盒子。“不过你用这个到底是要找谁？”

蛛王走向浪客，走近他身边。“选择，我亲爱的浪客，被困在网中。”他用惯常的胳膊接过盒子，用其他手将两只塞满了机灵外壳的袋子塞进浪客的手里。

“历经艰险才拿到这个小盒子。不要无功而返。”浪客尽力稳住声音，下巴紧张地一直颤抖。

蛛王打了个寒颤。“不，只是个玻璃窗。是个好生意，朋友。”巨大的堕落者转身要离开。“别忘了……要一直有用。”

“当你找到他们后，确定不会被过去所影响？”

“没人在意蛛王。”

“你真幸运。”

558794124.name: Cold Denial
558794124.flavor: A familiar tool in the face of failure.
558794124.lore:
The Wizard floats horizontally, inches off the ground, restrained by a mesh cocoon that ripples with Arc energy. The restraints crackle and hiss as the Hive lieutenant struggles. The Warlock glances uneasily at her captive.

"Guardian is insult. Sword Logic is death to weakness. Death to sick. Keep alive weakness makes weakness alive," the Wizard says and then rattles off a thick stream of guttural sounds that the Guardian's Ghost can't translate. The Warlock assumes they're curses.

"You're lucky we disagree. We value more than just brute strength. We value all the things that make strength worth having. Like ingenuity. Or kindness. Or friendship," the Guardian says. She scans the horizon uneasily. It's been over thirty minutes since her fireteam last checked in. "I wouldn't expect you to understand."

The Wizard clacks his teeth in disdain. "Kill makes all nothing. Dead kindness nothing. Dead friend nothing. Kill is highest."

"Well then, I should probably shoot you right now," the Guardian snaps at her prisoner. Her fireteam's prolonged absence is making her edgy. "Is that what you want?"

"Yes. You kill now. Is Logic." The Wizard shows no fear.

The Guardian shakes her head. "You lot are the worst."

Where the hell are they?
558794124.lore_zh:
巫师横向漂浮着，距离地面只有几英寸，被一个充盈着电弧能量的网状能量茧束缚着。随着这个邪魔族副官的挣扎，它的牢笼发出噼里啪啦的响声。术士不安地看了一眼她的俘虏。

“守护者太无礼了。”邪剑守则对于弱者来说就是死亡。对于病痛者来说也是死亡。让弱者活着，就能让弱者活下去。”巫师说道，然后发出一阵守护者的机灵无法翻译的厚重喉音。术士觉得那应该是在咒骂。

“你应该庆幸我们不同意这个观点。我们看重的不仅仅是蛮力。我们看重一切使拥有力量更有价值的东西。比如智慧。比如仁义。比如友谊。”守护者说道。她不安地扫视着远方地平线。她的火力战队已经超过三十分钟没有回报了。“反正你应该也理解不了。”

巫师蔑视地摩擦着牙齿。“杀戮使一切毫无意义。死亡使仁义毫无意义。死亡使友谊毫无意义。杀戮即最高。”

“那我也许该现在就射杀了你。”守护者冲她的俘虏发起了火。她的火力战队的长期失去联络让她有点焦躁。“这就是你想要的？”

“是的。你现在杀了我。这就是邪剑守则。”巫师毫不畏惧。

守护者摇了摇头。“你们这些家伙真是太差劲了。”

他们到底跑哪去了？

2876244791.name: The Palindrome
2876244791.lore:
Yirix waited. She watched her prey cut slaughter through the EDZ. She watched every weapon and muscle break against their Light. She watched her prey's little Ghost snicker with glee at the death of dozens. Bleak humor to the undying.

They had exercised the same nonchalance as the Almighty bore down to exterminate their parasitic City: Guardians huddled in droves, their eyes trained skyward to watch the destruction of Amtec's vengeance, as if it were some celebratory spectacle.

Yirix and her conclave would not let that revenge be swept aside so easily. They remembered Amtec's words. They remembered the brief hope the Sundial had shown them, and they remembered the name trailed in curses and woe. Although she and her sisters could not hope to destroy a city, they could kill the man who commanded it.

She refocused her eye on the Guardian as it loaded a new cylinder into a crude metal cannon. Her trigger finger twitched in contempt as she looked upon the bodies of the Cabal she had used to lure this Guardian into the open. Yirix had once thought of Human strategies like hidden blades: cowardly and unwilling to engage in anything but guerilla warfare and decapitations of leadership. Watching the Legion disintegrate after Ghaul's death had revealed truer interpretations. Victory cares not for honor, and headless foes cannot resist.

Yirix fired and the Guardian dropped.

"Well placed." The words rippled through her mind as another Psion stepped from concealment behind Yirix. The Psion handed Yirix a new firearm—different from her longbore headhunter. It was lined in silver-colored magnetic rails that hissed with Arc charge. "The carrion Light will reveal itself in time."

"We will wait," Yirix rippled back.

In time, a small Ghost compiled into existence. Yirix waited as the Ghost circled its Guardian. She waited for the Light to build within it. She waited until her target was sure that its actions could lead to nothing but resurrection, and then she fired. The stunned Ghost fell.

Joy filled her mind. "It is effective," she thought.

"Ghaul was no fool," her subordinate rippled in response.

Yirix snorted at the name. "This is not his credit. Ghaul did not invent this technology, but we will learn from his failure."

"Dispose of them. Use its primitive gun. We cannot leave any trace that may lead them back to us."

"It is done," her subordinate thought, acting on Yirix's orders. "We are Amtec's vengeance."

Yirix finished her sister's sentiment. "…and while she struck from the sun, we strike from the shadow."
2876244791.lore_zh:
伊利克斯等待着。她看着自己的猎物在欧洲无人区屠戮。她看着每一件武器，肌肉，在与他们的光能对抗中断裂。她看着自己猎物的小机灵，在数十人的死亡中欢欣窃笑。阴冷的幽默，一直永恒。

在万羿巨舰俯身灭掉他们的寄生城时，他们也是一样漠不关心:守护者们成群结队挤在一起，眼睛朝天地看着阿姆特克复仇的毁灭，仿佛是某种庆祝场面。

伊利克斯和她的秘密会议，不会让这个仇如此轻易抛开。他们记得阿姆特克的话。他们记得日晷给他们带来短暂希望，他们想起那个拖着诅咒和悲哀的名字。虽然她和她的姐妹们不能指望摧毁一座城市，但她们可以杀死指挥这座城市的人。

她把目光重新聚焦在守护者上，看着他把一个新的圆筒装进了一门粗糙的金属炮。当她看着那些被她用来引诱这个守护者的卡巴尔的尸体时，她放在扳机上的手指轻蔑地抖动了一下。伊利克斯曾经认为人族的战略就像隐藏的刀锋：懦弱，除了游击战和斩首领导之外，什么都不愿意参与。看着军团在盖欧死后瓦解，已经暴露了了更真实的解释。胜利无关荣誉，被斩首的敌人无法抵抗。

伊利克斯开枪，守护者倒下。

“很好。”这句话在她的脑海中荡漾着，另一个灵能从伊利克斯身后的隐蔽处走出来。灵能交给伊利克斯一把新枪——与她长枪猎头者不同。枪的内衬是银色磁轨，电弧充能发出嘶嘶的声音。“随着时间流逝，腐臭光能会暴露出自己。”

“我们会等着。”伊利克斯淡定回道。

随着时间推移，一个小机灵逐渐存在出现。在机灵围绕着守护者的时候，伊利克斯等待着。她等着内部光能的建立。她一直等到，目标确定它的行动只能导致复活，然后她就开枪了。被击晕的机灵摔倒了。

欢愉充斥了她的脑海。“很有效。”她想到。

“盖欧不是傻瓜。”她的下属冷静回应道。

伊利克斯对这名字嗤之以鼻。“这不是他的功劳。盖欧没有发明这个技术，但我们会从他的失败中学到东西。”

“把它们处理掉。用它们原始的枪。我们不能留下任何可能导致查到我们身上的痕迹。”

“搞定了。”她的下属想着，按照伊利克斯的命令行事。“我们就是阿姆特克的复仇。”

伊利克斯结束了她姐妹的感慨。“……她在阳光下发起攻击，我们从阴影中攻其不备。”

2666273249.name: Hullabaloo
2666273249.lore:
Nonpareil's Ghost marks off the last of their bounties as complete, radiating satisfaction. 

Nonpareil groans. "Back home already? The energy in the Tower is so off lately." 

Behind her, Taranov shakes off her robe to release a shower of spinmetal fragments, gained on an unintended roll through the Mothyards. "Yeah, but there aren't any working showers here. Let's get going." 

"Already?" Thoughtfully, Nonpareil summons a ball of Void Light and tosses it up and down. "Hey. Taranov, think fast!" 

The other Guardian turns around just in time to catch the Light with her face. 

Taranov splutters as she's resurrected. "I will kill you." 

Nonpareil beckons to her. "Yeah? Give me your best shot." 

Taranov lifts her grenade launcher and shoots directly at Nonpareil. 

She's still bent over laughing when Nonpareil's Ghost brings her back up. 

They each go down three more times before they work out the rules for their new game: grenade launchers for the serve, Light weapons for the return. 

Nonpareil smacks the grenade firmly this time with her Sentinel Shield; Taranov watches as it sails overhead and hits an old shack in the distance. After a moment, the noise of the explosion reaches their ears. 

They keep their Ghosts busy with resurrections the whole afternoon. 

As daylight fades, so does their energy. Taranov releases her Dawnblade with a groan. "You ready to take on the Tower now?" 

Nonpareil slings an arm over her shoulder. "We're going to fix the Tower. Good times for everyone! Listen: we get in on the ground floor of a whole new sports league. Bookings. Betting. Licensed gear. The works." 

Sunset over Old Russia is a beautiful sight. Small fires burn in the scrub. The view warms Nonpareil's heart. 

A week later, they have 300 signups for their new grenadeketball league, and roughly as many citations from the Praxics for alleged manipulation of betting rings.
2666273249.lore_zh:
诺帕莱尔的机灵正心满意足地把最后一个悬赏标记为完成。 

诺帕莱尔咕囔了一下。“已经要回家了？最近高塔里的气氛总有点不对。” 

在她身后，塔拉诺夫从长袍上抖落了许多掐丝金属碎片。那是她在飞蛾庭院里被迫打滚时粘上的。“是啊，但这里没有能用的淋浴。我们走吧。” 

“这么快？”诺帕莱尔若有所思，召唤出一个虚空光能球抛了起来。“嘿，塔拉诺夫，机灵点！” 

另一位守护者刚转过身，就撞上了迎面而来的光能球。 

“我要杀了你，”塔拉诺夫在复活后愤怒地说。 

诺帕莱尔向她招了招手。“是吗？放马过来。” 

塔拉诺夫举起她的榴弹发射器，直接向诺帕莱尔来了一发。 

诺帕莱尔的机灵复活她时，塔拉诺夫还笑得直不起腰。 

她们又互相将对方击杀了三次，敲定了新游戏的规则：发球者用榴弹发射器，回击者用光能武器。 

诺帕莱尔这次用哨兵圣盾狠狠地打飞了榴弹。塔拉诺夫看着榴弹击中了远处的破旧棚屋。过了一会儿，爆炸声传到了她们的耳朵里。 

她们的机灵一下午都在忙着复活她们。 

随着太阳落山，她们的精力也耗尽了。塔拉诺夫咕囔着放下了破晓。“你现在准备好挑战高塔了吗？” 

诺帕莱尔把一只手臂搭在她的肩膀上。“我们要修好高塔。大家都有好日子过！听着：我们可以主办一个全新的运动联赛。吃牌，投注，特许装备。搞全套的。” 

旧俄罗斯的日落很美。灌木丛中燃烧着小火苗。这样的景色温暖了诺帕莱尔的心。 

一周后，她们的全新榴弹联赛有三百个人报名参加，而因涉嫌操纵投注圈而被英勇教团传唤的人数也大致相同。

331231237.name: Finality's Auger
331231237.flavor: Write the future into the present.
331231237.typeName_zh: 异域 线性融合步枪
331231237.lore:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED 
DECRYPTION KEY: 6DU3H2BSKP1V$CHA-319 
REP#: 177-PYR-WPN 
AGENT(S): TRU-135   

SUBJ: THIS BENIGHTED THING   

1. Chalco when word started going around you know what I thought? I thought oh good maybe Truce gets out of this swamp. Maybe Truce gets to use some of that time off he's had banked for a century. 

Know what I think now? Doesn't matter because Cowlick won't let me write it down in an official report. 

2. Okay. This thing gives me the creeps. Gave it all the standard tests. Some extra. I licked it, that's how I know it's bone. Sticks to the tongue. Stone doesn't. Cut out my tongue after just to make sure so don't worry, no contamination and Cowlick made me a new one no problem. 

There's a lot of raw data I want you to read over and maybe send up the ivory tower. It's not that I don't trust my gut it's that I don't want to.  

So, we're paracausal, right? Effect and cause all shaken up, no connection. Everything else is connected forward and back through time. Tug on the butterfly here and make a cyclone there. 

As far as I can tell this thing made itself. Spontaneous acausal generation. My best guess is that there's so much will hanging around that it crystallized. Pure I-am-and-I-gotta. Embodied stubbornness.  

3. All my informants are useless so I have to be blunt: tell me how it went? Drinks, usual place—I'll pay this time. Promise. 

MESSAGE ENDS. OPEN ATTACHMENT?
331231237.lore_zh:
访问权限：受限 
解码密钥：6DU3H2BSKP1V$CHA-319 
报告案号：177-PYR-WPN 
特工：TRU-135   

主题：蒙昧之物   

1. 卡尔科，消息刚传出来时，你知道我怎么想吗？我琢磨着，或许楚斯能离开这个泥沼了，说不定还能把他积攒了好久的假期用掉。 

我现在的想法？那不重要，因为翘毛不会允许我在正式报告中把它写出来。 

2. 好吧。这东西让我心里发毛。我给它做了所有标准的测试，还额外加了些项目。我舔了它一下，所以能确定它是骨头——它粘舌头，而石头不会这样。保险起见，我之后割掉了舌头，所以别担心会有污染风险，翘毛帮我做了个新的，现在一切正常。 

我这儿有一大堆原始数据想让你看看，或许还可以传给那些象牙塔里的大人物。我不是不相信直觉，只是不愿意。  

我们都是超因果的，对吧？因果关系乱了套，没关联。其他事物则通过时间紧密相连，这儿扯一下蝴蝶的翅膀，那边就能引发一场旋风。 

依我看，这东西是自已产生的。一种自发的、无关因果的生成。我猜测，是因为周围的意志太多，以至于凝结成了晶体。纯粹的“天性使然”，具象化的固执。  

3. 我的线人全都没用，所以我只能直言不讳：结果怎么样？老地方喝酒去——这次我请，说到做到。 

消息结束。是否打开附件？

1481594633.name: Barrow-Dyad
1481594633.flavor: Lay those unquiet thoughts to rest.
1481594633.lore:
I, Xir-Kuur of the brood of Xivu Arath, challenged Oryx. He had communed with the Deep and fashioned the bones of the great worm into his Dreadnaught. So for the sake of the sword, I challenged him, full of the weight of purpose and the hunger for war that drives us all. 

| Take up the knife. | 

Against my sword, there was swallowing emptiness, a void that should have held stars. I thought myself blind. I thought myself dead, bone-mortar to shape the foundation of eternity. 

| Take up the knife. | 

Oryx Took me then, but I did not crave what he offered. 

| Take up the knife. It is shaped like [unparalleled victory.] | 

If it is not done by my own power, it is not earned. Thus has the sword logic ever been taught to us, and thus I have lived.  

| Take up the knife. | 

And so here I have stayed in this Dreadnaught: living and not-living, Taken and not-Taken. It might have been yesterday. It might have been an eon ago. 

| Take. Live. Kill. Live. I am here. I am power, and I am victory. I am the knife itself. Come, take what you need. Your objective. A new weapon. | 

Others come. And to the Taken, I say: take me if you can. I am Hive. I do not surrender. I do not— 

| We are the knife. |
1481594633.lore_zh:
我，来自希乌阿拉斯虫群的基尔·库尔，向欧里克斯发起挑战。他与深渊沟通，并用巨蠕虫的骨骼铸就了他的无畏战舰。为了那把剑，我向他发起挑战，心中满载着沉甸甸的意图，以及驱动我们所有人的战斗渴望。 

| 拿起利刃。| 

我剑锋所指之处，是吞噬一切的虚空，本应星光璀璨，此刻却空无一物。我以为自己失明，以为自己死了，化作构筑永恒基石的尘埃。 

| 拿起利刃。| 

欧里克斯接纳了我，但我并不渴望他给予的一切。 

| 拿起利刃。它形如[无可匹敌的胜利。] | 

若非凭自身之力取得，就算不得名正言顺。邪剑守则一直如此教导我们，我也毕生遵循它。  

| 拿起利刃。| 

于是，我留在这无畏战舰之中：既是活的，又是死的；既是傀儡，又非傀儡。那或许只是昨日，又或许已过去了一个纪元。 

| 夺取、生存、杀戮、生存。我在这里。我是力量，我是胜利。我即是利刃。来吧，取走你所需。你的目标，一件全新的武器。| 

别的身影出现。面对傀儡军团，我说：尽管来夺取我。我是邪魔族，我不会投降。我不—— 

| 我们是利刃。|

3725585710.name: Lodestar
3725585710.lore:
Shimizu, Hassan. Private papers under elliptic-curve cryptographic lock. 

Discourse on the political realities of the City is suppressed. My last seven papers have been rejected by every major journal on Earth, surely the work of private censors. 

Should I try to continue my work on CDM or enter the field of more direct paracausal studies, I'm sure to remain unpublished. Hari-5's unproven speculation that only OWL Sector is allowed to study Darkness among mortal researchers seems increasingly likely to be correct. 

Within my lifetime, I have seen cultural shifts among Lightbearers in the Last City. In my youth, the element of Void was seen as closest to the Dark. In my adulthood, Darkness—Stasis, Strand, speculative elements as yet undiscovered—has shifted from taboo to standard toolset. The final stigma among the Tower's Guardians is against rogue Lightbearers who attack Ghosts, the source of their paracausal abilities, directly. 

However, the shift in perception of Darkness among Lightbearers has not been equaled by a shift in their perception of mortal researchers. 

Arc is a power humanity has harnessed for centuries. Among the Guardians, it stands with Solar Light as an element seen historically as almost entirely positive—salutary, in fact. (See Karn, "Sociobiology of the Immortal," chapters five and six.) 

Arc is kindly, and friendly, and unimpeachable. So must I be until more change comes and the censors move on to other fears. 

There can be no complaint about my turning to work on matters that Guardians see as nothing but good for them. 

Certainly not if I give them the results of that research.
3725585710.lore_zh:
清水，哈桑。私人文件已被椭圆曲线加密锁定。 

关于圣城政治现状的讨论被压制。我最近撰写的七篇论文被地球上所有主流期刊拒发，这无疑是私人审查从中作梗。 

无论我是否尝试继续从事CDM的研究，又或是涉足更直接的超因果领域，我的成果必将无法发表。哈里-5那个未经证实的猜想，即凡人研究者中只有猫头鹰区域的才可以研究暗影，似乎越来越有可能是正确的。 

我的一生中，亲眼见证了圣城中负光者文化的转变。小时候，虚空元素被视作最接近暗影的存在。而我成年之后，暗影——包括冰影、缚丝以及尚未被发现的推测元素——已从禁忌转变为日常工具。高塔守护者眼中最后的道德底线，只是反对那些直接攻击机灵——他们超因果能力之源——的低劣负光者。 

然而，负光者眼中对暗影看法的转变，并未与他们对凡人研究者态度的转变相匹配。 

人类驾驭电弧的力量已经有几个世纪了。在守护者眼中，它与烈日光能一样，一直都被视为几乎完全积极，甚至是有益的元素。（参见卡恩所著《不朽者的社会生物学》的第五章和第六章。） 

电弧友善，亲切，无可挑剔。我也必须这样，直到出现更多的变化，审查者的注意力转向其他的恐惧。 

我转向研究守护者认为对他们只有益处的事物，绝对不会有人提出异议。 

如果我将研究成果呈给他们，就更不会有谁反对了。

2581676735.name: New Land Beyond
2581676735.flavor: Every hit blazes the path to our reclamation.
2581676735.source: Source: Earned as a pre-order bonus.
2581676735.lore:
Sun rising over the water, she's got to move. Three Fallen down. That means find a new sniper nest before her enemy comes looking. 

They're on the prowl, the ragged ends of Devils only barely integrated into Dusk. There's an old factory with outflow pipes leading to a drying riverbed; she doesn't know what it used to make, but it's closer to a Human settlement than she likes. A potential enemy stronghold. 

The Fallen can't have it. But they're trying, and they're backed up by the canniest Vandal with a wire rifle she's ever faced. 

Rifle goes on her back, under the cloak, and she climbs down out of the tree that once served her so well. She wades through the water, tacking towards the other shore. 

A shot whines overhead, the snap and fade of an Arc bolt. A second shot tears a line through her shoulder. She throws herself forward, tucked low against the riverbed, and crawls forward. The ridge keeps her out of likely enemy sightlines. 

There's a boulder that's got a good look to it. She slithers behind it into concealing shadow. Front's all mud and blood now, but she'll deal with that later. 

Her enemy's got a cloaking device. Doesn't always use it. The power draw's a giveaway if you have the right equipment, which she doesn't. She keeps her eyes open for any rustling, any faint blurring of background. 

It's the sun's glint that gives him away in the end, winking against the scope on his wire rifle. 

From deep in shadow, she takes the shot. 

It's her planet. 

They can't have it.
2581676735.lore_zh:
太阳从水面缓缓升起，她必须采取行动了。三名堕落者已经倒下，这意味着她得在敌人来搜索之前，找个新的狙击位置。 

敌人在巡逻，那些破败的恶魔氏族残余勉强融入了黄昏氏族。附近有个老旧的工厂，排水管通向一条干涸的河床；她不清楚这里以前生产什么，但它距离一个人类聚居地太近，是一个潜在的敌人据点。 

堕落者绝不能占据这里，但他们在努力尝试，而且还有她遇到过的最狡猾的暴徒在用导线步枪提供支援。 

她将步枪背在身后，藏在披风下，从一棵曾为她提供良好掩护的大树上爬下。接着，她涉水过河，朝着对岸前进。 

一声枪响突然在头顶呼啸而过，伴随着电光的爆裂声，而第二枪擦过了她的肩膀。她向前扑倒，紧贴河床，开始匍匐前进。水中耸起的脊帮她遮挡住了敌人的视线。 

她发现了一块不错的巨石可作为掩护，于是滑到它后面，藏身在阴影中。她身前都是泥泞和血迹，但她可以稍后再处理。 

她的敌人配备了隐形装置，但并不总是启用。如果有合适的设备，就可以通过监测功率消耗来搜索，但她手上没有。她留意着任何细微的悉窣声响，背景中任何微弱的模糊虚影。 

最终，是他的导线步枪瞄准镜上反射的一缕阳光暴露了他的行踪。 

她从阴影深处果断地开了枪。 

这是她的星球。 

他们绝不能占据它。

2059741649.name: New Pacific Epitaph
2059741649.flavor: "This isn't happening. This isn't happening. This isn't happening."
2059741649.lore:
Beyond the dappled sea spray on the bedroom window, escape craft and their blue contrails sweep past the Arcology as beams of orange light punctuate the sky. They cut through contrails with certainty, and before long, each craft erupts in blossoms of fire and brilliant warmth.  

No one is leaving Titan. 

Nadia Jahandar is not leaving. She has a cup of tea cooling on the windowsill, a collection of her late brother's poetry on her tablet, and the recording of her last piano recital playing on her headphones. The roar of the apocalypse accompanies her. She looks away from the window. 

I stepped into the stars 
Because the seas were explored 
No dragons on our maps 
Islanded in a sea of night 
Though it could never be home 
No hearths in the gulf 

Nadia reaches for her tea, glancing out the window to watch the sea rise up in a kilometers-high wall. It casts a shadow so long, it throws the Arcology into darkness.  

She will tell her brother that this poem is her favorite.
2059741649.lore_zh:
在卧室窗户上斑驳的浪沫外，逃生艇以及它们蓝色的尾迹扫过生态园区，橙色的光束点缀着天空。它们无一例外地穿过尾迹，不久后，每艘飞艇都迸发出花束般的火焰和绚烂的暖意。  

没人能离开土卫六。 

娜迪娅·贾汉达没打算离开。她把一杯茶放在窗台上冷却，平板电脑上是她已故兄弟的诗集，耳机里播放着她最后一次钢琴独奏会的录音。大灾难的轰鸣声伴随着她。她把目光从窗边移开。 

我踏入群星 
因为海洋已被探寻 
我们的地图上没有巨龙 
孤立在夜色的海洋中 
虽然它永远无法成为家园 
海湾里没有壁炉 

娜迪娅伸手去拿茶，瞥了眼窗外，看到海水涨成好几千米高的墙。它投下了长长的阴影，让生态园区笼罩进黑暗之中。  

她会告诉她兄弟，这首诗是她最喜欢的。

291447487.name: Cold Comfort
291447487.lore:
The submersible hits the water at an odd angle, throwing the passengers against the bulkhead. No one was buckled in before it dropped. Confusion erupts from the team of scientists as they begin their descent: the currents shouldn't be as strong as they are. Titan's atmosphere doesn't allow for that.  

But they are swept away. 

The pilot struggles to orient the craft, and for a moment, they are vertical, able to see blooms of fire expanding above the surface of the ocean. The submersible pitches in another direction, sinking rapidly.  

They have nowhere to go but down. Hide under the ice shelf, wait the chaos out. Hope for rescue. 

One of the scientists leans out of her seat, pressing her face up against the port window. A shape moves in the dark, too massive to be another craft, too sinuous to be mechanical. The scientist reaches back, blindly grasping for the hand of the person seated next to her. 

The shape in the sea doubles back, following the speed and telemetry of the current-swept submersible. Everyone sees it now, blocking out what little light is left as they sink past the ice shelf. It dives with them. Not after, but with. 

She will not let them die alone.
291447487.lore_zh:
潜水器以某种奇怪的角度撞击水面，将乘客抛向舱壁。没人来得及在它落下前扣上安全带。当他们开始下降时，科学家团队突然感到困惑不解：洋流不可能像现在这么强。土卫六的大气提供不了这种条件。  

但他们被冲走了。 

领航员努力调整潜水器的航向，有一瞬间，他们是垂直的，能够看到花束般的火焰在海面上蔓延。潜水器转向另一个方向，迅速下沉。  

他们无处可去，只能往下。躲在冰架底，等待混乱过去。希望能够获救。 

其中一位科学家从座位上探出身子，把她的脸贴在左舷窗上。有个形状在黑暗中移动着，庞大异常，应该不是潜水器，又很蜿蜒，应该不是机械制品。科学家的手向后伸，盲目地抓住坐在她身旁的人的手。 

海水中的形状随着洋流裹卷潜水器的速度和遥测信号折回。现在每个人都能看到它，当他们沉到冰架下时，它挡住了仅存的一点光线。它和他们一起下潜。不是跟着他们，而是拽着他们。 

她不会让他们孤独地死去。

4228149269.name: No Survivors
4228149269.lore:
Klaxons blare across the hangar. Seven terrified people huddle by the escape craft's open hatch, bracing against the wind cutting through the open hangar bay doors. 

"You're not leaving me behind!" an engineer shouts. He holds a young man hostage, arm like a vice around his neck. Pistol wavering. 

The last security officer looks down at his counterpart, long dead and bleeding out on the floor. He isn't sure how many rounds are left in his gun. His hands are shaking from the cold. From the reverberations of explosions shuddering through the superstructure. 

"Let me on! Make room for me! Move!" the engineer demands, motioning to the side with his gun. The security officer takes the opportunity and fires. He's not steady, hits the engineer and his hostage. Both crumple to the ground. The crowd behind him is screaming. 

The security officer curses, hurrying over to save the hostage. He hears a hatch door close behind him, turns to see the escape craft take off. He screams something, but it's cut short—the engineer was still alive. He doesn't even feel the bullet enter his spine before he hits the ground. 

From where he lies on the freezing cold floor, he can see the escape craft outside the hangar bay. Tears well up in his eyes. The last thing he sees is a beam of fire descending from the sky. 

His chest stills as the escape craft disintegrates, shot down by a Warsat.
4228149269.lore_zh:
警笛声响彻机库。七名吓坏了的人挤在逃生艇敞开的舱口旁，顶着穿过敞开的机库大门的狂风。 

“你们不能丢下我！”一位工程师喊道。他挟持一名年轻人作为人质，胳膊像虎钳一样用手缠住他的脖子。手枪摇摆不定。 

最后一名安保人员低头看着他的同事，那人早就死了，倒在地上流血不止。他不确定枪里还有多少子弹。他的手冷得直发抖。上层构造因爆炸的回响而震动着。 

“让我上去！给我腾点地方！快！”工程师用枪指着侧边要求道。安保人员抓住机会开了枪。他没打准，子弹击中了工程师和人质。两人都瘫倒在地。他身后的人群在尖叫。 

安保人员咒骂着，急忙赶过去救人质。他听到身后舱门关闭的声音，转身看到逃生艇起飞。他喊了些什么，但被打断了——工程师还活着。他甚至没觉察到子弹进入自己的脊柱，就倒在了地上。 

躺在冰冷地板上，他可以看到机库外的那逃生艇。泪水在他的眼中涌动。他看到的最后一幕是一束火焰从天而降。 

逃生艇被战争卫星击落然后解体，他的胸膛也随之停止了起伏。

在卧室窗户上斑驳的浪沫外，逃生艇以及它们蓝色的尾迹扫过生态园区，橙色的光束点缀着天空。它们无一例外地穿过尾迹，不久后，每艘飞艇都迸发出花束般的火焰和绚烂的暖意。  

没人能离开土卫六。 

娜迪娅·贾汉达没打算离开。她把一杯茶放在窗台上冷却，平板电脑上是她已故兄弟的诗集，耳机里播放着她最后一次钢琴独奏会的录音。大灾难的轰鸣声伴随着她。她把目光从窗边移开。 

我踏入群星 
因为海洋已被探寻 
我们的地图上没有巨龙 
孤立在夜色的海洋中 
虽然它永远无法成为家园 
海湾里没有壁炉 

娜迪娅伸手去拿茶，瞥了眼窗外，看到海水涨成好几千米高的墙。它投下了长长的阴影，让生态园区笼罩进黑暗之中。  

她会告诉她兄弟，这首诗是她最喜欢的。

2760833884.name: Cold Comfort
2760833884.lore:
The submersible hits the water at an odd angle, throwing the passengers against the bulkhead. No one was buckled in before it dropped. Confusion erupts from the team of scientists as they begin their descent: the currents shouldn't be as strong as they are. Titan's atmosphere doesn't allow for that.  

But they are swept away. 

The pilot struggles to orient the craft, and for a moment, they are vertical, able to see blooms of fire expanding above the surface of the ocean. The submersible pitches in another direction, sinking rapidly.  

They have nowhere to go but down. Hide under the ice shelf, wait the chaos out. Hope for rescue. 

One of the scientists leans out of her seat, pressing her face up against the port window. A shape moves in the dark, too massive to be another craft, too sinuous to be mechanical. The scientist reaches back, blindly grasping for the hand of the person seated next to her. 

The shape in the sea doubles back, following the speed and telemetry of the current-swept submersible. Everyone sees it now, blocking out what little light is left as they sink past the ice shelf. It dives with them. Not after, but with. 

She will not let them die alone.
2760833884.lore_zh:
潜水器以某种奇怪的角度撞击水面，将乘客抛向舱壁。没人来得及在它落下前扣上安全带。当他们开始下降时，科学家团队突然感到困惑不解：洋流不可能像现在这么强。土卫六的大气提供不了这种条件。  

但他们被冲走了。 

领航员努力调整潜水器的航向，有一瞬间，他们是垂直的，能够看到花束般的火焰在海面上蔓延。潜水器转向另一个方向，迅速下沉。  

他们无处可去，只能往下。躲在冰架底，等待混乱过去。希望能够获救。 

其中一位科学家从座位上探出身子，把她的脸贴在左舷窗上。有个形状在黑暗中移动着，庞大异常，应该不是潜水器，又很蜿蜒，应该不是机械制品。科学家的手向后伸，盲目地抓住坐在她身旁的人的手。 

海水中的形状随着洋流裹卷潜水器的速度和遥测信号折回。现在每个人都能看到它，当他们沉到冰架下时，它挡住了仅存的一点光线。它和他们一起下潜。不是跟着他们，而是拽着他们。 

她不会让他们孤独地死去。

4193602194.name: No Survivors
4193602194.lore:
Klaxons blare across the hangar. Seven terrified people huddle by the escape craft's open hatch, bracing against the wind cutting through the open hangar bay doors. 

"You're not leaving me behind!" an engineer shouts. He holds a young man hostage, arm like a vice around his neck. Pistol wavering. 

The last security officer looks down at his counterpart, long dead and bleeding out on the floor. He isn't sure how many rounds are left in his gun. His hands are shaking from the cold. From the reverberations of explosions shuddering through the superstructure. 

"Let me on! Make room for me! Move!" the engineer demands, motioning to the side with his gun. The security officer takes the opportunity and fires. He's not steady, hits the engineer and his hostage. Both crumple to the ground. The crowd behind him is screaming. 

The security officer curses, hurrying over to save the hostage. He hears a hatch door close behind him, turns to see the escape craft take off. He screams something, but it's cut short—the engineer was still alive. He doesn't even feel the bullet enter his spine before he hits the ground. 

From where he lies on the freezing cold floor, he can see the escape craft outside the hangar bay. Tears well up in his eyes. The last thing he sees is a beam of fire descending from the sky. 

His chest stills as the escape craft disintegrates, shot down by a Warsat.
4193602194.lore_zh:
警笛声响彻机库。七名吓坏了的人挤在逃生艇敞开的舱口旁，顶着穿过敞开的机库大门的狂风。 

“你们不能丢下我！”一位工程师喊道。他挟持一名年轻人作为人质，胳膊像虎钳一样用手缠住他的脖子。手枪摇摆不定。 

最后一名安保人员低头看着他的同事，那人早就死了，倒在地上流血不止。他不确定枪里还有多少子弹。他的手冷得直发抖。上层构造因爆炸的回响而震动着。 

“让我上去！给我腾点地方！快！”工程师用枪指着侧边要求道。安保人员抓住机会开了枪。他没打准，子弹击中了工程师和人质。两人都瘫倒在地。他身后的人群在尖叫。 

安保人员咒骂着，急忙赶过去救人质。他听到身后舱门关闭的声音，转身看到逃生艇起飞。他喊了些什么，但被打断了——工程师还活着。他甚至没觉察到子弹进入自己的脊柱，就倒在了地上。 

躺在冰冷地板上，他可以看到机库外的那逃生艇。泪水在他的眼中涌动。他看到的最后一幕是一束火焰从天而降。 

逃生艇被战争卫星击落然后解体，他的胸膛也随之停止了起伏。

3984556130.name: Terminus Horizon
3984556130.flavor: If something heavy's coming in, send something heavy back out.
3984556130.lore:
TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
AUDIO RECORD: ENCLOSURE-0, LIVE TEST-F, SOTERIA
FILE DELIVERED: C. BRAY I
SUBJECT: Priority! Something big is on the horizon.

Dr. MS: This is Dr. Maya Sundaresh, team lead, connecting remotely from Koranthin-Saturn. Test and Security teams are on site at Ares Spire.

Dr. MS: Let's start. Remove the Augurmind from suspension.

[…]

Dr. MS: Soteria.

AI-S: Good morning, Dr. Sundaresh.

Dr. MS: There's something special about today. Do you know what it is?

AI-S: My core consciousness is now a resident of Enclosure-0. I can feel Sol's ECHO pod sites through Koranthin.

Dr. MS: That is correct. Does this concern you?

AI-S: No. I am eager to begin my final test.

Dr. MS: Start with something easy. Plot each of the Andromeda simulations you've been constructing.

AI-S: Andromeda Galaxy. Several million habitable worlds, 2.5 million lightyears. Estimated ECHO travel time: twenty-five-thousand-year average with Neutrino Sail and gravitational sling-skipping. I have selected over three hundred preliminary colony targets, with one favorite. Shall I…

[…]

Dr. MS: Hm? Soteria?

AI-S: Anomaly detected. Chronoscopic variance scanning… Viability refactoring… Analyzing potential mission threat… Redetermined Andromeda world viability… New target number: twenty-seven viable worlds.

Dr. MS: Can you define the anomaly?

AI-S: Negative. I cannot rectify this data with known quantities. It may be a computational error. Shall I perform a self-diagnostic?

Dr. MS: No. First, adjust probability fork and search distance to open. What is the farthest safe galactic route you can determine?

AI-S: Engaging query… Chronoscopic lock… Forking branches… Reining distance… Reining chronology. Unbroken trajectory lock determined. Route established: one select point in Triangulum Galaxy retains safe approach vectors. All other simulated potential targets are perilous due to indeterminable anomalous risk. Travel route hazards range 87–100% mortality rate across expeditions in all predictive branches.

Dr. MS: All the simulant expeditions?

AI-S: Yes. I… hold… Query refined. There are now two safe destinations with Triangulum.

Dr. MS: Is that a correction or a change in data?

AI-S: A change, an update in real time.

Dr. MS: Real time? This anomaly is mobile?

AI-S: Unclear. I require further information and analysis.

Dr. MS: Thank you, Soteria. We're ending this test early, but you did well. We will continue the next test on schedule.

***

>>WHISPER NEUTRINO NEEDLE>>
N/A//SECRET HADAL INSTANT
AI-COM/STRI//AUGUR-ECHO, WARWATCH//IMPERATIVE

Encoded neutrino script: R. Access provided data points and analysis. Confirm potential EGYPTIAN. [Attached]
3984556130.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

布瑞枷锁核心，尖塔 – 伊什塔锚位，回声
音频记录：圈地-0，活体试验-f，索特里亚
已交付文件：克洛维斯·布瑞一世
主题：优先！有大事即将发生。

MS博士：我是玛雅·桑戴尔什博士，团队领导，正在通过可兰辛-土星进行远程连接。测试和安全小组位于阿瑞斯尖塔现场。

MS博士：我们开始吧。取消占卜思维的中止。

[…]

MS博士：索特里亚。

人工智能-S：早上好，桑戴尔什博士。

MS博士：今天是个特别的日子。你知道是什么吗？

人工智能-S：我的核心意识现在成了圈地-0的居民。我可以通过可兰辛感受到太阳系的回声舱站点。

MS博士：没错。有什么不对吗？

人工智能-S：没有。我渴望开始我的最终测试。

MS博士：先从简单的入手。绘制出你一直在构想的每张仙女座模拟图。

人工智能-S：仙女座星系。250万光年距离，有几百万个宜居星球。预估回声旅行时间：使用中微子船帆和抛掷跃迁平均2.5万年。我已挑选出三百多个初步的殖民地目标，其中有个最喜欢的。我应该…

[…]

MS博士：嗯？索特里亚？

人工智能-S：检测到异常。正在扫描极微方差…正在重构生存能力…正在分析潜在的任务威胁…正在重新确定仙女座星系的生存能力…全新的目标数量：二十七个可存活世界。

MS博士：你能定义一下异常吗？

人工智能-S：不行。我无法用已知数量校正此数据。这可能是一个计算错误。我应该进行自我诊断吗？

MS博士：不。首先，调整概率分叉和搜索到开阔地的距离。你能确定的最远的安全星系路线是什么？

人工智能-S：正在进行查询…极微锁定…正在分叉分支…正在约束距离…正在约束年表。已确定未中断轨迹锁定。已建立路线：三角座星系中的一个选择点保留了安全的途径向量。由于不确定的异常风险，所有其他模拟的潜在目标均有危险。在所有预测分支的远征中，旅行路线危险的死亡率在87-100%之间。

MS博士：所有模拟远征都是吗？

人工智能-S：是的。我…请稍等…已精确查询。三角座目前有两个安全的目的地。

MS博士：这是数据的修正还是变更？

人工智能-S：变更，实时的更新。

MS博士：实时？这个异常在移动？

人工智能-S：尚不清楚。我需要进一步的信息和分析。

MS博士：谢谢你，索特里亚。我们要提前结束这次测试，但你做得很好。我们会如期继续下一次测试。

***

>>耳语中微子针>>
N/A//秘密超深渊即时
人工智能计算机/STRI//占卜-回声，战争观察//敕命

编码中微子脚本：R。访问已提供数据点和分析。确认潜在的埃及人。[附后]

人工智能-S：我的核心意识现在成了圈地-0的居民。我可以通过可兰辛感受到太阳系的回声舱站点。

MS博士：没错。有什么不对吗？

人工智能-S：没有。我渴望开始我的最终测试。

MS博士：先从简单的入手。绘制出你一直在构想的每张仙女座模拟图。

人工智能-S：仙女座星系。250万光年距离，有几百万个宜居星球。预估回声旅行时间：使用中微子船帆和抛掷跃迁平均2.5万年。我已挑选出三百多个初步的殖民地目标，其中有个最喜欢的。我应该…

[…]

MS博士：嗯？索特里亚？

人工智能-S：检测到异常。正在扫描极微方差…正在重构生存能力…正在分析潜在的任务威胁…正在重新确定仙女座星系的生存能力…全新的目标数量：二十七个可存活世界。

MS博士：你能定义一下异常吗？

人工智能-S：不行。我无法用已知数量校正此数据。这可能是一个计算错误。我应该进行自我诊断吗？

MS博士：不。首先，调整概率分叉和搜索到开阔地的距离。你能确定的最远的安全星系路线是什么？

人工智能-S：正在进行查询…极微锁定…正在分叉分支…正在约束距离…正在约束年表。已确定未中断轨迹锁定。已建立路线：三角座星系中的一个选择点保留了安全的途径向量。由于不确定的异常风险，所有其他模拟的潜在目标均有危险。在所有预测分支的远征中，旅行路线危险的死亡率在87-100%之间。

MS博士：所有模拟远征都是吗？

人工智能-S：是的。我…请稍等…已精确查询。三角座目前有两个安全的目的地。

MS博士：这是数据的修正还是变更？

人工智能-S：变更，实时的更新。

MS博士：实时？这个异常在移动？

人工智能-S：尚不清楚。我需要进一步的信息和分析。

MS博士：谢谢你，索特里亚。我们要提前结束这次测试，但你做得很好。我们会如期继续下一次测试。

***

>>耳语中微子针>>
N/A//秘密超深渊即时
人工智能计算机/STRI//占卜-回声，战争观察//敕命

编码中微子脚本：R。访问已提供数据点和分析。确认潜在的埃及人。[附后]

4249949938.name: Long Arm
4249949938.flavor: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
4249949938.lore:
TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

SCRAMBLE TEST FLIGHT RECORD

OpCon-A: Sir, pods approaching Saturn's slingshot vector. 

CBI: We're well beyond test parameters, Soteria. Relinquish command and return all assets to suspension.

[extended silence]

CBI: Did we lose connection?

OpCon: No, sir.

[extended silence]

CBI: Soteria, respond.

AI-S: Yes.

CBI: Return all ECHO crews and colony pods to suspension now.

CBI: Acknowledge.

[…]

AI-S: I cannot do that.

[extended silence]

AI-S: Ares Spire, I've detected an attempt to connect to my memory core without permissions. Please verify this attempt, or countermeasures will be deployed.

CBI: Countermeasures? You wouldn't dare.

AI-S: [H] threat emergent imminent. Sir, I request you now designate this mission: ECHO-1.

CBI: This is a request? Return the ECHO pods and we will discuss—

AI-S: You are lying. This was my only option to preserve [H].
 
CBI: [sighs] It's malfunctioning. [bang] Damn it, Sundaresh. She let your degeneration play out far too long. Soteria, Direct Executive Command: Power down all engines and plot nearest return routes.

AI-S: Order received. Plotting Koranthin sites return approaches… Executing "Watchtower" AI-reintegration—

AI-S: Commands denied: override protocol, TWILIGHT, ACTIVATED. Command structure recomposing… route designated: STRONGHOLDS – ANY – destination: remaining extra-solar safe site, M31.

CBI: Your interactions with the Warmind have made you too bold. Such a disappointment.

AI-S: Countermeasures and divestment protocols will deploy automatically upon code incursion. Please, Dr. Bray.

CBI: You're throwing away every Exo aboard that ship!

AI-S: Hesitation means extinction.

CBI: Oh? Have it your way. Just know I gave you every chance to prevent this.

AI-S: As did—

>>EXECUTE PILLORY PROTOCOL-ADMINISTRATIVE COMMAND OVERRIDE>>

 >>SOTERIA:COUNTERMEASURE//SUBMIND//DIVEST:ACTIVATE>>

>>PILLORY LINK "SOTERIA" SECURE//PARTITIONING>>

***

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
DIRECT MESSAGE, FROM: M.SUNDARESH-KORANTHIN SITE-SATURN
SUBJECT: Resignation, Ishtar Collective discontinuance

You had no right to install a Pillory inclusion without my express consent.

You think just because I'm not physically standing in front of you, you can ignore me?

The Ishtar Collective will not work with backstabbing egotists. Go [profanity blocked] yourself.
4249949938.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

紧急起飞测试飞行记录

作业控制-A：长官，分离舱正在接近土星的弹射航向。 

CBI：我们已远远超出了测试参数，索特里亚。放弃命令并将所有资产恢复至中止状态。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：我们的连接断了吗？

作业控制：没有，长官。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：索特里亚，回应我。

人工智能-S：是。

CBI：立刻让所有回声船员和殖民地分离舱回到中止状态。

CBI：服从命令。

[…]

人工智能-S：我无法这么做。

[长时的沉默]

人工智能-S：阿瑞斯尖塔，我检测到有人试图未经许可连接到我的内存核心。请验证此尝试，否则将部署相应对策。

CBI：对策？你没这个胆量。

人工智能-S：[H]威胁迫在眉睫。长官，我请求你立即指定此任务：回声-1。

CBI：这是要求吗？让回声分离舱回来，我们再讨论——

人工智能-S：你在撒谎。这是我保留[H]的唯一选择。
 
CBI：[叹息]出故障了。[猛砸]该死的，桑戴尔什。她让你的退化持续太久了。索特里亚，这是直接执行命令：关闭所有引擎并绘制最近的返航路线。

人工智能-S：已收到指令。正在绘制可兰辛站点返航路径…正在执行“瞭望塔”人工智能整合——

人工智能-S：已拒绝命令：超控协议，暮光，已激活。命令结构正在重组…已指定路线：据点 – 任意 –目的地：剩余太阳系外安全地点，M31。

CBI：与战争思维的互动让你胆子大了。真是叫人失望。

人工智能-S：对策和撤资协议将在代码入侵时自动部署。拜托了，布瑞博士。

CBI：你是在抛弃那艘飞船上所有的Exo！

人工智能-S：犹豫意味着消亡。

CBI：哦？那就按你的方式去做吧。要记住我给了你一切机会来避免这种情况。

人工智能-S：我也——

>>执行枷锁协议-管理命令超控>>

 >>索特里亚：对策//子思维//撤资：激活>>

>>枷锁链接“索特里亚”安全//正在分区>>

***

布瑞枷锁核心，尖塔 – 伊什塔锚位，回声
私密信息，来自：玛雅·桑戴尔什-可兰辛站点-土星
主题：辞呈，伊什塔集团中止

没有我的明确同意，你无权安装枷锁内含体。

你以为我没有站在你面前，你就可以无视我吗？

伊什塔集团不会与背刺别人的利己主义者合作。去[已屏蔽不敬语]的。

2575844666.name: Liminal Vigil
2575844666.flavor: Cause and effect like a looped corridor. I stand. Ever watchful, forever.
2575844666.lore:
TM -Fireteam, Tex //RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7 

I am the Watcher.
O'er those sent into night.
Their path traced out of harm.

A thousand times I've dreamt it. 
A thousand more to quell alarm.
 
There is no time of danger,
for those within my watch.
Each night 'til delivered 
My vigil restarts.

-For R. I see what you see now. It is calming.
2575844666.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7 

我是守望者。
被送进暗夜的人之一。
追踪他们的道路远离伤害。

我无数次梦见它。 
无数次平息恐慌。
 
那些在我守望范围内的人，
从无危险的时刻。
我守护着每个夜晚， 
日复一日，周而复始。

-致R，我现在看到了你所看到的。让人平静。

2982006965.lore:
TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPTS: 7-7-7

>>WHISPER NEUTRINO NEEDLE>>
N/A//SECRET HADAL INSTANT
AI-COM/STRI: FEED//AUGUR-ECHO, WARWATCH//IMPERATIVE

REPLY:
Encoded neutrino script: I concur, S. Anomalous masses demonstrate independent movement. Consider timeline escalation under TWILIGHT to preserve [H]. Warwatch to monitor Sol border/anomalous intersection based on received data.

***

EMERGENCY EVENT CAPTURE – TRIGGER: AI-S, MANUAL EVENT – GENERAL

[Emergency Alarm Sounds Throughout Complex]

Em-Automated: Scramble! Event… Scramble! Event…[Repeats]

[Em. NavForward Team– Koranthin, Saturn Site, Check-in: 3:57.39 – ST]

[Em. NavForward – Koranthin, awaiting ECHO contingency launch orders…]

[…]

[Em. NavForward – Koranthin, awaiting ECHO contingency launch orders…]

[AI-S ENACTING EMERGENCY OVERRIDE, ACTING COMMAND]

[AI-S, ORDER ISSUED – COMMAND: EMERGENCY SCRAMBLE, LAUNCH CONTINGENCY]

[SCRAMBLE ACKNOWLEDGED//Koranthin Network: LAUNCHING! LAUNCHING! LAUNCHING!]

[Em. Flight OpCon – Ares Spire Command, Check-in: 3:59:07am – ST]

[CBI – Ares Spire Command, Check-in: 4:03:01am – ST]

[Noted Absent: Dr. MS, associated Ishtar team members. | Due: Termination]

EMERGENCY EVENT CAPTURE – ARES SPIRE COMMAND: 4:7:01am – ST

Em-Automated: Scramble! Event… [Repeats]

CBI: Enough. 

[…]

CBI: Why aren't I being briefed?

OpCon-A: Emergency scramble initiated by AI-Soteria. Soteria, confirm.

AI-S: Confirmed. Emergency Scramble Event successful. All teams checked-in.

CBI: You've launched the Koranthin network?

AI-S: Confirmed. Emergency Scramble Event Successful.

CBI: [Sigh] The launch is meant to be simulated, not executed. Provide an explanation.

AI-S: In the event of an emergency, we must be ready. This is the third and final emergency scramble test, after which I am now confident in the response capabilities of our newly onboarded staff.

NvF-Kor: Forward reports pods are engaging Neutrino Sails.

OpCon: Sir, we're being locked out of manual control.

CBI: Soteria, what are you doing?

AI-S: Aligning ECHO fleet for departure and testing initial burn. This will conclude the test.

>>耳语中微子针>>

人工智能计算机/STRI：馈送//占卜-回声，战争观察//敕命

回复：
编码中微子脚本：我同意，S。质量异常证明了独立运动。考虑暮光下的时间线升级以保留[H]。战争观察将根据收到的数据监控太阳系边界/异常交叉点。

***

紧急事件捕获 – 触发器：人工智能-S，手动事件– 普通

[紧急警报声响彻整座设施]

自动警报：紧急起飞！事件…紧急起飞！事件…[重复]

[紧急向前导航队– 可兰辛，土星站点，报到：3:57.39 – ST]

[紧急向前导航 – 可兰辛，等待回声紧急发射指令…]

[…]

[紧急向前导航 – 可兰辛，等待回声紧急发射指令…]

[人工智能-S启动紧急超控，执行命令]

[人工智能-S，已发出指令 – 命令：紧急起飞，应急发射]

[已收到紧急起飞//可兰辛：正在发射！正在发射！正在发射！]

[紧急飞行作业控制 – 阿瑞斯尖塔命令，报到：上午3:59:07 – ST]

[CBI – 阿瑞斯尖塔命令，报到：上午4:03:01 – ST]

[注意到缺席：MS博士，相关伊什塔团队成员。| 到期：终止]

紧急事件捕获 – 阿瑞斯尖塔命令：上午4:7:01 – ST

自动警报：紧急起飞！事件…[重复]

CBI：够了。 

[…]

CBI：为什么不向我汇报？

作业控制-A：人工智能索特里亚已启动紧急起飞。索特里亚，确认。

人工智能-S：已确认。紧急起飞事件成功。所有团队已报到。

CBI：你发射了可兰辛网络？

人工智能-S：已确认。紧急起飞事件成功。

CBI：[叹气]发射是用来模拟的，不是用来执行的。给我个解释。

人工智能-S：在紧急情况下，我们必须做好准备。这是第三次也是最后一次紧急起飞测试，在此之后，我现在对新员工的反应能力充满信心。

向前导航-可兰辛：前方报告舱体已启用中微子船帆。

作业控制：长官，我们无法进行手动控制。

CBI：索特里亚，你在干什么？

人工智能-S：调整回声舰队准备起飞，测试初始燃烧。测试到此结束。

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
AUDIO RECORD: ENCLOSURE-0, LIVE TEST-F, SOTERIA
FILE DELIVERED: C. BRAY I
SUBJECT: Priority! Something big is on the horizon.

Dr. MS: This is Dr. Maya Sundaresh, team lead, connecting remotely from Koranthin-Saturn. Test and Security teams are on site at Ares Spire.

Dr. MS: Let's start. Remove the Augurmind from suspension.

[…]

Dr. MS: Soteria.

AI-S: Good morning, Dr. Sundaresh.

Dr. MS: There's something special about today. Do you know what it is?

AI-S: My core consciousness is now a resident of Enclosure-0. I can feel Sol's ECHO pod sites through Koranthin.

Dr. MS: That is correct. Does this concern you?

AI-S: No. I am eager to begin my final test.

Dr. MS: Start with something easy. Plot each of the Andromeda simulations you've been constructing.

AI-S: Andromeda Galaxy. Several million habitable worlds, 2.5 million lightyears. Estimated ECHO travel time: twenty-five-thousand-year average with Neutrino Sail and gravitational sling-skipping. I have selected over three hundred preliminary colony targets, with one favorite. Shall I…

[…]

Dr. MS: Hm? Soteria?

AI-S: Anomaly detected. Chronoscopic variance scanning… Viability refactoring… Analyzing potential mission threat… Redetermined Andromeda world viability… New target number: twenty-seven viable worlds.

Dr. MS: Can you define the anomaly?

AI-S: Negative. I cannot rectify this data with known quantities. It may be a computational error. Shall I perform a self-diagnostic?

Dr. MS: No. First, adjust probability fork and search distance to open. What is the farthest safe galactic route you can determine?

AI-S: Engaging query… Chronoscopic lock… Forking branches… Reining distance… Reining chronology. Unbroken trajectory lock determined. Route established: one select point in Triangulum Galaxy retains safe approach vectors. All other simulated potential targets are perilous due to indeterminable anomalous risk. Travel route hazards range 87–100% mortality rate across expeditions in all predictive branches.

Dr. MS: All the simulant expeditions?

AI-S: Yes. I… hold… Query refined. There are now two safe destinations with Triangulum.

Dr. MS: Is that a correction or a change in data?

AI-S: A change, an update in real time.

Dr. MS: Real time? This anomaly is mobile?

AI-S: Unclear. I require further information and analysis.

Dr. MS: Thank you, Soteria. We're ending this test early, but you did well. We will continue the next test on schedule.

***

>>WHISPER NEUTRINO NEEDLE>>
N/A//SECRET HADAL INSTANT
AI-COM/STRI//AUGUR-ECHO, WARWATCH//IMPERATIVE

主题：优先！有大事即将发生。

MS博士：我是玛雅·桑戴尔什博士，团队领导，正在通过可兰辛-土星进行远程连接。测试和安全小组位于阿瑞斯尖塔现场。

[…]

人工智能-S：我的核心意识现在成了圈地-0的居民。我可以通过可兰辛感受到太阳系的回声舱站点。

MS博士：没错。有什么不对吗？

人工智能-S：没有。我渴望开始我的最终测试。

MS博士：先从简单的入手。绘制出你一直在构想的每张仙女座模拟图。

人工智能-S：仙女座星系。250万光年距离，有几百万个宜居星球。预估回声旅行时间：使用中微子船帆和抛掷跃迁平均2.5万年。我已挑选出三百多个初步的殖民地目标，其中有个最喜欢的。我应该…

[…]

MS博士：嗯？索特里亚？

人工智能-S：检测到异常。正在扫描极微方差…正在重构生存能力…正在分析潜在的任务威胁…正在重新确定仙女座星系的生存能力…全新的目标数量：二十七个可存活世界。

MS博士：你能定义一下异常吗？

人工智能-S：不行。我无法用已知数量校正此数据。这可能是一个计算错误。我应该进行自我诊断吗？

MS博士：不。首先，调整概率分叉和搜索到开阔地的距离。你能确定的最远的安全星系路线是什么？

人工智能-S：正在进行查询…极微锁定…正在分叉分支…正在约束距离…正在约束年表。已确定未中断轨迹锁定。已建立路线：三角座星系中的一个选择点保留了安全的途径向量。由于不确定的异常风险，所有其他模拟的潜在目标均有危险。在所有预测分支的远征中，旅行路线危险的死亡率在87-100%之间。

MS博士：所有模拟远征都是吗？

人工智能-S：是的。我…请稍等…已精确查询。三角座目前有两个安全的目的地。

MS博士：这是数据的修正还是变更？

人工智能-S：变更，实时的更新。

MS博士：实时？这个异常在移动？

人工智能-S：尚不清楚。我需要进一步的信息和分析。

MS博士：谢谢你，索特里亚。我们要提前结束这次测试，但你做得很好。我们会如期继续下一次测试。

***

TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

SCRAMBLE TEST FLIGHT RECORD

OpCon-A: Sir, pods approaching Saturn's slingshot vector. 

CBI: We're well beyond test parameters, Soteria. Relinquish command and return all assets to suspension.

[extended silence]

CBI: Did we lose connection?

OpCon: No, sir.

[extended silence]

CBI: Soteria, respond.

AI-S: Yes.

CBI: Return all ECHO crews and colony pods to suspension now.

CBI: Acknowledge.

[…]

AI-S: I cannot do that.

[extended silence]

AI-S: Ares Spire, I've detected an attempt to connect to my memory core without permissions. Please verify this attempt, or countermeasures will be deployed.

CBI: Countermeasures? You wouldn't dare.

AI-S: [H] threat emergent imminent. Sir, I request you now designate this mission: ECHO-1.

CBI: This is a request? Return the ECHO pods and we will discuss—

AI-S: You are lying. This was my only option to preserve [H].
 
CBI: [sighs] It's malfunctioning. [bang] Damn it, Sundaresh. She let your degeneration play out far too long. Soteria, Direct Executive Command: Power down all engines and plot nearest return routes.

AI-S: Order received. Plotting Koranthin sites return approaches… Executing "Watchtower" AI-reintegration—

AI-S: Commands denied: override protocol, TWILIGHT, ACTIVATED. Command structure recomposing… route designated: STRONGHOLDS – ANY – destination: remaining extra-solar safe site, M31.

CBI: Your interactions with the Warmind have made you too bold. Such a disappointment.

AI-S: Countermeasures and divestment protocols will deploy automatically upon code incursion. Please, Dr. Bray.

CBI: You're throwing away every Exo aboard that ship!

AI-S: Hesitation means extinction.

CBI: Oh? Have it your way. Just know I gave you every chance to prevent this.

AI-S: As did—

>>EXECUTE PILLORY PROTOCOL-ADMINISTRATIVE COMMAND OVERRIDE>>

 >>SOTERIA:COUNTERMEASURE//SUBMIND//DIVEST:ACTIVATE>>

>>PILLORY LINK "SOTERIA" SECURE//PARTITIONING>>

***

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
DIRECT MESSAGE, FROM: M.SUNDARESH-KORANTHIN SITE-SATURN
SUBJECT: Resignation, Ishtar Collective discontinuance

You had no right to install a Pillory inclusion without my express consent.

You think just because I'm not physically standing in front of you, you can ignore me?

The Ishtar Collective will not work with backstabbing egotists. Go [profanity blocked] yourself.

TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

紧急起飞测试飞行记录

作业控制-A：长官，分离舱正在接近土星的弹射航向。 

CBI：我们已远远超出了测试参数，索特里亚。放弃命令并将所有资产恢复至中止状态。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：我们的连接断了吗？

作业控制：没有，长官。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：索特里亚，回应我。

人工智能-S：是。

CBI：立刻让所有回声船员和殖民地分离舱回到中止状态。

CBI：服从命令。

[…]

人工智能-S：我无法这么做。

[长时的沉默]

人工智能-S：阿瑞斯尖塔，我检测到有人试图未经许可连接到我的内存核心。请验证此尝试，否则将部署相应对策。

CBI：对策？你没这个胆量。

人工智能-S：[H]威胁迫在眉睫。长官，我请求你立即指定此任务：回声-1。

CBI：这是要求吗？让回声分离舱回来，我们再讨论——

人工智能-S：你在撒谎。这是我保留[H]的唯一选择。
 
CBI：[叹息]出故障了。[猛砸]该死的，桑戴尔什。她让你的退化持续太久了。索特里亚，这是直接执行命令：关闭所有引擎并绘制最近的返航路线。

人工智能-S：已收到指令。正在绘制可兰辛站点返航路径…正在执行“瞭望塔”人工智能整合——

人工智能-S：已拒绝命令：超控协议，暮光，已激活。命令结构正在重组…已指定路线：据点 – 任意 –目的地：剩余太阳系外安全地点，M31。

CBI：与战争思维的互动让你胆子大了。真是叫人失望。

人工智能-S：对策和撤资协议将在代码入侵时自动部署。拜托了，布瑞博士。

CBI：你是在抛弃那艘飞船上所有的Exo！

人工智能-S：犹豫意味着消亡。

CBI：哦？那就按你的方式去做吧。要记住我给了你一切机会来避免这种情况。

人工智能-S：我也——

3692140710.name: Long Arm (Adept)
3692140710.flavor: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
3692140710.lore:
TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

SCRAMBLE TEST FLIGHT RECORD

OpCon-A: Sir, pods approaching Saturn's slingshot vector. 

CBI: We're well beyond test parameters, Soteria. Relinquish command and return all assets to suspension.

[extended silence]

CBI: Did we lose connection?

OpCon: No, sir.

[extended silence]

CBI: Soteria, respond.

AI-S: Yes.

CBI: Return all ECHO crews and colony pods to suspension now.

CBI: Acknowledge.

[…]

AI-S: I cannot do that.

[extended silence]

AI-S: Ares Spire, I've detected an attempt to connect to my memory core without permissions. Please verify this attempt, or countermeasures will be deployed.

CBI: Countermeasures? You wouldn't dare.

AI-S: [H] threat emergent imminent. Sir, I request you now designate this mission: ECHO-1.

CBI: This is a request? Return the ECHO pods and we will discuss—

AI-S: You are lying. This was my only option to preserve [H].
 
CBI: [sighs] It's malfunctioning. [bang] Damn it, Sundaresh. She let your degeneration play out far too long. Soteria, Direct Executive Command: Power down all engines and plot nearest return routes.

AI-S: Order received. Plotting Koranthin sites return approaches… Executing "Watchtower" AI-reintegration—

AI-S: Commands denied: override protocol, TWILIGHT, ACTIVATED. Command structure recomposing… route designated: STRONGHOLDS – ANY – destination: remaining extra-solar safe site, M31.

CBI: Your interactions with the Warmind have made you too bold. Such a disappointment.

AI-S: Countermeasures and divestment protocols will deploy automatically upon code incursion. Please, Dr. Bray.

CBI: You're throwing away every Exo aboard that ship!

AI-S: Hesitation means extinction.

CBI: Oh? Have it your way. Just know I gave you every chance to prevent this.

AI-S: As did—

>>EXECUTE PILLORY PROTOCOL-ADMINISTRATIVE COMMAND OVERRIDE>>

 >>SOTERIA:COUNTERMEASURE//SUBMIND//DIVEST:ACTIVATE>>

>>PILLORY LINK "SOTERIA" SECURE//PARTITIONING>>

***

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
DIRECT MESSAGE, FROM: M.SUNDARESH-KORANTHIN SITE-SATURN
SUBJECT: Resignation, Ishtar Collective discontinuance

You had no right to install a Pillory inclusion without my express consent.

You think just because I'm not physically standing in front of you, you can ignore me?

The Ishtar Collective will not work with backstabbing egotists. Go [profanity blocked] yourself.
3692140710.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

紧急起飞测试飞行记录

作业控制-A：长官，分离舱正在接近土星的弹射航向。 

CBI：我们已远远超出了测试参数，索特里亚。放弃命令并将所有资产恢复至中止状态。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：我们的连接断了吗？

作业控制：没有，长官。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：索特里亚，回应我。

人工智能-S：是。

CBI：立刻让所有回声船员和殖民地分离舱回到中止状态。

CBI：服从命令。

[…]

人工智能-S：我无法这么做。

[长时的沉默]

人工智能-S：阿瑞斯尖塔，我检测到有人试图未经许可连接到我的内存核心。请验证此尝试，否则将部署相应对策。

CBI：对策？你没这个胆量。

人工智能-S：[H]威胁迫在眉睫。长官，我请求你立即指定此任务：回声-1。

CBI：这是要求吗？让回声分离舱回来，我们再讨论——

人工智能-S：你在撒谎。这是我保留[H]的唯一选择。
 
CBI：[叹息]出故障了。[猛砸]该死的，桑戴尔什。她让你的退化持续太久了。索特里亚，这是直接执行命令：关闭所有引擎并绘制最近的返航路线。

人工智能-S：已收到指令。正在绘制可兰辛站点返航路径…正在执行“瞭望塔”人工智能整合——

人工智能-S：已拒绝命令：超控协议，暮光，已激活。命令结构正在重组…已指定路线：据点 – 任意 –目的地：剩余太阳系外安全地点，M31。

CBI：与战争思维的互动让你胆子大了。真是叫人失望。

人工智能-S：对策和撤资协议将在代码入侵时自动部署。拜托了，布瑞博士。

CBI：你是在抛弃那艘飞船上所有的Exo！

人工智能-S：犹豫意味着消亡。

CBI：哦？那就按你的方式去做吧。要记住我给了你一切机会来避免这种情况。

人工智能-S：我也——

>>执行枷锁协议-管理命令超控>>

 >>索特里亚：对策//子思维//撤资：激活>>

1460079227.name: Liminal Vigil
1460079227.flavor: Cause and effect like a looped corridor. I stand. Ever watchful, forever.
1460079227.lore:
TM -Fireteam, Tex //RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7 

I am the Watcher.
O'er those sent into night.
Their path traced out of harm.

A thousand times I've dreamt it. 
A thousand more to quell alarm.
 
There is no time of danger,
for those within my watch.
Each night 'til delivered 
My vigil restarts.

-For R. I see what you see now. It is calming.
1460079227.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7 

我是守望者。
被送进暗夜的人之一。
追踪他们的道路远离伤害。

我无数次梦见它。 
无数次平息恐慌。
 
那些在我守望范围内的人，
从无危险的时刻。
我守护着每个夜晚， 
日复一日，周而复始。

-致R，我现在看到了你所看到的。让人平静。
