3709368142.name: Aisha's Embrace
3709368142.flavor: Fill my wounds with molten gold and make me whole again.
3709368142.lore:
She has been here before.

Pale whisps of clouds swirl over pine trees the color of blackened emerald. No birds sing here; only the cold wind whistles through the tree branches. Flares of atomic fire bloom in the woods and lick against smoldering bark. There is poison in the ground, violence in the air. Screams, both human and inhuman, erupt and echo out into the gloom.

She has been here before.

Two dozen Hive Thrall erupt from the mouth of a cave, shimmering and opalescent like mollusk corpses. They scramble through the dark, shrieking cries of death and birth. Shayura stands, sword of fire held fast, screaming against the crashing tide of chitin and bone.

She has been here before.

Burning embers of Thrall rain around her, but with each dispatched wave of necrotic soldiers, their numbers seem to double. They press forward, inching her closer and closer to the crumbling ravine. Shayura knows that the only way out is through. Wings of flame roar off her back, leaving a trail of rippling heat and charred Thrall in her wake.

She has been here before.

The Thrall finally recede, but the towering Knight that strides through their parted ranks is an escalation, not a victory. Her sword clashes with the Knight's shield, shattering it in a single blow before tearing through the Knight's arm and sinking her blade into its chest.

She has been here before.

She can feel her Light ebbing and wastes no time splitting the Knight in half and separating head from body. Shayura exhales with relief, but with her next breath comes a blinding flash of light. It manifests above the Knight. Her vision swims, her mind reels; the shape is at once familiar and alien—a Ghost. Shayura sees the Hive Knight reborn, reconstructed, as a Guardian would be.

She has been here before. But not like this.

Deep panic builds in her chest. This is no Hive death ritual; this is not Titan. She runs from the Knight's next swing and slips into the reach of Thrall that tear at her armor. Mustering the last of her Solar energy, Shayura calls up a cyclonic pillar of flame that twists up into the sky and consumes the Knight.

…not like this.

The revenant Knight collapses in the flames, and its Ghost manifests again. Shayura leaps forward and drives her sword through, pinning the screaming Ghost to the forest floor. Her Solar aura flickers and fades; smoke and steam billow from her back and shoulders.

"NOT LIKE THIS!"

"Shay!"

Shayura's breath catches, her mind jostled. She feels the soft grass beneath her and sees the flower-dappled park that surrounds her, all sitting beneath the shadow of the Traveler in the heart of the City. Her SMG lies on the ground at her side. Tears shine below exhausted eyes, dark hair in a tangle matted to her head.

Aisha kneels in front of her friend as one might before a wild animal. Reed-7 stands at her back in abject silence, hand over his mouth. City security fans out behind him, their weapons trained on Shayura. 

"Shay?" Aisha pleads this time. She gingerly places her hands on Shayura's cheeks and looks into her eyes, searching for a sign of recognition. Shayura eventually reaches up and touches one of Aisha's hands. She tries to talk, but her words are merely whimpers.

Aisha wraps her arms around Shayura's shoulders and pulls her into an embrace. "It's going to be okay," Aisha whispers into Shayura's hair.

"We're going to get you help," Aisha promises.

Shayura does not trust herself or the world she thought she knew. Light is Dark, Dark is Light. The lines have blurred beyond recognition.

But at least in surrender, there is peace.
3709368142.lore_zh:
她经历过这个。

苍白的云朵盘旋在近乎黑色的深绿色松树上方。这里没有鸟儿歌唱；只有寒风呼啸着穿过树枝。原子火焰的光辉在树林的黑暗中绽放，舔舐着闷燃的树皮。地上毒药泛滥，空中暴力弥漫。人类和非人类的尖叫声在幽暗之中回荡。

她经历过这个。

二十几只邪魔族怨魂从洞口喷涌而出，闪烁着乳白色的光芒，如软体动物的尸体一般。它们在黑暗中窜来窜去，死亡与重生的尖叫不绝于耳。沙玉拉双手紧握一把火焰之刃，朝甲壳和骨头的浪潮咆哮着。

她经历过这个。

怨魂燃烧殆尽的残渣如雨点般落在她的身边，但是这些死灵士兵无论杀掉多少，数量却总是越来越多。在它们的强攻下，她被一步步地逼向了崩塌中的峡谷。沙玉拉知道，现在唯一的生路就是杀出重围。她张开一对火焰之翼，把荡漾的热浪和烧焦的怨魂留在了身后。

她经历过这个。

怨魂之潮退去，但从阵中大步上前的高大骑士说明这并不是胜利的迹象，而是战事的扩大。她用剑一击砍碎了骑士的盾牌，乘势斩下了它的手臂，然后一把刺进了它的胸膛。

她经历过这个。

她感到光能正在衰弱，于是利落地将骑士劈成了两半，取下了它的首级。沙玉拉如释重负地松了一口气，但气还没喘完，一道刺眼的光亮便出现了在她的眼前。这道光亮在骑士的尸体上具象化了出来——这幅既熟悉又陌生的景象使她的视线飘忽，心神不宁：那是一只机灵。邪魔族骑士在沙玉拉的眼前重生、重构，与守护者无异。

她经历过这个，但不是这样的。

沙玉拉的胸中升起了一股惧意。这不是邪魔族的死亡仪式；这不是土卫六。她为了躲开骑士的挥击而朝一旁跑去，却没想到刚起身就遭遇了一群怨魂撕扯着她的铠甲。她使出了全身最后的烈日能量，召唤出一道火焰龙卷风：这股灼热的能量立刻吞噬了眼前的骑士。

…不是这样的。

复生的骑士倒在了火焰里，而他的机灵又出现了。沙玉拉向前一跃，用手中利刃刺穿了机灵；它尖叫着，被扎定在了森林的地面上。围绕周身的烈日光环逐渐消褪，她的背后和肩膀上升起了片片雾气。

“不是这样的！”

“沙？”

沙玉拉缓过神来，思绪仍处于混乱之中。她感到了身下柔软的草地，看见了她四周花团锦簇的公园；所有的一切都坐落在圣城的中央，旅行者的阴影之下。沙玉拉的微型冲锋枪躺在她身旁。泪水从她疲惫的双眼中落下，挂在脸颊上闪闪发光。

艾莎跪在她的朋友前，好像面对着一只野兽。里德-7站在艾莎的身后，一只手捂着嘴，一声不吭。圣城安保人员在他身后呈扇形展开，将手中的武器一齐对准了沙玉拉。 

“沙？”艾莎的言语中带着乞求。她小心翼翼地将双手放在沙玉拉的脸颊上，注视着她的眼眸，寻找着沙玉拉认出她来的迹象。沙玉拉最终伸手碰了碰艾莎的手。她想要说些什么，但她的话语出口后成了一串细声呜咽。

艾莎一把抱住沙玉拉，把她拉进了怀里。“一切都会好起来的，”艾莎对着沙玉拉的头发轻声说道。

“我们会帮助你的，”艾莎许诺道。

沙玉拉不信任自己，也不信任她自以为了解的世界。光明就是黑暗，黑暗就是光明。两者的界线已模糊得无法辨清。

但至少屈服能带来和平。

2179624700.name: Aisha's Embrace
2179624700.flavor: Fill my wounds with molten gold and make me whole again.
2179624700.lore:
She has been here before.

Pale whisps of clouds swirl over pine trees the color of blackened emerald. No birds sing here; only the cold wind whistles through the tree branches. Flares of atomic fire bloom in the woods and lick against smoldering bark. There is poison in the ground, violence in the air. Screams, both human and inhuman, erupt and echo out into the gloom.

She has been here before.

Two dozen Hive Thrall erupt from the mouth of a cave, shimmering and opalescent like mollusk corpses. They scramble through the dark, shrieking cries of death and birth. Shayura stands, sword of fire held fast, screaming against the crashing tide of chitin and bone.

She has been here before.

Burning embers of Thrall rain around her, but with each dispatched wave of necrotic soldiers, their numbers seem to double. They press forward, inching her closer and closer to the crumbling ravine. Shayura knows that the only way out is through. Wings of flame roar off her back, leaving a trail of rippling heat and charred Thrall in her wake.

She has been here before.

The Thrall finally recede, but the towering Knight that strides through their parted ranks is an escalation, not a victory. Her sword clashes with the Knight's shield, shattering it in a single blow before tearing through the Knight's arm and sinking her blade into its chest.

She has been here before.

She can feel her Light ebbing and wastes no time splitting the Knight in half and separating head from body. Shayura exhales with relief, but with her next breath comes a blinding flash of light. It manifests above the Knight. Her vision swims, her mind reels; the shape is at once familiar and alien—a Ghost. Shayura sees the Hive Knight reborn, reconstructed, as a Guardian would be.

She has been here before. But not like this.

Deep panic builds in her chest. This is no Hive death ritual; this is not Titan. She runs from the Knight's next swing and slips into the reach of Thrall that tear at her armor. Mustering the last of her Solar energy, Shayura calls up a cyclonic pillar of flame that twists up into the sky and consumes the Knight.

…not like this.

The revenant Knight collapses in the flames, and its Ghost manifests again. Shayura leaps forward and drives her sword through, pinning the screaming Ghost to the forest floor. Her Solar aura flickers and fades; smoke and steam billow from her back and shoulders.

"NOT LIKE THIS!"

"Shay!"

Shayura's breath catches, her mind jostled. She feels the soft grass beneath her and sees the flower-dappled park that surrounds her, all sitting beneath the shadow of the Traveler in the heart of the City. Her SMG lies on the ground at her side. Tears shine below exhausted eyes, dark hair in a tangle matted to her head.

Aisha kneels in front of her friend as one might before a wild animal. Reed-7 stands at her back in abject silence, hand over his mouth. City security fans out behind him, their weapons trained on Shayura. 

"Shay?" Aisha pleads this time. She gingerly places her hands on Shayura's cheeks and looks into her eyes, searching for a sign of recognition. Shayura eventually reaches up and touches one of Aisha's hands. She tries to talk, but her words are merely whimpers.

Aisha wraps her arms around Shayura's shoulders and pulls her into an embrace. "It's going to be okay," Aisha whispers into Shayura's hair.

"We're going to get you help," Aisha promises.

Shayura does not trust herself or the world she thought she knew. Light is Dark, Dark is Light. The lines have blurred beyond recognition.

But at least in surrender, there is peace.
2179624700.lore_zh:
她经历过这个。

苍白的云朵盘旋在近乎黑色的深绿色松树上方。这里没有鸟儿歌唱；只有寒风呼啸着穿过树枝。原子火焰的光辉在树林的黑暗中绽放，舔舐着闷燃的树皮。地上毒药泛滥，空中暴力弥漫。人类和非人类的尖叫声在幽暗之中回荡。

她经历过这个。

二十几只邪魔族怨魂从洞口喷涌而出，闪烁着乳白色的光芒，如软体动物的尸体一般。它们在黑暗中窜来窜去，死亡与重生的尖叫不绝于耳。沙玉拉双手紧握一把火焰之刃，朝甲壳和骨头的浪潮咆哮着。

她经历过这个。

怨魂燃烧殆尽的残渣如雨点般落在她的身边，但是这些死灵士兵无论杀掉多少，数量却总是越来越多。在它们的强攻下，她被一步步地逼向了崩塌中的峡谷。沙玉拉知道，现在唯一的生路就是杀出重围。她张开一对火焰之翼，把荡漾的热浪和烧焦的怨魂留在了身后。

她经历过这个。

怨魂之潮退去，但从阵中大步上前的高大骑士说明这并不是胜利的迹象，而是战事的扩大。她用剑一击砍碎了骑士的盾牌，乘势斩下了它的手臂，然后一把刺进了它的胸膛。

她经历过这个。

她感到光能正在衰弱，于是利落地将骑士劈成了两半，取下了它的首级。沙玉拉如释重负地松了一口气，但气还没喘完，一道刺眼的光亮便出现了在她的眼前。这道光亮在骑士的尸体上具象化了出来——这幅既熟悉又陌生的景象使她的视线飘忽，心神不宁：那是一只机灵。邪魔族骑士在沙玉拉的眼前重生、重构，与守护者无异。

她经历过这个，但不是这样的。

沙玉拉的胸中升起了一股惧意。这不是邪魔族的死亡仪式；这不是土卫六。她为了躲开骑士的挥击而朝一旁跑去，却没想到刚起身就遭遇了一群怨魂撕扯着她的铠甲。她使出了全身最后的烈日能量，召唤出一道火焰龙卷风：这股灼热的能量立刻吞噬了眼前的骑士。

…不是这样的。

复生的骑士倒在了火焰里，而他的机灵又出现了。沙玉拉向前一跃，用手中利刃刺穿了机灵；它尖叫着，被扎定在了森林的地面上。围绕周身的烈日光环逐渐消褪，她的背后和肩膀上升起了片片雾气。

2838279629.lore:
"I never had it, but I'm fairly sure ramen existed before the Golden Age," Lodi nods, chopsticks unsteady in his hand. "I should cook for you sometime. What… food… still exists?" 

The Guardian leans in to answer, but Ghost pipes up, "Oh, good! Saint is here!" 

Lodi quickly stands up from the counter to greet him. He has heard so much. "Mr. Saint, a pleasure to meet you." 

He glances to the Guardian for an introduction, but is only met with a parting wave and a wiggle from Ghost as they walk away. 

The Titan crushes his fingers in an enthusiastic handshake, a box in his other wide palm. "Emissary! The pleasure is all mine!" 

Lodi freezes.  

He knows that accent from a thousand tapped phonelines and from behind a dozen two-way mirrors. He forces his face still. Wills his pulse to quiet. 

"Where are you from?" Lodi says in cautious Russian. 

"Ah! Finally!" Saint barks the same language in fluent staccato. "At last, someone to talk to!" And without warning, Lodi's hand is crushed in a second enthusiastic handshake. 

"Where are my manners? Here, a housewarming gift." 

Buzzing with nerves, the Emissary opens the package. He blinks; sparkling before him is a matching set of tasteful champagne flutes, the most timeless of housewarming gifts 

The fuel for his fears had been extinguished for centuries. His enemy is an apocalypse away. 

Lodi holds the box close. He looks at Saint directly. "This was a thoughtful gift. Thank you for your hospitality." His Russian flows easier this time, like an old friend. 

"You are most welcome!" He pauses, looking him over, and adds, "Are you all right?" 

Lodi's stomach flips over. He hunts for the right phrase and finds it arrive, gently, in his mind, "In my time, our people were… in conflict."

Saint barks a laugh and swings a leg over a chair. "Who won?" 

The earnestness of the question is so absurd that Lodi shrugs, feeling gravity lighten on his shoulders.  

"No idea," he smiles.
2838279629.lore_zh:
“虽然没吃过，但我很确定拉面在黄金时代之前就存在了。”洛迪点点头，手中的筷子微微发颤。“有机会给你们露一手。现在…还有哪些食物…存在？” 

守护者倾身准备回答，但机灵抢先说道：“哦，太好了！圣人来了！” 

洛迪立即从柜台起身相迎。他早已久仰大名。“圣人先生，很荣幸和你见面。” 

他望向守护者期待引荐，却只得到告别的挥手和机灵扭动着远去的背影。 

泰坦用力握住他的手热情摇晃，另一只宽大的手掌托着一个盒子。“使者！是我的荣幸才对！” 

洛迪瞬间僵住。  

他从千百条监听线路与十几面双向镜后早已熟悉这口音。他强压下脸上的表情，努力让心跳平静下来。 

“你来自哪里？”洛迪用俄语谨慎发问。 

“哈！终于！"圣人嚷起同一种语言，流利而顿挫分明地回应道。“总算有人能和我聊聊了！”话音未落，洛迪的手再次被热情地握住。 

“我真是失礼。给，送你的乔迁礼物。” 

使者神经紧绷地拆开礼盒。他眨了眨眼；眼前赫然是一对典雅相称的香槟杯，堪称最经典的温居贺礼。 

他的恐惧之源，几百年前就已烟消云散。他的敌人，距离他有一次世界末日那么远。 

洛迪紧紧抱着盒子，直视着圣人的眼睛。“这份礼物很贴心，谢谢你的热情。”这次，他的俄语说得流畅许多，如同老友交谈。 

“客气什么！”圣人停顿了一下，打量了他一番，然后说道，“你没事吧？” 

洛迪的胃一阵翻腾。他思索着合适的措辞，一句回答悄然浮现在脑海，“在我那个时代，你我双方…是敌对的。”

圣人大笑着一脚搭上椅子。“谁赢了？” 

这一本正经的疑问荒谬得让洛迪不禁耸了耸肩，感觉肩上的重力都减轻了几分。  

“不知道。”他微笑着回答。

190747610.name: Qua Nilus II
190747610.source: Source: The Edge of Fate Activities
190747610.lore:
Omar Saint Croix descended a long flight of concrete steps into a heavily fortified bunker beneath the Last City. Two armed Redjacks flanked the bottom of the stairway. A hard, wiry man with a scraggly beard perched on a stool behind a glass case filled with knives.  

"Whaddaya looking for?" he asked.   

Omar glanced around. The walls of the bunker were lined top to bottom with hundreds of weapons: a beat-up Rat King sidearm, an immaculately refurbished Sweet Business auto, and an original-issue Two-Tailed Fox rocket launcher. Even a Telesto, with a big Do Not Touch sign hung over it.  

"Uh, an SMG," Omar replied in a street drawl honed by years of undercover ops. "Something nasty-lookin'." 

"Trying to make an impression?" 

"Gotta let 'em know I mean business." 

The arms dealer nodded. He pulled a compact submachine gun off a nearby rack, checked the chamber, and handed it to Omar. 

"Don't recognize it," Omar said mildly. 

"Brand new. The alien-lovers in the Tower just got 'em," the dealer smirked. "Piggies always trying to keep power out of the hands of the people. You know how it is. But we got our ways." 

"They're not so bad," Omar said, pretending to examine the shotgun. "Took down Ghaul, didn't they?" 

"And why was he here in the first place? Trying to steal that piece of junk Traveler. The only reason they stopped him was to protect their own asses. Their immortality," the dealer sneered. 

Omar decided not to press. "I guess you got a point. No Traveler, no Ghaul." 

"No Pyramids, no damn Vex sieges," the peddler ranted. "Hell, even the Fallen would be back wherever the hell they came from. Filthy parasites. We gotta be ready." 

"Ready for what?"

190747610.lore_zh:
奥马尔·圣克鲁瓦沿着长长的混凝土台阶下行，深入圣城下的一座重兵把守的掩体。两名全副武装的红桃杰克把守着楼梯底部。一个瘦削精悍、胡子拉碴的男人坐在玻璃陈列柜后的高脚凳上，柜里摆满各式刀具。  

“找啥家伙？”他问道。   

奥马尔环顾四周。掩体墙壁从上到下挂满数百件武器：一把破旧的“鼠王”手枪，一支保养如新的“糖果生意”自动步枪，还有原厂“双尾狐”火箭发射器。甚至有把“土卫十三”悬在墙上，上方挂着“严禁触碰”的警示牌。  

“呃，要把微型冲锋枪，”奥马尔用多年卧底生涯磨炼出的街头腔调答道，“要看起来够凶的。” 

“打算镇场子？” 

“得让他们知道我不是闹着玩的。” 

军火贩子点点头，从架子上取下一把紧凑型微型冲锋枪，检查完弹膛后递给奥马尔。 

“没见过这型号。”奥马尔故作平淡。 

“全新货色。高塔里那些外星人舔狗刚搞到手的。”贩子咧嘴一笑，“那些猪猡总是想把力量攥在自己手里。你懂的。但我们自有门路。” 

“他们也没那么糟吧？”奥马尔假装端详着霰弹枪，“他们不是干掉了盖欧吗？” 

“那混蛋为啥会来这儿？不就是为了偷那个破烂旅行者！那群人阻止他也只是为了自保——保住他们的永生不死。”贩子嗤之以鼻。 

奥马尔决定迁就他。“说得也是。没有旅行者，就没有盖欧。” 

“没有金字塔，就没有那些该死的Vex围攻！”贩子叫嚷道。“要我说，连那些堕落者都会滚回他们的老窝。肮脏的寄生虫。我们得做好准备。” 

“准备什么？” 

“准备让普通人夺回这座该死的圣城！高塔以为能永远骑在我们头上。但我告诉你——他们迟早要栽大跟头。”

3011604536.name: Qua Nilus II
3011604536.lore:
Omar Saint Croix descended a long flight of concrete steps into a heavily fortified bunker beneath the Last City. Two armed Redjacks flanked the bottom of the stairway. A hard, wiry man with a scraggly beard perched on a stool behind a glass case filled with knives.  

"Whaddaya looking for?" he asked.   

Omar glanced around. The walls of the bunker were lined top to bottom with hundreds of weapons: a beat-up Rat King sidearm, an immaculately refurbished Sweet Business auto, and an original-issue Two-Tailed Fox rocket launcher. Even a Telesto, with a big Do Not Touch sign hung over it.  

"Uh, an SMG," Omar replied in a street drawl honed by years of undercover ops. "Something nasty-lookin'." 

"Trying to make an impression?" 

"Gotta let 'em know I mean business." 

The arms dealer nodded. He pulled a compact submachine gun off a nearby rack, checked the chamber, and handed it to Omar. 

"Don't recognize it," Omar said mildly. 

"Brand new. The alien-lovers in the Tower just got 'em," the dealer smirked. "Piggies always trying to keep power out of the hands of the people. You know how it is. But we got our ways." 

"They're not so bad," Omar said, pretending to examine the shotgun. "Took down Ghaul, didn't they?" 

"And why was he here in the first place? Trying to steal that piece of junk Traveler. The only reason they stopped him was to protect their own asses. Their immortality," the dealer sneered. 

Omar decided not to press. "I guess you got a point. No Traveler, no Ghaul." 

"No Pyramids, no damn Vex sieges," the peddler ranted. "Hell, even the Fallen would be back wherever the hell they came from. Filthy parasites. We gotta be ready." 

"Ready for what?" 

"For us regular people to take this damn City back. The Tower thinks they own us. But I'll tell ya something: they got a hard lesson coming."

2111625436.flavor: "The prospect of a future is something we have to keep in mind."
2111625436.source: Source: The Edge of Fate Activities
2111625436.lore:
"H-hello?" Saint-14 asked, poking his head into the dimly lit workshop. No one answered.  

He stepped over a crate in the doorway and was forced to push past a workbench turned on its side to enter the room.  

"Ana?"  

Still nothing. 

Cables hung like cobwebs from above, catching against his helmet. He brushed them away and barely missed a pile of stepper motors before tripping on an open container, sending hardware cascading across the shop floor. 

"Whatcha doing down there?" Ana said, suddenly positioned over him. 

"I—that is—well, I was looking for you," he sputtered, standing. 

"In a bucket of batteries?" she asked with a wink and brushed the mess aside with her foot. 

"You missed tea," Saint replied carefully. "Again." 

"Oh! I am so, so sorry. I'll make it up to you later this week, I promise." 

"You said that last time." 

She patted him on the shoulder. "I know, I know. But this time, I mean it." 

"Osiris knew you might say that. But he once told you—" 

"I haven't forgotten. Here, hold this, will you?"  

She thrust an empty bag into his hands, then filled it with circuit boards and pressure sensors. 

"Ana… I'm worried." 

She hefted containers of more hardware onto his shoulders. "About Osiris? A prophecy? The City, or …?" Her voice trailed off as she disappeared outside.  

"Ana!" Saint huffed and puffed. He struggled for several minutes, desperately attempting to catch up to her as she meandered through the streets of the City.  

"I am worried about you," he panted. He finally stopped in front of Ana, careful to balance the load in his arms.  

She sighed. "I know. It… hurts like hell that Red's gone… It always will. But I've decided to focus on something just as important as my feelings." 

She motioned for Saint to turn around, and he found himself standing beside Niik and Itzelas before a crowd of eager children of all ages, including a tiny Eliksni that clung to the leg of one of Caiatl's warriors.  

"Someone needs to nurture the next generation of scientific minds. Right, Niik?" Ana finished. 

Niik nodded. "Yes. The ropes don't teach themselves linear algebra." 

Ana grinned. "OK, who's ready to make some robots dance?" she called out. Saint smiled softly as a cheer went up from the children.
2111625436.lore_zh:
“有、有人在吗？”圣人14号探头走进昏暗的工作间，无人应答。  

他跨过门廊的板条箱，不得不侧身推开一张翻倒的工作台才挤进房间。  

“阿娜？”  

依然寂静无声。 

电缆像蛛网般从天花板上垂落，勾住他的头盔。他挥手拨开线缆，刚躲过一堆步进电机，又被敞开的零件箱绊倒，五金件哗啦啦撒了满地。 

“你趴地上找什么呢？”阿娜的声音突然从头顶传来。 

“我——那个——其实在找你。”他慌忙起身，说话都结巴起来。 

“在电池堆里找？”她眨眨眼问道，用脚拨开那堆零件。 

“你错过了下午茶，”圣人谨慎地开口，“又一次的。” 

“天！我真的很抱歉。这周末一定补偿你，我保证。” 

“上次你也是这么说的。” 

她拍拍他的肩头。“知道啦知道啦，但这次是认真的。” 

“奥斯里斯早料到你会这么说。但他曾经告诉过你——” 

“我没忘。来，拿着这个，好不？”  

她把空工具袋塞进他手中，接着往里面填满了电路板和压力传感器。 

“阿娜…我很担心。” 

她又把几箱零件摞在他肩上。“担心奥斯里斯？某个预言？圣城？还是…？”她走到门外，话音渐渐消失。  

“阿娜！”圣人气喘吁吁地喊道。他挣扎了好几分钟，拼命想要追上在圣城里大街小巷中漫步的她。  

“我担心的是你。”他喘着粗气说道。他终于在阿娜面前停了下来，小心平衡着怀中的重物。  

她叹了口气。“我知道。红老大走了…这真的让我痛不欲生…永远都是。但我已经决定把精力放在与这份痛苦同等重要的事情上。” 

她示意圣人转身——他发现自己此刻正站在妮可和伊泽拉斯身旁，面前簇拥着各个年龄层的热切孩童，其中还有个小个子埃里克斯尼族正抓着一名查厄托战士的腿甲。  

“总得有人培育下一代科学人才。对吧，妮可？”阿娜把话说完。 

妮可点头。“没错。绳索可不会自己教线性代数。” 

阿娜咧嘴一笑。“好了，谁想看机器人跳舞？”她高声问道。在孩子们的欢呼声中，圣人露出了温柔的笑容。

She thrust an empty bag into his hands, then filled it with circuit boards and pressure sensors. 

"Ana… I'm worried." 

She hefted containers of more hardware onto his shoulders. "About Osiris? A prophecy? The City, or …?" Her voice trailed off as she disappeared outside.  

"Ana!" Saint huffed and puffed. He struggled for several minutes, desperately attempting to catch up to her as she meandered through the streets of the City.  

"I am worried about you," he panted. He finally stopped in front of Ana, careful to balance the load in his arms.  

She sighed. "I know. It… hurts like hell that Red's gone… It always will. But I've decided to focus on something just as important as my feelings." 

She motioned for Saint to turn around, and he found himself standing beside Niik and Itzelas before a crowd of eager children of all ages, including a tiny Eliksni that clung to the leg of one of Caiatl's warriors.  

"Someone needs to nurture the next generation of scientific minds. Right, Niik?" Ana finished. 

Niik nodded. "Yes. The ropes don't teach themselves linear algebra." 

Ana grinned. "OK, who's ready to make some robots dance?" she called out. Saint smiled softly as a cheer went up from the children.
831719979.lore_zh:
“有、有人在吗？”圣人14号探头走进昏暗的工作间，无人应答。  

他跨过门廊的板条箱，不得不侧身推开一张翻倒的工作台才挤进房间。  

“阿娜？”  

依然寂静无声。 

电缆像蛛网般从天花板上垂落，勾住他的头盔。他挥手拨开线缆，刚躲过一堆步进电机，又被敞开的零件箱绊倒，五金件哗啦啦撒了满地。 

“你趴地上找什么呢？”阿娜的声音突然从头顶传来。 

“我——那个——其实在找你。”他慌忙起身，说话都结巴起来。 

“在电池堆里找？”她眨眨眼问道，用脚拨开那堆零件。 

“你错过了下午茶，”圣人谨慎地开口，“又一次的。” 

“天！我真的很抱歉。这周末一定补偿你，我保证。” 

“上次你也是这么说的。” 

她拍拍他的肩头。“知道啦知道啦，但这次是认真的。” 

“奥斯里斯早料到你会这么说。但他曾经告诉过你——” 

“我没忘。来，拿着这个，好不？”  

她把空工具袋塞进他手中，接着往里面填满了电路板和压力传感器。 

“阿娜…我很担心。” 

她又把几箱零件摞在他肩上。“担心奥斯里斯？某个预言？圣城？还是…？”她走到门外，话音渐渐消失。  

“阿娜！”圣人气喘吁吁地喊道。他挣扎了好几分钟，拼命想要追上在圣城里大街小巷中漫步的她。  

“我担心的是你。”他喘着粗气说道。他终于在阿娜面前停了下来，小心平衡着怀中的重物。  

她叹了口气。“我知道。红老大走了…这真的让我痛不欲生…永远都是。但我已经决定把精力放在与这份痛苦同等重要的事情上。” 

她示意圣人转身——他发现自己此刻正站在妮可和伊泽拉斯身旁，面前簇拥着各个年龄层的热切孩童，其中还有个小个子埃里克斯尼族正抓着一名查厄托战士的腿甲。  

“总得有人培育下一代科学人才。对吧，妮可？”阿娜把话说完。 

妮可点头。“没错。绳索可不会自己教线性代数。” 

阿娜咧嘴一笑。“好了，谁想看机器人跳舞？”她高声问道。在孩子们的欢呼声中，圣人露出了温柔的笑容。

3926153598.name: Boomslang-4fr
3926153598.typeName_zh: 传说 线性融合步枪
3926153598.source: Source: The Edge of Fate Activities
3926153598.lore:
"How's it going with the foundry reps?" Marc asked casually. 

"It's going well," Devrim replied. "The Tex Mechanica chap is a total pillock. But the rest of them are surprisingly receptive. I think this business in the Oort Cloud has them on edge." 

Devrim continued ferrying dishes and silverware from the kitchen to the balcony, where he set a small table for two.  

"They're lucky to have you. How much longer do you think you'll be in the City?" Marc called out from the kitchen.  

Devrim parsed his response carefully. Years of long-distance partnership had taught him that there was always a question behind the question. 

"At least another six weeks," he replied. His eyes traveled from the quiet side street below to the Tower, which loomed over the City's residential quarters. "Until they've compiled all the data from the Guardian's combat reports." 

"Wow!" Marc exclaimed, emerging from the apartment with a side salad in one hand and linguine arrabbiata in the other. "That's the longest you've been home in dog's years." 

"Since just after the Red War," Devrim agreed, quietly working the cork from the bottle of sparkling wine. 

"I know better than to get used to it, though," Marc quipped. "You'll be itching to run back to the front soon enough." 

"Please don't start," Devrim sighed. Marc pretended not to hear. 

"So, I'll just have to enjoy you while I can," Marc said with resolute cheer. He sat down and held out his champagne glass. Devrim poured. 

Marc lifted his glass. "To us." 

Devrim met his eyes. In them, he saw a well of grief over all the years they had lost. The prime of their lives spent apart. Their youth wasted by missed opportunities. 

But he also saw hope for the fleeting time that remained. Faith that their love would endure through their grim winter years. To the end. 

"To us," Devrim replied. "Always."
3926153598.lore_zh:
“和铸造厂代表的谈判进行得怎么样了？”马库漫不经心地问道。 

“进行得很顺利。”德弗里姆回答道，“特克斯机械的那个家伙真是个蠢货，不过其他人倒出乎意料地配合。我觉得奥尔特云那件事让他们有些紧张。” 

德弗里姆继续从厨房往阳台上端盘子、银器和餐具，他在那里摆了一张小桌子，足够两个人用餐。  

“他们有你真是幸运。你觉得你还会在圣城里待多久？”马库的声音从厨房里传来。  

德弗里姆仔细斟酌着答话。多年的异地相守让他明白，每个问题背后都藏着另一重诘问。 

“至少还要六周。”他回答道。他的目光从楼下安静的街道扫向高耸于圣城住宅区上空的高塔。“等他们把守护者的战斗报告数据都整理完。” 

“哇！”马库惊叹道，一手端着配菜沙拉，一手托着辣味番茄意面走出套间，“这是你多年以来在家时间最长的一次。” 

“从猩红战争结束那阵算起还真是。”德弗里姆附和道，同时安静地拔着起泡酒的瓶塞。 

“不过我还没天真到会习惯这种日子。”马库打趣道，“要不了多久，你准会坐立不安地想回前线。” 

“别又开始了。”德弗里姆叹了口气。马库假装没听见。 

“所以呢，我得趁现在好好享受和你在一起的时光。”马库坚定而欢快地说道。他坐了下来，举起香槟杯。德弗里姆给他倒上酒。 

马库举起酒杯。“敬我们。” 

德弗里姆迎上他的目光。在那双眼睛里，他看到了翻涌的哀伤，为他们那些不复存在的时光。为他们那些分隔两地消磨的盛年。为他们那些因错失良机虚掷的青春。 

但他也看见了对所剩无几光阴的希冀，相信这份爱能挺过人生寒冬的信念。直至终点。 

“敬我们，”德弗里姆回应道，“一如既往。”

2973900274.name: Third Iteration
2973900274.lore:
Alone in his tent, Louis undresses until he's down to his underclothes and his old man's watch.  

Even now, magnetism is buzzing in his skin, achingly far from Human. (Did the prior two Emissaries feel this way?)  

He misses visiting his mother in summer, in the town whose name he borrowed. He misses fishing with his brother. His sister-in-law's paintings, his nephew's jokes, his niece's smile, the baby who shares his ears. Most of all, he misses returning from the lake for a meal that could only be made in their house, that could only be made by them. No one but the Yeros know the preciousness of walleye ceviche. 

Louis sits with his face in his hands. They are gone, qué Diosito los tenga en su santa gloria, and he is here.  

Grief and eternity ringing in his ears, his eyes lose focus, and briefly, he Sees. 

His niece and nephew are playing in a yard full of fireflies. He hears Ben's laugh intermingling with his own. A loon wails in the distance, and leathery smoke curls into the air. 

Louis bolts to standing.  

A thousand years ago is also right now, and in this infinite heartbeat, his loved ones are dead, and they are also alive. 'Time is not linear,' sing Louis's electrons. 'You will always be with your family on a patio in July.' 

The vision ends, and Louis lets out a long shaky breath, filled with awe. As he does, his feet silently lift off the ground. 

He startles for a moment, then surrenders, a mad grin on his face. There are miracles at intersections. Nine and Human. Dead and alive. Lime and pike.  

He leans forward for his glasses and pants and puts them on in midair, every atom in his body searing neon, and drifts out of his tent into Kepler's indigo night. Light catches on Louis's glasses as he rises, his bare feet a meter from the ground, and he tilts his head toward the stars.
2973900274.lore_zh:
路易斯独自在帐篷里褪去衣衫，最后只剩贴身内衣和那块老旧的腕表。  

即便此刻，他肌肤之下仍涌动着磁力般的躁动，与人类相去甚远得令人刺痛。（前两位使者也曾有同样感受吗？）  

他怀念夏日回乡探望母亲的小镇——那个他借用了名字的地方。怀念和兄弟垂钓的时光，怀念嫂子的画作、侄子的俏皮话、侄女的笑靥，还有那个长着和他一样耳朵的婴儿。最令他思念的，是从湖边归来时那顿只有耶罗家才做得出的晚餐，唯有他们才懂得秘制酸橘汁腌碧古鱼的珍贵。 

路易斯双手掩面而坐。他们都不在了，而他却独留人间，愿主让他们的圣洁灵魂得到安息。  

哀恸与永恒在耳畔轰鸣，他的目光逐渐涣散，刹那间，他看见了。 

侄辈们在萤火虫飞舞的院子里嬉戏。本的笑声与他的交织在一起。远处潜鸟哀鸣，皮革气味的炊烟袅袅升起。 

路易斯猛然站起。  

一千年前的时光同时存在于此刻，在这无限延伸的瞬息间，他挚爱的人们已然逝去，却也永远鲜活。“时间并非线性，”路易斯体内的电子在歌唱，“七月露台上的天伦之乐，将与你永恒共存。” 

幻象消散，路易斯颤抖着长呼一口气，眼中仍盈满惊叹。就在这瞬间，他的双脚悄然离地。 

他惊惶片刻，随即释然，脸上绽开狂喜的笑容。奇迹总在交界处诞生——玖与人类，死者与生者，酸橙与长矛。  

他俯身去抓眼镜和长裤，在半空中将它们穿戴妥当，体内的每一颗原子都灼烧成霓虹光芒，随后飘出帐篷，融入开普勒的靛蓝夜色。路易斯悬空而起时星光掠过镜片，赤足离地一米，他仰首望向群星。

1202007252.name: Whirling Ovation
1202007252.flavor: Forget the pain, forget the practice, forget the blisters under your dancing shoes. Your audience is waiting.
1202007252.lore:
Rashida ab Owain, MS, clicks her field recorder on. With it clipped to her bag's strap, this means tapping at her chest. 

The metal-and-glass thing on the ridge taps, with mechanical jerkiness, at its own. 

She scratches her head with her pen. The thing scratches the pointed lower section of its cranium. Its cranium-like structure, Rashida reminds herself.  

The thing is taller than her, shorter than an adult Eliksni. Bipedal, two arms, bilaterally symmetrical. A light bisects its cranium-like structure, its blue-white glow brighter than that of the glass in its middle. She leans forward to get a better look at its contents; again, the thing mirrors her, its fan-like crest catching the light. 

Rashida ducks her head towards her recorder, aware of every small motion she makes. "New discovery needing investigation," she mutters into it. "Mechanical or biomechanical being, suspected sentient. Clear window on the ventral side filled with some glowing matter. Maybe liquid crystal? A power source?" 

Rashida is a mechanical engineer specializing in the design and maintenance of hydroponic systems. She is in no way qualified to initiate contact with a potential second non-human species on Kepler. 

"I need… language specialists. Anthropology. Biomechanics. Programming. Holy Anomaly help us all, I need the evolutionary biologists." 

The thing takes a rocking step closer. Rashida looks it up and down.  

She steps once towards it, mimicking its motion. It points at her; she points first towards it, then towards herself, waiting for its response. 

Rashida needs experts. What she has is herself. 

"Hypothesis, testing, iteration," she murmurs, the mantra calming. "Amen."
1202007252.lore_zh:
理学硕士拉希达·阿布·欧文轻点胸前的录音设备，将它别在背包带上启动。 

那个金属与玻璃构成的物体，正以机械生硬的节奏模仿她的动作。 

她用笔挠了挠头。那个物体也抬起尖锐的颅骨下部做出相同举动。拉希达提醒自己，那只是类似颅骨的结构。  

那物体比她高些，又比成年埃里克斯尼族矮小，双足直立，双臂对称。一道蓝白光芒从它的类颅骨中央劈开，比镶嵌在躯干中部的玻璃更耀眼。她凑近观察其中流动的物质，对方立刻同步前倾，扇状头冠折射出细碎光斑。 

拉希达低头凑向录音器，每个细微动作都变得谨慎。“有新发现需紧急调查。”她对着设备低语，“疑似具备感知能力的机械或生物机械体。腹侧透明窗口内充满发光物质，可能是液体水晶？能量源？” 

拉希达是一名机械工程师，专攻水培系统的设计与维护工作。她完全不具备与开普勒上潜在第二非人类物种进行首次接触的资质。 

“我需要…语言学家、人类学家、生物机械专家、程序员。神圣异常点在上，还得有进化生物学家。” 

那物体摇晃着迈近一步。拉希达与它互相打量。  

她朝它迈出一步，模仿它的动作。它指向她；她先是指向它，又指向自己，等待着回应。 

拉希达需要专家。而她现在能依靠的只有自己。 

“假设、验证、迭代，”她低声念着这句安抚人心的咒语，“阿门。”

648595258.name: Graviton Spike
648595258.flavor: Learning a new language isn't easy.
648595258.lore:
TOP SECRET UMBRA//NOFORN 

DEPARTMENT OF EXTERNAL OBSERVATIONS 

INCIDENT REPORT 196███ 

1. (S) 051632S: Reception intercepts a radio signal from deep space.  
2. (TS) 051744S: Natural causes, random chance, and foreign interference are ruled out. Signal is tentatively classified as contact with non-human intelligence. 
3. (TS) 052012S: Via ███████-█████, Central determines that the signal is tightly focused on Department of External Observations headquarters.  
4. (U) 052015S: Response teams are scrambled to search the building. 
5. (S) 052343S: Response team Tau-4 reports localized electrical interference and noticeable drop in ambient temperature on sublevel 3. 
6. (TS) 052350S: Tau-4 reports the spontaneous manifestation of a ██████████ object in the breakroom on level 2. 
7. (TS) 052354S: Tau-4 reports that the object appears to be the receiver and cord of a telephone of unknown make, white with gold trim. The object is noted to be floating approximately 6 ft. above the floor with no discernible support. 
8. (U) 060023S: Central directs Tau-4 to move the object to a safer location. 
9. (U) 060024S: Tau-4-1 makes physical contact with the object. 
10. (TS) 060025S: The entirety of Tau-4-1's body is converted to a metallic solid (later determined to be pure niobium). 
11. (U) 060032S: Tau-4-3 attempts to move object with his service rifle.  
12. (TS) 060033S: Tau-4-3 reports that his weapon begins to twist upon contact with the object, beginning from the muzzle, but he is able to move the object without resistance. 
13. (TS) 060035S: Tau-4-3 and his service rifle are violently drawn towards the object. Tau-4-3's service rifle is twisted into a large circle, while Tau-4-3's body contorts into a shape resembling the letter "N." Tau-4-3 expires from massive bodily trauma. 
14. (S) 060038S: Remaining members of Tau-4 report that ambient temperatures continue to fall.  
15. (U) 060040S: Tau-4-2 uses a broom to move the object towards the prepared enclosure. Tau-4-2 reports no resistance. 
16. (U) 060048S: Tau-4-2 successfully moves the object into the enclosure. 
17. (TS) 060049S: Tau-4-2 is able to disengage safely from the object but reports that the broom has deformed in his grip. Examination determines that the broom is now made of solid gold. 
18. (U) 060058S: Door to enclosure is locked with multiple redundant systems. Per regulations on extended active hours, Central agrees to reconvene for discussion at 061300S.
648595258.lore_zh:
绝密级 UMBRA//禁止外传 

对外观察部 

事件报告196███ 

1. (S) 051632S：接收站截获深空无线电信号。  
2. (TS) 051744S：排除自然成因、随机干扰及外国干预，初步判定信号系与非人类智能体接触。 
3. (TS) 052012S：经███████-█████系统分析，中央确认信号精准聚焦于对外观察部总部。  
4. (U) 052015S：应急小队展开全楼搜索。

4124362340.name: Agape
4124362340.lore:
Rebecca decided she would need to live forever the first time she fell in love.  

She was eight and had just learned what a horse was. She'd never seen anything like it—muscle and glistening hide, and the long toss of a mane over a curved neck. She had been told she was too young to learn to ride—experienced the profound frustration of not being there yet. And if there was such a thing as too young, then there was such a thing as too old. It worried her when she had barely begun to learn about worry. 

How to live forever? 

Rebecca decided again she would need to live forever, that second time she fell in love. Sixteen, and a book that spun out a tale like no other, golden words to consume her mind and light up her heart. How long did it take to tell a story like that? How long to tell ten, or a hundred, more? How could anyone have all the time it would take to pour forth every ounce of the love in their heart? 

She fell in love a hundred more times, again and again. Why shouldn't she? She had too much yearning in her to keep herself to just one thing. She gathered loves like a magpie, greedy for every shining joy—shellfish and magnets, gardens and penicillin, lace and the circuit-song of quantum computing.  

Stardust.  

Rebecca gazed into the heart of the universe and all she could do was love it boundlessly—this thing to which she was barely a speck, but had made her and all her love. She did not expect to be loved in return. Indeed, she expected nothing from it, save an understanding that would unfold to her if she gave it time.  

Time—of which there was never enough. 

She was decades older and a world away from home when she found time. It came to her veiled in mathematics like glittering spiderwebs, laws of physics bent aside under the force of their own being, this thing that she had crossed the stars to study. The dark mirror by which she meant to understand her true love. 

She spun it like starlight on a drop-spindle, her own self the counterweight, rising, rising—the twist moving from hand to spindle, flesh to dark matter.  

Rebecca would love this universe until it unraveled, until there was nothing left in it to understand, no room remaining in the wet matter of her brain and the red pound of her heart. And was that not the highest duty of love—to understand better than any other?
4124362340.lore_zh:
丽贝卡初次坠入爱河时便决心永生。  

那年她八岁，刚认识马这种生物。她从未见过如此存在——肌肉在油亮皮毛下起伏，鬃毛沿着优美颈线飞扬。大人们说她年纪太小还不能学骑马，她第一次体会到“未达时机”的深切挫败。既然有“太小”之说，自然也存在“太老”。这个认知让她忧心忡忡，尽管那时她连忧虑为何物都才刚刚知晓。 

如何才能永生？ 

十六岁再度坠入爱河时，丽贝卡再次下决心她需要永生。那本奇书编织出摄人心魄的故事，鎏金文字吞噬神思，点燃心火。要耗费多少光阴才能写出这般杰作？要多少岁月才能讲述十个、百个，甚至更多这样的传奇？凡人如何能有足够时间倾尽心中汹涌的爱意？ 

她一次次地坠入爱河，百次千回。何乐不为？她满腔热望岂能困于单一事物。她如喜鹊般贪婪收集每份闪耀的欢愉——贝类与磁石，花园与青霉素，蕾丝与量子计算的电路之歌。  

星尘。  

丽贝卡凝望着宇宙核心，所能做的唯有无尽地爱着它——这个视她如尘埃却孕育了她与她全部热忱的造物。她不曾期望得到爱的回报。事实上，除了一份终将随时间显现的领悟外，她别无奢求。  

时间——永远匮乏的时间。 

当她终于寻得时间时，已离家数十载，远隔星河。那领悟裹挟着数学的轻纱降临，如闪烁蛛网，物理法则在其存在之力下弯折——这竟是她穿越群星所求索之物。那面用以洞悉真爱的暗镜。 

她将其纺作纺锤上的星光，以自身为配重不断攀升、攀升——捻转从指尖传向纺锤，血肉融进暗物质。  

丽贝卡会爱这宇宙直至其分崩离析，直至再无奥秘可解，直至她湿润的脑髓与怦跳的心脏再容不下分毫。而这，岂非爱的至高使命——比任何人都更透彻地理解？

1674692344.name: Sublimation
1674692344.flavor: A voice not quite your own.
1674692344.lore:
Illiiks could feel his flesh peeling away from the inside of his carapace. He stretched his limbs with a dry, gristly crackle. The constant pain of Ether deprivation was now a dull roar. He willed himself back into the present, where the Prime Archon addressed his House from atop the ruins of their once-Ketch. 

"…No need for the ways of the past. The shackles of Kiir-Ohn. Here, the Giver has gifted us something beyond nourishment for our bodies. It offers ascension of the spirit." 

Is nourishment not enough? Illiiks thought. Are our bodies worthless? At least we never starved under Szuurin-kel.  

"Nor did we flourish," the Prime Archon bellowed, looking directly at Illiiks. The Dreg recoiled. Had he heard that?  

"For an eon in the Drift, survival was enough. It was all," the Archon continued, turning his attention back to the larger gathering. "And survival became our way. But a new era approaches: an age of revival. For both the Giver and our House." 

The Prime Archon held aloft a glass cannister, attached to a large rebreather. It once held shining white Ether. Now it brimmed with a dimly glowing vegetal sludge: the dark matter. 

"Accept the Giver, and you will become more than a survivor. More than Eliksni."  

Later, as Illiiks lay convulsing on the ground, phosphorescent blisters bubbling up through the joints in his carapace, he felt the dark matter surge through him. Mindless. Turbid. Powerful. His hunger unsated but forgotten.  

See? Illiiks thought, in a voice not quite his own. Take what is Given, and ascend.
1674692344.lore_zh:
伊利克斯能感觉到甲壳内层的血肉正在剥离。他伸展肢体时，外壳发出干涩的碎裂声。乙太匮乏带来的持续疼痛已化作沉闷轰鸣。他强迫自己集中精神，此刻首席执政官正站在他们氏族双桅船的残骸上发表演说。 

“…不必再遵循旧日之道，不必再受基尔-奥恩的枷锁禁锢。在此，赐予者馈赠我们的不仅是肉体的养料，更是灵魂的升华。” 

养料难道不够吗？伊利克斯暗想。我们的躯体就毫无价值？至少苏林-凯尔统治时期我们从未挨饿。  

“但也从未繁荣。”首席执政官突然直视伊利克斯吼道。这名堕落者士兵吓得一缩。执政官竟能听见他的心思？  

“在大漂流纪元，生存即是全部，是唯一的意义。”执政官转回身继续向集会群众宣讲，“生存曾是我们的唯一法则。但新时代即将来临，一个属于赐予者与我们氏族的复兴时代。” 

首席执政官高举连接着大型呼吸器的玻璃罐。曾经盛放闪耀白光的乙太物质，此刻却充盈着幽暗发光的植物状淤积物：暗物质。 

“接受赐予者，你将不再只是幸存者。不再只是埃里克斯尼族。”  

后来，当伊利克斯抽搐着倒在地上时，甲壳关节处泛起荧光的脓疱，他感受到暗物质在体内奔涌。无意识、浑浊而强大。饥饿感未被满足却已遗忘。  

瞧见了吗？伊利克斯用不属于自己的声音想着，接受馈赠，即可升华。

970034755.name: Giver's Blessing
970034755.lore:
The Archon flexes his new claws. How spindly and frail they are. He looks down to examine them and is surprised to see his bottom two arms missing, docked long ago. He can still feel them, though! Thrilling. 

He laughs. The voice that issues forth has the deep resonance of an Archon. He immediately adjusts it to the reedy timbre of a Dreg. 

Next to him is another menial, who glances over suspiciously. They are both bent over an outdated Shank, repaired for the hundredth time. 

"Tell me," the Archon asks in his adopted falsetto, "what do you think of Levaszk? The new Prime Archon?" 

"So that's what you were laughing about," the other Dreg sneers. "His fascination with dark matter is insane. He's turned Aionian." 

The Archon clenches his phantom lower arms, then calms himself. "But what if he's right?" he replies. "What if Levaszk has discovered something in the dark matter?" 

"That buffoon couldn't find his rebreather with all four arms," the Dreg replies. "Now get back to work." 

The Archon picks up an awl from the workbench. "You're wrong," he says in that thin, shrill voice.  

He raises the awl above his head with both arms. "He's discovered something beyond Ether. Beyond time." 

The Archon plunges the awl into the crease between the Dreg's head and thorax plating. The weakness of the strike surprises him. He's forced to stab a dozen more times before the Dreg goes still. 

"Levaszk has the Giver's blessing," he tells the twitching corpse. "He has already ascended."
970034755.lore_zh:
执政官活动着他的新爪肢。如此纤细脆弱。低头检视时，他惊觉下方两条手臂早已截除——但幻肢仍在刺痛！这感觉令他战栗。 

他大笑出声，喉间震荡着执政官特有的浑厚共鸣。他立即调整为堕落者士兵特有的尖细声线。 

身旁的杂役投来怀疑的目光。他们正共同检修那台返修过上百次的破旧堕落者侦察机。 

“说说看，”执政官用伪装的高音问道，“你觉得新任首席执政官列瓦兹克如何？” 

“原来你在笑这个。”另一名堕落者士兵嗤之以鼻，“他对暗物质的痴迷实在疯狂，简直就是变成了艾昂人。” 

执政官攥紧不存在的下臂，强压怒火。“但如果他是对的呢？”他答道。“要是列瓦兹克真在暗物质中发现了什么？” 

“那蠢货就算伸出四臂也找不着自己的呼吸器。”堕落者士兵讥讽道，“赶紧干活。” 

执政官从工作台抄起锥子。“你错了。”他用那尖细的声音说道。  

他双手高举锥子过头顶。“他发现的东西超越了乙太，超越了时间。” 

执政官将锥子刺入堕落者士兵头部与胸甲连接的缝隙。这一击的软弱令他吃惊。他又捅了十几下，堕落者士兵才停止动弹。 

“列瓦兹克得到了赐予者的祝福，”他对着抽搐的尸体说道，“他已经飞升了。”

367772693.name: Precipial
367772693.flavor: The best night of your life is yet to come.
367772693.lore:
He doesn't exactly have the text of his thesis on hand anymore. It's stuck on one of the servers in the Central Academy, and the network connection is… poor. Nonexistent, one might say. But it's fine! Cadogan knows his own work backward and forward at this point. He knows he can hold something symbolic of the work, instead of a copy of the thesis. "Do you think a gyroscope would be appropriate?" he asks his advisor, fidgeting with nothing to hold. "I could rig one pretty easily…" 

"Easy," she tells him. "There's precedent for declaring work relevant enough for Kepler itself to serve as symbol, and you've studied the manipulation of gravity itself, such as is generated by a planetary body… You're prepared for this, Cadogan." 

He's not sure he believes her, and so goes off to see what kind of a scale model he can make out of available scraps. The—siege? Occupation?—is as boring as it is nerve-wracking, and it eases his hands and heart to have something to do.  

Hopefully they can actually hold the ceremony. The amphitheater seems so far away from here. He knows how it's supposed to be: The defense will be somber and thorough, a questioning from the Dean herself to interrogate his ideas—and then, when he has held forth to satisfaction, she will smile at him.  

Then the feast will begin, and as sober reflection turns to triumph and elation, the Dean will gift him the first of his tools as a scientist grown, crafted from the progenitor ship. Something to carry with him always. 

Cadogan imagines the weight it will have in his hands, the joy of being received by his peers amid music and dancing and the majestic spin of the stars in the sky. 

He's not there yet, he reminds himself, biting his lip. Waiting even longer would be torture. He hopes the strangers can help.
367772693.lore_zh:
他手头早已没有论文文稿。资料全留在中央学院的服务器里，而网络连接…很差。或者说根本不存在。但没关系！卡多根对自己的研究了如指掌。他知道可以用象征物代替论文副本。“您觉得陀螺仪合适吗？”他摆弄着空荡荡的双手询问导师，“我可以临时组装一个…” 

“放轻松。”她告诉他道，“早有先例认定研究本身若足够重要，连开普勒都能作为象征——而你钻研的正是行星级天体重力操控…你准备好了，卡多根。” 

他并不确信，于是去找可用废料制作比例模型。这场——围城？占领？——既令人神经紧绷又无聊透顶，有事情做反而能让双手和心灵平静些。  

但愿他们真能举行仪式。圆形剧场仿佛远在天边。他清楚流程：答辩需庄重严谨，院长本人将质询他的理论——待他充分阐述后，她会向他微笑。  

接着盛宴开始，当肃穆的沉思化为胜利的狂喜，院长会赠予他成年科学家的第一件工具，用先祖飞船残骸打造的器物。永远随身携带的珍宝。 

卡多根想象着那物件在掌心的分量，在音乐舞蹈与浩瀚星旋中被同侪接纳的欢欣。 

还没到那步，他咬着嘴唇提醒自己。继续等待无异于酷刑。他希望那些陌生人能帮上忙。

3813721211.name: Last Thursday
3813721211.lore:
Naismith edges forward, the darkness broken only by the glow of his headlamp, one hand on the wall to his right. Sheets of slime mold squeak under his boots. Water trickles loudly through narrow channels in the rock. 

Kepler's structure is riddled with canyons and caverns, still largely unexplored. All the geologists are desperately curious about them. He'll get a thesis out of this for sure. 

Only it's a lot easier to make plans than it is to inch through narrow passages so deep that ground radar couldn't map them. 

Especially when Naismith doesn't know what's making the scraping sounds behind him. 

"We have no record of any fauna down here large enough to harm someone," he reassures himself, his voice thin in the wavering light. 

The scraping gets louder. Skkkrrch-skrrch, it says, light and quick. 

Skrrrrrch. Skrch. 

Naismith pushes forward, but it's slower than he wants to, as though he's slogging through water. As though time is reluctant to pass. 

Skkkkkrrrrrrrrrchhhhh.  

The scraping sound is elongated, distorted—as if played back on a recording at half speed without pitch correction. 

Naismith breaks into a painfully slow, shuffling run. 

The narrow corridor widens abruptly just as an unseen rock catches his feet. Naismith trips, falls, smacks his head against the ground. He lifts his eyes and gazes into absolute blackness. 

It's a long moment before he understands that something isn't wrong with his vision: his headlamp is broken. It's a much shorter moment before he realizes how badly he's screwed. 

Naismith scrambles to his feet, reaching out blindly. No wall at his side to guide his way back. No light. No way to know where he is. 

Behind him, drawing closer and closer, pitch deepening into the infinite like the drop of a continental shelf… 

Skkkrchhhhhhhhhhhhh. 

In the dark, Naismith screams.
3813721211.lore_zh:
奈史密斯向前挪动，四周的黑暗唯有他头灯的光芒刺破，他一只手紧贴着右侧岩壁。靴子踩过成片的黏菌，发出吱呀声响。水流在岩缝狭窄的沟槽间淙鸣。 

开普勒的地质结构布满峡谷与洞窟，至今仍有多数区域未被勘探。所有地质学家都对这片区域充满狂热的好奇。他肯定能凭此写篇优秀论文。 

只不过制定计划远比在地质雷达都无法测绘的深邃窄道里匍匐前行要轻松得多。 

尤其是当奈史密斯听见身后传来不明刮擦声的时候。 

“没有记录显示这里存在足以伤人的大型生物。”他自我安慰道，颤抖的光圈里嗓音发虚。 

刮擦声愈发清晰。嘶咔-嘶咔，轻快急促。 

嘶咔。咔。 

奈史密斯加速前进，动作却比预期迟缓，仿佛在深水中跋涉。仿佛连时间都不愿流逝。 

嘶——咔——  

刮擦声被拉长扭曲，如同半速播放却未修正音调的录音。 

奈史密斯跌跌撞撞地开始奔跑，步伐迟缓得令人揪心。 

狭窄的甬道突然开阔时，一块未被看见的岩石绊住了他的脚。他重重摔倒，头颅撞击地面发出闷响。待他抬起眼睛，视野里只剩下纯粹的黑暗。 

他花了很长时间才明白不是视力出了问题：头灯坏了。而他意识到处境危急所用的时间则短的多。 

奈史密斯手脚并用爬起来，在黑暗中胡乱摸索。身侧没有墙壁指引退路，没有光源，没有办法知道他在哪里。 

在他身后，如大陆架陡然陷落般深邃无底的漆黑正不断迫近… 

嘶咔咔咔咔。 

在黑暗中，奈史密斯发出了尖叫。

2647299044.name: Moirai
2647299044.lore:
Dinosaurs. 
Neanderthals. 
The Roman Empire. 
Abraham Lincoln. 
The USSR. 
The United States of America. 
The President. 
Dance halls. 
Football. 
Record stores. 
Game shows. 
My whole family. Every one of them:
My brother Ben. 
My sister-in-law Fernanda. 
My niece Betty. 
My nephews, Phillip, Benito. 
My mother, who taught me English. 
Opa and Oma, who taught me German. 
My father, who taught me Spanish. 
Gone. Gone. Now I'm the only one who knows their names. 
I have to remember the others. As many people as possible.  
There's no one else alive who can. 
Teresa, who taught me Polish behind the bleachers after football practice.  
My high school French teacher, who called my parents to ask them how I was confusing Polish with French. 
All those boys in basic. 
All those boys on the base. 
Frankie, Enzo, Michal, and Walter.  
All those folks we flew over.  
All the ones Frankie missed. 
Master Sgt. Grant, who gave me a new life. 
Moscow's finest inadvertent Russian tutors, who should have checked their phone lines more carefully. 
Mrs. Rodriguez on the third floor, who always brought tamales for Christmas. 
Fellini. 
Watson. Ginger. 
…Hypatia. 
The victims at Les Diablerets. 
The neighbor kid who gave me that great Cambodian psychedelic record in exchange for helping his parents with their taxes. 
The woman in yellow who gave me her number dancing at Latin Night at the Mirador.  
(It's still in my pants pocket. Her name was Rosario… Cosas así, sólo me pasan a mí…) 
Hundreds of cities.  
Thousands of languages. 
Millions of species. 
Billions upon billions of human lives. 

Ben. 
Ben.
2647299044.lore_zh:
恐龙。 
尼安德特人。 
罗马帝国。 
亚伯拉罕·林肯。 
苏联。 
美利坚合众国。 
总统。 
舞厅。 
橄榄球。 
唱片店。 
综艺节目。 
我的全家。每一个人：
我的兄弟本。 
我的嫂子费尔南达。 
我的侄女贝蒂。 
我的侄子们，菲利普、贝尼托。 
我的母亲，她教我英语。 
外公和外婆，他们教我德语。 
我的父亲，他教我西班牙语。 
消逝了。消逝了。如今只有我记得他们的名字。 
我必须记住其他人。越多越好。  
世上已再没有其他活人能做到。 
特蕾莎，她在橄榄球训练后的看台后教我波兰语。  
我的高中法语老师，她打电话问我父母为什么我会把波兰语和法语搞混。 
新兵营的所有小伙。 
基地里的所有小伙。 
弗兰基、恩佐、米哈尔和沃尔特。  
所有我们飞越的人们。  
所有弗兰基错过的人。 
格兰特军士长，他给了我新生。 
莫斯科最优秀的俄语导师们，他们真该好好检查电话线路。 
三楼的罗德里格斯太太，她每年圣诞节都会送玉米粽。 
费里尼。 
沃森。金杰。 
…希帕蒂娅。 
莱迪亚布勒雷的遇难者们。 
那个邻居家孩子，他送我一张绝佳的柬埔寨迷幻唱片，以答谢我帮他父母报税。 
在米拉多尔夜店拉丁之夜共舞的黄裙女子，她把电话号码塞进我口袋。  
（至今仍在我裤袋里。她叫罗萨里奥…这种事啊，只会发生在我身上…） 
数百座城市。  
数千种语言。 
数百万物种。 
数十亿的人类生命。 

本。 
本。

1781607626.name: Moirai
1781607626.lore:
Dinosaurs. 
Neanderthals. 
The Roman Empire. 
Abraham Lincoln. 
The USSR. 
The United States of America. 
The President. 
Dance halls. 
Football. 
Record stores. 
Game shows. 
My whole family. Every one of them:
My brother Ben. 
My sister-in-law Fernanda. 
My niece Betty. 
My nephews, Phillip, Benito. 
My mother, who taught me English. 
Opa and Oma, who taught me German. 
My father, who taught me Spanish. 
Gone. Gone. Now I'm the only one who knows their names. 
I have to remember the others. As many people as possible.  
There's no one else alive who can. 
Teresa, who taught me Polish behind the bleachers after football practice.  
My high school French teacher, who called my parents to ask them how I was confusing Polish with French. 
All those boys in basic. 
All those boys on the base. 
Frankie, Enzo, Michal, and Walter.  
All those folks we flew over.  
All the ones Frankie missed. 
Master Sgt. Grant, who gave me a new life. 
Moscow's finest inadvertent Russian tutors, who should have checked their phone lines more carefully. 
Mrs. Rodriguez on the third floor, who always brought tamales for Christmas. 
Fellini. 
Watson. Ginger. 
…Hypatia. 
The victims at Les Diablerets. 
The neighbor kid who gave me that great Cambodian psychedelic record in exchange for helping his parents with their taxes. 
The woman in yellow who gave me her number dancing at Latin Night at the Mirador.  
(It's still in my pants pocket. Her name was Rosario… Cosas así, sólo me pasan a mí…) 
Hundreds of cities.  
Thousands of languages. 
Millions of species. 
Billions upon billions of human lives. 

Ben. 
Ben.

3400283633.name: Assassin's Cowl
3400283633.flavor: Now you see me. Now you don't.
3400283633.lore:
"There are many Hunters who are unsung heroes. Many are unnamed. Many are known only by a glint of metal half a mile away and the crack that echoes across the canyon after their enemy falls. Others are known only by a muffled cry and the flash of a knife in the dark.

"Warlocks and Titans have their orders, but that is not our way. Hunters walk apart, separate from each other as much as from other Guardians. That is our way.

"And yet we share traditions. We share stories. We share… secrets.

"Killing is a dangerous and dirty business, be it from as far as an angel's perch or as close as a lover's embrace.

"When you get close, you need something like this.

"Unsung. Unnamed. Unseen.

"Remember these words. Repeat them to whoever follows you."

—Words of an unidentified Hunter, overheard as the Assassin's Cowl was passed to another unidentified Hunter
3400283633.lore_zh:
“有许多猎人都是未曾被传唱的英雄。许多人没有留下名姓。许多人只能通过半英里外的金属闪光，以及在敌人倒下后峡谷中回响的断裂声来留下自己的身名。其他人只能通过低沉的哭喊和黑暗中刀刃的闪光而留下身名。”

“术士和泰坦有他们的秩序，但那不是我们的道路。猎人们会四散开来，与其他人分道而行，也避开其他守护者。那是我们的道路。”

“我们分享着传统。我们分享着故事，我们也分享着……秘密。”

“杀戮是危险而肮脏的生意，远如天使的栖所，近若情人的拥抱。”

“当你靠的足够近，你需要这个。”

“无歌。无名。无形。”

“记住这些话。把这些话重复给跟随你的人听。”

——来自一位不具身份的猎人话语，在刺客风帽被传递给另一名不具身份的猎人时为人所闻。

2574019120.name: Mechaneer's Tricksleeves
2574019120.flavor: "This won't end well for one of us. And darling, it won't be me." —Self-styled "Lady" Olu Alderdice
2574019120.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2574019120.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2574019120.lore:
Attention, esteemed patrons of the Seven Stars! We are a semi-respectable business here. Until now, we've only had three or four rules, barring any newly invented misdeeds of which we are yet to be made aware. Unfortunately, we are forced to increase our rules by two. 

Four (or five): Olu Alderdice is heretofore banned from our establishment. 
Five (or six, who's counting): Alderdice's inventions are also forbidden. Anyone found to be in possession of devices such as, but not limited to, spring-razor petticoats, electrified fascinators, sidearm tricksleeves, or arsenic lipstick will be introduced to our bouncer. Who is a Titan. A very big one. Named Karl. 

Thank you for your understanding, and please enjoy your stay. Unless you're Olu Alderdice. Go away, Olu.
2574019120.lore_zh:
尊敬的七星金主们请注意！我们是一家声誉一般的商业公司。到现在为止，我们也只有三四条规则，且容忍我们意识到的新出现的任何错误。然而，我们被迫要求再加两条规则。

第四（或是第五）：欧卢·奥德黛丝在我们建立之前已经被加入黑名单了。
第五（或是第六，谁还数这个）：奥德黛丝的发明也被禁止。任何拥有以下，且不仅限于以下的装置，请交给我们的保安：弹簧刀片女士裙、电气化头巾、藏有手枪的怪异袖子、砒霜唇膏等。我们的保安叫做卡尔，是一位高大的泰坦。

谢谢您的理解，并祝您购物愉快。除了欧卢·奥德黛丝。欧卢，一边儿去！

368733543.name: Raiden Flux
368733543.flavor: Interfaces with synapses (or nearest equivalent) to draw electric power directly from the wearer's body.
368733543.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
368733543.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
368733543.lore:
"It's hard, in this age, for any warrior to find their inner peace. Our constant state of struggle breeds chaos, in the world and in our hearts. The Raiden Flux channels that chaos, regulates it by mapping and defining the wearer's true spiritual center. It is science merged with belief and the healing power of one's own natural energies. But there is more. The Raiden Flux is an amplifier of those energies. It seeks the spark in you and bolsters its charge, redirecting your innermost power that it may serve as an extension of your will. The staff then acts as a conduit through which one may forcibly deliver peace when such action is required. This seems a contradiction, to be sure. It is not. Because at its heart, peace defines war and peace is war's end." 

– Gao Sinyada, forger of the Raiden Flux
368733543.lore_zh:
“在这个年代，战士们要找到内心的平静很难。在世界及我们的内心，战斗和混乱永不休止。雷电通流引导混沌，通过映射和定义穿着者的真实精神中心进行调节。它是一种融合了信仰和自身治愈力量的科技。实际上还要更多。雷电通流将这些力量放大，发掘并强化你的闪光之处，重定向你内在的力量，这些力量可能就是意志的延伸。当进行此行为时，人们将作为媒介，实现强制和平。看起来有些矛盾，但实际上并不。因为其核心是，和平界定战争，和平是战争的终点。”

——雷电通流制造者，高信雅达

368733541.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

"Know thy self." —second dictate, first calling, The Hidden 
"Destroy thy self." —third dictate, first calling, The Hidden

"Embrace a new skin." —fifth dictate, first calling, The Hidden

671504994.name: Foetracer
671504994.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
671504994.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
671504994.lore: I thought I was dead. Held my own for bit, but I could hear the Wizard wasn't alone and she'd be coming for whoever took out her spawn. It was just lying there, honestly. Looked like a standard old Outrider kit, but it had this rig, enough small diamond conduits to make me think it was something pulled out of those old Bray labs in the MNP. I don't just go putting things on my head, but I was desperate. Not sure what activated the thing, but sure enough there she was. I already had a lock on her, and once I engaged, there was nowhere she could hide.
671504994.lore_zh: 我以为我快死了。我硬撑了一阵子，但我听到巫师不止一个，她想来向杀死她孩子的人报仇。老实说，它就在那里。看起来像是一件老旧的标准护卫装备，但是上面有一个装置像小钻石导管一样，让我觉得它是从那些MNP的旧布雷实验室里弄出来的东西。我一般不会胡思乱想，但当时我已经绝望了。不知道光能是不是能激活它，但她就在面前。我已经锁定了她，只要进入战斗，她就无处可藏了。

2405271938.name: Orpheus Rig
2405271938.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2405271938.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2405271938.lore:
Quantis Rhee has almost forgotten what colors are. For months, she has prowled the deep, shadowed catacombs of Nessus—the places where the inexorable Vex burrowed into the rogue planet and replaced natural life with a cold, inhuman labyrinth. 

Light is scarce in this place. But Quantis knows how to find it—how to feel for the un-ripples of the Void, to draw Light from the infinities between spaces. She knows how to roll black holes between her fingertips, and how to nock her bow with the inescapable gravities of the universe. 

Soon Quantis will leave this place, return to the City, report her findings. See colors again. But that won't last long. She is a Nightstalker. Out here—balanced upon the infinitesimal knife's edge—is where she truly belongs.
2405271938.lore_zh:
奎提斯·李几乎已经忘记颜色是什么。几个月里，她都在涅索斯地下阴暗的墓穴内徘徊——Vex惊人地在这个游离星球上挖掘藏身之地，用冰冷非人的迷宫取代自然的生活。

这个地方的光线很稀少。但是奎提斯知道如何找到它——如何感知虚空涟漪，在空间的极限中吸引光能。她知道如何在她的指尖之间翻转黑洞，并用宇宙中无处不在的重力拉开她的弓弦。

奎提斯将离开这个地方，回到圣城，并报告她的发现。又可以重见色彩了。不过不会持续很久。她是一名夜潜。在这之外，在极微的刀尖上穿梭，是她真正的归属。

2405271937.name: St0mp-EE5
2405271937.flavor: "I call them the Stompies! For when your legs need that extra kick." —Marcus Ren
2405271937.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2405271937.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2405271937.lore:
"Marcus, what—" 
"You're here! Finally! Get over here and hold this gun—" 
"Right down to business, huh?" 
"I will put these legs on—" 
"What are these? Frosties 2.0?" 
"No! They're completely different."  
"Uh-huh." 
"OK, they share some similarities. But these are the Stompies. I'm going to do a test-drive, and if they rip my legs off—" 
"Is that likely?" 
"You disintegrate me quick before the rogue mechasynapses spread—" 
"WHAT—" 
"Boaz, please. I thought you wanted to help?" 
"But shooting you? And I don't even get Crucible glory for it?" 
"I'll let you win the next race." 
"Cute." 
"C'mon. If you won't do it, I'll ask Ariadne. She'd love to shoot me."  
"Fine. Gimme the gun." 
"Thank you! Stompies Field Test One is go." 
"I might actually enjoy this." 
"That's the spirit."
2405271937.lore_zh:
“马库斯，什么——”
“你终于来了！快过来，拿上这把枪——”
“开始干活儿了，哈？”
“我要把这些腿甲装上——”
“这些是什么型号？冰冻2.0吗？”
“不！完全不一样。”
“呃啊。”
“好吧，还是有相似之处的。这些是小踩踩。我准备要试试它们了，要是它们把我的腿扯下来——”
“还有这种可能？”
“在异常机甲突触扩散之前把我拆掉——”
“什么——”
“波资，拜托。我以为你愿意帮我呢。”
“但要射你？这样我又拿不到熔炉竞技场荣耀。”
“下次比赛让你赢。”
“好哒。”
“快，你要不帮我，我就去找阿里阿德涅了。她可愿意射我了。”
“……好吧。把枪给我。”
“谢谢！小踩踩实地测试一，开始。”
“我会享受这过程的。”
“这才对嘛。”

2132672800.name: Gemini Jester
2132672800.flavor: "I love making people laugh. And by 'people,' I mean me. Haha!" "Haha! Me!"
2132672800.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2132672800.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2132672800.lore: He quietly giggled as he stood blocking my exit, almost as if to taunt me. I start to push my way past but the blasted fool pulls hard on my ear, swiftly takes a step back, and presents his rump in a jesting dance. Not willing to get pulled into his game, I ignore his blatant attempts at a farce and continue forward. Abrupt shrills of frenzied laughter break out as I feel the full force of his boot on my backside. I cannot ignore his flagrant mockery. I reel around, take hold of his collar and clock him full force. Behind me, in the distance, I hear hysterical laughter. Confused, I whirl my head back to see a jaunty man skipping off. I look back at my hands to find them empty. That jester has taken me for a fool.
2132672800.lore_zh: 他窃笑着挡住我的去路，几乎像是要嘲讽我一般。我开始挤过身去，但那该死的蠢货拽住我的耳朵，快速向后退了一步，然后开玩笑似的扭着屁股冲我跳起了舞。我不想被他牵着鼻子走，就没把他的胡闹当回事儿，继续向前走。我感觉到屁股上被人踹了一脚，身后爆发出疯狂的大笑声。我不能再放纵他明目张胆地愚弄我了。我转过身，揪住他的衣领，狠狠地给了他一记。我听见身后远远传来失控的狂笑。我很疑惑，转头望去，只见一个满心欢喜的家伙溜走了。我的双手已是空空如也。那个小丑把我当白痴在耍。

3642110725.name: Ophidia Spathe
3642110725.flavor: Listen carefully when the serpent speaks, for its tongue is forked, and its words have two meanings.
3642110725.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3642110725.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3642110725.lore:
Hunter,

You are the blade. 
You are balance. You cut through the air with poise and grace. 
Your hands are quick. Your feet are light. 
You strike like silent lightning. 
Your light shines like a glistening edge in the sun. 

You are the snake. 
You are level and silent. You move with purpose. 
Your enemies feel fear in your presence. 
Your fangs are sharp and quick. 
Your eyes are clear and your wrath is blinding. 

You are the blade. You are the snake. 

Strike. Shimmer. Survive.
3642110725.lore_zh:
猎人，

你是利刃。
你是平衡。你以自信而优雅的身姿划过空气。
你的双手灵活自如，你的双脚动若轻云。
你的攻击仿佛无声的闪电。
你的光能如太阳边缘一般闪耀。

你是巨蟒，
你悄无声息，伏地而行；你的行动自有目的。
敌人对你的身影惊恐不定。
你的毒牙迅猛锐利，
你的双目明亮清晰，你的愤怒令人昏聩。

你是利刃，你是巨蟒。

出击，闪耀，敌亡我存。

3721047650.name: Wormhusk Crown
3721047650.flavor: We strive to know infinity, and sharpen our minds on the whetstone of the impossible.
3721047650.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3721047650.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3721047650.lore:
I: A MIND LIKE A BLADE 

The second son. The disowned. Spawned into this world as a lesser being, so unlike the warrior-son, Crota. But one must not only sharpen their blade. 

Behold Nokris. 

A mind can also be a weapon. There is power in wisdom, in knowledge. 

There is much to be known. And he would know all. 

The ageless volumes and apocrypha, all consumed voraciously, feeding the mind of the lesser. Driven by a different kind of Sword Logic, he let the stories of the world fill the void just as the worm feeds. 

From the womb of unholy knowledge, Nokris's plan was born. He knew his strength lies in his mind, in his magic. But how to prove himself to his father, the proud, dreadful demon-warrior? 

Nokris is not the first. 

He sought power. He sought knowledge. He sought the worm.
3721047650.lore_zh:
I：利刃思想

次子，不被认同的子臣。生于此世，犹若草芥，与战士之子克洛塔大相径庭。但仅仅磨光利刃是不够的。

看呐，诺克里斯。

思想也能成为武器，智慧与知识中也存在力量。

要学习的还有很多，而他将习得一切。

永恒的书卷和伪书，被如饥似渴地啖食殆尽，哺喂着草芥之子的心灵。他受到别样邪剑守则的驱使，效仿虫神，将这个世界的故事填入虚空。

就在邪识的发源地中，诺克里斯的计划诞生了。他深知力量蕴藏在自己的思想中，在自己的魔法中。但他如何向父亲，向那自负可怖的恶魔战士证明自己呢？

诺克里斯并非第一个。

他追寻力量，他探求智慧，他寻觅虫神。

He sought power. He sought knowledge. He sought the worm.
917501872.lore_zh:
I：利刃思想

次子，不被认同的子臣。生于此世，犹若草芥，与战士之子克洛塔大相径庭。但仅仅磨光利刃是不够的。

看呐，诺克里斯。

思想也能成为武器，智慧与知识中也存在力量。

要学习的还有很多，而他将习得一切。

永恒的书卷和伪书，被如饥似渴地啖食殆尽，哺喂着草芥之子的心灵。他受到别样邪剑守则的驱使，效仿虫神，将这个世界的故事填入虚空。

就在邪识的发源地中，诺克里斯的计划诞生了。他深知力量蕴藏在自己的思想中，在自己的魔法中。但他如何向父亲，向那自负可怖的恶魔战士证明自己呢？

诺克里斯并非第一个。

他追寻力量，他探求智慧，他寻觅虫神。

"…I can work with this."
3883286570.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3883286570.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3883286570.lore:
The Sword of Galanor: A Selected Bibliography

"The Blade of Cutting Flame," The Folktales of Mars, ed. Hoell Gar.

"…and in the center of the pool was a creature of bronze and rust, with the head of a lizard and the body of a Human. Rust had fixed it in a position of supplication, with Galanor upon its upraised palms…"

"The Alliterative Galanor," Engram Orion 23.3.6.

"…beneath the weeping way he waded/ face full of fire and fleeting fever/ as he gazed upon the gleaming Galanor…"

A Theory of Golden Age Supermetals. Vivian Weyland.

"…a means of printing sheets of carbon fiber threaded with veins of superhot liquid metal, resulting in a heat-conductive material that is still highly durable. Though its existence is generally accepted, the means by which it can be created or repaired are still lost to us…"

"Analysis of Venusian Salvage Dindrane-43-59," Cryptarch Yareli.

"…an experimental satellite probe capable of entering the upper mantle of yellow stars, called Galaxy North, or known by the abbreviation GalaNor…"
3883286570.lore_zh:
北银河之剑：精选文献

“斩炎之刃”，火星民间故事，作者：赫尔·加。

“……在水池中央的是一个锈迹斑斑的生物铜像，拥有蜥蜴的脑袋和人类的身体。锈蚀将它的身体固定为祷告状，双手举起托着北银河……”

“北银河的诗”，猎户座记忆水晶23.3.6.

“……他一路走来，只见哀鸿遍野/遍地野火热浪阵阵袭来/当他凝视着闪闪发光的北银河……”

黄金时代超级金属理论。薇薇安·韦兰德。

“……一种用碳纤维薄片来承载超高温液态金属，以此制成的导热材料拥有超强耐久性能。虽然它的存在已被大众知晓，但我们仍然无法创造或修复它……”

“这是金星回收装置狄茵特兰-43-59的分析”，解密大师亚雷丽说到。

“……一个能够进入黄星上地幔的实验卫星探测器，名叫北银河系，或者简称为北银河……”

3883286571.name: Oathkeeper
3883286571.flavor: "I have not yet met my true death." —Sjur Eido, First Queen's Wrath
3883286571.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3883286571.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3883286571.lore:
"This was on her body, Your Grace."

A strange coin lay at the center of Abra's outstretched palm. Mara took it between thumb and forefinger and held up it to the cosmos with dainty contempt.

Weregild, she thought. Powerful grief filled her chest, as thick and caustic and heavy as unset concrete.

"And her bow?"

"Gone."

"Huginn? Muninn?"

"The Ahamkara are dead, and their bones are silent. But Petra Venj has—"

"Who?"

"A Corsair. Recently titled."

"…She is a CHILD."

Paladin Zire flinched as if slapped. "My Queen. Our spies in the House of Judgment tell us the Wolves plan to attack Hygiea next. I loved Sjur, as I love all we have lost, and I grieve her. But if we divert our attention now to vengeance against an unknown enemy…"

Mara put down the coin and allowed herself a small, humorless smile. "Then let it be my diversion."
3883286571.lore_zh:
“这是在她尸体上找到的，我的女王。”

阿布拉伸出手掌，一枚奇特的硬币映入眼帘。玛拉用拇指和食指夹住硬币，带着眼睛微屈将它举向空中。

她想，这是抚恤金吧。她的心中充满了强烈的悲痛，厚重、焦灼、沉痛，如未凝固的混凝土。

“她的弓呢？”

“不见了。”

“休津呢？缪宁呢？”

“阿罕卡拉都死了，他们的骨头也都沉寂了。不过佩特拉·万吉——”

“谁？”

“一个海盗军，刚刚入行。”

“……她不过是个孩子。”

圣骑士齐雷像被打了一耳光似的畏缩起来。“我的女王，我方安插在审判氏族的间谍回报，恶狼下一步要进攻健神星。我爱苏尔，我爱那些失去了的人，她的离去让我悲痛万分。不过如果我们现在将注意力用在向一个未知的敌人复仇……”

玛拉放下硬币，冷峻的面容挤出一丝严肃的微笑，“我不介意为此耽误些时间。”

1168370782.lore:
FROM THE DIARY OF HIMURA SHINOBU

I've deleted my previous entry. All I'll say about it is—

Only one thing scares me more than dying, and that's dying inside these walls.

But I made a promise to my home.

I took the three new Guardians for a tour of the tallwalk today. Two of them are blue. Actually, truly blue. I can't stop staring. Their names are Therin Vai and Nadiya. The third is an Exo, Lee-4.

Therin noticed my staring and laughed at me.

"Never seen anyone this good-looking before, have you?"

"Never seen anyone blue," I said.

Therin tried to explain about Awoken. He didn't know much. He doesn't remember anything since becoming a Guardian.

"Then how do Guardians pick their names?" I asked.

According to Therin, Exo Guardians usually remember their names, but that's it. Awoken and Human Guardians remember nothing, so they just pick new names.

So I asked them why they chose theirs. Therin puffed out his chest—his armor looked like it had once been really fancy, but it was scuffed and dirty from the road—and said, "Because it sounds awesome! Remember the name Therin Vai—it's the name of the Guardian who will find the lost Warmind Rasputin!"

When he said that, Lee-4 managed to look exhausted, which is impressive for an Exo.

Therin talked about Rasputin and the Baikonur for a while, so to sidetrack him I asked Nadiya where her name came from. But she just rolled her eyes. "I don't think Micah's paying me to chitchat."

"You're getting paid?" Therin said.

Lee-4 elbowed him hard.

"Ow! What was that for?"

"To remind you why we're here," said Lee-4. It was practically the first thing I'd heard her say.

"Why are you here?" I asked.

She fixed her electric eyes on me. "Old debts."

"To Micah?"

"No."

Nadiya slouched against the tallwalk parapet, her head flung back to hang over the side. I thought about pushing her over. "Good luck with that, whatever that means," said Nadiya. "I'm all about new debts. Preferably other people's debts to me."

Just then Lee-4 swung the sniper rifle off her shoulder so fast it almost cracked Nadiya in the head. Lee-4 fitted the scope to her eye and held the weapon perfectly still, without even leaning the barrel against the wall. A pause filled only by Nadiya's complaints—and then Lee fired off a shot.

On the horizon I saw a shadow fall.

"Fallen?" said Therin.

"Kings," Lee confirmed.
1168370782.lore_zh:
来自忍野绯村的日记

我已经删除了之前的记录。我想说的是——

只有一件事比死更让我害怕，就是在这些墙里死掉。

不过我向家人许下了承诺。

今天我带着三个新守护者去参观了高道。其中两个人是蓝色的，是那种真正的纯蓝色，我忍不住盯着看。他们一个叫索林·怀依，一个叫纳迪亚。第三位是一个Exo，名叫李-4。

索林发现我在盯着他们看，冲着我笑。

“从来没见过这么好看的人，是吧？”

“没见过蓝色的这么好看的”，我说道

索林试着解释什么是觉醒者。他知道的不多，成为守护者之后，以前的事情他都记不得了。

“守护者都怎么给自己起名字呢？”我问他。

据索林所说，Exo守护者会记住自己的名字，但也只有名字而已。觉醒者和人类守护者什么都不记得，所以他们就起个新名字。

我问他们是怎么给自己起名的。索林挺起胸膛——我发现他的护甲看起来曾经非常精美，但是已有些破损，还溅上了不少泥土——他说：“因为听起来很炫啊！请记住这个名字，索林·怀依——这位守护者将会找回失落的战争思维拉斯普廷！”

当他说出这些话的时候，李-4露出了一副“真受不了”的表情，作为Exo来说，还真是让人印象深刻。

索林又聊了会儿关于拉斯普廷和拜科努尔的事情，为了转移话题，我转而问纳迪亚她名字的由来。不过她只是转了转眼珠说：“我觉得米迦花钱雇我们来可不是为了闲聊的。”

“你收钱来的？”索林问。

李-4狠狠地给了他一记肘击。

“疼！你干嘛？”

“提醒你我们为什么要来这里”，李-4说道。那是我听到她说的第一句话。

“你们来这里做什么？”我问他们。

她用电子眼一动不动地盯着我。“旧账。”

“跟米迦有关？”

“不”。

纳迪亚懒洋洋地靠在高道旁的栏杆上，头向后仰在另一边。我真想把她掀翻过去。“祝你们好运吧，不管你说的旧账是什么意思”，纳迪亚说。“我只关心新的债务，最好是别人欠我的债。”

就在这时，李-4迅速地把狙击步枪从她肩膀上拽了下来，差点磕到纳迪亚的头。李-4的眼睛顶着狙击镜，举着枪纹丝不动，也没有将枪管架在墙上。纳迪亚抱怨了一句，紧接着李开了一枪。

我看见远处有个阴影倒了下去。

“堕落者？”索林问。

“国王氏族”，李确认地说。

1168370783.name: Gwisin Vest
1168370783.flavor: "The Traveler called me back. Told me my work on this side isn't done yet." —Seong-Do Whiteclaw
1168370783.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1168370783.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1168370783.lore_zh:
我们没法杀死自我；
生命也没有终结。
是别人做出的选择；
是那个曾经的自己。
我们复生，与他们划清界限，对他们采取行动。
我们不能被表象所迷惑，仿佛我们是幽魂：
我们从太阳中来。
带上你们的机灵——
破除生命的循环；
向那些杀死你的人复仇。

4175277987.lore_zh:
我们没法杀死自我；
生命也没有终结。
是别人做出的选择；
是那个曾经的自己。
我们复生，与他们划清界限，对他们采取行动。
我们不能被表象所迷惑，仿佛我们是幽魂：
我们从太阳中来。
带上你们的机灵——
破除生命的循环；
向那些杀死你的人复仇。

2749457084.name: Liar's Handshake
2749457084.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2749457084.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2749457084.lore:
While Otto and I finish up inside, Thalia covers the lookout.

He's a thin, quick shadow, this lookout, and he watches every angle. He listens for every sound. He's on his toes, ready to throw up the alarm the second he sees one little thing out of place.

Guy like that sees everything, but he doesn't see Thalia.

She comes out of the shadows like a ghost, but steps full into the light, because now she wants to be seen. She waits a second too long for my liking—gives him too much breathing room between the reveal and her first punch. But I shouldn't doubt her. He doesn't even have time to bring his hands up. He's fast, but she's faster.

She throws herself into every punch like it's her last, dodges and ducks his blows like a dancer. Scariest of all, she bares her teeth in this nasty smile while she does it. Doesn't make a sound.

So that's the last thing the lookout sees: her silent, grinning face, as her cross-counter reveals a hidden knife that slides smoothly into the soft flesh under his chin.

Never touches a gun, that girl. She likes to get close. Likes to look right in their eyes and be the last thing they see.

Thalia lets him drop, wipes her knife clean on her sleeve, and raises her hand for Ayrin. Go, man, go.
2749457084.lore_zh:
当奥托和我终于赶到的时候，塔利亚正在对付这个望风的人。

他是个瘦弱、行动迅速的盯梢人。这位望风者扫视着每个角落，聆听着每个声响。他保持着警觉，随时准备好在看到有什么东西出现的时候拉响警报。

这个家伙看到了一切，除了塔利亚。

她像个幽灵一样从阴影中出现，完全暴露在亮处，因为现在她想让他看见自己。她等了一秒钟，我觉得有点久——这给了他在反应过来和她出第一拳之间足够的缓神时间。但我不应该怀疑她。他手都没举起来。他很快，但显然她更快。

她出的每一拳都用力得像是最后一拳，自己却像个舞者一般躲避着他的拳头。最可怕的是，她这么做的时候竟然咧嘴露出让人讨厌的笑容，甚至安静得出奇。

当她交叉反击拳后隐藏的匕首流畅划过他脖子的时候，望风者最后看到的是她安静、龇牙咧嘴的脸。

那个女孩从不用枪。她喜欢近距离交战，喜欢直视他们的眼睛，成为他们人生的最后一幅画面。

塔利亚任他跌落，用自己的袖子将匕首擦拭干净，然后为艾润举起她的手。走好，兄弟，走好。

2177224557.name: The Bombardiers
2177224557.flavor: "Tallulah Fairwind never turns down a dare." —Tallulah Fairwind
2177224557.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2177224557.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2177224557.lore:
"It's Saint-14's idea more than mine," the Speaker said.

Tallulah leaned against the wall, her arms tightly crossed. "That guy has a lot of ideas, seems like."

"Would you consider it?"

She tilted her head to look at the sky, as if imploring the Traveler for patience. "Listen," she said, and dropped her chin again. "Organizing all the Hunters in the system doesn't make sense. The whole idea of being a Hunter is about…" She struggled to find the right word.

"Disorganization?" the Speaker supplied dryly.

"Ha ha." There was no amusement in the laughter. "It's about freedom. Independence. You look like a Warlock, so you wouldn't understand."

The Speaker smiled behind his mask. "Right," he said. "But I've seen you with the others. You've brought other Hunters together, and to great effect. The rescue effort you took to Old Russia, for instance. Or the supply recovery you've been doing with Tav and Venra. There is something to be said about solitary people coming together, working as one…"

"Don't try to make this poetic," Tallulah said. "And we're not solitary. Independent doesn't mean solitary."

The Speaker held up his hand. "You're right," he said. "But if the Warlocks have representation in Osiris, and the Titans in Saint-14, I feel the Hunters deserve some as well. And you're a strong candidate."

"Are there others?" Tallulah said, sobering a little. When the Speaker shrugged, she straightened her shoulders, then tried to shrug it off as well. "I don't know. I'm not sure I have time for… logistical stuff."

"Well, I thought you might be up for the challenge," the Speaker said. "Because it would be a challenge, given your schedule. A daring endeavor, even."

Tallulah was suddenly dead serious. "So it's a dare, Speaker?"

"It might be."
2177224557.lore_zh:
“这更多是圣人14号的主意，不是我的主意。”先知说道。

塔鲁靠在墙上，双臂交叉。“看起来，那个家伙有很多主意。”

“你会考虑吗？”

她歪了歪头，看着天空，好像是在恳求旅行者耐心。“听着，”她说到，再次低下头。“组织星系里的所有猎人没什么意义。作为一名猎人，最重要的就是……”她努力寻找合适的字眼。

“无组织化？”先知冷淡地补充道。

“哈哈。”笑声中毫无笑意。“是自由，独立。你看起来是个术士，所以你不会懂。”

先知藏在面具后的脸笑了。“是的，”他说道，“但我看过你和其他人在一起。你把其他猎人团结在一起，效果很好。比如你们在旧俄罗斯的营救工作。或者你和塔符还有樊拉一直做的补给找回工作。而当独行的人团结在一起，齐心协力的时候……”

“别把这事诗意化，”塔鲁说道，“我们也不是独行的。独立并不意味着独行。”

先知举起他的手，“你说得对。”他说道，“但如果术士有奥斯里斯代言，泰坦有圣人14号，我觉得猎人也该有这样一号人。而你是很强大的候选人。”

“还有其他人吗？”塔鲁说道，清醒了点。当先知耸肩时，她挺直了肩膀，然后又努力地故作轻松耸肩。“我不知道。我不知道有没有时间做……后勤工作。”

“好吧，我还以为你做好准备面对挑战了，”先知说道，“因为考虑到你的日程，这会是个挑战。甚至是个大胆的挑战。”

塔鲁突然变得极为严肃。“所以这是个大胆的挑战，先知？”

“可能是。”

2767482390.name: Raiju's Harness
2767482390.flavor: To tame that which knows no master, one must bear the storm.
2767482390.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2767482390.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2767482390.lore:
Tohr sat atop a storm-shrouded hill, surrounded in distance by sea and mist. The Maelstrom hung overhead, birthed from Tohr's relinquishment. It had raged for years, just as it did before when Tohr had claimed the reigns and issued his challenge to Raiju's Maelstrom. 

Clouds trundled at the storm's edge and forked bolts split through a central cumulonimbus supercell. Strikes of gnarled charge nipped scorch into the dirt with terrifying frequency as the sky rippled with lightning. Tohr's withered husk remained in meditative stillness, long dead, basking in the metronomic glow of each flashing termination. The armor around his corpse let slip a glint of light, pulsing like a guiding bannerette for thrill seekers. It had caught Tyv Lucine's eye many times.

She watched from the base, attempting to establish a safe route through the scattered fulmination. Salt-blasted dirt gave way underfoot, in places, while spindles of thatch-work glass weave held strong against her weight in others. She could feel static flow through the network of crystalline connections like conduits aching to reach out and touch the storm. Her Light shivered, welcoming the Arc surges that leapt up metal clasps on her boots, and she threw herself to another glossy foothold as a bolt dove to meet ground.

The Maelstrom calmed as she reached Tohr's body. A staff lay at his feet. The air was a screen of charged pressure around him, but Tyv knew how to find gaps. She knew how to bend away the lightning and loop Arc into itself. Lessons the Light had taught her. She slipped her hand through the barrier and lifted the plate from Tohr. She inhaled ozone and humidity and slid the Harness onto her shoulders.

Roars thundered from overhead and bolts scattered across Tohr's hill. Tyv swept the staff off the ground and drove her Arc-Light into its form. The reigns were in hand; the challenge issued. She would bend the storm, and live as lightning made flesh.


-Raiju's Legacy
2767482390.lore_zh:
托尔坐在被雷电覆盖的山顶，周围被大海和迷雾所笼罩。因托尔的让渡而产生的大漩涡在他的头顶盘桓。它像这样地狂暴已经有很多年了，就像当初托尔宣告统治并提出对雷兽的漩涡的挑战时一样。

在那风暴的边缘云层翻滚，而叉状闪电将中心的积雨云超晶包当空分裂。随着天空以恐怖的频率回荡闪电的光芒，咆哮的电弧打击将焦痕印上大地。托尔满是皱纹的皮肤保持着陷入冥想的静止，已经死去很长时间了，沉浸于每道闪电结束时那有节奏的闪烁之中。他尸体上的那套护甲露出一道闪烁的光，那光芒的律动就像是引领寻求刺激者的旗帜。它已经吸引了很多次泰芙·路西恩的注意力。

她在基地中查看了许久，试图找到一条能安全穿过破碎的轰鸣的路径。盐爆之后的泥土在一些地方提供了下脚的空间，在其他地方，又静电击中地面形成的纺锤状的编织玻璃有力地支撑起了她的身体。她可以感受到那静电流淌于晶体链接的网络之中，就像是电流，忍不住想要冲出牢笼去触碰那风暴。她的光能颤抖，似是在欢迎那让她靴子的金属纽扣不断摇摆跳跃的电涌。然后她在电弧触地的同时，再向前挪动到另一个光滑的落脚点。

当她到达托尔尸身的地方时，漩涡平静了下来。在他的脚下放着一柄权杖。在他周围的空气是充满电压的屏障，但是泰芙知道该如何寻找缝隙。她知道该如何折开闪电使电弧与其自身构成循环。这是光能教给她的。她的手穿过了屏障，将托尔的胸甲提起。她呼吸着空气中的臭氧和潮湿然后将挽具放到她的肩膀上。

雷霆的咆哮在头顶回荡，电弧在托尔的山顶碎裂四散。泰芙将地上的权杖扫开，然后驱使她的电弧光能显化。统治已尽在掌握，挑战已经发出。她将扭曲风暴，并入电闪雷鸣铸就之躯行走人间。


——雷兽的遗产

508515818.name: Mask of Bakris
508515818.flavor: "I cast off my carapace to be reborn, just like our glorious Riis."  —Atraks-1, Fallen Exo
508515818.lore:
"No! Leave her be! Praksis foresaw this. You will be silent! 

Don't listen to them, Atraks. Focus on my voice.

That is not you, Atraks. It is not. 

Do not turn away!

That body belongs to someone else. It wears a mask. Just a mask.

Take the mask off. 

Reach down and touch it. Good. Now take it off.

Pull harder!

This imposter is clever. The mask is affixed. You must cut it free. Take this blade.

Do not hesitate. Do not poke! Chop it. Smash it!

Yes… good. More. More. Wet your hands in this impostor's gore. Spread it about. Good!

There… you have it now. You have removed the mask…

Does that look like your body now? No. It is an empty thing.

I will take this mask and clean it. When others wear it, you will not see your face in it. You will know it is a mask."
508515818.lore_zh:
“不！别管她了！普拉克西斯预见了这一切。你要保持沉默！

别听他们的，阿特拉克斯。集中精神，听我说。

那不是你，阿特拉克斯。不是的。

不要转身！

那个身体是其他人的。戴着面具。只是个面具。

把面具摘下来。

下去，碰碰它。很好，现在摘下它。

用力拉！

这个骗子很聪明。面具被粘住了。你必须把它切开。拿上这把刀。

不要犹豫。不要戳！用砍的，砸碎它！

就这样……很好。继续，继续。在这个骗子的血中弄湿你的手。传播开来。很好！

现在……你拿到手了。你已经移除了面具……

看起来像你的身体了吗？不，那是空的。

我会带走这个面具，清洗下。当其他人带这个面具的时候，你会看到里面没有你的脸。你就知道那是面具。”

89619507.name: Athrys's Embrace
89619507.flavor: "There is no warrior fiercer than one shielding hatchlings from harm."  —Eliksni proverb
89619507.lore:
The suns have set. The day is done.
The pink gives way to gray.
The beasts of field find warren warm to keep the chill at bay.
But you are not a beast.
And you are not the sky.
You are your mothers' love-made-flesh, fragile as a sigh.
And so you need no warren,
Only mothers' warm embrace,
A soft cocoon of nursle, our hearts alike in pace.
So I hold you mother-strong,
Love a beacon, burning bright,
Second only to our Machine's eternal Light.

And so I hold you, young-one,
In our Machine's eternal Light.
Guard you as you slumber, dear,
In our Machine's eternal Light.
Wake soon, my young so rested,
In our Machine's eternal Light.
Feel the mother-warmth, hatchling,
In our Machine's eternal Light.

Your mothers must retire now,
Let you pass the night onward,
But love will keep a hearth alight if this, your heart, we stirred.
For you are not alone, my nymph,
'Neath your chest, our love does beat,
So mothers never stray too far, though distant we may be.
And we'll embrace in night's retreat,
When skies are pink once more,
When twilight grounds fear and deceit against the evening's foreign shore.
So shed no tear now, my young, 
You're within my ever-sight,
For always love it carries, by our Machine's eternal Light.

—Recovered audio file of a traditional Eliksni lullaby
89619507.lore_zh:
太阳已经下山。白天已经结束。
粉色给灰色让路。
野地里的野兽找到了暖和的地方，躲开寒气的侵袭。
但你不是野兽。
你也不是天空。
你是你母亲所爱的肉体，脆弱得像一声叹息。
你不需要大杂院，
只需要母亲温暖的拥抱，
柔软的蚕茧，我们的心跳步调一致。
我看着你母亲一般的坚强，
爱就像是灯塔，燃烧着光芒，
仅次于我们机器的永恒光能。

所以我举着你，年轻人，
在我们机器的永恒光能中。
在你沉睡时守护你，亲爱的，
在我们机器永恒的光能中。
快点醒来，我的年轻人如此安详，
在我们机器的永恒光能中。
感受母亲的温暖，孵化，
在我们机器的永恒光能之中。

你的母亲们现在必须离开了，
让你继续在黑夜中前行，
但爱会让炉火点燃，如果你的心，被我们鼓舞。
你不是独自一人，我的女神，
在你的胸膛之下，我们的爱在跃动，
母亲永远不会离得太远，尽管距离可能遥远。
我们会在夜色褪去后拥抱，
当天空再次变为粉色，
当暮光将恐惧和欺骗建立在夜晚的异国他乡时。
她现在不再流泪，我的年轻人，
你在我永恒的视野中，
因它所承载的永远是爱，我们机器的永恒光能。

——找回的传统埃里克斯尼摇篮曲音频文件

4255001288.name: Omnioculus
4255001288.flavor: See the danger, even when it cannot see you.
4255001288.lore:
Crash Site, Nessus Terrae, Day Five

**

Cabal search parties were thick—there was something decent on that frigate, and that meant it was worth keeping out of their hands.

Had to go clear twice to skirt the bigger groups. Nothing cowardly about it, just couldn't risk the noise of a firefight and didn't want 'em to know how close they were. Forced to shadow one of the big Chieftains for a while. Couldn't stand being close to it like that, even in the mountain air.

Finally found the frigate. Thing had spread itself across a gully, out of eyesight from most recon teams. Of course, my eyes are better than most.

Figured the cargo should have survived a low-atmo crash like that intact. Found two big crates of Cabal gold. Some statues, plates, gongs, that kind of thing. Transmatted the valuables out of there and left the rest for the rain.

Started feeling pretty good when something startled the hell out of me: a voice. Weak and quiet—the kind of quiet you get toward the very end.

Cracked into the wreckage and found a big Cabal warrior pinned in a hallway. Dropped it with no issue. Found a Lightbearer prisoner stuck the next room over—banged up, dehydrated, but alive.

Lightbearer seemed traumatized, but it was nothing personal. Gun butt to the temple quieted him right down. Tossed him on the back of my Sparrow and dropped him off at a recon station before he woke up. Outpost wasn't expecting survivors, so they needed their arms twisted before they'd pay up.

It's a thankless job, but that's all right. Thanks don't pay my debts.
4255001288.lore_zh:
坠落点，涅索斯地区，第五天

**

卡巴尔的搜索队有好几支——护卫舰上一定有什么好东西，所以一定不能让他们拿走了。

为了避开人数较多的搜索队，我们来回兜了两圈。这并不是怯懦，而是避免发生交火，让他们意识到自己已经深陷敌群。我们不得不耐着性子尾随一名族长。真受不了跟这种东西靠这么近，即便同呼吸这群山内的空气也让人感到恶心。

终于找到了那艘护卫舰。那玩意就横在一条沟渠里，大部分侦查队大概都找不到吧。显然，我的眼睛可比大多数人都要好。

货物从那种高度抛下来应该不会有损坏。我们找到两大箱卡巴尔金币。还有一些诸如雕像、盘子、徽章之类的东西。贵重物品先转移出去，其他的留下来以备不时之需。

刚开始一切都很正常，突然有个东西吓了我一跳：一个声音，口气虚弱且平和——那种人之将死般的平和。

我们剪开残骸，发现一个巨大的卡巴尔战士被武器钉在了墙上，应该是死透了。又在隔壁的牢房里找到了一位负光者，他遍体鳞伤，已经有些脱水迹象，不过还活着。

负光者见到我们便歇斯底里地叫喊起来，不过他应该是遭受了精神创伤，不是故意要闹出点动静。我用枪托轻砸他的太阳穴，立刻让他安静了下来。我把他扔上我的快雀后座，他还没醒的时候就把他丢在了一个哨站。前哨战可不是什么幸存者收容所，所以在他偿还我们的营救费之前，必须像个犯人一样被拷起来。

虽然这么干有些难看，不过我倒是不介意。一条命总不能就值一句谢谢吧，那我的账单谁来付？
