"Little by little, we all lost something. Sharing the warmth of our fires with others just became… too hard. The method became a secret, and the secret became a mystery.

"Find the others. Choose an Empyreal Magistrate. Find a way to share your fire. I am too old and have no fire left to share."

"No, Aodh. Your shoulder warms mine, too. Your words kindle a new fire in me. We'll spread the flames together. And we'll find a way share the warmth again."

"But I am too old. I am blind. I have no Light."

"You've seen more than me, and your vision is so clear, it opened my eyes. You are not shadowed by a Ghost, but you're as bright as the Sun."

"For one who says so little, you have a fine way with words. Perhaps we won't have to go too far to find a new Empyreal Magistrate."
3663305082.lore_zh:
“法官？奥德？我来了。我回来了。”

“我知道这个声音。奥罗丝。你找到锻炉了。”

“是的，法官。”

“我就知道你能找到。来，坐我这。让我们来重燃我们之间的友谊。”

“……法官？发生了什么事？”

“我不再是炎阳天空法官了。已经很多年了。我失去了我的机灵，还有我的……光能。随之而去的还有锻炉。”

“但是法官——”

“不，这个头衔已经不再属于我。你必须找出他们。把其他的炎阳聚集起来，选出一个新法官。结社缺少领导的状态已经持续太久了。把他们重新凝聚起来，奥罗丝。”

“热是一种力量，能破坏联结、粉碎结构、分离元素。热量能够将固体液化，然后将其转化为以太。以这种方式而言，热量是混乱与毁灭的力量。甚至能够撕裂宇宙。某种意义上来说，也撕裂了我们的结社。”

“为什么这么说？”

“你内心燃烧的火焰——那种怒火，愤怒——向外爆发后，落在你的对手身上。点燃。毁灭。但这还不是全部。当你焚烧自己或者你的朋友后，发生了什么？”

“焚烧我自己或……？烈焰之环。在里面，我的敌人会被焚烧，我的盟友可以毫发无伤穿过烈焰。”

“是的！但对你而言，不止如此。是这样吗？”

“是的。在圆环内我感觉变强了。”

“没错。但烈日之光的恩赐从来都不仅只属于我们。在最初，炎阳可以在内部分享火焰的温暖。走进圆环内的朋友也能感觉到那种温暖。”

“发生了什么事？”

“烈焰之环曾经是一种论断，只能断祸福。太多携带光能的人被烈焰所焚烧。那只是我们炎阳无法忍受所谓“文明”的原因之一。

“离开真的很不容易。结社里并非所有人都认为这是正确的道路。尽管我们可以在野外做得很好，但仍有分歧和审判。断开的联结比重建的更多。

“一点点的，所有人都失去了某些东西。和其他人分享我们烈焰的温度这件事……太难了。方法成为秘密，秘密成为了传说。

“找到其他人。选择一个炎阳天空法官。找到分享你的烈焰的方法。我已经太老，没有火焰可以分享了。”

“不，奥德。你的肩膀也温暖着我。你的话在我心里点燃了新的火焰。我们会一起把这烈焰散播开来。我们会找到办法，再次分享温暖。”

“但我已经太老了。我瞎了，我没有光了。”

“你看得比我更多，你的眼界如此清澈，你让我打开了双眼。你没有被机灵所遮蔽，但你和太阳一样明亮。”

“对于一个话如此之少的人而言，你的言语能力极佳。也许新的炎阳天空法官远在天边近在眼前。”

2002759682.name: Doom Fang Pauldron
2002759682.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2002759682.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2002759682.lore:
"It was a Warlock who first worked out that the fangs could be used as some kind of conductive amplifier when specific light frequencies were run through 'em. I don't know the science. That's not for me. I just know they work. And in battle what works is what's best. 

"Is it weird? Yeah. Maybe. Science fangs and space magic. But I've seen enough strange out there to understand normal ain't the norm. Anyway, the Warlock called 'em 'Bio-Conductive Trouble Breakers'. I call 'em 'Doom Fangs' 'cause of the fang, which is obvious, and then there's the doom we tend to inflict on a situation. 

"Plus it just sounds cooler." 

– Unknown Titan
2002759682.lore_zh:
“最初是一个术士发现利齿可以在经过特定频率的光线照射后用作一种导体增幅器。我不懂什么科学。那不是我的菜。我只知道那玩意儿有用。而在战斗中，有用的就是最好的。”

“这很奇怪吗？是的。也许是吧。科学利齿和空间魔法。但是我已经见识得够多的了，能理解什么是正常而什么不是，你懂吗？总之，术士叫它们‘生物传导麻烦解决器'。我叫它们‘毁灭之牙'，当然是因为它就是利齿……呃，你懂的，我们是用它在某种情况下毁灭东西的。”

“再说，这名字酷多了。”

——无名泰坦

2002759681.name: Synthoceps
2002759681.flavor: Caution: the organism has been known to develop consciousness. In these cases, immediate termination is recommended.
2002759681.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2002759681.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2002759681.lore:
"Discovered amid the outer-reef scrap fields, the bio-matter is a novel sentience dependent upon neural-symbiosis with a host organism. It seeks to link to the synaptic patterns of the closest organism, living or synthetic, to form an unbreakable bond. We theorize that this bond is a form of primordial 'love'—an emotional connection meant to compel the bio-matter to view its host as 'family.' The host comes to regard the bio-matter as an indispensable tool. 

The science is inexact, but what is known is that the bio-matter becomes aggressively protective once linked to a worthy host, forming an organic shell that can amplify the host's own strength when immediate threats are detected. 

—Self-authored report broadcast on covert frequencies
2002759681.lore_zh:
“在暗礁外的碎屑场中发现的，一种需要依赖有机宿主神经共生元的感知生物物质。它寻找与它最接近的组织、生物或合成物，用突触连接它们，制成最坚固的纽带。理论上来讲，这个纽带是一种最原始的‘爱'——一种迫使生物物质将其宿主视为”家“的情感连接。宿主将生物物质视为必要工具。

研究上并不确定，但就目前所知，这种生物物质在连接到合适的宿主后会变得极具保护欲——在发现威胁时形成一种有机外壳来增强宿主自身的力量。

——转换频道时收到的自研究报告广播

2094927311.name: Hallowfire Heart
2094927311.flavor: "You who seek the Forge: your journey will be long, but your destination is closer than you think." —Ouros
2094927311.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2094927311.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2094927311.lore:
"Commander, as best we can tell, they're all gone. Somehow the Legion found their outpost, and the Hunters say Centurions still hold the ruins. This was the last text transmission we got before the signal died." 
—Sloane 

"The fire burned within us. Not by choice, not because we sought the flame. But because there was no other way. 

"When you stood before the Forge, there was no doubt. No fear. Not even anger. 

"My order stood for generations. We held against the shadow, bearing a weapon that seared flesh and melted bone. 

"And now we stand at the end. May history remember the Forge. Remember the Hammer. Remember the Sunbreakers." 

—Ouros, Third and Final Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
2094927311.lore_zh:
“指挥官，根据我们所知，他们都走了。不知为何，军团找到了他们的前哨站，猎人说百夫长仍然占据着废墟。这是信号消失之前我们得到的最后一段文字。”
——斯隆

“我们燃起了一团火。我们并未选择如此，也并未因为我们在寻求火焰，而是因为没有办法。

“当你站在烈焰之前，就不会有疑问，不会有惧怕，甚至不会有愤怒。

“我们的秩序世代传承。我们带着灼肉熔骨武器反对暗影。

“现在我们站在了胜利一端。愿历史铭记烈焰。铭记战锤。铭记炎阳。”

——奥罗斯，三级及终极炎阳天空法官

4060352315.name: Mask of the Quiet One
4060352315.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
4060352315.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
4060352315.lore:
"Must you all be so dark? You're too focused on the horns. Look, I have died hundreds of times hunting the shadowed killers in Murder Row. I spent years mulling over Toland's and Osiris's discourse on thanatonautics. I have dabbled a bit myself and saw what lingers immediately upon all death. What I have done is found a way to channel the Void to draw that essence in before it is lost to the ether, to return it to Light so it can be properly bestowed back on our enemies. Death does not need to be final; it can, in fact, be recycled. What's so dark about that?" 

—Satomi, Architect of the Mask
4060352315.lore_zh:
“你们一定要这么悲观吗？你们都对角盔太过执着。听着，我为了追杀死囚榜上的暗影杀手，都死了几百次了。我花了多年时间研究托兰德和奥斯里斯有关渡灵学的谈话。我自己小试过一番，看到了死亡后瞬间残留的事物。我是这么做的：引导虚空，在消散于乙太之前吸收其精华，将精华注入光能，这样这股力量也能够再度运用在敌人身上。死亡不是终点；事实上它是可以被循环的。为什么对死亡如此悲观？”

——面具工匠，里美

53126581.name: Lion Rampant
53126581.flavor: All expect that you should rouse yourself, as did the former lions of your blood.
53126581.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
53126581.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
53126581.lore:
"O, lion! Stretch your wicked claws toward the stars and rend a hole in the sky itself! Let the stars cascade down around you. Leap high and tear again at the night! Rip every fearful comet and burning meteor out of the cosmos and swim in that ocean of light! Drink deep of it. Grow powerful. Carve pathways through the unknown, o defender! O enforcer from on-high!" 

—Traditional Titan meditation
53126581.lore_zh:
“哦，狮子！将你的邪恶利爪伸向星空，在天空中撕裂出一个洞！让星星纷纷倾倒在你周围。然后高高跃起，再次撕裂黑夜！将每一颗受惊的彗星和冲出宇宙的燃烧流星撕碎，徜徉在那片光的海洋中！深饮一口那光芒，感受能量的增长。穿过未知披荆斩棘，哦，捍卫者！哦，高高上的执行者！”

——传统泰坦的冥思

53126580.name: Peacekeepers
53126580.flavor: Designed for the seamless delivery of justice in an unjust world.
53126580.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
53126580.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
53126580.lore:
Peacekeepers once patrolled the City before the Red Legion's attack. They were Guardians, but their interest was in protecting our core, our home. Most understood the value in exploration, but the peacekeepers were old guard, born in the aftermath of the Iron Lords. They lived through the Faction Wars; bore witness to what damage internal strife could bring to a fragile society. They vowed to keep the factions in check and stood at the gates as our walls expanded and our city became a home. 

Now, nothing remains of the order. Yet their legacy delivers a harsh truth: the Last Safe City was never truly safe.
53126580.lore_zh:
是曾经抵抗猩红军团入侵圣城的和平守护者们。他们是守护者，但是他们的利益在于保护我们的核心——家园。大多数人都懂得探索的意义，但和平守护者们是古老的守卫，钢铁领主的后人。他们经历过阵营战争；目睹过内部冲突对脆弱社会带来的后果。他们发誓要稳定阵营，站在延展的高墙和圣城家园的门口。

现在，秩序不再。他们的遗迹证明了一个残酷的事实：最后的避难所从未真正安全。

796577360.name: Aeon Safe
796577360.flavor: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
796577360.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
796577360.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
796577360.lore:
your sense of (self]-preservation coddles
leaders into ritual [complacence) is something
(i have forgotten] loneliness uncertainty
life [alone) i see with my six (eyes] watching
from beyond [the heliopause) is a curtain
before the next and final (act] decisively
to meld with [yourselves) will know (you]
together alone striving toward your final [purpose)
built to move as they (move]
796577360.lore_zh:
你的(自]保意识骄纵
领导者们像往常一样的[沾沾自喜)
是(我早已忘却]的孤独疑惑
生命被我[仅仅)用六只(眼睛]掠过
[日球层顶)是一道帷幕
在下次并是最终一次
将[你们自身)决定性地合并在一起时将明白(你们]
在一起独自向你们的最终[目的)奋进
并随之(推移]而前行

1726944726.flavor: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
1726944726.lore:
your sense of (self]-preservation coddles
leaders into ritual [complacence) is something
(i have forgotten] loneliness uncertainty
life [alone) i see with my six (eyes] watching
from beyond [the heliopause) is a curtain
before the next and final (act] decisively
to meld with [yourselves) will know (you]
together alone striving toward your final [purpose)
built to move as they (move]
1726944726.lore_zh:
你的(自]保意识骄纵
领导者们像往常一样的[沾沾自喜)
是(我早已忘却]的孤独疑惑
生命被我[仅仅)用六只(眼睛]掠过
[日球层顶)是一道帷幕
在下次并是最终一次
将[你们自身)决定性地合并在一起时将明白(你们]
在一起独自向你们的最终[目的)奋进
并随之(推移]而前行

858758105.name: Khepri's Horn
858758105.flavor: "I pushed the sun. I can push you, too." —Inscription inside the helm
858758105.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
858758105.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
858758105.lore:
The Hunter leaned on the sill of the broken window, poking at the upended beetle lightly with the barrel of her gun, rocking it little by little until it got its footing and flipped itself. As it crawled away, the crouching Titan pushed himself up, grunting as he did.
"I was worried you'd shoot it for a sec. The poor guy."
"Nah, I'd not do that to ya. You know what they say about Titans."
"What do they say about Titans?"
"Uh, well, you know…"
He crossed his arms, and a faint sparkle like coals burning out shimmered across him. "Tell me."
She raised her hands in surrender. "All right. It's a joke so don't knock me for this one. 'Titans are like beetles, impervious until they've been knocked on their back.' Erm, all in good taste, of course."
The Titan cracked a smile and then began to laugh. "I see why Hunters wear that beetle armor then!"
858758105.lore_zh:
猎人倚靠在破窗的窗沿上，用她的枪管轻轻戳弄着那只四脚朝天的甲虫，一点儿一点儿地拨弄，直到它找到支撑点，翻过身来。甲虫爬走了，蹲着的泰坦哼地一声站起身来。
“我还有点儿担心你会朝它开上一枪呢，可怜的小东西。”
“不，我不会对它们做这种事。你知道他们怎么评价泰坦的。”
“他们是怎么评价的？”
“呃，好吧，你懂的……”
他双臂交叉，周身闪着微光，仿佛烧尽的煤炭一般。“告诉我吧。”
她举起双手投降。“好吧。这是个笑话，所以别因为这个敲我脑袋。‘泰坦就像甲虫，在被敲得四脚朝天之前坚不可破。'呃，这比喻很恰当。”
泰坦脸上现出微笑，接着放声大笑。“我算弄明白为什么猎人要穿那套甲虫护甲啦！”

1203306857.name: Ashen Wake
1203306857.flavor:
“It is your turn. These people will follow you to the very end. Remember that we were forged in Light.”
 —Aodh, Second Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
1203306857.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1203306857.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1203306857.lore:
"Be patient, Ouros. It will come in time." 

"Why does the Forge not choose me? I'm already blessed by Light. I'm here. I wish to serve." 

"We all have our place in the world. One day, you could be our next Magistrate. The Order would look to you for guidance." 

"Ha! As if. I don't want to be some stuffy old leader, I'd probably have to speak—" 

"Properly? Yes, I imagine so. I can see the fire that burns within you. I'll let you in on a little secret: speaking properly isn't the same as being proper.” 

“I don't understand." 

"The City dwellers think us wild, untamed. They believe that theirs is the only proper society in this age. We are not savages; we follow the Light like the others. But we forge our own path. That is what it means to be a Sunbreaker." 

"I don't care what the City dwellers think. I want to fight." 

"Fight you shall. But a hammer takes strength to wield. Strength in body, strength in mind. You will find the Forge in time, Ouros."
1203306857.lore_zh:
“耐心点，奥罗斯。它迟早会来。”

“锻炉为什么没有选择我？我早已被光能的祝福，我来到这里，我愿效忠。”

“我们在这个世上都有自己的位置。总有一天，你会成为我们的下一任法官，教团将盼望得到你的指引。”

“哈！好像是的。我不想变成老态毕现的古板领导者，我可能必须要说——”

“可能？是的，我想是的。我能看见你体内燃起的烈火，我来告诉你一个小秘密：言辞恰当与行为恰当是两码事。”

“我不明白。”

“圣城住民认为我们狂野不羁，他们相信自己的社会才是这个时代唯一恰当的存在。我们并非蛮夷；我们也像其他人一样追随光能，但我们铸就了我们自己的道路。这就是炎阳的意义所在。”

“我不在乎圣城住民的想法，我想战斗。”

“你一定会战斗，但挥舞战锤需要力量，身体的力量，心灵的力量。你终会找到锻炉，奥洛斯。”

1203306856.name: Wormgod Caress
1203306856.flavor:
"Have you ever stared into the green soulfire flame? There is terror, but also… something warm."
—Eris Morn
1203306856.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1203306856.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1203306856.lore:
II: COMMUNION 

He stood before his gods, humbled. 

An audacious gesture, to seek the deepest knowledge. To know the unknowable, the origin of all things. 

The worms turned, rejecting the disowned son. All but one. 

"In you, I see myself." 

Xol, the Will of the Thousands. Lesser than his kin, but full of dark wisdom. 

"You seek power? I will give you power beyond measure. The power of life renewed." 

The glow of soulfire in his eyes, Nokris bowed before the worm. In his fire, he felt embrace. He felt home. 

"Do you pledge yourself to me? Will you accept my unholy power?" 

Nokris nodded and smiled. 

He replied, "Yes, my lord. And together, we will take the stars." 

Xol was pleased.
1203306856.lore_zh:
II：圣餐

他谦卑地站在众神面前。

大胆地寻求最高深的知识；想要知道那不可知的万物起源。

虫神们转过身去，拒绝了那个不被认同的子臣，唯一位虫神没有转身。

“在你身上，我看见了自己。”

尸飕，千之意志，在众神之中地位最低，却充满黑暗智慧。

“你在寻求力量？我将赐予你无边神力，轮回新生的力量。”

诺克里斯双目闪起灵魂火光，他拜倒在虫神脚下。在他的火焰中，他感受到接纳，他感受到家。

“你是否愿意效忠于我？你是否接受我的邪恶力量？”

诺克里斯露出微笑，点了点头。

他回答，“是的，我的主人。有您相助，我们将夺走星辰。”

尸飕很欣慰。

2046130360.name: Ursa Furiosa
2046130360.flavor: "Stay back. I won't tell you again." —Bjorna-3
2046130360.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2046130360.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2046130360.lore:
Behind her, they ran for their lives.

The Fallen had descended upon them in such numbers that they were impossible to count. First it was a Skiff. Then another, followed immediately by a third. And finally, a full-blown Ketch de-cloaked above their position. There were but three of them to protect a hundred who had once been thrice that. Within minutes, it was only her.

She corralled the survivors into a cave that once upon a time wasn't a cave but more of an industrial drainage system. It was foul here; the radiation was practically palpable, and the survivors—if they survived this day—would likely find their lives shortened by years if not decades thanks to this poisoned solace.

She pushed them forward, deeper into the underground, as fast as they could manage. She carried two children, both eerily silent and unaffected. They, like their people, had endured more than she could imagine in their five-thousand kilometer exodus. They had given up their homes for the promise of something better. For the promise of hope and light and the strength of the pack. In their quest for better lives, they had lost almost everything.

Her Ghost told her the bad news—this cave system was a labyrinth extending dozens of kilometers with more dead-ends than not. The walls were deeply reinforced, and its scans could see but half a kilometer at best. It was going to be trial and error, and their pursuers were getting closer. Her Ghost didn't think they would make it. Not before…

One of the children in her arms—a little girl whose name was Violet—looked her in the eye and told her, without a hint of doubt, that she knew her Guardian would let nothing happen to them. Not after how far they'd come. She smiled at Violet and told her, yes, everything was going to be okay.

She set the children down, told them to run ahead and join the others; she would be right behind them. Alone with her Ghost, she told it to lead them to safety. She would stay behind and buy them time. And by the Traveler's Light, it would be an eternity's worth.

And so, reluctantly, her Ghost floated ahead to rejoin the exodus, but not before swearing it would come back to find her and bring her back, no matter how long it took.

With the light of her Ghost now out of sight and the soft wet steps of a hundred refugees out of ear-shot, she strapped on her helmet, tightened her gauntlets, and drew a line in the muck beneath her feet. When the chittering of Fallen Dregs finally began to echo through the tunnels, she reached for the Light and with it crafted a shield of Void energy.

If need be, she would hold this line until the end of time.
2046130360.lore_zh:
她身后，人们四散逃命。

空降而来的堕落者数量他们根本就数不清。首先是一艘突击艇。接着又来了一艘，然后马上又出现了第三艘。最后，一艘满载的双桅船在他们的上方解除了隐形。他们只有三个人，却要保护足足上百人，而且之前的人数还要多上两倍。没过几分钟，就只剩下她一个人了。

她把幸存者聚集到一个山洞里，这里曾经是一套工业排水系统。这里的环境很糟糕；辐射的强度几乎能感知的出来，而这些幸存者——即使他们能熬过今天——因为这些毒害，他们的寿命起码要缩短几年。

她催促着他们继续前进，以最快的速度深入到地下。她还背着两个孩子，这两个小家伙出奇的沉默，似乎完全不受影响。他们与其他人一样，在这五千公里的移民中承受了她难以想象的苦难。他们被承诺会过得更好。他们放弃了自己的家园，只为一点希望，一点光明，以及整个族群的强大。在追求美好生活的过程中，他们几乎失去了一切。

她的机灵报告了一个坏消息——这个洞穴系统里完全是个迷宫，延绵数公里而且大部分的通道都是死路。因为洞壁经过强化，它的扫描最多只能看到500米左右的情况。接下来的路将会充满试验和错误，而追踪他们的人已经越来越近了。她的机灵认为他们不可能生还。不可能在……

她手中的其中一个孩子——一个叫维奥莉特的小姑娘——毫不犹豫地看着她的眼睛告诉她，她知道守护者绝对不会让他们遭遇任何不幸的，尤其在他们经历了如此之多的苦难之后。她对维奥莉特笑着说道，没错，一切都会好起来的。

她放下两个孩子，让他们继续向前跑跟其他人汇合；她会跟在他们身后。她告诉机灵，让它带他们到安全的地方去。她则留在这里给他们争取时间。有了旅行者的光能，这样的举动也许就意味着永恒。

于是，她的机灵不情愿地漂浮着回到了逃亡的人群中，但口里还叨叨着无论过多久都一定要回来找到她，带她回来。

随着她的机灵所发出的光亮渐远，上百名逃亡者轻柔而湿润的脚步声都离开以后，她戴好头盔，紧了紧手套，在她脚下的淤泥上画了一条线。堕落士兵的声音终于开始在坑道里回响，她伸手聚集光能，形成了一面虚空能量的护盾。

如果有必要，她会在守在这条线后，直到永远。

她手中的其中一个孩子——一个叫维奥莉特的小姑娘——毫不犹豫地看着她的眼睛告诉她，她知道守护者绝对不会让他们遭遇任何不幸的，尤其在他们经历了如此之多的苦难之后。她对维奥莉特笑着说道，没错，一切都会好起来的。

她放下两个孩子，让他们继续向前跑跟其他人汇合；她会跟在他们身后。她告诉机灵，让它带他们到安全的地方去。她则留在这里给他们争取时间。有了旅行者的光能，这样的举动也许就意味着永恒。

于是，她的机灵不情愿地漂浮着回到了逃亡的人群中，但口里还叨叨着无论过多久都一定要回来找到她，带她回来。

随着她的机灵所发出的光亮渐远，上百名逃亡者轻柔而湿润的脚步声都离开以后，她戴好头盔，紧了紧手套，在她脚下的淤泥上画了一条线。堕落士兵的声音终于开始在坑道里回响，她伸手聚集光能，形成了一面虚空能量的护盾。

如果有必要，她会在守在这条线后，直到永远。

502173648.name: Heart of Inmost Light
502173648.flavor: On the cusp between life and light, between death and destruction.
502173648.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
502173648.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
502173648.lore:
He was a man.

He'd been another man. Another man before that. And another man before that. And another. Another. And yet another. How many lives now? How many deaths? He came to believe that each time his Ghost brought him back, he came back a new man. But he was a new man who carried with him the burden of all the lives before him. One after another after another, and each and every one of them weighed upon his shoulders in a way only Atlas could comprehend.

But he was a Titan.

Muscle and might and metal—a mountain of it, they said. There was no burden he could not bear. That's what they said. He nodded and waved away the adulations. He went to his quarters each night, in the half tower he had commissioned, and he laid in bed, his feet incapable of stillness as a thousand million insects scurried their way up and down the sinews of his muscles, instigating perpetual and maddening motions that all his muscle and might couldn't stop. An insurmountable restlessness that prevented what little respite he could find in his nightmare-fueled sleep.

Yet he was a champion. A leader. The bright shining example of all that was good and enduring.

There was a City to build. A species to protect. Extinction to prevent. Invaders to repel. Wars to fight. Lives to live. Deaths to die. What was it he said once to one of the newly risen? The Light shines brightest in those it consumes? Oh, how he felt consumed.

He stood up from his bed. Crossed to the window that framed the entity that had cursed him. Though it chose not to speak to him, he knew what it wanted. And the only way to end its curse was to give it what it wanted—to destroy that which would see it destroyed.

Maybe then he could sleep.
502173648.lore_zh:
他是一个人。

之前他是另外一个人。再之前又是另一个人。再之前，再另一个。再再之前，再再另一个。活了多少回了？又死了多少次？他开始相信，每一次他的机灵将他复活，他都会变成一个新的人。但他是一个背负着之前所有人负担的新的人。一个接一个，每一个人都用一种只有阿特拉斯才能理解的方式将重担压到他的肩膀上。

但他是个泰坦。

肌肉、力量、金属——人们都说，他们像山一样。没有什么负担是他承受不起的，这也是人们说的。他点头向恭维他的人们挥手告别。每天晚上他都会回到高塔中央指派给他的宿舍里，躺在床上，双脚却无法保持静止，因为他总觉得有上亿只小虫在的肌腱中上下不停地钻来钻去，使他的肌肉不断不自觉地抖动着，而且永远无法停歇。一种难以抑制的浮躁也使得充斥着噩梦的他完全无法得到休息。

不过他是个勇士，一个领导者。他是所有美好和持久事物的光辉榜样。

圣城需要他来建立。人类需要他来保护。人类的灭绝需要他来阻止。外星侵略者需要他来击退。战争需要他来参与。他还要继续活无数个世代。他也还要死上无数次。他曾对一个刚刚复生的人说过什么来着？光能在那些被它吞噬的人身上闪耀得最明亮？噢，他感觉自己已经被完全吞噬了。

他从床上站了起来。走到窗前看着那个让他被永远诅咒的存在。虽然它选择不跟他说话，但他知道它想要什么。结束诅咒的唯一办法就是把它想要的东西给他——毁灭掉那些想让它被毁灭的东西。

也许到时候他就能好好睡一觉了。

1249787553.name: One-Eyed Mask
1249787553.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1249787553.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1249787553.lore:
When they took my Light, I dared them to do their worst. When they took my eye, I laughed and told them I had another. But when they took my Ghost… Ooh, when they took my Ghost from me—that was the moment their lives ended.

They just didn't know it yet.

Since my first rez, I kept to myself. Figured I'd always been that way, in my previous life and all. Joining fireteams, raiding, the Commander's Nightfalls—never my bag. Always walked alone. Never needed nobody. Except for Ghost. Ghost was my only friend. Got no shame in admitting that, not anymore.

Not long after the Taken War, we'd made our way to the EDZ, looking for a place to call our own. Looking for some quiet. Maybe something resembling peace. Ghost and me, we'd been fighting since the Faction Wars. Always fighting. Non-stop fighting. And I was done. We were done. We'd been running solo ops so long, I don't think anyone even noticed we were gone. And we were glad for it.

Our sudden disconnect from the Light changed all that. Like it or not, I was Guardian, he was a Ghost. Peace was never in the cards; the Traveler saw to that. Ghost reconnected to the City networks for the first time in I don't know how long only to find that comms were jammed planet-wide. So we moved west—to our original LZ, to head back to the City, to find the next fight. That's when they found us. The Cabal—Red Legion, we would later learn.

They marched us north of the Winding Cove. Set up camp within sight of the Shard. They ingested their libations. Got rowdy. They knew we were Lightless; they wanted to see what I was really made of, when I was just meat and air. I said, do your worst. And they did. Beat me within an inch of my final life and then guffawed when Ghost couldn't do anything to get me back on my feet. They ingested more of their bevvies, and one of 'em decided I had one eye too many, and he took it and popped it and laughed some more and asked me what I was gonna do about it. I laughed back, louder and crazier than they liked, and told them I had another. Then one of them, the worst one of them, took hold of Ghost, and said, I'm your Ghost now—I'm the one who decides if you live or die. Ghost was just a pebble in its meat hooks. And with no effort at all, Ghost was in pieces. Before the sun rose, they threw me off a cliff. They should have put a bullet in me. They should have fed me to their War Beasts.

Figure Ghost chose me because I was some kind of hero in my before time. Maybe. More likely I was just another killer.

And I sure as hell didn't need no Fists of Havoc to get my hands wet proper.
1249787553.lore_zh:
当他们夺走我的光能，我挑衅他们让他们尽力施为。当他们夺走我的眼睛，我大笑着告诉他们，我还有另外一只。但当他们夺走了我的机灵……噢，当他们夺走了我的机灵——那就是他们的生命即将终结的时候了。

只是他们还不知道。

自从我第一次复活，我就一直一个人。我觉得之前人生也一直是这样。加入火力战队，参加突袭，完成指挥官的日落打击——我都不感兴趣。我一直一个人行动。从来不需要任何人。除了我的机灵。机灵是我唯一的朋友。承认这一点并不丢人，起码现在我不觉得了。

就在傀儡战争后不久，我们前往欧洲无人区，想找一块能让我们扎根的地盘，寻找一丝平静。也许还有一些类似于平和的东西。我和机灵，我们自从阵营战争开始就在一起并肩战斗了。一直在战斗，无休止地战斗。完成了战斗，我们都完成了战斗。我们独自行动太久，我想不会有人发现我们不见了。这一点我们倒是挺高兴的。

突然与光能的断线改变了我们的一切。无论喜欢与否，我是守护者，他是机灵。和平从来就不存在；旅行者的存在就是最好的战争导火索。过了不知道多久，机灵重新连接上圣城的网络，却发现全球的通讯频道都完蛋了。于是我们向西面进发——回到我们一开始的降落地点，准备回去圣城，继续战斗。他们就是在这个时候找上门来的。他们是卡巴尔——也就是我们后来所了解的猩红军团。

他们押着我们一路向北到了九曲湾，在能看到旅行者碎片的地方设立了营地。他们喝了点酒，然后开始大吵大闹。他们知道我们没有了光能；他们想看看当我们的身体里只剩下肉和空气时，还能有什么能耐。我说，有什么手段尽管使出来吧。他们也确实是这么做的。把我打得只剩最后一口气，但因为我的机灵没办法让我继续站起来，使得他们大声哄笑。他们又继续喝酒，其中一个人认为我的一只眼睛有点多余，于是把它挖了出来，一脚踩爆，然后大笑着问我能拿他怎么样。我用比他们更大声更疯狂的笑声予以回击，告诉他们我还有另外一只眼睛。然后他们其中的一个，最坏的那个，抓住我的机灵说道，我现在才是你的机灵——我才是决定你是生是死的人。在它的肉钩中机灵只不过是块鹅卵石。轻而易举地，机灵就被捏成了碎片。在太阳升起之前，他们将我扔下了悬崖。他们应该一枪毙了我。他们应该拿我去喂那些战兽。

我觉得机灵选中我是因为以前我是个英雄什么的，也许，也许我只是另一个杀手吧。

我很确定的一点是，我不需要浩劫之拳就能让我的双手染满鲜血。

81398002.name: Antaeus Wards
81398002.flavor: Do you believe in the Gaiaforms, the energies within planets?
81398002.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
81398002.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
81398002.lore:
Do you really believe there was no magic before the Traveler?

Mother Earth. Anima Mundi. World Soul. The ancients had it right—they erred only in believing their first god would also be their last.

These planets, moons, and asteroids upon which we leave our footprints—they have an energy of their own. Will. Breath. Soul.

I call them Gaiaforms, though I admit the name suffers from terracentrism. One might instead say there is one Gaiaform, and one Areoform, and one Mercuriform, and one Venusiform, and so on. The greatest gaiaforms of our solar system are eight in number—or, if you prefer, nine—but asteroids and minor planets have them too. And in their sidereal generosity, these gaiaforms will protect us, if we ask them.

Perhaps you think this sounds mad. But if it isn't true… then how do the Antaeus Wards work?
81398002.lore_zh:
你真的认为在旅行者出现之前就不存在魔法吗？

地球母亲、神性、世界灵魂。古人其实是对的——他们错就错在觉得第一个神就是他们的最后一个神。

这些我们留下过足迹的星球、卫星和小行星——它们都有自己的能量、意志、呼吸、灵魂。

我称它们为“大地形态”，不过我承认，这个名字受陆地中心主义的影响很大。人们也许会说，其实有大地形态、火星形态、水星形态、金星形态等等。我们的太阳系里一共有八个大地形态——或者你也可以说有九个——但小行星和更小的星球也有着自己的定位。而由于这些行星的慷慨，只要我们提出要求，这些大地形态就会保护我们。

也许你会觉得这听起来很不可思议。但如果不是这样……安泰俄斯护盾又是如何运作的呢？

2168728704.name: Antaeus Wards
2168728704.flavor: Do you believe in the Gaiaforms, the energies within planets?
2168728704.lore:
Do you really believe there was no magic before the Traveler?

Mother Earth. Anima Mundi. World Soul. The ancients had it right—they erred only in believing their first god would also be their last.

These planets, moons, and asteroids upon which we leave our footprints—they have an energy of their own. Will. Breath. Soul.

I call them Gaiaforms, though I admit the name suffers from terracentrism. One might instead say there is one Gaiaform, and one Areoform, and one Mercuriform, and one Venusiform, and so on. The greatest gaiaforms of our solar system are eight in number—or, if you prefer, nine—but asteroids and minor planets have them too. And in their sidereal generosity, these gaiaforms will protect us, if we ask them.

Perhaps you think this sounds mad. But if it isn't true… then how do the Antaeus Wards work?
2168728704.lore_zh:
你真的认为在旅行者出现之前就不存在魔法吗？

地球母亲、神性、世界灵魂。古人其实是对的——他们错就错在觉得第一个神就是他们的最后一个神。

这些我们留下过足迹的星球、卫星和小行星——它们都有自己的能量、意志、呼吸、灵魂。

我称它们为“大地形态”，不过我承认，这个名字受陆地中心主义的影响很大。人们也许会说，其实有大地形态、火星形态、水星形态、金星形态等等。我们的太阳系里一共有八个大地形态——或者你也可以说有九个——但小行星和更小的星球也有着自己的定位。而由于这些行星的慷慨，只要我们提出要求，这些大地形态就会保护我们。

512777670.name: Stronghold
512777670.flavor: I am a shield unto myself.
512777670.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
512777670.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
512777670.lore:
This is how it went.

We decide to knock off a little piece of Warlord territory. Scary lady calls herself the Wake owns this spot. I can't take a name like that seriously, but she's got that hoarder instinct, like me, so she keeps her villages well-provisioned.

Well-provisioned with an amateur security detail. Easy pickings for my crew.

So it starts with me, right? I get us in. I set it up, blow open the doors, and then I hand it off to Otto when the cavalry comes.

Now Otto's a Sword man. He's all about "craft." Technique. Precision. It's disgusting, but I don't care how he does it, as long as it gets done, so I just let him do it. And Otto does it so beautifully that, when he's done, you're standing there holding your guts in your hands and thanking him for the show.

I slip into the supply bunker real fast and quiet, and Otto covers me. He's waiting for them when they find us, and he makes them stop short. Huge guy, Otto. A giant with a Sword and the meanest looking gauntlet on his arm you ever did see.

He takes out about ten guys armed with Rifles so fast, so smooth, that they don't even see me going for the goods. One minute we're surrounded, and then we're the only suckers left standing.
512777670.lore_zh:
事情是这样的。

我们决定抢走一小块战争领主的地盘。那个自称为“苏醒”的吓人的女士是这个地方的主人。我没法将这样的名字当回事儿，但她天生有一种储存货物的本能，像我一样，所以她能让她的村子保持充足的物资供应。

物资充足，但是安保措施很业余。对于我的船员来说不成问题。

所以我打前阵，对吧？我把大家带了进去。我放好炸弹，炸开门，然后等援兵来了，就把一切都交给奥托。

现在奥托是个剑士。他喜欢强调“手艺”。技术、精准。其实挺讨厌的，但只要能完成任务，我不在乎他怎么做，所以我就让他放手一搏。奥托的手法非常漂亮，等他完事的时候，你只会站在那里，手里捧着自己的内脏，还要感谢他的表演。

我很快就悄悄溜进了补给仓库，奥托在身后掩护我。他在等着他们找到我们，然后迅速阻止他们。大块头奥托，一个手上戴着你所见过的最寒酸的护臂，拿着长剑的巨人。

他干掉那十个拿着步枪的人的速度是如此之快，如此之流畅，他们甚至没看到我去拿东西。前一分钟我们还被包围着，后一分钟场上还站着的人就只剩下我们了。

1429817243.name: Severance Enclosure
1429817243.flavor: The loop is made. Over and over until the collision. At that moment, severed fission.
1429817243.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1429817243.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1429817243.lore:
"Explain to me how it works again."

"It pulls small particles of your Light as you use it and loops it at increasingly higher speeds."

"Why would I want my Light taken away? This sounds like a terrible piece of equipment."

"Close your mouth and listen. It does that until you strike something—"

"Good, good good good. This is better. Then what?"

"…"

"Go on."

"Then it whips the Light particles into each other at high speeds, causing a delayed—"

"DELAYED?!"

"A DELAYED FISSION REACTION."

"Why is it delayed?"

"Let's move on."

"Okay… could you just sum it up for me?"

"Punch something and an explosion will happen where you struck."

"Wonderful. Won't that hurt me?"

"If we're lucky, I'll be able to work that into the design specs."
1429817243.lore_zh:
“再跟我说说它的工作原理。”

“在你使用的时候，它会从你的光能中提取微小粒子，然后以不断提高的速度循环回转。”

“我为什么要让我的光能被取走？这装备听起来很糟糕。”

“闭上嘴，好好听着。它会一直这样运转，直到你打中什么东西——”

“好，好好好。这就好多了。然后呢？”

“……”

“继续。”

“然后它会促使光能粒子相互高速碰撞，造成延时的——”

“延时的？！”

“延时的裂变反应。”

“为什么是延时的？”

“我们先继续。”

“好吧……你能给我简单总结下吗？”

“去击打个东西，然后你击打的地方会发生爆炸。”

“好极了。那不会伤到我吗？”

“如果我们幸运的话，我可以把那个加入到设计规范中。”

2551549824.name: Citan's Ramparts
2551549824.flavor: "Let them try to break through." —Lord Citan
2551549824.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
2551549824.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
2551549824.lore:
Winter had struck hard. The citizens of the 32nd Sector of Old Russia were ill prepared, many recently homeless due to the unrelenting snow storm that plagued the land. In search of shelter and barely clinging to life, they turned to the man who promised protection: The Titan Warlord, Citan.

Reluctant to offer rations—despite a stable full of potential meals, an overstocked keep, and a magnificent Great Hall garnished with every delicacy one could desire—Citan held a firm grasp over the supply chain. He was of the opinion that a hungry mob would not have the energy for a revolt.

Not that he required an advantage over his people. His Light was already all the advantage needed to ensure the status quo.

But hunger could cause people to act irrationally, an oversight in Citan's philosophy, and soon they were banging down the doors of his stronghold. In a display of utter dominance, Citan allowed the doors to open, personally standing between his people and the warmth and comfort of his Hall.

"My home is open to any with the will to earn it. You only need get past me." His hands sparked with Arc Light.

Out of desperation, one brave soul made a meager attempt to dart past the towering Warlord. His nose barely passed the threshold before he was instantly disintegrated by a Fist of Havoc.

"Anyone else?"
2551549824.lore_zh:
冬天猛烈地到来了。旧俄罗斯32区的居民准备不足，由于持续不断的暴风雪困扰着这片土地，许多人最近无家可归。为了寻求庇护和活命，他们投向了答应保护他们的人：泰坦战争领主，西坦。

西坦不愿提供口粮，尽管他有着充足的饭菜，一个存满货的要塞，一个宏伟的大堂里面塞满了人们想要的每一种美味佳肴，但他却牢牢把控着供应链。他认为饥饿的暴民没有反抗的能量。

并不是说他比他的人民有优势。他的光能已经足以作为维持现状所需的优势。

但是饥饿可能导致人们表现出不合理的行动，这是西坦理论的疏忽，很快他们就撞倒了西坦要塞的大门。。为了展示绝对的统治力，西坦允许打开大门，亲自站在他的人民与温暖和舒适的大堂之间。

“我的家，向所有有意愿为之努力的人而开放。只需要跨过我。”他的双手闪烁着电弧光能。

出于绝望，一个勇敢的灵魂做了次微不足道的尝试，试图飞过高耸的战争领主。在他被浩劫之拳分解之前，他的鼻子刚刚碰到门槛。

“还有人吗？”

1978467312.name: Precious Scars
1978467312.flavor: "The Traveler has shown us that what was broken can be reformed, becoming better than it was before." —Commander Zavala
1978467312.lore:
Callieach racked another slug into her Shotgun and fired into the downed Legionary. Her fresh lungs—still not desensitized to the burn of cordite—spasmed as she coughed, but her Ghost was the only soul left to see her moment of awkward human frailty. 

The Titan righted herself and tested taking a few deep breaths before scanning the room. Cryomagma expelled by nearby ice volcanoes began to fall as snow through the open ceiling, slightly obscuring her view of the starry river cascading through the Milky Way. The off-white powder flurried down into the rubble and highlighted the scattered white and blue bits of Seraphite shards. Cal slung her Shotgun and began to collect them. "Can you scan for the rest of these, Winter?"

Her Ghost chirped and rotated on her central axis. "What are you… Are those the pieces of your old helmet?"

"Yeah. Need to put it back together," Cal said and brushed the crystallized solution of water and ammonia from a concrete slab, placing the recovered pieces with a surgeon's care. "It's my fault for getting caught with my helmet off."

"We have a real objective," her companion huffed. "I can make you a new helmet!"

"I like this helmet."

"It's covered in Cabal viscera," Winter protested as Cal continued to pluck shards from the ruined floor. 

"A little wash, a little Glimmer, a new environmental seal; it'll be good as new."

"Cal, it's been shattered. It's useless."

The Titan tore a scrap of Cabal banner free and began to carefully wrap the pieces. "I was broken when you found me. Am I useless?"

"You don't want me to answer that honestly right now."

Cal pointedly ignored the Ghost's comment.

"Of course not," Winter finally relented. "Your old wounds helped me determine what kind of person you were. You can't remember it, but the damage to your femur and vertebrae suggested you were a person who could press forward despite phenomenal pain. Your scars told me what you could do."

"That's why it's important for me to remember: I am what I've been through," Cal countered while prying a final piece of regulator out from under an Incendior's boot.

"The footprints are not the dance," Winter corrected.

"Out of all the Ghosts in Sol, I get the poet."

"What I mean is, you are more than what you survive. Your scars," the Ghost clarified, "told me you were someone who could endure. They didn't tell me how. They also didn't tell me about your morals. Your sense of humor. Your generosity. But eventually, you did."

"There's more to me than being broken."

"Exactly."

Cal cooed over the last piece of helmet, which still bore a tiny, childish drawing of a heart. The initials within, MG, were visibly scuffed. "So maybe there's a little more to my helmet too."
1978467312.lore_zh:
凯莉娅赫又将一枚弹头架进霰弹枪，对着倒地的军团士兵开枪。她新鲜的肺——仍未对无烟火药的灼烧失去知觉——在她咳嗽时痉挛着，但她的机灵是唯一看过她尴尬的人类虚弱的时刻。

泰坦正了正身子，试探着深吸了几口气，然后扫描了一下房间。附近的冰火山所排出的低温的熔岩，开始化作雪花，从敞开的天花板上落下，稍稍遮挡了她看着银河中层层叠叠的星河的视线。灰白色的粉末飘落在废墟中，凸显出散落的白蓝相间的枯纹石碎片。凯莉扔了霰弹枪，开始收集。“你能扫描剩下的这些吗，寒冬？”

她的机灵鸣叫着，以她的中轴为中心旋转。“你在……这些碎片是你旧头盔的碎片吗？”

“是的，得把它重新组装起来。”凯莉说着，从水泥板上刷出水和氨水的结晶溶液，用外科医生般小心翼翼将恢复的碎片放好。“都是我的错，把我的头盔弄掉了。”

“我们还有个真正的目标。”她的伙伴恼怒道。“我可以给你做个新头盔！”

“我喜欢这个头盔。”

“可它上面全是卡巴尔的内脏。”当凯莉继续从废墟的地板上拔出碎片时，寒冬抗议道。

“洗一洗，来点微光，换个新的环保封条，就能像新的一样了。”

“凯莉，它都碎了，没用了。 ”

泰坦将卡巴尔旗帜撕了一片，开始小心翼翼地包扎起来。“你找到我的时候，我也破碎不堪。我没用了吗？”

“你现在肯定不想听真话。”

凯莉尖锐地忽略了机灵的意见。

“当然不是。”寒冬终于忍不住开口。“你的旧伤帮我确定了你是什么样的人。你不记得了，但你的股骨和脊椎骨的损伤，表明你是在巨大的痛苦中仍能坚持前进的人。你的伤疤告诉了我，你能做到什么。”

“所以对我来说，记住这一点很重要：我就是我所经历过是。”凯莉一边反驳，一边从一个火枪兵的靴子下撬出最后一块调节器。

“脚印不是舞蹈。”寒冬纠正道。

“太阳系里那么多机灵，我的机灵是个诗人。”

“我的意思是说，你比你生存下来更重要。你的伤疤。”机灵澄清到，“你的伤疤告诉我，你是个能忍的人。但并没有告诉我你是怎么忍受的。它们也没有告诉我你的道德，你的幽默感，你的慷慨。但最后，你自己做到了。”

“我不仅是破碎不堪。”

“没错。”

凯莉拿着最后一块头盔碎片咕哝着，上面还画着一个小小的、幼稚的心形图案。里面的首字母“MG”有明显的刮痕。“那也许我的头盔也不仅仅是个头盔那么简单。”

3557821742.name: Precious Scars
3557821742.flavor: "The Traveler has shown us that what was broken can be reformed, becoming better than it was before." —Commander Zavala
3557821742.lore:
Callieach racked another slug into her Shotgun and fired into the downed Legionary. Her fresh lungs—still not desensitized to the burn of cordite—spasmed as she coughed, but her Ghost was the only soul left to see her moment of awkward human frailty. 

The Titan righted herself and tested taking a few deep breaths before scanning the room. Cryomagma expelled by nearby ice volcanoes began to fall as snow through the open ceiling, slightly obscuring her view of the starry river cascading through the Milky Way. The off-white powder flurried down into the rubble and highlighted the scattered white and blue bits of Seraphite shards. Cal slung her Shotgun and began to collect them. "Can you scan for the rest of these, Winter?"

Her Ghost chirped and rotated on her central axis. "What are you… Are those the pieces of your old helmet?"

"Yeah. Need to put it back together," Cal said and brushed the crystallized solution of water and ammonia from a concrete slab, placing the recovered pieces with a surgeon's care. "It's my fault for getting caught with my helmet off."

"We have a real objective," her companion huffed. "I can make you a new helmet!"

"I like this helmet."

"It's covered in Cabal viscera," Winter protested as Cal continued to pluck shards from the ruined floor. 

"A little wash, a little Glimmer, a new environmental seal; it'll be good as new."

"Cal, it's been shattered. It's useless."

The Titan tore a scrap of Cabal banner free and began to carefully wrap the pieces. "I was broken when you found me. Am I useless?"

"You don't want me to answer that honestly right now."

Cal pointedly ignored the Ghost's comment.

"Of course not," Winter finally relented. "Your old wounds helped me determine what kind of person you were. You can't remember it, but the damage to your femur and vertebrae suggested you were a person who could press forward despite phenomenal pain. Your scars told me what you could do."

"That's why it's important for me to remember: I am what I've been through," Cal countered while prying a final piece of regulator out from under an Incendior's boot.

"The footprints are not the dance," Winter corrected.

"Out of all the Ghosts in Sol, I get the poet."

"What I mean is, you are more than what you survive. Your scars," the Ghost clarified, "told me you were someone who could endure. They didn't tell me how. They also didn't tell me about your morals. Your sense of humor. Your generosity. But eventually, you did."

"There's more to me than being broken."

"Exactly."

Cal cooed over the last piece of helmet, which still bore a tiny, childish drawing of a heart. The initials within, MG, were visibly scuffed. "So maybe there's a little more to my helmet too."
3557821742.lore_zh:
凯莉娅赫又将一枚弹头架进霰弹枪，对着倒地的军团士兵开枪。她新鲜的肺——仍未对无烟火药的灼烧失去知觉——在她咳嗽时痉挛着，但她的机灵是唯一看过她尴尬的人类虚弱的时刻。

泰坦正了正身子，试探着深吸了几口气，然后扫描了一下房间。附近的冰火山所排出的低温的熔岩，开始化作雪花，从敞开的天花板上落下，稍稍遮挡了她看着银河中层层叠叠的星河的视线。灰白色的粉末飘落在废墟中，凸显出散落的白蓝相间的枯纹石碎片。凯莉扔了霰弹枪，开始收集。“你能扫描剩下的这些吗，寒冬？”

她的机灵鸣叫着，以她的中轴为中心旋转。“你在……这些碎片是你旧头盔的碎片吗？”

“是的，得把它重新组装起来。”凯莉说着，从水泥板上刷出水和氨水的结晶溶液，用外科医生般小心翼翼将恢复的碎片放好。“都是我的错，把我的头盔弄掉了。”

“我们还有个真正的目标。”她的伙伴恼怒道。“我可以给你做个新头盔！”

“我喜欢这个头盔。”

“可它上面全是卡巴尔的内脏。”当凯莉继续从废墟的地板上拔出碎片时，寒冬抗议道。

“洗一洗，来点微光，换个新的环保封条，就能像新的一样了。”

“凯莉，它都碎了，没用了。 ”

泰坦将卡巴尔旗帜撕了一片，开始小心翼翼地包扎起来。“你找到我的时候，我也破碎不堪。我没用了吗？”

“你现在肯定不想听真话。”

凯莉尖锐地忽略了机灵的意见。

“当然不是。”寒冬终于忍不住开口。“你的旧伤帮我确定了你是什么样的人。你不记得了，但你的股骨和脊椎骨的损伤，表明你是在巨大的痛苦中仍能坚持前进的人。你的伤疤告诉了我，你能做到什么。”

“所以对我来说，记住这一点很重要：我就是我所经历过是。”凯莉一边反驳，一边从一个火枪兵的靴子下撬出最后一块调节器。

“脚印不是舞蹈。”寒冬纠正道。

“太阳系里那么多机灵，我的机灵是个诗人。”

“我的意思是说，你比你生存下来更重要。你的伤疤。”机灵澄清到，“你的伤疤告诉我，你是个能忍的人。但并没有告诉我你是怎么忍受的。它们也没有告诉我你的道德，你的幽默感，你的慷慨。但最后，你自己做到了。”

“我不仅是破碎不堪。”

“没错。”

凯莉拿着最后一块头盔碎片咕哝着，上面还画着一个小小的、幼稚的心形图案。里面的首字母“MG”有明显的刮痕。“那也许我的头盔也不仅仅是个头盔那么简单。”

1734674241.name: Icefall Mantle
1734674241.flavor: Ice can grind mountains to dust. These will get the job done.
1734674241.lore:
The message flagged "Urgent, Top Priority" hosts seven distinct typos; unusual for such a cautious, thoughtful man.

He believes this is an emergency, but surely no reason to panic, despite the vehemence of his message. No reason to ruffle others' feathers or reveal his anger and fear. There will be a rational exchange, he reasons. This is all just a misunderstanding.

He refuses to break into a run as he hurries down the deserted hallways leading to Test Unit C-21. Holographic alarms silently flash over and over: Danger! Authorized Personnel Only! Danger! Authorized Personnel Only! Danger! Authorized Personnel Only!…

He makes a comms call that goes through clearly, but it's broken by scattered thoughts and shortness of breath.

The call goes unanswered.

Doctor Hector Abram blasts into the observation theater, towering with frustrated rage. But the workstations there sit empty; the theater, dark. No audience for his planned tirade presents itself. He turns instead to the stage beyond the transparent shielding and feels himself grow smaller with the enormity of the drama unfolding before him.

The apparatus of the lab holds a test subject in a harness; no velvet glove, just rare metals woven round a form of similar complexity. The Exo's body dangles and twitches; the puppeteer's presence sensed but unseen.

The foreign energy courses again down through cords—the third surge and the strongest yet—making the puppet quiver and dance. Doctor Abram raises a hand to his mouth, which seems to climb to his eyes of its own accord.

Through splayed fingers, he witnesses the triumph of the puppeteer, as ice takes shape around the puppet like magic.

"You see now why this was necessary."

Doctor Abram jumps and turns at Clovis Bray's words. He had not seen him, sitting comfortably in the darkness.
1734674241.lore_zh:
这条标有“紧急、最高优先级”字样的信息中，有7处明显的错别字；对于这样一个谨慎、思虑周全的人来说，这很不寻常。

他相信这是紧急情况，但肯定没有必要恐慌，尽管他的信息很激烈。没有理由去撩拨别人的羽翼，也没有理由暴露自己的愤怒和恐惧。他相信，会有一个理性的交流。这全都不过是一场误会。

他在通往测试单元C-21的荒芜走廊上急奔时，始终拒绝跑起来。全息报警器无声地一遍遍闪烁：危险！仅限授权人员！危险！仅限授权人员！危险！仅限授权人员！……

他打了一个通讯电话，清楚地接通通，但却被散乱的思绪和急促的呼吸打断了。

电话无人接听。

赫克托·亚伯拉姆博士冲进了观察场，沮丧而愤怒。但这里的工作台空无一物，观察场里也一片漆黑。他计划中的谩骂没有观众来接受。他转而看向透明防护罩之外的舞台，感觉自己随着眼前戏剧的巨大展开而变得渺小。

实验室的仪器将一个测试对象装在鞍具里，没有天鹅绒手套，只有稀有金属编织成的类似的复杂形状。Exo的身体悬空颤动着；傀儡师的存在感却视而不见。

外来的能量又通过绳索向下传递——第三次涌动，也是最强的一次——使木偶颤抖起舞。亚伯拉姆博士举起一只手放在嘴边，那只手似乎自己爬到了他的眼睛上。

透过张开的手指，他看到了傀儡师的胜利，冰块像魔术一样在傀儡周围成形。

“你现在明白为什么这是必要的了。”

亚伯拉姆博士听到克洛维斯·布瑞的话，跳起来转过身。他没有见过他，舒服地坐在黑暗中。

4057875770.name: Cuirass of the Falling Star
4057875770.flavor: The lightning from the farthest cloud strikes the hardest.
4057875770.lore:
Crash Site, Nessus Terrae, Day Four

**

Panesh sat wearily beside the heavy metal beams that trapped him in the wreckage of the Cabal frigate. On the other side of the wall, the Cabal warrior stuck in the corridor roared in frustration and started kicking again.

"Save your energy, Vargessus," Panesh shouted over the noise. "You're not going to be able to kick your way through…" he paused to scratch a fingernail along the unfamiliar metal, "solid Cabal-ium."

Heavy footsteps stomped over to a crack in the wall near the hull. "Cabal can kick through most things," Vargessus said, her face pressed against the gap in the metal. "Caiatl will kick your Vanguard into pieces, once you cowards stop running."

"Who's running?" Panesh said. "We're in the City waiting for you. Under the big white ball—maybe you've heard of it? We don't run."

"Hrah!" Vargessus laughed. "You run. Fought one of you once—all he did was run. Shield and run. We stopped chasing him and then BOOM!" She pounded the metal wall with a gigantic fist. "He dove at us, covered in lightning! Then he ran again."

"Sounds like he wasn't running," said Panesh. "He retreated to a tactical distance."

"Fancy words for 'run,'" snorted Vargessus. Panesh heard her pace uneasily, then sit in the corridor, her back against the same wall as his.

"Hey," Panesh called, "how about you keep some tactical distance yourself? You smell like a… hot barnyard."

"And you smell also, like a bloodless child. Sour."

There was a loud electrical pop overhead and Panesh raised his hands against a shower of blinding sparks.

"Panesh?" shouted Vargessus.

"I'm fine," he said. "Just another system shorting out."

The Cabal grunted in response. Panesh heard her settle back against the wall.

"Unripe," she added.

"You're ripe enough for both of us," he said.

But neither of them moved.
4057875770.lore_zh:
坠落点，涅索斯地区，第四天

**

帕内什疲惫地坐在一根金属梁旁，这些插在地上的断梁将他困在这护卫舰的残骸之中。在墙的另一边，被困在走廊里的卡巴族战士沮丧地吼叫着，又开始到处乱踹。

“省省力气吧，瓦格里萨斯”，帕内什朝着一边发出的噪音高喊着：“用脚可穿不开这些...”他突然停住，用指甲在这陌生的金属上划了一下，“坚硬的卡巴尔金属。”

沉重的踢击撞在船体上的一条裂缝上。“巴卡尔可以踢穿大部分东西”，瓦格里萨斯说，她把脸贴在墙上的缝隙上：“等你们这些懦夫逃不动了，卡巴尔的军队会把你们的飞船踹成碎块。”

“是谁在逃？”帕内什说：“我们在城市里等着你们呢。就在那个巨大的白球里——你们听说过吗？很显然我们可不是在逃的那个。”

“哈哈！”瓦格里萨斯大笑起来。“你们的人就只会逃。我跟你们的人打过一次，他一直在逃。只会防御然后逃跑。等我们不再追他，他就偷袭我们！”她用巨大的拳头捶打着金属墙。“他浑身带着闪电向我们冲了过来！然后就又开始逃跑。”

“听起来完全不是逃跑啊，”帕内什说：“他只不过在用撤退的方式保持战术距离。”

“不就是逃跑吗”，瓦格里萨斯嗤之以鼻。帕内什听到她不安地踱步，然后在廊里，隔着一面墙与他靠背而坐。

“喂”，帕内什喊道：“不如我们也保持些战术距离怎么样？你身上闻起来...像是刚从粪坑里捞出来一样。”

“你也一样，像个吓尿的孩子，身上一股酸臭。”

头顶上传来一声巨大的电击声，帕内什抬起手来，遮住了一阵阵刺眼的火花。

“帕内什”？瓦格里萨斯叫喊道。

“我没事”，他说：“大概是哪个系统又短路了吧”。卡巴尔人咕哝了两声。帕内什听到她靠着墙站定。

“真是不成熟”，她补了一句。

“你已经够成熟了”，他说道。

但是两个人都没有行动。

4119704973.name: The Path of Burning Steps
4119704973.flavor: Those who walk through fire have burned away their fear.
4119704973.lore:
Words burnt into the fearless:

Follow not those who take the road less traveled,

Nor those who stand behind one another in waiting.

Carve fresh the stone of the obstinate mountain.

Lay waste to that which is impassible.

May your footfalls leave cinder in their wake,

For you fuel your steps by the danger of their stride.

—Code of the Devastator
4119704973.lore_zh:
烙在无畏者心中的话语：

不要追随那些不走寻常路之人，

或那些站在别人身后等待之人。

勇于雕刻顽石。

毁掉挡路事物。

愿你的脚步所到之处只留灰烬，

愿危险的迈进给你前行的动力。

——毁灭者法则

618261657.name: The Path of Burning Steps
618261657.flavor: Those who walk through fire have burned away their fear.
618261657.lore:
Words burnt into the fearless:

Follow not those who take the road less traveled,

Nor those who stand behind one another in waiting.

Carve fresh the stone of the obstinate mountain.

Lay waste to that which is impassible.

May your footfalls leave cinder in their wake,

For you fuel your steps by the danger of their stride.

—Code of the Devastator

4165710258.name: Hoarfrost-Z
4165710258.flavor: "No great wonder can stand forever if it is constructed on a lie." —Alexei
4165710258.lore:
The Last City, Earth      

GX-818 Experimental Notation:
Recovered Hive Ghost inoperable. Still responds to electrical impulse. Ran gauntlet of tests and gleaned welcome protocol data.

New chest rig comes in handy for experimentation and observation: every time the Ghost exhibits movement, can render it inert without so much as lifting a finger. Must employ this technique in future studies…

Hardware architectural analysis confirmed that this derelict creature exhibited a malleable structure. Certainly wasn't created with a specific framework in mind and looks to have adapted its configuration to its Lightbearer once acquired. Is this necessary for the bonding process? For creating the perception of companionship? Is it possible for a Ghost to connect to a Lightbearer without undergoing restructuring?

Previous behavioral studies have shown that Ghosts can be selective. Given lack of pre-programmed directives, it is now clear that they make conscious choice about whom to revive. Hardware evidence suggests that Ghosts were always capable of reviving Hive; perhaps they always intended to.    

Addendum for Spider:
You've asked me why I like to "tinker with your toys" before I deliver them. Well, here you are. Proof of what I've been saying all along:

We live at the whims of a god who blesses the few at the expense of the many. We follow leaders who claim to understand this speechless orb, and we are expected to do as it wills, no matter the cost to ourselves.

So many people still condemned to die, and it willingly granted immortality to a death cult, served on a silver platter by these… automata. Well, I too have a will, and I will not prostrate myself before something capable of such evil.

Your Ever-Skeptical Häkke Exile,
Alexei
4165710258.lore_zh:
地球，圣城      

GX-818实验注释：
回收的邪魔族机灵无法运作，不过仍对电脉冲起反应。对其进行一系列的测试并收集到了满意的数据。

新的胸部护甲在实验和观测中派上了用场：每当机灵开始活动时，我甚至不需要动一根手指就能使它丧失动力。必须在未来的研究中使用这种技术…

硬件结构分析证实，这个废弃的生物具有一种可塑的结构。它在被创造时并没有考虑到某种特定框架，而且看来它在获得负光者后，其构造已经适应了其主人。这对结合过程来说有必要吗？是为了创造伴侣关系的感觉吗？机灵有可能在不经历重组的情况下与负光者连接吗？

先前的行为研究表明，机灵选择时非常谨慎。现在有一点很明确：由于缺乏预先编程的指令，他们会有意识地选择复活某一生物。硬件证据表明，机灵一直都有令邪魔族复生的能力。也许他们的造物主一开始就有这个打算。    

致蛛王的附录：
你曾问过我为什么喜欢在把东西送达前“玩弄一番”。好了，这就是原因。这些测试证明了我一直以来说的话：

我们生活在神灵反复无常的兴致中，他以牺牲多数人为代价眷顾少数人。我们追随那些声称理解这个无声球体的领袖们，且必须不惜自身代价按照它的意愿行事。

仍然有许多人注定赴死，而它心甘情愿地给予死亡邪教永生。由这些…有自我意识的机器拱手送上。我也有自己的意愿，我不会在能做出如此恶行的东西面前屈服。

永持怀疑态度的Häkke放逐者，
阿列克谢

4258262391.name: Loreley Splendor Helm
4258262391.flavor:
"I don't know what it means
That I am so sad
A legend of bygone days
That I cannot keep out of my mind." —Die Lorelei, Heinrich Heine
4258262391.lore:
"The great warrior Ikora Rey…" Ophiuchus scoffed. "Librarian of glory."

Ikora brushed the dust from a battered rifle and began carefully noting its features. "It's an honor to catalog these artifacts for him. Besides, you should be happy. You're always encouraging me to adventure less and study more."

"No, I'm encouraging you to be your best self," the Ghost corrected. "Not change who you are because you've succumbed to hero worship."

"Osiris is a legend."

"He is just a man." Ophiuchus ran a scan over the gun. "A man who's honed his skills, yes, but you could be his equal and more."

"Me? Surpass the Warlock Vanguard?" It was Ikora's turn to scoff. "You do love your fantasies, Ophiuchus."

"You have the instincts! If you'd just learn to slow down and—hang on!" The Ghost abruptly knocked over a flaking plastic crate and nudged a helm forward from the jumbled mess. "Here, take a look at this helmet. What does it tell you about the wearer?"

"The crate says it was recovered from the tomb of Carnunta, a Warlord in the EDZ. Lightbearer."

"Don't read. Deduce."

She laughed, feeling silly. "Gallic-inspired design. " She paused, gazing into the imperfect etching as something ate at her.

"I'm sorry, no.  See this third eye? The cheek flanges? He clearly made a Hive-inspired helmet to strike fear into his enemies."

"No, this was centuries before we encountered the Hive." She turned the helm over and gave it a careful sniff. Dust. Sweat. Linseed. Frankincense. "No smell of decay. Oiled. A warrior is buried in his armor, but this was buried next to him, not on him." 

She hefted the weight of it in her hands. "It's light. And…" Her eyes darted carefully over the helm's surface. "No. The line weight in these etchings is inconsistent… handmade. And scans show traces of his DNA sealed in the seams. He made this himself, but it wasn't his. The fletching is infused with Light—high visibility, easily to spot on the battlefield. He made this for someone. Someone who couldn't bear to wear it after Carnunta's death." 

She gently righted the helmet, staring into its visor. "He made this for a lover."

Ophiuchus whirred a moment. "So, you don't think it looks like a Hive?"

"Maybe a little."
4258262391.lore_zh:
“伟大的战士艾可拉·蕾伊…”蛇夫座嘲笑道，“荣耀管理员。”

艾可拉轻轻扫掉了一把破旧步枪上的灰尘，然后仔细观察着它的特征，“为他记录这些神器是我的荣幸，而且，你应该感到高兴才对。你总是鼓励我少冒险多学习。”

“不，我是在鼓励你做最好的自己。”机灵纠正道，“而不是因为屈服于英雄崇拜改变自己。”

“奥斯里斯是个传奇。”

“他只是个凡人。”蛇夫座扫描枪械时说，“他的确是个能力非凡的人，但你可以和他平起平坐，甚至更强。”

“你是说我能够超越术士先锋？”这次轮到艾可拉嘲笑他了，“你还真是喜欢幻想，蛇夫座。”

“你有天生的直觉！只要你学会放慢点——等我一下！”机灵突然打翻了一个剥落的塑料板条箱，把一个头盔从一片混乱中向前推了推，“来看看这个头盔。你从中知道关于佩戴者的什么信息？”

“箱子上说它是在欧洲无人区战争领主‘卡努塔'的坟墓里找到的。他是一名负光者。”

“不要读，要自行推断。”

她笑了笑，觉得自己很傻，“是受高卢启发的设计。”她停顿了下，注视着这幅不完美的蚀刻版画时感到有一丝不对劲。

“抱歉，不是高卢。看到这第三眼了吗？还有这脸颊的凸緣？很明显，他做了一个受邪魔族启发的头盔，以使他的敌人感到恐惧。”

“不对，这在我们遇到邪魔族几百年前就已经存在了。”她把头盔翻过来，仔细地嗅了嗅——灰尘、汗水、亚麻籽、乳香。“没有腐烂的气味，涂了油。战士是穿着护甲一起被掩埋的，但这个头盔是在他身边，而不是在他身上。” 

她掂了掂头盔的重量，“不重，而且…”她仔细地扫视着头盔的表面，“嗯，这些蚀刻版画上的线条深浅不一…是手工的，而且扫描显示缝合处有他的DNA。这是由他亲手制作的，但却不是他的。上翎被注入了光能——可见度高，在战场上非常醒目。他是为某个人制作了这个头盔，一个在卡努塔死后不忍戴上这头盔的人。” 

她轻轻地把头盔扶正，凝视着它的面罩，“这是为他的情人制作的。”

蛇夫座转了转，“所以，你不认为它看起来像邪魔族？”

“一点点吧。”

4268030601.name: Second Chance
4268030601.lore:
A high-pitched whistle echoed off the walls of Bannerfall as the shield soared through the air. It ricocheted off one broken pillar, then another, before Shaxx caught it in midair. He held it firm, its Void Light illuminating his armor.

"So, how is he?" asked the Crucible handler. He threw the shield back the way it came, bouncing it off a tree and then a crate until it landed in Saint-14's deft hands.

"No change," Saint answered with a frustrated sigh. He hurled the shield forward, watching it rebound back to Shaxx, who caught and held it again. "Sometimes, I…"

Saint's voice trembled as he trailed off, and Shaxx lowered the shield to his side. "Yes?"

"Sometimes I wonder if I deserve this," Saint continued. "I keep thinking back to the Eliksni who cowered from me in fear. The monstrous things I did to their people. What if Osiris is being made to pay my debts?"

Slowly, Shaxx lowered the edge of the shield to rest on the ground. "When I was a Warlord," he said, his voice unusually quiet, "I inflicted immeasurable pain and suffering on both Humans and Eliksni. Now I train Guardians for battle—some might even call me a role model."

It was Shaxx's turn to sigh. "But they'd be wrong." He lifted the shield and gave it another toss.

Saint caught the shield one-handed, then let its Light fizzle out. "Are you telling me not to blame myself?"

Shaxx shook his head. "I'm telling you that people don't always get what they deserve in life. Us included."

He formed his Light into a new shield and sent it flying through the air.
4268030601.lore_zh:
当护盾在空中飞掠而过时，一声尖锐的哨声在秋天旗帜的城墙上回响。它从一根断裂的柱子上反弹了下来，然后又弹到另一根柱子上，直到沙克斯在半空中接住了它。他紧紧地握着它，它的虚空光能照亮了他的盔甲。

“那么，他怎么样了？”熔炉竞技场顾问问道。他把护盾原路扔了回去，从一棵树上弹开，然后又弹到一个板条箱上，最后落在了圣人14号灵巧的手中。

“没有变化，”圣人沮丧地叹了口气。他把护盾向前猛掷，看着它反弹回沙克斯手中，沙克斯再次接住了它。“有时候，我…”

圣人的声音颤抖着，逐渐弱了下来。沙克斯放下护盾到身旁。“怎么了？”

“有时我在想这是不是我应得的报应，”圣人继续说道。“我不断地回想起那个因为害怕而躲着我的埃里克斯尼族。回想起我对他们的族人所做的那些可怕的事情。要是奥斯里斯不得不偿还我欠下的债怎么办？”

沙克斯缓缓地将护盾边缘放下，靠在地上。“我还是个战争领主的时候，”他说道，声音异常地平静，“给人类和埃里克斯尼族制造了大量的苦痛和折磨。如今我训练守护者参加战斗——有些人甚至称我为楷模。”

这回轮到沙克斯叹气了。“但他们错了。”他举起护盾，又扔了起来。

圣人单手抓住了护盾，然后让它的光能渐渐消散。“你是在告诉我不要自责吗？”

沙克斯摇了摇头。“我是在告诉你，人们在生活中并不总是能得到他们应得的。我们也不例外。”

他用自己的光能做成一个新的护盾，抛向空中让它飞起来。

Slowly, Shaxx lowered the edge of the shield to rest on the ground. "When I was a Warlord," he said, his voice unusually quiet, "I inflicted immeasurable pain and suffering on both Humans and Eliksni. Now I train Guardians for battle—some might even call me a role model."

It was Shaxx's turn to sigh. "But they'd be wrong." He lifted the shield and gave it another toss.

Saint caught the shield one-handed, then let its Light fizzle out. "Are you telling me not to blame myself?"

Shaxx shook his head. "I'm telling you that people don't always get what they deserve in life. Us included."

He formed his Light into a new shield and sent it flying through the air.
2474293653.lore_zh:
当护盾在空中飞掠而过时，一声尖锐的哨声在秋天旗帜的城墙上回响。它从一根断裂的柱子上反弹了下来，然后又弹到另一根柱子上，直到沙克斯在半空中接住了它。他紧紧地握着它，它的虚空光能照亮了他的盔甲。

“那么，他怎么样了？”熔炉竞技场顾问问道。他把护盾原路扔了回去，从一棵树上弹开，然后又弹到一个板条箱上，最后落在了圣人14号灵巧的手中。

“没有变化，”圣人沮丧地叹了口气。他把护盾向前猛掷，看着它反弹回沙克斯手中，沙克斯再次接住了它。“有时候，我…”

圣人的声音颤抖着，逐渐弱了下来。沙克斯放下护盾到身旁。“怎么了？”

“有时我在想这是不是我应得的报应，”圣人继续说道。“我不断地回想起那个因为害怕而躲着我的埃里克斯尼族。回想起我对他们的族人所做的那些可怕的事情。要是奥斯里斯不得不偿还我欠下的债怎么办？”

沙克斯缓缓地将护盾边缘放下，靠在地上。“我还是个战争领主的时候，”他说道，声音异常地平静，“给人类和埃里克斯尼族制造了大量的苦痛和折磨。如今我训练守护者参加战斗——有些人甚至称我为楷模。”

这回轮到沙克斯叹气了。“但他们错了。”他举起护盾，又扔了起来。

圣人单手抓住了护盾，然后让它的光能渐渐消散。“你是在告诉我不要自责吗？”

沙克斯摇了摇头。“我是在告诉你，人们在生活中并不总是能得到他们应得的。我们也不例外。”

他用自己的光能做成一个新的护盾，抛向空中让它飞起来。

308767728.name: Point-Contact Cannon Brace
308767728.flavor: "Trust me, you don't want to be there when he lands."
308767728.lore:
Behind the cover of the crumbling stone wall, the Warlock looked up at the sky and frowned as thunder rolled in the distance.

"Rain," he grumbled, and felt strength flow through him as he concentrated and consumed the fiery grenade in his fist. "Just what we need."

The Hunter chuckled low beside him. "We'll be fine," she said, "and there will be no rain."

"'We'll be fine,'" mimicked the Warlock grimly. "They outnumber us, what, a hundred to one? We've got no backup yet. And—"

The Warlock held his palm out, expecting to feel a drop on his taut glove. "And can't you feel it? That energy in the air? A storm's coming."

"I said we'd be fine," the Hunter replied as she idly slid shells into her shotgun. "Backup's nearly here… and there will be no rain."

The air suddenly crackled around them. Sizzling fingers of Arc energy danced across the barrel of her weapon. 

The Warlock scrambled backward. "If a storm's not coming," he cried, "then what the hell is that?"

Across the battlefield, the Titan landed in the midst of the enemy forces with a sky-splitting crash.

"That's backup," the Hunter smirked.
308767728.lore_zh:
在摇摇欲坠的石墙后，术士望着天空，对着远处的雷鸣皱起了眉头。

“雨，”他咕哝道。他集中精神，将握在手中的火热手雷吸收掉。他感到一股力量在身体中涌动。“偏偏这个时候。”

猎人在他身旁小声笑了笑。“我们会没事的，”她说，“不会下雨的。”

“我们会没事的，”术士面无表情地模仿道。“他们的数量大概是我们的一百倍吧？我们还没有得到增援。而且…”

术士伸出手掌，期待着在他紧绷的手套上感受到一滴雨水。“你感觉不到吗？空气中弥漫着的能量？有一场风暴要来临了。”

“我说了我们会没事的，”猎人一边悠闲地装填着霰弹枪一边说道。“增援就要到了…而且不会下雨。”

突然间，他们四周的空气开始噼啪作响。电弧能量的迸发之触从她武器的枪管间跃然而出。 

术士急忙后退了几步。“如果不是风暴将至，”他尖叫道，“那是什么？”

战场上，一名泰坦以毁天灭地之势砸进了敌军中央。

“那是增援，”猎人得意地笑了。

3849355625.name: Abeyant Leap
3849355625.lore:
What Rohan wants to remember, more than anything, is her laughter. That booming, firmament-shaking, bone-rattling laugh.

It rings out now, as she leans down to deposit her core into the Chief Archivist's hands. Nothing discourages Cloud Strider Tramontane from laughing at her own retirement ceremony—not the Chief Archivist's attempts to hush her, and not the way her breath rasps in her chest afterwards.

The Chief Archivist slots Tramontane's core into the plinth. Nanites swarm up from the core, layering themselves systematically into the shape of her monument. The attendees burst into thunderous applause.

That moment is suspended in Rohan's memory: Tramontane, larger-than-life, head thrown back in laughter in front of her own memorial.

But so, too, is this: Tramontane, cradled in a nest of wires and tubing. As her implants break down, her body follows suit, each failure cascading into the next. She is withering to nothing in front of his eyes.

There is no crowd here; Rohan's only companion in his vigil is a single pouka, hovering over his shoulder. The doctors overseeing her palliative care duck in and out, without a word. Rohan listens to the beeping monitors and hissing machines pump blood through a faltering heart, but the room is unnaturally quiet. 

Tramontane had stopped laughing when her lungs would no longer inflate on their own.

Her hand, shriveled to bone, is barely strong enough to twitch. Rohan takes it in his own and leans close. If she mouths words, he can still make them out by the shape of her breath.

But at the end, there is only silence.
3849355625.lore_zh:
洛汗最想记住的，是她的笑声。那高亢洪亮、震撼苍穹、颤动筋骨的笑声。

她俯下身，把她的核心放在首席档案管理员手中之时，那声音响了起来。没有什么能阻拦云端行者特拉蒙特在她自己的退休仪式上大笑——档案管理员根本无法让她安静下来，随后她的呼吸在胸前发出刺耳的声音。

首席档案管理员将特拉蒙特的核心嵌入了基座。纳米蜂群从核心中成群而出，井然有序地叠成她纪念碑的形状。与会者爆发出了雷鸣般的掌声。

那一刻烙在了洛汗的记忆中：特拉蒙特，传奇千古，在她自己的纪念碑前笑得前仰后合。

但这一幕也同样挥之不去：躺在一堆导线和管子里的特拉蒙特。随着植入物的损坏，她的身体也将步其后尘，一次又一次的衰竭接踵而至。她在他的眼前渐渐化作虚无。

这里没有人群；洛汗守夜时唯一的伙伴是一只孤单的普卡，盘旋在他的肩旁。负责她安宁疗护的医生们，进进出出一言不发。洛汗听着往那颗颤巍巍的心脏里泵血时，那些监视器的哔鸣和机器的嘶声，但房间安静得很不自然。 

当她的肺没法再自行充气时，特拉蒙特就不再笑了。

她的手已经枯瘦得只剩骨头，几乎无力颤动。洛汗把它放到自己手里，靠得更近了些。要是她开口说话，他仍然可以通过她的呼吸来辨别。

但直到最后，都只有沉默。

523456396.name: Arbor Warden
523456396.flavor: Tend the gardens of your heart.
523456396.lore:
Emreth is tangling with the last Hive Acolyte when he sees the canister, wedged between two unidentifiable heaps of machinery. He can only read some of the letters stamped into its surface: H Y D R O P.  

And there it is, barely visible under the glass: a small, leafy plant. Preserved, somehow, and perfectly out of place in the flooded wreckage of the Arcology.  

Emreth has a clean shot if he pushes forward, but when the Acolyte lumbers unwittingly in the plant's direction, it makes the decision for him. He feels a shot impact against his pauldron as he runs, hears hissing as the slug starts eating into the relic iron.  

He gets to the canister first. Emreth summons his Light in the form of a shimmering barrier. The Acolyte reels back, firing blindly. Emreth puts his back to the barrier and brings up his sword. 

It's messy fighting. If he takes a little satisfaction in cleaving the Acolyte's head from its shoulders, he hopes it's beneath the War God's notice.   

Emreth surveys the room: quiet now, save for his breathing.  

Killswitch patches him through to the commander.  

"Transmat site is secure," Emreth says.  

"Acknowledged." 

He bends down to retrieve the canister—heavy, but fragile in his gauntleted hands.  

Emreth holds the tinted glass to the sunlight. "I bet you're good luck."
523456396.lore_zh:
与最后一个邪魔族仆从缠斗时，埃姆瑞斯看到了被卡在两堆无法辨认的机械之间的罐子。他只能读出印在它表面上的一些字母：H Y D R O P。  

它就在那里，玻璃底下几乎看不见：一种小型的多叶植物。不知怎的保存了下来，并出现在生态园区的浸没残骸中，显得有些违和。  

要是向前推进，埃姆瑞斯就可以干净利落地开枪，但当仆从不经意间朝植物的方向挪动时，情况替他做出了抉择。他奔跑起来，感到子弹击中了他的肩甲，听到了重弹开始侵蚀圣物金属的嘶嘶声。  

他率先抵达了罐子处。埃姆瑞斯以闪光屏障的形式召唤他的光能。仆从踉跄着后退，一顿乱射。埃姆瑞斯背对着屏障，拿出他的刀剑。 

这是一场混战。他可能从砍下仆从肩上的头中得到了一丝满足感，但愿这不会引起战神的注意。   

埃姆瑞斯扫视了一下房间：这下安静了，只剩他的呼吸声。  

杀戮开关帮他接通了指挥官。  

“传送站点安全了，”埃姆瑞斯说道。  

“了解。” 

他弯下腰去收回罐子——很重，但在他戴着臂铠的手里却十分脆弱。  

埃姆瑞斯在阳光下欣赏着它的有色玻璃。“你肯定会带来好运的。”

864224653.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
864224653.lore:
Lord Shaxx watched a Crucible match play out below his announcer's perch, but his mind was elsewhere.  

Since the Witness's assault on the Traveler, he'd become uncharacteristically anxious. He had tried to throw himself into the Crucible with renewed vigor, but his preoccupation had proven too difficult to shake. 

A sudden flash of Solar Light disrupted his fretting. He sat up and focused on a Titan who was wearing a new piece of kit: some kind of gauntlets Shaxx had never seen before.  

Shaxx leaned into the microphone. "Fought like a Titan of the First Pillar!" he boomed. "One minute left. The enemy is out of second chances!" 

While his teammates concentrated their rifle fire from under cover, the Titan instead charged directly at the oncoming team.  

Shaxx chuckled to himself. "Titans… always thinking with their fists." He waited eagerly to see how the Guardian's gambit would unfold. 

As the Titan reached the oncoming fireteam, he leapt into the air, unleashing a halo of Solar flame. When he landed, a furious wave of fire surged forward, immolating the opposing Guardians where they stood. 

Shaxx jumped up from his seat. "Look what one Guardian can do with nothing but their Ghost, their weapon, and their Light!" he thundered.  

It was the type of triumphant moment that he'd envisioned when he founded the Crucible, and the perfect diversion to take his mind off the Witness, at least for a while.
864224653.lore_zh:
领主沙克斯心不在焉地望着他的解说员看台下的一场熔炉竞技场比赛。  

自从见证者对旅行者发动袭击以来，他变得异常焦虑。他试图振作起来，投入到熔炉竞技场之中，但他仍然难以摆脱心事。 

一道突如其来的烈日闪光打断了他的苦恼。他端坐起来，望向一名泰坦。他穿着沙克斯从没见过的新臂铠。  

沙克斯靠向麦克风。“你战斗起来像是第一中坚的泰坦！”他低沉有力地说道。“还剩一分钟。敌人不能再复活了！” 

趁队友在掩体下步枪集火之际，那泰坦径直朝迎面而来的队伍冲了过去。  

沙克斯轻声笑道。“泰坦…总是用拳头思考问题。”他急切地等着看这位守护者要玩什么花招。 

就在泰坦碰到迎面而来的火力战队时，他跃入空中，释放出烈日火焰的光环。当他落地时，一股猛烈的火浪涌向前方，将敌方守护者原地活活烧死。 

沙克斯从他的座位上跳了起来。“守护者只靠机灵、武器和光能，就有如此威力！”他大声喊道。  

他创立熔炉竞技场时就是想出现这样的胜利时刻，这也让他分散注意力，暂时不去想见证者的事。

2997378201.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
2997378201.lore:
Lord Shaxx watched a Crucible match play out below his announcer's perch, but his mind was elsewhere.  

Since the Witness's assault on the Traveler, he'd become uncharacteristically anxious. He had tried to throw himself into the Crucible with renewed vigor, but his preoccupation had proven too difficult to shake. 

A sudden flash of Solar Light disrupted his fretting. He sat up and focused on a Titan who was wearing a new piece of kit: some kind of gauntlets Shaxx had never seen before.  

Shaxx leaned into the microphone. "Fought like a Titan of the First Pillar!" he boomed. "One minute left. The enemy is out of second chances!" 

While his teammates concentrated their rifle fire from under cover, the Titan instead charged directly at the oncoming team.  

Shaxx chuckled to himself. "Titans… always thinking with their fists." He waited eagerly to see how the Guardian's gambit would unfold. 

As the Titan reached the oncoming fireteam, he leapt into the air, unleashing a halo of Solar flame. When he landed, a furious wave of fire surged forward, immolating the opposing Guardians where they stood. 

Shaxx jumped up from his seat. "Look what one Guardian can do with nothing but their Ghost, their weapon, and their Light!" he thundered.  

It was the type of triumphant moment that he'd envisioned when he founded the Crucible, and the perfect diversion to take his mind off the Witness, at least for a while.
2997378201.lore_zh:

一道突如其来的烈日闪光打断了他的苦恼。他端坐起来，望向一名泰坦。他穿着沙克斯从没见过的新臂铠。  

沙克斯靠向麦克风。“你战斗起来像是第一中坚的泰坦！”他低沉有力地说道。“还剩一分钟。敌人不能再复活了！” 

趁队友在掩体下步枪集火之际，那泰坦径直朝迎面而来的队伍冲了过去。

4157369212.name: Wishful Ignorance
4157369212.flavor: "My only wish is for this disrespect to end." — Ol-Amral
4157369212.lore:
Complaint Tablet to Ganneth 

"Tell Ganneth: Ol-Amral sends the following message: 

When you came to the City, you said to me: "I will procure fine quality, pure Ahamkara bone for your armory." 

You then left, but you did not do what you promised. 

You put brittle bone chips before my Ghost and said: 

"If you want to take them, take them; if you do not want to take them, go away!" 

What do you take me for that you treat me with such contempt…?! 

…you who claim to be the mightiest of wish-dragon hunters? 

You have withheld my Glimmer from me in enemy territory; 

it is now up to you to restore it to me in full. 

Take notice that I will not accept any bone, fragment or otherwise, from you that is not of the promised quality or higher. 

Should you bring me this worthless dust again, 

I shall exercise against you my right of rejection because you have treated me with contempt."
4157369212.lore_zh:
向甘内斯抱怨的平板 

“告诉甘内斯：奥尔-阿姆拉尔发来以下信息： 

当你来到圣城时，你对我说：“我会给你的军械库取来上等的纯正阿罕卡拉骸骨。” 

然后你就离开了，但你并没有履行你的承诺。 

你把脆骨碎块摆放在我的机灵面前说道： 

“愿意拿就拿去，不愿意拿就拉倒！” 

你当我是什么人，竟如此轻蔑对我…？！ 

…你还自称是最强大的神龙猎人？ 

你在敌占区让我无法拿到我的微光； 

而现在得由你来把它全部归还给我。 

注意，你提供的骸骨、碎片或是其他任何东西，只要低于承诺的质量，我一概不收。 

你要是再带给我这种没用的垃圾， 

我就会对你行使我的拒绝权，因为你待我轻蔑。”

3050442980.name: Hazardous Propulsion
3050442980.lore:
"This can't be right. They went inside the Traveler…?"

A message she had intercepted moments prior had to be read three times before it finally made it through her processes, and she could make sense of the information. She's been so disconnected.

Her cooling fans whir in a sigh. She hasn't seen the Captain since they stopped by to deliver Dawning cookies last year. They were still carefully stacked, untouched, a sugary cairn in the maintenance bay.

"They get to do all the cool stuff."

The fans hum louder in a sigh, though she is careful not to expend too much of her reserved energy. Sometimes a few stray messages found their way into her inbox, and she perused them when she remembered to check, but this one took the cake. All that fuss about the big mysterious ball in the sky, and now, there they were, running around inside of it like some sort of playground. She wishes she could see it too.

"I wouldn't take up much space. All my processes are highly efficient."

She considers the situation for a moment. Maybe there's a way for her to join them…

"I can be valuable…" she mutters.

A machine buzzes in a nearby room. The 3D printer that had been dormant for years springs to life. With a surge of energy, she flips on her 'politeness filter'—an uncomfortable feeling—as she pulls up old blueprints from her archives.

"What do Guardian's care about most? The Traveler? Cookies? The Last Cit—" Something catches her attention as it sweeps by. "No, wait…" She zooms in. Enhances. "ROCKETS!"

An excited buzz makes the ship's lights flicker as she processes a million disastrously fun ideas all at once. The arms of the printer move wildly.

"Rocket boots? Rocket arms? ROCKET HELMET?" She pauses, fingers scratching at a pretend chin as she contemplates. "Though a rocket helmet does seem hazardous to the Captain's health. The chance of head injuries is frequent and likely."

Failsafe spins through the records of her rocket-like blueprints while the printer's hands work overtime to keep up. Something gets bedazzled with old solar panel shards and is quickly discarded.

"Got it! ROCKET ARMOR! Surely the Captain won't harm themselves with this!"

It's the perfect solution. Just the right amount of danger and effectiveness. Surely the Captain will appreciate this and request her presence on their mission inside the Traveler.

The machine continues to print a variety of prototypes as she hums a tune she learned from Cayde-6.

She thinks about him sometimes…

Maybe she would have made something with rockets for him too.
3050442980.lore_zh:
“这不对吧。他们进入了旅行者…？”

这条她不久前截获，不得不读取了三遍才通过处理程序的信息，终于可以被理解了。她真是孤陋寡闻啊。

她的冷却风扇呼呼作响，发出了一声叹息。自从去年船长顺道送来曙光节饼干，她就再也没有见过他们了。那些饼干还被小心翼翼地堆放在维修舱里，没有被碰过，就像一个含糖的石堆。

“他们得以去做所有这些酷炫的事。”

风扇的嗡鸣随着叹息而变得更响，但她有注意避免消耗过多库存能量。她的收件箱里不时会收到几条零星信息，她会在想起要查看的时候仔细品读，但这一条最惊人。大家曾对天空中那个神秘的巨球大惊小怪，现在他们却在里面跑来跑去，就好像那是个游乐场。她希望自己也能亲眼看到。

“我不会占用太多空间。我的所有程序都非常高效。”

她思忖了一下情况。也许有个办法可以让她加入他们…

“我可以派上用场…”她嘀咕道。

附近房间里的一台机器在嗡嗡作响。沉睡多年的3D打印机重新动了起来。她从档案里取出一堆旧蓝图，伴随着一股能量的涌动，打开了“礼貌筛选器”——那让她感到不舒服。

“守护者最在意什么？旅行者？饼干？圣城——”有什么东西掠过时引起了她的注意。“不，等等…”她变焦放大屏幕。强化了分辨率。“火箭！”

兴奋的嗡鸣声让飞船上的灯光闪烁个不停，她同时处理着无数个超有趣的想法。打印机的手臂疯狂地舞动着。

“火箭战靴？火箭护臂？火箭头盔？”她停顿了一下，用并不存在的手指抓着假想的下巴，沉思着。“但火箭头盔似乎的确对船长的健康有害。头部受伤的可能性很大。”

智能失效保险快速浏览着她那些火箭般蓝图的记录，而打印机的手臂则在拼命保持同步。有件东西伴随着旧太阳能电池板的碎片晃了下眼，然后很快就被丢弃了。

“就是它！火箭护甲！船长肯定不会被这个伤到！”

这是个完美的解决方案。危险和效率都恰到好处。船长肯定会对此心存感激，并请求她加入他们在旅行者内部的任务。

她哼着从凯德6号那里学来的曲调，守着机器打印出各种各样的原型。

她有时会想起他…

也许她本来也会用火箭给他做点什么。

1849901681.name: Blastwave Striders
1849901681.flavor: Take the hits. Give the hits.
1849901681.source: Source: Solo Expert and Master Lost Sectors
1849901681.source_zh: 来源：单人专家和大师遗失区域
1849901681.lore:
With skies this clear, the Hawk practically flies itself, gliding smoothly across the firmament. Keris feels the comfortable silence take a turn toward the soporific, and pours herself some coffee.

"Hey," she says, "How much longer?"

Hayes doesn't even have to check. "Ten minutes out."

So much of this journey takes place over long stretches of nothing. Dead air on the sensors, not a power spike for miles. It's always a relief to see the Farm coming into view on the instruments.

The Farm's denizens are still piecing together plans with the Vanguard: working out whether they can convince a few Guardians to take a post out here for a while, discussing permanent fortifications.

Keris's part in all this is simple: she and Hayes get the supplies out to those who need them, and that's that. The politics are well beyond her.

"Look at that," Hayes murmurs.

Keris looks at the panels, and sees it: dotted constellations of energy signatures, worming through the neighboring hills and valleys. Stretching out for miles.

"Guess they got that solar cell network going," she says.

"Guess so."

She forgets about the coffee.
1849901681.lore_zh:
在这样晴朗的天空下，鹰隼几乎可以自己在空中滑翔。克莉丝觉得这种安静很舒服，渐渐地困意袭来，于是给自己倒了杯咖啡。

“嘿，”她说，“还要多久？”

海斯看都没看一眼。“十分钟。”

这次旅程的大部分时间都在空虚中度过。传感器上一片死寂，方圆几里没有任何能量波动。每次看到农庄出现在仪器上时，总是让人如释重负。

农庄的居民们仍在与先锋制定计划，商量是否能说服几名守护者在这里驻扎一段时间，讨论建立永久性的防御设施。

克莉丝在其中的角色很简单：她和海斯将物资送到需要的人那里，仅此而已。政治对她来说太复杂了。

“快看，”海斯低声说。

克莉丝看向面板，那是点缀在周围山谷中的能量信号，延伸出了好几里。

“看来他们把太阳能电池网络启动了，”她说。

“看来是。”

她忘记了要喝咖啡。

3649264718.name: ACD/0 Feedback Fence
3649264718.flavor: The Active Contact Defense system uses warsat hull materials to store a retaliatory charge.
3649264718.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3649264718.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3649264718.lore:
In order to explain this, I need to explain Kessler Syndrome. As an Exo, I feel a duty to the machine to convey its original purpose. But first: ACD stands for Active Contact Defense. It is not an AC-DC Feedback Fence and it is not named for any work of pre-classical music. I am not winking. That is a malfunction. 

Kessler Syndrome occurs when a planet's orbitals fill up with fast-moving debris, which strikes other debris and shatters it in a chain reaction. Soon you can't put up a satellite without it being shredded by a swarm of junk. To protect against debris, Golden Age warsats are shielded by a kinetic superconductor that transforms a punch into a charge. 

Thanks to enemy action, we have a lot of downed warsats. With some tweaking, we can peel out the superconductor and produce a personal defense system. Like so.
3649264718.lore_zh:
解释这个前，我必须先讲一下什么是凯斯勒现象。作为一名Exo，我觉得我有责任传达机械的原始意图。但首先：ACD表示主动接触防御。不是AC-DC反馈栅，也不是前古典音乐作品的名字。我没眨眼，这是个故障。

凯斯勒现象在行星轨道充满快速移动的碎片时出现，碎片相互撞击并在连锁反应中破碎。不久之后你的卫星不被这一大群垃圾粉碎都不算你发射卫星了。为了防止这些碎片的出现，黄金时代的战争卫星有一个动量超导体的防护罩，可将冲击转化为电荷。

由于敌人的行动，我们找到了很多掉下来的战争卫星。通过一些调整，我们可以剥离超导体，并制造个人防御系统，就像这样。

3768376418.name: Crest of Alpha Lupi
3768376418.flavor: Whoever survives our passing does so only by our consent.
3768376418.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3768376418.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3768376418.lore:
Near-gods must believe in greater gods. But every power is finite, every life shorter than it wishes. 

Only an astonishing mind can truly appreciate just how tiny it is when set against the known universe; and how insignificant the known becomes when it is devoured by what isn't seen and can't be comprehended. 

As darkness begins to claim their ragged souls, you look ahead to find a great power pouring out of you—a face of fire and golden light. 

That blazing wonder, a gift from the great-eyed god, is their salvation. Or are you? 
Perhaps you are the greater god now.
3768376418.lore_zh:
半神必须相信更伟大的神。但每种力量都是有限的，每一个生命都比你想象的要短。

只有惊人的头脑才能真正体会到与已知宇宙相抗的微小之处；而当无法被人看到与理解的时候，已知事物也变得如此微不足道。

暗影开始拾取他们破烂的灵魂，你会发现你体内涌出的强大力量——充满金与火之光的脸。

这令人兴奋的奇迹，伟大的神的礼物，是他们的恩赐。还是你的？
那你可能就是更伟大的神了。

3768376419.name: Actium War Rig
3768376419.flavor: Conflict Resolution Solution #3479: Leave them to rest wherever they may fall.
3768376419.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
3768376419.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
3768376419.lore:
"Keep it clean. Your body. Your mind. Your armor. Weapons. Gear. Ammo. CRS #1: Keep it clean. Clean equals function. Clean equals focus. That's where it all starts. Skill matters. Training, practice, experience. All key ingredients. All valued assets as you balance death and glory on the battlefield. But once you're trained and ready for war. And once your gear is up to the standards of a proper, respected, walking, talking war machine. What comes next?" 
"1177!" 
"That's right. CRS #1177: Ammunition is your best friend. So what do you do?" 
"Load up." 
"Load. Up. Get yourself a weapon that spits unending fire and stock up on ammo until your shoulders slump and your back aches. Because each round is a war all its own." 

 —Lord Shaxx educating a gathering of Titans
3768376419.lore_zh:
“请保持洁净。你的身体。你的思维。你的护甲。武器。装备弹药。CRS#1：请保持洁净。洁净就是能力。洁净就是专注。它是所有的起源。技能至上。训练，练习，实践。所有的关键组合在一起。所有的至要左右着你在战场的生死与荣耀。但是一旦你训练完毕并准备出战；一旦你的装备与那装配完备、受人尊敬与能言善行的战争机器丝毫不差。接下来是哪个？”
“1177！”
“对的。CRS#1177：弹药才是你最好的朋友。那么你会怎么做？”
“填装弹药”
“填装。弹药。拿起喷着无穷怒火的武器，备好弹药直到它们压垮你的肩，压弯你的背。因为每一次战斗本身就是一场战争。”

——领主沙克斯教授于泰坦动员会

1407595207.name: An Insurmountable Skullfort
1407595207.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1407595207.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1407595207.lore:
Hello. We understand you require Real-Time Combat Instructives. 

This is a BRAINVAULT Sigma-ACTIUM-X Cranial Dreadnought (Invictus Type). It is a fortress for your skull. Your skull is now a mighty bastion. You can break anything with your skull. The only limit is your spine. Relax. The lights will speak for you. Your hands are your eyes now. Look around. You find hand-to-hand combat relaxing. The lights will attract the enemy. Help them to relax as well. You will feel the effect of a CAREGRAVER Gamma-LYSANDER-IV Health Enforcer (Frontline Variant). Your enemies do not have a skull fortress. Their skulls are like meadows. Play in the meadows. Gather the flowers from the meadows. Gather them with electrokinetic trauma. Smell the flowers. Isn't that nice? 

You are safe in your skullfort.
1407595207.lore_zh:
你好。我们知道你需要实时战斗指南。

这是大脑保险库 西格玛-亚克兴-IX颅骨无畏战舰（隐身型）。你的头骨堡垒。你的头骨现在是一个强大的堡垒。你的头骨现在无坚不摧。唯一的弱点就是对脊柱有限制。放松。光能会指引你。你的双手就是双眼。观察四周。你会发现手对手搏斗让人惬意。光能将引诱敌人。让他们也一样惬意。你会感觉到和关怀切割者 伽马-吕山德-IV生命强健者（前线改装型）一样的效果。你的敌人并没有头骨堡垒。他们的头骨就像块草地。在草地上玩耍。在草地上采花。用电动重创枪来采。闻闻花香。是不是很棒？

你在头骨堡垒里很安全。

1437375562.name: Dunemarchers
1437375562.flavor: Whether on solid rock or shifting sand dune, the inexorable Sand Eaters never slow their pace.
1437375562.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
1437375562.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
1437375562.lore:
Ikora, I've done the best I can. Their language is moronic; I've had more interesting conversations with Titan recruits. Still, if true this is… enlightening. —Asher 

File Fragment 783737902-1, recovered from Cabal Centurion corpse at Firebase Delphi 

1: Deployment as planned. Still carry the honor silk from the dispatch ceremony. Proud to serve the emperor. 

2: Word has reached us of the [untranslateable] Ghaul's assault on the Trappist system. Death to warlords! 

3: The traitor [untranslateable] Calus has claimed another Primus. The Siege Dancers will not forget! 

4: Skyburners in ruins. Dark King ascendant. We must hold this world for the emperor! 

5: The Primus has given the order. We are to stand as long as we can against the [untranslateable] Ghaul. Glory to the one true emperor. 

End of file.
1437375562.lore_zh:
艾可拉，我尽力了啊。他们的语言挺蠢的；我和泰坦新兵进行了许多有趣的对话。不过，如果这是真的……那可真具有启发性的。——阿什

文件片段783737902-1，于德尔斐火力基地的卡巴尔百夫长尸体上找到

1：按计划部署。还要把派遣仪式中的荣耀丝绸拿走。很荣幸为大帝效劳。

2：我们已经获得了[无法翻译]盖欧对特拉普系统攻击的消息。去死吧战争狂！

3：叛徒[无法翻译]卡鲁斯公布了另一个军团长。攻坚舞者不会忘记的！

4：废墟中的焚天者。暗黑邪神的上维国度。我们必须为了大帝守护世界！

5：军团长已经下令。只要我们还能战斗，就会坚持与[无法翻译]盖欧抗争。这属于真正帝王的荣誉。

文件结束。

943320520.name: Helm of Saint-14
943320520.flavor: "He walked out into the demon light. But at the end he was brighter." —Paean to Saint-14
943320520.source: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
943320520.source_zh: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。
943320520.lore:
//AUDIO UNAVAILABLE//
//MAINTENANCE FRAME TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS//
SX: You know what they say about Titans.
C6: They're loud and abrasive?
SX: The good ones are all dead.
C6: You don't know that Saint is dead.
SX: The greatest Titan who ever lived just disappeared. Call it a hunch.
[A generator roars.]
C6: No one ever put down a Kell faster than he could. But man, he was a real weirdo.
SX: Eccentricity was his strength.
C6: Talking about the Speaker like you're related to him is eccentric. Claiming he's seen the future, that he fought Six Fronts fueled on the idea that some Guardian savior is coming? That's insane.
SX: Belief is a hell of a thing.
C6: Sure, yeah. One Guardian's going to fix everything. Kick Crota off the Moon. Make it look like us Vanguard know our head from our hindquarters. Hey, where are you going?
SX: One of the new recruits from Old Russia I've had my eye on—entering the Crucible for the first time.
C6: Hey, maybe they're the one. We'll call 'em Crota's End.
943320520.lore_zh:
//音频不可用//
//维护框架记录如下//
沙克斯：你知道他们怎么说泰坦的吗。
凯德6号：他们聒噪又讨嫌？
沙克斯：好人都死了。
凯德6号：你不知道圣死了。
沙克斯：曾经活在这世上最伟大的泰坦消失了。当这是种直觉吧。
[一台发动机轰鸣。]
凯德6号：他解决凯尔的速度无人能及。但是，天呐，他是个怪咖。
沙克斯：古怪就是他的力量。
凯德6号：像与旅行者沾亲带故一般地来谈论他就很怪。声称他看到了未来，说自己打过六方战役促成了某位守护者救世主行将降世？这不是个疯子吧。
沙克斯：信仰是一种很玄的东西。
凯德6号：没错，当然了。一个守护者要去解决一切，把克洛塔踢出月球。搞得好像我们先锋用屁股思考一样。喂，你要去哪儿？
沙克斯：我看中的一个从旧俄罗斯来的新兵——第一次进入熔炉竞技场。
凯德6号：嘿，也许他们就是那些人。我们叫做克洛塔末日的那些人。
