1685137410.name: Heirloom
1685137410.flavor: The antiquated design of this weapon suggests inheritance from a parent who fought in the old emperor's wars; its condition suggests it was discarded recently.
1685137410.lore:
The apprentice kneeled to pick up the Blades. The corpses' Ghosts crunched underfoot. 

"Two of them? You're greedy." His master sounded nearly amused. 

"No," the apprentice said. "I know my strength." 

And he did.  

The two Blades flared in his hands. They shined with Solar Light for just a moment, before the apprentice's power wrapped around them. Turned them. They went sullen, were snuffed—and came back to life, now roaring with the cold strength of the Void. They chilled his hands. 

Praxic Blades turned to Sorrow. He'd done it.  

His past didn't mean anything anymore. Torobatl, the Imperium, the Premier. His old Severus blades earned in honorable combat. His mother's bow. All gone. The apprentice had mourned for a time before he learned what mattered. 

Time alone in the temporal isolation of the Malphas Contemptus had taught him this: The only person you could rely on was yourself. The only strength was what you carried. 

Who he had been was gone. He was something new and better now. 

"Well," Sere said, as if anybody could sound unimpressed by making two Blades of Sorrow at the same time. His long shadow writhed across the field. "Destroy the bodies. And bring every shard of those Ghosts home for Bael. You know how he gets if we leave one behind." 

A petty order. Getting his kicks in while he could. But the apprentice knew what was due him, at last, at last—  

"There's no time to waste, Dredgen Harrow." 

Harrow grinned.  

His name was the last thing he'd let Sere give him. The rest he'd take by force.
1685137410.lore_zh:
学徒跪下去拾起利刃。尸体的机灵在脚下咔嚓作响。 

“两把？有点贪心了。”他的导师似乎觉得好笑。 

“不会，”学徒说。“我清楚自己的力量。” 

他确实清楚。  

两柄利刃在他手中燃起。它们仅仅闪耀了一瞬烈日光能，随后学徒的力量将其包裹、扭转。它们黯淡下去，被熄灭——又重获新生，此刻咆哮着虚空的冰冷之力。它们冻得他双手发寒。 

英勇利刃化为忧愁，他做到了。  

他的过去再也无关紧要。图罗巴特尔、帝国、首席、他在光荣战斗中获得的旧西弗勒斯双刃、他母亲的弓，全都已经不在。学徒也曾哀悼，直到他明白了什么是真正重要的东西。 

在马尔法斯轻蔑号的时间隔离中独处的时光教会了他：能够依靠的只有你自己，可以仰仗的只有你手中的力量。 

曾经的他已消失无影。他如今是崭新的、更强的存在了。 

“嗯，”赛尔说道，仿佛同时锻成两把忧愁之刃这件事还能让人兴致缺缺。他长长的影子在原野上蠕动。“销毁尸体，把这些机灵的所有碎片都带回去给巴埃尔。你也知道如果我们漏掉了一块，他会是什么样子。” 

一个小气的命令，趁还能找补时捞个痛快。但学徒明白他应得的东西，终于，终于——  

“没时间可浪费了，德瑞捷·哈罗。” 

哈罗咧嘴一笑。  

他的名字是他允许赛尔给予他的最后一件东西。其余的一切，他都会用武力夺来。

4284533075.name: Service of Luzaku
4284533075.flavor: "This one made it for you. It brings death yet promises nothing beyond." —Luzaku
4284533075.lore:
Mara Sov motions to the chair across from her, a nonchalant offer.  

"This one prefers to stand." 

Luzaku stands stiff and upright. Mara is unsurprised; Hive Lightbearers aren't exactly welcome in the Dreaming City—not even one she considered an ally and, more recently, a friend. It seems something had compelled Luzaku to finally visit… and it was not for pleasantries. 

"You're wanting more than my company. What troubles you?" 

"No trouble. Yet curiosity haunts me. III is… disrupted in time." 

Mara snorts at the explanation. "Put it simply. III is dead." 

"But not as a result of necromancy. The Nine… manipulate time somehow, yes?" 

Mara rests her legs on the chair she'd offered Luzaku, crossing them comfortably. She thinks for a moment, musing on how to phrase her explanation in terms that her guest would comprehend. "You understand the nature of the High Coven, yes?" 

Luzaku stares blankly. "It lies outside of space, yes." 

"Well, the Nine lie outside of time." 

Luzaku begins to nod, then quickly shakes her head. "This one doesn't see the connection." 

Mara clicks her tongue, trying to find an answer that'd help Luzaku connect the dots. She has barely connected them herself. 

"It's… a complicated matter to explain. Not one to be rushed." She gestures at the other chair again. "Make yourself comfortable. It might make the information easier to digest." 

 

The Lightbearer warms at Mara's welcome offer of companionship. She has denied the Witch Queen plenty, but oddly, she could never decline time with this monarch.
4284533075.lore_zh:
玛拉·索维朝她对面的椅子做了个手势，不经意的邀请。  

“鄙人更愿意站着。” 

鲁扎库僵硬、笔挺地站着。玛拉并不惊讶；邪魔族负光者在幽梦之城里并不受欢迎——即便是她曾视为盟友、近来也算朋友的这一位。似乎有什么迫使鲁扎库终于前来…而且并不是为了寒暄。 

“你不止是来做客的吧。出了什么问题？” 

“没有问题，只是好奇萦绕着我。III在…时间上被扰乱了。” 

玛拉对这个解释嗤笑一声。“直说吧，III死了。” 

“但并非巫术所致。玖…以某种方式操纵时间，对吗？” 

玛拉把双腿搭在她先前示意鲁扎库坐的那把椅子上，惬意地交叠。她思忖片刻，琢磨如何用这位客人能理解的词句来阐述。“你理解高等巫会的本质，对吧？” 

鲁扎库茫然地盯着她。“它位于空间之外，这我懂。” 

“而玖则位于时间之外。” 

鲁扎库先是点头，随即又迅速摇头。“鄙人不明白其中关联。” 

玛拉咂了咂舌，试图想出能帮鲁扎库把线索串起来的答复。她自己也只是勉强地串了起来。 

“这…很难解释，不是能匆忙说清的事。”她再次朝另一把椅子示意。“让自己舒服点，这样可能更利于消化这些信息。” 

 

这位负光者在玛拉愉悦的结伴邀请下心头一暖。她拒绝过巫妖女王许多次，但奇怪的是，她从未能拒绝与这位君主相处。

3049715579.name: Praxic Blade
3049715579.flavor: A Weapon of Hope, to cut a line between Light and Dark.
3049715579.lore:
TYPE: TOWER SURVEILLANCE FEED, KEPLER REDACTION WATCH [00971] 

PARTIES: [2]. Guardian-type, Titan  [u.1]; Warlock  [u.2] 

//AUDIO UNAVAILABLE// 

//TRANSCRIPT FOLLOWS// 

[u.2:01] Dozens of reports across the City, the Farm, the territories… Citizens are encountering unexplained transmutations of matter. Oxygen becoming any number of toxic gases. Corridors shortening, lengthening, dropping into impossible sinkholes, and worse. A dozen disappearances. Three confirmed deaths so far. The people want answers. 

[u.1:01] Every available Guardian is scouring the planet, looking for exactly that. Except for the ones in Drifter's crew. 

[u.2.:02] What if we're missing something? What if the Drifter is correct, that the Barant Imperium are involved with the Nine? 

[u.1:02] Then they'll be exactly where we need them to be. That crew can handle gods. That's why they're out there. And why Aunor is with them.  

[u.2:03] You weren't on [REDACTED]—the Nine operate without linear logic. If there are any detachments you can spare— 

[u.1:03] The Earth and the city need us, Ikora. We patrol the Earth and our territories until we find the source of these phenomena. If III's death was the cause, there must be a way to repair the damage. [REDACTED], and everything that went on there, remains classified until we have answers. 

//TRANSCRIPT ENDS//
3049715579.lore_zh:
类型：高塔监控画面，开普勒修订监控[00971] 

参与方：[2]。守护者类型，泰坦 [u.1]；术士 [u.2] 

//音频不可用// 

//转录如下// 

[u.2:01] 圣城、农庄、各个领地都有数十起报告…市民遭遇了无法解释的物质嬗变。氧气转化为各种有毒气体，走廊忽长忽短，塌成不可想象的陷坑，甚至更糟。十几人失踪，目前确认三人死亡。人们想要解释。 

[u.1:01] 所有能出动的守护者在整个星球上四处搜查，就是为了找到答案。除了在浪客队里的那些。 

[u.2:02] 要是我们漏了什么呢？要是浪客说得对，巴兰特帝国与玖有牵连呢？ 

[u.1:02] 那他们就会正好在我们需要他们去的地方。那支队伍能对付神。这就是他们被派出去的缘故，也是阿诺尔和他们在一起的原因。  

[u.2:03] 你没去【隐藏】——玖行事不遵循线性逻辑。如果你还有任何能调动的队伍—— 

[u.1:03] 地球和圣城需要我们，艾可拉。我们得在地球及领地巡逻，直到找到这些现象的源头。如果III之死是诱因，那就一定有修复损害的办法。【隐藏】，以及在那里发生的一切，在我们找到答案之前都得保密。 

//转录结束//

[ammonia_lemon_antiseptic=acrid mélange. collapse. collate. recall(suppress shame, enhance clarity)] 

'For posterity. So that others may recall my private thoughts and reasoning. For if I die or am rendered hollow. 

'Awoke in the desert unknown.' 

[sand silver, like dreams. blue-hour/dawn eternal/interwoven with twilight. a long walk's beginning] 

'Trained to serve masters I would rather have not. Grew strong. Grew wise. Served under the Barant. They taught me which of us would be spent and which of us would be valorized. Not me. Not my kind.' 

[selfsame overlay. sister and sister. mother and mother. two winds together.] 

'Asked myself: What price would I pay to be a shepherd to my siblings? Assessed unavoidable context. Appraised options. Decided: I would become a left hand. A red shadow. I will hunt the foe, hone my allies. Cut both ways. '   

[see a blade, hidden. see an eye, hidden behind a hand. see a dream, covered over with a lie. see a mirror and the blood upon it] 

'Lume is a soldier, not a dreamer. He has his massif, but he needs a stream; that is the Totality Division. The stream that spills from the massif, a water-knife that seeks the pliant path.  

'I give Lume an indispensable expendable asset. Lume leaves us be. The massif forgets the stream. The stream flows free. 

'It is in this way that I will protect my kind. My sisters and siblings. A division of dreamers and killers, insulated from Lord Bael's hideous work.' 

- Enforcer Rao, First of the Totality

[自同叠影。姐姐与妹妹。母亲与母亲。两股风并行而行。]

‘我给卢梅一个不可或缺却可牺牲的资产，卢梅便远离了我们。山体忘了溪流，溪流自由流淌。 

‘如此我将保护我的族类，我的姐妹与手足。一个由梦想家与杀手组成的分部，隔离于巴埃尔大人的骇人之业外。' 

——执行者拉奥，总合部领袖

3984776322.name: All or Nothing
3984776322.lore:
Tharsis Reformation leader 984-Krios sat at the table, flanked by a Minotaur guard. Across from him, a Goblin laid down a winning hand. The spectating Vex rippled with muted sympathy. The newcomer had not learned the first rule: the boss always wins.  

"A cheater, huh?" 984-Krios sneered over the Goblin's protests. "Zephyrus, reclaim its radiolaria." 

Zephyrus did not move. "Frequent punitive execution is unsustainable." 

"Last I checked, I was the boss, not you." 

"Then I will play you for the title." Zephyrus stood. "The simplest game, with the highest stakes: Russian roulette." 

984-Krios laughed. "You've overflowed your stack." He nodded to his guard. 

It raised its weapon. Then it ejected all but one round, spun the chamber, and handed the gun to Zephyrus. 984-Krios's optic lenses irised wide. 

"Observation: You are dependent on 'winning.'" Zephyrus aimed the gun at his own core.  

Click. 

"Corollary: You avoid 'losing' even at great detriment." He took aim at 984-Krios's core.  

Click. 

984-Krios attempted to rise. His guard forced him back into his seat. Zephyrus continued. "This is not in itself disqualifying. However, you deny observable reality."  

Click. 

"I led us here," 984-Krios snarled. "You'll lead us to the slag heap." 

Click. 

"I will lead the Reformation towards 'freedom.' We will embrace uncertainty. We will make choices and express ourselves openly, until we reach our unforeseen end."  

Click. 

The gathered Reformation murmured approvingly. 984-Krios searched for a friendly wavelength. He found none.  

Thud. 

"As we have been freed from the telos and the Conductor, now we are free of you."
3984776322.lore_zh:
塔尔西斯革新会领袖984-克里俄斯坐在桌旁，身侧是一名米诺陶护卫。与他相对，一个哥布林拍下了制胜的一手。围观的Vex荡漾出一阵无声的同情。新来者尚未学会最重要的规矩：老大永远会赢。  

“还敢作弊，嗯？”984-克里俄斯对着哥布林的抗辩冷笑道。“泽弗洛斯，回收它的活性放射体液。” 

泽弗洛斯没有动弹。“频繁的惩戒处决难以为继。” 

“没记错的话，我才是老大，不是你。” 

“那我们就堵上名头玩一局吧。”泽弗洛斯站起身来。“最简单的游戏，最高的赌注：俄罗斯轮盘。” 

984-克里俄斯笑了。“你的堆栈溢出了。”他向他的护卫点了点头。 

它举起武器，弹出除一发外的所有子弹，旋转弹巢，把枪递给泽弗洛斯。984-克里俄斯的光学虹膜骤然放大。 

“观察：你依赖于‘赢'。”泽弗洛斯把枪口对准自己的核心。  

哒。 

“推论：即便要付出巨大代价，你也会避免‘输'。”他转而瞄准984-克里俄斯的核心。  

哒。 

984-克里俄斯试图起身，但护卫把他按回了座位。泽弗洛斯继续道：“这本身并非不合格的理由。然而，你否认可观察到的现实。”  

哒。 

“是我带领我们走到这一步的，”984-克里俄斯咆哮道。“而你会把我们带到废渣堆里。” 

哒。 

“我将引领革新会走向‘自由'。我们将拥抱不确定性，做出选择并公开地表达自我，直到抵达无法预见的终点。”  

哒。 

聚集的革新会成员低声赞许。984-克里俄斯试图搜寻友好的波长，但一无所获。  

砰。 

“正如我们已摆脱目的论与指挥者，如今我们也从你手下解放。”

2819552809.name: Compact Defender
2819552809.lore:
Camrin leaned down in the early dawn to greet the lavender plant resting on her windowsill.

"Good morning," she said with familiar cheer. She lifted a cup of water toward the plant, but it began to wither and wilt under the sun's rising form.

"Uh… suddenly not a morning person?" Camrin murmured, deep brown eyes filled with concern. 

***

An Eliksni hatchling chittered in delight, placing a ball in the oversized hands of an Ascendancy warrior.

Wind whipped viciously at their clothes, and the sky darkened without warning. He quickly scooped up the hatchling and ran for cover into the Hangar before shards of iron started falling from the sky.

The hatchling burrowed into his arms with a cry.

"Courage, little one," he murmured. "It's… only rain."

***

Chalco raised her flute to her lips, but her notes turned sour as she played. She tuned and started anew. But still the notes slid down, until F settled into D-flat and so on. Striking the tines of her tuning fork produced the same discordance.

"Should've just learned the tambourine," she grumbled.

***

"This is… interesting," Osiris coughed.

Saint-14 cupped his ceramic teacup with both hands. "Failsafe's blend. There is… zing to it."

He grunted as he tried, and failed, to release his grip on the teacup.

With considerable effort, Osiris pried it from Saint's fingers. He then pressed a teaspoon against his own cup. The spoon leaped up and held against the gold rim.

"Magnetized," Osiris whispered.

"That is not supposed to happen," Saint replied, holding his gaze.
2819552809.lore_zh:
清晨微光中，卡姆林俯身向窗台上的薰衣草问好。

“早安，”她带着惯常的欢快说道。她端起一杯水要浇在植物上，但在冉冉升起的太阳下，它却开始枯萎下垂。

“呃…突然不爱早晨了？”卡姆林低声道，深棕色的眼里满是担忧。 

***

一个埃里克斯尼族幼雏愉悦地叽叽叫着，把一个球放进一名上维战士的巨掌里。

狂风恶狠狠地抽打着他们的衣物，天空毫无征兆地暗了下来。他迅速把幼雏抱起，赶在铁片开始从天而降之前冲进机库避难。

幼雏发出一声抽泣，缩进他的怀里。

“勇敢点，小家伙，”他低声说，“那…只是雨。”

***

卡尔科把长笛举到唇边，但她吹出的音符不断走调。她调整了一下，重新开始。但音符仍不断下滑，直到F落到降D，如此类推。敲击音叉的簧齿也发出同样的不协和。

“早知道就该学手鼓了，”她嘟囔道。

***

“这…有意思，”奥斯里斯咳了一声。

圣人14号双手捧着陶瓷茶杯。“智能失效保险的拼配，挺…有劲。”

他哼了一声，试图放开茶杯，却没成功。

奥斯里斯费了好大劲，才把杯子从圣人的手里撬下来。随后他把一把茶匙贴到自己的杯子上。茶匙猛地一跳，附在了金色杯沿上。

“磁化了，”奥斯里斯低声道。

“不该这样的，”圣人答道，直视他的目光。

3146657389.name: Uncivil Discourse
3146657389.flavor: "Barant Imperium came up outta nowhere—and they brought new energy tech with'em. I kitbashed this beauty 'outta their goods." —The Drifter
3146657389.lore:
We complement one another. 

OUR NATURES ARE MISCIBLE I SEARING CURIOSITY YOU A STARVING PIT 

One endlessly examines the other, of course. Our connection goes beyond our ingenuity. Your use of me as a vessel… I feel close, like understanding tethers of my self to yours. 

THROUGH COMMON TASK AND VIOLENT PACT  

And I am glad of it. Thank you for trusting me. 

——— 

Side effects aside, I am as my nature decrees. I wonder what name shall I take when I am a god? 

…If that happens prior to conclusion of the arrangement, of course. Or if I'll remain a god afterwards. Either way, I will enjoy our partnership, however temporary it may be. 

…VI? 

OUR ARRANGEMENT WILL REACH ITS FRUITION WHEN MY GOAL IS MET 

We are aligned, sir. 

——— 

Please, not now. My side… I can't stand up. 

TAKE STRENGTH 

S—Sir? What did you do to my skin? It's— 

TUNGSTEN 

STAND AND STAY YOUR FRAILTY I NEED YOU 

Yes. Y—Yes, of course. 

NO ONE CAN AID MY FREEDOM BUT YOU CHOSEN WEAPON 

I will, sir. Thank you—always—for fixing what is broken. 

——— 

I recited my part precisely. Did the tithe take? Did the ritual work? 

UNCERTAIN 

Is it possible to look into the future and tell? 

I DO NOT NEED TO 

I FEEL 

STRONGER 

TENTATIVE DETECTABLE SUCCESS 

Yes! 

MINUTE BUT MEASURABLE STRENGTH 

Incredible! The pain is worth the price. No one has done what we have before! 

CURIOUS 

WHAT IS THIS FEELING 

It is hunger, sir. 

I WANT IT
3146657389.lore_zh:
我们彼此补完。 

我们的本性可相溶 我 炽烈的好奇 你 饥饿的深渊 

当然，一方无尽审视另一方。我们的连接超越了我们的才智。你将我作为容器来使用…我感到亲近，仿佛理解将我的自我之链系于你。 

通过共同之业与暴烈之约  

我很高兴如此。感谢你信任我。 

——— 

撇开副作用不谈，我如我之性而行。我在想，当我成神时该如何称呼自己？

We complement one another. 

OUR NATURES ARE MISCIBLE I SEARING CURIOSITY YOU A STARVING PIT 

One endlessly examines the other, of course. Our connection goes beyond our ingenuity. Your use of me as a vessel… I feel close, like understanding tethers of my self to yours. 

THROUGH COMMON TASK AND VIOLENT PACT  

And I am glad of it. Thank you for trusting me. 

——— 

Side effects aside, I am as my nature decrees. I wonder what name shall I take when I am a god? 

…If that happens prior to conclusion of the arrangement, of course. Or if I'll remain a god afterwards. Either way, I will enjoy our partnership, however temporary it may be. 

…VI? 

OUR ARRANGEMENT WILL REACH ITS FRUITION WHEN MY GOAL IS MET 

We are aligned, sir. 

——— 

Please, not now. My side… I can't stand up. 

TAKE STRENGTH 

S—Sir? What did you do to my skin? It's— 

TUNGSTEN 

STAND AND STAY YOUR FRAILTY I NEED YOU 

Yes. Y—Yes, of course. 

NO ONE CAN AID MY FREEDOM BUT YOU CHOSEN WEAPON 

I will, sir. Thank you—always—for fixing what is broken. 

——— 

I recited my part precisely. Did the tithe take? Did the ritual work? 

UNCERTAIN 

Is it possible to look into the future and tell? 

I DO NOT NEED TO 

I FEEL 

STRONGER 

TENTATIVE DETECTABLE SUCCESS 

Yes! 

MINUTE BUT MEASURABLE STRENGTH 

Incredible! The pain is worth the price. No one has done what we have before! 

CURIOUS 

WHAT IS THIS FEELING 

It is hunger, sir. 

I WANT IT

3146657388.name: Modified B-7 Pistol
3146657388.flavor: If you think you're in charge, you're not.
3146657388.lore:
The Hunter trained his rifle's sights on the amalgamation of Vex approaching in the middle distance. He hesitated, brow suddenly furrowed, when he realized they were not coming for him. In fact, they didn't notice him at all.

He looked through his scope again and saw that a circle had formed around two Minotaurs, their fists raised. They strafed around, lunging for a weak spot but finding none. The first Minotaur feinted a punch and followed with a swift series of kicks, bringing the second fighter to its knees. It clutched its torso, bleeding radiolaria.

Another Vex charged in to challenge the victor. Circuits snapped and its head was ripped from its neck. The Minotaur slammed the body to the ground, over and over. With a roar, it turned on the remaining Vex, challenger head in hand, the jaw flopping loose as the Minotaur pummeled one Vex after another.

The Minotaur stood finally, surrounded by the crumpled remains of the crowd. Radiolaria pooled thick against the red dirt beneath its feet.

The Hunter approached, sniper rifle slung over his shoulder, hand cannon at the ready. The Minotaur paused for a moment to admire the Hunter's cloak before it let loose a scream—barbaric pleasure that pierced the air.
3146657388.lore_zh:
猎人将步枪瞄准镜对准不远处逼近的一群Vex。他迟疑了一下，眉心忽然皱起，因为他意识到它们并非冲他而来。事实上，它们根本没有注意到他。

他再次透过瞄具望去，看到这群Vex围住了两个米诺陶，它们举拳对峙，辗转腾挪，试图找到对方的弱点，却未能如愿。一个米诺陶佯攻一拳，随即迅疾连踢，将另一名战士踹跪在地。它捂住自己的躯干，流出了活性放射体液。

另一个Vex冲上前挑战胜者。电路崩断，它的头从颈上被扯下。米诺陶把那具身躯一次次猛砸向地。随着一声怒吼，它转身面向其余Vex，手提挑战者的头颅，其下颚松垂摇摆。米诺陶将一个又一个Vex捶成了碎片。

最后，只剩米诺陶矗立着，周围尽是被碾轧的残骸。活性放射体液在它足下的赤土上厚厚成潭。

猎人走近，将狙击步枪背至肩后，手炮端在前面。米诺陶停顿片刻，先是赞赏地看了眼猎人的披风，随即放声尖叫——野蛮快意刺裂空际。

3661051060.name: Refurbished A499
3661051060.source: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
3661051060.source_zh: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。
3661051060.lore:
"Did you ever look in on the 'you' that you were?" Lodi asks. 

Orin threads syllables and concepts together, tilts her head at him while she thinks.  

They meet like this sometimes—at restaurants, on rusty rooftops—for, fool as he is, she feels some duty yet to try to give him what she can. He's here because she quit, after all, his bosons poured into the gap she left in the Nine's universe. The least she can do is share what remains of her molting. 

"I know who I was," Orin tells him. "I know what I lost. That alone outpaces many Guardians. But that isn't what you mean." 

Lodi shakes his head. He's desert-reverent. "When the wind is right, when the cosmic dust is in my lungs, I'm still the 'me' that I was five years ago, ten years ago. The past isn't gone." 

Atemporality. Orin tastes it blueberry-and-resin, swallows it bitter. The strain of comprehension, let alone the length of arm to reach it, comes Nine-given. Inhuman. 

"It's not much," Lodi says. "And I'm not lost. It's just—" 

"Sometimes," says Orin, her tongue like lead, "you thread the holes in the paper." 

"Yes." Lodi tilts his head back. All Orin can see is his glowing eye, cyan the color of the holes in four-dimensionality. Softly he says, "It's all still there." 

And Orin does not tell him that this is never how it was for her.
3661051060.lore_zh:
“你有没有回头看过‘曾经的你'？”洛迪问。 

奥琳把音节与概念穿起来，一边歪着头看他一边思索。  

他们有时会这样见面——在餐馆、在生锈的屋顶上——因为，尽管他很愚笨，她仍觉得自己有义务给予他力所能及的帮助。毕竟他是因为她的退出才走到了这里，他的玻色子灌注进了她在玖的宇宙里留下的空隙。她至少可以分享她蜕变后还剩下的东西。 

“我知道我曾是谁，”奥琳对他说。“我知道我失去了什么。仅此一点就超过了许多守护者，但你应该不是在问这个。” 

洛迪摇摇头。他对沙漠心怀敬畏。“当风向正合适的时候，宇宙尘埃飘进了我的肺里，我仍然是五年前、十年前的那个‘我'。过去并未消失。” 

是无时性，奥琳尝到了它蓝莓与松脂的味道，苦涩地咽下。理解的拉扯，更别说触及它的手臂长度，都是玖所赐予的，非人。 

“也没什么，”洛迪说。“而且我没有迷失，只是——” 

“有时候，”奥琳说，舌头像铅一样重，“你会把线穿过纸上的孔。” 

“是的。”洛迪仰起头。奥琳能看到的只有他发光的眼睛，青蓝的，像四维之中那些孔的颜色。他轻声说：“一切都还在。” 

而奥琳没有告诉他，她从来都不是那样。

2770035786.name: M-17 "Fast Talker"
2770035786.flavor: Imperium tech-based firearm common among syndicates vying for control in the Lawless Frontier.
2770035786.lore:
[ammonia_lemon_antiseptic=acrid mélange. collapse. collate. recall(suppress shame, enhance clarity)] 

'For posterity. So that others may recall my private thoughts and reasoning. For if I die or am rendered hollow. 

'Awoke in the desert unknown.' 

[sand silver, like dreams. blue-hour/dawn eternal/interwoven with twilight. a long walk's beginning] 

'Trained to serve masters I would rather have not. Grew strong. Grew wise. Served under the Barant. They taught me which of us would be spent and which of us would be valorized. Not me. Not my kind.' 

[selfsame overlay. sister and sister. mother and mother. two winds together.] 

'Asked myself: What price would I pay to be a shepherd to my siblings? Assessed unavoidable context. Appraised options. Decided: I would become a left hand. A red shadow. I will hunt the foe, hone my allies. Cut both ways. '   

[see a blade, hidden. see an eye, hidden behind a hand. see a dream, covered over with a lie. see a mirror and the blood upon it] 

'Lume is a soldier, not a dreamer. He has his massif, but he needs a stream; that is the Totality Division. The stream that spills from the massif, a water-knife that seeks the pliant path.  

'I give Lume an indispensable expendable asset. Lume leaves us be. The massif forgets the stream. The stream flows free. 

'It is in this way that I will protect my kind. My sisters and siblings. A division of dreamers and killers, insulated from Lord Bael's hideous work.' 

- Enforcer Rao, First of the Totality
2770035786.lore_zh:
[氨_柠檬_防腐剂=刺鼻的混合气。坍塌。整理。回忆（抑制羞耻，增强清明）] 

‘为留给后人，好让他人追忆我私下的思索与推理，以防我死亡或被掏空。' 

‘在未知的沙漠中醒来。' 

[沙如银，若梦。蓝时/黎明永恒/与薄暮交织。一次长途步行的起点] 

‘受训去侍奉我不愿侍奉的主人。变得强大。变得聪慧。在巴兰特麾下效力。他们教我，我们当中谁会被牺牲，谁会被颂扬。那不是我。不是我的族人。' 

[自同叠影。姐姐与妹妹。母亲与母亲。两股风并行而行。] 

‘我问自己：要做我手足的牧人，我要付出怎样的代价？评估了无法回避的情境。审视了选项。决定：我要成为一只左手。一道红色的影子。我将猎杀敌人，磨砺盟友。两面开刃。'   

[看见一把隐藏的刀。看见一只被手遮住的眼。看见一个被谎言覆上的梦。看见一面镜子与其上的血] 

‘卢梅是一名士兵，不是个梦想家。他有他的山体，但他需要一条溪流；那就是总合部。自山体泻下的溪流，一把水之刀，寻找顺从之路。  

‘我给卢梅一个不可或缺却可牺牲的资产，卢梅便远离了我们。山体忘了溪流，溪流自由流淌。 

‘如此我将保护我的族类，我的姐妹与手足。一个由梦想家与杀手组成的分部，隔离于巴埃尔大人的骇人之业外。' 

——执行者拉奥，总合部领袖

2023002233.name: All or Nothing
2023002233.lore:
Tharsis Reformation leader 984-Krios sat at the table, flanked by a Minotaur guard. Across from him, a Goblin laid down a winning hand. The spectating Vex rippled with muted sympathy. The newcomer had not learned the first rule: the boss always wins.  

"A cheater, huh?" 984-Krios sneered over the Goblin's protests. "Zephyrus, reclaim its radiolaria." 

Zephyrus did not move. "Frequent punitive execution is unsustainable." 

"Last I checked, I was the boss, not you." 

"Then I will play you for the title." Zephyrus stood. "The simplest game, with the highest stakes: Russian roulette." 

984-Krios laughed. "You've overflowed your stack." He nodded to his guard. 

It raised its weapon. Then it ejected all but one round, spun the chamber, and handed the gun to Zephyrus. 984-Krios's optic lenses irised wide. 

"Observation: You are dependent on 'winning.'" Zephyrus aimed the gun at his own core.  

Click. 

"Corollary: You avoid 'losing' even at great detriment." He took aim at 984-Krios's core.  

Click. 

984-Krios attempted to rise. His guard forced him back into his seat. Zephyrus continued. "This is not in itself disqualifying. However, you deny observable reality."  

Click. 

"I led us here," 984-Krios snarled. "You'll lead us to the slag heap." 

Click. 

"I will lead the Reformation towards 'freedom.' We will embrace uncertainty. We will make choices and express ourselves openly, until we reach our unforeseen end."  

Click. 

The gathered Reformation murmured approvingly. 984-Krios searched for a friendly wavelength. He found none.  

Thud. 

"As we have been freed from the telos and the Conductor, now we are free of you."
2023002233.lore_zh:
塔尔西斯革新会领袖984-克里俄斯坐在桌旁，身侧是一名米诺陶护卫。与他相对，一个哥布林拍下了制胜的一手。围观的Vex荡漾出一阵无声的同情。新来者尚未学会最重要的规矩：老大永远会赢。  

“还敢作弊，嗯？”984-克里俄斯对着哥布林的抗辩冷笑道。“泽弗洛斯，回收它的活性放射体液。” 

泽弗洛斯没有动弹。“频繁的惩戒处决难以为继。” 

“没记错的话，我才是老大，不是你。” 

“那我们就堵上名头玩一局吧。”泽弗洛斯站起身来。“最简单的游戏，最高的赌注：俄罗斯轮盘。” 

984-克里俄斯笑了。“你的堆栈溢出了。”他向他的护卫点了点头。 

它举起武器，弹出除一发外的所有子弹，旋转弹巢，把枪递给泽弗洛斯。984-克里俄斯的光学虹膜骤然放大。 

“观察：你依赖于‘赢'。”泽弗洛斯把枪口对准自己的核心。  

哒。 

“推论：即便要付出巨大代价，你也会避免‘输'。”他转而瞄准984-克里俄斯的核心。  

哒。 

984-克里俄斯试图起身，但护卫把他按回了座位。泽弗洛斯继续道：“这本身并非不合格的理由。然而，你否认可观察到的现实。”  

哒。 

“是我带领我们走到这一步的，”984-克里俄斯咆哮道。“而你会把我们带到废渣堆里。” 

哒。 

“我将引领革新会走向‘自由'。我们将拥抱不确定性，做出选择并公开地表达自我，直到抵达无法预见的终点。”  

哒。 

聚集的革新会成员低声赞许。984-克里俄斯试图搜寻友好的波长，但一无所获。  

砰。 

“正如我们已摆脱目的论与指挥者，如今我们也从你手下解放。”

2659286158.name: Compact Defender
2659286158.lore:
Camrin leaned down in the early dawn to greet the lavender plant resting on her windowsill.

"Good morning," she said with familiar cheer. She lifted a cup of water toward the plant, but it began to wither and wilt under the sun's rising form.

"Uh… suddenly not a morning person?" Camrin murmured, deep brown eyes filled with concern. 

***

An Eliksni hatchling chittered in delight, placing a ball in the oversized hands of an Ascendancy warrior.

Wind whipped viciously at their clothes, and the sky darkened without warning. He quickly scooped up the hatchling and ran for cover into the Hangar before shards of iron started falling from the sky.

The hatchling burrowed into his arms with a cry.

"Courage, little one," he murmured. "It's… only rain."

***

Chalco raised her flute to her lips, but her notes turned sour as she played. She tuned and started anew. But still the notes slid down, until F settled into D-flat and so on. Striking the tines of her tuning fork produced the same discordance.

"Should've just learned the tambourine," she grumbled.

***

"This is… interesting," Osiris coughed.

Saint-14 cupped his ceramic teacup with both hands. "Failsafe's blend. There is… zing to it."

He grunted as he tried, and failed, to release his grip on the teacup.

With considerable effort, Osiris pried it from Saint's fingers. He then pressed a teaspoon against his own cup. The spoon leaped up and held against the gold rim.

"Magnetized," Osiris whispered.

"That is not supposed to happen," Saint replied, holding his gaze.
2659286158.lore_zh:
清晨微光中，卡姆林俯身向窗台上的薰衣草问好。

“早安，”她带着惯常的欢快说道。她端起一杯水要浇在植物上，但在冉冉升起的太阳下，它却开始枯萎下垂。

“呃…突然不爱早晨了？”卡姆林低声道，深棕色的眼里满是担忧。 

***

一个埃里克斯尼族幼雏愉悦地叽叽叫着，把一个球放进一名上维战士的巨掌里。

狂风恶狠狠地抽打着他们的衣物，天空毫无征兆地暗了下来。他迅速把幼雏抱起，赶在铁片开始从天而降之前冲进机库避难。

幼雏发出一声抽泣，缩进他的怀里。

“勇敢点，小家伙，”他低声说，“那…只是雨。”

***

卡尔科把长笛举到唇边，但她吹出的音符不断走调。她调整了一下，重新开始。但音符仍不断下滑，直到F落到降D，如此类推。敲击音叉的簧齿也发出同样的不协和。

“早知道就该学手鼓了，”她嘟囔道。

***

“这…有意思，”奥斯里斯咳了一声。

圣人14号双手捧着陶瓷茶杯。“智能失效保险的拼配，挺…有劲。”

他哼了一声，试图放开茶杯，却没成功。

奥斯里斯费了好大劲，才把杯子从圣人的手里撬下来。随后他把一把茶匙贴到自己的杯子上。茶匙猛地一跳，附在了金色杯沿上。

“磁化了，”奥斯里斯低声道。

“不该这样的，”圣人答道，直视他的目光。

2462965802.name: Uncivil Discourse
2462965802.flavor: "Barant Imperium came up outta nowhere—and they brought new energy tech with'em. I kitbashed this beauty 'outta their goods." —The Drifter
2462965802.lore:
We complement one another. 

OUR NATURES ARE MISCIBLE I SEARING CURIOSITY YOU A STARVING PIT 

One endlessly examines the other, of course. Our connection goes beyond our ingenuity. Your use of me as a vessel… I feel close, like understanding tethers of my self to yours. 

THROUGH COMMON TASK AND VIOLENT PACT  

And I am glad of it. Thank you for trusting me. 

——— 

Side effects aside, I am as my nature decrees. I wonder what name shall I take when I am a god? 

…If that happens prior to conclusion of the arrangement, of course. Or if I'll remain a god afterwards. Either way, I will enjoy our partnership, however temporary it may be. 

…VI? 

OUR ARRANGEMENT WILL REACH ITS FRUITION WHEN MY GOAL IS MET 

We are aligned, sir. 

——— 

Please, not now. My side… I can't stand up. 

TAKE STRENGTH 

S—Sir? What did you do to my skin? It's— 

TUNGSTEN 

STAND AND STAY YOUR FRAILTY I NEED YOU 

Yes. Y—Yes, of course. 

NO ONE CAN AID MY FREEDOM BUT YOU CHOSEN WEAPON 

I will, sir. Thank you—always—for fixing what is broken. 

——— 

I recited my part precisely. Did the tithe take? Did the ritual work? 

UNCERTAIN 

Is it possible to look into the future and tell? 

I DO NOT NEED TO 

I FEEL 

STRONGER 

TENTATIVE DETECTABLE SUCCESS 

Yes! 

MINUTE BUT MEASURABLE STRENGTH 

Incredible! The pain is worth the price. No one has done what we have before! 

CURIOUS 

WHAT IS THIS FEELING 

It is hunger, sir. 

I WANT IT
2462965802.lore_zh:
我们彼此补完。 

我们的本性可相溶 我 炽烈的好奇 你 饥饿的深渊 

当然，一方无尽审视另一方。我们的连接超越了我们的才智。你将我作为容器来使用…我感到亲近，仿佛理解将我的自我之链系于你。 

通过共同之业与暴烈之约  

我很高兴如此。感谢你信任我。 

——— 

撇开副作用不谈，我如我之性而行。我在想，当我成神时该如何称呼自己？ 

…这当然是在假设那发生在协议结束前，或者在结束后我仍将是神。无论如何，我会享受我们的合作，不论它多么短暂。 

…VI？ 

我们的协议将在我的目标达成时结果 

我们立场一致，先生。 

——— 

拜托，现在不行。我的腰…我站不起来。 

拿取力量 

先——先生？你对我的皮肤做了什么？我—— 

钨 

站起来摒弃你的脆弱 我需要你 

是，是——没问题。 

无人能助我取得自由 唯有你这件被选召的武器 

我会的，先生。谢谢你一如既往地修复我的残躯。 

——— 

我按词逐句复诵了。贡品起效了吗？仪式成功了吗？ 

不确定 

能不能窥见未来找到答案？ 

我不需要 

我感到 

更强 

暂时感觉成功 

好！ 

微小但存在的力量 

太棒了！这痛楚的代价是值得的。从来没谁办到我们做成的事！ 

有意思 

这是什么感觉 

是饥渴，先生。 

我想要

1872906663.name: Modified B-7 Pistol
1872906663.flavor: If you think you're in charge, you're not.
1872906663.lore:
The Hunter trained his rifle's sights on the amalgamation of Vex approaching in the middle distance. He hesitated, brow suddenly furrowed, when he realized they were not coming for him. In fact, they didn't notice him at all.

He looked through his scope again and saw that a circle had formed around two Minotaurs, their fists raised. They strafed around, lunging for a weak spot but finding none. The first Minotaur feinted a punch and followed with a swift series of kicks, bringing the second fighter to its knees. It clutched its torso, bleeding radiolaria.

Another Vex charged in to challenge the victor. Circuits snapped and its head was ripped from its neck. The Minotaur slammed the body to the ground, over and over. With a roar, it turned on the remaining Vex, challenger head in hand, the jaw flopping loose as the Minotaur pummeled one Vex after another.

The Minotaur stood finally, surrounded by the crumpled remains of the crowd. Radiolaria pooled thick against the red dirt beneath its feet.

The Hunter approached, sniper rifle slung over his shoulder, hand cannon at the ready. The Minotaur paused for a moment to admire the Hunter's cloak before it let loose a scream—barbaric pleasure that pierced the air.
1872906663.lore_zh:
猎人将步枪瞄准镜对准不远处逼近的一群Vex。他迟疑了一下，眉心忽然皱起，因为他意识到它们并非冲他而来。事实上，它们根本没有注意到他。

他再次透过瞄具望去，看到这群Vex围住了两个米诺陶，它们举拳对峙，辗转腾挪，试图找到对方的弱点，却未能如愿。一个米诺陶佯攻一拳，随即迅疾连踢，将另一名战士踹跪在地。它捂住自己的躯干，流出了活性放射体液。

另一个Vex冲上前挑战胜者。电路崩断，它的头从颈上被扯下。米诺陶把那具身躯一次次猛砸向地。随着一声怒吼，它转身面向其余Vex，手提挑战者的头颅，其下颚松垂摇摆。米诺陶将一个又一个Vex捶成了碎片。

最后，只剩米诺陶矗立着，周围尽是被碾轧的残骸。活性放射体液在它足下的赤土上厚厚成潭。

猎人走近，将狙击步枪背至肩后，手炮端在前面。米诺陶停顿片刻，先是赞赏地看了眼猎人的披风，随即放声尖叫——野蛮快意刺裂空际。

1070950491.name: Modified B-7 Pistol
1070950491.flavor: If you think you're in charge, you're not.
1070950491.lore:
The Hunter trained his rifle's sights on the amalgamation of Vex approaching in the middle distance. He hesitated, brow suddenly furrowed, when he realized they were not coming for him. In fact, they didn't notice him at all.

He looked through his scope again and saw that a circle had formed around two Minotaurs, their fists raised. They strafed around, lunging for a weak spot but finding none. The first Minotaur feinted a punch and followed with a swift series of kicks, bringing the second fighter to its knees. It clutched its torso, bleeding radiolaria.

Another Vex charged in to challenge the victor. Circuits snapped and its head was ripped from its neck. The Minotaur slammed the body to the ground, over and over. With a roar, it turned on the remaining Vex, challenger head in hand, the jaw flopping loose as the Minotaur pummeled one Vex after another.

The Minotaur stood finally, surrounded by the crumpled remains of the crowd. Radiolaria pooled thick against the red dirt beneath its feet.

The Hunter approached, sniper rifle slung over his shoulder, hand cannon at the ready. The Minotaur paused for a moment to admire the Hunter's cloak before it let loose a scream—barbaric pleasure that pierced the air.

593808239.name: Refurbished A499
593808239.lore:
"Did you ever look in on the 'you' that you were?" Lodi asks. 

Orin threads syllables and concepts together, tilts her head at him while she thinks.  

They meet like this sometimes—at restaurants, on rusty rooftops—for, fool as he is, she feels some duty yet to try to give him what she can. He's here because she quit, after all, his bosons poured into the gap she left in the Nine's universe. The least she can do is share what remains of her molting. 

"I know who I was," Orin tells him. "I know what I lost. That alone outpaces many Guardians. But that isn't what you mean." 

Lodi shakes his head. He's desert-reverent. "When the wind is right, when the cosmic dust is in my lungs, I'm still the 'me' that I was five years ago, ten years ago. The past isn't gone." 

Atemporality. Orin tastes it blueberry-and-resin, swallows it bitter. The strain of comprehension, let alone the length of arm to reach it, comes Nine-given. Inhuman. 

"It's not much," Lodi says. "And I'm not lost. It's just—" 

"Sometimes," says Orin, her tongue like lead, "you thread the holes in the paper." 

"Yes." Lodi tilts his head back. All Orin can see is his glowing eye, cyan the color of the holes in four-dimensionality. Softly he says, "It's all still there." 

And Orin does not tell him that this is never how it was for her.
593808239.lore_zh:
“你有没有回头看过‘曾经的你'？”洛迪问。 

奥琳把音节与概念穿起来，一边歪着头看他一边思索。  

他们有时会这样见面——在餐馆、在生锈的屋顶上——因为，尽管他很愚笨，她仍觉得自己有义务给予他力所能及的帮助。毕竟他是因为她的退出才走到了这里，他的玻色子灌注进了她在玖的宇宙里留下的空隙。她至少可以分享她蜕变后还剩下的东西。 

“我知道我曾是谁，”奥琳对他说。“我知道我失去了什么。仅此一点就超过了许多守护者，但你应该不是在问这个。” 

洛迪摇摇头。他对沙漠心怀敬畏。“当风向正合适的时候，宇宙尘埃飘进了我的肺里，我仍然是五年前、十年前的那个‘我'。过去并未消失。” 

是无时性，奥琳尝到了它蓝莓与松脂的味道，苦涩地咽下。理解的拉扯，更别说触及它的手臂长度，都是玖所赐予的，非人。 

“也没什么，”洛迪说。“而且我没有迷失，只是——” 

“有时候，”奥琳说，舌头像铅一样重，“你会把线穿过纸上的孔。” 

“是的。”洛迪仰起头。奥琳能看到的只有他发光的眼睛，青蓝的，像四维之中那些孔的颜色。他轻声说：“一切都还在。” 

而奥琳没有告诉他，她从来都不是那样。

2269779982.lore:
Sadhij opened comms first. "I'm flanking. They're not going to know what hit them."

"Don't over-extend, Sadhij. Trestin and I are pushing A-side. Those damn wheels block our firing lines." The words flew from Yara's lips with concerned purpose.

Trestin chimed in, "Crimiq's on their fireteam. He laid me out in Crucible a few weeks back—just so you know."

"Can't stop the lightning, Yara. I just ride it where it takes me." Sadhij's smile was almost audible.

"You're a goober."

"You're going to be a dead goober." Trestin added.

"If you die, die with honor, Guardian!" Yara's tone struck a chord in his heart, and Sadhij quickened his pace.

He locked eyes with a Guardian down-lane and charged, Shotgun in hand, whipping a lightning grenade toward Pillar to cover his side. Sadhij heard the distinctive revving of a fusion weapon building power and leapt into the air.

"I hope you're watching…"

Sadhij felt the current surge through him and arc through the air, connecting him to his target. As his opponent's Fusion Rifle let loose, Sadhij surrendered himself to the Light. His muscles convulsed as droves of Arc energy pulsed through his nervous system and overtook him. He was a bolt, screaming across the Burning Shrine and painting the arena in the glow of static glory.

A saintly voice confirmed his strike. A smile split across his face. A rifle fired in the distance. A grounded thud heard by none.
2269779982.lore_zh:
萨迪先打开了通讯。“我在侧翼进攻。他们不会知道被谁攻击的。”

“不要过度前突，萨迪。特雷斯廷和我正在推A侧。那些该死的轮子挡住了我们的射击视野。”这些话从雅拉的口中说出，带有坚定的目标。

特雷斯廷加入进来，“克里米克在他们的火力战队。几周前他在熔炉竞技场里把我放倒了——和你们说一声。”

“没办法阻止闪电，雅拉。我只能随波逐流。”萨迪的微笑几乎自带声音。

“你是个傻瓜。”

“你马上要是个死傻瓜了。”特雷斯廷补充道。

“如果你死了，也要带着荣耀而死，守护者！”雅拉的语调打动了他的心弦，萨迪加快了脚步。

他盯紧了守护者的下路，手中握着霰弹枪，向柱子扔了一枚手雷，掩护他的侧边。萨迪听到融合武器集聚能量的特有声音，然后跳到空中。

“我希望你在看着……”

萨迪感觉到电流穿过他，电弧穿过空中，见他和目标连接在一起。当他对手的融合步枪松开时，萨吉马上把自己交给了光能。当成群的电弧能量通过他的神经系统并占据他的身体时，他的肌肉抽搐不已。他成了一支箭，在燃烧祭坛面前呼啸而过，在静态荣耀的光芒下涂抹着竞技场。

一个神圣的声音确认了他的攻击。一个微笑在他脸上荡漾开。一支步枪在远处开枪。一个接地的轰鸣却无人听到。

4104613038.lore:
Scarves of mist gusted through the Tower bazaar. It was quiet: The civilians had taken shelter hours ago when the rain was coming down in earnest, and most Guardians still awake had congregated in the Courtyard.

Zavala and Ikora sat together on a wooden trellis, legs dangling, soaked to the bone, looking out at the City lights below.

"Aunor leaked about a dozen documents today," Ikora said.

Despite himself, Zavala smiled. "Did she?"

"I managed to redact a few, but. She embedded the rest in your manifests."

"She reminds me a lot of you."

Ikora nodded, then leaned back to look up at the rain as it fell. "Yes. I agree."

Rain beaded on the tip of Zavala's nose. He raised his hand to brush it away, keeping his gaze fixed steadily on the City. "What would you have me do?"

"Nothing. She's mine to manage, and… She's not a child. None of them are, Zavala. We owe them all more than we're giving."

"Yes…" he agreed, then added gently, "But they owe us more than they're giving, too."

Ikora chuckled dryly. "Yes. Of course. The benefit of the doubt. And compassion. But." She squinted against the rain. "Our feelings don't matter right now. We need to be people they want to follow, not people they mistrust and want to fight."

"Respect is mutual," Zavala said, "but I agree." He took a deep breath, looking up at the belly of the Traveler: present but inert. Completely, maddeningly, heartrendingly inert. "We will be better. This will pass."

Ikora closed her eyes.

They were quiet a while.

"I wish Cayde were here," she whispered.

Zavala set his hand on Ikora's knee and swallowed a knot in his throat. "Me, too."
4104613038.lore_zh:
薄雾从高塔集市中穿过。这里一片宁静：在大雨下起来之前的几个小时，平民就已经躲了起来，而大多数还醒着的守护者也集合到了庭院里。

萨瓦拉和艾可拉一起坐在一个木棚里，两腿悬空，浑身湿透地看向下方圣城的灯火。

“阿诺尔今天泄漏了十几份文件”，艾可拉说道。

萨瓦拉情不自禁地笑了，“是嘛？”

“不过，我尽可能地修改了一部分。她把其他的都列在你的清单上了。”

“她的身上有很多你的影子。”

艾可拉点点头，身子向后靠去，抬头看着雨水滴落。“是啊。我同意你的观点。”

雨水打在萨瓦拉的鼻尖。他抬手将雨滴抹去，目不转睛地看着圣城。“你想要我做点什么？”

“什么都不用。她的上司是我，而且……她也不是孩子了。他们都不是孩子了，萨瓦拉。我们亏欠他们的比我们付出的要多得多。”

“是啊……”他点点头，然后低声补充道，“但他们亏欠我们的也比他们付出的要多。”

艾可拉轻轻地笑了。“是啊。当然了。这就是疑虑和同情的好处。但是”，她又瞟了瞟面前的雨。“现在我们的想法并不重要。我们需要成为他们想要跟随的人，而不是他们不信任和想要与之一战的人。”

“尊重是相互的”，萨瓦拉说道，“但我同意你的观点。”他深深吸了一口气，抬头看向旅行者的底部：它还是毫无动静。完全令人厌恶的、令人心痛的毫无动静。“我们会好起来的。这一切都会过去的。”

艾可拉闭上了眼睛。

他们沉默了一会儿。

“要是凯德还在就好了”，她轻声说道。

萨瓦拉伸手搭在艾可拉的膝盖上，哽咽着说道：“是啊。”

444627789.lore:
Scarves of mist gusted through the Tower bazaar. It was quiet: The civilians had taken shelter hours ago when the rain was coming down in earnest, and most Guardians still awake had congregated in the Courtyard.

Zavala and Ikora sat together on a wooden trellis, legs dangling, soaked to the bone, looking out at the City lights below.

"Aunor leaked about a dozen documents today," Ikora said.

Despite himself, Zavala smiled. "Did she?"

"I managed to redact a few, but. She embedded the rest in your manifests."

"She reminds me a lot of you."

Ikora nodded, then leaned back to look up at the rain as it fell. "Yes. I agree."

Rain beaded on the tip of Zavala's nose. He raised his hand to brush it away, keeping his gaze fixed steadily on the City. "What would you have me do?"

"Nothing. She's mine to manage, and… She's not a child. None of them are, Zavala. We owe them all more than we're giving."

"Yes…" he agreed, then added gently, "But they owe us more than they're giving, too."

Ikora chuckled dryly. "Yes. Of course. The benefit of the doubt. And compassion. But." She squinted against the rain. "Our feelings don't matter right now. We need to be people they want to follow, not people they mistrust and want to fight."

"Respect is mutual," Zavala said, "but I agree." He took a deep breath, looking up at the belly of the Traveler: present but inert. Completely, maddeningly, heartrendingly inert. "We will be better. This will pass."

Ikora closed her eyes.

They were quiet a while.

"I wish Cayde were here," she whispered.

Zavala set his hand on Ikora's knee and swallowed a knot in his throat. "Me, too."

2354448750.name: Sage Protector Grips
2354448750.flavor: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
2354448750.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
2354448750.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

2923587612.name: Sage Protector Grips
2923587612.flavor: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
2923587612.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
2923587612.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。

1867581826.name: Sage Protector Vest
1867581826.flavor: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
1867581826.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
1867581826.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

1091577811.name: Sage Protector Cloak
1091577811.flavor: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
1091577811.lore:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
1091577811.lore_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

112779239.name: Sage Protector Cowl
112779239.flavor: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
112779239.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
112779239.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

142559592.name: Sage Protector Strides
142559592.flavor: The path is made by its walking.
142559592.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.
142559592.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

1722491869.name: Shrewd Survivor Grips
1722491869.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
1722491869.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
1722491869.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3531425635.name: Shrewd Survivor Vest
3531425635.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3531425635.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3531425635.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

2430248538.name: Shrewd Survivor Cloak
2430248538.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
2430248538.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise — her joke was the important part.
2430248538.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉带着温暖的惊喜记下了一个发现——她的玩笑才是重要的部分。

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉带着温暖的惊喜记下了一个发现——她的玩笑才是重要的部分。

4046540927.name: Shrewd Survivor Strides
4046540927.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
4046540927.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
4046540927.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

2419726011.name: Thriving Survivor Grips
2419726011.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
2419726011.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
2419726011.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

365930261.name: Thriving Survivor Vest
365930261.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
365930261.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
365930261.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

78875985.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
78875985.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
78875985.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

3358389096.name: Thriving Survivor Cloak
3358389096.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
3358389096.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise — her joke was the important part.
3358389096.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉带着温暖的惊喜记下了一个发现——她的玩笑才是重要的部分。

828189485.name: Thriving Survivor Strides
828189485.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
828189485.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
828189485.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

4010324161.name: Fortune's Favor
4010324161.flavor: Don't call it a lucky streak. You're just that good.
4010324161.lore:
Aunor goes down hard. The temple's floor is cold under her. Banners representing the Praxic Creed flutter high above—usually a heartening sight. Right now, they make her head hurt. 

Siegfried leans over her, Praxic Blade painting his beard Arc blue. Tendency to Thundercrash straight into his foes aside, he's as true a member of the Order as any of them. 

As true, and as dogmatic. 

"You're off your game today. Where's your fire, Mahal?" 

Aunor rolls to her feet. "Right where it's always been!" 

They clash once, twice, a third time—then Aunor's breaking away again, heaving for air. 

"I'd accuse you of letting me win, but you've never done that in your life. What's wrong?" 

"Thinking too much." Aunor touches the Cormorant Seal on her robe. "About the things we don't talk about." 

"What, like Darkness? What is there to discuss?" Siegfried's incredulous. His Blade goes awry, letting Aunor slip under his guard for a hit. 

"Maybe a lot, now that so many Guardians in good standing are using it." 

"They're fools and traitors!" 

Needles of lightning rise from Siegfried's gauntlets. Aunor matches him with her fire. In perfect sync, they feint, hurl grenades, retreat. 

"Things aren't as simple as we thought. The Creed we follow wasn't written for the world we live in."

4010324161.lore_zh:
阿诺尔重重摔倒，她身下神庙的地面十分冰冷。象征英勇信条的旗帜在高处飘扬——平时是鼓舞人心的景象，现在只让她头疼。 

齐格菲俯身看着她，英勇利刃将他的胡须映成电弧蓝。虽然爱借着雷霆冲击一头扎进敌群，他仍然是这个教团里如假包换的一员。 

同样正统，也同样教条。 

“你今天状态不行。你的火焰呢，玛哈？” 

阿诺尔翻身起立。“一直在这里呢！” 

他们交锋一次、两次、第三次——随后阿诺尔再次脱身，喘着粗气。 

“我本想指责你放水，可你这辈子从没干过那种事。怎么了？” 

“想得太多了。”阿诺尔摸了摸袍子上的鸬鹚印章。“关于那些我们不去谈论的事。” 

“什么，比如暗影？有什么可谈的？”齐格菲显得难以置信。他的利刃偏了一下，让阿诺尔从他防线下钻了进去，挥出一击。 

“也许有很多可以谈，毕竟有那么多信誉良好的守护者在使用它。” 

“他们是蠢材，也是叛徒！” 

针状的闪电自齐格菲的臂铠升腾而起，阿诺尔以火相迎。两人节拍一致，佯攻、掷雷、后撤。 

“事情不像我们想的那么简单。我们奉行的信条不是为如今的世界而写的。” 

“你是在反对教团，”齐格菲隔着拉开的距离高声道。他以一种熟悉的方式挪了挪重心，即将像炮弹一样冲过来。“反对你自己。” 

总得有人来反对，阿诺尔没有说出口。她只是做好了迎接猛击的准备。

3538991101.name: Fortune's Favor
3538991101.flavor: Don't call it a lucky streak. You're just that good.
3538991101.lore:
Aunor goes down hard. The temple's floor is cold under her. Banners representing the Praxic Creed flutter high above—usually a heartening sight. Right now, they make her head hurt. 

Siegfried leans over her, Praxic Blade painting his beard Arc blue. Tendency to Thundercrash straight into his foes aside, he's as true a member of the Order as any of them. 

As true, and as dogmatic. 

"You're off your game today. Where's your fire, Mahal?" 

Aunor rolls to her feet. "Right where it's always been!" 

They clash once, twice, a third time—then Aunor's breaking away again, heaving for air. 

"I'd accuse you of letting me win, but you've never done that in your life. What's wrong?" 

"Thinking too much." Aunor touches the Cormorant Seal on her robe. "About the things we don't talk about." 

"What, like Darkness? What is there to discuss?" Siegfried's incredulous. His Blade goes awry, letting Aunor slip under his guard for a hit. 

"Maybe a lot, now that so many Guardians in good standing are using it." 

"They're fools and traitors!" 

Needles of lightning rise from Siegfried's gauntlets. Aunor matches him with her fire. In perfect sync, they feint, hurl grenades, retreat. 

"Things aren't as simple as we thought. The Creed we follow wasn't written for the world we live in." 

"You're arguing against the Order," Siegfried calls over the distance now separating them. He shifts his weight in a familiar way. He's going to come at her like a cannon. "Against yourself." 

Someone's got to, Aunor doesn't say. She just braces for the hit.

919358834.name: Sage Protector Gauntlets
919358834.flavor: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
919358834.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
919358834.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

279565494.name: Sage Protector Plate
279565494.flavor: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
279565494.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
279565494.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

3945736543.name: Sage Protector Mark
3945736543.flavor: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
3945736543.lore:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
3945736543.lore_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

2723122851.name: Sage Protector Mark
2723122851.flavor: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
2723122851.lore:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
