4118260899.name: Sage Protector Helm
4118260899.flavor: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
4118260899.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
4118260899.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

1320597132.name: Sage Protector Greaves
1320597132.flavor: The path is made by its walking.
1320597132.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.
1320597132.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

1849147777.name: Shrewd Survivor Gauntlets
1849147777.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
1849147777.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
1849147777.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

2629237079.name: Shrewd Survivor Plate
2629237079.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
2629237079.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
2629237079.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

462589222.name: Shrewd Survivor Mark
462589222.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
462589222.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
462589222.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

3343993331.name: Shrewd Survivor Greaves
3343993331.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
3343993331.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
3343993331.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

2854317543.name: Shrewd Survivor Greaves
2854317543.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
2854317543.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us

3917237407.name: Thriving Survivor Gauntlets
3917237407.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
3917237407.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
3917237407.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3093390809.name: Thriving Survivor Plate
3093390809.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3093390809.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3093390809.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

537150100.name: Thriving Survivor Mark
537150100.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
537150100.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
537150100.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

2838384481.name: Thriving Survivor Greaves
2838384481.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
2838384481.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
2838384481.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

4184605701.name: Praxic Vestment
4184605701.flavor: Siegfried was the first. Ensure that you are not the last.
4184605701.lore:
TYPE: CORMORANT-LEVEL ENCRYPTED REPORT FOLLOWS, KEPLER REDACTION WATCH [01003] 

ZAGAN GLORIOSUS EXTRACTION: DEBRIEFING 

My Ghost and I have searched every document available to us in the Vanguard, Hidden, and Praxic archives. 

After years of conflict, we know that every Legion is unique in both doctrine and combat potential. Yet we have been unable to track the lineage of any enemy-classified Cabal unit directly to the Barant Imperium. Imperium doctrines and technology, from squad formations to combat vehicle extraction and ablative defense technologies, seem to be their own in all ways except one: Caiatl's forces were actively developing these technologies and methods—and they are still years away from deployment. 

Of interest to you and the commander: One of the Imperium's field officers, Premier Lume, orchestrated their forces as we escaped their flagship. Our searches turned up a "Lume" in City records. He was an adolescent Barant whose military service had just begun when he suffered a critical wound in the conflict with Savathûn on her throne world. According to the empress herself, our Warlocks and medical frames were unable to extract Hive shrapnel from his abdomen, thereby assigning him a wounded-in-action status and permanent discharge from the front lines. His file ends there, coinciding with several desertions among the Coalition prior to the Neomuni crisis. It's the only correlation I've found. 

The "Premier" aboard the Gloriosus was a full-grown morph. For this to be the same Barant seems impossible… but the more I learn about the Imperium, from their tech to their weapons, the less they make sense.
4184605701.lore_zh:
类型：鸬鹚级加密报告如下，开普勒修订监控[01003] 

光荣扎甘号撤离：简报 

我的机灵与我已搜索先锋、隐秘者与英勇教团档案中可访问的一切文件。 

历经多年冲突，我们知道每一支军团在教义与战斗潜能上都独具一格。然而我们无法把任何被列敌方的卡巴尔单位与巴兰特帝国联系起来。帝国的教义与技术，从小队编成到战斗载具撤离、再到消融防御技术，似乎处处自成一派，唯独有一点例外：查厄托的部队正在积极研发这些技术与方法——而距离投入使用还需要许多年。 

你和指挥官或许会感兴趣的一点是：帝国的一名野战军官，首席卢梅，在我们逃离他们的旗舰时负责指挥他们的部队，而我们在圣城档案中找到了一个“卢梅”。他是个巴兰特青少年，刚开始服役，就在萨瓦图恩的王座世界冲突中腹部重伤。据女帝本人所述，我们的术士与医疗框架无法从他腹中取出邪魔族碎片，因此将他列为战伤状态，永久撤离前线。他的档案到此为止，时间点与内欧姆那危机前联盟内部的数起逃兵事件相吻合。这是我能找到的唯一关联。 

光荣号上的那位“首席”已是完全成形的变体。要说这是同一个巴兰特似乎不可能…但我对帝国了解得越多——从他们的技术到武器——就越觉得离谱。

2249815529.name: Sage Protector Gloves
2249815529.flavor: To whom do you answer, and what will you tell them?
2249815529.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the central finger, bound to match an Emperor's hand 

Enforcer Rao,  

A vision came to me on my last shift. An egg fell from its nest and broke on hitting the ground. What spilled from it was not yolk but dust. A seed with no life in it. Its mother then plucked the feathers from her breast, peeled away the skin, and broke the bars of her ribcage. She pulled out her heart and laid it in that dust; wet and purple, then dry and gray.  

Small things with small lives, but somehow enormous in my memory. I see her still, that mother, that egg. I know I'm a single bacterium upon that broken shell. 

I haven't received a reply, but your division accepted our last two shipments. I thank you from the heart and the head. 

This system is rich in life, so much more than anywhere else I've been. I feel it as if standing one step outside the threshold of a metaconcert. Not enough to pull me in, but enough to make me want to step forward. 

I never walked on Brand or saw the deep waters of Dithaa, but I imagine this is how our home system feels. I hope we grew somewhere so nurturing before we had to breathe thinner air.  

Enforcer, I fear for that life. What is vast might still be vulnerable. Landwhales have been hunted on Torobatl, we're told.  

The Barant soldiers who remember Torobatl talk of it regularly during our periods of temporal isolation. Trying to keep it alive. Their shared memory is withering slowly with time and attrition. I try to hold it for them, for when all that's left is young soldiers fresh from the cloning vats. 

The bird, the egg, the heart, the dust.  

The memory. 

They haven't left me yet.
2249815529.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以中央手指之印为钥，捆绑住以与帝王之手相合 

执行者拉奥：  

我在上一班时得到一个异象。一枚蛋自巢坠下，落地破裂。流出的不是蛋黄，而是尘土。一颗没有生命的种子。母鸟随即从自己胸前拔下羽毛，剥去皮肤，折断肋骨。她掏出自己的心脏，放入那尘土中；先是湿润而紫，再成干枯而灰。  

渺小之物，渺小生命，却在我记忆中巨大非常。那母鸟，那枚蛋，我至今仍见。我知晓我不过是那破壳上一枚细菌。 

我尚未收到回复，但你处收下了我们前两批货物。我自心与脑向你致谢。 

这个星系生机丰饶，远胜我去过的其它地方。我感到自己仿佛立于智库的门槛外一步之处。牵引不至于将我卷入，却足以令我想跨前一步。 

我从未踏足布兰德，未曾见过迪萨的深海，但我想这应当就是我们故乡星系的感觉。希望我们在不得不呼吸更稀薄的空气之前，曾在如此养育之地成长。  

执行者，我为那生命担忧。广大者亦或仍然脆弱。据说图罗巴特尔曾有人猎杀陆鲸。  

那些还记得图罗巴特尔的巴兰特士兵，在我们的时间隔离里常常谈起那里，想要将它保留在记忆中。他们共同的记忆正随着时间与折损缓慢枯萎。我试着替他们守住记忆，为那一天做好准备——当只剩下从克隆槽里新鲜出炉的年轻士兵时。 

那只鸟，那枚蛋，那颗心，那灰尘。  

那段记忆。 

它们尚未离我而去。

640369263.name: Sage Protector Robes
640369263.flavor: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
640369263.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of the single eye which sees beyond all 

Enforcer, 

Sere listens to the whisper in the dark and speaks to it in turn. His named apprentice shouts at it to demand power. His students learn to bear its voice or die. 

We avoid the Dredgens for fear of the shadow around them. No Psion has volunteered to study with them yet, and none of us want to be cut down for their practice. 

I request any duty that will send me away from the Malphas for a time, but now that Harrow is leading expeditions, there is nowhere out of their reach. There is nowhere to hide on a Harvester.  

We were on Mercury, where the sun burns so fiercely I thought the sand would turn to glass. I could feel the life of this system again, wrapping around us all in its warm humming threads. I felt the other Psions and Barant in my mind. I felt Lightbearers laughing and fighting together somewhere distant. 

Staring into the sun would burn my eye out. I knew it, but I was ready to pay the cost for its warmth. 

Then Harrow wrapped shadow around him, and every Legionary swayed, every Psion flinched.  

I looked toward him. I couldn't help it. I looked away from the sun.
640369263.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以独目洞观之印为钥 

执行者： 

赛尔在黑暗里倾听低语，并予以回应。他选中的学徒向它怒吼以索取力量。他的学徒要么学会承受它的声音，要么死去。 

我们避开德瑞捷是因为畏惧其周身之影。尚无灵能士兵自愿与他们学习，且我们谁也不愿为他们的练习而被砍倒。 

我请求任何能够让我暂时离开马尔法斯的任务，但如今哈罗带队远征，已经没有他们触及不到的地方。收割者上无处可藏。  

我们曾在水星，太阳炽燃之烈，令我以为沙会化为玻璃。我再次感到这个星系的生命，缠绕着我们，温暖而嗡鸣的丝线。我感到其他灵能士兵与巴兰特在我意识中，感到远处负光者同笑同战。 

直视太阳会灼瞎我的眼。我知道，但我愿为它的温暖付出代价。 

随后哈罗以阴影自裹，每一名军团士兵都摇晃起来，每一名灵能士兵都战栗不止。  

我朝他看去，情不自禁。我的视线离开了太阳。

1887527934.name: Sage Protector Bond
1887527934.flavor: Balance the fire within against the fire without.
1887527934.lore:
Unkeyed / Incomplete / Unsent 

Can you hear it, Rao? The thought like a gravity well, pressing down till we become diamond? 

I can't open the door, the bar's too heavy and my arms aren't strong enough. My mind isn't big enough. 

I think there was life in this system once. I don't know where it is. I can't feel it anymore. I walked into a room I thought was empty, and there were six Legionaries in it playing cards. I didn't feel their minds. They spoke and laughed and shouted at me to get out, and it was like clay figures speaking and laughing and shouting. 

There's a voice, and it's getting louder. I think I might die trying to hear it.  

Will you tell the others about it, Rao? I've trusted your silence so far. I hope I can trust your speech.  

I wish you were here in the whispers with me.
1887527934.lore_zh:
未加钥／未完成／未发出 

你能听见吗，拉奥？那如引力井般的念头，压迫着直至我们化为钻石？ 

我打不开门，门闩太重，而我的臂膀不够强壮。我的心智不够宽阔。 

我认为这星系曾有生命，但不知道它去了哪里，再也感觉不到它。我走进一间我以为空无一人的房间，里面却有六名军团士兵在打牌。我感觉不到他们的思维。他们聊天、嬉笑，大喊着叫我出去，可那感觉像是泥偶在说话、在嬉笑、在大喊。 

有一个声音，越来越响。我感觉自己可能会在试图倾听它时死去。  

你会把这件事告诉其他人吗，拉奥？到目前为止我信任你的沉默，希望我也能信任你的言说。  

真希望你此刻与我同处耳语之中。

1786011928.name: Sage Protector Cover
1786011928.flavor: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
1786011928.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 
Operant second rank aboard the Malphas Contemptus 
Loyal to the Barant Imperium 

Keyed to the sign of the Y-goblet with which our ancestors worshipped 

Enforcer Rao,  

We knew each other briefly in the old empress's service. You are still thought of with respect and envy on the Malphas, and there is a flavor to your name—an undernote that never rises to the surface—that makes me suspect I could talk to you and be heard. 

The temporal isolation is difficult. A dry-eyed, blank-minded time, no medium to carry our thoughts to one another. When we emerge, I'm thirsty. I want only to drink of Sol's living richness. I want to know my mind is not a dry seed rolling around an empty case. 

But this ship floats in poison. Touching the mist around the Dredgen and his students first hurts, then numbs, then compels. The Premier's Dredgen is always palpable within it, his iron pain and burning anger. And below him, untouchable immensity. 

The Valus Dredgen Sere immerses himself in it. We Psion operants and engineers build machines so he may approach it and hide his death in another world. 

These are words I cannot speak even by mind. I lay them silently in optical quartz and send them to you in hopes you will listen and speak in turn to our cousins.  

I close this missive in hopes that this will reach you in safety and secrecy, and that your reputation for the same is not misplaced.
1786011928.lore_zh:
出自耶提克-因的思维与手 
马尔法斯轻蔑号上的二级操作者 
忠于巴兰特帝国 

以先祖曾用以礼拜的“脸杯”之印为钥 

执行者拉奥：  

我们在旧女帝麾下曾短暂相识。你仍在马尔法斯上被人带着敬重与艳羡谈起，而你的名字带有一种风味，某种从不浮于表面的底色。这令我怀疑我可以与你交谈，被你听见。 

时间隔离很难熬。干涸的眼睛，空白的思维，没有介质可以承载我们彼此的思绪。我们离开之后，我感到一种饥渴，只想痛饮太阳系的生机丰盈。我想知道我的心智不是在空壳里滚动的一粒干种子。 

但这艘飞船漂浮在毒雾中。触及环绕德瑞捷和他学徒们的薄雾，先是疼，后是麻，再而受到压制。我总是能在其中感受到首席的德瑞捷，他的铁一般的痛与灼燃的怒。而在他之下，是不可触碰的浩瀚。 

军政官德瑞捷·赛尔将自身浸没其中。我们这些灵能操作者与工程师建造出机器，使他得以接近它，并把他的死亡隐藏在另一个世界。 

这些话我甚至无法以思维传达。我将它们默默镌入光学石英，寄与你，希望你能倾听，并转而向我们的同胞言说。  

信到这里作结，愿它能安全而隐秘地抵达你处，亦愿你在此方面的名声未被错付。

2541757371.name: Sage Protector Boots
2541757371.flavor: The path is made by its walking.
2541757371.lore:
From the mind and hand of Yetic-Ein 

Keyed to the sign of our people's shared soul 

Rao, 

Dredgen Sere has killed an engineer and elevated me in her place. My thoughts are waveforms flattened by the weight of his throne. I barely have the strength to imprint this on quartz. I hope it's readable. I hope you're still reading it. 

I can barely make my hands work at my assigned tasks. I am almost ready to stop trying. 

Sere swells with greater power daily, even as he loses his form. He's fraying like an old rope, growing stronger, mouthing along to the whispers. I would wish for Sere to tear himself apart, but I fear something worse would take his place. 

Something will make use of a dry seed on dead ground. Something that is not the bird's heart will fit itself back into the bird's ribcage. 

His project is more than I thought it was. It's more than a hiding place for one small death.  

It's a door, and there's something on the other side. A thought, too big to fit in my head. If I tried to think it, my every cell would burst. 

I don't know how Bael is still alive.

出自耶提克-因的思维与手 

以我族共享的灵魂之印为钥 

拉奥： 

德瑞捷·赛尔杀了一名工程师，并让我晋升代替她的职位。我的思绪是被他的王座之重压扁的波形。我几乎无力将这段话刻印到石英上，希望还能看得清，也希望你还在读。 

我几乎无法驱使双手完成分派给我的职责，就快要放弃努力了。 

赛尔的力量与日俱增，但他的形体日渐消解。他像一根旧缆般地磨损，愈发强壮，随着低语默诵。我愿寄望于赛尔自我毁灭，但又害怕会有更糟的东西取而代之。 

会有东西利用一粒落在死地上的干种子。会有并非鸟之心的东西，把自己安进那只鸟的肋笼。 

他的计划超出我所想，它不只是个让一场小小的死亡藏身的去处。  

它是一扇门，而门的另一侧有某个东西。一个念头，大到无法装进我的脑袋。如果尝试去想它，我的每个细胞都会爆裂。 

我不明白巴埃尔怎么还活着。

938861252.name: Shrewd Survivor Gloves
938861252.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
938861252.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
938861252.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3475188156.name: Shrewd Survivor Robe
3475188156.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3475188156.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3475188156.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

932088625.name: Shrewd Survivor Bond
932088625.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
932088625.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
932088625.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

702862701.name: Shrewd Survivor Bond
702862701.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
702862701.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。

2869507310.name: Shrewd Survivor Boots
2869507310.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
2869507310.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
2869507310.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

690430270.name: Thriving Survivor Gloves
690430270.flavor: Trust only the strength of your own arm.
690430270.lore:
Nazaire slips on rain-slick grass, and his pursuer leaps on him. His right arm goes numb as fishbone-thorns open a gash from wrist to shoulder. The Hive Acolyte grabs him by the throat. 

He wasn't supposed to be here. But the Tower forbids the knowledge he seeks, and the City dares not defy them. So he went into the wild looking for answers, and now he is going to die. 

Even as his vision darkens, survival instinct drives him to fight. He fumbles for his Sidearm with his good hand and fires wildly. Bone chips and blood spray across his hands, his face, until the Acolyte's laughter gurgles and dies. 

He lies on his back, gasping, blinking salty rain from his eyes. Hysteria bubbles in his chest. He wants to go home. 

A sudden scintillation. A Ghost appears over the dead Acolyte. It is more monstrous than any other, even the one that took his mother from him, because it bears Hive livery.  

He seizes it out of the air. "You," he wheezes, his voice a ruin, "you were—supposed—to protect us."  

It has no rebuttal, because it is a Ghost. And like every Ghost, it is not a protector. It is a liar and a thief, a wretched viper, and it wants to take everything from him, just like its kin. 

He digs his thumbs into its eye. It thrashes and screams. He squeezes harder, and harder, until something gives way, a nauseating squelch followed by a thrill of sick satisfaction. 

It is the first Ghost he kills. Drenched in icy rain, smeared with gore and mud, he clips the Ghost's shell to his belt and vows: it will not be the last.
690430270.lore_zh:
纳泽尔在被雨水润湿的草地上一滑，他的追猎者扑了上来。他的右臂瞬间麻木，鱼骨般的荆刺从腕至肩划开一道口子。邪魔族仆从掐住了他的喉咙。 

他本不该在这里。但高塔封禁了他所求的知识，而圣城不敢忤逆他们。于是他来到了荒野寻求答案，而今却要丧命于此。 

即便视线渐暗，求生本能仍驱使他反抗。他用完好的那只手去摸手枪，胡乱开火。骨屑与血溅满他的手、他的脸，直到仆从的笑声咯血而止。 

他仰躺在地，大口喘息，用力眨眼驱走其中的咸雨。歇斯底里的情绪在胸中翻涌，他只想回家。 

骤然一阵闪烁，一个机灵出现在死去的仆从上方。它比任何机灵都更为狰狞，甚至远超夺走他母亲的那一个，因为它披着邪魔族的涂装。  

他在空中攫住了它。“你，”他嘶哑道，声音支离破碎，“你——本该——保护我们。”  

它没有反驳，因为它是个机灵。而如同每一个机灵，它不是保护者。它是骗子，是盗贼，是卑鄙的毒蛇，意欲夺走他的一切，正如其同类。 

他把拇指按进它的眼里，它抽搐尖鸣。他越捏越紧，直到有什么破裂开来，恶心的腥软声响之后，是一阵病态的快意。 

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

这是他杀的第一个机灵。浑身被冷雨浇透，涂满血污与泥泞，他把机灵的壳扣在腰间，发誓道：这绝不会是最后一个。

3781374706.name: Thriving Survivor Robe
3781374706.flavor: There's no shame in wounds, so long as you walk away and they don't.
3781374706.lore:
Lodi's been lying in bed saying his family's names, hoping they'll help him rest.  

When he last slept, it was for 14 hours, dragged behind the tail of a comet, colder than a wet perch. Last week, he straddled the Byzantine Adrianople and a Yakima parking lot—one foot in each. He missed a full day. 

Eventually the world goes heavy and woolen, and a blanket of sleep smothers Lodi's fitful mind. When he opens his eyes it takes him a moment of confusion to realize there are now four of them.  

He panics and bolts into the dark on all fours, all sixes, his many clawed paws ignoring the pull of gravity. 

Language is gone. It is molten lava—it is a stretch of sandstone and the screech of apes and the hiss of natural gas. He opens both sets of jaws and cries whale song in search of meaning. He is alive, but he is wrong—he is Canidae Equidae Mantodea Acroporidae, the heaving shadow of every living creature. He's supposed to be somewhere else. 

home 

i need to go home 

Lodi startles awake. He feels for each of his limbs, the planes of his own face, and gasps for air. A monster is trying to talk to him. 

His unease is deepened as he realizes he has turned the bed to platinum in his nightmare. He coaxes metal back to linen, and even in the privacy of his new flat, he feels inhuman. Unnatural in every way. 

Wary and alone, Lodi returns to broken sleep.
3781374706.lore_zh:
洛迪躺在床上，反复念着家人的名字，希望这能助他安眠。  

上一次他睡下，是十四个小时，被拽在一条彗星尾巴后，冷得像条湿梭子鱼。上周，他两脚各跨一地：一脚在拜占庭的阿德里安堡，一脚在亚基马的停车场。他丢失了整整一天的时间。 

最终，世界变得沉重而柔软，睡眠将洛迪纷乱的心智包裹。当他睁开眼时，困惑了片刻才意识到，自己有四只眼睛。  

他惊惶作乱，四肢、六肢并用，扑进黑暗，多只带爪的足掌无视重力的牵引。 

语言不见了。那是熔岩——是段砂岩，是猿类的尖啸，是天然气的嘶嘶。他张开两副颚，用鲸歌呼唤意义。他还活着，但一切都不对——他是犬科、马科、螳螂目、鹿角珊瑚科，是每一种生灵的翻涌之影。他本该在别处。 

回家 

我需要回家 

洛迪惊醒。他抚摸自己的肢体，自己脸庞的轮廓，急促地喘气。有个怪物正试图和他说话。 

当发现自己在噩梦中把床变成了铂金时，他的不安更甚。他把金属诱哄变回亚麻，即便在新公寓的私密空间里，他仍觉得自己非人，任何方面都不自然。 

警惕而孤独，洛迪重又坠入破碎的睡眠。

123224963.name: Thriving Survivor Bond
123224963.flavor: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
123224963.lore:
Ikora sets down the takeout and watches Lodi read.  

They've been in this study for weeks now, desperately trying to decipher the prophecy. He taps the side of a datapad and the sound turns metallic as his fingertip flickers an experimental gold. Lodi's sleeves are rolled up, light catching on his forearm, if she looks carefully, she can make out something—a tattoo? Absurd. She's captivated. 

"This isn't right, Ikora. We can't hide the truth." He shakes his head. "Commander Zavala is making the wrong call." 

She still hears Zavala's insistence. "I know." 

They share a moment of mutual acknowledgment. Both are fundamentally incapable of disobeying a superior.  

"Have you told him…" 

About her future title. 

"Not yet." Ikora isn't sure how.  

"I'm not ambassador of… anything… yet either," he says with a dry shrug. "Guess we have yet to earn our promotions." 

"Lodi… is the future guaranteed?" 

He blinks, and stares into the middle-distance. Deep oak eye briefly flickering to burning blue. "You picked up pupusas for dinner," he prophesizes between sips of coffee. 

Ikora sighs, opens the bag, reveals his prize as she says, "I still don't believe you that cactus is edible but at least my death wouldn't be permanent." 

Lodi barks a laugh in surprise. Ikora's face becomes a question. 

"I didn't See you saying that!" He explains with a grin. 

"You didn't?" 

"No, I Saw you glare at me and start eating." His smile reaches his eyes, "The future happens. But the important parts aren't guaranteed." 

Ikora catalogues a discovery with warm surprise—her joke was the important part.
123224963.lore_zh:
艾可拉放下外卖，看着洛迪读书。  

他们已在这间书房困守数周，拼命想要解读那则预言。他轻叩数据板一侧，声响化作金属质感，他的指尖试探性地闪着金色。洛迪挽起袖子，光在他前臂上流转，她细看之下，好像能辨出些什么——是纹身吗？荒唐。她被其深深吸引。 

“这不对，艾可拉。我们不能隐瞒真相。”他摇头。“指挥官萨瓦拉做了错误的决定。” 

她仍能听见萨瓦拉的坚持。“我知道。” 

他们共享片刻默契。两人骨子里都做不到违抗上级。  

“你有没有告诉他…” 

她未来的头衔。 

“还没有。”艾可拉不知如何开口。  

“我也还不是…什么…大使，”他干巴巴地耸肩。“看来我们要晋升还得努力。” 

“洛迪…未来是注定的吗？” 

他眨了眨眼，凝望着不远处。深色橡木般的眼眸短暂地闪烁成燃烧的蓝。“你买了普普萨当晚餐，”他抿着咖啡预言道。 

艾可拉叹了口气，打开袋子，露出他的战利品，同时说道：“我还是不相信仙人掌能吃，但至少我的死亡不会是永久的。” 

洛迪惊讶地笑出了声。艾可拉脸上显现出疑惑的神情。 

“我没预见你会这么说！”他咧嘴解释。 

“你没有？” 

“没，我预见的是你瞪我一眼然后就开始吃了。”他的笑意抵达眼角，“未来会发生，但重要的部分并不是注定的。” 

艾可拉怀着温暖的惊喜记下一项发现：她的玩笑是重要的部分。

1109812632.name: Thriving Survivor Boots
1109812632.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
1109812632.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
1109812632.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。] 

贰 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 拒绝 + 拥抱他的命运 

[星系动荡，天界之战。霍普带着悔意恳求些许仁慈，明知这是他的选择。一次超因果之死，许多门开启了。] 

环中兄弟 + 为自己下注 + 但依然有希望 + 属于我们 + 所有人

354673070.flavor: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
354673070.lore:
[There are two paths. On one lies safety. The other, deep-grieved and needless death.] 

one + dredgen hope + accepts + shatters his animus 

[The system is at peace. A city under a paracausal sky rests, hollow and still, its towers in disuse. The people are placated, cared for, without want—ruled by a king called Dredgen Hope and his Imperium, who brokered peace.  It is a city without Lights: they are buried and named on every street, a cost of peace. One of the streets reads: Weapon. The city has no queen; she would not stand beside a Dredgen. The king lives in hate. Of himself, of his crown, the power it bestows, and the ochre god who gave it to him. That god, now bound to a compliant tool, is thus allowed to step into the paracausal sky, free.] 

two + dredgen hope + refuses + embraces his fate 

[The system in upheaval. War in heaven. Hope begs, in regret, for small mercies, knowing he chose this. A paracausal death. Many doors open.] 

brother in rings + gambits for himself + but still there is hope + for all + of us
354673070.lore_zh:
[有两条路可走。一条通向安全，另一条通向深重而无谓的死亡。] 

壹 + 德瑞捷·霍普 + 接受 + 粉碎他的灵核 

[星系处于和平中。城市在超因果天穹下安眠，空洞而寂静，塔楼荒废。人们受到了安抚，照料，衣食无忧——由名为德瑞捷·霍普的帝王及其帝国统治，他缔结了和平。这是一座没有光能的城市：光能被埋葬，名字刻在每一条街上，作为和平的代价。有一条街上写着：武器。城市没有女王；她不愿与一名德瑞捷并肩。帝王活在憎恨中，憎恨自己，憎恨他的王冠、它赐予的力量，以及赐予它的赭色神。那位神，如今被束缚于一件顺从的工具之上，因而得以迈入超因果天穹下，获得自由。]

1479082657.name: Deimosuffusion
1479082657.lore:
"I dare you to lick it."

"Ew, no! You lick it."

"No one is licking this," Novi declared. She looked between her little brother, Sunder, and their Eliksni friend, Phyksiis, with a practiced expression of grown-up disgust.

She grabbed the grenade and slung it with all her might at the lake, hoping to see it skip across the placid surface of the water. It sank with a giant, anticlimactic plop.

"Aww, you wasted it!" Phyksiis complained.

The surface of the lake shook as an immense column of water shot into the air. Particles of Strand rained down, twining together to form small, green creatures.

"Run… RUN!" Novi screamed. The Threadlings closed in, poised to explode, when suddenly the arms of a Hunter reached around to shield them. There were three shots, then silence.

Novi opened one eye to see a Ghost hovering in front of her. "What were you doing with a grenade?!" he cried.

The children exchanged terrified, guilty looks.

"You're not in trouble," the Hunter prodded gently, his amber eyes trained on them.

"We—we traded a kid at school for it," Phyksiis admitted. "He stole it from his dad."

"No takebacks," Sunder offered solemnly.

"For a rare Guardian weapon? That must have been some trade."

Novi hesitated then said quietly, "We gave him some Stasis stuff we found at home. But—but lots of parents have been collecting, uh, things… Guardian things too."

"For protection. I heard some Eliksni talking," Phyksiis mumbled.

"Yeah, after the man said he'd come to the City at nightfall," Sunder said and puffed his chest. "But I'm not afraid of the dark."

"Not 'at'—WITH Nightfall. Whatever that is," Novi corrected, the apprehension clear in her voice.

The Guardian and his Ghost stepped back. "This seems to confirm the rumors," the Ghost whispered. "People are arming themselves."

"Alert Zavala," the Hunter replied grimly.
1479082657.lore_zh:
“你敢不敢去舔一口。”

“呃，才不要！你自己去舔。”

“谁都不许舔，”诺薇宣布。她的目光在弟弟桑德和他们的埃里克斯尼族朋友菲克西斯之间游移，脸上挂着一副熟练的大人式嫌弃表情。

她抓起手雷，用尽全力朝湖面掷去，期盼着看它在平静的水面上弹跳。它随着巨大又沉闷的噗通声沉了下去。

“噢，你浪费掉了它！”菲克西斯抱怨道。

湖面一震，一道巨大的水柱冲天而起。缕缕缚丝粒子洒落，缠绕在一起，化作小小的绿色生物。

“跑…快跑！”诺薇尖叫道。线虫们合围而至，蓄势爆炸，忽然一位猎人的手臂伸来将他们护住。三声枪响，然后是寂静。

诺薇睁开一只眼，看到一个机灵悬停在她面前。“你们拿手雷干什么？！”他喊道。

孩子们交换着惊惶而内疚的眼神。

“放心，你们没闯祸，”猎人温和地引导，琥珀色的眼睛注视着他们。

“我——我们跟学校里的一个孩子换的，”菲克西斯招认道。“他是从他爸那里偷来的。”

“不许反悔，”桑德郑重其事地补充。

“这件稀有的守护者武器？你们可真会做买卖。”

诺薇犹豫了一下，低声说：“我们给了他一些在家里找到的冰影东西。可——可很多家长也一直在收集，呃，那些…守护者的东西。”

“为了自卫，我听一些埃里克斯尼族说的，”菲克西斯嘟囔道。

“是啊，在那个人说他会在日落降临时前来圣城之后，”桑德挺起胸膛说。“但我不怕黑。”

“不是‘在'——是‘伴随'日落降临，虽然不知道那是什么意思，”诺薇更正道，声音里带着明显的不安。

守护者和他的机灵退后了一步。“这似乎证实了传闻，”机灵低声说。“人们在武装自己。”

“通知萨瓦拉，”猎人阴沉地答道。

4277548087.lore:
Aunor was in a sour mood when she transmatted into Ikora's personal library. She hated visiting the Tower. Even in a room without doors, well away from the dank Annex basement, she could still smell the Drifter's sulfuric odor. How the others could stand it, she had no idea. 

Her irritation was softened slightly, when Ikora looked up from her writing with a smile. "I'm glad to see you," she said. 

"Interesting choice of words. I thought I was being summoned for a 'matter of grave importance. '" 

"'Relieved' may be the better word. There aren't many I can trust with an assignment like this." Ikora gestured towards a seat. Aunor shook her head.

"Is that so?" 

"I mean that as a compliment to you. Not a condemnation of anyone else." 

 "You don't need to butter me up before a bad job, Ikora." 

Ikora sighed, then tapped her datapad. "We've received word of another tainted Guardian in our ranks." 

Within her cloak, Aunor's pad dinged. She took it out, reading as she scrolled. "Disobeying orders, trading Vanguard secrets… Pretty standard. Prolonged and intentional torture?" She looked up questioningly. 

"Fallen civilians fleeing the House of Salvation," Ikora supplied, her voice grave. "According to her fireteam, she wanted to know how Eramis accessed the Darkness. "When they tried to intervene…" she trailed off. 

Aunor looked up sharply. "She tortured her own teammates too?" 

Ikora nodded. Aunor stowed her datapad back in her cloak. "Where's she headed now?" 

"We believe she's still on Europa, trying to access the Darkness on her own." 

"Makes sense. Now that the Vanguard's lifted the ban, she has plausible deniability. As does anyone else who's tempted by that power," she added pointedly. 

"Please don't make me go over this again. The Vanguard—"

"The Vanguard allowed Darkness into the Tower. You let Guardians play with it, so long as they do it under the Drifter's roving eye.  Otherwise, you'll send me after them as punishment." 

"Not punishment," Ikora corrected evenly. "Redemption. You offer them a chance to cooperate first. To make up for their selfish acts and rejoin the side of humanity." 

"And so far, I've had no takers." 

"That doesn't mean that none exist." 

"And this Trestin? You think she'll be lucky number…  how many are we up to now? At this point, the only chance I'm giving them is the chance to kill me first." 

"Enough." Ikora's eyes flashed. "I won't pretend to be optimistic about the outcome of this case. Or any future ones. But there's no guarantee that all who are touched are forever tainted. Until that's proven otherwise, your orders remain the same. Is that clear?" 

Aunor stared at her, jaw clenched. "Future cases?"  She shook her head. "Never mind. I'm sure you'll tell me after they've wreaked havoc somewhere." 

"You don't have to do this, if you don't want to. I'd understand." 

Aunor swatted the concern away. "I stand by my promise," she said.  Then, in a flash of blue, she was gone.
4277548087.lore_zh:
阿诺尔在传送到艾可拉的私人图书馆时，心情十分低落。她讨厌去高塔，哪怕是在那些没有门的、敞亮的大厅，那些寻不见阴暗地下室的地方，她依然感觉自己能闻到Drifter身上那股硫磺味。她不敢想像其他人到底是怎么忍受过来的。

当艾可拉停下笔，把头抬起来冲她微笑的时候，她的怒气稍稍消减了一些。“很高兴见到你”，艾可拉说道。

“这话说得真有意思，我听说是因为有‘极其重要的事'才把我叫到这里来的。”

“大概‘排忧解难'这个词会更准确一些吧。这样的任务，我信得过的人不多。”艾可拉示意她坐下，而阿诺尔则摇了摇头。

“你确定？”

“这是对你的赞美，而不是对其他人的贬斥。”

 “艾可拉，让我去干脏活的时候不用刻意奉承我。”

艾可拉叹了口气，点了点自己的数据板：“我收到消息，我们的队伍中又多了一个被污染的守护者。”

阿诺尔的数据板在她的斗篷下叮叮当当响了起来。她顺手拿了出来，边看边读出了声：“违抗命令、出卖先锋军机密信息...很标准背叛行为。嗯？长期故意折磨？”她疑惑地抬起头。

“是那些逃离救赎之家的堕落者平民”，艾可拉补充道，声音十分严肃：“根据火力战队的回报，她想知道伊拉莫斯是怎么跟黑暗建立联系的。”当他们试图干预的时候...她就销声匿迹了。

阿诺尔猛地抬起头：“她连队友也折磨？”

艾可拉点了点头。阿诺尔把数据板收了起来，问到：“她往哪里逃了？”

“我们相信她还在木卫二上，想要独立于黑暗建立联系。”

“这也说得通。现在先锋军解除了禁令，她就有否认依据。那些受到权力诱惑的人都是这样，”她一针见血的说道。

“请不要让我再重复这些内容，先锋军——”

“先锋允许黑暗进入高塔区域。只要在浪客的监视之下，你也允许守护者去接触这些。否则，你就会派我去追杀他们作为惩罚。”

“不是惩罚”，艾可拉纠正她到：“是救赎。你要先给他们一个就范的机会，让他们有机会弥补自己犯下的过错，重新回到正轨上来。”

“到目前为止，没有人接受这个提议。”

“这不代表他们所有人都不会接受。”

“那么这个特雷斯廷呢？你觉得你运气这么好，她就一定会接受你的提议吗？到目前为止已经有多少个了？在这种情况下我不率先出手，就等于给他们机会先杀了我。”

“够了”。艾可拉眼神有些闪烁：“我也不会假装对这个任务结果保持乐观，下次也不会。但是谁也不能保证这些被污染的人就彻底变坏了，一点拯救的可能性都没有。在你不能证明这些之前，我的命令不会更改。听清楚了没有？”

阿诺尔盯着她，狠狠咬着牙：“还有下次？”说罢便摇了摇头：“罢了，下次等这些人在某个地方大肆破坏的时候，我相信你会松口的。”

“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

阿诺尔将这些顾虑一扫而空。“我会信守承诺”，她回答。然后一道蓝色的光闪过，她便消失在空气中。

阿诺尔在传送到艾可拉的私人图书馆时，心情十分低落。她讨厌去高塔，哪怕是在那些没有门的、敞亮的大厅，那些寻不见阴暗地下室的地方，她依然感觉自己能闻到Drifter身上那股硫磺味。她不敢想像其他人到底是怎么忍受过来的。

当艾可拉停下笔，把头抬起来冲她微笑的时候，她的怒气稍稍消减了一些。“很高兴见到你”，艾可拉说道。

“这话说得真有意思，我听说是因为有‘极其重要的事'才把我叫到这里来的。”

“大概‘排忧解难'这个词会更准确一些吧。这样的任务，我信得过的人不多。”艾可拉示意她坐下，而阿诺尔则摇了摇头。

“你确定？”

“这是对你的赞美，而不是对其他人的贬斥。”

 “艾可拉，让我去干脏活的时候不用刻意奉承我。”

艾可拉叹了口气，点了点自己的数据板：“我收到消息，我们的队伍中又多了一个被污染的守护者。”

阿诺尔的数据板在她的斗篷下叮叮当当响了起来。她顺手拿了出来，边看边读出了声：“违抗命令、出卖先锋军机密信息...很标准背叛行为。嗯？长期故意折磨？”她疑惑地抬起头。

“是那些逃离救赎之家的堕落者平民”，艾可拉补充道，声音十分严肃：“根据火力战队的回报，她想知道伊拉莫斯是怎么跟黑暗建立联系的。”当他们试图干预的时候...她就销声匿迹了。

阿诺尔猛地抬起头：“她连队友也折磨？”

艾可拉点了点头。阿诺尔把数据板收了起来，问到：“她往哪里逃了？”

“我们相信她还在木卫二上，想要独立于黑暗建立联系。”

“这也说得通。现在先锋军解除了禁令，她就有否认依据。那些受到权力诱惑的人都是这样，”她一针见血的说道。

“请不要让我再重复这些内容，先锋军——”

“先锋允许黑暗进入高塔区域。只要在浪客的监视之下，你也允许守护者去接触这些。否则，你就会派我去追杀他们作为惩罚。”

“不是惩罚”，艾可拉纠正她到：“是救赎。你要先给他们一个就范的机会，让他们有机会弥补自己犯下的过错，重新回到正轨上来。”

“到目前为止，没有人接受这个提议。”

“这不代表他们所有人都不会接受。”

“那么这个特雷斯廷呢？你觉得你运气这么好，她就一定会接受你的提议吗？到目前为止已经有多少个了？在这种情况下我不率先出手，就等于给他们机会先杀了我。”

“够了”。艾可拉眼神有些闪烁：“我也不会假装对这个任务结果保持乐观，下次也不会。但是谁也不能保证这些被污染的人就彻底变坏了，一点拯救的可能性都没有。在你不能证明这些之前，我的命令不会更改。听清楚了没有？”

阿诺尔盯着她，狠狠咬着牙：“还有下次？”说罢便摇了摇头：“罢了，下次等这些人在某个地方大肆破坏的时候，我相信你会松口的。”

“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

阿诺尔将这些顾虑一扫而空。“我会信守承诺”，她回答。然后一道蓝色的光闪过，她便消失在空气中。

1705150753.name: Something New
1705150753.lore:
"Do you ever tire of the work?" asks Eva Levante.

Banshee-44 looks up from his workbench. Eva often crosses in front of his kiosk on her walks to and from the Bazaar, striking up conversations with him in passing when she does. He briefly wonders if they've had this particular talk before; he wouldn't put it past her to simply let it play out to spare him the embarrassment of not remembering it.

"Can't say that I do," Banshee replies cordially. "Memory's not so great. Every gun feels like a new one."

Eva nods as she takes a sip of tea from the mug in her hand. "It's just that I see Guardians deliver parts to you all the time, and you seem to construct the same gun for them repeatedly. Are they not satisfied with what you provide?"

Banshee chuckles. "Maybe." He leans on the bench, looking at the various weapon components strewn about his shop. "It's a bit like Solstice, now that I think about it."

That seems to pique Eva's interest. "Oh?" she asks, eyebrow raised.

"Guardians bring me scraps, pieces of guns they dismantled." Banshee explains. "And I turn them into something new. Not always what the Guardian was hoping for, but they hold onto that hope and keep bringing me parts."

Eva smiles. "Same interaction, different outcome."

"Yeah. I guess you could say that."

"How wonderful," Eva says cheerfully. She raises his cup to him and walks back to the Courtyard.

"Definitely had that talk before," Banshee says to himself.

But he never tires of it.
1705150753.lore_zh:
“你曾厌倦过这份工作吗？”伊娃·莱万特问道。

班西-44从工作台上抬起头来。伊娃在往返集市的路上经常从他的岗亭前经过，顺便与他攀谈。他一时间不禁好奇起来，他们之前是否有过这样的谈话；为了让他不会因为记不起来感到尴尬，她问得很自然，对此他早就习以为常了。

“没那样的事，”班西诚恳地答道。“我记性不好。每把枪感觉都像是新的一样。”

伊娃点点头，拿起手中的杯子咂了一口茶。“我看到守护者总是会给你零部件，而你似乎在反复为他们制造同样的枪支。他们是对你提供的东西不满意吗？”

班西笑着说。“也许吧。”他斜靠在长凳上，看着散落在他店里的各种武器部件。“我现在觉得，这有点像至日。”

这似乎激起了伊娃的兴趣。“哦？”她扬起眉毛问道。

“守护者们给我送来废料和他们拆卸的枪支碎片。”班西解释道。“而我把它们变成了新东西。虽然并不总是守护者所期望的，但他们依然坚守着这份期望，不断给我送来零件。”

伊娃笑着说道。“同样都是送东西，结果却不同。”

“没错。是可以这么说。”

“多好啊，”伊娃高兴地说道。她向他举杯，走回了庭院。

“以前肯定有过这样的谈话，”班西自言自语道。

但他从不厌倦。

253843484.flavor: Pull the trigger. Feed your appetite.
253843484.lore:
Traitor. Irredeemable traitor.

"Shut up," Churnbower muttered. He clutched the handle of the weapon case tight, as if to choke the nightmare hidden inside. 

Having regrets? Too late. I'm in your mind, Churnbower. I CAN SAY WHAT I WANT. 

Churnbower stumbled, snatching his bandaged, bloody hand to his head. 

That heat in your veins is me. You brought me to life. Can't get me out now. 

"Shut up." 

A tech approached him. "Director, are you OK?" 

"Get back to your station," Churnbower snapped at her. "Or I'll write you up." Her face fell, concern replaced by anger. Other technicians looked over at the sudden outburst with surprise, curiosity. 

You've caused a scene! Which of them will tell our Lord what you have done? 

Churnbower's wounded hand throbbed. "No more," he moaned. Glyphs squirmed across his field of vision, echoing the hideous markings he had etched across this weapon. He whimpered. 

Tithe to me again: Free me. Wield me and I will rid you of those gossiping mouths. 

Churnbower ignored the weapon's voice, the waves of anxious nausea. He had to be brave. He stood before the banks of secure bins waiting on a softly humming cart, one of Tex Mechanica's distribution barges loaded with the day's shipments. He placed the weapon case in a bin, closed the lid, and punched in the recipient: Commander Zavala. 

Oh well! Start running, traitor.

The cart slid away. The weapon began to laugh.
253843484.lore_zh:
叛徒，不可饶恕的叛徒。

“闭嘴，”切恩鲍尔低声说。他死死攥住武器箱的提手，仿佛要掐死藏在里面的梦魇。 

后悔了？太迟了。我就在你脑子里，切恩鲍尔。我想说什么就说什么。 

切恩鲍尔踉跄了一下，用缠着绷带、鲜血淋漓的手捂住自己的头。 

你血管里的灼热就是我。你让我诞生，现在没法把我赶出去了。 

“闭嘴。” 

一名技师走近他。“主任，你还好吗？” 

“返回你的岗位，”切恩鲍尔冲她吼道。“不然就给你记过。”她拉长了脸，关切被愤怒取代。其他技师听到这突如其来的爆发，投来惊讶、好奇的目光。 

你闹了个大动静！他们中的谁会把你做的事告诉给我们的主子？ 

切恩鲍尔受伤的手一阵刺痛。“够了，”他低声道。雕文在他视野中蠕动，回响着他刻在这件武器上的丑恶铭文。他呜咽出声。 

再次向我进贡：释放我。挥舞我，我会替你除掉说闲话的家伙。 

切恩鲍尔无视武器的声音与阵阵袭来的焦虑恶心感，他必须勇敢。他站在一辆轻声嗡鸣的小车前，上面整齐地码着一排安全储物箱。一艘特克斯机械的配送驳船，载满了当日的货物。他把武器箱放进一个储物箱里，合上盖子，输入收件人：指挥官萨瓦拉。 

那好吧！开始逃吧，叛徒。

小车滑走了，武器开始大笑。

1017906546.name: Latent Power
1017906546.description: Dealing damage builds Latent Power; precision hits and final blows build more. At full power, hold [Alternate Weapon Action] to trigger Unleashed Power, empowering the weapon with increased rate of fire and hip-fire accuracy and causing shots to weaken targets. After a short time, it becomes Overwhelming Power, which deals damage to you over time. Reload or stow the weapon to end these effects.
1017906546.description_zh: 造成伤害会积累潜藏能量；精准命中和最后一击会积累更多能量。能量全满时，按住[替换武器动作]即可触发“释放力量，提升武器射速和腰射精度，并且射击会削弱目标。短时间后转化为压迫能量，持续对自身造成伤害。填装或收起武器即可结束这些效果。

651256110.name: Power Surge

651256110.description_zh: 快速命中会将你的下一发子弹充能成高爆弹药，造成额外伤害并加速能量积累。强化后，每一发子弹都具有爆炸效果。

2984682459.name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
2984682459.description: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
2984682459.description_zh: 高基础伤害，提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

654512643.name: Gear Shift

4019266109.name: Collective Demolition
4019266109.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成手雷能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

136208450.description: Final blows or rapid hits with this weapon's frontal blades heal you and provide Soulfire Charges, which cause rounds fired by this weapon to inflict potent corruption. These frontal blades deal increased damage to targets afflicted by corruption.

640169129.name: Quantum Nova

2200470033.name: Cull's Shadow
2200470033.flavor: "…Cull's death will draw those most eager to tempt Darkness. All is proceeding as we envision." —Teben Grey
2200470033.lore:
It had been weeks since Bael had seen his own reflection, wary of new horrors on an unfamiliar face. Now safe in the darkened cavern, he removed his helmet. He felt gooey remnants of skin pull away from his face, stuck to the helmet's lining. The damp air stung his exposed nerves. 

The lull was interrupted by a sudden migraine radiating from behind his eyes. He fell to his knees, static threatening to overtake his consciousness.

DEVOTE YOUR EARS DREDGEN 

I BRANDISHED YOU EXPECTING CONQUEST 

"I'm closer than ever." Bael's voice felt like crushed glass in his throat. "My followers have discovered a Weapon of Sorrow—" 

YOU WERE OUR WEAPON 

YOU SUPPLANT YOURSELF 

Bael was thrown to the floor by a gravitic wave. A shrill squeal escaped him. 

"Not just a weapon—a Hive forge," he blurted. "Capable of making an arsenal worthy of your might." 

Bael felt the crushing weight lessen. He struggled to his knees. 

"We could tithe hundreds of Lightbearers to you with those weapons," he wheedled. "I just need a little more time—" 

TIME IS ABUNDANT PATIENCE IS NOT 

A WEAPON IS NOTHING WITHOUT ITS WIELDER 

YOU WILL NOT DISAPPOINT US AGAIN 

The gravitic pressure dissipated, along with the migraine. Bael's heartbeat settled back into a steady rhythm. 

Instead of relief, Bael was flooded with emptiness. VI was right—he already craved his oppressor's return.   

He rose, rededicated. He had a legacy to secure.
2200470033.lore_zh:
巴埃尔已有好几周没看见过自己的倒影了，他害怕在那张陌生的脸上又出现新的恐怖景象。此刻，他躲进昏暗洞窟，取下头盔时，能感觉到黏在头盔内衬上的黏稠皮肤残片，被生生从脸上扯下。潮湿的空气如针般灼刺着他裸露的神经。 

短暂的喘息被一阵突如其来的偏头痛打断，疼痛从双眼后方蔓延开。他跪倒在地，电流噪声几乎要将他的意识夺走。

注意听好了德瑞捷 

我挥舞你意在征服 

“我只有一步之遥。”巴埃尔的嗓子像被碎玻璃狠狠磨过，“我的追随者发现了一件忧愁武器——” 

你是我们的武器 

你妄图用它取代 

巴埃尔被一股引力冲击波掀翻在地，发出一声尖厉的惨叫。 

“不只是一件武器，是一座邪魔族锻炉。”他脱口而出，“能制造出配得上你伟力的军械库。” 

巴埃尔感觉身上的压力稍稍减轻。他艰难地跪坐起来。 

“有了那些武器，我们能向你进贡上百名负光者。”他谄媚地说，“我只需要再多一点时间——” 

时间很充足匮乏的是耐心 

没有持有者武器一无是处 

你绝不能再让我们失望了 

压迫性的引力消散了，偏头痛也一同消失。巴埃尔的心跳渐渐恢复平稳。 

没有解脱感，唯有漫漫空虚。VI说得没错——他已在渴求那压迫者的再次降临。   

他起身，再次决心满满。有一份传承等着他去夺取。

2197778303.name: Fafnir
2197778303.flavor: "Buck, what you've got down there is an interdimensional dragon." —Gen. Sam Galloway
2197778303.typeName_zh: 异域 线性融合步枪
2197778303.lore:
The yellow warning light gave way to green, and Director William 'Buck' Moffat's knees creaked as he entered containment with a slice of cake. 

At the far end of the room was a massive empty frame, the air inside thick like desert heat. He offered four pencils on the ground before it. 

"Figured I'd sneak away from the party to say goodbye. You be polite to my replacement; he's trying to build you a body. Like a real boy." Moffat took his regular seat. "Comprehension confirmation: What is your name?" 

The pencil on the far left turned to silvery striated lithium. 

"Confirmed. Last chance, Lee." 

Two objects blinked into existence on the ground in response. Lee always gave back two: one of hers, one of his. A varsity jacket gifted to Teresa Kierczynski, and Dr. Davis's gardening journal. Moffat had memorized the objects that disappeared when they did—his briefcase, her car, the USS Hornet—and seethed over decades as Lee would drip-feed them back. Twenty years talking to the elevated gravity levels in the basement, and all Lee would do was rummage around its lost and found. 

He fell quiet. "I failed them…" 

Moffat nudged the jacket. YERO. A mix of sadness, sentiment, and nostalgia moved him to ask one last time. 

"…will you send them something for me?" 

The second pencil turned to carbon, a yes, and Moffat's shoulders unstooped as he sat straight the hell up.

His hand trembled as he held up his plate. He willed his voice calm, "Can you give them this?" 

The chocolate cake slice, the words '-etirement, Buck!' in icing, paper plate, and fork vanished from his hand. He inhaled sharply. Tears slicked his cheeks, and Director Moffat beseeched the kidnapper in the basement with a wavering plea, "Tell them I tried."
2197778303.lore_zh:
黄色警示灯转为绿色时，主任威廉·“巴克”·莫法特端着一块蛋糕，膝盖嘎吱作响地走进收容间。 

房间最深处是一个巨大的空框架，框架内的空气像沙漠热浪般扭曲。他在框架前的地上放下四支铅笔。 

“我想着溜出派对一会，来跟你道个别。你要对我的接任者客气点，他在想办法给你造个身子，让你像个真正的小男孩。”莫法特坐到他惯常的位置，“理解确认：你叫什么名字？” 

最左边的那支铅笔变成了银白色条纹状的锂。 

“确认。最后的机会，李。” 

地上随即闪现出两样物件。李总是会还回两样：一件属于她，一件属于他。送给特蕾莎·凯尔钦斯基的棒球夹克，以及戴维斯博士的园艺日记。莫法特早已记住那些与他们一同消失的东西——他的公文包、她的车、大黄蜂号航空母舰——也在往后的几十年里，眼睁睁看着李一点点地把它们吐出来。二十年间，他对着地下室里被拔高的重力场说话，而李唯一会做的，就只是翻检一个失物招领箱。 

他沉默了片刻。“我辜负了他们…” 

莫法特拨了拨那件夹克，耶罗的。哀伤、眷恋与怀旧交织在一起，让他忍不住再次开口。 

“…你能替我送点东西给他们吗？” 

第二支铅笔变成了碳，肯定的答复，莫法特弯着的脊背一下子挺直了。

他颤抖着举起盘子，强压着让声音保持平静，“你能把这个给他们吗？” 

那块巧克力蛋糕，上面用糖霜写着“…休，巴克！”，连纸盘带叉子，一同从他手中消失。他猛地吸了一口气，泪水爬满脸颊。莫法特主任带着哽咽的祈求，对这名地下室里的绑匪低声说道：“告诉他们，我尽力了。”

meditation wasn't enough for you

YOU DIDN'T FIGHT HIM. 
Y O U T U R N E D A R O U N D S M A R T 
Others did. 
while we watched

1745368385.flavor: We are all burdened by the chains of our past.
1745368385.lore:
"My empress," Taurun reported, "the Vanguard has deployed a Guardian to investigate the Leviathan. Your presence has been requested aboard the H.E.L.M.—"

"Where is Calus?" Caiatl gazed ceaselessly at the Leviathan as it loomed beside Luna.

Taurun paused for a moment, datapad in hand. This question had become a common thread woven throughout their briefings.
 
"We do not know. The Leviathan is a gargantuan ship. It is quite possible Calus remains entrenched deep within its Underbelly."

"Then we will disembowel the beast."

"That would be… inadvisable."

Caiatl turned to face her, eyes as cold as her voice. "By all means, Taurun. Advise me."

Slowly, Taurun lowered her datapad. It was not the first time that Caiatl had bristled at her counsel. But since the Leviathan's sudden return, the empress's patience had winnowed to the width of a blade. Taurun chose her next words with caution.

"Calus has an unknown number of Loyalists at his disposal, along with whatever other horrors now inhabit the ship. Our soldiers would almost certainly pay the price for our nescience."

"Would you rather we die cowering behind our shields?" Caiatl scoffed.

"I would rather we not die at all."

The silence hung heavy in the air between them. "Noted," Caiatl decreed as she turned back toward the Leviathan. "You may take your leave."

Taurun nodded and made to depart. As she left the bridge, she hazarded a glance over her shoulder. Silhouetted by Luna, Caiatl bore a striking resemblance to another late leader of the Cabal.

One whose obsession led to ruin.
1745368385.lore_zh:
“陛下，”陶伦报告道，“先锋已经部署了一名守护者前去调查利维坦。希望您能登上应急后勤行动中心——”

“卡鲁斯在哪里？”查厄托始终凝视着在月球附近渐渐显现的利维坦。

陶伦手里拿着数据板，停顿了一会儿。这个问题已经成为了贯穿她们简报的一条主线。
 
“我们还不清楚。利维坦是一艘巨轮。很有可能卡鲁斯仍然盘踞在它的腹地深处。”

“那我们就把这头野兽开膛破肚。”

“我…不建议那样做。”

查厄托转过身来面对着她，目光与她的声音一样冰冷。“那好，陶伦。给我建议。”

陶伦慢慢地放下了她的数据面板。这不是查厄托第一次对她的忠告发怒。但自从利维坦突然归来后，女帝的耐性已大幅消磨殆尽。陶伦如履薄冰地思考下一句措辞。

“卡鲁斯手下有着规模不明的效忠者，还有现在占据飞船的其他可憎之物。我们的士兵几乎无疑会为我们的无知付出代价。”

“你宁愿我们畏缩在护盾后坐以待毙吗？”查厄托不以为然。

“我宁愿我们不要白白送死。”

她们之间的空气中弥漫着沉寂。“知道了，”查厄托命令道，她转身面向利维坦。“你下去吧。”

陶伦点头退下。她离开舰桥时，冒险回头看了一眼。在月球的映衬下，查厄托与另一位已故的卡巴尔领袖有着惊人的相似之处。

某个因执迷不悟而走向灭亡的人。

1400385226.name: New Purpose
1400385226.flavor: I see you adorned in spots of blood like fallen rose petals. I see you victorious and bathed in light, I see you.
1400385226.lore:
Consumed as she was with the scene in the arena, Caiatl forgot the chiddik in her hands as her young body imitated the action playing out before her eyes. The living accessory screamed, then leapt to the flagstones. Boneless or not, it resented having its neck wrenched.

"Gentle, small one," her father chided through a haze of wine. "Your chiddik was bred for a thousand generations to complement your tunic. Pick it up."

"Must I? It is always in the way."

"A princess must serve her purpose as much as any other beast. Once you outgrow this tunic, you may do anything you like with the chiddik. Eat it, perhaps. They are scrumptious boiled in wine with bitter herbs. But for now—"

"Yes, Father," she hastily recited, but already, her eyes wandered back to the red sand below. Ghaul lifted the slack-jawed head—torn, not cut, from his rival's body—toward the Imperial box. Every sinew in the warrior's flesh trembled with passion and triumph.

"Your prowess pleases us, gladiator." Calus rose. "You will join us this evening for repast."

In that moment, Caiatl realized that Ghaul would not wear an absurd chiddik to dinner. He had no use for a fragile accessory whose musk and chirping and scintillating tails boasted his position. He had never needed to learn the subtle gesticulations to summon a servant who would wick away the creature's urine without drawing attention. His hands had learned to direct blades, not cloacists.

She retrieved the trembling animal with hateful hands. For a moment, she clasped down on its maw. It writhed in wide-eyed panic, struggling for breath, but she quickly released. The beast bore no sin for its place in the world; no more than she assumed fault for hers.

But unlike a chiddik, she could create new purpose for herself.
1400385226.lore_zh:
太过专注于竞技场里的场景，查厄托幼小的身体模仿着眼前的比赛动作挥动时竟忘记了手中的奇迪克。这件饰品活物尖叫着，跳到了石板上。不管有没有骨头，它都讨厌脖子被拧断。

“温柔点，小家伙，”她的父亲带着酒意责备道。“你的奇迪克繁育了上千代来衬托你的外衣。把它捡起来。”

“非得这样吗？它总是碍事。”

“公主必须像其他野兽一样完成她的使命。等你穿不下这件外衣了，奇迪克可以任你处置。比如说，吃了它。在酒中将它们煮沸，再加上苦味药材，非常可口。但是现在——”

“好，父亲，”她匆匆念叨着，但目光已经游移回到了下面的红沙。盖欧举起目瞪口呆的头颅——从对手的身体上撕扯下来，而不是砍下来——走向帝国包厢。这位战士身上的每一根青筋都因激情和胜利而抖动着。

“角斗士，你的英勇取悦了我们。”卡鲁斯大声说道。“今晚你将和我们一起用餐。”

在那一瞬间，查厄托意识到，盖欧不会戴着荒唐的奇迪克去赴宴。他不需要一件娇弱的配饰，用它的麝香和啁啾还有闪烁的尾巴来吹嘘他的地位。他从来不需要学习微妙的手势来差遣仆从，让他们吸走这生物的尿液而不引起注意。他的双手学会了使唤刀刃，而不是抹布工。

她用心怀仇恨的双手取回了这只颤颤巍巍的动物。有那么一会儿，她紧紧扼住了它的咽喉。它惊恐地扭动着，挣扎着呼吸，但她很快就松开了。这只野兽无需为它在世上的地位承担任何罪过，正如她的身份也无需成为她的过错。

但与奇迪克不同，她可以为自己创造新的使命。

2862666249.name: Stormchaser
2862666249.typeName_zh: 传说 线性融合步枪
2862666249.lore:
Sparks flew as the cleavers scraped against each other, their keening screech echoing off the walls of the training hall.

"A half step too slow," rumbled Ghaul. "If this were a real duel, my next blow would have ended it."

Still holding her blade, Caiatl raised her forearm to wipe the sweat from her brow. "Do you talk this much during a real fight?"

Ghaul laughed. "I am not in the habit of tutoring my opponents. The lessons would be wasted upon my final blow."

"Perhaps you could bore them to death instead. What an end that would be—slain by a lecture from the Ghost Primus. A fate that may soon await me."

"Boredom is for those who lack ambition."

"Then stop droning on and attack!"

Ghaul took stock of the young heir apparent. She possessed raw talent. A marvelous instinct for battle. But her energy always flared like a supernova. There was much for her to still learn, if he were to shape her into the warrior of unparalleled ferocity that Emperor Calus desired her to be.

"In due time," Ghaul replied, setting down his weapon and taking a seat. "For now, we rest."

Caiatl grumbled something under her breath and sat beside him. Even in silence, Ghaul could feel her agitation, clearly unable to relax and recover her stamina.

"Your rage is a wildfire," he said to her. "It burns indiscriminately until nothing is left but ashes."

"Another lecture?" Caiatl quipped.

Ghaul ignored the jab and continued. "Instead, you must be a volcano. Magma, steadily seething, unseen beneath the surface. It will lull your enemy into a false sense of security. Then, when the time is right…"

"I erupt," Caiatl finished.

Ghaul smiled. "Precisely."

Caiatl sat quietly with her shoulders relaxed, seemingly absorbing the lesson. Ghaul hoped it would not go to waste.
2862666249.lore_zh:
大砍刀相互摩擦着，火花四溅，它们尖锐刺耳的声响在训练大厅的四壁回响。

“慢了半步，”盖欧咕哝道。“如果这是一场真正的决斗，我下一击就能让它结束。”

查厄托仍握着她的剑，举起前臂擦去额头上的汗水。“在真正的战斗中，你会说这么多话吗？”

盖欧笑了。“我没有辅导对手的习惯。在我使出最后一击时，那堂课就白上了。”

“也许你可以把他们烦死。那会是怎样的死法啊——被幽灵军团长训斥至死。也许那就是我不久后的命运。”

“只有那些缺乏雄心的人才会厌烦教导。”

“那就别再唠唠叨叨，进攻吧！”

盖欧审视着这位年轻的继承者。她拥有与生俱来的天赋，非凡的战斗本能。但她的能量总是像超新星一样爆发殆尽。如果他想把她塑造成卡鲁斯大帝所期望的那种无可匹敌的勇猛战士，她还有很多东西要学。

“别心急，”盖欧答道，放下他的武器，坐了下来。“现在，我们休息一会。”

查厄托低声抱怨着什么，然后在他旁边坐下。即使默不作声，盖欧也能感受得到她的激动不安，明显没法放松和恢复体力。

“你的愤怒就像野火，”他对她说。“不分青红皂白地燃烧，直至只剩下灰烬。”

“又开始上课了？”查厄托打趣道。

盖欧无视嘲讽，继续说道。“相反，你得像座火山一样。看不见的岩浆在地表下逐渐地沸腾，让你的敌人产生一种虚假的安全感。然后，等到时机成熟…”

“我再爆发，”查厄托帮他把话说完。

盖欧笑了。“没错。”

查厄托静静地坐着，肩膀放松，似乎在听取教诲。盖欧希望这堂课没有白上。
