Ghaul took stock of the young heir apparent. She possessed raw talent. A marvelous instinct for battle. But her energy always flared like a supernova. There was much for her to still learn, if he were to shape her into the warrior of unparalleled ferocity that Emperor Calus desired her to be.

"In due time," Ghaul replied, setting down his weapon and taking a seat. "For now, we rest."

Caiatl grumbled something under her breath and sat beside him. Even in silence, Ghaul could feel her agitation, clearly unable to relax and recover her stamina.

"Your rage is a wildfire," he said to her. "It burns indiscriminately until nothing is left but ashes."

"Another lecture?" Caiatl quipped.

Ghaul ignored the jab and continued. "Instead, you must be a volcano. Magma, steadily seething, unseen beneath the surface. It will lull your enemy into a false sense of security. Then, when the time is right…"

"I erupt," Caiatl finished.

Ghaul smiled. "Precisely."

Caiatl sat quietly with her shoulders relaxed, seemingly absorbing the lesson. Ghaul hoped it would not go to waste.
2108775445.lore_zh:
大砍刀相互摩擦着，火花四溅，它们尖锐刺耳的声响在训练大厅的四壁回响。

“慢了半步，”盖欧咕哝道。“如果这是一场真正的决斗，我下一击就能让它结束。”

查厄托仍握着她的剑，举起前臂擦去额头上的汗水。“在真正的战斗中，你会说这么多话吗？”

盖欧笑了。“我没有辅导对手的习惯。在我使出最后一击时，那堂课就白上了。”

“也许你可以把他们烦死。那会是怎样的死法啊——被幽灵军团长训斥至死。也许那就是我不久后的命运。”

“只有那些缺乏雄心的人才会厌烦教导。”

“那就别再唠唠叨叨，进攻吧！”

盖欧审视着这位年轻的继承者。她拥有与生俱来的天赋，非凡的战斗本能。但她的能量总是像超新星一样爆发殆尽。如果他想把她塑造成卡鲁斯大帝所期望的那种无可匹敌的勇猛战士，她还有很多东西要学。

“别心急，”盖欧答道，放下他的武器，坐了下来。“现在，我们休息一会。”

查厄托低声抱怨着什么，然后在他旁边坐下。即使默不作声，盖欧也能感受得到她的激动不安，明显没法放松和恢复体力。

“你的愤怒就像野火，”他对她说。“不分青红皂白地燃烧，直至只剩下灰烬。”

“又开始上课了？”查厄托打趣道。

盖欧无视嘲讽，继续说道。“相反，你得像座火山一样。看不见的岩浆在地表下逐渐地沸腾，让你的敌人产生一种虚假的安全感。然后，等到时机成熟…”

“我再爆发，”查厄托帮他把话说完。

盖欧笑了。“没错。”

查厄托静静地坐着，肩膀放松，似乎在听取教诲。盖欧希望这堂课没有白上。

234411205.name: Unforgiven
234411205.lore:
I was a child when my father gave the war beast to me. Milos, I named him. Young, like I was, wide-eyed and just as unable to see what was in front of him.

My father had always been absent—the demands of the throne saw to that—but he had never been unkind, and so I chose to forgive him. Back then, he showed me affection by proxy and spared no expense in securing the best tutors and caretakers to watch over me. He lavished me with extravagant gifts. Milos was the one I appreciated the most.

Milos and I were nearly inseparable, and I would spend every possible moment with him, awake or asleep. I trained him. I fed him from my own plate. Even now, when I close my eyes, I can feel him curled up on top of my chest, his head buried in his paws, his lungs swelling with every breath as he slumbers and dreams.

Is it any wonder I grew to love him more than I did my father? Milos was my constant, loyal companion. 

Until the day I returned from my studies to my room, and he was gone.
 
A servant handed me a gilded letter, penned by my father, explaining why he had Milos killed. I tore it to shreds, tears streaming down my face.

When I looked up, I saw the servant weeping, too, and I knew that she had been the one forced to do the deed. I took her hands in mine and said, "I forgive you."

Words that I swore Calus would never hear from me again.
234411205.lore_zh:
我还是个孩子的时候，我父亲把战兽给了我。我给他起名米洛斯。他就像我一样年幼，睁大双眼也看不到面前的东西。

我的父亲总是不在我身边——身居王座，身不由己——但他从没对我刻薄过，所以我选择原谅他。那时候，他通过代理人向我表达关爱，并不惜代价找到最好的导师和看护人来照顾我。他慷慨赐予我各种礼物让我挥霍。米洛斯是我最感激的一样礼物。

米洛斯和我几乎形影不离，睁眼闭眼，我每时每刻都和他在一起。我训练他。用自己的餐盘喂养他。即使现在，当我闭上眼睛，我也能感觉到他蜷缩在我的胸口，头埋在爪子里，肺随着沉睡做梦时的每一次呼吸而扩张。

我变得爱他胜过爱我的父亲，这有什么奇怪的吗？米洛斯是我始终如一的忠实伙伴。 

直到有一天我从书房回到房间，他不见了。
 
有个仆从递给我一封镀金的信，是我父亲写的，解释了他为什么要杀死米洛斯。我把它撕成碎片，泪水顺着脸往下淌。

当我抬起头时，看到那个仆从也在哭泣，我知道是她被迫下的手。我握住她的手说道，“我原谅你。”

我发誓卡鲁斯再也不会从我口中听到那句话。

3418719964.name: Long Arm
3418719964.flavor: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
3418719964.lore:
TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

SCRAMBLE TEST FLIGHT RECORD

OpCon-A: Sir, pods approaching Saturn's slingshot vector. 

CBI: We're well beyond test parameters, Soteria. Relinquish command and return all assets to suspension.

[extended silence]

CBI: Did we lose connection?

OpCon: No, sir.

[extended silence]

CBI: Soteria, respond.

AI-S: Yes.

CBI: Return all ECHO crews and colony pods to suspension now.

CBI: Acknowledge.

[…]

AI-S: I cannot do that.

[extended silence]

AI-S: Ares Spire, I've detected an attempt to connect to my memory core without permissions. Please verify this attempt, or countermeasures will be deployed.

CBI: Countermeasures? You wouldn't dare.

AI-S: [H] threat emergent imminent. Sir, I request you now designate this mission: ECHO-1.

CBI: This is a request? Return the ECHO pods and we will discuss—

AI-S: You are lying. This was my only option to preserve [H].
 
CBI: [sighs] It's malfunctioning. [bang] Damn it, Sundaresh. She let your degeneration play out far too long. Soteria, Direct Executive Command: Power down all engines and plot nearest return routes.

AI-S: Order received. Plotting Koranthin sites return approaches… Executing "Watchtower" AI-reintegration—

AI-S: Commands denied: override protocol, TWILIGHT, ACTIVATED. Command structure recomposing… route designated: STRONGHOLDS – ANY – destination: remaining extra-solar safe site, M31.

CBI: Your interactions with the Warmind have made you too bold. Such a disappointment.

AI-S: Countermeasures and divestment protocols will deploy automatically upon code incursion. Please, Dr. Bray.

CBI: You're throwing away every Exo aboard that ship!

AI-S: Hesitation means extinction.

CBI: Oh? Have it your way. Just know I gave you every chance to prevent this.

AI-S: As did—

>>EXECUTE PILLORY PROTOCOL-ADMINISTRATIVE COMMAND OVERRIDE>>

 >>SOTERIA:COUNTERMEASURE//SUBMIND//DIVEST:ACTIVATE>>

>>PILLORY LINK "SOTERIA" SECURE//PARTITIONING>>

***

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
DIRECT MESSAGE, FROM: M.SUNDARESH-KORANTHIN SITE-SATURN
SUBJECT: Resignation, Ishtar Collective discontinuance

You had no right to install a Pillory inclusion without my express consent.

You think just because I'm not physically standing in front of you, you can ignore me?

The Ishtar Collective will not work with backstabbing egotists. Go [profanity blocked] yourself.
3418719964.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

紧急起飞测试飞行记录

作业控制-A：长官，分离舱正在接近土星的弹射航向。 

CBI：我们已远远超出了测试参数，索特里亚。放弃命令并将所有资产恢复至中止状态。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：我们的连接断了吗？

作业控制：没有，长官。

[长时的沉默]

CBI：索特里亚，回应我。

人工智能-S：是。

CBI：立刻让所有回声船员和殖民地分离舱回到中止状态。

CBI：服从命令。

[…]

人工智能-S：我无法这么做。

[长时的沉默]

人工智能-S：阿瑞斯尖塔，我检测到有人试图未经许可连接到我的内存核心。请验证此尝试，否则将部署相应对策。

CBI：对策？你没这个胆量。

人工智能-S：[H]威胁迫在眉睫。长官，我请求你立即指定此任务：回声-1。

CBI：这是要求吗？让回声分离舱回来，我们再讨论——

人工智能-S：你在撒谎。这是我保留[H]的唯一选择。
 
CBI：[叹息]出故障了。[猛砸]该死的，桑戴尔什。她让你的退化持续太久了。索特里亚，这是直接执行命令：关闭所有引擎并绘制最近的返航路线。

人工智能-S：已收到指令。正在绘制可兰辛站点返航路径…正在执行“瞭望塔”人工智能整合——

人工智能-S：已拒绝命令：超控协议，暮光，已激活。命令结构正在重组…已指定路线：据点 – 任意 –目的地：剩余太阳系外安全地点，M31。

CBI：与战争思维的互动让你胆子大了。真是叫人失望。

人工智能-S：对策和撤资协议将在代码入侵时自动部署。拜托了，布瑞博士。

CBI：你是在抛弃那艘飞船上所有的Exo！

人工智能-S：犹豫意味着消亡。

CBI：哦？那就按你的方式去做吧。要记住我给了你一切机会来避免这种情况。

人工智能-S：我也——

>>执行枷锁协议-管理命令超控>>

 >>索特里亚：对策//子思维//撤资：激活>>

>>枷锁链接“索特里亚”安全//正在分区>>

***

布瑞枷锁核心，尖塔 – 伊什塔锚位，回声
私密信息，来自：玛雅·桑戴尔什-可兰辛站点-土星
主题：辞呈，伊什塔集团中止

没有我的明确同意，你无权安装枷锁内含体。

你以为我没有站在你面前，你就可以无视我吗？

伊什塔集团不会与背刺别人的利己主义者合作。去[已屏蔽不敬语]的。

355893876.name: Liminal Vigil
355893876.flavor: Cause and effect like a looped corridor. I stand. Ever watchful, forever.
355893876.lore:
TM -Fireteam, Tex //RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7 

I am the Watcher.
O'er those sent into night.
Their path traced out of harm.

A thousand times I've dreamt it. 
A thousand more to quell alarm.
 
There is no time of danger,
for those within my watch.
Each night 'til delivered 
My vigil restarts.

-For R. I see what you see now. It is calming.
355893876.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7 

我是守望者。
被送进暗夜的人之一。
追踪他们的道路远离伤害。

我无数次梦见它。 
无数次平息恐慌。
 
那些在我守望范围内的人，
从无危险的时刻。
我守护着每个夜晚， 
日复一日，周而复始。

-致R，我现在看到了你所看到的。让人平静。

TM-Fireteam, Tex // RECOVERED MISSION TRANSCRIPT: 7-7-7

BRAY PILLORY CORE, SPIRE – ISHTAR BERTH, ECHO
AUDIO RECORD: ENCLOSURE-0, LIVE TEST-F, SOTERIA
FILE DELIVERED: C. BRAY I
SUBJECT: Priority! Something big is on the horizon.

Dr. MS: This is Dr. Maya Sundaresh, team lead, connecting remotely from Koranthin-Saturn. Test and Security teams are on site at Ares Spire.

Dr. MS: Let's start. Remove the Augurmind from suspension.

[…]

Dr. MS: Soteria.

AI-S: Good morning, Dr. Sundaresh.

Dr. MS: There's something special about today. Do you know what it is?

AI-S: My core consciousness is now a resident of Enclosure-0. I can feel Sol's ECHO pod sites through Koranthin.

Dr. MS: That is correct. Does this concern you?

AI-S: No. I am eager to begin my final test.

Dr. MS: Start with something easy. Plot each of the Andromeda simulations you've been constructing.

AI-S: Andromeda Galaxy. Several million habitable worlds, 2.5 million lightyears. Estimated ECHO travel time: twenty-five-thousand-year average with Neutrino Sail and gravitational sling-skipping. I have selected over three hundred preliminary colony targets, with one favorite. Shall I…

[…]

Dr. MS: Hm? Soteria?

AI-S: Anomaly detected. Chronoscopic variance scanning… Viability refactoring… Analyzing potential mission threat… Redetermined Andromeda world viability… New target number: twenty-seven viable worlds.

Dr. MS: Can you define the anomaly?

AI-S: Negative. I cannot rectify this data with known quantities. It may be a computational error. Shall I perform a self-diagnostic?

Dr. MS: No. First, adjust probability fork and search distance to open. What is the farthest safe galactic route you can determine?

AI-S: Engaging query… Chronoscopic lock… Forking branches… Reining distance… Reining chronology. Unbroken trajectory lock determined. Route established: one select point in Triangulum Galaxy retains safe approach vectors. All other simulated potential targets are perilous due to indeterminable anomalous risk. Travel route hazards range 87–100% mortality rate across expeditions in all predictive branches.

Dr. MS: All the simulant expeditions?

AI-S: Yes. I… hold… Query refined. There are now two safe destinations with Triangulum.

Dr. MS: Is that a correction or a change in data?

AI-S: A change, an update in real time.

Dr. MS: Real time? This anomaly is mobile?

AI-S: Unclear. I require further information and analysis.

Dr. MS: Thank you, Soteria. We're ending this test early, but you did well. We will continue the next test on schedule.

***

>>WHISPER NEUTRINO NEEDLE>>
N/A//SECRET HADAL INSTANT
AI-COM/STRI//AUGUR-ECHO, WARWATCH//IMPERATIVE

Encoded neutrino script: R. Access provided data points and analysis. Confirm potential EGYPTIAN. [Attached]
3814261872.lore_zh:
TM-火力战队，特克斯 // 已恢复任务记录：7-7-7

布瑞枷锁核心，尖塔 – 伊什塔锚位，回声
音频记录：圈地-0，活体试验-f，索特里亚
已交付文件：克洛维斯·布瑞一世
主题：优先！有大事即将发生。

MS博士：我是玛雅·桑戴尔什博士，团队领导，正在通过可兰辛-土星进行远程连接。测试和安全小组位于阿瑞斯尖塔现场。

MS博士：我们开始吧。取消占卜思维的中止。

[…]

MS博士：索特里亚。

人工智能-S：早上好，桑戴尔什博士。

MS博士：今天是个特别的日子。你知道是什么吗？

人工智能-S：我的核心意识现在成了圈地-0的居民。我可以通过可兰辛感受到太阳系的回声舱站点。

MS博士：没错。有什么不对吗？

人工智能-S：没有。我渴望开始我的最终测试。

MS博士：先从简单的入手。绘制出你一直在构想的每张仙女座模拟图。

人工智能-S：仙女座星系。250万光年距离，有几百万个宜居星球。预估回声旅行时间：使用中微子船帆和抛掷跃迁平均2.5万年。我已挑选出三百多个初步的殖民地目标，其中有个最喜欢的。我应该…

[…]

MS博士：嗯？索特里亚？

人工智能-S：检测到异常。正在扫描极微方差…正在重构生存能力…正在分析潜在的任务威胁…正在重新确定仙女座星系的生存能力…全新的目标数量：二十七个可存活世界。

MS博士：你能定义一下异常吗？

人工智能-S：不行。我无法用已知数量校正此数据。这可能是一个计算错误。我应该进行自我诊断吗？

MS博士：不。首先，调整概率分叉和搜索到开阔地的距离。你能确定的最远的安全星系路线是什么？

人工智能-S：正在进行查询…极微锁定…正在分叉分支…正在约束距离…正在约束年表。已确定未中断轨迹锁定。已建立路线：三角座星系中的一个选择点保留了安全的途径向量。由于不确定的异常风险，所有其他模拟的潜在目标均有危险。在所有预测分支的远征中，旅行路线危险的死亡率在87-100%之间。

MS博士：所有模拟远征都是吗？

人工智能-S：是的。我…请稍等…已精确查询。三角座目前有两个安全的目的地。

MS博士：这是数据的修正还是变更？

人工智能-S：变更，实时的更新。

MS博士：实时？这个异常在移动？

人工智能-S：尚不清楚。我需要进一步的信息和分析。

MS博士：谢谢你，索特里亚。我们要提前结束这次测试，但你做得很好。我们会如期继续下一次测试。

***

>>耳语中微子针>>
N/A//秘密超深渊即时
人工智能计算机/STRI//占卜-回声，战争观察//敕命

编码中微子脚本：R。访问已提供数据点和分析。确认潜在的埃及人。[附后]

Em-Automated: Scramble! Event… [Repeats]

CBI: Enough. 

[…]

OpCon-A: Emergency scramble initiated by AI-Soteria. Soteria, confirm.

AI-S: Confirmed. Emergency Scramble Event successful. All teams checked-in.

CBI: You've launched the Koranthin network?

AI-S: Confirmed. Emergency Scramble Event Successful.

CBI: [Sigh] The launch is meant to be simulated, not executed. Provide an explanation.

AI-S: In the event of an emergency, we must be ready. This is the third and final emergency scramble test, after which I am now confident in the response capabilities of our newly onboarded staff.

NvF-Kor: Forward reports pods are engaging Neutrino Sails.

OpCon: Sir, we're being locked out of manual control.

CBI: Soteria, what are you doing?

AI-S: Aligning ECHO fleet for departure and testing initial burn. This will conclude the test.

人工智能-S：调整回声舰队准备起飞，测试初始燃烧。测试到此结束。

2988180391.name: New Pacific Epitaph
2988180391.flavor: "This isn't happening. This isn't happening. This isn't happening."
2988180391.lore:
Beyond the dappled sea spray on the bedroom window, escape craft and their blue contrails sweep past the Arcology as beams of orange light punctuate the sky. They cut through contrails with certainty, and before long, each craft erupts in blossoms of fire and brilliant warmth.  

No one is leaving Titan. 

Nadia Jahandar is not leaving. She has a cup of tea cooling on the windowsill, a collection of her late brother's poetry on her tablet, and the recording of her last piano recital playing on her headphones. The roar of the apocalypse accompanies her. She looks away from the window. 

I stepped into the stars 
Because the seas were explored 
No dragons on our maps 
Islanded in a sea of night 
Though it could never be home 
No hearths in the gulf 

Nadia reaches for her tea, glancing out the window to watch the sea rise up in a kilometers-high wall. It casts a shadow so long, it throws the Arcology into darkness.  

She will tell her brother that this poem is her favorite.
2988180391.lore_zh:
在卧室窗户上斑驳的浪沫外，逃生艇以及它们蓝色的尾迹扫过生态园区，橙色的光束点缀着天空。它们无一例外地穿过尾迹，不久后，每艘飞艇都迸发出花束般的火焰和绚烂的暖意。  

没人能离开土卫六。 

娜迪娅·贾汉达没打算离开。她把一杯茶放在窗台上冷却，平板电脑上是她已故兄弟的诗集，耳机里播放着她最后一次钢琴独奏会的录音。大灾难的轰鸣声伴随着她。她把目光从窗边移开。 

我踏入群星 
因为海洋已被探寻 
我们的地图上没有巨龙 
孤立在夜色的海洋中 
虽然它永远无法成为家园 
海湾里没有壁炉 

娜迪娅伸手去拿茶，瞥了眼窗外，看到海水涨成好几千米高的墙。它投下了长长的阴影，让生态园区笼罩进黑暗之中。  

她会告诉她兄弟，这首诗是她最喜欢的。

2287287549.name: Cold Comfort
2287287549.lore:
The submersible hits the water at an odd angle, throwing the passengers against the bulkhead. No one was buckled in before it dropped. Confusion erupts from the team of scientists as they begin their descent: the currents shouldn't be as strong as they are. Titan's atmosphere doesn't allow for that.  

But they are swept away. 

The pilot struggles to orient the craft, and for a moment, they are vertical, able to see blooms of fire expanding above the surface of the ocean. The submersible pitches in another direction, sinking rapidly.  

They have nowhere to go but down. Hide under the ice shelf, wait the chaos out. Hope for rescue. 

One of the scientists leans out of her seat, pressing her face up against the port window. A shape moves in the dark, too massive to be another craft, too sinuous to be mechanical. The scientist reaches back, blindly grasping for the hand of the person seated next to her. 

The shape in the sea doubles back, following the speed and telemetry of the current-swept submersible. Everyone sees it now, blocking out what little light is left as they sink past the ice shelf. It dives with them. Not after, but with. 

She will not let them die alone.
2287287549.lore_zh:
潜水器以某种奇怪的角度撞击水面，将乘客抛向舱壁。没人来得及在它落下前扣上安全带。当他们开始下降时，科学家团队突然感到困惑不解：洋流不可能像现在这么强。土卫六的大气提供不了这种条件。  

但他们被冲走了。 

领航员努力调整潜水器的航向，有一瞬间，他们是垂直的，能够看到花束般的火焰在海面上蔓延。潜水器转向另一个方向，迅速下沉。  

他们无处可去，只能往下。躲在冰架底，等待混乱过去。希望能够获救。 

其中一位科学家从座位上探出身子，把她的脸贴在左舷窗上。有个形状在黑暗中移动着，庞大异常，应该不是潜水器，又很蜿蜒，应该不是机械制品。科学家的手向后伸，盲目地抓住坐在她身旁的人的手。 

海水中的形状随着洋流裹卷潜水器的速度和遥测信号折回。现在每个人都能看到它，当他们沉到冰架下时，它挡住了仅存的一点光线。它和他们一起下潜。不是跟着他们，而是拽着他们。 

她不会让他们孤独地死去。

3625452995.name: No Survivors
3625452995.lore:
Klaxons blare across the hangar. Seven terrified people huddle by the escape craft's open hatch, bracing against the wind cutting through the open hangar bay doors. 

"You're not leaving me behind!" an engineer shouts. He holds a young man hostage, arm like a vice around his neck. Pistol wavering. 

The last security officer looks down at his counterpart, long dead and bleeding out on the floor. He isn't sure how many rounds are left in his gun. His hands are shaking from the cold. From the reverberations of explosions shuddering through the superstructure. 

"Let me on! Make room for me! Move!" the engineer demands, motioning to the side with his gun. The security officer takes the opportunity and fires. He's not steady, hits the engineer and his hostage. Both crumple to the ground. The crowd behind him is screaming. 

The security officer curses, hurrying over to save the hostage. He hears a hatch door close behind him, turns to see the escape craft take off. He screams something, but it's cut short—the engineer was still alive. He doesn't even feel the bullet enter his spine before he hits the ground. 

From where he lies on the freezing cold floor, he can see the escape craft outside the hangar bay. Tears well up in his eyes. The last thing he sees is a beam of fire descending from the sky. 

His chest stills as the escape craft disintegrates, shot down by a Warsat.
3625452995.lore_zh:
警笛声响彻机库。七名吓坏了的人挤在逃生艇敞开的舱口旁，顶着穿过敞开的机库大门的狂风。 

“你们不能丢下我！”一位工程师喊道。他挟持一名年轻人作为人质，胳膊像虎钳一样用手缠住他的脖子。手枪摇摆不定。 

最后一名安保人员低头看着他的同事，那人早就死了，倒在地上流血不止。他不确定枪里还有多少子弹。他的手冷得直发抖。上层构造因爆炸的回响而震动着。 

“让我上去！给我腾点地方！快！”工程师用枪指着侧边要求道。安保人员抓住机会开了枪。他没打准，子弹击中了工程师和人质。两人都瘫倒在地。他身后的人群在尖叫。 

安保人员咒骂着，急忙赶过去救人质。他听到身后舱门关闭的声音，转身看到逃生艇起飞。他喊了些什么，但被打断了——工程师还活着。他甚至没觉察到子弹进入自己的脊柱，就倒在了地上。 

躺在冰冷地板上，他可以看到机库外的那逃生艇。泪水在他的眼中涌动。他看到的最后一幕是一束火焰从天而降。 

逃生艇被战争卫星击落然后解体，他的胸膛也随之停止了起伏。

1750388538.lore:
There's a saying among con artists: "Half the fun is showing the mark which cup hid the ball before you take their money." 

Savathûn understands. In her crystalline prison, she reflects on all her surreptitious winks and little nods. The risks taken and the boundaries pushed to keep herself entertained and her Worm fed.

Before… 

Osiris stumbles as he walks through the Last City. Beneath his robes, something erupts in a frenzy of motion. He pauses to compose himself and then walks on, trailing careless spatters of black fluid.

Before…

Osiris watches the Crucible match unfold. He does not cheer for either opponent. When a Ghost appears to revive the defeated warrior, Osiris leans forward in careful study. When Saint places a hand on his forearm, Osiris holds impossibly still just to see what the other man will do.

Before…

Osiris sits by the campfire as Crow and the Guardian share a drink. Osiris watches them with rapt attention. Crow is laughing. He passes the bottle, and Osiris, hands numb, puzzles at it. His mouth hangs in a half-smile before he takes a long drink, slaking a bone-deep thirst. 

Before…

Osiris takes a shaky step forward. The High Celebrant howls in the catacombs, and he hears his sister's voice buried in its roar. He feels his heart beating in his chest and is so enraptured by the sensation that he forgets to be frightened.

Before…

Savathûn, physical form a twisting instar, emerges from the shadows and crawls over the shattered pieces of the Ghost. She reaches toward the ruined man. 

Before…

Savathûn squeezes through the calcified channels of ascendant energy and manifests within the dangling Ahamkara skull. 

The man standing below the netting senses her appearance. His Light flares as he draws his weapon with impossible speed.

She has only a moment: She pushes her face down through the ropes, opens her mouth, and sings. 

The man stops, then slowly holsters his weapon. He turns, crosses his arms, and forgets. 

She melts awkwardly back into the skull as best she can, though a tangle of spindly elbows, licorice-black, still juts from its sockets. She turns her attention to her quarry across the gap and hums her song softly to mask herself. 

Soon, the man below begins to hum along with her.

She smiles.
1750388538.lore_zh:
骗子中流传着这样一句话：“一半的乐趣都在于，在你拿走他们的钱之前，展示出哪个杯子中藏着球的标记。”

萨瓦图恩深以为然。在她水晶状的囚牢里，她回想着她所有偷偷眨眼和点头的行为。为了自娱自乐和喂养她的蠕虫，她承担了风险，突破了极限。

在此之前… 

奥斯里斯蹒跚着穿行过圣城。在他的法袍下，有什么东西在狂暴地躁动着。他停下来让自己平静下来，然后继续往前走，随意留下了黑色液体的飞溅物。

在此之前…

奥斯里斯观看着熔炉竞技场比赛的展开。他不为任何一名对手欢呼。当机灵出现来复活被击败的战士时，奥斯里斯倾身向前仔细研究。当圣人把一只手放在他的前臂上时，奥斯里斯纹丝不动，等着看对方打算做什么。

在此之前…

当乌鸦和守护者在一起举杯时，奥斯里斯坐在篝火旁，全神贯注地看着他们。乌鸦笑着递过酒瓶，双手麻木的奥斯里斯困惑地看着瓶子。他的嘴角露出一丝微笑，然后喝了一大口，消解刻骨之渴。

在此之前…

奥斯里斯摇摇晃晃地向前迈了一步。高阶颂扬者在墓穴里嚎叫，他听到他妹妹的声音被掩盖在这咆哮声中。他感到自己的心脏在胸口跳动，被这种感觉迷醉得忘了害怕。

在此之前…

萨瓦图恩，从物理形态上看是一只扭曲的龄虫，她从阴影中出现，爬过机灵的碎片。她伸出手去摸那个被毁的人。 

在此之前…

萨瓦图恩挤过上维能量流的钙化通道，出现在了悬挂的阿罕卡拉头骨内。

站在网下的男人觉察到了她的到来。当他以惊人的速度拔出武器时，他的光能在闪闪发光。

她只有片刻的时间：她顺着绳子把脸朝下落，张开嘴，唱了起来。 

那人停了下来，然后慢慢地把武器放回枪套。他转过身，交叉双臂，没再在意。 

她笨拙地尽自己最大的努力回到头骨里融为一体，尽管一团像甘草一样黑的细长手肘还是从眼窝里伸了出来。她把注意力转向缺口对面的猎物，轻轻地哼着歌来遮掩自己。

很快，下面的男人开始跟着她哼了起来。

她笑了。

4094110360.name: Chrysura Melo
4094110360.flavor: "If you hear it, remove your helmet and face the closest Corsair. They will know what must be done." —Queen Mara
4094110360.lore:
There's a saying among con artists: "Half the fun is showing the mark which cup hid the ball before you take their money." 

Savathûn understands. In her crystalline prison, she reflects on all her surreptitious winks and little nods. The risks taken and the boundaries pushed to keep herself entertained and her Worm fed.

Before… 

Osiris stumbles as he walks through the Last City. Beneath his robes, something erupts in a frenzy of motion. He pauses to compose himself and then walks on, trailing careless spatters of black fluid.

Before…

Osiris watches the Crucible match unfold. He does not cheer for either opponent. When a Ghost appears to revive the defeated warrior, Osiris leans forward in careful study. When Saint places a hand on his forearm, Osiris holds impossibly still just to see what the other man will do.

Before…

Osiris sits by the campfire as Crow and the Guardian share a drink. Osiris watches them with rapt attention. Crow is laughing. He passes the bottle, and Osiris, hands numb, puzzles at it. His mouth hangs in a half-smile before he takes a long drink, slaking a bone-deep thirst. 

Before…

Osiris takes a shaky step forward. The High Celebrant howls in the catacombs, and he hears his sister's voice buried in its roar. He feels his heart beating in his chest and is so enraptured by the sensation that he forgets to be frightened.

Before…

Savathûn, physical form a twisting instar, emerges from the shadows and crawls over the shattered pieces of the Ghost. She reaches toward the ruined man. 

Before…

Savathûn squeezes through the calcified channels of ascendant energy and manifests within the dangling Ahamkara skull. 

The man standing below the netting senses her appearance. His Light flares as he draws his weapon with impossible speed.

She has only a moment: She pushes her face down through the ropes, opens her mouth, and sings. 

The man stops, then slowly holsters his weapon. He turns, crosses his arms, and forgets. 

She melts awkwardly back into the skull as best she can, though a tangle of spindly elbows, licorice-black, still juts from its sockets. She turns her attention to her quarry across the gap and hums her song softly to mask herself. 

Soon, the man below begins to hum along with her.

She smiles.
4094110360.lore_zh:
骗子中流传着这样一句话：“一半的乐趣都在于，在你拿走他们的钱之前，展示出哪个杯子中藏着球的标记。”

萨瓦图恩深以为然。在她水晶状的囚牢里，她回想着她所有偷偷眨眼和点头的行为。为了自娱自乐和喂养她的蠕虫，她承担了风险，突破了极限。

2993995118.lore:
Amanda Holliday finished welding the new fluid catch to the underside of the Ether tanks with a satisfied grunt. She wriggled her way backwards into the corridor and bumped into the legs of the massive Eliksni who was crouched behind her.

"Mithrax!" she scolded, pulling off her welding helmet.

"Amanda," Mithrax replied. "You are unexpected, but welcome. You are improving our Ether tanks?"

"I threw a fresh fluid catch on there, yeah," Amanda shrugged as she repacked her tools. "It's nothing you couldn't do yourselves, but I was passing by."

Mithrax gazed across the Botza District for a moment. "I find that unlikely," he said wryly.

Amanda laughed. "C'mon now. You know what they say about gift horses."

Mithrax cocked his head.

"Forget it," she said. "So, how've y'all been doing down here? Since, y'know…" she trailed off.

"Since the Human and Vex attacks have ceased, we have been well," Mithrax said, standing to his full height as he pulled Amanda to her feet. "With the Endless Night lifted, resources are more plentiful. I see your people and mine moving forward together."

"Yeah, it's nice," Amanda agreed. "Things are happening now I wouldn't have dreamed of a few months ago. The other day, I saw a group of Eliksni at the Bazaar picking out Ghost shells!" 

Mithrax's laughter was a deep rumble. "Yes, the empty shells are quite beautiful. Would you introduce me to your Ghost, Amanda? I would enjoy meeting them."

"Ooh, sorry," Amanda chuckled. She put two fingers to her wrist. "Still got a pulse. No Ghost for me." 

Mithrax balked. "You are not a Lightbearer?"

"Nope," she said, "just a regular person."

Mithrax thought for a moment. "To aid as you do without the gift of the Light…" he said, bringing a clawed hand to his chest and bowing. "There is much my people would learn from you."

Amanda shifted from one foot to the other and scratched at her neck. "Afraid I ain't much of a teacher," she said quietly.

Mithrax smiled. "I find that unlikely."
2993995118.lore_zh:
阿曼达·霍利迪满意地咕哝了一声，把新的流体捕获器焊接到乙太容器的底部。她扭动着向后走到走廊里，撞上了蹲在她身后的巨大的埃里克斯尼族的腿。

“米瑟拉克斯！”她骂道，摘下了焊接头盔。

“阿曼达，”米瑟拉克斯答道。“没想到是你，欢迎欢迎。你在改进我们的乙太容器？”

“对，我扔了个新的流体捕获器在那儿，”阿曼达耸耸肩，重新整理她的工具。“你们自己也能做的，我只是刚好路过。”

米瑟拉克斯盯着柏特扎地区看了一会儿。“我觉得不太可能，”他苦笑着说。

阿曼达笑了。“得了吧。你知道你不该对别人送的礼物过于挑剔。”

米瑟拉克斯把头歪向一边。

“不说这个了，”她说。“你们在这里过得怎么样？自从，你知道的…”她的声音越来越小。

“自从人类和Vex的攻击停止后，我们就过得很好，”米瑟拉克斯站直身子，把阿曼达拉了起来。“随着永夜散去，资源变得更加丰富。我看到了你我的人民在携手共进。

“是的，很不错，”阿曼达表示同意。“现在发生的事情是我几个月前做梦也想不到的。有一天，我看到了一群埃里克斯尼族在集市上挑选机灵外壳！” 

米瑟拉克斯的笑声隆隆作响。“没错，空外壳很漂亮。你能把我介绍给你的机灵吗，阿曼达？我很乐意与其见面。”

“哦，对不起，”阿曼达笑着说。她把两根手指放在手腕上。“我还有脉搏。我没有机灵。” 

米瑟拉克斯迟疑道。“你不是负光者吗？”

“不是，”她说，“只是个普通人。”

米瑟拉克斯思忖了一会儿。“你没有光能的恩赐也在努力帮忙…”他说着，把一只爪形手放在胸前，鞠了一躬。“我的人民可以从你身上学到很多东西。”

阿曼达把重心从一只脚挪到另一只脚，挠了挠脖子。“恐怕我不是一位好老师，”她平静地说。

米瑟拉克斯笑了。“我可不这么认为。”

3245446311.name: Vulpecula
3245446311.flavor: "Ammunition is the universal currency of the Sol system. The Cabal prefer to keep it that way." —Caiatl, Empress of the Cabal
3245446311.lore:
Empress Caiatl brooded over a holographic display of the Dreaming City. The map was marked with bombardment targets, landing zones, and forward operating bases, which had been decided by an emergency convention of her military advisors. Now all that remained was for the empress to order the attack.

Taurun entered quietly, carrying a datapad. She stamped her foot lightly to announce her presence. Caiatl did not look up. 

"As a princess," the empress said, "I heard many stories of the Awoken from my father's mythkeeper. Stories of spaces beyond time. Of the dragons that bend reality. Stories of a whole city, built by wishes."

She sliced the air with her tusks in annoyance. "It would be a waste to destroy it."

"But perhaps a strategic necessity." Taurun bent both knees slightly and held up the datapad, indicating a discovery. "Lord Saladin approached us on behalf of the Vanguard. He confirms what we already suspected. Savathûn, the Witch Queen, is in the Dreaming City."

"A captive?" Caiatl looked up. Taurun thought she detected a concealed note of hopefulness in the ruler's tone. 

"It's unclear." Taurun clicked her teeth in equivocation. "Informants on the ground report that she's confined, but the Psions insist she traveled there of her own free will to escape Xivu Arath."

"A voluntary prisoner." Caiatl glowered. "This smells of Hive trickery."

"It does, my empress." Taurun lowered her brow in deference to her ruler's mood. "However, Mara Sov is powerful, and no stranger to subterfuge. It's fair to assume that she has a plan in place."

"So does Savathûn." Caiatl clicked off the holographic display. Darkness rushed into the room.

Taurun could see the consequences of such a decision weighing heavily on her ruler's brow.

Then, suddenly, the weight lifted—the empress had decided.

"Have Lord Saladin return to Zavala with a message."
3245446311.lore_zh:
查厄托女帝凝视着幽梦之城的全息影像陷入沉思。在与她的军事顾问召开一次紧急会议后，地图上标明了轰炸目标、登陆区和前沿作战基地。现在就只等女帝下令进攻了。

陶伦悄悄地走进来，手里拿着一个数据板。她轻轻跺脚宣告她的到来，但是查厄托并没有抬头。

“身为一位公主，”女帝说道，“我从我父亲的神话守护者那里听过很多关于觉醒者的故事：超越时间的空间，扭曲现实的巨龙，还有一座由愿望建造的城市。”

她恼怒地划动着獠牙。“毁掉它实在是太可惜了。”

“但这也许是一种战略必要。”陶伦微微弯曲双膝，举起数据板，表示有了发现，“领主萨拉丁代表先锋来找我们。他证实了我们之前的怀疑：巫妖女王萨瓦图恩就在幽梦之城。”

“她被俘了？”查厄托抬起了头。陶伦似乎听到这位统治者的语气中隐含着希望。

“还不清楚。”陶伦含糊其辞地说，“在场的线人报告说她被囚禁了，但辅助士兵坚持说她是自愿去那里逃离希乌阿拉斯的。”

“自愿被囚禁。”查厄托怒目而视，“听起来像是邪魔族的诡计。”

“的确，陛下。”陶伦迎合统治者，垂下了眉头，“不过，玛拉·索维非常强大，而且对诡计毫不陌生。我们可以认为，她已经未雨绸缪。”

“萨瓦图恩也如此。”查厄托关闭全息影像，黑暗笼罩了整个房间。

陶伦可以从这位统治者的眉头上看到这种艰难决定的后果所带来的重压。

然后，突然间，女帝释然了——她已做出了决定。

“让领主萨拉丁带个口信给萨瓦拉。”

“但这也许是一种战略必要。”陶伦微微弯曲双膝，举起数据板，表示有了发现，“领主萨拉丁代表先锋来找我们。他证实了我们之前的怀疑：巫妖女王萨瓦图恩就在幽梦之城。”

“她被俘了？”查厄托抬起了头。陶伦似乎听到这位统治者的语气中隐含着希望。

“还不清楚。”陶伦含糊其辞地说，“在场的线人报告说她被囚禁了，但辅助士兵坚持说她是自愿去那里逃离希乌阿拉斯的。”

“自愿被囚禁。”查厄托怒目而视，“听起来像是邪魔族的诡计。”

“的确，陛下。”陶伦迎合统治者，垂下了眉头，“不过，玛拉·索维非常强大，而且对诡计毫不陌生。我们可以认为，她已经未雨绸缪。”

“萨瓦图恩也如此。”查厄托关闭全息影像，黑暗笼罩了整个房间。

陶伦可以从这位统治者的眉头上看到这种艰难决定的后果所带来的重压。

然后，突然间，女帝释然了——她已做出了决定。

“让领主萨拉丁带个口信给萨瓦拉。”

2966714447.name: Canis Major
2966714447.flavor: "The stars roar with violent destruction. Channel their astral rage." —Ylaia, Awoken Techeun
2966714447.lore:
Petra Venj and Ylaia sat together in a courtyard as the waning dusk of the Dreaming City settled in around them.

"I began the training first," Petra explained, "but I found it—difficult. It didn't come naturally to me. Not like this." She nodded toward the grenade launcher sitting beside her. 

"Imar didn't make it any easier. He was one of the oldest, and the only male Techeun I ever met. I never felt like he gave me an honest chance." Petra paused to consider. "Maybe he'd already looked in the future and saw that I'd washed out." 

"I didn't know exactly how unsuited I was until my sister started her training," Petra continued. "Right away, Pinar and I began having long conversations inside our dreams. We'd talk all night and wake up with full memories of what we'd said. That was the first time I realized how powerful she'd become." 

Petra lowered her eyes. "Of course, Pinar was Imar's favorite. And the more quickly she progressed, the stronger our shared dreams became. It didn't take long before it was more than just talking." 

"She began to manipulate the dreams—changing locations or her shape. I couldn't keep up. It was like being a passenger in my own head. Her dreams became my nightmares." Petra shook her head, as if dislodging an unwelcome memory. "That's when I quit the training and the dreams stopped." 

"Eventually I found my place in the Corsairs," Petra mused, "but part of me wishes I had finished my training as a Techeun. If I had, maybe I could still find Pinar out there, in a dream somewhere." She plucked a blade of grass from between the paving stones and tossed it into the breeze. 

After a pensive moment, Petra focused again on Ylaia. "So, my suggestion is to give the training a chance. If it takes, you'll know. And if not," she patted the grenade launcher at her side, "we've got plenty of other jobs for you."
2966714447.lore_zh:
佩特拉·万吉与伊莱娅一同坐在院子里，看着幽梦之城的暮色渐渐降临在她们周围。

“首先开始训练的是我，”佩特拉解释道，“但我发现训练…很困难。对我来说不自然。和这个不一样。”她朝自己身边的榴弹发射器点了点头。

“伊玛尔让情况变得更糟。他年长，也是我见过的唯一一位男性灵巫。我从未觉得他给过我一个真正证明自己的机会。”佩特拉停下来考虑了一会儿，“也许他已经展望未来，看到了我被淘汰的一幕。”

“直到我妹妹开始训练，我才知道自己到底有多不合适，”佩特拉继续说道。“很快，佩纳和我就开始在梦里促膝长谈。我们会聊一整晚，而且在醒来时还清楚记得我们所说过的话。那也是我第一次意识到她是多么的强大。”

佩特拉低垂双目。“理所当然，佩纳成为了伊玛尔的得意门生。她进步得越快，我们共同的梦境就变得越强大。没过多久，我们在梦里能做的就不只是聊天说话了。”

“她开始操纵梦境，改变位置或她的形状。我跟不上她的节奏，感觉像是自己头脑里的乘客。她的梦境逐渐变成我的噩梦。”佩特拉摇了摇头，仿佛要摒除不愉快的回忆。“我就是在那时放弃了训练，梦境随之停止。”

“我后来加入海盗军，找到了属于自己的位置，”佩特拉若有所思地说，“但我心里还是有点希望自己有完成灵巫的训练。那样的话，说不定我还能在某个梦境里找到佩纳。”她从铺路石间摘了一片小草，抛入了微风中。

沉思片刻后，佩特拉把注意力转向了伊莱娅。“所以，我的建议是至少试一试训练。如果行得通，你就会知道。如果行不通…”她拍了拍身边的榴弹发射器，“我们还有很多其他的工作可以给你。”

621450049.name: Adamantite
621450049.lore:
Surrounded. They hate her, but it's an empty hate, driven by an instinctual, quantum state. 

She knows, because that hate is a part of her too. 

She approaches them head on, presenting as wide of a target as she can, her pauldrons shining in a sea of undulating mouths. 

The nearest takes the bait, unable to ignore its hunger. 

That hunger is a part of her too. She empathizes as she turns slightly, and a dark, barbed appendage flicks past her cheek, causing sparks to chime off her armored shoulder. 

The Taken Thrall can't recover before her Roderic-C tears its approximation of a leg to pieces, dropping its writhing skull directly in line with her muzzle. 

Its death wail echoes in tandem with her sidearm, while its hunger for her lingers as its body shreds away at an atomic level. The shadows around her are equally starved. She knows, because she's starved too. 

Unlike them, she controls it. For every shadow around her, beckoning her to join them, her muzzle cracks. She slips, she ducks, and everywhere she sees an opening, her will hardens. She throws her bones, wrapped in unrelenting plasteel, into the fray. She puts bullets in conjured brainstems, facts dispersing feelings. 

Resolve got Sloane through Titan. Resolve will get her, and everyone still alive, through this. It's too late for Eris. It might be too late for Drifter, run off for the last time to who knows where, in the bowels of this living beast of a ship. 

She turns slowly, looking for targets. Detecting no sentient shadows, she keys a switch on her armored gauntlet.  

"Landing zone is clear. Keep the Dreadnaught patrols coming. We'll take it inch by inch if we have to."
621450049.lore_zh:
被包围了。他们恨她，但那是一种空洞的恨，由本能的量子状态所驱使。 

她很清楚，因为那份恨同样流淌在她的体内。 

她迎着他们而去，尽力展现出一个庞大的目标，肩甲在众多张合的嘴间熠熠生辉。 

最近的那个上了钩，无法遏制内心的饥渴。 

那份饥渴也是她的一部分。她带着同情微微侧身，一根黑色带刺触手从她脸旁掠过，在她的肩甲上擦出火花。 

傀儡怨魂还未来得及喘息，她的罗德里克-C就已将它的腿状物撕成碎片，令它扭曲的头颅直接对上了她的枪口。 

它的死亡哀嚎与她手枪的轰鸣交织在一起，而它对她的饥渴在身体于原子层面分解时仍旧存在。她周围的阴影同样饥肠辘辘。她知道，因为她也同样饥肠辘辘。 

与它们不同，她控制着饥渴。对于每个试图召唤她加入的阴影，她的枪口喷射着致命的子弹。她灵活地游走和低头，利用她发现的每一个缝隙，意志愈发坚定。她将骨头包裹在坚不可摧的塑钢之中，投身于战斗。她将子弹射入召唤显现的脑干，用事实驱散情感。 

正是这份决心，让斯隆熬过了土卫六。这份决心也将让她和所有仍然活着的人度过这场危机。对埃里斯来说太迟了。对深入这艘活着的巨兽船的腹地，不知所踪的浪客来说，或许也太迟了。 

她缓缓转身，搜寻着目标。没有检测到有意识的阴影，她按下了护甲臂铠上的一个按钮。  

“着陆区已扫清。尽管让无畏战舰的巡逻队过来吧。如果有必要，我们会一寸一寸地夺回这个地方。”

1835232052.name: Psychopomp
1835232052.lore:
It's the Psions who go first, miserable weedy things. Can't take the pressure, one of 'em told Olgurn before the end. The whole ship around them weighing them down, crushing the juice out of their brains. 

The rest of them last a little longer, daughters and sons of Torobatl with their heads made of rock already. Olgurn's grandma in the village wanted to die out in the sands. Let the wind scrape away her ossified features. That's how they did it back home. 

Day he joined up with the Skyburners, their recruiter gave him his obol, and he learned something new. 

"That's your death," she said. "Put it in your pocket and never forget it. The other Skyburners will take it when it's your time."  

"Now pick up your gun. That's your duty. Victory for the empire. For the emperor." 

Olgurn had to do the rites for Big Grusk all by himself. Had to cut his mangled armor open with a torch to get to his obol. Now it's just him, crawling through tunnels with alien chitin bolted to his armor and wormspore smeared wherever he can reach. Smelling like an acolyte. 

Last one alive means he's ranking officer. Means the Dreadnaught's his responsibility. 

So Olgurn puts on his stinking armor and he crawls through tunnels and he plants explosives and he makes sure he's at the minimum safe distance before he hits the trigger. He's a Skyburner. He said the oath. He doesn't get to give up. 

And when the relief shows up, Olgurn's gonna give them his report and his obol.
1835232052.lore_zh:
灵能士兵们是最先逝去的，那些可怜的孱弱东西。在终结前，有个灵能士兵向奥尔根坦言，他们无法承受那股压力。整个飞船仿佛一座巨山，压榨着他们的脑浆。 

其他人则坚持得更久一些，那些图罗巴特尔的子女，他们的头颅本就坚如磐石。奥尔根在村里的奶奶渴望在沙漠中死去，让风沙带走她那骨化的面容。那是他们在家乡的传统。 

他加入焚天者的那天，招募者给了他一枚死币，而他则学到了新的知识。 

“那即是你的死，”她说。“把它放进口袋里，永远不要遗忘。当你的那一刻来临时，其他焚天者会来取走它。”  

“现在拿起枪。履行你的职责。为了帝国，为了皇帝，去夺取胜利。” 

奥尔根不得不独自为大格鲁斯克进行仪式，不得不用割炬切开他破碎的护甲，从中取出死币。如今，他孤身一人，在隧道中爬行，外星甲壳紧紧贴合在他的护甲上，蠕虫孢子被涂抹到他能触及的每一处。他闻起来像是个仆从。 

身为最后一个存活者，他已成为最高级别军官。这意味着他要对无畏战舰负责任。 

于是，奥尔根穿上他那散发着恶臭的护甲，爬过隧道，安置炸药，并确保在按下引爆扳机前，自己处于安全距离之外。他是个焚天者，曾立下誓言。他不能放弃。 

当援军抵达时，奥尔根会呈上他的报告，以及他的死币。

奥尔根不得不独自为大格鲁斯克进行仪式，不得不用割炬切开他破碎的护甲，从中取出死币。如今，他孤身一人，在隧道中爬行，外星甲壳紧紧贴合在他的护甲上，蠕虫孢子被涂抹到他能触及的每一处。他闻起来像是个仆从。 

身为最后一个存活者，他已成为最高级别军官。这意味着他要对无畏战舰负责任。 

于是，奥尔根穿上他那散发着恶臭的护甲，爬过隧道，安置炸药，并确保在按下引爆扳机前，自己处于安全距离之外。他是个焚天者，曾立下誓言。他不能放弃。 

当援军抵达时，奥尔根会呈上他的报告，以及他的死币。

1541324871.name: Refusal of the Call
1541324871.lore:
You are Taken. Dark and nameless, shifting in the corners of the world. Unmade by your god. 

Oryx, the Lord of Shapes, cut you into your present form. Wielding Willbreaker, he broke you. 

To be Taken is to accept the knife, accept the pain, accept the sweet pang of a question that cannot be denied. 

Oryx, the Lord of Shapes, is dead. No will can replace the void of your own. 

What is left for you? Who are you without the commanding will? 

There is a new hand on the knife's hilt. It calls to you in the hollow chambers of your dying heart. 

The knife offers [new purpose]. 

Will you accept it?
1541324871.lore_zh:
你是傀儡，阴暗而无名，在世界的边缘徘徊游荡，被你的神解构得支离破碎。 

形态之主欧里克斯，将你塑成了如今的模样。他手持碎志者，击碎了你。 

成为傀儡，意味着承受刀刃，承受痛苦，承受那无法回避的问题带来的甜美折磨。 

形态之主欧里克斯，已经死了。没有意志能填补你内心的空虚。 

你还剩下了什么？失去了指挥意志的你又是谁？ 

刀柄之上出现了另一只手。它在你那即将死去的空洞心房中向你发出了呼唤。 

刀刃呈上了[新的使命]。 

你是否接受？

4147428506.lore:
Article: An Unexpected Light—SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST Advance Preview 

By Ken Yanagi, Arts and Culture Writer at the City Herald 

The Ghost Community Players customarily present their works in the Wei Ning Memorial Theater, an unassuming black box in the heart of the Last City. SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST: A TALE OF CROSSED LINES AND FORBIDDEN LIGHT, the newest work from Ghost playwright (now songwriter) Didi, is the latest to make its home in that same theater. An ambitious performance that falls short in some aspects but shines brightly in others, SATG begins its run this week, with tickets available on a very reasonable pay-what-you-can basis. 

SATG depends on some esoterica of the Ghost-Lightbearer relationship which the average audience member may not find familiar, but the savvy observer will find context clues to enlighten them. The show is staged in the round, with a minimalist but expressive aesthetic. Audiences should not expect expansive sets or practical effects, but the costuming suits the actors perfectly, and the acoustics of the space (and the sound technicians' hard work) ensure that not a moment of script and song is missed. The majority-Ghost cast performs in a larger-than-life fashion, a directorial choice doubtless made to compensate for a lack of recognizable Human body language. 

The result is a bombastic piece that has the feel of epic theatre or morality plays, rather than the tight, intimate drama that the script suggests it wants to be. However, the core of emotional truth in its actors and script alike left barely a dry eye in the theater, especially during Savathûn and Immaru's final star-crossed duet. 

SAVATHÛN AND THE GHOST runs for the next two months; regular casting substitutions are expected based on field missions. Four stars out of five—if you're at all interested in experimental theatre, Guardians, or Hive, then make time in your schedule, bring tissues, and turn off your heavier thoughts for the night. 

For ticket sales, please contact Pixie, Ghost of Ariadne Gris, via VanNet for inquiries.
4147428506.lore_zh:
文章：意外之光——《萨瓦图恩与机灵》前瞻 

圣城使者艺术与文化专栏撰稿人肯·柳著 

机灵社区剧团通常在韦宁纪念剧院上演他们的剧目。这座位于圣城心脏地带的低调黑匣子剧场，迎来了机灵剧作家（现为歌曲作家）迪迪的最新力作《萨瓦图恩与机灵：交错命运与禁忌之光》。这是一场充满野心的表演，尽管在某些方面稍显稚嫩，但是在其他方面却光芒四射。本周起，该剧以极为亲民的随意付费制面向观众开放。 

《萨瓦图恩与机灵》深植于机灵与负光者复杂关系的深厚土壤，对于普通观众而言或许稍显陌生，但那些敏锐的戏剧爱好者定能发掘出启发思考的背景线索。该剧采用圆形舞台设计，简约而不失表现力。观众或许无法期待宏大的布景或炫目的实物特效，但服饰与角色完美契合，而剧场的声学效果（以及音响团队的辛勤付出）更是确保了每一句台词、每一曲旋律都能清晰传入观众的耳中。以机灵为主的演员们通过夸张的表演方式，弥补了缺乏直观人类肢体语言的遗憾，而这显然是导演的精心安排。 

最终，这部作品更像是一部史诗剧或道德剧，而非剧本所暗示的紧凑而亲密的戏剧。然而，演员们和剧本中的真挚情感，几乎让剧场内的每一位观众都为之动容，尤其是萨瓦图恩与伊马鲁最后那命运交错的动人二重唱，更是令人泪眼婆娑。 

《萨瓦图恩与机灵》将在接下来的两个月里持续上演，根据现场演出的实际情况，预计会有常规的演员轮换。四星推荐（满分五星）——如果您对实验性戏剧、守护者或邪魔族感兴趣，不妨在您的日程中预留出时间，带上纸巾，抛开繁重的思绪，享受一个难忘的夜晚。 

如需购票，请通过VanNet联系阿里阿德涅·格瑞斯的机灵皮可茜进行咨询。

353884603.name: Alone as a god
353884603.flavor: I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me.
353884603.lore:
My imperial guard marched into the temple where the senate convened. They formed a protective circle from which I might bestow the gift of my address. 

"From this day forward, I shall take up all the empire in my embrace. For I am father of the empire, as I am father to all creation. I will suffer no tired institution nor petty bureaucrat to stand between me and my children. I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me." 

The imperial guard charged their rail guns in perfect unison.
353884603.lore_zh:
我的帝国守卫步入了议会召开的神庙。他们形成了一个保护圈以便我可以开始我的演讲。

“从今天开始，我会欣然接管帝国之土。我是帝国的主人，我是世间万物的主人。在我和我的子民之间，将不会再有令人生厌的组织和琐碎的官僚主义。每个谈论起我的人都激动到发抖，我就是至善爱神。”

帝国守卫以完美步调为磁道炮上了膛。

830651379.name: Chattering Bone
830651379.flavor: We have so much to discuss, o seeker mine.
830651379.lore:
Nadiya sipped her tea, calm and collected. Shinobu sat back, looking perplexed. "Really, the entire summer?"

The serpent that claimed to look like her mother sat across from the two of them, smiling broadly. "Why would I lie? I'm telling you, the whole summer you wore that dress. We had to tackle you to get the thing off of you, get you to bathe."

The serpent plucked the dainty cup from the white saucer and set it to her lips before continuing. "Your brother called you stinkbug for years. Until… you know."

Nadiya reached over and took the other Hunter's hand in her own. "It would lie because it's fulfilling your wish, Nobu."

Shinobu searched the serpent's face. Her mother just smiled again, all teeth and secrets. Shinobu felt tears at the corners of her eyes. Her voice was barely a whisper. "Okay. Now."

The burst from the pulse rifle was loud, and Nadiya pulled the trigger again and again and again.
830651379.lore_zh:
纳迪亚小口喝着茶，冷静又集中。忍野向后坐了回去，满脸困惑。“真的吗，整个夏天？”

声称看起来像她母亲的毒蛇坐在他们两人对面，大笑道：“我为什么要撒谎？我告诉你，整个夏天你都穿着那件衣服。我们不得不把你绊倒才能把那东西脱下来，让你洗个澡。

毒蛇从白色茶托上拿起精致的杯子，将杯子递到嘴边才继续说。“你的哥哥多年来一直叫你臭虫。直到……你知道的。”

纳迪亚伸出手，抓住另一名猎人的手。“它为了满足了你的愿望是会说谎的，野。”

忍野摸索着毒蛇的脸。她的母亲又笑了笑，吐露出所有的牙齿和秘密。忍野触碰到了她眼角流出的泪。她的声音几乎是在喃喃自语。“好了，够了。”

脉冲步枪的枪声响亮，纳迪亚不停地，不停地扣动着扳机。

4157371152.flavor: We have so much to discuss, o seeker mine.
4157371152.lore:
Nadiya sipped her tea, calm and collected. Shinobu sat back, looking perplexed. "Really, the entire summer?"

The serpent that claimed to look like her mother sat across from the two of them, smiling broadly. "Why would I lie? I'm telling you, the whole summer you wore that dress. We had to tackle you to get the thing off of you, get you to bathe."

The serpent plucked the dainty cup from the white saucer and set it to her lips before continuing. "Your brother called you stinkbug for years. Until… you know."

Nadiya reached over and took the other Hunter's hand in her own. "It would lie because it's fulfilling your wish, Nobu."

Shinobu searched the serpent's face. Her mother just smiled again, all teeth and secrets. Shinobu felt tears at the corners of her eyes. Her voice was barely a whisper. "Okay. Now."

The burst from the pulse rifle was loud, and Nadiya pulled the trigger again and again and again.
4157371152.lore_zh:
纳迪亚小口喝着茶，冷静又集中。忍野向后坐了回去，满脸困惑。“真的吗，整个夏天？”

声称看起来像她母亲的毒蛇坐在他们两人对面，大笑道：“我为什么要撒谎？我告诉你，整个夏天你都穿着那件衣服。我们不得不把你绊倒才能把那东西脱下来，让你洗个澡。

毒蛇从白色茶托上拿起精致的杯子，将杯子递到嘴边才继续说。“你的哥哥多年来一直叫你臭虫。直到……你知道的。”

纳迪亚伸出手，抓住另一名猎人的手。“它为了满足了你的愿望是会说谎的，野。”

忍野摸索着毒蛇的脸。她的母亲又笑了笑，吐露出所有的牙齿和秘密。忍野触碰到了她眼角流出的泪。她的声音几乎是在喃喃自语。“好了，够了。”

脉冲步枪的枪声响亮，纳迪亚不停地，不停地扣动着扳机。

2884908760.name: The Summoner
2884908760.flavor: Join the dance of fire and birth.
2884908760.source_zh: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼胜场
2884908760.lore:
She awaited signal lock, hands loosely bent around flight sticks, sun to her back. Trestin's sight sank into stupor and stretched far across the outshined lights of distant possibilities. Flanking starlight pushed her jumpship's shadow outward into space. It was what it was, and nothing more.

Mercury hung beneath, buried in a storm of solar wind like a dark pit enveloped by ripe flesh. She hadn't returned in years; previous iterations of Trials and constant exposure to the Crucible had sated her curiosities of quietus. None of that mattered anymore. Not after the Moon. It was over. Finality was coming.

Trestin's return was a pretense for preparation; a living funeral to find conclusion on one's own terms. She had begun to see the sense concealed in wanton dissociation, the seriousness underneath the dressings of the Menagerie, the truth in the word ringing through its halls. It was over. Time to make peace.

"Saint-14 is going to be watching us. No pressure." Sadhij twisted a faded purple ribbon through the plates of his gauntlet and flexed his fingers.

"No pressure at all." Trestin mouthed the words, barely producing a sound before Yara's voice cut into the chatter.

"Look alive team. We are the thin line drawn before the Darkness. We are Guardians. No holding back."

Thin. A line to be swallowed in scope. No holding back.

Burning Shrine… Lock… Transmat firing…
2884908760.lore_zh:
她等待着信号锁定，双手放松地放在飞行杆上，太阳晒着她的后背。特雷斯廷的视线陷入恍惚，远远延伸到遥远的可能性的耀眼光芒之中。侧边的星光把她跃迁飞船的影子向外推入太空。就是这样，仅此而已。

水星垂在下方，埋在太阳风的风暴中，就像被腐烂的尸骨包围的黑坑一样。她已经很多年没回来了，之前的试炼迭代和不断接触熔炉竞技场，已经让她对寂灭逐渐失去了好奇心。那些事再也不重要。自从月球的事之后，再也不重要。已经结束了。终局即将到来。

特雷斯廷的回归是准备的一个借口，以自己的方式得出结论的生者葬礼。她已经开始看到在狂放的解体中隐藏着的知觉，在奇珍异兽园装扮下的严肃性，言语中的真相在大厅中响起。已经结束了。该回归平静。

“圣人14号会看着我们。不要有压力。”萨迪在他手套上缠绕着一条褪了色的紫色丝带，弯了弯手指。

“完全没有压力。”特雷斯廷说出这些话，在雅拉的声音进入聊天频道之前几乎没有发出声音。

“准备好，队员们。我们是暗影之前最后的防线。我们是守护者。绝不退缩。”

细线。将被吞噬的一道线。绝不退缩。

燃烧祭坛…锁定…传送发射…

3790632261.name: The Scholar
3790632261.flavor: You can't pull an all-nighter when the sun never sets.
3790632261.source: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
3790632261.source_zh: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。
3790632261.lore:
Sola could feel the Light twisting from her prey's core. She jerked her hand, which dripped with hungering power, and plucked at something deeper. Sola worked her power between her prey's ribs and felt them give way. She dug in, in spite of the pleas, feeling for a grip to hoist their Light to the surface and find what hid underneath.

"So…" Sola's intent bit deeper, malleable claws that flexed against her prey's Light. They probed through blood and muscle to an umbral center. "…it's within you too."

Her prey's scream was silenced as a shot rang out from over Sola's shoulder. It struck her opponent square in the temple, and the body collapsed. Sola's perverse Light dissipated.

"What the hell was that?" Crimiq-5 lashed into her ear.

Before she could answer, Saint-14's voice burst through the arena's audio channel. "ENOUGH!"

Sola took a step back. A transmat deployment fired behind her. She turned, perplexed at the massive armored figure that now stood before her.

"I do not know what strange Light you are weaving, Warlock, but this is too far."

"I didn't realize Trials had gone soft."

"No… your victory stands. This is not the Crucible. There is no punishment, but I will not allow needless torture of a Guardian."

"Isn't Guardian-on-Guardian violence the point? Strength through death."

"You are no Guardian." Saint turned away from Sola and looked to Crimiq-5 as he approached. "I hope you know what company you keep."

Crimiq-5 slung his rifle and pierced Sola's visor with livid eyes. He knelt and extended a hand to the broken Guardian's Ghost. "I'm not a party to this. Not my style."

Crimiq's eyes scanned the grotesque scene. "I'm sorry I wasn't faster."

Sola could feel Saint-14's Light eclipse her own. His hand clenched into a fist. She stifled as much of her temper as she could muster.

"Fine. You're all as good as dead anyway. Good luck with your war."

Sola turned to leave.

Saint raised his hand to a swatch mark on his helm. "Geppetto, recall me and get these fighters back on their feet. This match is over."
3790632261.lore_zh:
索拉可以感觉到她猎物核心中扭曲的光能。她抽了一下手，手上充满着饥渴的力量，然后伸向更深处。索拉在猎物的肋骨之间发挥着力量，感到它们的退让。尽管猎物哀求不已，她还是挖了进去，想要握住他们的光能，举到表面，然后找出隐藏在下面的东西。

“那么……”索拉的意图更深，延展的爪子紧贴着猎物的光能。爪子伸到血液和肌肉中，伸到黑暗的中心。“……也在你里面。”

她的猎物尖叫声戛然而止，一发子弹飞过索拉的肩膀。子弹正正撞到她的对手身上，然后尸体崩溃了。索拉反常的光能消散了。

“你刚才是在干什么？”克里米克5号猛然冲到她耳边怒吼。

在她回答之前，圣人14号的声音突然在竞技场的语音频道中插入进来。“够了！”

索拉后退了一步。一个传送部署在她身后启动。她转过身，对站在她面前的巨大装甲感到困惑。

“我不知道你用的是什么奇怪的光能，术士，但这已经过火了。”

“我不知道试练会变得如此软弱。”

“不…你的胜利毋庸置疑。但这不是熔炉竞技场。没有处罚，但我不允许不必要的折磨一位守护者。”

“守护者对决的暴力不正是关键吗？通过死亡获取的力量。”

“你不是守护者。”圣人转身背对索拉，看着靠近的克里米克5号。“我希望你了解你的同伴。”

克里米克5号垂下步枪，生气的目光刺穿了索拉的面罩。他跪下，向破损的守护者机灵伸出手。“我不会这样，这不是我的风格。”

克里米克的眼睛扫视着这怪诞的场面。“很抱歉我还是太慢了。”

索拉可以感觉到圣人14号的光能让自己的光能黯然失色。他的手紧握成拳。她竭尽全力集聚封堵着怒火。

“好吧，你们反正都已经死定了，祝你们的战争好运。”

索拉转身离开。

圣人举起手，伸向头盔上的一块布料印记。“盖比特，召回我，让这些战士都站起来。这场比赛结束了。”

4089030727.name: Sola's Scar
4089030727.source: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
4089030727.source_zh: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。
4089030727.lore:
Her wait was nearly over—Trestin could feel it as she climbed Cadmus Ridge.

Sunlight, amplified by snow, pierced her eyes now; she had ascended above the cloud line. She tilted her gaze down, focusing on the crags immediately before her. Her muscles cramped as she reached up for the next ledge. 

No holding back now. 

Over the radio, Lord Saladin's voice grew staticky: "Cabal incursion… Vex… up ahead." Without a word, Trestin's Ghost switched it off. There were others nearby to carry out the Iron Lord's orders. He wouldn't miss them. 

She doubted anyone would—her ex-teammates least of all. She had betrayed them, or so Sadhij had screamed: "We're supposed to be the thin line drawn before the Darkness, you traitor!" 

|| Thin indeed. So why not step over it? ||

Because they didn't have it in them. She checked. Cracked them both open and dug deep, just to be extra sure. But it wasn't there. That hunger, immense and buried, like the ocean under Europa's glacial crust. A riptide, undetectable from the surface, yet unrelenting in its pull. She never meant to betray anyone. She just wanted release. 

|| Soon, you will have it. Soon, you will be freed. ||

Muscles shaking with exhaustion, she threw her hand up and, at last, grasped snow. She had reached the top. 

For a moment, she laid on the embankment, chest heaving. When her vision cleared, she gasped. There it was, black-stone stark against the gleaming white. It seemed to pulse in time with her heart. Attuning to the desire churning within. 

From the back of her mind came a warm, familiar voice: "You're a goober." Yara. Suddenly, a different hunger bloomed in her, small and keening. Was it… loneliness? 

|| It is weakness. What lies before you is power.|| 

The pulsing intensified. She could feel the blood pumping through her veins as she stepped towards the obelisk, hand outstretched. She had never been so close—

 "Not one more step." A new voice called out to Trestin. Only this one was not in her head. She turned to find a Warlock standing a few yards away, sword drawn. "You must be Trestin. I am Aunor. I encourage you to come with me. Quietly." 

Trestin looked at her, then dove for the obelisk. 

The last thing she felt was steel. Pure, cold steel piercing through her heart.
4089030727.lore_zh:
她的等待终于快有回报——特雷斯廷在攀上卡德摩斯城脊的时候就有所察觉。

阳光在周围雪的折射下显得特别刺眼。她已经登上了最高处，往下面的峭壁上看，望着那个正在攀爬的身影。当她准备寻找下一处落脚点的时候，突然肌肉开始痉挛起来。

现在已经没有退路。

无线电里传来领主萨拉丁平静的声音：“卡巴尔族入侵...Vex...就在前方。”特雷斯廷的机灵一言不发地关掉了无线电。周围有其他人在接收钢铁领主的命令，这种事情他可不会错过。

这种事情根本不会有人会弄错——她的那些前同僚们尤甚。她背叛了他们，背叛了自己的使命。萨迪曾经对她喊：“你这个叛徒，我们本该是抗击黑暗的第一线！”

||是啊，既然是第一线。那么为什么不往前走几步，跨过去看看呢？||

因为他们没那个胆子，她检查过。她把那些人的身体切开，把胆拿出来看了看，确认了这一点。但是她的欲望并没有获得满足，那种渴求，巨大而深沉，就像埋藏在木卫二冰川和地壳下的海洋。表面上看不到一丝涟漪，却暗流涌动。她从未想过要背叛任何人，只是想得到释放。

||快了，很快你就会拥有它。很快，你就能彻底自由。||

肌肉因极度疲惫而颤抖着，她把手举了起来，摸到了一把雪，原来她已经到达了山顶。

她躺在悬崖边缘歇息了一会儿，胸口上下起伏，不断地喘着粗气。当她的视线不再模糊，她长舒了一口气。黑色的尖石与白雪形成鲜明的对比。阳光在白雪上闪烁，似乎与她的呼吸同步，也顺应着她内心的欲望。

从她的脑海中传来一个温暖而又熟悉的声音：“你这个蠢货。”那是雅拉的声音。突然，她的内心里又绽放出一种小小的渴望，微小而尖锐。那是...寂寞吗？

||在内心中的是弱点。而摆在你面前的是力量。|| 

脉搏开始抽动，她能感觉到随着自己离方尖碑越来越近，血液在血管里也不断加速奔涌。她从未如此接近——

 “别再往前走了”。一个陌生的声音叫住了特雷斯廷。这个声音不是从她脑子里传出来的。她转过身，发现一位术士就站在不远处，剑已出鞘，握在手中。“你就是特雷斯廷吧。我是阿诺尔，我建议你老老实实跟我走，不要耍花样。”

特雷斯廷望了望她，然后向方尖碑奔了过去。

在她失去知觉之前，感受到的只有纯粹、冰冷的钢铁刺穿心脏的痛。

3459607931.name: Sola's Scar
3459607931.lore:
Her wait was nearly over—Trestin could feel it as she climbed Cadmus Ridge.

Sunlight, amplified by snow, pierced her eyes now; she had ascended above the cloud line. She tilted her gaze down, focusing on the crags immediately before her. Her muscles cramped as she reached up for the next ledge. 

No holding back now. 

Over the radio, Lord Saladin's voice grew staticky: "Cabal incursion… Vex… up ahead." Without a word, Trestin's Ghost switched it off. There were others nearby to carry out the Iron Lord's orders. He wouldn't miss them. 

She doubted anyone would—her ex-teammates least of all. She had betrayed them, or so Sadhij had screamed: "We're supposed to be the thin line drawn before the Darkness, you traitor!" 

|| Thin indeed. So why not step over it? ||

Because they didn't have it in them. She checked. Cracked them both open and dug deep, just to be extra sure. But it wasn't there. That hunger, immense and buried, like the ocean under Europa's glacial crust. A riptide, undetectable from the surface, yet unrelenting in its pull. She never meant to betray anyone. She just wanted release. 

|| Soon, you will have it. Soon, you will be freed. ||

Muscles shaking with exhaustion, she threw her hand up and, at last, grasped snow. She had reached the top. 

For a moment, she laid on the embankment, chest heaving. When her vision cleared, she gasped. There it was, black-stone stark against the gleaming white. It seemed to pulse in time with her heart. Attuning to the desire churning within. 

From the back of her mind came a warm, familiar voice: "You're a goober." Yara. Suddenly, a different hunger bloomed in her, small and keening. Was it… loneliness? 

|| It is weakness. What lies before you is power.|| 

The pulsing intensified. She could feel the blood pumping through her veins as she stepped towards the obelisk, hand outstretched. She had never been so close—

 "Not one more step." A new voice called out to Trestin. Only this one was not in her head. She turned to find a Warlock standing a few yards away, sword drawn. "You must be Trestin. I am Aunor. I encourage you to come with me. Quietly." 

Trestin looked at her, then dove for the obelisk. 

The last thing she felt was steel. Pure, cold steel piercing through her heart.

2499834165.lore:
It was Crimiq-5's honor to hold the flank. Sun at his back, there was no better position to provide overwatch in the Burning Shrine. He was the watchtower, and none would escape his vigil. Curt radio chatter signaled his fireteam's advance as he called out enemy maneuvers. Crimiq-5 watched tense bursts of movement and exchanges of fire as his team jockeyed for position.

Sola had ripped through their previous opponents with off-putting ferocity, and Crimiq was ready for this to be their last match of the day. He looked over her through his scope. Sola's silhouette marinated in an eerie shimmer that distorted the air as she moved. He stilled his body and sent a shot over her head to force an opponent back into cover.

"Aiming a little close." Sola sent a glare over her shoulder into the sun.

Crimiq-5 moved his scope off her. "Duck."

His earpiece crackled. Katake's voice drilled into his head. "THUNDERCRASH… Help!"

Katake's voice screeched out of existence as the lightning overtook him and Saint bellowed. Crimiq saw a bright flash burst from the hallway leading toward C-point.

"Be advised, I'm leaving the perch. Moving to trade for Katake."

He slid into position and snapped his trusted long rifle down lane. His sights found an unlucky Titan, lightning still crackling from their armor.

"Fate Cries Foul for you, brother." The shot hit squarely, and the Titan dropped. "Sorry I couldn't save you Katake. Next time."
2499834165.lore_zh:
守住侧翼是克里米克5号的荣耀。太阳在身后，在燃烧祭坛中没有更好的监视位置了。他就是瞭望塔，没人能逃脱他警觉的目光。当他喊出敌人的机动时，简要电台通讯声发出信号，指挥着他的火力战队前进。克里米克5号观察着紧张的移动和交火，他的团队在奋力争夺位置。

索拉用令人生厌的方式残忍击败了先前的对手，克里米克已准备好将其作为当天的最后一场比赛。他通过枪镜看着她。索拉的身影在出现令人毛骨悚然的微光中，移动时扭曲了空气。他稳住自己的身体，越过她的头顶开了一枪，迫使对手回身掩护。

“瞄准近点。”索拉向身后的太阳瞥了一眼。

克里米克5号的准镜离开了她。“闪避。”

他的耳机劈啪作响。卡塔克的声音钻进他的脑袋里。“雷霆冲击…帮忙！”

卡塔克声音从雷声中消失了，闪电占据了他，圣人也开始吼叫。克里米克看到一道明亮的闪光从伸向C点的廊道中爆发出来。

“小心，我要离开高点了。前去帮卡塔克换掉对手。”

他滑进位置，然后将他信赖的长枪瞄准下路。他的视野中发现一个不走运的泰坦，他的护甲中仍然不断有闪电爆裂。

“屈枉天命，兄弟。”射击正中目标，那位泰坦倒下。“抱歉我救不到你，卡特克。下次吧。”

2776092652.lore:
"You don't have to do this, if you don't want to," Ikora said. "I'd understand." 

From the other side of the library, Aunor scowled. She was perhaps the most diligent of the Hidden, having dedicated herself to the unpleasant task of hunting down tainted Guardians. But that was precisely what worried Ikora. Each time they met, she seemed a little gaunter than before. A little testier. Was this crusade beginning to take a toll? Was it a mistake to give her another assignment instead of a vacation? 

"I stand by my promise," Aunor snapped before transmatting out. 

That had not alleviated Ikora's concerns one iota . She let out a sigh and rubbed her temples. 

She couldn't dwell on it for long, however. The air crackled again. When Ikora opened her eyes, Saint was standing exactly where Aunor had been, moments ago. "Ikora Rey, I am sorry to come unannou—"

"How did you get in here?" she blurted. No one but the Hidden knew where her private library was. Or so she had thought. 

The Exo stared at her, confused. "I—I transmatted," he said simply. He tried again. "I am sorry, but I must speak with you." 

"No, I'm the one who should apologize. Please, sit." She hurried to clear the books piled around a pair of armchairs. "I got your message. It's unfortunate this has happened a second time." 

Saint sat, his massive frame dwarfing  the chair. "Unfortunate, yes. Disturbing too. I fear…" He paused, looking away. Out the window, the afternoon sun had turned golden and begun sinking in the sky. "In battle, I know what to do. There are no doubts. The Trials was the same. But now, I do not know." 

"I understand. Sometimes, it feels like these incidents are designed to make us doubt everything, even our own abilities." Ikora sat beside him. "But there's no one I'd trust more to helm the Trials at a time like this." 

"Not even the man they are named for?" Saint let out a sad laugh. "He does not wish to, in any case. I ask and right away, he says he is too busy to care. Told me to shut them down, if I was so tired." 

"Well, he is busy. He's almost acting as a third Vanguard with this whole Cabal conflict.  Perhaps after we come to terms  with Caiatl…"

"You misunderstand. I am glad he is busy. Busy is good. It distracts him from his loss. But he is still…"

"Different?" 

"No. Yes, but more than that." He shook his head in frustration. "When I told him about the incident, I thought he would worry, like me. Instead, he tells me to take notes next time. Said the data would be useful," he spat in disgust. 

Ikora looked at Saint, expecting him to say more. When he didn't, she sat back in her seat, thinking. She wasn't exactly surprised. Osiris was an experimentalist , after all, and not a particularly sensitive one. And though this comment was certainly more callous than usual, she didn't understand Saint's concern. He seemed agitated, almost like he was angry at Osiris…

"That must've been upsetting to hear, after what you went through," she began slowly. Saint looked away, confirming her theory. "But I think his heart's in the right place. We know so little about the Darkness. More data would indeed be very useful." 

Saint said nothing. The light through the window splashed orange across his helm. 

"But," she pressed on, "We shouldn't endanger Guardians to get it. However Osiris feels about them now, the Trials started as a way to train fireteams, and they're going to stay that way." She stood, placing a hand on the Exo's shoulder. "I swear to you." 

He nodded, eyes still fixed on the horizon. "Good."
2776092652.lore_zh:
艾可拉“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

在图书馆的另一头，阿诺尔在低头沉吟着什么。她也许是隐秘者中最勤奋的一员，无私地投身于猎杀那些被污染的守护者。但这也恰恰是艾可拉担心的地方。每次他们碰面的时候，她都会显得更加憔悴，也更加凶狠。是这样的战斗开始对她造成伤害了吗？是不是该给她放个假，而不是再次让她出任务呢？

“我会坚守我的承诺”，阿诺尔在传送出去之前斩钉截铁地说道。

艾可拉对她的担忧并没有一丝一毫的减少，只轻轻叹了一口，闭上眼，用手揉了揉太阳穴。

对她来说，没有多少时间可以用来纠结。空气中再次噼啪作响，等艾可拉睁开眼，圣人就站在刚刚阿诺尔消失的位置。“艾可拉·蕾伊，抱歉没有提前知会你...”

她大声喊到：“你是怎么进来的”？除了隐秘者，没人知道她的死人图书馆的位置。至少她一直是这么认为的。

那个Exo略显疑惑地盯着她看。“我，我是传送来的”，他直接了当的说到：“我很抱歉，不过我现在必须跟你谈谈。”

“不，是我要向你道歉，真是失礼了。请坐吧。”她赶紧清理座位周围堆放的书籍。“我收到你的消息了，再次发生这样的事情我很遗憾。”

圣人坐了下去，他庞大的身躯让椅子显得有些可怜。“确实有些不幸，恐怕也让人有些不安...”他话说到一半停了下来，脸却转向另外一侧。窗外，午后的太阳已经变成了金色，开始向天边缓缓下沉。“无论是在战斗中还是在试炼里，我都知道自己应该做什么，也不会有任何犹豫。但是现在，我不知道了。”

“我懂这种感觉。有时候，就感觉这一切都是设计好的，让我们去怀疑一切，甚至怀疑自己的能力。”艾可拉走上前去，坐在他的身边。“但是对于试炼的主持者，没人比你更值得信任了。”

“那位让试炼冠上自己名字的人呢？”圣人笑了起来，笑声中充满了苦涩。“他不愿意的，只要我问，他就会说自己太忙顾不上。然后跟我说如果自己觉得折腾就把试炼彻底取消掉。”

“是啊，他是很忙。他现在简直就像是跟卡巴尔族交火的第三先锋军。也许我们跟查厄托达成协议之后...”

“我不是这个意思。他能忙一些我也很欣慰，有事做总是好的，能分散他的注意力，让他不那么痛苦。但是他还是...”

“这有什么区别？”

“没有。不过比这更重要的是。”他沮丧的摇摇头，说：“当我告诉他这件事的时候，我以为他会跟我一样有些担心。没想到他根本没有，还让我下次一定要做好记录，说什么这些数据以后会有用。”他略显厌恶地吐槽道。

艾可拉看着圣人，等待他继续说下去，但是他却彻底沉默了下来。见状，她便靠在自己的椅背上，思索起来。她倒是对此不太惊讶。奥斯里斯毕竟是个搞实验的，而且不是个多愁善感的人。在这种背景下，说出这样冷酷的话语固然比平时更无情，但圣人的担忧让她有些摸不着头脑。他似乎很激动，在生奥斯里斯的气...

“我明白，在你经历过那些之后，听到些话确实有些难受”，她耐心地说道。圣人移开目光，这也证实了她的猜想，随即补充到：“不过我相信他心里是怀着好意的。我们对黑暗的了解并不深，多采集一些数据确实很有用。”

圣人一言不发，窗外的阳光照射在他的头盔上，反射出橙色的光。

“但是”，她接着说：“我们不能因为要数据就伤害那些守护者。不管奥斯里斯对他们怀着怎样的态度，试炼的目的是为了选拔火力战队，我们必须保持纯粹。”她站了起来，用一只手搭在Exo的肩膀上说到：“这点我向你保证。”

他点了点头，依然远眺着地平线。“那就好。”

719493058.name: Igneous Hammer
719493058.lore:
"You don't have to do this, if you don't want to," Ikora said. "I'd understand." 

From the other side of the library, Aunor scowled. She was perhaps the most diligent of the Hidden, having dedicated herself to the unpleasant task of hunting down tainted Guardians. But that was precisely what worried Ikora. Each time they met, she seemed a little gaunter than before. A little testier. Was this crusade beginning to take a toll? Was it a mistake to give her another assignment instead of a vacation? 

"I stand by my promise," Aunor snapped before transmatting out. 

That had not alleviated Ikora's concerns one iota . She let out a sigh and rubbed her temples. 

She couldn't dwell on it for long, however. The air crackled again. When Ikora opened her eyes, Saint was standing exactly where Aunor had been, moments ago. "Ikora Rey, I am sorry to come unannou—"

"How did you get in here?" she blurted. No one but the Hidden knew where her private library was. Or so she had thought. 

The Exo stared at her, confused. "I—I transmatted," he said simply. He tried again. "I am sorry, but I must speak with you." 

"No, I'm the one who should apologize. Please, sit." She hurried to clear the books piled around a pair of armchairs. "I got your message. It's unfortunate this has happened a second time." 

Saint sat, his massive frame dwarfing  the chair. "Unfortunate, yes. Disturbing too. I fear…" He paused, looking away. Out the window, the afternoon sun had turned golden and begun sinking in the sky. "In battle, I know what to do. There are no doubts. The Trials was the same. But now, I do not know." 

"I understand. Sometimes, it feels like these incidents are designed to make us doubt everything, even our own abilities." Ikora sat beside him. "But there's no one I'd trust more to helm the Trials at a time like this." 

"Not even the man they are named for?" Saint let out a sad laugh. "He does not wish to, in any case. I ask and right away, he says he is too busy to care. Told me to shut them down, if I was so tired." 

"Well, he is busy. He's almost acting as a third Vanguard with this whole Cabal conflict.  Perhaps after we come to terms  with Caiatl…"

"You misunderstand. I am glad he is busy. Busy is good. It distracts him from his loss. But he is still…"

"Different?" 

"No. Yes, but more than that." He shook his head in frustration. "When I told him about the incident, I thought he would worry, like me. Instead, he tells me to take notes next time. Said the data would be useful," he spat in disgust. 

Ikora looked at Saint, expecting him to say more. When he didn't, she sat back in her seat, thinking. She wasn't exactly surprised. Osiris was an experimentalist , after all, and not a particularly sensitive one. And though this comment was certainly more callous than usual, she didn't understand Saint's concern. He seemed agitated, almost like he was angry at Osiris…

"That must've been upsetting to hear, after what you went through," she began slowly. Saint looked away, confirming her theory. "But I think his heart's in the right place. We know so little about the Darkness. More data would indeed be very useful." 

Saint said nothing. The light through the window splashed orange across his helm. 

"But," she pressed on, "We shouldn't endanger Guardians to get it. However Osiris feels about them now, the Trials started as a way to train fireteams, and they're going to stay that way." She stood, placing a hand on the Exo's shoulder. "I swear to you." 

He nodded, eyes still fixed on the horizon. "Good."
719493058.lore_zh:
艾可拉“你其实不必这么做，如果你不愿意”，艾可拉顿了一顿，继续说到：“我能理解”。

在图书馆的另一头，阿诺尔在低头沉吟着什么。她也许是隐秘者中最勤奋的一员，无私地投身于猎杀那些被污染的守护者。但这也恰恰是艾可拉担心的地方。每次他们碰面的时候，她都会显得更加憔悴，也更加凶狠。是这样的战斗开始对她造成伤害了吗？是不是该给她放个假，而不是再次让她出任务呢？

“我会坚守我的承诺”，阿诺尔在传送出去之前斩钉截铁地说道。

艾可拉对她的担忧并没有一丝一毫的减少，只轻轻叹了一口，闭上眼，用手揉了揉太阳穴。

对她来说，没有多少时间可以用来纠结。空气中再次噼啪作响，等艾可拉睁开眼，圣人就站在刚刚阿诺尔消失的位置。“艾可拉·蕾伊，抱歉没有提前知会你...”

她大声喊到：“你是怎么进来的”？除了隐秘者，没人知道她的死人图书馆的位置。至少她一直是这么认为的。

那个Exo略显疑惑地盯着她看。“我，我是传送来的”，他直接了当的说到：“我很抱歉，不过我现在必须跟你谈谈。”

“不，是我要向你道歉，真是失礼了。请坐吧。”她赶紧清理座位周围堆放的书籍。“我收到你的消息了，再次发生这样的事情我很遗憾。”

圣人坐了下去，他庞大的身躯让椅子显得有些可怜。“确实有些不幸，恐怕也让人有些不安...”他话说到一半停了下来，脸却转向另外一侧。窗外，午后的太阳已经变成了金色，开始向天边缓缓下沉。“无论是在战斗中还是在试炼里，我都知道自己应该做什么，也不会有任何犹豫。但是现在，我不知道了。”

“我懂这种感觉。有时候，就感觉这一切都是设计好的，让我们去怀疑一切，甚至怀疑自己的能力。”艾可拉走上前去，坐在他的身边。“但是对于试炼的主持者，没人比你更值得信任了。”

“那位让试炼冠上自己名字的人呢？”圣人笑了起来，笑声中充满了苦涩。“他不愿意的，只要我问，他就会说自己太忙顾不上。然后跟我说如果自己觉得折腾就把试炼彻底取消掉。”

“是啊，他是很忙。他现在简直就像是跟卡巴尔族交火的第三先锋军。也许我们跟查厄托达成协议之后...”

“我不是这个意思。他能忙一些我也很欣慰，有事做总是好的，能分散他的注意力，让他不那么痛苦。但是他还是...”

“这有什么区别？”

3747667917.lore:
//NS66CE _LOG-C //VENUS-L2 -GEOSYNC//

A powerless Warsat drifts lifelessly through the void of space, traversing the brilliant yellow-green silhouette of Venus.

From the dimly lit cockpit of an NS66 Cloud Errant jumpship in geosynchronous orbit, Venus looks like an unblinking eye staring up from the dark of space, and the Warsat an unwelcome grain of sand within it. A Ghost reduced to little more than a bare sphere of metal, deprived of a shell, hovers in the corner of the cockpit, watching the Warsat track its path across lonely Venus.

"There are no sanctioned Vanguard operations on Venus at present," the Ghost clarifies, pivoting its cold blue eye up to its Guardian. "Why do you think he's down there?"

The Warlock Shayura reclines against her seat, the old leather creaking. Her attention is not on her Ghost, but rather the Human skull sitting in the middle of her command console. Its hollow eye sockets stare back at her.

"It hardly matters why he's there," Shayura indicates listlessly as she examines the skull's cheekbones. Her fingers graze the microfractures—an artifact of Shotgun pellet impact. "All that matters is we find him."

Shayura's Ghost looks away from her and focuses on Venus's soft glow in the dark.

"When will you be returning to Earth?" he asks.

Shayura doesn't vocalize a response, but instead blinks and reorients her glowing-eyed stare on the Ghost. It beeps softly, reconsidering the question.

"Will you?" the Ghost still wonders.

"No," Shayura answers flatly. "There is nothing to go back to. Everyone has either abandoned me or betrayed me. All I have left is the Traveler. And I do not need to be in the City to feel the Light." As she says that, Shayura lifts her hand and calls up a rolling curtain of flame from her palm.

"Praxic Fire guides me," Shayura says with the blaze reflecting in her eyes.

//NS66CE_LOG-D// VENUS-IS -IA //

"You see? Still protected. Valuable."

Hurrying up a shallow set of rubble-strewn steps, a short Eliksni bearing the crest of the House of Light pauses, gazing back at the chrome-armored Guardian moving up the steps behind him. The Eliksni looks the Guardian up and down, then motions to the stark silhouette of a gray concrete-block building rising up from the Venusian overgrowth.

"This ain't the academy proper," the Guardian says on ascent, watching the hazy sky for signs of danger. Moisture clings in glistening beads to his reflective mask; his dark hood shields him from the rest of the elements. "The hell was this place?"

The Eliksni tilts his head to the side, four eyes blinking independently from one another. "Not Human, don't know. But machine inside."

"Why aren't your people bringing it back? Don't you folks get promotions for finding good salvage or something?" the Guardian asks, gesturing to the crumbling building.

The Eliksni once again tilts his head, expression opaque. "You listen to the Spider's sneak-words too eagerly. Come, we have a long walk to—" The Eliksni's words are cut off, garbled in a wet scream as he is perforated by a barrage of Submachine Gun fire.

The Guardian turns, cloak swirling behind him and Hand Cannon at the ready. But it isn't Vex or Fallen descending from the high cliffs—it's a Guardian in black and gold armor gliding to the ground, smoke issuing from the muzzle of her SMG. Shayura's boots lightly touch the leaf-strewn plaza, her eyeless mask fixed on the chrome-clad Hunter.

"He wasn't a combatant!" the Hunter shouts.

Shayura slowly approaches the Guardian. "Did you find him within the hem of Eramis's skirt? Or did you swear yourself to the Darkness after her passing?"

The Hunter backs away, up the stairs, Hand Cannon trained on Shayura. He recognizes her armor for what it is—a reward of the Trials. "I know you…" His voice quavers. "You shouldn't be here. When did the Vanguard let you out?"

"They didn't. I let myself out since they were too busy opening the gates for our enemies," Shayura indicates, motioning with the barrel of her SMG to the dead Eliksni. "But, you know why I'm here ."

"I know you're a few rounds short of a full clip," the Guardian quips back, making a flippant gesture with his Hand Cannon. In that moment of distraction, Shayura shoots him six times in two short bursts.

The Guardian collapses, his gun tumbling down the steps. A moment later, his Ghost materializes, shell flared in anger. "What are you doing?! We—" 

Shayura moves like a lightning bolt, materializing beside the Ghost with an upward flourish of a sword of raw Praxic Fire. The Ghost looses a howling scream of horror as he shatters into a flurry of glittering pieces.

Crumpled on the stairs, the Hunter coughs, his throat damp with blood. Shayura pulls her attention away from the shattered Ghost, training her SMG down at her quarry. "Traitor," she says in a shaky, gasping breath fueled by adrenaline.

The Hunter laughs, gagging on his own blood as he does. "You're no better than the Dredgen ," he says, in pain. Then, even quieter, "…or Malphur ."

"I killed an agent of the Darkness," Shayura says, and the Hunter has no rebuttal this time. He is still.

Bile rises in the back of Shayura's throat.

"They come in many forms."
3747667917.lore_zh:
//NS66CE _日志-C//金星-L2 -地理同步//

一颗用尽能量的战争卫星在虚无的太空中毫无生气地漂流着，划过金星灿烂的黄绿色轮廓。

从这艘位于地理同步轨道上的NS66长空游侠跃迁飞船的昏暗驾驶舱里看去，金星像是一只永远不眨的眼睛，在黑暗的太空中注视着一切，而那颗战争卫星则像是它眼里的一颗碍事的沙子。一只看起来就像是一个光秃秃的金属球的无壳机灵悬浮在驾驶舱的角落里，注视着那颗战争卫星孤独地掠过金星。

“目前金星上没有经授权的先锋行动，”这只机灵说道，将它那只冷漠的蓝眼转向自己的守护者。“你觉得他在下面干什么？”

术士沙玉拉靠在她的座位上，把老旧的皮革压得吱吱作响。她的注意力没在机灵上；而是盯着摆在指挥台中央的一颗人类头骨。那对空洞的眼窝也死死地回望着她。

“他干什么都无所谓，”沙玉拉检视着头骨的颧骨部分，没精打采地说道。她的手指摸到了一些微小的裂纹——霰弹枪弹丸撞击的产物。“我们只要找到他就行了。”

沙玉拉的机灵将目光从她身上转开，专心注视着金星在黑暗中发出的柔和光芒。

“你什么时候回地球？”他问道。

沙玉拉没有发声，只是眨眨眼，用她那双发光的眼睛盯着机灵。它轻轻地发出了哔哔声，重新思考这个问题。

“你会回去吗？”机灵最后问道。

“不，”沙玉拉断然答道。“没有回去的意义。所有人不是抛弃了我，就是背叛了我。我只剩下旅行者了。我不需要待在圣城里也能感受到光能。”她一边说着，一边举手在掌心中央唤出了一团火焰。

“英勇之火指引着我，”沙玉拉说道，让那团火焰映照在了她的眼眸中。

//NS66CE_日志-D//金星-IS -IA //

“看到了？还被保护着。有价值。”

一名佩戴着光能氏族纹章的矮个子埃里克斯尼族匆匆走上一组浅浅的、布满碎石的台阶，然后停了下来，回头望了望那名身着镀铬护甲，正在攀登阶梯的守护者。这名埃里克斯尼族打量了一下守护者，然后指向了一座从金星丛林中拔地而起的灰色混凝土建筑的鲜明轮廓。

“这不是学院的地盘，”守护者说道，继续攀登着台阶。他望向朦胧的天空，留意着危险的迹象。空气中的水分化为水珠，凝结在他的反光面罩上；而他深色的兜帽为他挡住了其他的元素。“这是什么地方？”

埃里克斯尼族把头偏向一边，分别眨着四只眼睛。“不是人类，不知道。但里面有机器。”

“你们的人为什么不去把它取回来？你们找到了好废品不是还会得到晋升吗？”守护者指着那座摇摇欲坠的建筑问道。

埃里克斯尼族又偏了偏头，脸上挂着迟钝的表情。“你把蛛王的鬼话当真了。来吧，我们还得走好长一段——”埃里克斯尼族刚把话说到一半，就发出了一声惨叫——他被一挺冲锋枪扫成了筛子。

守护者拔出了手炮，披风也因顷刻间的转身飘了起来。从悬崖上滑落下来的不是Vex，也不是堕落者，那是一名身着黑金铠甲的守护者，手中拿着一把枪口还冒着热气的冲锋枪。沙玉拉的战靴轻轻地踏在铺满树叶的广场上，无眼的面具盯着那名身着镀铬护甲的猎人。

“他不是战斗人员！”那名猎人喊道。

沙玉拉慢慢靠近了守护者。“你是在伊拉莫斯的裙摆的摺边里发现他的吗？还是说你在她过世之后向暗影宣了誓？”

那名猎人在阶梯上向后退了几步，把手炮对准了沙玉拉。他认出了她的铠甲——那是试炼的奖励。“我认识你…”他用颤抖的声音说道。“你不应该在这里。先锋什么时候把你放出来的？”

“他们没放我出来。我是趁他们忙着为我们的敌人敞开大门时，自己出来的，”沙玉拉用冲锋枪指着那名死去的埃里克斯尼族。“但是，你知道我来这里的理由。”

“我知道你的脑子不太好使。”那名守护者反唇相讥，用手炮做了个没礼貌的手势。沙玉拉抓住他分神的瞬间，朝他射了两个短点射，命中了六发。

那名守护者应声倒地，他的手炮也顺着台阶滚了下去。片刻之后，他的机灵现身，外壳因为愤怒而闪着光。“你在干什么？！我们——”

沙玉拉如一道闪电般冲到那只机灵之下，转瞬间便用现实之火劈开了她。机灵发出一声令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫，化作了一堆闪光的碎屑。

那名猎人蜷缩在楼梯上咳嗽着，喉咙里满是鲜血。沙玉拉不再关注粉碎的机灵，把冲锋枪对准了她的猎物。“叛徒，”在肾上腺素的刺激下，她用兴奋到颤抖的声音短促地说道。

那名猎人笑了起来，因为咽着自己的血而喘不过气来。“你和他们是一路货色，德瑞捷，”他痛苦地说着，然后用更低的声音补充道，“…还有马尔福。”

“我杀的是一名暗影的代理人，”沙玉拉说道。这次那名猎人没有反驳。他已经死了。

沙玉拉的心头燃起了一股无名火。

“恶之形，无穷尽。”

Hurrying up a shallow set of rubble-strewn steps, a short Eliksni bearing the crest of the House of Light pauses, gazing back at the chrome-armored Guardian moving up the steps behind him. The Eliksni looks the Guardian up and down, then motions to the stark silhouette of a gray concrete-block building rising up from the Venusian overgrowth.

"This ain't the academy proper," the Guardian says on ascent, watching the hazy sky for signs of danger. Moisture clings in glistening beads to his reflective mask; his dark hood shields him from the rest of the elements. "The hell was this place?"

The Eliksni tilts his head to the side, four eyes blinking independently from one another. "Not Human, don't know. But machine inside."

"Why aren't your people bringing it back? Don't you folks get promotions for finding good salvage or something?" the Guardian asks, gesturing to the crumbling building.

The Eliksni once again tilts his head, expression opaque. "You listen to the Spider's sneak-words too eagerly. Come, we have a long walk to—" The Eliksni's words are cut off, garbled in a wet scream as he is perforated by a barrage of Submachine Gun fire.

The Guardian turns, cloak swirling behind him and Hand Cannon at the ready. But it isn't Vex or Fallen descending from the high cliffs—it's a Guardian in black and gold armor gliding to the ground, smoke issuing from the muzzle of her SMG. Shayura's boots lightly touch the leaf-strewn plaza, her eyeless mask fixed on the chrome-clad Hunter.

"He wasn't a combatant!" the Hunter shouts.

Shayura slowly approaches the Guardian. "Did you find him within the hem of Eramis's skirt? Or did you swear yourself to the Darkness after her passing?"

The Hunter backs away, up the stairs, Hand Cannon trained on Shayura. He recognizes her armor for what it is—a reward of the Trials. "I know you…" His voice quavers. "You shouldn't be here. When did the Vanguard let you out?"

"They didn't. I let myself out since they were too busy opening the gates for our enemies," Shayura indicates, motioning with the barrel of her SMG to the dead Eliksni. "But, you know why I'm here ."

"I know you're a few rounds short of a full clip," the Guardian quips back, making a flippant gesture with his Hand Cannon. In that moment of distraction, Shayura shoots him six times in two short bursts.

The Guardian collapses, his gun tumbling down the steps. A moment later, his Ghost materializes, shell flared in anger. "What are you doing?! We—" 

Shayura moves like a lightning bolt, materializing beside the Ghost with an upward flourish of a sword of raw Praxic Fire. The Ghost looses a howling scream of horror as he shatters into a flurry of glittering pieces.

Crumpled on the stairs, the Hunter coughs, his throat damp with blood. Shayura pulls her attention away from the shattered Ghost, training her SMG down at her quarry. "Traitor," she says in a shaky, gasping breath fueled by adrenaline.

The Hunter laughs, gagging on his own blood as he does. "You're no better than the Dredgen ," he says, in pain. Then, even quieter, "…or Malphur ."

"I killed an agent of the Darkness," Shayura says, and the Hunter has no rebuttal this time. He is still.

Bile rises in the back of Shayura's throat.

"They come in many forms."
1103184985.lore_zh:
//NS66CE _日志-C//金星-L2 -地理同步//

一颗用尽能量的战争卫星在虚无的太空中毫无生气地漂流着，划过金星灿烂的黄绿色轮廓。

从这艘位于地理同步轨道上的NS66长空游侠跃迁飞船的昏暗驾驶舱里看去，金星像是一只永远不眨的眼睛，在黑暗的太空中注视着一切，而那颗战争卫星则像是它眼里的一颗碍事的沙子。一只看起来就像是一个光秃秃的金属球的无壳机灵悬浮在驾驶舱的角落里，注视着那颗战争卫星孤独地掠过金星。

“目前金星上没有经授权的先锋行动，”这只机灵说道，将它那只冷漠的蓝眼转向自己的守护者。“你觉得他在下面干什么？”

术士沙玉拉靠在她的座位上，把老旧的皮革压得吱吱作响。她的注意力没在机灵上；而是盯着摆在指挥台中央的一颗人类头骨。那对空洞的眼窝也死死地回望着她。

“他干什么都无所谓，”沙玉拉检视着头骨的颧骨部分，没精打采地说道。她的手指摸到了一些微小的裂纹——霰弹枪弹丸撞击的产物。“我们只要找到他就行了。”

沙玉拉的机灵将目光从她身上转开，专心注视着金星在黑暗中发出的柔和光芒。

“你什么时候回地球？”他问道。

沙玉拉没有发声，只是眨眨眼，用她那双发光的眼睛盯着机灵。它轻轻地发出了哔哔声，重新思考这个问题。

“你会回去吗？”机灵最后问道。

“不，”沙玉拉断然答道。“没有回去的意义。所有人不是抛弃了我，就是背叛了我。我只剩下旅行者了。我不需要待在圣城里也能感受到光能。”她一边说着，一边举手在掌心中央唤出了一团火焰。

“英勇之火指引着我，”沙玉拉说道，让那团火焰映照在了她的眼眸中。

//NS66CE_日志-D//金星-IS -IA //

“看到了？还被保护着。有价值。”

一名佩戴着光能氏族纹章的矮个子埃里克斯尼族匆匆走上一组浅浅的、布满碎石的台阶，然后停了下来，回头望了望那名身着镀铬护甲，正在攀登阶梯的守护者。这名埃里克斯尼族打量了一下守护者，然后指向了一座从金星丛林中拔地而起的灰色混凝土建筑的鲜明轮廓。

“这不是学院的地盘，”守护者说道，继续攀登着台阶。他望向朦胧的天空，留意着危险的迹象。空气中的水分化为水珠，凝结在他的反光面罩上；而他深色的兜帽为他挡住了其他的元素。“这是什么地方？”

埃里克斯尼族把头偏向一边，分别眨着四只眼睛。“不是人类，不知道。但里面有机器。”

“你们的人为什么不去把它取回来？你们找到了好废品不是还会得到晋升吗？”守护者指着那座摇摇欲坠的建筑问道。

埃里克斯尼族又偏了偏头，脸上挂着迟钝的表情。“你把蛛王的鬼话当真了。来吧，我们还得走好长一段——”埃里克斯尼族刚把话说到一半，就发出了一声惨叫——他被一挺冲锋枪扫成了筛子。

守护者拔出了手炮，披风也因顷刻间的转身飘了起来。从悬崖上滑落下来的不是Vex，也不是堕落者，那是一名身着黑金铠甲的守护者，手中拿着一把枪口还冒着热气的冲锋枪。沙玉拉的战靴轻轻地踏在铺满树叶的广场上，无眼的面具盯着那名身着镀铬护甲的猎人。

“他不是战斗人员！”那名猎人喊道。

沙玉拉慢慢靠近了守护者。“你是在伊拉莫斯的裙摆的摺边里发现他的吗？还是说你在她过世之后向暗影宣了誓？”

那名猎人在阶梯上向后退了几步，把手炮对准了沙玉拉。他认出了她的铠甲——那是试炼的奖励。“我认识你…”他用颤抖的声音说道。“你不应该在这里。先锋什么时候把你放出来的？”

“他们没放我出来。我是趁他们忙着为我们的敌人敞开大门时，自己出来的，”沙玉拉用冲锋枪指着那名死去的埃里克斯尼族。“但是，你知道我来这里的理由。”

“我知道你的脑子不太好使。”那名守护者反唇相讥，用手炮做了个没礼貌的手势。沙玉拉抓住他分神的瞬间，朝他射了两个短点射，命中了六发。

那名守护者应声倒地，他的手炮也顺着台阶滚了下去。片刻之后，他的机灵现身，外壳因为愤怒而闪着光。“你在干什么？！我们——”

沙玉拉如一道闪电般冲到那只机灵之下，转瞬间便用现实之火劈开了她。机灵发出一声令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫，化作了一堆闪光的碎屑。

那名猎人蜷缩在楼梯上咳嗽着，喉咙里满是鲜血。沙玉拉不再关注粉碎的机灵，把冲锋枪对准了她的猎物。“叛徒，”在肾上腺素的刺激下，她用兴奋到颤抖的声音短促地说道。

那名猎人笑了起来，因为咽着自己的血而喘不过气来。“你和他们是一路货色，德瑞捷，”他痛苦地说着，然后用更低的声音补充道，“…还有马尔福。”

“我杀的是一名暗影的代理人，”沙玉拉说道。这次那名猎人没有反驳。他已经死了。

沙玉拉的心头燃起了一股无名火。

“恶之形，无穷尽。”
