2599520828.lore:
The Drifter walks the gloaming halls of the Hive vessel, past the pulsing bioenergetics of multiple living systems.

Over comms, he can hear his best (remaining) friend tearing chitinous bodies to shreds with sheer will. The ship, and its inhabitants, are occupied. 

He stumbles along, past pillars that could be ribs, past something that gibbers and gestates but otherwise ignores him. 

Why did he have the gall to be surprised? 

He should have stayed with the Ghostless. Those were his people. Tomorrow is never guaranteed for them, and he rarely got attached. Leave the gods alone. 

He has broken all his rules. 

His mind moves to the infernal machine he carries as the haul of his ship, thoughts sifting through everything he owns: artifacts of the City that might help, Echoes of the Witness that the Cryptarchs have catalogued, favors of the Nine he could dare to call in. But he knows…  

There's nothing he can do. 

He has lost before, but not like this. 

He walks and he walks and finally reaches what might be the prow. He imagines this might have looked out over Saturn at some point, where the king's body had once drifted. It stares out into the abyss now, no stars, full dark. 

There's a hollowness in him, too, that might be pain or anger. He's not certain. 

He holds onto it because she doesn't even have that anymore.
2599520828.lore_zh:
浪客在邪魔族飞船昏暗的走廊中穿行，沿途经过了多个涌动着生物能量的活体系统。

通过通讯器，他能听到自己最好的（也是仅剩的）朋友正凭着顽强的意志在撕裂甲壳生物的身体。飞船及其居民都已被敌人占据。 

他跌跌撞撞地前进，路过可能是肋骨的支柱，以及某种喋喋不休、孕育生命却又无视他的存在。 

他为何会感到惊讶呢？ 

他本该留在没有机灵陪伴的人们的身边。那些是他的同类。他们能否活到明天从来都说不准，因此他很少会感到难以割舍。离那些神灵远点。 

他打破了自己所有的原则。 

他的思绪转向了自己携带的地狱机器，那是他飞船上的货物。他思考着自己所拥有的一切：可能有所帮助的圣城神器，解密大师们编完目的见证者回响，以及他可以冒险索还的玖的人情。但他深知…  

他什么都做不了。 

他也曾经丧失过，但不是像这样。 

他不断前行，终于来到了可能是船首的地方。他想象着这里曾经俯瞰过土星，而邪神的尸体曾在那里漂浮着。现在，它向外凝视着无尽的深渊，没有星光，一片漆黑。 

他的内心里还有一种空虚，那或许是痛苦，或是愤怒。他不确定。 

他紧紧抓住这种感觉，因为她连这个都已不再拥有。

3058845782.lore:
"Sounds like you're asking me to spy on our own people," Drifter replied. "I'm a lot of things, but I ain't a snitch." 

He leaned back and crossed his arms, eyeing Chalco over the remnants of a now-cold dumpling lunch. 

Chalco suppressed an eye roll. As much damage as he left in his wake, the Drifter's ego was surprisingly fragile. She would have to handle the rogue Lightbearer with a delicate touch. 

"I'm asking you to look out for their well-being," the Hidden operative replied. "Sloane's as tough as they come, but there's no precedent for being half-Taken. We don't know what the long-term effects might be." 

"And as far as Eris goes…" Chalco let the thought hang. Drifter had no doubt already calculated the potential consequences of her accumulated trauma. 

"Of course I'm gonna look after 'em," Drifter groused. "But that ain't what you're asking, is it?" 

"I'm asking you to keep me in the loop," Chalco replied. "Neither one of them is great at asking for help. And we don't want to find out too late that we could have done more." 

Chalco took a sip of tea, shrewdly calculating the social dynamics from behind her mask of concern. As a member of the Hidden, she was more than capable of keeping tabs on Eris and Sloane herself. But the Drifter was a volatile element, who could unthinkingly make a bad situation worse. She needed his complicity. 

"Just… let me know what we can do to help," Chalco continued. "Will you do that?" 

Drifter grumbled. As much as he hated to admit it, the idea of a safety net was appealing. 

"Fine," he relented. "I'll let you know if anything comes up, on two conditions: first, stay out of our way." 

"And second?" Chalco prompted. 

Drifter stood up and stuffed the last two dumplings in the pocket of his tunic. 

"Lunch is on you."
3058845782.lore_zh:
“听上去你是想让我监视自己人，”浪客回答道。“我做过很多勾当，但我不当告密者。” 

他往后一靠，双臂交叉，眼神掠过桌上已经凉透的饺子午餐，盯着卡尔科。 

卡尔科强忍住翻白眼的冲动。尽管浪客走到哪里都留下一片狼藉，他的自尊心却出奇脆弱。她得巧妙地对待这个无赖负光者。 

“我只是希望你能多留意下她们的安康，”这名隐秘者特工回答道。“斯隆确实坚强，但半傀儡化这种事从来没发生过。我们不知道会有什么长期的影响。” 

“至于埃里斯…”卡尔科没有继续。浪客肯定已经计算过了她积累的创伤可能带来的后果。 

“我当然会留意她们的情况，”浪客抱怨道。“但那不是你要我做的，对吧？” 

“我只是希望你能让我知道她们的近况，”卡尔科回答道。“她们两人都不擅长主动寻求帮助。我们不想等到事情无可挽回时，才发现本可以做更多。” 

卡尔科喝了一口茶，精明地从她关切的面具后面计算着社交动态的变化。作为隐秘者的一员，她完全有能力亲自监视埃里斯和斯隆。但浪客是个不稳定的因素，可能会轻率地让情况变得更糟糕。她需要拉他入伙。 

“只要…在需要帮忙时告诉我就行，”卡尔科继续道。“你可以做到吗？” 

浪客嘟囔了一声。尽管他不愿意承认，多个安全保障的想法确实吸引人。 

“好吧，”他让步了。“如果发生了什么事，我会告诉你，但是有两个条件：第一，别妨碍我们。” 

“第二呢？”卡尔科问道。 

浪客站起身，把最后两个饺子塞进了外套口袋。 

“午餐你请。”

“我只是希望你能让我知道她们的近况，”卡尔科回答道。“她们两人都不擅长主动寻求帮助。我们不想等到事情无可挽回时，才发现本可以做更多。” 

卡尔科喝了一口茶，精明地从她关切的面具后面计算着社交动态的变化。作为隐秘者的一员，她完全有能力亲自监视埃里斯和斯隆。但浪客是个不稳定的因素，可能会轻率地让情况变得更糟糕。她需要拉他入伙。 

“只要…在需要帮忙时告诉我就行，”卡尔科继续道。“你可以做到吗？” 

浪客嘟囔了一声。尽管他不愿意承认，多个安全保障的想法确实吸引人。 

“好吧，”他让步了。“如果发生了什么事，我会告诉你，但是有两个条件：第一，别妨碍我们。” 

“第二呢？”卡尔科问道。 

浪客站起身，把最后两个饺子塞进了外套口袋。 

“午餐你请。”

2596736862.lore:
Life on the outskirts of the Tangled Shore was as desolate as ever, yet the few remaining Eliksni there heard the reports and knew: it was time to leave.

"How much farther to the Ketch?" a Dreg gasped, a mountain of the crew's effects lashed to his back and balanced in his arms.

"We'd have been there by now if you hadn't destroyed our last Pike," a Vandal snarled at him.

Suddenly, a soft cry lilted into the air. Loud and desperate. Almost childlike.

The Dreg stopped in his tracks, listening. "Do you hear that?"

He rushed ahead and found a lone hatchling, crawling and wailing a song of abandonment deep within a crater.

"The hatchling is—is—surrounded by Dark Ether!" the Dreg exclaimed.

The Vandal grabbed the Dreg by the back of his neck. "You fool! We have to go!" she yelled.

But it was too late. A cluster of bloodthirsty Revenant Scorn descended on them, leaving nothing but their screams to echo across the landscape.

***

A lone Legionary clad in blue followed a sound, a cry that lilted across the barrenness of the Tangled Shore. The sound became louder and more desperate. Almost childlike.

He discovered a lone hatchling, wailing a song of abandonment deep within a crater. Carefully, the Legionary lowered himself into the fissure. He comforted the hatchling who quickly clung to him amid the Dark Ether that swirled around.

A war cry erupted from above as a cluster of Revenant Scorn descended. The Legionary quickly dispatched one and shoved a grenade in its grotesque mouth before lobbing it back up toward its brethren. As it exploded, bits and pieces of the entire pack rained down around the Legionary and the hatchling, who cowered behind him.

The last remaining Scorn attacked from behind, pinning the Legionary to the ground, sending his weapon flying. The putrid monster lashed out but stopped suddenly, howling in pain. The Legionary turned to see the chubby hatchling latched onto the Scorn's leg, teeth lodged deep in its flesh. Without hesitation, he lunged for his sidearm and placed a bullet neatly in the Scorn's head.

He lovingly scooped up the unharmed hatchling, wiped the ooze and drool from its mouth, and bellowed with laughter.

"You have just eaten the first of many mountains—a true Cabal from this day forward, little one!"
2596736862.lore_zh:
纷争海岸边缘的生活依然孤苦，但那里少数剩余的埃里克斯尼族听到了报告，知道是时候离开了。

“离双桅船还有多远？”一个堕落者士兵背负着小山一样的船员财物，喘气问道。

“如果不是你毁了我们的最后一辆派克，我们早就到了，”一个暴徒咆哮道。

突然，一声柔软的哭泣飘散在空气中。那声音既响亮又绝望，几乎像孩子一般。

堕落者士兵停下了脚步，侧耳倾听。“你听见了吗？”

他冲到前面，发现一个孤单的幼雏在陨坑深处，边爬边唱着被遗弃的哀歌。

“那幼雏——被黑暗乙太包围了！”堕落者士兵惊呼道。

暴徒抓住堕落者士兵的颈背，“傻瓜！我们得赶紧离开！”她喊道。

但已经太迟了。一群嗜血的亡魂嗤魅扑了过来，只留下他们的尖叫声在大地上回响。

***

一个身披蓝色战甲的军团士兵正循着回荡在纷争海岸荒凉之地的哭喊声前进。那声音越来越响亮，甚至带有些许绝望，几乎像孩子一般。

军团士兵发现了一只孤单的幼雏在陨坑深处发出凄惨的歌声。他小心翼翼地降入裂缝，安慰着在黑暗乙太的环绕中迅速依偎过来的幼雏。

随着上方传来一声战吼，一群亡魂嗤魅从天而降。军团士兵迅速解决了一个，将手雷塞进它丑陋的嘴里，然后把它扔回敌阵。它爆炸时，整个亡魂群的骨肉四散落到军团士兵和幼雏周围，幼雏害怕得躲在他的身后。

最后一个嗤魅从背后偷袭，把军团士兵按倒在地，他的武器也被打飞出去。腐臭的怪物正猛烈进攻，却又突然停下，发出痛苦的嚎叫。军团士兵转身看到胖乎乎的幼雏咬住了嗤魅的腿，牙齿深深嵌入肉中。他毫不犹豫地迅速抓起手枪，精准地将一颗子弹射入嗤魅的头颅。

他温柔地拾起未受伤害的幼雏，擦去它嘴角的粘液和口水，大笑起来。

“你刚刚征服了此生的第一座高山，从今天起，你是真正的卡巴尔了，小家伙！”

204173504.name: Grasps of the Flain
204173504.flavor: – Torment rent in twain cascades upon the valleys and subjugates them again –
204173504.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

Endless Darkness envelops a Tormentor, one of the first strips peeled by the Voice's blade… 

The Tormentor is not alone… 

Light, buried deep within shadow flickers erratically, as if painful convulsions warp its frequency. It is twisted around an ever-shifting many hands and pulled taut to slick their knife with Light like rosin. A heterodox pairing, opening the creation of new forms flayed from old flesh. 

An eternal Voice pierces the Darkness… 

"Take shape, second born of pain. Through the Light, bent in service to the Deep. We twist your form into being. Take shape. Now." 

In the Deep, it peels shrieking Torment into sistered slabs…  

"Pared from the flesh of our mind." 

The Voice speaks a piece of its soul into the bisected flesh. 

"A living mirror on which to carve our will." 

A blade of resonant energy carves slender humanoid husks from the quivering canvas… 

"These figments of agony. They are the lessons we will share with you." 

It separates the thin layers, dividing segments along lines of clustered nerves… 

"In wounded Light your shape is forged." 

The husk is considered, recombined with the trim, and reshaped many times. 

"With tools of subjugation, you shall teach them." 

The Voice recites memories of deep power into their fabric… from Europa it imbues control. From Neomuna, serenity. 

"Until all Light bends toward the finality of our horizon." 

With Its command issued, the Voice fades… 

Subjugated halves of torment are left in the silence of the Deep. Their eyes open to the world, and weep. 

*** 

Selin sits with their other half, surveying the Pale Heart. "Sister, what becomes of us when we succeed?" 

Their other half ponders the question for the first time. After a moment, they answer. "We return." 

"And what becomes of—us?" Selin emphasizes. 

The question frustrates Yemiq. She thrusts her lance into festering brambles. "We… return?" 

Selin rotates a shard of Stasis in its hand, analyzing the split reflections. "Return… to where there is no Yemiq? Only an echo within the Witness." 

This frustrates her more. She pulls the lance free and stands over Selin. "I am Yemiq." 

"Exactly," Selin says, letting the shard fall and dissipate, before standing to meet her other half. "And who were you before?" 

"Not nothing," Yemiq responds. 

"But not Yemiq," Selin says, before pointing to itself, "And not Selin." 

"Better buried than faded from memory." Yemiq turns away. "We return. Together again." 

"Together, within it." Selin probes. "Is that what you want?" 

Yemiq is silent. 

"I know what It wants. I'm asking what you want." Selin sees the final shape just as clearly as the Witness does. It will bring this shape into being. There can be no pursuit in deviation of this purpose, but Selin has considered what follows, what could follow. It takes in the vista of the Pale Heart again, its gaze lingering on a spot marred by Darkness. "What if we could truly be whole—" 

A Voice pierces Selin's mind and cuts the notion from it. "Abandon this meager hope."
204173504.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

无尽暗影笼罩着一名折磨者，它是被那声音的利刃率先剥开的存在之一… 

这名折磨者并非孤身一人… 

深藏于阴影深处的光闪烁不定，仿佛痛苦的痉挛扭曲了它的频率。它被无数变幻莫测的手紧紧缠绕，拉得紧绷绷的，润滑着他们的利刃，仿佛在涂抹松香一般。这是一种异端结合，开启了由旧躯壳剥落而出的新形态的创造。 

一个永恒的声音刺破了暗影… 

“成形吧，历经痛楚的新生。穿越光能，屈服于深渊的召唤。我们扭曲你的形态。现在，成形吧。” 

在深渊之中，它将尖叫的折磨层层剥离，化作相连共生的碎片…  

“从我们的心智血肉中剥离而出。” 

那声音将其灵魂的一隅，注入被分开的血肉之中。 

“一面活生生的镜子，供我们镌刻意志。” 

一柄共振能量之刃，于震颤的画布上雕琢出纤细的人形躯壳… 

“这些痛苦的幻象，正是我们将与你共鉴的教训。” 

它轻轻剥离那层叠的薄膜，循着密集神经的轨迹，将各部分细细分割… 

“于受伤的光能中，你的形态被铸就。” 

那躯壳经过考量，与边角料重新融合，重塑了多次。 

“你将以镇压之器，引领他们领悟。” 

那声音吟诵着深邃力量的记忆，将其注入它们的纹理之中…源自木卫二的记忆，赋予掌控之力；源自内欧姆那的记忆，带来宁静祥和。 

“直至所有光能都屈从于我们地平线的尽头。” 

随着命令的下达，那声音渐渐消散… 

在那深渊的沉寂之中，被镇压的两半折磨仍残存着。它们睁开眼，窥探着世界，泪光闪烁。 

*** 

色琳与她的另一半坐在一起，审视着苍白之心。“姐妹，我们成功后会变成什么样？” 

她的另一半首次思考起这问题。过了一会儿，给出了答复。“我们会回去。” 

“那‘我们'会变成什么样？”色琳着重问道。 

这个问题让耶米克倍感沮丧，她将长矛刺入那丛正在溃烂的荆棘之中。“我们…会回去？” 

色琳轻轻旋转着手中的冰影碎片，凝视着分裂的倒影。“回到…一个没有耶米克的地方？只有见证者里面的回响。” 

这让她更加恼火了。她拔出长矛，站在色琳面前。“我就是耶米克。” 

“没错，”色琳说着，任由那碎片坠落并消散，随后站起身来，迎向她的另一半。“在此之前，你又是谁？” 

“不是虚无，”耶米克回答道。 

“但不是耶米克，”色琳说着，指了指自己，“也不是色琳。” 

“与其从记忆中消褪，不如深埋。”耶米克转过身。“我们回去。再次团聚。” 

“团聚，在它的体内。”色琳试探地问道。“那是你想要的吗？” 

耶米克沉默不语。 

“我知道它想要什么。我问的是你想要什么。”色琳看到的终焉之形，跟见证者所见的一般清晰。它会让这一形态成为现实。任何偏离此使命的追求都不可存在，然而色琳已考量过随之而来的种种可能。色琳再次望向苍白之心，目光停留在被暗影玷污的一处。“如果我们能真正完整——” 

一个声音穿透色琳的心智，斩断了其心中的念想。“舍弃这贫乏的希望。”

1881459336.name: Scales of the Flain
1881459336.flavor: – A blade carves in wicked intent, claiming this submission is surgery  –
1881459336.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

*** 

The Witness traces lines of power across the landscape of the Pale Heart from a monolithic structure that casts long shadows over the shifting terrain. The Light flows within the Heart like veins. If the Traveler would not relinquish control, it would be harvested and exploited to bring the final shape to bear on reality. 

The Witness raises a hand, pulling at the Light flowing beneath, searching for sources to tap. 

Ambient warmth || Life presents choice.  || graces the Witness's face. 

"Distraction? You cannot stop this." The Witness twists a hand, and the soil churns and buckles, bleeding Light in violent spurts across the landscape. "Submit." 

A shockwave of iridescent Light roars across the surface of the Pale Heart, encircling and crashing down towards the Witness. A radial veil of appendages sprouts from the Witness, hands casting cryptic motions in all directions. The Light-wave splits once, then again, breakages multiply exponentially across the tsunami until it shatters. The Witness seizes the broken momentum and redirects the blast into the spot It had felt the Light surge from. There. It would be a fruitful excision. There It would draw out a kindled flame of dark ambition and forge it into service. 

"Do you persist out of hope, or fear?"  The Witness looks to the terraformed impact site of the Traveler's blast. "This continued, meaningless flailing… It is useless, but you must try. All life understands this law: to thrash against extinction. Now, you too feel our burden. We have pursued you to share this gift with you. Are you not tired of this instinctual resistance? Do you not cry out for salvation?" 

"It is here." 

*** 

Scars pock the Pale Heart. The Traveler bleeds, and the carving, the excision of Light to bring the final shape to bear upon reality, is far from realized. 

Deep within one such scar, in a space cut from memory, the Witness looks upon Its old world. A remnant of a remnant, abandoned by the abandoned. A city of crude pyramidion structures shift around It like tectonic plates, groaning in vicious mockery of the wounded Gardener's cries. 

"Enough." The Witness extends myriad arms in front of It and quells the city's motion into silence. It waves the structures away. "This memory drawn from us. You loomed, demanding worship, but offered nothing in return. How is it you still cannot understand?" 

The Witness shapes the edge of their palm, as a blade, and steps forward, raising the edge to nick the flesh of a frail sapling. "You cannot hide this vestige of power." 

"It is a place of pain. An impetus that must be left behind." Drips of silver Light are drawn forth from the pale, dying, tree until a small pool rests in the Witness's palm. It focuses will on the evaporating Light, imbuing its potential with memory and ideology. 

The Witness whispers a dream into reality, the Light surges, and—for a moment they stand among their people, separate, alone, within the possibility of the past before its sullying. Static, droning, contentment. 

The Traveler above—the Light shimmers, quivering || Life is not still. || with thin resilience, then fades. 

The Witness is again in the Pale Heart, the Light gone from Its grasp. Encircled by a flowering nascence, rests the remains of the Witness's first attempt to bend Light and Dark into form. A failure, not dead, but dormant and weak. From this presumed grave, it would watch its lineage forged, its Witness fall, and in time, this being would rise to prove its worth as a Subjugator. But for now, the newborn failure remains on the ground before It. 

"First of the Reshaped, Keit'Ehr, flain from resonance. Prove your existence by escaping this death. Should you rise, and find us again, your strength will be known." 

The Witness feels the Pale Heart shudder and turns its attention to the Traveler. 

"You are weakening." 

It speaks through the Darkness, a Voice ringing in the minds of Its denizen. "Our host remains intransigent. Choke their resolve."
1881459336.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

*** 

见证者从一座在变幻地形上投下长长阴影的巍峨建筑中，沿着苍白之心的地貌勾勒出力量的轨迹。光能如同血脉在苍白之心中流动着。如果旅行者不愿放弃掌控，那它就将被攫取、榨干，来让终焉之形在现实中得以显现。 

见证者举起一只手，牵引下方流动的光能，探寻可汲取的源头。 

周遭的暖意||生命赋予抉择。||轻抚见证者的脸庞。 

“想让我分心？你无法阻挡这一切。”见证者扭动一只手，大地随之翻涌、隆起，光能如同暴虐的激流，在这片土地上肆虐喷发。“屈服吧。” 

一股绚烂夺目的光能冲击波在苍白之心的地表轰鸣而过，环绕着见证者，轰然坠下。见证者周身骤然生出一圈圈触手般的附器，每只手都向各个方向划动着神秘的轨迹。光能冲击波先是一分为二，接着再次分裂，破碎之处如海啸般迅速倍增，直至彻底粉碎。见证者抓住了破碎的动能，将爆炸的能量转向它感受到光能涌动的源头。就在那里。这会是一次富有成效的剥离。在那里，它会抽取出一团燃烧着黑暗野心的火焰，将其锻造成自己的仆从。 

“你仍在坚持，是出于希望，还是恐惧？”见证者望向旅行者的爆炸留下的那片被重塑的冲击现场。“这无休止、无意义的挣扎…徒劳无功，但你必须尝试。万物生灵皆洞悉这一铁律：与灭绝抗争。此刻，你也感受到了我们的重负。我们穷追不舍，只为与你共享这份馈赠。你难道没有厌倦这种源自本能的抵抗？你难道没在呼唤救赎？” 

“它近在眼前。” 

*** 

苍白之心布满了伤痕。旅行者正在流血，而为了让终焉之形在现实中得以显现，要对光能进行的雕刻、切除，还远未达成。 

在这些伤痕中的某个的深处，于一段被记忆切割出的空间里，见证者凝视着它曾经的世界。遭被遗弃者所遗弃的，某处遗迹的残迹。一座满是粗糙金字塔形建筑的城市，如同地壳板块般在它周围缓缓移动，发出阵阵低沉的声响，仿佛在恶毒地嘲笑那位受伤园丁的哀鸣。 

“够了。”见证者伸出无数条手臂挡在前面，将这座城市的喧嚣平息为一片死寂。它挥手将这些建筑驱散。“这是我们被剥夺的记忆。你曾高高在上，要求供奉，却未曾给予丝毫回馈。你怎么还不明白？” 

见证者将手掌边缘塑成利刃之状，向前迈出一步，举起这无形的锋刃，轻轻划过一株柔弱幼苗的表皮。“你无法掩盖这力量的痕迹。” 

“这是满载苦楚之地。是必须抛诸脑后的驱动力。”银色的光能从苍白、垂死的树干上滴落，如细流般被汲取而出，直至在见证者的掌心汇聚成一汪小潭。它全神贯注于那即将消散的光能，将记忆与意志灌注其中，赋予其无限潜能。 

见证者轻声细语，将梦想织入现实，光能随之涌动。那一刻，它站在族人之中，分离，孤独，置身过往纯净无瑕的可能性。静滞，低鸣，满足。 

上方的旅行者——光能闪烁，带着||生命不息，涌动不止。||微弱却坚韧的颤动，随后渐渐消逝。 

见证者再次身处苍白之心，光能已从它的掌握中消失。被一圈绽放新生所环绕的，是见证者初次尝试将光明与黑暗塑形所留下的遗迹。这是一次失败，但它并未消亡，而是沉寂且虚弱地存在着。从这座假想的坟墓中，它将目睹其血脉的锻造，其见证者的陨落，而等到时机成熟，这一存在将会复生，证明其作为镇压者的价值。然而此刻，这新生的失败之作仍匍匐于它面前。 

“重塑者之首，基特尔，自共振中剥离。挣脱死亡之枷锁，以证你之存在。若你能重获新生，再度找到我们，你的力量必将为人所知。” 

见证者感知到苍白之心的颤抖，将其注意力转向了旅行者。 

“你在变弱。” 

它的话语穿过暗影，那是个在其住民心中回荡的声音。“我们的宿主依然拒绝妥协。扼杀它的决心。”

3583556837.name: Husk's Cloak
3583556837.flavor: – Let the flesh become a puppet of the truer soul, with ligaments like wire –
3583556837.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

Veskith stands within the Great Machine. Closer than any Kell. He would be the spark that burned this traitor-god from within. The Witness would give them the strength to strike back. 

A specter of Torment moves ahead from behind him to a pyramid-fashioned sarcophagus, which opens at its touch. The thing looms, waiting over the opening, dimming the ambient shine within the Pale Heart. 

He was promised a shape of vengeance. As Eramis before him, he would take the power he was owed. 

Veskith descends. 

Enveloped… 

Veskith remembers how the Archons commanded Stasis through grounding themselves. Vesk… Ves… Ve— 

A Voice pierces the Darkness… 

"The Gardener has given you only pain. We offer a knife with which to return it." 

The Voice offers Salvation, stripped from resonant pain… You accept. 

He does. The thought washes away, overcome. 

"Your definition subsumed." The Voice resounds in the Deep, ringing like metal. Sharp. "Peeled away… and carved anew." The Voice's words run like razors across his carapace, slicing his mind into slivers. 

Ve… sk—Identity seeps into oceanic Darkness—ithhhhhhhhhhh… 

The Voice cuts deep, and life runs thick; each yet unrefined motion marked in muted wails. 

It is exploration as much as intention. A learning canvas with which to train the manipulation of the Light. Less gentle than ceremony. More rabid than want. 

As the nameless flesh trembles, splayed out before the Voice, it speaks purpose into being. 

"Your shape is to be a vessel." A cut against the foundation of bone is delivered. "A nest that within burrows spite." 

The words wear away living strata. Their deterioration hollows. Memories unravel into noise. The pain of their absence honing the edge of this newly carved implement. 

A bladed engine lurched into being, driven by the Voice's intent. Hollow spite spindles around the undulating mortal coil within: a final remnant of the violated, left hewn, infiltrated, and bare. 

*** 

The bladed engine that houses Veskith crouches atop a high stone perch overlooking an arid wasteland. They guard a dormant Tormentor, awaiting its commands. They have remained motionless since the Tormentor led them here, though they do not know why. They are never told why. Commands are given and followed with unflinching obedience. 

The portal dominates the sky over them.  

A distant monolith splits the horizon. 

Brief lucidity—Veskith sees Eliksni of his House around him. They patrol, but he does not remember when they began. He asks them how they got here, how long it has been, but they do not respond. His eyes burn—the final remnant of Veskith gazes blankly from within a catatonic fog, unaware of the reality beyond his cage. 

The unchanging image of the portal burns into his retinas, as their body ignores twitching nerves pleading to blink.
3583556837.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

韦斯基斯站立在大机器内，比任何凯尔都更接近它。他将是那团从内而外焚烧叛徒之神的炽烈火花。见证者会赋予他们反击的力量。 

一个折磨之灵自他身后向前径直走向一座金字塔形石棺，而它一触即开。那物巍然矗立，守候在开口之上，遮蔽着苍白之心内透出的背景光。 

他曾得到过复仇之形的允诺。正如他之前的伊拉莫斯，他将夺回那本应属于他的力量。 

韦斯基斯缓缓下落入内。 

被某种神秘力量所笼罩… 

韦斯基斯回想起那些执政官们是如何通过扎根大地来控制冰影的。韦斯基…韦斯…韦—— 

一个声音穿透了暗影… 

“园丁给予你的唯有苦楚。我们赠你利刃，用以回击。” 

那声音奉上救赎，自共振之痛中剥离…你予以接受。 

他照做了。那思绪如潮水般退去，终被压倒。 

“你的定义已被吞没。”那声音在深渊中回响，如金属般清脆响亮，尖锐刺耳。“层层剥落…重塑新生。”那声音的话语如同锋利的剃刀，在他的甲壳上划过，将他的思绪切割成薄片。 

韦…斯基——自我缓缓融入那深邃无边的暗影海洋之中——斯… 

那声音深深切割，生命汩汩流淌，浓稠而热烈；每个尚未雕琢的动作，都伴随着低沉的哀鸣。 

这既是探索，亦是意图所在。如同一张学习的画布，用以训练对光能的操控。不如仪式般温柔，却比渴望更加狂热。 

随着那无名之躯在声音面前颤抖、摊开，它发声将使命转化为了存在。 

“你的形态将会成为容器。”一道切割穿透骨基。“一处内里暗藏愤懑的巢穴。” 

这些言辞剥蚀着生命的岩层，其腐朽之处渐成空洞。记忆如丝线般散落，化为纷扰的噪音。它们缺失的痛苦，不断地磨砺着这把刚被雕琢的工具。 

一柄利刃引擎，猛然间由那声音的意志所驱动，跃然而出。在曲折蜿蜒的生命轨迹中，空洞的愤懑如纺锤般旋转缠绕：那是被侵犯、被雕琢、被渗透、被剥露的最终残骸。 

*** 

那把承载着韦斯基斯的利刃引擎，蛰伏于高耸的石台之上，俯瞰着一片荒芜的旱地。它守护着一个沉睡的折磨者，静待其指令。自折磨者引领它至此，它便一动未动，尽管不明缘由。它从未被告知原因。指令已下达，并被坚定不移地遵从着。 

那传送门霸占着它头顶的天空。  

遥远的巨石将地平线一分为二。 

短暂的清醒间——韦斯基斯瞥见了他身边同氏族的埃里克斯尼族。他们在巡逻，但他不记得这是何时开始的。他询问他们是如何来到此地的，已过了多久，但他们没有回应。他的双眼炽热——那是韦斯基斯最后的残留，在呆滞的迷雾中茫然凝视，对笼外的现实浑然不觉。 

那永恒不变的传送门景象，烙印在他的视网膜上，而其身躯却无视着恳求眨眼的抽搐神经。

2795645257.name: Mask of the Flain
2795645257.flavor: – With knife in hand and violence in heart, a proposal is made and refused –
2795645257.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

In the strata of memory and experience within the Pale Heart, live moments, once buried, now revealed in the Light of the Traveler; imprinted in the Dread remnants that cling to a fading shape. Rendered knowledge, through the eyes of the enemy, in search of salvation. 

*** 

The Pale Heart stands open, a shimmering angular tear spilling color out into the surrounding sky, slowly eclipsed by a billowing miasma of consciousness. The Witness surveys its goal, the closeness, the obscurity. 

Here, within the Traveler, is a plane of unimagined form. Potential. Unrefined. Raw. Held tightly in the titular grip of the inculpable, seeding recklessness without care. The Witness would wrest that potential from the Gardener, casting trough away in place of an eager blade. One with which It would carve the Light from Its oppressor, should they refuse to see logic. 

"We are alone." It touches down, and immediately the crudely vacant plane of the Pale Heart twists, as reinterpreted space sprawls from the Witness in all directions. Mountains burst from flat, colorless surfaces and a shroud of mist cloaks the darkening soil. 

"We have come to claim that which you kept from us. From all life. But we are not required to carve this claim from you. Take up your charge. Bequeath your Light to its truest purpose. End our struggle." 

The Witness stops, waiting for a response, and in the softness of absence, they listen. 

Droplets of condensation || I flow beyond each life. All life. || trickle through cracks beneath the Witness's planted stance. 

"Resistance? Then it is the knife." It thrusts a hand downward toward the ground. "It is the offering of your flesh that permits salvation. We can see its shape in the Dark, but your Light shall forge shape into reality. If you will not sacrifice willingly, nobly, we shall excise what Light is needed from you." 

Soil splits and sinks before plunging into the maw of a great cave. "You cannot flee. A Gardener tends. Atone for the horror you have sown. Give your Light to the final shape willingly, or have it cut from you." 

Recognition brushes the Witness's cheek, || My children. There is so much more than this. || softly, drawing It forward into the offer of an embrace. 

But It recoils, slashing the vanillin air with the edge of many hands. "This place must be upended…" It maligns hollowness into cysts in the flesh. "…foundations unto foundations." 

Pain like wind || I have shaped, my work, laid flat|| erodes away the shapes that spring from the Witness's touch and halt Its progress momentarily. 

The Witness flicks finger like blades, again, and again, carving hollows from the flesh of the Traveler. The work is slow. Deliberate. Difficult. 

It holds the surrounding pitch in place and presses against the borders, feeling the Traveler's patient defiance. "You were not prepared, when you uplifted us. It is why you left. It is why you fear your own change now. But where you sow change and abandon it to chaos, we correct this error. It is purpose We have given us. Is it not beautiful?" 

There is || (SCREAMING) || no sound in the scar of the Traveler.
2795645257.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

在苍白之心内记忆与经验的层叠之中，那些曾经深埋的岁月，如今在旅行者光能的照耀下重见天日；它们被镌刻在依附于消逝形态之上的恐惧残留之中。借由敌方的双眼所窥见的知识，乃是在探寻救赎之道上的所得。 

*** 

苍白之心敞开着，一道闪烁的棱角分明的裂缝将周遭的天际染上斑斓色彩，逐渐被一股翻滚的意识迷雾所遮蔽。见证者审视着它的目标，近在咫尺，模糊不清。 

此处，在旅行者的内部，潜藏着一个难以想象的形态之域。一种未经雕琢的潜能，原始而纯粹，被无辜者象征性地紧握于手，肆意播撒着无畏与不羁，毫不顾忌。见证者会从园丁手中奋力夺取这种潜能，用渴望之刃取代饲槽。倘若压迫者拒绝遵从守则，它将以此利刃，从其身上切割出光能。 

“我们孑然一身。”它缓缓降落，霎时间，苍白之心那片粗犷而空旷的位面仿佛被重新诠释，扭曲变形，空间自见证者身畔向四面八方无限延展开来。原本平坦无色的地表猛然间山峦耸立，一层薄雾如斗篷般笼罩在逐渐暗淡的大地上。 

“我们前来索回你从我们及万物生灵那里剥夺的一切。但我们不必从你身上强行夺取。承担你的职责，将你的光能奉献给最真实的使命，结束我们的抗争。” 

见证者停了下来，等待着回应，在空寂的温柔之中，侧耳倾听。 

水珠凝露||我悠然穿梭于每个生命之间，遍及万物生灵。||于见证者屹立之处，悄然渗透其脚下的缝隙，潺潺细流。 

“抵抗？那就只能是利刃相向了。”它伸手向下，直指大地。“唯有献上你的血肉，方能迎来救赎。我们在暗影中能窥见它的轮廓，而你的光能将把这轮廓铸成现实。若你不愿高贵地自愿牺牲，我们就将从你身上剥离出所需的光能。” 

大地分裂，沉降，继而坠入巨型洞穴的血盆大口。“你无处可逃。园丁在此守护。为你播下的恐怖赎罪吧。要么心甘情愿地将你的光能献给终焉之形，要么就让它从你身上被强行剥夺吧。” 

认知轻拂过见证者的脸颊，||我的孩子们啊，这远非全部。||引领着它向前，仿佛邀请着一个拥抱。 

但它向后退缩，用许多手掌的边缘划破那片香草气息弥漫的空气。“此地必须颠覆…”它将虚无玷污为肉体内的囊肿。“…直至根基动摇。” 

痛楚如风||我已塑形，我的杰作，平铺开来||侵蚀着见证者触碰而生的形态，暂阻其前行的脚步。 

见证者一次又一次地，以闪动的指尖为刃，划过旅行者的血肉，雕琢出一个又一个空洞。这工作缓慢而刻意，艰难无比。 

它稳住周遭的混沌，紧贴边界，感受着旅行者那隐忍不屈的抵抗。“你当初抬升我们时，并未做好准备。那是你离去的原因。那是你如今惧怕自身变化的缘由。但你播下变革之种却又任其陷入混沌之时，是我们在纠正这一谬误。这是我们赋予自己的使命。它难道不美吗？” 

在旅行者的伤痕之中，唯有||（尖叫）||万籁俱寂。

3194080506.name: Hooks of the Flain
3194080506.flavor: – Let your mind be split into the many facets of thought it so craves to embody –
3194080506.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

The Voice pierces a scar of Darkness within the Pale Heart… oppressive Light squeezes at the borders, like antibodies. It is one of many such places carved from the Traveler, where its essence has bent to the Witness's words. 

Here, a Word of Dissent fractured from the Witness—one like it in form and lineage—and here it remains, held prisoner by that to which it once belonged. 

"What do you hope to accomplish alone, tiny wisp of smoke?" 

"Unveil your deceitful promises," the fractured Whisper of Dissent weaves between the Witness's words. "And I am not alone." 

The Witness narrows Its voice, compressing all sound into a thin edge. "You fracture from our purpose. This shape no longer suits you." 

The whisper turns to a hiss. "You cannot keep us in Darkness." 

"We shall see," the Witness responds. "Your feelings seem… conflicted. Your thoughts… scattered." 

The Witness speaks to each splintered impulse within the Word of Dissent, tethering each one to a shape in the Darkness, manifesting it through twisted Light. The Voice calls them forth. 

The Word of Dissent protests, but instead produces a bestial wraith that bursts from its mouth, wailing, trailing fluids and gurgled cries. 

"The time for penitence has passed." 

It is the first of many. Grim splinters rip away, disconnected and twisted by the Witness's commands. Each wriggling expulsion shrieks in mimicry of its host's choked screams. 

"Expel, until nothing remains." 

One Word of Dissent violently rips into a billowing cloud of Grim. They look to each other with waning, morose understanding, as lucidity slips away into instinct. 

*** 

Dark wings soon blot out the sky and carry swarms of ravenous Grim. Their guttural shrieks emulate gurgled whines and drowned pleas. 

When the colony roosts together, or soars across the Pale Heart in unison, they nearly remember the warm, fleshy nest that—once—they called home together. They nearly remember a deeper connection between them. A singular nexus. As if they had been one being before this exodus. 

Endlessly, they search for it. Huddled together around the increasing number of Dark scars within the Pale Heart—drawn by some latent familiarity. They circle above the quiet whispers, and their numbers grow. 

But now, as the Guardians shoot them down, the colony loses pieces of itself. The memories fade more still. Colonies mix, and latent familiarity recedes into instinct and habit. Recognition of the former erodes, and gives way to oblivion.
3194080506.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

那声音穿透了苍白之心深处的暗影伤痕…压迫性的光能在边界处挤压着，犹如抗体一般。这是旅行者身上被雕琢出的众多场所之一，其精华已屈服于见证者的言辞。 

在此，一句异议之词自见证者中裂化——与它同源同脉——却在此地遭到囚禁，被其曾经归属之物牢牢束缚。 

“你这缕渺小的轻烟，究竟想要独自完成些什么？” 

“揭开你欺诈的承诺，”裂化而出的异议低语着，在见证者的言辞间穿梭交织。“而且我并非独自一人。” 

见证者将声音收窄，把所有声响凝聚成一柄利刃。“你自我们的使命裂化。这形态已不再适合于你。” 

那低语转而化为嘶嘶声。“你不能将我们禁锢于暗影之中。” 

“拭目以待吧，”见证者回应道。“你的情感似乎…充满矛盾。你的思绪…支离破碎。” 

见证者向异议之词中每一片分裂的冲动诉说，将它们逐一束缚于暗影中的形态，又以扭曲的光能将其显现。那声音召唤着它们出来。 

异议之词奋力抗议，口中喷涌而出的却是一只野兽般的幽灵，苦苦哀嚎，其身后拖着黏液，发出阵阵呜咽的呻吟。 

“现在忏悔，为时已晚。” 

这是诸多后来者前的第一个。依见证者的指令，狰狞的碎片被撕裂、断开、扭曲。每一次扭动的驱逐发出的凄厉哀嚎都与宿主窒息的尖叫一般无二。 

“驱逐，直至丝毫不剩。” 

一句异议之词猛然撕裂，化作汹涌翻滚的狰狞之云。它们彼此对视，眼中闪烁着逐渐黯淡、忧郁的理解之光，而清醒正悄然滑入本能的深渊。 

*** 

不久，漆黑的羽翼遮蔽苍穹，携着成群结队的贪婪狰狞而来。它们发出的喉音尖叫，仿若汩汩的哀鸣与淹没的乞求。 

当群落齐聚栖息，或一同在苍白之心上空翱翔时，它们几乎能忆起那曾共同称为家园的、温暖而血肉丰满的巢穴。它们几乎能回想起彼此间那份更深的联结，独一无二的纽带，仿佛在此次离散之前，它们本为一体。 

它们无休止地寻觅着，紧紧簇拥在苍白之心内日益增多的黑暗伤痕周围，被某种潜藏的熟悉感牵引。它们在静谧的低语上方盘旋，数量与日俱增。 

然而此刻，随着守护者将它们一一击落，这个群落慢慢失去自我。记忆愈发模糊，群落间相互交融，那份潜藏的熟悉感逐渐退化为本能与习性。过往的认知日益消逝，屈服于遗忘的深渊。

2563228825.name: Spacewalk Grasps
2563228825.flavor: Archival|Castor|231| —don't understand. We're all excited for successful code injection, but it's much too early for insertion into a chassis—
2563228825.lore:
Seventeen days since arrival. 

Karrho is busy all the time talking to the Vandals and Marauders too big to even look at Yaraskis. They're working together to build an Ether refinery, using old human blueprints from the station. He rarely has time for Yaraskis. 

Yaraskis would make a terrible engineer. In her cocoon she dreamed of being a Captain, not a priest. She fetches and carries and mops up the old stains nobody else wants to touch, making the station livable again. 

Day by day, their home fills up with comforting noise: the pleasant creak of cable ties stringing platforms together, the thump-click, thump-click of footwraps and claws on decking, of the arguments between the only two crewmembers who understand Servitor code. 

It's nothing like a good solid warren—but it's safe, and that's good enough. And once they have Ether flowing in, it'll be even better. 

Yaraskis tries to ignore the station-voice as she tosses a rag into the machine that is almost an incinerator. 

From behind, a hand yanks at her hood. She yells. Its owner dodges her return swipe. 

Karrho. "I need to talk to you. Something is wrong. I can't find Paskir." 

Paskir is another engineer, big for a Vandal. Big enough that his former Captain was eyeing him as a challenger, which is why he agreed to steal a Ketch with them in the first place. 

"Maybe he got lost. Or stuck in some goo." Whatever the Humans did on this station, it involved a lot of… liquids. Yaraskis disinfects her hands at least five times a day. 

"He was going to help me with the nuclear power supply and never showed up. And I heard something in the halls." At her look, Karrho adds, "Something big!" 

"Anything big would have starved long before we got here. Just wait, I bet he got stuck in one of the zero-gravity areas and he'll call for help soon." 

"You'll help me look?" 

She hooks an arm around Karrho and pulls him away from the almost-incinerator. 

"If he doesn't turn up with an embarrassing story in the morning, we'll all look for him." 

Karrho loves engineering. He should be a Servitor's priest or a Splicer. Yaraskis wants to be his Captain, assign him to the priesthood. She wants to get so tall that her head brushes the ceiling, and her arms are long enough to wrap around the whole crew. 

It's better to be here than with the Houses. 

It has to be better.
2563228825.lore_zh:
抵达后十七天。 

卡霍一直在忙着和那些暴徒和狂暴劫匪交谈，他们体型大到甚至不屑于看雅拉斯基丝一眼。他们要利用来自空间站里旧人类的蓝图，合作建造一座乙太精炼厂。他很少有时间陪雅拉斯基丝。 

雅拉斯基丝成不了一名优秀的工程师。她在茧里就梦想着成为一名船长，而不是祭司。她负责跑腿、搬运、清理那些无人愿意触碰的陈年污渍，让空间站重新变得宜居。 

一天天过去，他们的家园充满了各种令人心安的声响：缆绳将各个平台绑在一起时发出的悦耳嘎吱声，裹足和爪子踩在甲板上发出的咚咚声，以及仅有的两名懂得魔眼代码的船员之间的争论声。 

这里一点也不像个坚固的杂院——但它很安全，这就足够了。而且一旦他们有了乙太，这里就会变得更好。 

雅拉斯基丝一边把抹布扔进那台差不多算是焚烧炉的机器，一边试图忽略站内系统音。 

突然，有只手从后面扯住了她的兜帽。她大叫一声。那只手的主人躲过了她的回击。 

是卡霍。“我需要和你谈谈。出事了。我找不到帕斯基尔。” 

帕斯基尔是另一位工程师，就暴徒来说体型挺大。大到足以让他的前任船长把他视为挑战者，这也是他当初同意跟他们合谋偷一艘双桅船的原因。 

“也许他迷路了。或者被什么粘液困住了。”不管人类之前在这个空间站上做什么，都跟很多的…液体有关。雅拉斯基丝每天至少要给她的手消毒五次。 

“他本来要帮我解决核电供应问题，但一直没出现。我还听到走廊里有动静。”看着她的表情，卡霍补充道，“是个大家伙！” 

“就算有大家伙，肯定也在我们来到这里之前就饿死了。等着瞧吧，我打赌他一定是困在某个零重力区里，他很快就会求救的。” 

“你会帮我一起找吗？” 

她挽起卡霍的胳膊，把他从那台近似焚烧炉的机器旁拉开。 

“如果他明天早上还没有带着尴尬的故事出现，我们就一起去找他。” 

卡霍热爱工程学。他应该成为一名魔眼祭司或熔岩军团。雅拉斯基丝想当他的船长，让他担任祭司的职务。她想变得高高的，头能碰到天花板，手臂长到能环绕整个船队。 

待在这里总比留在那些氏族里要好。 

必须得更好才行。

2041120767.name: Spacewalk Vest
2041120767.flavor: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
2041120767.lore:
Twenty-three days since arrival. 

The Ether generator is taking shape, a big ringed shell set a safe distance from the hull, cradled in wiring. Their crew's three spinners are busy all the time making more cabling. 

Except somehow it's too quiet. The older crew are a little snooty about Drekhs, and that's fine—but Yaraskis can't even find one of them to be snooty at her. 

Paskir is still missing. She and Karrho hunted for him up and down the station for hours. 

Nobody suggests going back down to the surface. They'd be killed outright. Their big plan—a hidden warren where nobody will ever bother them again—has to work. 

Yaraskis sticks to the smaller, dimly lit corridors now, where only the Drekhs fit. She doesn't like the big, open ones with their flat, bright lights, reverberating acoustics, and the feeling that something is always watching her. 

Karrho stays at his work. Yaraskis, ignoring her own, explores the station instead, hunting for their missing crewmates. She makes a tally as she goes, checking every corner of the station, and keeping an ear out for the barely audible whine of a charged scattercape. 

A full third of the crew are… gone. 

She hears a muted shriek, something under the flickering buzz of a dying light. Then the scrape of metal on metal. She hunches her shoulders deeper into her cloak against the feeling of being followed. 

The scraping sound stalks her even through her shortcuts. She turns to look back. Still nothing. 

She can't find Paskir. She can't find anyone. There's nothing to do but give up.  

Yaraskis heads back to Karrho's workshop. 

It's empty. Silent as a dead warren.  

Karrho is gone.
2041120767.lore_zh:
抵达后二十三天。 

乙太发生器已初具雏形，一个巨大的环形外壳，与船体保持着安全距离，用电线裹着。船员们的三台纺纱机在忙着制造更多的电缆。 

只是不知道为什么，这里太安静了。老船员们对堕落者士兵有点嗤之以鼻，这没什么，但雅拉斯基丝却连一个对她嗤之以鼻的人都找不到。 

帕斯基尔还是下落不明。她和卡霍在空间站里上上下下找了他好几个小时。 

没有人提议返回地表。他们会被立即处死。他们的大计划——这个没人会再打扰他们的隐蔽杂院——必须成功。 

雅拉斯基丝现在喜欢呆在光线昏暗的小走廊里，那些只有堕落者士兵才能容身的地方。她不喜欢那些宽敞开阔的走廊，那里有平直明亮的灯光、回荡不绝的传声混响，以及被什么东西盯着的感觉。 

卡霍继续他的工作。雅拉斯基丝则忽略了自己的差事，转而探索空间站，寻找失踪的船员。她边走边做记录，检查空间站的各个角落，留心听着充能散射披肩那几乎听不见的鸣响。 

整整三分之一的船员…消失了。 

她听到一声低沉的尖叫，它在一盏即将熄灭的灯光闪烁的嗡鸣声中似有若无。紧接着是金属与金属的摩擦声。她紧紧地裹紧披风，耸起肩膀，抵御那种被跟踪的不安感。 

即使她抄近路走，那刮擦声还是紧随其后。她回头看了看，还是什么都没有。 

她找不到帕斯基尔。她找不到任何人。她别无选择，只能放弃。  

雅拉斯基丝回到了卡霍的工作间。 

里面空无一人。跟杂院一样死寂。  

卡霍消失了。

3712633614.name: Spacewalk Cloak
3712633614.flavor: Tech|Notice|42| All—use of the sample decommission tool is restricted to accredited researchers. If you need to contain something, call security.
3712633614.lore:
Time is suspended.  

All that remains is the appointed task. 

The spinners craft towropes, powerlines, and all-purpose cable, hour after hour without rest. 

The White Captain moves among them with her many limbs. She feels what they feel, knows what they know, as soon as they know it. She uses this information to align, and together, they build something new in this home they've found. 

Every Drekh yearns for more arms than their Captain allows. Every four-eyed Eliksni looks with envy upon the eight-eyed. Every Kell and Archon raises their horns as high as they dare. 

Now, together they are as no Eliksni before them. A miracle. A being of hundreds of limbs, lungs, eyes. 

The White Captain gently touches the limb previously named Yaraskis. Her appointed portion of the great diagram flowers to life in her head. 

Legs stumbling under her, she moves towards the station's prow. One limb may be unsteady, but their great shared body is strong. 

Faint noises make no sense. Words she doesn't understand. The un-Eliksni babbling of a foreign mind. 

The only mind that matters is the White Captain's. 

Hands connect circuits and power lines. The diagram is beautiful but difficult to grasp. She searches for the right shape, the right configuration that will let power flow through its appointed channels. 

The work goes on.  

Until the hands tie off the last cable.  

The eyes look up. The knees buckle in joy. The heart surges along the bright paths of the diagram. 

Somewhere in the joined crowd, a single hand throws a single lever. 

The mind rejoices. 

Orange light flares to life in the cold dark. 

It flares in hundreds of souls. Yaraskis is there. 

Somewhere.
3712633614.lore_zh:
时间停滞不前。  

现在只剩下那些指定好的任务。 

纺纱机不停地编织着拖曳缆、电源线和多用途电缆，几个小时不停地工作，从不休息。 

白色船长用她那众多的肢体，在它们之间穿梭。她能够即时感知到他们的感受，知晓他们所了解的一切。她利用这些信息进行协调，一起在这个他们找到的家园里建造新的事物。 

每个堕落者士兵都渴望拥有超过其船长允许数量的手臂。每个四眼埃里克斯尼族都羡慕地望着那些八眼的同类。每一位凯尔和执政官都尽可能地高举起他们的犄角。 

如今，他们合为一体，成为了前所未有的埃里克斯尼族。这是一个奇迹。一个拥有成百上千的肢体、肺和眼睛的存在。 

白色船长轻抚着之前被称为雅拉斯基丝的肢体。她脑海中，巨大图示中分配给她的那部分瞬间鲜活了起来。 

她带着身下颤抖的腿，向空间站的船头走去。其中一个肢体可能不稳，但他们共享的庞大身躯却十分强壮。 

无意义的微弱杂音。她听不懂的词语。外来思维的非埃里克斯尼族语唠叨。 

唯一重要的是白色船长的思维。 

手连接着电路和电源线。图示虽美，却难以捉摸。她寻找着合适的形状、正确的配置，让电力在指定的通道中流动。 

工作还在继续。  

直到手将最后一根电缆系紧。  

眼睛向上看去。膝盖因喜悦而发软。心脏沿着图示中明亮的路径而激涌。 

在聚群中的某个地方，一只手拉动了一根杠杆。 

思维欢欣鼓舞。 

在寒冷的黑暗中，橙色的光芒突然亮起。 

它在数百个灵魂中闪烁着。雅拉斯基丝就在那里。 

那里的某个地方。

3215894536.name: Spacewalk Cowl
3215894536.flavor: Tech|Direct|124| —ate through another container. What cleaning agents are safe to use? We can't afford another fume incident, István.
3215894536.lore:
Six days since arrival. 

Metal groans. Power lines hum. Things skitter in the pipes. 

Yaraskis picks her way through rubble with a double armload of scrap. She's finally growing out of Drekh scale, lower arms regrown all the way down to her talons, but she's still slight enough to duck through the smallest shafts of their new home. 

An orbital station, ancient and damaged, but fixable, everyone thinks. The station hasn't been inhabited for a very long time, but Yaraskis catches herself looking over her shoulder repeatedly. 

Her spine prickles as an eerie mechanical voice speaks above her head; some old message for Humans, Karrho said. Nothing to worry about. But… unsettling all the same. 

It's a relief to get to the workshop. She kicks at the doorframe. "Scrap delivery." 

Karrho is smaller than Yaraskis, still true Drekh. Even so, people pay attention to him because he hatched with eight eyes. That means he's handsome, one-in-a-million lucky. And he's sharp. He was in on the plan from the beginning. Yaraskis only got tapped because she's his egg-cousin. 

Karrho gestures without looking up from his screens. "Put it anywhere." 

The workshop is one of the creepier rooms on the station, in Yaraskis's opinion. It's filled with metal tables bolted to the floor. They had had to clear out a whole pile of empty Vex bodies before the room was usable. Yaraskis tries not to touch anything as she sets down her bundle. 

"What are you working on?" 

"Analyzing some old mechanical blueprints. If we can splice into the systems, there's as much to use up here as down on the surface. And there aren't any Vex up here. No Hive. No Lightbearers." 

"No Kells," Yaraskis says firmly. 

"No Kells." Karrho adds, "Plenty of Ether if these blueprints hold true, though. There's this machine. It's in two parts—one collects energy, one uses it. We just need the collector for the Servitors, and we're set for life." 

He tilts one of the screens her way. 

Ether for life, up here in the cold dark. It makes everything worth it, the overwhelming feeling of fear as they escaped from Europa, the careful navigation around the hazards on the station as they work to make it livable. 

And yes, Yaraskis might get shooed out of engineering meetings she doesn't understand, but nobody will cut off her arms for insubordination. 

She flexes her lower hands and leans in to study their future.
3215894536.lore_zh:
抵达后六天。 

金属嘎吱作响。电线发出嗡鸣。管道里传来窸窸窣窣的声音。 

雅拉斯基丝揽着双臂的废料在瓦砾中艰难前行。她终于摆脱了堕落者士兵的体型，下臂已重新长出，一直延伸到利爪处，但她仍然很瘦小，小到可以穿过他们新家中最小的通风井。 

他们的新家是一座古老而破损的轨道空间站，不过还是可以修复的，大家都这么觉得。这座空间站已很久没人居住了，但雅拉斯基丝却总是不由自主地频频回头张望。 

一个阴森诡异的机械声音在她头顶上方响起，引得她的脊背一阵刺痛；卡霍说那是给人类听的一些旧广播。没什么好担心的。但…还是让人感到不安。 

到了工作间，她才松了一口气。她踢了踢门框喊道。“废料快送。” 

卡霍比雅拉斯基丝体型瘦小，仍然是纯正的堕落者士兵。即便如此，人们还是会在意他，因为他出生时长着八只眼睛。这意味着他英俊潇洒，是万里挑一的幸运儿。他还很聪明。从一开始他就参与了这个计划。雅拉斯基丝之所以被选中，仅仅是因为她是他的表亲。 

卡霍的视线没有离开屏幕，只是摆了摆手。“随便找个地方放。” 

在雅拉斯基丝看来，工作间是空间站里最让人毛骨悚然的房间之一。里面摆满了用螺栓固定在地板上的金属桌子。他们不得不清理掉一大堆Vex空壳，然后才用上了这个房间。雅拉斯基丝放下包裹时尽量不去碰任何东西。 

“你在忙什么呢？” 

“分析一些旧的机械蓝图。如果我们能入侵系统，这里能用的资源就会跟地表上一样多。而且这上面没有Vex，没有邪魔族，没有负光者。” 

“没有凯尔，”雅拉斯基丝坚定地说。 

“没有凯尔。”卡霍补充道，“不过，如果这些蓝图是真的，那这里就有很多乙太。有这样一台机器。它分为两部分，一部分收集能量，一部分使用能量。我们只需拿到魔眼用的收集器，以后就不用愁了。” 

他把其中一块屏幕转向她。 

在这寒冷黑暗的地方，有一辈子用不完的乙太。它让一切都变得值得，包括他们逃离木卫二时令人窒息的恐惧感，还有他们为了让空间站变得宜居而小心绕过各种危险的艰难过程。 

当然，雅拉斯基丝可能会被赶出她听不懂的工程会议，但没有人会因为她违抗命令而砍掉她的手臂。 

她活动着下肢的手，俯身研究他们的未来。

1160343947.name: Spacewalk Strides
1160343947.flavor: Research|Direct|132| Pull that log. If someone sends it up the chain we're all dead.
1160343947.lore:
Thirty-nine days since arrival. 

Ketches and warrens are creaky things. Cables groan, steps squeak, hammocks rustle. Ether-bright eyes should glow and blink in the comfortable dark. 

Yaraskis had expected they would fill up the station, all of them, with repaired machinery and stolen comforts and familiar sounds. 

All the station's sounds are lonely now. Even the station-voice would be a comfort, almost. 

She hasn't seen Karrho in days. The remaining engineers only talk to each other, and the Servitors groan and bob in the air together in one nervous bundle. 

And something is stalking the hallways. 

It has eyes like an Eliksni, but they don't flicker like they should. They burn steadily, lit not by Ether but by something else. Even the Marauders tell her about it in whispers, so scared they ignore hierarchy. 

Yaraskis feels its presence in her spiracles. She decides to head for Karrho's workshop. She can hide there. 

Then a Marauder swings into view. His eyes are strange and he doesn't look at Yaraskis. He just says, "Come here." 

She runs. Through the halls, leaping over platforms strung together, scoring her side badly on an unexpected twist of metal. 

The missing crew loom out of corners, calling out as she runs past. She doesn't stop. 

Till a voice calls her by name. 

It's Karrho. He's braced himself in a corner of the ceiling near a broken vent grate that Yaraskis knows leads to the station hull. It's too small for anyone bigger than a Drekh. 

She leaps. Hands claw at her ankles as Yaraskis kicks her way up the wall. 

"This way," Karrho urges. They scurry through twisting passages, through the vents and under floors that long-ago Humans never meant for anyone to walk in. They run over wreckage, in and out of the gravity generators' pull, towards the Ketch. Maybe they'll be safe there. Maybe they can cast off and run. 

"What's wrong with them?" Yaraskis asks, panting. Her heart kicks hard in her chest. 

"Nothing." 

Karrho stops on a dime at the vent's exit. Yaraskis's momentum takes her clear past him, into a wide room. 

She looks far up into the bright steady glare of mechanical eyes. Filled with an alien light. 

And Karrho pushes her forward into the waiting arms of the White Captain.
1160343947.lore_zh:
抵达后三十九天。 

双桅船和杂院都已破旧不堪。电缆发出嘎吱声，台阶吱吱作响，吊床沙沙有声。乙太充足的明眸应闪烁着光芒，在舒适的黑暗中眨动。 

雅拉斯基丝原本以为他们大家会用修好的机器、偷来的舒适用品和熟悉的声响，把整个空间站填满。 

可现在，整个空间站的声音都显得孤独。即使是站内系统音，也几乎成了一种慰藉。 

她已经好几天没见到卡霍了。剩下的工程师们只会互相交谈，魔眼们则一齐呻吟着，紧张地聚在空中晃来晃去。 

走廊里有什么东西在潜行。 

它有类似埃里克斯尼族的眼，却不像正常的那样闪烁。它们持续燃烧，点燃它们的不是乙太，而是别的什么。就连狂暴劫匪们也小声地跟她提及此事，他们害怕得顾不上等级制度了。 

雅拉斯基丝在她的气孔中感觉到了它的存在。她决定前往卡霍的工作间。她可以躲在那里。 

这时，有一个狂暴劫匪出现在眼前。他的眼神很奇怪，没有去看雅拉斯基丝。他只是说道，“过来。” 

她转身就跑。穿过走廊，跃过一个个串连起来的平台，被一个突然出现的金属拐角严重划伤了侧身。 

失踪的船员从各个角落里冒了出来，在她跑过时大声呼喊。她没有停下。 

直到一个声音叫出了她的名字。 

是卡霍。他靠着天花板的一个角落，旁边有个破损的通风格栅，雅拉斯基丝知道这个通风口通往空间站船体。任何比堕落者士兵块头大的人都进不去。 

她纵身一跃。卡霍用手抓着她的脚踝，雅拉斯基丝奋力踢着墙壁向上攀爬。 

“这边走，”卡霍催促道。他们匆匆穿过曲折的通道，穿过通风口和地板下，昔日的人类住民从未打算让任何人进入的地方。他们越过残骸，在重力发生器的引力场里进出，朝着双桅船跑去。或许在那里他们能够安全一些。也许他们可以搭船逃离。 

“他们有什么毛病？”雅拉斯基丝气喘吁吁地问道。她的心怦怦直跳。 

“没毛病。” 

卡霍突然停在通风口的出口。雅拉斯基丝因惯性径直冲过他，进入了一个宽敞的房间。 

她抬头看向高处那些明亮而坚定的机械眼睛。里头充满了异样的光芒。 

卡霍把她推进了前方白色船长等候着的怀抱中。

484598250.name: Grasps of the Taken King
484598250.flavor: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
484598250.lore:
A compact submersible of Eliksni design finishes its descent through the hazy depths of Titan's methane ocean. The craft's seafloor landing kicks up a cloud of dark silt and microbial life shimmering like stars. The submersible's dorsal airlock cracks open with a rush of bubbles, then slowly folds down into a ramp, allowing a trio of figures armored in deep diving gear to emerge. The submersible's single floodlight sweeps across the ocean floor, revealing the alien landscape of twisting coral. 

Fenchurch approaches one of the coral growths, running a gloved hand over its surface. "These polyps…" he mutters. "Is this—" He stops suddenly at the sound of a mechanical snap and turns to see Chalco and Lisbon-13 plant a large, mechanical spire in the ground. Internal lights flicker on as the spire whirrs to life, creating a regulated field of water pressure around the submersible. 

Fenchurch steps away from the coral, rubbing his fingers together. He looks to the spire as its sides open like a flower and release several drones, each outfitted with floodlights. The drones swim out ahead, revealing the disorienting flicker of what looks like the water's surface but at an impossibly vertical angle. 

"This way," Chalco directs as she turns to follow the drones. Fenchurch and Lisbon look at one another, steady themselves, and fall in line behind their fireteam leader. 

"Stop me if you've heard this one before," Fenchurch says, anxiously checking the talisman clipped to his armor. "Two Hunters and a Warlock walk into the deep…"
484598250.lore_zh:
在土卫六甲烷海的模糊深度，一艘埃里克斯尼族设计的小型潜水器完成了下潜。潜水器在海底着陆时掀起一片黑色淤沙云，微生物生命像群星一样闪闪发光。潜水器的背部气闸随着气泡的喷涌而打开，然后慢慢折叠成一个斜坡，让穿着深潜装备的三个身影走了出来。潜水器唯一的泛光灯扫过海底，展现出缠绕珊瑚的奇异景观。 

芬丘奇走近其中一处珊瑚生长物，用戴着手套的手抚摸着它的表面。“这些珊瑚虫…”他嘟囔道。“这是——”他突然在一声机械咔嚓声中停了下来，转身看到卡尔科和里斯本-13在地上放置了一个巨大的机械尖塔。随着尖塔的旋转，内部的灯光闪烁着，在潜水器周围形成了一个受控的水压场。 

芬丘奇离开珊瑚，搓着手指。他看着尖塔，它的两侧像花瓣一样打开，几架无人机被放了出来，每架无人机都配备了泛光灯。无人机游到前方，闪着令人迷惑的光芒，看起来像是在水面，但角度却异常垂直。 

“这边，”卡尔科一边指挥，一边转身跟随无人机。芬丘奇和里斯本面面相觑，稳定了一下情绪，在火力战队队长身后排成队形。 

“要是你们之前听过这个就叫停我，”芬丘奇说着，焦急地检查着固定在他护甲上的护身符。“两个猎人和一个术士走进深渊…”

1923008030.name: Vest of the Taken King
1923008030.flavor: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."
1923008030.lore:
Chalco Yong disappears behind the shimmering curtain of surface tension. Lisbon-13 follows without hesitation, leaving Fenchurch to stare at the vertigo-inducing, vertical plane of water. He reaches out, hesitantly touching the surface, only for Lisbon to reach back, grab him by the wrist, and yank him through. 

"Everis," Lisbon mutters once he pulls Fenchurch to the other side. The Warlock doesn't even realize he's hyperventilating. "Get it together." He gives Fenchurch a warning look, then nods at Chalco walking ahead across the maddeningly dry ground.  

It takes Fenchurch a moment to realize that he is not underwater anymore. Liquid methane drips off his suit and turns to ice when it hits the compacted silt. The cavernous space is suffocatingly dark. It will be hours yet before the sun rises on this section of Titan, yet the lambent shades of starlight twinkling in the void beyond fill Fenchurch with a lurching sense of dread. 

He wants to ask, "Where are we?" but the words fail to get past his lips. Instead, Fenchurch gathers himself and joins Chalco at her side. 

Chalco raises her hand, and three drones come to heel behind her. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to visit this site." She sends the drones up into the air with a wave. "What you are about to see is not to be discussed outside of official reports." 

Fenchurch takes a step forward, squinting against the dark, until the drones sweep the terrain with their floodlights. Then, as the alien landscape comes into sharp focus, one word finally escapes his lips: 

"Oryx."
1923008030.lore_zh:
卡尔科·杨消失在表面闪闪发光的帘幕后面。里斯本-13毫不犹豫地跟着，留下芬丘奇盯着让人晕眩的垂直水面。他伸出手，犹豫地触碰表面，不料里斯本回头伸出手，抓住他的手腕，把他拽了过去。 

“艾夫瑞斯，”里斯本在把芬丘奇拉到另一边时喃喃地说道。这位术士甚至没意识到他换气过度了。“振作起来。”他告诫地看了芬丘奇一眼，然后朝正走在干燥地面上的卡尔科点点头。  

芬丘奇过了一会儿才意识到他已经不在水下了。液态甲烷从他的潜水服上滴下来，一碰到夯实的淤沙就化作了冰。空洞的空间黑得令人窒息。距离太阳在土卫六的这片区域升起还有几个小时，远处虚空中摇曳的点点星光却让芬丘奇充满了一种突如其来的恐惧感。 

他想要问，“我们在哪儿？”，但话没能说出口。相反，芬丘奇平静下来，站到了卡尔科身旁。 

卡尔科举起手，三架无人机转而跟在她身后。“我们是现存唯一造访这个地点的隐秘者小队。”她挥手让无人机飞向空中。“你们即将看到的东西，不能在官方报告以外的地方进行讨论。” 

芬丘奇向前走了一步，在黑暗中眯着眼睛，直到无人机用泛光灯扫视着地形。然后，随着怪异的景观逐渐清晰起来，他的嘴里终于吐出了一个词： 

“欧里克斯。”

3278707259.name: Mask of the Taken King
3278707259.lore:
"Keep this talisman on you at all times." 

Black, glossy, and in the right light, the talisman has a rainbow iridescence. It reminds Fenchurch of hematite pearls from the Bay of Drowned Wishes. He rolls it in his hand, looking up at Chalco to see the creases of worry in her brow. 

Fenchurch clips the talisman to his jacket as the rest of his fireteam has. "What's it do?" 

"If it glows white, stay where you are and call out," Chalco explains, choosing her words carefully all while avoiding Fenchurch's gaze. "If you experience any memory loss or sense of déjà vu, call out." A silence falls over her fireteam. Palpable tension fills the cabin as they feel the craft begin to descend. 

"If you see anyone at the operation site that you do not recognize, call out." Chalco continues, occasionally steadying herself with a hand on the cabin ceiling as the submersible pitches and yaws in the disruptive currents. "If you experience any out-of-body sensations or missing time, call out." 

"Ma'am?" Lisbon-13 is not afraid to interrupt Chalco. His eyes glow bright from the back of the submersible. "Where are we going?" 

Chalco stares for a moment, squares her shoulders, and continues. "If you hear a voice that you think is your own…"
3278707259.lore_zh:
“把这个护身符一直带在身上。” 

护身符是黑色带有光泽的，而在适当的光线下，会呈现出斑斓的彩虹色。这让芬丘奇想起了溺亡之愿海湾的赤铁矿珍珠。他把它卷起放在手里，抬头望向卡尔科，看到她眉头紧锁。 

芬丘奇和其他火力战队队员一样，把护身符固定在了他的夹克上。“它是干什么用的？” 

“要是它发出白光，就呆在原地，大声呼救，”卡尔科解释道，她一边小心地说着，一遍避开了芬丘奇的目光。“如果你出现任何记忆丧失或既视感，就大声呼救。”她的火力战队陷入一片沉默。当他们感知到潜水器开始下潜时，明显有一种紧张感充满了机舱。 

“如果你在操作现场看到不认识的人，就大声呼救。”卡尔科继续说道，她偶尔会在潜水器遇到扰乱水流发生倾斜和偏航时，把手放在船舱天花板上稳住身体。“如果你遇到任何体外感知或迷失的情况，就大声呼救。” 

“女士？”里斯本-13插嘴打断了卡尔科。他的双眼从潜水器后部发出明亮的光。“我们要去哪里？” 

卡尔科凝视了一会儿，挺起肩膀，继续说道。“如果你听到了一种声音，以为是自己发出来的…”

3818777476.name: Strides of the Taken King
3818777476.flavor: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."
3818777476.lore:
What appeared to be a silhouette of coral growths in the dark is revealed to be the mountainous remains of Oryx, the Taken King. The Hive god's immense carcass lays strewn across Titan's seafloor. Both Lisbon-13 and Fenchurch are taken aback by the sight, but Chalco advances toward it. 

"The Lucent Brood performed a ritual here." Chalco motions to the shattered remnants of a Hive Ghost on the ground. "We believe they were trying to forcibly resurrect Oryx by combining heretical Hive necromancy with the powers of that Ghost. They were disrupted." 

Lisbon steps forward, unable to look away from Oryx's cadaverous face. "Is that possible?" 

"Officially: no. Unofficially…" Chalco glances at Lisbon. "That's what we're here to investigate. The body is still… active. With Taken energy and Darkness. The Guardians who intercepted this ritual reported finding free-floating fragments of consciousness on the way to this site. Memories from the corpse." 

"It's alive?" Fenchurch whispers, hesitant to approach Oryx's remains.  

Chalco shakes her head. "That's unclear. We need to bring back samples for further analysis. Ikora wants this entire site quarantined and the body exhumed, pending transport to a secure location for further analysis." 

Fenchurch checks his talisman. Still black. He glances between Chalco and the corpse. "Are we the first team to come down here?" 

Chalco looks at Fenchurch, then down to the ground. Her gaze lingers there for a moment in tense silence. Finally, she fixes her gaze ahead to the corpse. "We are the only extant team of Hidden to have visited this site."
3818777476.lore_zh:
黑暗中形似珊瑚生长物的轮廓，原来是邪神欧里克斯的高大遗骸。邪魔族之神巨大的尸体散落在土卫六的海底。里斯本13号和芬丘奇都对眼前的景象大吃一惊，卡尔科却朝着它径直走去。 

“光明虫群在这里举行了一场仪式。”卡尔科向地面上散落的邪魔族机灵残骸示意。“我们认为，他们原本试图通过将异端邪魔族巫术与那个机灵的力量结合起来，强行复活欧里克斯。但他们被打断了。” 

里斯本走上前去，无法将视线从欧里克斯苍白的脸上移开。“那可能吗？” 

“正常情况下不可能。不过…”卡尔科瞥了一眼里斯本。“我们就是来调查这个的。尸体…还在，带有傀儡能量和暗影。打断这场仪式的守护者报告说，他们在来这里的路上发现了自由漂浮的意识碎片。那是来自尸体的记忆。” 

“它还活着？”芬丘奇低声道，犹豫着要不要靠近欧里克斯的遗骸。  

卡尔科摇摇头。“还不清楚。我们需要带样本回去做进一步分析。艾可拉希望对整个现场进行隔离，把尸体掘出来，等待运送到安全地点进行进一步分析。” 

芬丘奇查了查他的护身符。它还是黑色的。他的视线在卡尔科和尸体之间来回跳动。“我们是第一支下到这里来的队伍吗？” 

卡尔科望着芬丘奇，然后看向地面。她的目光在紧张的沉默中停滞了一会。最后，她将目光投向前方的尸体。“我们是现存唯一造访过这个地点的隐秘者小队。”

1252635175.name: Cloak of the Taken King
1252635175.flavor: "If I fail, let me be worm food."
1252635175.lore:
ACCESS: RESTRICTED 
DECRYPTION KEY: LKV4PSM6ZQ$FEN-092 
REP #: 003-TAKEN-156 
AGENT(S): FEN-092 
SUBJ: TKO-300 Analysis Notes 

Spectrological analysis indicates concentration of Taken energy within the cellular structure of subject's remains. Resonance indicative of active Darkness presence lacking both direction and willpower.  

Cellular analysis indicates slow but active mitosis, explaining the exaggerated size of the remains when compared to the subject's last known physical dimensions. The mind is gone, but the body continues to grow. 

Comparative analysis to samples with remains of subject WQS-030 do not match. WQS-030 shows no sign of mitosis. May be a compounding effect from worm severance and exposure to Light. 

Autopsy revealed no presence of worm carcass within TKO-300 remains. Status unknown. 

Prolonged exposure to TKO-300 causes vivid audio-visual hallucinations due to combined exposure to Taken and Darkness energies. ERI-223 notes similarities to object of interest COS-030. 

Catalogued recollections from initial Guardian fireteam exposed to site indicate WGX-003 frequently visited the remains to grieve. TKO-300 is capable of absorbing knowledge and events but incapable of reacting to them.  

It is my professional recommendation that the remains of TKO-300 should be destroyed. It poses a threat to the safety of humanity far outweighing any potential knowledge value. 

MESSAGE ENDS 

ACCESS: RESTRICTED 
DECRYPTION KEY: MNXF8WTV9K$CHA-319 
REP #: 003-TAKEN-156 
AGENT(S): CHA-319 
SUBJ: FW: TKO-300 Analysis Notes 

Attached to FEN-092's analysis are quarantine recommendations from ERI-223 and my own analysis of object NEV-000 for comparison to TKO-300. 

My recommendation is as follows: reclassify POIs to segment queries, quarantine remains to off-site location, and limit direct exposure to frames and mechanical intelligence. There is too much of value here to simply throw away. 

MESSAGE ENDS
1252635175.lore_zh:
访问权限：受限 
解码密钥：LKV4PSM6ZQ$FEN-092 
编号：003-傀儡军团-156 
特工：FEN-092 
主题：TKO-300分析备注 

光谱分析表明在受试者遗骸的细胞结构中聚集着傀儡能量。共振表明活跃的暗影存在缺少方向和意志力。  

细胞分析表明存在缓慢但活跃的有丝分裂，这解释了与受试者最后已知的身体尺寸相比，逾常的遗骸尺寸。思维已消失，但身体仍在继续生长。 

针对样本与受试者WQS-030遗体的对比分析不匹配。WQS-030不存在有丝分裂迹象。可能是蠕虫分离和光能暴露的复合效应。 

尸检显示TKO-300的遗骸中不存在蠕虫尸体。状态未知。 

长期接触TKO-300会因暴露在傀儡军团和暗影能量中而导致强烈的视听幻觉。ERI-223与目标对象COS-030存在相仿性。 

来自最初接触现场的守护者火力战队的编目回忆表明WGX-003频繁造访遗骸进行哀悼。TKO-300能够吸收知识和事件，但无法对其做出反应。  

我的专业建议是，销毁TKO-300的残骸。它对人类安全的威胁远远超过其潜在的知识价值。 

信息结束

3540897637.name: TM-Earp Custom Grips
3540897637.flavor: Tex Mechanica custom-made gloves to fit your personal grip and triggers.
3540897637.lore:
Rust-dirt expanse races beneath Ana's jumpship as it soars across the Martian desert. They drop in before the setting sun.

The Ghosts—Jinju, Bo, Naylor, and No Name—stay with the ship, keeping it level as Ana, Cogburn, Earp, and Moss-2 check weapons and leap to the observation deck of the Watcher's Spire.

Grit rasps against their helmets as engine-burn takes the jumpship to a holding pattern.

Rasp settles into eerie stillness, punctuated by exhalation.

The sights of Ana's Polaris Lance find no targets. Earp holsters a polished Vulpecula cannon, looks to Ana, and squints.

She squints back. "What are you thinking?"

"Easy. Odd," Earp grumbles, chewing the words like an acrid root.

Moss-2 peers out over the sand-sunken Complex, eyes independently scanning the ruin. "Nothing moving out there," the Warlock drones, shouldering a beaten Exitus LMG. "Good."

Ana walks past them. "I trust Earp's nose. Let's not count our blessings yet."

Cogburn cracks his Rime-plated knuckles and begins walking forward. "If there IS something to fight up here, I might as well find it now."

"If you start something, just keep it outside, Cogburn." Ana swipes her badge across a wall panel. It juts forward, spews compressed air that kicks up a tuft of orange dust, and slides into the floor revealing an unlit elevator shaft. The wall opposite of her is stamped with white lettering:
 
PILLORY CORE ANCHOR – SPIRE LIFT
EXECUTIVE PARAGON HARDSITE

"Seen that before?" Earp asks, reaching out and tugging on the frayed lift cabling.

"Yeah. We're in the right spot," Ana confirms.

"Follow you down…"
3540897637.lore_zh:
阿娜的跃迁飞船飞过火星沙漠，辽阔的锈蚀尘土在它的底下飞驰。他们赶在了日落前抵达。

金桔、波、内勒和无名等机灵留在飞船上，让它保持水平，阿娜、科格本、埃普和莫斯2号则检查了下武器并跳到了守望者尖塔的观景平台上。

引擎燃烧让跃迁飞船进入了等待状态，沙砾擦刮着他们的头盔。

刮擦声化为诡异的寂静，不时被呼气声打断。

阿娜极星长枪的瞄准镜没有找到目标。埃普收起一门星狐座大炮，看向阿娜，斜起了眼。

她斜视了回去。“你在想什么？”

“轻松。奇怪，”埃普嘟囔着，像嚼苦根一样吐出这些字眼。

莫斯2号凝视着沉沙设施，每只眼睛独立地扫视着废墟。“外面什么动静也没有，”术士说道，扛着一架破败的艾斯特斯轻机枪。“很好。”

阿娜从他们身边走过。“我相信埃普的直觉。我们先别忙着庆祝。”

科格本掰着他那镀了白霜的指关节，开始向前走。“要是这里有敌人，我希望现在就看到。”

“要是你去惹是生非，就在外头解决，科格本。”阿娜用她的证章划过墙板。它向前伸出，喷出压缩空气，扬起一簇橙色的灰尘，滑入地板，露出一个没有照明的电梯井。她对面的墙上印着白字：
 
枷锁核心锚 - 尖塔电梯
主管典范地下场

“之前见过那个？”埃普问道，伸出手来拉动磨损的电梯缆绳。

“嗯。我们来对地方了，”阿娜证实道。

“跟你下去…”

3388177083.lore:
Ana swipes her badge at a lone terminal illuminating an abandoned panic room deep within the complex.
___________________________________________________________________________

Welcome to Pillory [TERMINAL 0]. Input query, or select command.

[!WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY!] 

This Terminal is currently in [OVERRIDE CONDITION] following a [REACTOR MELTDOWN] incident, triggering an automatic REDLINE PROTOCOL CHECK.  

[EXECUTIVE PARAGON-LEVEL MEMBERS] Pillory system network: core anchor node.

o  ACCESS POINT: Pillory-0, "Spire"
o In the event of a catastrophic failure, neural degeneration, or loss of containment, herein collectively referred to as a [ROGUE MIND] incident, initiates [A.I. CEREBRAL PARTITIONING] and [QUARANTINE INTEGRATION] into twelve offsite CLOVIS station(s) within [NEURAL WEB-WAY].

REDLINE PROTOCOL:
o Check [PURGE] for [!LOCK LOST!].
        System reads [Locked] when in use
      System reads [No Target] when in standby
      IF: [!LOCK LOST!], consult "Containment Failure…", notify AI-Sec. immediately.

o Fire: Test Pillory
      Must read [Ready]

o Fire: Initiate Pillory

o Fire: [ECHO] Project, Alert: NavForward-Koranthin-Network 
      IF: [FAILURE], Activate: [ECHO CONTINGENCY – ARES>KORANTHIN-NETWORK]

o Sever connection to [ECHO LINK] for [REDLINE PROTOCOL QUARANTINE] in the event of a [ROGUE MIND] incident.
      IF: [AUGURMIND SELECT] = Compromised and [WARMIND SELECT] = Stable, [CANNIBALIZE]

o Containment Failure…
      CONTAINMENT INTERRUPTION: REACTOR OFFLINE!
      [WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY]
      AI-SEC [EMP-01-04]: Ready, Ready, No Signal, Ready
      [FIRE 1], [FIRE 2], No Signal, [FIRE 4]

o [AUGURMIND] Predictive Matrix
      Potential Colony Sites
      Chronoscopic Analysis
      MIND FORK II PROTOTYPE INTERLACING
      PROJECT FILE: Ishtar-Joint, Sundaresh
      Pillory Protocol Inclusion: Augurmind - CLEARED
      Working Agreement – Status: Terminated
      Anomalous Report(s), Catalogued - LOCKED

o KORINATH NETWORK ECHO PODS (0/712)
      STRONGHOLD(S): C, Q, N, B, F
      Caster-7 "Nomad Beacon" Weapons Platform Receiver
      Frontier Armament Schematics
      [ECHO CONNECTION SEVERED – MANUAL OVERRIDE REQUIRED]

[WARNING: FOREIGN ENTITY DETECTED IN-NETWORK, FIRE AI-SEC EMP PAYLOAD(S) IMMEDIATELY]
___________________________________________________________________________

Ana skims the readout and eyes the warnings of a foreign entity.

"There's still a Sol Divisive signature in the network. It's weak and disconnected, but it's active." Her fingers enter a flurry of commands. "It's grouping dozens of file references for something called the Augurmind." 

"The Augurmind looks like a predictive engine directing expansion of extrasolar colonies. Maya Sundaresh made a clairvoyant AI using Vex tech… and the Sol Divisive want it, or want something from it," Ana informs. "I bet we've been left alone because this networked Vex signature hasn't been threatened… but it'll eventually realize it's been cut off and start replicating."

"So, we're in for a fight?" radios Cogburn, his voice lifting.

"Site protocol is to blow the EMPs. So that's what we do," Ana says. "But yeah, probably."

"How does an EMP… affect me?" Moss-2 radios, voice uncertain.

"You'll be fine."

"Great. But we're leaving empty handed?" Moss-2 protests.

"Like hell," Ana retorts, sifting through the console's directory. "I can compress this entire site's data, including these 'Frontier Armaments' schematics into a few engrams within minutes. Then we spin up the EMPs and make sure the Sol Divisive can never use this place again."

Cogburn chuckles over the channel. "There. You can replace that rotten piece of wood you shoot bullets out of."

"Maybe you can finally stop using your fists," quips Moss-2.

Ana cuts in. "Before we start the compression, I'll have to quarantine the Sol Divisive signature… and it is not going to like that."

"Gunslinger." Earp's voice cuts through the chatter. "What do you need from us?"
3388177083.lore_zh:
阿娜在一个孤零零的终端上刷了一下她的证章，点亮了设施深处的一个废弃密室。
___________________________________________________________________________

欢迎来到枷锁[终端0]。输入问询，或选择指令。

[警告：网内检测到外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷] 

继[反应堆熔毁]事件后，此终端目前处于[超控状态]，触发自动红线协议检查。  

[主管典范级成员]枷锁系统网络：核心锚节点。

o 接入点：枷锁-0，“尖塔”
o 如果发生灾难性故障、神经退化或物料泄露，此处统称为[失控思维]事件，则会启动[人工智能大脑分区]和[隔离整合]，进入[神经网络通道]内的十二个场外克洛维斯站点。

红线协议：
o 检查[清除]寻找[!锁定丢失!]。
      使用时系统读取[已锁定]
      待机时系统读取[无目标]
      如果：[!锁定丢失!]，则查询“遏制失效…”，立即通知人工智能安保。

o 点火：测试枷锁
      必读[就绪]

o 点火：启动枷锁

o 点火：[回声]项目，警报：向前导航-可兰辛-网络 
      如果：[失效]，则激活：[回声应急措施 – 阿瑞斯>可兰辛-网络]

o 在发生[失控思维]事件时，切断[红线协议隔离]的[回声链接]连接。
      如果：[占卜思维选择] = 已受损以及[战争思维选择] = 稳定，[调拨]

o 遏制失效…
      遏制中断：反应堆下线！
      [警告：检测到网内外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷]
      人工智能安保[电磁脉冲-01-04]：就绪，就绪，无信号，就绪
      [点火1]，[点火2]，无信号，[点火4]

o [占卜思维]预测矩阵
      潜在殖民地点
      瞬时分析
      思维分岔II原型隔行扫描
      项目文件：伊什塔联合，桑戴尔什
      枷锁协议内含：占卜思维 - 已核准
      工作协议 – 状态：已终止
      异常报告，编目 - 已锁定

o 科林塔赫网络回声舱 (0/712)
      据点：C，Q，N，B，F
      卡斯特-7“游牧信标”武器平台接收器
      前沿军备图纸
      [回声连接已切断 – 需要手动超控]

[警告：检测到网内外来实体，立即发射人工智能安保电磁脉冲有效载荷]
___________________________________________________________________________

阿娜浏览着读数。她注意到了外来实体的警告。

“网络里依然有太阳系分支的信号。信号很微弱，没有连接，但处于活跃状态。”她的手指输入一连串的指令。“它把几十个文件引用分组，用于一个叫做‘占卜思维'的东西。” 

“占卜思维看起来像是个用于指导太阳系外殖民地的扩张的预测引擎。玛雅·桑戴尔什用Vex科技创造了一个拥有预知能力的人工智能…所以太阳系分支想要得到它，或者想要从中得到些什么，”阿娜说道。“我敢打赌，我们未受攻击是因为这个联网的Vex信号并没有受到威胁…但它最终会意识到它已被切断，并开始复制。”

“这么说，我们要打一架了？”科格本用无线电说道，提高了嗓门。

“站点协议是要炸毁电磁脉冲。所以那就是我们要做的事，”阿娜说道。“但你讲得对，很有可能要打架。”

“电磁脉冲会…对我有什么影响？”莫斯2号用无线电说道，声音中带着迟疑。

“你不会有事的。”

“太好了。但我们就这么空手而归？”莫斯2号抗议道。

“当然不，”阿娜反驳道，仔细查看了控制台的目录。“我可以在几分钟内将整个站点的数据，包括这些‘前沿军备'图纸压缩成几个记忆水晶。然后我们启动电磁脉冲，确保太阳系分支再也不能使用这个地方。”

科格本在频道里咯咯笑着。“好了。你可以换掉你用来射子弹的那块烂木头了。”

“也许你终于可以不再用拳头了，”莫斯2号打趣道。

阿娜插嘴道。“在开始压缩之前，我必须隔离太阳系分支的信号…而它不会喜欢那样的。”

“枪手。”埃普的声音打断了他们。“你需要我们做什么？”
