50055852.lore:
Ana Bray stands from behind her workshop monitor, followed by her Ghost, Jinju. "The Vex did what?"

Niik peeks over an adjacent monitor.

"The Guardian thwarted their attempt," Osiris responds.

Ana sits back down with a sigh. "Here I thought we only had to deal with one robot."

Osiris raises a finger in protest, "The Vex aren't robo—"

Ana cuts in. "We need to make sure they can't try it again. A while back I found a Pillory bunker. Made sure only Rasputin could access them. Clearly the Sol Divisive didn't get the memo," Ana says, collecting equipment around the workshop. "They'll try again."

Osiris nods, the potential of adventure drawing his lips into a smirk. "Then I'll go—"

"No!" Ana dashes passed Osiris, "It's your night to watch the Colonel. I'll outsource a posse."

***

Three rugged Guardians crowd a wooden table in the Ether Tank. Ana spots their Tex Mechanica gear in the crowd. She sends Niik through the mingling bustle of Eliksni and Human patronage to order refreshments from the barkeep.

Ana saddles up to the table, slaps her hand down. "Wasn't sure you'd show after our talk."

"No one likes dealing with Vex, Gunslinger," the Awoken Hunter, Earp, grumbles from below the brim of his hat.

Ana smiles and tilts her head. " Which is why I'm paying you for the trouble."

"We accepted before some of us knew we were dealing with robots that delete you from existin'." A leather-robed, Exo Warlock, Moss-2, leans forward, followed by a Ghost hovering close to his head. 

"They're not actually robots," Ana grumbles.

"Nonetheless, hazard like that costs extra." Moss-2's eyes blink independently, followed by his Ghost's iris, as if in a sequence.

Ana looks to Earp quizzically, who shrugs, then back to Moss-2. "What is this, a shakedown?"

A grizzled Human Titan at the table, Cogburn, stands. His mountainous frame towers over the seated Guardians. "Moss wants claims to weapons, loot, or patterns we find. Boy's still fresh, grave dirt on his boots. Needs all the help he can get," he booms, then turns to his partners. "Why are we muddying this water, dancing around? Just ask her for it."

Ana laughs, leans back to meet Cogburn's gaze, then stares down Moss-2. "I'm going to assume you shot that offer so high because you're hoping to get something in the middle. Here it goes: you get your normal payment, plus first print of any weapon schematics we find that Tex can fabricate. They'll fit those custom threads."

"Sound good to you, Moss?" Cogburn barks with a gruff chuckle, sitting. "If things get too hot your Ghost can just do it for you."

Niik arrives, distributes drinks, and sits as Ana pulls a free chair next to her.

Ana studies Moss-2 and his Ghost as they silently consider her offer; a cranial implant embedded in Moss-2's skull flashes a light in sequence with his Ghost's iris. "What do you mean by that?"

"I don't have a firm grasp on the Light," Moss-2's illuminated mouth forms a frown. "But No Name does, so we share." The Ghost, settles into his open palm.

"Share what?"

Moss-2 taps the blinking implant on his cranial-plate. "Everything. And we find your offer agreeable."

The party share agreeing glances, then return a simple, silent nod before draining their cups.
50055852.lore_zh:
阿娜·布瑞从作坊显示器前站起身，她的机灵金桔紧随其后。“Vex干了什么？”

妮可望了望旁边的显示器。

“守护者挫败了他们的企图，”奥斯里斯回应道。

阿娜叹了口气，坐了下来。“我还以为我们只需要对付一个机器人。”

奥斯里斯抬起手指抗议，“Vex可不是机器——”

阿娜打断了他。“我们得确保它们没法再这样来一次。不久前，我袭击了每个枷锁地堡，确保只有拉斯普廷可以访问它们。很明显太阳系分支并不知情，”阿娜一边说，一边在作坊周围收集设备。“它们绝对还会再来一次。”

奥斯里斯点了点头，冒险的可能性让他不禁露出了笑容。“那就让我去…”

“不！”阿娜飞身挡住奥斯里斯，喊道，“今晚该你监视上校了。我会派其他人去…”

***

三个外表粗犷的守护者挤在乙太罐里一张木桌旁。阿娜在人群中认出了他们的特克斯机械装备。她让妮可穿过混杂的埃里克斯尼族和人类顾客，跟酒保点些酒水。

阿娜跨坐在桌边，往桌子上拍了一掌。“我原本还不确定我们谈话后你们是否会出现。”

“没人喜欢和Vex打交道，枪手，”帽檐下传来了觉醒者猎人埃普的嘟囔声。

阿娜笑了笑，歪着头。“这正是我付钱给你们的原因。”

“这活是在我们知道要去对付能把你直接‘删除'掉的机器人之前接下的。”一位穿着皮大衣的Exo术士向前倾身。他叫莫斯-2。他脑袋旁边还悬浮着一只机灵。 

“他们其实不是机器人，”阿娜咕哝道。

“无论如何，去对付那种危险对手得加价。”莫斯-2依次眨了眨眼，然后他的机灵也跟着眨了一下，像是有顺序似的。

阿娜疑惑地看向埃普，后者耸了耸肩。她的目光又回到了莫斯-2身上。“你们想敲诈我？”

桌旁发色灰白的人类泰坦科格本站了起来。他庞大的身躯让坐着的守护者显得格外渺小。“莫斯想得到我们发现的任何武器、战利品或模式。他是个新人，靴子上还沾着坟土呢。他需要能得到的所有帮助。”他用低沉的声音说道。“我们干嘛要绕圈子？直接问她要吧。”

阿娜笑着靠在椅背上，与科格本的目光相迎，然后盯着莫斯2号。“你刚刚开这么高的要求只是为了抬高我的价吧。这样如何，你们能拿到正常的报酬，再加上我们发现特克斯能制造的任何武器图纸的首个印本。它们会适合那些定制纱线的。”

“你觉得怎样，莫斯？”科格本坐下，粗声粗气地笑道。“如果事情太棘手，就交给你的机灵做呗。”

妮可拿着一堆酒水来到桌旁，坐在了阿娜拉过来的椅子上。

阿娜打量着正在考虑提案的莫斯-2和他的机灵；嵌入Moss-2颅骨的植入物与他机灵的虹膜依次闪烁着光芒。“那是什么意思？”

“我还没能完全掌握光能，”莫斯-2发光的嘴唇皱了皱。“不过我的机灵无名掌握了，所以我们会共享。”机灵落到了他的手心里。

“共享什么？”

莫斯2号敲了敲他颅骨上闪烁的植入物。“所有的一切。我们同意你的提案。”

一行人交换了同意的眼神，然后简单而沉默地点了点头，喝干了杯子里的酒。

3463666663.name: TM-Earp Custom Chaps
3463666663.flavor: Tex Mechanica custom-made chaps, cut for ease of use with accompanying Sparrows.
3463666663.lore:
TERMINAL-0 LINK – ACTIVE, flashes across Ana's wrist display.

"It'll be about five minutes from the beginning of the quarantine to the EMP detonation," she says, striding back out onto the Observation Deck. "Jinju, you ready for the transfer uplink?"

          Jinju: Whenever you are.

"We'll need to hold the observation deck and keep it clear for Jinju to bring the ship down. Once the EMP starts spinning up… transmats can get a little squirrely. Moss, you, that big gun of yours, and I keep the skies clear. Earp and Cog sweep the deck."

Moss-2 takes a deep breath and racks his machine gun.

Earp pauses from loading cylinders, charge running from his fingertips, to grunt acknowledgement.

"Five minutes shouldn't be a problem," Cogburn states with confidence, his eyes noting points of cover terrain.

"We'll need about 30 seconds to clear the effective range and break atmo… or, you know, we crash. So, account for that." Ana loosens 18 Kelvins in its holster, then unslings Polaris Lance. "Ghosts, I want you calling out contacts from up there. Take away their element of surprise."

          Jinju: Will do.

          No Name:
          Moss-2 blinks unevenly. "No Name on overwatch."

          Naylor: Keeping an eye on the situation.

          Bo: Targets will be marked.

Ana sets into a position and looks to her wrist display. "Here we go."

TERMINAL-0 LINK – ACTIVE//INITIATE AI-SEC, EMP FIRE//ALL

T-5:00…
3463666663.lore_zh:
阿娜的腕部显示器上闪烁着：终端-0连接 – 活跃。

“从隔离开始到电磁脉冲爆炸，大约需要五分钟，”她说着，大步走回观景平台。“金桔，你准备好上行传输了吗？”

          金桔：随时准备着。

“我们需要守住观景平台，让它保持畅通，以便金桔能够把飞船降下。一旦启动电磁脉冲…传送就可能会有点不受控制。莫斯，你和你那门大炮，还有我来负责保持空域畅通。埃普和科格负责扫清平台。”

莫斯2号深吸了一口气，架上他的机枪。

正在装填旋转弹膛的埃普停了下来，咕哝着示意，电荷从他的指尖流过。

“五分钟应该不成问题，”科格本自信地说道，四下打量着掩体的地形。

“我们需要大约30秒来扫清有效范围并冲破大气层…不然的话，你们懂的，我们会坠毁。所以，考虑清楚。”阿娜把18开氏度放进枪套，然后取下极星长枪。“机灵们，我要你们从上面喊出敌袭方位。别让他们出奇制胜。”

          金桔：遵命。

          无名：
          莫斯2号不规则地眨着眼。“无名守望。”

          内勒：密切关注形势。

          波：我会标记目标。

阿娜准备就位，看了看她的腕部显示器。“我们开始吧。”

终端-0连接 – 活跃//启动人工智能安保，电磁脉冲点火//全部

倒计时-5:00…

2169453906.name: TM-Earp Custom Cloaked Stetson
2169453906.flavor: Tex Mechanica custom-made cloak, complete with stylish headwear and impervious to weather.
2169453906.lore:
[Earp: T-4:59…]
Earp is the first to see the Sol Divisive materializing.

          Naylor: Hobgoblins marked. The Sol Divisive belong to the Witness, I hear.

Earp draws and sends shots singing from his Vulpecula through Hobgoblins until expending his cylinder. He takes to the edges of the deck, reloads mid-dodge over a searing line rifle beam, and flicks a Skip grenade into their ranks.

          Naylor: More snipers marked. I wonder if their Radiolaria is different from the main Collective.

Jolting Arc breaks the Hobgoblin formation. The remaining Vex pivot their attention to him. Arc amplification surges through Earp, shortening the span between him and his enemies. He hits their formation like a bolt jumping through open receivers, weaving chains of electricity through the outer ring of the deck, dancing between Sol Divisive frames with knife, cannon, and striking bolt.

          Naylor: Cogburn is about to die.

Earp covers the distance to Cogburn's attacker in a flash. He slides, rolls between the Minotaur's legs, and delivers a thunderous counter-blow uppercut that leaves the Vex blind open. The Hunter levels his cannon with his target's vulnerable radiolarian globe  and fires, leaving a frigid headstone in its place, which Cogburn pulverizes into shards with a backhand.

[Cogburn: T-3:42…]
          Bo: You have contact, straight ahead.

Cogburn lunges forward as enemies swarm the deck, shattering Goblin after Goblin with Behemoth fists like Stasis-encrusted pistons. He looks over his shoulder to Ana and Moss-2 clipping targets out of the sky, Earp drawing a circuit through the Vex at his flanks— 

          Bo: Minotaurs, phasing on your left.

Three newly materialized Minotaurs open fire. Cogburn is already in motion and slides under the blasts on Stasis sleet before hurling a Glacial grenade to cover his advance. Stasis crystals encase the closest Minotaur, and Cogburn crashes through it with shattering force, destroying them all.

Bo: Damn fine work. That's why I raised you. You're the closest I could get to a Cabal—Gunfire incoming, right!

Cogburn draws his Barricade through a Dark sieve; a wall of Stasis erupts to his right against the barrage. He dashes through it and into the Vex attackers, wrapped in hoarfrost mimicry and destruction. His fists rain on the Sol Divisive, an avalanche to bury them under the Darkness they claim to serve. 

Cogburn stands in a heap of twisted frames; radiolarian pools freeze solid at the lips of his boots.

A shot flies over his shoulder, downing a Harpy. He tracks it to Ana at the southern deck edge.

[Ana Bray: T-1:59…] 
Ana Bray skewers a fifth Harpy, causing it to combust in a Solar blast that scatters the Vex descending on the Southern deck. She hears Moss's gun running low when a Cyclops phases into being below the deck. Ana flings a Gunpowder bomb high into the air and sparks it with a shot from her rifle, demolishing a dozen Vex with a booming explosion to open a firing window on the Cyclops.
          
          Jinju: Ana! They're targeting the support structures.

As more Cyclopses  phase in around her, Ana slings Polaris Lance  and thrusts her empty gun hand forward; Solar flame ignites in her palm, forged into a Golden Gun. The heat of her shots leaves a molten trench and pools of simmering Light that drip over the observation deck. Her Golden rounds combust the air and sear holes through the eye of each Cyclops aiming to topple the Spire from under beneath the fireteam.

"How long, Jinju?"

          Jinju: Under a minute. Get ready, I'm starting my run.

[Moss-2: T-45]
Moss-2 braces his left arm and opens the barrels of his LMG to unleash a deluge of Void into the darkening sky. Harpies take evasive action, but many succumb to the hail of heavy munitions before they can align firing solutions on the Warlock. 

          No Name: From Moss-2's right hand, an Empowering 
          Rift flows, coaxing a Child of the Old Gods from 
          non-existence into the descending Vex, detonating 
          built-up volatility into a chain of violet consumption.

Moss-2/No Name takes cover to reload, and the Vex rain laser-fire upon them. A host of Minotaurs push his position.

          No Name: His right eye juts to the advancing Minotaurs.
          His right hand snaps toward them, palm open, and
          discharges a Handheld Supernova that deletes all but
          one Minotaur. It phases to his backside.

Moss-2 drops his machine gun to draw a sidearm, but the Minotaur is too fast and drives a metallic arm through the Warlock's gut, pinning him to the deck.

          

Moss gasps. "Take over. Now!"

          No Name: Moss-2's body shutters, his eyes sync, then  he 
          unleashes a shockwave of Nova Warp erasure, detonating the 
          shield of the Minotaur pinning him and devouring it entirely
          to stitch his wound. The Warlock rises like a marionette, floating in a violet singularity.

          No Name: "Jinju is nearing the deck. Moss-2 will cover the
          retreat." Moss-2 speaks as Light stiches their wound, eyes moving independently of each
          other, his voice layered with another, unfamiliar and frying with interference.

[Jinju: T-0:00]
Jinju brings the jump-ship down through a screen of laser fire, breaking speed just long enough to stabilize near the observation deck. Ana leaps aboard and lays down covering fire for Cogburn to slide in and shield the ship from harm with glacial walls.

Earp boards with a flourish, hurling an Arcstaff into the sky to stick a Harpy like a lightning rod and clear the air for takeoff. Moss-2 is the last to board, Void volatility flittering off his body as Jinju punches the engines. 

The fireteam blasts off toward the safety of the sun, followed by a wave of electrical distortion that leaves the complex dark and littered with fried Sol Divisive frames.
2169453906.lore_zh:
[埃普：倒计时-4:59…]
埃普是第一个看到太阳系分支在显现的人。

          内勒：已标记高等哥布林。我听说，太阳系分支听命于见证者。

埃普抽出他的星狐座来击穿这些高等哥布林，直到耗尽他的旋转弹膛。他走到平台的边缘，重新填装的同时闪身躲过灼热的线性步枪光束，朝他们的队伍中投掷出一枚弹跳手雷。

          内勒：已标记更多的狙击手。不知道他们的活性放射体液和主集合体有什么区别。

震颤电弧破坏了高等哥布林的队形。剩下的Vex将注意力转移到了他身上。电弧强化在埃普身上涌动，缩短了他与敌人之间的跨距。他像一道闪电穿过敞开的接收器一样击穿了Vex阵型，通过平台的外环编织出了一条电力锁链，在拿着刀、大炮和打击弩箭的太阳系分支框架之间跃动着。

          内勒：科格本快要死了。

埃普瞬间闪现到科格本的攻击者那里。他滑过身子，滚到米诺陶的两腿之间，发出一记强有力的上勾拳反击，打得Vex睁不开眼。猎人将他的大炮对准目标脆弱的放射体液球体并开了火，在原地留下一块墓碑，科格本反手抽击将其击成碎片。

[科格本：倒计时-3:42…]
          波：你正前方有敌人。

就在敌人涌向平台时，科格本向前猛冲，像覆有冰影外壳的活塞一样，用巨兽般的拳头击碎了一个又一个哥布林。他回头看了看拦截空中目标的阿娜和莫斯2号，以及在Vex中划出一道电路的埃普—— 

          波：米诺陶传送到了你左侧。

三个新出现的米诺陶开火了。已处于移动过程中的科格本在冰影冻雨的猛击下滑行，然后投掷出一枚冰川手雷来掩护前进。冰影水晶包裹住最近的米诺陶，而科格本则用粉碎性的力量撞穿它，将它们全部消灭。

波：干得漂亮。没白复活你。你是我能找到的最接近卡巴尔的人——有火力来袭，右侧！

科格本穿过一道黑色滤网抽出他的屏障；一堵冰影之墙在他的右手边突然冒出来抵挡炮火。他冲了过去，撞向Vex袭击者，包裹在白霜伪装和毁灭之中。他的拳头像雨点一样落在太阳系分支身上，如雪崩一般将他们埋葬在他们声称效忠的暗影之中。 

科格本站在一堆扭曲的框架里——放射体液池在他的战靴边冻结了起来。

一颗子弹越过他的肩膀，击落了一个机甲女妖。他循着它看到了南边平台边缘的阿娜。

[阿娜·布瑞：倒计时-1:59…] 
阿娜·布瑞刺穿了第五个机甲女妖。Vex降落在南部平台上时，机甲女妖的烈日爆炸冲散了他们的队伍。她能听到莫斯的枪快耗尽了，这时她发现一个独眼巨人正在平台下面不远的地方显现。阿娜将一枚火药炸弹高高地抛向空中，并用她的步枪射出一枚烈日子弹将其点燃，轰隆的爆炸消灭了十几个Vex，创造出射击独眼巨人的良机。
          
          金桔：阿娜！他们的目标是支撑结构。

随着更多的独眼巨人在她周围显现，阿娜放开极星长枪，向前伸出她的持枪手。烈日火焰在她的手掌中点燃，锻造成一把黄金枪。她射击的热量在她面前留下了一条熔化的沟渠，一滩滩沸腾的光能滴落在了观景平台上。她的金色子弹燃烧着空气，在每个想要把尖塔从火力战队的脚下掀翻的独眼巨人的眼睛上烧出了一个洞。

“还有多久，金桔？”

          金桔：不到一分钟。做好准备，我要开始试飞了。

[莫斯2号：倒计时-45]
莫斯2号撑起左臂，打开他的轻机枪枪筒，朝昏暗的天空射出大量的虚空弹药。机甲女妖们采取了规避行动，但很多女妖还没来得及对术士调整射击方案，就在密集如雨的重型弹药中落败。 

          无名：莫斯2号的右手边，一条强能 
          裂痕流动着，诱使着旧神之子从 
          无存化作突袭的Vex，引爆 
          累积的波动转化为紫色消耗链。

莫斯2号与无名机灵找了个掩体填装弹药，而Vex则用激光炮火朝他猛烈开火。一群米诺陶朝着他的位置推进。

          无名：他的右眼朝前进的米诺陶群探去。
          他的右手猛地朝向他们，手掌张开，
          扔出一颗手持超新星，消灭掉了所有的米诺陶，
          只留下一个。它瞬移到了他的背后。

莫斯2号放下机枪，想拔出一把手枪，但米诺陶速度太快，一只金属手臂穿过术士的内脏，将他钉在了平台上。

          

莫斯喘息道。“换你来，快！”

          无名：莫斯2号的身体颤动着，他的眼睛同步着，然后 
          释放出一个新星折跃的消除冲击波，引爆了 
          压在他身上的米诺陶护盾，将其完全吞噬，缝合他的伤口。
          术士像个木偶一般复活了过来，在紫色的奇点中飘动。

          无名：“金桔就在平台附近。莫斯2号会
          掩护撤退。”莫斯2号说。光能缝合着他的伤口。
          他的眼睛独立地游移着，声音因干扰而变得嘈杂起来。

[金桔：倒计时-0:00]
金桔穿过激光火力网降下跃迁飞船，刚好够在观景平台附近刹住。阿娜跳上飞船，开火掩护科格本滑进来，并用冰川护墙保护飞船免受伤害。

埃普动作潇洒地登上飞船，将一根电弧标杆抛向天空，像避雷针一样固定住一个机甲女妖，为起飞扫清障碍。莫斯2号是最后一个登船的，身上的虚空波动随着金桔按下引擎消散在空中。 

火力战队朝着太阳的安全方向升空，留下一股电气失真波，让那座设施变得一片昏暗，到处都是烧焦的太阳系分支框架。

1059495350.name: Flowing Grips (CODA)
1059495350.flavor: A mercurial limb: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
1059495350.lore:
"What is the Darkness?"

You open your eyes and gaze at your hands, seeking an answer to your question.

Searing glow from a tyrant light above you annihilates all shadow from the plain of sand you stand upon in a world full of L I G H T.

The last thing you perceive is a blazing outline of alabaster fingers gripping your wrist in a tight fist, before photokeratitis takes your sight.

The roar of the wind fills your ears.

Whatever has seized you is shaking you. You perceive shouting over the rush of air, but you can't make out the words. You lean closer to your hands, to whatever's clasping them, shaking them.

The shouting grows eager.

You can smell it now; whatever has seized you. Ancient. Rotting. Powerful.

Its grip is strong—as strong as yours, the heat of the Light coursing through it.

It can smell the Light on you, too. It knows you are just like it.

It has lived forever. A gift from your shared parent. Forever is too long.

You think you know what it's saying now.

It begs for death.

Your vision gradually returns…

A harsh glare blooms from the heavens above.

Your soul is weary.

Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.

Your cloak billows in the wind, yet something clings to it, weighing it down.
1059495350.lore_zh:
“暗影是什么？”

你睁开眼睛，凝视着你的双手，搜寻着问题的答案。

在这个充满光能的世界里，从你上方暴君光能中散发出来的炽热的光芒，湮灭了你所站立的沙原上的一切阴影。

在角膜炎夺走你的视力之前，你所能感觉到的最后一件事，就是雪花状手指紧紧握住你手腕的炽热轮廓。

风的呼啸声充斥着你的耳朵。

抓住你的东西正在摇晃着你。你听到到疾风中的呼喊声，但听不出说的是什么。你俯身靠近自己的手，不管是抓着你手正在晃动的是什么东西。

喊声越发急切了。

你甚至可以闻到抓住你的东西。古老，腐臭，强大。

它的抓握你的力量强大，和你一样强，光能的热度贯穿其中。

它也能闻到你身上光能的味道。它知道，你和它一样。

它已经活了太久。一个来自你们共同的父母的礼物。永远太远。

你认为你现在知道它说的是什么了。

它在恳求死亡。

你的视力慢慢恢复了……

一道刺眼的光从上方的空中绽放。

你的灵魂深感疲惫。

你的双脚在流沙中找到支点。

你的斗篷在风中飘扬，有什么东西紧贴着它，让斗篷十分沉重。

3599596410.name: Flowing Vest (CODA)
3599596410.flavor: A mercurial bust: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
3599596410.lore:
"What is the Darkness?"

You open your eyes and gaze upon your weary soul, seeking an answer to your question.

You don't recognize what you see, here in this world full of L I G H T.

It looks different from what you remember, but you can't remember what that was.

You remember the Cosmodrome. You remember your many lives since then.

But were they really you?

Because you died. You die. All the time.

How do you know that's not a whole new Hunter climbing out of that crater?

What if those other Hunters, those other you, are still dead?

Do you care? Do they?

Your vision gradually returns…

A harsh glare blooms from the heavens above.

Something grips your hands, desperately shaking them.

Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.

Your cloak billows in the wind, yet something clings to it, weighing it down.
3599596410.lore_zh:
“暗影是什么？”

你睁开眼睛凝视着你疲惫的灵魂，搜寻着问题的答案。

在这个充斥光能的世界，你认不出你所看到的东西。

看起来和你记忆中的不一样，但你想不起来它曾经的样子。

你还记得发射基地。你记得从哪之后的许多次生命。

但那些真的是你吗？

因为你死了，一直在死亡。

你如何知道那不是一个新的猎人从摇篮中爬出？

如果其他猎人，除了你之外的其他人，仍然还是死亡的呢？

你会关心吗？他们会吗？

你的视力慢慢恢复了……

一道刺眼的光从上方的空中绽放。

有什么东西抓住了你的手，绝望地摇晃着你的双手。

你的双脚在流沙中找到支点。

你的斗篷在风中飘扬，有什么东西紧贴着它，让斗篷十分沉重。

3248049739.name: Cloak Judgment (CODA)
3248049739.flavor: A mercurial gift: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
3248049739.lore:
"What is the Darkness?"

You open your eyes and gaze at your cloak, seeking an answer to your question.

It billows around you furiously, buffeted by roaring wind in a world full of L I G H T.

You see your Ghost clinging to it for dear life with bits of his shell.

"I thought you would never look back here!" Ghost shouts into your mind. "I've launched a battery of spectral scans off our position—what we're experiencing is real!"

WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO BE REAL

"Or as close to real as these… beings can conjure!"

THAT WORD DOES NOT DESCRIBE US WELL. WE ARE SO MUCH MORE THAN THAT. AND LESS.

"The armor you found in ontological space—it's giving off the same energy signature I picked up when you asked the Nine about the nature of the Dark!"

Your Ghost grips tighter as the wind whips your cloak, rippling it like a kite.

"I think that question produced an ontological effect—one that hasn't fully resolved!"

THE LIGHT DESTROYS. GUARDIANS DESTROY. BUT GHOSTS REBUILD. THEY ARE A TANGENTIAL EXPRESSION WITHIN THE COMMON EQUATION.

"They're still trying to answer the question!"

A harsh glare blooms from the heavens above.

Something grips your hands, desperately shaking them.

Your soul is weary.

Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.
3248049739.lore_zh:
“暗影是什么？”

你睁开眼睛，凝视着你的斗篷，搜寻着问题的答案。

你的周围狂风大作，在这个充斥光能的世界里，被咆哮的风吹得猎猎舞动。

你看到你的机灵用外壳的一部分紧紧抓着它不放。

“我还以为你不会回头看这里！”机灵大声喊着。“我已经从我们的位置发射了一组光谱扫描——我们正在经历的是真实发生的！”

如果是真的，意味着什么

“或者非常接近于真实…存在可以幻化出来！”

这些并没有说清楚我们的真实境况。我们所经历的远不止于此。也多过于此。

“你在本体空间找到的护甲——所发射的能量特征，和你问到玖暗影本质时，我收到的能量信号是一样的！”

狂风吹着你的斗篷，像风中的风筝一样飘荡着，你的机灵抓得更紧了。

“我觉得问题产生了一个本体效应——一个还没有完全解决的问题！”

光能会摧毁，守护者也会摧毁。但机灵能够建设。它们是一种普通方程内的切线表达式。

“他们仍然想要解答那个问题！”

一道刺眼的光从上方的空中绽放。

有什么东西抓住了你的手，绝望地摇晃着你的双手。

你的灵魂深感疲惫。

你的双脚在流沙中找到支点。

3240907311.name: Flowing Cowl (CODA)
3240907311.flavor: A mercurial skull: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
3240907311.lore:
"What is the Darkness?"

You open your eyes and gaze at the heavens, seeking an answer to your question.

A searing marble dominates an empty, colorless sky in a world full of L I G H T.

The glare throws a shadow across your vision like paint on canvas.

You feel every particle of your face catch fire as your sight burns away.

The heat persists, though you can no longer see.

You know there is nothing to see, anyway.

You hear nothing over the roar of the wind.

Your vision gradually returns…

Something grips your hands, desperately shaking them.

Your soul is weary.

Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.

Your cloak billows in the wind, yet something clings to it, weighing it down.
3240907311.lore_zh:
“暗影是什么？”

你睁开眼睛凝视着天空，搜寻着问题的答案。

在这个充斥光能的世界里，一块炽热的大理石主宰着空旷无色的天空。

眩目的光线，像画布上的颜料一样，在你的视野中投射出阴影。

你感到脸上的每颗分子都在燃烧，视线因灼热而变得模糊。

即使你看不到，仍能感到持续的高热。

你知道什么都看不见了。

除了风的呼啸声，你什么都听不到。

你的视力慢慢恢复了……

有什么东西抓住了你的手，绝望地摇晃着你的双手。

你的灵魂深感疲惫。

你的双脚在流沙中找到支点。

你的斗篷在风中飘扬，有什么东西紧贴着它，让斗篷十分沉重。

2271877648.name: Flowing Boots (CODA)
2271877648.flavor: A mercurial brace: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
2271877648.lore:
"What is the Darkness?"

You open your eyes and gaze down at your feet, seeking an answer to your question.

You see that your boots have found purchase in a plain of shifting sands that burns white hot as it reflects scalding light from the heavens in this world full of L I G H T.

Staring directly at the ground, you avoid the worst of a bout of photokeratitis. The wind roars around you.

The shifting sand is all you see.

As you continue to stare, it occurs to you that the Tower might look similar if you stood still for long enough. And your boots, sheathed as they are in a thin veneer of Light, would stay pristine.

You smell a rotting stench.

A harsh glare blooms from the heavens above.

Something grips your hands, desperately shaking them.

Your soul is weary.

Your cloak billows in the wind, yet something clings to it, weighing it down.
2271877648.lore_zh:
“暗影是什么？”

你睁开眼睛凝视着你的双脚，搜寻着问题的答案。

你看到你的靴子在站在一片流沙之中，流沙滚烫，反射着这个充斥着光能的世界天空中灼热的光。

直接目视着地面，你避开了角膜炎最难受的一阵子。周围仍然风声呼啸。

流沙是你唯一能看到的东西。

你继续盯着看的时候，突然意识到，如果你站的时间够久，高塔看起来会很像。而你的靴子，在薄薄的光能罩中，会保持原样。

你问道一阵腐烂的恶臭。

一道刺眼的光从上方的空中绽放。

有什么东西抓住了你的手，绝望地摇晃着你的双手。

你的灵魂深感疲惫。

你的斗篷在风中飘扬，有什么东西紧贴着它，让斗篷十分沉重。

306365328.name: Apostate's Blade Grips
306365328.flavor: What is made in the sword world is true.
306365328.lore:
When she hears of Eris, Mara thinks of Saturn. Remembers disintegration, molecule by molecule, the sword of Oryx's intent and throne severing her from the mortal coil more thoroughly than any firearm ever could. She remembers the pain of surrendering, looking out on cessation and allowing it in, against all her instincts. 

The journey across the Sea of Screams, and the safe harbor she barely reached. 

And its consequence: Eleusinia festers still. Mara ever has some awareness of its presence, her third and truest throne. In its placement it is bound with the Dreaming City, looped in the same febrile pulse again and again. Shattered, haunted with sickness, with no true capacity to heal.  

A ruin of a shining thing. Like some would have thought of Eris. 

So this is where that thought brings Mara back: the beginning again. First seedlings after frost, the delicacy of hope. Look at Eris. Look at what Eris wrought for herself, climbing up from the very bottom of the Pit. Mara will not mourn by ceasing, for that would not honor her. Instead, there is honor in action. In beginning to climb, even if one must first crawl. 

Sometimes, as she does now, Mara imagines a future where she and her Techeuns return to that heart of the Dreaming City. She does not hope for a miracle, new-made and perfect; instead, when Mara lets it come to her thoughts at all, she bears in mind the slow work of forming it, the queensfoil and the chisel, and what it means to start over again. The ragged edge sewn up; the broken stone mortared. 

She wants to scar her hands with the work. Someday, when she can, when she does, the name Eris Morn will be chiseled into the walls. 

The sky can always be found again.
306365328.lore_zh:
听闻埃里斯的消息时，玛拉脑海中浮现出土星。她回想起解体的那一刻，分子一一消散，欧里克斯奥的意图之剑和王座将她从凡尘中斩断，比任何火器都更加彻底。她记得放弃时的痛楚，却逆着所有的天性凝视着终结，任由其吞噬自己。 

穿越尖叫之海的旅途，她好不容易抵达的避风港。 

而结果是：厄琉息斯仍在腐烂。玛拉始终对它有所感知，那是她的第三个，也是最真实的王座。它与幽梦之城相连，不断在同样的狂热脉动中轮回。破碎、疾病缠身，无法真正愈合。  

辉煌事物留下的废墟，正如有些人眼中的埃里斯。 

这就是那思绪将玛拉带回的地方：最初的时候。如同霜后初生的第一抹绿意，希望的微妙象征。看看埃里斯吧，看看埃里斯是如何从深渊的最深处挣扎而起。玛拉不会选择停滞来哀悼，因为那并非对她的尊重。相反，行动才是尊重的体现，哪怕是艰难地爬行，她也要开始攀登。 

有时，就像现在，玛拉会构想一个未来，她与她的灵巫们会重返幽梦之城的中心。她不奢望奇迹，一个全新且完美的世界；相反，当玛拉让这样的念头涌入心田时，她铭记着慢工出细活的道理，女王兰与她的凿子，以及重新开始的意义。缝合破碎的边缘，用灰泥修补残破的石头。 

她想让自己的双手随着工作而留下疤痕。有朝一日，当她有能力做到时，埃里斯·摩恩的名字将被镌刻在墙上。 

总会再次找到天空的。

2817890488.name: Apostate's Blade Vest
2817890488.flavor: Sorrow is an indulgence. Never let it consume you.
2817890488.lore:
It's difficult to be furious with a man who is already hanging himself out to dry. Ikora wants to scream "Where were you?" and "How could you let this happen?" Any assortment of recriminations. 

She knows herself better than that. Knows the sharp cut that has opened a raw wound will ebb into a burning ache soon enough. Knows that whatever she would ask of the Drifter is truly what she wants to ask of herself. 

Where was she? How could she let this happen? 

Eris was right. Ikora would have kept her safe, and she would not have been the same Eris again. 

"Thank you," Ikora tells the Drifter instead. "For carrying the news. I know… you did what you could." 

He looks like she has struck him, regardless. Perhaps he would have preferred that. He tries, visibly, to say something, and words fail him. Words fail them both. Ikora can't excuse herself fast enough. 

"He wanted you to yell at him," Ophiuchus says later. "He's looking to get himself hurt." Ikora understands but isn't sure if she's helped or hindered his self-imposed penance. 

She wants to make herself titanium and fury, undaunted and vicious, to tear through the resurging Taken and pay loss out in violence. But she is too used to squashing it down, and now more than ever, she cannot leave her post. With responsibility has come the weight of age. 

Instead, for a little while, Ikora lets herself have sorrow.
2817890488.lore_zh:
对一个已经自暴自弃的人发火是很难的。艾可拉想要尖叫：“你那时候在哪里？”和“你怎么能让这种事发生？”有千言万语的责备想要倾泻而出。 

但她了解自己不是那样的人，深知锋利的伤口已经撕裂了肌肤，很快就会化作难以忍受的痛楚。她也明白，那些她想问浪客的问题，其实都是在质问自己。 

她那时候在哪里？她怎么能让这种事发生？ 

埃里斯是对的。艾可拉确实可以保护她，但那样一来，埃里斯就不再是昔日的埃里斯了。 

“谢谢你，”艾可拉改而对浪客说。“谢谢你带来消息。我知道…你尽力了。” 

即便如此，他看起来仍像是挨了她一拳似的。或许，他内心更愿意承受那样的痛苦。他明显是努力想说些什么，但最终还是欲言又止。两人相顾无言。艾可拉非常迅速地把他打发走了。 

“他希望你对他吼叫，”后来，蛇夫座说。“他想承受这份伤痛。”艾可拉明白这一点，但不确定自己是帮助了，还是阻碍了他的自我惩罚。 

她希望能让自己像钛一样坚硬而愤怒，无畏而凶猛，能够撕裂复兴的傀儡军团，血债血偿。但她早已习惯了压抑这种情绪，而且现在，她比以往任何时候都更不能离开自己的岗位。责任为她带来了岁月的沉重负担。 

于是艾可拉还是让自己悲伤了一小会儿。

1213384789.name: Apostate's Blade Cloak
1213384789.flavor: The mathematics of war was ever written in blood.
1213384789.lore:
Caiatl measures the distance to Torobatl not in light-years but in lives, not in star systems but in the ships that would need to be shored up, the legions re-conditioned to the pitch depths of space. It is not a matter of "if" it can be done, but rather "when." How long to wait for Human allies, piling rubble up into fortifications; how long to stamp out the dregs of exiled Legions in Sol. 

"Here." Valus Forge has brought her a set of records from the Vanguard. They unfold in sequences of recorded violence—blurry, difficult to parse chitin from armor—and a scrolling list of numbers, a death toll that spikes precipitously. "No one likes to speak of it. But the intel's valuable. The Great Disaster." 

"When the Vanguard sought to retake Luna from the Hive." Caiatl knows the story of it, if not the visceral truth. Has heard it murmured, rumors passed from one to another. "But Crota is dead. As is Oryx. And Xivu Arath is severed from her throne world…" 

"Even a Lightless Guardian is still a threat." Valus Forge does not name names. He does not have to. Caiatl is well familiar with Osiris, with Eris Morn who brought the Hive gods under her heel. 

Xivu Arath has no refuge, yet it does not mean she is dulled. As any with but one life, they will fight to the death, with all that they have and more. Caiatl nods with grave intention. 

She reviews the records. She changes her variables. And she does the math again.
1213384789.lore_zh:
查厄托在衡量前往图罗巴特尔的路程时，并不以光年作为尺度，而是以生命为单位，不按星系计算，而是依据需要加固的飞船数量和需要重新适应太空环境的军团规模来考量。重点不是“能否”做到，而是“何时”。他们需要等待多久，人类盟友才能将瓦砾堆砌成防御工事；又要多久，才能在太阳系里彻底清除流放军团。 

“给你。”军政官弗吉带来了一组先锋的记录。展开后，呈现出一系列暴力事件的影像——画面模糊，难以区分甲壳和护甲——以及一串不断攀升的伤亡数字。“没人愿意提起它，但情报的价值不容忽视。这就是大灾难。” 

“先锋试图从邪魔族手中夺回月球的时候。”查厄托不了解全部真相，但知道这个故事，听过在众人之间口耳相传的传闻。“但克洛塔已死，欧里克斯亦是如此。希乌阿拉斯与她的王座世界失去了联系…” 

“无光的守护者依然构成威胁。”军政官弗吉并未点名道姓。他无需如此。查厄托对奥斯里斯，以及将邪魔族之神踩在脚下的埃里斯·摩恩都很熟悉。 

希乌阿拉斯虽无避难之所，但这并不意味着她是一把钝剑。正如同任何只拥有一次生命的人，他们会倾尽所有，战斗至死。查厄托严肃地点了点头。 

她仔细查阅记录，调整变量，然后再次进行计算。

834580249.name: Apostate's Blade Mask
834580249.flavor: There is a knife for you.
834580249.lore:
To be Taken is to yield. Sloane hears it still, that refrain that haunted her in Titan's depths. Take. Live. And quieter, behind it, something that stirs. A whispered offer. There is a knife… 

That part is newer, and it troubles Sloane. Her bond with Ahsa insulates, protects. There can be no claim on her by force. But that says nothing of Sloane's own will. No material yet exists that cannot be worn down, in time. Oceans, whether methane or water, break rock into sand. 

Any yielding is akin to ceding entirely. 

Sloane cordons off any sense of that nagging offer. She will have no risk of slipping. She will know, perfectly, where she ends, where the Taken begins. There is no room for doubt. 

She thinks, in her meditation, of Eris. Eris who went down into the Pit. Eris who came back changed. Eris, Hive enough to stand as God of Vengeance. Does Eris have such a delineation? Does Eris say, here is the Hive, and here is Eris Morn, and never the two shall meet? 

No. She cannot. Or that new Hive god, made chitinous from her flesh, would have been someone else. 

Sloane imagines: what if she did the same? If she took into her hands a grievous knife and said, Sloane is the one who holds the knife—Sloane is the knife. She is sharp; sharper and alight with the sterile flame of the Taken— 

It is not the same. Sloane knows it heart-deep, bone-deep. She cannot put that knife down once she has taken it up. Not like Eris and the Hive. What is Taken is not given back. 

No. They cannot be the same.
834580249.lore_zh:
成为傀儡军团意味着屈服。斯隆的耳畔依旧回响着那个在土卫六深处萦绕不去的副歌——夺取、生存。而在其背后，更加隐秘地，有什么东西在悄然搅动，仿佛一个低语的诱惑。有一把刀… 

这个新状况让斯隆感到不安。她与阿莎之间的联系如同绝缘体，保护着她，没有人能够强迫她。但这并不代表斯隆能够完全掌控自己的意志，毕竟，没有物质能够经受住时间的侵蚀。无论其构成物是甲烷还是水，海洋最终都会将坚硬的岩石击碎成沙。 

任何一丝的屈服，都意味着完全的妥协。 

斯隆将那个扰人心神的诱惑隔离在外。她绝不会让自己陷入堕落的深渊。她会清晰地分辨，哪一部分是真正的自我，哪一部分是傀儡，绝不能有丝毫的犹豫。 

在冥想的过程中，她的思绪飘向了埃里斯。曾进入过深渊，归来后判若两人，邪魔族化得足以成为复仇之神的埃里斯。埃里斯是否也有过类似的界定呢？埃里斯是否也曾说过，这一部分是邪魔族，那一部分是埃里斯·摩恩，而两者永不交融？ 

不，这不可能。否则，那个从她的躯体中诞生的新邪魔族之神，就会是完全不同的存在。 

斯隆开始想象：如果她也走上这条路呢？如果她拿起一把痛苦之刀并宣称，斯隆是持刀者——斯隆就是那把刀。她很锋利；更加锋利，燃烧着傀儡军团澄澈的火焰—— 

这不一样。斯隆深知于心，深知于骨。一旦她拿起那把刀，就再没有放下的可能。这与埃里斯和邪魔族的情况不同。被夺取的是永远拿不回来的。 

不，绝对不同。

665000682.name: Apostate's Blade Strides
665000682.lore:
Compose audio message? 

"The problem with getting attached to people is—" 

Deleted without sending. 

"There's never been anyone like her. Never will be again." 

Deleted without sending. 

"Hey, hero, you know about this stuff, right?" 

Deleted without sending. 

"Hey, uh… you think any of those eggs have hatched yet?" 

Deleted without sending. 

"For all the times I've watched people move on, out of my life—never wished so hard to go with 'em. Knowing what she'd want don't make it doable." 

Deleted without sending. 

A howl of utmost anguish. "What do I do?!" 

Deleted without sending.

1106068818.name: Techeun's Regalia Grips
1106068818.flavor: "Look after the people. The Traveler can take care of itself… I hope." —Amanda Holliday
1106068818.lore:
Saint-14 followed the trajectory of the Hawk as it plummeted. He reached the crash site several miles out.  

The Legion patrol that arrived soon afterwards had come prepared to confront a few injured civilians. Not Saint-14. While the crew huddled under his Ward of Dawn, Saint hurled his shield at the field commander's rifle, then charged. 

Even battle couldn't silence his thoughts entirely. It was unkind of him, to wish for Osiris to be here beside him, trading blows with the enemy. Osiris was no longer helpless, but neither was he unchanged. If he were here, Saint would have asked that he stay inside the Ward's shield with the others. 

But Osiris had run off to Neptune, where Saint could do nothing for him but wait. 

Saint punched through a Phalanx shield, tore it from the Shadow Legionary's grip, and brought it down repeatedly onto the Legionary's head. 

When Saint was finished, he extended a hand toward the nearest civilian. 

"Come. Geppetto and I will lead you back to the Farm." 

The woman was focused on cutting at her scarf with her knife, working with the determined focus of someone performing a ritual. He looked at the faded violet cloth in her hand, and the familiarity of the moment washed over him.  

Saint sank to one knee and waited patiently as she tied the strip of material to his armor. 

Things had not changed so much. He could be patient. He would tell Osiris this story, too, when they were face to face once more.
1106068818.lore_zh:
圣人14号跟着鹰隼的坠落轨迹跟了过去，到达了几英里外的失事地点。  

随后到来的军团巡逻队也许能对付几个受伤的平民，但绝不是圣人14号的对手。机组成员蜷缩在他的黎明护罩之下，圣人则将他的护盾朝战地指挥官的步枪扔去，然后发起了冲锋。 

就连战斗也无法停止他的思绪。希望奥斯里斯在这里与他并肩作战不是很体贴的想法。奥斯里斯虽然能够战斗，但他已经变了。就算他在这里，圣人也会让他和其他人一起留在护罩之下。 

但奥斯里斯已前往了海王星。圣人除了等待之外什么也做不了。 

圣人打穿了一个方阵士兵的护盾，将它从暗影军团士兵的手里夺了过来，然后不断地用它敲打着士兵的头。 

解决掉敌人之后，圣人朝最近的平民伸出了手。 

“来吧。盖比特和我会将你们带回农庄。” 

那名女飞行员以仪式般的执着专心用刀砍自己的围巾。他盯着她手上那块褪色的紫布，猛地感到似曾相识。  

圣人单膝跪下，耐心地等着她把这块布绑在他的护甲上。 

其实变化也没那么多。他可以耐心一点。与奥斯里斯重逢时，他还会把这件事讲给他听。

2438408214.name: Techeun's Regalia Vest
2438408214.flavor: "I think I would have liked the Farm back before all this. Well, before a lot of things." —Crow
2438408214.lore:
While Devrim and the Guardian discussed strategy around a table littered with maps and steaming mugs of tea, Ghost glided silently away through one of the gaps in the roof. 

Once outside, he kept low, following the creek bed toward the outlying buildings. He looked at the broken waterwheel that lay toppled across the stones and tried to remember the Farm as he had last seen it. 

Survivors had flocked here during the Red War, banding together to collect supplies and resources. They built water purification equipment and planted crops. They built new homes for themselves. Even under the shadow of Ghaul's ambitions, there had been laughter here, and defiant joy. 

Now the Farm was still and quiet, frozen in the aftermath of the Shadow Legion's attack. The soldiers, technicians, and medics posted here tonight were all grim-faced and focused. No one was fishing off the dock. No one was laughing by a fire. 

The soccer field had been bombarded past recognition. Most of the surviving buildings could barely accommodate field equipment. The Farm wasn't much of a farm.

But then, it wasn't that long ago that there hadn't been anything here at all. 

Whether they faced Ghaul or the Shadow Legion, the task remained the same. Gather survivors. Help them reach safety. 

So long as there were people to rebuild it, there would be a Farm. There would be joy here again. 

Ghost took one final look at the stars. Then he turned and floated back toward the outpost and his Guardian. 

Time to get to work.
2438408214.lore_zh:
德弗里姆和守护者在一张布满地图和热茶的桌子旁讨论策略时，机灵悄悄地从屋顶上的缝隙里溜了出去。 

出去后，他压低高度，沿着溪床朝外围的建筑飞去。他看看翻倒在石头上的水车，试图回想起农庄以前的模样。 

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边欢笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

4263497347.name: Techeun's Regalia Mask
4263497347.flavor: "We can't be predictable or we'll never find a good place to stick a knife." —Crow
4263497347.lore:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."
4263497347.lore_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊眯着眼朝天看去。温暖的阳光与各处传来的鸟鸣反而使笼罩农庄的不祥之感更强烈了。一位年轻的飞行员坐在这位先锋领导人的对面，紧张地摆弄着飞行服的拉链。

“他们给你东西吃了吗？”艾可拉用从容平和的语气问道。

“给了，女士，”飞行员点头道。“他们给了我们一大碗褐色的粥。其实更像是个食槽。闻起来像是猫粮。他们大概是想让我们用手抓着吃吧？不过也没人相信那东西能吃。”

“那些狱卒是什么样的？”这位术士追问道。“是粗暴、温和，还是…吵闹？他们互相说话吗？”

“都不是，女士。他们…没什么特征。”女飞行员皱了皱眉头，努力寻找着合适的表达方式。“我以前接触过卡巴尔，友方的和敌对的都接触过。他们一般都很吵，喜欢打闹、打嘴炮…你知道的，就像普通士兵那样。” 

艾可拉点头表示理解。她也发现查厄托女帝的底层士兵在女帝不在时相当闹腾。
 
“但暗影军团感觉很…空虚，”飞行员继续说道。“有时，军官会大声喝令，但除那之外，监狱里总是一片寂静。我们的狱卒只会站在那里，一动不动，直视前方，沉重地呼吸着。几乎可以算是…喘息。就个性而言，他们和空壳无异。” 

她沉默了一会儿。“我也不知道原因，”她总结道，“但没什么比那种空虚感更可怕。”

1507307244.name: Techeun's Regalia Strides
1507307244.flavor: "You've got your Light and your Dark, but I've got a couple of shells, and that's enough." —Amanda Holliday
1507307244.lore:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
1507307244.lore_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

1768035391.name: Techeun's Regalia Cloak
1768035391.flavor: "The same challenge rises before us, and all we can do is survive." —Eris Morn
1768035391.lore:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to see the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riksor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying. 

"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
1768035391.lore_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者看到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

2429332885.name: Pantheos Resplendent Grasps
2429332885.lore:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected.

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2429332885.lore_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

751380107.name: Pantheos Resplendent Vest
751380107.flavor: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
751380107.lore:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets.

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
751380107.lore_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

2486500559.name: Pantheos Resplendent Vest
2486500559.flavor: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
2486500559.lore:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets.

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.

3827624354.name: Pantheos Resplendent Cloak
3827624354.lore:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks.

But you are still an icon.

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit.

We try again.

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all?

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse.

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready.

And I know we cannot be ready.

We must try anyway.
3827624354.lore_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。

但你依旧是个象征。

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。

我们再试一次。

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

1074455580.name: Pantheos Resplendent Mask
1074455580.lore:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
1074455580.lore_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

176521975.name: Pantheos Resplendent Strides
176521975.flavor: You know that you will fight forever.
176521975.lore:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
176521975.lore_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

1424596150.name: Grips of the Great Hunt
1424596150.lore:
Venus. A year into the Great Hunt.

Eris and Zavala watched as Shaxx sat with the dying Ahamkara, a hand on its snout.

"Is he gloating?" she asked.

"I think he is too pragmatic to gloat." Zavala said.

"Mourning, then."

"Perhaps."

The Ahamkara twitched, its eyes rolled up into its head. The biochemical glow just beneath its skin grew harsh. Zavala and Eris raised their hands against the increasing glare.

Then the corpse exploded. Dirt showered the Guardians like dusty rain on a clear day.

Shaxx sat silently in the resulting crater, covered in a sheet of green fire.

Zavala and Eris opened their mouths to speak, but Shaxx interrupted them.

"Shh," he said, as the flame quietly roared.

They could all hear a disembodied whisper. But they were used to that by now.
1424596150.lore_zh:
金星。加入大狩猎已经一年了。

埃里斯和萨瓦拉看着沙克斯坐在那只垂死的阿罕卡拉身边，一只手放在它的鼻子上。

“他是在幸灾乐祸吗？”她问道。

“他是个务实的人，不会做这样的事。”萨瓦拉说。

“那么就是在哀悼。”

“也许吧。”

阿罕卡拉一阵抽搐，翻了眼白。它皮肤下闪烁的生化光愈发刺眼，萨瓦拉和埃里斯不得不用手遮住眼睛。

尸体爆裂开来。污物如雨下，溅了守护者们一身。

沙克斯静静地坐在爆炸后产生的泥坑边，坑里覆盖了一层绿色的火焰。

萨瓦拉和埃里斯刚想张嘴说话，沙克斯便打断了他们。

“嘘”，他轻声说，只留火焰在空气中小声呜咽。

在他们耳边都响起了一阵无形的低语。不过他们早已经习惯了。

411363450.name: Vest of the Great Hunt
411363450.lore:
Venus. The Great Hunt.

The Ahamkara refused to die. For a day, Wei-Ning had been fighting it to a standstill with her bare hands, cratering it repeatedly into the ground. Eris had seen wish-dragons drive Titans mad by refusing to fall to brute strength. But Eris was pretty sure Wei-Ning was already insane.

"Confession time," the Titan said, as she hammered punches into the Ahamkara's tentacled face. "I've been wishing this fight would go on forever."

Eris balked. "Please stop, you psychopath. We have six others to handle!"

"No, no. We want this. Trust me," Wei-Ning said.

An hour later, six shapes emerged from the Venusian foliage. Ahamkara. Their compatriot, whom Wei-Ning continued to pound into the ground, was pulsating, growing stronger. Feeding. The others had come to feast at the same table.

Eris pulled her Arc Blade from the air and Blinked.

When the Hunter and the Titan finished their hunt, Eris thought she heard Wei-Ning whisper.

"Did you say something?"

"I was about to ask you."

"Huh."
411363450.lore_zh:
金星。伟大狩猎。

阿罕卡拉拼死反抗。整整一天，韦宁在一片狭小的区域徒手与之搏斗，不断将它摔倒在地。埃里斯曾经见过无惧蛮力的神龙将泰坦逼疯。不过埃里斯敢肯定韦宁已经疯了。

“忏悔时间到”，泰坦说道，她用榔头般的双拳砸进阿罕卡拉布满触须的脸。“我希望这场战斗永远都不要停下。”

埃里斯阻拦道，“求求你停手吧，你这个疯子。我们还要应付其他六只呢！”

“不，不。我们就要这一只。相信我”，韦宁说。

一小时后，金星的植物上映出了六种形状，都是阿罕卡拉。它们的同胞，那只被韦宁一次次锤倒在地的阿罕卡拉，不停抽动，变得更强了。嗅到猎物的气味，其他几个也围拢过来，准备一同分享这顿大餐。

埃里斯从空中抽走了她的电弧利刃并闪现离开。

当猎人和泰坦完成狩猎后，埃里斯以为自己听到了韦宁的低语声。

“你刚才说什么？”

“我还想问你呢。”

“啊。”

59816779.name: Cloak of the Great Hunt
59816779.lore:
The Great Disaster.

Years after the Hunt.

They are dead. Wei Ning. Eriana-3. Toland. Sai Mota. Omar. Vell Tarlowe.

Guardians live lives of loss. Everything around us inevitably turns to dust. When we come together, it's to war. Against enemies of humanity. Against each other.

One of our few comforts is the knowledge that our peers will be there tomorrow. For good or ill. My fireteam has been robbed of that.

I am lost in these lunar tunnels. Out of ammo. Short on Light. I am out of moves, save one. I clutch an Ahamkara bone in one hand, and my dead Ghost in the other. I hear a whisper.

My vision is gone. My face itches from the viscous flow from my eyes.

Though I can't see, I find that I suddenly know the way out.
59816779.lore_zh:
大灾难。

狩猎后数年。

他们都死了。韦宁、爱莲娜-3、托兰、塞·莫塔、奥马尔还有维尔·塔罗。

守护者过着失落的生活。我们所拥有的一切不可避免地化为了泡影。我们聚集之日，便是战争爆发之时。或对抗人类共同的敌人，或彼此争斗。

我们为数不多的安慰，便是知晓明天还能见到自己的同僚，无论是好是坏。我的火力战队没有机会体验这一切了。

我在这些月球隧道中迷失了方向。弹药耗尽，光能不足。我别无他法，只能自保。我一手抓着阿罕卡拉的骨头，另一只手拿着我那死去的机灵。我听见一阵低语。

我看不见了。眼中流出的粘液让我的脸瘙痒异常。

尽管我的双眼看不见，但是我突然发现自己知道怎么出去了。

3606008111.name: Mask of the Great Hunt
3606008111.lore:
The Ahamkara remain an issue. There's still so much we can learn from them but what they've done to Venus… no two Guardians see the same thing. Consultants from the War Cult have been brought in to gauge disagreements over timelines of events. One of our Warlocks stared into the paracausal phenomenon that formed over the Ishtar Academy and shot himself. (He is NOT an authorized Thanatonaut). Luckily, his Ghost hid from him beforehand. We managed to get him back. He has no lingering physical wounds, but he will need time to recover.

We thought we were gods who had found an opportunity for more power. A silly notion to the likes of you and me, but the average Guardian has not been threatened like this. The Titans are beside themselves.

We will take extreme measures. We must. But these creatures have such means… They will flee. Far and wide. Perhaps all the way to you.

Mara, I implore you. If you hold your people as dearly as you say you do, you will end them on sight.

—Eris Morn
3606008111.lore_zh:
阿罕卡拉依然是个问题。它们身上还有很多东西值得我们研究，不过它们究竟对金星做了什么……守护者们众说纷纭。来自战争狂热组织的顾问们已经介入，由他们来判断不同时间线上发生的事件有何异同。我们的一个术士在看了一眼伊什塔尔学院形成的超因果现象后就吞枪自尽了（他不是正式的探灵人）。万幸的是，他的机灵事先躲起来了。我们设法把他找回来了。他没有留下什么身体创伤，但需要一段时间才能恢复。

我们自以为是神明，找到了获取更多能量的方法。对你我来说这种想法显然愚蠢，但对普通守护者来说他们并没有遇到过这样的生命威胁。泰坦们则对此欣喜若狂。

我们将采取极端措施，我们必须这样做。但是这些生物也有应对的方法……它们会四散逃走，逃得远远的。也许会逃到你这边来。

玛拉，我恳求你。如果你真的如你口中所述那样爱民如子，就必须将它们格杀勿论。

——埃里斯·摩恩

2636978448.name: Strides of the Great Hunt
2636978448.lore:
Eris and Ikora stood over a graveyard of whispering bones.

An hour ago, this was a vibrant army of Ahamkara.

"What did they offer you?" said Eris. Her stare reached for a mile in front of them. So did the grave of bones.

"The same as you, I'm sure," Ikora stood buoyed by a gentle flow of Light, above the whispering bones. It was easier to concentrate up here.

"Everything they say is true," said Eris.

Ikora looked down at her sharply. "Sentiment like that leads to morbid places," she cautioned.

"Yes," came the reply.

"If you guide your Light north, I'll take the south. This will be quick—"

"I think they showed me my life before my Ghost."

"Eris. Focus."

"Yes."

Together, the Guardians summoned a storm of Light that consumed the bones around them. They ignored the whispers, but the voices grew louder, harsher as the maelstrom progressed. Soon, they couldn't tell the difference between the whispers and the storm.
2636978448.lore_zh:
埃里斯和艾可拉站在一片嗡嗡作响的骨头残骸堆旁。

一小时前，这堆骨头还是一支活蹦乱跳的阿罕卡拉大军。

“它们给你开出了什么样的条件？”说话的是埃里斯。她的凝视延伸至骨头堆后一公里的地方，骨头堆也是。

“跟你的一样，我确定”，艾可拉被一团柔和的光能包裹着飘在低语的骨头堆上方，她觉得在那里更容易集中精力。

“它们说的一切都是真的”，埃里斯说道。

艾可拉低头望向埃里斯，眼神中透出一丝寒意，她告诫道，“这样的情绪会引发病态的”。

“是的”，对方答道。

“如果你把光能引向北方，我就往南方走。这样比较快——”

“我觉得它们记录了我在机灵出现前的生命。”

“集中精神，埃里斯。”

“好吧。”

两位守护者召唤出了光能风暴，吞噬了她们周围的骨头。她们不去理会那些低语，但是耳边的声音随着风暴增强变得更响亮更刺耳。很快，她们便分不清耳边的是低语还是风暴了。

968831388.name: Grips of Exaltation
968831388.flavor: "You have the hands of an artist. Fortunately for us, one of those arts is war." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
968831388.lore:
Lisbon-13 looked around the grotto and then at his companions. Rekkana seemed tired. It had been a rough fight, but it was more than that. She'd lost confidence somehow. That wasn't normal.

"You underestimated them," Yardarm-4 accused.

Lisbon-13 felt Rekkana's hand on his arm and said nothing.

"Yes," she said. "But it has given us perspective."

"Perspective?" Yardarm-4 didn't wait for an explanation. "What perspective is worth nearly dying for?"

Rekkana looked to Lisbon-13, and he understood. She had underestimated the Vex. Never in her darkest dreams had she foreseen the kind of resistance they'd encountered. It meant their quest had more meaning. There was a destiny in it that had somehow gone unaccounted for.

"Those defenses were insane," Lisbon-13 said, thinking of the implications. "The relays and tethers. The Angelics. The Vex really don't want us to be here. That means they consider this place a weakness."

"Yes, it's a weakness," Yardarm-4 reasoned, and there was an echo in the cave. "Perhaps it's their greatest weakness."

But it was not an echo.

Another voice said "weakness" again.

"Yes. So we must—" Rekkana started, but then Lisbon-13 raised the weapon Rekkana had bade him carry. He scanned the area.

Yardarm-4 started as if hit by a spark and raised his gun. "What is that?" He sounded rattled. "Where's it coming from?"

Rekkana backed up to them, automatically taking a defensive position. "I don't hear…" Rekkana said before falling silent.

"Those with strength enough need not consider the weaknesses of others."
968831388.lore_zh:
里斯本-13看了看石窟四周，然后看着他的伙伴们。雷卡纳看起来疲惫不堪。刚刚经历了艰难的战斗，并不止如此。她还丧失了信心。这种情况并不正常。

“你低估了他们。”雅尔达姆-4骂道。

里斯本-13感到雷卡纳在他胳膊上的手，什么都没说。

“是的，”她说道。“但这给了我们看待的视角。”

“视角？”雅尔达姆-4并没等到一个解释。“什么视角值得为之去死？”

雷卡纳看着里斯本-13，然后他懂了。她低估了Vex。即使在她最黑暗的梦里，她也从未遇到过如此激烈的抵抗。这意味着他们的任务有更大的意义。中间有着命运，却不知为何而下落不明。

“那些防御太疯狂了。”里斯本-13说道，思考着其中的含义。“中继器和系链。那些天使。Vex真的很不愿意看到我们在这里。这就意味着他们觉得这地方是个弱点。”

“是的，这是个弱点。”雅尔达姆-4论述道，洞穴中响着回声。“也许是他们最大的弱点。”

但那里并不是回声。

另一个声音又说了一遍“弱点”。

“是的。所以我们必须——”雷卡纳开始了，但里斯本-13举起雷卡纳让他带着的武器。他扫描了这片区域。

雅尔达姆-4表现得好像被火星烫了下，举起了枪。“那是什么？”他听起来有些慌乱。“它从哪里来的？”

雷卡纳回到他们身边，自然而然的踏入防卫位置。“我没听到……”雷卡纳话没说完，就陷入了沉默。

“那些有力量的人不需要考虑其他人的弱点。”

1078817668.name: Vest of Transcendence
1078817668.flavor: "If you do this, it can't be undone. Some choices change you. This is one of them." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
1078817668.lore:
Their Ghosts all started chattering at once, and Lisbon-13 stepped away from his compatriots to hear his own.

"Scanning. No sign of complex life besides you three. Widening the scan parameters. I got bupkis."

"Look for any kind of transmission, or a nearby audio device," Lisbon-13 ordered. "We're getting sound without a source."

"Got it," his Ghost said, but then it wobbled in the air. "Whoa. Don't got it."

Lisbon-13 grabbed his Ghost before it could fall. In the grotto, their Light faded.

He heard Rekkana ask, "Yardarm, Lisbon, you OK?"

"I'm fine," he said. And he was. Something strange—something alarming—was happening, but Lisbon-13 felt no fear.

As the gloom faded to black, Lisbon-13 set his shoulders. Whoever—whatever—it was had spoken. It would speak again.

Lisbon-13 stood against the dark and waited to have words.
1078817668.lore_zh:
他们的机灵同一时间都开始震颤，里斯本-13远离了他的同伴们，听着自己机灵的声音。

“正在扫描。你们三人附近没有复杂生命的迹象。正在扩大扫描参数。啥也没有。”

“寻找任意类型的传输，或附近的音频设备。”里斯本-13下令。“我们听到了声音，却找不到来源。”

“好的。”他的机灵说到，但随后在空中摇摆不定。“哇哦。不好。”

里斯本-13在他的机灵摔倒之前抓住了它。在石窟中，他们的光能开始衰弱。

他听到雷卡纳问道“雅尔达姆，里斯本，你们没事吧？”

“我没事。”他说道。他之前是没事。有些奇怪而令人担忧的事情发生了，但里斯本-13并未感到恐惧。

随着昏暗蜕变为黑暗，里斯本-13耸起了双肩。不管是谁，不管是什么东西，它说话了。它还会继续说。

里斯本-13面对着黑暗，等着对方说话。

1822544601.name: Cloak of Temptation
1822544601.flavor: "What is it you want? What is this really about?" —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
1822544601.lore:
Lisbon-13 leaned hard against the boulder and reloaded. "I didn't want this!"

He leapt up as the grenade he'd been expecting landed. Shots tore through brush and kicked up stone on the other side of the boulder, but he was already moving up the slope, using the grenade's explosion to cover his movement.

A quick peek from his new vantage point revealed no sign of them downslope. A day ago, they would have taken the bait. Yardarm-4 would have run up and made a shield to cover Rekkana. Then she would have jumped over it to land behind the boulder, a comet of energy that would meteor down to finish him off.

He'd taught them to be more patient.

"What did you want?" Yardarm-4 called from about three o'clock, moving to Lisbon-13's right—but it could have been a feint. "You accepted. What did it offer you?" From farther to the right. It hadn't been a feint.

Lisbon-13 threw a grenade right where he knew Yardarm-4 would be, and then turned. Rekkana stood a few feet away. She'd crept up while he was focused on Yardarm-4. She'd probably been on the move before he'd spoken. It was what he'd have done. He almost smiled.

Her fist glimmered and quaked with an unfamiliar power. She only had to release her grip, and that energy would rip through him, burning without fire.

"It offered me what I most desired, but in the end, it could never give me that. It could only take it away."

Lisbon-13 lifted his gleaming eyes to meet Rekkana's cobalt gaze and raised Divinity.
1822544601.lore_zh:
里斯本-13紧紧靠在巨石上，开始装填弹药。“我并不想这么做！”

在手榴弹落地后，他跳了起来。射出的子弹撕碎了草丛，击飞了巨石另一边的石子，但他已经准备好沿着斜坡向上，用手雷的爆炸掩护自己的行动。

他在新占据的制高点快速瞥了下，发现斜坡下方并没有动静。一天之前，他们会陷入圈套。雅尔达姆-4会跑上去，制作一个护盾掩护雷卡纳。然后她会跳过去，落在巨石的后方，一颗能量流星会落下，干掉他。

然后他会教他们要更有耐心。

“你到底想干什么？”雅尔达姆-4从大约3点钟方向喊着，向里斯本-13的右侧移动——但这可能是次佯攻。“你接受了。它给了你什么好处？”从更远的地方到了右侧。并不是佯攻。

里斯本-13扔出手雷，正好落在他知道雅尔达姆-4会出现的位置，然后转身。雷卡纳站在几英尺之外。在他精神专注在雅尔达姆-4身上时，她会慢慢爬上来。她很可能在他开口之前就在行动了。他自己就会这么做。他几乎要笑出来。

她的拳头闪烁了下，微微颤抖，酝酿着一种陌生的力量。她只需要放手，那股能量就会撕裂他，在没有火焰的情况下将他燃烧殆尽。

“它给了我我最想要的，但最后，它什么也没给我。它只是夺取。”

里斯本-13抬起闪烁的双眼，碰上雷卡纳深蓝的目光，举起了神圣裁决。

316165677.name: Cowl of Righteousness
316165677.flavor: "You say this is for the greater good. Which good have you deemed lesser?" —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
316165677.lore:
Lisbon-13 was already walking away when she spoke.

"You don't trust her. I can see that."

He almost stumbled, but he quickened his pace to cover for it.

Rekkana saw so much. It was the thing that astonished him when they first met. She seemed to see right into him, to see all his flaws and failings, all the guilt and regret, and she didn't look away.

"I don't need to trust her. I trust you."

"And that's enough?"

"Always."

It was, and would be. The truth of that rested easy within him. It was the razor that cut through the chaos and ambiguity of their wild and dangerous lives. She knew what she wanted, and she wanted him by her side. It was an honor.

She lingered behind him, no doubt thinking about their mission.

"Hey, slowpoke. You coming?"

"Yes."

Lisbon-13 stopped to wait for her. He looked out at a landscape somehow outside space, terrible and yet still beautiful in its own way. Rekkana caught up to him.

"Strange, being through the looking glass."

"Yes."

Her eyes were a luminous blue. It was the first thing he'd noticed, before he understood what she could see. He wondered at the mind behind them.

He wondered what she knew about their mission that she wasn't telling him. He wondered what the ramifications of the Cryptochrons learning the truth about the Black Garden might be.

But then he remembered that none of that mattered. He didn't need to ask questions if she knew the answers.

"We should get back to Yardarm before he starts shooting bugs for fun."
316165677.lore_zh:
在她开口说话时，里斯本-13已经做好准备走开。

“你不相信她。我看得出来。”

他几乎站立不稳，但快速加快步伐，掩盖住了。

雷卡纳都看在眼里。那就是他们首次遇见时，震惊到他的东西。她似乎看穿了他，看到他所有的缺陷和失败，所有的负疚和后悔，她的目光没有移开。

“我不需要相信她。我相信你。”

“这就够了？”

“是的。”

曾经是，未来也是。真相在他心中，安然无忧。那是割裂他们狂野而危险生活中混乱和含糊不清的剃刀。她知道她想要的是什么，她希望他能陪在身旁。这是荣耀。

她徘徊在他的身后，对他们的任务毫不怀疑。

“喂，慢性子。你来不来？”

“是的。”

里斯本-13停下等她。他向外看了看外面空间的风景，恐怖却又不失美丽。雷卡纳跟上了他。

“很奇怪，从镜子里看东西。”

“是的。”

他的双眼闪着蓝光。这是他注意到的第一件事，之后他明白她能看到。他好奇他们身后的意志。

他好奇关于他们的任务，她知道了多少，又没有告诉他。他好奇隐秘历代了解的黑暗花园的真相的分歧是什么。

但随后他记起，这些都不重要。既然她知道答案，他就不需要再问。

“我们该回去找雅尔达姆了，不然他得无聊得射击虫子取乐。”

4266726694.name: Strides of Ascendancy
4266726694.flavor: "You said we'd dance through time—reel through realities—together. You can't stop now." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
4266726694.lore:
"We didn't come here for this." Lisbon-13 was convinced.

"Of course not. Who could have predicted it?" Rekkana's reply was quick. "But now, with all that's happened, does it matter what our mission was? This is so much more important."

Lisbon-13 wanted to believe that, but Rekkana didn't seem sure of herself. Her eyes were too bright. She was electric, excited but also scared. The razor he used to cut through the chaos wavered.

"And awesome. Don't forget how awesome this feels." Yardarm-4 said, oblivious of the feelings passing between them.

Lisbon-13 locked eyes with Rekkana, willing her to understand, to return to her senses. "But these things—these powers we've been given—they come from the wrong side."

Rekkana looked away. "I'm not so sure." She seemed to be staring at nothing, eyes unfocused.

"You remember on Io," Yardarm-4 blurted, stepping between them, "we were pinned down inside that shipping container with Phalanxes closing in from all sides, and you—you bastard. You ducked out a little hole in the back and made a run for it. I thought you'd left us behind."

"Never," snarled Lisbon-13, infuriated at this irrelevant interruption.

"I know," Yardarm-4 continued. "The whole box was rattling with bullets, and there were explosions, and we were shooting when we could, and suddenly, through it all, I hear you screaming. It was like a banshee wail. You came screaming back on an Interceptor—the Psion still in it. You were steering it with the Psion's head!"

"I remember," said Lisbon-13 as he tried to step around Yardarm-4, but the Titan moved with him, matching his motion.

"And you rammed it through four Phalanxes from the side," Yardarm-4 said, punching a fist into his palm. "And then, and then—you remember this, Rekkana?"

"I can't forget."

"You splashed that Interceptor across the shields of another Phalanx, and you RODE THE EXPLOSION over the top." Yardarm-4 threw his whole body into the performance of the story. He was trying to make Lisbon-13 laugh, or at least smile. "And when you hit the ground behind them, BOOM! It was the most beautiful thing I'd ever seen."

Lisbon-13 said nothing. He stopped trying to get past Yardarm-4 and simply looked at the Titan, waiting for him to get to the point.

"That's us right now. We're doing what you did. This whole universe is like that container, and the Last City, the Vanguard, the Traveler—they're all inside that box. But we just snuck out of a hole in the back. And there's that Interceptor, and there's not even a Psion in it."

Lisbon-13 narrowed his eyes.

"But here the metaphor gets a little muddy, because instead of one Interceptor, there's an Interceptor for you, a Goliath for me, and a Thresher for Rekkana. What would that fight have looked like if we'd had all their firepower on our side?"

Lisbon-13 let the question hang in the air, waiting for Rekkana to say something. But she continued to stare into space.

"Something ugly."
4266726694.lore_zh:
“我们可不是来干这个的。”里斯本-13十分确信。

“当然不是。谁能预测到？”雷卡纳迅速回应。“但现在，既然发生了这一切，我们的任务是什么还重要吗？这件事要重要得多。”

里斯本-13想要相信，但雷卡纳看起来对自己并不确信。她的双眼太过明亮。她激动不已，但也恐惧不已。他用来割裂混乱的剃刀挥舞不定。

“太棒了。不要忘记这感觉有多美妙。”雅尔达姆-4说道，忽略了他们之间传递的感觉。

里斯本-13的目光盯着雷卡纳，希望她能理解，找回她的感觉。“但这些东西，这些我们被给与的力量，来自于错误的一侧。”

雷卡纳眼神飘开。“我不确定。”她似乎盯着什么，眼神飘忽。

“你记得在木卫一上，”雅尔达姆-4说着，走上前来，“我们在那个运输容器里被火力压制，方阵士兵们从四面八方逼近，而你，你这个混蛋。你躲在后面的一个小洞里，逃之夭夭。我以为你丢下了我们。”

“绝不会。”里斯本-13怒吼道，对这无关的打断所激怒。

“我知道。”雅尔达姆-4继续道。“整个盒子里子弹乱飞，还有爆炸，我们尽力射击，突然间，通过这一切，我听到你的尖叫声。简直像是女妖之嚎。你在一架拦截者上一边尖叫着一边回来，甚至还有奴役魔兵在拦截者里。你当时用奴役魔兵的脑袋操纵的！”

“我记得。”里斯本-13说到，试着绕着雅尔达姆-4踱步，但泰坦随着他移动，和他的动作完美呼应。

“你横冲直闯，从一侧穿过了四个方阵士兵。”雅尔达姆-4说到，一拳砸入掌中。“然后，然后，你记得这个的，雷卡纳，对吧？”

“我不会忘记。”

“你用拦截者冲击在另一个方阵士兵的护盾上，然后在上方引发爆炸。”雅尔达姆-4整个身躯都投入到这个故事的表演中。他试图让里斯本-13大笑出来，或者至少让他有所笑意。“当你在他们身后落地时，轰！那是我见过最美丽的景象。”

里斯本-13什么都没说。他不再试图越过雅尔达姆-4，只是单纯看着泰坦，等着他讲到重点。

“现在是我们了。我们正在做你曾经做过的事。整个宇宙就像那个容器，最后的城市，先锋，旅行者——都在这个盒子里。但我们只是在后面开了个洞。然后我们找到了那拦截者，甚至里面都没有奴役魔兵。”

里斯本-13眯起了眼睛。

“但到了这里，这个比喻有点乱，除了拦截者的那部分，因为你有一艘拦截者，我有一架哥利亚坦克，雷卡纳有长尾鲨。如果我们这方有所有的火力，那么这场战斗结局会如何？”

里斯本-13留下了悬而未答的问题，等着雷卡纳说些什么。但她继续盯着空旷之处。

“丑陋不堪。”

726855135.name: Legacy's Oath Grips
726855135.flavor: "Certainty is our greatest asset. Without it, we're nothing but shots in the dark." —Lakshmi-2
726855135.lore:
Lakshmi-2 knew exactly what she was asking. The query was the question. She needed to be both literal and lateral.

>REMOTE ARCHIVE DATABASE TEXT ONLY SEARCH INITIALIZED
>WELCOME, USER "LAKSHMI-2"
>PLEASE ENTER SEARCH QUERY
>exo identification change post-Collapse
>RESULTS

A luminous ream flooded the holographic display: a few hundred thousand electric haystacks, likely nary a needle among them.

>PLEASE ENTER SEARCH QUERY
>exo identification/OR/name change—"Bray Exoscience"
>RESULTS

The haystacks had dwindled, but she could still spend years rummaging through them to no avail.

Lakshmi-2 stood silent amid the stacks, musing for some time.

>PLEASE ENTER SEARCH QUERY
>search for and identify Exo names; query sub-command: flag results as "exonamesearch"
>RESULTS

There! Now she had just one enormous haystack. What needles there may be would certainly lie within.

>PLEASE ENTER SEARCH QUERY
>query entries flagged exonamesearch; identify exo name -#; query sub-command: flag results as "exonamesearch-#"
>RESULTS

If anything changed in the millions of search results, Lakshmi-2 couldn't discern it.

>PLEASE ENTER SEARCH QUERY
>query entries flagged exonamesearch-#; identify "-#"; flag results as "exonumber"; cross-reference entries flagged exonamesearch-# and exonumber for results = exonamesearch-#+exonumber+1; flag results "haystack"; query entries flagged haystack; extract post-Collapse data

The computations couldn't have taken any longer than the other searches, but Lakshmi-2 didn't know if her typed commands would be interpreted. Anticipation stretched time.

>RESULTS

Lakshmi-2's eyes widened as the haystack vanished, leaving a double handful of glittering data points. But how many were needles?

After only a few minutes of reading, she knew: it had happened before. After a few hours, she felt she had all she'd find from the archive and made a few notes for further inquiry: 

Historical Basis for Spontaneous Reset Syndrome
—Heyka-3/4: Notorious Dark Ages Warlord. Post-reset, became a lone raider.
—Vander-2/3: Rescued from the Great Disaster because reset incapacitated him. Served as City guard post-reset. Ghost destroyed on Luna. (Pre- or post-reset? Do Ghosts protect Exo Guardians from spontaneous reset?) 
—Lilakee-5/6/7: Curious case. Known sufferer of severe DER-related nightmares and outbursts. Commandeered a jumpship and vanished.
—Selass-7/8: Technician sent to data mine Titan settlements. Reset occurred in return transit. Post-reset, remained research technician assisting Cryptarchs.

These were Exos that had seemingly rebooted themselves; they had wiped away their own identities and taken a new number. Or had someone else somehow done it for them? Could there be records of some of them outside the archive? Could one or two still be alive?

Lakshmi-2 closed her eyes, slowed her breathing, and focused on the dichotomy of her emotions. What she'd discovered felt momentous, but she knew her colleagues would treat it as a curiosity. People often discounted Exos. It was if there were a line between frame and flesh and blood. The idea offended Lakshmi-2, but at the same time, she knew Exos were different enough from normal Humans. The existence of Exos who reset themselves—for whatever reason—proved that.

Or did they?

A quick search of the medical archives turned up ailments and causes considered quackery by the Golden Age: psychogenic amnesia, dissociative fugue, retrograde memory loss, personal obliteration, betrayal theory…

What did it all mean?

Lakshmi-2 felt uncertain, and that always boded ill.
726855135.lore_zh:
拉克希米-2很清楚知道她问得是什么。质疑就是问题。她既要有字面意思，又要有侧面意思。

远程档案库数据库文字搜索初始化已完成
>欢迎你，用户“拉克希米-2”
>请输入搜索请求
>大崩溃后exo身份变化
>结果

全息显示屏上泛起了一片光亮：这就好像几十万的电子草垛里，要找其中可能不存在的一根针。

请输入搜索请求
>exo身份/或/名字更改—“布瑞Exo科技”
>结果

干草堆越来越少，但她依然可能要花上几年的时间去翻阅，最后却毫无收获。

拉克希米-2沉默地站在干草堆中，沉思了一会。

请输入搜索请求
>搜索Exo身份和名字；请求子命令：将结果标记为“exo名称搜索”
>结果

找到了！现在她要面对的只有一个巨型干草堆了。要是有针的话，肯定就在这里面。

请输入搜索请求
>请求条目标记为exo名字搜索；Exo身份-#; 请求子命令：将结果标记为“exo名称搜索-#”
>结果

如果数百万个搜索结果中有什么变化，拉克希米-2号无法分辨。

请输入搜索请求
>请求条目标记为exo名称搜索-#;身份"-#"；将结果标记为"exonumber";对照检索条目标记为exonamesearch-#和exonumber，结果为 = exonamesearch-#+exonumber+1；结果标记为“干草堆”'请求条目标记为干草堆；提取大崩溃数据

计算的时间不会比其他搜索的时间长，但拉克希米-2不知道她输入的命令是否能够被解读。期待的心情仿佛拉长了时间。

结果

拉克希米-2睁大了眼睛，干草堆消失了，留下了两堆发着光的数据点。但有多少是要找的针呢？

在读了几分钟后，她知道了：这种情况已经出现过。几个小时后，她觉得自己已经从档案馆里找到了所有的东西，于是做了一些记录，以便进一步查询：

自发性复位综合征的历史基础
—Heyka-3/4:臭名昭著的黑暗纪元军阀。重置之后，成为一个孤独的劫掠者。
—Vander-2/3:因为重置使他丧失了能力，所以他从大灾难中被救了出来。重置后担任城市守卫。月球上被摧毁的机灵。（重置前还是重置后？机灵能保护Exo守护者不被自发重置吗？）
—Lilakee-5/6/7:奇怪的情况。已知患有与DER相关的严重噩梦和爆发。抢了一搜跃迁飞船后消失。
—Selass-7/8:技术员被派去挖掘泰坦定居点的数据。回程时发生重置。重置后，仍然是协助解密大师的研究技术人员。

这些都是似乎重新启动了自己的Exo，它们抹去了自己的身份，取了一个新的编号。或许是有人以某种方式这样做的？档案馆外会不会有其中一些人的记录？会不会有一两个还活着的？

拉克希米-2闭上眼睛，放慢呼吸，专注于情绪的二元对立。她的发现让她觉得意义重大，但她知道她的同事们会把这仅仅当做一次好奇心。人们经常会UI忽视Exo。机械仆从和血肉之躯之间似乎有条线隔离开。这个想法让拉克希米-2号很不爽，但同时她也知道Exo和正常人类很不同。不管是什么原因，重置自己的Exo的存在证明了这一点。

还是说，真的是这样吗？

快速搜索医学档案，发现了被黄金时代认为是庸医的疾病和病因：精神性失忆症、解离性漫游、逆行性失忆、个人遗忘、背叛理论……

这都是什么意思？

拉克希米-2号感到不确定，这是个不好的兆头。
