1657654553.name: Legacy's Oath Vest
1657654553.flavor: "Every day is a recommitment to my path." —Elsie Bray
1657654553.lore:
I'm so angry, so frustrated. I've lost family and friends. The world has been ripped apart, and I'm left standing in the void at the center. Why me? Why am I left alone here? Survivor's guilt doesn't begin to describe my pain. I miss my family. I don't know what family means when I don't even carry the blood to tie us together any longer. At times, I feel I was made to be a walking advertisement for BrayTech. A product. "Look how successful the Exo Project was." I'm just a collection of memories and impulses—some kind of abomination.

I know that can't be true. I… just don't know what to do. I must be meant for more. I can't live a "normal life." I never had a chance for that, not with the family I was born into. I'm filled with rage. I want to correct the mistakes of my predecessors. The blights on humanity unleashed by my grandfather… could that be his intent when he made me? Was I born from unacknowledged guilt and some fear of consequence? He seemed incapable of those emotions, but he was only Human in the end. 

Whether he planned this or not, I'm going to destroy that damned crypt, and I'll rid the world of the shadow cast by Clovis Bray and his infernal creations.

I also know what that means for me. One day my mission will end, and I won't have to wonder what to do with myself. I will be the last to go.
1657654553.lore_zh:
我很愤怒，很沮丧。我失去了家人和朋友。世界已经被撕裂，而我却站在中心的虚空中。为什么是我？为什么我被独自丢在这里？幸存者的罪恶感并不能形容我的痛苦。我想念我的家人。当血缘都没有再把我们联系在一起的时候，我不知道什么叫家人。有时，我觉得自己是为布瑞科技做了一个行走的广告。一个产品。“看看，Exo的项目多么成功。”我只是记忆和冲动的集合体——某种畸形的东西。

我知道那不可能是真的。我只是……不知道该怎么做。我肯定有别的意义。我不能过“正常生活”。我从来没有这样的机会，我出生的家庭也没有这样的机会。我充满愤怒。我想修正我的前任们的错误。我爷爷对人性的摧残……难道这就是他造我时的意图？我是否因为不被承认的罪恶感，和对后果的某种恐惧而生？他似乎无法承受那些情感，但他终究只是人。

不管他是不是计划这样做，我都要毁掉那个该死的墓穴，我要让世界摆脱克洛维斯·布雷和他的地狱造物的阴影。

我也知道这对我意味着什么。有一天我的任务将会结束，我不必再想自己该怎么做。我会是最后走的人。

不管他是不是计划这样做，我都要毁掉那个该死的墓穴，我要让世界摆脱克洛维斯·布雷和他的地狱造物的阴影。

我也知道这对我意味着什么。有一天我的任务将会结束，我不必再想自己该怎么做。我会是最后走的人。

3013397204.name: Legacy's Oath Cloak
3013397204.flavor: "How would one such as myself commit Human error when I am no longer Human?" —Hari-5
3013397204.lore:
"Do you know why we're here?"

"Of course. You invited me to this interview… Oh, no tea, thank you. I don't drink."

"You're aware of why—"

"Why you're interested? Of course. I've been doing a lot of research since I awoke. You're from something called the Future War Cult. Odd name for what seems to be sensible precaution."

"Yes…"

"And so your interest in my case must have something to do with the Cult's 'sensible precaution.' I gather that our kind were made as some sort of super soldiers long ago, for a war no one seems to know much about. And now, we live much like other people in a universe that has gone to war with itself. Although, I think we Exos might also be immortal. Isn't it odd?"

"Much of this conversation is odd."

"I'm not talking about us. I mean that given a whole universe seemingly at war, with invading aliens of all sorts, there's a people specifically designed to be super soldiers. And yet, we Exos just do as we like?"

"Go on."

"Take me, for example. I'm a researcher—a scientist. And I'm a damn good scientist, from all that I've read. And when I woke up, there was nothing more natural for me to do than simply carry on doing that. Super soldier? More like super scientist. I'd hardly know which end of a gun to point at them. But here? In my lab? I touch a machine or just look at it, and I know how to use it. It's like… like…"

"Riding a bicycle."

"A what?" 

"Never mind. Tell me more about what happened when you woke up."

"Well. Suddenly I was here, in my lab, but lying on the floor over there. I looked around, and it was like I said. I just knew how everything worked. But I couldn't remember anything."

"Nothing at all? Not even your name?"

"No. Nothing. Well, language and motor skills and so on, obviously. But it was the oddest sensation. I've since looked up how I might describe it, and I never found anything better than déjà vu. Everything was familiar but foreign. Even my own body. It was… unsettling. But then I found files of some of my research. And I knew it was mine. It was like reading something I'd forgotten I'd written. I didn't remember where or when or even why I'd written it, but they were clearly my thoughts. It was clearly me. And that's how I found my old name."

"Yes, let's talk about your old name. The number. Why did you change it?"

"It… it wasn't… it didn't… A new designation was necessary."

"Are you all right?"

"Yes. I'm fine. Why?"

"Something happened to you there. Your eyes. Nothing moved." 

"Well, excuse me. I don't know what you mean. So… do you have a theory?"

"Several. What were you researching before you… before you changed your name?"

"Ah, a project with my colleagues, Gonzalez and Mwangi. Delightful people. Have you met?"

"Briefly. Your research?"

"Yes, well, I won't bore you with the technical details, but we're engaged in a study of dark matter and dark energy. It seems to be my main area of interest. I awoke when I'd been in the midst of looking into…"

"Yes?"

"Well… errors."

"Errors?"

"Yes. The data we've collected has peculiar… anomalies. Between you and me, I think it stems from human error. But I'm going back over all of my previous work to see if I missed something."

"And have you? Found anything amiss?"

"No. If anything, it's been quite therapeutic. It turns out that I'm a damn good scientist."

"…"

"Um… you know, it's odd. I find myself quite parched. Would you mind pouring me some of that tea?"
3013397204.lore_zh:
“你知道我们为什么会在这里吗？”

“当然。你邀请我参加这场放摊……哦，不要茶，谢谢。我不喝。”

“你明白为什么——”

“你为什么会感兴趣？当然。自从我醒来后我做了很多研究。你来自一个“未来战争狂热者”的东西。奇怪的名字，看似合理的预防措施。”

“是的……”

“所以你对我的情况感兴趣，一定和这些狂热者‘明智的预防措施'有关。我猜想，我们这种人很早以前就被制造成了某种超级士兵，为了打一场似乎没人知道的战争。而现在，我们和其他人一样，生活在一个与自己开战的宇宙中。但是，我想我们Exo可能是不死的。这不是很奇怪吗？”

“这场对话很多内容都很奇怪。”

“我不是在说我们。我的意思是，整个宇宙似乎都处于战争状态，面对各种入侵的外星人，有一种人，专门被设计成为超级士兵。而我们Exo就能随心所欲吗？”

“继续。”

“就拿我来举例子吧，我是个研究院——科学家。从我读到的所有东西来看，我他妈是个优秀的科学家。而当我醒来的时候，对我来说，没有什么比简单地继续做下去更自然的事了。超级士兵？更像是个超级科学家。我都不知道该把枪的哪一端对着他们。但在这里，我的实验室里。我只要碰一碰机器，或者看一眼，就知道怎么用。就像……就像……”

“骑自行车。”

“什么？”

“没事，跟我说说你醒来的时候发生了什么。”

“是这样的，我突然出现在这里，在我的实验室里，但是躺在那边的地板上。我四周看了看，就像我之前说的。我就知道所有东西怎么运作。但我什么都记不起来。”

“什么都记不起？你的名字也想不起吗？”

“是的，什么都记不起。当然了，语言和运动技能还有别的，还是记得。但就是这感觉很奇怪。我后来查了一下，关于怎么形容这种感觉，我再也找不到比‘似曾相识'更好的词了。一切都既熟悉又陌生。甚至我自己的身体。让人……感觉不安。但随后我找到一些我研究的文件。我知道那是我的。就像读到了我忘了自己所写的东西。我不记得是在什么时候，什么地方写的，甚至不记得为什么要写，但它们显然是我的想法。很显然就是我。这就是我怎么知道自己旧名字的。”

“是的，谈谈你的旧名字吧。那个编号。为什么你要改？”

“就……不是……没有……一个新的代号是必要的。”

“你没事吧？”

“是的，我没事。怎么了？”

“你在那里发生了某些事。你的眼睛，什么都没动。”

“抱歉，我不明白你的意思。那么……你有理论了吗？”

“有几个。在你……在你改名字之前，你在研究什么？”

“啊，和我同事冈萨雷斯和姆旺吉一起进行的项目。他们是很好的人。你见过了吗？”

“简单见过。你的研究呢？”

“是的，好吧，我就不用技术细节折腾你了。但我们正在从事暗物质和暗能量的研究。这好像是我感兴趣的领域。我醒来的时候，我一直在研究……”

“什么？”

“嗯……错误。”

“错误？”

“是的，我们收集的数据非常……异常。就我们俩之间来说，我认为这源于人为的错误。但我要把我以前的工作都翻一遍，看看有没有遗漏的地方。”

“你呢？发现什么不对劲的地方吗？”

“不，如果有什么不对劲的，那就是治疗效果相当好。结果我他妈真是个优秀的科学家。”

“……”

“呃……你知道的，这很奇怪。我发现自己很渴。能给我倒点茶吗？”

3572161646.name: Legacy's Oath Mask
3572161646.flavor: "It's not just what I'm capable of. It's how I use it that makes the difference." —Ada-1
3572161646.lore:
We're all thrust into situations we find unseemly. The real test is what you do when you find yourself in one. We're staring down the barrel at another Collapse. I can see all the signs around me. There is no denying it anymore. The Darkness has arrived. Now, I'm being tested once again.

I carry a great potential inside. To create. To forge. No one else can do what I do… and a part of me thinks I should keep it that way. I'm not sure I want to share this gift. It's a tremendous responsibility, this power. I know how I use it. Can I trust anyone else to do so reliably? Would this ability be corrupted, squandered; should others have access? I can already see the Darkness manipulating it to its advantage.

On the other hand, it would push Exos everywhere ahead technologically, elevating our standing and truly making us superior. I've always felt the Last City could use more protection than the Vanguard could afford. I could provide that, widespread, and make it readily available to all. March myself right into the Deep Stone Crypt and use the Bray Exoscience Facility to its fullest capability. Stave off this dark night. The armory is already known. It's a pointless institution if it's not providing help to those who need it.

Where would that leave me though? I imagine I'd be just another Exo, reducing the Black Armory and its traditions to some moot forgotten foundry. That's not the legacy I'm trying to preserve. The armory… me… we're more than just the weapons we make. What we represent—the values we stand for—would be lost without us and would run astray without supervision. Yet, if I don't act now, there won't be anything left to preserve. The Darkness will not yield. The Guardians will require more from me. The armory needs to evolve.
3572161646.lore_zh:
我们都会被迫被推入我们觉得不体面的情况。真正的考验是当你发现自己身处其中时，你会怎么做。我们正盯着另一个崩溃的桶。我可以看到我周围的所有迹象。再也无法否认。暗影已经到来。现在，我又一次接受了考验。

我的内心充满了巨大的潜力，创造，锻造，没有人可以像我这样做……而我内心深处认为我应该保持这种状态。我不确定我是否想分享这份礼物。这是一个巨大的责任，这种力量。我知道我该如何使用。我可以相信别人也能可靠地做到这一点吗？这种能力会不会被腐化，被挥霍，其他人是否应该有机会获得这种能力？我已经可以看到暗影操纵它发挥的优势。

另一方面，它也会让各地的外星生物在技术上领先于我们，提升我们的地位，让我们真正变得更优秀。我一直觉得最后的城市需要更多的保护，而不仅仅先锋所能提供的。我可以提供这样的保护，广泛的保护，并且让所有人都能随时使用。我自己直接进入深岩墓穴，充分发挥布雷Exo科学设施的作用。抵御黑夜。军械库已经有人知道。如果不能为需要帮助的人提供帮助，那它就是一个毫无意义的机构。

那我又该何去何从？我想我只是另一个Exo，把黑色军械库和它的传统缩减成某种被遗忘的铸造厂。这不是我想要保存的传承。军械库……我……我们不仅仅是我们制作出来的武器。我们所代表的东西——我们所代表的价值——没有了我们，这一切就会失去，没有监督，就会误入歧途。但是，如果现在不行动，就没有什么东西可以保护了。暗影不会屈服。守护者会对我有更多要求。军械库需要进化。

那我又该何去何从？我想我只是另一个Exo，把黑色军械库和它的传统缩减成某种被遗忘的铸造厂。这不是我想要保存的传承。军械库……我……我们不仅仅是我们制作出来的武器。我们所代表的东西——我们所代表的价值——没有了我们，这一切就会失去，没有监督，就会误入歧途。但是，如果现在不行动，就没有什么东西可以保护了。暗影不会屈服。守护者会对我有更多要求。军械库需要进化。

3943072673.name: Legacy's Oath Strides
3943072673.flavor: "I'm more interested in where I'm going." —Banshee-44
3943072673.lore:
Hmph. I don't always know where I've been, what I've done. Every so often, a weapon comes across my workbench, and I see… traces… what looks like my work. Something that sparks a memory, a flash. Nothing of substance. Nothing reliable.

Marks on my body tell me I've seen plenty of action. If need be, I'm ready for more. The Tower is my home. It suits me, and I'll protect it, no matter the cost. I'm treated like a person here, not a machine. Feeling accepted and enjoying your work aren't easy things to come by, and I'm… hmm, sure I'm already doing the most important work of any of my lives. Safeguarding humanity. Arming Guardians. Ready to defend what I care about. Can't think of a higher calling for myself.

Being an Exo isn't some sort of curse. It's given me opportunities I wouldn't have otherwise. I'm… uh, lucky. I don't live with the burden of whoever I was. Lotta folks only get one chance. I've had 44 to start over—to get it right. I feel like I've done it this time. Must have messed up the previous 43… I know I never want to see 45, that's for sure. If I have to give everything I have to save the people and home I care about, so be it. Might be time for a new generation, anyway.

This is who I want to be. My choice. I want to be good. Make a difference. A lot of people are driven by selfishness. Greed. Obsessing over things they can't control. I try not to let those things guide me. I aim to be my own guide, and so far, I'd say it's been pretty successful. Everyone should be so fortunate—a fresh start to do what's right. I'll keep doing what I can. There's a whole world of good and bad out there. Only one is worth helping.
3943072673.lore_zh:
哼。我不一定知道我去了哪里，做了什么。每隔一段时间，我的工作台上就会出现一件武器，我看到……像是……我工作的痕迹。都是一些能激发记忆的东西，一闪即逝。没什么有实质性的东西。没有什么可靠的。

身上的痕迹告诉我，我见证过很多次行动。如果需要，我准备好迎接更多的行动。高塔就是我的家。它适合我，我会保护它，不惜代价。我在这里被当做人看，而不是机器。感觉被接受和享受自己的工作，并不是一件容易的事情，而我……嗯，确定我已经在做我生命中最重要的工作了。守护人类。武装守护者。做好准备，保护我关心的人。我想不出自己还有什么更高的使命。

作为Exo，并不是诅咒。这给了我机会，否则我不会有其他机会。我……我很好运。我不会带着“曾经自己是谁”这样的负担而生活。很多人只有一次机会。我有过44次重新开始——来做正确的事。我感觉自己这次成功了。之前的43次肯定搞砸了……我知道我绝对不想看到第45次，这是肯定的。如果必须付出一切，才能拯救我所关心的人和家园，那就这样吧。总之，可能是时候换新一代的人了。

这就是我想做的人。我的选择。我想做个好人，做出改变。很多人被自私的欲望所驱动，贪婪。执着于他们无法控制的东西。我尽量不让这些东西来引导我。我的目标是做自己的向导，到目前为止，我想说，这一点相当成功。每个人都应该如此幸运——一个全新的开始，能够做正确的事。我会继续尽我所能。外面的世界有好有坏。只有一个世界值得帮助。

3552360921.name: Grips of Trepidation
3552360921.lore:
The slow drag of Koraxis's injured leg made the trek back to his empty ship longer than it had been before. Persistent exhaustion made itself known between each pang of pain that jolted through him. He was thankful the captain's beating had been interrupted by another patron's fist long enough for him to skitter away, but the paranoia of being tracked lingered.

It felt as if an unseen force hovered behind him.

Koraxis pushed onward and kept his gaze forward.

When he finally made it to his ship, the airlock hissed open and revealed a dark space within. He ignored his usual precautions, too focused on the unbearable pain in his limbs.

The hammock he'd fashioned for himself called to him. He collapsed into it and didn't exhale until he found a comfortable enough position.

Sleep found him as soon as he'd closed his eyes; the fastest he'd achieved it in days. Forced insomnia and a surprise beating had taken its toll.

Then there was a knock on the door.

The moment Koraxis heard the rap on the metal, he reached for the gun on the shelf beside his hammock.

He approached the door with the most delicate footsteps he could manage; a heaviness weighed down on every part of him.

He hesitated, eyes fixed on the rusted metal. Rap, tap, tap, went the door…

The door creaked open, and he immediately aimed down his sights at—

Nothing.

Confusion crept into his mind, as something hit him—hard. Koraxis scrunched his four eyes shut. He was flung backwards and braced for impact.

But it never came. 

Koraxis opened his eyes, expecting to see the walls of his Ketch. Instead, he saw the lunar Pyramid. Sleek and dark.
3552360921.lore_zh:
科拉西斯缓慢地拖动着伤腿，回到空船的路程比以前更加漫长。传遍全身的每一阵剧痛中都透着持续的疲惫。他很庆幸另一位顾客出手拦下了船长的殴打，让他得以溜走，但他一直笼罩在被追踪的阴影之下。

感觉好像有一股看不见的力量在他身后徘徊。

科拉西斯继续前进，眼睛一直盯着前方。

当他终于到达他的飞船时，气闸嘶嘶地打开了，露出里面的一个黑暗空间。他的四肢疼得难以忍受，以至于忽略了惯常的防范措施。

他为自己打造的吊床在召唤他。他倒在上面，直到找到了一个舒适的姿势，才大口呼气。

他闭上眼睛，很快就睡着了；这是几天内最快的一次。被迫的失眠和突如其来的殴打对他的影响很大。

这时响起了敲门声。

一听到金属上的敲击声，科拉西斯就伸手去拿吊床旁边架子上的枪。

他尽量用最轻柔的脚步向门口走去；一种沉重的感觉压在他身上的每个部位。

他犹豫着，眼睛一直盯着那块生锈的金属。一阵敲门声传来，咚，咚，咚…

门嘎吱一声开了，他立刻举枪瞄准——

什么也没有。

有什么东西狠狠地击中了他，他的脑海顿时一片混乱。科拉西斯闭上了四只眼睛。他被向后抛去，准备承受冲击。

但没撞上任何东西。 

科拉西斯睁开眼睛，想着能看到他双桅船的墙壁。相反，他看到了月球金字塔。光滑而黑暗。

155603519.name: Vest of Trepidation
155603519.lore:
Koraxis instinctively moved toward the Pyramid, an echo of a journey he wanted desperately to forget.

The Pyramid peaked over the edge of the chasm, a foreboding sight. It was complimented by a stillness that filled the area and made him feel as if he were on the edge of suffocating. He remembered how he carefully traversed the jagged paths. It seemed as if the Pyramid was pulling him in.

Everything felt familiar… including the paranoia. But something was off.

The architecture wobbled and shifted with every step he took. Statues felt as though their heads turned to watch him. Faint whispers danced around the rooms and faded before they could be comprehended. The air was thick with anxious anticipation, with fear.

Koraxis retread familiar hallways and staircases until suddenly, without realizing, he stepped into the innermost chamber… his chamber.

The whispers grew louder as he approached the body, slumped over, and shrouded in shadow at the center of the room. Hisses, yells, and fervent but unintelligible phrases all blended as Koraxis moved closer.

The corpse had been picked clean, barely anything left outside the vague shape of a body underneath the cloak.

Be it the threat of curses or sheer fear, his head remained untouched…

The whispers grew louder the closer Koraxis got to the entity's face. His entire body shook as he stared down at the darkened helmet, a ring of eyes pronounced even in the low light.

Despite the same dread that filled him, Koraxis followed through with the familiar actions and carefully removed one of the eyes. The room shook violently, and before he could safely stow the piece away, Koraxis toppled over. He closed his eyes and braced for impact.
155603519.lore_zh:
科拉西斯本能地朝着金字塔移动，这是他极力忘记的一段旅程的回响。

金字塔耸立在峡谷的边缘，一幅不祥的景象。伴随而来的是四周的一片寂静，让他感到仿佛快要窒息了。他还记得自己是如何小心翼翼地走过那些崎岖不平的小路。那感觉就像是金字塔在牵引着他。

一切感觉起来都很熟悉…包括这种疑虑。但有些事情不太对劲。

那建筑随着他走出的每一步而摇摆和移动。雕像们似乎都转过头来看着他。微弱的低语声在房间里舞动着，还没来得及让人听懂就消失了。空气中弥漫着急切的期待，还有恐惧。

科拉西斯重新走过熟悉的走廊和楼梯，直到突然间，他不自觉地走进了最深处的房间…他的房间。

当他走近这个空间中心的那具尸体时，低语声越来越大，那尸体倒在地上，被房间中央的阴影笼罩着。嘶嘶声、叫喊声、热烈但难以理解的话语，随着科拉西斯的靠近，全都混在了一起。

那具尸体被扒得干干净净，除了披风下模糊的身体轮廓外，几乎什么都没留下。

不知是源于诅咒的威胁还是纯粹的恐惧，他的头颅没有被碰过…

科拉西斯越靠近那怪物的脸，那低语声就越大。他全身都在颤抖，低头盯着那顶乌黑的头盔，即使在昏暗的光线下也能看到一圈眼睛。

尽管心中充满了同样的恐惧，科拉西斯还是完成了熟悉的动作，小心翼翼地摘下了其中一只眼睛。声音越来越大，房间剧烈摇晃着，还没等他把那眼睛安全收起，科拉西斯就翻倒在地。他闭上眼睛，准备承受冲击。

3712887043.lore_zh:
科拉西斯本能地朝着金字塔移动，这是他极力忘记的一段旅程的回响。

金字塔耸立在峡谷的边缘，一幅不祥的景象。伴随而来的是四周的一片寂静，让他感到仿佛快要窒息了。他还记得自己是如何小心翼翼地走过那些崎岖不平的小路。那感觉就像是金字塔在牵引着他。

一切感觉起来都很熟悉…包括这种疑虑。但有些事情不太对劲。

那建筑随着他走出的每一步而摇摆和移动。雕像们似乎都转过头来看着他。微弱的低语声在房间里舞动着，还没来得及让人听懂就消失了。空气中弥漫着急切的期待，还有恐惧。

科拉西斯重新走过熟悉的走廊和楼梯，直到突然间，他不自觉地走进了最深处的房间…他的房间。

当他走近这个空间中心的那具尸体时，低语声越来越大，那尸体倒在地上，被房间中央的阴影笼罩着。嘶嘶声、叫喊声、热烈但难以理解的话语，随着科拉西斯的靠近，全都混在了一起。

那具尸体被扒得干干净净，除了披风下模糊的身体轮廓外，几乎什么都没留下。

不知是源于诅咒的威胁还是纯粹的恐惧，他的头颅没有被碰过…

科拉西斯越靠近那怪物的脸，那低语声就越大。他全身都在颤抖，低头盯着那顶乌黑的头盔，即使在昏暗的光线下也能看到一圈眼睛。

尽管心中充满了同样的恐惧，科拉西斯还是完成了熟悉的动作，小心翼翼地摘下了其中一只眼睛。声音越来越大，房间剧烈摇晃着，还没等他把那眼睛安全收起，科拉西斯就翻倒在地。他闭上眼睛，准备承受冲击。

4205026632.name: Mask of Trepidation
4205026632.lore:
The Reef's labyrinth of asteroids and debris provided many a hideout for those who wished to be lost… and a potential gathering place for those that partook in less savory acts.

A large Ketch had set up among the debris, on a random asteroid of its captain's choosing and had opened for business. Supposedly, as a "bar."

The music bumped, and the clientele—Eliksni pirates—were as rowdy as they were ruthless.

Koraxis sat at a table with his head resting in his upper hands, his cup held in the lower. Exhausted, he hadn't taken a sip since he'd sat down. And he hadn't noticed that an imposing captain, flanked by two smaller Dregs, had entered the bar. The captain started toward his table.

"Where's the relic?" the captain, now towering over the table, chittered in their shared tongue.

Koraxis visibly tensed and gripped his cup so tightly that the cloth woven around his palms strained.

"I don't have it," he responded.

Before Koraxis could register what happened, the captain snatched him from his seat. Despite being loosely labeled "Captain" by his crew, Koraxis was nowhere near the size of the Eliksni before him. His feet dangled in the air.

"Pathetic. Not worthy of your crew."

"You're right," Koraxis agreed, defeat evident in his tone.

The captain's words were venomous, but not as impactful as the fist that collided with Koraxis's face. The other patrons scattered. A blur of fists and insults erupted, a faint chorus of ethereal laughter swelled beneath the violent chaos.
4205026632.lore_zh:
暗礁迷宫般的小行星和碎片为那些希望迷失的人提供了许多藏身之处…也是那些行迹不光彩之徒的潜在聚集地。

一艘大双桅船在其船长选择的一颗随机小行星上的废墟中开张营业，做起了一门所谓“酒吧”的生意。

音乐震耳欲聋，而那群埃里克斯尼族海盗客人既吵闹又冷酷。

科拉西斯坐在桌旁，上面一双手托着自己的头，下面那双举着酒杯。筋疲力竭的他坐下来后还没喝过一口。他也没注意到一位气势汹汹的船长，在两个身材较矮小的堕落者士兵的簇拥下，走进了酒吧。船长开始朝他的桌子走来。

“圣物在哪里？”船长在桌旁显得十分高大，用他们共同的语言唧喳叫道。

科拉西斯明显地紧张起来，紧紧握着杯子，连手掌上的布都绷紧了。

“不在我手上，”他答道。

还没等科拉西斯反应过来，船长就把他从座位上抓了起来。尽管被船员们随意地冠以“船长”的称号，但科拉西斯的体型依然远不及他面前的埃里克斯尼族。他的双脚在空中悬着。

“真是可悲。你配不上你的船员。”

“你说得对，”科拉西斯表示同意，语气中透着挫败感。

船长的话固然恶毒，打在科拉西斯脸上的拳头却更有力。其他顾客纷纷散开。一片模糊的拳打脚踢和辱骂声随即爆发，剧烈的混乱之中还夹杂着轻飘的笑声。

2149579211.name: Boots of Trepidation
2149579211.lore:
The energy of the crew bustled. Koraxis opened his eyes, revealing the vastness of space beyond the nearby porthole and a dozen or so Eliksni partaking in various activities. The air was heavy with tension, hushed tones, and cautious movements as they maneuvered around the decks.

Koraxis was quiet, as he had been the first time, the weight and power of the item he'd liberated heavy in his palm. It pulsed.

The world had changed. Another familiar moment.

"Things aren't looking well, Captain," a Dreg whispered to Koraxis. He remembered this conversation but did not recognize the Dreg's deep tone. It sounded out of place. The Dreg leaned a bit closer, eyes darting between his shipmates. "Our food is low, the ship needs repairs, and the crew is… worried it might be cursed."

"Then they can leave," Koraxis snapped. It was automatic, much like his trek through the Pyramid. The Dreg hesitated in surprise.

Koraxis blinked, no longer surrounded by his crew or their voices of discontent. He suddenly found himself in his quarters.

It was dark, the type of darkness that felt as if it would devour him.

Koraxis sat at the table by his hammock. Just him and the eye. He stared at it, and it stared back.

A book of magic lay beside it. A frantic solution to an unexpected problem. The ritual was simple—or so he thought. He was barely able to translate the text on his own but was too stubborn, too scared to ask for help. He grasped a pointed crystal in his hands. Words left his mouth, but he couldn't hear them over the incessant whispers.

The crystal glowed, and Koraxis was met with an energy blast that propelled him backwards. This time, he felt the impact.
2149579211.lore_zh:
船员的精力都很旺盛。科拉西斯睁开眼睛，看到了附近舷窗外的浩瀚太空和十几个参加各种活动的埃里克斯尼族。空气中弥漫着紧张的气氛，他们压低声音，小心翼翼地在甲板上移动。

科拉西斯很安静，就像第一次时那样，感受着他解救出的那东西在手心里沉甸甸的重量和力量。它在脉动。

世界已经改变了。这是另一个熟悉的时刻。

“情况不太妙，船长，”堕落者士兵低声对科拉西斯说道。他记得这段对话，但堕落者士兵说话的深沉语气很陌生。听起来不对劲。堕落者士兵靠得更近了，目光在他的船员同伴之间飞快扫视。“我们的食物不多了，飞船需要修理，而船员们…担心它可能被诅咒了。”

“那他们可以离开，”科拉西斯厉声说道。这话说得不假思索，就像他在金字塔中的跋涉一样。堕落者士兵惊讶地迟疑了。

科拉西斯眨了眨眼，周围没有了船员和他们不满的声音。他突然发现自己身处自己的营舍里。

四下一片漆黑，是那种感觉快要吞噬他的黑暗。

科拉西斯坐在吊床旁的桌子前。只有他和那只眼睛。他盯着它看，它也回瞪着他。

眼睛的旁边放着一本魔法书。针对意料之外问题的疯狂解决方案。仪式很简单…至少他是这么认为的。他太过固执，太过害怕，不敢寻求帮助，只是勉强自行翻译了文本。他手里攥着一块尖尖的水晶。但在不停的低语声中，他听不见他嘴里说出的话。

水晶发出光芒，科拉西斯遇到了一股能量将他向后推去。这一次，他感受到了冲击。

1402762062.name: Cloak of Trepidation
1402762062.lore:
The whispers and screams drilled into Koraxis's mind. He lifted his hands to his face. Whimpers and pitiful chitters were the only sounds that escaped him.

Again, the scenery around him had shifted, and he stood on the edge of a meteorite. Though the Reef was vast, he recognized the ship debris flowing past him, but it was different than he remembered, twisted in horrifying shapes. The deep purples and blues were dimmed. It was quiet, save for his own personal audience.

Koraxis held up the eye in his deteriorated hands. It still pulsed with energy.

…Free me…

He heard the allure, a voice seducing his soul to do its bidding, but the distortion that followed it reminded Koraxis why he'd come to this place. An untraceable end for this cursed relic.

He balled his fist around the eye. The screams pierced his ears as they grew louder. A dark hand reached out to him, fingers inches from his arm. Koraxis flung the eye into the Reef with all the strength he could muster.

He collapsed.

And then a knock on the door.

Koraxis jolted awake, hand already outstretched to grab his gun. The whispers were gone, his quarters were quiet. He gazed around the room, dazed.

Koraxis stumbled out of bed and delicately approached the door. He aimed down his sights.

The metal creaked open.

Outside was a Human, dressed in a dark, ornate cloak, one hand raised in greeting, the other tightly holding a tome. It gave off the same nightmarish energy as the eye… as Nezarec.

"Apologies for disturbing your sleep," said the man in a tongue Koraxis loosely understood. "But would you happen to be Koraxis?"
1402762062.lore_zh:
低语声和尖叫声钻进了科拉西斯的脑海。他把手举到面前，只能发出呜咽声和可怜的鸣叫声。

他周围的景色再次改变，他站在一块陨石的边缘。虽然暗礁十分辽阔，他还是认出了从他身边流过的船只残骸，但与他记忆中的不同，它们扭曲成了可怕的形状，深邃的紫色和蓝色黯淡无光。除了他自己这唯一的听众，一切都很安静。

科拉西斯用他变质了的手举起那只眼睛。它仍然在随着能量脉动。

…让我自由…

他听到了诱惑，一个引诱着他的灵魂服从的声音，但随后的扭曲提醒了科拉西斯自己为什么会来到这个地方。这受到诅咒的圣物应在这里迎来无迹可寻的终局。

他握拳攥紧着那只眼睛。尖叫声越来越大，刺穿了他的耳朵。一只黑手伸向他，手指离他的手臂只有几厘米。科拉西斯用尽全身力气把眼睛扔进了暗礁。

他瘫倒在地。

随后一阵敲门声响起。

科拉西斯猛然醒来，他的手已伸出去拿枪。低语声消失，他的住处安静了下来。他茫然地环视着房间。

科拉西斯踉跄地下了床，小心翼翼地走到门口。他举枪瞄准。

金属门嘎吱地打开了。

外面是个穿着黑色华丽披风的人类。一只手举起来问候，另一只手紧紧抓住一本书册。它散发出与那眼睛…与奈扎雷克一样噩梦般的能量。

“抱歉搅了你的睡梦，”那人用科拉西斯听不太懂的语言说道。“你不会刚好是科拉西斯吧？”

外面是个穿着黑色华丽披风的人类。一只手举起来问候，另一只手紧紧抓住一本书册。它散发出与那眼睛…与奈扎雷克一样噩梦般的能量。

“抱歉搅了你的睡梦，”那人用科拉西斯听不太懂的语言说道。“你不会刚好是科拉西斯吧？”

2311061287.name: Promised Reign Cloak
2311061287.flavor: "I turn, and there she is. Radiant."
2311061287.lore:
—-Inside you, the Kestrel and the Crow tangle in a bid for dominance. Hunter, you are ensnared, but you need not fear. We come to pry the trap open. We free you from your gilded prison; a cell bathed in light and glowing as if it would somehow fill the vast emptiness around it. Guilt follows you like a long shadow cast in the setting sun. In darkness, there is no shadow to fear. 

The children of Sol would force upon you the wretched title of "Vanguard," a title made famous by thieves and murderers. We do not offer you equality… we offer you sovereignty. We would make you king. 

Here, you are King Uldren, a Kestrel who slays the Crow and takes to the skies, triumphant. You are no longer a specter living in the shadow of an unfeeling sibling. The sun rises to greet you, the earth beneath your feet bends to your every whim.  

Would you not stay… and see your sunrise?—-
2311061287.lore_zh:
——在你的内心之中，快隼与乌鸦正为了主导权而搏斗。猎人，你被困住了，但你不必害怕。让我们来撬开陷阱。我们会把你从那个镀金牢笼里解救出来；那个沐浴在光芒中，仿佛那样就能填补周围巨大空虚的牢房。愧疚如夕阳投下的长影，跟随着你。黑暗中，没有令人恐惧的阴影。 

太阳系的孩子们把“先锋”这个卑鄙的称号强加给你。一个由小偷和杀人犯创造出来的头衔。我们要给你的不是平等…而是主权。我们会让你成为王。 

在这里，你是国王欧顿。一只杀死了乌鸦，得意洋洋地冲上云霄的快隼。你不再是一个活在无情姐姐阴影下的幽灵。太阳升起迎接你的到来，脚下的大地任由你的意愿重塑。  

你愿意留下来…看看你的日出吗？——

2771790736.name: Resonant Fury Grips
2771790736.flavor: I touch the void, and through this clasp, I learn to hold nothing.
2771790736.lore:
They are liquid fear sealed within porcelain flesh, my Witness, these Ahslid whose service you require. I arrived as you bid, without ceremony or fleets, and for 14 journeys around their star, I have stalked them in the dark, testing them to find even one who may serve as a warrior. I offer them every opportunity to unleash wrath upon me and prove their worth, and they cower, then bleed. Is it the death of my ego you crave as you dispatch me alone against these insects?

But I comprehend the depth now of this commandment. Yours is a lesson in insight, and sweet as their hemolymph may be, it is folly to spill it all myself. 

My violence inspires fear. Each new corpse come daylight substrates accusations. They need logic, a cause and effect that fits within their understanding of the universe. Even when massacre comes from the black depths between stars, they must lay its accounting at the tarsus of their most powerless.

They divide. They appoint authorities. They see lines in the parched dust that exist only in their minds, and they value these so, so dearly they will kill to define them. Achingly nostalgic. My gift of enlightenment. I am free of Lubrae, but I see its shape in these jostling masses, and this inspires me.

You have bidden me sharpen their fatuous minds into a spearpoint, as you did on Lubrae, but without showing my face to cow them. So instead, I shall press my shape into the dust of this world and cast a generation of Ahslid in my image. And they shall be my glaive.
2771790736.lore_zh:
我的见证者，他们是封在瓷制血肉里的液态恐惧，这些你需要他们效忠的阿赫斯利德。我照您的吩咐来了，没有仪式也没有舰队，在绕行他们恒星的14趟旅程中，我一直在黑暗中悄悄跟踪他们，考验他们看能否找到哪怕一个能作为战士效力的人。我给了他们每一个向我泄愤，证明其价值的机会，但他们都畏缩了，然后血流不止。您派我单独去对付这些虫子，是想要看到我的自我毁灭吗？

但我现在明白这诫命的深奥之处了。您给我上了一课真知灼见，尽管他们的血淋巴很纯净，但我自己把它全洒出来未免也太愚蠢了。 

我的暴力唤起了恐惧。每一具新尸体在日光下出现都会引来指责。他们需要逻辑，需要一个符合他们对宇宙理解的因果关系。即使屠杀来自群星之间的黑暗深处，他们也必须把解释置于其最无能为力者的睑板之上。

他们产生分歧。他们任命当局。他们在焦干的尘土中看到只存在于他们脑海中的界线，他们对此是如此珍视，以至于不惜一切代价来定义它们。太让人怀旧了。我的启蒙天赋。我摆脱了鲁布瑞，但我在摩肩接踵的人群当中看到了它的形状，这给了我启示。

您命令我把他们愚昧的头脑磨成矛尖，但不要露脸吓唬他们，就像您在鲁布瑞上所做的那样。因此，我反而要把我的形态埋入这世界的尘土之中，用我的形象铸造出一代阿赫斯利德人。他们将成为我的偃月。

4246884536.name: Resonant Fury Vest
4246884536.flavor: I feel the void, and through this experience, I learn that want is suffering.
4246884536.lore:
I am become circumstance, my Witness, the unseen whim of fate that shapes the lives of one score of infants in the same temper of luxury and hardship that honed my infallible edge. Where their families lack, I gift them with prosperity, opportunity, and the elimination of obstacles. Where they would know softness, I introduce suffering for which there is no salve, snatching away those who may carry them and nourish frailty.

My salubrious hand imbues strength, but far more critically. It weans them on immaculateness. They are self-made, they tell themselves, and grow strong for their suffering—should not all their kind be so capable? Is there—they conclude—any explanation for the failure that permeates their society beyond a sick sentiment for weakness? Their antennules quiver at the debility in their kind. Its stink disgusts them.

The youngest of my brood, I named him Uun, has taken his first life. Stoked on emotion, his craft is sloppy—the hand of a child—but I have removed the shoddy traces of his outburst and vanished those who might find fault with such a child. He shrinks now from the anonymous endowments I lay as laurels for his conquest. I have permitted too much softness for the offspring.

And I am left to ponder—did you so attentively hone me into your blade, my Witness, or did happenstance and my own tenacity ready a blade for you to draw?
4246884536.lore_zh:
如今我化作了命运本身，我的见证者，塑造出了二十条婴儿生命的无形命运奇想，他们的性情与磨练出我永不出错棱角的奢侈和艰苦脾性并无二致。在他们缺乏家人温暖的时刻，我给他们带来繁荣、机遇，帮助其消除障碍。在他们将要懂得温柔的时刻，我让他们初尝无以慰藉之苦，除掉那些可能扶助他们，滋养其薄弱意志的人。

我充满助益的援手为其灌注了力量，但更重要的是。这让他们戒除了纯洁。他们告诉自己，他们是白手起家的人，因为所受的苦难而变得强大，难道他们所有同类不应该都如此能干吗？他们得出结论，除了一种病态的软弱情绪外，还有什么能解释他们社会中弥漫的失败氛围吗？他们的触角因同类的虚弱而颤抖。这恶臭令他们感到厌恶。

我最小的孩子，我给他起名叫乌恩，杀了他手上第一条生命。在情绪的刺激下，他的技艺就像孩童之手一样粗糙，但我已经消除了他情绪激化的劣迹，还让那些会对这样一个孩子吹毛求疵的人销声匿迹了。面对我作为他征服的桂冠安放给他的无名禀赋。现在他却畏缩了。我已经对孩子的软弱太过纵容。

留给我思考的问题在于，您是如此用心地将我磨成您的刀锋，我的见证者，还是因为无心插柳以及我自身的坚韧为您备置好了随时出鞘的利刃？

2642378837.name: Resonant Fury Cloak
2642378837.flavor: I wear the void, and through this empathy, I learn that only my will endures.
2642378837.lore:
I have failed you, my Witness.

I taught the Ahslid to build a tower to heaven upon a foundation of sand. I hemmed for 10 long cycles over that final lesson in irrelevance, and in the end, my pupils exceeded my ability as a teacher. They tumbled. A sunset of atomic fire scrubs all but lichen from this arid globe.

But Uun stands before me, last survivor of his pointless kind. While he proved deaf to the lessons I taught regarding his people's worth, he devoured all I taught him of tenacity and made of it his core. He alone among his people saw the pattern in my killings, in the ascension of children whose backgrounds mirrored his own. 

My duty to you failed. The greatest flaw in my handicraft stands before me. And yet, I find myself burdened with pride.

He levels a weapon on me, and it occurs that I never learned what they call their devices. It is as irrelevant as everything else that made up their culture.

But he is the first to stand and face me.

He dashes hate against me. And breaks.

He does not know my name. He does not know my purpose. And he demands. Then implores. Then begs. He prostrates himself on the floor, his carapace wracking with convulsions, as if mourning milks the sorrow from his flesh.

And I am weak, my Witness. I whisper, "I am Rhulk."

Devoid of context, it is as meaningless as any other aspect of his people's end. Something sacred within him dies, and he gazes up as I have gazed at you.

And only now do I appreciate your lesson.
2642378837.lore_zh:
我让您失望了，我的见证者。

我教阿赫斯利德人在砂土地基上建造一座通向天堂的塔。我在无足轻重的最后一课上兜了10个大圈，最后，我的学生超出了我作为老师的能力范围。他们摔倒在地。原子火焰的余晖把这颗贫瘠的星球上除地衣外的一切都洗净了。

但乌恩站在我面前，他那毫无意义同类的唯一幸存者。虽然他对我关于其子民价值的教导充耳不闻，但他如饥似渴地听取了我教给他的所有关于坚韧的内容，并以此作为他的核心。在他的族人中，只有他在我的杀戮之中，在那些背景与他相似的孩子们的晋升之中看到了规律。 

我没有尽到对您的责任。我手艺的最大缺陷就站在我面前。然而，我发觉自己却为自傲所累。

他拿武器指着我，我却不知道他们管他们的装置叫做什么。它和构成他们文化的其他一切东西一样都无关紧要。

但他是第一个站起来直面我的人。

他冲我大发雷霆。然后停了下来。

他不知道我的名字。他不知道我的目的。于是他提出要求。接着是恳求。然后成了乞求。他匍匐在地板上，他的甲壳抽搐得厉害，仿佛哀痛从他的肉体中榨出了悲伤。

我的见证者，我太软弱了。我低声说道，“我是胡克。”

脱离语境，这与他族人结局的任何其他方面一样毫无意义。他内心神圣的东西消逝了，他抬头凝视着，就像我凝视着您一样。

直到现在我才明白您的教训。

He does not know my name. He does not know my purpose. And he demands. Then implores. Then begs. He prostrates himself on the floor, his carapace wracking with convulsions, as if mourning milks the sorrow from his flesh.

And I am weak, my Witness. I whisper, "I am Rhulk."

Devoid of context, it is as meaningless as any other aspect of his people's end. Something sacred within him dies, and he gazes up as I have gazed at you.

And only now do I appreciate your lesson.
3919625233.lore_zh:
我让您失望了，我的见证者。

我教阿赫斯利德人在砂土地基上建造一座通向天堂的塔。我在无足轻重的最后一课上兜了10个大圈，最后，我的学生超出了我作为老师的能力范围。他们摔倒在地。原子火焰的余晖把这颗贫瘠的星球上除地衣外的一切都洗净了。

但乌恩站在我面前，他那毫无意义同类的唯一幸存者。虽然他对我关于其子民价值的教导充耳不闻，但他如饥似渴地听取了我教给他的所有关于坚韧的内容，并以此作为他的核心。在他的族人中，只有他在我的杀戮之中，在那些背景与他相似的孩子们的晋升之中看到了规律。 

我没有尽到对您的责任。我手艺的最大缺陷就站在我面前。然而，我发觉自己却为自傲所累。

他拿武器指着我，我却不知道他们管他们的装置叫做什么。它和构成他们文化的其他一切东西一样都无关紧要。

但他是第一个站起来直面我的人。

他冲我大发雷霆。然后停了下来。

他不知道我的名字。他不知道我的目的。于是他提出要求。接着是恳求。然后成了乞求。他匍匐在地板上，他的甲壳抽搐得厉害，仿佛哀痛从他的肉体中榨出了悲伤。

我的见证者，我太软弱了。我低声说道，“我是胡克。”

脱离语境，这与他族人结局的任何其他方面一样毫无意义。他内心神圣的东西消逝了，他抬头凝视着，就像我凝视着您一样。

直到现在我才明白您的教训。

3300005657.name: Resonant Fury Mask
3300005657.flavor: I see the void, and through this gaze, I learn to covet no goal.
3300005657.lore:
Void. Bereft. There is a chasm where my fulfillment should live.

Today, you again gifted me purpose, my Witness. A rapturous day, by the old pattern, my fingers knitting finality once more. But now, this purpose is equivocal, serving not the glorious abyss. The race—the Ahslid, in their degenerate, clicking dialect—have never known the enemy's luminous caress, will never know that caress. They are unnecessary, destined to die in a paltry million years still orbiting the same blue-white star that gave them succor.

Irrelevant. And yet…

"Your presence shall raise no more concern than that of a speck of dust blown off course by a distant sun. And you shall bow this people to our service, just as we enlightened you. Your value shall be their value." 

I was born in irrelevance, and yet, you cast me back down that well.

I keep your sacred commandments, even this, closer and dearer than my own pulse. In your name, I bring crushing embrace by flame and glaive, my Witness. Fleets of black to blot out suns and moons. The enemy flees, and I burn all trace of its passing. This is my supplication.

But I castigate myself. Nothing is immaterial that is in your sight. My prayers offend my Witness, and so, here and now, I tear them out. I shall learn to forge by night and whispers, and silence shall be your choir.
3300005657.lore_zh:
空虚寂寞，孤苦无依。我的成就感堕入了无尽的鸿沟。

今天，您再次赋予我使命，我的见证者。在这欢天喜地的一天，循着老旧的图案，我的手指再次织就了终局。但现在，这一目标变得模棱两可，不再为光荣的深渊效力。这群人——用他们那退化的搭嘴音方言叫阿赫斯利德族——从来未曾知晓敌人光亮的爱抚，永远也不会知晓那种爱抚。它们无足轻重，注定要在微不足道的百万年内消亡，仍然沿着给予它们帮助的那颗蓝白恒星的轨道运行。

无关紧要。可是…

“你的出现不会比被遥远的太阳吹偏轨迹的一粒尘埃更引人关注。你要让人民臣服于我们，就像我们启迪你一样。你的价值就是他们的价值。” 

我生来就无足轻重，可您却把我扔回了那口井里。

我守着您神圣的戒律，而这条戒律，甚至比我自己的脉搏来得更亲密、更珍贵。以您之名，我借助烈焰和偃月带来幻灭的接纳，我的见证者。黑暗舰队遮蔽日月。敌人溃逃，我烧尽所有它逝去的痕迹。这是我的祈求。

但我苛责自己。在您眼里没有什么是无关紧要的。我的祈求冒犯了我的见证者，因此，此时此地，我把它们化作碎片。我将借助黑夜和低语学着锐意进取，寂静将成为您的唱诗班。

3130426090.name: Resonant Fury Strides
3130426090.flavor: I walk the void, and through this journey, I learn that no place shall embrace me.
3130426090.lore:
I find myself once more stalking the night, my Witness, unknown as their final gasps. But my sojourns are no longer otiose errands. I am no more a predator among the Ahslid than the weaver is a predator of flax. Death creates gaps into which my progeny rises and stokes paranoia to tighten their fists. Each carapace crushed winds the clockworks my hands assemble.

They no longer need my direct ministrations. My children have children—some bequeath my lessons. The favored spawn are those who learned my lessons well. They converge on my shape, and unprovoked, prepare banquets of wisdom on which their kin gorge. They craft weapons—little more than hurled rocks standing in the long shadow the Darkness casts—but enough to crack their world apart. Only Uun disappoints, frightened as he is now by his own potential for glory. I cut him free of my succor. Obscurity is the crueler fate.

You taught me the most precious lesson of irrelevance. Only purpose can be momentous. It is the moment of clarity that freed me from worldly soil. This final gift I withhold from my progeny. It is the most challenging lesson to teach, and I stand in awe of the elegance with which you revealed the truth to me. I cannot do the same without reflection. I have imitated myself all too well, but to imitate you, my Witness, it is the one challenge to which I find myself unworthy.
3130426090.lore_zh:
我的见证者，我发觉自己又一次在悄然追踪着黑夜，如同他们最后的喘息一样不为人知。但我的逗留不再是多余的差事。正如织布工不是亚麻的掠食者一样，我也不再是阿赫斯利德的掠食者。死亡制造出了缺口，让我的后代得以崛起，激起无端的疑虑，让他们握紧双拳。每一个粉碎的甲壳都上紧了我双手组装的齿轮发条。

他们不再需要我的调教。我的子孙也有了他们的子孙，一部分人会把我的经验传下去。那些好好听取我教训的子嗣深得我心。他们趋同于我的外形，自发地准备智慧盛宴，供其亲族大快朵颐。他们制造武器，不过是在暗影投下的长长阴影中猛扔的石块，但也足以让他们的世界分崩离析。只有乌恩感到了失望，因为他现在被自己的荣耀潜力吓坏了。我伸出援手解救了他。默默无闻是更为残酷的命运。

您给我上了关于无足轻重最宝贵的一课。只有决心才能举足轻重。正是这一刻的清醒，让我从世俗的土壤中解脱了出来。 这是我留给后代的最后一份礼物。这是最具挑战性的一课，我对您向我揭示真理的优雅姿态表示敬畏。我没法不假思索地就这样做。我已经很会模仿自己了，但是仿效您，我的见证者，这是我深知自己不配面对的一项挑战。

2251396699.name: Seventh Seraph Grips
2251396699.lore:
Chapter 3: For a Friend

Voronin found cover under uprooted trees and demolished vehicles as he made his way through the catastrophic weather. He could hardly believe he was still alive, bearing witness to the end of all things.

The storm encompassed the station, under siege from the elements. Civilians were being ushered toward the SMILE pods in droves as the lightning made its presence felt, igniting a nearby fuel supply. The explosion tore into the group, and as Voronin turned his head from the horror and the heat, he saw her. Roughly 250 meters away from the station. Morozova lay, singed and smoking, under rubble and ash.

Voronin pulled up his sensorium, but the electromagnetic fields in the air reduced it to static. There was no way to know if she was still alive or salvageable. She had treated him with respect despite outranking him, and she had been there for him when his marriage went to hell—

"We're all dead anyway," he thought and ran to her through the maelstrom of lightning and wind.

And then he was there, pulling off his gloves and wiping ash and blood from her face, as the storm bore down upon him.

As he made peace with his mortality, just shy of 82 years old, the storm around them calmed. The lightning stopped. The wind died. At the station, the civilians' eyes were fixed on the sky, though Voronin was looking only at Morozova. She was breathing, barely. Her eyes opened and met his. A half-smile came across her lips, then froze as her eyes went past him and widened in awe.

Voronin turned and found himself staring into the face of God.
2251396699.lore_zh:
第3章：为了朋友

沃罗宁穿越灾难性天气时，在连根拔起的树木和被毁车辆下找到了掩护之所。他几乎难以相信自己还活着，眼睁睁看着一切的灭亡。

这场暴风雨笼罩着站点，遭到了来自元素的围困。闪电出现后，点燃了附近的燃料供给，平民被驱赶到SMILE吊舱。爆炸把他们撕成碎片，沃罗宁惊恐地从热浪中转过头来，看见了她。大概距离站点250米远。莫洛佐娃躺着，被掩藏在碎石和灰尘下，浑身焦黑冒着烟。

沃罗宁拿出他的感应器，但空气中的电磁场将其显示的读数杂乱不堪。没办法知道她是否还活着，还能不能救。尽管他的官衔不如她，但她一直尊重他，当他的婚姻一团糟时，她也一直在他身边……

“我们反正都会死的。”他这样想着，然后穿过闪电和狂风的漩涡冲向了她。

然后他跑到了那里，暴风雨降临在他身上，他脱下手套，擦掉脸上的灰烬和鲜血。

就在他与不到82岁的死亡命运和解时，周围的风暴平息了。闪电也停止了。风也停了。在焊点里，平民的眼睛盯着天空，而沃罗宁的目光只盯着莫洛佐娃。她还在呼吸，虽然奄奄一息。她睁开眼睛，看见了他。她的唇角绽出微笑，然后目光越过他，突然因恐惧而瞪大了眼镜。

沃罗宁转过身，发自己自己正面对着神。

618725557.name: Seventh Seraph Vest
618725557.lore:
Chapter 2: Crashes

The first bolt of lightning sent static up Voronin's arm and filled the atmosphere around him with a pungent chlorine-like smell. His hand went to his chest without thinking, as if to make sure he was fully intact. His gaze shifted as a second bolt hit the ground near him, then another. He had never seen lightning so close before. Stunned, he stood his ground; while part of him knew he should be frightened for his life, he was more perplexed than afraid.

There was no rain. He looked toward the horizon, expecting clouds, expecting something, and only saw a shimmering curtain of blue lightning sifting toward him.

He raced for shelter in the surrounding field, abandoning his munitions container in the dust kicked up by his fevered stride. The strikes razed the ground, sparking wildfires and scorching stone. There was no logic to their timing, with bolts crashing so frequently, the sound of the thunder couldn't catch up.

He'd lost Morozova in the commotion. Already drained from hours spent hauling cargo, his mind recessed into primal instinct. RUN.

So he ran, doing his best to avoid the apocalypse that surrounded him. A call came through his earpiece as the ground quaked beneath him: "… auxiliary evac station…" was all he could make out before a roar of thunder swallowed the transmission.

He knew he needed to head west toward the station. The wind picked up and blew him off his feet, and again he felt a moment of sheer amazement at the storm's sudden ferocity. He hit the ground hard and checked his sensorium. It was scrambled from all the sinuous electricity undulating through the air, but he could just barely make out his compass. West. He ran.
618725557.lore_zh:
第2章：坠毁

第一道闪电让沃罗宁的手臂上产生了静电，周围散发出刺鼻的氯味。没有经过思考，他的手立即伸向胸口，仿佛要确保自己完好无损。当第二道闪电撞到他附近的地面时，他的视线随之转移，然后又是另一道。他从未如此近距离看过闪电。他惊呆了，站起身来。虽然内心知道他应该为自己的生命而害怕，但相比较于害怕，他更感到疑惑。

没有雨。他看着地平线，期待着云层，期待着会有什么东西，但只看到一道闪烁的蓝色闪电幕朝他飞来。

他拼命奔跑，想在在周围的田野中找到庇身之所，在发狂的步伐所踢起的尘土中，他丢掉了弹药容器。闪电焚烧大地，引发野火，烧焦了石头。时机毫无逻辑，闪电频繁地爆裂，雷声尚且无法追击。

他在混乱中失去了莫洛佐娃。他已经花了数小时拖运货物，耗尽了精力，他的思想陷入了麻木的本能。快跑。

所以他开始跑，尽全力避开周围的灾难。当脚下的大地震动时，他的耳机里传来个声音：“……辅助撤离点……”这是在雷声吞没信号之前他能听到的所有信息。

他知道他必须往西，朝站点走。再次起风了，吹着他双脚几乎离开地面，他再次感觉到风暴突入起来的凶猛。他猛地装上地面，检查他的传感器。它是从空中完全的电干扰而来，但是他几乎无法辨认出自己的指南针。向西，他开始奔跑。

3611287432.name: Seventh Seraph Cloak
3611287432.flavor: "You can't leave me. Not like this." —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
3611287432.lore:
Chapter 5: Abhorrent Imperative

Voronin tied his armband tight around her calf to cut off the blood flow from Morozova's gaping wound. He tried to keep her leg clean while the wind caked them with dirt and debris. Lightning was drawing closer. The sterile scent of ozone had returned and he knew he didn't have much time. "COME BACK!" he shouted hopelessly to the God. He hoisted Morozova up, supporting her on his shoulder, and pushed back against the elements that were conspiring against him.

It was 250 meters to the evac station. Every step was a battle of attrition. At this point, the thought of coldsleep sounded comforting. He just had to make it to the SMILE pods. The storm had other plans. A nearby HMMWV was struck by a wayward bolt and the explosion threw them back. He felt Morozova torn from his side as he landed, and the sound of his skull hitting stone was louder than the thunder had been. As blackness crept into his vision, he saw the Traveler in the sky, moving away, abandoning him.

…and then he was being dragged from the wreckage and violence onto a gurney. "…Morozova?" he struggled out. He was met with an oxygen mask. His eyes darted, in search of some sign that Morozova was alive. Voronin couldn't decipher anything out of the pandemonium around him. "I'm sorry," he thought to himself while cursing the orb in the sky for deserting him.

The last thing he remembered before they placed him into coldsleep was an explosion in the sky so bright it blinded him.
3611287432.lore_zh:
第5章：令人厌恶的命令

沃罗宁将臂带紧紧地绑在小腿上，以阻止莫洛佐娃的巨大伤口继续流血。风将灰尘和碎屑吹到他们脚上，他努力保持她的腿清洁。闪电越来越近了。臭氧的无菌气味又回来了，他知道自己没有太多时间。“快回来！”他绝望地朝着神喊道。他举起莫洛佐娃，架着她的肩膀，抵抗着围绕在他周围的元素们。

距离撤离站点250米远。每一步都是消耗战。在这个时候，冷冻睡眠的念头是如此令人舒适。他必须赶到SMILE吊舱。风暴可不这么想。附近的一辆HMMWV被闪电击中，爆炸把他们击退。他落地时感到莫洛佐娃从他身边被拉开，他的头骨撞到石头的声音比雷声响亮。当黑暗笼罩着他的视线，他看到了天空中的旅行者，逐渐离开，抛弃了他。

……他被从废墟中拖了出来，拽到一个轮床上。“……莫洛佐娃？”他挣扎问道。引入眼帘的是一个氧气面罩。他的双眼急切搜寻，想找寻找莫洛佐娃还活着的迹象。沃罗宁无法从他身边的哄闹中找到任何有用的信息。“我很抱歉，”他在诅咒天空中的球体抛弃他时，这样想到。

在他们进入冷冻睡眠状态之前，他记得的最后一件事是天上的爆炸如此明亮，他什么都看不见了。

1826620274.name: Seventh Seraph Cowl
1826620274.flavor: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
1826620274.lore:
Chapter 1: Out for Delivery

Voronin nearly dropped the munitions he was carrying, which would have been a disaster for everyone in the vicinity. Certainly not as bad as whatever calamity they were prepping for, but bad enough to warrant the panic that coursed through his body. He hated these kinds of assignments.

"Hey, Morozova!" Voronin called out to his ranking officer between heavy gasps. "Any idea where all these are going?"

Morozova carefully placed her container on the ground, as if she was laying a child to bed. "No clue. Word just came from on high to double-time it, though. Something about Titan has got everyone spooked."

Voronin removed his helmet and wiped the sweat from his brow. Titan? What the hell happened out there? Comms had been spotty and the orders that did get through were light on details: Procure munitions. Transpo munitions to coordinates provided. Stockpile munitions. Repeat. No HMMWVs either. This was meant to be low profile, staying off the roads.

Where was all this firepower going, and what were we going to do with it when it got there? Voronin picked up his container and his pace.

He trudged just shy of a click behind Morozova for what felt like hours. These containers were cumbersome and it was the height of the driest summer he could remember.

When they reached their destination, they received a cursory greeting from Bykov, who was busy compiling a list of all the deliverables. Two soldiers, whom Voronin didn't recognize, were placing the containers in the mouth of a shaft that protruded from the ground. One punched in a command and the shipment vanished below the surface with a hollow pneumatic "whoomp."

"Where does that go?" Voronin asked. Bykov's brows drew together and his expression hardened. He returned to his list.

"Ready for the next round?" Morozova posed with more spunk than Voronin could muster in a year.

"If we must."

The sky grew gray, and clouds formed overhead as they left. Procure, repeat.
1826620274.lore_zh:
第1章：外出送货

沃罗宁差点丢掉他携带的弹药，这对附近所有人来说都会是场灾难。当然，这并没有他们准备应付的灾难那么糟糕，但足以使恐慌蔓延他的身体。他讨厌这类任务。

“喂，莫洛佐娃！”沃罗宁喘粗气的间隙，喊着他的长官。“知道这些东西要送去哪里吗？”

莫洛佐娃小心把容器放在地上，好像在把孩子放在床上一样。“不知道。高层人只说加快速度。好像是土卫六让所有人都惊慌不已。”

沃罗宁移除了面具，擦了擦眉毛下的汗水。土卫六？那里到底发生了什么？通讯时好时坏，命令也没有太多细节：取得弹药。将弹药送往指定的坐标。存储弹药。重复步骤。也没有高机动多功能战车。这原本该是个秘密任务，远离大路。

所有这些军火都去了哪里，到达那里时我们将如何处理？沃罗宁抱起箱子，继续工作。

他在莫洛佐娃身后几步，感觉像过了几个小时一样漫长。这些箱子很麻烦，这是他记忆中最干燥的一个夏天。

当他们到达目的地时，他们收到了拜科夫的简单问候，他正忙着整理所有可交付成果的清单。两个沃罗宁不认识的士兵，将这些容器放在从地面伸出的竖井口中。其中一个人下达命令，然后随着空心的气动“嗡嗡声”，货物在地表下方消失。

“东西去了哪里？”沃罗宁问道。拜科夫的眉头皱在一起，他的表情更加严峻。他转过身看着清单。

“下一轮准备好了吗？”莫洛佐娃展现了沃罗宁需要一年才能积攒的勇气。

“如果我们一定要的话。”

天空变成了灰色，在他们离开时，头顶形成了乌云。获取，重复。

701436877.name: Seventh Seraph Strides
701436877.lore:
Chapter 4: Face to Face

Voronin's mouth hung agape. His lungs forgot how to breathe. His heart rate accelerated, his stomach turned, and he weakly wondered if this was his transition to the afterlife. Somehow he found his footing and stood.

The Traveler, they called it. He had heard the stories from throughout the system, but never did he think he would live to see it. Now it was as though it was seeing him.

He took a step forward as if it would bring him closer to the oblate spheroid in the sky above him. He stumbled. The ground had gotten so hot under him, the rubber on his boots had melted. A banal thought cut through his awe—"Now I look like a fool in front of the Traveler"—and he was ashamed.


The sound of cracking thunder still echoed in the distance. That was when he noticed he was in the eye of the storm. It was wailing all around him, but calm in his general circumference. Surely this was the Traveler's doing. The great savior. He grabbed Morozova, unsure of how long this would last, and brought her to her feet. She was badly injured, bleeding from a wound on her leg.

"Stay with me." He said to Morozova and the Traveler at once. Only one of them listened. The Traveler was on the move, and the storm was returning.
701436877.lore_zh:
第4章：面对面

沃罗宁的嘴巴大张着。他的肺忘记了该如何呼吸。他的心跳加速，胃里翻江倒海，他怀疑自己是不是要转世投胎了。然后突然他找到了立足点，又站立起来。

他们称之为的旅行者。他从整个星系都听过这些故事，但是他从来没有想过会活着看到它。现在好像它在看着他。

他向前迈了一步，似乎这样能让他更靠近上方天空中的球形物体。他蹒跚前行。他脚下的大地如此炽热，靴子上的碎石都融化了。一个无聊的想法减轻了他的敬畏感——“现在，我在旅行者面前就像个傻瓜。”他感到羞愧。


刺耳的雷声仍在远处回荡。这时他才注意到自己在暴风眼之中。周围全是呼啸声，但他周围还算平静。当然，都是旅行者的杰作。伟大的救世主。他抓着莫洛佐娃，不知道这种状况会持续多久，然后让莫洛佐娃站了起来。她受伤很重，腿上的伤口不断流血。

“留下来。”他同时对莫洛佐娃和旅行者说道。只有一个人听到了。旅行者仍在移动，风暴回归。

2374991792.name: Wildwood Grips
2374991792.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

276510936.name: Wildwood Vest
276510936.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

3391430133.name: Wildwood Cloak
3391430133.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
3391430133.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
3391430133.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

2478852409.name: Wildwood Mask
2478852409.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

2733627018.name: Wildwood Strides
2733627018.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

3043860795.name: Exodus Down Grips
3043860795.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what the Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

636661397.name: Exodus Down Vest
636661397.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

3629120232.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.

2577507538.name: Exodus Down Mask
2577507538.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

1452324269.name: Exodus Down Strides
1452324269.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

257978235.name: Reverie Dawn Grasps
257978235.flavor: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
257978235.lore:
She travels across the Ascendant Plane.

The voyage across the sea of screams threatens to erode her edges as no other trial ever has. In Oryx's throne world, she had a semblance of an identity. Treasure. Spoil of war. Defeated queen. Repugnant and alien and Not Me, but she could use these contortions as guideposts to trace her way back to herself.

Here in the emptiness between throne worlds, she has nothing but what she can carry.

The burden is growing heavier, but she is not alone.

He tries to speak to her from a place of high contempt. In doing so, he invites her into his topography.

She steps out of howling and finds her footing upon a plane of swords and madness and all-consuming curiosity.

"Who are you?"

The question summons an almost-forgotten answer deep within the rapidly solidifying shape of her.

"I AM MARA SOV. STARLIGHT WAS MY MOTHER, AND MY FATHER WAS THE DARK."

The thing that once was called Toland flees before her darkness/light/shadow/majesty. And she rests within this scrap of a world, before resuming her journey through the Howling.
257978235.lore_zh:
她横渡上维位面。

穿越尖叫之海比她遇到的任何一次试炼都更为严峻，不断侵蚀着她的极限。在欧里克斯的王座世界里，她似乎有一个身份。宝藏、战利品、战败的女王、令人厌恶的外星人，她可以凭借这些扭曲的词汇当成路标找回自己。

在王座世界之间的虚空中，她只能够背负她可以承担的。

负担越来越重，不过她并非孤身一人。

他试图居高临下地与她对话。因此，他邀请她进入自己的领域。

她穿越了尖叫之海，发现自己来到了一片充斥着战争、疯狂和狂热好奇心的位面。.

“你是谁？”

这个问题在她迅速固化的的形态中唤起了一个几乎被遗忘的答案。

“我是玛拉·索维。星光是我的母亲，黑暗是我的父亲。”

那个我们曾经称为托兰的人，在黑暗/光明/暗影/王权面前逃得无影无踪。在她重新踏上旅途之前，她在这块破碎的世界中小憩了一会儿。

966839765.name: Reverie Dawn Hauberk
966839765.flavor: "There is a place where we can remember who we are." —Imogen Rife
966839765.lore:
She feels Oryx's true death in both halves of her soul, a full imagined exhale before the aftershock reaches his throne world.

It crumbles around her like stone, like ash, like veils in a breeze.

Eris Morn's friends have succeeded. The Guardians have slain a god.

She steps through the ruins. In the end, there is nothing. Nothing but Mara Sov and the howling of rampant, untamed logics.

Her great and terrible gamble has paid off.

The rest is up to her now.
966839765.lore_zh:
她那分成两半的灵魂都感受到了欧里克斯的死亡，在余震抵达他的王座世界之前，她在蒸汽中想象出了一幅完整的画面。

它在她周围瓦解，如沙石，如灰烬，如微风中的面纱。

埃里斯·摩恩的朋友们已经成功了。守护者已经杀死了一位神明。

她穿过废墟。尽头，一无所有。有的只是玛拉·索维和狂暴的嚎叫声，以及难以捉摸的逻辑现实。

她孤注一掷的豪赌终于有了收获。

接下来就看她的了。

88788776.name: Reverie Dawn Cloak
88788776.flavor: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
88788776.lore:
She feels Oryx's true death in both halves of her soul, a full imagined exhale before the aftershock reaches his throne world.

It crumbles around her like stone, like ash, like veils in a breeze.

Eris Morn's friends have succeeded. The Guardians have slain a god.

She steps through the ruins. In the end, there is nothing. Nothing but Mara Sov and the howling of rampant, untamed logics.

Her great and terrible gamble has paid off.

The rest is up to her now.

4086489106.name: Reverie Dawn Casque
4086489106.flavor: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
4086489106.lore:
She waits.

She trusts that Eris will shepherd the Guardians and that the infinite ambition of those undying half-children will deliver her. They will enter the court and challenge its king and dance in its killing ground, and they will master the school of sword logic so mightily that they will overturn its teacher and forsake the crown.

Soon.

But soon may not be soon enough, because Oryx roams the hallowed spires and melancholy shores of the Dreaming City. He stands looking out over the mists of her beautiful creation, and he laughs.

She can feel him there like a thorn in the meat of her palm.
She scolds herself for not factoring Shuro Chi's love into her design. Then she berates herself for this nervous energy, this fretful self-cannibalism.

Lungless, Mara remembers the sensation of a deep breath. Enacts it in her mind.

She remembers the singularity before her.

She waits.
4086489106.lore_zh:
她在等待。

她相信埃里斯会带领那些守护者，那些充满野心不死不灭的小家伙们能实现她的愿望。他们会冲进朝堂，挑战王权，推翻统治。他们将超越自己的老师，领悟邪剑守则的真谛，权力再也无法束缚他们。

很快这一切就会成真。

不过很快也许还不够快，因为欧里克斯已经来到了幽梦之城，在神圣的尖塔与忧郁的海岸边徘徊。他站在一边，望着她亲手创造出的美丽迷雾开怀大笑。

她感受到他的存在，就像扎在手心里的一根刺一样。

她责怪自己没有把秋露·知的爱恋纳入设计。这种自责使她陷入了痛苦的自我否定和焦虑之中。

尽管已经没有了肺，玛拉依然记得深吸一口气时的感觉，那种感觉深深地印在她的脑海中。

她记得眼前那个奇点。

她在等待。

3002985709.name: Reverie Dawn Strides
3002985709.flavor: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
3002985709.lore:
Joy wells in her heart when her searching fingers trace the edges of Eleusinia.

She has passed through the desert. She has reached the far side of the chessboard. She is alive, or soon will be.

She opens the door and her joy dies on the threshold.

Her throne world is desecrated.

Not annihilated, as Oryx's was. The pillars and terraces and courtyards still retain their shape. But the roots have rotted, and the geometry festers.

She should have known she would not be the only one to plan for such eventualities.

Oryx's bootprints pucker like scars in the labyrinth that was once only her own.

She sits a while beneath Sjur's statue, then follows his tracks through the ruins of Eleusinia, back to the Dreaming City.
3002985709.lore_zh:
当她搜索的手指发现了厄琉息斯的边界时，心中乐开了花。

她穿越了沙漠，她抵达了棋盘的另外一边。她还活着，或者说马上就重获新生了。

她打开了门，原本喜悦的心一下跌入谷底。

她的王座世界被玷污了。

与欧里克斯的不一样，这个世界并没有消失。巨大的圆柱、梯田和庭院依然保持着本来的面貌。不过根部已经腐烂，几何状态不断溃烂。

她应该知道虽然自己有计策，但别人也不会坐以待毙。

在这个曾经只有她自己脚印的迷宫里，欧里克斯的靴印犹如烙在她身上的一块块伤疤。

她在苏尔的雕像下坐了一会儿，然后跟随着他的足迹走过了厄琉息斯废墟，回到了幽梦之城。

3418320358.name: Dreambane Grips
3418320358.flavor: "Their curses are now your charms. Hold such hatreds close, for they reveal their fears." —Eris Morn

1327035786.name: Dreambane Vest
1327035786.flavor: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn

1963853467.name: Dreambane Cloak
1963853467.flavor: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn

3060098719.name: Dreambane Cowl
3060098719.flavor: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn

2977452768.name: Dreambane Strides
2977452768.flavor: "You will go where none have gone before. Tread carefully." —Eris Morn

4134659289.name: Crystocrene Grips
4134659289.flavor: "Busy hands are warm hands! Do your part for the colony in these extra-insulated work gloves." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

2893611839.name: Crystocrene Vest
2893611839.flavor: "Conserving body heat is key to staving off hypothermia; a serious risk on Europa." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

4140770382.name: Crystocrene Cloak
4140770382.flavor: "Prepare for your arctic adventure with the very best in Bray outfitting!" —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

492357704.name: Crystocrene Cowl
492357704.flavor: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

2731877579.name: Crystocrene Strides
2731877579.flavor: "Ultra-light ion shielding keeps you protected AND mobile in a radiated, rapidly changing climate." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

1193572528.name: Veritas Grips
1193572528.flavor: "Truth is difficult. And that's fine. I don't trust anyone who doesn't like a challenge." —Chul Sobong, Hidden instructor

905917400.name: Veritas Vest
905917400.flavor: "You'll never know truth with real certainty. All you can do is hew away at preconception with the facts and pray that whatever shape's left at the end is a reasonable facsimile." —Dagget-4, Hidden analyst

4020836597.name: Veritas Cloak
4020836597.flavor: "You need to seek truth out. It's small, and it's ugly, and it's easy to miss. And it's also the only thing in this universe you can orient yourself by." —Hsei-22, Hunter

1297433145.name: Veritas Cowl
1297433145.flavor: "Life is lies. Comfort? Justice? Love? They're things we made up. Don't make the mistake of assuming true and false are the same as good and bad. What's important is being able to tell them apart." —Omar Saint Croix, Hidden handler

1552207754.name: Veritas Strides
1552207754.flavor: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty, and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator

2362752274.name: Thunderhead Grips
2362752274.flavor: "That 10-year timer simplifies things, in a way. What's most important? Right here, right now? What one thing makes Neomuna better?" —Derecho, Cloud Strider

1982705366.name: Thunderhead Vest
1982705366.flavor: "We're momentary creatures, and the future is distant and vast. But many stones, in time, change the river's course." —Briar, Cloud Strider

1691247683.name: Thunderhead Mask
1691247683.flavor: "Iterate and advance. That's what we do. No time to dwell on failures, only learn from them." —Kestrel, Cloud Strider

2764093868.name: Thunderhead Strides
2764093868.flavor: "That's what it's all about, right? You only ever see the seeds. The plants are for the children. Metaphorically." —Myriadical, Cloud Strider

1312332543.name: Thunderhead Cloak
1312332543.flavor: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider

1738534735.name: First Ascent Grips
1738534735.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Caiatl wonders what waits inside the Traveler. She's heard the stories from Red Legion defectors about how it swallowed Ghaul like a warbeast choking down a bone. 

"He's still in its belly," a Valus on her War Council once told her, and Saladin Forge had made a breathy sound through his nose that Caiatl interpreted as laughter. 

That was days ago. Now she stands on the bridge of her ship, wondering what of Ghaul remains, the Traveler's glow reflected in the black of her eyes and the ornamental jewelry she wears on her tusks. She does not feel the pull of it, as she imagines Ghaul did, or even Saladin's quiet reverence. It is not a thing to be conquered or worshipped, but it is important to the people who are important to her—and that is all that matters. 

When she hears footsteps behind her, she does not turn. She already knows whom they belong to. 

"I did not request your counsel," she says without reprimand. "But if you have something to say, then speak." 

"Must I always have some wisdom for you?" Saladin asks. "Can't we simply await the end together in comfortable silence?" 

"Your worth is your wisdom. It's the only reason I let you live." 

Saladin makes that noise again. He knows that isn't true. 

And so does she.
1738534735.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

查厄托想知道旅行者内部会有什么在等着他们。她从猩红军团叛逃者那里听说过旅行者是如何像战兽啃食骨头一样吞下了盖欧。 

“他还在它的肚子里，”战争议会上的一名军政官曾经这样告诉查厄托，而她将萨拉丁·弗吉用鼻子发出的哼哼声理解为了嗤笑。 

那是两天前的事了。她现在站在她飞船的舰桥上，琢磨着盖欧还剩下了什么。旅行者的光芒映在她的漆黑眼珠和装饰獠牙的珠宝上。她没有感受到在她的想象中盖欧对它的渴求，也没有感受到萨拉丁对它的崇敬。它不是一种该被征服或膜拜的东西，但它对那些对她很重要的人来说很重要——这才是重点。 

当她听到身后有脚步声时，她没有转身。她已经知道那是谁了。 

“我没有询问你的意见，”她说道，没有斥责的意思。“但如果你有话要讲，那就开口吧。” 

“难道我是位智慧导师？”萨拉丁问道。“我们就不能一起安静地等待终末吗？” 

“你的智慧是你的价值。那是我让你活着的唯一原因。” 

萨拉丁又发出了那种哼哼声。他知道那不是真的。 

而她也知道。

3211013545.name: First Ascent Vest
3211013545.flavor: Oh, to read a pulpy golden age detective novel… just once more.
3211013545.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Ikora studied the strange approximation of the Tower, dust kicked up around her as the wind gusted through creaking halls. She felt the pull to explore… to find her old office. To see just how deep the recreation would go. 

But as she took a step up the stairs, her foot caught something—a small but familiar rectangular shape. She picked up the book and gently brushed dust from the cover. It was a copy of "The Spine-Tingling Adventures of Sedona Kane, P.I." The pulpy cover art told her it was the fourth installment of the series, with the subtitle "The Curious Case of Doctor Pennyworth." 

Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Darkness. In a place of such potent Light, would it be enough to manifest… everything? She flipped through the book; even the coffee stain still adorned page 95. 

Flashes of memory came back to Ikora as she studied the bold colors and heavy lines of the book's tattered jacket. She recalled kicking her feet up against the wall in her bunk one night after a particularly nasty Crucible loss… Ophiuchus's glow providing just enough visibility. Remembered cleaning the spilled drink off the pages in the mess hall and praying there was no lasting damage. And thought of other moments, of a warm hand covering her own as she read the text out loud for the thousandth time… 

The Warlock held the book to her nose. Just to take in the scent once more.  

Light forgets, Darkness remembers, and so would she.
3211013545.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

艾可拉审视着这座近似高塔的奇特建筑。她周围的尘土随着破败大堂中的狂风扬起。她感受到了探索的渴望…她想找到她以前的办公室。看看这个复制品到底有多像。 

但刚踏上楼梯，她的脚就碰到了一件物品——它的形状小而熟悉。她拿起那本书，轻轻拂去封面上的灰尘。这是一本《私家侦探塞多纳·凯恩的惊奇历险记》。从它俗气的封面上可以看出，这是该系列的第四部，副标题是“潘尼沃斯医生奇案”。 

光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

暗影。在光能如此充足的地方，它是否能够显现…一切？她翻了翻书；甚至第95页上的咖啡渍都还在。 

当艾可拉打量着破旧书皮上大胆的色彩和厚重的线条时，她的记忆片段又闪现在了眼前。她回想起在熔炉竞技场中大败后，有一天夜里躺床上用脚蹬着墙…蛇夫座的光刚好够亮…在食堂里清理洒在书本上的饮料，祈祷没留下永久印记。她还想起，当她反复大声阅读时，一只温暖的手覆在自己的手上… 

这位术士把书抵到自己的鼻头，再一次感受它的气味。  

光能遗忘，暗影铭记，而她也会如此。

696349540.name: First Ascent Cloak
696349540.flavor: There is nothing as exquisite as the feeling of doing what no one has done.
696349540.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mara Sov grit her teeth as she held the H.E.L.M. steady, straining all the while to keep the portal open with her power just long enough for the Guardian, Ikora, and Commander Zavala to slip through. 

Mara shifted her focus to watch the live feed in the viewscreen beside her as the Guardian took their first steps into the Pale Heart. 

And instantly… she remembered what it felt like to be first. 

She remembered unending emptiness, the spark of protons, cold rock against her back, and the sensation of spilling upwards eternally. She remembered glacial till veined with platinum, a forest that spread as mycelium, and alpine saddles cradling crystal clear lakes. She remembered a world so young and old, where all life was equal, meaningless and meaningful. She remembered making that memory, that place, calling it awake from the cauldron of her own imagination and raising it into matter, her lips curled on its name. The Distributary. 

Mara would never see that world again, and yet, on the grainy video stuttering before her, was its doppelganger. It was not home, but it was close. 

The video feed sputtered out. 

A roar of violet streaked past the H.E.L.M., and with a sudden silence, the ship burst from the portal into open space. The portal did not snap shut behind them—the Witness must have let go. 

Mara caught her breath. Her hands shook. There was no sign of Crow in there, or on comms, no sign he was alive other than the tug on her own heart. She glanced back to the Traveler and the Pale Heart within.  

Mara Sov thought once more of home.
696349540.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

玛拉·索维咬紧牙关，拼尽全力让应急后勤行动中心保持稳定，同时用她的力量保持传送门开启，让守护者、艾可拉、指挥官萨瓦拉有机会顺利通过。 

玛拉把注意力转移到身旁的屏幕上，通过直播画面看到守护者在苍白之心中迈出了第一步。 

忽然…她记起了身为先行者的感受。 

她记起了无尽的空虚，质子的火花，抵着后背的冰冷岩石，永远向上的延伸感。她记起了被铂金缠绕的冰川，像菌丝一样蔓延的森林，还有被高山环抱的清澈湖泊。她记起了一个如此年轻而古老的世界。在那里，所有的生命都平等，没有意义，也充满意义。她记起自己创造那段记忆，那个地方，把它从自己想象的大锅里唤醒，将它升华为物质，嘴角微微翘起说出它的名字：两仪界。 

玛拉再也见不到那个世界了。然而，在她面前不断卡顿的模糊视频中，她看见了那个世界的复制品。那不是家，但已经很接近了。 

视频信号中断了。 

一道紫色的光芒席卷了应急后勤行动中心，飞船里忽然安静下来。他们通过传送门冲进了无垠的太空，身后的传送门并没有关闭——见证者肯定是松手了。 

玛拉喘过气来。她的手在颤抖。里面没有乌鸦的踪迹，也没有来自他的通讯。除了心中的牵挂，没有任何迹象表明他还活着。她回头瞥了一眼旅行者和其中的苍白之心。  

玛拉·索维再次想起了家园。

67839818.name: First Ascent Cloak
67839818.flavor: There is nothing as exquisite as the feeling of doing what no one has done.
67839818.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mara Sov grit her teeth as she held the H.E.L.M. steady, straining all the while to keep the portal open with her power just long enough for the Guardian, Ikora, and Commander Zavala to slip through. 

Mara shifted her focus to watch the live feed in the viewscreen beside her as the Guardian took their first steps into the Pale Heart. 

And instantly… she remembered what it felt like to be first. 

She remembered unending emptiness, the spark of protons, cold rock against her back, and the sensation of spilling upwards eternally. She remembered glacial till veined with platinum, a forest that spread as mycelium, and alpine saddles cradling crystal clear lakes. She remembered a world so young and old, where all life was equal, meaningless and meaningful. She remembered making that memory, that place, calling it awake from the cauldron of her own imagination and raising it into matter, her lips curled on its name. The Distributary. 

Mara would never see that world again, and yet, on the grainy video stuttering before her, was its doppelganger. It was not home, but it was close. 

The video feed sputtered out. 

A roar of violet streaked past the H.E.L.M., and with a sudden silence, the ship burst from the portal into open space. The portal did not snap shut behind them—the Witness must have let go. 

Mara caught her breath. Her hands shook. There was no sign of Crow in there, or on comms, no sign he was alive other than the tug on her own heart. She glanced back to the Traveler and the Pale Heart within.  

Mara Sov thought once more of home.

2468561950.name: First Ascent Casque
2468561950.flavor: Choose what you will become next.
2468561950.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Once, a Ghost was heard to speak thusly. 

This one is Luzaku. Here, this one tells what is known of Sky. 

Sky is the breath taken between actions. It permits speculation. It invites doubt. It slips from sight and grasp, and yet persists. 

This one's Ghost would have us yield to certainty. He wishes us to walk the Bladed Path, to seek Hive-strength in the Witch Queen's abandoned logic, whereby all things prove themselves in slaughter. 

This one turns from simple inevitability. This one makes a choice: this one does not kill and does not die. Yet this one exists. Aiat. What follows? What other choices are to be made? 

This one must know. 

This one hides within a blade-ship of the Witch Queen's great foe. This one's Ghost is angry now, but he remains. In the hollows where a worm once coiled, this one senses our swift motion through the firmament, toward a center. 

This one seeks Sky. In the Sky, there are many paths. 

In the Sky, there is change.
2468561950.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

很久以前，一个机灵说过这些话。 

鄙人是鲁扎库，在此讲述鄙人对苍穹的了解。 

苍穹是行动之间的喘息。它允许猜测。它引人怀疑。它难以追踪和把握，却始终留存。 

鄙人的机灵希望我们屈服于确定性。他希望我们走上刀锋之道，寻求邪魔族的力量，遵从巫妖女王遭抛弃的逻辑，即万物需在屠杀中证明自身。 

鄙人放弃了简单的必然性。鄙人做出了选择：鄙人不杀，也不死亡。然而，鄙人仍然存在。阿特。接下来呢？还要做出什么选择？ 

鄙人必须知晓。 

鄙人躲在巫妖女王宿敌的刀锋飞船里。鄙人的机灵很生气，但他没有离去。在蠕虫曾经盘踞的深渊里，鄙人感知到我们正迅速穿过苍穹，前往中心。 

鄙人探寻苍穹。苍穹内有许多道路。 

苍穹内有变化。

2313034993.name: First Ascent Strides
2313034993.flavor: To enter the body of a deity would be to unquestionably defile it.
2313034993.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mithrax stood at the bow of the H.E.L.M., watching as Zavala's ship vanished from view into the portal. That awful gateway pulsed and wavered, and though the H.E.L.M. was pointed straight at it, he was resolved in his decision. 

The notion of venturing inside the Great Machine was innately revolting. It reeked like a taboo as certain as cannibalism, as unthinkable as besmirching a house of worship; to enter the body of a deity would unquestionably be to defile it. He could find a way to support from afar. Surely that was plausible.  

"Father, the Queen is asking for you." 

Eido sidles up next to him, and the two look out over the Great Machine. It takes up the entirety of the window—the center of all Light punctured by the oscillating violet of the portal, and Mithrax realizes how small he feels alongside his daughter. 

"I'm not going down there without you," she says. 

Mithrax holds back his shiver and confesses, "To step inside feels like a transgression." 

"And who made that rule?" she says. Ever acute, ever wise. When Mithrax cannot answer, she continues, "The Traveler is in peril. So long as we can care, we are bound to enter and defend it. I have seen you still have fight in you, Father." 

"Would that not be worse? To wage war at the very center of Light?" 

"Only you can decide that. But I believe the Traveler would want you to enter the portal." 

"Why?" 

His daughter puts a loving hand on his own. "Because it knows you aren't there to hurt it."
2313034993.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

米瑟拉克斯站在应急后勤行动中心的船首，注视着萨瓦拉的飞船从视野中消失，进入传送门。那道可怕的大门在脉动和摇摆，尽管应急后勤行动中心正对着它，但他已经下定了决心。 

进入大机器内部的想法令他反感。像同类相食一般让人厌恶，像糟蹋圣堂一般难以想象；进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。他可以想办法从远处进行支援。他认为那是在理的。  

“父亲，女王在找你。” 

艾多走到他的身边。两人眺望着大机器。它填满了整个窗户——这位光能之神的中心，被传送门的震荡之紫刺穿了，米瑟拉克斯意识到自己和女儿在其身边是多么渺小。 

“没有你，我不会进去，”她说。 

米瑟拉克斯强忍着冷颤承认道，“进去像是一种亵渎。” 

“那种规则是谁定的？”她反问道。一如既往地机敏、睿智。米瑟拉克斯不知如何回答，而她还在继续，“旅行者正处于危险之中。只要我们还关爱它，我们就必须进去保护它。我知道你还有斗志，父亲。” 

“那样不是更糟糕吗？在光能的中心作战？” 

“那取决于你。但我相信旅行者会希望你进入传送门。” 

”为什么？“ 

他的女儿把一只充满爱意的手放在他的手背上。“因为它知道你不是去伤害它的。”
