作为一个满是暗影的世界，这里一片漆黑。

你闻到四周都是腐烂的腥臭味。

狂风在你的耳边怒吼着。

没有星星的天空就悬挂在你的上方。

你手足无措；在你目所能及的地方，没有任何可供触碰的东西。

你的灵魂深感疲惫。

你听到你的印记在风中翻腾。

你的光能消散了……

280416716.name: Apostate's Blade Gauntlets
280416716.flavor: What is made in the sword world is true.
280416716.lore:
When she hears of Eris, Mara thinks of Saturn. Remembers disintegration, molecule by molecule, the sword of Oryx's intent and throne severing her from the mortal coil more thoroughly than any firearm ever could. She remembers the pain of surrendering, looking out on cessation and allowing it in, against all her instincts. 

The journey across the Sea of Screams, and the safe harbor she barely reached. 

And its consequence: Eleusinia festers still. Mara ever has some awareness of its presence, her third and truest throne. In its placement it is bound with the Dreaming City, looped in the same febrile pulse again and again. Shattered, haunted with sickness, with no true capacity to heal.  

A ruin of a shining thing. Like some would have thought of Eris. 

So this is where that thought brings Mara back: the beginning again. First seedlings after frost, the delicacy of hope. Look at Eris. Look at what Eris wrought for herself, climbing up from the very bottom of the Pit. Mara will not mourn by ceasing, for that would not honor her. Instead, there is honor in action. In beginning to climb, even if one must first crawl. 

Sometimes, as she does now, Mara imagines a future where she and her Techeuns return to that heart of the Dreaming City. She does not hope for a miracle, new-made and perfect; instead, when Mara lets it come to her thoughts at all, she bears in mind the slow work of forming it, the queensfoil and the chisel, and what it means to start over again. The ragged edge sewn up; the broken stone mortared. 

She wants to scar her hands with the work. Someday, when she can, when she does, the name Eris Morn will be chiseled into the walls. 

The sky can always be found again.
280416716.lore_zh:
听闻埃里斯的消息时，玛拉脑海中浮现出土星。她回想起解体的那一刻，分子一一消散，欧里克斯奥的意图之剑和王座将她从凡尘中斩断，比任何火器都更加彻底。她记得放弃时的痛楚，却逆着所有的天性凝视着终结，任由其吞噬自己。 

穿越尖叫之海的旅途，她好不容易抵达的避风港。 

而结果是：厄琉息斯仍在腐烂。玛拉始终对它有所感知，那是她的第三个，也是最真实的王座。它与幽梦之城相连，不断在同样的狂热脉动中轮回。破碎、疾病缠身，无法真正愈合。  

辉煌事物留下的废墟，正如有些人眼中的埃里斯。 

这就是那思绪将玛拉带回的地方：最初的时候。如同霜后初生的第一抹绿意，希望的微妙象征。看看埃里斯吧，看看埃里斯是如何从深渊的最深处挣扎而起。玛拉不会选择停滞来哀悼，因为那并非对她的尊重。相反，行动才是尊重的体现，哪怕是艰难地爬行，她也要开始攀登。 

有时，就像现在，玛拉会构想一个未来，她与她的灵巫们会重返幽梦之城的中心。她不奢望奇迹，一个全新且完美的世界；相反，当玛拉让这样的念头涌入心田时，她铭记着慢工出细活的道理，女王兰与她的凿子，以及重新开始的意义。缝合破碎的边缘，用灰泥修补残破的石头。 

她想让自己的双手随着工作而留下疤痕。有朝一日，当她有能力做到时，埃里斯·摩恩的名字将被镌刻在墙上。 

总会再次找到天空的。

3622930836.name: Apostate's Blade Plate
3622930836.flavor: Sorrow is an indulgence. Never let it consume you.
3622930836.lore:
It's difficult to be furious with a man who is already hanging himself out to dry. Ikora wants to scream "Where were you?" and "How could you let this happen?" Any assortment of recriminations. 

She knows herself better than that. Knows the sharp cut that has opened a raw wound will ebb into a burning ache soon enough. Knows that whatever she would ask of the Drifter is truly what she wants to ask of herself. 

Where was she? How could she let this happen? 

Eris was right. Ikora would have kept her safe, and she would not have been the same Eris again. 

"Thank you," Ikora tells the Drifter instead. "For carrying the news. I know… you did what you could." 

He looks like she has struck him, regardless. Perhaps he would have preferred that. He tries, visibly, to say something, and words fail him. Words fail them both. Ikora can't excuse herself fast enough. 

"He wanted you to yell at him," Ophiuchus says later. "He's looking to get himself hurt." Ikora understands but isn't sure if she's helped or hindered his self-imposed penance. 

She wants to make herself titanium and fury, undaunted and vicious, to tear through the resurging Taken and pay loss out in violence. But she is too used to squashing it down, and now more than ever, she cannot leave her post. With responsibility has come the weight of age. 

Instead, for a little while, Ikora lets herself have sorrow.
3622930836.lore_zh:
对一个已经自暴自弃的人发火是很难的。艾可拉想要尖叫：“你那时候在哪里？”和“你怎么能让这种事发生？”有千言万语的责备想要倾泻而出。 

但她了解自己不是那样的人，深知锋利的伤口已经撕裂了肌肤，很快就会化作难以忍受的痛楚。她也明白，那些她想问浪客的问题，其实都是在质问自己。 

她那时候在哪里？她怎么能让这种事发生？ 

埃里斯是对的。艾可拉确实可以保护她，但那样一来，埃里斯就不再是昔日的埃里斯了。 

“谢谢你，”艾可拉改而对浪客说。“谢谢你带来消息。我知道…你尽力了。” 

即便如此，他看起来仍像是挨了她一拳似的。或许，他内心更愿意承受那样的痛苦。他明显是努力想说些什么，但最终还是欲言又止。两人相顾无言。艾可拉非常迅速地把他打发走了。 

“他希望你对他吼叫，”后来，蛇夫座说。“他想承受这份伤痛。”艾可拉明白这一点，但不确定自己是帮助了，还是阻碍了他的自我惩罚。 

她希望能让自己像钛一样坚硬而愤怒，无畏而凶猛，能够撕裂复兴的傀儡军团，血债血偿。但她早已习惯了压抑这种情绪，而且现在，她比以往任何时候都更不能离开自己的岗位。责任为她带来了岁月的沉重负担。 

于是艾可拉还是让自己悲伤了一小会儿。

496251113.name: Apostate's Blade Mark
496251113.flavor: The mathematics of war was ever written in blood.
496251113.lore:
Caiatl measures the distance to Torobatl not in light-years but in lives, not in star systems but in the ships that would need to be shored up, the legions re-conditioned to the pitch depths of space. It is not a matter of "if" it can be done, but rather "when." How long to wait for Human allies, piling rubble up into fortifications; how long to stamp out the dregs of exiled Legions in Sol. 

"Here." Valus Forge has brought her a set of records from the Vanguard. They unfold in sequences of recorded violence—blurry, difficult to parse chitin from armor—and a scrolling list of numbers, a death toll that spikes precipitously. "No one likes to speak of it. But the intel's valuable. The Great Disaster." 

"When the Vanguard sought to retake Luna from the Hive." Caiatl knows the story of it, if not the visceral truth. Has heard it murmured, rumors passed from one to another. "But Crota is dead. As is Oryx. And Xivu Arath is severed from her throne world…" 

"Even a Lightless Guardian is still a threat." Valus Forge does not name names. He does not have to. Caiatl is well familiar with Osiris, with Eris Morn who brought the Hive gods under her heel. 

Xivu Arath has no refuge, yet it does not mean she is dulled. As any with but one life, they will fight to the death, with all that they have and more. Caiatl nods with grave intention. 

She reviews the records. She changes her variables. And she does the math again.
496251113.lore_zh:
查厄托在衡量前往图罗巴特尔的路程时，并不以光年作为尺度，而是以生命为单位，不按星系计算，而是依据需要加固的飞船数量和需要重新适应太空环境的军团规模来考量。重点不是“能否”做到，而是“何时”。他们需要等待多久，人类盟友才能将瓦砾堆砌成防御工事；又要多久，才能在太阳系里彻底清除流放军团。 

“给你。”军政官弗吉带来了一组先锋的记录。展开后，呈现出一系列暴力事件的影像——画面模糊，难以区分甲壳和护甲——以及一串不断攀升的伤亡数字。“没人愿意提起它，但情报的价值不容忽视。这就是大灾难。” 

“先锋试图从邪魔族手中夺回月球的时候。”查厄托不了解全部真相，但知道这个故事，听过在众人之间口耳相传的传闻。“但克洛塔已死，欧里克斯亦是如此。希乌阿拉斯与她的王座世界失去了联系…” 

“无光的守护者依然构成威胁。”军政官弗吉并未点名道姓。他无需如此。查厄托对奥斯里斯，以及将邪魔族之神踩在脚下的埃里斯·摩恩都很熟悉。 

希乌阿拉斯虽无避难之所，但这并不意味着她是一把钝剑。正如同任何只拥有一次生命的人，他们会倾尽所有，战斗至死。查厄托严肃地点了点头。 

她仔细查阅记录，调整变量，然后再次进行计算。

1393530461.name: Apostate's Blade Helm
1393530461.flavor: There is a knife for you.
1393530461.lore:
To be Taken is to yield. Sloane hears it still, that refrain that haunted her in Titan's depths. Take. Live. And quieter, behind it, something that stirs. A whispered offer. There is a knife… 

That part is newer, and it troubles Sloane. Her bond with Ahsa insulates, protects. There can be no claim on her by force. But that says nothing of Sloane's own will. No material yet exists that cannot be worn down, in time. Oceans, whether methane or water, break rock into sand. 

Any yielding is akin to ceding entirely. 

Sloane cordons off any sense of that nagging offer. She will have no risk of slipping. She will know, perfectly, where she ends, where the Taken begins. There is no room for doubt. 

She thinks, in her meditation, of Eris. Eris who went down into the Pit. Eris who came back changed. Eris, Hive enough to stand as God of Vengeance. Does Eris have such a delineation? Does Eris say, here is the Hive, and here is Eris Morn, and never the two shall meet? 

No. She cannot. Or that new Hive god, made chitinous from her flesh, would have been someone else. 

Sloane imagines: what if she did the same? If she took into her hands a grievous knife and said, Sloane is the one who holds the knife—Sloane is the knife. She is sharp; sharper and alight with the sterile flame of the Taken— 

It is not the same. Sloane knows it heart-deep, bone-deep. She cannot put that knife down once she has taken it up. Not like Eris and the Hive. What is Taken is not given back. 

No. They cannot be the same.
1393530461.lore_zh:
成为傀儡军团意味着屈服。斯隆的耳畔依旧回响着那个在土卫六深处萦绕不去的副歌——夺取、生存。而在其背后，更加隐秘地，有什么东西在悄然搅动，仿佛一个低语的诱惑。有一把刀… 

这个新状况让斯隆感到不安。她与阿莎之间的联系如同绝缘体，保护着她，没有人能够强迫她。但这并不代表斯隆能够完全掌控自己的意志，毕竟，没有物质能够经受住时间的侵蚀。无论其构成物是甲烷还是水，海洋最终都会将坚硬的岩石击碎成沙。 

任何一丝的屈服，都意味着完全的妥协。 

斯隆将那个扰人心神的诱惑隔离在外。她绝不会让自己陷入堕落的深渊。她会清晰地分辨，哪一部分是真正的自我，哪一部分是傀儡，绝不能有丝毫的犹豫。 

在冥想的过程中，她的思绪飘向了埃里斯。曾进入过深渊，归来后判若两人，邪魔族化得足以成为复仇之神的埃里斯。埃里斯是否也有过类似的界定呢？埃里斯是否也曾说过，这一部分是邪魔族，那一部分是埃里斯·摩恩，而两者永不交融？ 

不，这不可能。否则，那个从她的躯体中诞生的新邪魔族之神，就会是完全不同的存在。 

斯隆开始想象：如果她也走上这条路呢？如果她拿起一把痛苦之刀并宣称，斯隆是持刀者——斯隆就是那把刀。她很锋利；更加锋利，燃烧着傀儡军团澄澈的火焰—— 

这不一样。斯隆深知于心，深知于骨。一旦她拿起那把刀，就再没有放下的可能。这与埃里斯和邪魔族的情况不同。被夺取的是永远拿不回来的。 

不，绝对不同。

926252150.name: Apostate's Blade Greaves
926252150.lore:
Compose audio message? 

"The problem with getting attached to people is—" 

Deleted without sending. 

"There's never been anyone like her. Never will be again." 

Deleted without sending. 

"Hey, hero, you know about this stuff, right?" 

Deleted without sending. 

"Hey, uh… you think any of those eggs have hatched yet?" 

Deleted without sending. 

"For all the times I've watched people move on, out of my life—never wished so hard to go with 'em. Knowing what she'd want don't make it doable." 

Deleted without sending. 

A howl of utmost anguish. "What do I do?!" 

Deleted without sending.

2367623270.name: Techeun's Regalia Gauntlets
2367623270.flavor: "Help when you can. This is best, most simple way to become hero." —Saint-14
2367623270.lore:
Saint-14 followed the trajectory of the Hawk as it plummeted. He reached the crash site several miles out.  

The Legion patrol that arrived soon afterwards had come prepared to confront a few injured civilians. Not Saint-14. While the crew huddled under his Ward of Dawn, Saint hurled his shield at the field commander's rifle, then charged. 

Even battle couldn't silence his thoughts entirely. It was unkind of him, to wish for Osiris to be here beside him, trading blows with the enemy. Osiris was no longer helpless, but neither was he unchanged. If he were here, Saint would have asked that he stay inside the Ward's shield with the others. 

But Osiris had run off to Neptune, where Saint could do nothing for him but wait. 

Saint punched through a Phalanx shield, tore it from the Shadow Legionary's grip, and brought it down repeatedly onto the Legionary's head. 

When Saint was finished, he extended a hand toward the nearest civilian. 

"Come. Geppetto and I will lead you back to the Farm." 

The woman was focused on cutting at her scarf with her knife, working with the determined focus of someone performing a ritual. He looked at the faded violet cloth in her hand, and the familiarity of the moment washed over him.  

Saint sank to one knee and waited patiently as she tied the strip of material to his armor. 

Things had not changed so much. He could be patient. He would tell Osiris this story, too, when they were face to face once more.
2367623270.lore_zh:
圣人14号跟着鹰隼的坠落轨迹跟了过去，到达了几英里外的失事地点。  

随后到来的军团巡逻队也许能对付几个受伤的平民，但绝不是圣人14号的对手。机组成员蜷缩在他的黎明护罩之下，圣人则将他的护盾朝战地指挥官的步枪扔去，然后发起了冲锋。 

就连战斗也无法停止他的思绪。希望奥斯里斯在这里与他并肩作战不是很体贴的想法。奥斯里斯虽然能够战斗，但他已经变了。就算他在这里，圣人也会让他和其他人一起留在护罩之下。 

但奥斯里斯已前往了海王星。圣人除了等待之外什么也做不了。 

圣人打穿了一个方阵士兵的护盾，将它从暗影军团士兵的手里夺了过来，然后不断地用它敲打着士兵的头。 

解决掉敌人之后，圣人朝最近的平民伸出了手。 

“来吧。盖比特和我会将你们带回农庄。” 

那名女飞行员以仪式般的执着专心用刀砍自己的围巾。他盯着她手上那块褪色的紫布，猛地感到似曾相识。  

圣人单膝跪下，耐心地等着她把这块布绑在他的护甲上。 

其实变化也没那么多。他可以耐心一点。与奥斯里斯重逢时，他还会把这件事讲给他听。

950387978.name: Techeun's Regalia Plate
950387978.flavor: "Normally, I would say nothing is beyond us with Queen Mara's assistance… but things are far from normal." —Commander Zavala
950387978.lore:
While Devrim and the Guardian discussed strategy around a table littered with maps and steaming mugs of tea, Ghost glided silently away through one of the gaps in the roof. 

Once outside, he kept low, following the creek bed toward the outlying buildings. He looked at the broken waterwheel that lay toppled across the stones and tried to remember the Farm as he had last seen it. 

Survivors had flocked here during the Red War, banding together to gather supplies and resources. They built water purification equipment and planted crops. They built new homes for themselves. Even under the shadow of Ghaul's ambitions, there had been laughter here, and defiant joy. 

Now the Farm was still and quiet, frozen in the aftermath of the Shadow Legion's attack. The soldiers, technicians, and medics posted here tonight were grim-faced and focused. No one was fishing off the dock. No one was laughing by a fire. 

The soccer field had been bombarded past recognition. Most of the surviving buildings could barely accommodate field equipment. The Farm wasn't much of a farm.

But then, it wasn't that long ago that there hadn't been anything here at all. 

Whether they faced Ghaul or the Shadow Legion, the task ahead remained the same. Gather survivors. Help them reach safety. 

So long as there were people to rebuild it, there would be a Farm. There would be joy here again. 

Ghost took one final look at the stars. Then he turned and floated back around toward the outpost and his Guardian. 

Time to get to work.
950387978.lore_zh:
德弗里姆和守护者在一张布满地图和热茶的桌子旁讨论策略时，机灵悄悄地从屋顶上的缝隙里溜了出去。 

出去后，他压低高度，沿着溪床朝外围的建筑飞去。他看看翻倒在石头上的水车，试图回想起农庄以前的模样。 

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边欢笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们眼前的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

2009401631.name: Techeun's Regalia Helmet
2009401631.flavor: "The absence of fear in the face of danger is not bravery. It's either foolishness… or insanity." —Lord Saladin
2009401631.lore:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."
2009401631.lore_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊眯着眼朝天看去。温暖的阳光与各处传来的鸟鸣反而使笼罩农庄的不祥之感更强烈了。一位年轻的飞行员坐在这位先锋领导人的对面，紧张地摆弄着飞行服的拉链。

“他们给你东西吃了吗？”艾可拉用从容平和的语气问道。

“给了，女士，”飞行员点头道。“他们给了我们一大碗褐色的粥。其实更像是个食槽。闻起来像是猫粮。他们大概是想让我们用手抓着吃吧？不过也没人相信那东西能吃。”

“那些狱卒是什么样的？”这位术士追问道。“他们是粗暴，温和，还是吵闹…？他们互相说话吗？”

“都不是，女士。他们…没什么特征。”女飞行员皱了皱眉头，努力寻找着合适的表达方式。“我以前接触过卡巴尔，友方的和敌对的都接触过。他们一般都很吵，喜欢打闹、打嘴炮…你知道的，就像普通士兵那样。” 

艾可拉点头表示理解。她也发现查厄托女帝的底层士兵在女帝不在时相当闹腾。
 
“但暗影军团感觉很…空虚，”飞行员继续说道。“有时，军官会大声喝令，但除那之外，监狱里总是一片寂静。我们的狱卒只会站在那里，一动不动，直视前方，沉重地呼吸着。几乎可以算是…喘息。就个性而言，他们和空壳无异。” 

她沉默了一会儿。“我也不知道原因，”她总结道，“但没什么比那种空虚感更可怕。”

1926755680.name: Techeun's Regalia Greaves
1926755680.flavor: "Though we go where none have walked before, we do not tread lightly." —Commander Zavala
1926755680.lore:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
1926755680.lore_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

1587205659.name: Techeun's Regalia Mark
1587205659.flavor: "What stories will they tell of you when this is over?" —Saint-14
1587205659.lore:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to hear the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riskor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying. 

"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
1587205659.lore_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者听到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

2609656681.name: Pantheos Resplendent Gauntlets
2609656681.lore:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected. 

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2609656681.lore_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。 

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

1774949103.name: Pantheos Resplendent Plate
1774949103.flavor: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
1774949103.lore:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets. 

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
1774949103.lore_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。 

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

3022107774.name: Pantheos Resplendent Mark
3022107774.lore:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks. 

But you are still an icon. 

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit. 

We try again. 

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all? 

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse. 

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready. 

And I know we cannot be ready. 

We must try anyway.
3022107774.lore_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。 

但你依旧是个象征。 

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。 

我们再试一次。 

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？ 

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。 

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。 

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。 

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

2145853080.name: Pantheos Resplendent Helm
2145853080.lore:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
2145853080.lore_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

2901598523.name: Pantheos Resplendent Greaves
2901598523.flavor: You know that you will fight forever.
2901598523.lore:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
2901598523.lore_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

3514115395.flavor: Worn by champions of the track.

3381988877.name: Circuit Chestplate
3381988877.flavor: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.

1961831168.name: Racer's Mark
1961831168.flavor: Your enemies will see the signs of your approach. They will not be able to stop you.

1742878074.name: Circuit Keeper
1742878074.flavor: Don't outthink your opponents. Outfly them.

1606162165.name: Circuit Striders
1606162165.flavor: These boots left their mark on victory lane.

798548386.name: Gauntlets of the Great Hunt
798548386.lore:
I am [Riven]. My work on the Dreaming [City] is complete.

I have done everything [the Queen] asked of me. But this is a [bargain].

I did so much more than that.

[The Queen] and her ilk will not understand for some time, though I think [the Queen] can see the signs. What I carved into the small corners. In the Wall of [Wishes] itself.

This will be a beautiful [City].

But not a safe [City].
798548386.lore_zh:
我是【魅痕】。我在幽梦之【城】的工作已经结束。

我已经完成了【女王】交代的任务。但这只是一个【协议】。

我所做的远远不止这些。

【女王】和她的亲信们暂时不会明白，不过我相信【女王】能看出一些征兆。我在一些小角落印刻了一些讯息。就在【愿望】墙里。

这里将会是一座美丽的【城】。

但不是一座安全的【城】。

2245795974.name: Plate of the Great Hunt
2245795974.lore:
Joxer checked the safety on his rifle for the ninth time.

Illyn of the Techeun stepped out of the greyness before him. A massive, coffin-shaped container levitated at her side.

"You won't need that," Illyn said of the rifle.

Joxer kept it in his hands.

 "All that Light and still your key motivation is fear. It's fear that drives you to ask the Queen for help."

"The Ahamkara are blasting and paving entire regions of Venus," he said.

"They wouldn't be so base. They're re-writing Venus."

"Whatever. It's a problem I can't punch. Do you have guns that will help, or not?"

The massive container lowered itself before the Titan. Illyn lifted the lid and pale cosmic light from within reflected off Joxer's eyes.

"Long rifles. Close quarters weapons. Silent killers in the night. All yours to borrow. You must return these when your Hunt is complete."

"Why?" Joxer frowned.

"Those are the conditions of her bargain. Take it or leave it."

"Her? The Queen?"

Illyn didn't respond.

Joxer took the entire container on his back.
2245795974.lore_zh:
这已经是乔科斯第九次检查自己的步枪保险了。

灵巫伊琳从他面前的灰雾中走了出来。一个巨大的棺材型箱子在她的身旁飘浮着。

“你用不到它的”，伊琳指的是那把步枪。

乔科斯攥紧了手中的枪。

“那些自诩为光能者的人还有你，你们依然被恐惧驱使。因为恐惧你们向女王求助。”

“阿罕卡拉正在摧毁整个金星”，他说。

“他们可没有这么原始，他们正在改造金星。”

“无论如何，这是我一个人解决不了的问题。你有我能用得上的枪吗？”

那个巨大的箱子降到了泰坦的面前。伊琳掀开盖子，乔科丝看到里面散射出苍白的宇宙之光。

“长管步枪、近战武器、夜晚使用的无声暗杀武器，你可以随便借去用。但在狩猎结束之后必须还给我。”

“为什么？”乔科斯不满地皱了皱眉。

“这是她开的条件，要么接受要么走人。”

“她？女王？”

伊琳并没有作答。

乔科斯直接把整个箱子背在了身后。

2988244847.name: Mark of the Great Hunt
2988244847.lore:
Mara stared at the Wall of Wishes. She had no more bargains to make. Her plans were in motion.

There was nothing left but the wait.

She pulled a sidearm from a hidden holster and cracked a dozen rounds into the Wall.

The cosmic balance shifted. Somewhere in the Dreaming City, Riven heard the Queen's wish and a thousand shrieking tears in reality cut through the space in front of her.

Lord Shaxx suddenly blocked Mara's view of the Wall.

"—YES, AND WE'D ALL BE DEAD!" He was screaming at no one, with a mug of caffeine in his fist.

He started, almost spilling his coffee. "Where are we?"

Mara slapped the mug out of his hand. It shattered on the floor. She shoved a weathered book in his face. "I told you there would come a time when I collect for the Reef Wars. Read this. Out loud."

"No one tells me what to do," he said, grabbing the book and incinerating it in a bolt of Striker lightning. "I can recite The Tempest by heart." And he did. Mara sat and listened. They stayed for a long time. 

The helmet stayed on.
2988244847.lore_zh:
玛拉凝视着愿望墙。她没有什么需要完成的协议了，她的计划正在实施中。

现在只要耐心等待就好。

她从随身的一个隐藏枪套中拔出枪，朝着墙上开了十几枪。

宇宙平衡转变。在幽梦之城的某处，魅痕听到女王的愿望，现实世界中无数的尖叫声撕裂着从她的面前穿过。

沙克斯领主突然挡在了玛拉和墙之间。

“——对，然后我们都得死！”他朝着空气大声吼道，手里还拿着一杯咖啡。

他差点儿把咖啡泼了出来，突然说道。“我们在哪儿？”

玛拉一把将他的咖啡杯打飞，杯子跌落到地上摔个粉碎。她拿起一本风化严重的书狠狠拍在了他的脸上。“当初我搜集暗礁战争信息的时候我就告诉过你会有这么一天。好好读读这个，大声读出来。”

“不用别人告诉我做什么”，说完，他抓起书本用一道强袭闪电将书化为了灰烬。“这本《暴风雨》我已经烂熟于心了。”事实果真如此。玛拉静静地坐着听他说，他们在这里待了好一会儿。

不过他们并没有卸下身上的装备。

3305541779.name: Helm of the Great Hunt
3305541779.lore:
[The Queen] would like to improve her means of [bargaining] with me. She has implied that I use the space between words to make [bargains] to my advantage.

How dare she.

She knows me so well.

What [the Queen] wants, the Techeun move worlds to obtain. And so the Witches devise an impossible machine that speaks a visual language with very few spaces between its words. This machine speaks [wishes]. Makes [bargains].

The Wall of [Wishes], it is called.

If the Techeun's design proves correct, it will be difficult for me to interpret the [wishes] made at the Wall to my advantage. But challenges entice me.

I look upon the Wall. Upon the Witches' visual language for [bargains]. For me, it is a menu of delights to feast upon.
3305541779.lore_zh:
【女王】想要跟我切磋一下完成【协议】的方法。她委婉地表示我在制定【协议】过程中的一些断句可能会产生对我有利的歧义。

她怎么敢这么说。

她真是太了解我了。

灵巫寻遍了整个世界为找到【女王】想要的东西。女巫们造出了一台不可思议的机器，这台机器可以说出一种词汇间连接紧密的视觉语言。这台机器会诉说【愿望】，还会拟【协议】。

它的名字叫【愿望】墙。

如果灵巫的设计没问题的话，我想在墙上那些许下的【愿望】里动手脚就会有些难度，不过这种挑战倒是很吸引我。

看看墙上吧，看看女巫们用来达成【协议】的视觉语言。对我来说，这只不过是一份美食菜单罢了。

3308728284.name: Greaves of the Great Hunt
3308728284.lore:
So the Dreaming City would have a Wall, too. Leona Bryl stared up at rows of blank, circular plates with dread.

This one was more valuable than everything behind the Wall of the Last City.

And not nearly as defensible.

The Tower has asked for help in its Great Hunt. If the Vanguard knew that the help the Queen rendered came at the behest of the Ahamkara, armies of Guardians would storm the Reef. So they will never know.

The Guardians brought this on themselves. The bargains they made, and the power and knowledge they gained was equivalent to the chaos wrought on this system by whispers. The Queen was glad to help them clean the mess if it meant Riven would be the last living Ahamkara. Power is useful. Unique power more so.

Leona wasn't sure if she was as glad as the Queen.
3308728284.lore_zh:
所以幽梦之城也会有一面愿望墙。蕾欧娜·布蕾尔惊恐地盯着一排排空的圆形金属板。

这东西比最后的城市高墙内的任何东西都更有价值。

这可不是信口开河。

高塔在大狩猎期间曾对外寻求帮助。如果先锋知道女王提供的帮助是奉阿罕卡拉的命令，守护者大军一定会踏平暗礁。所以他们永远不会知道

这都是守护者自找的。他们自己达成的协议，他们所获得的力量和知识就是逐渐给这个星系制造混乱。女王会很乐意帮他们收拾烂摊子，只要魅痕成为最后一个阿罕卡拉。力量是很有用的东西，独特的力量更甚。

蕾欧娜心中惴惴不安，她可不像女王那样乐于见到这样的事情。

1009804448.name: Gauntlets of Exaltation
1009804448.flavor: "Did you see that? Do you see what I can do?" —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
1009804448.lore:
Yardarm-4's back ached, and his feet were sore from running. But now nothing threated them in this unnatural vale. He looked over at his companions. They looked as bad as he felt. A joke wouldn't cut it, then. He needed to say something that would get their hackles up.

"You underestimated them," Yardarm-4 said.

Lisbon-13 turned his head sharply, but Rekkana touched Lisbon-13's arm.

Good boy, Yardarm-4 thought. She keeps you on a tight leash. These ideas came to Yardarm-4 unbidden, and so he said nothing.

"Yes," Rekkana said. "But it has given us perspective."

"Perspective?" What utter crap. Yardarm-4 had been tired, just playing at anger, but now it felt real. Still, Rekkana never said anything without purpose. "What perspective is worth nearly dying for?"

Something passed between Rekkana and Lisbon-13. She did not answer, and Lisbon-13 leapt into the gap she left, as he always would. "Those defenses were insane." That was true enough. "The relays and tethers. The Angelics. The Vex really don't want us to be here. That means they consider this place a weakness."

It's good to see some color back in her cheeks, observed Yardarm-4. And Lisbon-13 has his chest puffed out like some—

"Yes, it's a weakness," Yardarm-4 said, although he hadn't meant to. More words issued from his mouth. "Perhaps it's their greatest weakness."

Yardarm-4 shut his mouth in bewildered astonishment. The sentiments weren't wrong. It wasn't that they were things he wouldn't say. It's just… he hadn't meant to say them.

"Yes. So we must—" Rekkana began, but then Lisbon-13 raised the weapon they'd claimed and scanned the area.

Yardarm-4 jolted—a hypnic jerk. He wasn't tired anymore. He raised his own gun. "What is that? Where's it coming from?"

Rekkana joined them in defense against the unknown, her shoulder brushing Yardarm-4 as she drew her gun. "I don't hear—"

"You. It's coming from you. Because you're a hero."
1009804448.lore_zh:
雅尔达姆-4的背疼痛不止，他的双脚因奔跑而酸痛不堪。但在这个怪异的山谷中，没有任何东西能威胁他们。他看了看他的伙伴们。他们看起来和他感觉得一样糟糕。那么开个玩笑也无伤大雅。他需要说些什么，让他们打起精神来。

“你低估了他们。”雅尔达姆-4说到。

里斯本-13迅速转过头，但雷卡纳碰了碰里斯本-13的胳膊。

好孩子，雅尔达姆-4如此想着。她把你管的很紧。这些想法不自觉的就浮现在雅尔达姆-4的脑海中，但他什么都没说。

“是的，”雷卡纳说道。“但这给了我们看待的视角。”

“视角？”真是胡言乱语。雅尔达姆-4一直都很累，只是扮演愤怒，但现在感觉很真实。雷卡纳从来不会无的放矢。“什么视角值得为之去死？”

有些东西在雷卡纳和里斯本-13之间传递。她没有回答，和往常一样，里斯本-13跳进她留下的空隙。“那些防御简直疯了。”足够真实。“中继器和系链。那些天使。Vex真的很不愿意看到我们在这里。这就意味着他们觉得这地方是个弱点。”

看到她脸上恢复血色太好了，雅尔达姆-4观察到。里斯本-13的胸膛膨胀着，就像……

“是的，那是个弱点。”雅尔达姆-4说到，尽管他之前并不想说。他的口中说出了更多的话。“也许是他们最大的弱点。”

雅尔达姆-4闭上了嘴，困惑且惊讶。情绪并没有错。这些并不是他不愿意说的话。只是……他原本没想说出来。

“是的。所以我们必须……”雷卡纳开始了，但里斯本-13举起他们领的武器，开始扫描这片区域。

雅尔达姆-4震颤后，入睡前抽动了下。他再也不累了。他举起自己的枪。“那是什么？它从哪里来的？”

雷卡纳加入他们开始抵抗未知入侵，在抽出枪的时候她的肩膀擦过雅尔达姆-4.“我没听到……”

“是你。从你身体里发出来的。因为你是英雄。”

1743776488.name: Plate of Transcendence
1743776488.flavor: "The Vex can't stop us now. No one can."  —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
1743776488.lore:
Yardarm-4 spun, looking around the grotto.

"You hear that? Who is that?" Yardarm-4 had to stop himself from shouting.

"I hear it," Rekkana and Lisbon-13 said as one. A chill ran through him. How had they heard the voice if it was in his head?

All three Guardians called for their Ghosts.

"Ghost?" Yardarm-4 was first. "What have we got?"

Yardarm-4 started walking away even as his compatriots began talking with them.

"What are you looking for?" his Ghost asked.

"Anything. Everything. I… I'm not… Scan me. Look for something, someone else."

"Wow. OK…" His Ghost didn't understand, but it did as asked. "So, uh, what exactly am I look—?"

Yardarm-4 watched his Ghost's scan sputter out. Then the Ghost fell and clattered across the ground.

As Yardarm-4 picked it up, he felt his Light fading.

"Yardarm, Lisbon, you OK?" Rekkana asked from somewhere distant.

"Yeah. Sure." But Yardarm-4 did not feel OK, and he was not sure about anything.
1743776488.lore_zh:
雅尔达姆-4旋转着观察石窟的四方。

“你听到了吗？是谁？”雅尔达姆-4不得不阻止他的喊叫。

“我听到了，”雷卡纳和里斯本-13同时说道。他身上涌过一阵寒流。如果这声音是在他的脑中，他们又是怎么听到的？

三名守护者都呼叫了他们的机灵。

“机灵？”雅尔达姆-4是第一个。“现在什么情况？”

雅尔达姆-4开始往远处走去，即使他的同伴开始和他说话。

“你在找什么？”他的机灵问道。

“任何东西。所有一切。我……我不知道……扫描我。找到某种东西，某个人。”

“哇喔。好吧…”他的机灵并不懂，但也没问。“那么，我是要找什么……？”

雅尔达姆-4看着他机灵噼里啪啦的给出扫描。然后机灵跌落，摔在地上。

雅尔达姆-4把它捡起的时候，感觉自己的光能在衰减。

“雅尔达姆，里斯本，你们没事吧？”雷卡纳从远方问道。

“是的。没事。”但雅尔达姆-4感觉并非如此，他对一切都充满不确定。

3445873861.name: Temptation's Mark
3445873861.flavor: "If this is wrong, I don't want to be right." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
3445873861.lore:
"This isn't how the story is supposed to end," Rekkana said, seeming dazed.

"It's not over yet. We'll win this." Rekkana didn't look convinced. Yardarm-4 changed tack. "Listen, Lisbon's been holding back. He's afraid to use his new powers. So, in a straight-up fight against him, the advantage is ours, in numbers and strength."

"No."

"No?"

"Lisbon isn't afraid. He's angry. Desperate. He feels betrayed," said Rekkana. She was clear-eyed again, scanning their surroundings for signs of another ambush.

"HE feels betrayed?" It was a ludicrous idea. "He turned on us!"

"Yes, but it's because he doesn't see us as friends anymore."

"Well, he's got that part right. How'd he get so twisted? We all took the deal. And look at us now!"

Rekkana did look at herself, and then at him. "Did we do the right thing?"

Rekkana doubting herself? It was disorienting. He had to get her to focus.

"Of course we did. And we're going to return to the City and share what we've learned with your order. But first we have to make it out of the Black Garden. Listen, we don't have to fight Lisbon. But if we're going to avoid a showdown, we gotta know what he's planning."

Rekkana nodded.

"OK, so does he hit us from behind or block us? Should we expect more Vex to get funneled toward us?"

Rekkana closed her eyes. Her breathing slowed. Yardarm-4 kept an eye on their surroundings, but he glanced back at Rekkana often, to see the flicker of REM on her eyelids.

After a few minutes, Rekkana's breath quickened, and she opened her eyes.

"It's no use. There are too many possible threads to plot our paths."

"It's OK. We'll go where the wind blows us," Yardarm-4 mumbled.

"What?"

"I said, we'll chart our own course. We'll write our story as we live it."

Yardarm-4 put on a smile he didn't feel, and Rekkana pretended she had not heard what he'd first said.
3445873861.lore_zh:
“故事不应该这样结束。”雷卡纳说道，似乎困惑不已。

“还没结束。我们会赢的。”雷卡纳看起来并不十分确信。雅尔达姆-4改变了策略。“听着，里斯本一直没有用全力。他害怕使用自己的新能力。所以，在和他正面战斗的时候，我们是有优势的，不管是数量还是力量上。”

“不对。”

“不对？”

“里斯本并不害怕。他很愤怒。绝望。他觉得自己被背叛。”雷卡纳说到。她的目光再次清澈，扫描周围是否有埋伏的信号。

“他觉得被背叛了？”真是个滑稽的想法。“是他背叛了我们！”

“是的，但因为他再也不把我们视作朋友。”

“好吧，这一点他倒没错。他怎么会如此扭曲？我们都接受了那个交易。看看我们现在的样子！”

雷卡纳看了看她自己，然后看着他。“我们做的是正确的吗？”

雷卡纳怀疑自己？这让人迷惑不已。他必须让她集中精神。

“我们做的当然是正确的。我们会回到最后的城市，把我们发现的东西告诉你的教团。但首先，我们必须从黑暗花园出去。听着，我们没必要和里斯本战斗。但想要避开这场对决，我们必须知道他的计划。”

雷卡纳点了点头。

“好的，那么他是会从后方偷袭我们，还是阻挡我们？会有更多的Vex朝我们汇集吗？”

雷卡纳阖上双眼。放慢了呼吸。雅尔达姆-4盯着他们的周围，但是不时回头看一眼雷卡纳，看看她眼皮上的REM闪光。

片刻之后，雷卡纳的呼吸加快，睁开了双眼。

“这没用。我们的道路上有太多的可能性。”

“没关系。我们去风吹的地方。”雅尔达姆-4喃喃道。

“什么？”

“我说，我们走自己的路。我们会书写出自己的故事。”

雅尔达姆-4不经意间脸上挂上微笑，雷卡纳装作没有听到他最初所说的话。

3218395433.name: Helm of Righteousness
3218395433.flavor: "I know what needs to done. And I'm the one to do it." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
3218395433.lore:
"How about now?"

"Still nothing."

Yardarm-4 squinted up at his Ghost. "You sure?"

"Of course I'm sure. There are no Vex within at least a mile."

"What about—?"

"They're on their way back now. What do you think they were doing?"

Yardarm-4 rolled his eyes and kicked a stone over the cliff's edge. "Oh, come on. You've got all those sensors and you can't pick up on the signals they're sending?"

Yardarm-4's Ghost bobbed in the air, visibly acting out its waffling thoughts. "I—"

"Hey, don't worry about it. I'm not jealous."

"You're not?" His Ghost sounded shocked.

"Boy, you really don't get people do you?"

Yardarm-4 watched his Ghost shift its gaze around, trying to make up some excuse for itself.

"Hey, it's OK," he said. "I don't need you for that. I just need you to watch my back. I'll take care of the team dynamic. Rekkana might be the captain, but the good ship Kentarch needs sails if it's going to go anywhere."

"And the sails are you?"

"Yup. And the anchor, too."

"OK," his Ghost said, shifting its shell and trying to work through the metaphor. "What is Lisbon-13?"

"The rudder."

"The… rudder? I don't get it."

"The rudder is attached to the tiller. If the ship doesn't have it, the captain can't steer. The ship is adrift at sea."

"So you'd be lost without him?"

"Lost? Nah. We'd know where we were. We just couldn't be sure where we'd end up."

"Wow. That's… deep. Hey, how do you know so much about ships?"

Yardarm-4 shrugged. "Just do. Always have."

"So… you're really not jealous?"

"Shut up. You really don't get people."
3218395433.lore_zh:
“现在怎么样？”

“还是什么都没。”

雅尔达姆-4眯着眼向上看着他的机灵。“你确定吗？”

“我当然确定。至少一英里内没有Vex。”

“那么……”

“他们在返回的路上。你觉得他们现在在干什么？”

雅尔达姆-4翻了翻眼，把一颗石子踢下悬崖的边缘。“喔，拜托。所有的传感器你都有了，还是没法找到他们发送的信号吗？”

雅尔达姆-4的机灵在空中快速摆动，肉眼可见机灵想法的犹豫不决。“我……“

“嘿，别担心。我并不嫉妒。”

“不嫉妒？”他的机灵听上去震惊不已。

“小子，你是真的不招人喜欢。”

雅尔达姆-4看着他的机灵四处打量周围，想为自己找个借口。

“喂，没事的。”他说道。“我不需要你那么做。我只需要你能掩护我的后方。我会照看队伍活力。雷卡纳也许是船长，但百夫长要起航去任何地方的话，好船也需要好帆。”

“而你就是那个好帆？”

“对头。还是锚。”

“好吧。”他的机灵说到，升起它的外壳，试图理解这个比喻。“里斯本-13是什么？”

“船舵。”

“……船舵。我不明白。”

“船舵和舵柄是连在一起的。如果船没有这些的话，船长就无法操纵船。船就只能在大海上随波逐流。”

“所以没有他，你就会迷失方向？”

“迷失？”不对。我们会知道自己身在何方。只是不知道会沦落的什么地方。”

“哇喔。真是……深刻。嘿，你是怎么这么了解船的？”

雅尔达姆-4耸了耸肩。“就是知道，一如既往。”

“那么……你真的不嫉妒？”

“闭嘴。你是真的不招人喜欢。”

3999711322.name: Greaves of Ascendancy
3999711322.flavor: "I know where I stand." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
3999711322.lore:
Yardarm-4 watched Lisbon-13 brood.

He'll turn her against us.

Never.

We've welcomed him. He accepted our gifts. Yet now he fears us. Does that seem right to you?

No. But he always was an odd one.

The thought came to Yardarm-4 with a surprising amount of warmth. Lisbon-13 was his friend.

"We didn't come here for this," Lisbon-13 started.

"Of course not. Who could have predicted it?" Rekkana interjected. "But now, with all that's happened, does it matter what our mission was? This is so much more important."

"And awesome. Don't forget how awesome this feels," Yardarm-4 blurted. He meant to say more, to express something better and deeper than "awesome," but then Lisbon-13 jumped in.

"But these things—these powers we've been given—they come from the wrong side."

Rekkana couldn't look at him. "I'm not so sure."

How could she not be certain? What difference did it make, what side they came from?

"You remember on Io," Yardarm-4 said, stepping forward, "we were pinned down inside that shipping container with Phalanxes closing in from all sides, and you—you bastard. You ducked out a little hole in the back and made a run for it. I thought you'd left us behind."

"Never," spat Lisbon-13.

He means it. That's good.

"I know," Yardarm-4 continued. "The whole box was rattling with bullets, and there were explosions, and we were shooting when we could, and suddenly, through it all, I heard you screaming. It was like a banshee wail. You came screaming back on an Interceptor—the Psion still in it. You were steering it with the Psion's head!"

"I remember," said Lisbon-13 as he tried to step around Yardarm-4, but Yardarm-4 held firm and tried to catch his gaze.

"And you rammed it through four Phalanxes from the side, and then, and then—you remember this, Rekkana?"

"I can't forget."

Good. No one should forget.

"You splashed that Interceptor across the shields of another Phalanx, and you RODE THE EXPLOSION over the top. And when you hit the ground behind them, BOOM! It was the most beautiful thing I'd ever seen."

Lisbon-13 stopped and looked Yardarm-4 in the eyes.

This is it. This is the chance to turn the tide.

"That's us right now. We're doing what you did. This whole universe is like that container, and the Last City, the Vanguard, the Traveler—they're all inside that box. But we just snuck out of a hole in the back. And there's that Interceptor, and there's not even a Psion in it."

Lisbon-13 narrowed his eyes. He's thinking about it!

"But here the metaphor gets a little muddy, because instead of one Interceptor, there's an Interceptor for you, a Goliath for me, and a Thresher for Rekkana. What would that fight have looked like if we'd had all their firepower on our side?" Yardarm-4 ended, triumphant, almost breathless with admiration and love for his fireteam.

Lisbon-13's lip curled, and Yardarm-4 felt the shift as something almost physical. In his mind's eye, he saw a captain's wheel spinning wild and free.

"Something ugly," Lisbon-13 snarled and turned away.
3999711322.lore_zh:
雅尔达姆-4看着里斯本-13焦虑不易。

他会让她站在我们对立面。

绝对不会的。

我们向他表示了欢迎。他接受了我们的礼物。现在他却害怕我们。你觉得这合理吗？

不，但他一直都很奇怪。

这个想法出现在雅尔达姆-4的脑海中，还有意外的一阵温暖。里斯本-13是他的朋友。

“我们可不是来干这个的。”里斯本-13说到。

“当然不是。谁能预测到？”雷卡纳突然插嘴道。“但现在，既然发生了这一切，我们的任务是什么还重要吗？这件事要重要得多。”

“太棒了。不要忘记这感觉有多美妙。”雅尔达姆-4脱口而出。他原本想说的更多，表达比“美妙”更好更深刻的感情，但里斯本-13插了进来。

“但这些东西，这些我们被给与的力量，来自于错误的一侧。”

雷卡纳没办法看他。“我不确定。”

她怎么能不确定？这中间有什么差异，他们来自哪一边？

“你记得在木卫一上，”雅尔达姆-4说着，走上前来，“我们在那个运输容器里被火力压制，方阵士兵们从四面八方逼近，而你，你这个混蛋。你躲在后面的一个小洞里，逃之夭夭。我以为你丢下了我们。”

“绝不。”里斯本-13怒道。

他非常认真。这样很好。

“我知道。”雅尔达姆-4继续道。整个盒子里子弹乱飞，还有爆炸，我们尽力射击，突然间，通过这一切，我听到你的尖叫声。简直像是女妖之嚎。你在一架拦截者上一边尖叫着一边回来，甚至还有奴役魔兵在拦截者里。你当时用奴役魔兵的脑袋操纵的！”

“我记得。”里斯本-13说到，试着绕着雅尔达姆-4踱步，但雅尔达姆-4站着不动，盯着他的目光。

“然后你从一边的四个方阵士兵横冲直撞穿过去，然后，你记得这些吗，雷卡纳？”

“我不会忘记。”

很好。没人应该忘记。

“你用拦截者冲击在另一个方阵士兵的护盾上，然后在上方引发爆炸。当你在他们身后落地时，轰！那是我见过最美丽的景象。”

里斯本-13停了下来，盯着雅尔达姆-4的眼睛。

可以了。这就是扭转局势的机会。

“现在是我们了。我们正在做你曾经做过的事。整个宇宙就像那个容器，最后的城市，先锋，旅行者——都在这个盒子里。但我们只是在后面开了个洞。然后我们找到了那拦截者，甚至里面都没有奴役魔兵。”

里斯本-13眯起了眼睛。他在考虑这件事！

“但到了这里，这个比喻有点乱，除了拦截者的那部分，因为你有一艘拦截者，我有一架哥利亚坦克，雷卡纳有长尾鲨。如果我们这方有所有的活力，那么这场战斗结局会如何？”雅尔达姆-4停下了，得意洋洋，喘着粗气，带着对他火力战队的敬仰和热爱。

里斯本-13的嘴唇微翘，雅尔达姆-4感觉这种转变几乎是实质的。在他的遐想中，似乎看到船长舵轮肆意旋转。

“丑陋不堪。”里斯本-13咆哮着，转过身去。

3763941291.name: Legacy's Oath Gauntlets
3763941291.flavor: "My path is my own. Now, and forever." —Shiro-4
3763941291.lore:
"Suzume?" Shiro asked.

His Ghost materialized beside him in the cockpit. "Yes?"

"Why Shiro-4?"

Suzume spun 45 degrees clockwise and peered closer at the Exo, her equivalent of a raised eyebrow. "You'll have to elaborate."

"Sure. Sure," he said and waved away his Ghost's evident concern. "No, I mean, why the name?"

"It's your name."

"But you could have told me any name when you woke me up, and I'd have believed you."

This time, Suzume executed a slow counter-clockwise spin that Shiro had come to interpret like pursed lips.

"Well, yes, I suppose so. But your name is encoded in you—like how the color of someone's eyes exists in their DNA. You are Shiro-4."

"Huh. Why 'Shiro' then, I wonder."

"Hard to say. In the language of old Japan, the meaning of 'shiro' depends on context. Mostly, it means white, but perhaps castle."

"Don't feel like a castle. White seems odd."

"It can also mean…" Suzume's light blinked. "Innocence or purity."

"Hah!"

"I thought that might get a laugh. Why the sudden interest in your name?"

"I've been thinking a lot about everything we're learning from Europa. I've always thought that we're defined by our choices—that we are the good and the bad that we choose to do. But we're also defined by the choices of others. I didn't choose to be a Guardian. And my name, I didn't choose that either. Did I even choose to be an Exo?"

"So…" Suzume bobbed unsteady in the air, unused to so much soul searching. "Does that mean you want a new name?"

"Hmm. No. I guess not…"

Suzume spun 45 degrees clockwise and peered again at him.

"…because I've already chosen what Shiro-4 means to me."
3763941291.lore_zh:
“雀？”小白问道。

他的机灵在驾驶舱里实质化地出现在他身边。“什么？”

“为什么是白-4？”

雀顺时针转45度，近距离地观察着Exo，她扬了扬眉毛。“你得详细解释下。”

“当然，当然。”他一边说着，甩开了他的机灵明显的关心。“不，我是说，为什么是这个名字”

“是你的名字。”

“但你唤醒我的时候，可以告诉我任何名字，我会相信你。”

这一次，雀缓慢地逆时针旋转过来，小白把这理解为抿嘴。

“好吧，是的，我猜也这样。但你的名字是编码在你体内的——就像一个人的眼睛的颜色存在于他们的DNA中一样。你是白-4。”

“嗯，那么为什么是白，我很好奇。”

“很难说，在旧的日语中，白的意思取决于上下文。大部分时候，意思是白色，但也可能是城堡的意思。”

“感觉不像城堡，白色有点奇怪。”

“还有别的意思……”雀的光闪烁了下，“天真或纯洁。”

“哈！”

“我原本以为这会很好笑呢。为什么突然对你的名字感兴趣？”

“我一直在思考，关于我们从木卫二学习的一切。我一直觉得，我们是由我们的选择所定义——我们是我们选择的好或坏。但我们也被别人的选择所定义。我没有选择做一个守护者。我的名字，我也没机会选择。我难道选择成为Exo吗？”

“所以……”雀在空中摇摆不定，不太习惯这么多的灵魂在探寻。“意思是你想要个新名字？”

“唔，不，这可不好说……”

雀顺时针转了45度，又盯着他看。

“……因为我已经选择了白-4对我的意义。”

3046896869.name: Legacy's Oath Plate
3046896869.flavor: "What is necessary and what is right are not the same. All that matters is whichever serves you best." —Lisbon-13
3046896869.lore:
Lisbon-13's Ghost, Piri, quavered, "What have we done?"

"What was necessary."

Lisbon-13 raised his gun toward her.

"Was it? Did we really—whoa!" Piri cried and dove away as a beam of energy vaporized the tangle of vines through which she flew. 

Lisbon realized Divinity was too slow. He switched to his Hand Cannon.

Shards of stone from a nearby explosion suddenly battered Piri's shell. She had hoped she could talk her way out of this. But there was no time to think—just run.

"Listen, Lisbon! Please!" Piri pleaded. Each word was punctuated by a roar from his gun. She dodged the resulting explosions along the terrain. "Honestly, if you want to shoot me, I'll let you! Just stop and tell me why first!"

A grenade whirled through the air in response. Piri had seen this tactic too many times to be fooled. She zipped toward the falling explosive and sheltered under a shelf of rock. The blast rattled her senses, but Piri didn't have time for them to clear. She sped through the smoking terrain, inches above the ground, knowing Lisbon would be looking for her flight to either side of the drifting cloud.

And then in an instant, the feet of Lisbon-13 materialized in the smoke before her. She nearly ran right into him. How did he do that, she wondered, to think like others and anticipate them? She knew she needed to talk. Fast!

"Uh, okay. First thing's first. You want to destroy me. Got it. But why? What's next?" she asked.

Lisbon-13 remained silent.

Realization dawned. Piri bobbled in the air, shocked by her own conclusion. "…You want the secret to die with you. No… no, no, no. You can't kill yourself. You can't! Lisbon, there has to be another way."

Lisbon-13 looked up from his Ghost and through the wafting smoke. "She's right. This is not the way."

"What?"

Lisbon-13 was not looking at his Ghost. "It's not that the power is too terrible to wield. It's that the burden is too great to bear."

"Burden?" Piri asked. The Ghost dodged as Lisbon-13 suddenly stepped forward and brushed past her.

And stood, facing himself, once again.

The doppelganger—this other Lisbon-13—reached out and put a hand on the shoulder of the Lisbon-13 that stood a few paces behind Piri.

"You never doubted yourself. Not for a moment. The others revealed their weaknesses: their pride and self-absorption. But you remember what Rekkana said," it stated.

Lisbon-13 nodded. "If anyone can handle the responsibility of this power—"

"It's you," the doppelganger finished. "What you fear now is not the responsibility you have assumed. It is the burden…" the doppelganger said, glancing back at the Ghost, "…of having all this power and never getting what you want."

Lisbon-13 had seemed distant and cold to his fireteam and his Ghost. The arguments since the Black Garden, the fighting—oh, how she had pleaded to stop the fighting! All nails in the coffin of something dead within Lisbon-13—something killed by this doppelganger in the garden's grotto. But now, some of the old Lisbon's warmth blazed white hot as he shook off his double's hand. "You did this! You ruined everything," he said.

"We are all responsible for our choices. You chose this path. They chose theirs. Now is the time to select a new path. Together. We can help each other. We can free you from what you wanted. We can lighten your burden."

Piri knew what would happen next. She braced for the explosions and readied herself to leap to Lisbon's aid.

But none came.

"…Can you make me forget her?"

Lisbon-13's shadow-self embraced him. "Yes."
3046896869.lore_zh:
里斯本-13的机灵，皮里，颤声问道“我们做了什么？”

“必要的事。”

里斯本-13举起枪，对着她。

“是吗？我们真的——哇！”皮里喊着跳开，一束能量将她飞过的缠绕藤蔓蒸发了。

里斯本意识到神圣裁决太慢了。他切换到手炮。

附近爆炸产生的石块碎片突然砸入皮里的外壳中。她原本希望自己能说服她，离开这里。但没时间考虑了——只能马上跑。

“听着，里斯本！求你了！”皮里恳求道。每一个字都由他枪声点缀。她沿着地形躲避随之产生的爆炸。“老实说，如果你想开枪打我，我让你打！就是先暂停一下告诉我为什么！”

一颗手榴弹从空中旋转着飞过来，就是对他的回应。皮里见过太多次这种手段，她可不会被骗。她向着落下去的炸药扎去，躲在一个石架下。爆炸声震荡着她的感官，但皮里没有时间让它们恢复清醒。她在冒着烟的地形中飞驰，距离地面数寸，她知道，里斯本会在飘浮的云层两边寻找她。

然后瞬间，里斯本-13的脚就在她面前的烟雾中实质化了。她差点撞上他。她不禁好奇，他是怎么做到像别人一样思考，并提前预知他们的想法？她知道，她要谈谈。要快！

“啊，好吧。先说重要的事。你想摧毁我。我明白，但为什么？然后呢？”她问道。

里斯本-13沉默不语。

突然恍然大悟。皮里在空中晃了晃，被自己的结论感到震惊。“……你想让那个秘密和自己一起死去。”不……不不不不，你不能自杀。你不能！里斯本，肯定有别的办法。”

里斯本-13从他的机灵中抬起头来，目光穿过飘荡的烟雾。“她说的没错，这不是办法。”

“什么？”

里斯本-13没有看他的机灵。“不是因为那个力量太可怕，无法使用。而是责任太重，无法负担。”

“负担？”皮里问道。里斯本-13突然上前一步，从她身边擦身而过，机灵躲开了。

然后站住，再一次面对着他自己。

分身——另一个里斯本-13——伸出手，搭在站在皮里身后几步远的里斯本-13的肩上。

“你从没怀疑过你自己。一刻都没有。其他人暴露了他们的弱点：他们的骄傲和自恋。但你要记住雷卡纳所说的。”它说道。

里斯本-13点点头。“如果有人能应付这种力量的责任——”

“那这个人肯定是你。”分身以此为完结。“你现在害怕的不是你所承担的责任。而是负担……”分身说着，回头看了一眼机灵，“……拥有如此的力量，却永远得不到自己想要的东西。”

在他的火力战队和机灵看来，里斯本-13似乎遥远而冰冷。自黑暗花园以来的争论，争斗……哦，她曾经多少次恳求停止争斗！所有的钉子都钉在了里斯本-13的棺材里——在花园的石窟里被这个分身杀死的东西。但现在，老里斯本的一些温情，在他甩开替身的手时，炽热地燃烧着白热。“都是你！你毁了一切。”他说道。

“我们都要对自己的选择负责。你选了这条路。他们选了他们的。现在是时候选条新的道路。并肩一起。咱们能互相帮忙。我们可以让你摆脱你想要的东西。我们可以减轻你的负担。”

皮里知道接下来会发生什么。她为爆炸做好准备，并做好了准备，随时跳上去帮里斯本。

但并没有。

“……你能让我忘了她吗？”

里斯本-13的影子本体拥抱了他。“是的。”

里斯本-13的影子本体拥抱了他。“是的。”

1702811704.name: Legacy's Oath Mark
1702811704.flavor: "I know who I am. I am a Titan. So long as I am able, I stand between the Last City and those who would tear it down." —Saint-14
1702811704.lore:
Saint-14, like most Exos, dreamt of the Deep Stone Crypt often. The golden field. The looming black tower. The battle below, surging with faces that were eerily familiar. He was used to these dreams, like many of his mechanical kin, and resolutely uncurious about any deeper meaning. It couldn't be anything good, he reasoned long ago. Besides, his waking life kept him more than occupied.

However, since his return from the kaleidoscope depths of the Infinite Forest, the dreams had increased in frequency and in eeriness. 

For the first few weeks, instead of battle, he faced single opponents in duels: Osiris, Marin, Zavala, Ana—even the Guardian who rescued him from the Vex. No matter whom he fought, he would use all his energy and Light in the fight and lose every time. Flat on his back, he would look up at the tower and know that someone was watching from within. 

The night before Rasputin alerted everyone of Pyramid ships entering the system, winter fell on his dreamscape, forcing him to charge through pillowy snow drifts at a massive winged Vex, unlike any he'd seen. He lost that night as he would for many more nights, watching as an iridescent liquid—almost like Vex milk, but different, contaminated—flowed from his every joint, sizzling in the snow. 

During the waking day, he maintained his usual exuberance, taking great satisfaction in helping Guardians hone their craft in the Trials of Osiris. After all, the fights happening in reality were the ones to focus on. Why worry about what he can't control inside his head?

But then, the night before a new vacuum of grief was opened in the system, a woman appeared at the threshold of the tower. Her clothes were black; her hair prematurely gray. She watched, arms crossed, as Saint hurled grenade after flaming grenade at the Vex with little effect.

"You'll blind yourself with all that bright fire," she tutted. "Maybe then you'll finally learn to look instead of see."

In one mighty swipe, the Vex cut the Exo down. The woman sighed as Saint crumpled to the ground.

Silence fell, followed by the crunching of footsteps in the snow. "Just like your father," she said, kneeling by his head. "All of you." 

She laid a hand on the fore of his helm, as if feeling for a fever. "In your next life, you should take more after me."

With that, her hand slid down to his eyes and, for the brief moment before he woke up, all was dark.
1702811704.lore_zh:
圣人14号，像绝大多数Exo一样，经常会梦到深岩墓穴。金色的田野。高耸的黑色高塔。下面的战斗中，涌现出一张张诡异而熟悉的面孔。他和许多机械同族一样，习惯了这些梦境，对任何深层的意义都绝不好奇。他很早前就推理过，那不可能是什么好事。此外，他清醒的生活让他忙得不可开交。

但自从他从无尽森林的万花筒深处回来后，梦境的频率和诡异程度都有所增加。

在头几周的时间里，他没有战斗，而是在决斗中面对着一个个的对手：奥斯里斯、马林、萨瓦拉、阿娜——甚至是那些把他从Vex手里救回来的守护者。无论与谁战斗，他都会用尽自己所有的能量和光能战斗，但每次都会输。他平躺在塔上，抬头看着高塔，他知道有人在里面看着。

在拉斯普廷警告所有人金字塔飞船进入星系的前夜，冬天降临在他的梦境中，迫使他穿过枕头状的雪花，向一个身形巨大有翅膀的Vex冲去，这是他从未见过的。他失去了那个夜晚，就像其他更多的夜晚一样，他看着一种彩虹般的液体——几乎像Vex奶，但不同的是，这是被污染的——从他的每一个关节流出来，在雪地发出斯斯的声音。

在清醒的日子里，他保持着一贯的亢奋，在奥西里斯的试炼中，他从帮助守护者们磨练技艺的过程中获得了极大的满足。毕竟，现实中发生的战斗才是重点。为什么要担心他脑子里无法控制的东西呢？

但随后，在星系中开启新的悲伤真空的前夜，一个女人出现在高塔的门槛上。她穿着黑衣；头发过早的呈灰白色。她双手叉腰，看着圣人向Vex投掷烈焰手榴弹，但效果甚微。

“你会被那些明亮火焰弄瞎的。”她嘟囔着。“也许那时你最终会学会看，而不是理解。”

Vex猛力一挥，将Exo砍倒。女人叹了口气，圣人倒在地上。

一阵寂静，紧接着雪地里传来脚步声的脆响。“就像你父亲一样。”她说，跪在他的头边。“你们所有人。

她把手放在他的头盔前，仿佛在试探着他是否在发烧。“下辈子，你应该多学学我。”

随即，她的手滑落到他的眼睛上，在他醒来前的那一刹那，一切都暗了下来。

129329474.name: Legacy's Oath Helm
129329474.flavor: "Life's all about timing. You gotta know when to pull the trigger, when to go in for the kiss, and—most of all—when to make for the exit." —Cayde-6
129329474.lore:
High above the Last City, tucked in one of the Tower's many alcoves, Cayde-6 thumbs through an old book. Plucked from the Speaker's library, it's become delicate with age, or so he assumes, taking extra care turning each page. His sense of touch is good; there's certainly enough circuitry in his metal fingers to pull off the most precise of shots. But even a hair-trigger touch might rip the brittle paper… 

Cayde pauses on a page. "If sailor tales and sailor tunes, storm and adventure, heat and cold—"

Suddenly, a gust of surprisingly icy wind nearly rips the book from Cayde's hands. "To hell with this godforsaken ice cube!" he shouts, almost falling from his perch. 

He steadies himself and inhales deeply. Hang on there, Cayde. You're not on any ice cube, godforsaken or otherwise. You're on Earth, in the Last City.

But the memory lingers, like the floating neon outlines seconds after a blinding camera flash. The snow-white plains of a distant moon, a sarcophagus of ice and iron.

—flash—

Yes, that's what Europa feels like to Cayde-1 as he loads crate after crate onto the bay outside the Exoscience factory. Even the sky has turned a flat gray, casting all beneath it in dull, deadening light. A warning sky, he thinks. Sailors had some kinda rhyme for it, didn't they?

Either way, it hardly makes for a motivating work environment. Cayde sits on one of the crates. "I'm taking a break," he announces. "Need to or not, this is when we used to have lunch. I refuse to work through lunch."

Next to him, Knox-4 sighs with relief and longing. "I miss lunch. I miss getting hungry."

Cayde grins as much as his mechanical face will allow. "Hmm…" he intones in his best Dr. Abrams impression, "So you would say… you're hungry for hunger?"

Knox bursts into guffaws. Cayde chuckles weakly. It wasn't that funny. But as his friend's laughter grows, so does Cayde's. Soon, they're both clutching each other and howling. 

Then, gradually, their cheer fades. "What do you tell that shrink, by the way?" Knox asks. "You tell him about the whisper?"

Cayde shakes his head. Before he can snark about the uselessness of psychologists, the whisper rings in his metal skull. It's red sky in morning, sailor's warning. But you are no sailor. 

A whimper squeaks out from the loading bay. A moment later, a short snowsuitted figure scrambles out, racing for the far end of the factory. Cayde and Knox shout, taking off after the eavesdropper. No sharpshooter yet, Cayde fumbles for his BrayTech-issued handgun, aims shakily and…

—bang—

Cayde-6 comes back to himself just as he stumbles into his hideout. He rifles through the piles of loot, until… "Aha!" He finds a pen. Cayde-6 isn't done yet. He flips open the book, no longer being careful with the pages, and starts scrawling. 

"Spend time with an Exo who's been through it like we have and you'll see all the tells…"
129329474.lore_zh:
在最后的城市的高处，凯德6号藏在高塔的众多凹槽中，翻阅着一本旧书。这本书从先知的图书馆里取下来的，随着岁月，它变得很脆弱，或者说他看来，每翻一页都要格外小心。他的触觉很灵敏，金属手指上的电路，足以完成最精确的射击。但即使是最轻微的一触即发，也可能会把脆纸撕破……

凯德在其中一页停了下来。“如果水手的故事和水手的曲调，风暴和冒险，炎热和严寒……”

突然，一阵出其不意的冰风差点把书从凯德手中撕开。“这该死的神出鬼没的冰块！”他大喊一声，差点从自己的栖身之地摔下来。

他稳住身子，深深吸了口气。坚持住，凯德。你不在任何冰块上，管他什么神出鬼没的还是其他什么东西。你在地球，在最后的城市之中。

但记忆挥之不去，就像相机谣言的闪光灯后，浮动的霓虹轮廓。遥远月球雪白的平原，一座冰铁的石棺。

—闪光—

是的，当他把一箱又一箱的货物装到Exo科学外的海湾时，这就是木卫二在凯德1号眼里的感觉。就连天空也变成了纯灰色，将天空下的一切，都笼罩在暗淡、死气沉沉的光线中。警示的天空，他想着。水手们应该有描述这种情景的曲调吧？

无论哪种情况，都很难形成激励的工作环境。凯德坐在一个箱子上。“我要休息一下。”他说道。“不管需不需要，现在就是我们以前吃午饭的时间。我拒绝在午餐时间工作。”

旁边的诺克斯-4松了口气，憧憬不已。“我怀念午餐。我怀念饥饿的感觉。”

在他的机械面容允许的情况下，凯德尽情地笑着。“唔……”他用他最擅长的艾布拉姆斯医生的语气说道：“所以你是说……你渴望着饥饿的感觉？”

诺克斯顿时哈哈大笑。凯德微微一笑。其实没那么好笑。但随着他朋友笑的越来越大声，凯德也笑开了怀。很快，他们抱着对方，嚎叫起来。

然后，渐渐地，他们的欢呼声消散了。“对了，你对那个心理医生怎么看？”诺克斯问道。“你跟他说了低语的事吗？”

凯德摇了摇头。还没等他开起那个没用的心理学家的玩笑，低语声就在他的金属头骨中响起。这是清晨的红色天空，水手的警告。但你不是水手。

装货区里传出呜呜的尖叫声。片刻之后，一个矮小的穿着雪地服的身影冲了出来，向工厂的远处奔去。凯德和诺克斯大喊一声，起身去追那个偷听他们说话的人。现在还不是神枪手，凯德摸索着拿起布瑞科技配发的手枪，摇摇晃晃地瞄准，然后……

—砰—

凯德6号回过神来，跌跌撞撞地走进自己的藏身之处。他在一堆战利品中快速翻找，直到……“啊哈！”他找到一支笔。凯德6号还没有结束。他翻开书，不再小心翼翼地翻动书页，而是开始涂鸦。

“与一个拥有我们类似经历的Exo一起共度时光，你会看到所有的故事……”

凯德6号回过神来，跌跌撞撞地走进自己的藏身之处。他在一堆战利品中快速翻找，直到……“啊哈！”他找到一支笔。凯德6号还没有结束。他翻开书，不再小心翼翼地翻动书页，而是开始涂鸦。

“与一个拥有我们类似经历的Exo一起共度时光，你会看到所有的故事……”

943612349.name: Legacy's Oath Greaves
943612349.flavor: "I've traveled far and weathered much. How far and how much, I don't know. All I know is I'm not done yet." —Micah-10
943612349.lore:
Micah-10 roams the rolling hills of Old Russia as she has done for many years now. As she may do for many years more. 

A pack of Ghosts trails behind her, their little blue eyes blinking over the landscape. Micah has helped many a Ghost in their search—it's much easier to find a Guardian while someone else looks out for Fallen scavengers—though she privately wishes they would help her for once. How hard can it be to find a functioning ship?!

Very hard when you need said ship to make it far out of the atmosphere, even possibly all the way to the Jovians. Because while her little companions seek out their futures, Micah has her own glowing eyes set firmly on the past—on the Deep Stone Crypt. 

She once thought it was hidden on Earth, buried underneath the snow drifts of Siberia, but now she suspects it's further out. In a much darker, lonelier place. Somewhere very cold, that she knows for certain. 

She's dreamt of it thousands of times, fought thousands of battles on the golden field beneath the black tower. And every fiftieth instance, in the midst of the chaos, an older man puts a paternal hand on her shoulder and says, "You just need to get acclimated. It's colder here than on Mars." Every hundredth time, she makes it into the tower and finds a different man sitting in an armchair, writing on a notepad. "Dreams are messages from deep inside your mind," he reminds her, "Until you figure out the message, the dream will repeat."

Every single time, no matter whom she sees or what she hears, Micah-10 wakes up, feeling something in her tug towards space. She tells herself some internal magnet must have gotten knocked loose, then curses the ones who made her. In humans, bodily sensation is a form of communication, the connection between the mental and physical. But in Exos, it's all a lie. Cold, heat, hunger, exhaustion, pain—the signals aren't connected to real lack or breakage. For the most part, her body is impervious. On the rare occasion she does break, she won't know it unless someone else tells her.

So, in that sense, the Ghosts do help her.
943612349.lore_zh:
米迦-10像她多年来所做的那样，在旧俄罗斯的连绵群山中漫步。同样的事她可能还会做很多年。

一群机灵尾随在她身后，蓝色的小眼睛闪烁不已，看着风景。米迦曾帮助过许多机灵去寻找——如果有别人帮忙留意堕落拾荒者，寻找守护者要容易得多——虽然她私下里希望他们也能帮她一次。找一艘能用的船能有多难？！

如果你需要的飞船要能远离大气层，甚至有可能要一直飞到木星的时候，那就非常困难。因为当她的小伙伴们在寻找自己的未来时，米迦的眼睛却紧紧盯着过去——盯着深岩墓穴。

她曾经以为它藏在地球上，埋在西伯利亚的雪堆下面，但现在她怀疑它在更远的地方。在一个更黑暗，更孤独的地方。某个寒冷的地方，她很确定。

她梦到过几千次，在黑色高塔下的金色田野上，进行过数千次的战斗。而每到第五十次，混乱中，都会有一个老人用父爱的手搭在她的肩膀上，说：“你只需要适应一下就好。这里比火星要冷。”每隔一百次，她都会进入高塔，发现不同的人坐在扶手椅上，在记事本上写着什么。“梦是来自你心灵深处的信息。”他提醒她，“在你弄清楚这些信息前，梦会重复出现。”

每一次，无论看到谁，听到什么，米迦-10都会醒来，感觉到她拉扯着空间中的某种东西。她告诉自己，一定是内部的磁铁被敲松了，然后开始诅咒那些制造她的人。在人体中，身体感觉是一种交流形式，是心理和生理的联系。但在Exo这里，全都是谎言。寒冷、炎热、饥饿、疲惫、疼痛——这些信号与真正的缺乏或断裂没有关系。绝大多数情况下，她的身体不受影响。少数她真的断裂的情况，除非别人告诉她，否则她不会知道的。

所以，从这个意义上来说，机灵的确是在帮她。

2862524208.name: Gauntlets of Agony
2862524208.lore:
The cycle remained the same, but my actions were not my own. My blade felt heavier with each battle.

I did not recognize the shadow attached to me.

I did not recognize myself.

Did I even know who I was to begin with?

The shouts and pleas of my enemies reverberated in the air. My skin burned, and my heart pounded harder than a hammer striking an anvil. My head… my head was filled with a dense fog. I was present but lost.

My adversary fell to the ground gasping for air.

I fixed my eyes on their face, and a breathy, animalistic snarl escaped my lips. It lingered in the air like a haunting song.

Beneath it, was that laugh. His laugh.

I fell to my knees, staining them in the crimson that had pooled beneath my boots. I dropped my sword and lifted my shaky hands up to my eyes.

The fresh blood ran down my fingers, forming a tapestry in the palm lines. I saw his face in the pattern, felt the weight of his hands on my shoulders. On my mind.

I screamed.
2862524208.lore_zh:
循环依旧，但我的行为却不属于我自己。每一次战斗，我的刀刃都变得更加沉重。

我认不出附着在我身上的影子。

我认不出我自己。

我原本知道自己是谁吗？

敌人的呼喊和哀求在空气中回荡。我的皮肤在燃烧，我的心怦怦直跳，比锤子敲击铁砧还要用力。我的脑袋…我的脑袋里充满了浓雾。我仍然存在，但却迷失了方向。

我的对手倒在地上大口喘着气。

我盯着那张脸，嘴里发出气喘吁吁、动物般的咆哮。那声音像一首萦回的歌曲，在空中久久不能散去。

在那底下，是那笑声。他的笑声。

我跪倒在地，双膝沾染成猩红色，那颜色在我的战靴下汇集。我松开刀刃时，它在我身旁轻轻地发出砰砰声。我放下剑，把颤抖的双手举到眼前。

鲜血顺着我的手指流下，在我的手掌纹路上形成了一幅挂毯。我在图案中看到了他的脸，感觉到了他的双手在我的肩上，在我的脑海里的重量。

我尖叫起来。

3128778747.name: Plate of Agony
3128778747.lore:
…You are mine…

My threaded silk sheets were no longer a comfort. Instead, they felt like gravel against my skin. Every twist and turn yielded pain.

The lit candle beside my bed did not ease my mind. I turned onto my back, eyes trained on the ceiling to avoid the shadows dancing in the candlelight's orange glow.

As I sunk into my pillow, I felt as though it would eventually suffocate me. It could not grant me solace from the whispers.

They were always present—like white noise. At least until he required my attention.

…Bring me more…

Groans of pain and agony poured into my room. Each corner shifted and warped in ways I could only attribute to that fateful day in the woods.

I was paralyzed by the weight of it all.

The flame at the tip of the wick flickered weakly as it neared the bottom of the holder where the wax pooled. Numerous claws and black tendrils inched their way toward my bed.

…You will never be free…

I cried out as Solar energy burst forth. The hammer was warm in my grasp. I leapt from my bed, slammed the fiery weapon down into the floorboards. I felt the heat intensify, as flames licked at every surface they could find.

The shadows still danced. Still reached for me.

I tried to burn them away. Wood splintered and cracked as everything fell apart.

My screams drowned in the destruction of my home.
3128778747.lore_zh:
…你是我的…

我的床单丝线不再舒适。相反，它感觉就像是我皮肤上的碎石。每一次扭动和翻身，都会带来痛苦。

床边点燃的蜡烛并没有让我安心。我转过身去，眼睛盯着天花板，避开那些在橙色光芒中舞动着的阴影。

我陷入枕头，感觉就好像它终究会令我窒息。我没法因此摆脱窃窃私语。

它们如影随形，就像白噪音一样。至少在他需要我注意前是如此。

…带给我更多…

痛苦和折磨的呻吟声涌入我的房间。每个角落都在移动和扭曲，我只能将这一切归因于在树林里那个决定性的日子。

我被这一切的重量弄得不知所措。

灯芯顶端的火焰接近着烛台底部的蜡池，微弱地闪烁着。无数的爪子和黑色卷须在缓慢地朝我的床挪动。

…你永远不会自由…

烈日能量爆发时，我大叫起来。锤子在我手里是温热的。我从床上跳起来，将熊熊燃烧的武器砸向地板。我感到热量加剧，火焰舔舐着它们能找到的每一个表面。

那些阴影还在舞动。还在靠近着我。

我试图把它们烧掉。木头分崩离析，一切都四散开来。

我的尖叫声淹没在家园的毁灭之中。

1020854508.name: Helm of Agony
1020854508.lore:
The weight of the forest's darkness pressed down on me. 

Adrenaline pumped through me as I watched my opponent fall. I listened for the thud as their body collided with the ground.

Deep crimson painted a nearby tree, sliding down through bark and seeping into sapwood, the excess pooling on the ground to soak in the dead pine needles.

I don't remember who it was or why I had chosen to slay them.

In the past, I had seen my fair share of bloodshed. Killed indiscriminately. If you saw another day on my lands, it was because I willed it.

But this felt different.

Up ahead, shadows shifted in the sea of trees. I braced myself, sword held steady. Shivers traveled up my fingertips, electrified my arms, and settled as a chill on the back of my neck.

"Who's there?"

I could hear whispers all around me, from behind every tree. It was overwhelming, all-encompassing, indecipherable.

The shadow swiftly closed the distance between us until it towered over me.

It reached for me, and I stepped back.

I remember the sinister laugh, the way it touched a primal fear deep within me.

I was paralyzed. My mind flooded with whispers.

Its wispy body lurched forward and slammed through me. I felt myself fall. The wind left my lungs, and for a moment, there was nothing… an emptiness the likes of which I had never felt before.
1020854508.lore_zh:
森林暗影的重量压迫着我。 

我看着我的对手倒下，肾上腺素在我身上涌动。我听着他们的身体与地面碰撞时发出的砰砰声。

附近一棵树被喷溅成了深深的猩红色，它从树皮上滑落，渗入边材，多余的量在地上堆积，浸泡在枯死的松针中。

我不记得那是谁，也不记得我为什么要杀他。

过去，我也进行过不少杀戮。肆意地杀害。如果你在我的领地多活了一天，那只是因为我本意如此。

但这次感觉不一样。

前方，那些阴影在树木的海洋中移动。我打起精神，握紧刀刃。一阵寒颤从我的指尖传来，我的手臂一阵电击的麻木，在我的脖颈后形成了一股寒意。

“谁在那儿？”

我能听到四周每棵树后面传来的低语声。那声音让人不知所措，无处不在，难以辨别。

阴影迅速拉近了我们之间的距离，直到耸立在我面前。

它向我伸出手来，我后退了几步。

我记得那阴险的笑声，它触动我内心深处的那种原始恐惧的方式。

我动弹不得。我的脑海里充斥着窃窃私语。

它纤细的身体猛地向前冲，撞穿了我的身体。我感到自己摔倒了。我的肺无法呼吸，有那么一会儿，里头空无一物…一种我从未有过的空虚感。

2141123266.name: Helm of Agony
2141123266.lore:
The weight of the forest's darkness pressed down on me. 

Adrenaline pumped through me as I watched my opponent fall. I listened for the thud as their body collided with the ground.

Deep crimson painted a nearby tree, sliding down through bark and seeping into sapwood, the excess pooling on the ground to soak in the dead pine needles.

I don't remember who it was or why I had chosen to slay them.

In the past, I had seen my fair share of bloodshed. Killed indiscriminately. If you saw another day on my lands, it was because I willed it.

But this felt different.

Up ahead, shadows shifted in the sea of trees. I braced myself, sword held steady. Shivers traveled up my fingertips, electrified my arms, and settled as a chill on the back of my neck.

"Who's there?"

I could hear whispers all around me, from behind every tree. It was overwhelming, all-encompassing, indecipherable.

The shadow swiftly closed the distance between us until it towered over me.

It reached for me, and I stepped back.

I remember the sinister laugh, the way it touched a primal fear deep within me.

I was paralyzed. My mind flooded with whispers.

Its wispy body lurched forward and slammed through me. I felt myself fall. The wind left my lungs, and for a moment, there was nothing… an emptiness the likes of which I had never felt before.

522481959.name: Greaves of Agony
522481959.lore:
"I did not ask for your help!" I shouted.

Rage coursed through me.

My knife was stained red. I shouldn't have been able to see it. Any of it. But here I was, staring back at my Ghost.

"You need your sight!" Firethorn returned. His voice was laced with concern, something I ignored in the moment, but would remember for years to come.

"That is not up to you! He preys upon my vision!"

I stepped forward, and Firethorn floated up to meet my gaze.

The blade in my hand shook as a faint whisper tickled the back of my mind.

…Do it…

I shouted, covered my ears. I could see shapes forming in the darkness of the tree line again. I couldn't take it anymore, but I knew Firethorn would only continue to heal me.

"You need to snap out of this," Firethorn pushed. "You're losing control! Where is the great Briar of the Wild Brambles?"

…Dead…

"The thorn that pierced the heart of would-be gods?"

…A puppet…

"Pain and terror were your symphony!"

…MY symphony…

"What's become of—"

I remember how easily my hand wrapped around him; how I forced him to the ground and pierced his lens with my knife. I hadn't realized what I'd done until I saw the light flicker out of his eye.

Firethorn's pieces were the last things I saw before succumbing to permanent darkness.
522481959.lore_zh:
“我没有向你求助！”我叫道。

愤怒在我心中蔓延。

我的刀被染成了红色。我本该见不到它的。任何一丝血红。但我却身在此处，盯着我的机灵。

“你需要你的视力！”火棘回应道。他的声音中带着关切，我当时忽略了这一点，但多年以后都仍会记得。

“这不是你能决定的！他以我的视觉为食！”

我上前一步，火棘漂浮起来，与我的目光相遇。

我手中的刀刃在颤抖，微弱的低语声搔动着我的后颈。

…动手吧…

我大叫着，捂住了耳朵。我能再次看到形状在林木线的暗影中形成。我再也受不了了，但我知道火棘只会继续治愈我。

“你得振作起来。”火棘催促道。“你在失去控制！伟大的野荆棘蔷薇哪儿去了？”

…死了…

“那个刺穿了那些所谓众神的心脏的荆棘？”

…傀儡罢了…

“苦痛和恐惧曾是你的乐章！”

…我的乐章…

“那个曾经——”

我还记得我的手是多么轻易地抓住了他；记得我把他打倒在地还用刀刺穿了他的透镜。我几乎没有意识到我做了什么，直至我看到他眼中闪烁的微光。

火棘的碎片是我在屈服于永久的暗影之前看到的最后一样东西。

1485494930.name: Mark of Agony
1485494930.lore:
The campfire crackled and echoed throughout the cave. I reached toward it, allowing the warmth to guide me. The man across from me had remained silent throughout my recollection.

"You carry the scent of him… of Nezarec."

"As do you, Briar of the Wild Brambles," the man said. The title felt unfamiliar as it left his lips. Was I still deserving of that moniker? It felt long gone. "It's faint… but still there."

"What is the true reason you've sought me out?"

There was a long pause. Then I heard him shuffle around for something in his bag.

"My family has been in Nezarec's favor for generations," he said. 

I defensively gripped my walking stick, ready to draw my blade if necessary. Then I heard the thud of a heavy object, and, after a few seconds, the sound of pages turning. He spoke again.

"Our experiences will not be the last." The pages continued to turn, just loud enough for me to hear over the crackle of the fire. "Do you wish to feel his full power again?" the man asked.

Deep down, I felt an instantaneous "yes" ring loud and true. I'd spent so long fearing his influence, the sheer terror he amplified within me. But when he was gone, all that remained was a void—an all-consuming vacuum of terror.

"What do you need me to do?" I asked.

I had no way of definitively knowing, but something told me the man was smiling.
1485494930.lore_zh:
篝火噼啪作响，在整个洞穴中回荡。我把手伸向它，让暖意指引我，告诉我该在哪里停下来。在我回忆时，我对面的那个人一直保持沉默。

“你身上带着他…奈扎雷克的气味。”

“你也一样，野荆棘蔷薇。”那人说道。这称号从他嘴里说出来时的感觉很陌生。我还配得上这绰号吗？感觉早就失去它了。“很微弱…但还在那儿。”

“你找我的真正原因是什么？”

一阵长久的沉默。然后我听到他在包里翻找些什么。

“我家几代人都得到了奈扎雷克的青睐，”他说道。 

我防备性地抓住手杖，准备在必要时拔出我的刀刃。然后我听到一件重物发出砰的一声，还有几秒钟后翻页的声音。他又说话了。

“我们的经历不会是最后一次，”他说道。书页继续翻动着，刚好能盖过炉火的噼啪声。“你想再次感受他的全部力量吗？”那人问道。

在内心深处，我感受到那一声瞬间的“是的”响亮而真实。我花了这么长时间来畏惧他的影响，他在我体内放大的恐怖。但当他走后，只剩下虚空…一片吞噬一切的恐怖真空地带。

“你需要我做什么？”我问道。

我没有办法确切地知道，但直觉告诉我那人露出了笑容。
