1922960867.name: Promised Reunion Mark
1922960867.lore:
—-Titan, O Titan. Your Traveler betrayed you just as it betrayed us. We do not pity you; we mourn with you. We wail alongside you at the graves of your beloved son and your treasured partner. We hold you in our arms and bear the weight of your sorrows, for they are our own.  

We will not lament the absence of fairness in this universe; indifference does not balk in the face of righteous anger. Nor does it bend to judicious retribution.  

No action should be reviled more than inaction in the face of great pain and agony. One may do evil, one may do good, but one must do something. This is where our Gardener failed you. It hung in the sky watching as your boy, your Hakim, was slain so mercilessly. It did nothing as his lifeblood drained in Safiyah's arms. He left this existence knowing not the breadth of its delights, nor the depths of its heartaches. Stolen. 

We give you justice, Commander Zavala. We give you the joy denied to you under the unfeeling god you once worshipped. We give him back to you whole and perfect, and we ask for nothing in return.—-
1922960867.lore_zh:
——泰坦，啊，泰坦。你的旅行者背叛了你，就像它背叛了我们那样。我们不同情你；我们与你同悲。我们在你的爱子和挚友的墓前与你一起哭泣。我们将你拥入怀中，承受你的悲伤，因为它们也是我们自己的悲伤。  

我们不会哀叹这个宇宙的不公；冷漠不会在正义的愤怒面前退缩。它也不会屈服于明断的报复。  

在巨大的痛苦和折磨面前，没有什么行为比不作为更让人憎恶。人可以作恶，也可以行善，但必须有作为。这就是我们的园丁让你失望的地方。当你的孩子，你的哈基姆，被无情杀害时，它只是在空中注视着。当他的生命在萨菲亚的怀抱中流逝时，它什么也没做。他离开了这个世界，既不知道这个世界的快乐有多广阔，也不知道这个世界的痛苦有多深邃。他被窃取了。 

我们会为你伸张正义，指挥官萨瓦拉。我们会给予你，被你曾经崇拜的无情神明剥夺的快乐。我们会把他完整无缺地还给你，而我们不求任何回报。——

1333378716.lore:
++Stench follows. You drag it before you—

—It will not consume you, for you have conquered it—

—Or so you prefer to believe++

++TURN BACK FROM THE WORLD-KILLING WAY++

++OR YOU WILL LIVE AS WRATH AND DEVASTATION++

[In this life, there are beings that bring light to others. And there are beings that bring dark. He brought dark. Only dark. And was naught more than an unbreakable, unstoppable force.] 

[The cruel Leviathan learned this truth the hard way—he pulled from its chest a rib many times larger than the Subjugator himself. Yet he wielded it as nothing.]
[The Leviathan, winded, broken, cast its gaze on the Deep below.]

"You would not look upon the one who bested you, beast? Lift your eyes and meet mine."

[The Subjugator placed the rib beneath the beast's skull and raised it level.]

"What lies beyond belongs not to you. Nor to your false god hiding amongst the many moons. It belongs to that which witnesses all. You would do best not to forget it, regardless of your misplaced loyalties."

————————————————————————————

[The rib dropped into our dwelling. Our Deep. With force, it landed before us, uplifting the sediment of the Fundament floor into a dense cloud—from which he emerged.]

"You—who stand on the naked hull of an ancient ship. You—who stand exposed, should be annihilated by the crushing pressure and ferocious heat of the deeper Fundament. But you—survive of your own will. You… are not known to us."

[He was to be our fate…]

[这头残暴的利维坦在失去了组成它胸腔的一根肋骨之后才懂得了这一惨痛的教训——单单这根肋骨就比镇压者的体型还要大上好几倍。然而，他却举重若轻地挥舞着它。]
[利维坦大喘着气，衰弱不堪，它的目光投向底下的深渊，但它却一心想着自己的失败。]

“野兽，你难道不看看那个打败你的人吗？抬起你的头来见见我。”

[镇压者把肋骨放在野兽脑袋下，将其抬到与双眼齐平的位置。]

“外面的东西不属于你，也不属于你那藏在众多卫星之中的假神。而是属于那见证一切的人。抛开你那错位的忠诚不谈，你最好不要忘记这一点。”

————————————————————————————

[肋骨掉到了我们的寓所。我们的深渊。它用力落在我们面前，把虫群据点地面的沉积物掀了起来——他就是从那里出现的。]

“站在一艘古船裸露的船体之上的你。站立在虫群据点深处的高压和炽热之上的你。这应该消灭了你才对…但你却凭借自身意志存活了下来。你…不为我们所知。”

[他将是我们的命运…]

91750002.name: Resonant Fury Gauntlets
91750002.flavor: Yul yearns for nurture. It does so through honesty.
91750002.lore:
++Stench follows. You drag it before you—

—It will not consume you, for you have conquered it—

—Or so you prefer to believe++

++TURN BACK FROM THE WORLD-KILLING WAY++

++OR YOU WILL LIVE AS WRATH AND DEVASTATION++

[In this life, there are beings that bring light to others. And there are beings that bring dark. He brought dark. Only dark. And was naught more than an unbreakable, unstoppable force.] 

[The cruel Leviathan learned this truth the hard way—he pulled from its chest a rib many times larger than the Subjugator himself. Yet he wielded it as nothing.]
[The Leviathan, winded, broken, cast its gaze on the Deep below.]

"You would not look upon the one who bested you, beast? Lift your eyes and meet mine."

1962502788.name: Resonant Fury Plate
1962502788.flavor: Xol yearned for nurture. It did so amongst the thousands.
1962502788.lore:
[Madness. Whether he knew it or not, the Subjugator shared this characteristic with his very target, the Osmium King. Larvae in hand, the king was surrounded by whispers—whispers of the end of all things. Designed to incite madness.] 

[And then the movement of a silver moon in the sky made his madness fester. He raved. Ranted. Until others were so sick of listening that they tore him from this life. His daughters, fearing for theirs, fled.]

[From on high, they watched—the Witness and its Disciple—plotting their next move.]

"It toys with us, my Witness, as it always has. Our enemy in Fundament's sky. Its movements are a message, one that that belies our machinations."

—-It delays our desires so that it may seek its own. These frail siblings… will soon be claimed by the Light. Unless we claim them first. Our whispers were fed to a weak mind. But we have watched these siblings. These children of the king. They are brave minds. Clever minds. Ambitious minds. Yet unsullied by the weakness of aging that plagues their kind.—-

"Then what compels them to hear our whispers?"

—-Desperation. We will tell the most cunning sibling of a cataclysm. A prophecy… of great loss. We will feed her fear. Her pride. We will say… Young Sathona. The end is coming. A great cataclysm. A God-Wave. In the Sky… there is only death. But salvation… lies in the Deep. Lead your sisters down. Your cunning will spare their short lives. And you… will be reborn. The Witch Queen… Savathûn.—-

"Quite the embellished lie, my Witness."

—-Lie? Or perhaps a truth in the making? That will be of her choosing. She may even stand alongside you one day. In service of the final shape.—-

[In that moment, jealousy, envy- or something more was all but painted across the Subjugator's expression.]
1962502788.lore_zh:
[丧心病狂。不管他是否知道，镇压者和他的目标：锇素之王，都有着这一共同的特征。锇素之王手里拿着幼虫，耳边都是流言低语，一心煽动癫狂的低语。万物终结的低语。] 

[直到一轮银月在空中游移。在锇素之王的脑海中，古老的神话变成了现实。他咆哮着，叫嚷着。直到其他人因听得腻烦而了结了他的生命。他的女儿们担忧同样遭此下场，纷纷逃离。]

[他们居高临下，注视着见证者及其门徒，策划他们的下一步行动。]

“它在一如既往地玩弄我们，我的见证者。我们那在虫群据点空中的敌人。它的行迹是一则讯息，与我们的秘密计划相悖的讯息。”

—-它拖延了我们的欲望，这样它就可以寻求自己的欲望。这些脆弱的孩子…很快就会被光能所占有。除非我们先占有他们。我们的低语被灌输给了一个意志薄弱的人。但我们一直在观察这些孩子。这些锇素之王的孩子。他们是勇敢的人，聪明的人，有野心的人。但还没有被困扰他们这类人的衰老弱点所污染。—-

“那要怎么迫使他们听到我们的低语呢？”

—-绝望。我们会将大灾变的预言讲给最狡黠的孩子听：一则…毁天灭地的预言。我们会用她的恐惧和骄傲滋养她。我们会说…年轻的萨托娜唷。末日即将来临。一场巨大的灾变。一股神之巨浪。在天空中…只有死亡。救赎…就在深渊之中。将你的姐妹们带入深渊吧。你的狡黠会拯救她们短暂的生命。而你…将会重生。作为巫妖女王…萨瓦图恩。—-

“真是个精心编造的谎言啊，我的见证者。”

—-谎言？又或许是个正在成形的真相呢？那就要看她作何选择了。她甚至可能有一天会站在你身旁。为终焉之形效力。—-

[那一刻，镇压者脸上几乎写满了嫉妒。]

2706229721.name: Resonant Fury Mark
2706229721.flavor: Eir yearns for nurture. It does so through order.
2706229721.lore:
[The Witch Queen rarely paid visit to my prison. And when she did, it was not for me. She knew what I was, what I produced. I was a servant of the Subjugator. A servant of the Witness. A provider of that which took sustenance from her and many like her. She never cared for that. And as such, she never cared for me. Or for him. And he knew it.]

[She was cunning. Where wrath consumed Oryx and Xivu Arath, it always eluded Savathûn. Or perhaps, it was she who eluded it.]

[Of this, my Subjugator was not fond. Placed indefinitely in her throne world, he was made to watch her every move. To mentor and guide, to keep a close eye—so that one day, she, too, could serve the Witness. A Disciple in the making.] 

[It was as planned. The Krill became the Hive. The enemy amongst the moons of Fundament disappeared. My Subjugator served his Witness well. But he could not escape the very words of his Witness, which beat against his mind whenever Savathûn stood in his presence. —-The universe is wide, my child. With wrath matching if not exceeding yours in its vastness. Seek it before it seeks you. Or it will be your end.—-]

[I became a vessel for his jealousies. A source of power for his Upended to consume. To see Savathûn's world shattered should she ever step out of line.]

[In the Deep, my children pay a price in servitude, for survival. In ascendance, the Hive pay a price in servitude, for power. And in the dark, I pay a price in servitude, so that others may be nurtured.]

[It must not be in vain.]
2706229721.lore_zh:
[巫妖女王鲜少造访我的监狱。她这么做的时候，也不是为了我。她知道我曾是什么人物，我创造了什么。我是镇压者的仆从。见证者的仆从。一个从她和许多像她一样的人身上汲取养料的供养人。她从不关心这些。正因如此，她从不关心我。也不关心他。他知道这一点。]

[她是狡黠者。愤怒吞噬了欧里克斯和希乌阿拉斯。但它总是避开了萨瓦图恩。也许是她避开了它。]

[这一点，我的镇压者并不喜欢。她被无限期地安置在了她的王座世界里，用来监视她一举一动。用来指导和引导，密切关注她，这样有一天她也可以为见证者效忠。一个正在养成的门徒。] 

[一切都按计划进行。克里尔变成了邪魔族。虫群据点卫星中的敌人消失了。我的镇压者很好地效忠了他的见证者。但是，每当萨瓦图恩站在他面前的时候，他都无法逃避见证者说的那些不断激荡他脑海的话——宇宙是广阔的，我的孩子。有种愤怒与其浩瀚相媲美，甚至更胜一筹。要在它找到你之前，先找到它。否则它就将是你的末日。——]

[我成了他忌妒的对象。成了为他的颠倒者提供力量的源泉。一旦萨瓦图恩越轨，就将见证她的世界遭到摧毁。]

[在深渊里，我的孩子们付出了奴役的代价，换取生存。在上维中，邪魔族付出了奴役的代价，换取力量。而在黑暗中，我付出了奴役的代价，这样其他人才能得到养育。]

[这一切绝不能徒劳无功。]

680713005.name: Resonant Fury Helm
680713005.flavor: Ur yearns for nurture. It does so through hunger.
680713005.lore:
"I am Xita, the nurturing worm. Behold Yul, and Eir, and Xol, and Ur, and Akka. The virtuous worms. Look upon us and know that We are go[o]d. You, however, are not. You are inconsequential. And this is not your—"

"My what? Place? Privilege? Destiny?"

"You disrespect—"

"There are no pleasantries in the Deep. Only the decaying husks of oversized parasites towering before me. You take me for a fool, believing I am like all else—manipulated by your psychic machinations. But I will not be controlled, for I am wrath."

[He allowed us no audience. He knew of our hunger. Abandoned. Imprisoned. Our vulnerabilities stood clear, and he wasted no time in cracking them open with the rib he tore from the cruel Leviathan.]

"You desire life. My Witness desires your power. A trade is in the stars: your servitude for their lives," he said, lifting the rib and pointing it at my children.

"Their power requires sustenance. Without it, your Witness will have none."

"The surface of this disgusting rock is lined with their sustenance. Primitive beasts now stand at the verge of new purpose—giving life to your kind once again. I, kind Rhulk, will ensure your children survive. And you will aid a righteous cause in return."

[Outmatched. Death would one day be our recompense. But our part was still left to play.]

"Go on, then," [he snarked, holding the rib out.] "Sustenance has arrived."

[I grasped it, and he swam upwards, dragging me in tow. Rising, up from our Deep. Taking me from my children. Up and up, away from one prison, and toward another…]
680713005.lore_zh:
“我是养育蠕虫，西塔。瞧瞧尤尔、艾尔、尸飕、厄尔还有阿卡。自命清高的蠕虫们。看看我们，我们这才叫好。而你们，差得远了。你们是微不足道的。而这不是属于你们的-”

“你想说什么？地方？特权？命运？”

“你敢不敬-”

“深渊底下没有客套话。只有超大的寄生虫腐烂躯壳耸立在我面前。你把我当傻子耍。还以为我和其他所有人一样，会被你们的心灵技俩所操纵。但我不会被控制，因为我怒不可遏。”

[他不给我们申诉的机会。他了解我们的饥饿。我们受到遗弃，遭到囚禁。我们的弱点一目了然，他不失时机地用他从残暴的利维坦身上撕下的肋骨来逐一击破。]

“你渴望生命。我的见证者渴望得到你的力量。群星会见证这桩交易。生命，拿你的换他们的。”他说道，举起肋骨，指着我的孩子。

“我们的力量需要养料。生命的力量。没有养料，我们就没有力量。你也不会有。”

“这块令人作呕的岩石表面布满了你的养料。原始的野兽有了新的目标，那就是再次赋予你的同类生命。我，善良的胡克，会帮你做这件事。作为报答，你需要协助正义的事业。”

[寡不敌众。我们终有一日会以死相报。但我们的任务还没有完成。]

“那就继续吧，”他伸出肋骨咆哮道，“养料来了。”

[我抓住它，他拖着我向上游去。从我们的深渊升起。把我从我的孩子身边带走。一直向上，远离一个监狱，走向另一个监狱…]

4278730425.name: Resonant Fury Helm
4278730425.flavor: Ur yearns for nurture. It does so through hunger.
4278730425.lore:
"I am Xita, the nurturing worm. Behold Yul, and Eir, and Xol, and Ur, and Akka. The virtuous worms. Look upon us and know that We are go[o]d. You, however, are not. You are inconsequential. And this is not your—"

"My what? Place? Privilege? Destiny?"

"You disrespect—"

"There are no pleasantries in the Deep. Only the decaying husks of oversized parasites towering before me. You take me for a fool, believing I am like all else—manipulated by your psychic machinations. But I will not be controlled, for I am wrath."

[He allowed us no audience. He knew of our hunger. Abandoned. Imprisoned. Our vulnerabilities stood clear, and he wasted no time in cracking them open with the rib he tore from the cruel Leviathan.]

"You desire life. My Witness desires your power. A trade is in the stars: your servitude for their lives," he said, lifting the rib and pointing it at my children.

"Their power requires sustenance. Without it, your Witness will have none."

"The surface of this disgusting rock is lined with their sustenance. Primitive beasts now stand at the verge of new purpose—giving life to your kind once again. I, kind Rhulk, will ensure your children survive. And you will aid a righteous cause in return."

[Outmatched. Death would one day be our recompense. But our part was still left to play.]

"Go on, then," [he snarked, holding the rib out.] "Sustenance has arrived."

[I grasped it, and he swam upwards, dragging me in tow. Rising, up from our Deep. Taking me from my children. Up and up, away from one prison, and toward another…]

336306726.name: Resonant Fury Greaves
336306726.flavor: Akka yearned for nurture. It did so through secrets.
336306726.lore:
[The Subjugator did what he does best. Conquer. Capture. Many of his victims fell. But those who proved useful served.]

[From a prison within Fundament to another in the dark expanse of his making, I was taken… And that was only the beginning.]

[He knew of our strengths. Our powers. To grip the mind and guide. To fill it with vitality and power. To reduce it to rot and waste.]

[—-The universe is wide, my child—- his Witness would chide. —-With wrath matching if not exceeding yours in its vastness. Seek it before it seeks you. Or it will be your end.—-]

[He claimed to desire our powers for his Witness. But I overheard eons of their discussions. His omniscient god always reduced him to that which he claimed—wrath.]

[Though he wore such a designation proudly, he wanted more. Wanted our power for himself. To continue to do what he does best, better than before, alongside his Witness.]

[This is why I was kept. The desire for domination of all things.]

——————————————————————————————————————

[The Subjugator returned living pieces of me to Fundament: segments he called larvae. He set them adrift on the ocean, knowing full well where the current would carry them…] 

[To the shores of the Osmium Kingdom.]
336306726.lore_zh:
[镇压者做了他最擅长的事。征服与俘虏。许多受害者倒下了。但那些被证明有用的人，都得留下来效力。]

[我从一个虫群据点里的监狱被带到了一个黑暗中的监狱…这只是开头。]

[他了解我们的力量。我们的能量。控制并引导思想。让它充满活力与力量。任它沦为腐根和废料。]

[—-宇宙是广阔的，我的孩子，—-他的见证者会斥责道。—-有种愤怒与其浩瀚相媲美，甚至更胜一筹。要在它找到你之前，先找到它。否则它就将是你的末日。—-]

[他声称希望让他的见证者有这些力量。但我无意中听到了无数次他们的讨论。他的全知之神总是会让他沦落到他自称的那种地步——怒不可遏。]

[虽然他很傲然地流露着怒火，但他还想要更多。他想要据为己有。继续做他最擅长的事情，甚至做得比以前更好。]

[这就是我被关起来的原因。支配万事万物的欲望。]

——————————————————————————————————————

[镇压者把我活着的碎片带到了虫群据点。他称它们为幼虫。他让它漂浮在大海上，深知漂流会把它带往…] 

[锇素王国的海岸。]

1296681495.name: Seventh Seraph Gauntlets
1296681495.lore:
Chapter 3: For a Friend

Voronin found cover under uprooted trees and demolished vehicles as he made his way through the catastrophic weather. He could hardly believe he was still alive, bearing witness to the end of all things.

The storm encompassed the station, under siege from the elements. Civilians were being ushered toward the SMILE pods in droves as the lightning made its presence felt, igniting a nearby fuel supply. The explosion tore into the group, and as Voronin turned his head from the horror and the heat, he saw her. Roughly 250 meters away from the station. Morozova lay, singed and smoking, under rubble and ash.

Voronin pulled up his sensorium, but the electromagnetic fields in the air reduced it to static. There was no way to know if she was still alive or salvageable. She had treated him with respect despite outranking him, and she had been there for him when his marriage went to hell—

"We're all dead anyway," he thought and ran to her through the maelstrom of lightning and wind.

And then he was there, pulling off his gloves and wiping ash and blood from her face, as the storm bore down upon him.

As he made peace with his mortality, just shy of 82 years old, the storm around them calmed. The lightning stopped. The wind died. At the station, the civilians' eyes were fixed on the sky, though Voronin was looking only at Morozova. She was breathing, barely. Her eyes opened and met his. A half-smile came across her lips, then froze as her eyes went past him and widened in awe.

Voronin turned and found himself staring into the face of God.
1296681495.lore_zh:
第3章：为了朋友

沃罗宁穿越灾难性天气时，在连根拔起的树木和被毁车辆下找到了掩护之所。他几乎难以相信自己还活着，眼睁睁看着一切的灭亡。

这场暴风雨笼罩着站点，遭到了来自元素的围困。闪电出现后，点燃了附近的燃料供给，平民被驱赶到SMILE吊舱。爆炸把他们撕成碎片，沃罗宁惊恐地从热浪中转过头来，看见了她。大概距离站点250米远。莫洛佐娃躺着，被掩藏在碎石和灰尘下，浑身焦黑冒着烟。

沃罗宁拿出他的感应器，但空气中的电磁场将其显示的读数杂乱不堪。没办法知道她是否还活着，还能不能救。尽管他的官衔不如她，但她一直尊重他，当他的婚姻一团糟时，她也一直在他身边……

“我们反正都会死的。”他这样想着，然后穿过闪电和狂风的漩涡冲向了她。

然后他跑到了那里，暴风雨降临在他身上，他脱下手套，擦掉脸上的灰烬和鲜血。

就在他与不到82岁的死亡命运和解时，周围的风暴平息了。闪电也停止了。风也停了。在焊点里，平民的眼睛盯着天空，而沃罗宁的目光只盯着莫洛佐娃。她还在呼吸，虽然奄奄一息。她睁开眼睛，看见了他。她的唇角绽出微笑，然后目光越过他，突然因恐惧而瞪大了眼镜。

沃罗宁转过身，发自己自己正面对着神。

1673892193.name: Seventh Seraph Plate
1673892193.lore:
Chapter 2: Crashes

The first bolt of lightning sent static up Voronin's arm and filled the atmosphere around him with a pungent chlorine-like smell. His hand went to his chest without thinking, as if to make sure he was fully intact. His gaze shifted as a second bolt hit the ground near him, then another. He had never seen lightning so close before. Stunned, he stood his ground; while part of him knew he should be frightened for his life, he was more perplexed than afraid.

There was no rain. He looked toward the horizon, expecting clouds, expecting something, and only saw a shimmering curtain of blue lightning sifting toward him.

He raced for shelter in the surrounding field, abandoning his munitions container in the dust kicked up by his fevered stride. The strikes razed the ground, sparking wildfires and scorching stone. There was no logic to their timing, with bolts crashing so frequently, the sound of the thunder couldn't catch up.

He'd lost Morozova in the commotion. Already drained from hours spent hauling cargo, his mind recessed into primal instinct. RUN.

So he ran, doing his best to avoid the apocalypse that surrounded him. A call came through his earpiece as the ground quaked beneath him: "… auxiliary evac station…" was all he could make out before a roar of thunder swallowed the transmission.

He knew he needed to head west toward the station. The wind picked up and blew him off his feet, and again he felt a moment of sheer amazement at the storm's sudden ferocity. He hit the ground hard and checked his sensorium. It was scrambled from all the sinuous electricity undulating through the air, but he could just barely make out his compass. West. He ran.
1673892193.lore_zh:
第2章：坠毁

第一道闪电让沃罗宁的手臂上产生了静电，周围散发出刺鼻的氯味。没有经过思考，他的手立即伸向胸口，仿佛要确保自己完好无损。当第二道闪电撞到他附近的地面时，他的视线随之转移，然后又是一道。他从未如此近距离看过闪电。他惊呆了，站起身来。 虽然内心知道他应该为自己的生命而害怕，但相比较于害怕，他更感到疑惑。

没有雨。他看着地平线，期待着云层，期待着会有什么东西，但只看到一道闪烁的蓝色电幕朝他飞来。

他拼命奔跑，想在在周围的田野中找到庇身之所，在发狂的步伐所踢起的尘土中，他丢掉了弹药容器。闪电焚烧大地，引发野火，烧焦了石头。时机毫无逻辑，闪电频繁地爆裂，雷声尚且无法追击。

他在混乱中失去了莫洛佐娃。他已经花了数小时拖运货物，耗尽了精力，他的思想陷入了麻木的本能。快跑。

所以他开始跑，尽全力避开周围的灾难。当脚下的大地震动时，他的耳机里传来个声音：“……辅助撤离点……”这是在雷声吞没信号之前他能听到的所有信息。

他知道他必须往西，朝站点走。再次起风了，吹着他双脚几乎离开地面，他再次感觉到风暴突入起来的凶猛。他猛地装上地面，检查他的传感器。它是从空中完全的电干扰而来，但是他几乎无法辨认出自己的指南针。向西，他开始奔跑。

2880957884.name: Seventh Seraph Mark
2880957884.flavor: "You can't leave me. Not like this." —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
2880957884.lore:
Chapter 5: Abhorrent Imperative

Voronin tied his armband tight around her calf to cut off the blood flow from Morozova's gaping wound. He tried to keep her leg clean while the wind caked them with dirt and debris. Lightning was drawing closer. The sterile scent of ozone had returned and he knew he didn't have much time. "COME BACK!" he shouted hopelessly to the God. He hoisted Morozova up, supporting her on his shoulder, and pushed back against the elements that were conspiring against him.

It was 250 meters to the evac station. Every step was a battle of attrition. At this point, the thought of coldsleep sounded comforting. He just had to make it to the SMILE pods. The storm had other plans. A nearby HMMWV was struck by a wayward bolt and the explosion threw them back. He felt Morozova torn from his side as he landed, and the sound of his skull hitting stone was louder than the thunder had been. As blackness crept into his vision, he saw the Traveler in the sky, moving away, abandoning him.

…and then he was being dragged from the wreckage and violence onto a gurney. "…Morozova?" he struggled out. He was met with an oxygen mask. His eyes darted, in search of some sign that Morozova was alive. Voronin couldn't decipher anything out of the pandemonium around him. "I'm sorry," he thought to himself while cursing the orb in the sky for deserting him.

The last thing he remembered before they placed him into coldsleep was an explosion in the sky so bright it blinded him.
2880957884.lore_zh:
第5章：令人厌恶的命令

沃罗宁将臂带紧紧地绑在小腿上，以阻止莫洛佐娃的巨大伤口继续流血。风将灰尘和碎屑吹到他们脚上，他努力保持她的腿清洁。闪电越来越近了。臭氧的无菌气味又回来了，他知道自己没有太多时间。“快回来！”他绝望地朝着神喊道。他举起莫洛佐娃，架着她的肩膀，抵抗着围绕在他周围的元素们。

距离撤离站点250米远。每一步都是消耗战。在这个时候，冷冻睡眠的念头是如此令人舒适。他必须赶到SMILE吊舱。风暴可不这么想。附近的一辆HMMWV被闪电击中，爆炸把他们击退。他落地时感到莫洛佐娃从他身边被拉开，他的头骨撞到石头的声音比雷声响亮。当黑暗笼罩着他的视线，他看到了天空中的旅行者，逐渐离开，抛弃了他。

……他被从废墟中拖了出来，拽到一个轮床上。“……莫洛佐娃？”他挣扎问道。引入眼帘的是一个氧气面罩。他的双眼急切搜寻，想找寻找莫洛佐娃还活着的迹象。沃罗宁无法从他身边的哄闹中找到任何有用的信息。“我很抱歉，”他在诅咒天空中的球体抛弃他时，这样想到。

在他们进入冷冻睡眠状态之前，他记得的最后一件事是天上的爆炸如此明亮，他什么都看不见了。

1899944006.name: Seventh Seraph Helmet
1899944006.flavor: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
1899944006.lore:
Chapter 1: Out for Delivery

Voronin nearly dropped the munitions he was carrying, which would have been a disaster for everyone in the vicinity. Certainly not as bad as whatever calamity they were prepping for, but bad enough to warrant the panic that coursed through his body. He hated these kinds of assignments.

"Hey, Morozova!" Voronin called out to his ranking officer between heavy gasps. "Any idea where all these are going?"
Morozova carefully placed her container on the ground, as if she was laying a child to bed. "No clue. Word just came from on high to double-time it, though. Something about Titan has got everyone spooked."

Voronin removed his helmet and wiped the sweat from his brow. Titan? What the hell happened out there? Comms had been spotty and the orders that did get through were light on details: Procure munitions. Transpo munitions to coordinates provided. Stockpile munitions. Repeat. No HMMWVs either. This was meant to be low profile, staying off the roads.

Where was all this firepower going, and what were we going to do with it when it got there? Voronin picked up his container and his pace.

He trudged just shy of a click behind Morozova for what felt like hours. These containers were cumbersome and it was the height of the driest summer he could remember.

When they reached their destination, they received a cursory greeting from Bykov, who was busy compiling a list of all the deliverables. Two soldiers, whom Voronin didn't recognize, were placing the containers in the mouth of a shaft that protruded from the ground. One punched in a command and the shipment vanished below the surface with a hollow pneumatic "whoomp."

"Where does that go?" Voronin asked. Bykov's brows drew together and his expression hardened. He returned to his list.

"Ready for the next round?" Morozova posed with more spunk than Voronin could muster in a year.

"If we must."

The sky grew gray, and clouds formed overhead as they left. Procure, repeat.
1899944006.lore_zh:
第1章：外出送货

沃罗宁差点丢掉他携带的弹药，这对附近所有人来说都会是场灾难。当然，这并没有他们准备应付的灾难那么糟糕，但足以使恐慌蔓延他的身体。他讨厌这类任务。

“喂，莫洛佐娃！”沃罗宁喘粗气的间隙，喊着他的长官。“知道这些东西要送去哪里吗？”
 莫洛佐娃小心把容器放在地上，好像在把孩子放在床上一样。“不知道。高层人只说加快速度。好像是土卫六让所有人都惊慌不已。”

沃罗宁移除了面具，擦了擦眉毛下的汗水。土卫六？那里到底发生了什么？通讯时好时坏，命令也没有太多细节：取得弹药。将弹药送往指定的坐标。存储弹药。重复步骤。也没有高机动多功能战车。这原本该是个秘密任务，远离大路。

所有这些军火都去了哪里，到达那里时我们将如何处理？沃罗宁抱起箱子，继续工作。

他在莫洛佐娃身后几步，感觉像过了几个小时一样漫长。这些箱子很麻烦，这是他记忆中最干燥的一个夏天。

当他们到达目的地时，他们收到了拜科夫的简单问候，他正忙着整理所有可交付成果的清单。两个沃罗宁不认识的士兵，将这些容器放在从地面伸出的竖井口中。其中一个人下达命令，然后随着空心的气动“嗡嗡声”，货物在地表下方消失。

“东西去了哪里？”沃罗宁问道。拜科夫的眉头皱在一起，他的表情更加严峻。他转过身看着清单。

“下一轮准备好了吗？”莫洛佐娃展现了沃罗宁需要一年才能积攒的勇气。

“如果我们一定要的话。”

天空变成了灰色，在他们离开时，头顶形成了乌云。获取，重复。

2680862009.name: Seventh Seraph Greaves
2680862009.lore:
Chapter 4: Face to Face

Voronin's mouth hung agape. His lungs forgot how to breathe. His heart rate accelerated, his stomach turned, and he weakly wondered if this was his transition to the afterlife. Somehow he found his footing and stood.

The Traveler, they called it. He had heard the stories from throughout the system, but never did he think he would live to see it. Now it was as though it was seeing him.

He took a step forward as if it would bring him closer to the oblate spheroid in the sky above him. He stumbled. The ground had gotten so hot under him, the rubber on his boots had melted. A banal thought cut through his awe—"Now I look like a fool in front of the Traveler"—and he was ashamed.


The sound of cracking thunder still echoed in the distance. That was when he noticed he was in the eye of the storm. It was wailing all around him, but calm in his general circumference. Surely this was the Traveler's doing. The great savior. He grabbed Morozova, unsure of how long this would last, and brought her to her feet. She was badly injured, bleeding from a wound on her leg.

"Stay with me." He said to Morozova and the Traveler at once. Only one of them listened. The Traveler was on the move, and the storm was returning.
2680862009.lore_zh:
第4章：面对面

沃罗宁的嘴巴大张着。他的肺忘记了该如何呼吸。他的心跳加速，胃里翻江倒海，他怀疑自己是不是要转世投胎了。然后突然他找到了立足点，又站立起来。

他们称之为的旅行者。他从整个星系都听过这些故事，但是他从来没有想过会活着看到它。现在好像它在看着他。

他向前迈了一步，似乎这样能让他更靠近上方天空中的球形物体。他蹒跚前行。他脚下的大地如此炽热，靴子上的碎石都融化了。一个无聊的想法减轻了他的敬畏感——“现在，我在旅行者面前就像个傻瓜。”他感到羞愧。


刺耳的雷声仍在远处回荡。这时他才注意到自己在暴风眼之中。周围全是呼啸声，但他周围还算平静。当然，都是旅行者的杰作。伟大的救世主。他抓着莫洛佐娃，不知道这种状况会持续多久，然后让莫洛佐娃站了起来。她受伤很重，腿上的伤口不断流血。

“留下来。”他同时对莫洛佐娃和旅行者说道。只有一个人听到了。旅行者仍在移动，风暴回归。

1552647844.name: Wildwood Gauntlets
1552647844.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

4117549980.name: Wildwood Plate
4117549980.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

1532976913.name: Wildwood Mark
1532976913.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
1532976913.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
1532976913.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

2876804565.name: Wildwood Helm
2876804565.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

3483293774.name: Wildwood Greaves
3483293774.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

1303083975.name: Exodus Down Gauntlets
1303083975.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

3333520369.name: Exodus Down Plate
3333520369.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

1192406156.name: Exodus Down Mark
1192406156.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.

99093622.name: Exodus Down Helm
99093622.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

55889673.name: Exodus Down Greaves
55889673.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

1924293735.name: Reverie Dawn Gauntlets
1924293735.flavor: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
1924293735.lore:
She travels across the Ascendant Plane.

The voyage across the sea of screams threatens to erode her edges as no other trial ever has. In Oryx's throne world, she had a semblance of an identity. Treasure. Spoil of war. Defeated queen. Repugnant and alien and Not Me, but she could use these contortions as guideposts to trace her way back to herself.

Here in the emptiness between throne worlds, she has nothing but what she can carry.

The burden is growing heavier, but she is not alone.

He tries to speak to her from a place of high contempt. In doing so, he invites her into his topography.

She steps out of howling and finds her footing upon a plane of swords and madness and all-consuming curiosity.

"Who are you?"

The question summons an almost-forgotten answer deep within the rapidly solidifying shape of her.

"I AM MARA SOV. STARLIGHT WAS MY MOTHER, AND MY FATHER WAS THE DARK."

The thing that once was called Toland flees before her darkness/light/shadow/majesty. And she rests within this scrap of a world, before resuming her journey through the Howling.
1924293735.lore_zh:
她横渡上维位面。

穿越尖叫之海比她遇到的任何一次试炼都更为严峻，不断侵蚀着她的极限。在欧里克斯的王座世界里，她似乎有一个身份。宝藏、战利品、战败的女王、令人厌恶的外星人，她可以凭借这些扭曲的词汇当成路标找回自己。

在王座世界之间的虚空中，她只能够背负她可以承担的。

负担越来越重，不过她并非孤身一人。

他试图居高临下地与她对话。因此，他邀请她进入自己的领域。

她穿越了尖叫之海，发现自己来到了一片充斥着战争、疯狂和狂热好奇心的位面。.

“你是谁？”

这个问题在她迅速固化的的形态中唤起了一个几乎被遗忘的答案。

“我是玛拉·索维。星光是我的母亲，黑暗是我的父亲。”

那个我们曾经称为托兰的人，在黑暗/光明/暗影/王权面前逃得无影无踪。在她重新踏上旅途之前，她在这块破碎的世界中小憩了一会儿。

2178430353.name: Reverie Dawn Plate
2178430353.flavor: "There is a place where we can remember who we are." —Imogen Rife
2178430353.lore:
She feels Oryx's true death in both halves of her soul, a full imagined exhale before the aftershock reaches his throne world.

It crumbles around her like stone, like ash, like veils in a breeze.

Eris Morn's friends have succeeded. The Guardians have slain a god.

She steps through the ruins. In the end, there is nothing. Nothing but Mara Sov and the howling of rampant, untamed logics.

Her great and terrible gamble has paid off.

The rest is up to her now.
2178430353.lore_zh:
她那分成两半的灵魂都感受到了欧里克斯的死亡，在余震抵达他的王座世界之前，她在蒸汽中想象出了一幅完整的画面。

它在她周围瓦解，如沙石，如灰烬，如微风中的面纱。

埃里斯·摩恩的朋友们已经成功了。守护者已经杀死了一位神明。

她穿过废墟。尽头，一无所有。有的只是玛拉·索维和狂暴的嚎叫声，以及难以捉摸的逻辑现实。

她孤注一掷的豪赌终于有了收获。

接下来就看她的了。

78892972.name: Reverie Dawn Mark
78892972.flavor: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
78892972.lore:
She is home.

But it is not the same.

Shuro Chi has been Taken. Kalli and Sedia, too.

And Riven—

She used to sit in the shade of those wings. Laugh at the riddles that rumbled in that mercurial throat.

This creature is all teeth and broken promises, transformed by the expectations of another scheming, secretive sister.

"I cannot stay here."

These are the first words that pass through this throat. Her throat, though it shares none of the molecules that comprised the code of her former body. They scrape and ache as they pass through her lips.

Again, if only to remind herself that she is alive:

"I cannot stay here."
78892972.lore_zh:
她到家了。

不过家已不再是当年的家。

秋露·知成为了傀儡。卡丽和赛迪娅也是。

还有魅痕——

她曾在那对翅膀的荫庇下，嘲笑着那些从易变喉咙里发出的模糊字句。

这生物攻击性极强且十分恶毒，是被她那诡计多端、行事隐秘的姐姐转化而成的。

“我不能留在这里。”

这是喉咙里挤出的第一句话。她的喉咙，尽管这个身体已经没有残留之前身体的任何分子。词句滑过唇舌带来的是撕扯和疼痛。

如果要说有什么能让她意识到自己还活着，那便是：

“我不能留在这里。”

720200086.name: Reverie Dawn Helm
720200086.flavor: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
720200086.lore:
She waits.

She trusts that Eris will shepherd the Guardians and that the infinite ambition of those undying half-children will deliver her. They will enter the court and challenge its king and dance in its killing ground, and they will master the school of sword logic so mightily that they will overturn its teacher and forsake the crown.

Soon.

But soon may not be soon enough, because Oryx roams the hallowed spires and melancholy shores of the Dreaming City. He stands looking out over the mists of her beautiful creation, and he laughs.

She can feel him there like a thorn in the meat of her palm.
She scolds herself for not factoring Shuro Chi's love into her design. Then she berates herself for this nervous energy, this fretful self-cannibalism.

Lungless, Mara remembers the sensation of a deep breath. Enacts it in her mind.

She remembers the singularity before her.

She waits.
720200086.lore_zh:
她在等待。

她相信埃里斯会带领那些守护者，那些充满野心不死不灭的小家伙们能实现她的愿望。他们会冲进朝堂，挑战王权，推翻统治。他们将超越自己的老师，领悟邪剑守则的真谛，权力再也无法束缚他们。

很快这一切就会成真。

不过很快也许还不够快，因为欧里克斯已经来到了幽梦之城，在神圣的尖塔与忧郁的海岸边徘徊。他站在一边，望着她亲手创造出的美丽迷雾开怀大笑。

她感受到他的存在，就像扎在手心里的一根刺一样。

她责怪自己没有把秋露·知的爱恋纳入设计。这种自责使她陷入了痛苦的自我否定和焦虑之中。

尽管已经没有了肺，玛拉依然记得深吸一口气时的感觉，那种感觉深深地印在她的脑海中。

她记得眼前那个奇点。

她在等待。

677099433.name: Reverie Dawn Greaves
677099433.flavor: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
677099433.lore:
Joy wells in her heart when her searching fingers trace the edges of Eleusinia.

She has passed through the desert. She has reached the far side of the chessboard. She is alive, or soon will be.

She opens the door and her joy dies on the threshold.

Her throne world is desecrated.

Not annihilated, as Oryx's was. The pillars and terraces and courtyards still retain their shape. But the roots have rotted, and the geometry festers.

She should have known she would not be the only one to plan for such eventualities.

Oryx's bootprints pucker like scars in the labyrinth that was once only her own.

She sits a while beneath Sjur's statue, then follows his tracks through the ruins of Eleusinia, back to the Dreaming City.
677099433.lore_zh:
当她搜索的手指发现了厄琉息斯的边界时，心中乐开了花。

她穿越了沙漠，她抵达了棋盘的另外一边。她还活着，或者说马上就重获新生了。

她打开了门，原本喜悦的心一下跌入谷底。

她的王座世界被玷污了。

与欧里克斯的不一样，这个世界并没有消失。巨大的圆柱、梯田和庭院依然保持着本来的面貌。不过根部已经腐烂，几何状态不断溃烂。

她应该知道虽然自己有计策，但别人也不会坐以待毙。

在这个曾经只有她自己脚印的迷宫里，欧里克斯的靴印犹如烙在她身上的一块块伤疤。

她在苏尔的雕像下坐了一会儿，然后跟随着他的足迹走过了厄琉息斯废墟，回到了幽梦之城。

2296158778.name: Dreambane Gauntlets
2296158778.flavor: "Their curses are now your charms. Hold such hatreds close, for they reveal their fears." —Eris Morn

3224065934.name: Dreambane Plate
3224065934.flavor: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn

3542160471.name: Dreambane Mark
3542160471.flavor: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn

103494859.name: Dreambane Helm
103494859.flavor: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn

3977088116.name: Dreambane Greaves
3977088116.flavor: "You will go where none have gone before. Tread carefully." —Eris Morn

1356732989.name: Crystocrene Gauntlets
1356732989.flavor: "Busy hands are warm hands! Do your part for the colony in these extra-insulated work gloves." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

1982012355.name: Crystocrene Plate
1982012355.flavor: "Conserving body heat is key to staving off hypothermia; a serious risk on Europa." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

1263716154.name: Crystocrene Mark
1263716154.flavor: "Prepare for your arctic adventure with the very best in Bray outfitting!" —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

1409538404.name: Crystocrene Helm
1409538404.flavor: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

3722358623.name: Crystocrene Greaves
3722358623.flavor: "Ultra-light ion-shielding keeps you protected AND mobile in a radiated, rapidly changing climate." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

293997844.name: Veritas Gauntlets
293997844.flavor: "Truth is difficult. And that's fine. I don't trust anyone who doesn't like a challenge." —Chul Sobong, Hidden instructor

3380735020.name: Veritas Plate
3380735020.flavor: "You'll never know truth with real certainty. All you can do is hew away at preconception with the facts and pray that whatever shape's left at the end is a reasonable facsimile." —Dagget-4, Hidden analyst

1784423009.name: Veritas Mark
1784423009.flavor: "The truth outlives us. You can put a bullet through my heart and win an argument, but it doesn't make your account any more or less honest." —Amrit Vo, Titan

3849865029.name: Veritas Helm
3849865029.flavor: "Life is lies. Comfort? Justice? Love? They're things we made up. Don't make the mistake of assuming true and false are the same as good and bad. What's important is being able to tell them apart." —Omar Saint Croix, Hidden handler

157279006.name: Veritas Greaves
157279006.flavor: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator

2534916982.name: Thunderhead Gauntlets
2534916982.flavor: "That 10-year timer simplifies things, in a way. What's most important? Right here, right now? What one thing makes Neomuna better?" —Derecho, Cloud Strider

3434538298.name: Thunderhead Plate
3434538298.flavor: "We're momentary creatures, and the future is distant and vast. But many stones, in time, change the river's course." —Briar, Cloud Strider

4250191599.name: Thunderhead Helm
4250191599.flavor: "Iterate and advance. That's what we do. No time to dwell on failures, only learn from them." —Kestrel, Cloud Strider

3747196112.name: Thunderhead Greaves
3747196112.flavor: "That's what it's all about, right? You only ever see the seeds. The plants are for the children. Metaphorically." —Myriadical, Cloud Strider

2658534155.name: Thunderhead Mark
2658534155.flavor: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider

1974157643.name: First Ascent Gauntlets
1974157643.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Caiatl wonders what waits inside the Traveler. She's heard the stories from Red Legion defectors about how it swallowed Ghaul like a warbeast choking down a bone. 

"He's still in its belly," a Valus on her War Council once told her, and Saladin Forge had made a breathy sound through his nose that Caiatl interpreted as laughter. 

That was days ago. Now she stands on the bridge of her ship, wondering what of Ghaul remains, the Traveler's glow reflected in the black of her eyes and the ornamental jewelry she wears on her tusks. She does not feel the pull of it, as she imagines Ghaul did, or even Saladin's quiet reverence. It is not a thing to be conquered or worshipped, but it is important to the people who are important to her—and that is all that matters. 

When she hears footsteps behind her, she does not turn. She already knows whom they belong to. 

"I did not request your counsel," she says without reprimand. "But if you have something to say, then speak." 

"Must I always have some wisdom for you?" Saladin asks. "Can't we simply await the end together in comfortable silence?" 

"Your worth is your wisdom. It's the only reason I let you live." 

Saladin makes that noise again. He knows that isn't true. 

And so does she.
1974157643.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

查厄托想知道旅行者内部会有什么在等着他们。她从猩红军团叛逃者那里听说过旅行者是如何像战兽啃食骨头一样吞下了盖欧。 

“他还在它的肚子里，”战争议会上的一名军政官曾经这样告诉查厄托，而她将萨拉丁·弗吉用鼻子发出的哼哼声理解为了嗤笑。 

那是两天前的事了。她现在站在她飞船的舰桥上，琢磨着盖欧还剩下了什么。旅行者的光芒映在她的漆黑眼珠和装饰獠牙的珠宝上。她没有感受到在她的想象中盖欧对它的渴求，也没有感受到萨拉丁对它的崇敬。它不是一种该被征服或膜拜的东西，但它对那些对她很重要的人来说很重要——这才是重点。 

当她听到身后有脚步声时，她没有转身。她已经知道那是谁了。 

“我没有询问你的意见，”她说道，没有斥责的意思。“但如果你有话要讲，那就开口吧。” 

“难道我是位智慧导师？”萨拉丁问道。“我们就不能一起安静地等待终末吗？” 

“你的智慧是你的价值。那是我让你活着的唯一原因。” 

萨拉丁又发出了那种哼哼声。他知道那不是真的。 

而她也知道。

3430954245.name: First Ascent Plate
3430954245.flavor: Oh, to read a pulpy golden age detective novel… just once more.
3430954245.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Ikora studied the strange approximation of the Tower, dust kicked up around her as the wind gusted through creaking halls. She felt the pull to explore… to find her old office. To see just how deep the recreation would go. 

But as she took a step up the stairs, her foot caught something—a small but familiar rectangular shape. She picked up the book and gently brushed dust from the cover. It was a copy of "The Spine-Tingling Adventures of Sedona Kane, P.I." The pulpy cover art told her it was the fourth installment of the series, with the subtitle "The Curious Case of Doctor Pennyworth." 

Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Darkness. In a place of such potent Light, would it be enough to manifest… everything? She flipped through the book; even the coffee stain still adorned page 95. 

Flashes of memory came back to Ikora as she studied the bold colors and heavy lines of the book's tattered jacket. She recalled kicking her feet up against the wall in her bunk one night after a particularly nasty Crucible loss… Ophiuchus's glow providing just enough visibility. Remembered cleaning the spilled drink off the pages in the mess hall and praying there was no lasting damage. And thought of other moments, of a warm hand covering her own as she read the text out loud for the thousandth time… 

The Warlock held the book to her nose. Just to take in the scent once more.  

Light forgets, Darkness remembers, and so would she.
3430954245.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

艾可拉审视着这座近似高塔的奇特建筑。她周围的尘土随着破败大堂中的狂风扬起。她感受到了探索的渴望…她想找到她以前的办公室。看看这个复制品到底有多像。 

但刚踏上楼梯，她的脚就碰到了一件物品——它的形状小而熟悉。她拿起那本书，轻轻拂去封面上的灰尘。这是一本《私家侦探塞多纳·凯恩的惊奇历险记》。从它俗气的封面上可以看出，这是该系列的第四部，副标题是“潘尼沃斯医生奇案”。 

光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

暗影。在光能如此充足的地方，它是否能够显现…一切？她翻了翻书；甚至第95页上的咖啡渍都还在。 

当艾可拉打量着破旧书皮上大胆的色彩和厚重的线条时，她的记忆片段又闪现在了眼前。她回想起在熔炉竞技场中大败后，有一天夜里躺床上用脚蹬着墙…蛇夫座的光刚好够亮…在食堂里清理洒在书本上的饮料，祈祷没留下永久印记。她还想起，当她反复大声阅读时，一只温暖的手覆在自己的手上… 

这位术士把书抵到自己的鼻头，再一次感受它的气味。  

光能遗忘，暗影铭记，而她也会如此。

2086972248.name: First Ascent Mark
2086972248.flavor: There is nothing as exquisite as the feeling of doing what no one has done.
2086972248.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mara Sov grit her teeth as she held the H.E.L.M. steady, straining all the while to keep the portal open with her power just long enough for the Guardian, Ikora, and Commander Zavala to slip through. 

Mara shifted her focus to watch the live feed in the viewscreen beside her as the Guardian took their first steps into the Pale Heart. 

And instantly… she remembered what it felt like to be first. 

She remembered unending emptiness, the spark of protons, cold rock against her back, and the sensation of spilling upwards eternally. She remembered glacial till veined with platinum, a forest that spread as mycelium, and alpine saddles cradling crystal clear lakes. She remembered a world so young and old, where all life was equal, meaningless and meaningful. She remembered making that memory, that place, calling it awake from the cauldron of her own imagination and raising it into matter, her lips curled on its name. The Distributary. 

Mara would never see that world again, and yet, on the grainy video stuttering before her, was its doppelganger. It was not home, but it was close. 

The video feed sputtered out. 

A roar of violet streaked past the H.E.L.M., and with a sudden silence, the ship burst from the portal into open space. The portal did not snap shut behind them—the Witness must have let go. 

Mara caught her breath. Her hands shook. There was no sign of Crow in there, or on comms, no sign he was alive other than the tug on her own heart. She glanced back to the Traveler and the Pale Heart within.  

Mara Sov thought once more of home.
2086972248.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

玛拉·索维咬紧牙关，拼尽全力让应急后勤行动中心保持稳定，同时用她的力量保持传送门开启，让守护者、艾可拉、指挥官萨瓦拉有机会顺利通过。 

玛拉把注意力转移到身旁的屏幕上，通过直播画面看到守护者在苍白之心中迈出了第一步。 

忽然…她记起了身为先行者的感受。 

她记起了无尽的空虚，质子的火花，抵着后背的冰冷岩石，永远向上的延伸感。她记起了被铂金缠绕的冰川，像菌丝一样蔓延的森林，还有被高山环抱的清澈湖泊。她记起了一个如此年轻而古老的世界。在那里，所有的生命都平等，没有意义，也充满意义。她记起自己创造那段记忆，那个地方，把它从自己想象的大锅里唤醒，将它升华为物质，嘴角微微翘起说出它的名字：两仪界。 

玛拉再也见不到那个世界了。然而，在她面前不断卡顿的模糊视频中，她看见了那个世界的复制品。那不是家，但已经很接近了。 

视频信号中断了。 

一道紫色的光芒席卷了应急后勤行动中心，飞船里忽然安静下来。他们通过传送门冲进了无垠的太空，身后的传送门并没有关闭——见证者肯定是松手了。 

玛拉喘过气来。她的手在颤抖。里面没有乌鸦的踪迹，也没有来自他的通讯。除了心中的牵挂，没有任何迹象表明他还活着。她回头瞥了一眼旅行者和其中的苍白之心。  

玛拉·索维再次想起了家园。

玛拉再也见不到那个世界了。然而，在她面前不断卡顿的模糊视频中，她看见了那个世界的复制品。那不是家，但已经很接近了。 

视频信号中断了。 

一道紫色的光芒席卷了应急后勤行动中心，飞船里忽然安静下来。他们通过传送门冲进了无垠的太空，身后的传送门并没有关闭——见证者肯定是松手了。 

玛拉喘过气来。她的手在颤抖。里面没有乌鸦的踪迹，也没有来自他的通讯。除了心中的牵挂，没有任何迹象表明他还活着。她回头瞥了一眼旅行者和其中的苍白之心。  

玛拉·索维再次想起了家园。

2676089954.name: First Ascent Helm
2676089954.flavor: Choose what you will become next.
2676089954.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Once, a Ghost was heard to speak thusly. 

This one is Luzaku. Here, this one tells what is known of Sky. 

Sky is the breath taken between actions. It permits speculation. It invites doubt. It slips from sight and grasp, and yet persists. 

This one's Ghost would have us yield to certainty. He wishes us to walk the Bladed Path, to seek Hive-strength in the Witch Queen's abandoned logic, whereby all things prove themselves in slaughter. 

This one turns from simple inevitability. This one makes a choice: this one does not kill and does not die. Yet this one exists. Aiat. What follows? What other choices are to be made? 

This one must know. 

This one hides within a blade-ship of the Witch Queen's great foe. This one's Ghost is angry now, but he remains. In the hollows where a worm once coiled, this one senses our swift motion through the firmament, toward a center. 

This one seeks Sky. In the Sky, there are many paths. 

In the Sky, there is change.
2676089954.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

很久以前，一个机灵说过这些话。 

鄙人是鲁扎库，在此讲述鄙人对苍穹的了解。 

苍穹是行动之间的喘息。它允许猜测。它引人怀疑。它难以追踪和把握，却始终留存。 

鄙人的机灵希望我们屈服于确定性。他希望我们走上刀锋之道，寻求邪魔族的力量，遵从巫妖女王遭抛弃的逻辑，即万物需在屠杀中证明自身。 

鄙人放弃了简单的必然性。鄙人做出了选择：鄙人不杀，也不死亡。然而，鄙人仍然存在。阿特。接下来呢？还要做出什么选择？ 

鄙人必须知晓。 

鄙人躲在巫妖女王宿敌的刀锋飞船里。鄙人的机灵很生气，但他没有离去。在蠕虫曾经盘踞的深渊里，鄙人感知到我们正迅速穿过苍穹，前往中心。 

鄙人探寻苍穹。苍穹内有许多道路。 

苍穹内有变化。

3490372701.name: First Ascent Greaves
3490372701.flavor: To enter the body of a deity would be to unquestionably defile it.
3490372701.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mithrax stood at the bow of the H.E.L.M., watching as Zavala's ship vanished from view into the portal. That awful gateway pulsed and wavered, and though the H.E.L.M. was pointed straight at it, he was resolved in his decision. 

The notion of venturing inside the Great Machine was innately revolting. It reeked like a taboo as certain as cannibalism, as unthinkable as besmirching a house of worship; to enter the body of a deity would unquestionably be to defile it. He could find a way to support from afar. Surely that was plausible.  

"Father, the Queen is asking for you." 

Eido sidles up next to him, and the two look out over the Great Machine. It takes up the entirety of the window—the center of all Light punctured by the oscillating violet of the portal, and Mithrax realizes how small he feels alongside his daughter. 

"I'm not going down there without you," she says. 

Mithrax holds back his shiver and confesses, "To step inside feels like a transgression." 

"And who made that rule?" she says. Ever acute, ever wise. When Mithrax cannot answer, she continues, "The Traveler is in peril. So long as we can care, we are bound to enter and defend it. I have seen you still have fight in you, Father." 

"Would that not be worse? To wage war at the very center of Light?" 

"Only you can decide that. But I believe the Traveler would want you to enter the portal." 

"Why?" 

His daughter puts a loving hand on his own. "Because it knows you aren't there to hurt it."
3490372701.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

米瑟拉克斯站在应急后勤行动中心的船首，注视着萨瓦拉的飞船从视野中消失，进入传送门。那道可怕的大门在脉动和摇摆，尽管应急后勤行动中心正对着它，但他已经下定了决心。 

进入大机器内部的想法令他反感。像同类相食一般让人厌恶，像糟蹋圣堂一般难以想象；进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。他可以想办法从远处进行支援。他认为那是在理的。  

“父亲，女王在找你。” 

艾多走到他的身边。两人眺望着大机器。它填满了整个窗户——这位光能之神的中心，被传送门的震荡之紫刺穿了，米瑟拉克斯意识到自己和女儿在其身边是多么渺小。 

“没有你，我不会进去，”她说。 

米瑟拉克斯强忍着冷颤承认道，“进去像是一种亵渎。” 

“那种规则是谁定的？”她反问道。一如既往地机敏、睿智。米瑟拉克斯不知如何回答，而她还在继续，“旅行者正处于危险之中。只要我们还关爱它，我们就必须进去保护它。我知道你还有斗志，父亲。” 

“那样不是更糟糕吗？在光能的中心作战？” 

“那取决于你。但我相信旅行者会希望你进入传送门。” 

”为什么？“ 

他的女儿把一只充满爱意的手放在他的手背上。“因为它知道你不是去伤害它的。”

1148938453.name: Reach of the Flain
1148938453.flavor: – Torment rent in twain cascades upon the valleys and subjugates them again –
1148938453.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

Endless Darkness envelops a Tormentor, one of the first strips peeled by the Voice's blade… 

The Tormentor is not alone… 

Light, buried deep within shadow flickers erratically, as if painful convulsions warp its frequency. It is twisted around an ever-shifting many hands and pulled taut to slick their knife with Light like rosin. A heterodox pairing, opening the creation of new forms flayed from old flesh. 

An eternal Voice pierces the Darkness… 

"Take shape, second born of pain. Through the Light, bent in service to the Deep. We twist your form into being. Take shape. Now." 

In the Deep, it peels shrieking Torment into sistered slabs…  

"Pared from the flesh of our mind." 

The Voice speaks a piece of its soul into the bisected flesh. 

"A living mirror on which to carve our will." 

A blade of resonant energy carves slender humanoid husks from the quivering canvas… 

"These figments of agony. They are the lessons we will share with you." 

It separates the thin layers, dividing segments along lines of clustered nerves… 

"In wounded Light your shape is forged." 

The husk is considered, recombined with the trim, and reshaped many times. 

"With tools of subjugation, you shall teach them." 

The Voice recites memories of deep power into their fabric… from Europa it imbues control. From Neomuna, serenity. 

"Until all Light bends toward the finality of our horizon." 

With Its command issued, the Voice fades… 

Subjugated halves of torment are left in the silence of the Deep. Their eyes open to the world, and weep. 

*** 

Selin sits with their other half, surveying the Pale Heart. "Sister, what becomes of us when we succeed?" 

Their other half ponders the question for the first time. After a moment, they answer. "We return." 

"And what becomes of—us?" Selin emphasizes. 

The question frustrates Yemiq. She thrusts her lance into festering brambles. "We… return?" 

Selin rotates a shard of Stasis in its hand, analyzing the split reflections. "Return… to where there is no Yemiq? Only an echo within the Witness." 

This frustrates her more. She pulls the lance free and stands over Selin. "I am Yemiq." 

"Exactly," Selin says, letting the shard fall and dissipate, before standing to meet her other half. "And who were you before?" 

"Not nothing," Yemiq responds. 

"But not Yemiq," Selin says, before pointing to itself, "And not Selin." 

"Better buried than faded from memory." Yemiq turns away. "We return. Together again." 

"Together, within it." Selin probes. "Is that what you want?" 

Yemiq is silent. 

"I know what It wants. I'm asking what you want." Selin sees the final shape just as clearly as the Witness does. It will bring this shape into being. There can be no pursuit in deviation of this purpose, but Selin has considered what follows, what could follow. It takes in the vista of the Pale Heart again, its gaze lingering on a spot marred by Darkness. "What if we could truly be whole—" 

A Voice pierces Selin's mind and cuts the notion from it. "Abandon this meager hope."
1148938453.lore_zh:
这件护甲的材料垫着共振记忆。锻造出的层层防护之中印着恐惧被剥露的起源。 

无尽暗影笼罩着一名折磨者，它是被那声音的利刃率先剥开的存在之一… 

这名折磨者并非孤身一人… 

深藏于阴影深处的光闪烁不定，仿佛痛苦的痉挛扭曲了它的频率。它被无数变幻莫测的手紧紧缠绕，拉得紧绷绷的，润滑着他们的利刃，仿佛在涂抹松香一般。这是一种异端结合，开启了由旧躯壳剥落而出的新形态的创造。 

一个永恒的声音刺破了暗影… 

“成形吧，历经痛楚的新生。穿越光能，屈服于深渊的召唤。我们扭曲你的形态。现在，成形吧。” 

在深渊之中，它将尖叫的折磨层层剥离，化作相连共生的碎片…  

“从我们的心智血肉中剥离而出。” 

那声音将其灵魂的一隅，注入被分开的血肉之中。 

“一面活生生的镜子，供我们镌刻意志。” 

一柄共振能量之刃，于震颤的画布上雕琢出纤细的人形躯壳… 

“这些痛苦的幻象，正是我们将与你共鉴的教训。” 

它轻轻剥离那层叠的薄膜，循着密集神经的轨迹，将各部分细细分割… 

“于受伤的光能中，你的形态被铸就。” 

那躯壳经过考量，与边角料重新融合，重塑了多次。 

“你将以镇压之器，引领他们领悟。” 

那声音吟诵着深邃力量的记忆，将其注入它们的纹理之中…源自木卫二的记忆，赋予掌控之力；源自内欧姆那的记忆，带来宁静祥和。 

“直至所有光能都屈从于我们地平线的尽头。” 

随着命令的下达，那声音渐渐消散… 

在那深渊的沉寂之中，被镇压的两半折磨仍残存着。它们睁开眼，窥探着世界，泪光闪烁。 

*** 

色琳与她的另一半坐在一起，审视着苍白之心。“姐妹，我们成功后会变成什么样？” 

她的另一半首次思考起这问题。过了一会儿，给出了答复。“我们会回去。” 

“那‘我们'会变成什么样？”色琳着重问道。 

这个问题让耶米克倍感沮丧，她将长矛刺入那丛正在溃烂的荆棘之中。“我们…会回去？” 

色琳轻轻旋转着手中的冰影碎片，凝视着分裂的倒影。“回到…一个没有耶米克的地方？只有见证者里面的回响。” 

这让她更加恼火了。她拔出长矛，站在色琳面前。“我就是耶米克。” 

“没错，”色琳说着，任由那碎片坠落并消散，随后站起身来，迎向她的另一半。“在此之前，你又是谁？” 

“不是虚无，”耶米克回答道。 

“但不是耶米克，”色琳说着，指了指自己，“也不是色琳。” 

“与其从记忆中消褪，不如深埋。”耶米克转过身。“我们回去。再次团聚。” 

“团聚，在它的体内。”色琳试探地问道。“那是你想要的吗？” 

耶米克沉默不语。 

“我知道它想要什么。我问的是你想要什么。”色琳看到的终焉之形，跟见证者所见的一般清晰。它会让这一形态成为现实。任何偏离此使命的追求都不可存在，然而色琳已考量过随之而来的种种可能。色琳再次望向苍白之心，目光停留在被暗影玷污的一处。“如果我们能真正完整——” 

一个声音穿透色琳的心智，斩断了其心中的念想。“舍弃这贫乏的希望。”

283174091.name: Adornment of the Flain
283174091.flavor: – A blade carves in wicked intent, claiming this submission is surgery  –
283174091.lore:
Resonant memory lines the material of this armor. Imprinted within the folds of forged protection lies the flayed origin of the Dread. 

*** 

The Witness traces lines of power across the landscape of the Pale Heart from a monolithic structure that casts long shadows over the shifting terrain. The Light flows within the Heart like veins. If the Traveler would not relinquish control, it would be harvested and exploited to bring the final shape to bear on reality. 

The Witness raises a hand, pulling at the Light flowing beneath, searching for sources to tap. 

Ambient warmth || Life presents choice.  || graces the Witness's face. 

"Distraction? You cannot stop this." The Witness twists a hand, and the soil churns and buckles, bleeding Light in violent spurts across the landscape. "Submit." 

A shockwave of iridescent Light roars across the surface of the Pale Heart, encircling and crashing down towards the Witness. A radial veil of appendages sprouts from the Witness, hands casting cryptic motions in all directions. The Light-wave splits once, then again, breakages multiply exponentially across the tsunami until it shatters. The Witness seizes the broken momentum and redirects the blast into the spot It had felt the Light surge from. There. It would be a fruitful excision. There It would draw out a kindled flame of dark ambition and forge it into service. 

"Do you persist out of hope, or fear?"  The Witness looks to the terraformed impact site of the Traveler's blast. "This continued, meaningless flailing… It is useless, but you must try. All life understands this law: to thrash against extinction. Now, you too feel our burden. We have pursued you to share this gift with you. Are you not tired of this instinctual resistance? Do you not cry out for salvation?" 

"It is here." 

*** 

Scars pock the Pale Heart. The Traveler bleeds, and the carving, the excision of Light to bring the final shape to bear upon reality, is far from realized. 

Deep within one such scar, in a space cut from memory, the Witness looks upon Its old world. A remnant of a remnant, abandoned by the abandoned. A city of crude pyramidion structures shift around It like tectonic plates, groaning in vicious mockery of the wounded Gardener's cries. 

"Enough." The Witness extends myriad arms in front of It and quells the city's motion into silence. It waves the structures away. "This memory drawn from us. You loomed, demanding worship, but offered nothing in return. How is it you still cannot understand?" 

The Witness shapes the edge of their palm, as a blade, and steps forward, raising the edge to nick the flesh of a frail sapling. "You cannot hide this vestige of power." 

"It is a place of pain. An impetus that must be left behind." Drips of silver Light are drawn forth from the pale, dying, tree until a small pool rests in the Witness's palm. It focuses will on the evaporating Light, imbuing its potential with memory and ideology. 

The Witness whispers a dream into reality, the Light surges, and—for a moment they stand among their people, separate, alone, within the possibility of the past before its sullying. Static, droning, contentment. 

The Traveler above—the Light shimmers, quivering || Life is not still. || with thin resilience, then fades. 

The Witness is again in the Pale Heart, the Light gone from Its grasp. Encircled by a flowering nascence, rests the remains of the Witness's first attempt to bend Light and Dark into form. A failure, not dead, but dormant and weak. From this presumed grave, it would watch its lineage forged, its Witness fall, and in time, this being would rise to prove its worth as a Subjugator. But for now, the newborn failure remains on the ground before It. 

"First of the Reshaped, Keit'Ehr, flain from resonance. Prove your existence by escaping this death. Should you rise, and find us again, your strength will be known." 

The Witness feels the Pale Heart shudder and turns its attention to the Traveler. 

"You are weakening." 

It speaks through the Darkness, a Voice ringing in the minds of Its denizen. "Our host remains intransigent. Choke their resolve."
