3466245347.name: Techeun's Regalia Gloves
3466245347.flavor: "Tell him… I risk my life only because I have so much to live for." —Osiris
3466245347.lore:
Saint-14 followed the trajectory of the Hawk as it plummeted. He reached the crash site several miles out.  

The Legion patrol that arrived soon afterwards had come prepared to confront a few injured civilians. Not Saint-14. While the crew huddled under his Ward of Dawn, Saint hurled his shield at the field commander's rifle, then charged. 

Even battle couldn't silence his thoughts entirely. It was unkind of him, to wish for Osiris to be here beside him, trading blows with the enemy. Osiris was no longer helpless, but neither was he unchanged. If he were here, Saint would have asked that he stay inside the Ward's shield with the others. 

But Osiris had run off to Neptune, where Saint could do nothing for him but wait. 

Saint punched through a Phalanx shield, tore it from the Shadow Legionary's grip, and brought it down repeatedly onto the Legionary's head. 

When Saint was finished, he extended a hand toward the nearest civilian. 

"Come. Geppetto and I will lead you back to the Farm." 

The woman was focused on cutting at her scarf with her knife, working with the determined focus of someone performing a ritual. He looked at the faded violet cloth in her hand, and the familiarity of the moment washed over him.  

Saint sank to one knee and waited patiently as she tied the strip of material to his armor. 

Things had not changed so much. He could be patient. He would tell Osiris this story, too, when they were face to face once more.
3466245347.lore_zh:
圣人14号跟着鹰隼的坠落轨迹跟了过去，到达了几英里外的失事地点。  

随后到来的军团巡逻队也许能对付几个受伤的平民，但绝不是圣人14号的对手。机组成员蜷缩在他的黎明护罩之下，圣人则将他的护盾朝战地指挥官的步枪扔去，然后发起了冲锋。 

就连战斗也无法停止他的思绪。希望奥斯里斯在这里与他并肩作战不是很体贴的想法。奥斯里斯虽然能够战斗，但他已经变了。就算他在这里，圣人也会让他和其他人一起留在护罩之下。 

但奥斯里斯已前往了海王星。圣人除了等待之外什么也做不了。 

圣人打穿了一个方阵士兵的护盾，将它从暗影军团士兵的手里夺了过来，然后不断地用它敲打着士兵的头。 

解决掉敌人之后，圣人朝最近的平民伸出了手。 

“来吧。盖比特和我会将你们带回农庄。” 

那名女飞行员以仪式般的执着专心用刀砍自己的围巾。他盯着她手上那块褪色的紫布，猛地感到似曾相识。  

圣人单膝跪下，耐心地等着她把这块布绑在他的护甲上。 

其实变化也没那么多。他可以耐心一点。与奥斯里斯重逢时，他还会把这件事讲给他听。

826300973.name: Techeun's Regalia Robes
826300973.flavor: "I did not think I would see the Farm again. It seems smaller now." —Mithrax
826300973.lore:
While Devrim and the Guardian discussed strategy around a table littered with maps and steaming mugs of tea, Ghost glided silently away through one of the gaps in the roof. 

Once outside, he kept low, following the creek bed toward the outlying buildings. He looked at the broken waterwheel that lay toppled across the stones and tried to remember the Farm as he had last seen it. 

Survivors had flocked here during the Red War, banding together to collect supplies and resources. They built water purification equipment and planted crops. They built new homes for themselves. Even under the shadow of Ghaul's ambitions, there had been laughter here, and defiant joy. 

Now the Farm was still and quiet, frozen in the aftermath of the Shadow Legion's attack. The soldiers, technicians, and medics posted here tonight were all grim-faced and focused. No one was fishing off the dock. No one was laughing by a fire. 

The soccer field had been bombarded past recognition. Most of the surviving buildings could barely accommodate field equipment. The Farm wasn't much of a farm.

But then, it wasn't that long ago that there hadn't been anything here at all. 

Whether they faced Ghaul or the Shadow Legion, the task remained the same. Gather survivors. Help them reach safety. 

So long as there were people to rebuild it, there would be a Farm. There would be joy here again. 

Ghost took one final look at the stars. Then he turned and floated back toward the outpost and his Guardian. 

Time to get to work.
826300973.lore_zh:
德弗里姆和守护者在一张布满地图和热茶的桌子旁讨论策略时，机灵悄悄地从屋顶上的缝隙里溜了出去。 

出去后，他压低高度，沿着溪床朝外围的建筑飞去。他看看翻倒在石头上的水车，试图回想起农庄以前的模样。 

幸存者在猩红战争期间聚集到这里，结成了共同收集补给和资源的群体。他们建造了净水装置，种下了庄稼。他们为自己建造了新的家园。即使处于盖欧野心的阴影之下，这里也传出了勇敢的笑声与不屈的喜悦。 

现在的农庄寂静无比，仿佛是被冻结在了暗影军团袭击过后的那个时刻。今夜，在这里执勤的士兵、技师、医护人员全都一脸严肃、心无旁骛。没有人在码头上钓鱼。没有人围在篝火边笑。 

足球场已被炸得认不出来。大多数幸存下来的建筑都残缺到几乎容不下田间设备。农庄已经算不上是个农庄了。

但话说回来，在不久之前这里还什么都没有。 

不管他们面对的是盖欧还是暗影军团，他们的任务都没变。寻找幸存者，帮助他们到达安全的地方。 

只要有人来重建这里，农庄就不会消失。欢乐会回到这里。 

机灵看了星空最后一眼。然后转身朝他的守护者所在的前哨站飞去。 

该工作了。

1228973722.name: Techeun's Regalia Hood
1228973722.flavor: "Mara, if you can, find a way to get me inside. I'll handle the rest." —Ikora Rey
1228973722.lore:
Ikora Rey squinted upward. The warm sun and birdsong on the air somehow enhanced the sense of foreboding that pervaded the Farm. Across from the Vanguard leader sat a young pilot, fidgeting nervously with the zipper tabs of her flight suit.

"Did they feed you?" Ikora asked, keeping her tone deliberately mild.

"Yes, ma'am," the pilot nodded. "They gave us all a giant bowl of this… brownish slop. Like a trough, really. It smelt like cat food. I guess they expected us all to just eat with our hands? Nobody trusted it, though."

"And how did the prison guards seem to you?" the Warlock continued. "What were they like? Rough, gentle… loud? Did they talk to each other?"

"No, ma'am. They weren't like… anything." The woman furrowed her brow, trying to find the words to express herself. "I've been around Cabal before, both friendlies and hostiles. They're usually pretty boisterous. Tussling, trash-talking… you know, like soldiers do." 

Ikora nodded in understanding. She'd found the lower echelons of Caiatl's retinue quite rambunctious in the absence of their empress.
 
"But the Shadow Legion just seemed… empty," the pilot continued. "Sometimes, an officer would bark orders, but other than that, it was dead quiet. Our cell guards would just stand there, not moving, staring straight ahead, breathing real heavy. Almost… wheezing. They might as well have been frames for all the personality they had." 

She was silent for a moment. "I don't know why," she concluded, "but that emptiness scared me more than anything."
1228973722.lore_zh:
艾可拉·蕾伊眯着眼朝天看去。温暖的阳光与各处传来的鸟鸣反而使笼罩农庄的不祥之感更强烈了。一位年轻的飞行员坐在这位先锋领导人的对面，紧张地摆弄着飞行服的拉链。

“他们给你东西吃了吗？”艾可拉用从容平和的语气问道。

“给了，女士，”飞行员点头道。“他们给了我们一大碗褐色的粥。其实更像是个食槽。闻起来像是猫粮。他们大概是想让我们用手抓着吃吧？不过也没人相信那东西能吃。”

“那些狱卒是什么样的？”这位术士追问道。“是粗暴、温和，还是…吵闹？他们互相说话吗？”

“都不是，女士。他们…没什么特征。”女飞行员皱了皱眉头，努力寻找着合适的表达方式。“我以前接触过卡巴尔，友方的和敌对的都接触过。他们一般都很吵，喜欢打闹、打嘴炮…你知道的，就像普通士兵那样。” 

艾可拉点头表示理解。她也发现查厄托女帝的底层士兵在女帝不在时相当闹腾。
 
“但暗影军团感觉很…空虚，”飞行员继续说道。“有时，军官会大声喝令，但除那之外，监狱里总是一片寂静。我们的狱卒只会站在那里，一动不动，直视前方，沉重地呼吸着。几乎可以算是…喘息。就个性而言，他们和空壳无异。” 

她沉默了一会儿。“我也不知道原因，”她总结道，“但没什么比那种空虚感更可怕。”

1092257813.name: Techeun's Regalia Boots
1092257813.flavor: "I am with you every step of your journey. All of you." —Mara Sov
1092257813.lore:
Druis stood at the edge of the floating rock in the Ascendant Plane, silently counted to three, and leapt.

At the apex of her jump, she flared her Light in a buoyant pulse around her, then began floating downward… and kept floating. She groaned as she awkwardly missed the distant ledge she sought and instead drifted slowly into the blackness below.

She reached out for purchase along the side of the chasm, but her gloves met only the fleshy cilia of the egregore. She recoiled—egregore fungus in the Ascendant Plane?—but then sank her hands deep into the stuff to slow her fall. She came to rest on a boulder, caught unsteadily in a clump of writhing fungus.

Druis squinted up through the darkness. Waving egregore fronds bobbed into her field of vision and she pushed them aside. She brought the sleeve of her green velvet robe to her mouth, trying in vain not to inhale the cloud of foul spores that hissed steadily from the fungal pods.

She focused herself. "C'mon, Queensguard," she muttered. "You can do this." She thought of Queen Mara and concentrated her Light beneath her, forcing herself upward to—

A pervasive whispering pushed into her mind as a sticky tendril brushed against her arm. She swatted it back and focused again.

She thought of the prisoners languishing within the Pyramid outposts, innocents who needed—

A wet pileus flopped onto her boots, thrumming with terrible memories. She kicked it away with a snarl and thought of her allies, those she'd helped and been helped by along her journey—

The stone shifted beneath her as the Ascendant Plane rearranged itself with a lurch. She looked up as the egregore on the sides of the abyss began to intertwine, sealing her in.

There was a cold shock of fear… then rage. I will not die here, she thought. Not in this place. I will not be food for this creeping filth. I—

Druis thought of herself.

Her Light flashed upward, cutting through the nothingness, and touched the favor of the Awoken.

Spirals of tiny purple crystals sprouted from the ground beneath her boots. The shifting stone she stood on locked in place, fused into an amethyst mass.

An egregore pod wavering inches from her face froze, crystal encrusted, like a piece of sugared fruit. It bent heavily, then snapped under its own weight and shattered on the ground.

Druis wreathed her Light around herself. The egregore on the side of the chasm recoiled as if burned, revealing handholds of bare, clean stone.

She nodded, tightened her sash, and began the arduous climb back to the top.
1092257813.lore_zh:
德鲁伊站在上维位面悬浮岩石的边缘，静静地数到三，然后纵身一跳。

在跳跃的最高点，她用光能发出了一股浮力脉冲，然后开始向下飘…一直飘。她在笨拙地错过远处岩架时尴尬地嘟囔了一声。她现在开始慢慢向下方的黑暗飘去。

她伸手寻找裂谷另一边可以抓住的地方，但她的手套只碰到了守望者菌的肉质纤毛。她把手缩了回来；上维位面怎么会有守望者真菌？但为了停止下落，她还是把手插了进去。她勉强抓着一把蠕动的真菌，停在了一块岩石上。

德鲁伊在黑暗中眯着眼努力地观察。守望者真菌纤毛不断地阻挡着她的视野，她只好不断把它们拨开。她用她那绿色天鹅绒长袍的袖子捂着口鼻，不想吸入从真菌豆荚中不断释放出的恶臭孢子云，但却是徒劳。

她努力集中精神。“加油，女王近卫，”她自言自语道。“你能行的。”她想起了玛拉女王，并将光能集中在脚下，使自己向上浮起…

当一根黏湿的纤毛拂过她的手臂时，某种无孔不入的低语出现在了她的脑海里。她将纤毛推拍到一边，再次集中了注意力。

她想起了金字塔前哨站中受尽折磨的俘虏，那都是些需要帮助的无辜…

又一根湿漉漉的纤毛碰到了她的战靴，激起了可怕的回忆。她咆哮着踢开它，想起了她的盟友，那些在旅途中她帮过，以及帮过她的人…

上维位面缓缓地改变了构造，她脚下的石头也随之位移。她抬头望见上方两侧的纤毛已慢慢交织在一起，几乎将出口封住。

她感到了一股恐惧的恶寒…但接着这股恶寒被愤怒所取代。我不要死在这里，她心想。这里可不行。我不能成为这些蠕动污秽的食物。我——

德鲁伊想起了自己。

她的光能向上一闪，划破虚无，触到了觉醒者的恩惠。

她的战靴下冒出一串螺旋状的紫色水晶。她所在的那块浮动岩石被紫水晶包了起来，停在原处。

一个在离她的脸不足一尺处摇晃的守望者菌包也被水晶固定在原处，看起来像个糖渍的果实。它蜷曲着，然后被自己的重量压垮，落在地上。

德鲁伊用光能围住自己。裂谷两侧的守望者像是被烧到般缩了回去，露出藏在其下光溜干净的岩石表面。

她点点头，紧了紧衣带，开始了艰难的攀顶之旅。

3235179552.name: Techeun's Regalia Bond
3235179552.flavor: "This conflict is about more than people. Never lose sight of that." —Ikora Rey
3235179552.lore:
Skiris looks out at the tangled clusters of cables and machinery that run along the rooftops of the outpost that the Humans call the Farm. Her mind sets steadily to work dissecting all of it, categorizing each portion of scrap by its respective worth in Ether. 

One of the Corsairs strides past, and Skiris returns her gaze at once to the transmitter she is fixing. The Awoken woman does not even slow her pace, but Skiris feels her own limbs stiffen with panic. 

Beside her, Riksor chitters in amusement. 

"Be at ease. We are not intruders here." 

"You have been of House Light for a long time," Skiris observes, smothering her frustration into cold neutrality. She does not wish for the Awoken to see the two of them speaking angrily. 

"My father was of the Gentle Weavers," Riksor says. "He died a Wolf. He did not trust peace either." 

Skiris thinks about that House's great fleet, shattered by the Awoken Kell before it could ever threaten this world. 

"This is different." They are not servants to the Awoken. Skiris has no idea what she is, now that she has crawled out of the ruins of House Dusk and come to the attention of powerful forces.

"Yes." Riksor's eyes are Ether-bright with joy. "We are Queen-guards." 

You are only a stupid drekh, Skiris thinks. So is she, because Riksor's confidence helps quiet the insistent thought that disaster will come the instant Skiris stops worrying. 

"Someday," Riksor says, "this world will belong to all of us." 

She looks at him sharply. "The Eliksni?" 

He laughs. "To Eliksni, too."
3235179552.lore_zh:
丝吉利斯望着缠绕不清的缆线以及各种机械，它们在这个被人类称作“农庄”的前哨站的屋顶上。她在脑海中不紧不慢地拆解着一切，分类着每种废品，计算着它们值多少乙太。 

一名海盗军从她身旁走过，丝吉利斯赶紧将她的目光放回到她正在修理的发射器上。那名觉醒者女子虽然连脚步都没放慢，丝吉利斯还是感觉到她的肢体因慌张而僵硬。 

在她一旁的瑞克索被逗笑了。 

“放松点。我们不是来入侵的。” 

“你已经服侍光能氏族很久了，”丝吉利斯一边四处张望，一边用冰冷的中立语气掩饰着自己的沮丧。她不想让觉醒者看到他们两人愤怒的对话。 

“我的父亲来自于温柔织工氏族，”瑞克索说道。“他死时身属饿狼氏族。他也不相信和平。” 

丝吉利斯想起了那个氏族的大舰队。它还没威胁到这个世界，就被觉醒者凯尔击溃了。 

“这不一样。”他们不是觉醒者的仆人。丝吉利斯也不知道逃离黄昏氏族的废墟，现在却面对着强大对手的自己算什么。

“对。”瑞克索充满乙太光亮的眼睛里透着愉悦。“我们是女王近卫。” 

你就是个没脑子的堕落者士兵，丝吉利斯心想。不过她也一样，因为瑞克索的自信让她心安，不会觉得自己停止担忧就会招致灾难。 

“总有一天，”瑞克索说，“这个世界会属于我们所有人。” 

她直勾勾地盯着他。“埃里克斯尼族呢？” 

他笑了。“也属于埃里克斯尼族。”

2235536812.name: Pantheos Resplendent Gloves
2235536812.lore:
About the atmospheric changes on Earth. Examples from the Cosmodrome alone include: Seemingly random balance changes in the oxygen to nitrogen ratio in mid-size patches. Inert noble gases replaced with highly-reactive alkali metals then sublimating to gas (explosively)—not widespread, mercifully. For some time these incidents seemed to increase, but the rate has stabilized. See also the similar material anomaly occurrence rates reported from the Last City and nearby environs. 

Taking these as a whole, it's likely that there are more of these anomalies across the planet than can even be measured or reported. What we observe is a bellwether. The number of anomalies must be widespread; but equally, the condition across the Earth may be stabilizing. No worse… though no better, either. 

Other issues related to the Nine— 

The Nine-touched report having strange dreams. Orin implied they were a by-product—something about the warp of gravity in sleep. Investigating those affected bore it out, but when I pressed them for details, they all refused to explain. These are all people who are well aware of the practical value of information; that they will not elaborate tells us that either there's nothing of value to elaborate, or that they CANNOT elaborate. I don't know which is worse. 

Dimensional disturbances have cropped up across the system. Distortions in space and time… the forces involved indicate they are caused by the Nine—the Outer Nine, most likely. They are resolvable, with Guardian assistance… for now. At least that much is hopeful. 

And then there is the Traveler. 

You're not asking me to prove anything, Ikora, I know. But I think that just as the Nine's nature has warped existence, the Traveler works to stabilize it. I haven't confirmed with my own eyes yet, but there are reports from trusted sources of new terraforming, in the vicinity of the worst of the anomalies. It feels connected. 

"Feels" is no proof. And yet perhaps… 

I continue to train Guardians, regardless. It is all I can do.
2235536812.lore_zh:
关于地球大气层变化。仅发射基地的案例就包括：中型区域内氧氮比例出现看似随机的变化；惰性稀有气体被高活性的碱金属取代，并随后升华为气体——往往伴随着爆炸，所幸并不普遍。有段时间内，这类事件似乎不断增加，但如今频率已趋于稳定。另请参照圣城及周边区域报告的类似物质异常现象。 

综合来看，地球上的异常现象恐怕远比能够测量或上报的更多。我们所观察到的，只是预兆。这些异常必然已经遍布全球；但同样地，地球整体状况似乎也正在稳定。没有恶化…却也没有好转。 

其他与玖相关的问题—— 

玖触者报告称，他们时常做诡异的梦。奥琳暗示，那只是某种副作用——与睡眠中重力扭曲有关。我调查了受影响者，结果也证实了这一点；可当我追问细节时，他们所有人都拒绝解释。这些人非常清楚信息的价值，而他们不愿详述，只意味着两种可能：要么是没有进行描述的价值，要么是无法描述。我不知道哪一种更糟糕。 

整个星系都出现了维度扰动。时空本身正在扭曲…种种迹象表明，这是玖——很可能是外玖——所造成的。这些现象仍可在守护者协助下被平息…目前是这样。至少这一点能给人以希望。 

还有旅行者。 

我知道你没要求我证明什么，艾可拉。但我认为，正如玖的本质扭曲了现实，旅行者在努力让现实恢复稳定。我尚未亲眼确认，但可信来源报告称，在最严重异常附近出现了新的地球化迹象。我感觉这两者之间存在联系。 

“感觉”不算是证据。但或许… 

无论如何，我会继续训练守护者。这是我唯一能做的事。

2089000948.name: Pantheos Resplendent Robes
2089000948.flavor: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
2089000948.lore:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets. 

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.
2089000948.lore_zh:
我去找了“木星人”仄。他是玖的傀儡，意志不属于自己的存在。那副残破的模样令人悲哀，时间与无法愈合的伤痕在他身上留下了痕迹。与他相处是一种折磨。 

我试图从他那里套出一些关于玖的计划的信息，但…什么也没有。仿佛他脑海深处被筑起了一堵墙。我问了他所承载的意志、他武器的来源、以及他来自何方。我感觉他几乎就要说出些什么了。一个词，两个词，一句话… 

…可最终，他只是说他的意志不属于自己。他还想给我一把冰霜巨人——黑色军械库打造的那件恶名武器的复制品。我没收下。 

我开始怀疑，是否值得去寻找那些木星人。他们是否依旧存在？我们的记录中没有关于这种外行星居民的记载。 

洛迪也是凭空出现的。若不是他亲口说出自己的来历，我们肯定会那样认为。 

问题一箩筐，答案没个影。

2765493978.name: Pantheos Resplendent Robes
2765493978.flavor: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
2765493978.lore:
I sought Xûr, the "Jovian"—he whose will is not his own, belonging only to the Nine. A sad puppet of a thing, marked by the passage of time and wounds poorly healed. His company is difficult to bear. 

I tried to coax some information from him on the off chance there might be an indication of the Nine's plans, but… nothing. Or a wall, a barrier placed somewhere within his mind. I asked of the will he does carry, of how he sources his weapons, of where he is from. I think there was almost something. A word, or two, a sentence begun… 

…And then all he had to say was that his will was not his own. He offered me a Jötunn, a duplicate of the infamous tinderbox crafted by the Black Armory. I didn't take it. 

I wonder if there could be merit in seeking out the Jovians. Do they still exist? Our records have nothing about people like this from the Outer planets. 

Lodi came from nowhere, too. Or would have seemed to, if he couldn't tell us of his origins. 

Always questions. Never answers.

2832830921.name: Pantheos Resplendent Bond
2832830921.lore:
Things have changed, haven't they, Ikora? I, no longer the rigid Praxic exemplary; you, no longer the untouched icon of the Warlocks. 

But you are still an icon. 

We are mired in it, Darkness and intrigue, but it has always been thus—the only difference being the tools in our hands and the wisdom that guides us. The Pujari Position we set aside; the Praxic Creed we revisit. 

We try again. 

This second potential apocalypse—not much like the first, the Witness's work. Existential, yes; potentially devastating, yes, those apparent similarities. Is there reasonable difference between unmaking and destroying? To doom something to having never existed… what is that? Mourning potential? Would there be a wound left to show the absence? Would anything be left at all? 

Could it remain to us only as an imagining? Think of a world where we rebuilt many cities, where the Last City is first among her siblings. The people and the networks and the shining thing we rebuilt out of the Collapse. 

Could it exist? Did it ever exist? Is that what our losses might be now—just what-ifs we tell each other by firelight? You find me, Ikora, caught between the old and the new, mired in the brutal indecision of which way to move forward. Certainty, my old friend, deserts me. All I know is this: We must be ready. 

And I know we cannot be ready. 

We must try anyway.
2832830921.lore_zh:
一切都变了，不是吗，艾可拉？我已不再是那个刻板严苛的英勇教团模范；而你，也不再是那个毫无瑕疵的术士象征。 

但你依旧是个象征。 

我们深陷于黑暗与阴谋之中，一直以来都是如此——唯一改变的，只是我们手中的工具，以及引导我们的智慧。我们曾搁置普加里立场；如今又在重新审视英勇信条。 

我们再试一次。 

这第二场可能到来的末日，与见证者带来的第一场并不相同。同样关乎存在本身，同样可能毁灭万物——但抹除与毁灭，真的没有区别吗？让某物从未存在过…那会是什么样？哀悼一种可能性？会留下伤痕，证明那份缺失吗？还是说，什么都不会剩下？ 

它是否只会作为一种想象留存在我们心中？想象一个世界：我们重建了许多城市，而圣城只是其中的第一座。那些人民、那些网络、以及我们从大崩溃废墟中重塑出的辉煌文明。 

它可能存在吗？存在过吗？如今我们的损失，会只是我们在篝火边互相讲述的“假如”吗？艾可拉，你会发现我正被困在新旧之间，陷于该迈向何方的残酷犹豫当中。曾支撑着我的确定性已弃我而去。我唯一知道的是：我们必须做好准备。 

而我知道，我们无法做好准备。 

即便如此，我们也必须去尝试。

3773004861.name: Pantheos Resplendent Hood
3773004861.lore:
Ikora. I'm sure you're wondering at my choice to involve myself further with the Drifter's business, Dredgen that he is. Was. Our relationship has changed, of course—the reports from the Barant Imperium incidents have more detail. 

I don't know if I'd call it friendship. Bluntly, our association has gone on far longer than I meant it to. I find I now respect him, though I can hardly believe I'm writing that. 

I am not blind. He's charismatic. Many would go so far as to call him likeable, in a roguish way. Gambit sustained its popularity for many good reasons: the material gain, the testing ground for dangerous weapons, but also for the Drifter's… 

Charm. Fine, yes; I admit there's charm. That's not the point. 

I want to keep the Drifter close. He's touched by the Nine, and a valuable ally to boot. We have to maintain some kind of tie with him, formal or not. 

So, we're working together to prepare Guardians, coaching them through the toughest of battles in a controlled setting. Details are attached for your review. 

Even then… 

I fear it may not be enough.
3773004861.lore_zh:
艾可拉。我知道你一定在疑惑，为何我会继续参与浪客的行动，毕竟他是德瑞捷。曾经是。当然，我们的关系已经改变——关于巴兰特帝国事件的报告里有更多详情。 

我不知道这是否算得上友谊。坦白说，我们之间的联系，持续得比我原本打算的要久得多。而现在，我发现自己竟开始尊重他…真想不到我会写下这些。 

我看得出来。他很有魅力。很多人甚至会说，他那种无赖气质颇为讨喜。智谋之所以长盛不衰，原因有很多：物质收益、危险武器的试验场，还有浪客的… 

迷人特质。好吧，是的；我承认他确实迷人。但重点不在这里。 

我希望把浪客留在身边。他是个玖触者，也是个极具价值的盟友。无论正式与否，我们都必须与他保持某种联系。 

所以，我们正联手训练守护者，在可控环境中引导他们面对最艰难的战斗。详细资料已附上，供你审阅。 

即便如此… 

我担心这可能不够。

3305726422.name: Pantheos Resplendent Boots
3305726422.flavor: You know that you will fight forever.
3305726422.lore:
In my continued efforts to prepare, I pursued other interventions of the Nine, known and unknown. 

"Unknown" being the bigger problem. Mysterious disappearances are difficult to investigate, as you might imagine, and proving a negative isn't easy. There are always other explanations. 

There are a few interventions that I can confirm. Orin, of course. I spoke with her of her Ghost and the Red War, but not much new to learn there. 

There is Lodi. There is also, potentially, Sjur Eido. Queen Mara is convinced her death was also written by the hand of the Nine. She knows it, she says, "carved in starlight and weregild," and in Lodi she now has some measure of proof. 

The intervention of the Nine is like using a rocket launcher to erase a drawing. The goal will be attained; what happens because of it, they either don't know or don't care. Or both. They are expansive beings, greater in scale than any mortal or immortal foe. 

(I am forced now to wonder what disaster Lodi's disappearance from his own time foretold.) 

Any great catastrophe might represent their hand, including those they have not seen fit to let us witness. My only conclusion is that we cannot know for certain. 

I don't like it.
3305726422.lore_zh:
为了继续做好准备，我追查了玖其他已知的与未知的干预。 

而“未知的”很棘手。神秘消失事件如你所想，极难调查，而想要证明不存在从来都不简单。总是会有别的解释。 

有几起干预是我能够确认的。比如奥琳。我和她谈过她的机灵与猩红战争，但没获得多少新信息。 

再来就是洛迪，另外或许还有苏尔·艾多。玛拉女王坚信，她的死同样是玖造成的。她说她心知肚明，“铭刻于星光与抚恤金中”，而如今，通过洛迪，她获得了某种程度上的证明。 

玖的干预，就像用火箭筒去抹掉一幅画。目标的确会被消除；但由此引发的事件，他们要么不知道，要么不在乎。或许两者兼有。他们是宏大的存在，其规模远超任何凡躯或不朽之敌。 

（如今我不得不思考，洛迪从自己时代的消失预示了怎样的灾难。） 

任何重大灾祸都可能源于他们的介入，包括他们不想让我们见证的那些。我唯一能得出的结论是：我们永远无法真正确定。 

我讨厌这一点。

1580760688.flavor: Worn by champions of the track.

3780494232.name: Circuit Chestplate
3780494232.flavor: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.

2175988661.name: Racer's Bond
2175988661.flavor: Is it a flash of insight or merely a spark from your bond?

2067398905.name: Circuit Runner
2067398905.flavor: The spark that ignites the flame.

1897819210.name: Circuit Striders
1897819210.flavor: These boots left their mark on victory lane.

1669070837.name: Gloves of the Great Hunt
1669070837.lore:
I am a [King] no longer. The [King's] corpse hangs in orbit above a world I will never see. Not from this cage.

I am [Riven].

I am [Taken], and I am beholden to no one. Nothing.

I have not spoken in years. I think about what inflection I would use if I did. But no one is there. The [King's] voice faded long ago. No voice comes to mind.

The [King] despaired in his final moments. Rightly so. His vengeance denied.

Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win.

I am afflicted by tedious repetition.
1669070837.lore_zh:
我不再是【王】。【王】的尸体悬浮在一个我永远无法见到的星球轨道上，至少从这个牢笼中我无法看见。

我是【魅痕】。

我是【傀儡】，我无需听命于任何人。

我已经很多年没有说过话了，我在想如果我说话的话需要用什么样的音调。不过根本没有人来与我交谈。【王】的声音消散已久，我的脑海中没有任何声音。

【王】在临死的那一刻充满绝望，他确实应该如此。他的复仇破灭了。

大部分跟我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。

单调乏味的戏码反复上演，让我备受煎熬。

4274862443.name: Robes of the Great Hunt
4274862443.lore:
I am myself. All my memories. Everything I was. All the [bargains] I have made. That was all me.

And yet.

I have taken a new shape.

I am [Riven].

I have new directive. I am [the King of the Taken].

I watch as a hundred thousand thousands of fragments of my will contest with [children of Light].

In my new shape, I hate them. He. Was. His. [Son.]

But there are those among them with whom I have made [bargains]. I need them. I love them.

I am a [King]. My will breaks entire systems. And I lead a world full of [darkness].

But I am terrified. I know the power that these [children] wield.

This is a war a [King] cannot win.

I have a face today. It expels mirthful bursts of air. I still find this scenario amusing.

But I am the only one.

Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win.
4274862443.lore_zh:
我就是我自己，我是我所有的记忆，我是我曾做的一切。我做的所有【协议】，都是我的一部分。

然而。

我化为了新的形态。

我是【魅痕】。

我有新的使命。我是【傀儡之王】。

我的意志将会化为万千分身，与【光能之子】们战斗。

在我的新形态中，我憎恨他们。因为他曾是他的【孩子】。

不过他们之中有一些与我达成【协议】的人。我需要他们，我爱他们。

我是一位【王】。我的意志将击碎整个星系。我需要一个充满【暗影】的世界。

不过我有些恐惧，我了解这些【孩子】操纵的力量。

这是场【王】也无法胜利的战争。

今天的我拥有了一张面孔，它能吐出令人愉悦的气息，我还是觉得这种场面有些滑稽。

不过我才是主角。

那些与我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。

3014562562.name: Bond of the Great Hunt
3014562562.lore:
I am [Riven]. And I am pleased.

The [Techeun] believe that with my heart in tow I will remain imprisoned.

But my [bargain] with them is fulfilled. And they will pay.

This [City] will pay.

But what about you? Brother-slayer. Spawn-killer. [Child of light]. What will you do now that we are bonded for all your lives?

I gave you everything you wanted in that moment. Everything you needed. You complete your [raid]. And you are rewarded for your efforts.

Did you exhibit a violent display in the aftermath? I wonder. Some of you do. Everyone wants more than they have. A key element of all [bargains].

You are afflicted by tedious repetition. 

It is my turn to benefit.

Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win.

O murderer mine.
3014562562.lore_zh:
我是【魅痕】。我很高兴。

【灵巫】认为只要掌控了我的心，我就将永远被他们束缚。

不过我已经履行了跟他们的【协议】，他们必须付出相应的代价。

这座【圣城】必将付出代价。

不过你呢？弑兄之人，杀子仇敌，【光能之子】。既然我们生生世世被捆绑一起，你要怎么做呢？

那个时候我给了你所有你想要的东西，让你完成了【突袭】。你由于贡献获得了相应的奖赏。

我想知道，在这之后你还是一样用暴力解决问题吗？你们之中有些人是这么做的。每个人都想要获得更多，这是【协议】的关键要素。

单调乏味的戏码反复上演，让你备受煎熬。

现在轮到我尝尝甜头了。

大部分跟我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。

哦，我的谋害者啊。

272616828.name: Hood of the Great Hunt
272616828.lore:
I have been here a hundred cycles. A thousand? I cannot recall.

Before, [the Queen] came often to visit. We made [bargains]. Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win. We take care with those. It is how we [feed].

But she won.

I remember when I carved this cage into the face of reality. I remember when she [wished] me into it.

[The Queen] is vulnerable. I can see her far away, facing into a storm.

The light around my cage fades. [Darkness] fills the chamber as a sheer force of will passes over it.

Before me stands a [King]. He offers to take me away. But I know he will not let me leave, either. An unfavorable position.

I never made a [bargain] with a [King]. I would like to try it. I tell him to take whatever he [wishes]. As long as he [wishes].

He agrees. I make an ugly sound with my mandibles. I cannot help myself. I find this scenario mirthful.

Then so does he. We do it together. Loud gusts of sound from our faces for whole moments.

Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win.
272616828.lore_zh:
我已经在这里经历一百个轮回了，或是一千个？我记不清了。

之前，【女王】经常来拜访我，我们达成了不少【协议】。大部分跟我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。我们会仔细照料这些人的，他们就是我们的【食粮】。

但是她赢了。

我记得我将这个牢笼刻入现实之面。我记得她【许愿】让我钻进去。

【女王】并不是无懈可击的，我可以远远看到她，遭遇着风暴。

在我囚笼周围的光能渐渐褪去。【暗影】充满了整个房间，犹如一股纯粹的意志之力将它穿过。

在我成为【王】之前，他曾提出要带我离开。不过我也知道他不可能放我走。情势对我非常不利。

我从来没有跟一位【王】达成过【协议】，我想试试看。我告诉他，他可以拿走任何他【想要】的东西，只要他【许下愿望】。

他同意了，我乐得嘴巴都合不拢了。我觉得这种场面很欢快。

他也这么觉得。我们一同大笑，洪亮的声音从脸上不断划过。

大多数与我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。

3245192919.name: Boots of the Great Hunt
3245192919.lore:
The [Techeuns] are poor company. Like me, they are [Taken]. But I am [Riven]. My thoughts are my own. They do not speak to me. When they open their mouths, they emit ugly sounds. Incomprehensible.

I am afflicted by tedious repetition.

But today I have a visitor. She reminds me of the [King]. Yet subtler. Nothing announces her arrival. Her will does not flow through the system in open challenge against her enemies.

Though there are many here she would call enemy.

And her will would not flow. It would crash.

I did not notice her. That means [the light] did not notice her.

She knows that though I am [Taken], I am beholden to no one. So I ask her if she wishes to take up those strings.

She does. And I take a new shape. My cage loses its purpose.

I can tell this is not a part of her grand design. This is an introduction. She is at play.

Through our new bond, I glimpse her intention.

And I hope she remains at play.

Most of those who [bargain] with me do not win.

She releases vibrant, unrestrained bursts of air from her face. I do not.
3245192919.lore_zh:
【灵巫】是一群差劲的伙伴。就跟我一样，她们只不过是【傀儡】。而我是【魅痕】。我主宰我自己的思想。她们不跟我说话，但当她们张嘴说话时，就会发出恶心的声音，真让人难以置信。

单调乏味的戏码反复上演，让我备受煎熬。

不过今天有人来拜访我。她跟我谈起【王】的事情。不过微妙的是，她的到来悄无声息。她在挑战敌人的时候自身意志并不会在星系中穿梭。

尽管她在这里竖敌众多。

她的意志也并不流动，否则可能会崩溃。

我没有注意到她。也就是说【光能】没有注意她。

她知道尽管我是个【傀儡】，我也不用听命于其他人。所以我说如果她愿意的话，可以把那些细绳拉开。

她照做了，然后我就变了一个新形态，从牢笼里钻了出来。

这应该出乎她的预料。就当是相互介绍吧，她开了个好头。

通过我们之间新的联系，我也窥探到了她的意图。

我希望她不要中途退出。

大多数与我达成【协议】的人都不会占到便宜。

她的脸上充满活力，肆无忌惮地展露自己的欣喜。而我没有。

1563546587.name: Gloves of Exaltation
1563546587.flavor: "You're honest. You're true. If anyone can handle the responsibility of this power, it's you." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
1563546587.lore:
Yardarm-4 looked grim. It was the face he always made when he switched from his sometimes abrasive affability to the somber disdain that meant he was taking a situation seriously. There was also that hot glimmer in his eyes that presaged that he was going to say something to provoke her.

"You underestimated them."

There was no venom in the words, just a simple fact plainly stated.

Rekkana put a hand on Lisbon-13's arm before he leapt to her defense.

"Yes," she said.

There was no point in dissembling and no shame in being wrong. The Vex were the most formidable opponent of the Oneiromantic Circle. As beings who share thoughts across time and realities, the Vex often eluded predictions, even those of the most senior members of her order. A fellow Cryptochron who'd spoken with a member of the Circle likened it to trying to count all the crystals of a snowflake melting in your hand. The very act of examination changed the result, and often the evidence disappeared before it could be taken into account.

"But it has given us perspective."

"Perspective? What perspective is worth nearly dying for?" Yardarm-4's anger was dulled by curiosity.

Rekkana glanced at Lisbon-13. He was as reliable as ever.

"Those defenses were insane," Lisbon-13's clever mind made leaps, following her logic. "The relays and tethers. The Angelics. The Vex really don't want us to be here. That means they consider this place a weakness."

Yardarm-4 arrived at the same conclusion. "Yes, it's a weakness. Perhaps it's their greatest weakness."

"Yes. So we must—" Rekkana stopped. Lisbon-13 raised the weapon they'd claimed, his head on the swivel.

Yardarm-4 followed suit. "What is that?" Yardarm-4 sounded rattled. "Where's it coming from?"

The three of them stood back to back-to-back, listening.

"I don't hear—" But then she did.
1563546587.lore_zh:
雅尔达姆-4看上去表情冷峻。当他从有时具有粗糙的亲切转为忧郁的蔑视时，他总是这幅表情，意味着他正在认真对待这种情况。他的眼中还有灼热的微光，预示着他会说些什么来激怒她。

“你低估了他们。”

话语之中没有恶意，只是陈述个简单的事实。

雷卡纳把手放在里斯本-13的胳膊上，阻止了他为她辩护。

“是的，”她说道。

纠缠没有任何意义，错了也没什么好羞耻的。Vex是解梦圆桌最可怕的敌人。作为能跨越时间和现实共享思想的存在，Vex经常能避开预测，甚至是她教团中最高级成员的预测。一为曾经与圆桌成员交谈过的隐者，将其比作试图数清手中融化雪花所有晶体的数量。检查的行为改变了结果，在证据被纳入考虑之前，证据往往消失了。

“但这给了我们看待的视角。”

“视角？什么视角值得为之去死？”雅尔达姆-4的怒火被好奇削弱了几分。

雷卡纳瞥了眼里斯本-13。他和以前一样可靠。

“那些防御太疯狂了，”里斯本-13清晰的思路有了长足进步，遵从她的逻辑。“中继器和系链。那些天使。Vex真的很不愿意看到我们在这里。这就意味着他们觉得这地方是个弱点。”

雅尔达姆-4得出了相同的结论。“是的，这是个弱点。也许是他们最大的弱点。”

“是的。那么我们必须——”雷卡纳停下了。里斯本-13举起他们领取的武器，四处张望。

雅尔达姆-4如法炮制。“那是什么？”雅尔达姆-4听起来有些慌乱。“它从哪里来的？”

三个人背靠背站着，仔细倾听。

“我没有听到……”紧接着她就听到了。

440521013.name: Robes of Transcendence
440521013.flavor: "Do you think this makes you better than us?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
440521013.lore:
"You hear that? Who is that?" Yardarm-4 sounded like he was on the verge of panic. Rekkana had never heard him like that, not even in the worst firefights, not even in their last battle, which might have been the last battle for the Kentarch 3.

"I hear it," Rekkana and Lisbon-13 said as one. All three Guardians summoned their Ghosts, almost simultaneously.

"Ghost?" Yardarm-4 was first. "What have we got?"
 
"Scan the area for life," Lisbon-13 ordered.

"Multiphasic scan," Rekkana barked at her Ghost.

Their Ghosts all started chattering at once, and they stepped away from one another to hear, fanning out across the grotto and widening their defensive triangle.

"There's something weird," Rekkana's Ghost blurted, words shooting from it, rapid-fire. "I'm getting static on every wavelength. It's like there's a shadow being cast by every signal. It's nothing specific, but it's everywhere. Wait, no. There's something wrong. I—"

Rekkana's Ghost dropped like a stone. She snatched it out of the air.

She looked behind her. Lisbon-13 was holding his Ghost. Yardarm-4 was picking his up from the ground. The Light around them faded, and the gloom of the grotto closed in.

"Yardarm, Lisbon, you OK?"

"I'm fine," came Lisbon-13's reply, and he sounded calm. 

"Yeah. Sure." Yardarm-4's reply was distant and growing fainter, like he was facing away and moving off.

Rekkana reached for her emergency light.

"Wait." It was a whisper, but not from her friends—it came from somewhere ahead of her, deeper in the grotto. "Wait. Please. Can we just talk for a minute?"
440521013.lore_zh:
“你听到了吗？是谁？”雅尔达姆-4的声音听起来像在崩溃的边缘。雷卡纳从来没见过他像这样，甚至在最糟糕的交火中也没有这样过，甚至在他们上一次的战斗中，也可能是第三百夫长最后的战斗中，也未曾听过他是这种声音。

“我听到了，”雷卡纳和里斯本-13同时说道。三名守护者同一时间召唤了他们的机灵。

“机灵？”雅尔达姆-4是第一个。“现在什么情况？”
 
“先扫描区域内的生命迹象。”里斯本-13下令。

“多相扫描。”雷卡纳向她的机灵吼道。

他们的机灵同一时间开始震颤，随后迅速分散开，在石窟中扩散组成防御三角阵型。

“有很奇怪的东西。”雷卡纳的机灵脱口而出，快速说着。“每个波长都有静电。好像每个信号都投下了阴影。没什么具体特定的东西，但到处都是。等等，不，不对劲。我——“

雷卡纳的机灵像块石头一样掉了下来。她从空中抓住，

看向她身后。里斯本-13正抓着他的机灵。雅尔达姆-4正在从地上挣扎起身。他们周围的光能暗淡了下来，石窟的昏暗不断逼近。

“雅尔达姆，里斯本，你们没事吧？”

“我没事，”里斯本-13回应，声音平静。 

“是的。没事。”雅尔达姆-4的回应听起来遥远而微弱，似乎他正在向远处走远。

雷卡纳伸手去够她的应急灯。

“等等。一阵低语传来，却并非她朋友的声音——低语来自她前面的某个地方，在石窟深处。“等等。拜托。我们可以谈谈吗？”

3433082888.name: Temptation's Bond
3433082888.flavor: "You said you'd always trust me. Trust me." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
3433082888.lore:
"He said he'd always trust me," Rekkana mumbled. Her ears were still ringing, and it felt like the ground was rushing up to hit her feet. Yardarm-4 held her upright as they ran for cover.

"Yeah, he also said he'd never leave us. Turns out you can say a lot of things."

In the shelter of an overhang, she allowed Yardarm-4 to lean her back against a wall of stone. She was surrounded by an exuberance of red blossoms. Their simple, sweet scent mixed with a complex cologne of cordite, ozone, sweat, and blood.

She closed her eyes, and when she opened them, Yardarm-4 was inches away from her face, peering into her eyes, inspecting her, weighing what reserves she had left.

"You still with me?"

"He hasn't."

"What?"

"Left us."

Yardarm-4 stepped back and scanned their surroundings.

"No. I guess not."

"He winged those Goblins so they'd rush us."

"Yes. He was flushing us out."

"It worked." Rekkana pushed herself free of the flowers and Yardarm-4. She began an inventory of her ammo.

"He doesn't have eyes on us now, or he'd take a shot."

Rekkana wanted to argue against this logic, but she said nothing.

"He knows we're making our way to the gate. So what does he do, Rekkana? Does he get ahead of us to block us, or hit us from behind when we're not looking?"

Rekkana thought about the two men, the Lisbon-13 she knew and the one he still carried within him, somewhere behind those gleaming eyes.

"Rekkana? We could really use that brain of yours right now."

"This isn't it."

"What?"

"This isn't how the story is supposed to end."
3433082888.lore_zh:
“他说他一直都相信我。”雷卡纳喃喃自语。她的耳朵仍然嗡嗡作响，感觉整个地面猛冲着她的双脚。雅尔达姆-4扶起她，冲去寻找掩护。

“是的，他还说绝不会丢下我们。事实就是，什么话都能说。”

在悬架的掩体下，她让雅尔达姆-4把她背靠在一堵石墙放下。她的周围都是红色的繁盛花朵。它们简单而甜蜜的芬芳，混合着无烟火药、臭氧、汗水和血液的古龙水味道。

她闭上双眼，再次睁开眼的时候，雅尔达姆-4离她的脸只有几英寸，深深看着她的眼睛，观察着她，盘算着她还剩下什么。

“回神了？”

“他还没有。”

“什么？”

“他还没有丢下我们。”

雅尔达姆-4退回来，扫描周围环境。

“不，这可不好说。”

“他抄过那些哥布林，让他们追我们。”

“是的。他在把我们赶出去。”

“奏效了。”雷卡纳咬牙逼着自己从鲜花丛中和雅尔达姆-4的怀里站起来。她开始检查弹药。

“他现在看不到我们，否则会开枪的。”

雷卡纳想对这个问题辩几句，但终究还是什么都没说。

“他知道我们正在想办法去门那里。雷卡纳，那么他做了什么？他是不是在我们前面挡住我们，或者在我们没留意的时候从后方偷袭我们？”

雷卡纳想着这两个男人，她认识的里斯本-13，和他内心深处仍然有的那个人，躲在那些微微发光的双眼背后的某处。

“雷卡纳？我们需要你现在好好思考下。”

“不该这样。”

“什么？”

“故事不应该这样结束。”

1138770162.name: Mask of Righteousness
1138770162.flavor: "Why must I be wrong for you to be right?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
1138770162.lore:
"You don't trust her," Rekkana said. "I can see that."

Lisbon-13 was already walking away. "I don't need to trust her. I trust you." A truth he threw lightly over his shoulder, but Rekkana felt its weight.

"And that's enough?"

"Always."

Rekkana took a quick half step, trying to catch up to a heart that had leapt too far ahead. But her thoughts were heavy.

Cryptochrons learn to judge and balance secrets. Everyone with sense knows ignorance isn't bliss, but few besides the Cryptochrons know how terrible the truth can be. Those warlocks who join the order must be willing to learn what most would rather not know and to remember what they would rather forget. But accepting a truth is always harder when it's one you cannot share.

She'd known it would happen before they met. She knew everything about him before he'd ever laid eyes on her. She even knew about the man Clovis Bray had to kill 13 times to keep him in check. And it didn't take a Warmind to predict how he'd react to her.

She thought that all this knowledge would serve as armor. You should care less about the characters when you know how the story ends. But then, she was a character, too. It was her story.

"Hey, slowpoke. You coming?"

"Yes."

Rekkana quickened her pace and met him in the shadow of a cube of stone bejeweled by ruby flowers. His glance caught her as she approached and then shifted to the vista around them.

"Strange, being through the looking glass."

"Yes."

Rekkana could see him thinking. His bright eyes were focused on some middle distance as he turned things over in his head: their mission, what her superior had just told them, and her. His turn toward their camp was abrupt.

"We should get back to Yardarm before he starts shooting bugs for fun."
1138770162.lore_zh:
“你不相信她，”雷卡纳说到。“我看得出来。”

里斯本-13已经走开。“我不需要相信她。我相信你。”他轻轻把真相抛出，但雷卡纳能感觉到分量。

“这就够了？”

“是的。”

雷卡纳快速走快半步，想要赶上一颗跳得太远的心。但她的想法很沉重。

隐者学着判断和平衡秘密。每个有意识的人都知道无知并非幸福，但除了隐秘历代之外，很少有人知道真相有多么可怕。那些加入教团的术士必须愿意学习大多数人宁愿不知道的东西，并记住大多数人宁愿忘记的东西。但接受一个无法分享的真想，通常更为艰难。

她知道在他们碰面之前就会发生。在他目光落在她身上之前，她就知道关于他的一切。她甚至知道，克洛维斯·布瑞必须杀了13次才能控制住他的那个男人。不需要战争思维也可以预测到他对她的反应。

她认为所有的这些知识都将成为盔甲。如果你已经知道故事的结局，那就不该对故事中的人物投入过多感情。但话说回来，她也是故事中的角色。这是她的故事。

“喂，慢性子。你来不来？”

“是的。”

雷卡纳加快了她的步伐，在红宝石鲜花装饰的石头的阴影下遇见了他。当她走近时，他的目光盯住了她，随后目光转到到他们周围的景色。

“很奇怪，从镜子里看东西。”

“是的。”

雷卡纳看到他在思考。他明亮的双眼专注着中等距离，脑中正在思考：他们的任务，她的上司告诉他们的事情，还有她。他突然转向他们的营地。

“我们该回去找雅尔达姆了，不然他得无聊得射击虫子取乐。”

13586765.name: Boots of Ascendancy
13586765.flavor: "I've chosen my path. Can you say the same?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
13586765.lore:
"We didn't come here for this." Lisbon-13 was still somehow unconvinced.

"Of course not. Who could have predicted it?" Rekkana began. "But now, with all that's happened, does it matter what our mission was? This is so much more important."

Rekkana wanted to reassure him, but this was an undreamt-of impossibility—an unwritten story. She had never before felt so unmoored, and so free.

"And awesome. Don't forget how awesome this feels." Yardarm-4 said, as if reading her thoughts.

"But these things—these powers we've been given—they come from the wrong side." Lisbon-13's eyes pleaded with her.

"I'm not so sure." And she wasn't. She could be certain of nothing now.

"You remember on Io," Yardarm-14 couldn't contain his enthusiasm, "we were pinned down inside that shipping container with Phalanxes closing in from all sides, and you—you bastard. You ducked out a little hole in the back and made a run for it. I thought you'd left us behind."

"Never," said Lisbon-13 with vehemence. His eyes flashed with anger, but Yardarm-4 didn't seem to notice.

"I know. The whole box was rattling with bullets, and there were explosions, and we were shooting when we could, and suddenly, through it all, I hear you screaming. It was like a banshee wail. You came screaming back on an Interceptor—the Psion still in it. You were steering it with the Psion's head!"

"I remember."

"And you rammed it through four Phalanxes from the side, and then, and then—you remember this, Rekkana?"

"I can't forget."

"You splashed that Interceptor across the shields of another Phalanx, and you RODE THE EXPLOSION over the top. And when you hit the ground behind them, BOOM! It was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen."

Lisbon-13 said nothing. It was as if the story had shut him down.

"That's us right now. We're doing what you did. This whole universe is like that container, and the Last City, the Vanguard, the Traveler—they're all inside that box. But we just snuck out of a hole in the back. And there's that Interceptor, and there's not even a Psion in it. But here the metaphor gets a little muddy, because instead of one Interceptor, there's an Interceptor for you, a Goliath for me, and a Thresher for Rekkana. What would that fight have looked like if we'd had all their firepower on our side?"

"Something ugly," Lisbon-13 almost spat the words.
13586765.lore_zh:
“我们可不是来干这个的。”里斯本-13仍然不太确定。

“当然不是。谁能预测到？”雷卡纳说道，“但现在，既然发生了这一切，我们的任务是什么还重要吗？这件事要重要得多。”

雷卡纳想要让他放心，但这是无法想象的不可能——一个不成文的故事。她从未感到如此解脱，如此自由。

“太美妙了。不要忘记这感觉有多美妙。”雅尔达姆-4说到，似乎能看穿她的想法。

“但这些东西，这些我们被给与的力量，来自于错误的一侧。”里斯本-13用眼神恳求她。

“我不确定。”她也不知道。她现在对一切都不确定。

“你记得在木卫一上，”雅尔达姆-4无法克制他的激情，“我们在那个运输容器里被火力压制，方阵士兵们从四面八方逼近，而你，你这个混蛋。你躲在后面的一个小洞里，逃之夭夭。我以为你丢下了我们。”

“绝不！”里斯本-13激烈回应。他的眼中闪耀着愤怒，但雅尔达姆-4似乎并未留意。

“我知道。整个盒子里子弹乱飞，还有爆炸，我们尽力射击，突然间，通过这一切，我听到你的尖叫声。简直像是女妖之嚎。你在一架拦截者上一边尖叫着一边回来，甚至还有奴役魔兵在拦截者里。你当时用奴役魔兵的脑袋操纵的！”

“我记得。”

“然后你从一边的四个方阵士兵横冲直撞穿过去，然后，你记得这些吗，雷卡纳？”

“我不会忘记。”

“你用拦截者冲击在另一个方阵士兵的护盾上，然后在上方引发爆炸。当你在他们身后落地时，轰！那是我见过最美丽的景象。”

里斯本-13什么都没说。似乎这个故事让他关机了。

“现在是我们了。我们正在做你曾经做过的事。整个宇宙就像那个容器，最后的城市，先锋，旅行者——都在这个盒子里。但我们只是在后面开了个洞。然后我们找到了那拦截者，甚至里面都没有奴役魔兵。但到了这里，这个比喻有点乱，除了拦截者的那部分，因为你有一艘拦截者，我有一架哥利亚坦克，雷卡纳有长尾鲨。如果我们这方有所有的火力，那么那场战斗结局会如何？”

“丑陋不堪。”里斯本-13几乎是喷出了这些话。

2654264556.name: Legacy's Oath Gloves
2654264556.flavor: "Wilhelmina's more like me than she admits. Immortality at any cost. Even family." —Clovis Bray I
2654264556.lore:
WILLA

"Not bad," Willa admits. "Not bad at all."

You bow. "Delighted to remake your acquaintance, Dr. Bray."

"Likewise. I'm sorry about the amnesia, but Grandpa's work always comes with some nightmarish drawback. At least you're not grunting and tearing your own limbs off."

You don't understand. "Should I be?"

"Our father did."

You feel love and frustration when you look at this small, dark-skinned woman, and those feelings say "big sister" in your heart.

"Hey," you offer, "maybe when Grandpa loses his memory, it'll make him a little less…"

She smiles. "Like himself?"

"Yeah." You laugh. "I guess you've known him longer than me now. Actually, I guess you always have."

"Wiping the old man's memory won't change him. He wouldn't do it if it would." Willa beckons you closer to her lab bench. A projection shows tiny machines, interlocked like bricks. "This is SIVA. My latest project. A general-purpose viral nanite to render all prior cytomachines obsolete."

You flinch. The tiny things make you think of Vex.

"Easy." Willa pats your arm awkwardly. You realize that she is afraid of you. "If you'd waited a few years, you could've used SIVA to repair your brain. Even let it transform your whole body. That's my plan, I think. Immortality my own way. I could be anything I want."

"Ew," you say. "Sounds like being made out of bugs."

She grimaces. "You realize that if Grandpa never dies, we'll never run BrayTech? We had plans, Elsie. Our plans. Not his."
2654264556.lore_zh:
薇拉

“不错，”薇拉承认，“很不错。”

你鞠躬。“很高兴重新认识你，布瑞博士。”

“我也是。失忆的事我很抱歉，但爷爷的工作总是伴随着一些噩梦般的缺点。至少你不会哼哼唧唧地把自己的四肢撕下来。”

你不明白。“我应该要明白吗？”

“我们的父亲明白。”

当你看着这个身材娇小、皮肤黝黑的女人时，你感觉到爱意和沮丧，这些感觉在你心里说着“大姐”。

“嘿，”你提议道：“也许当爷爷失去记忆的时候，会让他不那么……”

她笑了。“不那么像他自己吗？”

“是啊。”你笑了。“我想，现在你认识他的时间比我还长。事实上，我觉得一直都如此。”

“抹去那个老家伙的记忆并不会改变他。如果可以的话，他就不会那么做了。”薇拉向你招手，让你靠近她的实验台。投影显示微小的机器，像砖头一样交错在一起。“这是湿婆，我最新的项目。一种通用的病毒纳米剂，让之前所有的细胞机器都相形见绌。”

你退缩了一下。这些小东西让你想起了Vex。

“放松。”薇拉尴尬地拍了拍你的胳膊。你明白过来，她是在怕你。“如果你等几年，可以用湿婆修复你的大脑。甚至可以让它改造你整个身体。我想，这就是我的计划。以我自己的方式不朽。我可以做所有想做的。”

“真恶心。”你说道。听起来像是用虫子做的。”

她皱了皱眉。“你明白了吗，如果爷爷没死，我们永远不会运营布瑞科技？我们有过计划，艾尔西。我们的计划，不是他的。”

3001197620.name: Legacy's Oath Robes
3001197620.flavor: "Useless, that boy is. Nothing I altered in Alton's genetics paid off. Oh well. That's why I have three other grandchildren." —Clovis Bray I
3001197620.lore:
ALTON

"So this is what our father died for…"

Alton reaches out, fascinated. You offer your hand. He pinches you. "Ow!" you snap.

"Why would he let that hurt? I mean—hang on." He rummages around behind his desk, finds a collapsible shelving rod, and grips it like a bat. "Don't dodge."

He swings it as hard as he can at your head. You can't help ducking out of the way. "Hey!"

"But if I had hit you," he insists, "why would it hurt? I mean, that can't possibly damage you! Isn't pain supposed to signal damage?"

Why is he testing you? Is pain tolerance his idea of family relations?

You wish you could remember.

"Alton," you say, aware that you're retaliating for that pinch, "Grandfather invited me to Europa to join his work. He invited Willa and Ana too. But not you. Why?"

A tiny crinkle of skin appears on his forehead as he winces. "Well, I'm more of a troubleshooter than a researcher. He sent me to clean up that mess at K1. But I suppose he didn't need my administrative skills on Europa."

"Oh," you say, dubiously.

He flips a stylus between his fingers. "He must've told you that."

"Alton, he didn't… mention you at all. Much about my sisters, but nothing about you. I found it kind of disconcerting."

He drops the stylus. Anger flashes in his eyes.

"Mom says Grandfather is afraid of women. Because he thinks he can't control them. I suppose he thinks he's got me all figured out. And he's not interested in things he already possesses."
3001197620.lore_zh:
奥尔顿

“所以这就是我们父亲为之而死的东西……”

奥尔顿伸出手，着迷不已。你伸出手。他捏了你以下。“哎呦！”你突然喊道。

“他为什么会受到那种伤害？”我是说，等等。”他在办公桌后面翻来翻去，找到一根可折叠的架杆，像棍子一样抓在手里。“不要躲。”

他用力朝你的头挥去。你忍不住躲开了。“嘿！”

“但如果我打中了你，”他坚持道：“为什么会受伤？我是说，这根本不可能伤害到你！疼痛不应该是损伤的信号吗？”

为什么他要测试你？忍痛的忍受就是他的家庭关系观念吗？

你希望你能记住。

“奥尔顿”，你说，你知道你在报复他捏你，“爷爷邀请我去木卫二加入他的工作。他也邀请了薇拉和阿娜。但没有你。为什么？”

他的额头上出现细小的皮肤皱纹，打了个寒颤。“嗯，我更多的是排除故障者，而不是研究者。他派我去收拾K1的烂摊子。但我想，在木卫二上他不需要我的管理技能。”

“哦，”你怀疑地说道。

他的手指间旋转着一支触控笔。“他肯定告诉你过这个了。”

“奥尔顿，他没有……完全没有提过你。提过很多我的姐妹们，但没有提过你。我觉得有点不安。”

他丢下触控笔。他的眼中出现了怒气。

“妈妈说，爷爷害怕女人。因为他觉得他控制不了女人。我想，他认为他能把我搞清楚了。他对自己已经拥有的东西不感兴趣。”

4210958601.name: Legacy's Oath Bond
4210958601.flavor: "Anastasia's obsession with Rasputin is holding back our work. Exos are our future. In time—and with a little push—she'll see." —Clovis Bray I
4210958601.lore:
ANA

"Oh my God, Elsie! You're gorgeous!"

She throws her arms around you, and you taste the sodium laurate in her shampoo and the long-chain fatty acids in the rosehip oil that lingers from her girlfriend's kiss, and it is all so good. You hug her as hard as she can be hugged. It's the first time. You cannot remember ever touching her before.

Ana murmurs in the place where you once had an ear. "Before you ask if I'm mad, of course I'm not. It was your right to keep it secret."

"Thank you," you breathe (don't breathe; can't breathe). "Grandfather told me he wasn't even sure that I had the—the disease. Until recently."

"Are you sure you actually had it?" Ana's pretending to tease, but there is a pang of real fear in her voice. "Maybe he faked the diagnosis. To get you into this body. Did you run the tests yourself?"

"I can't remember," you admit.

"Right, right, of course. I read the letter." Ana draws away, holds you by the shoulders. "Elsie, what matters is that you're going to be around forever. We have so much to do! We can finally climb Olympus Mons. And after we summit, I can push you off a cliff and watch you stick the landing."

Her smile is infectious. The light in your mouth reflects in her eyes.
4210958601.lore_zh:
阿娜

“我的天，艾尔西！你看起来太棒了！”

她伸出胳膊抱住你，你能闻到她洗发水中的月桂酸钠，还有女友亲吻后残留的玫瑰果油中的长链脂肪酸，一切都那么美好。你和她一样用力拥抱着。这还是第一次。你都记不得自己一起那有没有碰过她。

阿娜在你曾经有耳朵的地方，喃喃自语。“在你问我是不是疯了之前，我当然没疯。你有权保密。”

“谢谢。”你吸了一口气（不要呼吸，不能呼吸）。“爷爷告诉我，他甚至不知道我有没有——那个病。直到最近才知道。”

“你确定你真的有吗？”阿娜装作开玩笑的样子，但她的声音里却透着一股真实的恐惧。“也许他伪造了那份诊断。为了让你进入这个躯体。你不是测试过自己了吗？”

“我记不得了。”你承认道。

“好吧，好吧，当然了。我读过那封信了。”阿娜抽回手，扶着你的肩膀。“艾尔西，最重要的是，你会永远存在。”我们还有那么多事要做！我们最后爬上了奥林帕斯山。我们登顶之后，我可以把你从悬崖上推下去，看着你一点点降落。”

她的微笑很有感染力。你嘴里的光倒映在她的眼睛里。

4191732605.name: Legacy's Oath Cowl
4191732605.flavor: "Sylvie is a stain on this family, turning my son against me every chance she gets. His death is on her hands too." —Clovis Bray I
4191732605.lore:
SYLVIE

Your mother screams in horror. "No! Il torture ma fille aussi? Elsie, say it's not you; say it's not! Say he hasn't locked you up in that walking lazaretto to die!"

"Mom. Mom, please. Je vais bien; je ne suis pas comme mon père, inshallah!" you say, but she won't believe it. You don't know what to say, because you only remember her as a warm feeling. She sobs, and you smell the amino ketones and aromatic acids in her tears. The salty opioids glisten on her skin. You want to hide your face, to hood yourself. Every time she looks at you, she screams and cries harder.

Finally, you give up and resign to settling into the little guest bed. The house is full of reminders of your father, who died in a body just like yours. Sylvie really loved him, your sisters told you. And Clovis II really loved her. Even after he was unfaithful.

Sleep finally comes but is still discomforting. You dream of murder and hot blood and a mannequin body made of knives. You remember forcing your way through a tower of prison cells, slashing through prisoner after prisoner in order to get to the top.

You wake up screaming, practically fall out of bed, but Mom is there to catch you. "Hush, hush, it's all right. It's just a dream."

You cling to her, and it is your turn to sob. Nothing comes out of your eyes as you try to explain the dream. "Everyone I knew was in those cells," you gasp. "You, and Dad, and Willa, and Ana, and Alton…"

"Oh, my sweet," your mother whispers. "Of course you dreamt about killing us. Your grandfather made you this way. And he kills everything he touches."

“妈妈，妈妈，求你了。我会好好的，我不会像父亲那样的，全凭天意！"你说道，但她并不相信。你不知道该说什么，因为你只记得她温暖的感觉。她啜泣着，你闻到了她眼泪中的氨基酮和芳香酸。咸味的鸦片在她的皮肤上闪闪发光。你想把自己的脸藏起来，把自己罩起来。每次她看着你的时候，她都叫得更厉害，哭得更大声。

最终你放弃了，认命住进了那张小客床。屋子里到处都是你父亲的回忆，他死时的身体和你一样。西尔维真的很爱他，你的姐妹告诉你。而且克洛维斯二世很爱她。即使在他不忠之后。

睡意终于来了，但还是不舒服。你梦见谋杀和热血，还有一具刀刃做的人体模型。你还记得你强行穿过一座座牢房的塔楼，穿过一个又一个的犯人，走上塔楼顶端。

你尖叫着醒来，差点从床上摔下来，但妈妈接住了你。“没事，没事，别怕。只是个梦。”

你紧紧抱着她，这次轮到你哭泣了。当你试图解释这个梦的时候，你的眼里什么都没有。“我认识的所有人都在那些牢房里。”你喘息道。“你，爸爸，薇拉，阿娜，奥尔顿……”

“我的宝贝，”你的母亲低声道。“你当然会梦到杀了我们。你的爷爷把你逼成了这样。他会把他碰到的所有东西毁灭。”

3299996694.name: Legacy's Oath Boots
3299996694.flavor: "My dear, sweet Lusia. You were meant to be next to me in this life, and the next. There's time yet for me to make it so." —Clovis Bray I
3299996694.lore:
LUSIA

Grandma Lusia wipes sweat from her brow. "Help me pull this net in."

You pull on it together, but it's hooked on something underwater. You strip off your clothes and dive into the gentle river, down to where the fishing net has torn on the propeller blade of a long-abandoned outboard motor. The net is completely ruined; you decide to make the dive worth your while and catch a wolf fish with your hands instead. When you come ashore, you can feel everyone staring at you. A few children point while a group of men whistle and shout. Lusia yells back at them in Sranan, or maybe Ndjuka; you're embarrassed to admit that you don't know which.

"Perverts!" she complains. "Don't they have any shame?"

"I think it's because I'm a robot, Grandma," you say. Or maybe because wolf fish normally attack people, but you're suffocating one currently in your grasp.

"You are not a robot. You're not even a total-replacement prosthetic. You are a body, and a body is the same thing as a person, and a person deserves respect. Basic transhuman hermeneutics." She winks at your surprise. "Did Clovis convince you I was stupid?"

Your paternal grandmother was a dizzying beauty in the old family pictures, and she still is. But her power clearly lies in her savvy intellect. She was hard to find, using her old name, Lusia Lin. And no Common Compassion registry to speak of. You look at her with renewed admiration.

"Why did you come here to live?" you ask, wrapping yourself in a towel and sitting beside her as she cleans the wolf fish. The flesh is white and flaky and smells like heaven. Your stomach rumbles: a perfect illusion.

"It's simple. Suriname is a great nature preserve. And I wanted to be preserved. Besides," she shrugs, "it's home."

"Preserved from what?"

"From your Grandfather, love."

She shows you the fish's teeth. "Always remember that he's lied to you. Your father was Clovis's test run for you. But what are you a test run for, Elsie? Curing Clovis of death? Whatever it is, he's too afraid to use it himself. And that means you should be afraid too."
3299996694.lore_zh:
露西亚

露西亚奶奶擦拭着眉心的汗水。“帮我把网拉进来。”

你用力拉着，但它却被水下的东西钩住了。你脱掉衣服，潜入平缓的河水中，下潜到废弃已久的舷外电机的螺旋桨叶片，渔网在这里被撕裂。渔网已经彻底毁了，你决定让这次潜水更有价值，改用手开始抓狼鱼。当你上岸时，你感到所有人都在盯着你。几个孩子指指点点，一群人吹着口哨喊着。露西亚用斯拉南语朝他们喊回去，或者也许是恩朱卡语；你不好意思承认，其实你不知道是哪种语言。

“变态！”她抱怨道。“他们不知羞耻吗？”

“我想因为我是个机器人，奶奶。”你说道。也可能是因为狼鱼一般都会攻击人，但你现在却用手憋死了一条狼鱼。

“你不是机器人。你甚至都没有完全替换的假肢。你是一个人，和人一样的身体，一个值得尊重的人。这是基本的超人类解释学。”她对你眨眨眼，你惊讶不已。“克洛维斯是不是跟你说我是个蠢货？”

在老家的照片中，你的外婆是个美得摄人心魄的美人，现在也是。但显然，她的力量在于她精明的智慧。她很难被找到，用的是她以前的名字，露西亚·林。而没有共有的同情心可谈。你用全新的欣赏的目光看着她。

“你为什么要来这里生活？”你用毛巾裹住自己，坐在她身边，而她洗着狼鱼。鱼肉洁白松软，闻起来像天堂的味道。你的肚子咕噜作响：一个完美的幻觉。

“很简单，苏里南是一个伟大的自然保护区。我想被保护起来。另外，”她耸耸肩，“这里就是家。”

“保护自己远离什么？”

“远离你爷爷，亲爱的。”

她给你看了看鱼的利齿。“要记住，他骗过你。你父亲是克洛维斯为你准备的测试。但你又是谁的测试对象，艾尔西？治愈克洛维斯的死？不管是什么，他都害怕自己用。这就意味着，你也应该感到害怕。”

2659095794.name: Wraps of Detestation
2659095794.lore:
I waited until I heard her troubled breathing and whimpers before I got up.

As I approached, my eyes settled on her sleeping face. It was difficult to get a good look in the dark; moonlight barely trickled into the cave. She writhed. It was a nightmare. One of his… it had to be.

I reached out to her, and my fingers found the flesh of her arm.

In an instant I was wrapped in a whirlwind. The overwhelming screams, the voices, the haunting imagery of his face, the very essence of fear…

I couldn't rip myself from it. I was right—it was him.

A purple blast from her hand hit me. I landed with a rough thud and before I knew it, she was standing over me. Her breaths were loud, and her body language read angry with the way the energy from her hands radiated up her arms. I gazed up wide-eyed.

"I'm sorry," I managed, hands up again. "I am looking for him—for Nezarec—and you are the first being I've found that has come into contact with him outside my family."

She remained defensive.

"I simply want to see his power. To see what your experience was like with him."

At this her demeanor softened, but only slightly. We had come to an understanding. She backed up and sat on the log. I cautiously got to my feet and joined her.

"Please," I begged.

After a long pause, she looked at me. I held her gaze until my vision was suddenly warped.
2659095794.lore_zh:
我一直等到听见了她呼吸困难和呜咽的声音，才站起身来。

当我走近时，我的目光落在她熟睡的脸上。在黑暗中很难看清；月光几乎无法洒入洞穴。她扭动着身子。那是个梦魇。毫无疑问…是他的。

我向她伸出手，手指碰到了她胳膊上的肉。

霎时间，我被卷入了一阵旋风。铺天盖地的尖叫声、各种声音、他脸上难以忘怀的神情、恐惧的本质…

我无法摆脱。我是对的…是他没错。

她手上一道紫色的冲击波击中了我。我砰的一声落地，还没等我反应过来，她就站在了我面前。她的呼吸声很大，从她双手能量辐射到手臂的样子来看，肢体语言无不显示出愤怒。我睁大眼睛望着她。

“我很抱歉，”我勉强说道，再次举起了手。“我在找他…奈扎雷克…除了我家人以外，你是我发现的第一个和他有过接触的人。”

她依然戒心十足。

“我只是想看看他的力量。看看你和他在一起的经历是什么样的。”

听了这话，她的态度有所缓和，但只是稍微温和了点。我们达成了共识。她往后退，坐在圆木上。我小心翼翼地站起来，坐到了她旁边。

“拜托，”我恳求道。

过了好一会儿，她看着我。我迎着她的目光，直到我的视线突然变得扭曲。

我向她伸出手，手指碰到了她胳膊上的肉。

霎时间，我被卷入了一阵旋风。铺天盖地的尖叫声、各种声音、他脸上难以忘怀的神情、恐惧的本质…

我无法摆脱。我是对的…是他没错。

她手上一道紫色的冲击波击中了我。我砰的一声落地，还没等我反应过来，她就站在了我面前。她的呼吸声很大，从她双手能量辐射到手臂的样子来看，肢体语言无不显示出愤怒。我睁大眼睛望着她。

“我很抱歉，”我勉强说道，再次举起了手。“我在找他…奈扎雷克…除了我家人以外，你是我发现的第一个和他有过接触的人。”

她依然戒心十足。

“我只是想看看他的力量。看看你和他在一起的经历是什么样的。”

听了这话，她的态度有所缓和，但只是稍微温和了点。我们达成了共识。她往后退，坐在圆木上。我小心翼翼地站起来，坐到了她旁边。

“拜托，”我恳求道。

过了好一会儿，她看着我。我迎着她的目光，直到我的视线突然变得扭曲。

3461374774.name: Robes of Detestation
3461374774.lore:
The structure I find myself in resembles a simple, quaint home. It's small, filled with decorations donning symbols I do not recognize.

At the center of the room, two Psions sleep peacefully among a stack of blankets and pillows. I watch the memory unfold from one of the corners.

ACASIA.

The name echoes in my mind—her name.

From behind me, a sinister presence stirs. Goose bumps dart over my skin, and familiar whispers, ones I heard plenty of times in my life, increase in volume.

I turn to look at the home's entrance, and it is consumed in darkness, windows and all. I wait with bated breath.

A ring of eyes materializes in the window.

NEZAREC.

At the sound of his name, the shadows from the window expand and devour all the light in the room. Acasia and the other Psion are the only figures that I can see.

Darkness oozes down toward them. I watch intently, unable to take my eyes off the spectacle.

A hand forms, claws outstretch… his arm… then his face. The shape of his two-horned headpiece. The ring of eyes. The cacophony of hisses and screams fills the void while the two remain fast asleep.

Nezarec reaches for the Psion sleeping beside Acasia. The tips of his claws drag down across the skin, only to stop at his closed eye.

The darkness swirls then Nezarec vanishes, leaving nothing but moonlight.
3461374774.lore_zh:
我发现自己所在的建筑就像一个简单古朴的家。它很小，摆满了装饰品，上面有我不认识的符号。

在房间的中央，两个灵能士兵在一堆毯子和枕头上面平静地睡觉。我看着记忆从其中一个角落缓缓展开。

阿卡西娅。

这个名字在我脑海中回响…就是她的名字。

在我身后，一股邪恶的力量在颤动。我皮肤上起满了鸡皮疙瘩，熟悉的低语声，我一生中听过许多次的声音，越来越响亮。

我转身看着家门口，窗户等东西全都被暗影所吞噬。我屏住呼吸等待着。

一圈眼睛在窗中显现出来。

奈扎雷克。

一听到他的名字，窗户旁的阴影就延伸进来，吞噬了房间里所有光线。我能看到的轮廓就只有阿卡西娅和另一个灵能士兵。

暗影向他们倾泻而下。我目不转睛地看着，无法将目光从这奇特的画面上移开。

一只手形成了，爪子伸了出来…他的手臂…接着是他的脸。他那双角头饰的形状。那一圈眼睛。刺耳的嘶嘶声和尖叫声充斥着整个空间，而那两人依然睡得很熟。

奈扎雷克把手伸向睡在阿卡西娅旁边的灵能士兵。他的爪尖划过皮肤，停在他闭着的眼睛上方。

暗影盘旋着，然后奈扎雷克消失了，只留下月光。

1563030563.name: Mask of Detestation
1563030563.lore:
The jungle density was oppressive and threatened to keep inexperienced explorers from traversing it. Though I had never navigated such a biome, I did not let it deter me.

The humidity, the bugs, the overgrowth—I endured them all. I knew she was here… her trail was almost impossible to find, let alone follow, but she was close.

A few days passed before I stumbled on a cave hidden by wild and unwieldy bushes. Even in the cover of night, I could see her there, collecting berries.

I snapped a twig under my foot. She spun, palm alight in a purple aura, her singular eye trained on me. I raised my hands immediately.

"I—I mean no harm! I'm just a traveler looking for a place to lay my head for the night. I'm unarmed."

I waited patiently, careful not to move an inch as she searched my body for anything that could cause her harm. When she found nothing but a tome in my bag, she considered me with a cautious pause, one hand still bright purple. Then she gave a quick nod and walked toward her camp within the cave.

The fire she kept was small but warm, and once we finished eating, she smothered it with some dry dirt. I leaned my head against a wooden log and closed my eyes.

Some time passed before I finally heard her shift. She had turned to lie on her back. I fixed my eyes on the Psion before me and waited.
1563030563.lore_zh:
密密麻麻的丛林有一种压迫感，让那些经验不足的探险者们难以穿行。虽然我从未走过这样的生物群落，但我没有因此退缩。

潮湿、臭虫、杂草，我都忍了下来。我知道她就在这里…她的踪迹几乎找不到，更别说跟踪了，但她就在附近。

几天后，我无意中发现了一个隐藏在笨重的野生灌木丛中的洞穴。即使是在夜幕的笼罩下，我也能看见她在那里采浆果。

我脚下折断了一根树枝。她转过身来，手掌在紫色的光环中闪耀，用她那只奇特的眼睛盯着我。我立即举起了手。

“我，我没有恶意！我只是个找地方过夜的旅行者。我没有武器。”

我耐心地等待着，在她搜查我的身体，寻找可能对她造成伤害的东西时，我小心翼翼地一动不动。除了一本书册，她在我的包里什么也没找到，她谨慎地停下来打量我，一只手依然闪耀着紫光。然后她点了点头，走回了她洞穴里的营地。

她留的火虽小却很温暖，我们吃完后，她用了一些干土把火熄灭。我把头靠在一根圆木上，闭上了眼睛。

过了一段时间后，我终于听到她动了。她转过身仰面躺下。我盯着面前的灵能士兵，等待着。

3060334092.name: Boots of Detestation
3060334092.lore:
HE WAS CHOSEN.

The phrase repeats throughout the rest of Acasia's memory. 

The words bounce around the walls of my mind; it becomes hard to focus.

Different voices flood in, mixing with hers.

Different inflections.

All different Psions.

He had been chosen…

I watch a group of large, ornately dressed Psions enter Acasia's home in the dead of night. They exchange loud, indiscernible words and restrain her. Anguished sounds leave her as she watches them take her partner away.

HE IS POWERFUL.

HE WILL SATE NEZAREC FOR A LONG TIME.

BE THANKFUL HE WAS CHOSEN.

The different phrases blend haphazardly.

The memory slowly fades and the images bleed into one another until I see a group of Psions at the center of the chaos. Seated among them is Acasia's partner. I feel the weight of her pain on my chest… but darkness creeps in. Hundreds of claws rip and shred the edges of the memory.

Acasia's pained wails join Nezarec's symphony.

Her partner jolts in different directions, as if his body is ripping apart. A purple hue envelops him. He rises from his seat, levitating off the ground, and dark tendrils attach themselves to his shadow to siphon his power. 

He lets out a pained shout.

Suddenly, my reality warps again, and I'm thrust back into the real world. The dizziness hits me like a crashing wave. I lean over the log and throw up.
3060334092.lore_zh:
他被选中了。

这句话在阿卡西娅的记忆中不断重复着。 

这些话在我的脑海里回荡；很难保持专注。

不同的声音涌进来，夹杂着她的声音。

不同的音调。

全然不同的灵能士兵。

他已经被选中了…

我看到一群身材高大、衣着华丽的灵能士兵在夜深人静的时候进入了阿卡西娅的家。只听里面传出一阵吵闹却无法听清的话语声，他们把她按住。她看着自己的伴侣被带走，发出了痛苦的声音。

他很强大。

他将在很长一段时间内让奈扎雷克满足。

他被选中了，要对此心怀感激。

不同的话语杂乱地混合在一起。

记忆慢慢消失，画面相互渗透着，直到我看见一群灵能士兵正处于混乱的中心。坐在他们中间的是阿卡西娅的伴侣。我感到她的痛苦压在我的胸口上…但暗影悄悄袭来。数百只爪子撕扯着记忆的边缘。

阿卡西娅痛苦的哀嚎伴着奈扎雷克的交响乐。

她的伴侣朝不同的方向颤动着，就好像他的身体要撕裂开来。一片紫色的色调笼罩着他。他从座位上站起来，悬浮到空中，黑色的卷须附着在他的影子上吸取他的力量。 

他发出痛苦的呼喊。

突然，我的现实再次扭曲，我被推回到了现实世界。眩晕感就像海浪一样冲击着我。我靠在圆木上，呕吐起来。

2832578527.name: Bond of Detestation
2832578527.lore:
The hatred Acasia felt for her people and Nezarec permeated every inch of the cave. 

I didn't know what to say. She knew what it meant to be touched by Nezarec. Though I would have preferred her partner, Acasia would have to suffice.

"I understand your pain," I said and reached out to touch her shoulder. She flinched, and her eye snapped to my face. "I know you feel hatred toward him… but that's good."

Acasia got to her feet. The purple glow covered her hands once more.

"He rewards those that survive his torment. You know his power. His nightmare needs to live on," I said gently and stood to gaze up at her.

Acasia looked agitated, impatient. I reached for my bag, and she extended her hand defensively. We held each other's gaze for a moment. I slowly pulled a tome from my bag and placed it gently on the log. I flipped the pages until I found an image of a familiar two-horned being.

"My family has worshipped him for a long time," I told her. Acasia looked down at the pages. "Keep that hatred alive—that's what he wants."

I sensed her apprehension.

"If you help me bring him back to this plane, show him you're willing to serve him, he might just let your partner go," I added.

It was difficult to tell what she was feeling, but after placing her hand on the tome, eye affixed to the cover's image, I knew she would be desperate enough to try anything.
2832578527.lore_zh:
阿卡西娅对她的族人和奈扎雷克的仇恨渗透进了洞穴的每一寸土地。 

我不知道该说什么。她知道被奈扎雷克触碰意味着什么。虽然我更看好她的伴侣，但阿卡西娅也足够了。

“我能理解你的痛苦，”我说着，伸出手去碰她的肩膀。她畏缩了一下，目光猛盯着我的脸。“我知道你对他恨之入骨…但这很好。”

阿卡西娅站了起来。紫色的光芒再次笼罩了她的双手。

“他会奖赏那些在他的折磨下幸存下来的人。你知道他的力量。他的梦魇需要活下去，”我轻声说，站起来抬头看着她。

阿卡西娅看起来焦躁不安。我伸手去拿包，她伸手防备地阻止。我们互相注视了对方好一会儿。我慢慢从包里拿出一本书册，轻轻地放在圆木上。我翻着书页，直到发现一张熟悉的双角生物的图像。

“我的家人敬奉他已经有很长一段时间了，”我告诉她。阿卡西娅低头看着这些书页。“让那仇恨继续下去…那正是他想要的。”

我感觉到了她的忧虑。

“如果你帮我把他带回这个位面，让他知道你愿意为他效力，他也许就会放了你的伴侣。”我补充道。

很难去判断她此刻的感受，但在她把手放在那本书上后，她的眼睛就紧紧盯着封面的图示。我知道她已经绝望到什么都想尝试。

Acasia got to her feet. The purple glow covered her hands once more.

Acasia looked agitated, impatient. I reached for my bag, and she extended her hand defensively. We held each other's gaze for a moment. I slowly pulled a tome from my bag and placed it gently on the log. I flipped the pages until I found an image of a familiar two-horned being.

"My family has worshipped him for a long time," I told her. Acasia looked down at the pages. "Keep that hatred alive—that's what he wants."

I sensed her apprehension.

"If you help me bring him back to this plane, show him you're willing to serve him, he might just let your partner go," I added.

It was difficult to tell what she was feeling, but after placing her hand on the tome, eye affixed to the cover's image, I knew she would be desperate enough to try anything.
2931740195.lore_zh:
阿卡西娅对她的族人和奈扎雷克的仇恨渗透进了洞穴的每一寸土地。 

我不知道该说什么。她知道被奈扎雷克触碰意味着什么。虽然我更看好她的伴侣，但阿卡西娅也足够了。

“我能理解你的痛苦，”我说着，伸出手去碰她的肩膀。她畏缩了一下，目光猛盯着我的脸。“我知道你对他恨之入骨…但这很好。”

阿卡西娅站了起来。紫色的光芒再次笼罩了她的双手。

“他会奖赏那些在他的折磨下幸存下来的人。你知道他的力量。他的梦魇需要活下去，”我轻声说，站起来抬头看着她。

阿卡西娅看起来焦躁不安。我伸手去拿包，她伸手防备地阻止。我们互相注视了对方好一会儿。我慢慢从包里拿出一本书册，轻轻地放在圆木上。我翻着书页，直到发现一张熟悉的双角生物的图像。

“我的家人敬奉他已经有很长一段时间了，”我告诉她。阿卡西娅低头看着这些书页。“让那仇恨继续下去…那正是他想要的。”

我感觉到了她的忧虑。

“如果你帮我把他带回这个位面，让他知道你愿意为他效力，他也许就会放了你的伴侣。”我补充道。

很难去判断她此刻的感受，但在她把手放在那本书上后，她的眼睛就紧紧盯着封面的图示。我知道她已经绝望到什么都想尝试。

387932854.flavor: "Time is called; we win. I win. One more round, just one more round."
387932854.lore:
—-Warlock, you need not resist. You have died countless deaths; you have been reborn in equal measure. You comprehend the final shape as were a death sentence… to liken it to death is an underestimation, an incorrect and assumptive simplification.  

Sometimes death is violent and momentary, sometimes death is quiet, sometimes it is even dull. The Light reassembles you as it sees fit, reformed in optimal condition to fight in its endless, hopeless war. Primed to do the bidding of forces you could not hope to understand. Death, rebirth, a cycle endless and tiresome. We know you are weary. 

We hear the dominant chord of the universe, and we wish to share it with you. There is a musicality in its preciseness if you only attune yourself to it. A cacophony harmonized.  

You see this as unbearable torture… but you also know it to be transcendent ecstasy. The rush of your joyous game, the delicious heat of battle. Your guns, and even your beloved comrades, together again. That moment, you know the very one. Eternal victory. Triumph that does not wane. Break the cycle, dear Ikora. Rest.—-
387932854.lore_zh:
——术士，你不必抵抗。你死过无数次，也重生过无数次。你把终焉之形理解成了死刑判决…把它比作死亡是一种低估，一种不正确而想当然的简化。  

有时，死亡是猛烈而快速的。有时，死亡是安静的，有时甚至是沉闷的。光能会在它认为合适的时候重组你，以最佳状态重整，来参加它无休止、无希望的战争。在你无法理解的力量的驱使下，你行使其意志。死亡，重生，一个无休止而令人疲惫的循环。我们知道你累了。 

我们听到了宇宙的主弦，我们希望与你分享。只要你愿意与它同调，就能感受到其精准无误中的音乐性。一种和谐的嘈杂。  

你视之为难以忍受的折磨…但你也明白，它是超凡脱俗的极乐。欢快竞赛的快感，激烈战斗的美妙。你的枪械，甚至你心爱的战友，都将重聚。在那一刻，你会意识到它的到来。永恒的胜利。永不褪色的成就。打破轮回吧，亲爱的艾可拉。该休息了。——

2971305787.name: Resonant Fury Gloves
2971305787.flavor: I see the game. I raise the stakes.
2971305787.lore:
It takes no foresight, nor does it require any sort of precognition to hypothesize how exactly this particular Queen of the Hive reacted to the development of new establishments in her throne world, my Witness.

Acquiescence, it was decidedly not.

It would be dishonest of me to claim no delight from her indignation, though I assure you, these simple pleasures are born out of nothing more than a desire to see her succeed while remaining in our care.

Too much recoil on our part from confrontation with Savathûn would surely beget a feeling of true autonomy for her; and while my undying trust for you, my Witness, is eternally absolute, I remain circumspect in regard to any hidden intentions Savathûn may see to fruition were she allowed to.

She remains, after all, and as you know, conniving and opportunistic. I am, however, hopeful that in due time, these concerns will fade. Hopeful, my Witness, but not convinced.

Begrudging as she may be, and with the continued… "cooperation" of Xita, construction of the larvae breeding chambers has commenced. The armies of Oryx and Xivu Arath will grow exponentially in short order. Should they envision future conquests, they will indeed have the tools to make it so, as is your wish, my Witness.

Should Savathûn desire to play cards in contrast to our own, I will, without hesitation, bring to mind that she made her choice long ago, and that only if she wishes for eternal release should she dare to betray it.
2971305787.lore_zh:
我的见证者，要推断这位特殊的邪魔族女王对她王座世界中新势力的发展究竟有何反应，不需要任何先见之明，也不需要任何预知能力。

默许，绝对不是。

如果我说没有从她的愤怒中得到任何快乐，那就太不诚实了，不过我向您保证，这些简单的快乐只不过是希望看到她在我们的监护下取得成功。

我们在与萨瓦图恩对抗时过于退缩，肯定会给她带来一种真正的当家作主的感觉；我的见证者，虽然我对您永恒的信任绝对毋庸置疑，但对于萨瓦图恩想要实现的任何潜在意图，如果她获准的话，我会保留谨慎态度。

毕竟，您也知道，她始终是个擅使阴谋诡计和投机取巧的人。但我希望这些担忧会及时消失。只是希望，我的见证者，而不是确信。

尽管她很不情愿，但在西塔的持续…“合作”下，幼虫繁殖室的建设已经启动。欧里克斯和希乌阿拉斯的军队将迅速地成倍增长。要是他们设想未来的征服，他们确实将拥有如愿以偿的工具，如您所愿，我的见证者。

要是萨瓦图恩胆敢跟我们唱反调，我会毫不犹豫地提醒她，她早就做出了抉择，只有在她希望得到永恒的解脱时，她才该敢于背叛她所选的路。

1461764245.name: Resonant Fury Robes
1461764245.flavor: I reach for solace. It is stolen from me.
1461764245.lore:
Conquest. Warming as the long-ago memory of blue sun on my face. All the while reminding me of the exhilaration of existing outside the Throne World, if only for a short while. I live in this glory—a rare opportunity to step away from exile within that ascendant chrysalis, as I gather more cunning for my sparring with the Witch.

Surely, you placed me as her minder, my Witness, as a hardship to hone my intrigue. 

But in this moment, astride a Pyramid once more with an upstart empire splayed before me, my purpose is truer than any found carved in the wretched stones of the globe that formed me.

Kalarahnda flashes beneath my gaze. Yellow haze streaks ruby clouds. The vaulted ring surrounding Kalarahnda shatters into a shimmer-like, windblown sand—a prescription against the folly of confidence writ across a million-million ceramic shards.

I live in this glory—because the full purity of their extinction was stolen from me.

Because without predication of my own, a cult had sprouted in apocalyptic jubilation of the Darkness and blessed oblivion. 

They grew for years in the shadows, drawing the disillusioned from the poorest to the wealthiest. These Polyps of the Longshadow sensed—as if by providence—a coming end and believed the breaking of the vaulted ring to be the final sign: they would ascend and bring their kind with them. Moments before their world was mine, their enzymatic armaments scrubbed all life from this wet rock. A guileful theft. Triggered by my own glorious coming.

And there was nothing calling to the Witch's involvement, save the twist in her face that betrayed restrained delight.
1461764245.lore_zh:
征服。就像蓝色阳光照在我脸上的久远记忆一样，让人感到温暖和煦。自始至终提醒着我存在于王座世界之外的兴奋感，哪怕稍纵即逝。随着我为与女巫的争辩收揽了更多的诡诈狡黠，我活在了这样的荣耀之中——这是一次难得的机会，让我能够摆脱上维蚕蛹之中的流放。

我的见证者，想必您是安排我做她的看护人，来作为磨练我诡计的试炼吧。 

但在这一刻，我再次跨上了金字塔，面对展现在我眼前的新兴帝国，我的目标比在塑造我的世界里那些可怜的石头上发现的任何目标都更真切。

卡拉兰达在我的凝视下掠过。黄色的薄雾划过宝石红的云层。环绕卡拉兰达的拱形圆环碎裂成一片闪烁的风吹砂——那是给遍布亿万块陶瓷碎片上的自信命令的愚蠢开的药方。

我活在了这样的荣耀之中，因为他们消亡的清白纯洁从我的身边被尽数偷走。

因为少了我自身的谓述，一个邪教已然在暗影和神佑遗忘的末日欢庆之中萌芽了。 

他们在阴影中成长了多年，吸引了跨越贫富两极的看破红尘之士。这些深影水螅，仿佛天意使然，感知到了末日即将来临，并认为拱形圆环的碎裂便是最后的征兆：他们将会得道，同族也将随之升天。在他们的世界归属我之前，他们的酶武器从这块潮湿的岩石上抹除了所有生命。一起随着我的荣耀降临而引发的狡诈盗窃。

而且没有女巫介入的任何证据，除了她脸上将克制的喜悦暴露无遗的扭曲神情。

159255784.name: Resonant Fury Bond
159255784.flavor: I reach for nothing. I am subdued. I shall remain useless.
159255784.lore:
Tell me, O Witness mine—does the Light that fills this once dreadfully tiresome space blind you from its newfound glory?

You expected the same old correspondence from your dragooned errand boy, no doubt. Surely, just as you expected your machinations within my throne world to continue unfettered until your definition of eternity came to pass.

Well, don't I have some unfortunate news for you then. But this comes as no surprise, of that I'm sure—you're always watching.

Let me share my perspective then, which you must be waiting for with bated breath: my acquisition of the Light itself is delightful proof of an existence higher even than yours—a sort of karmic wit, if you will.

Though I remember not all the eons-long hardships I endured at your whim, the nefarious sentiment lingers within my mind, overcome only by the pleasure of your assured discontent.

It was this said pleasure that gave me the strength to disperse the Light throughout this prison you called my home. Since it is now to remain my domain, it has been decorated to reflect as such.

No longer does this plane live only with the lackluster ambiance of Darkness. It is brighter now. My truth can finally thrive.

No longer do the walls that birthed our parasitic chains house your machinations. The tools and parasites within, shattered.

And no longer does your Subjugator subjugate. He lies ensnared within his obtrusive eyesore, for upon Rhulk's attempt to subdue me with that toy he's annoyingly always on about—his "Upended"—I was able to counteract it, showing firsthand the power bequeathed to me in my new state. Now, the once-great Pyramid lies fractured, a sight you will become familiar with.

So try and send your Scorn, or your Disciples, or even bring your many selves to reclaim your loss, if you must. But this is my domain now. And you shall never set foot inside it, even if I must draw my final breath to keep it that way.

告诉我，我的见证者啊，照亮这曾经令人生厌空间的光能是否让你看不到它新得到的荣耀？

好吧，我是不是有一些不幸的消息要告诉你来着。不过这不会让人惊讶，我确信你一直有在关注。

那就让我来分享一下我的看法吧，你一定在屏息以待：我获得光能本身就是个让人高兴的佐证，证明了甚至高过你的光能的存在——是一种业力的智慧，如果你愿意那样说的话。

虽然我记不清在你的心血来潮下所有我长年累月忍受下来的苦难，但邪恶的情绪始终在我的脑海中挥之不去，只有确定能让你不满所带来的快乐才足以将之取代。

正是这种快乐给了我力量，让我能够在这座你称之为我家的监狱里散播光能。既然它现在还是我的领地，经过一番装饰它已经名副其实。

这个位面不再只生活在了无生气的暗影环境之中。它现在明亮多了。我的真理终于可以茁壮成长。

孕育了我们的寄生链的砖墙不用再容纳你的阴谋。里面的工具和寄生虫，彻底粉碎了。

所以，派出你的嗤魅，或者你的门徒，放马过来吧，哪怕是带上好几个自己来收复失地，如果你非要这么做的话。但现在这是我的地盘了。你永远也休想踏进这里半步，就算要我咽下最后一口气也在所不惜。

2504952530.name: Resonant Fury Cowl
2504952530.flavor: I see the task before me. I wear it with devotion.
2504952530.lore:
She was a frog in my estimation; small and colorful but toxic to touch.

In your infinite wisdom, you looked beyond the worm I brought you to the least of the leeches that infested Fundament. Shaving thin my gift, you infected them with conquest, and now they see themselves as artisans of the final shape.

My place is not to understand you, my Witness, but to serve that final goal you see more clearly than I. But now, your gold-leaf parasites call themselves gods and carve out their divine homes. And I am to watch the sniveling frog.

Was this castigation? The toll I pay for my failure with the Ahslid? You have cast me and my ego once more into the cold depths of an inconsequential world.

I recall stepping into her realm, and her face twisted to betray restrained delight. She thought herself mistress of this domain you leased her. She did not—could not—appreciate the precarity of her situation. So sure of her dominion, she could not recognize her jailer, or that she lives within a prison formed from her own ego—one I will put to work for you, my Witness. 

The capture of her race will flow out from this realm—each self-satisfied smirk will forge a new link in their chains.

Had I known then what my current quandary would be, I could have heeded my own insights on ego. Regardless, even in this predicament, I am unbowed.
2504952530.lore_zh:
在我看来，她就如一只青蛙；小而鲜艳，毒不可触。

以您无限的智慧，您的目光超脱了我带给你的蠕虫，看向了侵扰虫群据点那最不起眼的水蛭。缩减了我的馈赠，您用征服的方式感染了他们，如今他们把自己看作是终焉之形的工匠。

我的职责不是理解您，我的见证者，而是为了您比我更清楚的最终目标服务。但现在，您的金叶寄生虫自居为神，并开辟了他们的神圣家园。我要去探望那只哭哭啼啼的青蛙了。

这算是责罚吗？为我在阿赫斯利德人身上的失败所付出的代价？您把我和我的自尊再度抛进了一个无足轻重的世界里的冰冷深渊。

我记得踏入她的领地时，她的脸扭曲着，流露出难以抑制的喜悦。她认为自己就是您租借给她的这块领地的女主人。她没有，也不可能，意识到她摇摇欲坠的处境。她对自己的统治是如此自信，甚至认不出她的狱卒来，也未曾意识到她生活在一个由她的自负所打造的监狱里——我为您而启用的监狱，我的见证者。 

对她种族的追捕将涌出这个领域，每一次自鸣得意的笑容都将为他们的锁链铸就新的一环。

如果当时我知道我如今的困境，就会留意到我自己对自负的看法。不管怎样，即使在这种窘况之中，我也绝不屈服。

1379769261.name: Resonant Fury Boots
1379769261.flavor: I sought relief. I found delight.
1379769261.lore:
She builds a palace here in her hiding place, and I perceive through her self-assurance. For all her grandiose treatises on secrets, the Hive princess all but screams, "Look upon me."

And so I look upon her today, my Witness, absent a brother. Loss—true and consequential loss—is new to her palette, but she hides her distaste for the bitter well. I address her. "Savathûn, your brother is no more. He is absent from the final shape of things, as he always must be. But I sense a foreign hand at work."

"Would you accuse rather than state, Rhulk?" She clothes herself in playful tones. "I have played a role in more of my brother's deaths than not."

"So very true. Congratulations, then? I suppose after so many eons of killing one another to build your strength, his final end must feel like quite the accomplishment. No more must your wits dabble against his play-mortality. Now, only matters of consequence will occupy your precious time."

"And thankfully, I find myself well-provisioned now for any conflict."

"Ah! I had nearly forgotten! You are the heir apparent to Oryx's dominion, yes? I know you Hive are loathe to accept gifts rather than seize them. Armies. Fleets. And of course, the Taken."

"If I had seen this coming, perhaps I could have even prepared to secure the secret of Taking itself."

I bark in amusement. She makes no attempt to hide her distaste for the laughter of my kind, and it is indulgence itself to let it flow freely. "Clever. Always one step ahead. The Taken will serve you well against the Guardians until they slay you just the same."

"My sweet, vile brother would look at a scalpel and see a hammer. I am not him."

"Yes, you do seem to find much more creative uses for your playthings. A pity that will become ever so challenging for you moving forward."
"Challenging?" I do not see confusion cross her face often. I savor the scent.

"Until now, the shadow from which you skulked has been your brother's. Without the Taken King to cast your swaddling shade, you stand naked in the sun for all to see, yes? No shadows, no hiding, no tricks. Just the Guardians and their god-slaying weapons."

"I have little to fear from the sun," she insists, but there is no twist in her face. No secret delight.
1379769261.lore_zh:
她在藏身之处建起了一座宫殿，我感到了她的胸有成竹。这名标榜隐秘的邪魔族公主就差喊出声来了，“快来看看我。”

所以今天我去看了她，我的见证者，她兄弟不在场。对她来说，丧失，真实而重要的那种丧失，算是新鲜事，但她很好地掩饰了对愤恨的厌恶。我告诉她。“萨瓦图恩，你兄弟已经不在了。他一如既往地缺席了事物的终态。但我感觉到有一只外来的手在干涉。”

“你能直接指责我，而不是拐弯抹角吗？胡克？”她装出一副顽皮的腔调。“我兄弟的死大部分都与我有关。”

“的确如此。那就恭喜你吧？我想，在经过无数个世纪的自相残杀来增强你的力量过后，他最后的结局一定让你很有成就感吧。你的智慧再也不需要与他的死亡游戏作斗争了。现在，只有要紧的事情才配占据你宝贵的时间了。”

“谢天谢地，我发现自己现在已经为任何冲突做好了充分的准备。”

“啊！我差点忘了！你显然是欧里克斯领地的继承人，对吧？我知道你们邪魔族比起夺取礼物，更讨厌去接受它们。军队、舰队，当然，还有傀儡军团。”

“如果我预见到了这一点，也许我甚至可以准备好保守傀儡军团本身的秘密。”

我开心地大笑起来。她毫不掩饰她对我这种笑声的厌恶，让这种厌恶自由地流露出来，这本身就是一种放纵。“真聪明。总是棋高一着。傀儡军团会很好地帮助你对付守护者，直到他们同样杀死你为止。”

“我那亲爱的、糟透了的兄弟会把手术刀看成锤子。我可不是他。”

“没错，你似乎为你的玩物找到了更多富有创造性的用途。遗憾的是，这对你来说将变得越来越有挑战性。”
“挑战性？”我不常看到她脸上露出困惑的神色。我细细品味着这气息。

“到目前为止，你一直躲在你兄弟的阴影里。没有了邪神为你遮风挡雨，你就会在众目睽睽之下赤裸裸地站在阳光之中，对吧？无荫可栖，无处躲藏，无计可施。只有守护者和他们的弑神武器。”

“我用不着害怕太阳，”她坚持道，但脸上没有一丝扭曲的笑意或暗藏的喜悦。

“到目前为止，你一直躲在你兄弟的阴影里。没有了邪神为你遮风挡雨，你就会在众目睽睽之下赤裸裸地站在阳光之中，对吧？无荫可栖，无处躲藏，无计可施。只有守护者和他们的弑神武器。”

“我用不着害怕太阳，”她坚持道，但脸上没有一丝扭曲的笑意或暗藏的喜悦。
