3640316102.name: Seventh Seraph Gloves
3640316102.lore:
Chapter 3: For a Friend

Voronin found cover under uprooted trees and demolished vehicles as he made his way through the catastrophic weather. He could hardly believe he was still alive, bearing witness to the end of all things.

The storm encompassed the station, under siege from the elements. Civilians were being ushered toward the SMILE pods in droves as the lightning made its presence felt, igniting a nearby fuel supply. The explosion tore into the group, and as Voronin turned his head from the horror and the heat, he saw her. Roughly 250 meters away from the station. Morozova lay, singed and smoking, under rubble and ash.

Voronin pulled up his sensorium, but the electromagnetic fields in the air reduced it to static. There was no way to know if she was still alive or salvageable. She had treated him with respect despite outranking him, and she had been there for him when his marriage went to hell—

"We're all dead anyway," he thought and ran to her through the maelstrom of lightning and wind.

And then he was there, pulling off his gloves and wiping ash and blood from her face, as the storm bore down upon him.

As he made peace with his mortality, just shy of 82 years old, the storm around them calmed. The lightning stopped. The wind died. At the station, the civilians' eyes were fixed on the sky, though Voronin was looking only at Morozova. She was breathing, barely. Her eyes opened and met his. A half-smile came across her lips, then froze as her eyes went past him and widened in awe.

Voronin turned and found himself staring into the face of God.
3640316102.lore_zh:
第3章：为了朋友

沃罗宁穿越灾难性天气时，在连根拔起的树木和被毁车辆下找到了掩护之所。他几乎难以相信自己还活着，眼睁睁看着一切的灭亡。

这场暴风雨笼罩着站点，遭到了来自元素的围困。闪电出现后，点燃了附近的燃料供给，平民被驱赶到SMILE吊舱。爆炸把他们撕成碎片，沃罗宁惊恐地从热浪中转过头来，看见了她。大概距离站点250米远。莫洛佐娃躺着，被掩藏在碎石和灰尘下，浑身焦黑冒着烟。

沃罗宁拿出他的感应器，但空气中的电磁场将其显示的读数杂乱不堪。没办法知道她是否还活着，还能不能救。尽管他的官衔不如她，但她一直尊重他，当他的婚姻一团糟时，她也一直在他身边……

“我们反正都会死的。”他这样想着，然后穿过闪电和狂风的漩涡冲向了她。

然后他跑到了那里，暴风雨降临在他身上，他脱下手套，擦掉脸上的灰烬和鲜血。

就在他与不到82岁的死亡命运和解时，周围的风暴平息了。闪电也停止了。风也停了。在焊点里，平民的眼睛盯着天空，而沃罗宁的目光只盯着莫洛佐娃。她还在呼吸，虽然奄奄一息。她睁开眼睛，看见了他。她的唇角绽出微笑，然后目光越过他，突然因恐惧而瞪大了眼镜。

沃罗宁转过身，发自己自己正面对着神。

3571299690.name: Seventh Seraph Robes
3571299690.lore:
Chapter 2: Crashes

The first bolt of lightning sent static up Voronin's arm and filled the atmosphere around him with a pungent chlorine-like smell. His hand went to his chest without thinking, as if to make sure he was fully intact. His gaze shifted as a second bolt hit the ground near him, then another. He had never seen lightning so close before. Stunned, he stood his ground; while part of him knew he should be frightened for his life, he was more perplexed than afraid.

There was no rain. He looked toward the horizon, expecting clouds, expecting something, and only saw a shimmering curtain of blue lightning sifting toward him.

He raced for shelter in the surrounding field, abandoning his munitions container in the dust kicked up by his fevered stride. The strikes razed the ground, sparking wildfires and scorching stone. There was no logic to their timing, with bolts crashing so frequently, the sound of the thunder couldn't catch up.

He'd lost Morozova in the commotion. Already drained from hours spent hauling cargo, his mind recessed into primal instinct. RUN.

So he ran, doing his best to avoid the apocalypse that surrounded him. A call came through his earpiece as the ground quaked beneath him: "… auxiliary evac station…" was all he could make out before a roar of thunder swallowed the transmission.

He knew he needed to head west toward the station. The wind picked up and blew him off his feet, and again he felt a moment of sheer amazement at the storm's sudden ferocity. He hit the ground hard and checked his sensorium. It was scrambled from all the sinuous electricity undulating through the air, but he could just barely make out his compass. West. He ran.
3571299690.lore_zh:
第2章：坠毁

第一道闪电让沃罗宁的手臂上产生了静电，周围散发出刺鼻的氯味。没有经过思考，他的手立即伸向胸口，仿佛要确保自己完好无损。当第二道闪电撞到他附近的地面时，他的视线随之转移，然后又是一道。他从未如此近距离看过闪电。他惊呆了，站起身来。 虽然内心知道他应该为自己的生命而害怕，但相比较于害怕，他更感到疑惑。

没有雨。他看着地平线，期待着云层，期待着会有什么东西，但只看到一道闪烁的蓝色电幕朝他飞来。

他拼命奔跑，想在在周围的田野中找到庇身之所，在发狂的步伐所踢起的尘土中，他丢掉了弹药容器。闪电焚烧大地，引发野火，烧焦了石头。时机毫无逻辑，闪电频繁地爆裂，雷声尚且无法追击。

他在混乱中失去了莫洛佐娃。他已经花了数小时拖运货物，耗尽了精力，他的思想陷入了麻木的本能。快跑。

所以他开始跑，尽全力避开周围的灾难。当脚下的大地震动时，他的耳机里传来个声音：“……辅助撤离点……”这是在雷声吞没信号之前他能听到的所有信息。

他知道他必须往西，朝站点走。再次起风了，吹着他双脚几乎离开地面，他再次感觉到风暴突入起来的凶猛。他猛地装上地面，检查他的传感器。它是从空中完全的电干扰而来，但是他几乎无法辨认出自己的指南针。向西，他开始奔跑。

4208117371.name: Seventh Seraph Bond
4208117371.flavor: "You can't leave me. Not like this." —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
4208117371.lore:
Chapter 5: Abhorrent Imperative

Voronin tied his armband tight around her calf to cut off the blood flow from Morozova's gaping wound. He tried to keep her leg clean while the wind caked them with dirt and debris. Lightning was drawing closer. The sterile scent of ozone had returned and he knew he didn't have much time. "COME BACK!" he shouted hopelessly to the God. He hoisted Morozova up, supporting her on his shoulder, and pushed back against the elements that were conspiring against him.

It was 250 meters to the evac station. Every step was a battle of attrition. At this point, the thought of coldsleep sounded comforting. He just had to make it to the SMILE pods. The storm had other plans. A nearby HMMWV was struck by a wayward bolt and the explosion threw them back. He felt Morozova torn from his side as he landed, and the sound of his skull hitting stone was louder than the thunder had been. As blackness crept into his vision, he saw the Traveler in the sky, moving away, abandoning him.

…and then he was being dragged from the wreckage and violence onto a gurney. "…Morozova?" he struggled out. He was met with an oxygen mask. His eyes darted, in search of some sign that Morozova was alive. Voronin couldn't decipher anything out of the pandemonium around him. "I'm sorry," he thought to himself while cursing the orb in the sky for deserting him.

The last thing he remembered before they placed him into coldsleep was an explosion in the sky so bright it blinded him.
4208117371.lore_zh:
第5章：令人厌恶的命令

沃罗宁将臂带紧紧地绑在小腿上，以阻止莫洛佐娃的巨大伤口继续流血。风将灰尘和碎屑吹到他们脚上，他努力保持她的腿清洁。闪电越来越近了。臭氧的无菌气味又回来了，他知道自己没有太多时间。“快回来！”他绝望地朝着神喊道。他举起莫洛佐娃，架着她的肩膀，抵抗着围绕在他周围的元素们。

距离撤离站点250米远。每一步都是消耗战。在这个时候，冷冻睡眠的念头是如此令人舒适。他必须赶到SMILE吊舱。风暴可不这么想。附近的一辆HMMWV被闪电击中，爆炸把他们击退。他落地时感到莫洛佐娃从他身边被拉开，他的头骨撞到石头的声音比雷声响亮。当黑暗笼罩着他的视线，他看到了天空中的旅行者，逐渐离开，抛弃了他。

……他被从废墟中拖了出来，拽到一个轮床上。“……莫洛佐娃？”他挣扎问道。引入眼帘的是一个氧气面罩。他的双眼急切搜寻，想找寻找莫洛佐娃还活着的迹象。沃罗宁无法从他身边的哄闹中找到任何有用的信息。“我很抱歉，”他在诅咒天空中的球体抛弃他时，这样想到。

在他们进入冷冻睡眠状态之前，他记得的最后一件事是天上的爆炸如此明亮，他什么都看不见了。

3706448895.name: Seventh Seraph Hood
3706448895.flavor: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
3706448895.lore:
Chapter 1: Out for Delivery

Voronin nearly dropped the munitions he was carrying, which would have been a disaster for everyone in the vicinity. Certainly not as bad as whatever calamity they were prepping for, but bad enough to warrant the panic that coursed through his body. He hated these kinds of assignments.

"Hey, Morozova!" Voronin called out to his ranking officer between heavy gasps. "Any idea where all these are going?"

Morozova carefully placed her container on the ground, as if she was laying a child to bed. "No clue. Word just came from on high to double-time it, though. Something about Titan has got everyone spooked."

Voronin removed his helmet and wiped the sweat from his brow. Titan? What the hell happened out there? Comms had been spotty and the orders that did get through were light on details: Procure munitions. Transpo munitions to coordinates provided. Stockpile munitions. Repeat. No HMMWVs either. This was meant to be low profile, staying off the roads.

Where was all this firepower going, and what were we going to do with it when it got there? Voronin picked up his container and his pace.

He trudged just shy of a click behind Morozova for what felt like hours. These containers were cumbersome and it was the height of the driest summer he could remember.

When they reached their destination, they received a cursory greeting from Bykov, who was busy compiling a list of all the deliverables. Two soldiers, whom Voronin didn't recognize, were placing the containers in the mouth of a shaft that protruded from the ground. One punched in a command and the shipment vanished below the surface with a hollow pneumatic "whoomp."

"Where does that go?" Voronin asked. Bykov's brows drew together and his expression hardened. He returned to his list.

"Ready for the next round?" Morozova posed with more spunk than Voronin could muster in a year.

"If we must."

The sky grew gray, and clouds formed overhead as they left. Procure, repeat.
3706448895.lore_zh:
第1章：外出送货

沃罗宁差点丢掉他携带的弹药，这对附近所有人来说都会是场灾难。当然，这并没有他们准备应付的灾难那么糟糕，但足以使恐慌蔓延他的身体。他讨厌这类任务。

“喂，莫洛佐娃！”沃罗宁喘粗气的间隙，喊着他的长官。“知道这些东西要送去哪里吗？”

莫洛佐娃小心地把容器放在地上，好像在把孩子放在床上一样。“不知道。高层人只说加快速度。好像是土卫六让所有人都惊慌不已。”

沃罗宁移除了面具，擦了擦眉毛下的汗水。土卫六？那里到底发生了什么？通讯时好时坏，命令也没有太多细节：取得弹药。将弹药送往指定的坐标。存储弹药。重复步骤。也没有高机动多功能战车。这原本该是个秘密任务，远离大路。

所有这些军火都去了哪里，到达那里时我们将如何处理？沃罗宁抱起箱子，继续工作。

他在莫洛佐娃身后几步，感觉像过了几个小时一样漫长。这些箱子很麻烦，这是他记忆中最干燥的一个夏天。

当他们到达目的地时，他们收到了拜科夫的简单问候，他正忙着整理所有可交付成果的清单。两个沃罗宁不认识的士兵，将这些容器放在从地面伸出的竖井口中。其中一个人下达命令，然后随着空心的气动“嗡嗡声”，货物在地表下方消失。

“东西去了哪里？”沃罗宁问道。拜科夫的眉头皱在一起，他的表情更加严峻。他转过身看着清单。

“下一轮准备好了吗？”莫洛佐娃展现了沃罗宁需要一年才能积攒的勇气。

“如果我们一定要的话。”

天空变成了灰色，在他们离开时，头顶形成了乌云。获取，重复。

3623802816.name: Seventh Seraph Boots
3623802816.lore:
Chapter 4: Face to Face

Voronin's mouth hung agape. His lungs forgot how to breathe. His heart rate accelerated, his stomach turned, and he weakly wondered if this was his transition to the afterlife. Somehow he found his footing and stood.

The Traveler, they called it. He had heard the stories from throughout the system, but never did he think he would live to see it. Now it was as though it was seeing him.

He took a step forward as if it would bring him closer to the oblate spheroid in the sky above him. He stumbled. The ground had gotten so hot under him, the rubber on his boots had melted. A banal thought cut through his awe—"Now I look like a fool in front of the Traveler"—and he was ashamed.


The sound of cracking thunder still echoed in the distance. That was when he noticed he was in the eye of the storm. It was wailing all around him, but calm in his general circumference. Surely this was the Traveler's doing. The great savior. He grabbed Morozova, unsure of how long this would last, and brought her to her feet. She was badly injured, bleeding from a wound on her leg.

"Stay with me." He said to Morozova and the Traveler at once. Only one of them listened. The Traveler was on the move, and the storm was returning.
3623802816.lore_zh:
第4章：面对面

沃罗宁的嘴巴大张着。他的肺忘记了该如何呼吸。他的心跳加速，胃里翻江倒海，他怀疑自己是不是要转世投胎了。然后突然他找到了立足点，又站立起来。

他们称之为的旅行者。他从整个星系都听过这些故事，但是他从来没有想过会活着看到它。现在好像它在看着他。

他向前迈了一步，似乎这样能让他更靠近上方天空中的球形物体。他蹒跚前行。他脚下的大地如此炽热，靴子上的碎石都融化了。一个无聊的想法减轻了他的敬畏感——“现在，我在旅行者面前就像个傻瓜。”他感到羞愧。


刺耳的雷声仍在远处回荡。这时他才注意到自己在暴风眼之中。周围全是呼啸声，但他周围还算平静。当然，都是旅行者的杰作。伟大的救世主。他抓着莫洛佐娃，不知道这种状况会持续多久，然后让莫洛佐娃站了起来。她受伤很重，腿上的伤口不断流血。

“留下来。”他同时对莫洛佐娃和旅行者说道。只有一个人听到了。旅行者仍在移动，风暴回归。

3306445147.name: Wildwood Gloves
3306445147.flavor: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay

601487797.name: Wildwood Robes
601487797.flavor: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay

3594049672.name: Wildwood Bond
3594049672.flavor: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
3594049672.lore:
Right, well… I'm afraid you won't get far with that attitude. Hawthorne doesn't care about that "Trials of Osiris" rubbish. Gilded armor can't feed hungry refugees. And don't go nattering on with that "Guardian" business either, not where she can hear you. There are no "Guardians" out here. To her, anyone that can pick up a gun and shoot is a "Guardian." 

I know you're new here. You've done a lot, seen a lot. And I know Hawthorne can be a bit rough around the edges, eh? But listen to her. What she says is sound: "Look out for each other. Don't do anything stupid. Pitch in where you can." She's not claiming to be one of your Vanguard. She is simply doing what she feels is her duty—defending those under her protection until all are safe and we can rebuild what we've lost.
3594049672.lore_zh:
好吧，行……恐怕你这种态度不会走得太远。霍桑可不在乎那个什么“奥斯里斯试炼”的垃圾。镀金的防护能喂饱饥饿的难民吗？而且不要对那个“守护者”的事感到歉意，也不要让她听见你这么说。这里没有“守护者”。对她来说，能拿枪开火的就是“守护者”。

我知道你刚来这里。我知道你成就非凡，见多识广。霍桑不是个完人，是吧？但要听她的话。她是这么说的：“互相帮助。别做蠢事。能做尽量做好。”她不是说要做个先锋。她就是做她觉得职责范围内应当要做的——护卫她要保护的人们直到大家都安全，我们可以重建失去的一切。

2881668722.name: Wildwood Cover
2881668722.flavor: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay

1756485325.name: Wildwood Boots
1756485325.flavor: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay

3574967478.name: Exodus Down Gloves
3574967478.flavor: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise

3722582138.name: Exodus Down Robes
3722582138.flavor: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

3371035467.name: Exodus Down Bond
3371035467.flavor: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.

1461412143.name: Exodus Down Hood
1461412143.flavor: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe

492382480.name: Exodus Down Boots
492382480.flavor: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova

1402155924.name: Reverie Dawn Gloves
1402155924.flavor: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
1402155924.lore:
She travels across the Ascendant Plane.

The voyage across the sea of screams threatens to erode her edges as no other trial ever has. In Oryx's throne world, she had a semblance of an identity. Treasure. Spoil of war. Defeated queen. Repugnant and alien and Not Me, but she could use these contortions as guideposts to trace her way back to herself.

Here in the emptiness between throne worlds, she has nothing but what she can carry.

The burden is growing heavier, but she is not alone.

He tries to speak to her from a place of high contempt. In doing so, he invites her into his topography.

She steps out of howling and finds her footing upon a plane of swords and madness and all-consuming curiosity.

"Who are you?"

The question summons an almost-forgotten answer deep within the rapidly solidifying shape of her.

"I AM MARA SOV. STARLIGHT WAS MY MOTHER, AND MY FATHER WAS THE DARK."

The thing that once was called Toland flees before her darkness/light/shadow/majesty. And she rests within this scrap of a world, before resuming her journey through the Howling.
1402155924.lore_zh:
她横渡上维位面。

穿越尖叫之海比她遇到的任何一次试炼都更为严峻，不断侵蚀着她的极限。在欧里克斯的王座世界里，她似乎有一个身份。宝藏、战利品、战败的女王、令人厌恶的外星人，她可以凭借这些扭曲的词汇当成路标找回自己。

在王座世界之间的虚空中，她只能够背负她可以承担的。

负担越来越重，不过她并非孤身一人。

他试图居高临下地与她对话。因此，他邀请她进入自己的领域。

她穿越了尖叫之海，发现自己来到了一片充斥着战争、疯狂和狂热好奇心的位面。.

“你是谁？”

这个问题在她迅速固化的的形态中唤起了一个几乎被遗忘的答案。

“我是玛拉·索维。星光是我的母亲，黑暗是我的父亲。”

那个我们曾经称为托兰的人，在黑暗/光明/暗影/王权面前逃得无影无踪。在她重新踏上旅途之前，她在这块破碎的世界中小憩了一会儿。

1144358828.name: Reverie Dawn Tabard
1144358828.flavor: "There is a place where we can remember who we are." —Imogen Rife
1144358828.lore:
She feels Oryx's true death in both halves of her soul, a full imagined exhale before the aftershock reaches his throne world.

It crumbles around her like stone, like ash, like veils in a breeze.

Eris Morn's friends have succeeded. The Guardians have slain a god.

She steps through the ruins. In the end, there is nothing. Nothing but Mara Sov and the howling of rampant, untamed logics.

Her great and terrible gamble has paid off.

The rest is up to her now.
1144358828.lore_zh:
她那分成两半的灵魂都感受到了欧里克斯的死亡，在余震抵达他的王座世界之前，她在蒸汽中想象出了一幅完整的画面。

它在她周围瓦解，如沙石，如灰烬，如微风中的面纱。

埃里斯·摩恩的朋友们已经成功了。守护者已经杀死了一位神明。

她穿过废墟。尽头，一无所有。有的只是玛拉·索维和狂暴的嚎叫声，以及难以捉摸的逻辑现实。

她孤注一掷的豪赌终于有了收获。

接下来就看她的了。

3843014113.name: Reverie Dawn Bond
3843014113.flavor: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
3843014113.lore:
She is home.

But it is not the same.

Shuro Chi has been Taken. Kalli and Sedia, too.

And Riven—

She used to sit in the shade of those wings. Laugh at the riddles that rumbled in that mercurial throat.

This creature is all teeth and broken promises, transformed by the expectations of another scheming, secretive sister.

"I cannot stay here."

These are the first words that pass through this throat. Her throat, though it shares none of the molecules that comprised the code of her former body. They scrape and ache as they pass through her lips.

Again, if only to remind herself that she is alive:

"I cannot stay here."
3843014113.lore_zh:
她到家了。

不过家已不再是当年的家。

秋露·知成为了傀儡。卡丽和赛迪娅也是。

还有魅痕——

她曾在那对翅膀的荫庇下，嘲笑着那些从易变喉咙里发出的模糊字句。

这生物攻击性极强且十分恶毒，是被她那诡计多端、行事隐秘的姐姐转化而成的。

“我不能留在这里。”

这是喉咙里挤出的第一句话。她的喉咙，尽管这个身体已经没有残留之前身体的任何分子。词句滑过唇舌带来的是撕扯和疼痛。

如果要说有什么能让她意识到自己还活着，那便是：

“我不能留在这里。”

663055813.name: Reverie Dawn Hood
663055813.flavor: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
663055813.lore:
She waits.

She trusts that Eris will shepherd the Guardians and that the infinite ambition of those undying half-children will deliver her. They will enter the court and challenge its king and dance in its killing ground, and they will master the school of sword logic so mightily that they will overturn its teacher and forsake the crown.

Soon.

But soon may not be soon enough, because Oryx roams the hallowed spires and melancholy shores of the Dreaming City. He stands looking out over the mists of her beautiful creation, and he laughs.

She can feel him there like a thorn in the meat of her palm.
She scolds herself for not factoring Shuro Chi's love into her design. Then she berates herself for this nervous energy, this fretful self-cannibalism.

Lungless, Mara remembers the sensation of a deep breath. Enacts it in her mind.

She remembers the singularity before her.

She waits.
663055813.lore_zh:
她在等待。

她相信埃里斯会带领那些守护者，那些充满野心不死不灭的小家伙们能实现她的愿望。他们会冲进朝堂，挑战王权，推翻统治。他们将超越自己的老师，领悟邪剑守则的真谛，权力再也无法束缚他们。

很快这一切就会成真。

不过很快也许还不够快，因为欧里克斯已经来到了幽梦之城，在神圣的尖塔与忧郁的海岸边徘徊。他站在一边，望着她亲手创造出的美丽迷雾开怀大笑。

她感受到他的存在，就像扎在手心里的一根刺一样。

她责怪自己没有把秋露·知的爱恋纳入设计。这种自责使她陷入了痛苦的自我否定和焦虑之中。

尽管已经没有了肺，玛拉依然记得深吸一口气时的感觉，那种感觉深深地印在她的脑海中。

她记得眼前那个奇点。

她在等待。

1265437086.name: Reverie Dawn Boots
1265437086.flavor: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
1265437086.lore:
Joy wells in her heart when her searching fingers trace the edges of Eleusinia.

She has passed through the desert. She has reached the far side of the chessboard. She is alive, or soon will be.

She opens the door and her joy dies on the threshold.

Her throne world is desecrated.

Not annihilated, as Oryx's was. The pillars and terraces and courtyards still retain their shape. But the roots have rotted, and the geometry festers.

She should have known she would not be the only one to plan for such eventualities.

Oryx's bootprints pucker like scars in the labyrinth that was once only her own.

She sits a while beneath Sjur's statue, then follows his tracks through the ruins of Eleusinia, back to the Dreaming City.
1265437086.lore_zh:
当她搜索的手指发现了厄琉息斯的边界时，心中乐开了花。

她穿越了沙漠，她抵达了棋盘的另外一边。她还活着，或者说马上就重获新生了。

她打开了门，原本喜悦的心一下跌入谷底。

她的王座世界被玷污了。

与欧里克斯的不一样，这个世界并没有消失。巨大的圆柱、梯田和庭院依然保持着本来的面貌。不过根部已经腐烂，几何状态不断溃烂。

她应该知道虽然自己有计策，但别人也不会坐以待毙。

在这个曾经只有她自己脚印的迷宫里，欧里克斯的靴印犹如烙在她身上的一块块伤疤。

她在苏尔的雕像下坐了一会儿，然后跟随着他的足迹走过了厄琉息斯废墟，回到了幽梦之城。

1892366441.name: Dreambane Gloves
1892366441.flavor: "Their curses are now your charms. Hold such hatreds close, for they reveal their fears." —Eris Morn

469791215.name: Dreambane Robes
469791215.flavor: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn

1716949886.name: Dreambane Bond
1716949886.flavor: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn

1428562840.name: Dreambane Hood
1428562840.flavor: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn

2184308283.name: Dreambane Boots
2184308283.flavor: "You will go where none have gone before. Tread carefully." —Eris Morn

2382720962.name: Crystocrene Gloves
2382720962.flavor: "Busy hands are warm hands! Do your part for the colony in these extra-insulated work gloves." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

4143953830.name: Crystocrene Robes
4143953830.flavor: "Conserving body heat is key to staving off hypothermia; a serious risk on Europa." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

591435279.name: Crystocrene Bond
591435279.flavor: "Prepare for your arctic adventure with the very best in Bray outfitting!" —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

128816179.name: Crystocrene Hood
128816179.flavor: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

131899516.name: Crystocrene Boots
131899516.flavor: "Ultra-light ion-shielding keeps you protected AND mobile in a radiated, rapidly changing climate." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide

437403069.name: Veritas Gloves
437403069.flavor: "Truth is difficult. And that's fine. I don't trust anyone who doesn't like a challenge." —Chul Sobong, Hidden instructor

3006725699.name: Veritas Robe
3006725699.flavor: "You'll never know truth with real certainty. All you can do is hew away at preconception with the facts and pray that whatever shape's left at the end is a reasonable facsimile." —Dagget-4, Hidden analyst

2288429498.name: Veritas Bond
2288429498.flavor: "Lies are manufactured. Truth grows naturally… with or without a gardener." —Nayyir Gimenez, Warlock

490208484.name: Veritas Hood
490208484.flavor: "Life is lies. Comfort? Justice? Love? They're things we made up. Don't make the mistake of assuming true and false are the same as good and bad. What's important is being able to tell them apart." —Omar Saint Croix, Hidden handler

2803028703.name: Veritas Boots
2803028703.flavor: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator

4284293055.name: Thunderhead Gloves
4284293055.flavor: "That 10-year timer simplifies things, in a way. What's most important? Right here, right now? What one thing makes Neomuna better?" —Derecho, Cloud Strider

1271409273.name: Thunderhead Robes
1271409273.flavor: "We're momentary creatures, and the future is distant and vast. But many stones, in time, change the river's course." —Briar, Cloud Strider

3259089614.name: Thunderhead Cover
3259089614.flavor: "Iterate and advance. That's what we do. No time to dwell on failures, only learn from them." —Kestrel, Cloud Strider

3205543169.name: Thunderhead Boots
3205543169.flavor: "That's what it's all about, right? You only ever see the seeds. The plants are for the children. Metaphorically." —Myriadical, Cloud Strider

3010135860.name: Thunderhead Bond
3010135860.flavor: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider

1608373876.name: First Ascent Gloves
1608373876.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Caiatl wonders what waits inside the Traveler. She's heard the stories from Red Legion defectors about how it swallowed Ghaul like a warbeast choking down a bone. 

"He's still in its belly," a Valus on her War Council once told her, and Saladin Forge had made a breathy sound through his nose that Caiatl interpreted as laughter. 

That was days ago. Now she stands on the bridge of her ship, wondering what of Ghaul remains, the Traveler's glow reflected in the black of her eyes and the ornamental jewelry she wears on her tusks. She does not feel the pull of it, as she imagines Ghaul did, or even Saladin's quiet reverence. It is not a thing to be conquered or worshipped, but it is important to the people who are important to her—and that is all that matters. 

When she hears footsteps behind her, she does not turn. She already knows whom they belong to. 

"I did not request your counsel," she says without reprimand. "But if you have something to say, then speak." 

"Must I always have some wisdom for you?" Saladin asks. "Can't we simply await the end together in comfortable silence?" 

"Your worth is your wisdom. It's the only reason I let you live." 

Saladin makes that noise again. He knows that isn't true. 

And so does she.
1608373876.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

查厄托想知道旅行者内部会有什么在等着他们。她从猩红军团叛逃者那里听说过旅行者是如何像战兽啃食骨头一样吞下了盖欧。 

“他还在它的肚子里，”战争议会上的一名军政官曾经这样告诉查厄托，而她将萨拉丁·弗吉用鼻子发出的哼哼声理解为了嗤笑。 

那是两天前的事了。她现在站在她飞船的舰桥上，琢磨着盖欧还剩下了什么。旅行者的光芒映在她的漆黑眼珠和装饰獠牙的珠宝上。她没有感受到在她的想象中盖欧对它的渴求，也没有感受到萨拉丁对它的崇敬。它不是一种该被征服或膜拜的东西，但它对那些对她很重要的人来说很重要——这才是重点。 

当她听到身后有脚步声时，她没有转身。她已经知道那是谁了。 

“我没有询问你的意见，”她说道，没有斥责的意思。“但如果你有话要讲，那就开口吧。” 

“难道我是位智慧导师？”萨拉丁问道。“我们就不能一起安静地等待终末吗？” 

“你的智慧是你的价值。那是我让你活着的唯一原因。” 

萨拉丁又发出了那种哼哼声。他知道那不是真的。 

而她也知道。

光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

查厄托想知道旅行者内部会有什么在等着他们。她从猩红军团叛逃者那里听说过旅行者是如何像战兽啃食骨头一样吞下了盖欧。 

“他还在它的肚子里，”战争议会上的一名军政官曾经这样告诉查厄托，而她将萨拉丁·弗吉用鼻子发出的哼哼声理解为了嗤笑。 

那是两天前的事了。她现在站在她飞船的舰桥上，琢磨着盖欧还剩下了什么。旅行者的光芒映在她的漆黑眼珠和装饰獠牙的珠宝上。她没有感受到在她的想象中盖欧对它的渴求，也没有感受到萨拉丁对它的崇敬。它不是一种该被征服或膜拜的东西，但它对那些对她很重要的人来说很重要——这才是重点。 

当她听到身后有脚步声时，她没有转身。她已经知道那是谁了。 

“我没有询问你的意见，”她说道，没有斥责的意思。“但如果你有话要讲，那就开口吧。” 

“难道我是位智慧导师？”萨拉丁问道。“我们就不能一起安静地等待终末吗？” 

“你的智慧是你的价值。那是我让你活着的唯一原因。” 

萨拉丁又发出了那种哼哼声。他知道那不是真的。 

而她也知道。

3555622028.name: First Ascent Robes
3555622028.flavor: Oh, to read a pulpy golden age detective novel…just once more.
3555622028.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Ikora studied the strange approximation of the Tower, dust kicked up around her as the wind gusted through creaking halls. She felt the pull to explore… to find her old office. To see just how deep the recreation would go. 

But as she took a step up the stairs, her foot caught something—a small but familiar rectangular shape. She picked up the book and gently brushed dust from the cover. It was a copy of "The Spine-Tingling Adventures of Sedona Kane, P.I." The pulpy cover art told her it was the fourth installment of the series, with the subtitle "The Curious Case of Doctor Pennyworth." 

Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Darkness. In a place of such potent Light, would it be enough to manifest… everything? She flipped through the book; even the coffee stain still adorned page 95. 

Flashes of memory came back to Ikora as she studied the bold colors and heavy lines of the book's tattered jacket. She recalled kicking her feet up against the wall in her bunk one night after a particularly nasty Crucible loss… Ophiuchus's glow providing just enough visibility. Remembered cleaning the spilled drink off the pages in the mess hall and praying there was no lasting damage. And thought of other moments, of a warm hand covering her own as she read the text out loud for the thousandth time… 

The Warlock held the book to her nose. Just to take in the scent once more.  

Light forgets, Darkness remembers, and so would she.
3555622028.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

艾可拉审视着这座近似高塔的奇特建筑。她周围的尘土随着破败大堂中的狂风扬起。她感受到了探索的渴望…她想找到她以前的办公室。看看这个复制品到底有多像。 

但刚踏上楼梯，她的脚就碰到了一件物品——它的形状小而熟悉。她拿起那本书，轻轻拂去封面上的灰尘。这是一本《私家侦探塞多纳·凯恩的惊奇历险记》。从它俗气的封面上可以看出，这是该系列的第四部，副标题是“潘尼沃斯医生奇案”。 

光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

暗影。在光能如此充足的地方，它是否能够显现…一切？她翻了翻书；甚至第95页上的咖啡渍都还在。 

当艾可拉打量着破旧书皮上大胆的色彩和厚重的线条时，她的记忆片段又闪现在了眼前。她回想起在熔炉竞技场中大败后，有一天夜里躺床上用脚蹬着墙…蛇夫座的光刚好够亮…在食堂里清理洒在书本上的饮料，祈祷没留下永久印记。她还想起，当她反复大声阅读时，一只温暖的手覆在自己的手上… 

这位术士把书抵到自己的鼻头，再一次感受它的气味。  

光能遗忘，暗影铭记，而她也会如此。

1493379009.name: First Ascent Bond
1493379009.flavor: There is nothing as exquisite as the feeling of doing what no one has done.
1493379009.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mara Sov grit her teeth as she held the H.E.L.M. steady, straining all the while to keep the portal open with her power just long enough for the Guardian, Ikora, and Commander Zavala to slip through. 

Mara shifted her focus to watch the live feed in the viewscreen beside her as the Guardian took their first steps into the Pale Heart. 

And instantly… she remembered what it felt like to be first. 

She remembered unending emptiness, the spark of protons, cold rock against her back, and the sensation of spilling upwards eternally. She remembered glacial till veined with platinum, a forest that spread as mycelium, and alpine saddles cradling crystal clear lakes. She remembered a world so young and old, where all life was equal, meaningless and meaningful. She remembered making that memory, that place, calling it awake from the cauldron of her own imagination and raising it into matter, her lips curled on its name. The Distributary. 

Mara would never see that world again, and yet, on the grainy video stuttering before her, was its doppelganger. It was not home, but it was close. 

The video feed sputtered out. 

A roar of violet streaked past the H.E.L.M., and with a sudden silence, the ship burst from the portal into open space. The portal did not snap shut behind them—the Witness must have let go. 

Mara caught her breath. Her hands shook. There was no sign of Crow in there, or on comms, no sign he was alive other than the tug on her own heart. She glanced back to the Traveler and the Pale Heart within.  

Mara Sov thought once more of home.
1493379009.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

玛拉·索维咬紧牙关，拼尽全力让应急后勤行动中心保持稳定，同时用她的力量保持传送门开启，让守护者、艾可拉、指挥官萨瓦拉有机会顺利通过。 

玛拉把注意力转移到身旁的屏幕上，通过直播画面看到守护者在苍白之心中迈出了第一步。 

忽然…她记起了身为先行者的感受。 

她记起了无尽的空虚，质子的火花，抵着后背的冰冷岩石，永远向上的延伸感。她记起了被铂金缠绕的冰川，像菌丝一样蔓延的森林，还有被高山环抱的清澈湖泊。她记起了一个如此年轻而古老的世界。在那里，所有的生命都平等，没有意义，也充满意义。她记起自己创造那段记忆，那个地方，把它从自己想象的大锅里唤醒，将它升华为物质，嘴角微微翘起说出它的名字：两仪界。 

玛拉再也见不到那个世界了。然而，在她面前不断卡顿的模糊视频中，她看见了那个世界的复制品。那不是家，但已经很接近了。 

视频信号中断了。 

一道紫色的光芒席卷了应急后勤行动中心，飞船里忽然安静下来。他们通过传送门冲进了无垠的太空，身后的传送门并没有关闭——见证者肯定是松手了。 

玛拉喘过气来。她的手在颤抖。里面没有乌鸦的踪迹，也没有来自他的通讯。除了心中的牵挂，没有任何迹象表明他还活着。她回头瞥了一眼旅行者和其中的苍白之心。  

玛拉·索维再次想起了家园。

869273765.name: First Ascent Hood
869273765.flavor: Choose what you will become next.
869273765.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Once, a Ghost was heard to speak thusly. 

This one is Luzaku. Here, this one tells what is known of Sky. 

Sky is the breath taken between actions. It permits speculation. It invites doubt. It slips from sight and grasp, and yet persists. 

This one's Ghost would have us yield to certainty. He wishes us to walk the Bladed Path, to seek Hive-strength in the Witch Queen's abandoned logic, whereby all things prove themselves in slaughter. 

This one turns from simple inevitability. This one makes a choice: this one does not kill and does not die. Yet this one exists. Aiat. What follows? What other choices are to be made? 

This one must know. 

This one hides within a blade-ship of the Witch Queen's great foe. This one's Ghost is angry now, but he remains. In the hollows where a worm once coiled, this one senses our swift motion through the firmament, toward a center. 

This one seeks Sky. In the Sky, there are many paths. 

In the Sky, there is change.
869273765.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

很久以前，一个机灵说过这些话。 

鄙人是鲁扎库，在此讲述鄙人对苍穹的了解。 

苍穹是行动之间的喘息。它允许猜测。它引人怀疑。它难以追踪和把握，却始终留存。 

鄙人的机灵希望我们屈服于确定性。他希望我们走上刀锋之道，寻求邪魔族的力量，遵从巫妖女王遭抛弃的逻辑，即万物需在屠杀中证明自身。 

鄙人放弃了简单的必然性。鄙人做出了选择：鄙人不杀，也不死亡。然而，鄙人仍然存在。阿特。接下来呢？还要做出什么选择？ 

鄙人必须知晓。 

鄙人躲在巫妖女王宿敌的刀锋飞船里。鄙人的机灵很生气，但他没有离去。在蠕虫曾经盘踞的深渊里，鄙人感知到我们正迅速穿过苍穹，前往中心。 

鄙人探寻苍穹。苍穹内有许多道路。 

苍穹内有变化。

1896112510.name: First Ascent Boots
1896112510.flavor: To enter the body of a deity would be to unquestionably defile it.
1896112510.lore:
Light forgets, Darkness remembers. 

Mithrax stood at the bow of the H.E.L.M., watching as Zavala's ship vanished from view into the portal. That awful gateway pulsed and wavered, and though the H.E.L.M. was pointed straight at it, he was resolved in his decision. 

The notion of venturing inside the Great Machine was innately revolting. It reeked like a taboo as certain as cannibalism, as unthinkable as besmirching a house of worship; to enter the body of a deity would unquestionably be to defile it. He could find a way to support from afar. Surely that was plausible.  

"Father, the Queen is asking for you." 

Eido sidles up next to him, and the two look out over the Great Machine. It takes up the entirety of the window—the center of all Light punctured by the oscillating violet of the portal, and Mithrax realizes how small he feels alongside his daughter. 

"I'm not going down there without you," she says. 

Mithrax holds back his shiver and confesses, "To step inside feels like a transgression." 

"And who made that rule?" she says. Ever acute, ever wise. When Mithrax cannot answer, she continues, "The Traveler is in peril. So long as we can care, we are bound to enter and defend it. I have seen you still have fight in you, Father." 

"Would that not be worse? To wage war at the very center of Light?" 

"Only you can decide that. But I believe the Traveler would want you to enter the portal." 

"Why?" 

His daughter puts a loving hand on his own. "Because it knows you aren't there to hurt it."
1896112510.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

米瑟拉克斯站在应急后勤行动中心的船首，注视着萨瓦拉的飞船从视野中消失，进入传送门。那道可怕的大门在脉动和摇摆，尽管应急后勤行动中心正对着它，但他已经下定了决心。 

进入大机器内部的想法令他反感。像同类相食一般让人厌恶，像糟蹋圣堂一般难以想象；进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。他可以想办法从远处进行支援。他认为那是在理的。  

“父亲，女王在找你。” 

艾多走到他的身边。两人眺望着大机器。它填满了整个窗户——这位光能之神的中心，被传送门的震荡之紫刺穿了，米瑟拉克斯意识到自己和女儿在其身边是多么渺小。 

“没有你，我不会进去，”她说。 

米瑟拉克斯强忍着冷颤承认道，“进去像是一种亵渎。” 

“那种规则是谁定的？”她反问道。一如既往地机敏、睿智。米瑟拉克斯不知如何回答，而她还在继续，“旅行者正处于危险之中。只要我们还关爱它，我们就必须进去保护它。我知道你还有斗志，父亲。” 

“那样不是更糟糕吗？在光能的中心作战？” 

“那取决于你。但我相信旅行者会希望你进入传送门。” 

”为什么？“ 

他的女儿把一只充满爱意的手放在他的手背上。“因为它知道你不是去伤害它的。”

"And who made that rule?" she says. Ever acute, ever wise. When Mithrax cannot answer, she continues, "The Traveler is in peril. So long as we can care, we are bound to enter and defend it. I have seen you still have fight in you, Father." 

"Would that not be worse? To wage war at the very center of Light?" 

"Only you can decide that. But I believe the Traveler would want you to enter the portal." 

"Why?" 

His daughter puts a loving hand on his own. "Because it knows you aren't there to hurt it."
1944622828.lore_zh:
光能遗忘，暗影铭记。 

米瑟拉克斯站在应急后勤行动中心的船首，注视着萨瓦拉的飞船从视野中消失，进入传送门。那道可怕的大门在脉动和摇摆，尽管应急后勤行动中心正对着它，但他已经下定了决心。 

进入大机器内部的想法令他反感。像同类相食一般让人厌恶，像糟蹋圣堂一般难以想象；进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。他可以想办法从远处进行支援。他认为那是在理的。  

“父亲，女王在找你。” 

艾多走到他的身边。两人眺望着大机器。它填满了整个窗户——这位光能之神的中心，被传送门的震荡之紫刺穿了，米瑟拉克斯意识到自己和女儿在其身边是多么渺小。 

“没有你，我不会进去，”她说。 

米瑟拉克斯强忍着冷颤承认道，“进去像是一种亵渎。” 

“那种规则是谁定的？”她反问道。一如既往地机敏、睿智。米瑟拉克斯不知如何回答，而她还在继续，“旅行者正处于危险之中。只要我们还关爱它，我们就必须进去保护它。我知道你还有斗志，父亲。” 

“那样不是更糟糕吗？在光能的中心作战？” 

“那取决于你。但我相信旅行者会希望你进入传送门。” 

”为什么？“ 

他的女儿把一只充满爱意的手放在他的手背上。“因为它知道你不是去伤害它的。”

2420567618.description_zh: 向肆虐幽梦之城的诅咒发起反击。

1652224118.name: Luna's Calling
1652224118.description: Complete the "Memory" quest for Eris to find mementos of her lost fireteam.
1652224118.description_zh: 帮助埃里斯完成“记忆”任务，为她找回死去的火力战队成员的纪念物。

1257909267.name: Luna's Calling
1257909267.description: Use Eris's portal in Sanctuary to go collect your reward in the Enduring Abyss.
1257909267.description_zh: 在埃里斯位于避难所的传送门处领取你在无尽深渊中的奖励。

1361772227.name: Dawning Duty
1361772227.description: Return to the Tower for powerful rewards.
1361772227.description_zh: 回去高塔领取强力奖励。

3968129300.name: Collect Candy
3968129300.description: Collect Candy by defeating combatants anywhere in the system while wearing a Festival of the Lost mask.
3968129300.description_zh: 在装备一件英灵日面具的情况下在星系任意地点击败敌人来收集糖果。

3968129301.name: Just Desserts
3968129301.description: Return to Eva in the Tower Courtyard.
3968129301.description_zh: 返回高塔庭院拜访伊娃。

3798174846.name: Return to the Arbor of Light

235305603.name: A Few More Couldn't Hurt
235305603.description: Now that you've warmed up Eva's Holiday Oven, use the skills you've learned to bake a few more treats.
235305603.description_zh: 既然伊娃的节日烤箱温度升了起来，利用你学到的技能来再烤制一些点心吧。

1975231911.name: A Baking Break
1975231911.description: The fires of the oven are low once more. Visit Tess Everis in the Tower Courtyard for a reward.
1975231911.description_zh: 烤箱的火力再次减弱。拜访在高塔庭院里的泰斯·艾夫瑞斯以获取奖励。

2934007708.name: Welcome to Crimson Days
2934007708.description: Speak to Shaxx in the Tower.
2934007708.description_zh: 前往高塔与沙克斯交谈。

1098618399.name: Irradiant Contender
1098618399.description: Land Void final blows or final blows with the Prismatic subclass equipped in the Guardian Games Rushdown or Vanguard Ops playlists. Higher Rushdown scores and defeating combatants with Super or precision damage grants additional progress.
1098618399.description_zh: 在守护者游戏急速强攻或先锋行动游戏列表中造成虚空最后一击或装备棱镜分支职业造成最后一击。更高的急速强攻得分与超能，以及用超能或精准伤害击败战斗人员可提供额外进度。

1098618398.name: Galvanic Contender
1098618398.description: Land Arc or Void final blows in Guardian Games Rushdown or strikes. Higher Rushdown scores, grenade final blows, and rapidly defeating combatants grants additional progress.
1098618398.description_zh: 在守护者游戏急速强攻或打击中造成电弧或虚空最后一击。更高的急速强攻得分与超能，手雷最后一击以及快速击败战斗人员可提供额外进度。

1098618397.name: Electric Contender
1098618397.description: Land Arc final blows or final blows with the Prismatic subclass equipped in Guardian Games Rushdown or strikes. Higher Rushdown scores and defeating combatants with melee abilities or finishers grants additional progress.
1098618397.description_zh: 在守护者游戏急速强攻或打击中造成虚空最后一击或装备棱镜分支职业造成最后一击。更高的急速强攻得分与超能，以及用近战技能或终结技击败战斗人员可提供额外进度。

1077245331.name: Illuminated Strategies
1077245331.description:
Get final blows and assists with Light abilities and debuffs in Gambit. 

Completing Gambit activities grants additional progress.
1077245331.description_zh:
在智谋中使用光能技能和减益取得最后一击和助攻。

完成智谋活动可提供额外进度。

1077245330.name: Shadowy Maneuvers
1077245330.description:
Get final blows and assists with Dark debuffs in Gambit. 

Completing Gambit activities grants additional progress.
1077245330.description_zh:
在智谋中使用暗影减益取得最后一击和助攻。

完成智谋活动可提供额外进度。

1077245329.name: Ammo Artifice
1077245329.description:
Get final blows, precision final blows, or rapidly defeat targets with weapons in Gambit. 

Completing Gambit activities grants additional progress.
1077245329.description_zh:
在智谋中使用武器取得最后一击、精准最后一击或快速击败目标。

完成智谋活动可提供额外进度。

2809262148.name: Blinding Radiance
2809262148.description:
Get final blows with Arc, Void, or Solar weapons or abilities. 

Completing Crucible Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
2809262148.description_zh:
使用电弧、虚空、烈日武器或技能取得最后一击。

以较高评级完成熔炉竞技场行动活动可提供额外进度。

2809262149.name: Night's Crucible
2809262149.description:
Get final blows with Stasis, Strand, or Kinetic weapons, or with abilities or shatter damage. 

Completing Crucible Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
2809262149.description_zh:
使用冰影、缚丝、动能武器或技能，或碎裂伤害取得最后一击。

以较高评级完成熔炉竞技场行动活动可提供额外进度。

2809262150.name: Munitions Challenge
2809262150.description:
Get final blows with your weapons in Crucible Ops. 

Completing Crucible Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
2809262150.description_zh:
在熔炉竞技场行动中使用你的武器取得最后一击。

以较高评级完成熔炉竞技场行动活动可提供额外进度。

1799098213.name: Unerring Contender
1799098213.description: Land Void final blows or final blows with the Prismatic subclass equipped in an Episodic activity. Defeating combatants with precision damage and with weapons using Special ammo grants additional progress. Completing activities on a higher difficulty grants massively increased progress.
1799098213.description_zh: 在篇章活动中造成虚空最后一击或装备棱镜分支职业造成最后一击。用精准伤害并使用特殊弹药武器击败战斗人员可提供额外进度。完成更高难度的活动可提供大量进度。

1799098212.name: Steadfast Contender
1799098212.description: Land Void or Arc final blows in an Episodic activity. Rapidly defeating combatants and landing final blows with weapons using Heavy ammo grants additional progress. Completing an activity on a higher difficulty grants massively increased progress.
1799098212.description_zh: 在篇章活动中造成虚空或电弧最后一击。快速击败战斗人员并用重型弹药武器造成最后一击可获得额外进度。完成更高难度的活动可提供大量进度。

1799098215.name: Decisive Contender
1799098215.description: Land Arc final blows or final blows with the Prismatic subclass equipped in an Episodic activity. Defeating combatants with finishers and landing final blows with weapons using Primary ammo grants additional progress. Completing an activity on a higher difficulty grants massively increased progress.
1799098215.description_zh: 在篇章活动中造成电弧最后一击或装备棱镜分支职业造成最后一击。用终结技击败战斗人员并使用主弹药武器造成最后一击可提供额外进度。完成更高难度的活动可提供大量进度。

1038478538.name: Leading Edge Luminesce
1038478538.description:
Get final blows with Light abilities in the Lawless Frontier. 

Defeating opposing Guardians and exfil from the Lawless Frontier with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1038478538.description_zh:
在无序边界中使用光能技能取得最后一击。

击败敌对守护者和以较高评级撤离无序边界可提供额外进度。

1038478539.name: Stark Stunner
1038478539.description: Get final blows with Dark abilities in the Lawless Frontier. Defeating opposing Guardians and exfil from the Lawless Frontier with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1038478539.description_zh: 在无序边界中使用暗影技能取得最后一击。击败敌对守护者和以较高评级撤离无序边界可提供额外进度。

1038478536.name: First Pioneer
1038478536.description:
Get final blows with weapons in the Lawless Frontier. 

Defeating opposing Guardians and exfil from the Lawless Frontier with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1038478536.description_zh:
在无序边界中使用武器取得最后一击。

击败敌对守护者和以较高评级撤离无序边界可提供额外进度。

1709644009.name: Lit Solitude
1709644009.description:
Get final blows or assists with Light debuffs in Solo Ops. 

Completing Solo Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1709644009.description_zh:
在单人行动中使用光能减益取得最后一击或助攻。

以较高评级完成单人行动活动可提供额外进度。

1709644008.name: Singular Shadow
1709644008.description:
Get final blows or assists with Dark debuffs in Solo Ops. 

Completing Solo Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1709644008.description_zh:
在单人行动中使用暗影减益取得最后一击或助攻。

以较高评级完成单人行动活动可提供额外进度。

1709644011.name: Armed Alone
1709644011.description:
Get precision final blows or rapidly defeat targets with weapons in Solo Ops. 

Completing Solo Ops activities with higher scoring grades grants additional progress.
1709644011.description_zh:
在单人行动中使用武器取得精准最后一击或快速击败目标。

以较高评级完成单人行动活动可提供额外进度。

1249119259.name: Light Touch
1249119259.description:
Get final blows with Light abilities in Arena Ops. 

Final blows and assists with Light debuffs score higher grades and grant additional progress.
1249119259.description_zh:
在竞技场行动中使用光能技能取得最后一击。

使用光能减益取得最后一击或助攻可获得较高评级和提供额外进度。

1249119258.name: Dark Indulgence
1249119258.description:
Get final blows with Dark abilities in Arena Ops. 

Final blows and assists with Dark debuffs score higher grades and grant additional progress.
1249119258.description_zh:
在竞技场行动中使用暗影技能取得最后一击。

使用暗影减益取得最后一击或助攻可获得较高评级和提供额外进度。

1249119257.name: Weapons Free
1249119257.description:
Get weapon final blows in Arena Ops. 

Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with your weapons in Arena Ops activities grants additional progress.
1249119257.description_zh:
在竞技场行动中取得武器最后一击。

在竞技场行动活动中使用你的武器取得精准最后一击或快速击败目标可提供额外进度。

2098370171.name: Fireteam Ignite
2098370171.description:
Get final blows and assists with Light debuffs in Fireteam Ops. 

Completing Fireteam Ops activities with higher scoring grades or getting final blows in Rushdown grants additional progress.
2098370171.description_zh:
在火力战队行动中使用光能减益取得最后一击和助攻。

以较高评级完成火力战队行动活动或在急速强攻中取得最后一击可提供额外进度。

2098370170.name: Fireteam Extinguish
2098370170.description:
Get final blows and assists with Dark debuffs in Fireteam Ops. 

Completing Fireteam Ops activities with higher scoring grades or getting final blows in Rushdown grants additional progress.
2098370170.description_zh:
在火力战队行动中使用暗影减益取得最后一击和助攻。

以较高评级完成火力战队行动活动或在急速强攻中取得最后一击可提供额外进度。

2098370169.name: Fireteam Firearms
2098370169.description:
Get precision final blows and rapidly defeat targets with weapons in Fireteam Ops. 

Completing Fireteam Ops activities with higher scoring grades or getting final blows in Rushdown grants additional progress.
2098370169.description_zh:
在火力战队行动中使用武器取得精准最后一击和快速击败目标。

以较高评级完成火力战队行动活动或在急速强攻中取得最后一击可提供额外进度。

1359658754.name: Aggressive Acuity
1359658754.description: Land melee or precision final blows in Survival, Trials, Iron Banner, or Supremacy. Any final blows in Trials or Supremacy grant additional progress.
1359658754.description_zh: 在生存模式、试炼、铁旗或霸权中造成近战或精准最后一击。在试炼或霸权中造成任意最后一击可获得额外进度。

1359658755.name: Volatile Tactics
1359658755.description: Land grenade or Super final blows in Survival, Trials, Iron Banner, or Supremacy. Any final blows in Trials or Supremacy grant additional progress.
1359658755.description_zh: 在生存模式、试炼、铁旗或霸权中造成手雷或超能最后一击。在试炼或霸权中造成任意最后一击可获得额外进度。

1359658752.name: Competitive Conduit
1359658752.description: Land Solar, Arc, Void, Strand, or Stasis final blows in Survival, Trials, Iron Banner, or Supremacy. Any final blows in Trials, Supremacy, or with the Prismatic subclass equipped grant additional progress.
1359658752.description_zh: 在生存模式、试炼、铁旗或霸权中造成烈日、电弧、虚空、缚丝或冰影最后一击。在试炼、霸权或者装备棱镜分支职业时造成任意最后一击可获得额外进度。

1359658753.name: Ambitious Arsenal
1359658753.description: Land final blows with any weapon in Survival, Trials, Iron Banner, or Supremacy. Any final blows in Trials or Supremacy grant additional progress.
1359658753.description_zh: 使用任意武器在生存模式、试炼、铁旗或霸权中造成最后一击。在试炼或霸权中造成任意最后一击可获得额外进度。

995273136.name: Light the Depths
995273136.description: Defeat combatants in higher difficulty Lost Sectors. Combatants defeated in Master Lost Sectors grant more progress. Completing a higher difficulty Lost Sector grants significantly more progress.
995273136.description_zh: 在较高难度的遗失区域内击败战斗人员。在大师遗失区域内击败的战斗人员可提供更多进度。 完成较高难度的遗失区域可大幅提供进度。

995273137.name: Strategic Spelunking
995273137.description: Defeat combatants in higher difficulty Lost Sectors. Defeating Champions grants more progress. Completing a higher difficulty Lost Sector grants significantly more progress.
995273137.description_zh: 在较高难度的遗失区域内击败战斗人员。击败勇士可提供更多进度。完成较高难度的遗失区域可大幅提供进度。

191616380.name: Carrying Capacity
191616380.description:
Defeat combatants in Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown. Higher difficulty Nightfalls grant more progress.

Completing the activities with more final blows grants increased progress.
191616380.description_zh:
在日落或专家急速强攻中击败战斗人员。较高难度的日落可提供更多进度。

以较多最后一击数完成活动可提供更多进度。

191616381.name: Stand-Alone Performance
191616381.description:
Defeat combatants in Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown. Higher difficulty Nightfalls grant more progress. 

Completing Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown with fewer deaths grants increased progress.
191616381.description_zh:
在日落或专家急速强攻中击败战斗人员。较高难度的日落可提供更多进度。

以较少死亡数完成日落或专家急速强攻可提供更多进度。

191616382.name: Stand-Out Performance
191616382.description: Defeat combatants in Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown. Completing Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown with higher scores grants increased progress.
191616382.description_zh: 在日落或专家急速强攻中击败战斗人员。以较高得分完成日落或专家急速强攻可提供更多进度。

191616383.name: Timeless Performance
191616383.description: Defeat combatants in Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown. Completing Nightfalls or Expert Rushdown with faster finish times grants increased progress.
191616383.description_zh: 在日落或专家急速强攻中击败战斗人员。以较快的通关时间完成日落或专家急速强攻可提供更多进度。

3821311001.name: Platinum Plunderer
3821311001.description: Earn points by defeating combatants and generating Orbs during raids and dungeons. Completing a raid or dungeon grants significant progress.
3821311001.description_zh: 在突袭和地牢期间通过击败战斗人员和生成能量球来获得分数。完成一个突袭或地牢给予大量进度。

3166523987.name: Volume or Volume
3166523987.description: Defeat combatants in higher difficulty Episodic content. Rapidly defeating combatants or getting final blows with Submachine Guns and Machine Guns grants more progress. Completing activities grants significantly more progress.
3166523987.description_zh: 在较高难度篇章内容中击败战斗人员。快速击败战斗人员或使用微型冲锋枪和机枪造成最后一击可提供更多进度。完成活动可提供大量进度。

3166523986.name: Pin Pointed
3166523986.description: Defeat combatants in higher difficulty Episodic content. Defeating combatants with Pulse Rifles, Trace Rifles, and precision damage grants more progress. Completing activities grants significantly more progress.
3166523986.description_zh: 在较高难度篇章内容中击败战斗人员。使用脉冲步枪、追踪步枪和精准伤害击败战斗人员可提供更多进度。完成活动可提供大量进度。

3147591222.name: Elevated Enlightenment
3147591222.description:
Get final blows and assists with Light debuffs in Pinnacle Ops. 

Completing Pinnacle Ops activities with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3147591222.description_zh:
在巅峰行动中使用光能减益取得最后一击和助攻。

以B或更高评级完成巅峰行动活动可提供额外进度。

3147591223.name: Rewritten Fears
3147591223.description:
Get final blows or assists with Dark debuffs in Pinnacle Ops. 

Completing Pinnacle Ops activities with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3147591223.description_zh:
在巅峰行动中使用暗影减益取得最后一击或助攻。

以B或更高评级完成巅峰行动活动可提供额外进度。

3147591220.name: Topped Off
3147591220.description:
Get precision final blows or rapidly defeat combatants in Pinnacle Ops. 

Completing Pinnacle Ops activities with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3147591220.description_zh:
在巅峰行动中造成精准最后一击或快速击败战斗人员。

以B或更高评级完成巅峰行动活动可提供额外进度。

2205125592.name: Explosive Rivalry
2205125592.description:
Get grenade, melee, or Super final blows in Trials or Competitive Crucible Ops. 

Winning rounds grants additional progress.
2205125592.description_zh:
在试炼或多人竞技熔炉竞技场行动中取得手雷、近战或超能最后一击。

赢得回合可提供额外进度。

2205125593.name: Competitive Element
2205125593.description:
Get Solar, Arc, Void, Strand, or Stasis final blows in Trials or Competitive Crucible Ops. 

Winning rounds grants additional progress.
2205125593.description_zh:
在试炼或多人竞技熔炉竞技场行动中取得烈日、电弧、虚空、缚丝或冰影最后一击。

赢得回合可提供额外进度。

2205125594.name: Precise Opponents
2205125594.description:
Get precision final blows in Trials or Competitive Crucible Ops. 

Winning rounds grants additional progress.
2205125594.description_zh:
在试炼或多人竞技熔炉竞技场行动中取得精准最后一击。

赢得回合可提供额外进度。

3149086435.name: Rekindled Heat
3149086435.description:
Get final blows or assists with Light debuffs in Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts. 

Completing Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3149086435.description_zh:
在宗师先锋警戒中使用光能减益取得最后一击或助攻。

以B或更高评级完成宗师先锋警戒可提供额外进度。

3149086434.name: Beckoning Umbra
3149086434.description:
Get final blows or assists with Dark debuffs in Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts. 

Completing Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3149086434.description_zh:
在宗师先锋警戒中使用暗影减益取得最后一击或助攻。

以B或更高评级完成宗师先锋警戒可提供额外进度。

3149086433.name: Well-Rounded Weapon Wielder
3149086433.description:
Get precision final blows or rapidly defeat combatants with weapons in Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts. 

Completing Grandmaster Vanguard Alerts with a grade of B or higher grants additional progress.
3149086433.description_zh:
在宗师先锋警戒中使用武器取得精准最后一击或快速击败战斗人员。

以B或更高评级完成宗师先锋警戒可提供额外进度。

1099446506.name: Diamond Trials
1099446506.description: Win rounds in the Trials of Osiris. Losses reduce progress.
1099446506.description_zh: 在奥斯里斯试炼中赢得多个回合。败场会减少进度。

209894090.name: Diamond Raider
209894090.description: Complete all encounters within a Raid with a full fireteam of the same class.
209894090.description_zh: 以一支全员使用相同职业的火力战队，在一次突袭中完成所有遭遇战。

209894091.name: Diamond Dungeoneer
209894091.description: Complete a dungeon with a full fireteam of the same class.
209894091.description_zh: 以一支全员使用相同职业的火力战队，完成一个地牢。

209894088.name: Diamond Grandmaster
209894088.description: Complete a Grandmaster Nightfall with a full fireteam of the same class. Each fireteam member must use a different elemental subclass.
209894088.description_zh: 以一支全员使用相同职业的火力战队，完成一次宗师日落。每个火力战队成员必须使用不同的元素分支职业。

45262603.name: End Game
45262603.description: Complete matches and rounds. Wins in the Trials of Osiris grant the most efficient progress.
45262603.description_zh: 完成比赛和回合。在奥斯里斯试炼中获胜可最高效地提升进度。
45262603.typeName_zh: 稀有 试炼每周悬赏

3051422226.name: Sweep the Field
3051422226.description: Defeat opponents. Multikills and streaks in the Trials of Osiris grant the most efficient progress.
3051422226.description_zh: 击败对手。在奥斯里斯试炼中的多杀和连杀将给予最有效进度。
3051422226.typeName_zh: 稀有 试炼每周悬赏

3497386880.name: Trial of Decryption

1422515300.name: No HUD Expert
1422515300.description: Achieve grade A or better on Expert difficulty or higher activities with the No HUD Gameplay Stake active.
1422515300.description_zh: 启用无HUD游戏风险的情况下，在专家或更高难度的活动中达到B或更好的评级。

1422515307.name: Master Modifier
1422515307.description: Complete an activity on Master difficulty or higher with 3 modifiers active.
1422515307.description_zh: 启用3个修改器的情况下以大师或更高难度完成一项活动。

1422515306.name: Shaxx's Favorite
1422515306.description: Earn Bonus Score medals in Crucible Ops activities.
1422515306.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场行动活动中获得加成得分勋章。
1422515306.typeName_zh: 传说 熔炉竞技场命令

1506403330.name: Crucible and Gambit Crusher
1506403330.name_zh: 熔炉竞技场和智谋粉碎者
1506403330.description: Achieve grade A+ or higher within Crucible Ops or Gambit Ops activities.
1506403330.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场行动或智谋行动活动中达到A+或更高的评级。
1506403330.typeName_zh: 传说 熔炉竞技场命令

1506403331.name: Faithful Opposition
1506403331.description: Defeat opposing Guardians in Crucible Ops or Gambit Ops.
1506403331.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场行动或智谋行动中击败敌方守护者。
1506403331.typeName_zh: 传说 熔炉竞技场命令

582968305.name: Peaked Pinnacle
582968305.description: Achieve grade S or better on Master difficulty or higher in any Pinnacle Ops activity.
582968305.description_zh: 在任意巅峰行动活动中，以大师或更高难度达到S或更好的评级。

582968304.name: Seasonal Arsenal
582968304.description: Defeat combatants or Guardians while using Seasonal Exotic weapons from the Rewards Pass.
582968304.description_zh: 使用来自奖励通票的赛季异域武器击败战斗人员或守护者。

582968307.name: Sightless Mastery
582968307.description: Complete a Pinnacle Ops activity on Master difficulty or higher with the No HUD Gameplay Stake active.
582968307.description_zh: 启用无HUD游戏风险的情况下，以大师或更高难度完成一次巅峰行动活动。

582968306.name: Mastered Pinnacle
582968306.description: Complete 2 Pinnacle Ops activities with grade A or higher.
582968306.description_zh: 以A或更高的评级完成2次巅峰行动活动。

582968309.name: Melee Master
582968309.description: Defeat combatants or Guardians without dying while using Swords, Glaives, or melee attacks.
582968309.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，使用刀剑、偃月或近战攻击击败战斗人员或守护者。

582968308.name: Praxic Professional
582968308.description:
While using the Praxic Blade Exotic Sword, defeat combatants in Solo, Fireteam, Arena, or Pinnacle Ops activities on Expert difficulty or higher without dying.

While this Order is active, your Praxic Blade regenerates ammo in Solo, Fireteam, Arena, or Pinnacle Ops activities.
582968308.description_zh:
在专家或更高难度的单人、火力战队、竞技场或巅峰行动活动中，使用英勇利刃异域刀剑，在不死亡的情况下击败战斗人员。

此命令生效时，你的英勇利刃会在单人、火力战队、竞技场或巅峰行动活动中回复弹药。

582968311.name: Shaxx's Champion
582968311.description: Achieve first place on your team in the Crucible.
582968311.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中获得团队第一名。
582968311.typeName_zh: 异域 熔炉竞技场命令

582968310.name: Benefits to Reap
582968310.description: Defeat opposing Guardians in Crucible Ops or Gambit Ops.
582968310.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场行动或智谋行动中击败敌方守护者。
582968310.typeName_zh: 异域 熔炉竞技场命令

582968313.name: Reaper Supreme
582968313.description: Defeat the most Guardians or earn the highest efficiency in Crucible matches.
582968313.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场比赛中击败最多守护者或获得最高效率评价。
582968313.typeName_zh: 异域 熔炉竞技场命令

582968312.name: Omnidextrous
582968312.description: Defeat combatants or Guardians with Kinetic, Energy, and Power slot weapon final blows.
582968312.description_zh: 使用动能、能量和威能插槽武器最后一击击败战斗人员或守护者。

2739557088.name: Micah-10's Training
2739557088.description:
Create orbs and apply buffs to your fireteam.

Buffs include Cure, Restoration, Woven Mail, Invisibility, and Overshield.
2739557088.description_zh:
生成能量球，为你的火力战队成员施加增益。

增益包括治愈、恢复、织造铠甲、隐身和覆盖护盾。

2739557089.name: Traveler's Tutelage
2739557089.description:
Defeat combatants or Guardians with Arc, Solar, and Void damage.

Ability final blows grant significantly greater progress.
2739557089.description_zh:
使用电弧、烈日和虚空伤害击败战斗人员或守护者。

技能最后一击可大幅加快进度。

3337739523.name: Ascendant Challenge
3337739523.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
3337739523.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

128980839.name: Ascendant Challenge
128980839.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
128980839.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

1147672297.name: Ascendant Challenge
1147672297.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
1147672297.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

2338128705.name: Ascendant Challenge
2338128705.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
2338128705.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

3207732940.name: Ascendant Challenge
3207732940.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
3207732940.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

542328999.name: Ascendant Challenge
542328999.description: "The Awoken have long practiced the art of walking between worlds." —Techeun Kalli
542328999.description_zh: “觉醒者很早之前就熟练地游走于各个世界之间。”——灵巫卡丽

1319723906.name: Gateway Between Worlds
1319723906.description: "The Blind Well can split wide the veins that run between realities." —Techeun Sedia
1319723906.description_zh: “盲目之井会分裂开现实的血管。”——灵巫赛迪娅

871673916.name: Audience with the Queen
871673916.description: Present an Offering to the Oracle Engine.
871673916.description_zh: 为神谕引擎献上一份贡品。

2661223204.name: Fieldwork
2661223204.description: "If you spot any of my Corsairs in the field, don't be shy to say hello." —Petra Venj
2661223204.description_zh: “如果你在战场上看到我的海盗军们，不用不好意思打招呼。”——佩特拉·万吉

1001399024.name: Public Works
1001399024.description: Complete public events in the Dreaming City. Heroic public events contribute the most progress.
1001399024.description_zh: 在幽梦之城完成公共事件。英雄公共事件能最高效地提升进度。

379746735.name: Reagent Resourcing
379746735.description: "The Techeuns call for more spell ingredients." —Petra Venj
379746735.description_zh: “灵巫需要更多的法术原料。”——佩特拉·万吉

2192699203.name: Decimation
2192699203.description: "Our enemies outnumber the Awoken, but they cannot outlast the Guardians." —Petra Venj
2192699203.description_zh: “我们的敌人数量超过觉醒者，但他们无法消灭守护者。”——佩特拉·万吉

2173508794.name: Defender of the Well
2173508794.description: "We don't have the resources to repair the Well if it fails. We must defend it." —Petra Venj
2173508794.description_zh: “如果塌陷了，我们会没有资源修复盲目之井。我们必须守住它。”——佩特拉·万吉

1940788333.name: Scourge of the Taken
1940788333.description: "The Taken have infected the City at its core. Every kill helps ease the pressure." —Petra Venj
1940788333.description_zh: “傀儡已经感染了城市的核心。每次击杀都会帮忙缓解压力。”——佩特拉·万吉

3531980021.name: Scourge of the Scorn
3531980021.description: "The Scorn seek revenge for the death of the Fanatic. They will never willingly leave the Dreaming City." —Petra Venj
3531980021.description_zh: “嗤魅想要为狂热者报仇。他们绝不愿主动离开幽梦之城。”——佩特拉·万吉

1225647738.name: Lost in the Mists
1225647738.description: Explore the Bay of Drowned Wishes in the Dreaming City.
1225647738.description_zh: 在幽梦之城中探索溺亡之愿海湾。

973983247.name: Lost in Rheasilvia
973983247.description: Explore the Chamber of Starlight in the Dreaming City.
973983247.description_zh: 在幽梦之城中探索星光大殿。

973983256.name: Lost in the Strand
973983256.description: Explore Aphelion's Rest in the Dreaming City.
973983256.description_zh: 在幽梦之城中探索远日点之栖。

1391363409.name: Challenge: Headhunter
1391363409.description: "For every enemy commander that steps forward, we need to destroy two." —Petra Venj
1391363409.description_zh: “敌人每来一个指挥官，我们就得消灭两个。”——佩特拉·万吉

2662637005.name: Challenge: Heroic Public Events
2662637005.description: "Ah, I've seen how you Guardians fight. Put your back into it!" —Paladin Kamala Rior
2662637005.description_zh: “啊，我看过你们守护者的战斗。再加把劲儿！”——圣骑士卡马拉·雷奥

4095766153.name: Challenge: Secret Secrets
4095766153.description: "The Dreaming City is rich with secrets. Seek them out and be enlightened." —Techeun Kalli
4095766153.description_zh: “幽梦之城充满了秘密。找出秘密，获得启示。”——灵巫卡丽

2271002093.name: Challenge: Deathproof
2271002093.description: "You're causing quite a stir among my Corsairs. They think you're invincible." —Petra Venj
2271002093.description_zh: “你让我的海盗军变得有些骚动。他们都认为你是无敌的。”——佩特拉·万吉

2494871935.name: Challenge: The Shattered
2494871935.description: "Is it true that the spirit of a Guardian wanders the Ascendant Plane?" —Petra Venj
2494871935.description_zh: “据说一个守护者的灵魂在上维位面漫游，是真的吗？”——佩特拉·万吉

1912981534.name: Challenge: Plaguebreaker
1912981534.description: "Our enemies are drawn to the Blind Well like moths to a flame…" —Techeun Sedia
1912981534.description_zh: “我们的敌人被盲目之井吸引，像飞蛾扑火……”——灵巫赛迪娅

346263927.name: Purification Ritual
346263927.description: Complete the dungeon "The Shattered Throne" while wearing a full Reverie Dawn set and while Ascendant.
346263927.description_zh: 在被上维诅咒的情况下穿戴整套梦想陷落套装完成地牢“破碎王座”。

1123124244.name: Purification Ritual
1123124244.description: Defeat any Plague of the Well while Ascendant.
1123124244.description_zh: 在被上维诅咒的情况下击败所有深井瘟疫。

2256480378.name: Purification Ritual
2256480378.description: Defeat Abyssal Champions in Ascendant challenges while Ascendant.
2256480378.description_zh: 在被上维诅咒的上维挑战中击败深渊勇士。

455233900.name: Purification Ritual
455233900.description_zh: 在被上维诅咒的情况下完成打击“腐蚀”。

2663541547.name: Purification Ritual
2663541547.description: Defeat Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger in the dungeon "The Shattered Throne" while Ascendant.
2663541547.description_zh: 在被上维诅咒的情况下在地牢“破碎王座”中击败无边饥渴，沃戈斯。

1706185766.name: Vengeance
1706185766.description_zh: 追捕并击败海盗军克星，图克斯尼。

110539500.name: O Deepsight Mine
110539500.description: Complete all encounters of the "Last Wish" raid.
110539500.description_zh: 完成“最后一愿”突袭中的所有遭遇战。

2305891963.name: Deepsight Signal
2305891963.description: Complete all encounters of the "Garden of Salvation" raid.
2305891963.description_zh: 完成“救赎花园”突袭中的所有遭遇战。

152476114.name: Fated Deepsight
152476114.description: Complete all encounters of the Vault of Glass Raid.
152476114.description_zh: 完成玻璃拱顶突袭的所有遭遇战。

1271443422.name: The Relic
1271443422.description: Investigate the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
1271443422.description_zh: 调查火星上飞地内的圣物。

3202230445.name: The Relic
3202230445.description: Access the Relic in the Enclave and shape a weapon from the artifact you found on Savathûn's ship.
3202230445.description_zh: 找到飞地内的圣物，用你在萨瓦图恩飞船上发现的神器塑形一件武器。

3202230444.name: The Relic
3202230444.description:
Choose components to customize the Enigma Glaive. 

More components will become available as the weapon level increases. 

After you have chosen all of the components, press and hold the Shape button to create the Glaive.
3202230444.description_zh:
选择组件自定义谜团偃月。

随着武器等级的增加，更多的组件将正式开放。

选择所有组件后，按住塑形按钮来打造偃月。

3202230447.name: The Relic
3202230447.description: Access the Conduit on the side of the Relic.

658479834.name: Reshaping the Enigma
658479834.description: To upgrade the Enigma with enhanced traits, Ascendant Alloys are required. Speak with Rahool in the Tower to learn about this material.
658479834.description_zh: 你需要上维合金来升级谜团以获取强化特征。与位于高塔的拉乎尔交谈来了解这种材料。

1232302363.name: Reshaping the Enigma
1232302363.description:
The Enigma can be upgraded with enhanced intrinsics and traits by increasing its level. 

Level up the Enigma to Level 3.
1232302363.description_zh:
通过提升谜团等级，可使用强化固有特性和强化特征进行升级。

将谜团升到等级3。

1232302361.name: Reshaping the Enigma
1232302361.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
1232302361.description_zh: 回到火星上隐密者飞地内的圣物前。

3099265193.name: Reshaping the Enigma
3099265193.description:
Select "Reshape" at the Relic in the Enclave on Mars, then select the Enigma.

The Enigma must be unlocked and unequipped to reshape.
3099265193.description_zh:
在火星上飞地内的圣物前选择“重塑”，然后选择谜团。

你必须解锁并卸下谜团来进行重塑。

1232302360.name: Reshaping the Enigma
1232302360.description:
Insert an enhanced intrinsic to upgrade the Enigma.

These intrinsics grant an immediate stat boost as well as a smaller stat increase across all stats at level {var:125299441}.
1232302360.description_zh:
插入一个强化固有特性来升级谜团。

强化固有特性可提供一项即时的属性提升，并在达到等级{var:125299441}时提供较小的全属性提升。

1232302367.name: Reshaping the Enigma
1232302367.description: Select an enhanced trait to insert into the Enigma.
1232302367.description_zh: 选择一个强化特征来插入谜团。

3216708524.name: Reshaping the Enigma
3216708524.description: Select "Finalize Shape" to reshape the Enigma.
3216708524.description_zh: 选择"完成塑形"来重塑谜团。

1232302366.name: Reshaping the Enigma
1232302366.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
1232302366.description_zh: 回到火星上隐密者飞地内的圣物前。

3640917386.name: Foundry Resonance
3640917386.description: Visit the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
3640917386.description_zh: 拜访火星上飞地内的圣物。

3169161323.name: Foundry Resonance
3169161323.description:
Complete a Vanguard, Crucible, or Gambit Ops activity.

Completion will award a Deepsight Resonant weapon ready for Pattern extraction.
3169161323.description_zh:
完成一次先锋、熔炉竞技场或智谋行动活动。

完成后将奖励一件可进行模式萃取的深视共振武器。

3169161322.name: Foundry Resonance
3169161322.description:
You've obtained a weapon with Deepsight Resonance. Extract Pattern progress from the weapon, or dismantle it to make Pattern progress.

Extraction from Resonant weapons with Patterns will also make progress toward unlocking the Pattern to shape it at the Relic.
3169161322.description_zh:
你获得了一件带有深视共振的武器。从武器上萃取模式进度，或将其拆解来获得模式进度。

从带有模式的共振武器上萃取，还可获得解锁该模式的进度，从而在圣物处将其塑形。

3169161321.name: Foundry Resonance
3169161321.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
3169161321.description_zh: 回到火星上飞地内的圣物前。

164710717.name: Foundry Shaping
164710717.description: Visit the Relic Conduit in the Enclave on Mars.
164710717.description_zh: 前往火星上飞地内的圣物通道。

3730181654.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181654.description:
Complete an offensive activity such as Dares of Eternity or the Wellspring. 

Activity completion will award a Deepsight Resonant weapon.
3730181654.description_zh:
装备深视武器完成攻略活动，例如永恒挑战或泉源。

完成活动将奖励深视共振武器。

3730181655.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181655.description:
Extract or dismantle a Deepsight Resonant weapon to be awarded Pattern progress.

Pattern extraction from Deepsight Resonant weapons will also progress unlocking the Pattern to shape it at the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
3730181655.description_zh:
萃取或拆解深视共振武器将获得模式进度。

从深视共振武器中萃取模式也将解锁模式，并能在火星上的飞地圣物处进行塑形。

3730181652.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181652.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
3730181652.description_zh: 回到火星上飞地内的圣物前。

3730181653.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181653.description: At the Relic in the Enclave on Mars, shape either Taipan-4fr or Ammit AR2.
3730181653.description_zh: 在火星上飞地内的圣物处，塑形太攀蛇-4fr或阿米特AR2。

3730181650.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181650.description:
Level up a Shaped weapon by completing activities and defeating targets with the weapon. 

Upon leveling up, your Shaped weapon will begin to unlock new perk capabilities.
3730181650.description_zh:
通过完成活动并用武器击败目标来升级塑形武器。

升级后，你的塑形武器将开始解锁新的特性。

3730181651.name: Foundry Shaping
3730181651.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
3730181651.description_zh: 回到火星上飞地内的圣物前。

2462004150.name: Ascendant Alloy Requisition
2462004150.description:
Shaping weapons with Enhanced Traits requires Ascendant Alloys.

Complete a weekly campaign mission to receive an Ascendant Alloy.
2462004150.description_zh:
塑形带有强化特征的武器需要上维合金。

完成一项每周战役任务来获得一块上维合金。

2857969519.name: Ascendant Alloy Requisition
2857969519.description: Return to the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.
2857969519.description_zh: 回到火星上飞地内的圣物前。

3956285600.name: Shaping: Extraction
3956285600.description: Obtain a Resonant weapon from the Throne World, rituals, or other activities, and extract the Pattern mod or dismantle the weapon to make Weapon Pattern progress.
3956285600.description_zh: 通过王座世界、仪式或其他活动获得共振武器，并通过萃取模式模组或拆解武器来获得武器模式进度。

3956285601.name: Shaping: Extraction
3956285601.description:
Complete the weapon objective to unlock its Pattern and Resonant Elements. 

Check the objective in the weapon tooltip or details screen.
3956285601.description_zh:
武器的共振模式和共振元素可以通过完成武器任务目标来解锁。

你可以通过武器提示或详情界面查看目标。

3956285602.name: Shaping: Extraction
3956285602.description:
A Deepsight Resonant weapon can provide Weapon Pattern progress by extracting the pattern in the weapon details screen. Dismantling the weapon also gives Weapon Pattern progress. 

Extract or dismantle a Resonant weapon to progress. 

This process only provides one segment of a Weapon's Pattern. Once the extraction or dismantle is complete, all the Resonance is consumed for that weapon.
3956285602.description_zh:
深视共振武器可以通过在武器详情界面萃取模式来提供武器模式进度。拆解武器也会提供武器模式进度。

萃取或拆解共振武器以获得进度。

此过程仅提供武器模式的一部分。萃取或拆解完成后，该武器的所有共振都会被耗尽。

3956285603.name: Shaping: Extraction
3956285603.description: Return to the Relic Conduit in the Enclave on Mars.
3956285603.description_zh: 回到火星上隐密者飞地内的圣物前。

1675348676.name: Celebrating Solstice
1675348676.description: Speak with Eva in the Tower.

2376985818.name: Celebrating Solstice

3604605344.description_zh: 去高塔找伊娃领取你的英灵日面具。

3604605346.name: Classic Carving
3604605346.description: Complete the Haunted Altars of Sorrow activity or a Crucible Rumble match occurring as part of the Festival of the Lost.
3604605346.description_zh: 在英灵日期间，完成闹鬼忧愁圣坛活动或熔炉竞技场混战比赛。

3604605347.name: Classic Carving
3604605347.description_zh: 领取你的活动等级奖励。

3604605348.name: Classic Carving
3604605348.description: Speak to Eva in the Tower Courtyard.
3604605348.description_zh: 在高塔庭院与伊娃交谈。

3604605349.name: Classic Carving
3604605349.description: Purchase a Festival of the Lost mask mod from the Haunted Mask tab in the Event Home.
3604605349.description_zh: 从活动主页的闹鬼面具选项卡中购买英灵日面具模组。

3604605350.name: Classic Carving
3604605350.description: Complete and claim a Daily Challenge.
3604605350.description_zh: 完成并领取一个日常挑战。

945552735.name: The Dawning
945552735.description:
Use Eva's Holiday Oven to bake a gift for Commander Zavala.

The oven can be found in your Inventory screen under Accessories, in the Event Home, and in the Quests tab.
945552735.description_zh:
用伊娃的节日烤箱为指挥官萨瓦拉烘焙一份礼物。

烤箱位于物品栏界面的配件、活动主页和任务选项卡中。

2992171990.name: The Dawning
2992171990.description: Deliver your gift to Commander Zavala in the Tower Courtyard.
2992171990.description_zh: 把你的礼物送给高塔庭院里的指挥官萨瓦拉。

877456553.name: The Dawning
877456553.description: Return to Eva Levante to let her know Zavala has received his gift.
877456553.description_zh: 回去找伊娃·莱万特，告诉她萨瓦拉已经收到了他的礼物。

776643744.name: The Dawning
776643744.description: Purchase an upgrade from Eva Levante.
776643744.description_zh: 向伊娃·莱万特购买升级。

826976633.name: The Dawning
826976633.description: Complete a match of the Dawning Snowball Fight activity.
826976633.description_zh: 完成曙光节打雪仗活动中的一场比赛。

877309490.name: The Dawning
877309490.description: Claim your first Event Rank reward.
877309490.description_zh: 领取你的首个活动等级奖励。

1079082139.name: The Dawning
1079082139.description: Return to Eva Levante in the Tower.
1079082139.description_zh: 回去高塔找伊娃·莱万特。

452968427.name: The Dawning
452968427.description: The Dawning has returned to the Tower. Seek out Eva Levante in the Courtyard to join the festivities.
452968427.description_zh: 曙光节回归高塔。在庭院找到伊娃·莱万特以加入节日庆典。

3400290392.name: Cookie Delivery Helper
3400290392.description: Bake a Dark Matter Drizzler for the Dean of the Aionians. These cosmically delicious confections are composed of Ether Cane and Dark Frosting ingredients and may confound physics, but certainly not the taste buds! The Dean can be found in Caldera on Kepler or in  the Caldera Solo Op.
3400290392.description_zh: 为艾昂人的院长烘焙一份暗物质淋酱曲奇。这些超美味甜点由乙太藤条和暗影糖霜制成，或许会颠覆物理学，但绝对不会影响味蕾！院长可以在开普勒的火山喷口或火山喷口单人行动中找到。

3467400836.name: Cookie Delivery Helper
3467400836.description: Bake a Peanut Butter Paw Print for Archie. These canine-friendly cookies are made from Dark Ether Cane and Balanced Flavors. Archie loves these cookies, even though he cannot truly eat them. You can find Archie in the Tower Annex.
3467400836.description_zh: 为阿奇烤一份花生酱爪印。这款狗狗友好型饼干采用黑暗乙太藤条和平衡风味制成。阿奇虽然不能真的吃掉，但很喜欢这些饼干。你可以在高塔附属建筑找到阿奇。

3534658471.name: Cookie Delivery Helper
3534658471.description: Return to Eva in the Tower Courtyard.
3534658471.description_zh: 返回高塔庭院拜访伊娃。

2723555753.name: Top of Class
2723555753.description: Earn a Medallion by completing activities with your class item equipped.
2723555753.description_zh: 通过装备职业物品并完成活动来获取勋章。

2723555752.name: Top of Class
2723555752.description: Defeat targets with Machine Guns. Bonus progress granted for defeating Guardians.
2723555752.description_zh: 使用机枪击败目标。击败守护者可提供额外进度。

3250989937.name: Competitive Catalyst
3250989937.description: Earn points by obtaining Medallions. Higher tier Medallions are worth more points.
3250989937.description_zh: 通过获取勋章来赢取得分。高阶勋章可提供更多积分。

3250989939.name: Competitive Catalyst
3250989939.description: Defeat combatants with Machine Guns to collect Competitive Spirit. Precision final blows grant bonus progress.
3250989939.description_zh: 用机枪消灭战斗人员以收集竞技精神。精准最后一击提供额外进度。

1249087722.name: Guardian Games
1249087722.description: Speak with Eva Levante at the Tower about the Guardian Games ceremony.
1249087722.description_zh: 与高塔中的伊娃·莱万特交谈关于守护者游戏仪式的事项。

1526879941.name: Guardian Games

1526879941.description_zh: 与高塔中的伊娃·莱万特交谈关于守护者游戏仪式的事项。

4268434096.description_zh: 与高塔庭院中的伊娃·莱万特交谈。

339462811.name: Guardian Games
339462811.description: Speak with Zavala about the Closing Ceremony.
339462811.description_zh: 与萨瓦拉谈谈闭幕仪式的事。

1919833091.name: Best in Class
1919833091.description:
Medallions are earned by completing activities while your Guardian Games class item is equipped, or through Contender or Platinum Cards, which can be purchased from Eva. Medallions can be turned in at the podium for rewards. 

Use the Glimmer that Eva gave you to pick up a card.
1919833091.description_zh:
勋章可以通过在装备守护者游戏职业物品时完成活动来获取，或通过在伊娃处购买的竞争者或白金卡片获得。勋章可以用来在领奖台换取奖励。

用伊娃给的微光买一张卡片吧。

1919833088.name: Best in Class
1919833088.description:
Complete a Supremacy match or Rushdown to earn your first Medallion!

Medallions are earned by completing activities with your class item equipped.
1919833088.description_zh:
完成一场霸权比赛或急速强攻来获得你的第一个勋章！

通过装备你的职业物品并完成活动来获取勋章。

1919833089.name: Best in Class
1919833089.description: Speak with Eva Levante in the Tower Courtyard.
1919833089.description_zh: 与高塔庭院中的伊娃·莱万特交谈。

1919833094.name: Best in Class
1919833094.description: Deposit your Medallion at the Guardian Games podium in the Tower Courtyard.
1919833094.description_zh: 在高塔庭院中的守护者游戏领奖台处存放勋章。

1919833095.name: Best in Class
1919833095.description_zh: 领取你的活动等级奖励。

1919833093.description_zh: 与高塔中的沙克斯交谈。

23222722.description_zh: 拜访高塔庭院中的领奖台。

852152129.name: Drop In
852152129.description:
Complete ANY of the following objectives to earn the Skimmer:

• Accumulate points by depositing Medallions in the Tower.

• Earn a top 10% score from Expert Rushdown in any week of Guardian Games.

• Complete unique Rushdown boss combinations (changes daily).
852152129.description_zh:
完成以下任意目标即可获得滑翔板：

• 通过将勋章存入高塔来积累分数。

• 在任何一周的守护者游戏中，分数达到专家急速强攻前10%。

• 完成独特急速强攻首领组合（每日变化）。

520800949.name: Medallion Case
520800949.description:
Displays proof of your prestigious exploits during the Guardian Games.

Earn Medallions by completing activities with your class item equipped and completing Eva's Contender and Platinum Cards.
520800949.description_zh:
在守护者游戏期间展示出你的高超技巧。

装备职业物品时完成活动，以及完成伊娃的竞争者和白金卡片可获得勋章。
