3606357111.description_zh: 在遗落飞船上与布鲁交谈。

3657956817.name: Renegades
3657956817.description: Retrieve Aunor's note from the bar.
3657956817.description_zh: 从酒吧取回阿诺尔的便条。

3421161287.name: Renegades
3421161287.description: Speak with Commander Zavala at the Tower.
3421161287.description_zh: 与高塔中的指挥官萨瓦拉交谈。

1480973242.name: Renegades
1480973242.description: Speak with Drifter at Tharsis Cantina.
1480973242.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与浪客交谈。

3563454117.name: Renegades
3563454117.description: See if you can gain entry to the deeper Cantina and speak with the bouncer outside of the Piker hangout.
3563454117.description_zh: 尝试进入酒屋更深处，与派克组据点外的保镖交谈。

3922330416.name: Renegades
3922330416.description: Speak with Aunor in the Tharsis Cantina.
3922330416.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与阿诺尔交谈。

4133800.name: Renegades
4133800.description: Speak with Drifter's Ghost at Tharsis Cantina.
4133800.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与浪客的机灵交谈。

4195958277.name: Renegades
4195958277.description: Speak with Drifter at Tharsis Cantina.
4195958277.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与浪客交谈。

1511003763.name: Renegades
1511003763.description: Access the recording that Drifter left for you.
1511003763.description_zh: 播放浪客留给你的录音。

1594586396.name: Renegades
1594586396.description: You've agreed to help Drifter's Ghost get her voice back, which she lost long ago helping her Guardian. Search for any raw materials you can find in Tharsis Bazaar that might be used for parts in the repairs.
1594586396.description_zh: 你已同意帮助浪客的机灵找回她的声音，那是她很久以前为了帮助她的守护者而失去的东西。在塔尔西斯集市搜寻可用于修复的原材料。

3823080851.name: Renegades
3823080851.description: Reach out to Spider for assistance in repairing the Drifter's Ghost. Find him at Tharsis Cantina.
3823080851.description_zh: 联系蛛王，请他帮忙修复浪客的机灵。在塔尔西斯酒屋找到他。

1409409940.name: Renegades
1409409940.description_zh: 完成任务“欢迎来到边界”。

3866511213.name: Renegades
3866511213.description: Speak to Spider in the Tharsis Cantina.
3866511213.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与蛛王交谈。

1482586711.name: Renegades
1482586711.description: Visit Drifter's Ghost at Tharsis Cantina.
1482586711.description_zh: 前往塔尔西斯酒屋见浪客的机灵。

1538575442.name: Praxic's Path
1538575442.description: Speak with Aunor in the Tharsis Cantina.
1538575442.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与阿诺尔交谈。

1638793398.name: Praxic's Path
1638793398.description: Sharpen your skills with your Praxic Blade by defeating targets with light attacks, by throwing your Blade, and by reflecting projectiles back at combatants.
1638793398.description_zh: 通过用轻攻击打败目标、投掷利刃和反弹战斗人员的射弹，来磨砺你的英勇利刃技艺。

928786913.name: Praxic's Path
928786913.description: Return to Tharsis and meditate on the Praxic path.
928786913.description_zh: 返回塔尔西斯，冥想英勇之道。

3508059163.name: Praxic's Path
3508059163.description: Purchase a Praxic Blade mod in the Tharsis Bazaar.
3508059163.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯集市购买一件英勇利刃模组。

4033055185.name: Praxic's Path
4033055185.description: Equip your new mod to your Praxic Blade.
4033055185.description_zh: 将新模组装备至你的英勇利刃。

2387906161.name: Praxic's Path
2387906161.description: As part of your training, revisit the Exotic mission "Fire and Ice" with guidance from Aunor, and defeat combatants with your Praxic Blade.
2387906161.description_zh: 作为训练的一部分，在阿诺尔的指引下重温“冰与火”任务，并使用英勇利刃击败战斗人员。

4254208608.name: Praxic's Path
4254208608.description: Speak with Aunor in the Tharsis Cantina.
4254208608.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯酒屋与阿诺尔交谈。

2478741670.name: The Territory War Begins
2478741670.description: Gather the remaining components from around Tharsis.
2478741670.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯周边收集剩余的组件。

2461964083.name: The Territory War Begins
2461964083.description: Transmit the Prophecy from the repaired broadcaster in the Tharsis Bazaar.
2461964083.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯集市修好的广播器上发送预言。

2562629701.name: The Territory War Begins
2562629701.description: Meet with Blue at Tharsis Outpost's Ghost commune.
2562629701.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯前哨站的机灵交流地与布鲁会面。

2562629696.name: The Territory War Begins
2562629696.description: Speak to Spider in the Cantina.

2545852114.name: The Territory War Begins
2545852114.description: Enter the Lawless Frontier and take on the Imperium presence on Europa.
2545852114.description_zh: 进入无序边界，迎战木卫二上的帝国势力。

2512296841.name: The Territory War Begins
2512296841.description: Speak with Lodi through your Ghost in the Tharsis Cantina.
2512296841.description_zh: 通过你的机灵在塔尔西斯酒屋与洛迪交谈。

2394706448.name: The Territory War Begins
2394706448.description: The Syndicates are recruiting allies for the brewing territory war. Visit their quartermasters to hear their pitches and see what they have to offer.
2394706448.description_zh: 帮派们正在为酝酿中的地盘之战招募盟友。拜访他们的军需官，听听他们的说辞，看他们能给出什么条件。

549712779.name: The Territory War Begins
549712779.description:
Ally yourself to one of the Syndicates at their banner.

You will be able to change your allied Syndicate at a later time.
549712779.description_zh:
在旗帜前与其中一个帮派结盟。

你之后可以更换结盟的帮派。

600045636.name: The Territory War Begins
600045636.description: Your new Syndicate's leader wishes to have a word with you.
600045636.description_zh: 你的新帮派首领想跟你谈谈。

2596332034.name: The Territory War Begins
2596332034.description:
Work your way up your Syndicate's ranks by completing a Priority Contract for your Syndicate. You may optionally complete an Invasion on the Lawless Frontier to disrupt rival Syndicates. Wager additional Deathmarks to increase rewards from successful Invasions.
 
Check the Map Guide on the Renegades Map screen to review your active Contracts.
2596332034.description_zh:
通过为你的帮派完成一份首要合约，逐步提升你在帮派中的阶级。你可以选择在无序边界完成一次入侵，以扰乱敌对帮派势力。押注额外死亡标记可以增加成功入侵的奖励。
 
在反叛地图界面查看地图指南，以了解你的生效合约。

751338493.name: The Territory War Begins
751338493.description: Return to your Syndicate's den in the Cantina and deposit Dark Matter Ingots in their War Chest to increase your Reputation with them.
751338493.description_zh: 回到酒屋中你的结盟帮派的巢穴，将暗物质锭存入其军资箱以提升你的声望。

650525684.name: The Territory War Begins
650525684.description: Speak with your Syndicate leader to debrief on your activities on the Lawless Frontier.
650525684.description_zh: 与帮派首领交谈，汇报你在无序边界的活动。

2462802630.name: The Territory War Begins
2462802630.description: Continue completing Syndicate Contracts and doing Jobs on the Lawless Frontier. At the next daily reset, your Priority Contract will reset, and you can decide to stick with your current Syndicate or ally with a new one.
2462802630.description_zh: 继续完成帮派合约并在无序边界执行差事。下一次日常重置后，你的首要合约将会重置，你可以决定继续与当前帮派结盟，或是与新的帮派结盟。

2765241121.name: The Territory War Begins
2765241121.description:
A new day has dawned on the Lawless Frontier. Because you completed yesterday's Priority Contract, competing Syndicates will now offer you additional incentives for allying with them instead.

You may now ally with a different Syndicate for extra rewards or stay loyal to your current Syndicate and keep doing Jobs.

The choice is yours.
2765241121.description_zh:
无序边界又迎来了新的一天。因为你已完成昨天的首要合约，竞争帮派现在将提供额外激励以求与你结盟。

你现在可以与不同的帮派结盟以获取额外奖励，或继续忠于当前帮派并持续执行差事。

选择权在你手中。

2664428344.name: The Territory War Begins
2664428344.description:
Strengthen your ties and unlock greater rewards by reaching Rank 3 with any of the Syndicates.

Completing Contracts and depositing Dark Matter Ingots at a Syndicate's War Chest will increase your reputation with that Syndicate.
2664428344.description_zh:
通过达到任何帮派的等级3，加强你的联结并解锁更大的奖励。

完成合同并在帮派的战争宝箱中存入暗物质锭，将提高你的帮派声望。

3262459648.name: The Territory War Begins
3262459648.description: At Rank 3, Syndicates offer you special access to a new Renegade Ability to use in the Lawless Frontier. Earn enough Credits and purchase it from the Syndicate's Quartermaster.
3262459648.description_zh: 达到等级3后，帮派将提供全新反叛者技能的特殊权限，可在无序边界中使用。积累足够的信用点后，即可从帮派军需官处购买。

3066431936.name: Territorial Profit
3066431936.description: Participate in the Territory War by completing Contracts and contributing Dark Matter Ingots at Syndicate War Chests in Tharsis Outpost. Priority Contracts award additional progress.
3066431936.description_zh: 在塔尔西斯前哨站通过完成合约以及向帮派战争宝箱贡献锭来参与地盘之争。完成首要合约可获得额外进度。

1221438395.name: Territorial Profit
1221438395.description: Return to Spider in the Tharsis Cantina.
1221438395.description_zh: 返回塔尔西斯酒屋的蛛王处。

505143283.name: A Guardian Rises
505143283.description_zh: 完成任务“守护者的诞生”。

2955116910.name: A Guardian Rises
2955116910.description: Find Shaw Han at his camp.

3039004941.name: A Guardian Rises
3039004941.description: Purchase any daily bounty from Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
3039004941.description_zh: 在发射基地的韩潇处购买任意每日悬赏。

2972041656.name: A Guardian Rises
2972041656.description: Sync with Shaw's ship near his camp.
2972041656.description_zh: 在韩潇的营地附近与他的飞船同步。

605956092.name: A Guardian Rises
605956092.description: Defeat Fallen to recover data scraps.
605956092.description_zh: 击败堕落者来取回数据碎片。

2818924418.name: A Guardian Rises
2818924418.description: Find Shaw back at his camp.

1491176377.name: A Guardian Rises
1491176377.description: Return to Shaw at his camp.
1491176377.description_zh: 回到韩潇的营地去找他。

1793614740.name: A Guardian Rises
1793614740.description: Report back to Shaw at his camp.
1793614740.description_zh: 回到韩潇的营地向他汇报。

3706704623.name: A Guardian Rises
3706704623.description: Travel to the Tower in the Last City.

3605891814.name: A Guardian Rises
3605891814.description: Complete your tour of the Tower in the "Advent" quest.
3605891814.description_zh: 在“降临”任务中完成你在高塔的游览。

3689779845.name: A Guardian Rises
3689779845.description: Complete your tour of the Tower in the "Advent" quest.
3689779845.description_zh: 在“降临”任务中完成你在高塔的游览。

2721036673.description_zh: 在“降临”任务中完成你在高塔的游览。

2821849482.description: Complete your tour of the Tower in the "Advent" quest.
2821849482.description_zh: 在“降临”任务中完成你在高塔的游览。

238346451.name: A Guardian Rises
238346451.description: Complete your tour of the Tower in the "Advent" quest.
238346451.description_zh: 在“降临”任务中完成你在高塔的游览。

339159260.name: A Guardian Rises
339159260.description: Complete the strike "The Disgraced" by accessing Cosmodrome from the Destinations tab.
339159260.description_zh: 通过目的地选项卡前往发射基地完成打击“耻辱”。

3656769954.name: Malfeasance
3656769954.description: Defeat a Primeval found within Gambit.
3656769954.description_zh: 击败一个出现于智谋中的古昧。

692805471.name: Tex Mechanica Tournament
692805471.description: Reach the rank of Brave in Crucible.
692805471.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场达到勇者等级。

2411744491.name: Wish-Ender
2411744491.description: Present this talisman to an Awoken warrior within the Shattered Throne.
2411744491.description_zh: 将这个护身符交给破碎王座内的一位觉醒者战士。

2464189896.name: Blast from the Past
2464189896.description: Defeat combatants. Stronger combatants grant more progress.
2464189896.description_zh: 消灭战斗人员。高阶战斗人员能最高效地提升进度。

82312451.name: Blast from the Past
82312451.description: Defeat combatants with your Super and other class abilities. Supers grant the most efficient progress.
82312451.description_zh: 使用你的超能和其他职业技能消灭战斗人员。超能击杀能最高效地提升进度。

2665815610.name: Blast from the Past
2665815610.description: Present this Holliday Family Blueprint data to Banshee-44 in the Tower.
2665815610.description_zh: 将霍利迪家族蓝图数据带给位于高塔的班西-44。

2632260305.name: Blast from the Past
2632260305.description:
Come back after Banshee has had time to analyze the data.

Complete the quest "A Guardian Rises."
2632260305.description_zh:
等班西花时间分析完数据后再回来。

完成任务“守护者的诞生”。

2615482721.name: Blast from the Past
2615482721.description: Return to Banshee-44 in the Tower.

283938165.name: Blast from the Past
283938165.description: Collect data by defeating combatants and completing public events on Europa.
283938165.description_zh: 在木卫二消灭战斗人员和完成公共事件以收集数据。

183125260.name: Blast from the Past
183125260.description: Defeat targets with precision damage and defeat targets with Shotguns in Gambit or Crucible matches. Guardians grant the most efficient progress.
183125260.description_zh: 用精准伤害消灭目标，以及在智谋或熔炉竞技场比赛中用霰弹枪消灭目标。击败守护者能最高效地提升进度。

2532286206.name: Blast from the Past
2532286206.description: Return the finished data to Banshee-44.
2532286206.description_zh: 带着完成的数据回去找班西-44。

1789244740.name: The Queen Beckons
1789244740.description:
Defeat foes of the Traveler wherever they're found.

More powerful foes grant additional progress.
1789244740.description_zh:
击败各处旅行者的敌人。

更强大的敌人可奖励额外进度。

3702334623.name: The Queen Beckons
3702334623.description: Defeat combatants using your abilities or Super.
3702334623.description_zh: 使用你的技能或超能消灭战斗人员。

1420431413.name: The Queen Beckons
1420431413.description: Complete the quest "A Guardian Rises" while you wait for the schematic to finish processing the data.
1420431413.description_zh: 在等待图纸完成数据处理的同时，完成“守护者的诞生”任务。

1537874741.name: The Queen Beckons
1537874741.description: Bring the schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
1537874741.description_zh: 把图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

3634238441.name: The Queen Beckons
3634238441.description: Defeat combatants and complete public events on the newly discovered destination: Throne World.
3634238441.description_zh: 消灭战斗人员并在新发现的目的地：王座世界完成公共事件。

3533425632.name: The Queen Beckons
3533425632.description:
Defeat targets while using any Auto Rifle.

Defeated Guardians grant additional progress.
3533425632.description_zh:
使用任意自动步枪击败目标。

被击败的守护者可奖励额外进度。

3735051218.name: The Queen Beckons
3735051218.description: Deliver the completed schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
3735051218.description_zh: 将完成的图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

2397886961.name: Another Last City
2397886961.description:
Defeat foes of the Traveler wherever they're found.

More powerful foes grant additional progress.
2397886961.description_zh:
击败各处旅行者的敌人。

更强大的敌人可奖励额外进度。

2498699770.name: Another Last City
2498699770.description: Defeat combatants using your abilities or Super.
2498699770.description_zh: 使用你的技能或超能击败战斗人员。

4243719212.name: Another Last City

4243719212.description_zh: 在等待图纸完成数据处理的同时，完成“守护者的诞生”任务。

4260496796.description: Bring the schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
4260496796.description_zh: 把图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

16009420.name: Another Last City
16009420.description: Defeat combatants and complete public events in the newly discovered destination: Neomuna.
16009420.description_zh: 击败战斗人员并在新发现的目的地——内欧姆那完成公共事件。

116822325.name: Another Last City
116822325.description:
Defeat targets while using any Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle.

Defeated Guardians grant additional progress.
116822325.description_zh:
使用任意融合步枪或线性融合步枪击败目标。

被击败的守护者可奖励额外进度。

2465983143.name: Another Last City
2465983143.description: Deliver the completed schematic to Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
2465983143.description_zh: 将完成的图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

2561829998.name: New Light Armor Requisition
2561829998.description: Defeat combatants with abilities and your Super.
2561829998.description_zh: 使用技能和超能击败战斗人员。

2461017189.name: New Light Armor Requisition
2461017189.description: Return to Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
2461017189.description_zh: 回到高塔集市找艾可拉·蕾伊。

1218497598.name: The Heart's Depths
1218497598.description:
Defeat foes of the Traveler wherever they're found.

More powerful combatants grant additional progress.
1218497598.description_zh:
击败各处旅行者的敌人。

更强大的战斗人员可提供额外进度。

3265116853.name: The Heart's Depths
3265116853.description: Defeat combatants using your abilities or Super.
3265116853.description_zh: 使用你的技能或超能击败战斗人员。

3197859223.description_zh: 在等待图纸完成数据处理的同时，完成“守护者的诞生”任务。

3113971187.description_zh: 把图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

3063491139.name: The Heart's Depths
3063491139.description: Cross the threshold and discover what lies within the Traveler.

1352027002.description_zh:
使用任意融合步枪或线性融合步枪击败目标。

1150401288.description_zh: 将完成的图纸带给高塔庭院的班西-44。

2238822094.name: A Spark of Hope
2238822094.description:
Acquire a New Light Kit from Ikora Rey, the Warlock Vanguard.

Find Ikora in the Tower Bazaar.
2238822094.description_zh:
从术士先锋艾可拉·蕾伊那里获取一套新曙光装备包。

在高塔集市中找到艾可拉。

2020271858.name: A Spark of Hope
2020271858.description: Return to Zavala in the Tower.

1969939001.name: A Spark of Hope
1969939001.description:
Claim the completed Guardian Rank 2 objective:
- The Vanguard
1969939001.description_zh:
领取已完成的守护者等级2目标：
- 先锋

1936383702.name: A Spark of Hope
1936383702.description: Receive your new Guardian Rank at the Tree in the Tower.
1936383702.description_zh: 在高塔树下领取你的新守护者等级。

2154492783.name: A Spark of Hope
2154492783.description: Let Zavala know you've reached Guardian Rank 2.
2154492783.description_zh: 通知萨瓦拉你已达到守护者等级2。

2121084667.name: A Spark of Hope
2121084667.description: Return to Ikora Rey in the Tower.
2121084667.description_zh: 回到高塔找艾可拉·蕾伊。

3966078208.name: A Spark of Hope
3966078208.description: Find Devrim Kay in the EDZ.
3966078208.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区找到德弗里姆·卡伊。

4066891017.name: A Spark of Hope
4066891017.description:
Reclaim the map fragments by defeating Fallen or looting a Lost Sector chest.

Fallen and [Lost Sector] Lost Sectors can be found within Trostland in the EDZ. The Lost Sectors are hidden in the area surrounding the church… and maybe even within. Look for the [Lost Sector] symbol in the world to find them.
4066891017.description_zh:
通过击败堕落者或劫掠遗失区域宝箱来夺回地图碎片。

堕落者和遗失区域可在欧洲无人区的慰藉之地内找到。遗失区域就隐藏在教堂周边…甚至内部的某些区域。你可以在游戏世界中通过符号来识别它们。

8928990.name: A Spark of Hope
8928990.description: Return to Devrim in the EDZ to see if he can help.
8928990.description_zh: 回去欧洲无人区找德弗里姆，看看他能不能帮忙。

109741767.name: A Spark of Hope
109741767.description:
Complete the mission "Risk/Reward" in the EDZ.

The node for this mission can be found in the EDZ section of the Destinations tab.
109741767.description_zh:
在欧洲无人区完成“风险与回报”任务。

此任务的节点可以在目的地选项卡的“欧洲无人区”区域中找到。

1009546525.name: A Spark of Hope
1009546525.description: Return to Zavala in the Tower.

2262912266.name: Quid Pro Quo
2262912266.description: Report your success to Drifter in the Tower.
2262912266.description_zh: 向高塔的浪客报告你的成功。

2392484247.name: Light Reforged
2392484247.description: Complete matches in any Crucible activity.
2392484247.description_zh: 在任意熔炉竞技场活动中完成比赛。

4136665139.name: Light Reforged
4136665139.description:
The Crucible handler is eager to hear of your progress.

Speak to Shaxx in the Tower.
4136665139.description_zh:
熔炉竞技场顾问很想了解你的进度。

去高塔与沙克斯交谈。

4205508063.name: Learning Light
4205508063.description: Speak with Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
4205508063.description_zh: 与位于发射基地的韩潇交谈。

2292418180.name: Learning Light
2292418180.description: Commune with the Traveler to learn its lesson.
2292418180.description_zh: 与旅行者交流，听取它的教诲。

4238224658.name: Learning Light
4238224658.description: Return to Shaw Han and tell him of what you learned.
4238224658.description_zh: 回到韩潇身边，告诉他你所了解到的情况。

44070171.name: Learning Light
44070171.description: Continue "A Guardian Rises" to find someone who can teach you more about your Light.
44070171.description_zh: 继续“守护者的诞生”，寻找能够提供更多光能教诲的人。

2889206213.name: Power from Ops
2889206213.description: Select the Training (1 of 7) difficulty level on any Solo Ops or Fireteam Ops activity. New elements and mechanics are detailed in the description.
2889206213.description_zh: 在任意单人行动或火力战队行动活动中选择训练（1/7）难度等级。新的元素与机制会在描述中详细说明。

2990019022.name: Power from Ops
2990019022.description: In Training (2 of 7), select a Challenge Modifier. These make activities more challenging, which increases your Reward Score Forecast!
2990019022.description_zh: 在训练（2/7）中，选择一个挑战修改器。此类修改器会让活动更具挑战性，同时提升你的奖励得分预测！

943399863.name: Power from Ops
943399863.description: In Training (3 of 7), a locked Time Bonus modifier has been added. Time Bonuses grant larger scores if the activity is completed within the time limit. For this exercise, a Time Bonus is expected to receive an A-Grade Reward Package.
943399863.description_zh: 在训练（3/7）中，新增了锁定的时间奖励修改器。时间奖励会在你于限定时间内完成活动时给予更高得分。本次训练中，需要取得时间奖励来获得A级奖励包裹。

774490776.name: Power from Ops
774490776.description: Reach Power Level 90 and complete a Common Order.
774490776.description_zh: 达到能量等级90并完成一个普通命令。

875303553.name: Power from Ops
875303553.description: In Training (4 of 7), select two Challenge Modifiers simultaneously. This will compound the challenge in your activity, and increase your Reward Score Forecast to a higher grade.
875303553.description_zh: 在训练（4/7）中，同时选择两个挑战修改器。这将进一步提升活动的挑战性，同时将你的奖励得分预测提升到更高等级。

976116362.name: Power from Ops
976116362.description: Reach Power Level 120 and complete two Common Orders.
976116362.description_zh: 达到能量等级120并完成2个普通命令。

2687580627.name: Power from Ops
2687580627.description:
In Training (5 of 7), set your Reward Forecast to an A-Grade Reward Package by adjusting your gear and selecting modifiers.

Achieve an A-Grade Reward Package to advance.
2687580627.description_zh:
在训练（5/7）中，通过调整装备和选择修改器，将奖励预测设为A级奖励包裹。

获得A级奖励包裹即可进入下个阶段。

908020180.name: Power from Ops
908020180.description: Reach Power Level 140 and complete two Daily Objectives.
908020180.description_zh: 达到能量等级140并完成2个日常目标。

3156368221.name: Power from Ops
3156368221.description:
In Training (6 of 7), select a Player Stake Modifier, which puts you and your fireteam at a specific disadvantage for a score boost. 

The first Stake is "Avant Garde," which restricts your weapons and armor to New Gear or Featured Gear during the activity. 

Select Avant Garde, equip only New or Featured Gear, and achieve an A-Grade Reward Package to advance.
3156368221.description_zh:
在训练（6/7）中，选择一个玩家风险修改器，让你和火力战队处于特定劣势，以换取得分提升。

第一个风险是“前卫”，在活动期间只可使用新装备或特色装备。

选择前卫，仅穿戴新装备或特色装备，在活动中获得A级奖励包裹即可进入下个阶段。

3719078191.name: Power from Ops
3719078191.description: Reach Power Level 170 and complete a Weekly Objective.
3719078191.description_zh: 达到能量等级170并完成一个周常目标。

3618265382.name: Power from Ops
3618265382.description:
In Training (7 of 7), select an additional Player Stake modifier: No HUD, which removes all the information normally available via your heads-up display!

Select the No HUD Player Stake modifier and achieve an A-Grade Reward Package to complete the final Training exercise.
3618265382.description_zh:
在训练（7/7）中，额外选择一个玩家风险修改器：无HUD，它会移除你抬头显示上的所有常规信息！

选择无HUD玩家风险修改器并获得A级奖励包裹，即可完成最终的训练。

4054336349.name: Power from Ops
4054336349.description: Visit Zavala in the Tower Courtyard to receive a reward!
4054336349.description_zh: 拜访高塔庭院中的萨瓦拉以领取奖励！

1805988308.name: Power from Ops
1805988308.description: Reach Weekly Rank 4 in the Seasonal HUB.
1805988308.description_zh: 在赛季中心达到周常等级4。

1705175531.name: Power from Ops
1705175531.description: Claim your Powerful Engram reward from the Seasonal HUB.
1705175531.description_zh: 从赛季中心领取强力记忆水晶奖励。

1604362722.name: Power from Ops
1604362722.description: Reach Rank 7 on the Seasonal HUB Reward Track and claim a weekly armor reward from Zavala.
1604362722.description_zh: 达到赛季中心奖励路线等级7，从萨瓦拉处领取一份周常护甲奖励。

3550169200.name: Power from Ops
3550169200.description:
Acquire and complete a Legendary Order.

You may earn a Legendary Order anytime you complete a Common Order. Completing activities and playing with others increases your chances of earning a Legendary Order. Your first 4 Legendary Orders completed each week will grant gear with greater than average Power.
3550169200.description_zh:
获得并完成一个传说命令。

完成任意普通命令时都有几率获得传说命令。完成活动以及与他人一起玩能增加获得传说命令的几率。每周完成的前四个传说命令将奖励高于平均能量等级的装备。

3887987150.name: Power from Ops
3887987150.description: Complete an Ops activity and earn a Prime Engram. Complete a Conquest activity.
3887987150.description_zh: 完成一次行动活动并获得一个至高记忆水晶。完成一次征服活动。

1547962234.name: Power from Ops
1547962234.description: Visit Zavala in the Tower Courtyard to receive a reward!
1547962234.description_zh: 拜访高塔庭院中的萨瓦拉以领取奖励！

2591382989.name: Riding the Storm
2591382989.description:
Awaken your latent power of [Arc] Arc Light by generating Orbs of Power and defeating combatants to earn points; using [Arc] damage grants substantially more points.

Orbs of Power can be generated by casting your Super.

Energy weapons deal elemental damage. Arc element weapons can be identified by selecting them in your Character screen and looking for the [Arc] symbol.
2591382989.description_zh:
通过生成能量球和击败战斗人员来获得分数，唤醒你的电弧光能潜力；使用伤害所获得的分数将大幅提升。

你可以通过施放超能来生成能量球。

能量武器可造成元素伤害。你可以在角色界面选择武器并根据图示中的符号来识别电弧元素武器。

2155312022.name: Riding the Storm
2155312022.description:
The Vanguard will be eager to hear of your newfound power.

Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower.
2155312022.description_zh:
先锋很想了解你新发现的力量。

去高塔与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

913332794.name: Stoking The Flame
913332794.description:
Awaken your latent power of [Solar] Solar Light by generating Orbs of Power and defeating combatants to earn points; using [Solar] damage grants substantially more points.

Orbs of Power can be generated by casting your Super.

Energy weapons deal elemental damage. Solar element weapons can be identified by selecting them in your Character screen and looking for the [Solar] symbol.
913332794.description_zh:
通过生成能量球和击败战斗人员来获得分数，唤醒你的烈日光能潜力；使用伤害所获得的分数将大幅提升。

你可以通过施放超能来生成能量球。

能量武器可造成元素伤害。你可以在角色界面选择武器并根据图示中的符号来识别烈日元素武器。

812519985.name: Stoking The Flame
812519985.description:
The Vanguard will be eager to hear of your newfound power.

Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower.
812519985.description_zh:
先锋一定很想听到关于你新发现的力量。

与高塔中的艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

3676690659.name: Gazing Into The Abyss
3676690659.description:
Awaken your latent power of [Void] Void Light by generating Orbs of Power and defeating combatants to earn points; using [Void] damage grants substantially more points.

Orbs of Power can be generated by casting your Super.

Energy weapons deal elemental damage. Void element weapons can be identified by selecting them in your Character screen and looking for the [Void] symbol.
3676690659.description_zh:
通过生成能量球和击败战斗人员来获得分数，唤醒你的虚空光能潜力；使用伤害所获得的分数将大幅提升。

你可以通过施放超能来生成能量球。

能量武器可造成元素伤害。你可以在角色界面选择武器并根据图示中的符号来识别虚空元素武器。

1763600808.name: Gazing Into The Abyss
1763600808.description:
The Vanguard will be eager to hear of your newfound power.

Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower.
1763600808.description_zh:
先锋一定很想听到关于你新发现的力量。

与高塔中的艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

2163974081.name: Ornamental Container
2163974081.description: Ikora Rey has information on how to harness the Light in other ways. Speak with her to begin your journey towards unlocking additional subclasses.
2163974081.description_zh: 艾可拉·蕾伊知道如何用其他方式来利用光能。跟她谈谈，开始解锁额外分支职业的旅途吧。

836278577.name: Meditate on the Light
836278577.description: Meditate to receive new subclass abilities.
836278577.description_zh: 通过冥想获得新分支职业技能。

3688853371.name: Exalting the Flame
3688853371.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
3688853371.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

1238879616.name: Exalting the Flame
1238879616.description:
With a [Solar] Solar subclass equipped, defeat targets affected by Scorch, defeat targets with abilities, and cast your Super.

Some Solar abilities Scorch your targets. Scorched targets take damage over time, and this damage increases as your target accumulates Scorch stacks. After enough Scorch stacks are applied, your foes ignite in a large explosion.

To make progress, equip abilities, aspects, fragments, or gear with the Scorch keyword. For example, the Ember of Char fragment makes your Solar Ignitions spread Scorch to affected targets.
1238879616.description_zh:
装备烈日分支职业时，击败受到灼烧影响的目标，使用技能击败目标，然后施放你的超能。

一些烈日技能会灼烧你的目标。被灼烧的目标会随着时间推移受到伤害，此伤害将随着你的目标灼烧层数的积累而提高。在施加足够多的灼烧层数后，你的敌人会在大型爆炸中被点燃。

要取得进度，应装备带有“灼烧”关键词的技能、星相、碎片或装备。例如，烧焦余烬碎片能让你的烈日点燃将灼烧效果蔓延至受影响的目标。

1322767807.name: Exalting the Flame
1322767807.description: Defeat a strong adversary in any Ops activity while using your Solar subclass.
1322767807.description_zh: 使用烈日分支职业时，在任意行动活动中败一名强大敌人。

1339692425.name: Exalting the Flame
1339692425.description: Purchase grenade abilities from Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1339692425.description_zh: 从高塔集市中的艾可拉·蕾伊处购买手雷技能。

1390025282.name: Exalting the Flame
1390025282.description:
Meditate to learn your new subclass ability.

The Meditation device is next to Ikora in the Tower Bazaar.
1390025282.description_zh:
进行冥想来学习你的新分支职业技能。

冥想装置位于高塔集市中的艾可拉·蕾伊身旁。

1306975926.name: Exalting the Flame
1306975926.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1306975926.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

1390863957.name: Exalting the Flame
1390863957.description:
Equip your Solar subclass and new Exotic armor.

If you no longer have access to your Exotic, it can be reacquired from Collections.
1390863957.description_zh:
装备你的烈日分支职业和新异域护甲。

如果你的异域装备已丢失，你可以在收藏中重新取得。

1407788735.name: Exalting the Flame
1407788735.description: Achieve a grade of B or greater in any Solo Ops activity on Advanced or higher difficulty with your [Solar] Solar subclass and new Exotic armor equipped.
1407788735.description_zh: 装备烈日分支职业和新异域护甲，以高级或更高难度完成任意单人行动活动并达到B或更高评级。

3789666148.name: Exalting the Flame
3789666148.description: Speak with Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
3789666148.description_zh: 去高塔庭院与班西-44交谈。

1000118612.name: Taming the Storm
1000118612.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1000118612.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

2913208495.name: Taming the Storm
2913208495.description:
With an [Arc] Arc subclass equipped, defeat targets affected by Jolt, defeat targets with abilities, and cast your Super.

Some Arc abilities will jolt your targets. As the jolted target takes additional damage, it chains lightning to other nearby targets.

To make progress, equip abilities, aspects, fragments, or gear with the Jolt keyword. For example, the Spark of Shock Fragment adds a Jolt effect to your Arc grenades.
2913208495.description_zh:
装备电弧分支职业时，击败被震颤的目标，用技能击败目标，然后施放你的超能。

一些电弧技能会震颤你的目标。被震颤的目标会受到额外伤害，还会将连锁闪电传递给附近的目标。

若要取得进度，则需装备有“震颤”关键词的技能、星相、碎片或装备。例如，震颤火花碎片能给你的电弧手雷添加震颤效果。

2829320432.name: Taming the Storm
2829320432.description: Defeat a strong adversary in any Ops activity while using your Arc subclass.
2829320432.description_zh: 使用电弧分支职业时，在任意行动活动中击败一名强大敌人。

697680249.name: Taming the Storm
697680249.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
697680249.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

748013106.name: Taming the Storm
748013106.description:
Equip your Arc subclass and new Exotic armor.

If you no longer have access to your Exotic, it can be reacquired from Collections.
748013106.description_zh:
装备你的电弧分支职业和新异域护甲。

如果你的异域装备已丢失，你可以从收藏中重新获取。

2744299504.name: Taming the Storm
2744299504.description: Achieve a grade of B or greater on any Solo Ops activity on Advanced or higher difficulty with your [Arc] Arc subclass and new Exotic armor equipped.
2744299504.description_zh: 装备电弧分支职业和新异域护甲，以高级或更高难度完成任意单人行动活动并达到B或更高评级。

899305835.name: Taming the Storm
899305835.description: Speak with Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
899305835.description_zh: 去高塔庭院与班西-44交谈。

1348325864.name: Into the Abyss
1348325864.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1348325864.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

3261415715.name: Into the Abyss
3261415715.description:
With a [Void] Void subclass equipped, defeat weakened targets, defeat targets with abilities, and cast your Super.

Some Void abilities weaken your targets. Weakened targets take increased damage, move more slowly, and fire less accurately.

To make progress, equip abilities, Aspects, Fragments, or gear with the Weaken keyword. For example, the Echo of Undermining Fragment adds a weaken effect to your Void grenades.
3261415715.description_zh:
装备虚空分支职业时，击败被削弱的目标，使用技能击败目标，然后施放你的超能。

一些虚空技能会削弱你的目标。被削弱的目标会受到更高伤害，行动更加迟缓并失去射击精准度。

要取得进度，应装备带有“削弱”关键词的技能、星相、碎片或装备。例如，弱化回声碎片能给你的虚空手雷增添削弱效果。

3311748604.name: Into the Abyss
3311748604.description: Defeat a strong adversary in any Ops activity while using your Void subclass.
3311748604.description_zh: 使用虚空分支职业时，在任意行动活动中击败一名强大敌人。

3697486682.name: Into the Abyss
3697486682.description: Purchase the Chaos Accelerant Aspect from Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
3697486682.description_zh: 从高塔集市中的艾可拉·蕾伊处购买混沌加速星相。

3647153793.name: Into the Abyss
3647153793.description:
Meditate to learn your new subclass ability.

The meditation device is next to Ikora in the Tower Bazaar.
3647153793.description_zh:
进行冥想来学习你的新分支职业技能。

冥想装置位于高塔集市中的艾可拉·蕾伊身旁。

1315609237.name: Into the Abyss
1315609237.description: Speak with Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1315609237.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

1231721206.name: Into the Abyss
1231721206.description:
Equip your Void subclass and new Exotic armor.

If you no longer have access to your Exotic, it can be reacquired from Collections.
1231721206.description_zh:
装备你的虚空分支职业和新异域护甲。

如果你的异域装备已丢失，你可以从收藏中重新获取。

1214796460.name: Into the Abyss
1214796460.description: Achieve a grade of B or greater in any Solo Ops activity on Advanced or higher difficulty with your [Void] Void subclass and new Exotic armor equipped.
1214796460.description_zh: 装备虚空分支职业和新异域护甲，以高级或更高难度完成任意单人行动活动并达到B或更高评级。

1517234823.name: Into the Abyss
1517234823.description: Speak with Banshee-44 in the Tower Courtyard.
1517234823.description_zh: 去高塔庭院与班西-44交谈。

2991727273.name: Timeline Reflection
2991727273.description: Complete the mission "Cayde's Fate" from the Timeline.
2991727273.description_zh: 完成时间线任务“凯德的命运”。

2890914464.name: Timeline Reflection
2890914464.description: Complete the mission "Crux of Stasis" from the Timeline.
2890914464.description_zh: 完成时间线任务“冰影核心”。

3059823455.name: Timeline Reflection
3059823455.description: Complete the mission "Lucent Hive" from the Timeline.
3059823455.description_zh: 完成时间线任务“光明邪魔族”。

811475414.name: Timeline Reflection
811475414.description: Complete the mission "Stranded" from the Timeline.

1146733572.name: Timeline Reflection
1146733572.description: Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
1146733572.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

4210816705.name: Timeline Reflection
4210816705.description: Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
4210816705.description_zh: 去高塔集市与艾可拉·蕾伊交谈。

3995422990.name: Dividing the Ladder
3995422990.description: Complete a match in the Competitive playlist.
3995422990.description_zh: 在多人竞技游戏列表中完成一场比赛。

3995422991.name: Dividing the Ladder
3995422991.description: Complete your Placement Series matches to establish your starting position on the tiered ladder.
3995422991.description_zh: 完成你的定级系列赛来确定你在阶段天梯上的起始排名。

3995422988.name: Dividing the Ladder
3995422988.description: Return to Lord Shaxx in the Tower.
3995422988.description_zh: 回到高塔找领主沙克斯。

3934247791.name: Forged Anew
3934247791.description: Complete a match in the New Territory playlist.
3934247791.description_zh: 在新领域游戏列表中完成一场比赛。

3934247790.name: Forged Anew
3934247790.description: Complete matches in each New Territory. Earn bonus progress for wins.
3934247790.description_zh: 在每个新领域中完成比赛。胜场可获得额外进度。

3934247789.name: Forged Anew
3934247789.description: Return to Lord Shaxx in the Tower.
3934247789.description_zh: 回到高塔找领主沙克斯。

4121463065.name: Trials Returns
4121463065.description: Speak with Saint-14 in the Tower Hangar.
4121463065.description_zh: 与高塔机库中的圣人14号交谈。

1359460005.name: Trials Access
1359460005.description:
Your zeal is noted, friend, but your Light requires refinement. As the acting officiator of the Trials of Osiris, Saint-14 has assessed the necessary requirements for entry. His assessment has set the entry bar at a measurable Power of {var:3800354482}. While every Guardian has strength in their own right, some do not yet have the battle experience to operate seamlessly in a Trials fireteam.

Reach Power {var:3800354482}, complete your Competitive Placement Matches, and defeat opponents in Competitive Crucible to participate in the Trials of Osiris.
1359460005.description_zh:
你的热情值得肯定，朋友，但你的光能还需要磨练。作为奥斯里斯试炼的代理司仪，圣人14号已评估出进入比赛的先决条件。他将门槛设置在了一个比较合理的{var:3800354482}能量等级。尽管每个守护者都有自己的长项，但有些人的战斗经验还不足以在试炼火力战队中完美发挥。

达到{var:3800354482}能量等级，完成你的多人竞技定级赛，并在多人竞技熔炉竞技场中击败对手，以获得奥斯里斯试炼的参加资格。

1359460004.name: Trials Access
1359460004.description: Return to Saint-14 in the Tower Hangar.
1359460004.description_zh: 回到高塔机库与圣人14号交谈。

1359460007.name: Trials Access
1359460007.description: Acquire a Trials Passage from Saint-14 to begin the Trials of Osiris. Play a game, win a round, and eliminate an opponent.
1359460007.description_zh: 从圣人14号处获得试炼入场券来开始奥斯里斯试炼。进行游戏，赢下回合，消灭对手。

1359460006.name: Trials Access
1359460006.description: Return to Saint-14 in the Tower Hangar for your reward: a weapon to help secure future victories.
1359460006.description_zh: 回到高塔机库与圣人14号交谈来获取奖励：一件有助于获得未来胜利的武器。

3715926175.name: The Journey
3715926175.description: Around you… darkness. If you are to discover your path, you must anchor yourself to light.
3715926175.description_zh: 你身边……一片黑暗。要想发现自己的道路，你就必须将自己固定到光能之上。

3710486535.name: The Journey
3710486535.description: A light shines on your path. But you have yet to bring it into focus. Until then, your path remains among the lost.
3710486535.description_zh: 一道光照亮了你的道路。但你还没能让它落入目光的焦点。在此之前，你的道路仍然迷失。

2269402074.name: The Journey
2269402074.description: Your path brightens, shining through the barrier of emerald, beneath a harbor built from sorrow.
2269402074.description_zh: 在翡翠屏障的照耀下，在由忧伤所建成的港湾之中，你的道路明亮了起来。

1503907116.name: The Journey
1503907116.description: The Pariahs stand guard over far more than just despair, for within these tunnels lie many secrets.
1503907116.description_zh: 那些流放者守卫着的绝不仅只是绝望，因为这些隧道中隐藏着太多的秘密。

60788839.name: The Journey
60788839.description: The end of your path is in sight. Defeat those who would keep you from it.
60788839.description_zh: 你已经看到了道路的尽头。消灭所有阻止你走向终点的敌人吧。

1465888553.name: The Journey
1465888553.description: Return to Eris Morn with the Hive bug.
1465888553.description_zh: 带着邪魔族臭虫回去找埃里斯·摩恩。

613601972.name: Symphony of Death
613601972.description: Eris Morn believes the Hive's wicked science can be turned against them. Help her investigate the Circle of Bones beneath the Moon.
613601972.description_zh: 埃里斯·摩恩认为可以逆转邪魔族的邪恶科技来对付他们。帮助她调查月球地表以下的骸骨之环。

3908666296.name: Symphony of Death
3908666296.description: Your understanding of the Hive's Deathsong has only just begun. Take the Silent Skull to Eris Morn.
3908666296.description_zh: 你对邪魔族死亡之歌的理解只不过是个开始。将沉默头骨带去给埃里斯·摩恩。

1479328354.name: Symphony of Death
1479328354.description: Collect bones from public events near the Hellmouth, the Lost Sector K1 Revelation in Sorrow's Harbor, and a wandering Bone Collector on the Moon.
1479328354.description_zh: 从地狱深渊附近的公共事件、悲伤港口的K1启示区遗失区域和在月球上游荡的骸骨收集者身上收集骸骨。

926942410.name: Symphony of Death
926942410.description: Enter the Scarlet Keep strike and slay the High Conductor, Sulmâkta, within.
926942410.description_zh: 进入“猩红要塞”打击，在那里击杀高阶指挥，苏尔马科塔。

1325063399.name: Symphony of Death
1325063399.description: Record your enemies' screams. Defeat base combatants to record discomfort. Defeat elites and minibosses to record pain. Defeat bosses and other Guardians to record anguish. Screams gathered on the Moon count more.
1325063399.description_zh: 记录下你的敌人的尖叫声。消灭基础战斗人员以记录不适。消灭精英和初级首领以记录疼痛。消灭首领和击败其他守护者以记录痛苦。在月球上收集到的尖叫声能更高效地提升进度。

1961485542.name: Symphony of Death
1961485542.description: Fight your way into the depths of the Circle of Bones, survive the Aria, and defeat the Deathsinger, Ir Airâm. Then, bring her skull to Eris Morn.
1961485542.description_zh: 一路杀入骸骨之环深处，在死亡之歌的咏叹调中幸存下来，然后消灭死亡歌者伊尔·艾拉姆。随后，将她的头骨带给埃里斯·摩恩。

2887971121.name: Symphony of Death
2887971121.description: Bring the Singing Skull to Eris Morn to complete your terrifying new instrument of war.
2887971121.description_zh: 将吟唱头骨带给埃里斯·摩恩，完成这件可怕的新战争乐器。

1295283020.name: Divine Fragmentation
1295283020.description: "We found this on the corpse of that Vex Minotaur on the Moon. It's a core of some kind. Definitely Vex made… but I can't verify exactly what, when, where… or why. We could find the information we need by tapping into a Vex construct, but there are none on the Moon…" —Ghost
1295283020.description_zh: “在月球上的Vex米诺陶的尸体身上，我们找到了这个。这应该是某种核心。肯定是Vex制造出来的…但我没法验证它到底是什么，来自什么时间，来自哪里……以及，有什么作用。只要我们能连接到一个Vex构造体，就能找到我们所需要的信息，但月球上没有这种东西……”——机灵

3918035165.name: Divine Fragmentation
3918035165.description: "I had to dig deep into encrypted Vex data to find anything regarding the core. I didn't find much—only that it's designed for decryption of something and that its origin lies with the Sol Divisive Vex. I couldn't learn anything further. It's broken and its data is largely corrupted. We might be able to repair it if we had access to Sol Divisive parts." —Ghost
3918035165.description_zh: “我必须深入挖掘加密的Vex数据，才能找到跟核心有关的内容。虽然找到的信息不多——但它似乎就是为了解码某种东西而设计的……它的来源应该与太阳系分支Vex有关。我无法取得更多进展。核心已经损坏，里面的数据大多数都被破坏了。如果我们能找到一些太阳系分支的零件，也许能将它修好。”——机灵

2574261183.name: Divine Fragmentation
2574261183.description: "The Decryption Core is mended, but remains inactive. I was able to mine it for further data, and there are segments of data in a language I'm unable to decipher. Let me see if I can define its resonant energy pattern—wait, what? That's the same energy that pulsates from the Nightmare Essences. The energy signature is weak, but we should have the means to empower it." —Ghost
2574261183.description_zh: “解码核心已经修好了，但还是无法启动。我设法挖掘到了更多数据，但里面有一部分数据的语言我无法解码。我来看看是不是能搞清楚它的共振能量模式——等等，怎么回事？这种能量与梦魇精华所散发出来的能量一模一样。虽然能量特征很微弱，但我们应该有办法能对它进行充能了。”——机灵

2101914852.name: Divine Fragmentation
2101914852.description: "I've fully analyzed the Decryption Core now that we've empowered it. There's a ton more data in here—but again, I don't understand most of its language. I was able to extract some key information, sporadic words here and there. 'Garden… Defenses… Guardians…' I haven't made complete sense of it yet, but there's only one Garden I know of associated with the Sol Divisive." —Ghost
2101914852.description_zh: “我已经充分分析了充能后的解码核心。这里面还有大量的数据——但还是那句话，我无法理解其中的大多数语言。不过我提取出了一些核心数据，一些零星的词汇。‘花园……防御……守护者……'我还没能理解完整的意思，但跟太阳系分支有关的花园我只知道那么一个。”——机灵

55722088.name: The Vow
55722088.description: Banshee has a new Exotic weapon catalyst for you—but first he needs a favor.
55722088.description_zh: 班西为你准备了一件新的异域武器催化剂——但首先你得帮他一个忙。

2354690788.name: The Vow
2354690788.description: Earn progress by completing Ops activities.
2354690788.description_zh: 完成行动活动可获得进度。

55722089.name: The Vow
55722089.description: Return to Banshee to receive your new Exotic weapon catalyst.
55722089.description_zh: 回去找班西领取你的新异域武器催化剂。

4039893890.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4039893890.description: Investigate the strange Hive behavior near the Scarlet Keep.
4039893890.description_zh: 调查猩红要塞附近奇怪的邪魔族活动。

4016941122.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4016941122.description:
A Nightmare of Omnigul has stormed through the lunar encampment.

Return to Sanctuary to speak with Eris Morn.
4016941122.description_zh:
一个奥姆尼哥的梦魇穿过了月球营地。

回去圣所与埃里斯·摩恩交谈。

4010589224.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4010589224.description:
Eris believes the Essence dropped by the Nightmare of Crota is a key to entering the Pyramid and learning the truth behind its presence on the Moon.

Cleanse the Essence of Despair to allow Eris to learn its secrets.

Complete the quest "Essence of Despair."
4010589224.description_zh:
埃里斯认为，克洛塔的梦魇所掉落的精华是进入金字塔和了解它出现在月球的真相的关键。

净化绝望精华，让埃里斯了解它的秘密。

完成任务“绝望精华”。

2369227168.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2369227168.description:
The Essence of Despair is cleansed. Its true purpose may now be uncovered.

Return to Eris Morn with the Cleansed Essence.
2369227168.description_zh:
绝望精华已经被净化。现在可以找出它的真正用途了。

带着净化后的精华回去找埃里斯·摩恩。

4039893891.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4039893891.description:
Eris used a Hive talisman of her own to create the first piece of protective armor.

To pass beyond the Pyramid's warding and discover what lies within, you'll need to wear a full set of Dreambane armor.

Take the first step and hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.
4039893891.description_zh:
埃里斯利用她自己的一块邪魔族护身符来打造出了第一件保护性护甲。

若想穿过金字塔的结界，探索隐藏其中的秘密，你需要装备一整套梦境祸根护甲。

先迈出第一步，去猎杀奥姆尼哥的梦魇吧。

2663040515.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2663040515.description: Speak with Eris Morn to learn what she believes lies within the Scarlet Keep.
2663040515.description_zh: 与埃里斯·摩恩交谈，了解她认为猩红要塞中隐藏着哪些威胁。

2579262077.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2579262077.description:
Investigate the Scarlet Keep to locate more Hive curios and discover a connection between the Hive and the Pyramid.

Launch the strike "The Scarlet Keep" from the Moon on the Director.
2579262077.description_zh:
调查猩红要塞，找到更多邪魔族古物，然后找出邪魔族与金字塔之间的关联。

在月球上使用导航器发动“猩红要塞”突击。

1074168413.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
1074168413.description:
Cleanse the Essence of Anguish dropped by Omnigul.

It can be viewed in the Quests tab of the Director.
1074168413.description_zh:
净化奥姆尼哥掉落的痛苦精华。

你可以在导航器的“任务”选项卡中查看它。

2369227171.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2369227171.description:
Hashladûn's death has yielded information of great value: the existence of the Hive Cryptoglyph and where to find it.

Return to Eris Morn with news of the Hive Cryptoglyph uncovered during the strike "The Scarlet Keep."
2369227171.description_zh:
哈什拉顿的死为我们带来了一条具有重要价值的信息：邪魔族秘符的存在以及它的所在地。

带着你在“猩红要塞”打击中发现的有关邪魔族秘符的消息回去找埃里斯·摩恩。

3076437306.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
3076437306.description:
Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
3076437306.description_zh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

2369227170.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2369227170.description:
Taking the Cryptoglyph from the Catacombs has interrupted the dark rituals planned by the Hidden Swarm… for now.

With the Cryptoglyph and Eris's magic, you should be able to craft further Dreambane armor.

Return to Eris Morn with the Cryptoglyph.
2369227170.description_zh:
从墓穴中拿走秘符使的隐秘的虫群秘密谋划的黑暗仪式被中断……但这只是暂时的。

有了秘符和埃里斯的魔法，你应该可以打造更多梦境祸根护甲了。

带着秘符回去找埃里斯·摩恩。

4150657477.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4150657477.description: Use the Cryptoglyph to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris Morn.
4150657477.description_zh: 使用秘符为埃里斯·摩恩身旁的附魔台充能。

4141787158.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
4141787158.description:
Ikora has arrived on the Moon to see the Pyramid for herself and deliver a message.

Take the portal near Eris to meet Ikora in the Enduring Abyss on the Moon.
4141787158.description_zh:
艾可拉已经抵达月球来亲自观察金字塔，同时她还给你带来了一则消息。

穿过埃里斯身边的传送门，到月球上的永恒深渊去找艾可拉。

1858645823.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
1858645823.description:
Defeat the three remaining Nightmare bosses to collect their Essences: the Essence of Fear, the Essence of Isolation, and the Essence of Pride.

Each piece of Dreambane armor crafted is another step closer to entering the Pyramid and searching within for anything that can help stave off the impending threat Ikora has warned us about.
1858645823.description_zh:
消灭剩余的三个梦魇首领以收集它们的精华：恐惧精华、孤立精华和傲气精华。

每打造出一件梦境祸根护甲，你距离踏入金字塔就近了一步。只有在那里，你才能找到可以缓解艾可拉曾经警告过我们的那场紧迫威胁的办法。

2369227173.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2369227173.description:
You now have a full set of Dreambane armor. 

Return to Eris Morn for final preparations before entering the Pyramid.
2369227173.description_zh:
你现在有一整套的梦境祸根护甲了。 

回去找埃里斯·摩恩，完成进入金字塔前的最后准备。

1983731381.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
1983731381.description:
What secrets lie within the Pyramid? It sits in silence, waiting for you.

Head to the Enduring Abyss, past the Pyramid's warding, and find a way inside.
1983731381.description_zh:
金字塔里面到底有着怎样的秘密呢？它就在一片寂静之中，等待着你的到来。

前往永恒深渊，穿过金字塔的结界，找到进去的路。

2369227172.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2369227172.description: Return to Eris Morn with the Unknown Artifact.
2369227172.description_zh: 带着未知神器回去找埃里斯·摩恩。

1322836372.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
1322836372.description: Share your findings from the Moon with the Vanguard leaders in the Tower.
1322836372.description_zh: 将你在月球上的发现告诉高塔中的先锋领袖。

1322836373.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
1322836373.description: Share your findings from the Moon with the Vanguard leaders in the Tower.
1322836373.description_zh: 将你在月球上的发现告诉高塔中的先锋领袖。

2178015352.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
2178015352.description: Travel to the Moon and stave off the Hive resurgence alongside your fellow Guardians.
2178015352.description_zh: 前往月球，与你的守护者伙伴们一起延缓邪魔族的复苏。

88202002.name: Legacy: Shadowkeep
88202002.description: Find Eris Morn at the encampment in Sanctuary.
88202002.description_zh: 在圣所的营地中找到埃里斯·摩恩。

1340580576.name: Memory of Sai Mota
1340580576.description: Complete the "Lunar Spelunker" bounty to earn a Firewall Data Fragment. Use the fragment to access the system core vault in the K1 Revelation Lost Sector.
1340580576.description_zh: 完成“月球探险家”悬赏以获取一份防火墙数据碎片。使用碎片打开K1启示部遗失区域中的系统核心库。

1340580577.name: Memory of Sai Mota
1340580577.description: Search for scraps of Sai Mota's necklace by defeating Nightmares on the Moon with Arc abilities. Stronger combatants grant more progress.
1340580577.description_zh: 在月球上使用电弧技能消灭梦魇，搜索赛·莫塔的项链碎片。更强大的敌人能最高效地提升进度。

1340580578.name: Memory of Sai Mota
1340580578.description: Use the portal in Sanctuary to return Sai Mota's Repaired Necklace to Eris.
1340580578.description_zh: 使用圣所中的传送门，将赛·莫塔的修好的项链交还给埃里斯。

1340580579.name: Memory of Sai Mota
1340580579.description: Collect your reward from the chest in Eris Morn's overlook in the Enduring Abyss.
1340580579.description_zh: 前往永恒深渊，从埃里斯·摩恩的了望塔里的宝箱中领取你的奖励。

3077591737.name: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
3077591737.description: Complete the currently active replayable story mission on the Moon.
3077591737.description_zh: 完成当前月球上的可重复剧情任务。

3077591736.name: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
3077591736.description:
Search for fragments of Vell Tarlowe's Titan Mark.

In Nightmare Hunts of Adept difficulty or above, use melee abilities to defeat powerful combatants.

Nightmares grant the most efficient progress.
3077591736.description_zh:
寻找维尔·塔罗的泰坦印记碎片。

在专家或以上难度的梦魇狩猎中，使用近战技能消灭强大的战斗人员。

消灭梦魇能最高效地提升进度。

3077591739.name: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
3077591739.description: Use the portal in Santuary to return Vell Tarlowe's Mark to Eris.
3077591739.description_zh: 使用圣所中的传送门，将维尔·塔罗的印记交还给埃里斯。

3077591738.name: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
3077591738.description: Collect your reward from the chest in Eris Morn's overlook in the Enduring Abyss.
3077591738.description_zh: 前往永恒深渊，从埃里斯·摩恩的了望塔里的宝箱中领取你的奖励。

3496531766.name: The Bank Job
3496531766.description: Speak to Banshee-44 to learn more about the catalyst for the Witherhoard.
3496531766.description_zh: 与班西-44谈谈，了解更多关于枯萎囤积的催化的信息

2003401139.name: The Bank Job
2003401139.description: Acquire Vault Keys by defeating combatants with Kinetic or Energy Grenade Launchers. Rapidly defeat combatants for a higher chance to receive a key.
2003401139.description_zh: 使用动能或能量榴弹发射器消灭战斗人员，取得金库钥匙。快速消灭战斗人员有更高几率获得钥匙。

2300040094.name: The Bank Job
2300040094.description:
Earn points, rapidly defeat targets with Grenade Launchers, and defeat Guardians while using Grenade Launchers. 

Points are earned when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
2300040094.description_zh:
获得分数，使用榴弹发射器快速击败目标，并在使用榴弹发射器时击败守护者。

完成行动活动可获得分数。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

3496531767.name: The Bank Job
3496531767.description: Visit Banshee-44 to receive the catalyst for the Witherhoard.
3496531767.description_zh: 拜访班西-44，获得枯萎囤积的催化

1744528000.name: A New Season Arrives at Eververse
1744528000.name_zh: 新赛季已降临永恒之诗
1744528000.description: Speak with Tess Everis in the Tower.
1744528000.description_zh: 与高塔中的泰斯·艾夫瑞斯交谈。

2652352679.name: Walk the Line
2652352679.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Duality. 

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
2652352679.description_zh:
使用二象性校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

3387343924.name: Walk the Line
3387343924.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive your reward.
3387343924.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取你的奖励。

3679234405.name: Timeless Victory
3679234405.description:
In Crucible matches, defeat opponents with precision final blows, defeat opponents with melee final blows while using a [Stasis] Stasis subclass, and collect Stasis Essence.

Stasis Essence has a chance to drop when defeating frozen Guardians.
3679234405.description_zh:
在熔炉竞技场比赛中，用精准最后一击击败对手，在装备冰影分支职业时用近战最后一击击败对手，并收集冰影精华。

击败被冻结的守护者时有几率掉落冰影精华。

2719903032.name: Umbral Conquest
2719903032.description:
Complete the listed objectives in Crucible matches.

Collect Crystalline Formations by defeating slowed Guardians.
2719903032.description_zh:
在熔炉竞技场比赛中完成列出的目标。

击败被减速的守护者以收集水晶构造。

1490203679.name: Umbral Strife
1490203679.description: Complete the listed objectives in Crucible matches.
1490203679.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场比赛中完成列出的目标。

1930571866.name: Umbral Conflict
1930571866.description:
Complete the listed objectives in Crucible matches.

Shatter damage is caused by shattering Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
1930571866.description_zh:
在熔炉竞技场比赛中完成列出的目标。

碎裂伤害可通过破碎冰影水晶和被冻结的目标而产生。

435145886.name: Umbral Plunder
435145886.description:
Complete the listed objectives in Gambit matches.

Shatter damage is caused by shattering Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
435145886.description_zh:
在智谋比赛中完成列出的目标。

碎裂伤害可通过破碎冰影结块和被冻结的目标而产生。

3339057603.name: Umbral Hunger
3339057603.description: Complete the listed objectives in Gambit matches.
3339057603.description_zh: 在智谋比赛中完成列出的目标。

1360203916.name: Umbral Schemes
1360203916.description:
Complete the listed objectives in Gambit matches.

Umbral Particles can drop when banking Motes.
1360203916.description_zh:
在智谋比赛中完成列出的目标。

存入萤光时会掉落本影粒子。

2308577369.name: Umbral Riches
2308577369.description: Complete the listed objectives in Gambit matches.
2308577369.description_zh: 在智谋比赛中完成列出的目标。

904478927.name: Umbral Flames
904478927.description: Complete the listed objectives in strikes and Vanguard playlists.
904478927.description_zh: 在打击和先锋游戏列表中完成列出的目标。

3963636042.name: Umbral Duty
3963636042.description:
Complete the listed objectives in strikes and Vanguard playlists.

Dark Reflections have a chance to drop from defeated strike bosses.
3963636042.description_zh:
在打击和先锋游戏列表中完成列出的目标。

击败打击首领有几率掉落暗影映像。

2880619157.name: Umbral Incursions
2880619157.description: Complete the following objectives in strikes and Vanguard playlists: Collect Dusk Slivers from rifle final blows; defeat frozen combatants; and defeat challenging combatants, bosses, and Champions with [Stasis] Stasis damage.
2880619157.description_zh: 在打击和先锋游戏列表中完成以下目标：通过步枪最后一击收集薄暮白银；消灭被冻结的战斗人员；用冰影伤害击败强力战斗人员、首领和勇士。

3765938216.name: Umbral Infiltration
3765938216.description:
Complete the listed objectives in strikes and Vanguard playlists:

Shatter damage is caused by shattering Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
3765938216.description_zh:
在打击和先锋游戏列表中完成列出的目标。

碎裂伤害可通过碎裂冰影结块和被冻结的目标而产生。

4208139872.name: Points Piercing Forever
4208139872.description: Siphon energy for the Ticuu's Divination catalyst by collecting Orbs of Power, defeating combatants, and defeating Guardians.
4208139872.description_zh: 收集能量球、消灭战斗人员和击败守护者，为帝喾预言催化虹吸能量。

3805576189.name: Points Piercing Forever
3805576189.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Ticuu's Divination.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
3805576189.description_zh:
使用帝喾预言校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

3834743350.name: Points Piercing Forever
3834743350.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the repaired catalyst.
3834743350.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取修复的催化。

3273285996.name: Stasis Trigger
3273285996.description: Reverse-engineer the schematics for Cryosthesia 77K's catalyst by defeating combatants, defeating Guardians, and delivering precision final blows.
3273285996.description_zh: 通过消灭战斗人员、击败守护者和打出精准最后一击来逆向工程冷冻状态77K的催化的图纸。

3644638448.name: Stasis Trigger
3644638448.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Cryosthesia 77K. 

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
3644638448.description_zh:
使用冷冻状态77K校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

3815407261.name: Stasis Trigger
3815407261.description: Return to Banshee-44 in the Tower to receive the calibrated catalyst.
3815407261.description_zh: 回去找高塔中的班西-44领取已校准的催化。

1688645344.name: REVISION 7.2.2
1688645344.description: Gather field data for Lorentz Driver's catalyst by defeating challenging combatants, Guardians, and Champions or high-value targets.
1688645344.description_zh: 通过击败高阶战斗人员、守护者、勇士或高价值目标为洛伦兹驱动器收集实战数据。

3452090911.name: REVISION 7.2.2
3452090911.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Lorentz Driver.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
3452090911.description_zh:
使用洛伦兹驱动器校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

514115916.name: REVISION 7.2.2
514115916.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
514115916.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

2729195975.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
2729195975.description: Investigate the Loot Cave for Shaw Han. Complete the "Grasp of Avarice" dungeon.
2729195975.description_zh: 为韩潇调查战利品洞穴。完成“贪婪之握”地牢。

1907272938.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
1907272938.description: Bring the Wolfpack Round to Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
1907272938.description_zh: 把狼群弹药带给位于发射基地的韩潇。

1092992613.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
1092992613.description: Collect Wolfpack Rounds by defeating powerful Fallen in the Cosmodrome.
1092992613.description_zh: 在发射基地击败强大堕落者来收集狼群弹药。

4267361189.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
4267361189.description: Return to Shaw Han with the Wolfpack Rounds.
4267361189.description_zh: 带着狼群弹药回去找韩潇。

1351533424.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
1351533424.description: Visit Banshee-44 in the Tower to see what he can tell you about Gjallarhorn.
1351533424.description_zh: 拜访位于高塔的班西-44，得到更多关于加拉尔号角的情报。

2223009594.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
2223009594.description: Banshee believes you'll find the last component to rebuild Gjallarhorn guarded in one of the Fallen's old hideouts.
2223009594.description_zh: 班西认为你会在堕落者的旧藏身处找到复原加拉尔号角的最后组件。

2126919859.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
2126919859.description: Return to Shaw Han's camp and use the tool chest in the hideout to assemble the reclaimed Gjallarhorn components.
2126919859.description_zh: 回到韩潇的营地，使用藏身处的工具箱拼装取回的加拉尔号角组件。

4094027156.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
4094027156.description: Return to Shaw Han to complete Gjallarhorn.
4094027156.description_zh: 回去找韩潇，完成加拉尔号角。

282753691.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
282753691.description: Xûr believes you should speak to Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
282753691.description_zh: 仄认为你应该到发射基地与韩潇交谈。

2881153063.name: And Out Fly the Wolves
2881153063.description: Xûr asked you to speak to Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
2881153063.description_zh: 仄让你去发射基地找韩潇交谈。

3236557427.name: Restless Slumber
3236557427.description: While in the Dreaming City, complete a public event, loot a Lost Sector, and complete bounties provided by Petra Venj.
3236557427.description_zh: 在幽梦之城，完成一次公共事件，洗劫一个遗失区域，并完成佩特拉·万吉所提供的悬赏。

1424280353.name: Restless Slumber
1424280353.description: Activate the Blind Well and defeat the foes drawn to the engine.
1424280353.description_zh: 激活盲目之井并消灭被引擎吸引的敌人。

1391563758.name: Restless Slumber
1391563758.description: Return to Petra Venj in the Dreaming City.
1391563758.description_zh: 回到幽梦之城去找佩特拉·万吉。

4213377134.name: Hunters' Remembrance
4213377134.description: Petra Venj sent a cryptic request for assistance. Locate her in the Dreaming City and ask her for details.
4213377134.description_zh: 佩特拉·万吉发来一个神秘的援助请求。在幽梦之城找到她，向她询问详情。

3732541924.name: Hunters' Remembrance
3732541924.description: Purify Awoken mementos by hunting down three Taken within the Shattered Throne: a Minotaur in Erebus, a Captain in The Descent, and an Ogre in Eleusinia.
3732541924.description_zh: 在破碎王座内追猎三名傀儡军团来净化觉醒者纪念物：厄瑞玻斯的米诺陶，陷窟的队长，以及厄琉息斯的虫瘤。

4271579370.name: Hunters' Remembrance
4271579370.description: Present purified Awoken mementos to the statue of Sjur Eido.
4271579370.description_zh: 将净化的觉醒者纪念物呈递至苏尔·艾多的雕像处。

1202973617.name: Hunters' Remembrance
1202973617.description: Return to Petra Venj for a debriefing. She will want to see the Awoken bow with her own eyes.
1202973617.description_zh: 返回佩特拉·万吉处接收简报。她一定想亲眼看看觉醒者弓箭。

981988968.name: A Single Thread
981988968.description: Return to Hawthorne in the Tower Bazaar.
981988968.description_zh: 回到高塔集市去找霍桑。

1246673684.name: Ares Desperado
1246673684.description: Complete the "Spire of the Watcher" dungeon.

2216822043.name: Ares Desperado
2216822043.description: Return to Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar and report your success.
2216822043.description_zh: 回到高塔集市找艾可拉·蕾伊并报告你的成功。

2163065963.name: Magnum Opus
2163065963.description: Collect Strange Coins and bring them back to Starhorse in Eternity.
2163065963.description_zh: 收集奇异硬币，把它们带回给位于永恒的星马。

2163065962.name: Magnum Opus
2163065962.description:
Obtain and complete bounties from Starhorse in Eternity.

Bonus progress granted for higher-difficulty Starhorse bounties.
2163065962.description_zh:
从位于永恒的星马处获得并完成悬赏。

更高难度的星马悬赏可获得额外进度。

418611489.name: Magnum Opus
418611489.description: Obtain the Strange Key from Xûr in Eternity after reaching Strange Favor Rank "Brave."
418611489.description_zh: 达到奇异恩惠等级“勇者”后，从位于永恒的仄处获得奇异钥匙。

2163065961.name: Magnum Opus
2163065961.description: Return to Eternity now that you've risen to the impossible horse's challenges.
2163065961.description_zh: 既然你已经完成不可思议之马的挑战，就回到永恒去吧。

2163065960.name: Magnum Opus
2163065960.description: Unlock the way forward with the Strange Key and follow the path it opens to claim the mysterious object.
2163065960.description_zh: 使用奇异钥匙解锁前行之路，沿着它开启的道路领取神秘物品。

2163065967.name: Magnum Opus
2163065967.description: Bring the Anomalous Object to Banshee in the Tower to see if he can repair it.
2163065967.description_zh: 把异常物体带到位于高塔的班西处，看他能不能修好它。

3722092874.name: Magnum Opus II
3722092874.description: Complete the Dares of Eternity and get a fantastic score in order to earn the missing part of Forerunner.
3722092874.description_zh: 完成永恒挑战并获得优异得分，以获得“先驱者”缺失的部件。

3722092875.name: Magnum Opus II
3722092875.description: Bring the Anomalous Weapon Part back to Banshee in the Tower to install it on your Forerunner.
3722092875.description_zh: 把异常武器部件带到位于高塔的班西处来将其安装至“先驱者”上。

685371146.name: Eternity Beckons
685371146.description: Complete a round of Dares of Eternity.
685371146.description_zh: 完成一个永恒挑战回合。

2290695758.name: Strange Xûr in a Strange Land
2290695758.description: Complete a round of Dares of Eternity.
2290695758.description_zh: 完成一个永恒挑战回合。

1898629824.name: To the Daring Go the Spoils
1898629824.description: Obtain a Treasure Key by completing a round of Dares of Eternity.
1898629824.description_zh: 完成一个永恒挑战回合来获得一把宝藏钥匙。

1898629825.name: To the Daring Go the Spoils
1898629825.description: Use a Treasure Key to open a chest in Xûr's vault in Eternity.
1898629825.description_zh: 使用宝藏钥匙来开启仄的永恒宝库中的宝箱。

1898629830.name: To the Daring Go the Spoils
1898629830.description_zh: 回去找位于永恒中的仄。

2471210438.name: Europa Legs
2471210438.description: Look for another Stasis-sealed chest in Bray Exoscience.
2471210438.description_zh: 在布瑞Exo科学所寻找另一个被冰影封印的宝箱。

3560528864.name: Europa Arms
3560528864.description: Look for Stasis-sealed chests in Bray Exoscience and Eternity.
3560528864.description_zh: 在布瑞Exo科学所和永恒寻找被冰影封印的宝箱。

908878819.name: Europa Class
908878819.description: Look for a Stasis-sealed chest in Perdition.
908878819.description_zh: 在永劫地狱寻找被冰影封印的宝箱。

658526296.name: Europa Chest
658526296.description: Look for Stasis-sealed chests in Riis-Reborn Approach and Technocrat's Iron.
658526296.description_zh: 在重生的里斯入口和技术专家的烙印寻找被冰影封印的宝箱。

1666445095.name: Europa Helm
1666445095.description: Look for Stasis-sealed chests in Nexus and Well of Infinitude.
1666445095.description_zh: 在枢纽和无尽之井寻找被冰影封印的宝箱。

1239957057.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957057.description: Return to Variks to discuss what to do about Eramis's growing power.
1239957057.description_zh: 回去找瓦里克斯讨论该如何应对伊拉莫斯不断增长的力量。

2757895694.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2757895694.description_zh: 完成“抵抗势力的崛起”任务。

1239957058.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957058.description: Speak to the Exo Stranger to learn why she's here and what the monolith is.
1239957058.description_zh: 与Exo陌客交谈，了解她为什么要来这里，以及那个方尖碑是什么。

431984071.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
431984071.description: Attune the Splinter of Darkness in the Ziggurat in Beyond.
431984071.description_zh: 在超越层的通灵塔同调暗影裂片。

785647195.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
785647195.description: Commune with a Crux of Darkness in Nexus.
785647195.description_zh: 在枢纽与一个暗影核心进行交流。

3513278115.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3513278115.description: Secure the nearby [Stasis: Glyph 0] locked chest in Nexus by breaking the Stasis Seal and opening the container.
3513278115.description_zh: 在枢纽找到附近的上锁宝箱，破坏其冰影封印并打开容器。

1239957064.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957064.description: Regroup with Variks in Charon's Crossing.
1239957064.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口与瓦里克斯会合。

1438363708.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1438363708.description: In a single life, defeat Fallen in Eventide Ruins.
1438363708.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在薄暮废墟消灭堕落者。

1013534599.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1013534599.description: Draw out and defeat Elenaks, Salvation Elite in Asterion Abyss.
1013534599.description_zh: 在猎犬座深渊引出并消灭艾连纳克斯，救赎精英。

1239957060.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957060.description: Return to the Exo Stranger in Beyond.

431984070.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
431984070.description: Attune your Splinter of Darkness with the next Stasis Seal in the Ziggurat in Beyond.
431984070.description_zh: 将你的暗影裂片与超越层的通灵塔中的下一个冰影封印同调。

785647194.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
785647194.description: Commune with the next Crux of Darkness in Bray Exoscience.
785647194.description_zh: 在布瑞Exo科学所与下一个暗影核心进行交流。

1239957059.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957059.description: Regroup with Variks in Charon's Crossing.
1239957059.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口与瓦里克斯会合。

1438363709.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1438363709.description: Collect tracking devices by defeating Vex in Asterion Abyss. Minotaurs will always drop the devices.
1438363709.description_zh: 在猎犬座深渊消灭Vex，收集追踪装置。米诺陶一定会掉落该装置。

4224533134.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
4224533134.description: In Cadmus Ridge, locate and shut down the Vex conflux created by Praksis.
4224533134.description_zh: 在卡德马斯山脊找到并关闭由普拉克西斯制造的Vex节点。

2943602311.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2943602311.description_zh: 完成“技术专家”帝国猎杀。

1239957061.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957061.description: Return to your camp in Beyond.
1239957061.description_zh: 回到位于超越层的营地。

2577006689.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2577006689.description: Speak to Shaw Han in The Steppes.

3577538269.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3577538269.description: Defeat Fallen in the Cosmodrome, The Divide, to gather intel on the location of Bakris, the Adamantine.
3577538269.description_zh: 在发射基地鸿沟消灭堕落者，收集关于巴克里斯，刚勇者所在位置的情报。

3577538268.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3577538268.description: Eliminate Bakris, the Adamantine and scatter the Devils in the Exodus Garden 2A Lost Sector in The Divide.
3577538268.description_zh: 消灭巴克里斯，刚勇者并击溃位于鸿沟的“黑色移民号花园2A”遗失区域中的恶魔氏族。

1495419808.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1495419808.description: Complete "The Glassway" strike. Select it from the Europa map.
1495419808.description_zh: 完成“玻璃小径”打击。你可以在木卫二的地图上选择它。

1239957063.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957063.description: Return to the Exo Stranger in Beyond.

431984069.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
431984069.description: Attune your Splinter of Darkness with the next Stasis Seal in the Ziggurat in Beyond.
431984069.description_zh: 将你的暗影裂片与超越层的通灵塔中的下一个冰影封印同调。

785647193.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
785647193.description: Commune with the next Crux of Darkness in the Riis-Reborn Approach.
785647193.description_zh: 在重生的里斯入口与下一个暗影核心进行交流。

1239957062.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
1239957062.description: Regroup with Variks in Charon's Crossing.
1239957062.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口与瓦里克斯会合。

2683598861.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2683598861.description: In Eventide Ruins, ensure that the fleeing allied Skiff escapes Europa.
2683598861.description_zh: 在薄暮废墟，确保逃离的同盟突击艇离开木卫二。

2577006691.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2577006691.description: Return to the Exo Stranger in Beyond.

3848329302.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3848329302.description: Attune your Splinter of Darkness with the final Stasis Seal in the Ziggurat in Beyond.
3848329302.description_zh: 使你的暗影裂片与超越层的通灵塔中的最后一个冰影封印同调。

3824718318.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3824718318.description:
Now, embrace the power of Darkness and close out this chapter of your journey.

Go beyond and fully realize the potential of Stasis.
3824718318.description_zh:
现在，拥抱暗影的力量，为你的这段旅程画上句号吧。

去寻找并完全理解冰影的潜能。

2577006690.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
2577006690.description: Return to the Exo Stranger in Beyond and stand before her as an adept of Stasis.
2577006690.description_zh: 回到超越层去找Exo陌客，让她知道你已经成为一名冰影专家。

422583190.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
422583190.description: Return to the Tower and discuss your successes on Europa with Zavala.
422583190.description_zh: 回到高塔，告诉萨瓦拉你在木卫二的成功。

3612061731.name: Legacy: Beyond Light
3612061731.description: Meet Variks inside of the Charon's Crossing comms station to learn about the Fallen on Europa and their use of Darkness.
3612061731.description_zh: 在卡戎的十字路口的通讯站内与瓦里克斯会面，了解木卫二上的堕落者以及它们对暗影的使用。

2242123839.name: A Hard Rain Falls
2242123839.description:
Subdue the plans of House Salvation by thinning their ranks and completing public events and patrols in the current Eclipsed Zone.

Powerful combatants and Heroic public events grant the most efficient progress.
2242123839.description_zh:
在当前日蚀区消灭救赎氏族部队并完成公共事件和巡逻，阻碍救赎氏族的计划。

高阶战斗人员和英雄公共事件可最高效地提升进度。

2242123836.name: A Hard Rain Falls
2242123836.description: Report your success and findings to the Exo Stranger.
2242123836.description_zh: 把你的成功和发现报告给Exo陌客吧。

1784552507.name: Old Secrets, New Challenges
1784552507.description: Find out what's siphoning power from within Bray Exoscience.
1784552507.description_zh: 找出是什么东西在从布瑞Exo科学所吸取能量。

1784552506.name: Old Secrets, New Challenges
1784552506.description: Return to the Exo Stranger in Charon's Crossing.
1784552506.description_zh: 回去卡戎的十字路口找Exo陌客。

1399678798.name: Lost Lament
1399678798.description: Locate and scan 3 dead Exos on Europa.
1399678798.description_zh: 在木卫二找到并扫描3名死去的Exo。

25511490.name: Lost Lament
25511490.description: Locate the Giant Exo hidden in the Exo facility.
25511490.description_zh: 找到隐藏在Exo设施内的巨大Exo。

4107530250.name: Lost Lament
4107530250.description: Prove yourself to the Clovis AI by using Swords against the Vex across Europa.
4107530250.description_zh: 在木卫二用刀剑对付Vex，向克洛维斯的人工智能证明你的实力。

465838244.name: Lost Lament
465838244.description: Acquire and complete the listed quests from Commander Zavala and Variks to prove yourself to the Clovis AI and continue on with "Lost Lament."
465838244.description_zh: 获取并完成下列来自指挥官萨瓦拉和瓦里克斯的任务，向克洛维斯的人工智能证明你的实力，并继续“失落的挽歌”。

3938019989.name: Lost Lament
3938019989.description: Prove your worth to the Clovis AI by completing an Exo Challenge.
3938019989.description_zh: 完成一个Exo挑战，向克洛维斯的人工智能证明你的实力。

3535843838.name: Lost Lament
3535843838.description: Defeat Vex with finishers to satisfy the Clovis AI. Defeating powerful Vex grants the most efficient progress.
3535843838.description_zh: 用终结技消灭Vex，令克洛维斯的人工智能满意。消灭高阶Vex可最高效地提升进度。

2423789933.name: Lost Lament
2423789933.description: Access the strike "The Glassway" and locate the blade pieces within.
2423789933.description_zh: 进入打击“玻璃小径”并找到隐藏在内的剑刃碎片。

3263361561.name: Lost Lament
3263361561.description: Head back to the Tower and speak to Banshee-44 about the broken blade.
3263361561.description_zh: 回到高塔与班西-44谈谈断剑的事。

3357553626.name: Lost Lament
3357553626.description: Search Eventide Ruins for an abandoned bunker and explore inside.
3357553626.description_zh: 在薄暮废墟中搜寻一个废弃的地堡并进入探索。

4257510940.name: Lost Lament
4257510940.description: Complete the mission "Reforging the Past" to save the Clovis AI from being destroyed.
4257510940.description_zh: 完成任务“重铸过去”，阻止克洛维斯的人工智能被毁灭。

2711270400.name: Lost Lament
2711270400.description: Head back to the Tower and report your discoveries to Banshee-44.
2711270400.description_zh: 回到高塔，把你的发现报告给班西-44

3136133748.name: The Stasis Prototype
3136133748.description: Defeat Fallen Captains and Servitors on Europa to collect intel.
3136133748.description_zh: 在木卫二消灭堕落者队长和魔眼以收集情报。

3459548846.name: The Stasis Prototype
3459548846.description:
Defeat one of Eramis's council members in an Empire Hunt.

Requires completion of the "Reclaiming Europa", "Empire's Fall" and "The Dark Priestess" quests.
Visit Variks in Charon's crossing to purchase Empire Hunts quests.
3459548846.description_zh:
在一场帝国猎杀中击败一位伊拉莫斯的议会成员。

需要完成“ 重夺木卫二”、“ 帝国的陨落”任务和“暗影女祭司”任务。
帝国猎杀任务可以在卡戎的十字路口向瓦里克斯购买。

3257985301.name: The Stasis Prototype
3257985301.description: Eliminate combatants with, or affected by, your Stasis abilities.
3257985301.description_zh: 用你的冰影技能消灭战斗人员，或消灭被你的冰影技能影响的战斗人员。

1388623635.name: The Stasis Prototype
1388623635.description: Rendezvous with Spider's associate in the Concealed Void Lost Sector.
1388623635.description_zh: 到“隐匿虚空”遗失区域与蛛王的手下会合。

3184764590.name: The Stasis Prototype
3184764590.description: Visit the Drifter in the Annex.
3184764590.description_zh: 到附属建筑拜访漂泊者。

3599609918.name: The Stasis Prototype
3599609918.description_zh: 拜访附属建筑中的浪客。

2510021890.name: Soon
2510021890.description: Defeat combatants in the BrayTech facility.
2510021890.description_zh: 在布瑞科技设施中消灭战斗人员。

2510021888.name: Soon
2510021888.description: Defeat Vex with No Time to Explain in Nexus, Infinitude, and The Glassway on Europa.
2510021888.description_zh: 使用无时辩解在木卫二的枢纽、无尽之井和玻璃小径击败Vex。

1730090752.name: The Technocrat
1730090752.description: Collect tracking devices by defeating Vex in Asterion Abyss. Minotaurs will always drop the devices.
1730090752.description_zh: 在猎犬座深渊消灭Vex，收集追踪装置。米诺陶一定会掉落该装置。

1730090753.name: The Technocrat
1730090753.description: In Cadmus Ridge, locate and shut down the Vex conflux created by Praksis.
1730090753.description_zh: 在卡德马斯山脊找到并关闭由普拉克西斯制造的Vex节点。

1730090754.name: The Technocrat
1730090754.description_zh: 完成“技术专家”帝国猎杀。

1730090755.name: The Technocrat
1730090755.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯。

227508941.name: The Technocrat

4204937011.description_zh: 在卡德马斯山脊找到并关闭由普拉克西斯制造的Vex节点。

3629873751.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在猎犬座深渊用精准最后一击消灭Vex并收集活性放射体液。

1672479017.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在薄暮废墟消灭堕落者。

1672479016.name: The Warrior

1672479016.description_zh: 在猎犬座深渊引出并消灭艾连纳克斯，救赎精英。

1672479018.name: The Warrior
1672479018.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯。

2057304092.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在薄暮废墟用电弧、烈日和虚空武器消灭堕落者。

3519390051.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在薄暮废墟用动能、能量和威能武器消灭堕落者。

1916728398.description_zh: 在薄暮废墟消灭2名或以上成组的堕落者。

1916728399.name: The Warrior

1916728399.description_zh: 在猎犬座深渊引出并消灭艾连纳克斯，救赎精英。

1916728397.name: The Warrior
1916728397.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯。

3897611837.name: The Dark Priestess
3897611837.description: In a single life, defeat Fallen in groups of 2 or more with precision final blows in Cadmus Ridge.
3897611837.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在卡德马斯山脊用精准最后一击消灭2个或以上成组的堕落者。

3897611836.name: The Dark Priestess
3897611836.description_zh: 守护正在逃离的堕落者突击艇。

3897611839.name: The Dark Priestess
3897611839.description_zh: 完成“暗影女祭司”帝国猎杀。

3897611838.name: The Dark Priestess
3897611838.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯。

221921328.description_zh: 不死的前提下，在卡德马斯山脊用精准最后一击消灭堕落者。

2111258439.description_zh: 从卡德马斯山脊的堕落者身上收集暗影微斑，进一步了解他们的计划。精准最后一击有更高几率掉落。

1708910513.description_zh: 从瓦里克斯处购买并完成两个破坏任务。

113061891.name: Empire's Fall
113061891.description: Speak with Variks in Charon's Crossing.
113061891.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口与瓦里克斯交谈。

1781597160.name: Empire's Fall
1781597160.description: Speak with Variks in Charon's Crossing.
1781597160.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口与瓦里克斯交谈。

2572296686.name: Europan Protector I
2572296686.description:
Defeat combatants on Europa.

Unlocks an increased rate of earning Herealways Pieces for the first 30 per day.
2572296686.description_zh:
在木卫二消灭战斗人员。

解锁每天前30块永恒碎片的获取速度提升。

2572296687.name: Europan Protector I
2572296687.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯

2564508105.name: Europan Protector II
2564508105.description:
On Europa, defeat combatants with or affected by Stasis.

Unlocks ability to earn Herealways Pieces by defeating combatants on Europa with or affected by Stasis.
2564508105.description_zh:
在木卫二，使用冰影消灭战斗人员，或消灭受冰影影响的战斗人员。

解锁在木卫二使用冰影消灭战斗人员或消灭受冰影影响的战斗人员可获得永恒碎片的能力。

2564508104.name: Europan Protector II
2564508104.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯

3691663932.name: Europan Protector III
3691663932.description:
On Europa, defeat combatants with precision final blows using Kinetic weapons, Power weapons, and in groups of 2 or more.

Unlocks chance to earn Herealways Pieces by defeating combatants on Europa with precision final blows.
3691663932.description_zh:
在木卫二使用动能、威能武器的精准最后一击消灭2名或以上成组战斗人员。

解锁在木卫二使用精准最后一击消灭战斗人员有几率获得永恒碎片的能力。

3691663933.name: Europan Protector III
3691663933.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯

3169276698.name: Europa Power I

Complete bounties acquired from Variks.

Awards Tier II powerful Europa gear.
3169276698.description_zh:
完成从瓦里克斯处获得的悬赏。

奖励第II阶强力木卫二装备。

3169276699.name: Europa Power I
3169276699.description_zh: 到卡戎的十字路口拜访瓦里克斯

Awards Tier III powerful Europa gear.
35303605.description_zh:
完成所有帝国猎杀任务。

奖励第III阶强力木卫二装备。

35303604.name: Europa Power II

在帝国猎杀中取得精准最后一击、近战最后一击，以及消灭一个首领。

在帝国猎杀中，消灭3名或以上的成组战斗人员、勇士及首领。

2975357706.name: Born in Darkness Part 1

2975357706.description_zh:

• Use Stasis abilities against combatants in Vanguard Ops.
2975357707.description_zh:

• 在先锋行动中用冰影技能对付战斗人员。

2975357704.name: Born in Darkness Part 1
2975357704.description: Defeat Weniks's platoon near the Crux of Darkness in Eternity.
2975357704.description_zh: 在永恒的暗影核心附近消灭温尼克斯的部队。

2975357705.name: Born in Darkness Part 1

2975357705.description_zh: 带着骸骨密钥前往薄暮废墟的“地堡E15”遗失区域找Exo陌客。

2975357710.name: Born in Darkness Part 1
2975357710.description: Regroup with the Exo Stranger in Beyond.

285715023.name: Born in Darkness Part 2
285715023.description:
• Defeat Vex on Europa for their energy.
• Get Stasis shatter final blows by shattering frozen combatants and stasis crystals on Europa.
285715023.description_zh:
• 在木卫二消灭Vex并取得他们的能量。
•通过破碎冻结的战斗人员和冰影水晶来取得冰影破碎最后一击。

285715022.name: Born in Darkness Part 2
285715022.description:
• Complete Vanguard, Crucible, or Gambit Ops activities with your Stasis subclass equipped.
• Use Stasis abilities in Vanguard, Crucible, or Gambit Ops activities. Defeating Guardians grants additional progress.
285715022.description_zh:
• 装备冰影分支职业并完成先锋、熔炉竞技场或智谋行动活动。
• 在先锋、熔炉竞技场或智谋行动活动中使用冰影技能。击败守护者可获得额外进度。

285715021.name: Born in Darkness Part 2
285715021.description: Defeat the House Salvation Fallen platoon near the Crux of Darkness in Riis-Reborn Approach.
285715021.description_zh: 在重生的里斯入口的暗影核心附近消灭救赎氏族的堕落者部队。

285715020.name: Born in Darkness Part 2

285715020.description_zh: 带着骸骨密钥前往卡德马斯山脊的“永劫地狱”遗失区域找Exo陌客。

285715019.name: Born in Darkness Part 2
