1145603399.description_zh:
摧毁那些提炼玖的力量来保护集合体的Vex思维，为取得最后一个奇异子胶囊扫清道路。

从“监控”和“虹吸”任务中获取加速子，以进入并完成“微积分”和“干扰”任务。

1447128681.name: The Gorge Strangelet
1447128681.description: Defeat the Vex Mind maintaining the quarantine around the Acceleron and retrieve the strangelet capsule it holds.
1447128681.description_zh: 击败维持加速子隔离区的Vex思维，取回其持有的奇异子胶囊。

261046310.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
261046310.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
261046310.description: Meet Lodi in the Curtilage Divide within the Exile's Accord.
261046310.description_zh: 在流亡氏族协议地的宅地鸿沟与洛迪见面。

629807684.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
629807684.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
629807684.description: Engage the Exiles to acquire the Relocator tech and the Acceleron held by the Exile commander here.
629807684.description_zh: 与流亡氏族交战，以获取此处流亡氏族指挥官所持有的重定位器技术装置和加速子。

2709649276.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
2709649276.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子

232000212.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
232000212.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
232000212.description: Sabotage the House of Exile's Arc refinery operations.
232000212.description_zh: 破坏流亡氏族的电弧提炼行动。

261046311.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
261046311.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
261046311.description_zh: 在预言者圣地中找到洛迪。

429783253.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
429783253.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
429783253.description: Acquire the Acceleron from Spoil to access mission "Saturnism."
429783253.description_zh: 从污染中获取加速子来进入任务“土星中毒”。

2258411286.name: The Exile's Accord Strangelet
2258411286.name_zh: 流亡氏族协议地奇异子
2258411286.description: Destroy the Exiles' Prime Servitor and claim the House's strangelet capsule.
2258411286.description_zh: 摧毁流亡氏族的原始魔眼并夺取氏族的奇异子胶囊。

418685604.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
418685604.description: Locate the Emeritus in the Aionian Campus to obtain more information about the strangelet capsule there.
418685604.description_zh: 在艾昂校园内找到名誉教授，获取更多关于那里的奇异子胶囊的信息。

3764625196.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
3764625196.description: Find a way into the Aionian laboratory to rescue the scientists held there and obtain the Acceleron.
3764625196.description_zh: 设法进入艾昂人实验室来营救困在那里的科学家并取得加速子。

1343763011.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
1343763011.description: Let the Emeritus know that you have saved his researchers.
1343763011.description_zh: 告知名誉教授，你已拯救他的研究员。

573683850.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
573683850.description: Push back the assault on the Aionian Agricultural Center.
573683850.description_zh: 击退艾昂人农业中心的敌袭。

2234037074.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
2234037074.description: Let the Emeritus know the problem at the Agricultural Center has been resolved.
2234037074.description_zh: 告知名誉教授，农业中心的问题已被解决。

1182689487.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
1182689487.description: Speak with Dean Rebecca in the Aionian Campus.
1182689487.description_zh: 在艾昂校园与丽贝卡院长交谈。

1827275207.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
1827275207.description: Talk to the Emeritus in the Aionian Campus.
1827275207.description_zh: 与艾昂校园的名誉教授交谈。

341007722.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
341007722.description: Speak with the dean in the Aionian Campus regarding the Vex.
341007722.description_zh: 在艾昂校园与院长讨论Vex的事。

1322118319.name: The Central Academy Strangelet
1322118319.description: Retrieve the strangelet capsule from its resting place, which is currently overrun by Vex.
1322118319.description_zh: 从当前被Vex占据的奇异子胶囊休眠之地取回它。

870155466.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
870155466.description: Ikora wants you to investigate the relationship between dark matter and Kepler, but first she needs you to meet up with Lodi's Aionian contact in the Stacks.
870155466.description_zh: 艾可拉希望你调查暗物质与开普勒之间的关系，但首先，她要你去资料库与洛迪的艾昂人联系人见面。

3427598700.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
3427598700.description: Dr. Carnahan's office has been ransacked. Trace amounts of of Stasis and Strand energy hang in the air. Find the culprits, and maybe the Dr.
3427598700.description_zh: 卡纳汉博士的办公室被洗劫了。空气中残留着细微的冰影与缚丝能量。找到作案者，同时也找找博士。

714938645.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
714938645.description: Track down the last of the Exiles who ransacked the lab and claim the leader's Acceleron.
714938645.description_zh: 追踪洗劫实验室的流亡氏族的残党，夺取其首领携带的加速子。

1294183585.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
1294183585.description: Talk to Dr. Carnahan about the murder of her assistant.
1294183585.description_zh: 与卡纳汉博士交谈，讨论她助手被杀的事。

270723513.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
270723513.description: Find the murderer. Exact justice and retrieve the stolen technology.
270723513.description_zh: 找到凶手。伸张正义，追回被盗的技术装置。

271106369.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
271106369.description: Return to Dr. Carnahan with the Mattermorph technology.
271106369.description_zh: 带着物质变形技术装置返回卡纳汉博士处。

3834851019.name: The Outer Steppes Strangelet
3834851019.description: Retrieve the Outer Steppes strangelet capsule in mission "Charge."
3834851019.description_zh: 在任务“充能”中取回外域草原奇异子胶囊。

1124254372.name: The Edge of Fate
1124254372.description: Follow the invitation. Travel to Kepler and uncover the nature of the mysterious signal emanating from this drifting rim-world.
1124254372.description_zh: 跟随邀请。前往开普勒，发现这颗漂流的边缘星球发出的神秘信号的真相。

3911040957.name: The Edge of Fate
3911040957.description: Integrate the strangelet capsule at the Altar of Relativity.
3911040957.description_zh: 在相对论圣坛整合奇异子胶囊。

1378922139.name: The Edge of Fate
1378922139.description: Return power to the altar systems.

2301870092.name: The Edge of Fate
2301870092.description:
The strangelet capsules are critical to stabilizing and containing the singularity at the heart of Kepler. 
Integrate the capsule into the Altar of Relativity.
2301870092.description_zh:
奇异子胶囊对于稳定和抑制开普勒核心处的奇点至关重要。
将胶囊整合到相对论圣坛中。

3817006762.name: The Edge of Fate
3817006762.description: Meet Rebecca, Dean of the Aionians.
3817006762.description_zh: 与艾昂人的院长丽贝卡见面。

90819397.name: The Edge of Fate
90819397.description: Draw out the Barricade Mind to obtain the Acceleron it guards.
90819397.description_zh: 引出屏障思维以获取其守卫的加速子。

1081937072.name: The Edge of Fate
1081937072.description: Access the terminal to acquire the translation cipher "Rosetta."
1081937072.description_zh: 访问终端来获取翻译暗码“罗塞塔”。

3817006761.name: The Edge of Fate
3817006761.description: Return to Dean Rebecca with the Rosetta technology and attempt another conversation.
3817006761.description_zh: 带着罗塞塔技术装置回到丽贝卡院长处，尝试再次交流。

751119954.name: The Edge of Fate
751119954.description: Access the Aionians's telemetry buoys to locate the disruptive signal.
751119954.description_zh: 访问艾昂人的遥测浮标来定位干扰信号。

384567555.name: The Edge of Fate
384567555.description: Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking down the lost strangelet capsules.
384567555.description_zh: 访问相对论圣坛，开始追踪丢失的奇异子胶囊。

2481608195.name: The Edge of Fate
2481608195.description: Visit the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking strangelet capsules in the Central Academy and Exile's Accord.
2481608195.description_zh: 访问相对论圣坛，开始追踪中央学院以及流亡氏族协议地内的奇异子胶囊。

4052488163.name: The Edge of Fate
4052488163.description: Recover strangelet capsules across Kepler and return them to the Altar of Relativity.
4052488163.description_zh: 取回开普勒各处的奇异子胶囊并把它们送回相对论圣坛

3924303346.name: The Edge of Fate
3924303346.description: The strangelet capsule is ready for integration. Return to the Altar and perform the integration.
3924303346.description_zh: 奇异子胶囊已可以整合。返回圣坛进行整合。

833558114.name: The Edge of Fate
833558114.description: Restore Power to the Altar of Relativity.
833558114.description_zh: 为相对论圣坛恢复供能。

3623595775.name: The Edge of Fate
3623595775.description: The strangelet capsule is ready for integration. Return to the Altar and perform the integration.
3623595775.description_zh: 奇异子胶囊已可以整合。返回圣坛进行整合。

2753243352.name: The Edge of Fate
2753243352.description_zh: 在火山喷口与浪客见面。

2041340298.name: The Edge of Fate
2041340298.description: Acquire the strangelet capsule located in Central Academy.
2041340298.description_zh: 获取位于中央学院的奇异子胶囊。

2406992543.name: The Edge of Fate
2406992543.description: Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule located in Exile's Accord.
2406992543.description_zh: 找到并获取流亡氏族协议地中的奇异子胶囊。

3454986034.name: The Edge of Fate
3454986034.description: Integrate the Central Academy strangelet capsule at the Altar of Relativity.
3454986034.description_zh: 在相对论圣坛整合中央学院奇异子胶囊。

3356250183.name: The Edge of Fate
3356250183.description: Integrate the Exile's Accord strangelet capsule at the Altar of Relativity.
3356250183.description_zh: 在相对论圣坛整合流亡氏族协议地奇异子胶囊。

1713968321.name: The Edge of Fate
1713968321.description: Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking the stranglet capsule in Outer Steppes.
1713968321.description_zh: 访问相对论圣坛，开始追踪外域草原内的奇异子胶囊。

1001275728.name: The Edge of Fate
1001275728.description: Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule from Outer Steppes.
1001275728.description_zh: 找到并获取外域草原中的奇异子胶囊。

3815488208.name: The Edge of Fate
3815488208.description: Integrate the strangelet capsule from Outer Steppes at the Altar of Relativity. Then only one remains.
3815488208.description_zh: 在相对论圣坛整合外域草原奇异子胶囊。这样就只剩下一个了。

3004620527.name: The Edge of Fate
3004620527.description: Meet with Lodi and Ikora at the Altar of Relativity.
3004620527.description_zh: 在相对论圣坛与洛迪和艾可拉见面。

2405373351.name: The Edge of Fate
2405373351.description: Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking the stranglet capsule in The Gorge.
2405373351.description_zh: 访问相对论圣坛，开始追踪峡谷内的奇异子胶囊。

2904384410.name: The Edge of Fate
2904384410.description: Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule from The Gorge.
2904384410.description_zh: 找到并获取峡谷中的奇异子胶囊。

3059064441.name: The Edge of Fate
3059064441.description: Speak with Orin in the Assimilated Easement.
3059064441.description_zh: 在同化地役与奥琳交谈。

3669359672.name: The Edge of Fate
3669359672.description: Complete mission "Criticality" to shut down the overloading reactors and save the Aionian settlement from obliteration.
3669359672.description_zh: 完成任务“临界”来关闭过载的反应堆，拯救艾昂人定居点免于毁灭。

3414086942.name: The Edge of Fate
3414086942.description: Integrate the strangelet capsule from The Gorge into the Altar of Relativity.
3414086942.description_zh: 将来自峡谷的奇异子胶囊整合到相对论圣坛中。

1773716996.name: The Edge of Fate
1773716996.description: Meet with Lodi and Orin near the Altar.
1773716996.description_zh: 在圣坛附近与洛迪和奥琳见面。

2262866846.name: The Edge of Fate
2262866846.description: Meet with Lodi and your fireteam to discuss what you've learned.
2262866846.description_zh: 与洛迪及你的火力战队见面，讨论你了解到的信息。

2761249057.name: The Edge of Fate
2761249057.description: Meet with Lodi in the Caldera to discuss his intel.
2761249057.description_zh: 在火山喷口与洛迪见面讨论他的情报。

2899952451.name: Graviton Through the Ages
2899952451.description: Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
2899952451.description_zh: 在火山喷口与名誉教授交谈。

921768335.name: Graviton Through the Ages
921768335.description: Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in the Outer Steppes.
921768335.description_zh: 使用外域草原的罗塞塔设备三角定位武器部件的位置。

1089887054.name: Graviton Through the Ages
1089887054.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
1089887054.description_zh: 在搜索区域内搜寻遗失的对外观察部武器部件。

2899952448.name: Graviton Through the Ages
2899952448.description: Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
2899952448.description_zh: 在火山喷口与名誉教授交谈。

921768332.name: Graviton Through the Ages
921768332.description: Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in the Gorge.
921768332.description_zh: 使用峡谷的罗塞塔设备三角定位武器部件的位置。

1089887053.name: Graviton Through the Ages
1089887053.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
1089887053.description_zh: 在搜索区域内搜寻遗失的对外观察部武器部件。

2899952449.name: Graviton Through the Ages
2899952449.description: Speak with Lodi in the Caldera.
2899952449.description_zh: 在火山喷口与洛迪交谈。

921768333.name: Graviton Through the Ages
921768333.description: Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in Exile's Accord.
921768333.description_zh: 使用流亡氏族协议地的罗塞塔设备三角定位武器部件的位置。

1089887052.name: Graviton Through the Ages
1089887052.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
1089887052.description_zh: 在搜索区域内搜寻遗失的对外观察部武器部件。

2899952454.name: Graviton Through the Ages
2899952454.description: Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
2899952454.description_zh: 在火山喷口与名誉教授交谈。

896613373.name: Graviton Through the Ages
896613373.description: Collect Data Fragments from defeated Vex. More powerful Vex will provide more data.
896613373.description_zh: 从被击败的Vex身上收集数据碎片。强力Vex能提供更多的数据。

1089887051.name: Graviton Through the Ages
1089887051.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
1089887051.description_zh: 在搜索区域内搜寻遗失的对外观察部武器部件。

2027753418.name: Graviton Through the Ages
2027753418.description:
Assemble the weapon using the Sieve.

The Sieve activity is only available periodically. Look for it on the Kepler map.
2027753418.description_zh:
使用滤网组装武器。

滤网活动仅周期性开放。请在开普勒地图上寻找它。

2686022506.name: Correspondence
2686022506.description: Mysterious chess pieces may have some relation to the Aionians's history. Maybe an Aionian historian will know more.
2686022506.description_zh: 神秘棋子可能与艾昂人的历史有关。也许艾昂人历史学家会知道更多信息。

4019658221.name: Correspondence
4019658221.description: The chess pieces are long-lost correspondences to Earth! The Aionians have asked you to find more, if you can.
4019658221.description_zh: 这些棋子是发往地球、遗失已久的通信！艾昂人希望你尽力找回更多的棋子。

2686022505.name: Correspondence
2686022505.description: You've found another encoded chess piece, but it's significance is unclear.
2686022505.description_zh: 你找到了另一枚加密棋子，但其意义尚不明确。

693840694.name: Correspondence
693840694.description: The historian believes the chess pieces provide insight into how Aionian society came to be. They've has asked you to collect more lost correspondences from across Kepler.
693840694.description_zh: 历史学家认为这些棋子揭示了艾昂文明的起源。这名艾昂人委托你收集更多散落于开普勒各地的遗失通信。

1249896600.name: Correspondence
1249896600.description: You've collected the remainder of the lost correspondences. Return the completed collection to Dean Rebecca.
1249896600.description_zh: 你集齐了剩余的遗失通信。将整套收藏返还给丽贝卡院长。

3247371271.name: Dark Academia
3247371271.description: Return the strange device you found to the Aionian encampment in the Caldera.
3247371271.description_zh: 将你找到的奇异装置带回火山喷口的艾昂人营地。

447068219.name: Dark Academia
447068219.description: You have the unstable artifact, and Dean Rebecca has asked that you return to her in the Caldera.
447068219.description_zh: 你已获得不稳定的神器，丽贝卡院长请你返回火山喷口找她。

4144260662.name: Forensic Horology
4144260662.description: Locate and investigate Temporal Disturbances across Kepler that are being tampered with by the Conductor's Vex.
4144260662.description_zh: 找到并调查指挥者的Vex正在篡改的开普勒时间扰动。

1123841232.name: Forensic Horology
1123841232.description: Ikora found a strange relic and requests your presence immediately. Meet with her to investigate further.
1123841232.description_zh: 艾可拉发现了一件奇怪的圣物，要求你立即到场。与她见面来展开进一步的调查。

333972147.name: Forensic Horology
333972147.description: Locate and scan the next disturbance site.
333972147.description_zh: 找到并扫描下一处扰动地点。

2369741157.name: Forensic Horology
2369741157.description: Ghost is detecting a Vanguard signal. Establish contact with Ikora Rey and hear what she has to say.
2369741157.description_zh: 机灵侦测到先锋信号，与艾可拉·蕾伊建立联系，听听她想说什么。

1664229795.name: Hyperreal G-Man
1664229795.description: Ikora has forwarded the coordinated of a number of Vex data spikes. Lodi's been bouncing signals off of them. Find them, and pull the data.
1664229795.description_zh: 艾可拉转发了一批Vex数据尖刺的坐标。洛迪一直在通过这些节点反射信号。找到它们并提取数据。

795784746.name: Hyperreal G-Man
795784746.description: Now that the Vex lures are deciphered, Lodi is trying to contact you. Find a clear signal and answer his call.
795784746.description_zh: Vex诱饵已被破译，洛迪正尝试联系你。找到清晰信号，接收他的呼叫。

1280324466.name: Declassification
1280324466.description: Void signals indicate the locations of the microscopic singularities. Find and destroy them.
1280324466.description_zh: 虚空信号标出了微观奇点的位置。找到并摧毁它们。

1280324467.name: Declassification
1280324467.description: The singularities are being caused by axion bolts. Destroy them to prevent further singularity development.
1280324467.description_zh: 这些奇点由量子光束引发。摧毁它们来阻止奇点继续生成。

1280324464.name: Declassification
1280324464.description: Another axion-bolt-created singularity remains to be destroyed.
1280324464.description_zh: 另一个量子光束引发的奇点有待摧毁。

4112214724.name: Declassification
4112214724.description: One final set of readings remains. Track them down.
4112214724.description_zh: 还剩最后一组读数。追踪它们。

1735162791.name: Declassification
1735162791.description: Defend the Ares One against the encroaching Vex.
1735162791.description_zh: 保护战神一号不受Vex侵袭。

3855958218.name: Faculty Advisement
3855958218.description: Use your basic understanding of the Aionian language to converse with the Aionian researcher.
3855958218.description_zh: 运用你对艾昂语的基础理解，与艾昂人研究员进行交流。

2306703768.name: Faculty Advisement
2306703768.description: You're told there is a monument here that carries great importance to the Aionians. Find it and learn what you can from it.
2306703768.description_zh: 据说此地有一座对艾昂人而言意义非凡的纪念碑。找到它并尽力从中探寻情报。

1891059392.name: Faculty Advisement
1891059392.description: Speak with Dean Rebecca to learn more about the Aionians and how you can help.
1891059392.description_zh: 与丽贝卡院长聊聊，深入了解艾昂人，以及你如何能帮上忙。

3819424393.name: Faculty Advisement
3819424393.description: Collect samples of the local Vex for the Aionians' studies.
3819424393.description_zh: 为艾昂人的研究收集当地Vex的样本。

3855958219.name: Faculty Advisement
3855958219.description: Return the Vex samples to the Aionian researcher as requested.
3855958219.description_zh: 按要求将Vex样本交给艾昂人研究员。

2188712690.name: Faculty Advisement
2188712690.description: An offline terminal in House of Exile territory holds data that could be valuable to the Aionians.
2188712690.description_zh: 流亡氏族领地内的一个离线终端保存着可能对艾昂人有价值的数据。

2178080007.name: Faculty Advisement
2178080007.description: Return to Ikora to speak with her about everything that's happened.
2178080007.description_zh: 返回艾可拉那里，与她交流近期发生的所有事。

3391367636.name: Orientation
3391367636.description: Seek out vestiges of the Nine's presence across Kepler.
3391367636.description_zh: 在开普勒星上寻找玖的踪迹。

3391367639.name: Orientation
3391367639.description: Locate a second group of symbols of the Nine.

3391367638.name: Orientation
3391367638.description: Locate a third group of symbols of the Nine.

3391367633.name: Orientation
3391367633.description: Locate a fourth group of symbols of the Nine.

70884179.name: Orientation
70884179.description: Bind your connections with the Nine to the Orrery.
70884179.description_zh: 将你和玖的联系与太阳系仪绑定起来。

3358744199.name: The Man Out Of Time
3358744199.description: Investigate the time scars Lodi has located.
3358744199.description_zh: 调查洛迪找到的时间裂痕。

3235330220.name: The Man Out Of Time
3235330220.description: Investigate the next time scar Lodi has located.
3235330220.description_zh: 调查洛迪找到的下一处时间裂痕。

2290544465.name: The Man Out Of Time
2290544465.description: One time scar remains to investigate.
2290544465.description_zh: 剩余一处时间裂痕待调查。

1520650325.name: Turophile
1520650325.description: Destroy the Vex hunting after a strange signal.

2239309442.name: Turophile
2239309442.description: Examine the remaining wreckage of Vex.

3631716173.name: Turophile
3631716173.description: This particular Vex seems well-mannered. For now. Search the area for clues about its provenance.
3631716173.description_zh: 这个特殊的Vex显得很守规矩，至少目前如此。搜索该区域，寻找关于其来源的线索。

1520650326.name: Turophile
1520650326.description: The Vex arrive once again. They want what you carry. Defeat them!
1520650326.description_zh: Vex再度来袭。它们觊觎你携带之物。击败它们！

3425720481.name: Turophile
3425720481.description: Return Sharp Cheddar to Dean Rebecca.
3425720481.description_zh: 将浓味切达带回给丽贝卡院长

3900061864.name: Vessel of the Nine
3900061864.description: Lodi's voice channel is being overloaded with some kind of strange interference, but his signal is pinging your comms. Search for a spot with a clearer signal and contact him.
3900061864.description_zh: 洛迪的语音频道因某种奇怪的干扰而过载，但他的信号正在呼叫你的通讯器。寻找信号更清晰的地方与他联系。

1072701727.name: Vessel of the Nine
1072701727.description: Search for a signature that might indicate Lodi's presence by inspecting the House of Exile corpses coated in strange energy.
1072701727.description_zh: 通过检查覆盖着奇异能量的流亡氏族尸体，寻找可能指向洛迪方位的能量信号。

1143556309.name: Vessel of the Nine
1143556309.description: Search the area for anything of relevance to Lodi's strange experience.
1143556309.description_zh: 搜索区域，寻找与洛迪奇怪经历相关的线索。

1143556310.name: Vessel of the Nine
1143556310.description: Find another slime in order to reach back to the Archon. Hopefully it can be stopped from impacting Lodi.
1143556310.description_zh: 再找一个黏泥来联络执政官，但愿能阻止他影响洛迪。

2443614657.name: Vessel of the Nine
2443614657.description: Use the resonance of the energy point to attract the Archon's attention.
2443614657.description_zh: 利用能量点的共振吸引执政官的注意。

809874453.name: The Paper Crane
809874453.description: A nearby radiolaria pool contains strange dark matter signatures. Investigate it and see what knowledge can be gleaned.
809874453.description_zh: 附近的活性放射体液池含有异常的暗物质信号。前往调查，看看能获得什么信息。

3640820183.name: The Paper Crane
3640820183.description: A Vex ambush protects the pool. Destroy the attackers and find what secrets they're guarding.
3640820183.description_zh: 一群Vex伏兵正在守护池子。消灭袭击者，查明它们守护的秘密。

3981633273.name: The Paper Crane
3981633273.description: Ikora suspects there is a life form, maybe a plant, that may be actively feeding off of the dark matter. She surmises that we might be able to find a specimen in the Caldera.
3981633273.description_zh: 艾可拉猜测存在一种主动以暗物质为食的生命体，可能是某种植物。她推测，我们或许能在火山喷口找到样本。

2514237104.name: The Paper Crane
2514237104.description: Ghost is tracking a concentration of dark matter traces. They converge in the Stacks, near where you landed.
2514237104.description_zh: 机灵正在追踪一组高浓度暗物质痕迹，信号汇聚点位于你着陆点附近的资料库。

870411438.name: The Paper Crane
870411438.description: The Aionians have a Shrine to Failure nearby. Perhaps it holds a clue to the Aionian's history.
870411438.description_zh: 附近有一座艾昂人的失败神殿。也许那里藏有解开艾昂人历史的线索。

2523889577.name: Transfer of Power
2523889577.description: Defeat Vex in the area to collect radiolaria specimens for the temporal beacon.
2523889577.description_zh: 击败该区域的Vex来收集时间信标所需的活性放射体液样本。

2580338934.name: Transfer of Power
2580338934.description: Orin needs you to plant the completed beacon to act as a temporal antenna. She means to show something to Lodi.
2580338934.description_zh: 奥琳需要你安置完成的时间信标来充当时间天线。她打算向洛迪展示一些东西。

4140618828.name: Transfer of Power
4140618828.description: Orin is pinging you on a private channel. Pinpoint the signal and connect to her call.
4140618828.description_zh: 奥琳正在私人频道呼叫你。找到信号并接通她的呼叫。

2679258427.name: Transfer of Power
2679258427.description: Your attempts to tap into Unknown Space have drawn in Vex of the Nessian Schism. Remove them.
2679258427.description_zh: 你试图进入未知空间，却引来了涅索斯裂缝的Vex。将其移除。

1099314475.name: Transfer of Power
1099314475.description: Return to Orin to speak with her.

3182409793.name: Sacred Emergence
3182409793.description: Continue helping Orin recover fragments of herself across Kepler.
3182409793.description_zh: 继续协助奥琳在开普勒各处寻回她自我的碎片。

1260962137.name: Sacred Emergence
1260962137.description: There is more of Orin's past to uncover, deeper within Kepler.
1260962137.description_zh: 奥琳还有更多过往深藏于开普勒之中，等待发掘。

3968529813.name: Sacred Emergence
3968529813.description: Track down the remnants of Orin's Ghost, Gol.
3968529813.description_zh: 找到奥琳的机灵花尔的残骸。

2903390121.name: Skylines
2903390121.description: Orin needs your help finding Lodi before the Vex do.
2903390121.description_zh: 奥琳请求你赶在Vex之前找到洛迪。

1720482314.name: Skylines
1720482314.description: There is a faint bio-signature on the telescope. Maybe Lodi was here.
1720482314.description_zh: 望远镜上有一个微弱的生物信号，也许洛迪来过这里。

2913772187.name: Skylines
2913772187.description: Starting at the North Star, Outline the constellation Ursa Major.
2913772187.description_zh: 从北极星开始，勾勒出大熊座。

2913772184.name: Skylines
2913772184.description: Outline the constellation Orion, the Hunter.

2684755243.name: Skylines
2684755243.description: Orin is calling back into the comms line for an update. Find a safe spot to speak.
2684755243.description_zh: 奥琳正在通讯线路上询问近况。找个安全的地方交谈吧。

2499607616.name: Map and Territory
2499607616.description_zh: 在开普勒与丽贝卡院长见面。

2259155960.name: Map and Territory
2259155960.description: Approach the Simulant Ansible within the Nursery.
2259155960.description_zh: 靠近苗圃内的模拟应答器。

803088062.name: Map and Territory
803088062.description: Use your network proximity sensor to identify areas where simulations converge.
803088062.description_zh: 使用你的网络近接传感器来辨明模拟交汇的区域。

3100679920.name: Map and Territory
3100679920.description: Search for convergences to add to Maya and Chioma's data set.
3100679920.description_zh: 搜寻集聚地，将其添进玛雅和希欧玛的数据集。

4142710206.name: Map and Territory
4142710206.description: Maya and Chioma signal you back to the communications hub in the Nursery.
4142710206.description_zh: 玛雅和希欧玛呼叫你返回苗圃内的通信中心。

3095529046.name: Atlas and Almanac
3095529046.description: Return to one of the anchors you placed to untangle more data.
3095529046.description_zh: 返回你已放置的一个锚点，解读更多数据。

3129084348.name: Atlas and Almanac
3129084348.description: Return to your placed anchors to study the layers of simulations beneath them.
3129084348.description_zh: 返回你已放置的锚点，研究其下方的各层模拟。

3145861935.name: Atlas and Almanac

3162639490.description_zh: 返回你已放置的锚点，研究其下方的各层模拟。

2722243586.description_zh: 在“世界等级：闻名”中收集奇异子胶囊，并在相对论圣坛进行整合。

325356765.name: Explore Kepler: Fabled
325356765.description: Defeat the Archon in World Tier: Fabled.
325356765.description_zh: 在“世界等级：闻名”中击败执政官。

4284902391.description_zh: 使用“巨坑的躯壳”击败邪魔族。在“克洛塔的末日”突袭中造成“巨坑的躯壳”最后一击，可获得额外进度。

3758175010.description_zh: 在发射基地的“耻辱”打击中搜寻机灵遥测数据。

3422699009.description: Speak with an old friend at the campfire.
3422699009.description_zh: 在篝火边与一位老朋友交谈。

1165414665.description: Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Speakers.
1165414665.description_zh: 在先知避难所与机灵协商。

4009316293.description_zh: 开始穿越苍白之心的旅程，寻找乌鸦。

1016912462.description_zh: 尝试与破碎深渊中的旅行者交流。

3113918754.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
3113918754.description: Attempt to commune with the Traveler in the Forgotten Deep.
3113918754.description_zh: 在遗忘深渊中尝试与旅行者交流。

1433731838.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1433731838.description: Attempt to commune with the Traveler in the Blooming Deep.
1433731838.description_zh: 在繁盛深渊中尝试与旅行者交流。

1492240036.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1492240036.description: Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Beginnings.
1492240036.description_zh: 在开端避难所与机灵协商。

2783395451.name: Legacy: The Final Shape

4096912375.name: Legacy: The Final Shape

4096912375.description_zh: 清出一条穿过凋零山口的路，揭开一段尘封已久的往事。

2761711865.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
2761711865.description: Crow is going to try to talk Zavala down. This may not end well.
2761711865.description_zh: 乌鸦会试着说服萨瓦拉。这可能不会有好结果。

2929046193.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
2929046193.description: Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Wishes.
2929046193.description_zh: 在许愿避难所与机灵协商。

3862422804.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
3862422804.description: Help Targe find Zavala, before it's too late.
3862422804.description_zh: 帮助塔格找到萨瓦拉，趁还来得及。

1924771146.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1924771146.description: Support Zavala at Refuge of Endings.
1924771146.description_zh: 在终局避难所支持萨瓦拉。

3324027446.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
3324027446.description: Confer with Ghost at Refuge of Endings.
3324027446.description_zh: 在终局避难所与机灵协商。

4227599758.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
4227599758.description: Confront the Witness in the place where it was made.
4227599758.description_zh: 在见证者的被造之地直面它。

2215711693.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
2215711693.description: Confer with Ghost in the Lost City.
2215711693.description_zh: 在失落之城与机灵协商。

1002654008.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1002654008.description_zh: 与凯德和乌鸦一起追踪未知威胁。

1047491773.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1047491773.description:
The final shape looms. There isn't much time to prepare.

You won't be able to defeat the Witness alone. Recover powerful artifacts across the Pale Heart, rally your allies, and fortify the Traveler's Light. Only through your combined strength will you prevail.
1047491773.description_zh:
终焉之形近在咫尺。没多少时间做准备了。

你不可能单凭一己之力击败见证者。在苍白之心找回强大的神器，集结你的盟友，强化旅行者的光能。你们只有携手合力才能取得胜利。

1142335168.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
1142335168.description: Return with Ghost to the Lost City in the Pale Heart.
1142335168.description_zh: 与机灵返回苍白之心里的失落之城。

93470569.name: Legacy: The Final Shape
93470569.description: Confer with Ghost in the Lost City.
93470569.description_zh: 在失落之城与机灵协商。

1768751086.name: Wild Card
1768751086.description:
Investigate an unknown threat with Cayde and Crow.

Complete the mission "Wild Card."
1768751086.description_zh:
与凯德和乌鸦一起调查未知威胁。

完成任务“万能卡牌”。

488004607.name: Wild Card
488004607.description: Listen to the radio transmission in the Lost City Tower.
488004607.description_zh: 在失落高塔收听无线电通讯。

3878661814.name: Found in the Dark
3878661814.description: Find a manifestation of Darkness in the cave in the Seclusion.
3878661814.description_zh: 在隔绝之地的洞穴里找到暗影的显现。

3858524939.name: Found in the Dark
3858524939.description: Investigate Shadow Legion activity in the Transgression.
3858524939.description_zh: 在罪过之地调查暗影军团活动。

3878661813.name: Found in the Dark
3878661813.description: Return to the cave in the Seclusion and commune with the Darkness.
3878661813.description_zh: 返回隔绝之地的洞穴，与暗影交流。

3843819494.name: Found in the Dark
3843819494.description: Destroy Shadow Legion mining operations in the Divide.
3843819494.description_zh: 在分歧之地破坏暗影军团的采矿行动。

3634243230.name: Found in the Dark
3634243230.description:
Paracausal ripples have unearthed a manifestation of Darkness. 

Return to the cave in the Seclusion.
3634243230.description_zh:
超因果涟漪揭示了暗影的显现。

返回隔绝之地的洞穴。

4096435878.name: Lost in the Light
4096435878.description: Find a manifestation of the Light in the cave in the Refraction.
4096435878.description_zh: 在折射之地的洞穴里找到光能的显现。

3208963371.name: Lost in the Light
3208963371.description: Uncover House Salvation's operations in the Blooming.
3208963371.description_zh: 揭露救赎氏族在繁盛之地的行动。

4096435877.name: Lost in the Light
4096435877.description: Return to the cave in the Refraction and commune with the Light.
4096435877.description_zh: 返回折射之地的洞穴，与光能交流。

186303403.name: Lost in the Light
186303403.description: Launch "The Hollow, Part II" to travel to Europa and eliminate the Wrathborn threat.
186303403.description_zh: 开始“空洞，第二部分”，前往木卫二，消除暴怒之子的威胁。

3627559758.name: Lost in the Light
3627559758.description:
Paracausal ripples have unearthed a manifestation of Light. 

Return to the cave in the Refraction.
3627559758.description_zh:
超因果涟漪揭示了光能的显现。

返回折射之地的洞穴。

2145594812.name: Destined Heroes
2145594812.description: There's a strange radio transmission coming from the old Tower in the Lost City… and it's using a Hive frequency.
2145594812.description_zh: 有个奇怪的无线电通讯从失落之城的旧高塔传来…它使用的是邪魔族的频率。

227865745.name: Destined Heroes
227865745.description: Investigate the activity of Savathûn's Lucent Hive near the portal.
227865745.description_zh: 在传送门附近调查萨瓦图恩的光明邪魔族的活动。

1437284567.name: Destined Heroes
1437284567.description: Speak to Micah-10 through her conduit in the Arbor of Light.
1437284567.description_zh: 在光能之亭通过米迦-10的管道与她交谈。

3108716040.name: Destined Heroes
3108716040.description: Talk to Cayde-6 in the Lost City.
3108716040.description_zh: 与失落之城的凯德6号交谈。

2505385643.name: Destined Heroes
2505385643.description: Ghost has something he wants to talk to you about. Go to the ledge of the old Tower in the Lost City to speak with him.
2505385643.description_zh: 机灵有话要跟你说。前往失落之城旧高塔的窗台与他交谈。

3381752080.name: Destined Heroes
3381752080.description: Talk to Ghost to begin the quests "Lost in the Light" and "Found in the Dark." Work with your allies to explore the possibility of synergy between Light and Darkness.
3381752080.description_zh: 与机灵交谈，开始任务“迷失在光中”和“发现于黑暗”。与你的盟友齐力探索协同光能与暗影的可能性。

2036483182.name: Destined Heroes
2036483182.description: Investigate spikes in Taken energy in the Refraction.
2036483182.description_zh: 在折射之地调查傀儡能量的峰值。

2505385640.name: Destined Heroes
2505385640.description: Go to the Lost City and confer with Ghost.
2505385640.description_zh: 前往失落之城与机灵协商。

3761753927.name: Destined Heroes
3761753927.description: Use the Dyadic Prism to access the new landing zone in the Sacrarium and claim your destiny.
3761753927.description_zh: 使用二元棱镜访问圣堂的新着陆区，把握你的命运。

3838101920.name: Convalescence: Rootbound
3838101920.description: Explore the search area to find the missing, possibly injured, Ghost.
3838101920.description_zh: 探索搜索区域，找到可能受了伤的失踪机灵。

2162076565.name: Convalescence: Rootbound
2162076565.description: Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
2162076565.description_zh: 调查光能之亭中的新成长。

3308978151.name: Convalescence: Rootbound
3308978151.description: Speak with Micah in the Arbor of Light to assess the injured Ghost's wounds.
3308978151.description_zh: 在光能之亭与米迦交谈，评估受伤机灵的伤势。

2617996611.name: Convalescence: Underbrush
2617996611.description: Acquire a Flickering Blessing mod by opening chests anywhere in the Pale Heart. Pathfinder field assignment chests have a massively higher chance of granting Traveler's Blessing mods.
2617996611.description_zh: 通过打开苍白之心任意位置的宝箱来获得闪烁祝福模组。寻路者外勤任务宝箱有更高的机会获得旅行者的祝福模组。

2154917694.name: Convalescence: Underbrush
2154917694.description:
Equip the new Flickering Blessing.

Flickering Blessings are a type of Traveler's Blessings. These are powerful combat mods that are only active while in the Pale Heart.

To equip: Open the Traveler's Blessings menu on the Pale Heart map.
2154917694.description_zh:
装备新的闪烁祝福。

闪烁祝福是旅行者的祝福的一种。这些是强大的战斗模组，仅可在苍白之心中启用。

装备：打开苍白之心地图上的旅行者的祝福菜单。

2750760699.name: Convalescence: Underbrush
2750760699.description: Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
2750760699.description_zh: 调查光能之亭中的新成长。

931113523.name: Convalescence: Underbrush

931113523.description_zh: 在光能之亭与米迦交谈，讨论你与光能的新联系。

3465651225.name: Convalescence: Greenery

3465651225.description_zh: 在着陆之地打开颠覆宝箱来进入米迦指示的地点。

1043681923.name: Convalescence: Greenery
1043681923.description:
Follow the vision of Light into the depths of the Pale Heart and fight the infection found there.

Complete Sword Dance Cyst.
1043681923.description_zh:
跟随光能幻象进入苍白之心的深处，与那里的感染作战。

完成刀剑之舞囊肿。

2259993497.name: Convalescence: Greenery

2259993497.description_zh: 返回失落之城的光能之亭。

1831806500.name: Convalescence: Budding

Possible Rewards:
—Bold Endings (Hand Cannon)
—Axial Lacuna (Fusion Rifle)
—False Idols (Sword)
607910367.description_zh:
米迦发现了另一个受伤机灵的坐标。获取此任务开始另一场回收行动。

可能的奖励：
—大胆终末（手炮）
—轴向缺漏（融合步枪）
—虚假偶像（刀剑）

Commune with the bird of Light to invert the cyst.
3750052023.description_zh:
囊肿已变异，以它目前的状态，你无法带着受损的机灵通过。
