2740092152.name: Report: STEPS-RETRACED
2740092152.description: Discover new Insights by defeating Champions in weekly missions on any difficulty. Finishers drop additional Insights.
2740092152.description_zh: 在任意难度的周常任务中击败勇士，发现新见解。终结技将会掉落额外见解。

2198664628.name: Report: STEPS-RETRACED
2198664628.description: Report your findings to the Evidence Board in the Enclave.
2198664628.description_zh: 前往飞地内的证据板报告你的发现。

493722940.name: Report: STEPS-RETRACED
493722940.description: Review the case on the Evidence Board in the Enclave.
493722940.description_zh: 查阅飞地内的证据板上的案件报告。

208310296.name: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
208310296.description: The Hidden have new intel. Check the Evidence Board in the Enclave for details.
208310296.description_zh: 隐秘者有新情报。查看飞地内的证据板来了解更多细节。

2546111175.name: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
2546111175.description: Complete the "Preservation" mission and defeat Scorn to collect Hive runes.
2546111175.description_zh: 完成“存续”任务，并击败嗤魅以收集邪魔族符文。

2669571139.name: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
2669571139.description: Report your findings to the Evidence Board in the Enclave.
2669571139.description_zh: 前往飞地内的证据板报告你的发现。

2141451951.name: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
2141451951.description: Review the case on the Evidence Board in the Enclave.
2141451951.description_zh: 查阅飞地内的证据板上的案件报告。

984859733.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
984859733.description: The Hidden are ready to wrap up the case. Check the Evidence Board in the Enclave for next steps.
984859733.description_zh: 隐秘者已准备好结案了。查看飞地内的证据板了解下一步。

997566004.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
997566004.description: Take the Osmic Fragment from the Evidence Board in the Enclave to Queen's Bailey.
997566004.description_zh: 把在飞地内证据板上的锇素碎片带到女王的城墙。

1076383911.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
1076383911.description: Take the Osmic Fragment to Queen's Bailey to lure in Immaru and the Lucent Brood.
1076383911.description_zh: 把锇素碎片带到女王的城墙，引诱伊马鲁和光明虫群。

2168835075.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
2168835075.description: Use Deepsight to reach a vantage point from which you can observe the lure.
2168835075.description_zh: 使用深视到达制高点以观察诱饵。

3740507945.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
3740507945.description: Verify that the Lucent Brood took the Osmic Fragment.
3740507945.description_zh: 确认光明虫群取走了锇素碎片。

3858918530.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
3858918530.description: Follow the Lucent Brood to Immaru's location in Queen's Bailey.
3858918530.description_zh: 跟踪光明虫群找到在女王的城墙内的伊马鲁。

506874682.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
506874682.description: Defeat the Lucent Brood in Queen's Bailey.
506874682.description_zh: 击败女王的城墙内的光明虫群。

2666759724.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
2666759724.description: Retrieve the Osmic Fragment and resonant runes.
2666759724.description_zh: 取回锇素碎片和共振符文。

374243063.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
374243063.description: Log your final report on the Evidence Board in the Enclave.
374243063.description_zh: 在飞地内的证据板上记录最终报告。

3907500186.name: Report: REVERSE-LURE
3907500186.description: Shape your reward at the Relic.
3907500186.description_zh: 在圣物处塑造你的奖励。

472120382.name: Of Queens and Worms
472120382.description: Meet with Mara Sov in the Enclave on Mars.
472120382.description_zh: 在火星上的飞地内面见玛拉·索维。

3383073000.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073000.description: Complete the "Birthplace of the Vile" strike.

3383073002.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073002.description: Locate a Cryptoglyph rune in the Temple of the Cunning.
3383073002.description_zh: 在狡诈之殿中找到秘符符文。

3494281470.name: Of Queens and Worms
3494281470.description: Defeat Scorn in the Throne World to charge the depleted rune.
3494281470.description_zh: 在王座世界中击败嗤魅来为耗尽的符文充能。

595317119.name: Of Queens and Worms
595317119.description: Find the entrance to the Sepulcher Lost Sector in the Florescent Canal.
595317119.description_zh: 在荧光运河中找到通往墓冢遗失区域的入口。

3383073003.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073003.description: Locate a larvae incubator at the end of the Sepulcher Lost Sector in the Florescent Canal.
3383073003.description_zh: 在荧光运河内墓冢遗失区域的尽头找到幼虫孵化器。

773742346.name: Of Queens and Worms
773742346.description: Gather leads by completing three patrols in the Florescent Canal.
773742346.description_zh: 在荧光运河中完成三次巡逻任务来收集线索。

3383073004.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073004.description: Locate a Cryptoglyph Rune in the Queen's Bailey.
3383073004.description_zh: 在女王的城墙内找到秘符符文。

1921923758.name: Of Queens and Worms
1921923758.description: Find the entrance to the Metamorphosis Lost Sector in the Miasma.
1921923758.description_zh: 在瘴气区中找到通往蜕变遗失区域的入口。

3383073005.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073005.description: Locate a larvae incubator at the end of the Metamorphosis Lost Sector in Miasma.
3383073005.description_zh: 在瘴气区内蜕变遗失区域的尽头找到幼虫孵化器。

3383073006.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073006.description: Locate a Cryptoglyph rune in the Alluring Curtain.
3383073006.description_zh: 在魅惑帷幕内找到秘符符文。

3383073007.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383073007.description: Find the nearby Deepsight cache in the Alluring Curtain.
3383073007.description_zh: 在魅惑帷幕内找到附近的深视缓存箱。

3338373948.name: Of Queens and Worms
3338373948.description: Find the entrance to the Extraction Lost Sector in Quagmire.
3338373948.description_zh: 在沼泽区找到通往萃取地遗失区域的入口。

3383072992.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383072992.description: Locate a larvae incubator at the end of the Extraction Lost Sector in the Quagmire.
3383072992.description_zh: 在沼泽区内萃取地遗失区域的尽头找到幼虫孵化器。

3383072993.name: Of Queens and Worms
3383072993.description: Visit Fynch and see if he can help Savathûn's worm.
3383072993.description_zh: 拜访芬奇，看看他能不能帮助萨瓦图恩的蠕虫。

3890873294.name: Memory Alembic
3890873294.description: Uncover more Executioners each day to fill the Memory Alembic.
3890873294.description_zh: 通过每天发现更多的行刑者来填充记忆蒸馏器。

3890873295.name: Memory Alembic
3890873295.description: Return to Fynch to see what ancient memories are brewing.
3890873295.description_zh: 回到芬奇处，看看他在酿制什么古代记忆。

1083548812.name: Trust Goes Both Ways
1083548812.description: Defeat Scorn and complete a public event in the Miasma.
1083548812.description_zh: 击败嗤魅并在瘴气区完成一次公共事件。

1083548815.name: Trust Goes Both Ways
1083548815.description: Loot Faction Chests and complete patrols in the Miasma.
1083548815.description_zh: 洗掠阵营宝箱并在瘴气区完成巡逻任务。

1083548814.name: Trust Goes Both Ways
1083548814.description: Earn enough reputation with Fynch to reach Rank 3.
1083548814.description_zh: 在芬奇处获得足够的声望，达到等级3。

3010588096.name: The Gift of Appreciation
3010588096.description: Defeat Scorn in the Miasma to obtain 10 Umbral Helmets.
3010588096.description_zh: 在瘴气区击败嗤魅，寻获10个本影头盔。

3010588098.name: The Gift of Appreciation
3010588098.description: Defeat Lucent Brood and complete a public event in the Florescent Canal.
3010588098.description_zh: 击败光明虫群并在荧光运河完成一次公共事件。

3010588099.name: The Gift of Appreciation
3010588099.description: Within the Queen's Bailey, place the Umbral Helmets and defeat the Hive Lightbearers, then crush their Ghosts.
3010588099.description_zh: 在女王的城墙内，放置本影头盔并击败邪魔族负光者，然后摧毁他们的机灵。

3078568019.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
3078568019.description: Beat the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon on any difficulty.
3078568019.description_zh: 以任意难度完成“分离教义”地牢。

130703567.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
130703567.description: Pick up the Hidden report on your findings and enter their proposed code into the Pyramid's machinery in their base camp.
130703567.description_zh: 拿取关于你的发现的隐秘者报告，将提供的代码输入其大本营里的金字塔机器。

83808423.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
83808423.description:
Find Rhulk's experimental Hive worms, and hunt down a group of Dread studying the workings of the Pyramid to claim their knowledge.

With greater insight into its inner workings, more of the Pyramid may reveal itself to you…
83808423.description_zh:
找到胡克的实验性邪魔族蠕虫，追杀一群研究金字塔运作机制的恐惧来获取其知识。

了解金字塔的内部运作，或许能揭示更多它的秘密…

261410846.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
261410846.description: Complete the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon to see if anything within the Pyramid has changed with your increased insight into its workings.
261410846.description_zh: 完成“分离教义”地牢，看看随着你对金字塔运作的理解不断加深，其内部是否已发生变化。

3765398854.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
3765398854.description: Wait for the Hidden researchers to complete their study of the information you brought them from inside the Pyramid.
3765398854.description_zh: 等待隐秘者研究人员分析完你从金字塔内部带回的信息。

788576066.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
788576066.description:
Pick up the latest Hidden report, find more of Rhulk's laboratory worms, and discover what the Hive are hiding in the depths of the Pyramid.

With greater insight to its inner workings, more of the Pyramid may reveal itself to you…
788576066.description_zh:
拿取最新的隐秘者报告，找到更多胡克实验室的蠕虫，查清邪魔族在金字塔深处隐藏了什么。

了解金字塔的内部运作，或许能揭示更多它的秘密…

2437268361.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
2437268361.description: Complete the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon to check on the status of the vault door.
2437268361.description_zh: 完成“分离教义”地牢，检查保险库门的状态。

3832860594.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
3832860594.description: Wait for the Hidden researchers to complete their study of the information you brought them from inside the Pyramid.
3832860594.description_zh: 等待隐秘者研究人员分析完你从金字塔内部带回的信息。

2526287581.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
2526287581.description:
Pick up the newest Hidden report, find Rhulk's experimental Hive worms, and use your knowledge to track down the Pyramid's auxiliary control chamber.

With greater insight into its workings, more of the Pyramid may reveal itself to you…
2526287581.description_zh:
拿取最新的隐秘者报告，找到胡克的实验性邪魔族蠕虫，利用你的知识寻找金字塔的辅助控制室。

了解金字塔的运作，或许能揭示更多它的秘密…

2095884141.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
2095884141.description:
Return to Rhulk's vault and discover what is beyond its door.
Complete the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon.
2095884141.description_zh:
重返胡克的保险库，看看那道门的后面是什么。
完成“分离教义”地牢。

2405856252.name: The Drowning Labyrinth
2405856252.description: Return to Ikora in the Bazaar for a debriefing.

627172891.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
627172891.description: Rumors swirl about an old friend returning to the Tower. Investigate what's happening.
627172891.description_zh: 传言说有个老朋友回到了高塔。去调查一下情况。

3984170438.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
3984170438.description: Secure a foothold on Europa. Complete the quest "Darkness's Doorstep."
3984170438.description_zh: 在木卫二上拿下据点。完成“暗影门阶”任务。

802552739.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
802552739.description: Travel to Europa and recover the research data from the BrayTech facilities.
802552739.description_zh: 前往木卫二，从布瑞科技设施取回研究数据。

802552738.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
802552738.description: Find the processing unit the schematics refer to.
802552738.description_zh: 找到图纸上的处理单元。

802552737.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
802552737.description: Visit Ada-1 in the Tower to discuss your findings.
802552737.description_zh: 拜访高塔中的艾达-1，讨论你的发现。

802552736.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
802552736.description: Interact with the Loom to connect the processing unit and finish the device.
802552736.description_zh: 与纺织机互动来连接处理单元和完成设备。

802552743.name: Armor Synthesis Introduction
802552743.description: Return to Ada-1 to learn about the finished Loom.
802552743.description_zh: 回去找艾达-1，了解已完工的纺织机。

478850325.name: Tying It All Together
478850325.description: Speak with Ada-1 in the Tower to receive starter materials for Armor Synthesis.
478850325.description_zh: 与高塔中的艾达-1交谈，领取护甲合成的初始材料。

495775103.name: Tying It All Together
495775103.description: Use the Synthweave that Ada provided to create an ornament from any piece of Legendary armor you've acquired.
495775103.description_zh: 用艾达给的合成纤维照着你已获得的任意一件传说护甲制作皮肤。

2877652516.name: Tying It All Together
2877652516.description: Return to Ada-1 in the Tower to discuss your progress.
2877652516.description_zh: 回去找高塔中的艾达-1，与她讨论你的进度。

2978465325.name: Tying It All Together
2978465325.description: Purchase any Armor Synthesis bounty from Ada-1.
2978465325.description_zh: 从艾达-1那里购买任意护甲合成悬赏。

2676026930.name: Tying It All Together
2676026930.description: Complete any Armor Synthesis bounty and claim its reward.
2676026930.description_zh: 完成任意护甲合成悬赏并领取其奖励。

2776839739.name: Tying It All Together
2776839739.description: Use the Loom to convert your Synthcord into Synthweave.
2776839739.description_zh: 用纺织机将合成线转换成合成纤维。

326865984.name: Tying It All Together
326865984.description: Return to Ada-1 in the Tower Armory and report your successful operation of the Loom.
326865984.description_zh: 回去找高塔军械库中的艾达-1，报告你已成功操作纺织机。

427678793.name: Tying It All Together
427678793.description: Acquire 10,000 Glimmer in order to purchase another Armor Synthesis bounty from Ada-1.
427678793.description_zh: 收集10000微光，从艾达-1那里购买另一个护甲合成悬赏。

664684062.name: Tying It All Together
664684062.description: Return to Ada-1 to continue manufacturing Synthweave.
664684062.description_zh: 回去找艾达-1，继续制造合成纤维。

1264358026.name: Rise
1264358026.description: Complete the "Ghosts of the Deep" dungeon.

2870922921.name: Rise
2870922921.description: Return to Hawthorne in the Tower Bazaar.
2870922921.description_zh: 回到高塔集市去找霍桑。

1875434402.name: Legacy: Lightfall
1875434402.description: Go see Osiris in the Hall of Heroes.
1875434402.description_zh: 去英雄大厅见奥斯里斯。

1831789550.name: Legacy: Lightfall
1831789550.description: Go see Rohan in the Hall of Heroes.

1120173220.name: Legacy: Lightfall
1120173220.description: Go see Osiris in the Hall of Heroes.
1120173220.description_zh: 去英雄大厅见奥斯里斯。

1113204948.name: Legacy: Lightfall
1113204948.description: Go see Zavala in the Tower.

3401811367.name: Legacy: Lightfall
3401811367.description: Go see Ikora in the Tower.

3670562313.name: Legacy: Lightfall
3670562313.description: Go to the Hall of Heroes and meditate to receive your Strand subclass.
3670562313.description_zh: 前往英雄大厅，冥想并接受你的缚丝分支职业。

3638686275.name: Legacy: Lightfall
3638686275.description:
You have made a breakthrough in your journey of mastering Strand. Strand subclasses are now available to equip at any time.

You can also purchase an Aspect from the Pouka Pond in the Hall of Heroes on Neptune.
3638686275.description_zh:
你在掌握缚丝的过程中取得了突破。你现在随时可以装备缚丝分支职业。

你还可以从海王星英雄大厅内的普卡池购买星相。

3760780188.name: Stargazer
3760780188.description: Loot the Terminal Overload reward chest at the end of the activity.
3760780188.description_zh: 在活动结束时劫掠终端过载奖励宝箱。

4234895841.name: Stargazer
4234895841.description: Defeat the Vex Hydra in Esi Terminal to obtain a high-security passcode.
4234895841.description_zh: 在艾西太空港中击败Vex九头蛇来获得高安全性密码。

2864855727.name: Stargazer
2864855727.description: Obtain a Terminal Overload Key by completing public events, looting chests, or completing patrols.
2864855727.description_zh: 通过完成公共事件、劫掠宝箱或完成巡逻来收集终端过载密钥。

3340629005.name: Stargazer
3340629005.description: Use a key to open a Terminal Overload Key Chest.
3340629005.description_zh: 使用密钥开启终端过载密钥宝箱。

2280565321.name: Stargazer
2280565321.description: Return to the Hall of Heroes to repair Stargazer's memorial.
2280565321.description_zh: 回到英雄大厅，修复观星者的纪念碑。

857352656.name: Stargazer
857352656.description: Return to Quinn to discuss the next steps.
857352656.description_zh: 返回昆恩处讨论下一步行动。

1181188552.name: Maelstrom
1181188552.description: Bond with Strand sources, and participate in public events, patrols, and loot resources, all within the Vex Incursion Zone.
1181188552.description_zh: 与缚丝源头建立联系，在Vex入侵区内参与公共事件、巡逻及劫掠资源。

1372768543.name: Maelstrom
1372768543.description: Complete the Lost Sector within the Vex Incursion Zone.
1372768543.description_zh: 在Vex入侵区内完成遗失区域。

3531355350.name: Maelstrom
3531355350.description: Return to the Hall of Heroes to repair Maelstrom's memorial.
3531355350.description_zh: 回到英雄大厅，修复漩涡的纪念碑。

2411419739.name: Maelstrom
2411419739.description: Return to Quinn to discuss the next steps.
2411419739.description_zh: 返回昆恩处讨论下一步行动。

3072532148.name: Bluejay
3072532148.description: Defeat combatants in the current Vex Incursion Zone with a Strand subclass equipped to obtain Shellcode Fragments, and open a Terminal Overload Key Chest to obtain a Polymorphic Engine.
3072532148.description_zh: 在当前的Vex入侵区内装备缚丝分支职业击败战斗人员来获得壳代码碎片，并开启终端过载密钥宝箱来获得多态引擎。

3233428571.name: Bluejay
3233428571.description: Return to the Hall of Heroes to repair Bluejay's memorial.
3233428571.description_zh: 回到英雄大厅，修复冠蓝鸦的纪念碑。

4080979246.name: Bluejay
4080979246.description: Return to Quinn to discuss the next steps.
4080979246.description_zh: 返回昆恩处讨论下一步行动。

3413453049.name: Strider
3413453049.description: Spend keys on a Terminal Overload Key Chest in each of the three different areas of Neomuna.
3413453049.description_zh: 在内欧姆那三个不同区域的终端过载密钥宝箱上花费密钥。

2557879920.name: Strider
2557879920.description: Defeat Shadow Legion forces in Neomuna to find location data, and dive into the Ahimsa Park Lost Sector for a data cipher to put the data together.
2557879920.description_zh: 击败内欧姆那的暗影军团部队，找到位置数据，潜入非暴力公园遗失区域寻找数据暗码来整合数据。

2670023973.name: Strider
2670023973.description: The archivist wants to discuss your findings.
2670023973.description_zh: 档案管理员想要讨论一下你的发现。

4054032200.name: Strider
4054032200.description: Approach Strider's memorial to repair it.
4054032200.description_zh: 靠近云端行者的纪念碑来修复它。

2945759410.name: Strider
2945759410.description: Destroy the Hydras and shut down the confluxes at Maya's Retreat.
2945759410.description_zh: 击败九头蛇并在玛雅的隐居处关闭汇流。

1918331978.name: Strider
1918331978.description: The archivist has a reward for you.
1918331978.description_zh: 档案管理员为你准备了一份奖励。

1670328174.name: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
1670328174.description: Explore the Hall of Heroes audio tour.
1670328174.description_zh: 探索英雄大厅的语音导览。

656632067.name: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
656632067.description: Visit the damaged memorials to learn more about them and see what data can be salvaged.
656632067.description_zh: 到访被损坏的纪念碑，深入了解它们，看看有什么可回收的数据。

1409238785.name: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
1409238785.description: Scan the remaining damaged memorial to see what data can be salvaged.
1409238785.description_zh: 扫描剩余被损坏的纪念碑，看看有什么可回收的数据。

3742423637.name: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
3742423637.description: The Archivist wants to discuss your new use for Strand.
3742423637.description_zh: 档案管理员想与你谈谈缚丝的新用处。

3107649396.name: Unfinished Business
3107649396.description: Go to the Hall of Heroes.

1354288074.name: Unfinished Business
1354288074.description: Visit Nimbus to find out why they left Rohan's induction ceremony early.
1354288074.description_zh: 拜访宁博思，找出他提早离开洛汗入厅典礼的原因。

4252762628.name: Unfinished Business
4252762628.description: Collect cipher qubits from the Vex and use them to extract Rohan's data from Cloud Accretions in Neomuna.
4252762628.description_zh: 从Vex身上收集暗码量子比特，并利用它们从内欧姆那的云端积层中提取洛汗的数据。

3578439097.name: Unfinished Business
3578439097.description: Locate the final data packet in Maya's Retreat.
3578439097.description_zh: 在玛雅的隐居处找到最终数据包。

2884502477.name: Unfinished Business
2884502477.description: Survive the Vex attack and recover the data packet from their conflux.
2884502477.description_zh: 在Vex攻击中存活下来，并从他们的汇流中找回数据包。

2392943047.name: Unfinished Business
2392943047.description: Regroup with Nimbus and Osiris in Radiosonde to find out what was in Rohan's notes.
2392943047.description_zh: 与宁博思和奥斯里斯在无线电探空仪会合，看看洛汗的笔记里写了什么。

3055839705.name: Unfinished Business
3055839705.description: Retrieve a Vex compass from the Lost Sector in Límíng Harbor.
3055839705.description_zh: 从莱明港的遗失区域找回Vex指南针。

157696345.name: Unfinished Business
157696345.description: Create chaos in Ahimsa Park to draw Shadow Legion forces away from Calus's ship. The more you use your abilities to defeat combatants, the more mayhem you create.
157696345.description_zh: 在非暴力公园制造混乱，把暗影军团部队从卡鲁斯的飞船上引开。你使用技能击败越多的战斗人员，你就能制造越多的骚乱。

965473706.name: Unfinished Business
965473706.description: The passkey's other component is a Seed of Silver Wings. One can be found in Calus's trove deep within the Typhon Imperator.
965473706.description_zh: 密钥的另一个组件是银翼之种。可以在提丰大帝号内部深处的卡鲁斯宝库中找到。

802746785.name: Unfinished Business
802746785.description: Return to Nimbus in Striders' Gate to build the passkey.
802746785.description_zh: 返回行者大门找宁博思构建密钥。

3680805371.name: Unfinished Business
3680805371.description: Bring the Conceptual Mind's memory core to Nimbus in Striders' Gate.
3680805371.description_zh: 将概念思维的记忆核心带到行者大门的宁博思处。

3317571822.name: Unfinished Business
3317571822.description: Go to the Hall of Heroes to honor those who cut their years short for the sake of humanity.
3317571822.description_zh: 前往英雄大厅纪念那些为了人类而英年早逝的英雄。

3610649340.name: The Final Strand
3610649340.description: Visit Nimbus in Striders' Gate in Neomuna.
3610649340.description_zh: 在内欧姆那的行者大门拜访宁博思。

3161484303.name: The Final Strand
3161484303.description: Search for Strand-inoculated gadgets in Veil Containment in Neomuna.
3161484303.description_zh: 在内欧姆那的面纱遏制舱中搜索缚丝接种工具。

1550193703.name: The Final Strand
1550193703.description: Defeat the Shadow Legion looters and read their orders to learn where they took the spoils.
1550193703.description_zh: 消灭暗影军团掠夺者，阅读他们的命令，了解他们把战利品运到了哪里。

3646525804.name: The Final Strand
3646525804.description: Retrieve the Veil spectrometer from the Typhon Imperator.
3646525804.description_zh: 从提丰大帝号取回面纱分光计。

235749523.name: The Final Strand
235749523.description: Visit the Pouka Pond in the Hall of Heroes in Neomuna.
235749523.description_zh: 拜访内欧姆那英雄大厅内的普卡池。

34163917.name: The Final Strand
34163917.description: Complete Osiris's training program in Radiosonde in at least 5 minutes 30 seconds to retune the Veil spectrometer.
34163917.description_zh: 至少在5分30秒内完成奥斯里斯在无线电探空仪中的训练计划，以重新调节面纱分光计。

2632313001.name: The Final Strand
2632313001.description: Visit the Pouka Pond in the Hall of Heroes to finish your Strand weapon.
2632313001.description_zh: 拜访英雄大厅的普卡池完成你的缚丝武器。

484414765.name: From Zero…
484414765.description: Retrieve supply caches from region chests  in Neomuna.
484414765.description_zh: 从内欧姆那的地区宝箱中取回补给缓存箱。

456278504.name: From Zero…
456278504.description: Work with the Neomuni people to defend the city by completing patrols and public events, and bolster their supplies by gathering resource nodes and chests.
456278504.description_zh: 通过完成巡逻和公共事件，并通过收集资源节点和宝箱来加强供给，与内欧姆那人民携手捍卫城市。

2093863435.name: From Zero…
2093863435.description: Travel to Esi Terminal and defeat Shadow Legionary Trask.
2093863435.description_zh: 前往艾西太空港并击败暗影军团士兵特拉斯克。

3907528162.name: …To Hero
3907528162.description: Retrieve the remaining supply caches from region chests  in Neomuna.
3907528162.description_zh: 从内欧姆那的地区宝箱中取回剩余的补给缓存箱。

777349811.name: …To Hero
777349811.description: Work with the Neomuni people to defend the city by completing patrols and public events, and bolster their supplies by gathering resource nodes and chests.
777349811.description_zh: 通过完成巡逻和公共事件，并通过收集资源节点和宝箱来加强供给，与内欧姆那人民携手捍卫城市。

1347976320.name: …To Hero
1347976320.description: Travel to the Typhon Imperator, sabotage Shadow Legion supplies, and defeat Shadow Legionary Gha'ram.
1347976320.description_zh: 前往提丰大帝号，破坏暗影军团的补给，并击败暗影军团士兵加拉姆。

1056064029.name: Any Data Port in a Storm
1056064029.description: Gain data to support the nanite calibration by rapidly defeating combatants in Neomuna with Auto Rifles, grenades, and any Grenade Launchers. Rapidly defeating combatants with Grenade Launchers grants the most progress.
1056064029.description_zh: 通过在内欧姆那使用自动步枪、手雷及任意榴弹发射器快速击败战斗人员，获得数据来支持纳米蜂群校准。使用榴弹发射器快速击败战斗人员能最高效地提升进度。

2958186031.name: Any Data Port in a Storm
2958186031.description: Go visit Banshee-44 in the Tower to see what he has to say about Quicksilver Storm's progress.
2958186031.description_zh: 去拜访位于高塔的班西-44，看看他对瞬变风暴的进展有什么看法。

4265906105.name: Any Data Port in a Storm
4265906105.description: Defeat combatants in Neomuna with the Grenade Launcher alternate fire mode of Quicksilver Storm.
4265906105.description_zh: 在内欧姆那使用瞬变风暴的榴弹发射器次要射击模式击败战斗人员。

3534533410.name: Unveiled
3534533410.description: Check on Osiris's data crawler for more information about the Veil's history.
3534533410.description_zh: 查看奥斯里斯的数据爬虫，获取有关面纱历史的更多信息。

3117358110.name: Unveiled
3117358110.description: Return to the meditation table to obtain your next Strand Aspect.
3117358110.description_zh: 回到冥想桌来获得你的下一个缚丝星相。

699674453.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
699674453.description: Complete the "Warlord's Ruin" dungeon in the EDZ.
699674453.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区中完成“战争领主的废墟”地牢。

3342537589.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
3342537589.description_zh: 收集腐化的阿罕卡拉遗骨。

528631697.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
528631697.description_zh: 收集五份黑暗乙太酊剂。

1248338443.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
1248338443.description:
Find and restore three lost Bones of Hefnd:
- First Bone: Across the bridge inside the first fort, before an arresting Knight assails you.
- Second Bone: Across from imprisonment, after ascending through the ceiling.
- Third Bone: At the top of the summit, face back from the cliff and find shelter.
1248338443.description_zh:
找到并恢复三块失落的赫芬德骸骨：
- 第一块骸骨：在第一座堡垒内的桥对面，一名醒目的骑士袭击你之前。
- 第二块骸骨：在监狱对面，穿过天花板之后。
- 第三块骸骨：在峰顶，背对着悬崖，寻找庇护之所。

4140478887.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
4140478887.description:
Find and restore three more lost Bones of Hefnd:
- Fourth Bone: In the snowfallen maze, through the broken wall, seek the banner of kings.
- Fifth Bone: Cross into the Tempest, through the portcullis, at the sewer's mouth.
- Sixth Bone: At summit's base, find shelter off the beaten path. Too far, and the Taken will descend upon you.
4140478887.description_zh:
找到并恢复另外三块失落的赫芬德骸骨：
- 第四块骸骨：在大雪纷飞的迷宫中，穿过残垣断壁，寻找王族的旗帜。
- 第五块骸骨：穿过风暴，经过闸门，位于阴沟口。
- 第六块骸骨：在峰顶的底部，人迹罕至之地寻找庇护。走得太远，傀儡军团就会发动突然袭击。

2965218580.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
2965218580.description:
Find and restore the three final lost Bones of Hefnd:
- Seventh Bone: Within the maze, stride spanning a pitfall, light calls through the window.
- Eighth Bone: The Taken roil at cave's bottom sends you to scurry over boulders into a ruined alcove.
- Ninth Bone: Within a tunnel on the broken cliffs, brave the Taken storm.
2965218580.description_zh:
找到并恢复最后三块失落的赫芬德骸骨：
- 第七块骸骨：在迷宫之中，大步跨过陷阱，光线透过窗户呼唤着。
- 第八块骸骨：洞穴底部的傀儡军团骚动不安，让你匆忙越过巨石，进入一间破败的凹室。
- 第九块骸骨：在破碎悬崖上的地道内，勇敢面对傀儡军团。

867172810.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
867172810.description: Gather Blighted Wishing Glass and Dark Ether Tinctures to empower the portal in the Blighted Keep.
867172810.description_zh: 收集凋零许愿玻璃和黑暗乙太酊剂，为凋零要塞的传送门供能。

825259733.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain

1945738920.name: In the Shadow of the Mountain
1945738920.description: Return to Ikora and report your findings.
1945738920.description_zh: 回去找艾可拉，报告你的发现。

576600994.name: The Way Between
576600994.description: Speak with Aunor to learn about a new threat to the Praxic Order.
576600994.description_zh: 与阿诺尔交谈，了解英勇教团面临的新威胁。

3363318562.name: The Way Between
3363318562.description: Stop the Barant Imperium's Dredgens from pillaging Venus's Praxic Temple in "Equilibrium."
3363318562.description_zh: 在“平衡”中，阻止巴兰特帝国的德瑞捷劫掠金星的英勇圣殿。

2931101575.name: The Way Between
2931101575.description: Visit the Praxic Temple and bring Sere's stolen relic back to its place.
2931101575.description_zh: 拜访英勇圣殿，将赛尔窃取的圣物带回其原位。

2074473131.name: The Way Between
2074473131.description:
Recover another of the Praxic relics stolen by the Imperium, integrate the Light and Darkness within it, and bring it back to where it belongs.

Praxic trainee, remember your Blade will serve you on your way.
2074473131.description_zh:
找回帝国窃取的另一件英勇圣物，整合其中的光能与暗影，将其带回它应归之处。

英勇学徒，切记你的利刃将在过程中为你效力。

197553903.name: The Way Between
197553903.description: Master the Darkness to find another stolen Praxic relic.
197553903.description_zh: 掌握暗影来找到另一件失窃的英勇圣物。

891167861.name: The Way Between
891167861.description: Traverse the Imperium's shadows to find the last stolen relic.
891167861.description_zh: 穿越帝国的阴影，找到最后一件失窃的圣物。

3811800277.name: The Way Between
3811800277.description: Open the Taken portal in the inner temple, and face the Dark.
3811800277.description_zh: 开启内殿中的傀儡军团传送门，直面暗影。

2457004046.name: The Way Between
2457004046.description: Defeat the lingering shade of Dredgen Sere and restore the Praxic Temple.
2457004046.description_zh: 击败德瑞捷·赛尔残留的阴影，修复英勇圣殿。

3669113309.name: Heavy Does It
3669113309.description: Rebuild the Grand Overture's catalyst by defeating Cabal, defeating targets with Power weapons, and rapidly defeating targets.
3669113309.description_zh: 通过使用击败卡巴尔、使用威能武器击败目标和快速击败目标来重铸大序曲的催化。

74310575.name: Heavy Does It
74310575.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Grand Overture.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
74310575.description_zh:
使用大序曲校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

1248482780.name: Heavy Does It
1248482780.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
1248482780.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

364003008.name: No Trespassing
364003008.description: Adjust Trespasser's retrofitted catalyst by defeating Fallen, defeating targets with Arc damage, and defeating targets with precision final blows.
364003008.description_zh: 通过消灭堕落者、使用电弧伤害消灭目标以及使用精准最后一击消灭目标，调整入侵者的改装催化。

4023822046.name: No Trespassing
4023822046.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Trespasser.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
4023822046.description_zh:
使用入侵者校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

1083370359.name: No Trespassing
1083370359.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
1083370359.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

2927847132.name: The Form of the Danger
2927847132.description:
Design the Delicate Tomb's catalyst by defeating targets with Energy slot weapons and defeating challenging combatants. 

Defeating minibosses, bosses, and Champions provides additional progress.
2927847132.description_zh:
通过使用能量位武器击败目标和击败高阶战斗人员，来设计精致坟墓的催化。

击败初级首领、首领、勇士能提供额外进度。

1931939585.name: The Form of the Danger
1931939585.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Delicate Tomb.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
1931939585.description_zh:
使用精致坟墓校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

4290081602.name: The Form of the Danger
4290081602.description: Return to Banshee-44 in the Tower to receive the calibrated catalyst.
4290081602.description_zh: 回到高塔找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

2855966190.name: Volantes Violentiam
2855966190.description: Reconstruct The Manticore's catalyst by defeating targets with Submachine Guns while airborne.
2855966190.description_zh: 在空中时用微型冲锋枪击败目标来重建蝎狮的催化。

3083700040.name: Volantes Violentiam
3083700040.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using The Manticore.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
3083700040.description_zh:
使用蝎狮校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

3029618517.name: Volantes Violentiam
3029618517.description: Return to Banshee-44 in the Tower to receive the calibrated catalyst.
3029618517.description_zh: 回到高塔找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

2857343851.name: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
2857343851.description: Recreate the Verglas Curve catalyst by defeating targets with Stasis and rapidly defeating them.
2857343851.description_zh: 通过使用冰影击败目标、实现快速击败来重制雨淞弧线的催化。

169598011.name: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
169598011.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Verglas Curve.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
169598011.description_zh:
使用雨淞弧线校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

1129394320.name: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
1129394320.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
1129394320.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

4188409722.name: Higher Voltage
4188409722.description: Rebuild the Centrifuse's catalyst by rapidly defeating targets and defeating them with Arc final blows.
4188409722.description_zh: 通过使用电弧最后一击快速击败目标来重建离心混合器的催化。

2196850110.name: Higher Voltage
2196850110.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Centrifuse.

Calibration occurs when you complete Os activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
2196850110.description_zh:
使用离心混合器校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

2749996823.name: Higher Voltage
2749996823.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the rebuilt catalyst.
2749996823.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已重建的催化。

1429553682.name: Parting the Veil
1429553682.description: Defeat Cabal in Neomuna to find Vex tracking data.
1429553682.description_zh: 在内欧姆那击败卡巴尔，找到Vex追踪数据。

3659291540.name: Parting the Veil
3659291540.description: Acquire Vex data from Maya's Retreat.
3659291540.description_zh: 从玛雅的隐居处获得Vex数据。

1420409259.name: Parting the Veil
1420409259.description: Acquire additional Vex data from the exterior of the Irkalla Complex.
1420409259.description_zh: 从伊尔卡拉设施的外部获得额外的Vex数据。

1941367117.name: Parting the Veil
1941367117.description: Pick up your next Strand Aspect at the table.
1941367117.description_zh: 在桌旁获得你的下一个缚丝星相。

2429897656.name: Grenade Logic
2429897656.description: Recreate the Ex Diris catalyst by defeating multiple targets in rapid succession and defeating targets without dying.
2429897656.description_zh: 通过快速连续击败多个目标，并在不死亡的情况下击败目标来重新打造不祥之兆催化。

2682863308.name: Grenade Logic
2682863308.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Ex Diris.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
2682863308.description_zh:
使用不祥之兆校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

1584790193.name: Grenade Logic
1584790193.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
1584790193.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

3854532214.name: An Old Flame
3854532214.description: Recreate the Dragon's Breath catalyst by defeating scorched combatants and bosses.
3854532214.description_zh: 通过击败被灼烧的战斗人员和首领来重建龙息催化。

1113229786.name: An Old Flame
1113229786.description:
Calibrate data and defeat targets while using Dragon's Breath.

Calibration occurs when you complete Ops activities. Crucible wins provide additional progress.
1113229786.description_zh:
使用龙息校准数据并击败目标。

完成行动活动可提供校准。熔炉竞技场胜场可提供额外进度。

1339164299.name: An Old Flame
1339164299.description: Return to Banshee-44 to receive the calibrated catalyst.
1339164299.description_zh: 回去找班西-44领取已校准的催化。

262952568.name: Armament Protocol
262952568.description: Speak with Devrim Kay at the Tower to learn more about Call to Arms.
262952568.description_zh: 去高塔与德弗里姆·卡伊交谈，以了解更多关于武装召唤的信息。

384320542.name: Armament Protocol
384320542.description: Open a Daily Shipment chest at the Tower and complete an activity to acquire an attuned weapon. Talk to Devrim at the Tower to set the attuned weapon that could drop when an activity is completed.
384320542.description_zh: 在高塔打开每日补给，完成一项活动即可获得一把同调武器。与高塔的德弗里姆对话来设置同调武器，它可以在完成活动后掉落。

283507733.name: Armament Protocol
283507733.description: Complete a Call to Arms Crucible match or Solo Ops activity. Call to Arms activities can be found in the Play Now tab of the Event Home.
283507733.description_zh: 完成一场武装召唤熔炉竞技场比赛或单人行动活动。武装召唤活动可以在活动主页的立刻进行游戏选项卡中找到。

182694956.name: Armament Protocol
182694956.description: Claim the first reward from the Event Reward Track.
182694956.description_zh: 从活动奖励路线中领取第一个奖励。

2229314211.name: Armament Protocol
2229314211.description: Complete and claim a Daily Challenge from the Call to Arms Event Home.
2229314211.description_zh: 通过武装召唤活动主页，完成并领取一项日常挑战。

2665385178.name: Armament Protocol
2665385178.description: Return to Devrim Kay at the Tower.
2665385178.description_zh: 回高塔去找德弗里姆·卡伊。

2158533271.name: The Last Hurrah
2158533271.description: The Call to Arms event has ended and Celebration Week has begun. Speak with Devrim Kay at the Tower to learn more about Celebration Week.
2158533271.description_zh: 武装召唤活动已结束，庆祝周已开始。去高塔与德弗里姆·卡伊交谈，以了解更多关于庆祝周的信息。

2604394056.name: The Last Hurrah
2604394056.description: The Call to Arms event has ended, but Celebration Week has just begun. Speak with Devrim Kay at the Tower to learn more about Celebration Week.
2604394056.description_zh: 武装召唤活动已结束，但庆祝周已开始。去高塔与德弗里姆·卡伊交谈，以了解更多关于庆祝周的信息。

222516611.name: The Last Hurrah
222516611.description: You've earned some prestigious rewards! Open the chest beside Devrim in the Tower to claim them.
222516611.description_zh: 你赢得了一些颇具声望的奖励！在高塔打开德弗里姆旁边的宝箱进行领取。

2806019770.name: The Last Hurrah
2806019770.description: Speak with Devrim Kay at the Tower to learn about the remaining benefits of Celebration Week.
2806019770.description_zh: 去高塔与德弗里姆·卡伊交谈，了解庆祝周的其他福利。

3021933331.name: Distortions
3021933331.description: Lodi has been keeping tabs on the Nine and has something he wants to share with you. Seek him out in the Bazaar area of the Tower.
3021933331.description_zh: 洛迪一直在收集有关玖的情报，并希望与你分享一些信息。到高塔的集市区域去找他。

2962137983.name: Distortions
2962137983.description: Look for signs of a nearby Distortion Breach after completing a public event on a Distorted Destination.
2962137983.description_zh: 在扭曲目的地完成公共事件后，寻找附近扭曲裂口的迹象。

750031125.name: Distortions
750031125.description: Collect Strange Matter on the current Distorted Destination.
750031125.description_zh: 收集当前扭曲目的地上的奇异物质。

750031124.name: Distortions
750031124.description:
Your Strange Matter combined into a Strange Signal.

Open your map and find where the Strange Signal leads.
750031124.description_zh:
你的奇异物质已组合成奇怪信号。

打开你的地图，查明奇怪信号指向何处。

3244260066.name: Weapons of the Pantheon
3244260066.description: Complete each encounter of "The Pantheon: Calus Resplendent."
3244260066.description_zh: 完成“众神殿：辉煌卡鲁斯”中的每场遭遇战。

3160371907.name: Weapons of the Pantheon
3160371907.description: Complete each encounter of "The Pantheon: Morgeth Surpassing" with at least one feat active.
3160371907.description_zh: 启用至少一个壮举的情况下，完成“众神殿：超越摩格斯”中的每场遭遇战。

1545037868.name: Weapons of the Pantheon
1545037868.description: Return in time for new challenges…

3344925812.name: Weapons of the Pantheon
3344925812.description: Complete each encounter of "The Pantheon: Insurrection Prime Revolutionary" with at least one feat active.
3344925812.description_zh: 启用至少一个壮举的情况下，完成“众神殿：革命暴动首领”中的每场遭遇战。

4171392409.name: The Tenets
4171392409.description: Investigate the monument in the Tower Courtyard.
4171392409.description_zh: 调查高塔庭院中的纪念碑。

456184898.name: The Tenets
456184898.description: Access the Tenet of Bravery to claim "The Monument" Triumph.
456184898.description_zh: 访问忠诚信条以领取“纪念碑”成就。

1303879934.name: The Tenets
1303879934.description: Purchase any item from the Tenet of Bravery.
1303879934.description_zh: 在忠诚信条处购买任意物品。

1844297021.name: The Tenets
1844297021.description: Speak with Ikora in the Tower Bazaar.
1844297021.description_zh: 前往高塔集市与艾可拉交谈。

2125848607.name: Xenology
2125848607.description:
Complete Ops activities with performance grade B or higher.

Additional progress is awarded for better performance grades, activities with a longer average duration, and for succeeding with clanmates.
2125848607.description_zh:
以B或更高的表现等级完成行动活动。

更好的表现等级、平均持续时间更长的活动，以及与公会成员一起成功可获得额外进度。

2125848606.name: Xenology
2125848606.description:
Return and speak to Xûr.

You may hold a maximum of 5 Exotic Ciphers in your inventory.
2125848606.description_zh:
回去与仄交谈。

你的物品栏中最多可保存5个异域密码。

2185538252.name: CAYDE'S FATE
2185538252.description: Peer into the past with Ikora to relive the final moments of Hunter Vanguard Cayde-6.
2185538252.description_zh: 与艾可拉一起回顾往昔，重温猎人先锋凯德6号的最后时刻。

2784452573.name: CRUX OF STASIS
2784452573.description: Peer into the past with Ikora to relive the moment when Guardians first wielded the Darkness.
2784452573.description_zh: 与艾可拉一起回顾往昔，重温守护者第一次驾驭暗影的时刻。

1811470891.name: LUCENT HIVE
1811470891.description: Peer into the past with Ikora to discover the truth about Savathûn.
1811470891.description_zh: 与艾可拉一起回顾往昔，揭开有关萨瓦图恩的真相。
1811470891.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

445871069.name: STRANDED
445871069.description: Peer into the past with Ikora to learn about Strand and the Witness's plans on Neptune.
445871069.description_zh: 与艾可拉一起回顾往昔，了解缚丝和见证者对海王星的计划。

1081239042.name: Destiny Calls
1081239042.description:
Learn about the Traveler, its arrival in Sol, and our intertwined destiny.

Playing this cinematic will return you to orbit.
1081239042.description_zh:
认识旅行者，了解它来到太阳系的过程，以及我们相互交织的命运。

播放此过场动画，你将回到轨道。

951916121.name: The Witness
951916121.description:
Learn about the Witness, architect of humanity's Collapse.

Playing this cinematic will return you to orbit.
951916121.description_zh:
了解人类大崩溃的罪魁祸首：见证者。

播放此过场动画，你将回到轨道。

1198173559.name: Shadowkeep
1198173559.description: Return to orbit and watch a cinematic to learn about the Pyramid on the Moon and our first interaction with the Witness.
1198173559.description_zh: 返回轨道，观看过场动画，了解月球上的金字塔以及我们与见证者的首次互动。

449150323.name: Skip New Light
449150323.description: Fly straight to the Tower to skip the New Light tutorial and join the Vanguard on the frontlines to combat the foes of humanity.
449150323.description_zh: 直接飞往高塔，跳过新曙光教程，到前线随先锋对抗人类之敌。

1454880421.name: Haunted Forest
1454880421.description: A darkened instance of the Infinite Forest. Descend into its depths with a fireteam, and see how far you can get before it disintegrates.
1454880421.description_zh: 无尽森林的黑暗副本。带领一支火力战队深入其中，看看在它解体之前你们能走多远。

707826522.name: Firewalled Haunted Forest
707826522.name_zh: 被防火墙保护的鬼蜮森林
707826522.description:
A darkened instance of the Infinite Forest. Descend into its depths and see how far you can get before it disintegrates.

The Firewalled Haunted Forest has no matchmaking.
707826522.description_zh:
无尽森林的黑暗副本。深入其中，看看在它解体之前你能走多远。

被防火墙保护的鬼蜮森林无法使用匹配。

3874292246.name: Haunted Forest
3874292246.description: In the Infinite Forest, a new threat rises—a spooky threat. Put on your mask and celebrate Festival of the Lost by exploring the depths of the Haunted Forest.
3874292246.description_zh: 在无尽森林中出现了一个新的威胁——一个幽灵般的威胁。带上你的面具，通过深入探索鬼蜮森林来庆祝英灵日。

69981056.name: Cold Boot
69981056.description: Restart the dormant array to balance the Cosmodrome power grid.
69981056.description_zh: 重启休眠阵列，从而平衡发射基地的供电网络。

511839752.name: Schism
511839752.description: Work with Shaw to find his missing teammates.
511839752.description_zh: 和韩潇一起找到他迷失的队友。

3836310890.name: Vendetta
3836310890.description: Enter the Superconductor chamber and find Shaw.
3836310890.description_zh: 进入超导体室，找到韩潇。

3906017155.name: A Guardian Rises
3906017155.description: Fight through Old Russia and make your escape.
3906017155.description_zh: 从旧俄罗斯中杀出血路，逃离出去。

1928961926.name: Cosmodrome
1928961926.description: A derelict spaceflight complex in the ruins of Old Russia.
1928961926.description_zh: 旧俄罗斯废墟中一处被遗弃的太空设施。

603986551.name: Risk/Reward
603986551.description: Search the Cosmodrome for a secret stash. Find it to claim your reward.
603986551.description_zh: 在发射基地搜索一个秘密藏货。找到它来领取你的奖励。

174131855.name: The Disgraced
174131855.description: Defeat the shamed Hive Wizard Navôta in the Cosmodrome.
174131855.description_zh: 消灭发射基地内蒙羞的邪魔族巫师纳沃塔。

1917776943.name: The Devils' Lair
1917776943.description: Enter into the Devils' Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.
1917776943.description_zh: 进入恶魔巢穴，削弱堕落者在发射基地的存在感。

3777220691.name: Fallen S.A.B.E.R.
3777220691.description: Enter Rasputin's bunker in the Cosmodrome and discover the source of the security breach.
3777220691.description_zh: 进入拉斯普廷在发射基地的地堡，寻找安全漏洞的源头。

1684420962.name: The Disgraced
1684420962.description: Defeat the shamed Hive Wizard Navôta in the Cosmodrome.
1684420962.description_zh: 消灭发射基地内蒙羞的邪魔族巫师纳沃塔。

969982762.name: The Devils' Lair
969982762.description: Enter into the Devils' Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.
969982762.description_zh: 进入恶魔巢穴，削弱堕落者在发射基地的存在感。

3597990372.name: Fallen S.A.B.E.R.
3597990372.description: Enter Rasputin's bunker in the Cosmodrome and discover the source of the security breach.
3597990372.description_zh: 进入拉斯普廷在发射基地的地堡，寻找安全漏洞的源头。

4078656646.name: Grasp of Avarice: Standard
4078656646.description: A cautionary tale for adventurers willing to trade their humanity for riches.
4078656646.description_zh: 一个给愿意用人性换取财富的冒险者的警示故事。

10008626.name: Refracted Lesson
10008626.description: Open your mind to the Traveler's teaching through meditation.
10008626.description_zh: 通过冥想向旅行者的教诲敞开心扉吧。

2856932809.name: The Dreaming City
2856932809.description: A long-hidden stronghold sacred to the Awoken of the Reef.
2856932809.description_zh: 一处隐藏甚久的大本营，暗礁觉醒者将之奉为圣地。

1254422902.name: The Corrupted
1254422902.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
1254422902.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

723056533.name: The Corrupted
723056533.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
723056533.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

1711185200.name: The Corrupted
1711185200.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
1711185200.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

2707682597.name: European Dead Zone
2707682597.description: The cradle of humanity - a world of ancient glory, waiting to be retaken.
2707682597.description_zh: 人类的摇篮——一个充满古老荣耀的世界，等待着回归。

3451118946.name: European Dead Zone
3451118946.description: The cradle of humanity - a world of ancient glory, waiting to be retaken.
3451118946.description_zh: 人类的摇篮——一个充满古老荣耀的世界，等待着回归。

1206039799.name: European Aerial Zone
1206039799.description: The Vanguard is dispatching Guardians to the EAZ for combat drills and meditation. Join them.
1206039799.description_zh: 先锋正在派遣守护者前往欧洲空中区进行作战和冥想训练。去加入他们吧。

706456362.name: European Aerial Zone: [Arc] Day
706456362.description:
Arc energies crackle through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of ozone.

Equip your Arc subclass and weapons to generate Arc orbs, then collect them to become Arc Empowered. While empowered, Guardians move with enhanced speed, deal greater melee and Sword damage, and drain Super energy half as quickly.
706456362.description_zh:
电弧能量在欧洲空中区劈啪作响，让空气中充满臭氧的味道。

装备电弧分支职业和武器以生成电弧光球，然后收集这些光球获得电弧强化。守护者进入电弧强化状态时，移动速度会加快、近战和刀剑可造成更大伤害，并且超能能量消耗速度减半。

953001825.name: European Aerial Zone: [Solar] Day
953001825.description:
Solar energies blast through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of sunbaked earth.

Equip your Solar subclass and weapons to generate Solar orbs, then collect them to become Solar Empowered. While empowered, Guardians emit a burning wave of energy.
953001825.description_zh:
烈日能量在欧洲空中区不断爆发，劈啪作响，让空气中充满焦糊的味道。

装备烈日分支职业和武器以生成烈日光球，然后收集这些光球获得烈日强化。在获得强化后，守护者会散发出一股燃烧能量波。

680401932.name: European Aerial Zone: [Void] [Stasis] Day
680401932.description:
Equip your Void or Stasis subclass and weapons to generate corresponding orbs. Collect them to become empowered by the element of the final orb collected.

Void empowerment grants invisibility while crouching, Truesight, and enhanced ability energy regeneration.

Stasis empowerment reduces Super energy drain and defeated combatants spawn exploding Stasis crystals.
680401932.description_zh:
装备虚空或冰影分支职业和武器以生成对应的能量球。收集能量球可获得你所收集的最后一个能量球的元素赋能。

虚空赋能可提供蹲伏时的隐身效果和真视效果，以及技能能量恢复强化。

冰影赋能可降低超能能量的消耗，且消灭战斗人员会生成冰影水晶，冰影水晶会爆炸。

1587905185.name: European Aerial Zone: PRISM Day
1587905185.description:
Light ripples through the EAZ, filling the air with power.

Use elemental subclasses and weapons to generate the corresponding Elemental Orbs, then collect them to become empowered. Elemental empowerment will match the element of your subclass.
1587905185.description_zh:
光能在欧洲空中区涌动，空气中充满了能量。

使用元素分支职业和武器生成对应的元素能量球，然后收集它们来获得强化。元素强化会对应你的分支职业。

2004855007.name: Warlord's Ruin: Standard
2004855007.name_zh: 战争领主的废墟: 标准
2004855007.description: Nestled deep in the mountains of the EDZ, Scorn lay claim to a Dark Age castle containing dangerous relics, and a blighted vengeance festers in the dirt.
2004855007.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的深山中，嗤魅找到了一座藏着危险圣物的黑暗纪元城堡。土壤中酝酿着凋零阴影的复仇之火。
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成

1813752023.name: Europa
1813752023.description: A desolate and frozen moon, testament to humanity's ambition and hubris.
1813752023.description_zh: 一颗荒无人烟的寒冷卫星，人类野心和狂妄的证明。

3270200327.name: Darkness's Doorstep
3270200327.description_zh: 追踪瓦里克斯的求救信号。

343231615.name: The New Kell
343231615.description: Race towards the Fallen City of Riis-Reborn and prevent Eramis from further wielding the Darkness.
343231615.description_zh: 赶往堕落者之城重生的里斯，阻止伊拉莫斯进一步使用暗影。

2730753804.name: Rising Resistance
2730753804.description: Help Variks set up a secret Fallen comms network to communicate with other House Salvation refugees.
2730753804.description_zh: 帮助瓦里克斯设立一个秘密堕落者通讯网络，与其他救赎氏族难民进行联系。

103710490.name: The Aftermath
103710490.description: Help the Vanguard investigate the Vex presence in the Fallen city to gain a tactical advantage over House Salvation.
103710490.description_zh: 帮助先锋调查出现在堕落者之城的Vex，取得对救赎氏族的战术优势。

3627106226.name: Sabotaging Salvation
3627106226.description: Help the Vanguard destabilize what remains of House Salvation by sabotaging an important Fallen weapons factory.
3627106226.description_zh: 破坏一个重要的堕落者武器工厂，帮助先锋动摇救赎氏族仅存的根基。

949315777.name: Europa Sabotage
949315777.description: Help the Vanguard destabilize what remains of House Salvation by sabotaging an important Fallen weapons factory.
949315777.description_zh: 破坏一个重要的堕落者武器工厂，帮助先锋动摇救赎氏族仅存的根基。

3362656479.name: The Technocrat
3362656479.description: Defeat Eramis's technology expert, Praksis, the Technocrat.
3362656479.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的技术专家普拉克西斯。

3095855876.name: The Warrior
3095855876.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
3095855876.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

2364451451.name: The Kell of Darkness
2364451451.description: Defeat Eramis, the Kell of Darkness.
2364451451.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯，暗影凯尔。

2226120409.name: The Glassway
2226120409.description: Prevent ancient and powerful Vex from escaping the Glassway on Europa.
2226120409.description_zh: 阻止强大的上古Vex从木卫二的玻璃小径中离开。

2930649307.name: The Glassway
2930649307.description: Prevent ancient and powerful Vex from escaping the Glassway on Europa.
2930649307.description_zh: 阻止强大的上古Vex从木卫二的玻璃小径中离开。

1787238303.name: The Technocrat
1787238303.description: Defeat Eramis's technology expert, Praksis, the Technocrat.
1787238303.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的技术专家普拉克西斯。

1221473220.name: The Warrior
1221473220.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
1221473220.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

2135920336.name: The Dark Priestess: Adept
2135920336.name_zh: 暗影女祭司: 得心应手
2135920336.description: Defeat the new leader of the Fallen, Kridis, the Dark Priestess.
2135920336.description_zh: 击败堕落者的新领袖，克里迪斯，暗影女祭司。

3965479856.name: The Glassway
3965479856.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
3965479856.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

376759502.name: The Glassway
376759502.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
376759502.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

3329390423.name: The Glassway
3329390423.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
3329390423.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

289368916.name: Stealing Stasis
289368916.description: Work with the Drifter to steal a Fallen prototype for a Stasis-wielding Grenade Launcher.
289368916.description_zh: 与浪客合作窃取一台堕落者冰影榴弹发射器的原型。

1022114229.name: Reforging the Past

modifiers_zh: 火力战队能量加速器已禁用

3959604832.name: Simulation: Safeguard Heroic

3360152151.name: Simulation: Survival Heroic

3360152151.description_zh: 模拟技能组训练：击倒高级Vex的同时在恶劣的天气中生存下来。

3784931086.name: Simulation: Agility
3784931086.description: Simulated Skill-Set Training: Test your dexterity as you move against the Vex.
3784931086.description_zh: 模拟技能组训练：在对抗Vex的战斗中检验你的敏捷激动能力。

2603051550.name: A Mysterious Disturbance
2603051550.description: Travel to the Moon and stave off the Hive resurgence alongside your fellow Guardians.
2603051550.description_zh: 前往月球，与你的守护者伙伴们一起延缓邪魔族的复苏。

2354279177.name: In the Deep
2354279177.description:
Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
2354279177.description_zh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

1517708944.name: Beyond
1517708944.description:
What secrets lie within the Pyramid? It sits in silence, waiting for you.

Head to the Enduring Abyss, past the Pyramid's warding, and find a way inside.
1517708944.description_zh:
金字塔里面到底有着怎样的秘密呢？它就在一片寂静之中，等待着你的到来。

前往永恒深渊，穿过金字塔的结界，找到进去的路。

2580423606.description_zh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

3216122734.description_zh: 新的梦魇自月球的阴影中浮现。受到挥之不去的幻影召唤，埃里斯·摩恩回来了。快来与她并肩作战，在梦魇自月球袭来，将人类文明拖回黑暗时代之前，把它们通通消灭。

3815660878.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

620544813.name: Memories of Ruin
620544813.description: Visit the Altar of Reflection to witness a memory tied to the Tablet of Ruin.
620544813.description_zh: 前往沉思祭坛以见证与毁灭石板相关联的一段记忆。
620544813.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

620544814.name: Memories of Loss
620544814.description: Visit the Altar of Reflection to witness a memory tied to the crystal shard.
620544814.description_zh: 前往沉思祭坛以见证与水晶碎片相关联的一段记忆。
620544814.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1044339451.name: The Ghosts
1044339451.description: Follow Fynch's tip to a Hive temple that may contain a clue about how Savathûn stole the Light.
1044339451.description_zh: 跟着芬奇的情报前往一座邪魔族寺庙。那里面可能有关于萨瓦图恩窃取光能的方法的线索。

3169259134.name: The Lightblade
3169259134.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
3169259134.description_zh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。
3169259134.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1682266665.name: Birthplace of the Vile
1682266665.description:
Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

Beat them back.
1682266665.description_zh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。
1682266665.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1012655911.name: The Lightblade
1012655911.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
1012655911.description_zh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。
1012655911.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

2241536682.name: Birthplace of the Vile
