Beat them back.
2241536682.description_zh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。
2241536682.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

201280774.name: The Wellspring: Attack: Standard
201280774.description: Stop Golmag, Warden of the Spring from completing the ritual at the Wellspring.
201280774.description_zh: 阻止泉源典狱官戈尔马格在泉源处完成仪式。
201280774.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

54269080.name: The Wellspring: Attack: Standard
54269080.description: Stop Bor'gong, Warden of the Spring from completing the ritual at the Wellspring.
54269080.description_zh: 阻止泉源典狱官博尔冈在泉源处完成仪式。
54269080.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

2948928434.name: The Wellspring: Defend: Standard
2948928434.description: Stop Vezuul, Lightflayer from gaining control of the Wellspring.
2948928434.description_zh: 阻止试图获得泉源控制权的夺光魔维祖尔。
2948928434.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

3333680772.name: The Wellspring: Defend: Standard
3333680772.description: Stop Zeerik, Lightflayer from gaining control of the Wellspring.
3333680772.description_zh: 阻止试图获得泉源控制权的夺光魔泽里克。
3333680772.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

560024331.name: Parasitic Pilgrimage
560024331.description: With Mara's disappearance and Savathûn's worm suffering a deadly curse, your only course of action for now is to find a way to keep it alive…
560024331.description_zh: 玛拉忽然消失，萨瓦图恩的蠕虫受到致命诅咒，你现在的唯一出路就是找到让蠕虫活下去的方法…
560024331.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

998325559.name: Altar of Reflection: Pact
998325559.description: Revisit the memory linked to Sagira's shell. The entry point is located deep within the Extraction Lost Sector.
998325559.description_zh: 再次访问与萨吉拉的机壳相连的记忆。入口位于萃取地遗失区域的深处。
998325559.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

998325556.name: Altar of Reflection: Insight
998325556.description: Revisit the memory linked to the Tablet of Ruin. The entry point is located deep within the Sepulcher Lost Sector.
998325556.description_zh: 再次访问与毁灭石板相连的记忆。入口位于墓冢遗失区域的深处。
998325556.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

998325557.name: Altar of Reflection: Choice
998325557.description: Revisit the memory linked to the crystal shard. The entry point is located deep within the Metamorphosis Lost Sector.
998325557.description_zh: 再次访问与水晶碎片相连的记忆。入口位于蜕变遗失区域的深处。
998325557.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

998325554.name: Altar of Reflection: Catalyst
998325554.description: Witness the memory linked to the Enigma. The entry point is located deep within the Temple of the Wrathful.
998325554.description_zh: 见证与谜团相连的记忆。入口位于忿怒之殿的深处。
998325554.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

3774730113.name: The Arrival
3774730113.description: Track Savathûn on Mars, where temporal abnormalities scar the planet's surface and the Cabal seek to claim new territory.
3774730113.description_zh: 在火星上追踪萨瓦图恩，那里不仅被时空异常所摧残，还前有来开辟疆土的卡巴尔。

3272105279.name: The Enclave
3272105279.description: The Hidden's base of operations on Mars.
3272105279.description_zh: 隐秘者在火星上的行动基地。

2906950631.name: Vow of the Disciple
2906950631.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1441982566.name: Vow of the Disciple: Standard
1441982566.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

2140729809.name: Preservation
2140729809.description: Enter the Throne World Pyramid and prevent the Scorn from reclaiming its power.
2140729809.description_zh: 进入王座世界金字塔，阻止嗤魅夺回其力量。
2140729809.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1485585878.name: Vault of Glass: Challenge Mode
1485585878.description: All Encounter Challenges Enabled and Required
1485585878.description_zh: 所有关卡挑战开启且为必需

2727361621.name: Equilibrium: Standard
2727361621.description: Between fire and shadow, the path to balance.
2727361621.description_zh: 火焰与阴影之间，是通往平衡之路。

1754635208.name: Equilibrium: Contest
1754635208.description: Between fire and shadow, the path to balance.
1754635208.description_zh: 火焰与阴影之间，是通往平衡之路。
modifiers_zh: 火力战队能量加速器已禁用

265600452.name: Dares of Eternity: Standard
265600452.description: Become a contestant in the Dares of Eternity and compete in challenges from across the paraverse.
265600452.description_zh: 成为永恒挑战的参赛者并参加超宇宙各处的挑战。

2081550970.name: The Enclave
2081550970.description: The Hidden's base of operations on Mars.
2081550970.description_zh: 隐秘者在火星上的行动基地。

2823159265.name: Duality: Standard
2823159265.description: Dive into the depths of the exiled emperor's mind in search of dark secrets.
2823159265.description_zh: 深入流放大帝的心灵深处，搜寻黑暗秘密。

3416179771.name: The Sunless Cell
3416179771.description: Pursue the Hive into the deep prison of the Dreadnaught.
3416179771.description_zh: 追击邪魔族进入无畏战舰的深层牢狱。

1262462921.name: Spire of the Watcher: Standard
1262462921.description: Machinations run wild in this dust-ridden ruin. Bring them to heel.
1262462921.description_zh: 阴谋在这片尘土飞扬的废墟上横行。让它们就范。

2992386051.name: Neomuna
2992386051.description: A hidden tech-metropolis, untouched by the Collapse.
2992386051.description_zh: 一座隐秘的科技大都会，未曾受到大崩塌的影响。

681459255.name: Terminal Overload: ZC
681459255.description: Transmat to Zephyr Concourse with your fellow Guardians to combat the grid-shattering chaos of Terminal Overload!
681459255.description_zh: 和你的守护者同伴传送至和风广场，一起对抗终端过载的电网碎裂乱象！

508116160.name: Terminal Overload: AP
508116160.description: Transmat to Ahimsa Park with your fellow Guardians to combat the grid-shattering chaos of Terminal Overload!
508116160.description_zh: 和你的守护者同伴传送至非暴力公园，一起对抗终端过载的电网碎裂乱象！

2375923691.name: Terminal Overload: LH
2375923691.description: Transmat to Límíng Harbor with your fellow Guardians to combat the grid-shattering chaos of Terminal Overload!
2375923691.description_zh: 和你的守护者同伴传送至莱明港，一起对抗终端过载的电网碎裂乱象！

3377887753.name: First Contact
3377887753.description: Find Osiris in the Shadow Legion fleet and sow chaos through their ranks.
3377887753.description_zh: 在暗影军团舰队中找到奥斯里斯，并在其部队中制造混乱。

223092404.name: What Remains
223092404.description: Infiltrate the Black Garden to defeat the Conceptual Mind that holds the data you need.
223092404.description_zh: 潜入黑暗花园以击败持有你所需数据的概念思维。

231808097.name: Vex Incursion Zone
231808097.description:
The Vex are testing CloudArk defenses in this region. Reality fractures as the VexNet bleeds through into Neomuna.

In the Vex Incursion Zone, Vex will appear in greater numbers and Strand energy sources will temporarily increase Strand ability recovery. 

Rarely, the Vex will succeed in disabling the CloudArk's defenses, and the elite Vex strike force will deploy a concentrated assault.
231808097.description_zh:
Vex正在这片区域试探云端方舟的防御系统。Vex网络渗透进了内欧姆那，现实随之破裂。

在Vex入侵区，Vex将会以更多的数量出现，而缚丝能量源将会暂时提升缚丝技能恢复速度。

极少数情况下，Vex会成功摧毁云端方舟的防御系统，而精锐的Vex打击小队将部署集中攻击。

708242452.name: Partition: Hard Reset
708242452.description: Chase down a Shadow Legionary wreaking havoc in the VexNet.
708242452.description_zh: 追捕在Vex网络里猖狂肆虐的一名暗影军团士兵。

227379247.name: Partition: Ordnance
227379247.description: Help a Neomuni citizen break through VexNet defenses to upload a virus.
227379247.description_zh: 帮助一名内欧姆那市民突破Vex网络防御系统来上传病毒。

1026439577.name: Partition: Backdoor
1026439577.description: Break into a Vex Mind's stronghold and defeat it.
1026439577.description_zh: 闯入Vex思维的据点并击败它。

2194994421.name: Headlong: Time Trial
2194994421.description: Perfect your Strand skills in locomotion and combat to achieve the fastest time.
2194994421.description_zh: 在运动和战斗中完善你的缚丝技术，达成最快时间。

3168712894.name: Rohan
3168712894.description_zh: 云端行者，宁博思的导师

2456777453.name: First Contact
2456777453.description: Find Osiris in the Shadow Legion fleet and sow chaos through their ranks.
2456777453.description_zh: 在暗影军团舰队中找到奥斯里斯，并在其部队中制造混乱。

56734840.name: Parting the Veil
56734840.description: Investigate anomalous Vex activity with Osiris and Nimbus.
56734840.description_zh: 与奥斯里斯和宁博思一起调查Vex异常活动。

3077032303.name: Veil Containment
3077032303.description: An Ishtar Collective research facility housing the dangerous paracausal enigma known as "the Veil."
3077032303.description_zh: 一处伊什塔集团研究设施，里面存放着被称为“面纱”的危险超因果谜团。

2381413764.name: Root of Nightmares: Standard
2381413764.description: A sinister threat has taken root.
2381413764.description_zh: 一个邪恶的威胁扎根于此。

313828469.name: Ghosts of the Deep: Standard
313828469.description: Drown in the deep, or rise from it.
313828469.description_zh: 沉溺于深渊，或从中重生。
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成

433498225.name: Moth-Infested Cavern
433498225.description: Traverse a treacherous cave full of deadly moths.
433498225.description_zh: 穿越满是致命飞蛾的险恶洞穴。

2537316712.name: Sword Dance
2537316712.description: Take up a Sword and carve your way through the Hive.
2537316712.description_zh: 拿起刀剑，在邪魔族中杀出一条路。

488540889.name: Searing Light
488540889.description: Weather an onslaught of unstable Light.
488540889.description_zh: 抵御不稳定的光能的猛攻。

842158758.name: Slayer
842158758.description: Slay an unstoppable giant and end its brutal ritual.
842158758.description_zh: 杀死不可阻挡的巨人，结束其残忍的仪式。

3807732227.name: Aerial Ace
3807732227.description: Soar through the air without touching the ground.

816659206.name: The Message, Part I
816659206.description: Cayde and Crow need your help to find a means by which to communicate with the Traveler.
816659206.description_zh: 凯德和乌鸦需要你的帮助来找到与旅行者沟通的方式。

861801002.name: The Message, Part II
861801002.description: Continue the search for means to commune with the Traveler.
861801002.description_zh: 继续寻找与旅行者交流的方式。

466424646.name: The Message, Part III
466424646.description: Journey into the depths of the Pale Heart and commune with the Traveler.
466424646.description_zh: 前往苍白之心深处，并与旅行者交流。

230477216.name: Ascent: Cooperative Focus Campaign
230477216.name_zh: 飞升: 合作专注战役
230477216.description: Join Cayde-6 and Crow on a scouting mission to find a way across a frozen mountain and into the domain of the Witness.
230477216.description_zh: 与凯德6号和乌鸦一起执行侦察任务，设法穿越冻结山脉，进入见证者的领地。

1329796464.name: Dissent: Cooperative Focus Campaign
1329796464.name_zh: 异议: 合作专注战役
1329796464.description: Working as a united fireteam, pursue Zavala through a violent storm and across the threshold of Darkness and Light.
1329796464.description_zh: 与火力战队通力合作，追随萨瓦拉穿越狂风暴雨，越过暗影与光能的限度。

1475344277.name: Iconoclasm: Cooperative Focus Campaign
1475344277.name_zh: 破除圣像: 合作专注战役
1475344277.description: Using the Vanguard's diversion and your fireteam's resourcefulness, seek out the ritual site where the Witness was created to learn how to destroy it.
1475344277.description_zh: 利用先锋的声东击西和你火力战队的智慧谋略，找到见证者被造的仪式地点，了解如何摧毁它。

2657428132.name: Excision: Narrative
2657428132.description: Join your fellow Guardians to unmake the Witness once and for all.
2657428132.description_zh: 与你的守护者同伴一起，彻底毁掉见证者。

1872146461.name: Overthrow in Progress
1872146461.description: An endless tide of the Witness's forces are converging on the Impasse.
1872146461.description_zh: 潮水般的见证者部队正在朝僵局之地聚集。

3508317798.name: Overthrown
3508317798.description: With the defeat of the Witness's forces in the Impasse, the Light flows freely once again.
3508317798.description_zh: 随着见证者的部队在僵局之地中被击败，光能得以再次自由流动。

292108645.name: Overthrow in Progress
292108645.description: The forces of the Witness and the Lucent Hive battle for control of the Blooming.
292108645.description_zh: 见证者和光明邪魔族的部队在为争夺繁盛之地的控制权而战。

534432654.name: Overthrown
534432654.description: The Light once more flows freely through the Blooming and the Witness's forces are in retreat.
534432654.description_zh: 光能再次自由流经繁盛之地，见证者的部队撤退了。

764325601.name: Overthrow in Progress
764325601.description: The Lucent Hive are laying siege to the Landing to try and wrest control of the Traveler's Light.
764325601.description_zh: 光明邪魔族正在围攻着陆之地，试图夺取对旅行者光能的控制权。

3257212914.name: Overthrown
3257212914.description: The Lucent Hive have scattered and the Light flows freely through the Landing once again.
3257212914.description_zh: 光明邪魔族四散而逃，光能得以再次自由流经着陆之地。

2162125410.name: Dual Destiny
2162125410.description: Two Guardians enter the depths of the Pale Heart in search of power…
2162125410.description_zh: 两名守护者进入苍白之心的深处寻找力量…

4245298551.name: Hope
4245298551.description: The end is upon us. Return to the Veiled Circle in the Sacrarium and receive one final gift from the Traveler.
4245298551.description_zh: 终局就在眼前。返回圣堂中的蒙纱之环并接受来自旅行者的最后一份馈赠。

3114327585.name: Wild Card
3114327585.description: Track down an unknown threat with Cayde and Crow.
3114327585.description_zh: 与凯德和乌鸦一起追踪未知威胁。

1299710743.name: Home, Part I
1299710743.description: As Zavala struggles with the loss of his Light, join Caiatl on a mission to crush the Shadow Legion.
1299710743.description_zh: 萨瓦拉还在应对丧失光能之痛，与查厄托一起执行任务，粉碎暗影军团。

626545882.name: Home, Part II
626545882.description: With Zavala facing a crisis of faith, join Caiatl on a mission to restore his hope and destroy a Shadow Legion operation in the Divide.
626545882.description_zh: 萨瓦拉面临着信仰危机，与查厄托一起执行任务，摧毁暗影军团在分歧之地的行动，让萨瓦拉重拾希望。

1684600519.name: The Hollow, Part I
1684600519.description: Join Mithrax in a mission to disrupt the operations of House Salvation in the Blooming.
1684600519.description_zh: 与米瑟拉克斯一起执行任务，在繁盛之地破坏救赎氏族的行动。

2271625679.name: The Hollow, Part II
2271625679.description: Follow Mithrax to Europa on a mission of revenge.
2271625679.description_zh: 跟随米瑟拉克斯前往木卫二执行复仇任务。

3658126435.name: Queens, Part II
3658126435.description: Help Queen Mara unravel a mystery of the Pale Heart and uncover Savathûn's plot.
3658126435.description_zh: 帮助玛拉女王解开苍白之心的一个谜团，揭露萨瓦图恩的阴谋。

3769839120.name: Queens, Part I
3769839120.description: Following the Vanguard's escape from the Witness, a new threat arrives in the Pale Heart.
3769839120.description_zh: 先锋逃离见证者之后，一个新的威胁来到了苍白之心。

1512617309.name: Excision: Replay
1512617309.description: Join your fellow Guardians to unmake the Witness once and for all.
1512617309.description_zh: 与你的守护者同伴一起，彻底毁掉见证者。

3312889894.name: The Pale Heart
3312889894.description: A surreal domain of memory within the Traveler, corrupted by the Witness.
3312889894.description_zh: 旅行者体内的一处超现实的记忆领域，受到了见证者的腐化。

2192826039.name: Salvation's Edge
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成
火力战队能量加速器已禁用

1662058597.name: Paranormal Activity
1662058597.description: Ghosts are reporting strange artifacts in the area. Follow their trail to investigate.
1662058597.description_zh: 机灵报告称该地区出现了奇怪的神器。跟随他们的足迹进行调查。

1788162989.name: Memory: Refractions of Light
1788162989.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Refraction in the Pale Heart.
1788162989.description_zh: 在苍白之心折射之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

1788162990.name: Memory: Blooming of Light
1788162990.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Blooming in the Pale Heart.
1788162990.description_zh: 在苍白之心繁盛之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

1788162991.name: Memory: Seclusions of Light
1788162991.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Seclusion in the Pale Heart.
1788162991.description_zh: 在苍白之心隔绝之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

560273180.name: Memory: Divisive Darkness
560273180.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Divide in the Pale Heart.
560273180.description_zh: 在苍白之心分歧之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

560273183.name: Memory: Impassive Darkness
560273183.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Impasse in the Pale Heart.
560273183.description_zh: 在苍白之心的僵局之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

560273182.name: Memory: Transgressive Darkness
560273182.description: Locate the source of the memory somewhere in the Transgression in the Pale Heart.
560273182.description_zh: 在苍白之心罪过之地内的某处找到记忆的源头。

88598428.name: Convalescence: Full Flower
88598428.description: Investigate the new growth in the Arbor of Light.
88598428.description_zh: 调查光能之亭中的新成长。

3794571135.name: Excision: Grandmaster
3794571135.description: Join your fellow Guardians to unmake the Witness once and for all.
3794571135.description_zh: 与你的守护者同伴一起，彻底毁掉见证者。

4068828792.name: World Tier: Brave
4068828792.description: The destination of Kepler at a Brave level of difficulty.
4068828792.description_zh: 勇者难度等级的开普勒目的地。

226815557.name: World Tier: Legendary
226815557.description: The destination of Kepler at a Legendary level of difficulty.
226815557.description_zh: 传说难度等级的开普勒目的地。

226815558.name: World Tier: Fabled
226815558.description: The destination of Kepler at a Fabled level of difficulty.
226815558.description_zh: 闻名难度等级的开普勒目的地。

226815559.name: World Tier: Mythic
226815559.description: The destination of Kepler at an Mythic level of difficulty.
226815559.description_zh: 神话难度等级的开普勒目的地。

2626024486.name: Kepler
2626024486.description: A lighthouse, beckoning from the sea of stars. A lost enclave, unmoored in time.
2626024486.description_zh: 宛如一座灯塔，在星海中召唤；似一块遗失的飞地，在时光中漂泊无依。

63854423.name: Quantum Substance (Word-Bearer)
63854423.description: Defeat combatants in this area to lure out one of the Archon's Word-bearer Shanks, who holds a Quantum Substance.
63854423.description_zh: 在此区域击败战斗人员以引出一个携带量子物质的执政官的承言者侦察机。

63854422.name: Quantum Substance (Assimilation Scout)
63854422.description: Defeat combatants in this area to lure out an Assimilation Scout who holds a Quantum Substance.
63854422.description_zh: 在此区域击败战斗人员以引出一个携带量子物质的同化斥候。

63854421.name: Quantum Substance (Well of the Archon)
63854421.description: Defeat combatants in this area to lure out a House Exile Servitor known as a Well of the Archon.
63854421.description_zh: 在此区域击败战斗人员以引出一个被称为执政官之井的流亡魔眼。

63854420.name: Quantum Substance (Polus)
63854420.description: Defeat combatants in this area to lure out an iteration of Polus, the Singular Volley.
63854420.description_zh: 在此区域击败战斗人员以引出一个奇异制造者波鲁斯的迭代。

1459303702.name: Fabled Mission: Quarantine
1459303702.description: Destroy a powerful Vex Mind to breach the quarantine around the singularity, and seize the final strangelet capsule.
1459303702.description_zh: 摧毁强大的Vex思维以突破奇点周围的隔离，夺取最后的奇异子胶囊。

1459303703.name: Mythic Mission: Quarantine
1459303703.description: One last big push to the far side of the Vex Quarantine Zone to uncover and defeat their containment projector.
1459303703.description_zh: 发起最后一次大规模推进，深入Vex隔离区的远端，找到并击败它们的遏制投射器。

2765528837.name: Fabled Mission: Disruption
2765528837.description: Evade towering Vex Minds casting a protective signal to the Collective, and find a way to bring them down to sow chaos in the Vex defenses.
2765528837.description_zh: 避开向集合体发送保护信号的高耸Vex思维，设法除掉它们以扰乱Vex防线。

2765528836.name: Mythic Mission: Disruption
2765528836.description: Evade towering Vex Minds casting a protective signal to the Collective, and find a way to bring them down to sow chaos in the Vex defenses.
2765528836.description_zh: 避开向集合体发送保护信号的高耸Vex思维，设法除掉它们以扰乱Vex防线。

2083729880.name: Fabled Mission: Calculus
2083729880.description: Follow Orin's guidance through a labyrinth to locate the site where the Vex refine the power of the Nine, and raze their technology to ashes.
2083729880.description_zh: 跟随奥琳的引导穿过迷宫，找到Vex提炼玖之力的地点，并将其技术装置付之一炬。

2083729881.name: Mythic Mission: Calculus
2083729881.description: Follow Orin's guidance through a labyrinth to locate the site where the Vex refine the power of the Nine, and raze their technology to ashes.
2083729881.description_zh: 跟随奥琳的引导穿过迷宫，找到Vex提炼玖之力的地点，并将其技术装置付之一炬。

1518086484.name: Acceleron: Surveillance
1518086484.description: Bring down the Conductor's security lattice to advance deeper into the Gorge to uncover the Acceleron that's been integrated into their defenses. Once claimed, use the Acceleron to open the way forward.
1518086484.description_zh: 摧毁指挥者的安全晶格以深入峡谷，找到整合进其防御系统的加速子。到手后，使用加速子开辟前行道路。

1877662959.name: Acceleron: Siphon
1877662959.description: Disrupt the Vex assimilation of Kepler's geology and uncover the Acceleron they draw power from. Once claimed, use the Acceleron to open the way forward.
1877662959.description_zh: 破坏Vex对开普勒地质的同化，找到它们从中汲取能量的加速子。到手后，使用加速子开辟前行道路。

2163004629.name: Fabled Mission: Gouge
2163004629.description: Hunt down the House of Exile's Prime Servitor, destroy it, steal the strangelet capsule it guards, and tarnish the Archon's hold over his House.
2163004629.description_zh: 追踪流亡氏族的原始魔眼并摧毁它，窃取它守护的奇异子胶囊，削弱执政官对氏族的控制。

2163004628.name: Mythic Mission: Gouge
2163004628.description: Hunt down the House of Exile's Prime Servitor, destroy it, steal the strangelet capsule it guards, and tarnish the Archon's hold over his House.
2163004628.description_zh: 追踪流亡氏族的原始魔眼并摧毁它，窃取它守护的奇异子胶囊，削弱执政官对氏族的控制。

1031141961.name: Fabled Mission: Saturnism
1031141961.description: Lodi believes dark matter is poisoning the Exiles' Ether supply. Destroy their dark matter production and confront the Archon.
1031141961.description_zh: 洛迪认为暗物质正在污染流亡氏族的乙太供应。摧毁他们的暗物质生产并直面执政官。

1031141960.name: Mythic Mission: Saturnism
1031141960.description: Lodi believes dark matter is poisoning the Exiles' Ether supply. Destroy their dark matter production and confront the Archon.
1031141960.description_zh: 洛迪认为暗物质正在污染流亡氏族的乙太供应。摧毁他们的暗物质生产并直面执政官。

2552742882.name: Fabled Mission: Transient
2552742882.description: Follow Lodi's lead to a House of Exile power facility and shut down their generators before the Archon's warship finishes its preparations.
2552742882.description_zh: 跟随洛迪前往流亡氏族的能源设施，在执政官的战舰完成准备前关闭他们的发生器。

2552742883.name: Mythic Mission: Transient
2552742883.description: Follow Lodi's lead to a House of Exile power facility and shut down their generators before the Archon's warship finishes its preparations.
2552742883.description_zh: 跟随洛迪前往流亡氏族的能源设施，在执政官的战舰完成准备前关闭他们的发生器。

1387963936.name: Acceleron: Displacement
1387963936.description: Uncover the Exiles' teleportation advancements made with dark matter, and the Acceleron at the heart of this new technology. Once claimed, use the Acceleron to open a way forward.
1387963936.description_zh: 找到流亡氏族利用暗物质打造的传送技术装置，以及作为其核心的加速子。到手后，使用加速子开辟前行道路。

1534092927.name: Acceleron: Spoil
1534092927.description: Investigate the potentially contaminated Ether and uncover the Acceleron being used to maintain the dark matter-infused Ether stores. Once claimed, use the Acceleron to open a way forward.
1534092927.description_zh: 调查可能被污染的乙太，并找到用于维持暗物质乙太储备的加速子。到手后，使用加速子开辟前行道路。

1350796200.name: Fabled Mission: The Message
1350796200.description: Confront Archon Levaszk under the heart of the singularity and uncover the mystery behind the invitation that brought you to Kepler.
1350796200.description_zh: 在奇点中心下方直面执政官列瓦兹克，揭开将你带到开普勒的邀请背后的谜团。

1350796201.name: Mythic Mission: The Message
1350796201.description: Confront Archon Levaszk under the heart of the singularity and uncover the mystery behind the invitation that brought you to Kepler.
1350796201.description_zh: 在奇点中心下方直面执政官列瓦兹克，揭开将你带到开普勒的邀请背后的谜团。

2406687436.name: Fabled Mission: Commencement
2406687436.description: Fight through subordinate Vex to lure out and defeat a Gate Lord in the Aionian Campus.
2406687436.description_zh: 击败下级Vex，诱出并战胜艾昂校园中的门神。

2406687437.name: Mythic Mission: Commencement
2406687437.description: Fight through subordinate Vex to lure out and defeat a Gate Lord in the Aionian Campus.
2406687437.description_zh: 击败下级Vex，诱出并战胜艾昂校园中的门神。

251203634.name: Fabled Mission: Fallow
251203634.description: Go to the Agricultural Center at the Aionian Campus to eliminate the Vex sabotaging the last stable food production on Kepler.
251203634.description_zh: 前往艾昂校园的农业中心，消灭那些破坏开普勒最后稳定食物供应的Vex。

251203635.name: Mythic Mission: Fallow
251203635.description: Go to the Agricultural Center at the Aionian Campus to eliminate the Vex sabotaging the last stable food production on Kepler.
251203635.description_zh: 前往艾昂校园的农业中心，消灭那些破坏开普勒最后稳定食物供应的Vex。

2337450949.name: Fabled Mission: Nostos
2337450949.description: Eliksni from the House of Exile plan to destroy the structural history of the Aionians, and most of the campus with it. Stop them before it's too late!
2337450949.description_zh: 流亡氏族的埃里克斯尼族企图摧毁艾昂人的历史遗迹和大部分的校园，及时阻止他们！

2337450948.name: Mythic Mission: Nostos
2337450948.description: Eliksni from the House of Exile plan to destroy the structural history of the Aionians, and most of the campus with it. Stop them before it's too late!
2337450948.description_zh: 流亡氏族的埃里克斯尼族企图摧毁艾昂人的历史遗迹和大部分的校园，及时阻止他们！

2410838726.name: Acceleron: Laboratory
2410838726.description: Rescue Aionian scientists, taken captive by Exiles, to obtain the Acceleron they have been studying.
2410838726.description_zh: 解救被流亡氏族俘虏的艾昂人科学家，获取他们一直在研究的加速子。

1064507257.name: Acceleron: Translate
1064507257.description: Draw out the Vex Barricade Mind and defeat it to claim the Acceleron that it holds.
1064507257.description_zh: 诱出Vex屏障思维，将其击败来夺取其持有的加速子。

3491522834.name: Fabled Mission: Charge
3491522834.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
3491522834.description_zh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

3491522835.name: Mythic Mission: Charge
3491522835.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
3491522835.description_zh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

3864101701.name: Fabled Mission: Criticality
3864101701.description: The reactor powering the Aionian Campus threatens to melt down, potentially destroying all of Kepler. Rout the Exile saboteurs and shut the reactor down before it's too late.
3864101701.description_zh: 为艾昂校园提供能源的反应堆面临熔毁威胁，可能会摧毁开普勒的一切。击退流亡氏族破坏分子并关闭反应堆，否则就将为时已晚。

3864101700.name: Mythic Mission: Criticality
3864101700.description: The reactor powering the Aionian Campus threatens to melt down, potentially destroying all of Kepler. Rout the Exile saboteurs and shut the reactor down before it's too late.
3864101700.description_zh: 为艾昂校园提供能源的反应堆面临熔毁威胁，可能会摧毁开普勒的一切。击退流亡氏族破坏分子并关闭反应堆，否则就将为时已晚。

1633298727.name: Fabled Mission: Morphology
1633298727.description: Fallen from the House of Exile stole dangerous Aionian technology. Track them down and retrieve it.
1633298727.description_zh: 流亡氏族的堕落者窃取了危险的艾昂人技术装置。找到他们并取回它。

1633298726.name: Mythic Mission: Morphology
1633298726.description: Fallen from the House of Exile stole dangerous Aionian technology. Track them down and retrieve it.
1633298726.description_zh: 流亡氏族的堕落者窃取了危险的艾昂人技术装置。找到他们并取回它。

4031602888.name: Fabled Mission: The Invitation
4031602888.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
4031602888.description_zh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

4031602889.name: Mythic Mission: The Invitation
4031602889.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
4031602889.description_zh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

352164424.name: Acceleron: Locksmith
352164424.description: Readings indicate a nearby Acceleron that may be collected. Find a way to uncover it.
352164424.description_zh: 读数显示附近有可收集的加速子。设法找到它。

2289726423.name: Acceleron: Reflux
2289726423.description: Track down the Marauder hunting Dr. Carnahan and secure the stolen Acceleron.
2289726423.description_zh: 追踪正在追杀卡纳汉博士的狂暴劫匪，并夺回失窃的加速子。

3344433206.name: The Edge of Fate: World Tier: Brave
3344433206.name_zh: 宿命边缘: 世界等级：勇者
3344433206.description: Follow the invitation. Travel to Kepler and uncover the nature of the mysterious signal emanating from this drifting rim-world.
3344433206.description_zh: 跟随邀请。前往开普勒，发现这颗漂流的边缘星球发出的神秘信号的真相。

22513938.name: Mission: The Invitation
22513938.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
22513938.description_zh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

1073708151.name: The Sieve
1073708151.description: Protect Drifter's mining rigs as he collects dark matter in his Haul. Repel the House of Exile and the Vex as they strive to control the Sieve for themselves.
1073708151.description_zh: 浪客正在曳室中忙着收集暗物质，你需在此期间保护他的采矿设备。抵御争夺滤网控制权的流亡氏族和Vex。

3037439068.name: The Sieve
3037439068.description: Drifter is preparing the Haul. Make ready to protect his operation and collect dark matter from Kepler's mysterious anomaly.
3037439068.description_zh: 浪客正在准备曳室。做好准备以守护他的行动，从开普勒神秘的异常点中收集暗物质。

1247739807.name: Brave
1247739807.description: Launch a random Time Latch mission on Brave difficulty.
1247739807.description_zh: 启动一项勇者难度的随机时间锁扣任务。

1247739806.name: Legendary
1247739806.description: Launch a random Time Latch mission on Legendary difficulty.
1247739806.description_zh: 启动一项传说难度的随机时间锁扣任务。

1247739805.name: Fabled
1247739805.description: Launch a random Time Latch mission on Fabled difficulty.
1247739805.description_zh: 启动一项闻名难度的随机时间锁扣任务。

1247739804.name: Mythic
1247739804.description: Launch a random Time Latch mission on Mythic difficulty.
1247739804.description_zh: 启动一项神话难度的随机时间锁扣任务。

1044919065.name: The Desert Perpetual: Standard
1044919065.description: Step across the threshold of the infinite.
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成

3896382790.name: The Desert Perpetual: Contest
3896382790.description: Step across the threshold of the infinite.
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成
火力战队能量加速器已禁用

3817322389.name: The Desert Perpetual (Epic): Standard
3817322389.name_zh: 永恒沙漠（史诗）: 标准
3817322389.description: Sing for the end of the unknown.
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成

2586252122.name: The Desert Perpetual (Epic): Contest
2586252122.name_zh: 永恒沙漠（史诗）: 竞赛
2586252122.description: Sing for the end of the unknown.
modifiers_zh: 已获得异域装备掉落率加成
火力战队能量加速器已禁用

11051712.name: The Edge of Fate
11051712.description: Follow the invitation. Travel to Kepler and uncover the nature of the mysterious signal emanating from this drifting rim-world.
11051712.description_zh: 跟随邀请。前往开普勒，发现这颗漂流的边缘星球发出的神秘信号的真相。

3324532452.name: Multiple Side Quests Available
3324532452.description: Multiple side quests with progression steps are available.
3324532452.description_zh: 有多个支线任务进度可推进。

1006719590.name: Correspondence
1006719590.description:
Learn about the flight of the Aionian people and their estrangement from Earth.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
1006719590.description_zh:
了解艾昂人的星际迁徙及其与地球的失联。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

3631001995.name: Dark Academia
3631001995.description:
You've stumbled across an Aionian site that's been sealed away and hidden. The shifting of the singularity has unearthed it again, revealing a grim memory.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
3631001995.description_zh:
你偶然发现了一处被封印和隐藏的艾昂场所。奇点的异动让它重见天日，揭示出一段悲惨的回忆。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

3031353918.name: The Paper Crane
3031353918.description:
Garner a better unstanding of how dark matter is woven through Kepler and its inhabitants.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
3031353918.description_zh:
深入了解暗物质如何渗透开普勒及其居民。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

3861886231.name: Transfer of Power
3861886231.description: Orin is concerned about what Lodi could become, and has asked you to help her show him a potential version of his future self.
3861886231.description_zh: 奥琳忧心洛迪可能陷入某种境地，请求你协助展示他未来可能的样子。

3851074148.name: Forensic Horology
3851074148.description: Uncover a lost history that the Nessian Schism Vex are attempting to bury.
3851074148.description_zh: 揭开涅索斯裂缝Vex试图掩埋的遗失历史。

2961809574.name: Hyperreal G-Man
2961809574.description:
Determine who Lodi is, and what his true motives are on Kepler.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
2961809574.description_zh:
查明洛迪的身份及其在开普勒上的真实动机。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

4261086592.name: The Man Out Of Time
4261086592.description:
Investigate the time scars on Kepler's surface. Lodi thinks—Lodi hopes—that he might be able to go home.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
4261086592.description_zh:
调查开普勒地表的时间裂痕。洛迪认为——或者说期盼——这或许能带他回家。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

2495137501.name: Declassification
2495137501.description: Track down microscopic singularities on the surface of Kepler, and eliminate the causes.
2495137501.description_zh: 追踪开普勒地表的微观奇点，消除其成因。

1412027638.name: The Man Out Of Time
1412027638.description:
Investigate the time scars on Kepler's surface. Lodi thinks—Lodi hopes—that he might be able to go home.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
1412027638.description_zh:
调查开普勒地表的时间裂痕。洛迪认为——或者说期盼——这或许能带他回家。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

3856203882.name: Sacred Emergence
3856203882.description:
Learn about Orin, and her choice to abandon her post as Emissary of the Nine.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
3856203882.description_zh:
了解奥琳，以及她放弃玖的使者身份的决定。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

3063135050.name: Faculty Advisement
3063135050.description:
Humanity has another outpost here. Despite their differences, they came from the same Earth, long ago. Learn from the Aionians, and find those common roots.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
3063135050.description_zh:
人类在此处有另一个前哨站。尽管存在差异，但他们很久以前来自同一个地球。向艾昂人学习，探寻共同的根源。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

1486820303.name: Turophile
1486820303.description:
Something is different about the Vex on Kepler. Some have turned on each other. Learn why, and disrupt their plans.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
1486820303.description_zh:
开普勒上的Vex与其他地方不同，有些会互相攻击。查明原因，并破坏它们的计划。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

2582106052.name: Skylines
2582106052.description:
Track down Lodi's location before the Vex find him, and hear his recollections under the stars.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
2582106052.description_zh:
在Vex发现洛迪前，找到其位置，并在星空下聆听他的回忆。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

1243554670.name: Vessel of the Nine
1243554670.description:
Work with Lodi to learn more about him and the mysteries of what is possessing him.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
1243554670.description_zh:
与洛迪合作，深入了解关于他的情况，以及附身于他的神秘事物。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

866585819.name: Oblation: Bloodline
866585819.description: Follow in the bloody wake of Syndicate forces as they breach the Hive fortress.
866585819.description_zh: 沿着帮派部队突破邪魔族要塞时留下的血路前进。

2551929583.name: Oblation: Soulfed
2551929583.description: You've thwarted Bael's attempts to secure Cull's heirloom weapon, but the Dredgens' plans extend much deeper into the Hive fortress…
2551929583.description_zh: 你已挫败了巴埃尔夺取库尔传家宝武器的企图，但德瑞捷的阴谋早已蔓延至邪魔族要塞深处…

4092098458.name: Oblation: Immolation
4092098458.description: Delve into the heart of the Hive forge and uncover the secret of their profane techniques.
4092098458.description_zh: 深入邪魔族锻炉的核心，揭开其亵渎工艺的秘密。

2733919295.name: Oblation
2733919295.description:
Delve into the Hive's soulfire forge and thwart Dredgen Bael's ambitions for an Arsenal of Sorrow.

A continuous run of all three parts of Exotic mission "Oblation."

30-40 minutes
2733919295.description_zh:
深入邪魔族的魂火锻炉，挫败德瑞捷·巴埃尔打造忧愁军械库的野心。

连续完成异域任务“奉献”的所有三个部分。

30-40分钟

4148187374.name: Prophecy
4148187374.description: Enter the realm of the Nine and ask the question: "What is the nature of the Darkness?"
4148187374.description_zh: 进入玖之界域，提出问题：“暗影的本质是什么？”

1082553800.name: Destiny 2: Beyond Light
1082553800.description: Go beyond the Light and discover dark secrets held within the frozen frontier of Europa.
1082553800.description_zh: 超越光能的限制，探索隐藏在木卫二冰冷前线的黑暗奥秘。

1292955609.name: Destiny 2: The Witch Queen
1292955609.description: Delve into Savathûn's surreal throne world to uncover hidden memories and expose a web of lies.
1292955609.description_zh: 深入萨瓦图恩的超现实王座世界，揭开隐藏的记忆，揭露谎言之网。

1331858208.name: Destiny 2: Bungie's 30th Anniversary Pack
1331858208.description: Xûr invites you to the shores of Eternity where your skill will be tested… and rewarded. Celebrate 30 years of Bungie with new content that pays homage to a legendary legacy of gaming.
1331858208.description_zh: 仄邀请你前往永恒海岸，接受考验…并获得奖励。迎接向传奇的游戏传承致敬的全新内容，庆祝Bungie成立30周年。

2160512434.name: Lightfall
2160512434.description:
The Witness has arrived, threatening the City, the Traveler, and all of Sol. Aided by its newest disciple, Emperor Calus, the Witness aims to bring about a second collapse.

Race Emperor Calus to the edge of the solar system. Learn the ways of the Cloud Striders, wield Strand, a new power of the Darkness, and bring an end to Calus's reign.
2160512434.description_zh:
见证者已来临，圣城、旅行者和太阳系各处都受到了严重的威胁。在新门徒卡鲁斯大帝的帮助下，见证者意图带来第二次大崩溃。

抢在卡鲁斯大帝之前抵达太阳系边陲。学习云端行者之道，运用全新的暗影之力结束卡鲁斯的统治。

3809865670.name: The Final Shape
3809865670.description:
The Final Shape looms—a nightmarish calcification of reality into the Witness's twisted design.

Embark on a perilous journey into the heart of the Traveler, rally the Vanguard, and end the War of Light and Darkness.
3809865670.description_zh:
终焉之形即将到来——一个由见证者所造，如同噩梦般的扭曲现实。

踏上进入旅行者之心的险恶旅程，集结先锋，结束这场光明与黑暗的战争。

1717505396.description: Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents.
1717505396.description_zh: 占领区域并击败对手以获得胜利。

480175362.name: Checkmate Control
480175362.description:
Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents.

Ability and Primary ammo damage is reduced. Special ammo is earned by engaging in combat and is not lost on death.
480175362.description_zh:
通过占领区域并击败对手来取得胜利。

技能和主弹药伤害降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

76529701.description:

Vehicles enabled.
76529701.description_zh:

929911366.name: Countdown
929911366.description: Achieve victory by detonating a charge, defusing the opposing charge, or eliminating all opponents.
929911366.description_zh: 引爆炸弹，拆除对方的炸弹，或者击败所有对手来获得胜利。

2921096415.name: Countdown
2921096415.description: Achieve victory by detonating or defusing both opposing charges.
2921096415.description_zh: 通过引爆或拆除两个对方炸弹来取胜。

1957660400.name: Elimination
1957660400.description: Achieve victory by eliminating all opponents in this round-based mode.
1957660400.description_zh: 在这个回合制模式中消灭所有对手，以获得胜利。

586293844.name: Dominion
586293844.description: Achieve victory by eliminating all opponents in this round-based mode.
586293844.description_zh: 在这个回合制模式中消灭所有对手，以获得胜利。

4271742672.name: Lockdown
4271742672.description: Achieve victory by capturing and holding zones. Win rounds instantly by capturing all three.
4271742672.description_zh: 占领并防守区域，以获得胜利。占领全部三个区域将立即赢得回合。

3847433434.name: Mayhem
3847433434.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents. Abilities and Supers regenerate faster. Heavy ammo spawns more frequently.
3847433434.description_zh: 击败对手，以获得胜利。技能和超能回复速度加快。更频繁地刷新重型弹药。

935998519.name: Momentum Control
935998519.description: Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents. All weapons are more lethal; abilities replenish only with targets defeated, and tracker is disabled.
935998519.description_zh: 占领区域并击败对手，以获得胜利。所有武器更加致命，技能只在击败目标之后充能，雷达已禁用。

2259621230.name: Rumble
2259621230.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents. No teams. No allegiance. A free-for-all where the leader had better watch their back.
2259621230.description_zh: 击败对手，以获得胜利。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

142028034.name: Showdown
142028034.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and preventing revives. Win the most rounds or face off in an elimination showdown.
142028034.description_zh: 击败对手并阻止敌人复活，以获得胜利。争取赢得最多回合，或在最终决战中取胜。

2081353834.name: Supremacy
2081353834.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and securing the crests they drop. Recover friendly crests to deny them from opponents.
2081353834.description_zh: 击败对手并收集他们掉落的纹章，以获得胜利。回收友方纹章可以阻止对手获得它们。

3964389183.name: Survival
3964389183.description: Achieve victory by depleting your opponents' shared life pool, then eliminating them.
3964389183.description_zh: 削减对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们，以获得胜利。

3787302650.name: Team Scorched
3787302650.description: Everyone on both teams has a Scorch Cannon. Be brave.
3787302650.description_zh: 双方所有人都持有灼烧发射器。勇往直前。

2424021445.name: Zone Control
2424021445.description: Achieve victory by controlling zones, earning points for your team over time.
2424021445.description_zh: 占领区域，随着时间为团队赢取得分以获得胜利。

2056796644.name: Rift
2056796644.description: Achieve victory by collecting the Spark and igniting the opponent's Rift.
2056796644.description_zh: 收集火花并点燃对手的裂痕即可获胜。

4149537035.name: Clash
4149537035.description: Fight for victory by defeating opponents.

2043447315.name: New Territory
2043447315.description: Experience a trio of new Crucible maps in a variety of 3v3 modes.
2043447315.description_zh: 在各种3v3模式中体验三张新的熔炉竞技场地图。

872557219.name: Relic
872557219.description: Achieve victory by earning relics. Score points by using the relics to defeat opponents.
872557219.description_zh: 通过获取圣物取胜。使用圣物击败对手来获得分数。

2885746670.name: Collision
2885746670.description: Collide with your opponents over a series of shifting zones in this high-intensity 3v3 shootout!
2885746670.description_zh: 在这场高强度的3v3枪战中，与你的对手争夺一系列不断变化的区域！

342590048.name: Sparrow Racing League
342590048.description: The people of the City have spoken, and the Sparrow Racing League has returned. Speed your way past other Guardians in a death-defying race to the finish line.
342590048.description_zh: 顺应圣城人民的呼声，赛雀联赛现已回归。在一场玩命竞速中，超越其他守护者，冲向终点线。

740456878.description_zh: 通过获取圣物取胜。使用圣物击败对手来获得分数。

3830177287.name: Mayhem
3830177287.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents. Abilities and Supers regenerate faster. Heavy ammo spawns more frequently.
3830177287.description_zh: 击败对手，以获得胜利。技能和超能回复速度加快。更频繁地刷新重型弹药。

3950599078.name: Momentum Control
3950599078.description: Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents. All weapons are more lethal; abilities replenish only with targets defeated, and tracker is disabled.
3950599078.description_zh: 占领区域并击败对手，以获得胜利。所有武器更加致命，技能只在击败目标之后充能，雷达已禁用。

333931889.name: Team Scorched
333931889.description: Everyone on both teams has a Scorch Cannon. Be brave.
333931889.description_zh: 双方所有人都持有灼烧发射器。勇往直前。

2465027225.name: Checkmate Control
2465027225.description:
Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents.

Ability and Primary ammo damage is reduced. Special ammo is earned by engaging in combat and is not lost on death.
2465027225.description_zh:
通过占领区域并击败对手来取得胜利。

技能和主弹药伤害降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

1787014656.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and securing the crests they drop. Recover friendly crests to deny them from opponents.
1787014656.description_zh: 击败对手并收集他们掉落的纹章，以获得胜利。回收友方纹章可以阻止对手获得它们。

3189412460.description_zh:
通过损耗对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们来取得胜利。

技能和主弹药伤害均被降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

1910587321.description: Achieve victory by detonating a charge, defusing the opposing charge, or eliminating all opponents.
1910587321.description_zh: 引爆炸弹，拆除对方的炸弹，或者击败所有对手来获得胜利。

4209906178.name: Countdown
4209906178.description: Achieve victory by detonating or defusing both opposing charges.
4209906178.description_zh: 通过引爆或拆除两个对方炸弹来取胜。

658183591.description_zh: 击败对手，以获得胜利。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

2249376979.name: Showdown
2249376979.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and preventing revives. Win the most rounds or face off in an elimination showdown.
2249376979.description_zh: 击败对手并阻止敌人复活，以获得胜利。争取赢得最多回合，或在最终决战中取胜。

1683791010.name: Iron Banner: Control
1683791010.description:
"There will come a day when the Tower falls again. Our ability to hold territory is paramount." —Lord Saladin

Capture zones to increase points for each opponent defeated. Capture all three to lock the zones and hunt your opponents.
1683791010.description_zh:
“终会有高塔再次倾倒的那天。我们守护领土的能力至关重要。”——领主萨拉丁

占领区域可提升每个击败的对手所提供的分数。占领全部三个区域可锁定并猎杀你的对手。

2393304349.name: Iron Banner: Rift
2393304349.description:
"Carrying precious cargo through enemy lines is an all too inevitable battle scenario." —Lord Saladin

Collect the Spark and ignite the opponent's Rift. First team to 5 points wins.
2393304349.description_zh:
“运送珍贵的货物穿越敌人防线难逃一战。”——领主萨拉丁

收集火花并点燃对手的裂痕。率先获得5分的队伍获胜。

1214397515.name: Iron Banner: Control: Eruption
1214397515.description:
"Pressure builds with each enemy felled. No one will be safe from the eruption." —Lord Saladin

Earn streaks to generate score multipliers. Max out your streak to erupt!
1214397515.description_zh:
“每打倒一个敌人，都会累积压力。面对爆发，没人能独善其身。”——领主萨拉丁

获得连杀来生成得分增量。达到连杀上限即可爆发！

2888503916.name: Iron Banner: Fortress
2888503916.description:
"The Guardian who controls their position masters the flow of the battle. Hold your ground!" —Lord Saladin

Control the zones—and watch your head!
2888503916.description_zh:
“能控制自己位置的守护者就能控制战斗的节奏。坚守阵地！”——领主萨拉丁

控制占领区——小心别被打到头！

2955009825.name: Iron Banner: Tribute
2955009825.description:
"The heat of battle consumes the undisciplined. Combat is a means to victory, not its own end." —Lord Saladin

Collect crests from defeated opponents. Bank crests at the beacons to score points for your team.

3240105938.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的黑暗森林内找到一处景色优美的地方。

399770750.name: A Futuristic Vision
399770750.description: Find a scenic spot in Límíng Harbor on Neomuna.
399770750.description_zh: 在内欧姆那的莱明港内找到一处景色优美的地方。

188264018.name: An Impossible View
188264018.description: Find a scenic spot in the Lost City in the Pale Heart.
188264018.description_zh: 在苍白之心的失落之城内找到一处景色优美的地方。

666063689.name: Last Call
666063689.description: Fight alongside Cayde-6 to help Petra Venj regain control of the dangerous Prison of Elders.
666063689.description_zh: 与凯德6号并肩作战，帮助佩特拉·万吉重新掌控危机四伏的长老监狱。

521403014.name: Legacy: Forsaken: Last Call
521403014.name_zh: 传统：遗落之族: 最后一战
521403014.description: Fight alongside Cayde-6 to help Petra Venj regain control of the dangerous Prison of Elders.
521403014.description_zh: 与凯德6号并肩作战，帮助佩特拉·万吉重新掌控危机四伏的长老监狱。

3226038743.name: High Plains Blues
3226038743.description: Search the Tangled Shore for Cayde's killers.
3226038743.description_zh: 在纷争海岸寻找杀害凯德的凶手。

530720427.name: High Plains Blues
530720427.description: Search the Tangled Shore for Cayde's killers.
530720427.description_zh: 在纷争海岸寻找杀害凯德的凶手。

2345788617.name: Scorned
2345788617.description: Follow Spider's tip to the Scorned Barons' hideout and avenge Cayde-6.
2345788617.description_zh: 按照蛛王提供的线索找到嗤魅公爵的藏身处，为凯德6号报仇。

851841785.name: The Machinist
851841785.description: Battle across the toxic wastelands to take down the Scorned Baron known as the Machinist.
851841785.description_zh: 征战被毒物浸润的荒芜废土，击败名为机械姬的嗤魅公爵。

3559661941.name: Nothing Left to Say
3559661941.description: Climb the Watchtower to stop Uldren and the Fanatic.
3559661941.description_zh: 登上守望塔，阻止欧顿和狂热者。

4204849452.name: Nothing Left to Say
4204849452.description: Climb the Watchtower to stop Uldren and the Fanatic.
4204849452.description_zh: 登上守望塔，阻止欧顿和狂热者。

2974605887.name: Awakening
2974605887.description: "The gates of hell are open night and day; smooth the descent, and easy is the way: but to return, and view the cheerful skies, in this the task and mighty labor lies." —Dryden
2974605887.description_zh: “地狱之门日夜敞开；顺从而下，畅通无阻：但要返回，且观欢愉天穹，归途艰辛不可怠。”——德莱登

2068689865.name: Destiny 2: Forsaken
2068689865.description:
Return to the Reef, a lawless frontier and home to a broken people.

Hunt down a murderer and his gang, ally with the underbelly of the system, and walk the wrong side of right to see justice served.
2068689865.description_zh:
回到暗礁，回到那个被支离破碎的人们当做家的不法边境。

追猎那个谋杀者和他的同伙，与太阳系的软肋结盟，站在正义的另一边审视世界。

2032534090.name: The Shattered Throne
2032534090.description: Strike back at the curse that plagues the Dreaming City.
2032534090.description_zh: 向肆虐幽梦之城的诅咒发起反击。

1640956655.name: Broken Courier
1640956655.description: Respond to a distress call in the Strand.

3746811765.name: The Oracle Engine
3746811765.description: The Taken threaten to take control of an irreplaceable Awoken communications device.
3746811765.description_zh: 傀儡军团扬言要占有一台无可替代的觉醒者通讯设备。

1313738982.name: Dark Monastery
1313738982.description: Provide recon for Petra's forces by investigating strange enemy activity in Rheasilvia.
1313738982.description_zh: 通过调查雷亚希尔维亚境内的异常敌人活动为佩特拉的部队提供侦察信息。

1893059148.name: The Blind Well
1893059148.description: Arcane Awoken technology with the power to split the seams between realities.
1893059148.description_zh: 奥术觉醒者科技，拥有将现实撕裂的力量。

548750096.name: Scourge of the Past
548750096.description: Beneath the ruins of the Last City lies the Black Armory's most precious vault, now under siege by Siviks and his crew, the Kell's Scourge.
548750096.description_zh: 最后的城市的废墟下，隐藏着黑色军械库最珍贵的保险库。如今被斯威克斯和他的手下“凯尔的祸根”们包围。

743628305.name: Vanguard Ops
743628305.description: The Vanguard seeks Guardians to undertake high-priority missions against the City's enemies.
743628305.description_zh: 先锋寻觅守护者，去执行对抗圣城敌人的高优先级任务。

2875598802.name: Vanguard Ops Cross Play Beta
2875598802.description:
The Vanguard seeks Guardians to undertake high priority missions against the City's enemies.

In this playlist, players will encounter Guardians from all platforms where Destiny is played.
2875598802.description_zh:
先锋正在寻找执行对抗圣城敌人的高优先级任务的守护者。

在这个游戏列表中，玩家将遇到在所有平台上玩《命运》的守护者。

3121231695.name: Lake of Shadows
3121231695.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.
3121231695.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区清除威胁要占领水库并污染其珍贵水源的傀儡军团和暗影军团部队。

3219500702.name: The Arms Dealer
3219500702.description: Stifle the legacy of a notorious ironmonger providing weapons to the Shadow Legion.
3219500702.description_zh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

2157013599.name: Lake of Shadows
2157013599.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.
2157013599.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区清除威胁要占领水库并污染其珍贵水源的傀儡军团和暗影军团部队。

1918032438.name: The Arms Dealer
1918032438.description: Stifle the legacy of a notorious ironmonger providing weapons to the Shadow Legion.
1918032438.description_zh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

3437865231.name: Quickplay: Normal
3437865231.description: A rotating selection of activities at a low difficulty level.
3437865231.description_zh: 一组低难度等级的轮换活动。

2979918986.name: The Lightblade
2979918986.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
2979918986.description_zh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。
2979918986.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1670460538.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.
1670460538.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区清除威胁要占领水库并污染其珍贵水源的傀儡军团和暗影军团部队。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1208674877.name: The Corrupted
1208674877.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
1208674877.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1940015759.name: The Scarlet Keep
1940015759.description: Investigate the recently erected Scarlet Keep and discover its dark purpose.
1940015759.description_zh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1355549829.name: The Disgraced
1355549829.description: Defeat the shamed Hive Wizard Navôta in the Cosmodrome.
1355549829.description_zh: 消灭发射基地内蒙羞的邪魔族巫师纳沃塔。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

334456849.name: The Sunless Cell
334456849.description: Pursue the Hive into the deep prison of the Dreadnaught.
334456849.description_zh: 追击邪魔族进入无畏战舰的深层牢狱。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1801242213.name: Exodus Crash
1801242213.description: Purge the Vex and Fallen, who have overrun the Exodus Black crash site.
1801242213.description_zh: 清除占领黑色移民号坠毁现场的Vex和堕落者。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2542177651.description_zh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

742725632.name: Warden of Nothing
742725632.description: Help the Drifter restore order at the Prison of Elders.
742725632.description_zh: 帮助浪客复原长老监狱的秩序。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1791649259.name: Birthplace of the Vile
1791649259.description:
Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

Beat them back.
1791649259.description_zh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。
1791649259.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2995865590.name: Heist Battleground: Mars
2995865590.description: Blitz the BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
2995865590.description_zh: 闪击火星上的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3345897732.name: Defiant Battleground: EDZ
3345897732.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion Pyramid outpost in the EDZ.
3345897732.description_zh: 从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团金字塔前哨站中营救俘虏。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3326311746.name: Heist Battleground: Moon
3326311746.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
3326311746.description_zh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1367817661.name: Fallen S.A.B.E.R.
1367817661.description: Enter Rasputin's bunker in the Cosmodrome and discover the source of the security breach.
1367817661.description_zh: 进入拉斯普廷在发射基地的地堡，寻找安全漏洞的源头。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1408518181.name: HyperNet Current
1408518181.description: Stop the Shadow Legion from bringing down Neomuna's defenses.
1408518181.description_zh: 阻止暗影军团摧毁内欧姆那的防御系统。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

887919127.name: The Insight Terminus
887919127.description: Break into the ancient Vex installation.
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

631573424.name: Battleground: Core
631573424.description: Navigate and traverse the Vex structures at the core of Nessus.
631573424.description_zh: 穿行并走出位于涅索斯核心的Vex建筑。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3007247333.name: Battleground: Delve
3007247333.description: Descend into Nessus and explore the Vex structures within.
3007247333.description_zh: 深入涅索斯，探索位于其中的Vex建筑。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3224011655.name: Battleground: Conduit
3224011655.description: Follow the flow of Vex radiolaria deep within Nessus.
3224011655.description_zh: 跟随涅索斯深处的Vex活性放射体液的流动。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2407738200.name: Expedition: Nessus
2407738200.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Nessus, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
2407738200.description_zh: 挖出深埋在涅索斯的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3082680901.name: Expedition: Cosmodrome
3082680901.description: Dig up buried pirate riches in the Cosmodrome, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
3082680901.description_zh: 挖出深埋在发射基地的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

4263349830.name: Expedition: Europa
4263349830.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Europa, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
4263349830.description_zh: 挖出深埋在木卫二的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3486548245.name: Battleground: Behemoth
3486548245.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
3486548245.description_zh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2578582483.name: Battleground: Foothold
2578582483.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
2578582483.description_zh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3196076085.name: Battleground: Oracle
3196076085.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
3196076085.description_zh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

174334337.name: The Warrior
174334337.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
174334337.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3701802980.name: The Technocrat
3701802980.description: Defeat Eramis's technology expert, Praksis, the Technocrat.
3701802980.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的技术专家普拉克西斯。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2210314865.name: The Dark Priestess
2210314865.description: Defeat the new leader of the Fallen, Kridis, the Dark Priestess.
2210314865.description_zh: 击败堕落者的新领袖，克里迪斯，暗影女祭司。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2108981509.name: The Devils' Lair
2108981509.description: Enter into the Devils' Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.
2108981509.description_zh: 进入恶魔巢穴，削弱堕落者在发射基地的存在感。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2322253862.name: The Glassway
2322253862.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
2322253862.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

4204077770.name: The Inverted Spire
4204077770.description: End the Red Legion expedition that's ripped open the planet's surface.
4204077770.description_zh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1742998109.name: Liminality
1742998109.description: Carve your way through a treacherous mountain pass teeming with Lucent Hive and Taken.
1742998109.description_zh: 突破满是光明邪魔族和傀儡军团的危险山口。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2817513378.name: Proving Grounds
2817513378.description: Defeat Caiatl's Chosen aboard the Land Tank, Halphas Electus, on Nessus.
2817513378.description_zh: 在涅索斯的陆地坦克哈帕斯·伊莱克特斯上击败查厄托的天选者。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3710473105.description_zh: 帮助浪客复原长老监狱的秩序。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

858086038.name: Birthplace of the Vile
858086038.description:
Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

Beat them back.
858086038.description_zh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。
858086038.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

4222879947.name: Heist Battleground: Mars
4222879947.description: Blitz the BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
4222879947.description_zh: 闪击火星上的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3910052301.name: Defiant Battleground: EDZ
3910052301.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion Pyramid outpost in the EDZ.
3910052301.description_zh: 从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团金字塔前哨站中营救俘虏。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3188495327.name: Heist Battleground: Moon
3188495327.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
3188495327.description_zh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2740322932.name: Fallen S.A.B.E.R.
2740322932.description: Enter Rasputin's bunker in the Cosmodrome and discover the source of the security breach.
2740322932.description_zh: 进入拉斯普廷在发射基地的地堡，寻找安全漏洞的源头。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2692846748.name: HyperNet Current
2692846748.description: Stop the Shadow Legion from bringing down Neomuna's defenses.
2692846748.description_zh: 阻止暗影军团摧毁内欧姆那的防御系统。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1909782042.name: The Insight Terminus
1909782042.description: Break into the ancient Vex installation.
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2816527361.name: Battleground: Core
2816527361.description: Navigate and traverse the Vex structures at the core of Nessus.
2816527361.description_zh: 穿行并走出位于涅索斯核心的Vex建筑。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1911812956.name: Battleground: Delve
1911812956.description: Descend into Nessus and explore the Vex structures within.
1911812956.description_zh: 深入涅索斯，探索位于其中的Vex建筑。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

204281290.name: Battleground: Conduit
204281290.description: Follow the flow of Vex radiolaria deep within Nessus.
204281290.description_zh: 跟随涅索斯深处的Vex活性放射体液的流动。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1230209641.name: Expedition: Nessus
1230209641.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Nessus, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
1230209641.description_zh: 挖出深埋在涅索斯的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3302997692.name: Expedition: Cosmodrome
3302997692.description: Dig up buried pirate riches in the Cosmodrome, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
3302997692.description_zh: 挖出深埋在发射基地的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3766038363.name: Expedition: Europa
3766038363.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Europa, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
3766038363.description_zh: 挖出深埋在木卫二的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2720898636.name: Battleground: Behemoth
2720898636.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
2720898636.description_zh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3991362110.name: Battleground: Foothold
3991362110.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
3991362110.description_zh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3314414828.name: Battleground: Oracle
3314414828.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
3314414828.description_zh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2284347696.name: The Warrior
2284347696.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
2284347696.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2318060333.name: The Technocrat
2318060333.description: Defeat Eramis's technology expert, Praksis, the Technocrat.
2318060333.description_zh: 击败伊拉莫斯的技术专家普拉克西斯。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2041930080.name: The Dark Priestess
2041930080.description: Defeat the new leader of the Fallen, Kridis, the Dark Priestess.
2041930080.description_zh: 击败堕落者的新领袖，克里迪斯，暗影女祭司。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2502016636.name: The Devils' Lair
2502016636.description: Enter into the Devils' Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.
2502016636.description_zh: 进入恶魔巢穴，削弱堕落者在发射基地的存在感。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

129979.name: The Glassway
129979.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
129979.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

2928840839.name: The Inverted Spire
2928840839.description: End the Red Legion expedition that's ripped open the planet's surface.
2928840839.description_zh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

357717140.name: Liminality
357717140.description: Carve your way through a treacherous mountain pass teeming with Lucent Hive and Taken.
357717140.description_zh: 突破满是光明邪魔族和傀儡军团的危险山口。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

1116637119.name: Proving Grounds
1116637119.description: Defeat Caiatl's Chosen aboard the Land Tank, Halphas Electus, on Nessus.
1116637119.description_zh: 在涅索斯的陆地坦克哈帕斯·伊莱克特斯上击败查厄托的天选者。
modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

436972802.name: The Lightblade: Matchmade
436972802.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
436972802.description_zh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。
436972802.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

380769906.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.
380769906.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区清除威胁要占领水库并污染其珍贵水源的傀儡军团和暗影军团部队。

2054035351.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

28248463.description_zh: 消灭发射基地内蒙羞的邪魔族巫师纳沃塔。

3353968685.description: Happy Dawning! Celebrate the occasion by gifting your fellow Guardians a snowball to the face!
3353968685.description_zh: 曙光节快乐！为庆祝佳节，送你的守护者同伴们一个雪球糊脸吧！
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

441739340.name: Guardian Games: Supremacy: Matchmade
441739340.name_zh: 守护者游戏：霸权: 匹配
441739340.description: In Guardian Games: Supremacy, Guardians are teamed up with other Guardians of the same class.
441739340.description_zh: 在守护者游戏：霸权中，守护者将与同一职业的其他守护者进行组队。
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

2870733370.name: Control: Matchmade
2870733370.description:
"There will come a day when the Tower falls again. Our ability to hold territory is paramount." —Lord Saladin

Capture zones to increase points for each opponent defeated. Capture all three to lock the zones and hunt your opponents.
2870733370.description_zh:
“终会有高塔再次倾倒的那天。我们守护领土的能力至关重要。”——领主萨拉丁

占领区域可提升每个击败的对手所提供的分数。占领全部三个区域可锁定并猎杀你的对手。
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

2570433546.name: Eruption: Matchmade
2570433546.description:
"Pressure builds with each enemy felled. No one will be safe from the eruption." —Lord Saladin

Earn streaks to generate score multipliers. Max out your streak to erupt!
2570433546.description_zh:
“每打倒一个敌人，都会累积压力。面对爆发，没人能独善其身。”——领主萨拉丁

获得连杀来生成得分增量。达到连杀上限即可爆发！
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

2454074184.name: Tribute: Matchmade
2454074184.description:
"The heat of battle consumes the undisciplined. Combat is a means to victory, not its own end." —Lord Saladin

Collect crests from defeated opponents. Bank crests at the beacons to score points for your team.
2454074184.description_zh:
“战斗的紧张感会吞噬没有纪律的人。战斗是胜利的手段，而不是目的。”——领主萨拉丁

从被击败的对手身上收集纹章。在信标处储存纹章为队伍得分。
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

2684393063.name: Fortress: Matchmade
2684393063.description:
"The Guardian who controls their position masters the flow of the battle. Hold your ground!" —Lord Saladin

Control the zones—and watch your head!
2684393063.description_zh:
“能控制自己位置的守护者就能控制战斗的节奏。坚守阵地！”——领主萨拉丁

控制占领区——小心别被打到头！
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

4288724222.name: Heavy Metal: Supremacy: Matchmade
4288724222.description: It's Brigs, Tanks, and Behemoths in a clash of heavy metal and high explosives! Smash your way to the top of the scrap heap by defeating opponents and securing the coins they drop, while recovering friendly coins to deny them to opponents.
4288724222.description_zh: 机甲、坦克，以及巨兽，重金属与高爆炸物的激烈碰撞！击败对手并收集他们掉落的硬币，同时回收友方硬币以阻止对手获得它们，一路奋战至废料堆的顶端。
modifiers_zh: 已启用熔炉竞技场得分

2726272323.description:

Medieval weapons only: Bows, Glaives, and Swords. Hardware modifier active, no abilities or Supers. Weapons only.

已为特选武器启用不稳定武器模组。
仅限中世纪兵器：弓箭、偃月、刀剑。已启用硬件修改器，无技能或超能。仅限武器。

1813217007.description: Lodi believes dark matter is poisoning the Exiles Ether supply. Destroy their dark matter production and confront the Archon.
1813217007.description_zh: 洛迪认为暗物质正在污染流亡氏族的乙太供应。摧毁他们的暗物质生产并直面执政官。

2852920047.name: Charge: Normal
2852920047.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
2852920047.description_zh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

470101943.name: Charge: Legendary

470101943.description_zh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

1957458397.name: Commencement: Normal
1957458397.description: Fight through subordinate Vex to lure out and defeat a Gate Lord in the Aionian Campus.
1957458397.description_zh: 击败下级Vex，诱出并战胜艾昂校园中的门神。

415368209.name: Commencement: Legendary
415368209.description: Fight through subordinate Vex to lure out and defeat a Gate Lord in the Aionian Campus.
415368209.description_zh: 击败下级Vex，诱出并战胜艾昂校园中的门神。

3799131196.name: Mission: Disruption: Normal
3799131196.description: Evade towering Vex Minds casting a protective signal to the Collective, and find a way to bring them down to sow chaos into the Vex defenses.
3799131196.description_zh: 避开向集合体发送保护信号的高耸Vex思维，设法除掉它们以扰乱Vex防线。

3598735554.name: Mission: Disruption: Legendary

3598735554.description_zh: 避开向集合体发送保护信号的高耸Vex思维，设法除掉它们以扰乱Vex防线。

2802076450.name: Mission: Criticality: Normal
2802076450.description: The reactor powering the Aionian Campus threatens to melt down, potentially destroying all of Kepler. Rout the Exile saboteurs and shut the reactor down before it's too late.
2802076450.description_zh: 为艾昂校园提供能源的反应堆面临熔毁威胁，可能会摧毁开普勒的一切。击退流亡氏族破坏分子并关闭反应堆，否则就将为时已晚。

4250211952.name: Mission: Criticality: Legendary
4250211952.description: The reactor powering the Aionian Campus threatens to melt down, potentially destroying all of Kepler. Rout the Exile saboteurs and shut the reactor down before it's too late.
4250211952.description_zh: 为艾昂校园提供能源的反应堆面临熔毁威胁，可能会摧毁开普勒的一切。击退流亡氏族破坏分子并关闭反应堆，否则就将为时已晚。

1349441320.name: Mission: Morphology: Normal
1349441320.description: Fallen from the House of Exile stole dangerous Aionian technology. Track them down and retrieve it.
1349441320.description_zh: 流亡氏族的堕落者窃取了危险的艾昂人技术装置。找到他们并取回它。

42165478.name: Mission: Morphology: Legendary

42165478.description_zh: 流亡氏族的堕落者窃取了危险的艾昂人技术装置。找到他们并取回它。

2131485965.name: Quarantine: Normal
2131485965.description: Destroy a powerful Vex Mind to breach the quarantine around the singularity and seize the final strangelet capsule.
2131485965.description_zh: 摧毁强大的Vex思维以突破奇点周围的隔离，夺取最后的奇异子胶囊。

3907319841.name: Quarantine: Legendary
3907319841.description: Destroy a powerful Vex Mind to breach the quarantine around the singularity and seize the final strangelet capsule.
3907319841.description_zh: 摧毁强大的Vex思维以突破奇点周围的隔离，夺取最后的奇异子胶囊。

2463077903.name: Gouge: Normal
2463077903.description: Hunt down the House of Exile's Prime Servitor, destroy it, steal the strangelet capsule it guards, and tarnish the Archon's hold over his House.
2463077903.description_zh: 追踪流亡氏族的原始魔眼并摧毁它，窃取它守护的奇异子胶囊，削弱执政官对氏族的控制。

3686816891.name: Gouge: Legendary
3686816891.description: Hunt down the House of Exile's Prime Servitor, destroy it, steal the strangelet capsule it guards, and tarnish the Archon's hold over his House.
3686816891.description_zh: 追踪流亡氏族的原始魔眼并摧毁它，窃取它守护的奇异子胶囊，削弱执政官对氏族的控制。

1723283994.name: Mission: Transient: Normal
1723283994.description: Follow Lodi's lead to a House of Exile power facility and shut down their generators before the Archon's warship finishes its preparations.
1723283994.description_zh: 跟随洛迪前往流亡氏族的能源设施，在执政官的战舰完成准备前关闭他们的发生器。

559144296.name: Mission: Transient: Legendary
559144296.description: Follow Lodi's lead to a House of Exile power facility and shut down their generators before the Archon's warship finishes its preparations.
559144296.description_zh: 跟随洛迪前往流亡氏族的能源设施，在执政官的战舰完成准备前关闭他们的发生器。

2676684267.name: Mission: Calculus: Normal
2676684267.description: Follow Orin's guidance through a labyrinth to locate the site where the Vex refine the power of the Nine and raze their technology to ashes.
2676684267.description_zh: 跟随奥琳的引导穿过迷宫，找到Vex提炼玖之力的地点，并将其技术装置付之一炬。

4149309255.name: Mission: Calculus: Legendary

4149309255.description_zh: 跟随奥琳的引导穿过迷宫，找到Vex提炼玖之力的地点，并将其技术装置付之一炬。

3583259793.name: Mission: The Invitation: Normal
3583259793.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
3583259793.description_zh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

3124375945.name: Mission: The Invitation: Legendary
3124375945.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
3124375945.description_zh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

2296346665.name: The Message: Normal
2296346665.description: Confront Archon Levaszk under the heart of the singularity and uncover the mystery behind the invitation that brought you to Kepler.
2296346665.description_zh: 在奇点中心下方直面执政官列瓦兹克，揭开将你带到开普勒的邀请背后的谜团。

1240909349.name: The Message: Legendary
1240909349.description: Confront Archon Levaszk under the heart of the singularity and uncover the mystery behind the invitation that brought you to Kepler.
1240909349.description_zh: 在奇点中心下方直面执政官列瓦兹克，揭开将你带到开普勒的邀请背后的谜团。

2513694906.name: Mission: Nostos: Normal
2513694906.description: Eliksni from the House of Exile plan to destroy the structural history of the Aionians, and most of the campus with it. Stop them before it's too late!
2513694906.description_zh: 流亡氏族的埃里克斯尼族企图摧毁艾昂人的历史遗迹和大部分的校园，及时阻止他们！

1060540968.name: Mission: Nostos: Legendary
1060540968.description: Eliksni from the House of Exile plan to destroy the structural history of the Aionians, and most of the campus with it. Stop them before it's too late!
1060540968.description_zh: 流亡氏族的埃里克斯尼族企图摧毁艾昂人的历史遗迹和大部分的校园，及时阻止他们！

3361746271.name: Zero Hour: Standard
3361746271.description: Race against the clock to stop House Salvation agents from stealing a dangerous weapon from the Old Tower.
3361746271.description_zh: 抓紧时间，阻止救赎氏族特工从旧高塔中偷走一件危险的武器。

1848771417.name: Zero Hour (Expert)
1848771417.description: Race against the clock to stop House Salvation agents from stealing a dangerous weapon from the Old Tower.
1848771417.description_zh: 抓紧时间，阻止救赎氏族特工从旧高塔中偷走一件危险的武器。

3743446313.name: The Whisper: Standard
3743446313.description: Investigate a Taken anomaly deep beneath the surface of Io.
3743446313.description_zh: 调查深藏在木卫一表面之下的傀儡军团异常。

3871520787.name: The Whisper (Expert)
3871520787.description: Investigate a Taken anomaly deep beneath the surface of Io.
3871520787.description_zh: 调查深藏在木卫一表面之下的傀儡军团异常。

2754695317.name: Competitive
2754695317.description:
Matches affect your Competitive Division placement. Wins will lead to promotions. Losses will lead to demotion. 
Higher divisions grant greater reward bonus.
2754695317.description_zh:
比赛将影响你的多人竞技级别排名。获胜将成功晋级。落败将导致降级。
级别越高，奖励加成越大。

3687521241.name: Sparrow Control
3687521241.description:
Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents.

Vehicles enabled.
3687521241.description_zh:
占领区域并击败对手以获得胜利。

已启用载具。

2668737148.name: Vox Obscura: Standard
2668737148.description: A Psionic propaganda transmission threatens to destabilize the Vanguard's Cabal allies. Breach the rebel stronghold to discover who's behind the new Psionic offensive.
2668737148.description_zh: 一则灵能宣传通讯威胁到了先锋的卡巴尔盟友。攻破叛军据点，找出新灵能攻势的幕后黑手。

666172264.name: Vox Obscura (Expert)
666172264.description: Despite the Vanguard's recent victories, a dissident Psion faction continues to release Darkness-inspired propaganda. Return to Mars and learn how far the conspiracy goes.
666172264.description_zh: 尽管先锋最近取得了胜利，持不同政见的灵能士兵阵营还在继续发布受暗影影响的宣传。回到火星去，查明这场阴谋的规模到底有多大。

1221538367.name: Operation: Seraph's Shield: Standard
1221538367.name_zh: 行动：炽天使之盾: 标准
1221538367.description: Infiltrate Seraph Station in Earth's orbit to plant a virus in the Warsat network.
1221538367.description_zh: 潜入地球轨道上的炽天使空间站，在战争卫星网络中植入病毒。

2919809209.name: Operation: Seraph's Shield (Expert)
2919809209.description: Uncover Seraph Station's secrets to upgrade Revision Zero.
2919809209.description_zh: 揭开炽天使空间站的秘密来升级零号修订。

3883295757.name: Presage: Standard
3883295757.description: Jump coordinates matching an errant distress signal.
3883295757.description_zh: 跃迁坐标与一个怪异的求救信号重合。

4201846671.name: Presage (Expert)
4201846671.description: A nearby anomaly flares with Dark radiation. Move quickly or fall to shadow.
4201846671.description_zh: 一个附近的异常点散发出暗影辐射。尽快行动，否则将堕入阴影。

509188661.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//
509188661.description: Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
509188661.description_zh: 调查欧洲无人区中的一个Vex网络节点，该节点已被一个词覆盖：阿瓦隆。

3951571983.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//: Legendary
3951571983.description: Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
3951571983.description_zh: 调查欧洲无人区中的一个Vex网络节点，该节点已被一个词覆盖：阿瓦隆。

196691221.name: Starcrossed
196691221.description: Within the Black Garden, the Sol Divisive toil endlessly, systematically shutting down potential futures. With Riven's blessing, it's time to shut them down.
196691221.description_zh: 在黑暗花园中，太阳系分支无休止地工作着，系统性地抹除可能的未来。有了魅痕的祝福，是时候把它们抹除了。

3214480871.name: Starcrossed (Legend)
3214480871.description: Within the Black Garden, the Sol Divisive toil endlessly, systematically shutting down potential futures. With Riven's blessing, it's time to shut them down.
3214480871.description_zh: 在黑暗花园中，太阳系分支无休止地工作着，系统性地抹除可能的未来。有了魅痕的祝福，是时候把它们抹除了。

2880643894.name: Encore: Standard
2880643894.description: Explore the strange structures at the core of Nessus, converted by the Vex at the Conductor's command.
2880643894.description_zh: 探索位于涅索斯核心的奇特建筑，它是Vex奉指挥者之命转化而成的。

2166410122.name: Encore (Expert)
2166410122.description: Explore the strange structures at the core of Nessus, converted by the Vex at the Conductor's command.
2166410122.description_zh: 探索位于涅索斯核心的奇特建筑，它是Vex奉指挥者之命转化而成的。

3878270936.name: Kell's Fall
3878270936.description: Enter Fikrul's Revenant Fortress in the Tangled Shore, where dark reflections make it difficult to discern illusion from reality.

203360913.name: Battleground: Foothold
203360913.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
203360913.description_zh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。

3061652915.name: Battleground: Oracle
3061652915.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.

modifiers_zh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械

3890076515.description: It's Brigs vs. Tanks in a clash of heavy metal and high explosives! Smash your way to the top of the scrap heap by defeating opponents and securing the coins they drop, and recovering friendly coins to deny them to opponents.
3890076515.description_zh: 机甲大战坦克，重金属与高爆炸物的激烈碰撞！击败对手并收集他们掉落的硬币，同时回收友方硬币以阻止对手获得它们，一路奋战至废料堆的顶端。

2461220411.name: Checkmate Rumble
2461220411.description:
Achieve victory by defeating opponents. No teams. No allegiance. A free-for-all where the leader had better watch their back.

Ability and Primary ammo damage is reduced. Special ammo is earned by engaging in combat and is not lost on death.
2461220411.description_zh:
通过击败对手来取得胜利。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

技能和主弹药伤害均被降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

1843951587.name: Competitive
1843951587.description:
"Here, you will find yourself closely matched with your fellow Guardians. Here, steel sharpens steel to its finest!"—Lord Shaxx

Matches in this playlist affect your Competitive Division placement. Wins will lead to Promotions, increasing your Division placement. Losses will lead to Relegations, lowering your Division placement.
1843951587.description_zh:
“在这里，你将会发现自己与你的守护者同伴旗鼓相当。在这里，你将精益求精，百炼成钢！”——领主沙克斯

此游戏列表中的比赛将影响你的多人竞技级别排名。获胜将成功晋级，提升你的级别排名。落败则将导致降级，降低你的级别排名。
