1136712465.name: Defiant Battleground: EDZ
1136712465.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion Pyramid outpost in the EDZ.
1136712465.description_zh: 从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团金字塔前哨站中营救俘虏。

2688144252.name: Defiant Battleground: Cosmodrome
2688144252.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion Pyramid outpost in the Cosmodrome.
2688144252.description_zh: 从位于发射基地的暗影军团金字塔前哨站中营救俘虏。

2290349874.name: Defiant Battleground: Orbital Prison
2290349874.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion prison in near-Earth orbit.
2290349874.description_zh: 从位于近地轨道的暗影军团监狱中营救俘虏。

3562636616.name: Mission: Jailbreak
3562636616.description: A distress signal has been detected coming from a secret Shadow Legion prison in the EDZ. Amanda Holliday and Mithrax request your assistance in liberating the civilian captives.
3562636616.description_zh: 一个求救信号从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团秘密监狱中传来了出来。阿曼达·霍利迪以及米瑟拉克斯请求你协力解救被关押的平民。

4059764257.name: Mission: Retribution
4059764257.description: With Queen Mara's power, you are able to traverse the Ascendant Plane and breach the Shadow Legion flagship. Mithrax, Devrim, and Crow will join you in your assault.
4059764257.description_zh: 凭借玛拉女王的力量，你获得了穿越上维位面并闯入暗影军团旗舰的能力。米瑟拉克斯、德弗里姆、乌鸦都会随你一同进攻。

3020505556.name: Defiant Battlegrounds
3020505556.description: Launch daring rescue missions to liberate civilian captives from Shadow Legion prisons.
3020505556.description_zh: 启动大胆营救任务，从暗影军团监狱中营救平民俘虏。

700101128.name: Legend Defiant Battleground: EDZ
700101128.name_zh: 传说抗战战场：欧洲无人区
700101128.description: Coordinate your fireteam to take on this Legendary challenge. Rescue captives from Shadow Legion prisons across the system.
700101128.description_zh: 协调你的火力战队，迎接此传说挑战。从位于星系各处的暗影军团监狱中营救俘虏。

2572988947.name: Legend Defiant Battleground: Cosmodrome

3755529435.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//
3755529435.description: Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
3755529435.description_zh: 调查欧洲无人区中的一个Vex网络节点，该节点已被一个词覆盖：阿瓦隆。

3083261666.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//: Legend

3965088759.name: The Farm
3965088759.description: Reclaimed Vanguard camp from the Red War.
3965088759.description_zh: 从猩红战争中收复的先锋营地。

1451941146.name: Deep Dives: Deep Dives (Matchmade)
1451941146.name_zh: 深渊潜水: 深渊潜水（匹配）
1451941146.description:
Dive into the dark waters of Titan's methane sea and battle sunken horrors to retrieve precious resources for Sloane's newfound ally, Ahsa.

Victory at each depth leads ever deeper to greater rewards, hidden treasures, and challenges beneath Kraken Mare.
1451941146.description_zh:
潜入土卫六黑暗的甲烷海，与出没海底的恐怖生物作战，为斯隆的新盟友阿莎取回珍贵资源。

在每个深度层取得胜利，下潜越深，奖励就越多。隐藏的宝藏和挑战都在克拉肯海中等着你。

1837478777.name: Deep Dives: Deep Dives (Private)
1837478777.name_zh: 深渊潜水: 深渊潜水（私人）
1837478777.description:
Dive into the dark waters of Titan's methane sea and battle sunken horrors to retrieve precious resources for Sloane's newfound ally, Ahsa.

Victory at each depth leads ever deeper to greater rewards, hidden treasures, and challenges beneath Kraken Mare.
1837478777.description_zh:
潜入土卫六黑暗的甲烷海，与出没海底的恐怖生物作战，为斯隆的新盟友阿莎取回珍贵资源。

在每个深度层取得胜利，下潜越深，奖励就越多。隐藏的宝藏和挑战都在克拉肯海中等着你。

2052926546.name: Operation Thunderbolt (Twilight)
2052926546.description: Dive to the Twilight depth of Titan's methane sea, fight back the horrors that encroach from sunken hollows, and extract all the egregore coral you can to strengthen Sloane's connection with her newfound ally, Ahsa.
2052926546.description_zh: 下潜至土卫六甲烷海的暮光深度，击败出没深海的恐怖生物，并尽量带回守望者珊瑚，以强化斯隆与其新盟友阿莎之间的联系。

542921658.name: Mayday, Mayday (Midnight)
542921658.description:
The call hits the Tower, 'mayday!'. A fireteam has gone missing beneath the waves of Titan's methane sea.

Dive to the Midnight depth of Titan's ocean, find the missing fireteam, and assist them in completing their mission to recover as much egregore coral as they can before extracting safely.
542921658.description_zh:
高塔收到了一段求救信号。一支火力战队在土卫六的甲烷海中失踪了。

潜入土卫六海洋的午夜深度，找到失踪的火力战队，并协助他们完成取回守望者珊瑚的任务，然后安全撤离。

1821570930.name: Operation Fulgurite (Abyss)
1821570930.description:
A high-value concentration of egregore coral has been detected fathoms beneath the ocean.

Dive to the Abyss depth of Titan's methane sea, fight back the horrors that lurk there, and recover all the egregore coral you can.
1821570930.description_zh:
深海中发现了高价值的守望者珊瑚群落。

潜入土卫六的甲烷海，反击出没海底的恐怖生物，尽力带回守望者珊瑚。

831332675.name: Barotrauma: Operation Fulgurite (Abyss)
831332675.name_zh: 潜渊症: 雷击石行动（深渊）
831332675.description:
Ahsa's signature has been detected deep beneath Kraken Mare, behind enemy lines. The Vanguard fears she has been captured by Xivu Arath.

Prepare your armaments and venture once more into Titan's methane sea to find and rescue Ahsa.
831332675.description_zh:
阿莎的信号出现在了克拉肯海的深处，位于敌军前线后方。先锋担心她已被希乌阿拉斯擒获。

准备好你的武器，再次潜入土卫六的甲烷海，找到并救出阿莎。

971509017.name: The Descent
971509017.description: Return to Titan, the lost moon of Saturn, to discover the source of an impossible distress call.
971509017.description_zh: 返回土星失落的卫星土卫六，找到某个离奇求救信号的来源。

999685224.name: Salvage
999685224.description: Collect Golden Age salvage from the shallows of the Kraken Mare for the Drifter.
999685224.description_zh: 替浪客从克拉肯海的浅海收集黄金时代的回收物。

283043.name: Salvage Legend
283043.description: Coordinate your fireteam to take on this Legend challenge. Haul up Golden Age salvage from Titan's sea while defending against your foes.
283043.description_zh: 协调你的火力战队完成此传说挑战。在抵御敌人的同时从土卫六海洋中打捞黄金时代回收物。

2609103236.name: The Descent
2609103236.description: Return to Titan, the lost moon of Saturn, to discover the source of an impossible distress call.
2609103236.description_zh: 返回土星失落的卫星土卫六，找到某个离奇求救信号的来源。

3938185410.name: Way of the Witch
3938185410.description: Weave Hive magic with your Light to reveal Savathûn's Spire.
3938185410.description_zh: 使用光能编织邪魔族魔法来揭示萨瓦图恩的尖塔。

2239891035.name: Way of the Witch
2239891035.description: Weave Hive magic with your Light to reveal Savathûn's Spire.
2239891035.description_zh: 使用光能编织邪魔族魔法来揭示萨瓦图恩的尖塔。
2239891035.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

2079566393.name: Mission: Invoke
2079566393.description: Explore the ritual chambers beneath Savathûn's Spire to unlock Eris Morn's newfound power.
2079566393.description_zh: 探索萨瓦图恩的尖塔下的仪式室，来解锁埃里斯·摩恩新获得的力量。
2079566393.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

3483444271.name: Mission: Conjure
3483444271.description: Repel Xivu Arath's invasion of the Altars of Summoning. Prevent her forces from claiming the Witch Queen's most valuable tithes.
3483444271.description_zh: 击退希乌阿拉斯对召唤圣坛的入侵。阻止她的部队夺取巫妖女王最宝贵的贡品。
3483444271.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

88632762.name: Mission: Sunder
88632762.description: Throw open the gates and challenge Xivu Arath's deadliest forces. Defeat them to enact Eris Morn's final ritual.
88632762.description_zh: 打开大门并挑战希乌阿拉斯最致命的部队。击败他们来进行埃里斯·摩恩的最终仪式。
88632762.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

3637500864.name: Savathûn's Spire
3637500864.description: Master the magic of the Witch Queen's Spire and open the way to the Altars of Summoning.
3637500864.description_zh: 掌握巫妖女王的尖塔的魔法，开辟通往召唤圣坛的道路。
3637500864.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

440840879.name: Savathûn's Spire (Legend)
440840879.description: Gather your coven to master this Legend challenge. Empower the Witch Queen's Spire and face the experiments within.
440840879.description_zh: 召集你的女巫会，完成这个传说挑战。向巫妖女王的尖塔提供能量，面对其中的各种试验品。
440840879.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1675910381.name: Altars of Summoning
1675910381.description: Summon terrible foes using ritual magic. Defeat them and tithe your conquests to Eris Morn!
1675910381.description_zh: 使用仪式魔法召唤恶敌。击败他们，将你的征服进贡给埃里斯·摩恩！
1675910381.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

3521636256.name: The Imbaru Engine
3521636256.description: Investigate the chamber above the Altars of Summoning.
3521636256.description_zh: 调查召唤圣坛上方的房间。
3521636256.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

679769719.description: Crawl through the Sensorium wing of Riven's Lair and retrieve her clutch.
679769719.description_zh: 穿过魅痕巢穴的感知界区域并取回她的蛋。

2439292398.name: Battleground: Behemoth
2439292398.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
2439292398.description_zh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。

598728782.name: Battleground: Oracle
598728782.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.

4084219508.description_zh: 最近有守护者在欧洲无人区失踪了。调查他们的踪迹，并猎杀造成此问题的光明邪魔族。

3103640929.name: Legendary PsiOps Battleground: Cosmodrome
3103640929.name_zh: 传说灵能行动战场：发射基地
3103640929.description: The Lucent Hive are using stolen Guardian Light for some wicked purpose. Breach their stronghold and uncover their plot.
3103640929.description_zh: 光明邪魔族用窃取的守护者光能作恶。攻破他们的堡垒，揭露他们的阴谋。

3143928283.name: Legendary PsiOps Battleground: Moon
3143928283.name_zh: 传说灵能行动战场：月球
3143928283.description: The Lucent Hive have opened a portal between Savathûn's throne world and the Scarlet Keep. Break up the portal ritual, and prevent a full-scale invasion of Earth.
3143928283.description_zh: 光明邪魔族打开了萨瓦图恩王座世界和猩红要塞之间的传送门。阻止传送门仪式，防止他们全面入侵地球。

901429423.name: Vox Obscura: Normal
901429423.description: A Psionic propaganda transmission threatens to destabilize the Vanguard's Cabal allies. Breach the rebel stronghold to discover who's behind the new Psionic offensive.
901429423.description_zh: 一则灵能宣传通讯威胁到了先锋的卡巴尔盟友。攻破叛军据点，找出新灵能攻势的幕后黑手。

613120446.name: Vox Obscura (Master)
613120446.description: Despite the Vanguard's recent victories, a dissident Psion faction continues to release Darkness-inspired propaganda. Return to Mars and learn how far the conspiracy goes.
613120446.description_zh: 尽管先锋最近取得了胜利，持不同政见的灵能士兵阵营还在继续发布受暗影影响的宣传。回到火星去，查明这场阴谋的规模到底有多大。

3572691267.name: Nightmare Containment: CONTAINMENT
3572691267.description: Draw out and defeat powerful Nightmares to imprison them with the Nightmare Harvester.
3572691267.description_zh: 引出并击败强大的梦魇，用梦魇收割者囚禁他们。

3886047149.name: Operation: Midas
3886047149.description: Board the Leviathan, uncover where it has been, and learn why it has returned.
3886047149.description_zh: 登上利维坦，发现它曾经的去处，了解它为何归来。

3339520338.name: Catharsis
3339520338.description: Return to the Leviathan and prepare for one final ritual to prevent Calus from assuming control of the lunar Pyramid.
3339520338.description_zh: 返回利维坦，为最后的仪式做好准备，阻止卡鲁斯控制月球金字塔。

4109707968.name: Sever - Shame
4109707968.description: Hidden agents have found ingress into the lower armory decks. Infiltrate the Underbelly with Crow and perform a ritual severance to weaken Calus's connection to the Pyramid.
4109707968.description_zh: 隐秘者特工找到了进入下层军械库甲板的入口。和乌鸦一起潜入腹地，执行断舍仪式来削弱卡鲁斯与金字塔的联系。

1844147706.name: Sever - Reconciliation
1844147706.description: Return to the Underbelly with Crow and help him face the Nightmare that haunts him in order to complete the severance ritual.
1844147706.description_zh: 与乌鸦一道返回腹地，帮助他直面困扰他的梦魇，以完成断舍仪式。

2268360624.name: Sever - Grief
2268360624.description: Hidden agents have found ingress into the garden's depths. Infiltrate the Underbelly with Zavala and perform a severance ritual.
2268360624.description_zh: 隐秘者特工找到了进入花园深处的入口。和萨瓦拉一起潜入腹地，执行断舍仪式。

2895576266.name: Sever - Forgiveness
2895576266.description: Return to the Underbelly with Zavala and help him face the Nightmare that haunts him in order to complete the severance ritual.
2895576266.description_zh: 与萨瓦拉一道返回腹地，帮助他直面困扰他的梦魇，以完成断舍仪式。

1632646193.name: Sever - Rage
1632646193.description: Hidden agents have found ingress into the engineering bay, but Caiatl has rushed ahead with her own assault! Track her down and make sure she makes it out alive.
1632646193.description_zh: 隐秘者特工找到了进入工程舱的入口，但查厄托已经自行发动了进攻！找到她，确保她活着出来。

1507540143.name: Sever - Resolve
1507540143.description: Return to the Underbelly with Caiatl and help her face the Nightmare that haunts her in order to complete the severance ritual.
1507540143.description_zh: 与查厄托一道返回腹地，帮助她直面困扰她的梦魇，以完成断舍仪式。

4291087534.name: Operation: Midas
4291087534.description: Board the Leviathan, uncover where it has been, and learn why it has returned.
4291087534.description_zh: 登上利维坦，发现它曾经的去处，了解它为何归来。

3594496514.name: Ketchcrash
3594496514.description: Ship-to-ship combat with the most ferocious pirates in the Sol system.
3594496514.description_zh: 与最为凶残的海盗在太阳系中进行舰对舰作战。

287709797.name: Ketchcrash: Master
287709797.description: Ship-to-ship combat with merciless pirates in the depths of space.
287709797.description_zh: 与冷酷无情的海盗在宇宙深处进行舰对舰作战。

1516872611.name: Expedition: Nessus
1516872611.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Nessus, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
1516872611.description_zh: 挖出深埋在涅索斯的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

1516872608.name: Expedition: Cosmodrome
1516872608.description: Dig up buried pirate riches in the Cosmodrome, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
1516872608.description_zh: 挖出深埋在发射基地的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

1516872609.name: Expedition: Europa
1516872609.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Europa, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
1516872609.description_zh: 挖出深埋在木卫二的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

1657597684.name: Expedition Playlist
1657597684.description: Repel roving pirate crews to excavate long-buried treasures!
1657597684.description_zh: 击退游荡的海盗，挖掘深埋已久的宝藏！

2563167541.name: Salvage and Salvation
2563167541.description: Help Drifter retrieve his stolen cargo from House Salvation.
2563167541.description_zh: 帮助浪客从救赎氏族手中取回被盗的货物。

4029403794.name: Pirate Hideout: The Beast Tamer
4029403794.description: Storm Alaaks, the Beast Tamer's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
4029403794.description_zh: 猛攻驯兽师阿拉克斯的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

2269367761.name: Pirate Hideout: The Brute
2269367761.description: Storm Val'aug, the Brute's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
2269367761.description_zh: 猛攻恶汉瓦尔洛格的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

1959757913.name: Pirate Hideout: The Bully
1959757913.description: Storm Arask, the Bully's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
1959757913.description_zh: 猛攻恶霸亚拉斯克的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

1474509247.name: Pirate Hideout: The Scrapworker
1474509247.description: Storm Ithyks, the Scrapworker's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
1474509247.description_zh: 猛攻废料工伊瑟克斯的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

1309806224.name: Pirate Hideout: The Lucent Brood
1309806224.description: Storm the Overrun Pirate Hideout and claim a lost relic.
1309806224.description_zh: 猛攻被占领的海盗藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

888901696.name: Pirate Hideout: The Coward
888901696.description: Storm Vrisk, the Coward's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
888901696.description_zh: 猛攻胆怯者弗瑞斯克的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

84447503.name: Pirate Hideout: The Sharpshooter
84447503.description: Storm Iriks, the Sharpshooter's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
84447503.description_zh: 猛攻狙击兵伊里克斯的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

3294692067.name: Pirate Hideout: The Blademasters
3294692067.description: Storm Tagh'al and Thagh'urn, the Blademasters' Hideout and claim a lost relic.
3294692067.description_zh: 猛攻剑圣塔格哈尔和萨格恩的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

1095192671.name: Asteroid Base
1095192671.description:
Eramis has agreed to parley with Eido and Mithrax at a remote asteroid base.
Travel to the asteroid via the Destinations tab in the H.E.L.M.
1095192671.description_zh:
伊拉莫斯同意在一个偏远的小行星基地与艾多和米瑟拉克斯谈判。
通过应急后勤行动中心中的目的地选项卡前往此小行星。

3053411168.name: Last City: Eliksni Quarter
3053411168.description: The area of the Last City that shelters Mithrax and his House of Light.
3053411168.description_zh: 圣城内用来庇护米瑟拉克斯及其光能氏族的区域。

2229153515.name: Hierarchy
2229153515.description: Travel to Europa to seek the aid of the AI Clovis Bray I in restoring the Warmind, Rasputin.
2229153515.description_zh: 前往木卫二，寻求人工智能克洛维斯·布瑞一世的帮助，以修复战争思维拉斯普廷。

3535439033.name: ABHORRENT IMPERATIVE
3535439033.description: After an assault on Seraph Station, Rasputin is connected to the Warsat network and ready to execute his plan.
3535439033.description_zh: 对炽天使空间站发起进攻后，拉斯普廷已连接至战争卫星网络，并准备好实施计划。

758739851.name: Hierarchy
758739851.description: Travel to Europa to seek the aid of the AI Clovis Bray I in restoring the Warmind, Rasputin.
758739851.description_zh: 前往木卫二，寻求人工智能克洛维斯·布瑞一世的帮助，以修复战争思维拉斯普廷。

1883814254.name: Operation: Sancus
1883814254.description: Recover highly classified files from a Warmind bunker beneath the Cosmodrome.
1883814254.description_zh: 前往发射基地下的战争思维地堡，取回机密文件。

1006087237.name: Emergency Briefing
1006087237.description: Participate in an emergency briefing and plan a response to Xivu Arath's imminent takeover of the Warsat network.
1006087237.description_zh: 参加紧急简报会，为希乌阿拉斯即将占领战争卫星网络一事筹备应对计划。
1006087237.place: Hub for Emergency Logistics and Maneuvers

2561208221.name: ABHORRENT IMPERATIVE
2561208221.description: Return to Seraph Station to prevent the Warsat network from firing on the Traveler.
2561208221.description_zh: 回到炽天使空间站，阻止战争卫星网络向旅行者开火。

4154866252.name: Heist Battlegrounds: Adept
4154866252.name_zh: 盗劫战场: 得心应手
4154866252.description: Embark on daring heists to repossess fragments of Rasputin's scattered subminds in order to restore the Warmind.
4154866252.description_zh: 实施大胆盗劫，收回拉斯普廷四散的子思维碎片来复原战争思维。

2898147772.name: Heist Battleground: Europa: Heist Battlegrounds
2898147772.description: Brave the cold winds of Europa to reclaim fragments of a hidden submind's code from the depths of Bray Exoscience.
2898147772.description_zh: 勇闯木卫二的寒风，从布瑞Exo科学所深处取回隐匿子思维的代码碎片。

248396467.name: Heist Battleground: Moon: Heist Battlegrounds
248396467.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
248396467.description_zh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。

4187915185.name: Heist Battleground: Mars: Heist Battlegrounds
4187915185.description: Blitz the BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
4187915185.description_zh: 闪击火星上的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。

3726105351.name: Legend Heist Battleground: Europa
3726105351.description: Brave the legendarily cold winds of Europa to repossess fragments of a hidden submind's code from the depths of Bray Exoscience.
3726105351.description_zh: 勇闯木卫二传说级的寒风，从布瑞Exo科学所深处取回隐匿子思维的代码碎片。

296609104.name: Legend Heist Battleground: Moon
296609104.description: Infiltrate a legendary Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
296609104.description_zh: 潜入藏在月尘之下传说级的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。

327058878.name: Legend Heist Battleground: Mars
327058878.description: Blitz the legendary BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
327058878.description_zh: 闪击火星上传说级的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。

3941721853.name: Operation: Archimedes
3941721853.description: Infiltrate the Seraph Launch Facility and reboot the auxiliary reactor.
3941721853.description_zh: 潜入炽天使发射设施并重启辅助反应堆。

1878125121.name: Operation: Diocles
1878125121.description: Infiltrate the Seraph Launch Facility and download the launch codes.
1878125121.description_zh: 潜入炽天使发射设施并下载发射代码。

1230973847.name_zh: 守护者游戏：休闲游戏列表: 普通
1230973847.description: Earn Laurels, Medallions, and Vanguard Medals as you compete for individual distinction and class supremacy.
1230973847.description_zh: 赢得桂冠、勋章和先锋勋章，为个人荣誉和职业排名而战。

2812525063.name: Scourge of the Past
2812525063.description: Beneath the ruins of the Last City lies the Black Armory's most precious vault, now under siege by Siviks and his crew, the Kell's Scourge.
2812525063.description_zh: 最后的城市的废墟下，隐藏着黑色军械库最珍贵的保险库。如今被斯威克斯和他的手下“凯尔的祸根”们包围。

4183025786.name: A Cry from Beyond
4183025786.description: A memory of a dream has led to a question. What lies inside the Hallowed Grove?
4183025786.description_zh: 一个梦境的回忆带来一个问题。神圣丛林里藏着什么？

1929591941.name: The Crow and the Hawk
1929591941.description: Follow the manifestation of the Traveler into the Hallowed Grove and unleash Hawkmoon's potential.
1929591941.description_zh: 跟随旅行者的实体进入神圣丛林，释放隼月的潜能。

1738383283.name: Harbinger
1738383283.description: Embody the will of the Traveler and hunt those who would serve the Darkness.
1738383283.description_zh: 承载旅行者的意志，追杀那些屈从暗影的人。

3738431206.name: WANTED: Silent Fang
3738431206.description: Hunt down the wanted Silent Fang who escaped from the Prison of Elders.
3738431206.description_zh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯寂牙。

1157123053.description_zh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯寂牙。

925348811.name: Battleground: Behemoth
925348811.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
925348811.description_zh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。

3458232326.name: Battleground: Hailstone
3458232326.description: In a bid to earn Empress Caiatl's favor, a Cabal force has descended on Europa to scour the icy moon for relics of the Golden Age including the secrets of the Exo contained in the Deep Stone Crypt. Travel to Europa and put a stop to this operation.
3458232326.description_zh: 为了获得查厄托女帝的青睐，一支卡巴尔部队来到木卫二，企图在这颗冰封卫星上搜寻黄金时代的圣物，包括隐藏在深岩墓室中与Exo有关的秘密。前往木卫二去阻止这次行动吧。

920521905.name: Battleground: Foothold
920521905.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
920521905.description_zh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。

679234423.name: Battleground: Oracle
679234423.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
679234423.description_zh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。

25688104.name: Override: Europa
25688104.description: Brave the frozen wastelands of Europa to help Mithrax splice the Vex network.
25688104.description_zh: 勇闯木卫二冰冻荒原，帮助米瑟拉克斯切入Vex网络。

2865532048.name: Override: The Moon
2865532048.description: Use teamwork and your Splicer skills to force your way into the Vex network and crash it from the inside.
2865532048.description_zh: 用团队合作以及你的熔岩军团技能闯入Vex网络，从内部将其破坏。

3933916447.name: Override: Tangled Shore
3933916447.description: Infiltrate the Vex network and confront the Subjugated Mind that rules their digital domain.
3933916447.description_zh: 潜入Vex网络，直面统治数字领域的奴役思维。

612985278.name: Override: Last City
612985278.description: Use your Splicer skills to crush the Vex assault on the Last City and collapse their Network.
612985278.description_zh: 用你的熔岩军团技能击溃Vex对圣城的猛攻，使它们的网络崩塌。

2421123184.name: The Lost Splicer
2421123184.description: Locate Mithrax on Europa and ask him to aid you in your fight against the Vex.
2421123184.description_zh: 在木卫二上找到米瑟拉克斯，并请他协助你对抗Vex。

1655431815.name: Expunge: Labyrinth: Normal
1655431815.description: Analysis of Vex Subjugated Minds have revealed a labyrinthine domain of the Vex Nexus, governed by a powerful Oppressive Mind. Destroy this mind and the entire domain will collapse.
1655431815.description_zh: 对Vex奴役首脑进行分析之后，我们发现了一个Vex纳克斯枢纽的迷宫领域，那里的支配者是一个强大的暴虐首脑。摧毁这个首脑，整个领域就会崩塌。

1774824719.name: Expunge: Corrupted Labyrinth
1774824719.description: When the Labyrinth domain of the Vex Nexus collapsed it was not destroyed, but infected by an incursion of Taken. The Endless Night's subroutines flow through a now corrupted Oppressive Mind. Return and destroy the Oppressive Mind once and for all.
1774824719.description_zh: Vex纳克斯枢纽的迷宫领域崩塌时，它没有被摧毁，而是被傀儡军团的入侵所感染。永夜的子程序流经一个已被腐化的暴虐首脑。返回那里彻底摧毁暴虐首脑。

1358982784.name: Expunge: Styx: Normal
1358982784.description: A river of Vex code flows into a hub within the Nexus where an Oppressive Mind manages the flow of directives maintaining the Endless Night. Destroy this mind and its domain will collapse.
1358982784.description_zh: Vex代码如河流般汇入纳克斯枢纽内的中心，那里的暴虐首脑管理着维持永夜的指令流。摧毁这个首脑，其领域就会崩塌。

2496896744.name: Expunge: Corrupted Styx
2496896744.description: As the Styx domain of the Vex Nexus collapsed it allowed an incursion of Taken to assume direct control of the Oppressive Mind and its functions. Return and destroy the Oppressive Mind once and for all.
2496896744.description_zh: Vex纳克斯枢纽的冥河领域崩塌时，傀儡军团通过入侵直接控制了暴虐首脑及其功能。返回那里彻底摧毁暴虐首脑。

192312245.name: Expunge: Tartarus: Normal
192312245.name_zh: 删除：塔耳塔罗斯: 普通
192312245.description: The architect of the Endless Night has routed programming directives deep within the Vex Nexus to a terminus domain where old code and abandoned terraforming projects are eradicated. Destroy the Oppressive Mind and collapse that domain.
192312245.description_zh: 永夜的幕后黑手将编程指令路由到Vex纳克斯枢纽深处的某个终界领域，那里是旧代码和弃用的地球化项目被销毁的场所。摧毁暴虐首脑，使该领域崩塌。

3075674397.name: Expunge: Corrupted Tartarus
3075674397.description: The Taken have infested what remains of the Tartarus domain within the Vex Nexus and wrested control of the Oppressive Mind. Return and destroy the Oppressive Mind once and for all.
3075674397.description_zh: 傀儡军团感染了Vex纳克斯枢纽的塔耳塔罗斯领域残余，并控制了暴虐首脑。返回那里彻底摧毁暴虐首脑。

3867969864.name: Expunge: Delphi
3867969864.description: Hidden within a corrupted core of the Vex Nexus lies the domain of Quria, Blade Transform, the Dreaming Mind. This Taken agent of Savathûn, the Witch Queen, is the architect behind the Endless Night. Destroy Quria and save the Last City.
3867969864.description_zh: 幽梦思维“剑灵”奎利娅的领域隐藏在Vex纳克斯枢纽的腐化核心内。她是巫妖女王萨瓦图恩的傀儡军团代理人，也是永夜的幕后黑手。摧毁奎利娅，解救圣城。

2178562902.name: Astral Alignment: Normal
2178562902.description: Charge your Wayfinder's Compass and reawaken ancient Ley Lines throughout the Dreaming City. Seal your accomplishments by defending the Blind Well from Xivu Arath's encroaching forces.
2178562902.description_zh: 给你的寻迹者罗盘充能，唤醒遍布幽梦之城的古代灵脉。抵御希乌阿拉斯对盲目之井的侵袭，捍卫你的成果。

2394302500.name: Astral Alignment: Legend
2394302500.description: Charge your Wayfinder's Compass and reawaken ancient Ley Lines throughout the Dreaming City. Seal your accomplishments by defending the Blind Well from Xivu Arath's encroaching forces.
2394302500.description_zh: 给你的寻迹者罗盘充能，唤醒遍布幽梦之城的古代灵脉。抵御希乌阿拉斯对盲目之井的侵袭，捍卫你的成果。

25668234.name: Exorcism
25668234.description: Fight your way to the Spire of Exorcism and defend Mara Sov as she extracts the Witch Queen's worm. Repel Xivu Arath's ferocious attempts to invade the Dreaming City and interrupt the ritual.
25668234.description_zh: 一路打到驱魔尖塔，并在玛拉·索维取出巫妖女王的蠕虫时保护她。击退希乌阿拉斯对幽梦之城的猛攻，防止她打断仪式。

488873878.name: Shattered Realm: Forest of Echoes: Normal

1502633527.description_zh: 守护者的家园，你可以在此集结、重整并铸就新的联盟，然后继续踏上征程。

3434499700.name: Initiation
3434499700.description: Locate the entrance to the Black Armory.
3434499700.description_zh: 找到黑色军械库的入口。

2639045396.name: Scourge of the Armory
2639045396.description:
Siviks's syndicate, the Kell's Scourge, is fearless and growing fast. The Fallen are distributing his tainted Black Armory gear everywhere.

Track the origin of the tainted gear by investigating Fallen caches in the EDZ.
2639045396.description_zh:
斯威克斯辛迪加，凯尔的祸根，无所畏惧且发展迅速。堕落者正四下发放他那些被污染的装备。

调查欧洲无人区中的堕落者缓存箱，追查被污染装备的来源。

1134562791.name: Origin: Nessus
1134562791.description:
Kell's Scourge operatives intercepted on Nessus revealed Siviks's center of operations here on Nessus.

Investigate Siviks's center of operations to track the origin of the tainted Black Armory gear.
1134562791.description_zh:
在涅索斯上截获的凯尔的祸根行动特工暴露了涅索斯上斯威克斯指挥中心的位置。

调查斯威克斯的指挥中心，追查被污染的黑色军械库装备来源。

2604307096.name: Another Lost Forge
2604307096.description:
The scan of Siviks's Black Armory crates revealed the true origin of the tainted gear: a second Black Armory forge.

Explore an uncharted location on Nessus and locate the lost forge.
2604307096.description_zh:
对斯威克斯黑色军械库箱子的扫描结果显示，被污染装备的真正来源是另一个黑色军械库锻炉。

在涅索斯上探索未知的地区，并找到丢失的锻炉。

606484622.name: Black Armory signature
606484622.description:
The source of the Vex transponder signal has been located.

Go to this unexplored area of Nessus and track the signal that is using a Black Armory signature.
606484622.description_zh:
Vex应答器的信号来源已经找到了。

前往这个未经探索的涅索斯地区，追踪使用了黑色军械库特征的信号。

3641102502.name: Refurbished Izanami Igniter
3641102502.description: Survive waves of Vex while collecting energy.
3641102502.description_zh: 在收集能量时顶住Vex的连绵攻势。

3614852628.name: Repair the Izanami Igniter
3614852628.description: Complete this advanced version of "The Insight Terminus" and collect a Cabal component from the boss to fully repair the Izanami igniter.
3614852628.description_zh: 完成进阶版“洞悉终界”，从首领身上收集一个卡巴尔组件来完成对伊弉冉尊点火器的修复。

855989781.name: Reignite the Izanami Forge
855989781.name_zh: 重新点燃伊邪那美锻炉
855989781.description: Now that the igniter is fully repaired, use it to reignite the Izanami Forge.
855989781.description_zh: 现在点火器已被完全修复，利用它来重新点燃伊邪那美锻炉。

1431348899.name: Unidentified Frame: The Pyramidion
1431348899.name_zh: 不明确的模型: 金字塔
1431348899.description: Complete the strike "The Pyramidion" to collect Radiant Phaseglass for the Unidentified Frame.
1431348899.description_zh: 完成打击“金字塔”以为不明确的模型收集辐射相位琉璃。

2375911307.name: Unidentified Radiant Frame
2375911307.description:
The Unidentified Radiant Frame needs to be crafted in the Bergusia Forge.

Complete the quest "Lock and Key" in the EDZ.
2375911307.description_zh:
需要在柏尔古希亚锻炉中制造不明确的辐射模型。

在欧洲无人区中完成任务“锁与匙”。

1367215417.name: Lost Souvenir
1367215417.description: The Antechamber requires a new passcode.
1367215417.description_zh: 打开前厅需要新的密码。

619321468.name: The Damnation
619321468.description:
The artifact is calling to something dark.

Uncover a dark ritual on Titan and stop the twisted ceremony.
619321468.description_zh:
这件神器正在召唤某种黑暗物质。

在土卫六上找到黑暗仪式并阻止扭转仪式。

3628257792.name: The Conversation
3628257792.description:
Enkaar, the Hive weapon master, is hiding in Hellrise Canyon in the Tangled Shore.

Hunt him down!
3628257792.description_zh:
邪魔族武器大师恩卡尔现在躲藏在纷争海岸的狱涌峡谷中。

去追捕他！

3536651661.name: The Other Side
3536651661.description: Some bones live on after death.

158022875.name: European Aerial Zone
158022875.description: The Vanguard is dispatching Guardians to the EAZ for combat drills and meditation. Join them.
158022875.description_zh: 先锋正在派遣守护者前往欧洲空中区进行作战和冥想训练。去加入他们吧。

3840133183.name: European Aerial Zone
3840133183.description: The Vanguard is dispatching Guardians to the EAZ for combat drills and meditation. Join them.
3840133183.description_zh: 先锋正在派遣守护者前往欧洲空中区进行作战和冥想训练。去加入他们吧。

1199493030.name: European Aerial Zone: [Arc] Day
1199493030.description:
Arc energies crackle through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of ozone.

Equip your Arc subclass and weapons to generate Arc orbs, then collect them to become Arc Empowered. While empowered, Guardians move with enhanced speed, deal greater melee and Sword damage, and drain Super energy half as quickly.
1199493030.description_zh:
电弧能量在欧洲空中区劈啪作响，让空气中充满臭氧的味道。

装备电弧分支职业和武器以生成电弧光球，然后收集这些光球获得电弧强化。守护者进入电弧强化状态时，移动速度会加快、近战和刀剑可造成更大伤害，并且超能能量消耗速度减半。

770505917.name: European Aerial Zone: [Solar] Day
770505917.description:
Solar energies blast through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of sunbaked earth.

Equip your Solar subclass and weapons to generate Solar orbs, then collect them to become Solar Empowered. While empowered, Guardians emit a burning wave of energy.
770505917.description_zh:
烈日能量在欧洲空中区不断爆发，劈啪作响，让空气中充满焦糊的味道。

装备烈日分支职业和武器以生成烈日光球，然后收集这些光球获得烈日强化。在获得强化后，守护者会散发出一股燃烧能量波。

2429391832.name: European Aerial Zone: [Void] Day
2429391832.description:
Void energies pulse through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of potential.

Equip your Void subclass and weapons to generate Void orbs, then collect them to become Void Empowered. While empowered, Guardians can crouch to become invisible, gain Truesight, and enhance ability energy regeneration.
2429391832.description_zh:
虚空能量在欧洲空中区产生脉动，让空气中充满潜能的气息。

装备虚空分支职业和武器以生成虚空光球，然后收集这些光球获得虚空强化。守护者进入电弧强化状态时，只要蹲伏就可获得隐身和真视效果，及技能充能速度强化。

466447952.name: Destiny 2: Shadowkeep
466447952.description: New nightmares have emerged from the shadows of our Moon. Called forth by haunting visions, Eris Morn has returned. Join her to slay these nightmares before they reach out beyond the Moon to cast humanity back into an age of darkness.
466447952.description_zh: 新的梦魇自月球的阴影中浮现。受到挥之不去的幻影召唤，埃里斯·摩恩回来了。快来与她并肩作战，在梦魇自月球袭来，将人类文明拖回黑暗时代之前，把它们通通消灭。

2237396749.name: Vex Offensive
2237396749.description: Enter a portal to the Black Garden and fight on the frontlines of an ongoing battle against the Vex.
2237396749.description_zh: 进入通往黑暗花园的传送门，到与Vex的战斗前线参与战斗。

2999911583.name: Vex Offensive
2999911583.description: Enter a portal to the Black Garden and fight on the frontlines of an ongoing battle against the Vex.
2999911583.description_zh: 进入通往黑暗花园的传送门，到与Vex的战斗前线参与战斗。

1967175017.name: Vex Offensive: Final Assault
1967175017.description: Summon the Undying Mind from thousands of different timelines. Destroy it to secure the Black Garden and contain the Vex incursion on the Moon.
1967175017.description_zh: 召唤来自数千个不同时间线中的不朽首脑。消灭它以确保黑暗花园的安全并抑制Vex在月球上的入侵。

2090903475.name: Vex Offensive: Final Assault
2090903475.description: Summon the Undying Mind from thousands of different timelines. Destroy it to secure the Black Garden and contain the Vex incursion on the Moon.
2090903475.description_zh: 召唤来自数千个不同时间线中的不朽首脑。消灭它以确保黑暗花园的安全并抑制Vex在月球上的入侵。

2446907856.name: A Mysterious Disturbance
2446907856.description: Travel to the Moon and stave off the Hive resurgence alongside your fellow Guardians.
2446907856.description_zh: 前往月球，与你的守护者伙伴们一起延缓邪魔族的复苏。

4167922031.name: In the Deep
4167922031.description:
Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
4167922031.description_zh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

778535230.name: Beyond
778535230.description:
What secrets lie within the Pyramid? It sits in silence, waiting for you.

Head to the Enduring Abyss, past the Pyramid's warding, and find a way inside.
778535230.description_zh:
金字塔里面到底有着怎样的秘密呢？它就在一片寂静之中，等待着你的到来。

前往永恒深渊，穿过金字塔的结界，找到进去的路。

346345236.name: The Scarlet Keep
346345236.description: Investigate the recently erected Scarlet Keep and discover its dark purpose.
346345236.description_zh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

1296063136.name: Faculties of the Skull
1296063136.description: Eris Morn believes the Hive's wicked science can be turned against them. Help her investigate the Circle of Bones beneath the Moon.
1296063136.description_zh: 埃里斯·摩恩认为可以逆转邪魔族的邪恶科技来对付他们。帮助她调查月球地表以下的骸骨之环。

1396849690.name: Choir of the Damned
1396849690.description: Fight your way into the depths of the Circle of Bones, survive the Aria, and defeat the Deathsinger, Ir Airâm. Then, bring her skull to Eris Morn.
1396849690.description_zh: 一路杀入骸骨之环深处，在死亡之歌的咏叹调中幸存下来，然后消灭死亡歌者伊尔·艾拉姆。随后，将她的头骨带给埃里斯·摩恩。

4252456044.name: Vanguard Strikes
4252456044.description: The Vanguard seeks Guardians to undertake high-priority missions against the City's enemies.
4252456044.description_zh: 先锋寻觅守护者，去执行对抗圣城敌人的高优先级任务。

3879143309.name: The Scarlet Keep
3879143309.description: Investigate the recently erected Scarlet Keep and discover its dark purpose.
3879143309.description_zh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

1035850837.description: Descend into the heart of Io's Pyramidion and root out a burgeoning infestation.
1035850837.description_zh: 深入木卫一金字塔的核心，根除迅速发展的隐患。

4134816102.name: Lake of Shadows
4134816102.description: Stem the tide of Taken flowing into the European Dead Zone from beneath the waves.
4134816102.description_zh: 在暗中阻止傀儡军团涌入欧洲无人区。

4261351281.name: The Pyramidion
4261351281.description: Seek vengeance against the Vex Mind that corrupted Asher's arm.
4261351281.description_zh: 向腐化阿什手臂的Vex思维复仇。

2753180142.name: The Inverted Spire
2753180142.description: End the Red Legion expedition that's ripped open the planet's surface.
2753180142.description_zh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。

2971335647.name: Exodus Crash
2971335647.description: Purge the Fallen infestation of the Exodus Black.
2971335647.description_zh: 清除黑色移民号上的堕落者分泌物。

1679518121.name: The Arms Dealer
1679518121.description: Shut down the operations of an ironmonger providing weapons to the Red Legion.
1679518121.description_zh: 终止向猩红军团提供武器的军械商的行为。

1542611209.name: Savathûn's Song
1542611209.description: Delve deep into the Hive-infested Arcology in search of missing fireteams.
1542611209.description_zh: 深入遭受邪魔族感染的生态园区，寻找失散的火力战队。

2579344189.name: A Garden World
2579344189.description: Help Osiris cut back an out-of-control Vex Mind.
2579344189.description_zh: 帮助奥斯里斯削弱失控的Vex思维。

2684121894.name: Tree of Probabilities
2684121894.description: Contain a rampant army of Red Legion within the Infinite Forest.
2684121894.description_zh: 遏制无尽森林内一支肆意妄为的猩红军团军队。

3751421841.name: The Insight Terminus
3751421841.description: Break into the ancient Vex installation.

2248296964.name: Strange Terrain
2248296964.description: Defeat Nokris before he completes his ritual.
2248296964.description_zh: 在诺克里斯完成仪式前将其击败。

1317492847.name: Will of the Thousands
1317492847.description: Defeat Xol before everything is destroyed.
1317492847.description_zh: 在一切被毁灭前击败尸飕。

1134446996.name: Warden of Nothing
1134446996.description: Help the Drifter restore order at the Prison of Elders.
1134446996.description_zh: 帮助浪客复原长老监狱的秩序。

224295651.name: The Corrupted
224295651.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
224295651.description_zh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

955874134.name: The Hollowed Lair
955874134.description: The Fanatic has returned. Take him down and finish the job you started.
955874134.description_zh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

3813623455.name: Broodhold
3813623455.description: Eradicate a Hive infestation seething in the depths of the Tangled Shore.
3813623455.description_zh: 根除聚集在纷争海岸深处的邪魔族危害。

Match Game: Fallen

Champions: Overload, Barrier
1288602363.description_zh:
前往拾荒者巢穴并消灭盲目队长格莱萨克斯，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：堕落者

3792818796.description_zh:

元素匹配：卡巴尔

勇士：势不可挡，屏障

3792818799.description_zh:

Match Game: Vex

Champions: Barrier, Overload
265024475.description_zh:
前往阿菲克斯通道并消灭堕落思维的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：Vex

勇士：屏障，过载

265024472.description:

Match Game: Cabal

Champions: Barrier, Unstoppable
265024472.description_zh:
前往骸骨圣地并消灭加拉尔，逃亡者的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：卡巴尔

勇士：屏障，势不可挡

1552357266.name: Grove of Ulan-Tan (Legendary)
1552357266.description:
Head to the Grove of Ulan-Tan and defeat Qeldron, Keeper to retrieve Warmind Bits.

Match Game: Vex

Champions: Barrier, Overload
1552357266.description_zh:
前往乌兰-坦丛林并消灭监护者，奎尔德隆，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：Vex

勇士：屏障，过载

1352934668.name: K1 Logistics (Legendary)
1352934668.description:

Match Game: Fallen

Champions: Barrier, Overload
1352934668.description_zh:
前往K1后勤区并消灭凯尔尼克斯·重生的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：堕落者

勇士：屏障，过载

1411733329.description:

Match Game: Fallen

Champions: Barrier, Overload
1411733329.description_zh:
前往K1员工宿舍并消灭雷伊克斯，激励者的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：堕落者

勇士：屏障，过载

45113325.name: K1 Communion (Legendary)
45113325.description:
Head to K1 Communion and defeat the Nighmare of Rizaahn, the Lost to retrieve Warmind Bits.

Match Game: Fallen

Champions: Barrier, Overload
45113325.description_zh:
前往K1通讯区并消灭利扎恩，迷失者的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：堕落者

勇士：屏障，过载

921878495.name: Interference
921878495.description: Break Savathûn's assault and help Eris secure the Cradle.
921878495.description_zh: 破坏萨瓦图恩的袭击，帮助埃里斯保护摇篮。

3083820154.name: A Shadow Overhead
3083820154.description: Beneath the last place touched by the Traveler.
3083820154.description_zh: 位于被旅行者触碰过的最后地点下方。

4034557395.name: Homecoming
4034557395.description: The Last City is under attack by the Red Legion. It's time to fight back.
4034557395.description_zh: 猩红军团袭击了最后的城市，反击！

1658347443.name: Homecoming
1658347443.description: The Last City is under attack by the Red Legion. It's time to fight back.
1658347443.description_zh: 猩红军团袭击了最后的城市，反击！

1597801559.name: The Farm
1597801559.description: A refugee camp set up during the Red War for Guardians and non Guardians alike, on the outskirts of the EDZ.
1597801559.description_zh: 猩红战争期间，在欧洲无人区的市郊建立起了一座为守护者以及普通人服务的难民营。

3359466010.name: Spark
3359466010.description: While Hawthorne offers shelter to those who fled the City, a vision points to a long-forgotten place.
3359466010.description_zh: 一处被遗忘许久的地方，霍桑将此处作为逃离圣城人们的避难所。

2052289205.name: Combustion
2052289205.description: Hawthorne's waiting on the cliffs above the salt mines. Help her get the word out: we rally at the Farm.
2052289205.description_zh: 霍桑正在盐矿上方的悬崖上等待，帮她传话：我们在农庄集合。

3272002712.name: Hope
3272002712.description: Commander Zavala is building a resistance at a moon of Saturn. Make contact and join the fight.
3272002712.description_zh: 指挥官萨瓦拉正在土星的一颗卫星上组建一支反抗军。联系他并加入战斗。

3147707814.name: Riptide
3147707814.description: Without power, Zavala's resistance has hit a wall. Travel deeper into the Arcology and help them past it.
3147707814.description_zh: 没有能量，萨瓦拉的反抗军碰了壁。深入生态园区并帮他们通过那里。

2559514952.name: Utopia
2559514952.description: Venture deep into the heart of the Hive to retrieve a powerful Golden Age CPU—and make it out alive.
2559514952.description_zh: 冒险深入邪魔族核心地区，找到一个黄金时代的强大CPU并成功逃出来。

1490848577.name: Looped
1490848577.description: No one's heard from Cayde-6 since the Hunter took off for an uncharted world. Track him down.
1490848577.description_zh: 在凯德6号前往了一个未知世界后，就没人再听过这位猎人的消息了。追随他的踪迹。

2642769170.name: Six
2642769170.description: A crashed colony ship, an interspecies war... Cayde-6 got that adventure he wanted. Go save him from it.
2642769170.description_zh: 一艘坠毁的殖民飞船，一场种群间的战争……凯德6号终于得到了他梦寐以求的探险。把他解救出来。

2113712124.name: Sacrilege
2113712124.description: Since the loss of her Light, Ikora has many questions—and she's not leaving Io without answers.
2113712124.description_zh: 在失去光能后，艾可拉充满疑惑——在找到答案之前她是不会离开木卫一的。

2297638408.name: Fury
2297638408.description: Help Ikora use the Warmind on Io to learn more about the Almighty—and turn the tide of the war.
2297638408.description_zh: 在木卫一上帮助艾可拉使用战争思维了解更多万羿巨舰的信息——并扭转战争的局势。

3897198695.name: The Farm
3897198695.description: A refugee camp set up during the Red War for Guardians and non Guardians alike, on the outskirts of the EDZ.
3897198695.description_zh: 猩红战争期间，在欧洲无人区的市郊建立起了一座为守护者以及普通人服务的难民营。

2926767881.name: Payback
2926767881.description: Time for Zavala's grand entrance—finally attacking the Red Legion base in the EDZ head-on.
2926767881.description_zh: 萨瓦拉隆重登场的时间到了——终于要正面进攻欧洲无人区的猩红军团基地了。

938512773.name: Unbroken
938512773.description: Find Thumos the Unbroken and take the key codes he carries—by any means necessary.
938512773.description_zh: 找到不羁者苏墨斯并使用一切手段获取他身上的密钥代码。

1243390694.name: Larceny
1243390694.description: Break into the Red Legion base and steal the personal shuttle of Thumos the no-longer-Unbroken.
1243390694.description_zh: 攻入猩红军团基地并窃取“不济者”苏墨斯的私人飞船。

955852466.name: 1AU
955852466.description: The time has come to stop the Almighty. Board the ship, and shut down its annihilation weapon.
955852466.description_zh: 终于轮到万羿巨舰了。登舰并瘫痪其毁灭性武器。

553537971.name: Chosen
553537971.description: The Almighty is finished. Time to go home, save the Traveler, take back the City, and end this war. Be brave.
553537971.description_zh: 万羿巨舰的命运到此为止。回家吧，拯救旅行者，夺回圣城，结束这场战争。勇者无畏。

3828168919.name: Tower
3828168919.description: Home of the Guardians, where you can regroup, rearm, and form new alliances before venturing beyond.
3828168919.description_zh: 守护者的家园，你可以在此集结、重整并铸就新的联盟，然后继续踏上征程。

3105090879.name: Adieu
3105090879.description: The Red Legion has overrun the Last City. The Light is gone. You are powerless. Live to fight another day.
3105090879.description_zh: 猩红军团攻入最后的城市。光能消失。你无力抵抗。活下去，择日再战。

2351745587.name: The Gateway
2351745587.description: Osiris's damaged Ghost appeared on Mercury—along with a Vex army. That can't be a coincidence.
2351745587.description_zh: 奥斯里斯受损的机灵在水星出现了，一支Vex大军也随之出现。这肯定不是巧合。

1175770231.name: The Gateway
1175770231.description: Osiris's damaged Ghost appeared on Mercury—along with a Vex army. That can't be a coincidence.
1175770231.description_zh: 奥斯里斯受损的机灵在水星出现了，一支Vex大军也随之出现。这肯定不是巧合。

1057017675.name: The Gateway
1057017675.description: Osiris's damaged Ghost appeared on Mercury—along with a Vex army. That can't be a coincidence.
1057017675.description_zh: 奥斯里斯受损的机灵在水星出现了，一支Vex大军也随之出现。这肯定不是巧合。

1512980468.name: The Gateway
1512980468.description: Osiris's damaged Ghost appeared on Mercury—along with a Vex army. That can't be a coincidence.
1512980468.description_zh: 奥斯里斯受损的机灵在水星出现了，一支Vex大军也随之出现。这肯定不是巧合。

2279197206.name: A Deadly Trial
2279197206.description: Brother Vance says there's a Temple of Osiris in the EDZ where you can revive Sagira.
2279197206.description_zh: 万斯修士说欧洲无人区里有个奥斯里斯神庙，在那里可以复活萨吉拉。

1049899965.name: Beyond Infinity
1049899965.description: It's time to enter the Infinite Forest and find Osiris. Be prepared for anything.
1049899965.description_zh: 需要进入无尽森林寻找奥斯里斯了。做好应对各种状况的准备。

1426391278.name: Deep Storage
1426391278.description: Search the Pyramidion on Io for a map of the Infinite Forest to guide you to Panoptes.
1426391278.description_zh: 搜索木卫一上的金字塔，搜寻指引你找到潘诺普忒斯的无尽森林地图。

1002145272.name: Tree of Probabilities
1002145272.description: Now you know where to find the map of the Infinite Forest. Go and get it.
1002145272.description_zh: 现在你知道要去哪里寻找无尽森林的地图了。去找到它吧。

2199986157.name: Hijacked
2199986157.description: You need a Vex Mind to help you read the map of the Infinite Forest. Head to Nessus to find one.
2199986157.description_zh: 你需要Vex思维帮助你解读无尽森林的地图。前往涅索斯寻找思维。

1278641935.name: A Garden World
1278641935.description: Enter the Infinite Forest and steal the algorithm that will let you track Panoptes in the present.
1278641935.description_zh: 进入无尽森林，窃取可使你在现时追踪潘诺普忒斯的算法。

2276204547.name: Omega
2276204547.description: It's now or never. Enter the Infinite Forest and defeat Panoptes now, before the Vex future victory becomes inevitable.
2276204547.description_zh: 机不可失。现在，在Vex在未来取得胜利变得不可避免之前，进入无尽森林并击败潘诺普忒斯。

1194986370.name: Ice and Shadow
1194986370.description: A friendly Guardian has requested assistance on Mars. Help her investigate falling Warsats and battle a new threat.
1194986370.description_zh: 一位友好的守护者在火星上请求支援。帮助她调查掉落的战争卫星并与新的威胁进行战斗。

1021495354.name: Ice and Shadow
1021495354.description: A friendly Guardian has requested assistance on Mars. Help her investigate falling Warsats and battle a new threat.
1021495354.description_zh: 一位友好的守护者在火星上请求支援。帮助她调查掉落的战争卫星并与新的威胁进行战斗。

1967025365.name: Ice and Shadow
1967025365.description: A friendly Guardian has requested assistance on Mars. Help her investigate falling Warsats and battle a new threat.
1967025365.description_zh: 一位友好的守护者在火星上请求支援。帮助她调查掉落的战争卫星并与新的威胁进行战斗。

1166237584.name: Pilgrimage
1166237584.description: You've discovered the fabled BrayTech Futurescape. Investigate and search for traces of the Warmind.
1166237584.description_zh: 你发现了举世闻名的布瑞科技未来景象。调查并搜索战争思维的踪迹。

1419459505.name: Off-World Recovery
1419459505.description: You need something to draw out Xol. A fragment of the Traveler has been located in the EDZ. Recover it.
1419459505.description_zh: 你需要找些什么将尸飕吸引出来。欧洲无人区中有一块旅行者碎块。把它拿回来。

1926167080.name: Strange Terrain
1926167080.description: Enter Hive territory and find Xol's feeding ground. Draw him out and stop him before he can surface.
1926167080.description_zh: 进入邪魔族领地，找到尸飕的供养地。将他吸引出来并阻止他重返地表。

2718696427.name: Will of the Thousands
2718696427.description: Xol has surfaced and is attacking Rasputin. You're out of time. But Ana has one last plan.
2718696427.description_zh: 尸飕重返地表，并且正在对拉斯普廷进行攻击。你没有时间了。但阿娜仍有最后一个计划。

2249739266.name: The Reckoning
2249739266.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
2249739266.description_zh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

501703034.name: The Reckoning
501703034.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
501703034.description_zh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

1786054751.name: Premeditation
1786054751.description: Ikora's agents have reported unusual Taken activity on the plateaus of Io. Confirm the intel.
1786054751.description_zh: 艾可拉的特工报告称木卫一的高原上有异常傀儡军团活动。确认情报。

3410530777.name: Calculated Action
3410530777.description: Ikora fears that the Taken may have new leadership. Figure out what they're up to.
3410530777.description_zh: 艾可拉怕傀儡军团已经有了新领袖。查明他们在干什么。

2336998357.name: The Long Play
2336998357.description: The Taken are assembling a new army to march on the Vex Collective. It is essential to stop them.
2336998357.description_zh: 傀儡军团正在组建一支新的军队，向Vex集合体进发。务必阻止他们。

2291549972.name: Enhance!
2291549972.description: Devrim has spotted Fallen in the area that are behaving strangely. Find the source of the strangeness.
2291549972.description_zh: 德弗里姆发现了区域内举止怪异的堕落者。找到怪异情况的来源。

2776929937.name: Differential Diagnosis
2776929937.description: Search for any remaining trace of enhanced Ether in the region and destroy it before the Fallen rise again.
2776929937.description_zh: 在区域内搜寻任何强化乙太的残余痕迹，在堕落者苏醒之前予以摧毁。

3346345105.name: Experimental Treatment
3346345105.description: Search for the Fallen in charge of the enhanced Ether production and dissemination—and eliminate them.
3346345105.description_zh: 寻找生产和散布强化乙太的堕落者——然后消灭他们。

3304835347.name: Calling Them Home
3304835347.description: Hawthorne is broadcasting a message from the Farm to guide refugees there. Help her amplify it to reach the entire region.
3304835347.description_zh: 霍桑准备广播一条指引难民前往农庄的信息。帮助她增强信号，使信号能够覆盖整个地区。

1159314159.name: Poor Reception
1159314159.description: The Fallen are trying to block all communications in the EDZ. Find the source of the interference and shut it down.
1159314159.description_zh: 堕落者企图屏蔽欧洲无人区的所有通讯。找到干扰源并关闭它。

153537894.name: A New Frontier
153537894.description: Explore the European Dead Zone as Devrim provides support from the church.
153537894.description_zh: 探索欧洲无人区，德弗里姆会在教堂提供支援。

80726883.name: O Captain
80726883.description_zh: 在涅索斯上完成任务“哦，船长”。

1428050875.name: My Captain
1428050875.description_zh: 在涅索斯上完成任务“我的船长”。

2307090074.name: Signal Light
2307090074.description: Locate the source of the familiar signal inside the Infinite Forest.
2307090074.description_zh: 找到无尽森林中类似信号的来源。

1725302079.name: The Up and Up
1725302079.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
1725302079.description_zh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

1823921651.name: The Up and Up
1823921651.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
1823921651.description_zh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

1279862229.name: Bug in the System
1279862229.description: Corrupt a Vex data-harvesting operation by withstanding an onslaught of Hive.
1279862229.description_zh: 通过抵御一次邪魔族的猛攻来破坏一次Vex的数据收集行动。

2675435236.name: Bug in the System
2675435236.description: Corrupt a Vex data-harvesting operation by withstanding an onslaught of Hive.
2675435236.description_zh: 通过抵御一次邪魔族的猛攻来破坏一次Vex的数据收集行动。

1570598249.name: The Runner
1570598249.description: Stop a Cabal simulation carrying heavily encrypted data.
1570598249.description_zh: 阻止一次带有高度加密数据的卡巴尔模拟。

1418217191.name: The Up and Up (Heroic)
1418217191.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
1418217191.description_zh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

3920569453.description_zh: 通过抵御一次邪魔族的猛攻来破坏一次Vex的数据收集行动。

3370527053.description_zh: 阻止一次带有高度加密数据的卡巴尔模拟。

1987624188.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
1987624188.description_zh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

3248193378.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
3248193378.description_zh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

1874578888.description: Corrupt a Vex data-harvesting operation by withstanding an onslaught of Hive.
1874578888.description_zh: 通过抵御一次邪魔族的猛攻来破坏一次Vex的数据收集行动。

1740310101.description: Corrupt a Vex data-harvesting operation by withstanding an onslaught of Hive.
1740310101.description_zh: 通过抵御一次邪魔族的猛攻来破坏一次Vex的数据收集行动。

723733266.name: The Runner (Heroic)
723733266.description: Stop a Cabal simulation carrying heavily encrypted data.
723733266.description_zh: 阻止一次带有高度加密数据的卡巴尔模拟。

2091731913.name: Legacy Code
2091731913.description: Investigate the blank spot in Rasputin's system memory.
2091731913.description_zh: 调查拉斯普廷系统记忆中的空白点。

3204449126.name: A Piece of the Past
3204449126.description: Return to Rasputin with the mysterious engram.
3204449126.description_zh: 带着神秘的记忆水晶回去找拉斯普廷。

2752743635.name: Hephaestus (Heroic)
2752743635.description: Destroy dangerous information before it falls into the wrong hands.
2752743635.description_zh: 在危险信息落入敌手之前销毁它。

1682036469.name: Deathly Tremors (Heroic)
1682036469.description_zh: 调查奇怪的邪魔族信号。

1202325607.name: Ice and Shadow
1202325607.description: A friendly Guardian has requested assistance on Mars. Help her investigate falling Warsats and battle a new threat.
1202325607.description_zh: 一位友好的守护者在火星上请求支援。帮助她调查掉落的战争卫星并与新的威胁进行战斗。

1202325606.name: Ice and Shadow
1202325606.description: A friendly Guardian has requested assistance on Mars. Help her investigate falling Warsats and battle a new threat.
1202325606.description_zh: 一位友好的守护者在火星上请求支援。帮助她调查掉落的战争卫星并与新的威胁进行战斗。

185515551.name: (Heroic) Invitation from the Emperor
185515551.description: Cayde's worried about a mysterious message drawing the Red Legion to a remote corner of Nessus.
185515551.description_zh: 凯德很在意某条将猩红军团吸引到涅索斯上某个偏远角落的神秘信息。

1671235700.name: (Heroic) Release
1671235700.description: The Vex appear to be capturing the Fallen, and Failsafe wants it stopped.
1671235700.description_zh: Vex似乎抓捕了一些堕落者，智能失效保险希望对此事进行阻止。

3664729722.name: (Heroic) Exodus Siege
3664729722.description: The Fallen prepare to attack Failsafe's mainframe aboard the Exodus Black.
3664729722.description_zh: 堕落者准备攻击黑色移民号上智能失效保险的主机。

785871069.name: (Heroic) Unbreakable
785871069.description: Failsafe has caught wind of Vex tech that could result in unstoppable barriers.
785871069.description_zh: 智能失效保险偶然了解到Vex拥有能够建造坚不可摧屏障的技术。

3042112297.name: (Heroic) Hack the Planet
3042112297.description: Ghost has a plan to interface with the Nessus core. But he'll need Failsafe's help.
3042112297.description_zh: 机灵计划与涅索斯核心连接。但他需要智能失效保险的协助。

856342832.name: (Heroic) Deep Conversation
856342832.description: Failsafe has a plan to retrieve Vex data. But she'll need Ghost's help.
856342832.description_zh: 智能失效保险计划取得Vex数据。但她需要机灵的协助。

2069143995.name: (Heroic) Lost Crew
2069143995.description: Help Failsafe find two long-lost members of her crew.
2069143995.description_zh: 协助智能失效保险找到两名失散已久的船员。

96442917.name: (Heroic) Red Legion, Black Oil
96442917.description: Destroy the dark liquid that the Cabal use to power their technology or contaminate it, for a subtler approach.
96442917.description_zh: 用一个巧妙的方法，破坏或污染卡巴尔用来驱动设备的黑色液体。

2245202378.name: (Heroic) Anti-Anti-Air
2245202378.description: Infiltrate the Red Legion base and disable their network of flak turrets.
2245202378.description_zh: 渗入猩红军团基地并关闭他们的高射炮塔网络。

1018385878.name: (Heroic) Dark Alliance
1018385878.description: Red Legion Psions are meddling with forces best left alone. Investigate their connection to dark forces in the region.
1018385878.description_zh: 猩红军团辅助士兵正在干预最好不要接触的势力。调查他们与区域中黑暗力量的联系。

999972877.name: (Heroic) Stop and Go
999972877.description: Power generators in the Red Legion base are open to attack—but only for a short time. Speed into the subterranean complex and shut them down.
999972877.description_zh: 猩红军团基地中的发电机暴露在外，但这情况不会持续很久。冲进地下建筑群关闭它们。

1018040791.name: (Heroic) Getting Your Hands Dirty
1018040791.description: Seize upon the Taken invasion of the EDZ, direct their assault against the Red Legion, and end it before it gets out of control.
1018040791.description_zh: 利用傀儡军团对欧洲无人区的入侵，把他们的进攻引向猩红军团，在事态失控前解决此事。

1333621919.name: (Heroic) Unsafe at Any Speed
1333621919.description: A nasty Fallen Pike gang is wreaking havoc in the area. Capture enemy vehicles and use them to even the odds.
1333621919.description_zh: 一队讨厌的堕落者派克正在该区域内肆虐。夺取敌人的载具并利用它们扳回劣势。

1302437673.name: (Heroic) A Frame Job
1302437673.description: Travel deep into enemy territory, ambush the Red Legion, and trick them into retaliating against the Fallen.
1302437673.description_zh: 深入敌军领地，伏击猩红军团，并把矛头引向傀儡军团。

2310677039.name: (Heroic) Calling Them Home
2310677039.description: Hawthorne is broadcasting a message from the Farm to guide refugees there. Help her amplify it to reach the entire region.
2310677039.description_zh: 霍桑准备广播一条指引难民前往农庄的信息。帮助她增强信号，使信号能够覆盖整个地区。

2831644165.name: (Heroic) Reversing the Polarity
2831644165.description: The Cabal tend to use a single technology to power everything in their arsenal. Take advantage of that design flaw to send them a message.
2831644165.description_zh: 卡巴尔倾向于使用单一技术驱动军械库中的一切。利用这点设计漏洞给他们上一课。

2340776707.name: (Heroic) Poor Reception
2340776707.description: The Fallen are trying to block all communications in the EDZ. Find the source of the interference and shut it down.
2340776707.description_zh: 堕落者企图屏蔽欧洲无人区的所有通讯。找到干扰源并关闭它。

993905880.name: (Heroic) Supply and Demand
993905880.description: An old friend is looking for Red Legion supplies to… reappropriate. Scour Fallen territory for anything to scavenge.
993905880.description_zh: 一个老朋友正在寻找猩红军团的补给，希望能够……重新占有。在堕落者领地寻找一切能够搜刮的东西。

3691789482.name: (Heroic) No Safe Distance
3691789482.description: The Red Legion base is full of explosives even more dangerous than usual. Find and neutralize them before they can enter the field.
3691789482.description_zh: 猩红军团基地充满了异常危险的炸药。找到并摧毁它们，以免它们出现在战场上。

3255524827.name: (Heroic) Cliffhanger
3255524827.description: Asher has information about the Vex's next conversion site, and he wants it stopped.
3255524827.description_zh: 阿什有关于Vex下一个转换站点的信息，他想要阻止转换的发生。

2219006909.name: (Heroic) Arecibo
2219006909.description: Investigate a mysterious broadcast that only you and your Ghost can hear.
2219006909.description_zh: 调查只有你和你的机灵才能听到的神秘广播。

3644215993.name: (Heroic) Road Rage
3644215993.description: Asher's worked up about Vex interest in the Io Vault. He's got an unusual suggestion for how to deal with the problem.
3644215993.description_zh: 阿什找出了Vex对木卫一保险库产生兴趣的原因。他用一种非常规的方法处理了这个问题。

449926115.name: (Heroic) Postmodern Prometheus
449926115.description: Ikora is reluctantly allowing Asher to explore a plan where he'd convert the Traveler's energy into a form of synthetic Light.
449926115.description_zh: 阿什想要将旅行者的能量转换为合成光能的形式，艾可拉无奈应允了他的研究计划。

801458995.name: (Heroic) Unexpected Guests
801458995.description: Ikora's worried about some Taken emanations from beneath the moon's surface.
801458995.description_zh: 艾可拉担心傀儡军团在卫星表面下的扩散。

1275562432.name: (Heroic) Thief of Thieves
1275562432.description: Recover the supplies that the Fallen have taken.
1275562432.description_zh: 夺回堕落者抢走的补给物资。

3033151437.name: (Heroic) Siren Song
3033151437.description: Disrupt a Hive Ritual to keep the Rig from sinking.
3033151437.description_zh: 干扰邪魔族力量仪式，防止钻井下沉。

319240296.name: (Heroic) Deathless
319240296.description: Clear out the Knight that's keeping Sloane's crews from their work.
319240296.description_zh: 剿灭妨碍斯隆手下工作的骑士。

3015346707.name: (Heroic) Bad Neighbors
3015346707.description: Resolve a dangerous conflict between the Fallen and the Hive.
3015346707.description_zh: 解决堕落者和邪魔族力量之间的危险冲突。

3069330044.name: The Hangman (Heroic)
3069330044.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Hangman off your list.
3069330044.description_zh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为刽子手的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

625165976.name: The Trickster (Heroic)
625165976.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Trickster off your list.
625165976.description_zh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为骗术师的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

1800749202.name: The Rider (Heroic)
1800749202.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Rider off your list.
1800749202.description_zh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为骑师的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

3601218952.name: The Rifleman (Heroic)
3601218952.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Rifleman off your list.
3601218952.description_zh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为枪客的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

2258680077.name: The Mindbender (Heroic)
2258680077.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Mindbender off your list.
2258680077.description_zh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为心灵操纵者的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

3143659188.name: The Reckoning: Tier I
3143659188.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
3143659188.description_zh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

3264501078.name: The Reckoning: Tier II

3753505781.name: Iron Banner
3753505781.description:
"There will come a day when the Tower falls again. Our ability to hold territory is paramount." —Lord Saladin

Capture zones to increase points for every kill.
3753505781.description_zh:
“终会有高塔再次倒塌的那天。我们守卫领土的能力至关重要。”——领主萨拉丁

占领区域以提高每次击杀所获得的点数。

2063575880.name: Doubles

2063575880.description_zh: 与队友并肩作战，粉碎对手。

1746163491.description_zh: 击败对手并夺走他们的纹章。

1276739382.name: Breakthrough
1276739382.description: Deploy the Breaker to expose your opponents' vault. Then, hack their vault to plunder it.
1276739382.description_zh: 部署突破者，暴露对手保险库。入侵并掠夺。

3243244011.name: Lockdown
3243244011.description: Seize at least two zones to make capture progress. Control all three for a Lockdown to win the round early.
3243244011.description_zh: 获得占领进度需握有至少两个区域。控制全部三个区域即可进行区域拒止，提前赢得回合。

1151331757.name: Showdown
1151331757.description: All-out team warfare. Revive a defeated teammate to steal back the point your opponents scored.
1151331757.description_zh: 全力以赴的团队战争。复活倒下的队友可夺回对手获得的得分。

1358255449.name: Crimson Days
1358255449.description:
"Your partner is your life." —Lord Shaxx 

Fight alongside a teammate and work together to crush your opponents.
1358255449.description_zh:
“搭档就是生命！”——领主沙克斯

与队友并肩作战，消灭对手。

3176544780.name: Control
3176544780.description:
"The key to victory is not simply capturing territory, but knowing exactly how and when to push your advantage." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by capturing zones and defeating opponents.
3176544780.description_zh:
“胜利的关键不是简单的占领地盘，而是清楚地知道在何时该如何将你的优势最大化。”——领主沙克斯

占领区域并击败对手，为英勇而战。

2303927902.name: Clash
2303927902.description:
"The Crucible is a strange thing when you think about it. We die over and over, that we may live in the end." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents.
2303927902.description_zh:
“仔细想想，熔炉竞技场其实挺奇怪的。我们一次又一次地死去，却只为在最后能活下来。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手，为英勇而战。

3780095688.name: Supremacy
3780095688.description:
"Secure those crests, and send a clear message of dominance to your opponents. Just don't forget to give them back after the match. We're not monsters." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents and securing the crests they drop. Recover friendly crests to deny them from opponents.
3780095688.description_zh:
“尽量多收集一些纹章，让你的对手清楚地知道你才是最强的。但也不要忘记在比赛过后把它们还回去。毕竟我们可不是怪物。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手并收集他们掉落的纹章，为英勇而战。回收友方纹章可以阻止对手获得它们。

1219083526.name: Team Scorched
1219083526.description:
"You've got a Scorch Cannon, they've got Scorch Cannons. Make a mess." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents using Scorch Cannons.
1219083526.description_zh:
“你有烈日发射器，他们也有灼烧发射器。去大闹一场吧。”——领主沙克斯

使用灼烧发射器击败对手，为英勇而战。

4209226441.name: Hardware
4209226441.description: Fight for Valor in large-scale combat scenarios.
4209226441.description_zh: 在一个大型战斗场景中为英勇而战。

952904835.name: Momentum Control
952904835.description:
"You've been capturing zones and destroying your enemies for a long time, haven't you? Let's pick up the pace a bit." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by capturing zones and defeating opponents. All weapons are more lethal, abilities replenish only on kills, and tracker is disabled.
952904835.description_zh:
“长期以来，你一直在占领区域和摧毁你的敌人，对不对？我们来把步伐再加快一些。”——领主沙克斯

占领区域并击败对手，为英勇而战。所有武器更加致命，技能只有在击杀之后才刷新冷却时间，追踪器已禁用。

1102379070.name: Mayhem
1102379070.description:
"Enjoy yourselves, Guardians. You've earned it." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents. Abilities and Supers regenerate faster. Heavy ammo spawns more frequently.
1102379070.description_zh:
“守护者，尽情享受吧。这是你应得的。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手，为英勇而战。技能和超能回复速度加快。重型弹药的生成更加频繁。

2304691867.name: Classic Mix
2304691867.description:
"To novices, the Crucible is filled with tough lessons. For veterans like you, it is a litany of lessons yet to be taught. Teach well, my friend." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor in a variety of game modes using connection-based matchmaking.
2304691867.description_zh:
“对于新手来说，熔炉竞技场充满了惨痛的教训。而对于像你这样的老兵来说，应该有许多值得教授给他们的东西。好好教吧，我的朋友。”——领主沙克斯

在各种游戏模式中使用偏好连接性的匹配方式，为英勇而战。

135537449.name: Survival
135537449.description:
"Outlive your foes, and there can be no possible outcome but victory." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Glory by depleting your opponents' shared life pool, then eliminating them.
135537449.description_zh:
“只要你能比你的对手活得更久，那么唯一可能的结局就是胜利。”——领主沙克斯

削减对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们，为荣耀而战。

740891329.name: Survival: Freelance
740891329.description:
"Outlive your foes, and there can be no possible outcome but victory." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Glory by depleting your opponents' shared life pool, then eliminating them.
740891329.description_zh:
“只要你能比你的对手活得更久，那么唯一可能的结局就是胜利。”——领主沙克斯

削减对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们，为荣耀而战。

1478171612.name: Elimination
1478171612.description:
"This is the ultimate test of your skill as a fireteam, Guardians! Make me proud." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by eliminating all opponents in this round-based mode.
1478171612.description_zh:
“守护者，这是对你作为火力战队技能的终极测试！别让我失望。”—领主沙克斯

为英勇而战，在这个回合制的模式中消灭所有对手。

3011324617.name: Breakthrough
3011324617.description:
"Deploying the Breaker makes a wager with your opponents. Don't let them call your bluff." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by deploying the Breaker and hacking the opposing vault or by defending your own vault.
3011324617.description_zh:
“部署断路器来跟你的对手赌一把。不能让他们认为你在虚张声势。”——领主沙克斯

部署断路器并入侵对手的保险库或防守你自己的保险库，为英勇而战。

3646079260.name: Countdown
3646079260.description:
"I hope the remaining Red Legion can see this: weapons they brought to destroy us, used as mere toys in training exercises. Do be mindful of the blast radius, though." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by detonating a charge, defusing the opposing charge, or eliminating all opponents.
3646079260.description_zh:
“真希望能让剩下的猩红军团看看：他们用来毁灭我们的武器，现在成了我们训练演习中的玩具。不过，千万要注意它的爆炸半径哦。”——领主沙克斯

引爆炸弹，拆解对方的炸弹，或者击败所有对手，为英勇而战。

1457072306.name: Showdown
1457072306.description:
"This combat drill will test you from start to finish. Stay on your game, lest you find yourself on the wrong end of the final showdown." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents and preventing revives. Win the most rounds or face off in an elimination showdown.
1457072306.description_zh:
“这次战斗演习将从头到尾地对你进行检验。小心别死了，不然你就有可能出现在失败的那一方了。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手并阻止敌人复活，为英勇而战。争取赢得最多回合，或在最终决战中取胜。

3239164160.name: Lockdown
3239164160.description:
"Hold your ground. Yield to no one." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by capturing and holding zones. Win rounds instantly by capturing all three.
3239164160.description_zh:
“坚守阵地。不要屈服于任何人。”——领主沙克斯

占领并防守区域，为英勇而战。占领全部三个区域将立即赢得回合。

740422335.name: Survival
740422335.description:
"Outlive your foes, and there can be no possible outcome but victory." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by depleting your opponents' shared life pool, then eliminating them.
740422335.description_zh:
“只要你能比你的对手活得更久，那么唯一可能的结局就是胜利。”——领主沙克斯

削减对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们，为英勇而战。

920826395.name: Doubles
920826395.description:
"Take risks and learn the art of war. You have one focus: The enemy must fall." —Lord Shaxx 

Fight for Valor in more focused combat scenarios.
920826395.description_zh:
“承担风险，学习兵法。你的专注点只有一个：敌人必须倒下。”——领主沙克斯 

在更专注的战斗场景中为英勇而战。

914148167.name: Rumble
914148167.description:
"It's you against the world. Make them remember your name." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents. No teams. No allegiance. A free-for-all where the leader had better watch their back.
914148167.description_zh:
“你一个人对抗全世界。让他们记住你的名字吧。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手，为英勇而战。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

3633915199.name: Crimson Days
3633915199.description:
"Your partner is your life." —Lord Shaxx 

Fight alongside a teammate and work together to crush your opponents.
3633915199.description_zh:
“搭档就是生命！”——领主沙克斯

与队友并肩作战，消灭对手。

2421741347.name: The Chasm of Screams
2421741347.description:
While you were speaking to Tyra, she mentioned something called the Hated Path, a sort of primer to transform an ordinary Hand Cannon into a Thorn. Bathe your Light in horrors. Feed your weapon with death. Bind it with sickness. Horrors, death, sickness… that all sounds like the Hive nests on Titan to you.

Defeat the Arbiters, Sardav and Telesh, then defeat Savathûn's Song in an epic reprise of strike "Savathûn's Song" on Titan.
2421741347.description_zh:
在你和泰拉谈话的过程中，她提到了一个叫做憎恨之路的东西，是一种可以将普通手炮转变为荆棘的引物。在恐惧中浸没你的光能，用死亡喂养你的武器，将它与疾病捆绑。恐惧、死亡、疾病……对你而言，这些听起来像是对土卫六上邪魔族巢穴的描述。

在土卫六上的打击“萨瓦图恩之歌”的史诗重奏中击败仲裁者萨达夫和仲裁者特莱仕，然后击败萨瓦图恩之歌。

1998911089.name: Dead Drop
1998911089.description:
The Jerky is dialed into a Fallen transponder somewhere on Titan. You'll need to pick up the goods in person to complete your errand for Drifter.

Complete a heroic reprise of adventure "Thief of Thieves" on Titan.
1998911089.description_zh:
肉干连接了土卫六上某处的一个堕落者应答器。你需要亲自前往拿取货物，完成浪客的差事。

在土卫六上完成探险“盗亦有盗”的英雄重奏。

3352425710.name: Looking for a Lead
3352425710.description:
Spider told you Drifter might be planning something on Titan. Aunor agrees it's worth taking a look around. Without any sense of where to start, you set a course for the Rig.

Complete a Heroic reprise of adventure "Siren Song" on Titan.
3352425710.description_zh:
蛛王告诉你浪客可能在土卫六上策划着什么事。阿诺尔也觉得应该去看看。由于毫无头绪应该从何处开始，你决定从钻井入手。

在土卫六上完成探险“塞壬之歌”的英雄重奏。

622895925.description: Investigate a mysterious broadcast that only you and your Ghost can hear.
622895925.description_zh: 调查只有你和你的机灵才能听到的神秘广播。

3500791146.name: Cliffhanger
3500791146.description: Asher has information about the Vex's next conversion site, and he wants it stopped.
3500791146.description_zh: 阿什有关于Vex下一个转换站点的信息，他想要阻止转换的发生。

1651979106.name: Postmodern Prometheus
1651979106.description: Ikora is reluctantly allowing Asher to explore a plan where he'd convert the Traveler's energy into a form of synthetic Light.
1651979106.description_zh: 阿什想要将旅行者的能量转换为合成光能的形式，艾可拉无奈应允了他的研究计划。

2949941834.name: Unexpected Guests
2949941834.description: Ikora's worried about some Taken emanations from beneath the moon's surface.
2949941834.description_zh: 艾可拉担心傀儡军团在卫星表面下的扩散。

1824067376.name: Road Rage
1824067376.description: Asher's worked up about Vex interest in the Io Vault. He's got an unusual suggestion for how to deal with the problem.
1824067376.description_zh: 阿什找出了Vex对木卫一保险库产生兴趣的原因。他用一种非常规的方法处理了这个问题。

1228327586.name: Anti-Anti-Air
1228327586.description: Infiltrate the Red Legion base and disable their network of flak turrets.
1228327586.description_zh: 渗入猩红军团基地并关闭他们的高射炮塔网络。

1971154629.name: Unsafe at Any Speed
1971154629.description: A nasty Fallen Pike gang is wreaking havoc in the area. Capture enemy vehicles and use them to even the odds.
1971154629.description_zh: 一队讨厌的堕落者派克正在该区域内肆虐。夺取敌人的载具并利用它们扳回劣势。

539897061.name: Reversing the Polarity
539897061.description: The Cabal tend to use a single technology to power everything in their arsenal. Take advantage of that design flaw to send them a message.
539897061.description_zh: 卡巴尔倾向于使用单一技术驱动军械库中的一切。利用这点设计漏洞给他们上一课。

3780356141.name: Stop and Go
3780356141.description: Power generators in the Red Legion base are open to attack—but only for a short time. Speed into the subterranean complex and shut them down.
3780356141.description_zh: 猩红军团基地中的发电机暴露在外，但这情况不会持续很久。冲进地下建筑群关闭它们。

1254990192.name: No Safe Distance
1254990192.description: The Red Legion base is full of explosives even more dangerous than usual. Find and neutralize them before they can enter the field.
1254990192.description_zh: 猩红军团基地充满了异常危险的炸药。找到并摧毁它们，以免它们出现在战场上。

122988657.name: Red Legion, Black Oil
122988657.description: Destroy the dark liquid that the Cabal use to power their technology or contaminate it, for a subtler approach.
122988657.description_zh: 用一个巧妙的方法，破坏或污染卡巴尔用来驱动设备的黑色液体。

320680002.name: Supply and Demand
320680002.description: An old friend is looking for Red Legion supplies to… reappropriate. Scour Fallen territory for anything to scavenge.
320680002.description_zh: 一个老朋友正在寻找猩红军团的补给，希望能够……重新占有。在堕落者领地寻找一切能够搜刮的东西。

2174556965.name: A Frame Job
2174556965.description: Travel deep into enemy territory, ambush the Red Legion, and trick them into retaliating against the Fallen.
2174556965.description_zh: 深入敌军领地，伏击猩红军团，并把矛头引向傀儡军团。

1829866365.name: Getting Your Hands Dirty
1829866365.description: Seize upon the Taken invasion of the EDZ, direct their assault against the Red Legion, and end it before it gets out of control.
1829866365.description_zh: 利用傀儡军团对欧洲无人区的入侵，把他们的进攻引向猩红军团，在事态失控前解决此事。

3002511278.name: Dark Alliance
3002511278.description: Red Legion Psions are meddling with forces best left alone. Investigate their connection to dark forces in the region.
3002511278.description_zh: 猩红军团辅助士兵正在干预最好不要接触的势力。调查他们与区域中黑暗力量的联系。

1956541147.description: Hawthorne is broadcasting a message from the Farm to guide refugees there. Help her amplify it to reach the entire region.
1956541147.description_zh: 霍桑准备广播一条指引难民前往农庄的信息。帮助她增强信号，使信号能够覆盖整个地区。

1265390366.name: Poor Reception
1265390366.description: The Fallen are trying to block all communications in the EDZ. Find the source of the interference and shut it down.
1265390366.description_zh: 堕落者企图屏蔽欧洲无人区的所有通讯。找到干扰源并关闭它。

1981289329.description_zh: 堕落者准备攻击黑色移民号上智能失效保险的主机。

1063969232.description_zh: 凯德很在意某条将猩红军团吸引到涅索斯上某个偏远角落的神秘信息。

4150577752.description_zh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯黑暗之眼。
