3805779101.description: Hunt down the wanted Combustor Valus that escaped from the Prison of Elders.
3805779101.description_zh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯燃烧者军政官。

2737374369.name: Trials of the Nine
2737374369.description: Enter the Trials of the Nine to face your fellow Guardians. Prepare to be judged.
2737374369.description_zh: 进入玖的试炼面对你的守护者同伴吧。准备接受审判。

3799743268.name: Trials of the Nine
3799743268.description: Enter the Trials of the Nine to face your fellow Guardians. Prepare to be judged.
3799743268.description_zh: 进入玖的试炼面对你的守护者同伴吧。准备接受审判。

719906507.name: The Third Spire
719906507.description: You have no idea where it is, but somehow you know exactly how to get there...
719906507.description_zh: 你不知道它的位置，但在某种程度上你知道如何到达……

2559374374.name: Pit of Heresy: Master
2559374374.description: Deep beneath Sorrow's Harbor, the Hive keep their darkest secrets.
2559374374.description_zh: 悲伤港口的地下深处，邪魔族保守着它们最黑暗的秘密。

3474760008.name: Worthy
3474760008.description: Provide tremendous support toward the Restoration effort and rekindle the Lighthouse to usher in a new age of Guardians.
3474760008.description_zh: 为修复工作提供巨大的帮助并重新点燃灯塔以引导新世纪的守护者。

2211843879.name: Sundial Spire
2211843879.description: Travel to the Sundial Spire to visit Osiris.
2211843879.description_zh: 前往日晷尖塔拜访奥斯里斯。

1406685380.name: Exploring the Corridors of Time
1406685380.description: You've saved Saint-14, but you've left the Corridors of Time largely unexplored. See what you can find.
1406685380.description_zh: 你拯救了圣人14号，但时间走廊的大部分地方仍未探索。看看你能有何发现。

392815422.name: Disturbance on Mercury
392815422.description: Meet Osiris in the Sundial Spire.
392815422.description_zh: 在日晷尖塔和奥斯里斯会面。

2163254576.name: Corridors of Time Part 1
2163254576.description: Use the Sundial to travel back in time and attempt the impossible: saving Saint-14.
2163254576.description_zh: 使用日晷回到过去，完成不可能的任务：救下圣人14号。

189477140.name: Open the Gate
189477140.description: Open the Infinite Forest entrance to free Saint-14.
189477140.description_zh: 打开无尽森林入口以解救圣人14号。

1657533742.name: Corridors of Time Part 2
1657533742.description: The Sundial is ready for another time jump. Use it to travel back to the coordinates broadcast to you by the Perfect Paradox Shotgun.
1657533742.description_zh: 日晷已经准备好进行下一次时间跃迁。用日晷回到完美悖论霰弹枪所发给你的坐标。

787912925.name: The Sundial: Normal
787912925.description: Stop the Cabal from rewriting history and laying claim to the future.
787912925.description_zh: 阻止卡巴尔改写历史以夺回未来的阴谋。

3611556688.name: The Sundial: Legend
3611556688.description: Stop the Cabal from rewriting history and laying claim to the future.
3611556688.description_zh: 阻止卡巴尔改写历史以夺回未来的阴谋。

537912098.name: More Strange Offers
537912098.title: More Strange Offers
537912098.description: Xûr comes and goes freely, his strange curios eagerly sought by adventurous Guardians.
537912098.description_zh: 仄来去自如，爱冒险的守护者们热切搜寻着他的奇珍异宝。

919809084.name: Eva Levante
919809084.title: Event Vendor
919809084.description: No longer an outfitter for heroes of the Tower, Eva now devotes her time to making sure Guardians enjoy seasonal events.
919809084.description_zh: 伊娃已经不再是高塔英雄们的服装商人，她现在致力于让守护者们享受季节性活动。

1940559404.name: Book of the Forgotten
1940559404.title: Haunted Tome
1940559404.description: A tattered book filled with lost legends and forgotten folklore.
1940559404.description_zh: 一本写满失落传说和被遗忘的民间故事的破旧书籍。

1990023985.name: Ada-1
1990023985.title: Armor Synthesis
1990023985.description: Advanced Prototype Exo and warden of the Black Armory.
1990023985.description_zh: 高级原型Exo和黑色军械库守卫。

3982706173.name: Asher Mir
3982706173.title: Fragmented Researcher
3982706173.description: Left scarred by his encounter with the Vex, the irascible Asher Mir holds Io for the Vanguard... and science.
3982706173.description_zh: 在与Vex的遭遇中留下了累累伤痕，急躁的阿什·米尔为先锋们占据木卫一……也为了科学。

396892126.name: Devrim Kay
396892126.title: Dead Zone Scout
396892126.description: Ever the gentleman sniper, Devrim Kay holds fast in the wilds of the EDZ.
396892126.description_zh: 曾是名绅士狙击手，德弗里姆·卡伊坚守在欧洲无人区的野外。

3347378076.name: Suraya Hawthorne
3347378076.title: Clan Steward
3347378076.description: Once a wanderer beyond the City, Suraya Hawthorne now acts as a liaison between humanity and the Guardians.
3347378076.description_zh: 曾经圣城外的羁客，苏拉娅·霍桑现在是人类和守护者之间的联系人。

3466008634.name: Arcite 99-40
3466008634.title: Crucible Gunsmith
3466008634.description: Once a champion of the Red Jack frames, Arcite now serves Shaxx and Dahlia as an aide-de-camp.
3466008634.description_zh: 曾经红桃杰克机械仆从中的一位勇士，阿赛特现在作为副官为沙克斯和大丽菊服务。

1748437699.name: Tyra Karn
1748437699.title: Cryptarch Archivist
1748437699.description: A historian and Cryptarch, Tyra Karn decodes engrams and seeks the treasures of humanity's past.
1748437699.description_zh: 作为一名历史学家和解密大师，泰拉·卡恩解码记忆水晶，寻找旧时人类文明的宝藏。

1062861569.name: Sloane
1062861569.title: Field Commander
1062861569.description: A veteran of many battlefields, Sloane oversees operations on Titan.
1062861569.description_zh: 战地老兵，斯隆负责监督土卫六上的行动。

1265988377.name: Benedict 99-40
1265988377.title: Emperor's Advocate
1265988377.description: x#4(_ This maintenance frame is *amp;_ eager to assist you with #*amp; TREASURES FROM THE EMPEROR.  x#9(_
1265988377.description_zh: x#4(_此维护机械仆从*amp;_渴望帮助您#*amp;如果您有帝王的宝藏。x#9(_

3161908920.name: Kadi 55-30
3161908920.title: Postmaster
3161908920.description: Postmaster Frames dutifully oversee deliveries, messages, and lost items.
3161908920.description_zh: 邮递、消息和丢失的物品由邮政长机械仆从管理。

1846565192.name: Darbi 55-30
1846565192.title: Postmaster
1846565192.description: Postmaster Frames dutifully oversee deliveries, messages, and lost items.
1846565192.description_zh: 邮递、消息和丢失的物品由邮政长机械仆从管理。

1576276905.name: Failsafe
1576276905.title: Exodus Black AI
1576276905.description: Survivor of a crashed Golden Age colony ship, the AI Failsafe acts as a guide to the Vex-haunted wastes of Nessus.
1576276905.description_zh: 坠毁的黄金时代移民舰船幸存者，在Vex经常出没的涅索斯废墟中，人工智能智能失效保险一直作为向导而存在。

1303210083.name: Cayde-6
1303210083.title: Hunter Vanguard
1303210083.description: The freewheeling Cayde-6 outfits and "advises" Hunters as their Vanguard.
1303210083.description_zh: 无忧无虑的凯德6号作为先锋为猎人提供装备及“建议”。

69482069.name: Commander Zavala
69482069.title: Titan Vanguard
69482069.description: The resolute Commander Zavala advises Guardians on all Vanguard-related activities.
69482069.description_zh: 坚定的指挥官萨瓦拉会为所有与先锋相关的守护者活动提供建议。

1976548992.name: Ikora Rey
1976548992.title: Warlock Vanguard
1976548992.description: The wise Ikora Rey aids and advises Guardians in the protection of humanity and beyond.
1976548992.description_zh: 睿智的艾可拉·蕾伊会协助守护者并提供建议，帮助你们守护人类和其他种族。

3603221665.name: Lord Shaxx
3603221665.title: Crucible Handler
3603221665.description: The Crucible is the arena in which Guardians forge their Light. Lord Shaxx is the Crucible.
3603221665.description_zh: 熔炉竞技场是守护者磨砺光能的场所。领主沙克斯是熔炉竞技场的负责人。

2255782930.name: Master Rahool
2255782930.title: Cryptarch
2255782930.description: A senior representative of the Cryptarchy, Master Rahool decodes engrams and seeks the treasures of humanity's past.
2255782930.description_zh: 高级解密大师，拉乎尔大师解码记忆水晶，寻找旧时人类文明的宝藏。

3354631265.name: Arach Jalaal
3354631265.title: Dead Orbit
3354631265.description: Dead Orbit believes the fate of Earth is sealed. Arach Jalaal accepts all comers willing to fight in their name.
3354631265.description_zh: 死亡轨道认为地球的命运已经被封印。蛛族杰尔拉欢迎所有以死亡轨道之名而战的前来者。

2260557667.name: Lakshmi-2
2260557667.title: Future War Cult
2260557667.description: Readying for the battles to come, Lakshmi of Future War Cult is happy to accept any who would bear their mark.
2260557667.description_zh: 随时为即将到来的战斗做好准备，未来战争狂热者拉克希米很乐意接受带有印记的守护者们。

672118013.name: Banshee-44
672118013.title: Gunsmith
672118013.description: Banshee-44 has lived many lives. As master weaponsmith for the Tower, he supplies Guardians with only the best.
672118013.description_zh: 班西-44经历过许多次不同人生。作为高塔的武器大师，他只为守护者提供最棒的武器。

895295461.name: Valus Saladin
895295461.title: Iron Banner
895295461.description: Saladin Forge, the last surviving Iron Lord and Valus of Caiatl's empire, oversees the Iron Banner event: trial by combat where only the strongest survive.
895295461.description_zh: 作为钢铁领主的最后一名幸存者和查厄托帝国的军政官，萨拉丁·弗吉负责铁旗活动：只有最强的守护者能存活下来的战斗试炼。

3819664660.name: Executor Hideo
3819664660.title: New Monarchy
3819664660.description: With the rise of a new Golden Age, Executor Hideo is ready to accept all who would wear the colors of New Monarchy.
3819664660.description_zh: 随着新黄金时代的崛起，执行者秀夫已准备好迎接所有身着新王派配色的守护者们。

2190858386.name: Xûr
2190858386.title: Agent of the Nine
2190858386.description: A peddler of strange curios, Xûr's motives are not his own. He bows to his distant masters, the Nine.
2190858386.description_zh: 一位奇怪的古玩商贩，仄的初衷不是为了自己，他是向遥远的主人玖致意。

460529231.name: Amanda Holliday
460529231.title: Chief Shipwright
460529231.description: Shipwright to the Tower, Amanda Holliday runs the Hangar like a finely tuned engine.
460529231.description_zh: 高塔船匠，阿曼达·霍利迪将机库运作得如同一台状态良好的引擎。

2398407866.name: Brother Vance
2398407866.title: Follower of Osiris
2398407866.description: A scholar and devout acolyte of the mysterious Osiris.
2398407866.description_zh: 神秘奥斯里斯的研究者和虔诚仆从。

1735426333.name: Ana Bray
1735426333.title: Warmind Crypto-Linguist
1735426333.title_zh: 战争思维密码语言学家
1735426333.description: Golden Age scientist and legendary hero of Twilight Gap.
1735426333.description_zh: 黄金时代的科学家兼暮光峡谷之战中的传奇英雄。

1841717884.name: Petra Venj
1841717884.title: Queen's Wrath
1841717884.description: A warrior of the Reef, Petra Venj puts duty above all else.
1841717884.description_zh: 暗礁的战士，佩特拉·万吉将职责视作高于一切。

1616085565.name: Eris Morn
1616085565.title: Bane of the Swarm
1616085565.description: Once a Lightbearer, Eris Morn descended into the Hellmouth of the Moon where she lost her fireteam, her Ghost, and her Light to the Hive.
1616085565.description_zh: 曾经的负光者埃里斯·摩恩在深入月球地狱深渊与邪魔族的战斗中失去了她的火力战队、她的机灵和她的光能。

3411552308.name: Lectern of Enchantment
3411552308.title: Harnesser of Dark Hymns
3411552308.description: A mechanism of the occult built by Eris Morn to harness even the most unstable of magics. Access the lectern to create gear using Nightmare Essences and collect bounties.
3411552308.description_zh: 一个由埃里斯·摩恩制造的用于支配最不稳定的魔法的神秘机关。在附魔台使用梦魇精华打造装备和领取悬赏。

765357505.name: Saint-14
765357505.title: Legendary Titan
765357505.description: A legendary hero and the former Titan Vanguard, Saint-14 disappeared into the Infinite Forest only to be later rescued by a fellow Guardian.
765357505.description_zh: 传说中的英雄和前泰坦先锋，圣人14号消失于无尽森林之后被一名同伴守护者救出。

3057459034.name: Spirit of Riven
3057459034.title: Paracausal Apparition
3057459034.description: A paracausal manifestation of Riven, the last Ahamkara. She can use Wishing Glass found in her lair to provide you with additional power.
3057459034.description_zh: 最后的阿罕卡拉——魅痕的超因果外显。她能用在其巢穴发现的许愿玻璃为你提供额外力量。

3020182142.name: The Crow
3020182142.title: Freelance Lightbearer
3020182142.description: The amnesiac Lightbearer once known as Prince Uldren Sov of the Reef.
3020182142.description_zh: 一名患有失忆症的负光者，曾经是暗礁的欧顿·索维王子。

1822093886.name: War Table
1822093886.title: Vanguard Operations
1822093886.description: A tactical hub used by the Vanguard to combat the system's greatest threats.
1822093886.description_zh: 一个先锋用来对抗星系最大威胁的战术枢纽。

1816541247.name: Shaw Han
1816541247.title: Vanguard Operative
1816541247.description: A skilled Hunter, Shaw leads fireteams on dangerous missions throughout the solar system.
1816541247.description_zh: 作为一位技艺精湛的猎人，韩潇带领着火力战队在太阳系内各地执行危险任务。

3431983428.name: Starhorse
3431983428.title: Paraversal Entity
3431983428.description: A mysterious, impossible horse. Starhorse's origins and motives are unknowable.
3431983428.description_zh: 神秘的不可思议之马。星马的起源和动机不得而知。

2531198101.name: Variks the Loyal
2531198101.title: Eliksni Rebel
2531198101.description: The formerly two-faced Fallen now serves as a faithful guide on Europa for Guardians and Light-bound Eliksni alike.
2531198101.description_zh: 这位原来的两面派现在成了守护者和向往光能的埃里克斯尼族在木卫二上的忠实向导。

4254652401.name: Exo Stranger
4254652401.title: A Link to the Future
4254652401.description: Burdened with the knowledge one can only gain from time travel, the Stranger is here to divert us from an inescapable dark future.
4254652401.description_zh: 背负着众多只能通过时间旅行来获取的知识，陌客到这里来的目的是让我们摆脱不可避免的黑暗未来。

1670274555.name: Evidence Board
1670274555.title: Investigatory Apparatus
1670274555.description: The Hidden's hub for intel on any and all Enclave investigations.
1670274555.description_zh: 隐秘者的情报中心，汇集了所有飞地调查的成果

1660659508.name: Ghost
1660659508.title: Your Light in Dark Times
1660659508.description: Your Ghost has been by your side all along. No matter what.
1660659508.description_zh: 无论怎样，你的机灵一直在你身边。

3352059696.name: Micah's Conduit
3352059696.title: Lost Ghost Analytics
3352059696.description: This machinery collates telemetry from the Pale Heart, tracks lost Ghosts, and is a comms relay for Micah-10 herself.
3352059696.description_zh: 此机器可收集来自苍白之心的遥测数据，追踪失踪的机灵，它同时也是米迦-10自用的通讯中继器。

2384113223.name: Fynch
2384113223.title: Conscientious Objector
2384113223.description: A Hive Ghost who no longer believes the Hive deserve the Light, Fynch has defected from Savathûn's followers in order to help humanity.
2384113223.description_zh: 芬奇是个不再认为邪魔族有资格获得光能佑护的邪魔族机灵，他为了协助人类而背叛了萨瓦图恩的追随者。

296729347.name: Special Deliveries
296729347.title: Terminal
296729347.description: Receive special gifts and rewards from various sources.
296729347.description_zh: 从各种来源获得特殊礼物与奖励。

3484140575.name: Quest Archive
3484140575.title: Terminal
3484140575.description: Kiosk to acquire old or abandoned quests.
3484140575.description_zh: 可获得旧任务或已放弃任务的终端。

3884814177.name: New Light
3884814177.title: Terminal
3884814177.description: Quests related to the New Light experience.

1099523204.name: Ritual Playlists
1099523204.title: Terminal
1099523204.description: Quests related to strikes, Crucible, and Gambit.
1099523204.description_zh: 与打击、熔炉竞技场和智谋相关的任务。

2776510816.name: Exotic
2776510816.title: Terminal
2776510816.description_zh: 与异域装备相关的任务。

4242059374.name: The Past
4242059374.title: Terminal
4242059374.description_zh: 与过去版本相关的任务。

4230408743.name: Monument to Lost Lights
4230408743.title: Exotic Archive
4230408743.description: Built in honor of those who sacrificed their Light to defend humanity. Created in collaboration with Cryptarchs to help Guardians manage armaments.
4230408743.description_zh: 为纪念牺牲自己的光能来守护人类的人而建造。与解密大师合作制造，用于帮助守护者管理武器。

272081343.name: Red War Exotics
272081343.title: Exotic Archive
272081343.description_zh: 《命运2》年1期间发布的异域装备

3298600270.name: Forsaken Exotics
3298600270.title: Exotic Archive
3298600270.description_zh: 《命运2》年2期间发布的异域装备

1854671592.name: Shadowkeep Exotics
1854671592.title: Exotic Archive
1854671592.description_zh: 《命运2》年3期间发布的异域装备。

2209308523.name: Beyond Light Exotics
2209308523.title: Exotic Archive
2209308523.description_zh: 《命运2》年4期间发布的异域装备。

1125969407.name: The Witch Queen Exotics
1125969407.title: Exotic Archive
1125969407.description_zh: 《命运2》年5期间发布的异域装备。

67760598.name: Lightfall Exotics
67760598.title: Exotic Archive
67760598.description_zh: 《命运2》年6期间发布的异域装备。

2996039207.name: The Final Shape Exotics
2996039207.title: Exotic Archive
2996039207.description_zh: 《命运2》年7期间发布的异域装备。

2779423129.name: Light and Dark Saga Exotics
2779423129.name_zh: 光明与黑暗传奇异域装备
2779423129.title: Exotic Archive
2779423129.description: Exotics released during Destiny 2 Light and Dark Saga.
2779423129.description_zh: 《命运2》光明与黑暗传奇期间发布的异域装备。

523199268.name: Fate Saga Exotics
523199268.title: Exotic Archive
523199268.description: Exotics released during Destiny 2 Fate Saga.
523199268.description_zh: 《命运2》宿命传奇期间发布的异域装备。

399563869.name: The Edge of Fate Exotics
399563869.title: Exotic Archive
399563869.description_zh: 《命运2》年8期间发布的异域装备。

1092954315.name: Legacy Gear
1092954315.title: Exotic Archive
1092954315.description: Seasonal weapons and armor that are no longer available from the original quests.
1092954315.description_zh: 已无法通过原始任务获取的赛季武器和护甲。

1521939433.name: Loom
1521939433.title: Armor Synthesis Device
1521939433.description: A matter programming engine, designed by Ada-1 using Golden Age schematics. Used to create Synthweave for Armor Synthesis.
1521939433.description_zh: 艾达-1利用黄金时代图纸设计出来的物质编程引擎。用于创造护甲合成所需的合成纤维。

2572415929.name: Monument to Seasons Past
2572415929.title: Seasonal Archive
2572415929.description: The Seasonal Archive offers rewards from prior Season and Rewards Passes. Acquire rewards with Chronologs, which are earned from the Rewards Pass or through purchase of an Archived Pass.
2572415929.description_zh: 赛季档案提供往期赛季及奖励通票的奖励。花费时序币获取奖励。时序币可通过奖励通票或购买归档通票获取。

1438051276.name: Lodi
1438051276.title: Emissary of the Nine
1438051276.description: Former DEO agent from pre-Golden Age Chicago, pulled through time to serve as Emissary of the Nine.
1438051276.description_zh: 来自前黄金时代芝加哥的前对外观察部特工，被玖从时间中拉过来担任玖的使者。

1986023360.name: Monument of Guardian Tenets
1986023360.title: Devotion, Bravery, Sacrifice, Death
1986023360.description: Celebration for the four tenets of the Guardians.
1986023360.description_zh: 纪念守护者的四大信条。

1021220385.name: Nimbus
1021220385.title: Cloud Strider
1021220385.description: The latest recruit in a long line of cybernetically enhanced protectors of Neomuna.
1021220385.description_zh: 众多接受智械强化的内欧姆那保护者当中的最新成员。

1413212512.name: The Pouka Pond
1413212512.title: Meditative Focal Point
1413212512.description: Explore Strand and the power it has to offer.

2592921209.name: Gear Attunement
2592921209.title: Conductor-Forged Communicator
2592921209.description: Activate to increase the drop chance of one piece of previously acquired gear for each encounter in "The Desert Perpetual."
2592921209.description_zh: 启用以提高“永恒沙漠”中每场遭遇战掉落一件已获得装备的几率。

400557438.name: Simulant Ansible
400557438.title: Conductor-Forged Communicator
400557438.description: A construct of the Vex allowing communication across the many layers of their network.
400557438.description_zh: 用于跨网络层级通信的Vex构造体。

1474045886.name: Altar of Relativity
1474045886.title: A sacred, liminal space.
1474045886.description: An artifact bridging Aionian science and spiritual belief.
1474045886.description_zh: 一件连接艾昂人科学与精神信仰的神器。

2529835827.name: Spider
2529835827.title: Eliksni Entrepreneur
2529835827.description: Unlike some of his Eliksni brethren, the clever Spider prefers to parley instead of fight.
2529835827.description_zh: 和他的埃里克斯尼族同胞不同，聪明的蛛王更倾向于谈判，而不是战斗。

3790213143.name: Tess Everis
3790213143.title: Eververse
3790213143.description: Tess Everis is an accomplished broker of stylish and highly coveted items procured from the City and beyond.
3790213143.description_zh: 泰斯·艾夫瑞斯是成熟的时尚买手，从圣城和其他地方采购令人垂涎的物品。

352010699.name: Aerial Support Terminal
352010699.title: Ready to load out.
352010699.description: Load up your ship with Renegade Abilities to give you an edge in the Lawless Frontier.
352010699.description_zh: 为你的飞船装载反叛者技能，在无序边界中占得先机。

3841830749.name: Tharsis Cantina
3841830749.title: Anything could happen here.
3841830749.title_zh: 在这里任何事都有可能发生。
3841830749.description: The crime syndicates of Mars gather here to plot against each other in their ongoing power struggles.
3841830749.description_zh: 火星的犯罪帮派汇聚于此，在持续不断的权力斗争中相互算计。

3262478067.name: Enforcer Rao
3262478067.title: Totality Division
3262478067.description: Imperium law enforcement local to Tharsis that has carved territory for itself among the Syndicates. Unofficially. They wield the same war-machines as the Imperium, and could offer those weapons to renegades who prove their loyalty.
3262478067.description_zh: 塔尔西斯当地的帝国执法部门，在各帮派势力范围之间划出了自己的地盘，不过这并非官方行为。他们操纵着与帝国相同的战争机器，可以将那些武器提供给为其效忠的反叛者。

332994435.name: Boss Riliks
332994435.title: The Pikers
332994435.description: A gang of Pike-loving free spirits with no sense of hierarchy or religion common with Eliksni. They'll accept anyone—as long as you're Piker material. Their mechanical prowess might prove useful.
332994435.description_zh: 一帮崇尚派克、热爱自由的埃里克斯尼族，与其他族人不同，他们没有等级或宗教观念。他们来者不拒——只要你是块当“派克组”的料。其机械造诣或许能派上用场。

1187345551.name: Zephyrus, Autonomous Mind
1187345551.title: Tharsis Reformation
1187345551.description: A group of independent Vex who broke free from Maya Sundaresh's Collective. Along with their individual sentience comes a unified obsession with aesthetics and random chance.
1187345551.description_zh: 一群脱离玛雅·桑戴尔什集合体的独立Vex。伴随自我意识觉醒而来的，是对美学和随机性的共同痴迷。

1499949918.name: Armorer Aghol
1499949918.title: Totality Division Quartermaster
1499949918.description: Totality Division quartermaster with a well-hidden soft spot for war beasts.
1499949918.description_zh: 总合部军需官，暗地里对战兽情有独钟。

1305220558.name: Mechanic Deoriks
1305220558.title: Pikers Quartermaster
1305220558.description: Piker Gang quartermaster. Good with a shock rifle. Better with a spreadsheet.
1305220558.description_zh: 派克组军需官，用震颤步枪很在行，做电子表格更在行。

1664442954.name: Reformancer Guzheng
1664442954.title: T. Reformation Quartermaster
1664442954.title_zh: 塔尔西斯革新会军需官
1664442954.description: Curious Vex unit serving as Tharsis Reformation quartermaster.
1664442954.description_zh: 一个好奇的Vex单位，担任塔尔西斯革新会军需官。

424914393.name: Renegade Abilities
424914393.title: Purchase and upgrade Renegade Abilities from the Totality Division here.
424914393.title_zh: 在这里从总合部处购买和升级反叛者技能。
424914393.description: Purchase and upgrade Renegade Abilities for use in the Lawless Frontier.
424914393.description_zh: 购买和升级可在无序边界使用的反叛者技能。

4195846091.name: Arms Week Focusing
4195846091.title: Use Combat Telemetry to acquire your choice of Arms Week gear!
4195846091.title_zh: 使用战斗遥测，获取你心仪的武器周装备！
4195846091.description: Use Combat Telemetry to acquire your choice of Arms Week gear!
4195846091.description_zh: 使用战斗遥测，获取你心仪的武器周装备！

444807002.name: Focused Decoding
444807002.title: Your Light in Dark Times
444807002.description: Focus Pale Heart Engrams into the weapons and armor of your choosing by using Focused Decoding.
444807002.description_zh: 通过使用聚焦破译，将苍白之心记忆水晶聚焦为你所选的武器和护甲。

1618576679.name: Forged in Fire
1618576679.description: Trophies from conquest in the Crucible.
1618576679.description_zh: 熔炉竞技场征战的记录。

131593566.name: Destinations: Red War
131593566.description: Trophies from the battlefields of the Red War.

2890730975.name: Destinations: Forsaken
2890730975.description: Trophies from the Tangled Shore and Dreaming City.
2890730975.description_zh: 纷争海岸和幽梦之城的记录。

3033829788.name: Destinations: Curse of Osiris and Warmind
3033829788.name_zh: 目的地：《冥王诅咒》和《战争思维》
3033829788.description: Trophies from your explorations across Mercury and the icecaps of Mars.
3033829788.description_zh: 探索水星和火星冰盖的记录。

2845546152.name: Destinations: Dreaming City
2845546152.description: Trophies hidden in the depths of the Dreaming City.
2845546152.description_zh: 幽梦之城深处隐藏的记录。

4182231867.name: Destinations: Curse of Osiris and Warmind
4182231867.name_zh: 目的地：《冥王诅咒》和《战争思维》
4182231867.description: Trophies from your explorations across Mercury and the icecaps of Mars.
4182231867.description_zh: 探索水星和火星冰盖的记录。

3653101661.name: Destinations: Curse of Osiris and Warmind
3653101661.name_zh: 目的地：《冥王诅咒》和《战争思维》
3653101661.description: Trophies from your explorations across Mercury and the icecaps of Mars.
3653101661.description_zh: 探索水星和火星冰盖的记录。

2243204240.name: Annual Pass: Jokers Wild
2243204240.description: Trophies earned through mastery of Gambit Prime and the Reckoning.
2243204240.description_zh: 在征服全盛智谋和大清算期间获得的记录。

268771181.name: Throne World Collector
268771181.description_zh: 在王座世界获得的成就。

1418003.name: Neomuni Souvenirs
1418003.description_zh: 来自海王星内欧姆那的战利品。

1087859471.name: Season of the Undying
1087859471.description: Trophies earned by defending the solar system via strikes, Gambit, the Crucible, Exotic quests, and the Vex Uprising.
1087859471.description_zh: 通过在打击、智谋、熔炉竞技场、异域任务和Vex暴乱中守护太阳系所获得的奖章。

1087859470.name: Season of Dawn
1087859470.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
1087859470.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

421362242.name: Season of the Worthy
421362242.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
421362242.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

909609058.name: Trials of Osiris: Veteran Disciple
909609058.name_zh: 奥斯里斯试炼：老兵门徒
909609058.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
909609058.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

421362243.name: Season of Arrivals
421362243.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
421362243.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

1082441448.name: Exotics: Red War
1082441448.description: Exotic trophies from the Red War.

3403286862.name: Exotics: Curse of Osiris and Warmind
3403286862.name_zh: 异域：《冥王诅咒》和《战争思维》
3403286862.description: Exotic trophies from Curse of Osiris and Warmind.
3403286862.description_zh: 《冥王诅咒》和《战争思维》的异域记录。

1425761064.name: Sacred Duty
1425761064.description: Trophies from the "Garden of Salvation" raid on the Moon.
1425761064.description_zh: 在月球突袭“救赎花园”获得的成就。

2364370869.name: Raid: Deep Stone Crypt
2364370869.description: Trophies from the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid on Europa.
2364370869.description_zh: 在木卫二突袭“深岩墓室”获得的成就。

298234659.name: Raid: Vault of Glass
298234659.description: Trophies from the "Vault of Glass" raid on Venus.
298234659.description_zh: 来自金星上“玻璃拱顶”突袭的战利品。

3863105619.name: Raid: Vow of the Disciple
3863105619.description: Trophies from the "Vow of the Disciple" raid in the Throne World.
3863105619.description_zh: 在王座世界突袭“门徒誓约”获得的成就。

3694809203.description_zh: 捍卫人类最后幸存者的英勇士兵，正在学习如何对抗多样且具有挑战性的敌人。

3694809200.name: Veteran
3694809200.description: A dependable and battle-proven fighter for the Vanguard who shows flashes of creative brilliance in any firefight.
3694809200.description_zh: 可靠而久经战斗考验的先锋战士，在任何战斗中都能展现出创造性的光辉。

3694809201.name: Defender
3694809201.description: An accomplished warrior who has bested many of the emerging threats to humanity and is now assembling their fireteam for the Vanguard's most difficult challenges.
3694809201.description_zh: 战胜了人类面临的诸多新威胁的成功战士，如今正在组建其火力战队，以应对先锋最艰巨的挑战。

3694809214.name: Elite
3694809214.description: These elite Vanguard forces have proven they can defeat humanity's most difficult challenges and are now taking them down, one by one.
3694809214.description_zh: 这些精锐的先锋战士已经证明了他们可以战胜人类最艰难的挑战，并且现在正在逐一击破的过程中。

3694809215.name: Vanquisher
3694809215.description: Leader and mentor to Guardians of all ranks, guiding through actions that inspire others.
3694809215.description_zh: 所有级别守护者的领袖和导师，通过激励他人的行动进行引导。

650947429.name: Exemplar
650947429.description: A force of nature on the battlefield and a shrewd tactical genius, one of the Vanguard's most trusted and capable agents.
650947429.description_zh: 战场上的自然之力和精明的战术天才，先锋最值得信赖和最有能力的特工之一。

650947428.name: Paragon
650947428.description: Exalted to all and a respected leader, their stories are of myth and legend. One would be lucky to meet one.
650947428.description_zh: 作为受众人尊崇爱戴的领袖，其故事充满了神话和传奇。遇上这样的人可谓三生有幸。

448445933.name: Acquire Riskrunner
448445933.description:
Complete the Exotic weapon mission "Spark of Hope" to obtain Riskrunner.

Exotic weapons provide unique effects and are a critical part of your Guardian's loadout. You can only equip one Exotic weapon at a time.

There are many different ways that Exotic weapons can be acquired, including by completing Exotic quests.
448445933.description_zh:
完成异域武器任务“希望的火花”来获得赴险者。

异域武器会提供独特的效果，是你的守护者军械装备中的关键一环。你一次只能装备一件异域武器。

获取异域武器有许多途径，包括通过完成异域任务。

1087296870.name: Masterwork Riskrunner
1087296870.description:
Once the Riskrunner catalyst has been obtained, open Riskrunner's weapon details and apply the catalyst to the weapon.

Upon completing the catalyst objectives, you will be able to upgrade Riskrunner to Masterwork.

Many Exotic weapons have catalysts, which grant new powers to the weapon when completed and applied.
1087296870.description_zh:
获得赴险者催化后，打开赴险者的武器详情，将催化应用在此武器上。

完成催化任务后，你就可以把赴险者升级为大师杰作。

许多异域武器都有催化。将催化应用在武器上并完成催化任务后，它们会赋予武器新的能力。

2586308559.name: Subclass Mastery Quests
2586308559.description:
Complete one of the Subclass Mastery Quests.

There are three quests:
"Taming the Storm" for Arc, "Exalting the Flame" for Solar, and "Into the Abyss" for Void.
They can be acquired from Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
They each reward an Exotic Armor piece related to your Light Subclasses.
2586308559.description_zh:
完成一个分支职业大师任务。

共有三个任务：
电弧为“驯服风暴”，烈日为“颂扬烈焰”，虚空则为“踏入深渊”。
这些任务可在高塔集市的艾可拉·蕾伊处获得。
它们会分别奖励一件与你的光能分支职业相关的异域护甲。

2759941394.name: Faction Unit Challenge Modifiers
2759941394.description:
Complete an activity with a Faction Unit modifier active.

Faction Unit modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Expert difficulty or higher.
2759941394.description_zh:
启用一个阵营单位修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以专家或更高难度游玩时，阵营单位修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

3546329660.name: Threat Challenge Modifiers
3546329660.description:
Complete an activity with a Threat modifier active.

Threat modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization.
3546329660.description_zh:
启用一个威胁修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

威胁修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

3395506002.name: Major Negative Challenge Modifiers
3395506002.description:
Complete an activity with a Major Negative modifier active.

Major Negative modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Expert difficulty or higher.
3395506002.description_zh:
启用一个主要负面修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以专家或更高难度游玩时，主要负面修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

4254887469.name: Surge Boon Modifiers
4254887469.description:
Complete an activity with a Surge modifier active.

Surge modifiers can be activated in the Boon and Event Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Expert difficulty or higher.
4254887469.description_zh:
启用一个激涌修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以专家或更高难度游玩时，激涌修改器可在行动活动自定义的“恩惠和活动修改器”部分启用。

325659769.name: Faction Drop Challenge Modifiers
325659769.description:
Complete an activity with a Faction Drop modifier active.

Faction Drops can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization.
325659769.description_zh:
启用一个阵营掉落修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

阵营掉落可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

1660995340.name: Vanguard Armory Assignment: Armor
1660995340.description: Earn the Armory Requisition I from the Seasonal Hub, then claim your armor reward from Zavala's Weekly: Vanguard Arms Rewards.
1660995340.description_zh: 从赛季中心获得军械库配给I，然后通过萨瓦拉的周常：先锋武器奖励领取你的护甲奖励。

3566925483.name: Vanguard Ops
3566925483.description:
Complete Vanguard Ops.

Navigate to the Vanguard destination in the Director and find the Vanguard Ops playlist and launch.
3566925483.description_zh:
完成先锋行动。

前往导航器的先锋目的地，找到先锋行动游戏列表并开始。

923676974.name: Complete Vanguard Bounties
923676974.description:
Complete Vanguard bounties in Vanguard Ops.

Vanguard bounties are a good source of Vanguard Ops reputation.
923676974.description_zh:
在先锋行动中完成先锋悬赏。

先锋悬赏是先锋行动声望的不错来源。

3071126945.name: Commendations
3071126945.description:
Commend other players in Vanguard Ops.

You can give other players commendations during the mission summary.

You can bring up the mission summary early by pressing  [Back] during the end-of-mission countdown.
3071126945.description_zh:
在先锋行动中嘉奖其他玩家。

你可以在任务概览期间给予其他玩家嘉奖。

你可以在任务结束倒计时期间按下[返回]，提前打开任务概览界面。

4041951726.name: Meet Lord Shaxx
4041951726.description:
Learn about the Crucible from Lord Shaxx.

You can find Lord Shaxx at the Courtyard in the Tower.

The Crucible is where Guardians hone their skills by engaging in player vs. player combat.
4041951726.description_zh:
从领主沙克斯处了解有关熔炉竞技场的信息。

你可以在高塔中的庭院处找到领主沙克斯。

熔炉竞技场是守护者们通过参与玩家对战来磨练其技能的场所。

3782030468.name: Meet Drifter
3782030468.description:
Learn about Gambit from the Drifter.

You can find Drifter at the Annex in the Tower.

Gambit is a 4v4 competitive co-op game mode. Collect Motes and bank them to summon a Primeval. First team to destroy their Primeval wins.
3782030468.description_zh:
从浪客处了解有关智谋的信息。

你可以在高塔中的附属建筑处找到浪客。

智谋是一种4v4的多人竞技合作游戏模式。收集萤光并将它们存放入库以召唤古昧。第一个消灭古昧的团队获胜。

1339111343.name: Pathfinder
1339111343.description:
Complete Pathfinder nodes.

You can view the Pathfinder from the Vanguard, Crucible, or Gambit Director screens.
1339111343.description_zh:
完成寻路者节点。

你可以从 先锋、熔炉竞技场或智谋导航器界面查看寻路者。

1011873769.name: Collect Weapons
1011873769.description: Increase the number of Legendary weapons in your collection.
1011873769.description_zh: 增加你收藏的传说武器数量。

2801866667.name: Collect Armor
2801866667.description: Increase the number of Legendary armor pieces in your collection.
2801866667.description_zh: 增加你收藏的传说护甲数量。

2719448085.name: Expert Difficulty
2719448085.description_zh: 以专家难度完成3项活动。

3798919535.name: Equipment Locked Activity Buildcraft Stake
3798919535.name_zh: 装备锁定活动配装风险
3798919535.description:
Complete any activity with the Equipment Locked Activity loadout restriction active.

Equipment Locked Activity can be activated in the Buildcraft Stakes section of Ops activity customization.
3798919535.description_zh:
启用装备在活动中锁定配装限制的情况下完成任意活动。

装备在活动中锁定可在行动活动自定义的“配装风险”部分启用。

2398814027.name: Ascension II
2398814027.description:
Equip gear to reach the 200 Power threshold.

Remember, you can improve your favorite items by infusing them with similar items of higher Power.
2398814027.description_zh:
穿戴装备来达到200能量门槛。

请记住，你可以通过向你喜欢的物品灌注更高能量的类似物品来提升其能量。

3445054902.name: Subclass Mastery Quests
3445054902.description:
Complete one of the Subclass Mastery Quests.

There are three quests:
"Taming the Storm" for Arc, "Exalting the Flame" for Solar, and "Into the Abyss" for Void.
They can be acquired from Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
They each reward an Exotic Armor piece related to your Light Subclasses.
3445054902.description_zh:
完成一个分支职业大师任务。

共有三个任务：
电弧为“驯服风暴”，烈日为“颂扬烈焰”，虚空则为“踏入深渊”。
这些任务可在高塔集市的艾可拉·蕾伊处获得。
它们会分别奖励一件与你的光能分支职业相关的异域护甲。

3493729662.name: Trials Introduction
3493729662.description:
Talk to Saint-14 to learn about Trials of Osiris.

Saint-14 can be found at the Tower in the Hangar.

Trials of Osiris is a weekly tournament where teams of three compete for prestige and rewards. Purchase a Trials Passage from Saint-14 and turn in completed Passages for extra rewards.
3493729662.description_zh:
与圣人14号交谈，了解奥斯里斯试炼。

你可以在高塔的机库中找到圣人14号。

奥斯里斯试炼是一项每周一次的比赛，由三人队伍来争夺声望和奖励。从圣人14号处购买试炼入场券，上交已完成的入场券可获得额外奖励。

456889159.name: Enhancement Materials
456889159.description:
Acquire Enhancement Prisms.

Enhancement Prisms can be obtained through various methods, including the following:

• Seasonal Hub rewards
• Rewards Pass rewards
• Ops activity rewards
• Rahool's material exchange
456889159.description_zh:
获得增强棱镜。

增强棱镜可通过各种方式获得，包括以下渠道：

• 赛季中心奖励
• 奖励通票奖励
• 行动活动奖励
• 拉乎尔的材料兑换

1204523806.name: Weapon Shaping
1204523806.description:
Unlock the ability to shape weapons at the Relic in the Mars Enclave.

Weapon shaping is unlocked by completing the first mission of The Witch Queen campaign "The Arrival" and progressing the quest "The Relic."

"The Arrival" mission and the Mars Enclave can be found in the Throne World.
1204523806.description_zh:
在火星飞地的圣物处解锁塑形武器的能力。

完成邪姬魅影战役的首个任务“到来”并继续推进追猎任务“圣物”，即可解锁武器塑形。

“到来”任务和火星飞地可在王座世界找到。

2032742280.name: Prime Engram
2032742280.description:
Earn a Prime Engram.

Prime Engrams are rare drops earned from Ops activities. Higher grades increase your odds.
2032742280.description_zh:
获取一个至高记忆水晶。

至高记忆水晶是通过行动活动获得的稀有掉落，高表现等级会提升获取几率。

2886819415.name: Vanguard Arsenal Assignment: Weapons
2886819415.description: Earn the Arsenal Credit from the Seasonal Hub, then claim your weapon from Zavala the following week from his Weekly: Vanguard Arms Rewards.
2886819415.description_zh: 从赛季中心获得军械库信用，然后在下周通过萨瓦拉的周常：先锋武器奖励领取你的武器。

3405246786.name: Seasonal Artifact
3405246786.description:
Obtain the current Seasonal Artifact.

Each Season provides a new Artifact. Learn where to acquire it from the locked Seasonal Artifact gear slot in the Character screen.
3405246786.description_zh:
获得当前的赛季神器。

每个赛季都会提供一件新神器。通过角色界面中已锁定的赛季神器装备插槽来了解获取途径。

2322748768.name: Seasonal Artifact Perks
2322748768.description:
Activate perks from your Artifact.

Artifact perks provide bonuses to your Guardian.
2322748768.description_zh:
激活神器的特性。

神器特性会为你的守护者提供加成。

516937237.name: Rewards Pass Rank
516937237.description:
Acquire ranks on any Rewards Pass.

Your Rewards Pass rank is increased by earning XP. Owners of the Rewards Pass get access to both the free and paid rewards tracks.
516937237.description_zh:
获取任意奖励通票等级。

你的奖励通票等级可通过获得经验值提升。拥有奖励通票的玩家可同时解锁免费及付费奖励路线。

52483109.name: Seasonal Challenges
52483109.description:
Complete Seasonal Challenges from the current Season.

Seasonal Challenges grant XP, Seasonal vendor upgrade currencies, Bright Dust, and other rewards. Seasonal Challenges are revealed weekly through the first 10 weeks of the Season.
52483109.description_zh:
完成当前赛季的赛季挑战。

赛季挑战奖励经验值、赛季商人升级货币、光尘以及其他奖励。赛季挑战会在赛季开始的头10周里逐周发布。

1956935310.name: The Invitation
1956935310.description: Complete the mission "The Invitation" on Kepler.
1956935310.description_zh: 在开普勒完成任务“邀请”。

1181788405.name: Expert Conquest
1181788405.description:
Complete an Expert Conquest activity from the Seasonal Hub.

Conquests can be found in the Conquests tab of the Seasonal Hub. These are challenging activities that will test you and your fireteam's capabilities.
1181788405.description_zh:
在赛季中心完成一项专家征服活动。

征服活动可在赛季中心的“征服”选项卡中找到。这些极具挑战性的活动将考验你和火力战队的实力。

488820863.name: Loadout Modifiers
488820863.description: Complete an activity with a loadout modifier.
488820863.description_zh: 启用一个配置修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

1929500594.name: Trade-Off Challenge Modifiers
1929500594.description:
Complete an activity with a Trade-Off modifier active.

Trade-Off modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization.
1929500594.description_zh:
启用一个险益修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

险益修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

1963631667.name: Difficult Threat Challenge Modifiers
1963631667.description:
Complete an activity with a Difficult Threat modifier active.

Difficult Threat modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Master difficulty or higher.
1963631667.description_zh:
启用一个困难威胁修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以大师或更高难度游玩时，困难威胁修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

3940929532.name: Expert Solo Flawless
3940929532.description: Complete an Expert Lost Sector solo without dying.
3940929532.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下单人完成一个专家遗失区域。

1459867496.name: Solo Expert Lost Sectors
1459867496.description:
Complete Expert Lost Sectors solo.

Each day, one Lost Sector is available to play on Expert difficulty. Completing it solo grants an opportunity for much rarer rewards, at a greatly increased combat difficulty.

You must complete the normal version of a Lost Sector to unlock the Expert version.

The most recent Exotic armor pieces can only be acquired through completing Expert Lost Sectors solo.
1459867496.description_zh:
单人完成一个专家遗失区域。

每天都会有一个专家难度的遗失区域开放。单人完成它可获得非常稀有的奖励，不过战斗难度也会大幅提升。

你必须完成普通难度的遗失区域才能解锁专家难度。

最新的异域护甲只能通过单人完成专家遗失区域获得。

1974782577.name: Expert: Gold
1974782577.description: Complete an activity on Expert difficulty and earn grade B+ or higher.
1974782577.description_zh: 以专家难度完成一项活动并获得B+或更高表现等级。

381822815.name: Platinum Grade
381822815.description: Earn a Platinum performance grade in any activity.
381822815.description_zh: 在任意活动中获得白金表现等级。

719795661.name: Masterwork: Weapon
719795661.description_zh: 将一件武器升级为大师杰作。

620611848.name: Masterwork: Armor
620611848.description_zh: 将一件护甲升级为大师杰作。

3477162220.name: Reward Packages I
3477162220.description: Earn Tier 2+ reward packages from Ops activities.
3477162220.description_zh: 通过行动活动获得2阶以上奖励包裹。

3993442471.name: Bonus Focus I
3993442471.description: Attain 5 Bonus Focus drops from Focus activities.
3993442471.description_zh: 从专注活动中获得5次加成专注掉落。

3199822344.name: Unstoppable Champions
3199822344.description_zh:
眩晕势不可挡勇士。

势不可挡勇士会发动猛烈的攻击并且只会受到极少的伤害。

眩晕他们，阻止他们回复生命值的条件是：

当你致盲他们；
当你悬停他们；
当你碎裂他们；
当你用点燃伤害他们；
用通过赛季神器特性获得眩晕特征的武器伤害他们。

1857238866.name: Barrier Champions
1857238866.description_zh:
眩晕屏障勇士。

屏障勇士受伤时会激活几乎无敌的护盾。

伤害屏障勇士护盾并眩晕他们，阻止他们回复生命值的条件是：

你处于焕光状态；
你的武器上有不稳定弹药；
你的武器上有瓦解弹药；
用通过赛季神器特性获得穿甲特性的武器伤害他们。

1447730027.name: Overload Champions
1447730027.description:
Stun Overload Champions.

[Disruption] Overload Champions move quickly and use their abilities frequently. 

You can stun them, preventing their health regeneration:

[Void] when you suppress them;
[Stasis] when you slow them;
[Arc] when you jolt them and trigger the chain lightning effect; and
[Headshot] when you damage them with a weapon granted the [Disruption] Overload Trait by a Seasonal Artifact perk.
1447730027.description_zh:
眩晕过载勇士。

过载勇士移动速度快，并且频繁使用技能。

眩晕他们，阻止他们回复生命值的条件是：

当你压制他们；
当你减缓他们；
当你震颤他们并触发连锁闪电效果；以及
用通过赛季神器特性获得过载特征的武器伤害他们。

2763346397.name: Seasonal Artifact Perks
2763346397.description:
Activate perks from your Artifact.

Artifact perks provide bonuses to your Guardian.
2763346397.description_zh:
激活神器的特性。

神器特性会为你的守护者提供加成。

3294690729.name: Dry Start
3294690729.description:
Complete an activity with the No Starting Ammo modifier active.

Activate the No Starting Ammo modifier in the Buildcraft Stakes section of activity customization within Ops on Master difficulty or higher.
3294690729.description_zh:
启用无起始弹药修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以大师或更高难度游玩时，无起始弹药修改器可在行动内活动自定义的“配装风险”部分启用。

1361786232.name: Match Game Challenge Modifier
1361786232.description:
Complete an activity with the Match Game modifier active.

Match Game modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of any Ops activity when playing on Master difficulty or higher.
1361786232.description_zh:
启用元素匹配修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以大师或更高难度游玩时，元素匹配修改器可在任意行动活动的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

277196180.name: Mastery
277196180.description_zh: 以大师难度完成3项活动。

1931287403.name: Pinnacle Ops
1931287403.description: Complete one Pinnacle Ops activity in Vanguard Ops.
1931287403.description_zh: 在先锋行动中完成一个巅峰行动活动。

345102470.name: Rewards Pass Rank
345102470.description:
Acquire ranks on any Rewards Pass.

Your Rewards Pass rank is increased by earning XP. Owners of the Rewards Pass get access to both the free and paid rewards tracks.
345102470.description_zh:
获取任意奖励通票等级。

你的奖励通票等级可通过获得经验值提升。拥有奖励通票的玩家可同时解锁免费及付费奖励路线。

3954661918.name: Seasonal Challenges
3954661918.description:
Complete Seasonal Challenges from the current Season.

Seasonal Challenges grant XP, Seasonal vendor upgrade currencies, Bright Dust, and other rewards. Seasonal Challenges are revealed weekly through the first 10 weeks of the Season.
3954661918.description_zh:
完成当前赛季的赛季挑战。

赛季挑战奖励经验值、赛季商人升级货币、光尘以及其他奖励。赛季挑战会在赛季开始的头10周里逐周发布。

646050121.name: Service of Luzaku
646050121.description: Defeat targets with Exotic weapons Service of Luzaku or Turncoat.
646050121.description_zh: 使用鲁扎库之役或叛贼异域武器击败目标。

3054129846.name: Ascension IV
3054129846.description:
Equip gear to reach the 300 Power threshold.

Remember, you can improve your favorite items by infusing them with similar items of higher Power.
3054129846.description_zh:
穿戴装备来达到300能量门槛。

请记住，你可以通过向你喜欢的物品灌注更高能量的类似物品来提升其能量。

3087438628.name: Exotic Arsenal
3087438628.description: Increase the number of Exotic weapons in your collection.
3087438628.description_zh: 增加你收藏的异域武器数量。

3492759654.name: Xenology
3492759654.description: Acquire and complete the Xenology quest from Xur in the Tower.
3492759654.description_zh: 领取并完成从高塔的仄处获取的异星学任务。

2729353711.name: Reward Packages II
2729353711.description: Earn Tier 3+ reward packages from Ops activities.
2729353711.description_zh: 通过行动活动获得3阶以上奖励包裹。

1505401247.name: Rewards Pass Ranks
1505401247.description: Acquire ranks on any Rewards Pass.
1505401247.description_zh: 获取任意奖励通票等级。

3550651722.name: Orders
3550651722.description:
Complete Orders from the Vanguard and their allies. Orders come in three tiers: Common, Legendary, and Exotic. Legendary and Exotic Orders provide additional progress.

Orders can be found within the Seasonal Hub. Completing Orders will earn you Payouts of the corresponding tier. Completed Orders will be refreshed—you may even get lucky and draw a higher-tier Order than the one you completed!
3550651722.description_zh:
完成先锋及其盟友发布的命令。命令分为三阶：普通、传说和异域。传说和异域命令可提供额外进度。

命令可在赛季中心内查看。完成命令即可获得相应阶级的报酬。已完成的命令会被刷新——你甚至有可能抽到比已完成命令更高阶的命令！

98902018.name: Seasonal Artifact Perks
98902018.description:
Activate perks from your Artifact.

Artifact perks provide bonuses to your Guardian.
98902018.description_zh:
激活神器的特性。

神器特性会为你的守护者提供加成。

2837907401.name: Master Conquests
2837907401.description: Complete all Master Conquests from the Seasonal Hub.
2837907401.description_zh: 完成赛季中心内的所有大师征服。

2626288361.name: Bonus Drops III
2626288361.description: Activate Bonus Drops to earn extra rewards once active.
2626288361.description_zh: 激活加成掉落，以在生效后获得额外奖励。

2577098962.name: Rewards Pass Ranks
2577098962.description: Acquire ranks on any Rewards Pass.
2577098962.description_zh: 获取任意奖励通票等级。

2053543131.name: Artifact Power Bonus
2053543131.description:
Increase your Power bonus from the Seasonal Artifact.

The Power bonus is increased by earning XP.
2053543131.description_zh:
提升来自赛季神器的能量加成。

能量加成可通过获取经验值提升。

304146543.name: Seasonal Artifact Perks
304146543.description:
Activate perks from your Artifact.

Artifact perks provide bonuses to your Guardian.
304146543.description_zh:
激活神器的特性。

神器特性会为你的守护者提供加成。

779608716.name: Ascension V
779608716.description:
Equip gear to reach the 400 Power threshold.

Remember, you can improve your favorite items by infusing them with similar items of higher Power.
779608716.description_zh:
穿戴装备来达到400能量门槛。

请记住，你可以通过向你喜欢的物品灌注更高能量的类似物品来提升其能量。

2931797275.name: Grandmaster
2931797275.description: Complete an Ops activity on Grandmaster difficulty.
2931797275.description_zh: 以宗师难度完成一项行动活动。

4188078030.name: Grandmaster II: Gold
4188078030.description: Complete a Grandmaster II activity and earn a Gold medal or higher.
4188078030.description_zh: 完成一项宗师II活动并获得黄金或更高等级奖牌。

1789666095.name: Matchmade Exotic
1789666095.description: Complete an Exotic matchmade mission in Pinnacle Ops.
1789666095.description_zh: 在巅峰行动中完成一个异域匹配任务。

1368161486.name: Beat Time
1368161486.description: Select the Beat Time modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
1368161486.description_zh: 选择分秒必争修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

3328949011.name: Revival: Champions
3328949011.description: Select the Revival: Champions modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
3328949011.description_zh: 选择复活：勇士修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

3473922880.name: Revival: Score-Based
3473922880.description: Select the Revival: Score-Based modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
3473922880.description_zh: 选择复活：基于得分修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

318748019.name: Galvanized Challenge Modifiers
318748019.description: Select a Galvanized modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
318748019.description_zh: 选择一个电镀修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

2547769407.name: Hunger Challenge Modifiers
2547769407.description:
Complete an activity with a Hunger modifier active.

Hunger modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customizations on Grandmaster difficulty or higher.
2547769407.description_zh:
启用一个饥饿修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以宗师或更高难度游玩时，饥饿修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

1396629961.name: Heavy Ammo Focus Challenge Modifiers
1396629961.name_zh: 重型弹药专注挑战修改器
1396629961.description: Select a Heavy Ammo Focus modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
1396629961.description_zh: 选择一个重型弹药专注修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

19013020.name: Incentive Modifiers
19013020.description: Select an Incentive modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
19013020.description_zh: 选择一个激励修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

1237311439.name: Brawler
1237311439.description: Select the Brawler modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
1237311439.description_zh: 选择搏击手修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

2409704178.name: Tier III Curated Threat Challenge Modifiers
2409704178.name_zh: III阶特选威胁挑战修改器
2409704178.description: Select a Tier III Curated Threat modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
2409704178.description_zh: 选择一个III阶特选威胁修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

3421658705.name: No HUD Gameplay Stake
3421658705.description: Some Ops require you to play with others. You can use Fireteam Finder to help you get through even the toughest activity.
3421658705.description_zh: 某些行动需要你与他人共同参与。你可以利用火力战队搜索器，来帮助你完成高难度活动。

3687855884.name: Brawn Buildcraft Stake
3687855884.description:
Complete an activity with the Brawn health model modifier active.

Brawn can be activated in the Buildcraft Stakes section of Ops activity customization on Grandmaster difficulty or higher.
3687855884.description_zh:
启用彪悍生命值模型修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以宗师或更高难度游玩时，彪悍可在行动活动自定义的“配装风险”部分启用。

1912175668.name: Elemental Medal Modifiers
1912175668.description: Select an Elemental Medal modifier and complete an activity with grade B+ or higher.
1912175668.description_zh: 选择一个元素勋章修改器，并以B+或更高等级完成一项活动。

2024540840.name: Famine Challenge Modifiers
2024540840.description:
Complete an activity with a Famine modifier active.

Famine modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Grandmaster difficulty or greater.
2024540840.description_zh:
启用一个饥荒修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以宗师或更高难度游玩时，饥荒修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

3959847875.name: Catalyst Collector
3959847875.description:
Fully Masterwork Exotic weapons using catalysts and claim the catalysts in Collections.

You can discover where Exotic catalysts are found via the Patterns & Catalysts section of Collections.

When you find a new catalyst, complete its objective and socket the catalyst to Masterwork the Exotic weapon.
3959847875.description_zh:
使用催化得到完全大师杰作异域武器，并在收藏中获取催化。

你可以通过收藏中的模式催化面板找到异域催化的掉落地点。

当你找到新催化后，完成对应目标，并将催化装进插槽，便可得到大师杰作异域武器。

2582710400.name: Reward Packages III
2582710400.description: Earn Tier 4+ reward packages from Ops activities.
2582710400.description_zh: 通过行动活动获得4阶以上奖励包裹。

3942540604.name: Rewards Pass Ranks
3942540604.description: Acquire ranks on any Rewards Pass.
3942540604.description_zh: 获取任意奖励通票等级。

340857458.name: Grandmaster Conquests
340857458.description: Complete all Grandmaster Conquests from the Seasonal Hub.
340857458.description_zh: 完成赛季中心内的所有宗师征服。

3069010155.name: Ultimate
3069010155.description: Complete a Vanguard Ops activity on Ultimate difficulty.
3069010155.description_zh: 以终极难度完成一项先锋行动活动。

2035399717.name: Extinction Gameplay Stake
2035399717.description:
Complete an activity with the Extinction revives modifier active.

Extinction can be activated in the Gameplay Stakes section of Ops activity customization on Ultimate difficulty.
2035399717.description_zh:
启用灭亡复活修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以终极难度游玩时，灭亡修改器可在行动活动自定义的“游戏风险”部分启用。

431127001.name: Pressure-Cooked Gameplay Stake
431127001.description:
Complete an activity with the Pressure-Cooked time-limit modifier active.

Pressure Cooked can be activated in the Gameplay Stakes section of Ops activity customization on Ultimate difficulty.
431127001.description_zh:
启用高压环境限时修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以终极难度游玩时，高压环境修改器可在行动活动自定义的“游戏风险”部分启用。

2707115631.name: Deadly Threat Challenge Modifiers
2707115631.description:
Complete an activity with a Deadly Threat modifier active.

Deadly Threat modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Ultimate difficulty.
2707115631.description_zh:
启用一个致命威胁修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以终极难度游玩时，致命威胁修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

1056502503.name: Anti-Surge Challenge Modifiers
1056502503.description:
Complete an activity with an Anti-Surge modifier active.

Anti-Surge modifiers can be activated in the Challenge Modifiers section of Ops activity customization on Ultimate difficulty.
1056502503.description_zh:
启用一个反涌修改器的情况下完成一项活动。

以终极难度游玩时，反涌修改器可在行动活动自定义的“挑战修改器”部分启用。

3788566005.name: Galvanized II
3788566005.description: Select the Galvanized II modifier and complete any activity with grade A or higher.
3788566005.description_zh: 选择电镀II修改器，并以A或更高等级完成任意活动。

1338012521.name: Blindspot
1338012521.description: Select the Blindspot modifier and complete any activity with grade A or higher.
1338012521.description_zh: 选择盲点修改器，并以A或更高等级完成任意活动。

2188794023.name: High-End Loadout Modifiers
2188794023.description: Select a High-End Loadout loadout restriction and complete any activity with grade A or higher.
2188794023.description_zh: 选择一个高端配置配置限制，并以A或更高等级完成任意活动。

3958645077.name: Other Medal Modifiers
3958645077.description: Select a precision, streak, or Kinetic Medal scoring modifier and complete any activity with grade A or higher.
3958645077.description_zh: 选择一个精准、连杀或动能勋章得分修改器，并以A或更高等级完成任意活动。

4065549341.name: Final Blow Bonus Modifiers
4065549341.description: Select a Final Blow Bonus scoring modifier and complete any activity with grade A or higher.
4065549341.description_zh: 选择一个最后一击加成得分修改器，并以A或更高等级完成任意活动。

546559681.name: Ascension VI
546559681.description:
Equip gear to reach the 550 Power threshold.

Remember, you can improve your favorite items by infusing them with similar items of higher Power.
546559681.description_zh:
穿戴装备来达到550能量门槛。

请记住，你可以通过向你喜欢的物品灌注更高能量的类似物品来提升其能量。

914587616.name: Ultimate Conquests
914587616.description: Complete all Ultimate Conquests in the Seasonal Hub.
914587616.description_zh: 完成赛季中心内的所有终极征服。

1086595906.name: Ultimate : A+
1086595906.description: Complete an activity at Ultimate difficulty with a grade of A+ or higher.
1086595906.description_zh: 以A+或更高等级完成一项终极难度活动。

2808071712.name: Reward Packages IV
2808071712.description: Earn Tier 5+ reward packages from Ops activities.
2808071712.description_zh: 通过行动活动获得5阶以上奖励包裹。

3548721858.name: The Vanguard
3548721858.description:
Complete the New Light quest, "A Guardian Rises."

"A Guardian Rises" teaches you the basics of playing Destiny 2.
3548721858.description_zh:
完成新曙光任务“守护者的诞生”。

“守护者的诞生”任务会为你提供《命运2》的基础游戏教学。

1433993288.name: Ops Introduction
1433993288.description: Complete three activities in Solo Ops, Fireteam Ops, Gambit Ops, or Crucible Ops.
1433993288.description_zh: 在单人行动、火力战队行动、智谋行动或熔炉竞技场行动中完成三项活动。

2114753951.name: Artifact Perks
2114753951.description:
Activate perks from your Artifact.

Artifact perks provide bonuses to your Guardian.
2114753951.description_zh:
激活神器的特性。

神器特性会为你的守护者提供加成。

2421625683.name: Modify Armor
2421625683.description:
Equip slot-specific mods on armor. 

Mods add stats or minor gameplay elements when they're equipped to an active piece of gear.

Each armor piece has sockets for general mods, like stat boosts, as well as slot-specific sockets and combat style mods.
2421625683.description_zh:
在护甲上装备插槽特定的模组。

模组安装在穿着中的装备上时会提供额外属性或次要游戏元素。

每件护甲都有用于普通模组（如属性提升），插槽特定模组，以及战斗风格模组的插槽。

3585127134.name: Shaders
3585127134.description:
Apply shaders to your gear.

Shaders allow you to recolor your armor and weapons. You can change the shaders on a piece of gear by looking at the gear's details and then navigating to the appearance screen.

You can find new shaders in the world and at the Eververse Bright Dust store.
3585127134.description_zh:
在你的装备上应用着色器。

着色器可改变护甲和武器的颜色。你可以通过查看装备详情进入外观界面，来改变该装备的着色器。

你可以在世界各处发现新着色器，也可以在永恒之诗光尘商店中购买。

881855337.name: Upgrading Your Ghost
881855337.description:
Equip an Economic or Tracking mod on your Ghost.

The Ghost's Economic mod socket can accept mods that boost your acquisition of Glimmer or loot.

The Tracking mod socket can accept mods that track caches or resource nodes.

Increase the energy of your Ghost to apply more powerful mods.
881855337.description_zh:
在你的机灵上装备一个经济或追踪模组。

机灵的经济模组插槽可接受能增加微光或战利品获取量的模组。

追踪模组插槽可接受能追踪补给箱或资源节点的模组。

提升机灵的能量可应用更强大的模组。

348042572.name: Meet Banshee-44
348042572.description:
Talk to Banshee-44.

Banshee-44 can be found in the Courtyard in the Tower.
348042572.description_zh:
与班西-44对话。

班西-44位于高塔庭院。

1761058746.name: Glimmer
1761058746.description:
Collect Glimmer.

Glimmer is the currency of the Last City. Spend Glimmer at vendors across the system in exchange for a variety of goods, bounties, and more.

Glimmer can be found by defeating combatants, completing bounties, finishing public events, and looting combatant caches.
1761058746.description_zh:
收集微光。

微光是圣城的货币。在遍布星系的商人处花费微光可换取各种货物、悬赏等物品。

微光可以通过击败战斗人员、完成悬赏、完成公共事件、劫掠敌人的补给箱获得。

4161222123.name: Enhancement Cores
4161222123.description: Complete Gunsmith bounties to earn Enhancement Cores.
4161222123.description_zh: 完成枪匠悬赏来获取强化核心。

2509417424.name: Arming Up
2509417424.description:
Purchase weapons from Banshee-44.

Banshee-44's inventory of weapons rotates weekly.
2509417424.description_zh:
在班西-44处购买武器。

班西-44的武器存货每周更新一次。

314196961.name: Purchase Aspects
314196961.description:
Purchase Aspects from Ikora Rey.

Aspects are powerful ingredients in your Guardian's build. You can purchase Aspects for Light subclasses from Ikora Rey.

You can find Ikora Rey at the Bazaar in the Tower.
314196961.description_zh:
从艾可拉·蕾伊处购买星相。

星相在你的守护者配装中是强大的材料。你可以从艾可拉·蕾伊处购买光能分支职业的星相。

你可以在高塔内的集市找到艾可拉·蕾伊。

711326297.name: Purchase Fragments
711326297.description:
Purchase Fragments from Ikora Rey.

Fragments let you further customize your Guardian's build. You can purchase Fragments for Light subclasses from Ikora Rey.

You can find Ikora Rey at the Bazaar in the Tower.
711326297.description_zh:
从艾可拉·蕾伊处购买碎片。

碎片可以让你进一步自定义守护者配装。你可以从艾可拉·蕾伊处购买光能分支职业的碎片。

你可以在高塔内的集市找到艾可拉·蕾伊。

954226887.name: Light Subclasses
954226887.description:
Complete a Light subclass quest from Ikora Rey.

Fragments let you further customize your Guardian's build. You can purchase Fragments for Light subclasses from Ikora Rey.

You can find Ikora Rey at the Bazaar in the Tower.
954226887.description_zh:
完成艾可拉·蕾伊的光能分支职业任务。

碎片可以让你进一步自定义守护者配装。你可以从艾可拉·蕾伊处购买光能分支职业的碎片。

你可以在高塔内的集市找到艾可拉·蕾伊。

2591707397.name: Bonus Focus: Fireteam Ops
2591707397.name_zh: 加成专注：火力战队行动
2591707397.description: Complete a Fireteam Ops activity with a Bonus Focus reward.
2591707397.description_zh: 完成带有加成专注奖励的火力战队行动活动。

3015011674.name: Bonus Focus: Solo Ops
3015011674.description: Complete a Solo Ops activity with a Bonus Focus reward.

510634284.description: Acquire medals in the Crucible Gold Tier category.
510634284.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场黄金级别中取得奖牌。

4007234633.name: Placement Series Matches
4007234633.description: Complete your Placement Series matches in the Competitive playlist.
4007234633.description_zh: 在多人竞技游戏列表中完成你的定级系列赛。

3270112463.name: Division Promotion
3270112463.description: Successfully complete a Promotion Series and get promoted to a higher Division.
3270112463.description_zh: 成功完成晋级系列赛并晋级至更高级别。

193233095.name: Division Debut
193233095.description: Complete matches in the Competitive 3v3 playlist. Earn bonus progress for wins.
193233095.description_zh: 在3v3多人竞技游戏列表中完成比赛。胜场可获得额外进度。

120485216.name: Climbing the Ladder
120485216.description: Achieve Platinum Division in any Season.
120485216.description_zh: 在任意赛季中达到白金级别。

609861418.name: Get Those Reps
609861418.description: Earn points by completing objectives in the Competitive 3v3 playlist.
609861418.description_zh: 通过在3v3多人竞技游戏列表中完成目标来获得分数。

4048343545.name: Fight for Glory
4048343545.description: Earn Glory Ranks across all Seasons.
4048343545.description_zh: 在所有赛季中获得荣耀等级。

45143115.name: Fabled Warrior
45143115.description: Earn weapon rewards from the "Fabled" Glory Rank in multiple Seasons.
45143115.description_zh: 在多个赛季中获得荣耀等级“闻名”的武器奖励。

848601993.name: Become Legend
848601993.description: Achieve a Glory Rank of "Legend" in any Season.
848601993.description_zh: 在任意赛季中达到荣耀等级“传说”。

3801322071.name: A Glorious Legend
3801322071.description: Achieve a Glory Rank of "Legend" in multiple Seasons.
3801322071.description_zh: 在多个赛季中达到荣耀等级“传说”。

2990442706.name: Unstoppable Glory
2990442706.description: Win consecutive matches in any season.
2990442706.description_zh: 在任意赛季连续赢得比赛。

3033882148.name: Forever Valorous
3033882148.description: Earn Crucible Ranks across all Seasons.
3033882148.description_zh: 在跨所有赛季中获得熔炉竞技场等级。

821572644.name: Legendary Valor
821572644.description: Achieve a Crucible Rank of "Legend" in any Season.
821572644.description_zh: 在任意赛季中达到熔炉竞技场等级“传说”。

2190303633.name: Right Back at It Again
2190303633.description: Reset your Crucible Rank within a single Season.
2190303633.description_zh: 在单一赛季中重置熔炉竞技场等级。

3270584291.name: Prestigious
3270584291.description: Reset your Crucible Rank across all Seasons.
3270584291.description_zh: 在跨所有赛季中重置熔炉竞技场等级。

3815562073.name: Unbroken Valor
3815562073.description: Earn the maximum Crucible Rank win streak bonus in any Season.
3815562073.description_zh: 在任意赛季中获得最高熔炉竞技场等级连胜奖励。

3937029060.name: Auto Rifle Mastery
3937029060.description: With any Auto Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3937029060.description_zh: 使用任意自动步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

792778666.name: Pulse Rifle Mastery
792778666.description: With any Pulse Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
792778666.description_zh: 使用任意脉冲步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

2604627899.name: Scout Rifle Mastery
2604627899.description: With any Scout Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
2604627899.description_zh: 使用任意斥候步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

3525486243.name: Hand Cannon Mastery
3525486243.description: With any Hand Cannon, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3525486243.description_zh: 使用任意手炮，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

4235993550.name: Bow Mastery
4235993550.description: With any Bow, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
4235993550.description_zh: 使用任意弓箭，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

3100783191.name: Sidearm Mastery
3100783191.description: With any Sidearm, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3100783191.description_zh: 使用任意手枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

4272358785.name: Submachine Gun Mastery
4272358785.description: With any Submachine Gun, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
4272358785.description_zh: 使用任意微型冲锋枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

349070628.name: Shotgun Mastery
349070628.description: With any Shotgun, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
349070628.description_zh: 使用任意霰弹枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

4107780895.name: Sniper Rifle Mastery
4107780895.description: With any Sniper Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
4107780895.description_zh: 使用任意狙击步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

3387118902.name: Fusion Rifle Mastery
3387118902.description: With any Fusion Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3387118902.description_zh: 使用任意融合步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

832436622.name: Trace Rifle Mastery
832436622.description: With any Trace Rifle, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
832436622.description_zh: 使用任意追踪步枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

3364492516.name: Grenade Launcher Mastery
3364492516.description: With any Grenade Launcher, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3364492516.description_zh: 使用任意榴弹发射器，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

52324766.name: Machine Gun Mastery
52324766.description: With any Machine Gun, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
52324766.description_zh: 使用任意机枪，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

3285170890.name: Rocket Launcher Mastery
3285170890.description: With any Rocket Launcher, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
3285170890.description_zh: 使用任意火箭发射器，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

4024183569.name: Sword Mastery
4024183569.description: With any Sword, defeat Guardians in the Crucible.
4024183569.description_zh: 使用任意刀剑，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

89114360.name: Titan Mastery
89114360.description: As a Titan, win matches, defeat combatants, deposit Motes, and defeat opposing Hunters and Warlocks.
89114360.description_zh: 作为泰坦，赢得比赛，击败战斗人员，储存萤光并击败对方猎人和术士。

1676011372.name: Hunter Mastery
1676011372.description: As a Hunter, win matches, defeat combatants, deposit Motes, and defeat opposing Titans and Warlocks.
1676011372.description_zh: 作为猎人，赢得比赛，击败战斗人员，储存萤光并击败对方泰坦和术士。

2129704137.name: Warlock Mastery
2129704137.description: As a Warlock, win matches, defeat combatants, deposit Motes, and defeat opposing Titans and Hunters.
2129704137.description_zh: 作为术士，赢得比赛，击败战斗人员，储存萤光并击败对方泰坦和猎人。

3081776353.name: Penchant for Destruction
3081776353.description: Win a Gambit match as the player who dealt the most damage (across both teams).
3081776353.description_zh: 以造成最高伤害（双方队伍中）的状态赢得一场智谋比赛。

835127044.name: Undying
835127044.description: Win a Gambit match without ever dying.
835127044.description_zh: 在未死亡的情况下赢得一场智谋比赛。

795443429.name: Ranks
795443429.description: Earn ranks in Gambit across all seasons.
795443429.description_zh: 在各赛季的智谋中获得等级。

84979789.name: Brave
84979789.description: Reach the Brave division in Gambit.
84979789.description_zh: 在智谋中达到勇者阶层。

1465187465.name: Heroic
1465187465.description: Reach the Heroic division in Gambit.
1465187465.description_zh: 在智谋中达到英雄阶层。

3730763182.name: Legend
3730763182.description: Reach the Legend division in Gambit.
3730763182.description_zh: 在智谋中达到传说阶层。

2306002103.name: Mythic
2306002103.description: Reach the Mythic division in Gambit.
2306002103.description_zh: 在智谋中达到神话阶层。

1568354300.name: Fully Loaded
1568354300.description: Defeat an invader in Gambit while carrying 15 Motes.
1568354300.description_zh: 在智谋中携带15粒萤光击败一名入侵者。

985373860.name: Takedown
985373860.description: As an Invader, defeat an opposing Guardian.
985373860.description_zh: 作为入侵者，击败一名对方守护者。

3775956279.name: Four the Hard Way
3775956279.description: Defeat four Guardians in a single Gambit invasion without using a Power weapon or Super.
3775956279.description_zh: 在单次智谋入侵中，在不使用威能武器或超能的情况下击败四名守护者。

1472453385.name: Mote Thief
1472453385.description: As an invader in Gambit, collect 3 Motes in the opposing arena and return safely.
1472453385.description_zh: 在智谋中，作为入侵者在对方竞技场中收集3粒萤光并安全返回。

3804369761.name: Heal-By-Death
3804369761.description: As an invader in Gambit, heal the enemy team's Primeval by destroying an opposing Guardian.
3804369761.description_zh: 在智谋中，作为入侵者通过消灭一名对方守护者来治疗敌人队伍的古昧。

1398935792.name: Most Motes
1398935792.description: Win a Gambit match as the player with the most Motes deposited (across both teams).
1398935792.description_zh: 以存入最多萤光（双方队伍中）的状态赢得一场智谋比赛。

3581224713.name: In Sync
3581224713.description: As a fireteam, deposit 60 Motes at once during any match of Gambit.
3581224713.description_zh: 火力战队团队合作，在任意一场智谋比赛中一次性存入60粒萤光。

583127756.name: I Don't Carry Motes
583127756.description: As a team, win a Gambit match in which you summoned only small Blockers.
583127756.description_zh: 团队合作，在仅召唤小型阻绝者的情况下赢得一场智谋比赛。

2867829930.name: Conservative Banker
2867829930.description: As a team, win a Gambit match in which you summoned only medium Blockers.
2867829930.description_zh: 团队合作，在仅召唤中型阻绝者的情况下赢得一场智谋比赛。

3816696004.name: Big Better
3816696004.description: As a team, win a Gambit match in which you summoned only large Blockers.
3816696004.description_zh: 团队合作，在仅召唤大型阻绝者的情况下赢得一场智谋比赛。

2206124374.name: High-Value Hawk
2206124374.description: Defeat high-value targets (such as wanted enemies) from all enemy species.
2206124374.description_zh: 消灭各敌人种族的高价值目标（例如被通缉的敌人）。

572729504.name: Light Versus Light
572729504.description: Defeat an opponent in Gambit while their Super is active.
572729504.description_zh: 在智谋中，在一名对手激活超能期间将其击败。

903856480.name: Gambit for All Seasons
903856480.description: Win Gambit matches against all combatant races.
903856480.description_zh: 赢得对抗各战斗种族的智谋比赛。

1965921084.name: Dark Age Arsenal
1965921084.description: Win a Gambit match with a Gambit weapon equipped in every slot.
1965921084.description_zh: 在每个插槽中都装备智谋武器的情况下赢得一场智谋比赛。

2467484432.name: Protect the Runner
2467484432.description: As a fireteam, win a match where a single player deposits 50 Motes, never losing any.
2467484432.description_zh: 火力战队团队合作，在一名玩家从未损失任何萤光且存入50粒的情况下赢得一场比赛。

2261562430.name: Perfect Round
2261562430.description: In a single round, defeat a high-value target, defeat two Guardians as an Invader, summon a Large Blocker, defeat three Blockers, defeat an Invader, and win the round.
2261562430.description_zh: 单个回合中，击败一个高价值目标，作为入侵者消灭两名守护者，召唤一个大型阻绝者，击败三名阻绝者，击败一名入侵者并赢得回合。

2096302465.name: Jolder's Victory
2096302465.description: Win matches in the Iron Banner playlist across all events and seasons.
2096302465.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中的铁旗游戏列表中赢得比赛。

4159436958.name: Radegast's Legacy
4159436958.description: Win Iron Banner matches as each character class.
4159436958.description_zh: 使用各角色职业赢得铁旗比赛。

999240767.name: Felwinter's Fury
999240767.description: Defeat opponents in the Iron Banner playlist across all events and seasons.
999240767.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中的铁旗游戏列表中击败对手。

280201145.name: Perun's Tactics
280201145.description: Capture zones in the Iron Banner playlist across all events and seasons.
280201145.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中的铁旗游戏列表中占领区域。

3191049056.name: Timur's Study
3191049056.description: Defeat opponents while holding all three zones in the Iron Banner playlist.
3191049056.description_zh: 在铁旗游戏列表中在占领全部三个区域时击败对手。

4001216960.name: Gheleon's Armor
4001216960.description: Defeat opponents attempting to capture your team's zones in the Iron Banner playlist.
4001216960.description_zh: 在铁旗游戏列表中击败试图占领己方队伍区域的对手。

3644674925.name: Skorri's Song
3644674925.description: Complete Iron Banner bounties across all events and Seasons. This Triumph can no longer be completed after the end of Season of the Risen.
3644674925.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中完成铁旗悬赏。此成就在苏生赛季结束后将无法完成。

1867424608.name: Silimar's Design
1867424608.description: On three separate characters, complete every Iron Banner bounty available within a single event. This Triumph can no longer be completed after the end of Season of the Risen.
1867424608.description_zh: 用三个不同角色，在单次活动中完成所有可用的铁旗悬赏。此成就在苏生赛季结束后将无法完成。

3854997626.name: Finnala's Finesse
3854997626.description: In Iron Banner: Rift, capture the Spark across all events and Seasons.
3854997626.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中的铁旗：裂痕中捕获火花。

3258270768.name: Deidris's Rejection
3258270768.description: In Iron Banner: Rift, defeat opponent Spark Runners across all events and Seasons.
3258270768.description_zh: 在各赛季和活动中的铁旗：裂痕中击败敌方火花逃亡者。

1309367942.name: Gunnora's Seal
1309367942.description: Acquire Iron Banner armor. Each armor piece must be unique to count towards the total.
1309367942.description_zh: 获取铁旗护甲。必须是独特的护甲才能计入总数。

2519991248.name: Orimund's Taste
2519991248.description: Acquire Iron Banner weapons. Each weapon must be unique to count towards the total.
2519991248.description_zh: 获取铁旗武器。必须是独特的武器才能计入总数。

3052275480.name: Orewing's Spirit
3052275480.description: Earn points by completing objectives in Iron Banner playlist modes.
3052275480.description_zh: 通过在铁旗游戏列表模式中完成目标来赢取得分。

89629611.name: Jorum's Howl
89629611.description: Complete Iron Banner matches while wearing at least one piece of Iron Banner armor. Earn additional progress for each piece of Iron Banner armor equipped.
89629611.description_zh: 穿戴至少一件铁旗护甲完成铁旗比赛。每多装备一件铁旗护甲可获得额外进度。

3642623255.name: Pack Hunting
3642623255.description: Complete matches in the Iron Banner playlist.
3642623255.description_zh: 完成铁旗游戏列表中的比赛。

1031853948.name: Track Alpha
1031853948.description: Complete Event Rank Track in the Event Home.
1031853948.description_zh: 在活动主页完成活动等级路线。

3064133018.name: Confidence Is High
3064133018.description: Earn all of the weekly win streak rewards from the Lighthouse.
3064133018.description_zh: 从灯塔获得所有每周连胜奖励。

1662916867.name: Safe Harbor
1662916867.description: After earning a Win Streak of at least 5 on a Lighthouse Passage, assist another player in reaching the same milestone for their first time this episode.
1662916867.description_zh: 使用一张灯塔入场券获得至少5次连胜后，协助另一名玩家在本篇章首次达到相同的里程碑。

1965035984.name: Test Your Mettle
1965035984.description: Win matches on a 7 win Lighthouse Passage during the current Episode.
1965035984.description_zh: 在当前篇章，使用一张7胜灯塔入场券赢得比赛。

1522246467.name: This Is the Way
1522246467.description: While on a Lighthouse Passage, earn a win streak of 5 or higher on different maps.
1522246467.description_zh: 使用灯塔入场券时，在不同地图上获得5次或以上的连胜。

2502902092.name: All Roads to Victory
2502902092.description: Earn wins in Trials of Osiris while on a Lighthouse Passage.
2502902092.description_zh: 使用灯塔入场券时，在奥斯里斯试炼中取得胜场。

1268432769.name: Undeniable Grandeur
1268432769.description: Complete a Grandmaster difficulty Conquest from the Seasonal Hub during the current Season.
1268432769.description_zh: 当前赛季期间，完成赛季中心内的一项宗师难度征服。

4018593209.name: Grand Conqueror
4018593209.description: Complete Conquests at Grandmaster difficulty from the Seasonal Hub during any Season.
4018593209.description_zh: 任意赛季期间，完成赛季中心内的宗师难度征服。

1063506858.name: Advanced
1063506858.description: Complete a Nightfall strike on Advanced difficulty.
1063506858.description_zh: 以高级难度完成一场日落打击。

1063506861.name: Expert
1063506861.description: Complete a Nightfall strike on Expert difficulty.
1063506861.description_zh: 以专家难度完成一场日落打击。

1063506860.name: Master
1063506860.description: Complete a Nightfall strike on Master difficulty.
1063506860.description_zh: 以大师难度完成一场日落打击。

1987522793.name: Breaker of Champions
1987522793.description_zh: 在日落打击中击败勇士。

2250745187.name: Lightbearer
2250745187.description: Earn the high score in a Nightfall strike.
2250745187.description_zh: 在一场日落打击中获得最高得分。

3034652948.name: Total Conquest
3034652948.description_zh: 完成6个不同的宗师日落打击。

574517844.name: Conqueror's Discipline
574517844.description: Complete a Grandmaster Nightfall strike with each subclass.
574517844.description_zh: 使用每种分支职业完成一场宗师日落打击。

2780814366.name: The Best Offense
2780814366.description: In any strike activity, land precision final blows, generate Orbs of Power, and complete activities. Nightfall strikes grant the most efficient progress.
2780814366.description_zh: 在任意打击活动中，取得精准最后一击，生成能量球，以及完成活动。日落打击能最高效地提升进度。

1742761645.name: Strike Savvy
1742761645.description: Complete strikes in any strike playlist.
1742761645.description_zh: 完成任意打击列表中的打击。

1275364805.name: Strike Spelunker
1275364805.description: Complete strikes in any strike playlist.
1275364805.description_zh: 完成任意打击列表中的打击。

3194213185.name: Strike Specialist
3194213185.description: Complete strikes in any strike playlist.
3194213185.description_zh: 完成任意打击列表中的打击。

3686188394.name: Triumphant
3686188394.description: Increase your Triumph Score by completing Triumphs.
3686188394.description_zh: 完成成就以提升你的成就得分。

281839810.name: Power Vacuum
281839810.description: Defeat powerful combatants; they can be identified by their non-red health bar.
281839810.description_zh: 消灭强大的战斗人员；这些敌人可以通过非红色的生命条进行区分。

2309255992.name: Bane of Bosses
2309255992.description: Defeat combatant bosses, often found in public events and strikes.
2309255992.description_zh: 击败战斗人员首领，通常可在公共事件和打击中找到。

1056716977.name: Fallen Slayer
1056716977.description: Defeat Fallen anywhere in the system.
1056716977.description_zh: 在星系任意地点消灭堕落者。

333382113.name: Hive Slayer
333382113.description: Defeat Hive anywhere in the system.
333382113.description_zh: 在星系任意地点消灭邪魔族。

2673612828.name: Cabal Slayer
2673612828.description: Defeat Cabal anywhere in the system.
2673612828.description_zh: 在星系任意地点消灭卡巴尔。

1693176508.name: Vex Slayer
1693176508.description: Defeat Vex anywhere in the system.

110048312.name: Taken Slayer
110048312.description: Defeat Taken anywhere in the system.
110048312.description_zh: 在星系任意地点消灭傀儡军团。

3579560508.name: Scorn Slayer
3579560508.description: Defeat Scorn anywhere in the system.
3579560508.description_zh: 在星系任意地点消灭嗤魅。

2982322544.name: Armor Archivist
2982322544.description: Unlock armor entries in your collection by acquiring pieces of armor for the first time.
2982322544.description_zh: 首次获取一件护甲即可在你的收藏中解锁该护甲条目。

1209487292.description_zh: 一个来自神秘人的求救信号也许是解开木卫二上暗影阴谋的关键。

1209487295.name: Beyond Light - Chapter 2
1209487295.description: Eramis and her council hold the fate of Europa in their hands. It's ours to pry from them.
1209487295.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯和她的议会将木卫二的命运掌握在了他们的手中。我们必须从他们那里打探消息。

1209487294.name: Beyond Light - Chapter 3
1209487294.description: Eramis awaits within the walls of Riis-Reborn. Hunt her down.
1209487294.description_zh: 伊拉莫斯在重生的里斯的高墙中等待着你。去把她干掉吧。

1961610045.name: Europan Tour
1961610045.description: Earn a score of 1400 or more in the Europa Destination Triumphs.
1961610045.description_zh: 在木卫二目的地成就中获得1400以上的得分

3013438617.name: Platoon Ambush
3013438617.description: In the "Ambush" step of the Warrior Empire Hunt, while in a fireteam of 3, defeat Elenax, Salvation Elite.
3013438617.description_zh: 在“战士”帝国猎杀的“伏击”阶段，在3人火力战队中击败艾连纳克斯，救赎精英。

869599000.name: The Warrior
869599000.description: Complete "The Warrior" Empire Hunt on a higher difficulty.
869599000.description_zh: 完成更高难度的“勇士”帝国猎杀。

972168297.name: Aspiration Denied
972168297.description: In the "Eliksni Evacuation" step of the Dark Priestess Empire Hunt, summon all 3 Archon Aspirants at once and defeat them within 90 seconds.
972168297.description_zh: 在“暗影女祭司”帝国猎杀的“埃里克斯尼撤离行动”阶段，同时召唤全部3个执政官渴望者并在90秒内击败他们。
rewards_zh: 堕落者突击艇全息投影

575251332.name: The Dark Priestess
575251332.description: Complete "The Dark Priestess" Empire Hunt on a higher difficulty.
575251332.description_zh: 完成更高难度的“暗影女祭司”帝国猎杀。

3987299246.name: Flies to Honey
3987299246.description: In the "Scientific Method" step of the Technocrat Empire Hunt, rapidly defeat combatants in streaks of 4 or more.
3987299246.description_zh: 在“技术专家”帝国猎杀的“科学方法”阶段，快速连续消灭4个或以上的战斗人员。

1345853611.name: The Technocrat
1345853611.description: Complete "The Technocrat" Empire Hunt on a higher difficulty.
1345853611.description_zh: 完成更高难度的“技术专家”帝国猎杀。
rewards_zh: 普拉克西斯的护甲碎片

1377192424.name: Hunt for Power
1377192424.description: Generate Orbs of Power in Empire Hunts.
1377192424.description_zh: 在帝国猎杀中生成能量球。

1055226128.name: Hunting Party
1055226128.description: While in a fireteam, defeat Champions in Empire Hunts on a higher difficulty.
1055226128.description_zh: 组成火力战队，在更高难度的帝国猎杀中击败勇士。

1363459558.name: Master of the Hunt
1363459558.description: Complete any Empire Hunt on Master difficulty.
1363459558.description_zh: 完成任意大师难度的帝国猎杀。

1840382084.name: Flawless Master of the Hunt
1840382084.description: Complete any Empire Hunt on Master difficulty without dying.
1840382084.description_zh: 不死的前提下，完成任意大师难度的帝国猎杀。

2699580344.name: Fresh from the Crypt
2699580344.description: Complete the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid within the first 24 hours of release.
2699580344.description_zh: 在“深岩墓室”突袭发布后24小时内将其完成。

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者

3560923614.name: Survival of the Fittest
3560923614.description: Complete all encounters in the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid without any member of your fireteam dying.
3560923614.description_zh: 在没有任何火力战队成员阵亡的前提下完成“深岩墓室”突袭的所有遭遇战。
rewards: Increases initial Eyes of Tomorrow drop rate.
rewards_zh: 提高明日之眼的初始掉落率。

518342793.name: Clan Night: Deep Stone Crypt
518342793.description: Complete the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid with a team made entirely of clanmates.
518342793.description_zh: 使用完全由公会成员组成的队伍完成“深岩墓室”突袭。

3834307795.name: Electric Sheep
3834307795.description: Complete all raid encounters with a fireteam made entirely of Arc subclasses.
3834307795.description_zh: 与一支完全由电弧分支职业组成的火力战队共同完成所有突袭遭遇战。

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者

3200831458.name: Meltdown

3200831458.description_zh: 与一支完全由烈日分支职业组成的火力战队共同完成所有突袭遭遇战。

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者

513707022.description_zh: 与一支完全由冰影分支职业组成的火力战队共同完成所有突袭遭遇战。

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败坦尼克斯，厌恶者
