1931249621.name: Sealed Stash
1931249621.description: Investigate the area around the Derelict Shipyard.
1931249621.description_zh: 调查遗落船坞附近的区域。

1931249620.name: The Perilous Path
1931249620.description: Investigate the area around the Shattered Enclave.
1931249620.description_zh: 调查碎裂飞地附近的区域。

1767438219.name: Caches of Dreams
1767438219.description: Find all of the data caches in the Debris of Dreams.
1767438219.description_zh: 在梦境碎片中找到所有数据缓存。

2962897853.name: The Conjuring
2962897853.description: A cache of data awaits discovery in the Ruined Outpost.
2962897853.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在前哨废墟中等着被人发现。

2962897852.name: Corsair's Tale
2962897852.description: A cache of data awaits discovery in the Overlook.
2962897852.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在高地中等着被人发现。

2962897855.name: Harbingers
2962897855.description: A cache of data awaits discovery in the Derelict Shipyard.
2962897855.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在遗落船坞中等着被人发现。

4078726305.name: Wayfinding Wrath
4078726305.description: Solve the mysteries in the Ruins of Wrath.
4078726305.description_zh: 解开暴怒废墟中的谜团。

730362375.name: Harrowed Hall
730362375.description: Investigate the area below the Warbringer's Tower.
730362375.description_zh: 调查战祸高塔下方的区域。

730362372.name: Eclipsed Cache
730362372.description: Investigate the Debris Field with multiple Compass powers.
730362372.description_zh: 使用多种罗盘能力调查瓦砾区。

3430706981.name: Trivial Wayfinding Wrath
3430706981.description: Solve all the Trivial Mysteries in the Ruins of Wrath.
3430706981.description_zh: 解开暴怒废墟中的所有琐碎谜团。

1359171688.name: The Deep
1359171688.description: Investigate the area below the Warbringer's Tower.
1359171688.description_zh: 调查战祸高塔下方的区域。

543030486.name: Caches of Wrath
543030486.description: Find all of the data caches in the Ruins of Wrath.
543030486.description_zh: 在暴怒废墟中找到所有数据缓存。

1302458586.name: Hive Movements
1302458586.description: A cache of data awaits you in the Undercroft.
1302458586.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在地窖中等着你。

1302458587.name: Wrathful Maneuvers
1302458587.description: A cache of data awaits you in the Outer Islands.
1302458587.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在外围岛屿上等着你。

1302458584.name: The Loop
1302458584.description: A cache of data awaits you in the Staging Ground.
1302458584.description_zh: 一个数据缓存在集结地等着你。

4070362244.name: Blind Well Justice
4070362244.description: Defeat both Scorn and Taken bosses in the Astral Alignment activity.
4070362244.description_zh: 在星芒校准活动中击败嗤魅和傀儡军团首领。

576359229.name: Eternal Alignment
576359229.description: Complete the Astral Alignment activity without dying.
576359229.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成星芒校准活动。

382839907.name: Alignment of the Undying
382839907.description: Complete the Astral Alignment activity without any Guardians dying.
382839907.description_zh: 在没有守护者阵亡的情况下完成星芒校准活动。

1196094162.name: Legendary Alignment
1196094162.description: Complete the Legendary version of the Astral Alignment activity.
1196094162.description_zh: 完成传说难度的星芒校准活动。

690400774.name: Exterminator of Champions
690400774.description: Defeat Champions during the Astral Alignment activity.
690400774.description_zh: 在星芒校准活动中击败勇士。

1916285825.name: Ether Denier
1916285825.description: Prevent any Ether from being harvested by the Scorn during the Astral Alignment activity.
1916285825.description_zh: 在星芒校准活动中阻止嗤魅收获任何乙太。

3881427439.name: Many Hands Make the Light Work
3881427439.description: Complete the Astral Alignment activity with every Guardian installing a Paracausal Battery.
3881427439.description_zh: 在每位守护者都安装过超因果电池的情况下完成星芒校准活动。

4208751479.name: Mods of the Lost
4208751479.description: Collect all Season of the Lost mods.
4208751479.description_zh: 收集所有神隐赛季模组。

4206770197.name: Instruments of the Lost
4206770197.description: Collect all Seasonal weapons and armor from Season of the Lost, available as rewards from Astral Alignment, Shattered Realm, and focused Umbral Engrams.
4206770197.description_zh: 通过获得来自星芒校准，碎裂领域，聚焦本影记忆水晶的奖励，收集所有神隐赛季的赛季武器和护甲。

20985512.name: Slayer for the Lost
20985512.description: Defeat Scorn, Taken, and Hive combatants with at least 4 pieces of the Pathfinder armor set equipped.
20985512.description_zh: 装备至少四件寻路者护甲，消灭嗤魅、傀儡军团、邪魔族战斗人员。

2099405021.name: Conqueror for the Lost
2099405021.description: Defeat bosses in the Astral Alignment activity with at least four pieces of the Pathfinder armor set equipped.
2099405021.description_zh: 装备至少四件寻路者护甲，在星芒校准活动中消灭首领。

2926196505.name: Weapon of the Lost
2926196505.description: Earn the Ascendancy ritual weapon during Season of the Lost.
2926196505.description_zh: 在神隐赛季期间获得权势仪式武器。

1419856322.name: Decorated Wayfinder
1419856322.description: Earn the first of three Seasonal ornaments from Crucible, Gambit, or strikes.
1419856322.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场、智谋或打击中获得三款赛季皮肤中的第一款。

1741120471.name: Strike Show Off
1741120471.description: Earn the Vanguard ornament for the Ascendancy Rocket Launcher by reaching the max Vanguard Rank after resetting it once.
1741120471.description_zh: 通过在重置一次先锋等级后再次达到最高等级来获取权势火箭发射器的先锋皮肤。

3389088618.name: Crucible Hotshot
3389088618.description: Earn the Crucible ornament for the Ascendancy Rocket Launcher by reaching the max Crucible Rank after resetting it once.
3389088618.description_zh: 通过在重置一次熔炉竞技场等级后再次达到最高等级来获取权势火箭发射器的熔炉竞技场皮肤。

2956332015.name: Gambler's Garb
2956332015.description: Earn the Gambit ornament for the Ascendancy Rocket Launcher by reaching the max Gambit Rank after resetting it once.
2956332015.description_zh: 通过在重置一次智谋等级后再次达到最高等级来获取权势火箭发射器的智谋皮肤。

1495470829.name: Finding the Way Forward
1495470829.description: Increase the power of your Wayfinder's Compass during the Season of the Lost.
1495470829.description_zh: 在神隐赛季期间强化你的寻迹者罗盘的力量。

1193340946.name: Lost and Wayfinding
1193340946.description: Increase your Season Rank during Season of the Lost.
1193340946.description_zh: 在神隐赛季期间提升你的赛季等级。

4174857293.name: Ager's Scepter Claimed
4174857293.description: Complete "Tracing the Stars" and "A Hollow Coronation," and claim Ager's Scepter.
4174857293.description_zh: 完成“追逐星辰”和“空洞的加冕礼”，并取得阿格尔的权杖。

771892910.name: Devotee's Remnant
771892910.description: Complete the catalyst for Ager's Scepter.
771892910.description_zh: 完成阿格尔的权杖的催化。

2646372956.name: Scattered by Storms
2646372956.description: Collect each Atlas Skew and listen to its recording.
2646372956.description_zh: 收集所有阿特拉斯航图并聆听其录音。

517806453.name: Signal Jammer
517806453.description_zh: 完成“暗屋之声”异域任务。

2846845044.name: Tank Master
2846845044.description: Complete the "Vox Obscura" Exotic quest on Master difficulty.
2846845044.description_zh: 以大师难度完成“暗屋之声”异域任务。

3219227863.name: Catalytic Converter
3219227863.description: Complete the catalyst from the Master difficulty "Vox Obscura" Exotic quest.
3219227863.description_zh: 完成从大师难度“暗屋之声”异域任务中获得的催化。

2012324885.name: Old Foes Rise Again
2012324885.description: Listen to all four unique Psionic propaganda messages in the control room of the "Vox Obscura" Exotic quest.
2012324885.description_zh: 在“暗屋之声”异域任务的控制室中聆听所有四条不同的灵能宣传讯息。

978050738.name: Ghost Not Needed
978050738.description: Complete the "Vox Obscura" Exotic quest on Master difficulty without dying.
978050738.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成大师难度的“暗屋之声”异域任务。

2733613128.name: PsiOps Arsenal
2733613128.description: Collect all six Seasonal Legendary weapons.
2733613128.description_zh: 收集所有六件赛季传说武器。

1060408350.name: PsiOps Armorer
1060408350.description: Collect all five Seasonal armor pieces.
1060408350.description_zh: 收集所有五件赛季护甲。

3006924815.name: Peak Operator
3006924815.description: Defeat targets using Seasonal weapons. Defeating Guardians grants additional progress.
3006924815.description_zh: 使用赛季武器消灭目标。击败守护者可获得额外进度。

3348135192.name: Mindcraft
3348135192.description: Craft each of the Seasonal weapons.

61771244.name: Synaptic Fanatic
61771244.description: Unlock Seasonal Artifact mods during Season of the Risen.
61771244.description_zh: 在苏生赛季期间解锁赛季神器模组。

1587198371.name: Psionic Operator
1587198371.description_zh: 完成任务“厄尔布鲁士行动。”

2898788850.name: Applied Psychotronics
2898788850.description: Unlock all the upgrades from the War Table.
2898788850.description_zh: 解锁所有战争圆桌的升级。

830708908.name: Psychic Warrior
830708908.description: Reset your rank with the War Table.
830708908.description_zh: 重置你的战争圆桌等级。

572752222.name: Codebreaker
572752222.description: Spend Psychogenic Intel to decode the Runic Chest at the end of Legend PsiOps Battlegrounds.
572752222.description_zh: 在传说灵能行动战场的结尾花费精神情报解码符文宝箱。

1949917465.name: Active Listener
1949917465.description: Listen to all of the Season of the Risen radio messages in the H.E.L.M.
1949917465.description_zh: 在应急后勤行动中心中聆听所有苏生赛季广播消息。

339236285.name: Mind Reading
339236285.description:
Collect all the pages of the "Acts of Mercy" and "Quintessence" lore books.

Pages can be found by completing the "Psionic Operator," "Active Listener," and "Over Your Dead Body" Triumphs.
339236285.description_zh:
收集所有“仁慈之举”和“精萃”传奇故事书的书页。

你可以通过完成“灵能特工”、“积极听众”、“誓死抵抗”成就来得到这些书页。

977458679.name: Mental Focus
977458679.description: Decrypt Umbral Engrams using Focused Decoding at the War Table.
977458679.description_zh: 在战争圆桌处使用聚焦破译解码本影记忆水晶。

2852874162.name: Critical Insight
2852874162.description: Achieve a critical roll when using Focused Decrypting at the War Table with the Umbral Echo upgrade.
2852874162.description_zh: 获取本影回声升级后，在战争圆桌处使用聚焦解码时摇出一次暴击。

208029774.name: PsiOps Battleground: Cosmodrome
208029774.name_zh: 灵能行动战场：发射基地
208029774.description_zh: 完成灵能行动战场：发射基地。

3968807748.name: PsiOps Battleground: EDZ
3968807748.name_zh: 灵能行动战场：欧洲无人区
3968807748.description_zh: 完成灵能行动战场：欧洲无人区。

3143132143.name: PsiOps Battleground: Moon
3143132143.description_zh: 完成灵能行动战场：月球。

1219237947.name: One Light Prevails
1219237947.description: Defeat all Champions in a PsiOps Battleground.
1219237947.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场中击败所有勇士。

3921259732.name: No Ghost Needed
3921259732.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，完成灵能行动战场。

1471685878.name: Operation Blinding Light
1471685878.description: Complete a PsiOps Battleground in the playlist without any member of your fireteam dying.
1471685878.description_zh: 在没有任何火力战队成员死亡的前提下，完成游戏列表里的灵能行动战场。

1458459943.name: Strenuous Exorcise
1458459943.description: Destroy Lucent Hive Ghosts in PsiOps Battlegrounds.
1458459943.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场里摧毁光明邪魔族机灵。

236627231.name: Their Own Medicine
236627231.description: Defeat combatants with a Lucent Hive Sword in PsiOps Battleground: EDZ.
236627231.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场：欧洲无人区里，使用光明邪魔族刀剑消灭战斗人员。

4172105905.name: Reclaimed Light
4172105905.description: Reclaim 2 or more Burdens of Tribute at the same time in PsiOps Battleground: Moon.
4172105905.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场：月球中，同时夺回2个或更多的贡品重担。

891115502.name: Impress the Empress
891115502.description: Complete PsiOps Battleground: Moon without letting any Cabal allies die.
891115502.description_zh: 在没有任何卡巴尔盟友死亡的情况下，完成灵能行动战场：月球。

1308500117.name: Over Your Dead Body
1308500117.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场中消灭囤光者。

3694890899.name: This House Is Clean
3694890899.description: Defeat Aspects of Savathûn with the Synaptic Spear in PsiOps Battlegrounds.
3694890899.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场里，使用突触之矛击败萨瓦图恩的神态。

1628804801.name: Synaptic Symphony
1628804801.description: Defeat combatants with the Synaptic Spear in PsiOps Battlegrounds.
1628804801.description_zh: 在灵能行动战场里，使用突触之矛消灭战斗人员。

3023379542.name: Legend Battlegrounds Completed
3023379542.description: Complete Season of the Risen Legend Battlegrounds.
3023379542.description_zh: 完成苏生赛季传说战场。

2834482426.name: Flawless PsiOps Legend
2834482426.description: Complete a PsiOps Battleground without dying on Legend difficulty or higher.
2834482426.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，完成传说或更高难度的灵能行动战场。

287777529.name: Reckless Display
287777529.description: Earn any of the three ornaments for Reckless Endangerment.
287777529.description_zh: 获得三个鲁莽致险皮肤中的任意一个。

3431988403.name: Skin of the Stalwart
3431988403.description: Earn the Stalwart Skin ornament for Reckless Endangerment.
3431988403.description_zh: 获得鲁莽致险的尽忠竭力皮肤。

1480969782.name: Skin of the Dusted
1480969782.description: Earn the Done and Dusty ornament for Reckless Endangerment.
1480969782.description_zh: 获得鲁莽致险的大功告成皮肤。

3134742219.name: Skin of a Serpent
3134742219.description: Earn the Serpentine Skin ornament for Reckless Endangerment.
3134742219.description_zh: 获得鲁莽致险的蜿蜒曲折皮肤。

292307915.name: Synaptic Surge
292307915.description: Gain bonus power from your Synaptic Spear.
292307915.description_zh: 从你的突触之矛中获得能量加成。

3950914558.name: Risen Levels
3950914558.description: Gain ranks in the Season Pass.

3009441888.name: Platinum Torchbearer
3009441888.description:
Light Platinum Torches in the Tower.

Two Platinum Torches can be unlocked every week: one for depositing Medallions, and another for achieving a Platinum score in the Guardian Games: Competitive playlist.
3009441888.description_zh:
在高塔中点亮白金火炬。

每周有两个白金火炬可供解锁：一个可通过存放勋章解锁，另一个可通过在守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表中达到白金得分解锁。

3159450431.name: Medallion Stallion
3159450431.description:
Deposit Medallions at the Tower's podium during Guardian Games. 

Higher tier Medallions are worth more.
3159450431.description_zh:
在守护者游戏期间，在高塔的领奖台上存入勋章。

勋章越高阶，价值就越高。

4185928116.name: Rack 'Em Up
4185928116.description:
Accumulate scores in the Guardian Games: Competitive and Training playlists. 

Defeat combatants and earn Vanguard Medals for higher scores.
4185928116.description_zh:
在守护者游戏：多人竞技和训练游戏列表中积累得分。

通过消灭战斗人员、获取先锋勋章来获得更高的得分吧。

1778243330.name: Multi-Medaler
1778243330.description: Earn Vanguard Medals of any kind during Guardian Games playlist activities.
1778243330.description_zh: 在守护者游戏列表活动期间获得任何种类的先锋勋章。

1762023028.name: The Bronze Effect
1762023028.description: Earn a Bronze score in a Guardian Games: Competitive playlist activity.
1762023028.description_zh: 在一场守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表活动中获得一次青铜得分。

942560415.name: Silver Surfing
942560415.description: Earn a Silver score in a Guardian Games: Competitive playlist activity.
942560415.description_zh: 在一场守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表活动中获得一次白银得分。

1868261462.name: The Gold Standard
1868261462.description: Earn a Gold score in a Guardian Games: Competitive playlist activity.
1868261462.description_zh: 在一场守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表活动中获得一次黄金得分。

3696109800.name: Plat? Please.
3696109800.description: Earn a Platinum score in a Guardian Games: Competitive playlist activity.
3696109800.description_zh: 在一场守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表活动中获得一次白金得分。

921769974.name: Run the Circuit
921769974.description_zh: 完成守护者游戏列表活动。

2656330218.name: Vanguard Contender
2656330218.description_zh: 完成3张先锋游戏列表竞争者卡片

3443640800.name: Seasonal Contender
3443640800.description_zh: 完成3张赛季竞争者卡片。

4101131956.name: Throne World Contender
4101131956.description_zh: 完成3张王座世界竞争者卡片。

1200967002.name: Gambit Contender
1200967002.description_zh: 完成3张智谋竞争者卡片。

1592849591.name: Crucible Contender
1592849591.description_zh: 完成3张熔炉竞技场竞争者卡片。

1636001158.name: Tower's Finest
1636001158.description: By the end of Guardian Games 2022, get high enough scores from each week's Guardian Games: Competitive playlist to rank in the top 10% of the Destiny 2 community's combined best scores.
1636001158.description_zh: 在2022年守护者游戏结束前，在每周的“守护者游戏：多人竞技游戏列表”中获得足够高的分数来排进命运2社区综合最佳得分的前10%。

1977664746.name: Primary Spree
1977664746.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
1977664746.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败3个战斗人员。

1738230665.name: Primary Rampage
1738230665.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
1738230665.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败6个战斗人员。

2371096584.name: Primary Frenzy
2371096584.description: Rapidly defeat 9 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
2371096584.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败9个战斗人员。

3681971305.name: Special Spree
3681971305.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with weapons using Special ammo.
3681971305.description_zh: 使用特殊弹药武器快速击败3个战斗人员。

451998294.name: Special Rampage
451998294.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with weapons using Special ammo.
451998294.description_zh: 使用特殊弹药武器快速击败6个战斗人员。

2619672223.name: Special Frenzy
2619672223.description: Rapidly defeat 9 combatants with weapons using Special ammo.
2619672223.description_zh: 使用特殊弹药武器快速击败9个战斗人员。

2187328865.name: Heavy Spree
2187328865.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with weapons using Heavy ammo.
2187328865.description_zh: 使用重型弹药武器快速击败3个战斗人员。

413340486.name: Heavy Rampage
413340486.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with weapons using Heavy ammo.
413340486.description_zh: 使用重型弹药武器快速击败6个战斗人员。

1055228339.name: Heavy Frenzy
1055228339.description: Rapidly defeat 9 combatants with weapons using Heavy ammo.
1055228339.description_zh: 使用重型弹药武器快速击败9个战斗人员。

1880289748.name: Precision Spree
1880289748.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with precision damage.
1880289748.description_zh: 用精准伤害快速击败3名战斗人员。

2646177239.name: Precision Rampage
2646177239.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with precision damage.
2646177239.description_zh: 用精准伤害快速击败6名战斗人员。

2079320414.name: Precision Frenzy
2079320414.description: Rapidly defeat 9 combatants with precision damage.
2079320414.description_zh: 用精准伤害快速击败9名战斗人员。

4230752814.name: Eagle Eye

1921436120.name: Head to Head

1921436120.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，用近战武器击败10名战斗人员。可用武器：手枪，微型冲锋枪，霰弹枪，偃月，刀剑。

1114617101.name: Hand to Hand
1114617101.description: Without dying, defeat 20 combatants with close-range weapons: Sidearms, Submachine Guns, Shotguns, Glaives, or Swords.
1114617101.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，用近战武器击败20名战斗人员。可用武器：手枪，微型冲锋枪，霰弹枪，偃月，刀剑。

3471036934.name: Eye to Eye

3471036934.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，用近战武器击败30名战斗人员。可用武器：手枪，微型冲锋枪，霰弹枪，偃月，刀剑。

769734266.name: Indestructible
769734266.description: Finish a Guardian Games playlist activity without dying.
769734266.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，完成一项守护者游戏列表活动。

220470888.name: Flawless Fireteam
220470888.description: Finish a Guardian Games playlist activity without anyone in your fireteam dying.
220470888.description_zh: 在无火力战队成员死亡的情况下，完成一项守护者游戏列表活动。

1382657670.name: Fireteam Spree
1382657670.description: As a fireteam, rapidly defeat 30 combatants.
1382657670.description_zh: 火力战队团队合作，快速击败30个战斗人员。

991410189.name: Demolition Expert
991410189.description_zh: 用手雷快速击败3名战斗人员。

2255325323.name: Berserker
2255325323.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with melee final blows.
2255325323.description_zh: 用近战最后一击快速击败3名战斗人员。

2833778598.name: Let There Be Light
2833778598.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with Super abilities.
2833778598.description_zh: 用超能快速击败3名战斗人员。

1593394595.name: On Thin Ice
1593394595.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants frozen by Stasis weapons or abilities.
1593394595.description_zh: 快速击败3个被冰影武器或技能冻结的战斗人员。

2610370706.name: Size Does Shatter
2610370706.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with Stasis shatter damage.
2610370706.description_zh: 用冰影碎裂伤害快速击败3名战斗人员。

331838041.name: Master at Arms
331838041.description: Earn Kinetic, Energy, and Power weapon final blow medals in rapid succession.
331838041.description_zh: 连续快速获得动能、能量和威能武器最后一击勋章。

1146380988.name: Virtuoso
1146380988.description: Earn melee, grenade, and Super ability final blow medals in rapid succession.
1146380988.description_zh: 连续快速获得近战、手雷和超能最后一击勋章。

934429995.name: Jack of All Trades
934429995.description: Earn Kinetic, Energy, Power weapon, grenade, melee, and Super final blow medals in rapid succession without dying.
934429995.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下，连续快速获得动能、能量、威能武器、手雷、近战和超能最后一击勋章。

2993848507.name: Finishing Touches
2993848507.description: Defeat a powerful combatant with a finisher.
2993848507.description_zh: 用终结技击败一个强力战斗人员。

226722519.name: Insult to Injury
226722519.description: After using an emote, use a finisher to defeat a powerful combatant.
226722519.description_zh: 使用一个动作表情后，再用终结技击败一个强力战斗人员。

3916833245.name: Crossed the Bronze threshold
3916833245.description: Pass the Bronze score threshold during a Guardian Games playlist activity.
3916833245.description_zh: 在一项守护者游戏列表活动中达到青铜得分门槛。

1944973870.name: Crossed the Silver threshold
1944973870.description: Pass the Silver score threshold during a Guardian Games playlist activity.
1944973870.description_zh: 在一项守护者游戏列表活动中达到白银得分门槛。

97360355.name: Crossed the Gold threshold
97360355.description: Pass the Gold score threshold during a Guardian Games playlist activity.
97360355.description_zh: 在一项守护者游戏列表活动中达到黄金得分门槛。

3597558778.name: Crossed the Platinum threshold
3597558778.description: Pass the Platinum score threshold during a Guardian Games playlist activity.
3597558778.description_zh: 在一项守护者游戏列表活动中达到白金得分门槛。

572408382.name: Bronze Tier Achieved
572408382.description: Within the Guardian Games playlists, finish an activity with a Bronze Tier score.
572408382.description_zh: 在守护者游戏列表中，以青铜阶得分完成一项活动。

3359952677.name: Silver Tier Achieved
3359952677.description: Within the Guardian Games playlists, finish an activity with a Silver Tier score.
3359952677.description_zh: 在守护者游戏列表中，以白银阶得分完成一项活动。

2940732344.name: Gold Tier Achieved
2940732344.description: Within the Guardian Games playlists, finish an activity with a Gold Tier score.
2940732344.description_zh: 在守护者游戏列表中，以黄金阶得分完成一项活动。

913093665.name: Platinum Tier Achieved
913093665.description: Within the Guardian Games playlists, finish an activity with a Platinum Tier score.
913093665.description_zh: 在守护者游戏列表中，以白金阶得分完成一项活动。

368791520.name: Lead by Example
368791520.description: Earn the Machine Gun, Chain of Command.

420665768.name: Ornamental Branding
420665768.description: Earn any of the three ornaments for Chain of Command.
420665768.description_zh: 获得指挥链的三款皮肤中的任意一款。

3468730524.name: Vanguard Decor: Chain of Command
3468730524.description: Earn the Vanguard ornament for Chain of Command.
3468730524.description_zh: 获得指挥链的先锋皮肤。

1640011073.name: Crucible Decor: Chain of Command
1640011073.name_zh: 熔炉竞技场装饰：指挥链
1640011073.description: Earn the Crucible ornament for Chain of Command.
1640011073.description_zh: 获得指挥链的熔炉竞技场皮肤。

2100941700.name: Gambit Decor: Chain of Command
2100941700.description: Earn the Gambit ornament for Chain of Command.
2100941700.description_zh: 获得指挥链的智谋皮肤。

3639193500.name: Harvested Power
3639193500.description: Gain bonus power levels on the Seasonal Artifact.
3639193500.description_zh: 获得赛季神器加成能量等级。

1436176126.name: Nightmare Harvester Tuning
1436176126.description: Unlock artifact mods on the Season of the Haunted Nightmare Harvester Artifact.
1436176126.description_zh: 解锁宿怨赛季梦魇收割者神器的神器模组。

2574923249.name: Guardian of the Haunted
2574923249.description: Gain ranks on the Season Pass during Season of the Haunted.
2574923249.description_zh: 在宿怨赛季期间获得季票等级。

3234892555.name: Ghost in the Machine
3234892555.description: Listen to all of the Season of the Haunted radio messages in the H.E.L.M.
3234892555.description_zh: 在应急后勤行动中心中聆听所有宿怨赛季广播消息。

3517214791.name: Vendor Upgrades Unlocked
3517214791.description: Unlock all upgrades for the Crown of Sorrow.
3517214791.description_zh: 解锁所有忧愁王冠升级

3243524064.name: Vendor Rank Reset
3243524064.description: Reset your vendor rank with the Crown of Sorrow.
3243524064.description_zh: 使用忧愁王冠重置你的商人等级。

3734062649.name: Opulent Avarice
3734062649.description: Open locked chests with Opulent Keys on the Derelict Leviathan.
3734062649.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上使用丰盈密钥开启上锁的宝箱。

256362216.name: Harvester of Sorrows
256362216.description: Bind Nightmares after completing Tier III Nightmare Containment activities.
256362216.description_zh: 在完成阶段III梦魇遏制活动后束缚梦魇。

500233634.name: Nightmare Harvester
500233634.description:
Transform Bound Presence into rewards.

Bound Presence is occasionally found by binding Nightmares in the Nightmare Containment, and is automatically consumed for rewards upon opening chests in Sever.
500233634.description_zh:
将束缚存在转化为奖励。

束缚存在可不定期通过在梦魇遏制中束缚梦魇找到，在断舍活动中开启宝箱时会自动消耗以获取奖励。

1070611764.name: #1 Fan
1070611764.description: Collect all of the dignified effigies of Calus aboard the Derelict Leviathan and proudly display them in the H.E.L.M.
1070611764.description_zh: 收集所有卡鲁斯在遗落利维坦上的庄严雕像，将它们在应急后勤行动中心中自豪地展示出来。

3290370653.name: Nightmare Containment Completions
3290370653.description: Successfully complete tiers of the Nightmare Containment public event.
3290370653.description_zh: 成功完成各阶梦魇遏制公共事件。

2862587143.name: Bound Perfection
2862587143.description: Successfully complete the Nightmare Containment public event at Tier III.
2862587143.description_zh: 成功完成III阶梦魇遏制公共事件。

3391780251.name: Tritainment
3391780251.description: Successfully defeat each Tier III Nightmare Containment boss.
3391780251.description_zh: 成功逐一击败III阶梦魇遏制的首领。

3938092586.name: Harvest
3938092586.description: In the Nightmare Containment public event, deposit Cores of Dread.
3938092586.description_zh: 在梦魇遏制公共事件中，放置恐惧核心。

4266921166.name: Reaper's Blade
4266921166.description: Defeat combatants on the Derelict Leviathan with the Scythe.
4266921166.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上使用镰刀消灭战斗人员。

1240017095.name: Shadow's Return
1240017095.description: Defeat dangerous Loyalist threats while exploring the Derelict Leviathan destination and claim the associated Triumphs.
1240017095.description_zh: 击败探索遗落利维坦目的地时的危险效忠者威胁，领取对应成就。

1058769126.name: A Guardian Is a Guardian, Even in a Nightmare
1058769126.name_zh: 守护者就是守护者，即便身处梦魇
1058769126.description: Assist coalition troops by disrupting Calus's Loyalist forces aboard the Derelict Leviathan and claim the associated Triumphs.
1058769126.description_zh: 扰乱遗落利维坦上的卡鲁斯的效忠者部队来协助联军，领取对应成就。

1279753168.name: Fever Dream
1279753168.description: Defeat each of the powerful Nightmares within Haunted Alcoves on the Derelict Leviathan and claim the associated Triumphs.
1279753168.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，逐一击败宿怨壁龛内的强力梦魇，领取对应成就。

1302704537.name: Get to Taking Out Their Commanders, One by One
1302704537.name_zh: 一个接一个地干掉他们的指挥官
1302704537.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat each of the roaming Nightmare targets within the Royal Pools.
1302704537.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，逐一击败皇家水池内的游荡梦魇目标。

1302704536.name: Controlled Burn
1302704536.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat each of the roaming Nightmare targets within the Pleasure Gardens.
1302704536.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，逐一击败欢愉花园内的游荡梦魇目标。

835032483.name: Exile Ended
835032483.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat a Loyalist commander and release its prisoner.
835032483.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，击败一名效忠者指挥官并释放其俘虏。

835032481.name: Shared Fears
835032481.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat each of the Nightmares linked by an old bond of war.
835032481.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，逐一击败由古老的战争纽带联系在一起的梦魇。

835032482.name: At the Behest of the Empress
835032482.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat a troublesome Loyalist commander.
835032482.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，击败一名麻烦的效忠者指挥官。

835032480.name: Battle Lines
835032480.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, defeat a Loyalist force defending their territory, and bring down their commander.
835032480.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，击败捍卫领土的效忠者部队，并打倒其指挥官。

670894108.name: Sporest of Beasts
670894108.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, clear the Haunted Alcove guarded by resting hounds.
670894108.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，清理由休眠猎犬看守的宿怨壁龛。

670894109.name: Nightmare Breached
670894109.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, clear the Haunted Alcove opposite Calus.
670894109.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，清理在卡鲁斯对面的宿怨壁龛。

670894110.name: Drainage
670894110.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, clear the Haunted Alcove connected to an old, unused passage.
670894110.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，清理与一条废弃旧步道相连的宿怨壁龛。

670894111.name: Ritual Under Shadow
670894111.description: On the Derelict Leviathan, clear the Haunted Alcove passageway containing a Nightmare ritual.
670894111.description_zh: 在遗落利维坦上，清理包含梦魇仪式的宿怨壁龛步道。

942284496.name: Severing Scythe
942284496.description: Defeat combatants with the Scythe in Sever activities.
942284496.description_zh: 在断舍活动中使用镰刀消灭战斗人员。

3670253780.name: Hear, Don't Heed
3670253780.description: In Sever activities, find and listen to each of Calus's automatons.
3670253780.description_zh: 在断舍活动中，找到并聆听卡鲁斯的每个自动机。

2190763519.name: Paranormal Firepower
2190763519.description: Acquire each Season of the Haunted weapon.
2190763519.description_zh: 获取每件宿怨赛季武器。

493352893.name: CWU-27p Anti-Haunt Gear
493352893.description: Acquire a full set of the Season of the Haunted Eidolon Pursuant armor.
493352893.description_zh: 获取整套宿怨赛季精灵追寻者护甲。

1569591873.name: Malicious Haunt

Defeat combatants and Guardians with Season of the Haunted weapons. 

Defeated Guardians grant additional progress.
1569591873.description_zh:
使用宿怨赛季武器击败战斗人员和守护者。

击败的守护者可奖励额外进度。

4290552912.name: Nightmares Take Shape
4290552912.description: Shape each Season of the Haunted weapon.
4290552912.description_zh: 塑形每件宿怨赛季武器。

1103401490.name: Shape Opulent Weapons

1103401490.description_zh: 宿怨赛季期间在火星飞地圣物处塑形每个回归的丰盈武器。

911679101.name: Nightmarish Decryption
911679101.description: Use Focused Decoding to decrypt a weapon at the Crown of Sorrow with both the Double Perk and Deepsight upgrades active.
911679101.description_zh: 在忧愁王冠使用聚焦破译解码武器，同时激活双重特性和深视升级。

262973521.name: Flag of Mutiny
262973521.description: Earn any of the 3 ornaments for Cry Mutiny.
262973521.description_zh: 获得叛乱疾呼三款皮肤中的任意一款。

128585854.name: Intended Overthrow
128585854.description: Earn the Intended Overthrow ornament for Cry Mutiny.
128585854.description_zh: 获得叛乱疾呼的蓄意颠覆皮肤。

3166966835.name: Intended Mischief

3166966835.description_zh: 获得叛乱疾呼的蓄意捣乱皮肤。

2338926187.name: Intended Authority

2338926187.description_zh: 获得叛乱疾呼的蓄意授权皮肤。

1899278019.name: Skeleton Key Power

1899278019.description_zh: 从你的骸骨密钥中获得能量加成。

161131735.name: Skeleton Key Mods
161131735.description: Unlock Artifact mods on your Skeleton Key.
161131735.description_zh: 解锁骸骨密钥上的神器模组。

2058692502.name: Plundered Levels
2058692502.description: Gain ranks in the Season Pass.

406880362.name: Ketchkiller's Attire
406880362.description: Acquire a full set of Season of Plunder armor.
406880362.description_zh: 获得整套侠盗赛季护甲。

2946689224.name: Captain's Cache

2946689224.description_zh: 获得每一件侠盗赛季武器。

271695081.name: Salty Smith

271695081.description_zh: 解锁侠盗赛季武器模式。

3013301237.name: Savior of the Seven Seas

3013301237.description_zh: 前往每个海盗藏身处并击败藏身其中的海盗领主。

1768658147.name: Commander and Cartographer

1768658147.description_zh: 从双桅船交锋宝箱中收集地图碎片。

1768658144.name: Map Quest

1768658144.description_zh: 通过成功完成侠盗赛季活动来收集宝藏坐标。

1768658145.name: Unburied Treasure

1768658145.description_zh: 从远征的额外深埋宝箱中收集侠盗本影能量。

3190260640.name: Foundry Weapons Focus
3190260640.description: Focus Umbral Engrams from each of the foundry engram pools.
3190260640.description_zh: 聚焦来自每个铸造厂记忆水晶池的本影记忆水晶。

1247414319.name: Plundered Weapon Focus
1247414319.description: Focus each of the Seasonal weapon engrams at the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.
1247414319.description_zh: 在应急后勤行动中心里的星图处聚焦每个赛季武器记忆水晶。

2975184965.name: Plundered Armor Focus
2975184965.description: Focus each of the Season of Plunder armor engrams at the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.
2975184965.description_zh: 在应急后勤行动中心里的星图处聚焦每个侠盗赛季护甲记忆水晶。

1168911778.name: Distant Harbor
1168911778.description: Reset your Reputation Rank with the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.
1168911778.description_zh: 在应急后勤行动中心里的星图处重置你的声望等级

1970142892.name: With Full Sails
1970142892.description: Purchase all upgrades from the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.
1970142892.description_zh: 购买应急后勤行动中心里星图的所有升级。

1168911783.name: Semaphore Signals
1168911783.description: Listen to radio messages in The Ether Tank.
1168911783.description_zh: 在乙太罐里听无线电消息。

1168911782.name: Marking the Spot
1168911782.description: Unlock bonus chests in Expedition with each map type.
1168911782.description_zh: 在每个地图类型的远征中解锁额外宝箱。

1168911785.name: Beacon's Guidance
1168911785.description: Use the Treasure Beacons to decipher the location of the hidden treasure.
1168911785.description_zh: 使用宝藏信标来解密隐藏宝藏的地点。

1168911784.name: Me Hearties
1168911784.description: Summon crewmates into Expedition and Ketchcrash activities.
1168911784.description_zh: 召唤船员进入远征和双桅船交锋活动。

2099923804.name: Crew's Control
2099923804.description: Summon each crewmate assigned as your First Mate during Expedition and Ketchcrash activities.
2099923804.description_zh: 在远征和双桅船交锋活动中召唤每一位被任命为大副的船员。

1152134093.name: High Seas, High Spirits
1152134093.description:
Celebrate with your crewmates using an emote at the end of successful Expedition and Ketchcrash activities.

Requires the first Swashbuckler upgrade from the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.
1152134093.description_zh:
在成功完成远征和双桅船交锋活动后，用动作表情与船员们一同庆祝。

需要应急后勤行动中心里星图处的第一个斗剑士升级。

2450461425.name: Flawless Ketchcrash
2450461425.description: Complete the Ketchcrash activity without dying.
2450461425.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成双桅船交锋活动。

2450461426.name: Flawless Boarding Party
2450461426.description: Complete the Ketchcrash activity on Master difficulty, without anyone in your fireteam dying.
2450461426.description_zh: 在无火力战队成员死亡的情况下，完成大师难度双桅船交锋活动。

2450461427.name: Boarding School
2450461427.description: Defeat Champions during the Ketchcrash activity.
2450461427.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋活动中击败勇士。

2450461428.name: Crash Course
2450461428.description: Complete the Ketchcrash activity on Master difficulty.
2450461428.description_zh: 完成大师难度双桅船交锋活动。

2450461429.name: Scourge of Themis Cluster
2450461429.description_zh: 击败所有双桅船交锋首领。

2467239009.name: Powder Runner
2467239009.description: Activate Cannon Accelerators aboard the deck of your ship in Ketchcrash.
2467239009.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，启动你飞船甲板上的大炮加速器。

2467239008.name: Degenerate
2467239008.description: In Ketchcrash, destroy shield generators in the Maintenance Bay.
2467239008.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，在维修舱中摧毁护盾发生器。

2467239015.name: Terminal Velocity
2467239015.description: In Ketchcrash, hack terminals in the treasure hoard.
2467239015.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，入侵宝藏窖藏的终端。

2467239014.name: Ether Way
2467239014.description: In Ketchcrash, destroy storage tanks in Ether Storage.
2467239014.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，摧毁乙太仓库中的储存罐。

2450461431.name: Double Broadside
2450461431.description: Initialize all 4 cannon accelerators during the first Ketchcrash encounter, without letting the privateers reclaim any of them.
2450461431.description_zh: 在第一个双桅船交锋遭遇战中启动所有4个大炮加速器，且不让私掠者夺回其中任何一个。

2450461433.name: Dunk Tanks
2450461433.description: In Ketchcrash, finish the Maintenance Bay encounter within one minute of the second Spider Tank's appearance.
2450461433.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，在第二辆蜘蛛坦克出现一分钟内结束维修舱遭遇战。

2467239011.name: Stealth Check
2467239011.description: In Ketchcrash, complete the Treasure Hoard encounter without any member of your fireteam being spotted by the Security Optic.
2467239011.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，在所有火力战队成员都没被安全镜头发现的情况下完成宝藏窖藏遭遇战。

2467239010.name: Tank Banker
2467239010.description: In Ketchcrash, rapidly destroy storage tanks during the Ether Storage encounter.
2467239010.description_zh: 在双桅船交锋中，在乙太仓库遭遇战中快速破坏储存罐。

2831263727.name: Flawless Expedition
2831263727.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成远征。

2831263724.name: Multiple Fronts
2831263724.description: In Expedition, defeat Champions on Nessus, Europa, and the Cosmodrome.
2831263724.description_zh: 在远征中，在涅索斯、木卫二、发射基地中击败勇士。

2831263725.name: Dig Site
2831263725.description: Complete Expeditions on Nessus, Europa, and the Cosmodrome.
2831263725.description_zh: 在涅索斯、木卫二、发射基地中完成远征。

2831263720.name: Fabulous Wealth
2831263720.description: Deposit treasure into the treasure haul.

2831263722.name: You Know the Drill
2831263722.description: Complete a Drill Phase in Expedition within 2 minutes.
2831263722.description_zh: 在远征中，在2分钟以内完成一个钻探阶段。

322648346.name: Community Contributor
322648346.description: Acquire Captain's Coins during the Season of Plunder Community Event.
322648346.description_zh: 在侠盗赛季社区活动期间获得船长的硬币。

322648345.name: Eliksni Ambassador
322648345.description: Acquire each of the personal rewards during the Season of Plunder Community Event.
322648345.description_zh: 在侠盗赛季社区活动期间获得各项个人奖励。

322648348.name: Eliksni Inspector
322648348.description: Investigate each of the Eliksni Quarter improvements.
322648348.description_zh: 调查埃里克斯尼居住区的各项改善。

862888875.description_zh: 在Exo框架处重置商人等级。

3129048719.description_zh: 花费炽天使密钥代码，在盗劫战场结束时解锁炽天使宝箱。

1361569064.name: Might and Magic

2027858735.name: Spire of the Undying

1504518237.description_zh: 完成专家难度的萨瓦图恩的尖塔。

777652753.name: Living Legend

777652753.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成专家难度的萨瓦图恩的尖塔。

3571313728.description_zh: 以一支拥有电弧、虚空和烈日分支职业的完整火力战队完成萨瓦图恩的尖塔。

3253046164.description_zh: 解开萨瓦图恩的尖塔中邪魔族符文迷宫的谜团。

1532375312.name: Flawless Logic

1532375312.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成召唤圣坛遭遇战。

2240862792.name: Acolyte's Offerings

1897504702.name: Insatiable Hunger

1897504702.description_zh: 完成召唤圣坛遭遇战。完成更高难度的遭遇战可获得额外进度。

2916449614.name: Quick Tithe

1254352124.name: Secrets of the Spire I

1254352124.description_zh: 激活攀升中的第一套元素符文。

1254352127.name: Secrets of the Spire II

1254352127.description_zh: 激活迷宫中的第一套元素符文。

Defeat combatants in the Dreaming City. 

Targets defeated in Seasonal activities award additional progress.
55366574.description_zh:
在幽梦之城中击败战斗人员。

182019880.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成魅痕巢穴中的通路。在不死亡的情况下开启盘蜷中的最终宝箱可提供额外进度。

4136865154.name: Smash 'n' Grab

4136865154.description_zh: 作为火力战队，在盘蜷中打破器皿。

2119847656.description_zh: 打开魅痕巢穴和盘蜷中的宝箱。

4134061639.name: Shooting Stars

3136809314.description_zh: 在一次盘蜷中到访许愿室。

2690761459.description_zh: 在异域任务中找到第一个秘密宝箱。

2690761456.name: Taranis's Treasures
2690761456.description: Find the second secret chest in the Exotic mission.
2690761456.description_zh: 在异域任务中找到第二个秘密宝箱。

2690761457.name: Taranis's Fortune

2690761457.description_zh: 在异域任务中找到第三个秘密宝箱。

2690761462.name: Taranis's Dragonhoard!

311245371.name: Vision of the Future
311245371.description: Earn Gold scores for each encounter in the "Prophecy" dungeon on Ultimatum mode.
311245371.description_zh: 在最后通牒模式“预言”地牢的每个遭遇战中获得黄金得分。

4086652922.name: Running the Gauntlet
4086652922.description: Complete a Dungeon Gauntlet from beginning to end.
4086652922.description_zh: 从头到尾完成一次地牢考验。

3762396616.name: Competitions: SRL
3762396616.description:
Complete Triumphs in the Competitions: Sparrow Racing League subcategory.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
3762396616.description_zh:
完成竞赛：赛雀联赛子类别中的成就。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

2414828951.name: Podium Placement
2414828951.description:
Finish races in the top three. First and second place reward additional progress.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
2414828951.description_zh:
以前三名的成绩完成竞速。取得冠军和亚军奖励额外进度。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

3230243213.name: Built To Win
3230243213.description:
Complete a race in first place.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
3230243213.description_zh:
以第一名完成一场竞速。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

2074076376.name: Racetrack Runway
2074076376.description:
Complete a race while using a full set of SRL armor and weapons.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
2074076376.description_zh:
在使用一整套赛雀联赛护甲和武器的情况下完成一场竞速。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。
rewards_zh: 解锁：鹿角甲虫异域快雀

3703297530.name: Gate Lord
3703297530.description:
Complete a lap without missing a single boost gate and place in the top three.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
3703297530.description_zh:
在单圈内不错过任何一道加速光门并取得前三名的成绩。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

3737431915.name: Defensive Driver
3737431915.description:
Complete a race without dying.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
3737431915.description_zh:
在不死亡的情况下完成一场竞速。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

1975535080.name: Don't Mess With The Honk
1975535080.description:
Sound your horn upon defeating a combatant in SRL.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
1975535080.description_zh:
在赛雀联赛中击败一名战斗人员时鸣响喇叭。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

835687040.name: SRL Tricky
835687040.description:
Perform {var:990332019} or more Sparrow tricks during a race and finish in the top five.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
835687040.description_zh:
在一场竞速中使出{var:990332019}个或更多快雀特技并以前五名完赛。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

3021677923.name: Furiously Fast
3021677923.description:
Complete a lap on a track with an excellent time.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
3021677923.description_zh:
以出色的时间记录跑完一圈赛道。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

2107222771.name: Light Speed
2107222771.description:
Complete a race on the Eternity track with a time under {var:3638000683}:{var:562609879}.

Completing SRL Triumphs increases your chance of earning higher tier SRL gear.
2107222771.description_zh:
在永恒赛道以低于{var:3638000683}:{var:562609879}的时间成绩完成一场竞速。

完成赛雀联赛成就可提升获得高阶赛雀联赛装备的几率。

2718707885.name: Scrapper
2718707885.description: Complete 3v3 Rotator activities in the Crucible.
2718707885.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中完成3v3轮换活动。

2577396751.name: Crowd Control
2577396751.description: Capture zones in Control in the Crucible.
2577396751.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中的占领中占领区域。

2565857646.name: A Little Friendly Competition
2565857646.description: Complete competitive matches in the Crucible.
2565857646.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中完成多人竞技比赛。

82633904.name: Rite of Passage
82633904.description: Complete Trials of Osiris matches. Wins grant bonus progress.
82633904.description_zh: 完成奥斯里斯试炼比赛。胜场可提供额外进度。

3913223589.name: Boop
3913223589.description: Defeat a Guardian with a melee ability in Rumble in the Crucible.
3913223589.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中的混战中使用近战技能击败一名守护者。

806023015.name: Medal Medley
806023015.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中赢取勋章。

1555277870.name: Thrice-Ordained
1555277870.description: Win Crucible matches with each Light subclass.
1555277870.description_zh: 使用每个光能分支职业赢得熔炉竞技场比赛。

2964948820.name: Recluse Atop the Mountain
2964948820.description: Defeat Guardians with Grenade Launchers and Submachine Guns.
2964948820.description_zh: 使用榴弹发射器和微型冲锋枪击败守护者。

149170606.name: Striking Stare
149170606.description: Defeat Guardians with Hand Cannons and Sniper Rifles.
149170606.description_zh: 使用手炮和狙击步枪击败守护者。

4125308883.name: Lunar Prophecy
4125308883.description: Defeat Guardians with Hand Cannons and Shotguns.
4125308883.description_zh: 使用手炮和霰弹枪击败守护者。

2003314074.name: Deadly Furnace
2003314074.description: Defeat Guardians with Pulse Rifles and Shotguns.
2003314074.description_zh: 使用脉冲步枪和霰弹枪击败守护者。

820278195.name: Frozen Due to Suspicious Activity
820278195.description: Summon small, medium, and large Blockers in Gambit.
820278195.description_zh: 在智谋中召唤小型、中型和大型阻绝者。

744730575.name: Two Sides, Same Coin
744730575.description: Defeat Invaders or defeat Guardians as an Invader in Gambit.
744730575.description_zh: 在智谋中击败入侵者或作为入侵者击败守护者。

2535608645.name: No One Lives Forever
2535608645.description: Defeat combatants with Hand Cannons in Gambit. Bonus progress for final blows with Malfeasance and defeating Guardians.
2535608645.description_zh: 在智谋中使用手炮击败战斗人员。使用渎职造成最后一击和击败守护者可获得额外进度。

1895454498.name: Elite Executioner
1895454498.description_zh: 在智谋中击败具有挑战性的敌人。

objectives.desc_zh: 具有挑战性的战斗人员

3481840232.name: Envoy While It Lasts
3481840232.description: Defeat Primeval envoys during Gambit matches.
3481840232.description_zh: 在智谋比赛中消灭古昧使节。

3096262928.name: Don't Tell The Order
3096262928.description: As a fireteam, defeat combatants with Praxic Blades in the Lawless Frontier, then complete a Lawless Frontier activity.
3096262928.description_zh: 作为一个火力战队，在无序边界中使用英勇利刃击败战斗人员，然后完成一项无序边界活动。

1719376226.name: Telesto Report
1719376226.description: Defeat combatants with the Exotic weapon Telesto in any activity. Bonus progress is granted while you have a Telesto emblem equipped.
1719376226.description_zh: 在任意活动中使用异域武器土卫十三击败战斗人员。装备土卫十三徽标时可获得额外进度。

3152385520.name: Knife of My Slaying
3152385520.description: Complete an activity with only Swords or Glaives equipped in your weapon slots, and defeat at least 50 combatants in that activity with Swords or Glaives.
3152385520.description_zh: 在武器栏仅装备刀剑和偃月的情况下完成一项活动，并在该活动中用刀剑或偃月击败至少50名战斗人员。

1905505605.name: 7th Column
1905505605.description_zh: 达到守护者等级7或更高。

1423289253.name: Have a Blast
1423289253.description: In Dares of Eternity, defeat combatants with Rocket Launchers and complete the entire run. Bonus progress is granted while Gjallarhorn is equipped.
1423289253.description_zh: 在永恒挑战中，使用火箭发射器击败战斗人员并完成整个行动。装备加拉尔号角时可获得额外进度。

232467698.name: Glass Cannon
232467698.description: Complete the strike "The Glassway" with your Health stat below ten and your Weapons stat at 100 or higher. Defeat combatants with weapons during the strike.
232467698.description_zh: 在生命值属性低于10，武器属性不低于100的情况下完成打击“玻璃小径”。在打击期间使用武器击败战斗人员。

1007915188.name: The Light of Dawn
1007915188.description: Complete "The Sunless Cell" strike with a Solar subclass equipped and defeat combatants with Solar damage.
1007915188.description_zh: 在使用烈日分支职业的情况下完成“无光之牢”打击，并使用烈日伤害击败战斗人员。

2240189388.name: Thunderstruck
2240189388.description: Complete Dares of Eternity with an Arc subclass equipped and defeat combatants with Arc damage. Bonus progress is granted for defeating Xûr's Chosen during the Lightning Round.
2240189388.description_zh: 装备电弧分支职业完成永恒挑战并用电弧伤害击败战斗人员。在快速回合中击败仄选中的战士可获得额外进度。

3735246647.name: GOOOAAAALLL!!!
3735246647.description: Score a goal in the hidden net using the soccer ball in the Tower Hangar.
3735246647.description_zh: 将高塔机库中的足球踢进隐藏的球网。

1348609896.name: All Together Now!
1348609896.description: Complete group emotes with other Guardians.
1348609896.description_zh: 与其他守护者一起完成群体动作表情。

1532373875.name: Reset The Clock!
1532373875.description: Reset the site safety counter in the Tower Hangar.
1532373875.description_zh: 重置高塔机库中的现场安全计数器。

2815010145.name: Sweeper, No Sweeping
2815010145.description: Help sweeperbots clean up pigeon trouble in the Tower.
2815010145.description_zh: 帮助扫地机器人清理高塔里的鸽子麻烦。

2290835488.name: Who Needs Floors Anyways
2290835488.description: Complete an optional "Floor is Lava" platforming challenge without touching designated forbidden platforms or ground areas.
2290835488.description_zh: 在不触碰指定禁止平台或地面区域的情况下完成可选的“岩浆地面”平台挑战。

1687537471.name: Strange Coinage
1687537471.description: Spend Strange Coins with Xûr at the Tower Bazaar.
1687537471.description_zh: 在高塔集市中的仄处花费奇异硬币。

1404564874.name: Tower Spending Spree
1404564874.description: Visit the Tower, then leave with at least 100,000 less Glimmer than you had when you arrived.
1404564874.description_zh: 前往高塔并在离开时花掉至少100,000微光。

2398475457.name: Traveler's Manifestation
2398475457.description: Spawn the giant ball in the Tower or witness it being spawned.
2398475457.description_zh: 在高塔中生成巨球，或见证其生成。

1583073581.name: What Came Before
1583073581.description: Acquire the Forerunner Exotic Sidearm from Xûr's Treasure Hoard in Eternity.
1583073581.description_zh: 从仄在永恒的宝藏窖藏中获得先驱者异域手枪。

4186853167.name: I'll Go High
4186853167.description: Complete the upper obstacle-course path after the first encounter in Dares of Eternity.
4186853167.description_zh: 在永恒挑战中，在第一场遭遇战后完成上层的障碍路径。

479253340.name: Called It
479253340.description: Correctly predict the branching path in Dares of Eternity by standing on the winning circle before it is revealed.
479253340.description_zh: 在永恒挑战中，通过在获胜圆环揭晓前站在其上来正确预测分支路径。

3897735344.name: Sortie Send-Off
3897735344.description:
Complete Rendezvous Triumphs from different categories.

Afterwards, speak with Lodi one last time at the Tower.
3897735344.description_zh:
完成不同类别的会合成就。

然后，最后一次与高塔中的洛迪交谈。

4037290772.name: Me and You, Big Blue
4037290772.description:
Complete Triumph Completion triumphs from different categories.

Afterwards, interact with Zavala's autorifle between the Tenets of Bravery and Devotion in the Tower.
4037290772.description_zh:
完成不同类别的凯旋完成成就。

随后，在高塔的忠诚信条与奉献信条之间与萨瓦拉的自动步枪进行互动。

2519069859.name: Full Deck
2519069859.description: Complete the mission "Cayde's Fate" in the Timeline, after having defeated 52 combatants with the Ace of Spades Hand Cannon.
2519069859.description_zh: 使用手炮黑桃A击败52名战斗人员后，完成时间线中的任务“凯德的命运”。

1996637290.name: Just a Dream
1996637290.description: Complete any Nightmare Hunt on the Moon.
1996637290.description_zh: 在月球上完成任意梦魇狩猎。

368921315.name: Above and Beyond
368921315.description:
In the "Beyond" mission, defeat the Bestowed Darkblade and acquire the Darkblade Harvester buff. Then, complete the mission without dying.

This mission is periodically available on the Moon.
368921315.description_zh:
在“超越”任务中，击败受赐暗刃并获得暗刃收割者增益。然后在不死亡的情况下完成任务。

此任务在月球上周期性开放。

2004433732.name: Into Darkness
2004433732.description: Complete any Beyond Light campaign mission or Empire Hunt on Europa.
2004433732.description_zh: 完成木卫二上的任意一项凌光之刻战役任务或帝国猎杀。

1389264495.name: Reality Check
1389264495.description: Complete any Exo Challenge on Europa.
1389264495.description_zh: 完成木卫二上的任意一项Exo挑战。

2088123662.name: Cunning Is Strength
2088123662.description: In the mission "The Cunning" in the Throne World, find the Drake Tank during the escape and eliminate all Abominations.
2088123662.description_zh: 在王座世界的任务“狡诈”中，在逃离阶段找到幼龙坦克并消灭所有憎恶。

2438784599.name: Relics of the Past
2438784599.description: In the mission "The Ghosts" in the Throne World, find the Solar Scythe and defeat combatants with it.
2438784599.description_zh: 在王座世界的任务“机灵”中，找到烈日镰刀并用它击败战斗人员。

729436309.name: Just Stand Riiiight There
729436309.description: In the "Desperate Measures" mission on Neomuna, use the orbital strike relic to defeat Cabal combatants.
729436309.description_zh: 在内欧姆那上的“铤而走险”任务中，使用轨道打击圣物击败卡巴尔战斗人员。

1245308094.name: Count on Khvostov
1245308094.description: Complete the mission "Ascent" in The Final Shape campaign and defeat combatants while using only the Khvostov 7G-0X Exotic Assault Rifle.
1245308094.description_zh: 在仅使用异域突击步枪赫沃斯托夫7G-0X的情况下击败战斗人员并完成终焉之形战役的任务“飞升”。

3792989757.name: Play Nice
3792989757.description: Destroy splinters within each of the three major surrounding storms to summon a fearsome foe in mission "Dissent" in The Final Shape campaign.
3792989757.description_zh: 在终焉之形战役的任务“异议”中，摧毁三个大型环伺风暴内的碎片来召唤一名可怕的敌人。

1289729629.name: Where'd We Park?
1289729629.description: Locate the Pike in the mission "Requiem" in the Pale Heart and use it to defeat combatants.
1289729629.description_zh: 在苍白之心内的任务“安魂曲”中找到派克并用它击败战斗人员。

1820058203.name: Still Have Reserves?
1820058203.description: Defeat the Witness in the mission "Excision."
1820058203.description_zh: 在任务“切除”中击败见证者。

920285581.name: Dry Feet
920285581.description: Complete mission "Fallow" on Kepler without taking damage from hazardous water or dying.
920285581.description_zh: 在不被危险水域伤害且不死亡的情况下完成开普勒上的任务“休耕”。

2983877236.name: Who Needs Roads?
2983877236.description: In the "Imperium" mission in the Renegades campaign, locate the Interceptor in the hangar and defeat combatants with it.
2983877236.description_zh: 在反叛战役的“帝国”任务中，找到机库内的拦截者并用它击败战斗人员。

4160641767.name: Last Grasp for Glory
4160641767.description: Defeat Premier Lume with a Praxic Blade equipped in the "Glory Beyond" mission, available in the Renegades campaign.
4160641767.description_zh: 在反叛战役的“荣耀长存”任务中，在装备英勇利刃的情况下击败首席卢梅。

2873226773.name: Hooked on the Look
2873226773.description: Complete any Armor Synthesis bounty available from Ada-1 in the Tower.
2873226773.description_zh: 完成由高塔中的艾达-1提供的任意护甲合成悬赏。

3636219447.name: Key for Free
3636219447.description: Open Maeve's stash near Shaw Han in the Cosmodrome.
3636219447.description_zh: 在发射基地打开韩潇附近的梅芙的储物箱。

3028275595.name: Fragments of Light
3028275595.description: Purchase all Fragments of Light from Ikora in the Tower.
3028275595.description_zh: 在高塔的艾可拉处购买所有光能碎片。

2326099425.name: Daydreaming
2326099425.description: Complete any of Petra's daily bounties in the Dreaming City.
2326099425.description_zh: 完成幽梦之城中的任意一个佩特拉的日常悬赏。

3314216788.name: Champions Overcome
3314216788.description_zh: 在任意活动中击败勇士。

3498814024.name: Perks of the Job
3498814024.description: Complete any mission, strike, or Ops activity with an Artifact equipped with 7 perks.
3498814024.description_zh: 使用装备了7个特性的神器完成任意任务、打击或行动活动。

1266969461.name: Battle-Forged
1266969461.description_zh: 完成火力战队行动中的战场。

646103139.name: Pinnacle Operative
646103139.description: Complete an activity of each type in Pinnacle Ops with grade S or higher.
646103139.description_zh: 以S或更高评级完成巅峰行动中各个类型活动各一次。

824450797.name: A Legend Rises
824450797.description: Complete the strike "The Disgraced" without dying.
824450797.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成打击“耻辱”。

2297854589.name: Mind Games
2297854589.description: Get 20 precision Sniper Rifle final blows in the strike "The Insight Terminus."
2297854589.description_zh: 在打击“洞悉终界”中，使用狙击步枪造成20次精准最后一击。

2967969114.name: Spoiler Free
2967969114.description: Complete the strike "Liminality" in Fireteam Ops with the No HUD modifier active while on Advanced difficulty or higher.
2967969114.description_zh: 在启用无HUD修改器的情况下，以高级或更高难度完成火力战队行动中的打击“阈限”。

1538423216.name: Old School
1538423216.description: Complete the "Devils' Lair" strike with a Solar, Void, or Arc subclass equipped.
1538423216.description_zh: 在装备烈日、虚空或电弧分支职业的情况下完成打击“恶魔巢穴”。

4213978314.name: Familiar Territory
4213978314.description: Complete Exotic mission "The Whisper" with the Whisper of the Worm Exotic Sniper Rifle equipped.
4213978314.description_zh: 在装备异域狙击步枪蠕虫低语的情况下，完成异域任务“冥冥低语”。

3828243410.name: Pure Perfection
3828243410.description: Complete the Exotic mission "Zero Hour" with the Outbreak Perfected Exotic Pulse Rifle equipped.
3828243410.description_zh: 在装备异域脉冲步枪全面爆发的情况下完成异域任务“行动时刻”。

476814483.name: Nimble Zero Hour
476814483.description: Survive TR3-VR's maze and reach the Cryptarch vault in the Exotic mission "Zero Hour" without dying.
476814483.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下穿过异域任务“行动时刻”中TR3-VR的迷宫并抵达解密大师保险库。

846398159.name: Tell the Tale
846398159.description: Complete the Exotic mission "Presage" with the Dead Man's Tale Exotic Scout Rifle equipped.
846398159.description_zh: 在装备异域斥候步枪亡者传说的情况下完成异域任务“前兆”。

2547616574.name: On the Double
2547616574.description: In the Pale Heart, complete the Exotic mission "Dual Destiny" in {var:457790546} minutes or less.
2547616574.description_zh: 在苍白之心中，在{var:457790546}分钟内完成异域任务“双重命运”。

226708009.name: Cull's Shadow
226708009.description: Acquire the Cull's Shadow Exotic Fusion Rifle from the Exotic mission "Oblation."
226708009.description_zh: 在异域任务“奉献”中获得库尔之影异域融合步枪。

109458567.name: It's My Turn
109458567.description: Defeat the Forgemaster in the "Oblation" Exotic mission and loot the final reward chest.
109458567.description_zh: 在异域任务“奉献”中击败锻造大师，并开启最终奖励宝箱。

1113748224.name: That's a New PB
1113748224.description: Complete a full run of the Exotic mission "Oblation" before its timer expires.
1113748224.description_zh: 在时限内完成一次完整的异域任务“奉献”。

1401561385.name: Oh Worm?
1401561385.description: Collect 9 hidden worms in the Exotic mission "Oblation."
1401561385.description_zh: 在异域任务“奉献”中收集9只隐藏的蠕虫。

4072470187.name: Darkest Depths
4072470187.description: Search within the darkest depths of the Moon.
4072470187.description_zh: 在月球最黑暗的深处寻找。

2516952320.name: Rendezvous: Nessus
2516952320.description: Locate Ikora on Nessus to learn more about the Conductor.
2516952320.description_zh: 前往涅索斯找到艾可拉，了解更多关于指挥者的信息。

2042128684.name: Rendezvous: Moon
2042128684.description: Speak with Eris Morn in the Enduring Abyss, on the Moon.
2042128684.description_zh: 前往月球的永恒深渊与埃里斯·摩恩交谈。

3590053009.name: Rendezvous: Europa
3590053009.description: Speak with Lodi in Beyond, on Europa.
3590053009.description_zh: 前往木卫二的超越层与洛迪交谈。

496806110.name: Rendezvous: EDZ
496806110.description: Speak with Lodi in Sojourner's Camp, in the European Dead Zone.
496806110.description_zh: 前往欧洲无人区的旅居者营地与洛迪交谈。

2333027731.name: Rendezvous: Eternity
2333027731.description: Speak with Lodi in Eternity.  Land in Xûr's Treasure Hoard and then teleport to the arena beyond to locate him.
2333027731.description_zh: 前往永恒与洛迪交谈。降落到仄的宝藏窖藏，随后传送至另一侧竞技场找到他。

473722985.name: Rendezvous: Dreaming City
473722985.description: Speak with Queen Mara Sov in the Confluence, within the Dreaming City.
473722985.description_zh: 前往幽梦之城的汇流与玛拉·索维女王交谈。

1034074944.name: Rendezvous: Throne World
1034074944.description: Speak with Luzaku in the Queen's Bailey, in Savathûn's throne world.
1034074944.description_zh: 前往萨瓦图恩的王座世界中的女王的城墙，与鲁扎库交谈。

2637144481.name: Worlds: Vistas
2637144481.description: Complete Triumphs in the Worlds: Vistas category.
2637144481.description_zh: 完成世界：景观类别中的成就。

622162938.name: Worlds: Patrol
622162938.description: Complete Triumphs in the Worlds: Patrol category.
622162938.description_zh: 完成世界：巡逻类别中的成就。

2833939184.name: Worlds: Treasure Hunting
2833939184.description: Complete Triumphs in the Worlds: Treasure Hunting category.
2833939184.description_zh: 完成世界：寻宝类别中的成就。

1305695156.name: Worlds: Distortions
1305695156.description: Complete Triumphs in the Worlds: Distortions category.
1305695156.description_zh: 完成世界：扭曲类别中的成就。

1432148564.name: Stories: The Tower
1432148564.description: Complete Triumphs in the Stories: The Tower category.
1432148564.description_zh: 完成剧情：高塔类别中的成就。

3065247799.name: Stories: Allies
3065247799.description: Complete Triumphs in the Stories: Allies category.
3065247799.description_zh: 完成剧情：盟友类别中的成就。

1292743970.name: Stories: Campaigns
1292743970.description: Complete Triumphs in the Stories: Campaigns category.
1292743970.description_zh: 完成剧情：战役类别中的成就。

1303787458.name: Stories: The Nine
1303787458.description: Complete Triumphs in the Stories: The Nine category.
1303787458.description_zh: 完成剧情：玖类别中的成就。

2370033294.name: Combat: Targets
2370033294.description: Complete Triumphs in the Combat: Targets category.
2370033294.description_zh: 完成战斗：目标类别中的成就。

1351452907.name: Combat: Armaments
1351452907.description: Complete Triumphs in the Combat: Armaments category.
1351452907.description_zh: 完成战斗：武装类别中的成就。

364613283.name: Combat: Exotic Missions
364613283.description: Complete Triumphs in the Combat: Exotic Missions category.
364613283.description_zh: 完成战斗：异域任务类别中的成就。

3320998870.name: Teamwork: Strikes and Battlegrounds
3320998870.description: Complete Triumphs in the Teamwork: Strikes and Battlegrounds category.
3320998870.description_zh: 完成团队合作：突袭和战场类别中的成就。

4194303319.name: Teamwork: Raid Challenges
4194303319.description: Complete Triumphs in the Teamwork: Raid Challenges category.
4194303319.description_zh: 完成团队合作：突袭挑战类别中的成就。

2675172285.name: Teamwork: Dungeon Challenges
2675172285.description: Complete Triumphs in the Teamwork: Dungeon Challenges category.
2675172285.description_zh: 完成团队合作：地牢挑战类别中的成就。

1561426387.name: Competitions: PvP
1561426387.description: Complete Triumphs in the Competitions: PvP category.
1561426387.description_zh: 完成竞赛：PvP类别中的成就。

3464145993.name: Competitions: Gambit
3464145993.description: Complete Triumphs in the Competitions: Gambit category.
3464145993.description_zh: 完成竞赛：智谋类别中的成就。

471281008.name: Handle Randal the Vandal
471281008.description: Defeat Randal the Vandal in Cosmodrome's Forgotten Shore.
471281008.description_zh: 在发射基地的遗忘海岸击败暴徒兰德尔。

1171177906.name: Forcible Disconnect
1171177906.description: Defeat the Assimilated Demolishers on Nessus.
1171177906.description_zh: 在涅索斯上击败同化破坏者。

3004245718.name: Vex Invalidated
3004245718.description: On Europa, defeat Vex combatants using Void abilities or the Choir of One Exotic weapon.
3004245718.description_zh: 在木卫二上，使用虚空技能或单人合唱异域武器击败Vex战斗人员。

2060234891.name: Step Into the War
2060234891.description: On Nessus, defeat Cabal combatants using Solar abilities or the Skyburner's Oath Exotic weapon.
2060234891.description_zh: 在涅索斯上使用烈日技能或焚天者誓约异域武器击败卡巴尔战斗人员。

1764043866.name: Fallen Galvanized
1764043866.description: In Cosmodrome, defeat Fallen combatants using Arc abilities or the Lord of Wolves Exotic weapon.
1764043866.description_zh: 在发射基地中使用电弧技能或狼王异域武器击败堕落者战斗人员。

1527020180.name: Hive Torpor
1527020180.description: On the Moon, defeat Hive combatants using Stasis abilities or the Ex Diris Exotic weapon.
1527020180.description_zh: 在月球上，使用冰影技能或不祥之兆异域武器击败邪魔族战斗人员。

2321036253.name: Dread Unraveled
2321036253.description: In the Pale Heart, defeat Dread using Prismatic abilities or the Tessellation Exotic weapon.
2321036253.description_zh: 在苍白之心，使用棱镜技能或细分曲面异域武器击败恐惧。

130892800.name: Scorn Calcination
130892800.description: In the Throne World, defeat Scorn combatants while using Strand abilities or the Slayer's Fang Exotic weapon.
130892800.description_zh: 在王座世界中，使用缚丝技能或杀手之牙异域武器击败嗤魅战斗人员。

727487794.name: Taken Resorption
727487794.description: In the Dreaming City, defeat Taken combatants while using Stasis abilities or the Whisper of the Worm Exotic weapon.
727487794.description_zh: 在幽梦之城中，使用冰影技能或蠕虫低语异域武器击败傀儡军团战斗人员。

2120411062.name: Are You Sure About This
2120411062.description: Use the Exotic weapon Telesto to defeat Tethys, the Defended. They were last seen in Rheasilvia in the Dreaming City.
2120411062.description_zh: 使用异域武器土卫十三击败受护者忒提斯。其最后一次出现的地点是幽梦之城的雷亚希尔维亚。

2134240709.name: Yarn Ball of Fate
2134240709.description: On Neptune, harness Strand sources and complete Vex Incursion Zone public events.
2134240709.description_zh: 在海王星上驾驭缚丝之源并完成Vex入侵区公共事件。

1358222483.name: That Wizard…
1358222483.description: On the Moon, defeat a powerful Wizard with your Super.
1358222483.description_zh: 在月球上，使用超能击败一个强大巫师。

1604631695.name: Hidden Thorn
1604631695.description: Defeat Nightmares on the Moon while the Exotic weapon Thorn is equipped.
1604631695.description_zh: 装备异域武器荆棘时在月球上消灭梦魇。

1988292922.name: A Bit Much, Really
1988292922.description: In any combatant-focused activity, defeat a single rank-and-file enemy combatant with your Super.
1988292922.description_zh: 在任意聚焦战斗人员的活动中，使用你的超能击败单个普通敌方战斗人员。

2087026461.name: That's More Like It
2087026461.description: Defeat 7 combatants with a single Nova Bomb, Thundercrash, or Blade Barrage.
2087026461.description_zh: 使用单次新星炸弹、雷霆冲击或利刃弹幕击败7名战斗人员。

3782809943.name: The Line Between Light and Dark
3782809943.name_zh: 光明和黑暗之间的界限
3782809943.description: Complete one strike with a Light subclass equipped and one strike with a Darkness subclass equipped.
3782809943.description_zh: 在装备光能分支职业和暗影分支职业的情况下分别完成一次打击。

1518435707.name: Stranded on Neomuna
1518435707.description: Defeat combatants on Neomuna with Strand energy. Bonus progress for defeating them with Strand abilities.
1518435707.description_zh: 在内欧姆那上使用缚丝能量击败战斗人员。使用缚丝技能击败他们可获得额外进度。

3675266603.name: Prismatic Heart
3675266603.description: Defeat combatants in the Pale Heart with abilities while a Prismatic subclass is equipped.
3675266603.description_zh: 在装备棱镜分支职业的情况下，使用技能击败苍白之心内的战斗人员。

476913641.name: Queqiao-41
476913641.description: Find the crashed satellite within K1 Logistics on the Moon.
476913641.description_zh: 在月球的K1后勤区内找到坠毁的卫星。

2426891225.name: Imbaru Chest
2426891225.description: Find the Imbaru chest hidden in the Queen's Bailey in the Throne World.
2426891225.description_zh: 找到隐藏在王座世界的女王的城墙内的薄雾宝箱。

1259632252.name: Pieces of the Whole
1259632252.description: Retrieve and return leftovers of strange meals belonging to Xûr. He may have dropped them at locations he's visited before.
1259632252.description_zh: 取得并归还属于仄的奇异膳食的剩余物。他可能把它们落在了以前去过的地方。

objectives.desc_zh: 奇异剩余物 - 欧洲无人区
奇异剩余物 - 涅索斯

1353863346.name: Right on the Marc
1353863346.description: Defeat combatants with a Sniper Rifle in Trostland in the EDZ.
1353863346.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的慰藉之地内使用狙击步枪击败战斗人员。

2569070679.name: A Poke in the Eye
2569070679.description: Defeat any Servitor boss in the EDZ.
2569070679.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区中击败任意魔眼首领。

2226302536.name: My Preciousssss
2226302536.description: Complete any full set of the following collectibles: Starcats in the Dreaming City, action figures on Neomuna, Lucent Moths in the Throne World, Visions of the Traveler in the Pale Heart, penguin souvenirs on Europa, or Jade Rabbits on the Moon.
2226302536.description_zh: 收集任意一整套下列收藏品：幽梦之城中的星猫、内欧姆那上的玩具人、王座世界中的光明飞蛾、苍白之心中的旅行者的幻象、木卫二上的企鹅纪念品，或是月球上的玉兔。

801789923.name: Ak-Baral, Nine-Touched
801789923.description: Find and destroy a corruption within the Veles Labyrinth in the Cosmodrome to draw the Nine's attention to Ak-Baral, Nine-Touched, then defeat him.
801789923.description_zh: 在发射基地的溪谷迷宫内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者阿克巴拉尔，然后将其击败。

1852316088.name: Yann, Nine-Touched
1852316088.description: Find and destroy a corruption within the Quarry in the EDZ to draw the Nine's attention to Nine-Touched Yann, then defeat him.
1852316088.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的采石场内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者扬，然后将其击败。

2314301817.name: Talas, Nine-Touched
2314301817.description: Find and destroy a corruption within The Rift on Nessus to draw the Nine's attention to Talas, Nine-Touched, then defeat him.
2314301817.description_zh: 在涅索斯的裂痕内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者塔拉斯，然后将其击败。

1560973788.name: Nightmare of Arguth, Nine-Touched
1560973788.description: Find and destroy a corruption within K1 Revelation on the Moon to draw the Nine's attention to Nightmare of Arguth, Nine-Touched, then defeat him.
1560973788.description_zh: 在月球的K1启示区内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者阿古斯的梦魇，然后将其击败。

643428014.name: Inkasi, Nine-Touched
643428014.description: Find and destroy a corruption within the Chamber of Starlight in the Dreaming City to draw the Nine's attention to Inkasi, Nine-Touched, then defeat her.
643428014.description_zh: 在幽梦之城的星光大殿内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者因卡希，然后将其击败。

3384926888.name: Teliks, Nine-Touched
3384926888.description: Find and destroy a corruption within the Concealed Void on Europa to draw the Nine's attention to Teliks, Nine-Touched, then defeat him.
3384926888.description_zh: 在木卫二的隐匿虚空内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者泰利克斯，然后将其击败。

2193413617.name: Bar-Zel, Nine-Touched
2193413617.description: Find and destroy a corruption within the Sepulcher in the Throne World to draw the Nine's attention to Bar-Zel, Nine-Touched, then defeat him.
2193413617.description_zh: 在王座世界的墓冢内找到并摧毁一个腐化，从而让玖注意到玖触者巴-泽尔，然后将其击败。

189880055.name: Don't Even Slow Down
189880055.description: Defeat combatants on the Moon with your Sparrow.
189880055.description_zh: 在月球上使用你的快雀击败战斗人员。

2424611893.name: I'm Tired, Boss
2424611893.description: Score or witness a perfect round of the Tire Game on the Moon.
2424611893.description_zh: 在月球上的轮胎游戏中赢得或见证一个完美回合。

2086197492.name: The Monument
2086197492.description: Inspect the Monument of Triumph in the Tower Courtyard.
2086197492.description_zh: 查看高塔庭院中的凯旋纪念碑。

1485875837.name: Lost Hope
1485875837.description: Find a scenic spot in the Exodus Black on Nessus.
1485875837.description_zh: 在涅索斯的黑色移民号内找到一处景色优美的地方。

1104760940.name: A Window to Eternity
1104760940.description: Find a scenic spot in Eternity. Land in Xûr's Treasure Hoard and then teleport to the arena beyond to locate it.
1104760940.description_zh: 在永恒找到一处景色优美的地方。降落到仄的宝藏窖藏，随后传送至另一侧竞技场找到它。

3698615008.name: Greetings from the Cosmodrome
3698615008.description: Find a scenic spot in Mothyards in the Cosmodrome.
3698615008.description_zh: 在发射基地的飞蛾庭院内找到一处景色优美的地方。

1159707090.name: The Silver of the Moon
1159707090.description: Find a scenic spot in Archer's Line on the Moon.
1159707090.description_zh: 在月球的弓手界线内找到一处景色优美的地方。

3208678441.name: A Dreamy View
3208678441.description: Find a scenic spot in The Strand in the Dreaming City.
3208678441.description_zh: 在幽梦之城的滨岸内找到一处景色优美的地方。

1682150570.name: Cloudy Skies and Mountains Bare
1682150570.description: Find a scenic spot in the Asterion Abyss on Europa.
1682150570.description_zh: 在木卫二的猎犬座深渊内找到一处景色优美的地方。

347005656.name: Witch Queen's Point of View
347005656.description: Find a scenic spot in the Quagmire in the Throne World.
347005656.description_zh: 在王座世界的沼泽区内找到一处景色优美的地方。

3621532773.name: Changed Perspective
3621532773.description: Find a scenic spot in the The Dark Forest in the EDZ.
3621532773.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的黑暗森林内找到一处景色优美的地方。

3911959437.name: A Futuristic Vision
3911959437.description: Find a scenic spot in Límíng Harbor on Neomuna.
3911959437.description_zh: 在内欧姆那的莱明港内找到一处景色优美的地方。

3582661423.name: An Impossible View
3582661423.description: Find a scenic spot in the Lost City in the Pale Heart.
3582661423.description_zh: 在苍白之心的失落之城内找到一处景色优美的地方。

980520049.name: Have You Lost Your Mind
980520049.description: Defeat combatants with Vex Craniums in the Ancient's Haunt on Nessus.
980520049.description_zh: 在涅索斯的远古故地内使用Vex颅骨击败战斗人员。

993673022.name: Laid to Rest… Again
993673022.description: Defeat combatants with the Solar Scythe in the K1 Crew Quarters on the Moon.
993673022.description_zh: 在月球的K1员工宿舍内使用烈日镰刀击败战斗人员。

858849207.name: Doomed Hydra
858849207.description: On Europa, in the Perdition Lost Sector, defeat the opening boss Hydra before it teleports to the second room.
858849207.description_zh: 在木卫二的永劫地狱遗失区域中，在开场首领九头蛇传送至第二个房间前将其击败。

2390659185.name: I've Got This
2390659185.description: Flawlessly solo any Expert Lost Sector.
2390659185.description_zh: 单人无瑕完成任意专家遗失区域。

627246520.name: Spider Tanks Defeated
627246520.description: Defeat a Fallen Spider Tank anywhere in the Cosmodrome.
627246520.description_zh: 在发射基地的任意位置击败一个堕落者蜘蛛坦克。

943774646.name: Loot Goblin
943774646.description: Disturb the remains in Skywatch in the Cosmodrome, then defeat the remnants of the past.
943774646.description_zh: 在发射基地的苍穹岗哨内打扰遗骸，然后击败来自过去的残余敌人。

3604299321.name: Intercepted Call
3604299321.description: Defeat combatants with an Interceptor anywhere in the EDZ.
3604299321.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区中使用拦截者击败战斗人员。

1334563377.name: Jump Starter
1334563377.description: During the "Rift Generator" public event, deliver Arc charges to the rift generator in the Dreaming City.
1334563377.description_zh: 在公共事件“裂痕发生器”期间，将电弧充能送至幽梦之城中的裂痕发生器。

1950118905.name: Treasure Hunt
1950118905.description: Open Ascendant chests with Tincture of Queensfoil in the Dreaming City.
1950118905.description_zh: 在幽梦之城中使用女王箔酊打开上维宝箱。

1948067627.name: Hurry Up
1948067627.description: Defeat Vex with the No Time to Explain Pulse Rifle on Europa.
1948067627.description_zh: 在木卫二上使用无时辩解脉冲步枪击败Vex。

621429186.name: Fireteam's Shadow
621429186.description: Defeat a Hive Guardian Knight, a Hive Guardian Wizard, and a Hive Guardian Acolyte anywhere in the Throne World.
621429186.description_zh: 在王座世界中的任意地点击败一个邪魔族守护者骑士、一个邪魔族守护者巫师和一个邪魔族守护者仆从。

objectives.desc_zh: 已击败邪魔族守护者骑士
已击败邪魔族守护者巫师
已击败邪魔族守护者仆从

2452164086.name: Vent Core: Frog Blasted
2452164086.description: Destroy a vent during the Cabal Injection Rig public event. The public event can be found at the EDZ, Nessus, or Neptune.
2452164086.description_zh: 在卡巴尔注入钻机公共事件期间摧毁一个排气口。此公共事件可发现于欧洲无人区、涅索斯或海王星。

3640619179.name: No Free Lunch
3640619179.description: Destroy a Glimmer refiner during a Fallen Glimmer Extraction public event. The public event can be found at the Cosmodrome or in the EDZ.
3640619179.description_zh: 在堕落者微光萃取公共事件期间摧毁一个微光精炼器。此公共事件可发现于发射基地或欧洲无人区。

2657312911.name: Mine Now
2657312911.description: Dunk an Arc charge during a Fallen Walker public event. The public event can be found at the Cosmodrome or on the Moon.
2657312911.description_zh: 在堕落者地行者公共事件期间存入一个电弧充能。此公共事件可发现于发射基地或月球。

2207811548.name: Maxed Out
