4292949226.name: Ghost Fragment: Vell Tarlowe's Ghost
4292949226.name_zh: 机灵碎片：维尔·塔罗的机灵

148777054.name: Regarding Eris's Fireteam
148777054.name_zh: 关于埃里斯的火力战队

148777055.name: Regarding Omnigul, Will of Crota
148777055.name_zh: 关于奥姆尼哥，克洛塔之意志

1387891285.name: Regarding Crota, Son of Oryx
1387891285.name_zh: 消灭克洛塔，欧里克斯之子

9093147.name: Confession of Hope | Part One
9093147.name_zh: 希望的告解 | 第I部分

4287282850.name: Confession of Hope | Part Two
4287282850.name_zh: 希望的告解 | 第II部分

3206508359.name: Regarding Stasis
3206508359.description: Collect Entropic Shards across Europa to unlock pages of this lore book and discover more about Eris's perspective on Stasis.
3206508359.description_zh: 收集木卫二上的暗熵碎片，解锁这本传奇故事书的页面并发掘埃里斯对于冰影的看法。

361587248.name: Pathfinding
361587248.description: The tale of Ada-1's journey to find new purpose in a dark time.
361587248.description_zh: 这则故事讲述了艾达-1在黑暗时期中寻找新目标的历程。

730835502.name: Triage
730835502.description: A Dark Age tale of love and loss.
730835502.description_zh: 一段来自黑暗时代的，关于爱情和丧失的故事。

2576000076.name: Persona
2576000076.description: A collection of selected poems detailing key experiences and machinations of the Warmind, Rasputin.
2576000076.description_zh: 详尽描述了战争思维拉斯普廷的主要经历和策划的精选诗集。

4060329179.name: The Collapse and The Dark Age

1304764682.name: Grimoire: Eris Morn—Hive God of Vengeance
1304764682.name_zh: 魔典：埃里斯·摩恩——邪魔族复仇之神

1304764687.name: Article: A Darker Hour? Looking Back at the Great Disaster
1304764687.name_zh: 文章：一个更黑暗的时刻？回顾大灾难

1304764673.name: Article: United in Hope—Our Neighbors in Neomuna
1304764673.name_zh: 文章：在希望中团结——我们在内欧姆那的邻居

1985151258.name: Article: A Consensus for the Rest of Us
1985151258.name_zh: 文章：我们其他人的元老院

1985151257.name: Grimoire: Allies—Eliksni
1985151257.name_zh: 魔典：盟友——埃里克斯尼族

1985151263.name: Article: Visitors Out of Dreams—Changing Reef Relations
1985151263.name_zh: 文章：梦中来客——暗礁关系变化

2829128988.name: Lightning Strike
2829128988.description: Defeat an opponent within 3 seconds of activating Arc Staff.
2829128988.description_zh: 电弧法杖激活后3秒内击败一名对手。

1520948702.name: Hurricane
1520948702.description: Defeat 3 opponents in a single Arc Staff activation.
1520948702.description_zh: 单次电弧法杖激活期间击败3名对手。

610352431.name: Expert Parry
610352431.description: Defeat an opponent with a deflected projectile.
610352431.description_zh: 通过转向的弹头击败一名对手。

254226652.name: Double Struck
254226652.description: Defeat 2 opponents in a single Gathering Storm Super.
254226652.description_zh: 使用单次风起云涌超能击败2名对手。

3171828746.name: Lethal Instinct
3171828746.description: Defeat an opponent within 2 seconds of activating Golden Gun.
3171828746.description_zh: 黄金枪激活后2秒内击败一名对手。

4075867812.name: Handful of Bullets
4075867812.description: Defeat 3 opponents in a single Golden Gun activation.
4075867812.description_zh: 单次激活黄金枪期间击败3名对手。

1968531028.name: Ace up the Sleeve
1968531028.description: Defeat at least three opponents with a single use of Blade Barrage.
1968531028.description_zh: 通过单次利刃弹幕击败至少三名对手。

1241987663.name: Entangled
1241987663.description: Defeat a tethered opponent within 5 seconds of casting Shadowshot.
1241987663.description_zh: 释放暗影箭矢后的5秒内击败一名被束缚的对手。

2369802491.name: Longbow
2369802491.description: Defeat an opponent with Shadowshot at a distance greater than 30 meters.
2369802491.description_zh: 在30米外使用暗影箭矢击败一名对手。

3420787827.name: Phantom
3420787827.description: Take no damage while defeating at least two opponents with Spectral Blades.
3420787827.description_zh: 使用鬼灵利刃击败至少两名对手而不受伤害。

4293979340.name: Silent Burst
4293979340.description: Shatter 2 or more opponents within 5 seconds of casting Silence and Squall.
4293979340.description_zh: 在施放沉默狂啸后的5秒内碎裂2名或更多对手。

3704115374.name: Distant Roar
3704115374.description: Defeat 2 opponents with Silence and Squall from a long distance.
3704115374.description_zh: 使用沉默狂啸从远距离击败2名对手。

1488324309.name: Weave-Shooter
1488324309.description: Defeat an opponent with a Silkstrike direct hit at maximum distance.
1488324309.description_zh: 在最远距离处使用丝线打击直接命中并击败一名对手。

1536279761.name: Weave-Slinger
1536279761.description: Defeat three or more opponents in a single use of Silkstrike, without taking any damage.
1536279761.description_zh: 在不受任何伤害的情况下，使用单次丝线打击击败三名或更多对手。

888959031.name: Perfect Guard
888959031.description: Block fatal damage within 2 seconds of activating Ward of Dawn.
888959031.description_zh: 黎明护罩激活后2秒内抵挡住致命伤害。

749935109.name: Flying Fortress
749935109.description: Defeat an opponent with a Shield Bash within 3 seconds of defeating an opponent with a Sentinel Shield melee.
749935109.description_zh: 使用哨兵圣盾强袭击败一名对手后的3秒内使用盾牌猛攻再击败一名对手。

3883136412.name: Fortified Assault
3883136412.description: Guard at least two teammates with Banner Shield.
3883136412.description_zh: 使用英杰圣盾保护至少两名队友。

2607171202.name: Absolute Force
2607171202.description: Defeat two or more opponents in a single Fists of Havoc slam.
2607171202.description_zh: 单次浩劫之拳猛击击败两名或两名以上对手。

320469561.name: Striker Special
320469561.description: In a single activation, defeat two opponents with Shoulder Charge, then a third with Fists of Havoc.
320469561.description_zh: 单次激活期间，先使用肩部冲撞击败两名对手，再使用浩劫之拳击败第三名对手。

1853453787.name: Cannonball!
1853453787.description: Defeat at least two opponents with Thundercrash after flying for more than five seconds.
1853453787.description_zh: 在空中飞行五秒以上后使用雷霆冲击击败至少两名对手。

4043184591.name: Pitch Perfect
4043184591.description: Defeat an opponent with Hammer of Sol at a distance greater than 30 meters.
4043184591.description_zh: 在30米外使用烈焰战锤击败一名对手。

2384812506.name: Everything Looks Like a Nail
2384812506.description: Defeat three opponents within a single Hammer of Sol activation.
2384812506.description_zh: 单次烈焰战锤激活期间，击败三名对手。

1449123915.name: Let's Go to the Maul
1449123915.name_zh: 让暴风锤来得更猛烈些吧
1449123915.description: Defeat at least three opponents with Burning Maul in under one second.
1449123915.description_zh: 使用燃烧锻锤在一秒内击败至少三名对手。

3382376169.name: 7-10 Split
3382376169.description: Shatter 2 or more opponents within 5 seconds of casting Glacial Quake.
3382376169.description_zh: 在施放冰川震击后的5秒内碎裂2名或更多对手。

2854653932.name: Agile Avalanche
2854653932.description: Defeat 3 opponents in a single Glacial Quake Super.
2854653932.description_zh: 使用单次冰川震击超能击败3名对手。

249719022.name: Suspended Action
249719022.description: Suspend opponents three or more times in a single use of Bladefury.
249719022.description_zh: 使用单次剑刃之怒悬停对手三次或以上。

1790349352.name: Unrelenting Fury
1790349352.description: Defeat three or more opponents in less than 3 seconds with Bladefury.
1790349352.description_zh: 使用剑刃之怒在3秒内击败三名或更多对手。

150410742.name: Falling Star
150410742.description: Defeat an opponent with Phoenix Dive while Daybreak is active.
150410742.description_zh: 黎明激活期间，使用凤凰俯冲击败一名对手。

2245159067.name: Defying Gravity
2245159067.description: In a single Daybreak activation, defeat two or more opponents without touching the ground.
2245159067.description_zh: 单次黎明激活状态下不接触地面击败两名或两名以上对手。

804966342.name: You Have My Sword
804966342.description: Earn three Radiant Assists from your allies defeating opponents inside your Well of Radiance.
804966342.description_zh: 通过站在你光焰之井中的同盟击败对手来获得三次光芒助攻。

3250576821.name: Singularity
3250576821.description: Defeat an opponent with a Nova Bomb Vortex.
3250576821.description_zh: 使用新星炸弹涡流击败一名对手。

2730873912.name: From Downtown
2730873912.description: Defeat two or more opponents with a Nova Bomb that was in the air for at least 5 seconds.
2730873912.description_zh: 在新星炸弹滞空至少5秒的情况下，击败两名或两名以上对手。

2873664434.name: Greetings from the Void
2873664434.description: Defeat at least two opponents with Nova Warp within a second of warping to them.
2873664434.description_zh: 使用新星折跃在折跃至敌人处的一秒内击败至少两名敌人。

122232331.name: Thunderstruck
122232331.description: Defeat an opponent with Landfall while casting Stormtrance.
122232331.description_zh: 释放雷霆万钧期间使用万雷轰顶击败一名对手。

1661433402.name: Lightning Storm
1661433402.description: Defeat two or more opponents in a single Stormtrance activation.
1661433402.description_zh: 单次雷霆万钧激活期间，击败两名或两名以上对手。

3247770296.name: Chaos Theory
3247770296.description: Defeat three opponents with a single use of Chaos Reach.
3247770296.description_zh: 通过单次混沌之触消灭三名敌人。

2110813544.name: Silver Thaw
2110813544.description: Freeze opponents 3 or more times in a single use of Winter's Wrath.
2110813544.description_zh: 使用单次严冬之怒冻结对手3次或以上。

2845565005.name: Cold as Ice
2845565005.description: Defeat 2 or more opponents in less than 1 second with Winter's Wrath.
2845565005.description_zh: 使用严冬之怒在1秒内击败2名或更多对手。

3553539685.name: Threatening Reach
3553539685.description: Defeat an opponent with a Needlestorm direct hit at a distance of greater than 30m.
3553539685.description_zh: 在30米外使用织针风暴直接命中并击败一名对手。

821105316.name: Tangled Teamwork
821105316.description: In a single use of Needlestorm, defeat two opponents with a direct hit, then defeat a third with Needlestorm's Threadlings.
821105316.description_zh: 使用单次织针风暴直接命中并击败两名对手，然后用织针风暴的线虫击败第三名对手。

1949622959.name: Blood For Blood
1949622959.description: Defeat an opponent who just defeated an ally.
1949622959.description_zh: 击败刚刚击败一名友军的对手。

1085820806.name: Best Served Cold
1085820806.description: Land the final blow on the Guardian who last defeated you.
1085820806.description_zh: 对上次击败你的守护者造成最后一击。

744611781.name: Not on My Watch
744611781.description: Land a final blow on an opponent who has damaged an ally.
744611781.description_zh: 对一名对友军造成伤害的对手造成最后一击。

1354623597.name: Quick Strike
1354623597.description: Defeat an opponent within the first 20 seconds of a match.
1354623597.description_zh: 在比赛开始的前20秒内击败一名对手。

1368535881.name: Scavenger
1368535881.description: Within three seconds of recovering a dropped ammo brick, use a Power weapon to defeat an opponent.
1368535881.description_zh: 在三秒内，拾起一个掉落的弹药盒并使用威能武器击败一名对手。

524267283.name: Comeback Kid
524267283.description: Defeat three opponents in a single life after having been defeated at least two consecutive times.
524267283.description_zh: 被连续击败至少两次后，在单次生命中击败三名对手。

1665727451.name: Dodge This
1665727451.description: Defeat a Hunter attempting to dodge.
1665727451.description_zh: 击败一名试图闪身的猎人。

2117657525.name: Barricade Breaker
2117657525.description: Defeat a Titan within 3 seconds of their deploying a Barricade.
2117657525.description_zh: 在一名泰坦部署一道屏障3秒内将其击败。

3551269017.name: Rift Breaker
3551269017.description: Defeat a Warlock while they are within their active Rift.
3551269017.description_zh: 在一名术士激活裂痕期间将其击败。

927808447.name: The Cycle
927808447.description: In a single match, land at least one final blow with each class of weapon (Kinetic, Energy, Power) and ability (Melee, Grenade, Super).
927808447.description_zh: 单场比赛中，使用每种武器（动能、能量、高能）和技能（近战、手雷、超能）各造成至少一次最后一击。

2093112817.name: Not So Fast, My Friend
2093112817.description: Defeat an opposing Guardian using your Super while their Super is active.
2093112817.description_zh: 在一名对方守护者超能激活情况下使用你的超能将其击败。

2553022812.name: Fight Me!
2553022812.description: Deal the most total damage to opponents in a single match.
2553022812.description_zh: 在单场比赛中对对方造成的总伤害最大。

2383705347.name: Never In Doubt
2383705347.description: Win a match in which your team always held the lead.
2383705347.description_zh: 在队伍始终领先的情况下赢得一场比赛。

818168620.name: From the Jaws of Defeat
818168620.description: Win a match after having trailed by a significant margin.
818168620.description_zh: 在大幅落后的情况下赢得一场比赛。

1113570756.name: Time and a Half
1113570756.description_zh: 在加时阶段赢得一场比赛。

2929994651.name: Crushed Them
2929994651.description: Win a match with a large margin of victory.
2929994651.description_zh: 以大幅优势赢得一场比赛。

2838497880.name: Never Speak of This Again
2838497880.description: Run over an opponent with your Sparrow.

125880363.name: Polyarmory
125880363.description: Crimson Days: In a single round, both you and your partner must land one final blow each with Kinetic, Energy, and Power weapons.
125880363.description_zh: 血色浪漫：在单个回合中，你和搭档必须用动能武器、能量武器和威能武器分别完成最后一击。

2466401256.name: Third Wheel
2466401256.description: Crimson Days: Rapidly defeat both your opponents while your partner is down.
2466401256.description_zh: 血色浪漫：当搭档倒下后，快速击败两名对手。

3366843568.name: Broken Up
3366843568.description: Crimson Days: As a pair, defeat both your opponents within 3 seconds while they are separated from each other.
3366843568.description_zh: 血色浪漫：双人合作，在对手彼此分开的情况下，3秒内击败两人。

3621793514.name: Heartbreaker
3621793514.description: Crimson Days: Win a match in sudden death.
3621793514.description_zh: 血色浪漫：突然死亡的情况下赢得一场比赛。

380324140.name: [Insert Medal Here]
380324140.description: In a single life, defeat 50 opposing Guardians.
380324140.description_zh: 单次生命中击败50名对方守护者。

380324143.name: I Made This for You
380324143.description: Shaxx made this for you. Awarded upon earning "[Insert Medal Here]."
380324143.description_zh: 沙克斯为你做的。在赢得“【此处有勋章】”时获得。

1110690562.name: Seventh Column
1110690562.description_zh: 快速击败7名对方守护者。

1708014788.name: Undefeated
1708014788.description: Complete a match in which you are never defeated by an opponent.
1708014788.description_zh: 在你从未被任何对手击败的情况下完成一场比赛。

2097461644.name: Annihilation
2097461644.description: Land final blows on the entire enemy team before any of them respawn.
2097461644.description_zh: 在对方其他队伍成员复活之前对整个对方队伍造成最后一击。

1582949833.name: We Ran Out of Medals
1582949833.description: In a single life, defeat 20 opposing Guardians
1582949833.description_zh: 单次生命中击败20名对方守护者

3354992513.name: Ghost in the Night
3354992513.description: Land final blows on seven opponents without taking any damage from any source.
3354992513.description_zh: 在未受到任何形式的伤害的情况下对七名对手造成最后一击。

4013516180.name: The Crown Is Mine
4013516180.description: Defeat an opponent who is on a streak of 20 or more.
4013516180.description_zh: 击败一名连胜20或以上的对手。

1923723704.name: Not. One. Inch.
1923723704.description: Breakthrough: Win a match in which your opponent never scores and never gains any capture progress on the Breaker.
1923723704.description_zh: 突破：在对手从未得分且从未由突破者获得任何占领进程的情况下赢得一场比赛。

1158326207.name: Power Overwhelming
1158326207.description: Control: As a team, defeat all opposing Guardians at least once during a single Power Play.
1158326207.description_zh: 占领：单次权力游戏期间，至少一次通过团队合作消灭所有敌方守护者。

3309756013.name: Perfect Game
3309756013.description: Countdown: Win a Countdown match in which your opponent never scores and never sets a charge.
3309756013.description_zh: 争分夺秒：在对方未得分且未安装炸弹状态下赢得一场争分夺秒模式比赛。

2547254187.name: Angels of Death
2547254187.description: Dominion: Win a match in which no one on your team is eliminated and no opponent is revived.
2547254187.description_zh: 统御：在无任何队友被击败且无任何对手复活的情况下赢得一场比赛。

4059534641.name: Total Mayhem
4059534641.description: Mayhem: As a team, land 10 Super final blows without anyone on your team being defeated.
4059534641.description_zh: 鏖战：在团队中任何成员未被击倒的情况下，团队合作，完成10次超能最后一击。

3320253771.name: Territorial Instinct
3320253771.description: Lockdown: Win a match without surrendering any capture progress.
3320253771.description_zh: 区域拒止：在不放弃任何占领进度的情况下赢得一场比赛。

2443801999.name: Saladin's Run
2443801999.description: Rift: Complete a Rift match with 2 or more carries and a 100% capture rate.
2443801999.description_zh: 裂痕：以2次或更多次携带以及100%捕获率完成一次裂痕比赛。

3454861973.name: The Sum of All Tears
3454861973.description: Rumble: Win a match with a score greater than or equal to the sum of all opponents' scores.
3454861973.description_zh: 混战：以高于或等于所有对手分数总和的分数赢得一场比赛。

906414425.name: Invincible
906414425.description: Showdown: Win a match in which no one on your team is defeated.
906414425.description_zh: 较量：在无任何队友被击败的情况下赢得一场比赛。

2498999201.name: A Crown of Crests
2498999201.description: Supremacy: Complete a match with the most crests created and a 100% secure rate.
2498999201.description_zh: 霸权：以最大纹章产生数量和100%夺取率完成一场比赛。

4292930078.name: Untouchable
4292930078.description: Survival: Win a match where no one on your team is defeated across all rounds.
4292930078.description_zh: 生存：在所有回合均无任何队伍成员被击败的情况下赢得一场比赛。

578825672.name: Pristine Guard
578825672.description: Zone Control: Win a match in which none of the zones your team owns are neutralized by the opposing team.
578825672.description_zh: 区域占领：在不让敌队中立化任何一个己方占领区的情况下赢得一场比赛。

1164610972.name: Lord of the Hunt
1164610972.description: As a team, defeat all opposing Guardians at least once during the Hunt.
1164610972.description_zh: 狩猎期间，至少一次通过团队合作击败对方全部守护者。

1164610975.name: Gone to Ground
1164610975.description: Survive a Hunt in which no member of your team is defeated—then start the next Hunt.
1164610975.description_zh: 在队友均未被消灭的情况下，在狩猎中存活下来——然后开始下一场狩猎。

1147833355.name: Field General
1147833355.description: Complete an Iron Banner match with the most combined Advantage and Hunt kills.
1147833355.description_zh: 以最高的优势和狩猎击杀数完成一场铁旗比赛。

1147833352.name: Sitting Ducks
1147833352.description: Defeat five opponents while holding Zone Advantage before the opposing team recaptures a zone.
1147833352.description_zh: 在对方队伍重新占领区域前保持区域优势消灭五个对手。

1147833353.name: Release the Hounds
1147833353.description: In a single life, participate in capturing all three zones leading to the Hunt.
1147833353.description_zh: 单次生命中，参与占领全部三个区域后的狩猎。

1147833358.name: Sly Fox
1147833358.description: Survive your opponents' Hunt without being defeated.
1147833358.description_zh: 在不被击败的情况下，在对手的狩猎中存活下来。

1131055798.name: Iron Protector
1131055798.description: In a single life, defeat three opponents attempting to capture allied capture zones.
1131055798.description_zh: 单次生命中，击败尝试占领盟友已占领区域的三名对手。

1131055797.name: Reversal of Fortune
1131055797.description: Recapture a zone within 15 seconds of it being captured by your opponents.
1131055797.description_zh: 在对方开始占领某区域15秒内重新将其占领。

1131055796.name: Tactical Shift
1131055796.description: Defeat two or more opponents with Zone Advantage within 10 seconds of capturing a zone.
1131055796.description_zh: 占领某个区域后的10秒内利用区域优势击败两名或两名以上对手。

1131055795.name: Midnight Society
1131055795.description: Capture a zone with your entire team present.
1131055795.description_zh: 在整个队伍都在场的情况下占领一个区域。

3837122685.name: One Fell Swoop
3837122685.description: Land final blows on the entire enemy team before any of them respawn.
3837122685.description_zh: 在对方其他队伍成员复活之前对整个对方队伍造成最后一击。

2551866397.name: Seven Deadly
2551866397.description_zh: 快速击败7名对方守护者。

2535088810.name: Six Fronts
2535088810.description_zh: 快速击败6名对方守护者。

2518311239.name: Gimme Five
2518311239.description_zh: 快速击败5名对方守护者。

2501533652.name: Go Fourth
2501533652.description_zh: 快速击败4名对方守护者。

2484756065.name: Triple Strike
2484756065.description_zh: 快速击败3名对方守护者。

2467978494.name: Double Quick
2467978494.description_zh: 快速击败2名对方守护者。

2125533337.name: Blood Will Have Blood
2125533337.description: Land the final blow on the Guardian who last defeated you.
2125533337.description_zh: 对上次击败你的守护者造成最后一击。

1972046984.name: Settled Score
1972046984.description: Land the final blow on an opponent who just defeated an ally.
1972046984.description_zh: 对刚刚击败一名盟友的对手造成最后一击。

3280660743.name: Bite Back
3280660743.description: Land the final blow on an opponent who has recently damaged an ally.
3280660743.description_zh: 对最近伤害一名盟友的对手造成最后一击。

15096579.name: Warlord
15096579.description: Complete an Iron Banner match in which you defeat at least seven opponents and are never defeated by an opponent.
15096579.description_zh: 在击败至少七名对手且从未被任何对手击败的情况下完成一场铁旗比赛。

4123151973.name: Usurper
4123151973.description: Shut down an opponent's streak of 20 or more
4123151973.description_zh: 终结一名对手20或以上的连杀

1314438298.name: Fifth Horseman
1314438298.description: In a single life, defeat 50 opposing Guardians.
1314438298.description_zh: 单次生命中击败50名对方守护者。

874511848.name: Iron Legend
874511848.description: In a single life, defeat 20 opposing Guardians.
874511848.description_zh: 单次生命中击败20名对方守护者。

341381567.name: Iron Lord
341381567.description: In a single life, defeat 10 opposing Guardians.
341381567.description_zh: 单次生命中击败10名对方守护者。

3219328888.name: Heart of the Pack
3219328888.description: As a team, defeat 7 opposing Guardians without any member of your team being defeated.
3219328888.description_zh: 团队合作，在任何队伍成员不被击败的情况下击败7名对方守护者。

689957971.name: Wolf at the Door
689957971.description: In a single life, defeat 5 opposing Guardians.
689957971.description_zh: 单次生命中击败5名对方守护者。

1155506910.name: Vindication
1155506910.description: Defeat 3 opponents in a single life after having been defeated two consecutive times.
1155506910.description_zh: 被连续击败两次后，在单次生命中击败3名对手。

933887906.name: Running with the Pack
933887906.description: In a single life, defeat 3 opposing Guardians while assisting or assisted by your teammates.
933887906.description_zh: 单次生命中在助攻队友或队友助攻的情况下击败3名对方守护者。

4099706534.name: Ghost Wolf
4099706534.description: Land final blows on seven opponents without taking any damage from any source.
4099706534.description_zh: 在未受到任何伤害的情况下对七名对手造成最后一击。

1206381584.name: Overwhelming Force
1206381584.description: Win an Iron Banner match with a large margin of victory.
1206381584.description_zh: 以大幅优势赢得一场铁旗比赛。

3444384395.name: Violent Delights
3444384395.description: Deal the most total damage to opponents in a single Iron Banner match.
3444384395.description_zh: 在单场铁旗比赛中对对方造成的总伤害最大。

2928272465.name: About Face
2928272465.description: Win an Iron Banner match after having trailed by a significant margin.
2928272465.description_zh: 在大幅落后的情况下赢得一场铁旗比赛。

1983224700.name: From the Front
1983224700.description: Win a match in which your team always held the lead.
1983224700.description_zh: 在队伍始终领先的情况下赢得一场比赛。

1275964985.name: Down to the Wire
1275964985.description: Win an Iron Banner match in overtime.
1275964985.description_zh: 在加时赛中赢得一场铁旗比赛。

3033690936.name: The Armory
3033690936.description: In a single Iron Banner match, land at least one final blow with each class of weapon (Kinetic, Energy, Power) and ability (melee, grenade, Super).
3033690936.description_zh: 单场铁旗比赛中，使用每种武器（动能、能量、高能）和技能（近战、手雷、超能）各造成至少一次最后一击。

2460187465.name: First Blood
2460187465.description: Land the first final blow of the match.
2460187465.description_zh: 在比赛中造成第一个最后一击。

1109255000.name: Force of Nature
1109255000.description: Stop an opponent's Super with your Super.
1109255000.description_zh: 用你的超能打断对手的超能。

1209923636.name: Let's Plow the Road!
1209923636.description: Breakthrough: As a team, defeat each defending opponent at least once after deploying the Breaker and before their base is exposed.
1209923636.description_zh: 突破：团队合作，在部署突破者后以及对手基地暴露前，击败每个进行防守的对手至少一次。

1209923639.name: Better Late than Never
1209923639.description: Breakthrough: Hack your opponent's vault in Sudden Death.
1209923639.description_zh: 突破：在突然死亡时入侵对方保险库。

1209923638.name: You're Breaking Up
1209923638.description: Breakthrough: In a single life, defeat three opponents attempting to deploy the Breaker.
1209923638.description_zh: 突破：单次生命中，击败尝试部署突破者的三名对手。

1159590909.name: The Line Must Be Drawn Here!
1159590909.description: Breakthrough: Defend your vault without allowing your opponents to gain any capture progress.
1159590909.description_zh: 突破：在你的对手没有获得任何占领进程的情况下防守你的保险库。

1159590910.name: Steamroller
1159590910.description: Breakthrough: Win a round by deploying the Breaker and hacking your opponent's vault in under a minute total.
1159590910.description_zh: 突破：以在一分钟内部署突破者并入侵对手保险库的方式赢得一个回合。

1229563347.name: Perimeter Control
1229563347.description: Control: In a single life, defeat three opponents attempting to capture your team's capture zones.
1229563347.description_zh: 占领：单次生命中，击败尝试占领你队伍已占领区域的三名对手。

1229563344.name: Reclaimer
1229563344.description: Control: Recapture a zone within 15 seconds of it being captured by your opponents.
1229563344.description_zh: 占领：在对方开始占领某区域15秒内重新将其占领。

1229563345.name: Capture and Control
1229563345.description: Control: Defeat two opponents with Zone Advantage within 10 seconds of capturing a zone.
1229563345.description_zh: 占领：占领某个区域后的10秒内利用区域优势击败两名对手。

1212785790.name: Flagbearer
1212785790.description: Control: Complete a Control match with the most combined Advantage and Power Play kills.
1212785790.description_zh: 占领：以最高的优势和权力游戏综合击杀数完成一场占领比赛。

1212785789.name: Dominant Advantage
1212785789.description: Control: Score five Advantage or Power Play kills before the opponent recaptures a zone.
1212785789.description_zh: 占领：在对手重新占领某个区域之前完成五次优势击杀或权力游戏击杀。

980199497.name: Counter Attack
980199497.description: Countdown: Defeat an opponent within 5 seconds of them setting a charge.
980199497.description_zh: 争分夺秒：在对方安装炸弹后5秒内将其击败。

980199498.name: Pyrotechnics
980199498.description: Countdown: Set a charge that successfully detonates.
980199498.description_zh: 争分夺秒：安装一枚炸弹并成功引爆。

980199499.name: Bombs? What Bombs?
980199499.description: Countdown: Defuse multiple charges in a single match.
980199499.description_zh: 争分夺秒：单场比赛中拆除多枚炸弹。

1030532224.name: Last Stand
1030532224.description: Countdown: Defuse the charge as the last Guardian standing.
1030532224.description_zh: 争分夺秒：作为最后存活的守护者拆除炸弹。

1030532227.name: The Gang's All Here
1030532227.description: Countdown: Win a round with your entire team alive.
1030532227.description_zh: 争分夺秒：在整个队伍存活的情况下赢得一个回合。

1774860535.name: Speedrunner
1774860535.description: Dominion: As a team, win a round within 20 seconds.
1774860535.description_zh: 统御：团队合作，在20秒内赢得一个回合。

1774860532.name: Back in the Fight
1774860532.description: Dominion: Revive all teammates as the last Guardian standing.
1774860532.description_zh: 统御：作为最后一名存活的守护者复活所有队友。

1774860533.name: Oldest Trick in the Book
1774860533.description: Dominion: Eliminate both an opponent who was just revived and the opponent who revived them.
1774860533.description_zh: 统御：击败一个刚刚复活的对手和复活此人的对手。

1758082914.name: Sharing is Caring
1758082914.description: Dominion: As a team, win a round in which each player eliminates a different opponent and no opponent is revived.
1758082914.description_zh: 统御：团队合作，在每人击败一个不同的对手且无对手复活的情况下赢得一个回合。

1758082913.name: Process of Dominion
1758082913.description: Dominion: In a single round, eliminate all opponents without any assistance from your teammates.
1758082913.description_zh: 统御：在单个回合中，在无任何队友援助的情况下击败所有对手。

3304227751.name: We're Halfway There
3304227751.description: Lockdown: Reach 50% progress without being halted or controlling fewer than two zones.
3304227751.description_zh: 区域拒止：在进度未被中止或控制两个或两个以上区域的情况下完成50%的进度。

3304227748.name: Nice Try
3304227748.description: Lockdown: Defeat an opponent attempting to capture a third zone.
3304227748.description_zh: 区域拒止：击败一名试图占领第三个区域的对手。

3304227749.name: Slow and Steady
3304227749.description: Lockdown: Win a match without earning a Lockdown.
3304227749.description_zh: 区域拒止：在未完成区域拒止的情况下赢得一场比赛。

3287450194.name: Still Counts!
3287450194.description: Lockdown: Win a round with a Lockdown while trailing in total progress.
3287450194.description_zh: 区域拒止：在总进度落后的情况下，通过完成区域拒止而赢得回合。

3287450193.name: Last Line
3287450193.description: Lockdown: Block a Lockdown by halting capture progress and recapturing a zone.
3287450193.description_zh: 区域拒止：通过中止占领进度并重获区域来阻止区域拒止。

168901129.name: Light 'Em Up
168901129.description: Mayhem: Cast the first Super of the match.
168901129.description_zh: 鏖战：施放比赛中的第一个超能。

168901130.name: Fire in the Hole!
168901130.description: Mayhem: In a single life, land five grenade final blows.
168901130.description_zh: 鏖战：单次生命中完成五次手雷最后一击。

168901131.name: Punch and Pie
168901131.description: Mayhem: In a single life, land three melee final blows.
168901131.description_zh: 鏖战：单次生命中完成三次近战最后一击。

219234112.name: Superstar
219234112.description: Mayhem: In a single life, cast three Supers.
219234112.description_zh: 鏖战：单次生命中施放三次超能。

219234115.name: By Our Powers Combined…
219234115.description: Mayhem: As a team, rapidly cast all of your Supers.
219234115.description_zh: 鏖战：团队合作，全部成员迅速施放超能。

2319188939.name: Clear a Path
2319188939.description: Rift: In a single Spark run, defeat 2 opponents who damage your team's Runner.
2319188939.description_zh: 裂痕：在单次火花竞逐中，击败2名对你队伍的逃亡者造成伤害的对手。

2319188936.name: Spark Denied
2319188936.description: Rift: Defeat an opposing Spark Runner near the Rift.
2319188936.description_zh: 裂痕：击败一名靠近裂痕的敌对火花逃亡者。

2302411382.name: Sweep the Leg
2302411382.description: Rift: Defeat an opposing Spark Runner 3 times in a single match.
2302411382.description_zh: 裂痕：单次比赛中击败一名敌对火花逃亡者3次。

2302411381.name: Caiatl's Dominance
2302411381.description: Rift: Capture the Spark 3 times in a single match.
2302411381.description_zh: 裂痕：单场比赛中捕获火花3次。

2285633765.name: Saladin's Run
2285633765.description: Rift: Complete a Rift match with 2 or more carries and a 100% capture rate.
2285633765.description_zh: 裂痕：以2次或更多次携带以及100%捕获率完成一次裂痕比赛。

1780466125.name: Best in Class
1780466125.description: Rumble: In a single life, defeat at least one Hunter, one Titan, and one Warlock.
1780466125.description_zh: 混战：单次生命中击败至少一名猎人、一名泰坦和一名术士。

1780466126.name: Assassin
1780466126.description: Rumble: In a single life, land three unassisted final blows without taking any damage in between.
1780466126.description_zh: 混战：单次生命中，在未受到帮助且未受到任何伤害的情况下完成三次最后一击。

1780466127.name: Pickpocket
1780466127.description: Rumble: In a single life, steal five final blows from your opponents.
1780466127.description_zh: 混战：单次生命中从对手处盗走五次最后一击。

1830798852.name: Podium Finish
1830798852.description: Rumble: Finish in the top three.
1830798852.description_zh: 混战：在一次混战比赛中获得前三。

1830798855.name: Round Robin
1830798855.description: Rumble: In a single life, defeat each opposing player at least once.
1830798855.description_zh: 混战：单次生命中击败每一名对方玩家至少一次。

3440773513.name: Local Maxima
3440773513.description: Showdown: Defeat the most opponents in a single round.
3440773513.description_zh: 较量：在单个回合中击败最多对手。

3440773514.name: Denial of Service
3440773514.description: Showdown: As a team, collect three consecutive ammo crates in a single match.
3440773514.description_zh: 较量：团队合作，在单个比赛中连续获得三个弹药补给箱。

3440773515.name: Clawing Back
3440773515.description: Showdown: Within a round, retake the lead after trailing by 5 points.
3440773515.description_zh: 较量：同一回合内，在落后5分情况下夺回领先地位。

3491106496.name: When the Dust Clears
3491106496.description: Showdown: Win a Final Showdown in which your entire team survives.
3491106496.description_zh: 较量：全队存活情况下赢得最终较量。

3491106499.name: We're Not Done Yet
3491106499.description: Showdown: Force a Final Showdown round after trailing 0–2.
3491106499.description_zh: 较量：在落后0-2的情况下进行最终较量。

1914568433.name: First Secure
1914568433.description: Supremacy: Secure the first crest in a match.
1914568433.description_zh: 霸权：在比赛中夺取第一枚纹章。

1914568434.name: Steadfast Ally
1914568434.description: Supremacy: Recover three allied crests in a single life.
1914568434.description_zh: 霸权：单次生命中回收三枚友军的纹章。

1914568435.name: Safe and Secured
1914568435.description: Supremacy: Secure three opposing crests in a single life.
1914568435.description_zh: 霸权：单次生命中夺取三枚对方的纹章。

1964901160.name: Crestfallen
1964901160.description: Supremacy: In a single life, create five consecutive crests that are secured by your teammates.
1964901160.description_zh: 霸权：单次生命中连续产生五枚纹章并由队友夺取。

1964901163.name: My Crest is My Own
1964901163.description: Supremacy: Complete a match in which your crest is never collected by an opponent.
1964901163.description_zh: 霸权：在自己的纹章从未被对方收集的情况下完成一场比赛。

842396238.name: Lone Gun
842396238.description: Survival: Win a round as the last surviving Guardian on your team.
842396238.description_zh: 生存：作为队伍唯一存活的守护者赢得一个回合。

842396237.name: Survivor
842396237.description: Survival: Win a round without being defeated.
842396237.description_zh: 生存：在未被击败的情况下赢得一个回合。

842396236.name: Minute to Win It
842396236.description: Survival: As a team, win a round within 1 minute.
842396236.description_zh: 生存：在一分钟内团队合作赢得生存模式的一个回合。

859173795.name: Undertaker
859173795.description: Survival: Land all knockout blows on the opposing team in a single round.
859173795.description_zh: 生存：在单个回合中对对方队伍全部成员造成最后一击。

859173792.name: According to Plan
859173792.description: Survival: Win a round despite being scoreless on Match Point.
859173792.description_zh: 生存：在赛点未得一分的情况下赢得一个回合。

1466614104.name: Proactive Defense
1466614104.description: Zone Control: In a single life, defeat 3 opponents attempting to neutralize an allied zone.
1466614104.description_zh: 区域占领：单次生命中，击败3名试图中立化己方占领区的对手。

1466614107.name: Fractured Capture
1466614107.description: Zone Control: Reclaim a zone that was neutralized but not captured by the opposing team.
1466614107.description_zh: 区域占领：重新占领遭敌队中立化但尚未被其占领的区域。

1466614106.name: Close Call
1466614106.description: Zone Control: Neutralize a zone within 15 seconds of the opposing team capturing it.
1466614106.description_zh: 区域占领：在敌队占领一个区域后的15秒内使之中立化。

1416281313.name: Peak Performance
1416281313.description: Zone Control: Win a match with the highest score on your team.
1416281313.description_zh: 区域占领：获得本队最高分，并赢得比赛。

1416281314.name: Squad Goals
1416281314.description: Zone Control: In a single match, neutralize and capture 2 zones with 3 or more teammates.
1416281314.description_zh: 区域占领：在单场比赛中，与至少3名队友一起中立化并占领2个区域。

2598105597.name: Double Play
2598105597.description_zh: 快速击败2名对方守护者。

2865685235.name: Combined Fire
2865685235.description: In a single life, defeat 3 opposing Guardians while assisting or assisted by your teammates.
2865685235.description_zh: 单次生命中在助攻队友或队友助攻的情况下击败3名对方守护者。

2581327754.name: Triple Play
2581327754.description_zh: 快速击败3名对方守护者。

1148315053.name: Ruthless
1148315053.description: In a single life, defeat 5 opposing Guardians.
1148315053.description_zh: 单次生命中击败5名对方守护者。

2497439851.name: Lights Out
2497439851.description_zh: 快速击败4名对方守护者。

742600771.name: Unyielding
742600771.description: In a single life, defeat 10 opposing Guardians.
742600771.description_zh: 单次生命中击败10名对方守护者。

2480662264.name: Slayer
2480662264.description_zh: 快速击败五名对方守护者。

3914317025.name: Wrecking Crew
3914317025.description: As a team, defeat 7 opposing Guardians without any of your team dying.
3914317025.description_zh: 在任何队伍成员不死亡的情况下进行团队合作击败7名对方守护者。

2530995009.name: Reaper
2530995009.description_zh: 快速击败6名对方守护者。

3384914270.name: Flawless Execution
3384914270.description: Win a match in which no one on your team is eliminated and no opponent is revived.
3384914270.description_zh: 在你的队伍中没有人被击败且无对手被复活的情况下赢得一场比赛。

3384914269.name: Lighthouse Ascendant
3384914269.description: Complete a match in which you eliminate at least 7 opponents and are never eliminated by an opponent.
3384914269.description_zh: 在击败至少7名对手且未被对手击败的情况下完成一场比赛。

3368136653.name: Paradoxically Perfect
3368136653.description: As a team, win a round in which each player eliminates a different opponent and no opponent is revived.
3368136653.description_zh: 团队合作，在每人击败一个不同的对手且无对手被复活的情况下赢得一个回合。

3368136654.name: Only One Ascends
3368136654.description: In a single round, eliminate all opponents without any assistance from your teammates.
3368136654.description_zh: 单个回合中，在没有来自队友的助攻的情况下击败所有对手。

3368136655.name: Dead Never Die
3368136655.description: Win a round in which each player on your team is revived once.
3368136655.description_zh: 在队伍每人均被复活一次的情况下赢得一个回合。

3368136648.name: Phoenix Strike
3368136648.description: Land the final elimination of a round after being revived.
3368136648.description_zh: 在被复活后完成一个回合中最后的击杀。

3418469380.name: Time Trial
3418469380.description: As a team, win a round within 20 seconds.
3418469380.description_zh: 团队合作，在20秒内赢得一个回合。

3418469383.name: Anchor of Light
3418469383.description: Revive a teammate as the last Guardian standing.
3418469383.description_zh: 作为最后存活的守护者复活一名队友。

3418469382.name: False Hope
3418469382.description: Eliminate both an opponent who was just revived and the opponent who revived them.
3418469382.description_zh: 击败一个刚刚复活的敌人和复活他的人。

3418469377.name: Evens at Odds
3418469377.description: Eliminate at least one opponent attempting to capture the tiebreaker.
3418469377.description_zh: 击败至少一个企图占领决胜区域的敌人。

2261995322.name: Starless Night
2261995322.description: Eliminate every opponent in the match without being eliminated.
2261995322.description_zh: 在比赛中从未被击败的情况下击败所有对手。

1005367067.name: Bring the Dawn
1005367067.description: Instantly eliminate the entire opposing team without any assistance from your teammates.
1005367067.description_zh: 在没有获得队友的助攻的情况下瞬间击败整支敌方队伍。

3865828514.name: They Will Sing of You
3865828514.description_zh: 在不被击败的情况下击败11名对手。

2099732824.name: I Am Invincible!
2099732824.description: Eliminate 5 opponents without taking any damage from any source.
2099732824.description_zh: 在未受到任何伤害的情况下击败5名对手。

2143963537.name: Immortal Icon
2143963537.description_zh: 在不被击败的情况下击败7名对手。

3227371467.name: Showstopper
3227371467.description: Eliminate an opponent on a streak of 3 or more.
3227371467.description_zh: 击败一名已经连杀3人或以上的对手。

4151048165.name: Saintly Glow
4151048165.description_zh: 在不被击败的情况下击败3名对手。

2069423792.name: Concentrated Fireteam
2069423792.description: Eliminate an opponent with damage from your entire team.
2069423792.description_zh: 通过整支队伍的伤害击败一名对手。

2017982576.name: Ambition of Osiris
2017982576.description: Win a match in which your opponent never scores.
2017982576.description_zh: 在对手未得一分的情况下赢得一场比赛。

1261592446.name: Flight of the Pigeon
1261592446.description: Win a match in which your team always held the lead.
1261592446.description_zh: 在队伍始终领先的情况下赢得一场比赛。

3572804503.name: From the Brink
3572804503.description: Win a match after having been scoreless at match point.
3572804503.description_zh: 在己方未得分且对方拥有赛点的情况下翻盘一场比赛。

2244695745.name: Skull Breaker
2244695745.description: Deal the most total damage to opponents in a match.
2244695745.description_zh: 在单场比赛中对对手造成的总伤害最高。

2775732982.name: Brighter
2775732982.description: Stop an opponent's Super with your own Super.
2775732982.description_zh: 用你自己的超能阻止一名敌人的超能。

3385572622.name: The Sword
3385572622.description: Eliminate an opponent who has just eliminated a teammate.
3385572622.description_zh: 击败一个刚刚击败了你的队友的敌人。

428678661.name: The Shield
428678661.description: Eliminate an opponent who has damaged a teammate.
428678661.description_zh: 击败一个刚刚伤害了你的队友的敌人。

125435091.name: In This Life or the Next
125435091.description: Eliminate the opponent who last eliminated you.
125435091.description_zh: 击败最后击败你的对手。

976378567.name: The Beginning
976378567.description: Land the first elimination of a match.

2640484617.name: The End
2640484617.description: Land the final elimination of a match.
2640484617.description_zh: 在比赛中完成最后的击杀。

3544952408.name: Assault Specialist
3544952408.description: In a single match, defeat 7 opponents with Auto Rifle final blows.
3544952408.description_zh: 单场比赛中使用自动步枪对7名对手造成最后一击。

3391681972.name: Lethal Cadence
3391681972.description: In a single match, defeat 7 opponents with Pulse Rifle final blows.
3391681972.description_zh: 单场比赛中，使用脉冲步枪对7名对手造成最后一击。

2567785345.name: Field Scout
2567785345.description: In a single match, defeat 5 opponents at long range with Scout Rifle final blows.
2567785345.description_zh: 单场比赛中，使用斥候步枪远距离对5名对手造成最后一击。

3899252358.name: Hawkeye
3899252358.description: In a single life, defeat two opponents with precision Hand Cannon final blows.
3899252358.description_zh: 单次生命中使用手炮对两名对手造成精准最后一击。

2305914832.name: Sub Machinist
2305914832.description: In a single life, defeat 2 opponents with Submachine Gun final blows.
2305914832.description_zh: 单次生命中使用微型冲锋枪对2名对手造成最后一击。

1426442870.name: One for Each of You
1426442870.description: Deliver a final blow with a Sidearm within 5 seconds of landing a final blow with any other weapon.
1426442870.description_zh: 使用任何其他武器完成最后一击的5秒内使用手枪再次完成最后一击。

2342176915.name: My Bowfriend's Back
2342176915.description: In a single life, land three precision final blows with a Bow.
2342176915.description_zh: 单次生命中，使用一支弓箭完成三次精准最后一击。

1463572369.name: Cold Fusion
1463572369.description: In a single life, defeat two opponents with a Fusion Rifle.
1463572369.description_zh: 单次生命中使用融合步枪击败两名对手。

3108604421.name: Close Encounters
3108604421.description: Defeat two opponents at close range with a Shotgun without switching weapons or reloading.
3108604421.description_zh: 在不切换武器或填装的情况下，使用霰弹枪近距离击败两名对手。

4197058840.name: Mission Control
4197058840.description: Defeat two opponents with long range, precision Sniper Rifle final blows without switching weapons or reloading.
4197058840.description_zh: 在不切换武器或填装的情况下，利用狙击步枪的远程精准最后一击击败两名对手。

3213956593.name: Calculated Trajectory
3213956593.description: In a single life, defeat three opponents with Grenade Launcher final blows.
3213956593.description_zh: 单次生命中使用榴弹发射器最后一击击败三名对手。

3460650895.name: Make It Rain
3460650895.description: With any Machine Gun, defeat three opponents without reloading or switching weapons.
3460650895.description_zh: 使用任意机枪，在不装填或切换武器的情况下击败三名敌人。

3711241817.name: Splash Damage
3711241817.description: Defeat two or more opponents with a single rocket.
3711241817.description_zh: 使用一枚火箭击败两名或两名以上对手。

740707568.name: Regent
740707568.description: Defeat two opponents with a sword without switching weapons.
740707568.description_zh: 在不切换武器的情况下，用刀剑击败两名对手。

2998853647.name: Fond Farewell
2998853647.description: Kill an opposing Guardian in the last five seconds of your invasion and be emoting when Drifter brings you back to your side.
2998853647.description_zh: 在你入侵的最后五秒钟内击杀一名对方守护者，并在浪客将你带回己方阵地时做动作。

1639297179.name: Maximum Carnage
1639297179.description: As an Invader, defeat seven Guardians in a single invasion before Drifter brings you back to your side.
1639297179.description_zh: 作为入侵者，在浪客将你带回己方阵地前的单次入侵中击败七名守护者。

511083400.name: Army of One
511083400.description: As an invader, defeat four opposing Guardians in a single invasion.
511083400.description_zh: 作为入侵者，在单次入侵中击败对方四名守护者。

947052851.name: Mote Have Been
947052851.description: As an invader, defeat a Guardian carrying 15 Motes.
947052851.description_zh: 作为入侵者，击败一名携带15粒萤光的守护者。

2789598066.name: Denied!
2789598066.description: As an invader, deny at least 10 Motes by destroying all Guardians who are carrying Motes.
2789598066.description_zh: 作为入侵者，通过击败所有携带萤光的守护者否认至少10粒萤光。

4283831816.name: Bank THIS!
4283831816.description: As an invader, defeat a Guardian who is carrying Motes near the bank.
4283831816.description_zh: 作为入侵者，击败一名位于萤光库附近携带萤光的守护者。

477058234.name: Relentless Invader
477058234.description: As an invader, get a kill after your time limit expires.
477058234.description_zh: 作为入侵者，在时限结束后完成一次击杀。

2616500967.name: Get Primeval
2616500967.description: Deal over half of your team's damage to a Primeval and defeat the Primeval to win the round.
2616500967.description_zh: 对古昧的伤害量占己方队伍总量的一半以上，并击败古昧以赢得回合。

4206114008.name: Rainmaker
4206114008.description: Win a round with the most combatants killed and fewest Motes lost on your team.
4206114008.description_zh: 作为己方队伍击杀战斗人员最多且失去萤光最少的成员赢得回合。

4220005143.name: Last Guardian Standing
4220005143.description: Kill an Invader while you're the only living member of your team.
4220005143.description_zh: 作为己方队伍唯一存活的成员击杀一名入侵者。

3495228040.name: By the Skin of Your Teeth
3495228040.description: Kill your Primeval while the opposing Primeval has very little health remaining.
3495228040.description_zh: 在对方古昧生命值非常低的情况下击杀己方古昧。

3976371416.name: Locksmith
3976371416.description: Defeat the last Blocker at your team's bank three times in a single round.
3976371416.description_zh: 在单个回合中，击败位于己方萤光库的最后一名阻绝者，共计3次。

1197518485.name: Half-Banked
1197518485.description: Deposit at least half your bank's capacity in a single round.
1197518485.description_zh: 单回合中注入的萤光数量至少占己方萤光库的一半。

1438116414.name: Killmonger
1438116414.description: Defeat 20 enemies in a single match without dying.
1438116414.description_zh: 单场比赛中，在不死亡的情况下击败20名敌人。

2257346269.name: Thrillmonger
2257346269.description: Defeat 40 enemies in a single match without dying.
2257346269.description_zh: 单场比赛中，在不死亡的情况下击败40名敌人。

433799052.name: Overkillmonger
433799052.description: Defeat 80 enemies in a single match without dying.
433799052.description_zh: 单场比赛中，在不死亡的情况下击败80名敌人。

3800921268.name: Payback
3800921268.description: Before you die again, defeat the player who last defeated you.
3800921268.description_zh: 在再次死亡之前，击杀上一个击败你的玩家。

353633377.name: Rapid Payback
353633377.description: After reviving, defeat the invader who destroyed you before they escape.
353633377.description_zh: 在复活后，在击败你的入侵者逃脱之前将其击杀。

3483842827.name: Massacre
3483842827.description: Defeat 12 enemies with no more than 3 seconds between kills.
3483842827.description_zh: 在每次击杀间隔不超过3秒的情况下连续击败12名敌人。

2476159161.name: No Escape
2476159161.description: Defeat an invader with 5 seconds or less left on their timer.
2476159161.description_zh: 在入侵者的入侵倒计时剩余5秒或不足5秒的情况下将其消灭。

2345177128.name: Blockbuster
2345177128.description: Defeat three Blockers with no more than 3 seconds between kills.
2345177128.description_zh: 在每次击杀间隔不超过3秒的情况下连续消灭三名阻绝者。

1622244172.name: First to Block
1622244172.description: Be the first player in a round to lock the other team's bank.
1622244172.description_zh: 在一个回合中成为第一个封锁对方萤光库的人。

3359240632.name: Big Game Hunter
3359240632.description: Defeat three powerful enemies within a short time period.
3359240632.description_zh: 短时间内消灭三名强大的敌人。

1334533602.name: Not on My Watch
1334533602.description: Defeat an invader within 10 seconds of their appearance in your arena before they defeat anyone on your team.
1334533602.description_zh: 在入侵者出现在己方竞技场的10秒内且未击败己方任何队员的情况下击败一名入侵者。

910211739.name: Titan Smash
910211739.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Fists of Havoc Super.
910211739.description_zh: 通过单次浩劫之拳超能快速消灭多名敌人。

1161965014.name: A Titan Can Fly
1161965014.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Thundercrash Super.
1161965014.description_zh: 通过单次雷霆冲击超能快速消灭多名敌人。

1863786393.name: Captain of the Void
1863786393.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Sentinel Shield Super.
1863786393.description_zh: 通过单次哨兵圣盾超能快速消灭多名敌人。

2832773742.name: Impenetrable Ward of Dawn
2832773742.description: Block a huge amount of damage with a single Ward of Dawn.
2832773742.description_zh: 通过单次黎明护罩阻挡大量伤害。

2773581715.name: A Time for Hammers
2773581715.description: Rapidly defeat multple enemies with a single Hammer of Sol Super.
2773581715.description_zh: 通过单次烈焰战锤超能快速消灭多名敌人。

2002973152.name: Burning Path
2002973152.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Burning Maul Super.
2002973152.description_zh: 通过单次燃烧锻锤超能快速消灭多名敌人。

3968380564.name: Lightning Rod
3968380564.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Arc Staff Super.
3968380564.description_zh: 通过单次电弧法杖超能快速消灭多名敌人。

618307569.name: Electrical Potential
618307569.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Gathering Storm Super.
618307569.description_zh: 通过单次风起云涌超能快速击败多个目标。

2218579677.name: Fire Slinger
2218579677.description: Defeat three enemies with a single Golden Gun Super.
2218579677.description_zh: 通过单次黄金枪超能消灭三名敌人。

4040391123.name: Fan of Knives
4040391123.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Blade Barrage Super.
4040391123.description_zh: 通过单次利刃弹幕超能快速消灭多名敌人。

642685696.name: Spectral Surgeon
642685696.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Spectral Blades Super.
642685696.description_zh: 通过单次鬼灵利刃超能快速消灭多名敌人。

147433438.name: Ensnarement
147433438.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies tethered from a single Shadowshot Super.
147433438.description_zh: 快速消灭多名被单次暗影箭矢超能所束缚的敌人。

3287306628.name: Ride Lightning
3287306628.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Stormtrance Super.
3287306628.description_zh: 通过单次雷霆万钧超能快速消灭多名敌人。

301879443.name: Chaos Incarnate
301879443.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Chaos Reach Super.
301879443.description_zh: 通过单次混沌之触超能快速消灭多名敌人。

2145668938.name: Void-Based Demolition
2145668938.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Nova Bomb Super.
2145668938.description_zh: 通过单次新星炸弹超能快速消灭多名敌人。

124804105.name: Void Unleashed
124804105.description: Defeat a large number of enemies with a single Nova Warp Super.
124804105.description_zh: 通过单次新星折跃超能快速消灭多名敌人。

3912618144.name: Rain of Fire
3912618144.description: Rapidly defeat multiple enemies with a single Dawnblade Super.
3912618144.description_zh: 通过单次破晓超能快速消灭多名敌人。

2739464567.name: Dug In
2739464567.description: Defeat a large number of enemies while inside the aura from a single Well of Radiance Super.
2739464567.description_zh: 在身处单次施放的光焰之井超能光环中的情况下消灭大群敌人。

745267515.name: Far Below Zero
745267515.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Silence and Squall Super.
745267515.description_zh: 通过单次沉默狂啸超能快速击败多个目标。

1766382717.name: Icebound Uproar
1766382717.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Glacial Quake Super.
1766382717.description_zh: 通过单次冰川震击超能快速击败多个目标。

2640670594.name: Blizzard Wizard
2640670594.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Winter's Wrath Super.
2640670594.description_zh: 通过单次严冬之怒超能快速击败多个目标。

1997471688.name: Spliced and Diced
1997471688.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Silkstrike Super.
1997471688.description_zh: 通过单次丝线打击超能快速击败多个目标。

93550919.name: Flurry of Claws
93550919.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Bladefury Super.
93550919.description_zh: 通过单次剑刃之怒超能快速击败多个目标。

2293420882.name: Summoner of the Weave
2293420882.description: Rapidly defeat multiple targets with a single Needlestorm Super.
2293420882.description_zh: 通过单次织针风暴超能快速击败多个目标。

981679810.name: Cleaned Out
981679810.description: As a team, completely drain the opposing bank.
981679810.description_zh: 团队合作，将对方萤光库清空。

1283285076.name: Siphoned Funds
1283285076.description: As a team, summon your Primeval by draining Motes from the opposing team's bank.
1283285076.description_zh: 团队合作，通过从对方队伍的萤光库中汲取萤光来召唤己方古昧。

2303954378.name: Bloodsuckers
2303954378.description: As a team, drain a large portion of the opposing bank's contents in a single round.
2303954378.description_zh: 团队合作，在单个回合中从对方萤光库的存货中汲取大量萤光。

4126515325.name: Following Instructions
4126515325.description: Once your team holds enough Motes to summon a Primeval, deposit your Motes without picking up more.
4126515325.description_zh: 当己方队伍持有足够召唤古昧的萤光时，将你手中的萤光存起来并停止拾取更多萤光。

1295992439.name: From the Jaws of Defeat
1295992439.description: Win the round after the opposing team summons their Primeval while your team has fewer than 25 Motes banked or carried.
1295992439.description_zh: 在对方队伍已召唤古昧，而己方队伍萤光储存及携带量少于25的情况下，赢得回合。

2606273279.name: Open 24/7
2606273279.description: Win a round in which your team's bank spent very little time locked.
2606273279.description_zh: 当己方队伍萤光库几乎未被锁定的情况下赢得回合。

608205766.name: Block Party
608205766.description: As a team, have four Blockers at the enemy's bank at the same time.
608205766.description_zh: 团队合作，在敌方萤光库同时部署四名阻绝者。

1442998857.name: Never Say Die
1442998857.description: Come back from a 25% deficit in Primeval health to win the round.
1442998857.description_zh: 在己方古昧生命值超出对方25%的情况下转危为安赢得该回合。

2381265747.name: Taking Turns
2381265747.description: As a team, have all four players invade at least once during a round.
2381265747.description_zh: 团队合作，在某回合中让全部四名选手均完成至少一次入侵。

4162194649.name: Let There Be Light
4162194649.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with Super abilities.
4162194649.description_zh: 用超能快速击败3名战斗人员。

1967692406.name: Berserker
1967692406.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with melee final blows.
1967692406.description_zh: 用近战最后一击快速击败3名战斗人员。

1114376832.name: Demolition Expert
1114376832.description_zh: 用手雷快速击败3名战斗人员。

23859304.name: Primary Spree
23859304.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
23859304.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败3个战斗人员。

23859307.name: Primary Rampage
23859307.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
23859307.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败6个战斗人员。

23859306.name: Primary Frenzy
23859306.description: Rapidly defeat 9 combatants with weapons using Primary ammo.
23859306.description_zh: 使用主弹药武器快速击败9个战斗人员。

3745408473.name: Special Spree
3745408473.description: Rapidly defeat 3 combatants with weapons using Special ammo.
3745408473.description_zh: 使用特殊弹药武器快速击败3个战斗人员。

3745408474.name: Special Rampage
3745408474.description: Rapidly defeat 6 combatants with weapons using Special ammo.
3745408474.description_zh: 使用特殊弹药武器快速击败6个战斗人员。

3745408475.name: Special Frenzy

3831005100.name: Clean Up on Aisle Five
3831005100.description: Get kills with Threat Level at the Bergusia Forge.
3831005100.description_zh: 在柏尔古希亚锻炉附近使用威胁等级获得击杀。

3562251014.name: Beautiful but Deadly
3562251014.description: Get kills with Le Monarque at the Gofannon Forge.
3562251014.description_zh: 在戈菲隆锻炉附近使用帝王蝶获得击杀。

1518946959.name: Reunited Siblings
1518946959.description: Get kills with Izanagi's Burden at the Izanami Forge.
1518946959.description_zh: 在伊邪那美锻炉附近使用伊邪那岐的重担获得击杀。

2925485370.name: Like a Diamond
2925485370.description: Complete the flawless version of the "Scourge of the Past" raid.
2925485370.description_zh: 完成“往日之苦”突袭的完美版本。

132377266.name: To Each Their Own
132377266.description: Complete the To Each Their Own challenge.

1180238715.name: Hold the Line
1180238715.description: Complete the Hold the Line challenge.

223175561.name: All for One, One for All
223175561.description: Complete the All for One, One for All challenge.
223175561.description_zh: 完成挑战“万众一心，只为一人”。

974101911.name: Fast and Unwieldy
974101911.description: Escape Ablazed Glory without losing a single fireteam member.
974101911.description_zh: 在未损失任何一名火力战队成员的情况下逃离闪耀荣耀。

1778986403.name: Raider of the Lost Treasure
1778986403.description: Loot hidden chests in the "Scourge of the Past" raid 5 times.
1778986403.description_zh: 洗掠“往日之苦”突袭中的隐藏宝箱，共计5次。

2472740040.name: Reckoner
2472740040.description_zh: 完成所有《莫测鬼牌》成就。

4065625952.name: Annual Pass: Jokers Wild
4065625952.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
4065625952.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

963059480.name: Call Me… Collector
963059480.description: Win a Gambit Prime match with a complete set of Notorious Collector armor equipped.
963059480.description_zh: 在装备完整恶名收集者护甲套装的情况下赢得一场全盛智谋比赛。

2468242682.name: Call Me… Invader
2468242682.description: Win a Gambit Prime match with a complete set of Notorious Invader armor equipped.
2468242682.description_zh: 在装备完整恶名入侵者护甲套装的情况下赢得一场全盛智谋比赛。

2209929702.name: Call Me… Reaper
2209929702.description: Win a Gambit Prime match with a complete set of Notorious Reaper armor equipped.
2209929702.description_zh: 在装备完整恶名收割者护甲套装的情况下赢得一场全盛智谋比赛。

1203174014.name: Call Me… Sentry
1203174014.description: Win a Gambit Prime match with a complete set of Notorious Sentry armor equipped.
1203174014.description_zh: 在装备完整恶名哨兵护甲套装的情况下赢得一场全盛智谋比赛。

3986442658.name: Swift Reckoning
3986442658.description: Complete a time trial run of Tier III in the Reckoning.
3986442658.description_zh: 在大清算中完成第III阶的限时试炼。

2403187670.name: One Skip Ahead
2403187670.description: Successfully complete the Reckoning at Tier III twice, once with each boss.
2403187670.description_zh: 成功完成两次大清算第III阶，各击败一名首领。

1518761369.name: Get Recked
1518761369.description: While in the Reckoning, defeat powerful enemies, land precision final blows, and defeat Shadow Thrall.
1518761369.description_zh: 在进行大清算期间，击败强大的敌人，造成精准最后一击并击败暗影怨魂。

1839709275.name: Triumphant Collector
1839709275.description: While you have the Collector Aura in Gambit Prime, win matches, deposit Motes, summon Small Blockers, summon Giant Blockers, and earn Half-Banked medals.
1839709275.description_zh: 当你在全盛智谋中带有收集者光环时：赢得比赛，储存萤光，召唤小型阻绝者，召唤巨型阻绝者，获得半库江山勋章。

3815595217.name: Triumphant Invader
3815595217.description: While you have the Invader Aura in Gambit Prime, win matches, defeat opposing Guardians with your Super, defeat opposing Guardians with Sniper or Linear Fusion Rifles, defeat opposing Guardians with Fusion Rifles or Shotguns, defeat opposing Guardians with any other weapon, and drain Motes while near the enemy bank.
3815595217.description_zh: 当你在全盛智谋中带有入侵者光环时：赢得比赛，使用超能击败对方守护者，使用狙击步枪或线性融合步枪击败对方守护者，使用融合步枪或霰弹枪击败对方守护者，使用任意其他武器击败对方守护者，位于敌人萤光库附近汲取萤光。

370877867.name: Triumphant Reaper
370877867.description: While you have the Reaper Aura in Gambit Prime, win matches, defeat combatants, defeat high-value targets, defeat Blockers and envoys, and earn Massacre Medals.
370877867.description_zh: 当你在全盛智谋中带有收割者光环时：赢得比赛，击败战斗人员，击败高价值目标，击败阻绝者和使节，获得连环杀手勋章。

884787703.name: Triumphant Sentry
884787703.description: While you have the Sentry Aura in Gambit Prime, win matches, mark Invaders, defeat Blockers before your Primeval has spawned, defeat Taken when your Primeval has spawned, and earn Locksmith Medals.
884787703.description_zh: 当你在全盛智谋中带有哨兵光环时：赢得比赛，标记入侵者，在生成己方古昧前击败阻绝者，在生成己方古昧前击败傀儡，赢得锁匠勋章。

2056461735.name: A Shadow Rises
2056461735.description: Complete all Season of Opulence Triumphs.
2056461735.description_zh: 完成所有丰盈赛季成就。

1900478309.name: Mint in Box
1900478309.description: Earn the Season of Opulence collections badge.
1900478309.description_zh: 赢得丰盈赛季收藏品证章。

966207508.name: Moments of Triumph: MMXIX
966207508.description: Complete these feats of strength before 9/17/2019 to claim your unique rewards.
966207508.description_zh: 在2019年9月17日前，完成这些光辉事迹来领取你的独特奖励。

4161811604.name: Bungie Rewards Triumph Shirt Available
4161811604.name_zh: Bungie Rewards凯旋时刻T恤现已上架
4161811604.description: Complete Triumphs to earn a Bungie Rewards discount voucher for the 2019 Moments of Triumph T-shirt, redeemable in the Bungie Store.
4161811604.description_zh: 完成成就，以赢取Bungie Rewards 2019凯旋时刻T恤专用折扣券，该券可在Bungie商店中兑换。

1787453662.name: Reward: Jumpship
1787453662.description: Complete Triumphs to earn the 2019 Moments of Triumph jumpship.
1787453662.description_zh: 完成成就，赢取2019凯旋时刻跃迁飞船。

1921754672.name: Reward: Sparrow
1921754672.description: Complete Triumphs to earn the 2019 Moments of Triumph Sparrow.
1921754672.description_zh: 完成凯旋，赢取2019凯旋时刻快雀。

2546504514.name: Reward: Emblem
2546504514.description: Complete Triumphs to earn the 2019 Moments of Triumph emblem.
2546504514.description_zh: 完成成就，赢取2019凯旋时刻徽章。

3271742593.name: Forges Afield
3271742593.description: Forge weapons from research frames and Black Armory frames
3271742593.description_zh: 利用研究模型和黑色军械库模型铸造武器

2887353766.name: Prime Fashion
2887353766.description: Win a Gambit Prime match while wearing a full set of Notorious armor.
2887353766.description_zh: 在装备完整恶名护甲套装的情况下，赢得一场全盛智谋比赛。

833624414.name: Bedazzled
833624414.description: Fully upgrade the Chalice of Opulence.

1001258828.name: The Majesty of It
1001258828.description: Obtain the complete Majestic Solstice 2019 armor set.
1001258828.description_zh: 获得整套2019庄严至日护甲套装。

2618443722.name: Above and Beyond
2618443722.description: Masterwork any piece of Majestic Solstice armor.
2618443722.description_zh: 将任意一件庄严至日护甲升级至大师杰作。

294783668.name: Exotic Arsenal
294783668.description: Claim Bad Juju, Outbreak Perfected, and Whisper of the Worm from their respective Exotic missions.
294783668.description_zh: 从相应的异域任务中，领取邪恶符咒、全面爆发和蠕虫低语。

1428579593.name: Gun for Hire
1428579593.description_zh: 在整个星系内完成悬赏。

70027490.name: Challenger
70027490.description: Complete weekly challenges throughout the system.
70027490.description_zh: 在整个星系内完成周常挑战。

3313840816.name: For the Vanguard
3313840816.description: Complete strikes in any strike playlist.
3313840816.description_zh: 完成任意打击列表中的打击。

2046101248.name: Vanguard Pinnacle Weapons
2046101248.description: Earn a Vanguard pinnacle weapon from any Season.
2046101248.description_zh: 从任何赛季赢取先锋巅峰武器。

1904945501.name: Crucible Pinnacle Arsenal
1904945501.name_zh: 熔炉竞技场巅峰军械库
1904945501.description: Earn a Crucible pinnacle weapon from any Season.
1904945501.description_zh: 从任何赛季赢取熔炉竞技场巅峰武器。

1581660581.name: Gambit Pinnacle Arsenal
1581660581.description: Earn a Gambit pinnacle weapon from any Season.
1581660581.description_zh: 从任何赛季赢取智谋巅峰武器。

2159542632.name: Valiant Savior
2159542632.description: Complete the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

2584970263.name: Shadowkeep
2584970263.description_zh: 完成《暗影要塞》的所有成就。

351867733.name: Lunar Rover
351867733.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
351867733.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

3866024089.name: Sacred Duty
3866024089.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
3866024089.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

1866578144.name: Undying
1866578144.description: Complete all Triumphs for Season of the Undying.
1866578144.description_zh: 完成不朽赛季的所有成就。

2625282296.name: Season of the Undying
2625282296.description: Complete the associated badge on the Collections screen in order to claim this Triumph.
2625282296.description_zh: 完成收藏品界面中的相关证章，获得此成就。

1696919903.name: The Front Lines
1696919903.description: In the Vex Offensive, complete encounters and close the warp gate. Successful encounter completions grant the most efficient progress.
1696919903.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，完成遭遇战并关闭传送门。成功完成遭遇战能最高效地提升进度。

2028348378.name: Final Assault
2028348378.description: In the Vex Offensive, defeat the Undying Mind.
2028348378.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，消灭不朽首脑。

1297176500.name: Perfect Assault
1297176500.description: In the Vex Offensive, close the warp gate without dying.
1297176500.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，在不阵亡的前提下关闭传送门。

3104214333.name: Offensive Expert
3104214333.description: In the Vex Offensive, land final blows with Hand Cannons, Submachine Guns, Bows, Fusion Rifles, and Auto Rifles. Challenging combatants grant the most efficient progress.
3104214333.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，使用手炮、微型冲锋枪、弓箭、融合步枪和自动步枪造成最后一击。具有挑战性的战斗人员能最高效地提升进度。

800778259.name: Offensive Tactician
800778259.description: In the Vex Offensive, get multikills with Submachine Guns, Fusion Rifles, and Auto Rifles.
800778259.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，使用微型冲锋枪、融合步枪和自动步枪获得多杀。

3082894563.name: Offensive Sharpshooter
3082894563.description: In the Vex Offensive, land precision final blows with Hand Cannons and Bows.
3082894563.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，使用手炮和弓箭造成精准最后一击。

2122081892.name: Offensive Finisher
2122081892.description: In the Vex Offensive, defeat combatants using finishers. Challenging enemies grant the most efficient progress.
2122081892.description_zh: 在Vex之攻略中，使用终结技消灭战斗人员。具有挑战性的敌人能最高效地提升进度。

445693902.name: Operative
445693902.description: As a fireteam, destroy Oracles in the Vex Offensive.
445693902.description_zh: 以一只火力战队的身份摧毁Vex之攻略中的神谕。

1585475952.name: Moonlight Crescendo
1585475952.description: In Season 8, defeat combatants on the Moon with finishers. Challenging combatants grant the most efficient progress.
1585475952.description_zh: 在第8赛季中，于月球上使用终结技消灭战斗人员。具有挑战性的战斗人员能最高效地提升进度。

2244422782.name: Lunar Fashion
2244422782.description: In Season 8, complete public events on Earth's Moon while wearing a full set of seasonal armor.
2244422782.description_zh: 在第8赛季中，穿着整套赛季护甲于月球上完成公共事件。

1810520711.name: Dark Side of the Moon
1810520711.description: In Season 8, defeat combatants on Earth's Moon using Void abilities.
1810520711.description_zh: 在第8赛季中，于月球上使用虚空技能消灭战斗人员。

321789703.name: Crater Spark
321789703.description: In Season 8, defeat combatants on Earth's Moon using Arc abilities.
321789703.description_zh: 在第8赛季中，于月球上使用电弧技能消灭战斗人员。

2644004361.name: Over the Moon
2644004361.description: In Season 8, defeat Vex Overlords on Earth's Moon in Archer's Line, Hellmouth, and Anchor of Light.
2644004361.description_zh: 在第8赛季中，于月球上的弓手界线、地狱深渊和光之锚消灭Vex霸主。

1185680627.name: Dawn
1185680627.description: Complete all Triumphs for the Season of Dawn.
1185680627.description_zh: 完成黎明赛季的所有成就。

291458920.name: EDZ Resonance
291458920.description: Increase the Resonance Rank of the EDZ Obelisk.
291458920.description_zh: 提高欧洲无人区方尖碑的回声等级。

1153362310.name: Tangled Shore Resonance
1153362310.description: Increase the Resonance Rank of the Tangled Shore Obelisk.
1153362310.description_zh: 提高纷争海岸方尖碑的回声等级。

763938915.name: Mars Resonance
763938915.description: Increase the Resonance Rank of the Mars Obelisk.
763938915.description_zh: 提高火星方尖碑的回声等级。

1248156859.name: Nessus Resonance
1248156859.description: Increase the Resonance Rank of the Nessus Obelisk.
1248156859.description_zh: 提高涅索斯方尖碑的回声等级。

2871657237.name: Global Resonance
2871657237.description: Increase the Resonance Rank of any obelisks.
2871657237.description_zh: 提高任意方尖碑的回声等级。

1508442134.name: Link Repair
1508442134.description: Repair each of the fractured links found on the Tower Obelisk.
1508442134.description_zh: 修复高塔方尖碑上找到的所有受损的连接。

1747321434.name: Saintly Savior
1747321434.description: Save Saint-14 from the Infinite Forest.
1747321434.description_zh: 从无尽森林中救出圣人14号。

1171931389.name: Flayer Slayer
1171931389.description: Defeat each of the Psion Flayers found within the Sundial.
1171931389.description_zh: 消灭日晷内发现的所有灵能劫掠者。

3323428844.name: Inotam's Ruin
3323428844.description: Defeat Inotam, Oblivion's Triune, within the Sundial.
3323428844.description_zh: 在日晷内消灭伊诺塔姆，虚无之三体。

3930591080.name: Race Through Time
3930591080.description: Complete a Sundial run in under 14 minutes.

2074146021.name: Undefeatable
2074146021.description: Complete a run of the Sundial without dying.
2074146021.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成英雄难度的日晷一次。

1159175758.name: Legendary Psion
1159175758.description: Defeat Inotam, Oblivion's Triune on Legend difficulty.
1159175758.description_zh: 在传说难度击败伊诺塔姆，虚无之三位一体。

819234811.name: Torch-Bearer
819234811.description: Complete the Empyrean Restoration effort and light the beacon.
819234811.description_zh: 完成至高天修复工程，点亮信标。

1387544045.name: Devil's Ruin
1387544045.description: Travel to Twilight Gap and collect the materials required to repair Devil's Ruin.
1387544045.description_zh: 前往暮光峡谷收集所需材料，修复“魔鬼之厄”。

4163746264.name: Bastion
4163746264.description: Acquire the Exotic Fusion Rifle, Bastion.
4163746264.description_zh: 获得异域融合步枪“堡垒”。

2499679097.name: Almighty
2499679097.description: Complete all Season of the Worthy Triumphs.
2499679097.description_zh: 完成所有英杰赛季成就。

1922277248.name: Full-stack Warmind Security
1922277248.description_zh: 完全升级所有炽天使地堡。

2895711472.name: Algorithm Efficiency
2895711472.description: Clear all three Seraph Bunkers in a day.
2895711472.description_zh: 在一天内清理全部三个炽天使地堡。

4065463607.name: Hardcoded Victory
4065463607.description: Complete a Seraph Tower Public Event without failing a single Support Tower charge cycle.
4065463607.description_zh: 在每一轮辅助塔充能均不失败的情况下完成一次炽天使之塔公共事件。

3316425088.name: Resolved Bugs: EDZ Legendary Lost Sectors
3316425088.name_zh: 解决漏洞：欧洲无人区传说遗失区域
3316425088.description: Complete each Legendary Lost Sector in the EDZ.
3316425088.description_zh: 完成欧洲无人区上的每个传说遗失区域。

3452071203.name: Resolved Bugs: Io Legendary Lost Sectors
3452071203.name_zh: 解决漏洞：木卫一传说遗失区域
3452071203.description: Complete each Legendary Lost Sector on Io.
3452071203.description_zh: 完成木卫一上的每个传说遗失区域。

2822112395.name: Resolved Bugs: Moon Legendary Lost Sectors
2822112395.name_zh: 解决漏洞：月球传说遗失区域
2822112395.description: Complete each Legendary Lost Sector on the Moon.
2822112395.description_zh: 完成月球上的每个传说遗失区域。

748164296.name: Object-Oriented
748164296.description: Complete a Legendary Lost Sector without dying.
748164296.description_zh: 不死情况下完成一个传说遗失区域。

2072890963.name: Flawless
2072890963.description: Complete all Season of the Worthy flawless Triumphs.
2072890963.description_zh: 完成所有英杰赛季完美无瑕成就。

414594905.name: Trials of Osiris: Veteran Disciple
414594905.name_zh: 奥斯里斯试炼：老兵门徒
414594905.description: Trophies from conquest in Trials of Osiris.
414594905.description_zh: 奥斯里斯试炼比赛征战的记录。

2513112125.name: Confidence Is High
2513112125.description: Complete a Flawless Passage of Confidence during the current Season.
2513112125.description_zh: 当前赛季期间，无暇完成一次信心入场券。

3234678028.name: Safe Harbor
3234678028.description: After earning a Win Streak of at least 5 on a Lighthouse Passage, assist another player in reaching the same milestone for their first time this episode.
3234678028.description_zh: 使用一张灯塔入场券获得至少5次连胜后，协助另一名玩家在本篇章首次达到相同的里程碑。

683601641.name: Test Your Mettle

683601641.description_zh: 在当前篇章，使用一张7胜灯塔入场券赢得比赛。

3801611192.name: This Is the Way

3801611192.description_zh: 在本赛季期间的4周中各完成一次无暇入场券。

2226626398.name: Conqueror
2226626398.description: Complete all Season of the Worthy Grandmaster Triumphs.
2226626398.description_zh: 完成所有英杰赛季宗师成就。

557691830.name: Grandmaster: Insight Terminus
557691830.description: Complete the "Insight Terminus" Nightfall on Grandmaster difficulty during Season of the Worthy.
557691830.description_zh: 在英杰赛季期间，完成宗师难度的“洞悉终界”日落。

400097518.name: Grandmaster: Exodus Crash
400097518.description: Complete the "Exodus Crash" Nightfall on Grandmaster difficulty during Season of the Worthy.
400097518.description_zh: 在英杰赛季期间，完成宗师难度的“移民号的坠毁”日落。

1801610032.name: Grandmaster: The Arms Dealer
1801610032.description: Complete "The Arms Dealer" Nightfall on Grandmaster difficulty during Season of the Worthy.
1801610032.description_zh: 在英杰赛季期间，完成宗师难度的“军火交易商”日落。

3454831225.name: Grandmaster: Warden of Nothing
3454831225.description: Complete the "Warden of Nothing" Nightfall on Grandmaster difficulty during Season of the Worthy.
3454831225.description_zh: 在英杰赛季期间，完成宗师难度的“虚无典狱官”日落。
