676986588.description_zh: 在启用英灵日修改器的情况下完成行动活动。

4093874420.name: Phantasmic Fighter
4093874420.description: Defeat Nightmares in the Haunted Altars of Sorrow activity.
4093874420.description_zh: 在闹鬼忧愁圣坛活动中消灭梦魇。

471733135.name: Defensive Décor
471733135.description: Purchase defenses in the Haunted Altars of Sorrow activity.
471733135.description_zh: 在闹鬼忧愁圣坛活动中购买防御。

1388516343.name: Gold Shiver
1388516343.description: Complete Haunted Altars of Sorrow with a performance grade of B or higher.
1388516343.description_zh: 以B或更好的表现等级完成闹鬼忧愁圣坛。

2420530579.name: Candy Collector
2420530579.description: Collect Candy during Festival of the Lost.
2420530579.description_zh: 在英灵日期间收集糖果。

3754218902.name: Wear the Mask
3754218902.description: Wear a mask and complete a dungeon or raid, win rounds in Trials of Osiris, or complete Ops activities on Master difficulty or higher.
3754218902.description_zh: 佩戴面具并完成一次地牢或突袭，在奥斯里斯试炼中获得回合胜利，或以大师或更高难度完成行动活动。

1802596959.name: Total Gem
1802596959.description: Complete Haunted Altars of Sorrow with a performance grade of A or higher.
1802596959.description_zh: 以A或更好的表现等级完成闹鬼忧愁圣坛。

3249408038.name: Moments of Triumph 2022
3249408038.description: Complete 28 of 30 of these Feats of Strength before 2/28/2023 to claim unique rewards.
3249408038.description_zh: 在2023年2月28日前，完成30项光辉事迹中的28项来领取独特奖励。

2658563592.name: Reward: Emblem
2658563592.description: Complete Triumphs to earn a bungie.net token that unlocks the 2022 Moments of Triumph emblem for redemption on bungie.net.
2658563592.description_zh: 完成成就以赢取一枚Bungie.Net代币来解锁2022凯旋时刻徽标，该徽标可在Bungie.Net兑换。

3186000759.name: Reward: Emblem
3186000759.description: Complete Triumphs to earn a special emblem.
3186000759.description_zh: 完成成就以获得一个特殊徽标。

3084788911.name: Reward: Ghost Shell
3084788911.description: Complete Triumphs to earn the 2022 Moments of Triumph Ghost Shell.
3084788911.description_zh: 完成成就以获得2022凯旋时刻机灵外壳。

1329166918.name: T-Shirt Unlocked at Bungie Store
1329166918.description:
Complete Triumphs to unlock the 2022 T-shirt for purchase in the Bungie Store.

Visit bungiestore.com/rewards
1329166918.description_zh:
完成成就即可在Bungie商店解锁2022 T恤的购买权限。

访问bungiestore.com/rewards

2773485199.name: Raid Runner, Dungeon Diver
2773485199.description:
Complete the following raid and dungeon objectives to earn a special Sparrow and emblem. 

Additionally, completing this Triumph unlocks the Bungie rewards Moments of Triumph patch.
2773485199.description_zh:
完成以下突袭和地牢任务目标来获得一个特殊的快雀和徽标。

此外，完成此成就可解锁Bungie奖励“凯旋时刻”标识！

2379114159.name: Vanguard Victory
2379114159.description: Defeat combatants in Vanguard playlists with any of the following ritual weapons: Reckless Endangerment, Chain of Command, Cry Mutiny, or Veles-X.
2379114159.description_zh: 使用以下任意仪式武器在先锋游戏列表中击败战斗人员：鲁莽致险，指挥链，叛乱疾呼，溪谷-X。

1704885249.name: Crucible Contract
1704885249.description: Defeat Guardians in Crucible with any of the following ritual weapons: Reckless Endangerment, Chain of Command, Cry Mutiny, or Veles-X.
1704885249.description_zh: 使用以下任意仪式武器在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者：鲁莽致险，指挥链，叛乱疾呼，溪谷-X。

2724606020.name: Gambit Gauntlet
2724606020.description:
Defeat targets in Gambit with any of the following ritual weapons: Reckless Endangerment, Chain of Command, Cry Mutiny, or Veles-X.

Bonus progress for defeating opposing Guardians.
2724606020.description_zh:
使用以下任意仪式武器在智谋中击败目标：鲁莽致险，指挥链，叛乱疾呼，溪谷-X。

击败敌对守护者可获得额外进度。

390121297.name: Trials Wins
390121297.description: Win rounds in the Trials of Osiris.
390121297.description_zh: 在奥斯里斯试炼中赢得多个回合。

3314125579.name: Ordeal
3314125579.description:
Complete Nightfall strikes.

Bonus progress for higher-difficulty strikes.
3314125579.description_zh:
完成日落打击。

难度更高的打击会奖励额外进度。

1752954723.name: But This One Is Mine
1752954723.description:
Gain 20 weapon levels using crafted weapons.

Weapon levels can be gained across several weapons.
1752954723.description_zh:
使用制作的武器获得20个武器等级。

武器等级可由多件武器获得。

1191832612.name: Buildcrafter
1191832612.description: Complete playlist or Seasonal activities using each Light subclass.
1191832612.description_zh: 使用每一种光能分支职业完成游戏列表或赛季活动。

2028879190.name: Don't Call It A Staff
2028879190.description:
Defeat targets with Glaive projectile and melee final blows.

Bonus progress for defeating opposing Guardians.
2028879190.description_zh:
使用偃月射弹或近战最后一击消灭目标。

击败敌对守护者可获得额外进度。

2253402840.name: Empty Throne
2253402840.description: Complete all Witch Queen campaign missions on any difficulty.
2253402840.description_zh: 在任意难度下完成所有邪姬魅影战役任务

3330688881.name: Here We Go Again
3330688881.description: Complete 6 raid or dungeon rotator challenges.
3330688881.description_zh: 完成6个突袭或地牢轮转挑战。

1634238708.name: I'll Build It Myself
1634238708.description: Acquire 1 Weapon Pattern from a raid or dungeon.
1634238708.description_zh: 从突袭或地牢中获得1个武器模式。

2126152885.name: Star Baker
2126152885.description: Complete Event Challenges during the Dawning. Progress resets at the end of the event.
2126152885.description_zh: 在曙光节期间完成活动挑战。进度会在活动结束时重置。

1081376704.name: The First Gift
1081376704.description: Bake and deliver your first cookie during the Dawning.
1081376704.description_zh: 在曙光节期间烘焙和送出你的第一块饼干。

2563595194.name: Cookbook Completionist
2563595194.description: Bake a cookie with each recipe using your Dawning oven.
2563595194.description_zh: 用你的曙光节烤炉烘焙每一种配方的饼干。

objectives.desc_zh: 曙光节烤箱已进化为大师杰作

1118340699.name: High Spirits
1118340699.description: Collect Dawning Spirit during the Dawning event.
1118340699.description_zh: 在曙光节活动期间收集曙光节精神。

2857791135.name: Brisk Boss
2857791135.description: Complete Snowball Fight matches during the Dawning.
2857791135.description_zh: 在曙光节期间完成打雪仗比赛。

3745805545.name: POW-der Snow
3745805545.description: Defeat combatants with snowballs or Shatter damage throughout the Dawning. Snowball final blows earn bonus progress.
3745805545.description_zh: 在整个曙光节期间，使用雪球或碎裂伤害击败战斗人员。造成雪球最后一击可获得额外进度。

3066731810.name: Ice Cold
3066731810.description_zh: 使用冰影伤害击败目标。

1405824101.name: Icy Optimization
1405824101.description: Acquire all upgrades during the Dawning.
1405824101.description_zh: 在曙光节期间获取所有升级。

3444540518.name: Reason for the Season
3444540518.description_zh: 在曙光节期间送出饼干。

3674703185.name: Festive Spirit
3674703185.description: Spend Dawning Spirit during the Dawning.
3674703185.description_zh: 在曙光节期间花费曙光节精神。

1348174393.name: Snowball Specialist
1348174393.description: Get final blows with Stasis damage and snowballs in Portal activities at Master level or higher. Bonus progress for snowball final blows.
1348174393.description_zh: 在大师或更高等级的门户活动中用冰影伤害和雪球造成最后一击。雪球最后一击提供额外进度。

3906538939.name: Lightfall
3906538939.description_zh: 完成所有光陨之秋成就。

2400233569.name: Neomuni Souvenirs
2400233569.description_zh: 来自海王星内欧姆那的战利品。

905181048.name: Spire of the Watcher
905181048.description: Trophies from the "Spire of the Watcher" dungeon.
905181048.description_zh: 来自“守望者尖塔”地牢的战利品。

674616608.name: Raid: Root of Nightmares
674616608.description: Trophies from the "Root of Nightmares" raid.
674616608.description_zh: 来自“梦魇根源”突袭的战利品。

3646306576.name: Champ
3646306576.description: Complete Event Challenges during Guardian Games. Progress resets at the end of the event.
3646306576.description_zh: 在守护者游戏期间完成活动挑战。进度会在活动结束时重置。

4076704393.name: In It to Win It
4076704393.description: Earn a Medallion from activity completions, and bank it at the podium in the Tower for rewards and class points!
4076704393.description_zh: 通过完成活动获得一个勋章，然后在高塔的领奖台处将其存入，以获取奖励和职业得分！

1243179709.name: Boss Bully
1243179709.description_zh: 在任意活动中击败首领。

1637409881.name: Supremely Forged
1637409881.description: Complete matches of Supremacy or Trials of Osiris. Earn bonus progress for winning matches.
1637409881.description_zh: 完成霸权或奥斯里斯试炼的比赛。赢得比赛可获得额外进度。

2174950046.name: High Voltage
2174950046.description: Defeat targets with final blows from Arc damage. Bonus progress for defeating other Guardians.
2174950046.description_zh: 使用电弧伤害最后一击击败目标。击败其他守护者可获得额外进度。

683485813.name: Record Setter
683485813.description: Complete Contender and Platinum Cards, which can be obtained from Eva Levante. Platinum Cards award more progress.
683485813.description_zh: 完成从伊娃·莱万特处获得的竞争者和白金卡片。白金卡片奖励更多进度。

4009943274.name: Podium Terminus
4009943274.description: Complete Rushdown or Supremacy activities with a performance grade of B or higher.
4009943274.description_zh: 以B或更好的表现等级完成急速强攻或霸权活动。

2969029761.name: Going the Distance
2969029761.description: Bank Medallions at the podium in the Tower to contribute points towards your class standing! Higher-ranked Medallions grant more points.
2969029761.description_zh: 在高塔的领奖台处存入勋章，为你的职业排位贡献得分！更高等级的勋章可提供更多得分。

3096041900.name: Divine Slayer
3096041900.description_zh: 在急速强攻中击败首领。

219577591.name: Hall of Fame
219577591.description: Get an A grade performance in Rushdown without dying. Also, complete a match of Supremacy with a score of at least 30.
219577591.description_zh: 在不死亡的情况下完成A级表现的急速强攻。另外，以至少30分完成一场霸权比赛。

objectives.desc_zh: 已完成不死A级急速强攻

3570567217.name: Aquanaut
3570567217.description: Complete all Season of the Deep Title Triumphs to earn the Title of Aquanaut.
3570567217.description_zh: 完成所有深渊赛季称号成就以获得“潜水员”称号。

3251955396.name: Weekly Wetwork
3251955396.description: Complete each week of the quest "Into the Depths."
3251955396.description_zh: 完成每周的“潜入深渊”任务。

612688178.name: Challenges Accepted
612688178.description: Unlock all Seasonal bonuses earned by completing Seasonal Challenges.
612688178.description_zh: 完成赛季挑战，解锁所有获得的赛季加成。

4280013283.name: Reprised Reckoning
4280013283.description:
Defeat targets with Season of the Deep weapons.

Defeated Guardians grant additional progress.
4280013283.description_zh:
使用深渊赛季武器击败目标。

击败守护者可提供额外进度。

2077350212.name: Quantity Over Quality
2077350212.description: Catch fish at any Fish Pond.

2662869859.name: Ambitious Angler
2662869859.description: Catch an Exotic fish at any fishing pond.
2662869859.description_zh: 在任意钓鱼池中钓起一条异域鱼。

3974717227.name: Ghosts of the Deep
3974717227.description: Triumphs to unlock the "Ghosts of the Deep" dungeon Title.
3974717227.description_zh: 解锁“深渊机灵”地牢称号的成就。

2519881105.name: Ghosts of the Deep
2519881105.description: Trophies from the "Ghosts of the Deep" dungeon.

2269203216.name: Haruspex
2269203216.description: Complete all Season of the Witch Title Triumphs to earn the Title of Haruspex.
2269203216.description_zh: 完成所有奇巫赛季称号成就以获得“脏卜师”称号。

3133617928.name: Drawn Blades
3133617928.description: Defeat targets with weapons from the Season of the Witch (Eleatic Principle, Kept Confidence, Brya's Love, The Eremite, Semiotician, and Locus Locutus) or the Red War era (The Showrunner, Deadpan Delivery, Persuader, and Nightshade).
3133617928.description_zh: 使用奇巫赛季武器（埃里亚原则、笃信、布瑞亚之爱、隐士、符号学家和言语轨迹）或猩红战争时期武器（赶秀人、冷面专递、谈判专家和暗夜魅影）击败目标。

3001808084.name: The Bladed Path
3001808084.description: Complete every week in "The Bladed Path" quest line.
3001808084.description_zh: 完成“刀锋之道”每周任务线。

794450031.name: Arcane Collector
794450031.description: Identify Minor Arcana at the Lectern of Divination.
794450031.description_zh: 在占卜台上辨明小阿卡纳。

851523651.name: Cartomancer
851523651.description: Complete all Major Arcana quests from the Lectern of Divination.
851523651.description_zh: 完成来自占卜台的所有大阿卡纳任务。

2533011697.name: May You Never Cease
2533011697.description: Complete the tests in the Imbaru Engine.
2533011697.description_zh: 完成薄雾引擎中的测试。

1630746421.name: Tithebringer
1630746421.description: Complete Altars of Summoning encounters. Earn bonus progress by completing more difficult encounters.
1630746421.description_zh: 完成召唤圣坛遭遇战。完成更高难度的遭遇战可获得额外进度。

4083696547.name: Wishbearer
4083696547.description: Complete all Season of the Wish Title Triumphs to earn the Title of Wishbearer.
4083696547.description_zh: 完成所有终愿赛季称号成就以获得“承愿者”称号。

3175660257.name: Moments of Triumph 2023
3175660257.description: Complete 26 of 30 feats of strength to claim unique rewards.
3175660257.description_zh: 完成30项光辉事迹中的26项来领取独特奖励。

3166190369.name: Moments of Triumph T-Shirt Token
3166190369.description: Complete 5 Triumphs to earn a Bungie.net token that unlocks the 2023 T-shirt for purchase on the Bungie Store.
3166190369.description_zh: 完成5个成就以获得一枚Bungie.Net代币，用于在Bungie商店解锁购买2023 T恤。

3623734410.name: Reward: Ghost Shell
3623734410.description: Complete 14 Triumphs to earn the 2023 Moments of Triumph Ghost shell.
3623734410.description_zh: 完成14个成就以获得2023凯旋时刻机灵外壳。

1020717027.name: Reward: Sparrow
1020717027.description: Complete 21 Triumphs to earn the Moments of Triumph 2023 Sparrow.
1020717027.description_zh: 完成21个成就以获得凯旋时刻2023快雀。

2467982350.name: Paracausal Adventurer
2467982350.description: Complete a run of each Year 6 raid and dungeon to earn the 2023 raid patch.
2467982350.description_zh: 完成所有年6突袭和地牢以获得2023突袭标识。

1142693639.name: Warlord's Ruin
1142693639.description: Nestled deep in the mountains of the EDZ, Scorn lay claim to a Dark Age castle containing dangerous relics, and a blighted vengeance festers in the dirt.
1142693639.description_zh: 在欧洲无人区的深山中，嗤魅找到了一座藏着危险圣物的黑暗纪元城堡。土壤中酝酿着凋零阴影的复仇之火。

1342446533.name: Warlord's Ruin
1342446533.description: Uncover buried histories and lingering grudges within a ruined Dark Age castle.
1342446533.description_zh: 在毁弃的黑暗纪元城堡中，揭开尘封已久的历史和挥之不去的怨恨。

1156427773.name: BRAVE
1156427773.description: Complete all Into the Light Title Triumphs to earn the title of BRAVE.
1156427773.description_zh: 完成所有“进入光能”称号成就以获得“勇者”称号。

1568864289.name: Raid: Salvation's Edge
1568864289.description_zh: 来自“救赎的边缘”突袭的成就。

149024466.name: Intrepid
149024466.description: Complete all Episode: Echoes Title Triumphs to earn the Title of Intrepid.
149024466.description_zh: 完成所有“篇章：回响”称号成就以获得“无畏”称号。

3357357436.name: Exquisite Radiolite
3357357436.description_zh: 收集任意精致放射石样本。

1537772602.name: Nessian Warrior
1537772602.description: Complete any Episode: Echoes Battleground on Expert difficulty.
1537772602.description_zh: 以专家难度完成任意“篇章：回响”战场。

2176354074.name: Discord and Discoveries
2176354074.description: Collect the weapon crafting intrinsics by completing all of the secrets in Exotic mission "Encore."
2176354074.description_zh: 通过完成异域任务“安可”中的所有秘密来收集武器制作固有特性。

1554492016.name: Hack the Centaur
1554492016.description: Collect all 7 secret chests in the Exotic mission "Encore."
1554492016.description_zh: 在异域任务“安可”中收集所有7个秘密宝箱。

3315095100.name: The Final Shape
3315095100.description: Complete all The Final Shape triumphs.
3315095100.description_zh: 完成所有终焉之形成就。

3047534189.name: Slayer Baron
3047534189.description: Complete all Episode: Revenant Triumphs to earn the title of Slayer Baron.
3047534189.description_zh: 完成所有“篇章：怨魂”成就以获得“杀手公爵”称号。

113673425.name: Modern Major General
113673425.description_zh: 完成三项主要外勤工作。

2436140944.name: Sharpened Fang
2436140944.description: Unlock all catalysts for the Slayer's Fang Exotic Shotgun.
2436140944.description_zh: 解锁杀手之牙异域霰弹枪的所有催化。

4062961115.name: Vesper's Host
4062961115.description: Defy the algorithm. Cut through its web.

1296550017.name: Dungeon: Vesper's Host
1296550017.description_zh: 来自“晚星之主”地牢的成就。

2963918856.name: Sundered Doctrine
2963918856.description: Power lies in the deepest vault.
2963918856.description_zh: 力量就在最深处的保险库中。

1809824416.name: Dungeon: Sundered Doctrine
1809824416.description_zh: 来自“分离教义”地牢的成就。

3779882910.name: Equilibrium
3779882910.description: Between fire and shadow, the path to balance.
3779882910.description_zh: 火焰与阴影之间，是通往平衡之路。

393827228.name: Heretic
393827228.description: Complete all Episode: Heresy Title Triumphs to earn the title of Heretic.
393827228.description_zh: 完成所有“篇章：异端”称号成就以获得异教徒称号。

1770171811.name: Dreadful Discoveries
1770171811.description: Complete the side quests via Sloane's Dossier linked to Episode: Heresy's first Act, Echoed Warnings.
1770171811.description_zh: 通过链接到“篇章：异端”的首个章节“回响警告”的斯隆的档案，完成支线任务。

1556838374.name: Dreadful Secrets
1556838374.description: Find secrets hidden throughout the Nether aboard the Dreadnaught.
1556838374.description_zh: 在无畏战舰的幽冥中找到隐藏的秘密。

344798513.name: Nether Rites
344798513.description: Acquire any type of boon during Nether runs. Major and Corrupted Boons grant additional progress.
344798513.description_zh: 在幽冥期间获取任意类型的恩惠。主要和腐化恩惠可提供额外进度。

680642236.name: Rune-Burner
680642236.description: Spend Runes to buy armaments in Court of Blades. Higher tier Runes grant additional progress.
680642236.description_zh: 在利刃大厅中花费符文购买军备。高阶符文可提供额外进度。

126238604.name: Moments of Triumph 2024
126238604.description: Complete 26 of 33 feats of strength to claim unique rewards.
126238604.description_zh: 完成33项光辉事迹中的26项来领取独特奖励。

4287983804.name: Moments of Triumph T-Shirt Token
4287983804.description: Complete 5 Triumphs to earn a Bungie.net token that unlocks the 2024 T-shirt for purchase on the Bungie Store.
4287983804.description_zh: 完成5个成就以获得一枚Bungie.Net代币，用于在Bungie商店解锁购买2024 T恤。

532144877.name: Reward: Ghost Shell
532144877.description: Complete 14 Triumphs to earn the 2024 Moments of Triumph Ghost shell.
532144877.description_zh: 完成14个成就以获得2024凯旋时刻机灵外壳。

3342516760.name: Reward: Sparrow
3342516760.description: Complete 21 Triumphs to earn the Moments of Triumph 2024 Sparrow.
3342516760.description_zh: 完成21个成就以获得凯旋时刻2024快雀。

3588285107.name: Light and Darkness
3588285107.description: Complete a run of each Year 7 raid and dungeon to earn the 2024 raid pin.
3588285107.description_zh: 完成所有年7突袭和地牢以获得2024突袭印章。

390537696.description:
Complete Orders from the Vanguard and their allies. Orders come in three tiers: Common, Legendary and Exotic.

Orders can be found within the Seasonal Hub. Completing Orders will earn you Payouts of the corresponding tier. Completed Orders will be refreshed—you may even get lucky and draw a higher-tier Order than the one you completed!

命令可在赛季中心内查看。完成命令即可获得相应阶级的报酬。已完成的命令会被刷新——你甚至有可能抽到比已完成命令更高阶的命令！

1816541247.name: Vanguard Operative
1816541247.description: A skilled Hunter, Shaw leads fireteams on dangerous missions throughout the solar system.
1816541247.description_zh: 作为一位技艺精湛的猎人，韩潇带领着火力战队在太阳系内各地执行危险任务。

888343189.name: Purveyor of Strange Goods
888343189.description: Compete in the Dares of Eternity to earn Strange Favor. Rank up to earn various rewards. Your rank can be reset up to {var:365343461} more times.
888343189.description_zh: 参加永恒挑战来获得奇异恩惠。提升等级来获得各种奖励。你还能重置你的等级{var:365343461}次。

2158154699.name: Purveyor of Strange Goods
2158154699.description: Compete in the Dares of Eternity to earn Strange Favor. Rank up to earn various rewards. Your rank can be reset up to {var:365343461} more times.
2158154699.description_zh: 参加永恒挑战来获得奇异恩惠。提升等级来获得各种奖励。你还能重置你的等级{var:365343461}次。

2531198101.name: Eliksni Rebel
2531198101.description: The formerly two-faced Fallen now serves as a faithful guide on Europa for Guardians and Light-bound Eliksni alike.
2531198101.description_zh: 这位原来的两面派现在成了守护者和向往光能的埃里克斯尼族在木卫二上的忠实向导。

3307474199.name: Spoils of the Morning Star
3307474199.description: The Morning Star has crashed and the spoils amongst the wreckage are now yours to take… for a price.
3307474199.description_zh: 晨星已经坠毁，废墟中的战利品等候着你来夺取……但你必须付出代价。

4254652401.name: A Link to the Future
4254652401.description: Burdened with the knowledge one can only gain from time travel, the Stranger is here to divert us from an inescapable dark future.
4254652401.description_zh: 背负着众多只能通过时间旅行来获取的知识，陌客到这里来的目的是让我们摆脱不可避免的黑暗未来。

1474045886.name: A sacred, liminal space.
1474045886.description: An artifact bridging Aionian science and spiritual belief.
1474045886.description_zh: 一件连接艾昂人科学与精神信仰的神器。

1547260251.name: Remnant of Oryx
1547260251.description: Oryx, the Taken King, sovereign of the Osmium Throne, God-King of the Hive, and master of the Taken, now rests in the void of space.
1547260251.description_zh: 邪神欧里克斯——锇素王座之主，邪魔族神王，傀儡军团的主人，现已在宇宙的虚空中沉眠。

1670274555.name: Investigatory Apparatus
1670274555.description: The Hidden's hub for intel on any and all Enclave investigations.
1670274555.description_zh: 隐秘者的情报中心，汇集了所有飞地调查的成果

1857431946.name: Former Hunter Vanguard
1857431946.description_zh: 传说枪手，也是位老朋友。

1660659508.name: Your Light in Dark Times
1660659508.description: Your Ghost has been by your side all along. No matter what.
1660659508.description_zh: 无论怎样，你的机灵一直在你身边。

3352059696.name: Lost Ghost Analytics
3352059696.description: This machinery collates telemetry from the Pale Heart, tracks lost Ghosts, and is a comms relay for Micah-10 herself.
3352059696.description_zh: 此机器可收集来自苍白之心的遥测数据，追踪失踪的机灵，它同时也是米迦-10自用的通讯中继器。

2672439609.name: Residuum of the Disciple
2672439609.description: The scythe of infinite nightmares lies before you awaiting your cooperation.
2672439609.description_zh: 无尽梦魇镰刀躺在你面前，等待着你的合作。

2384113223.name: Conscientious Objector
2384113223.description: A Hive Ghost who no longer believes the Hive deserve the Light, Fynch has defected from Savathûn's followers in order to help humanity.
2384113223.description_zh: 芬奇是个不再认为邪魔族有资格获得光能佑护的邪魔族机灵，他为了协助人类而背叛了萨瓦图恩的追随者。

1244708409.name: Remnant of the Disciple
1244708409.description: The disciple's Glaive, harbinger of ruin for eons, now lies still, ready for your communion.
1244708409.description_zh: 门徒的偃月，亘古不变的毁灭先知，如今静静卧躺，为你们的交流做好了准备。

1148069064.name: Special Deliveries
1148069064.description: Receive special gifts and rewards from various sources.
1148069064.description_zh: 从各种来源获得特殊礼物与奖励。

3820772794.name: Quest Archive
3820772794.description: Kiosk to acquire old or abandoned quests.
3820772794.description_zh: 可获得旧任务或已放弃任务的终端。

1614177448.name: Memorial
1614177448.description: Built in honor of those who sacrificed their Light to defend humanity. Created in collaboration with Cryptarchs to help Guardians manage armaments.
1614177448.description_zh: 为纪念牺牲自己的光能来守护人类的人而建造。与解密大师合作制造，用于帮助守护者管理武器。

18889211.name: Armor Synthesis
18889211.description: Advanced Prototype Exo and warden of the Black Armory.
18889211.description_zh: 高级原型Exo和黑色军械库守卫。

836772306.name: Seasonal Archive
836772306.description: The Seasonal Archive offers rewards from prior Season and Rewards Passes. Acquire rewards with Chronologs, which are earned from the Rewards Pass or through purchase of an Archived Pass.
836772306.description_zh: 赛季档案提供往期赛季及奖励通票的奖励。花费时序币获取奖励。时序币可通过奖励通票或购买归档通票获取。

1021220385.name: Cloud Strider
1021220385.description: The latest recruit in a long line of cybernetically enhanced protectors of Neomuna.
1021220385.description_zh: 众多接受智械强化的内欧姆那保护者当中的最新成员。

1413212512.name: Meditative Focal Point
1413212512.description: Explore Strand and the power it has to offer.

1414296538.name: Spoils of the Vault
1414296538.description: Atheon has been destroyed. Thanks to you, Kabr's spirit lives on, and his spoils are yours to take… for a price.
1414296538.description_zh: 埃希恩已被消灭。多亏了你，卡布尔的精神得以延续，而他的战利品也等着你来领取…不过并不是免费的。

753288796.name: Sword of Crota
753288796.description: Crota, the God-Knight, Eater of Hope and Light-Destroyer, is no more. The final deaths of countless Guardians are finally avenged.
753288796.description_zh: 神骑士克洛塔——希望吞噬者和光能毁灭者，已经不复存在。无数守护者的牺牲终于大仇得报。

976973631.name: Event Vendor
976973631.description: No longer an outfitter for heroes of the Tower, Eva now devotes her time to making sure Guardians enjoy seasonal events.
976973631.description_zh: 伊娃已经不再是高塔英雄们的服装商人，她现在致力于让守护者们享受季节性活动。

942726845.name: Armor Synthesis
942726845.description: Advanced Prototype Exo and warden of the Black Armory.
942726845.description_zh: 高级原型Exo和黑色军械库守卫。

2784922779.name: Spider
2784922779.description: Ever the opportunist, Spider has already begun to ensnare this lawless outpost in the web of his plans.
2784922779.description_zh: 蛛王一如既往地嗅到商机，已开始将这座无序前哨站纳入他的计划之网。

1212236591.name: Totality Division
1212236591.description: Imperium law enforcement local to Tharsis that has carved territory for itself among the Syndicates. Unofficially. They wield the same war-machines as the Imperium, and could offer those weapons to renegades who prove their loyalty.
1212236591.description_zh: 塔尔西斯当地的帝国执法部门，在各帮派势力范围之间划出了自己的地盘，不过这并非官方行为。他们操纵着与帝国相同的战争机器，可以将那些武器提供给为其效忠的反叛者。

2425597567.name: The Pikers
2425597567.description: A gang of Pike-loving free spirits with no sense of hierarchy or religion common with Eliksni. They'll accept anyone—as long as you're Piker material. Their mechanical prowess might prove useful.
2425597567.description_zh: 一帮崇尚派克、热爱自由的埃里克斯尼族，与其他族人不同，他们没有等级或宗教观念。他们来者不拒——只要你是块当“派克组”的料。其机械造诣或许能派上用场。

67251427.name: Tharsis Reformation
67251427.description: A group of independent Vex who broke free from Maya Sundaresh's Collective. Along with their individual sentience comes a unified obsession with aesthetics and random chance.
67251427.description_zh: 一群脱离玛雅·桑戴尔什集合体的独立Vex。伴随自我意识觉醒而来的，是对美学和随机性的共同痴迷。

3031194730.name: Armorer Aghol
3031194730.description: Totality Division quartermaster with a well-hidden soft spot for war beasts.
3031194730.description_zh: 总合部军需官，暗地里对战兽情有独钟。

1536219866.name: Mechanic Deoriks
1536219866.description: Piker Gang quartermaster. Good with a shock rifle. Better with a spreadsheet.
1536219866.description_zh: 派克组军需官，用震颤步枪很在行，做电子表格更在行。

73764014.name: Reformancer Guzheng
73764014.description: Curious Vex unit serving as Tharsis Reformation quartermaster.
73764014.description_zh: 一个好奇的Vex单位，担任塔尔西斯革新会军需官。

2979950953.name: Renegade Abilities Selector
2979950953.description: Load up your ship with Renegade Abilities to give you an edge in the Lawless Frontier.
2979950953.description_zh: 为你的飞船装载反叛者技能，在无序边界中占得先机。

2550874616.name: Clan Steward
2550874616.description: Complete activities while in a clan to earn clan reputation. More difficult activities grant more progress. Playing with clanmates grants a large bonus to progression.
2550874616.description_zh: 加入公会期间完成各项活动可获得公会声望。难度越高的活动提供的进度越多。与公会成员共同游戏可获得大量进度加成。

697030790.name: The Crucible
697030790.description: Compete in the Crucible. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.
697030790.description_zh: 在熔炉竞技场中参与竞技。每次升级均可获得护甲和武器奖励，升段还可获得强力奖励。

4235119312.name: Dead Zone Scout
4235119312.description: Devrim Kay stands watch in the EDZ, protecting the small group of people who now call the Farm their home.
4235119312.description_zh: 德弗里姆·卡伊负责守卫欧洲无人区，保护那些以农庄为家的一小群人。

1393733616.name: Eververse
1393733616.description: Tess Everis sells curios and accessories from her stylish boutique in the Tower.
1393733616.description_zh: 泰斯·艾夫瑞斯在她位于高塔的精品店里贩卖奇珍异宝和饰品配件。

1021210278.name: Gunsmith
1021210278.description: Dismantle weapons and complete Gunsmith bounties to increase your Reputation Rank with Banshee-44.
1021210278.description_zh: 通过拆解武器和完成枪匠悬赏，增加你在班西-44处的声望等级。

3231773039.name: Vanguard Research
3231773039.description: Ikora Rey oversees the Vanguard's research and intelligence operations. Guardians and scholars seek her mentorship from far and wide.
3231773039.description_zh: 艾可拉·蕾伊负责监管先锋的研究和智能操作。守护者和学者们从四面八方过来寻求她的指导。

1660497607.name: Exodus Black AI
1660497607.description: A Golden Age AI marooned on  Nessus, Failsafe stands watch over the wreckage of her ship.
1660497607.description_zh: 一个被放逐到涅索斯的黄金时代人工智能，智能失效保险负责看守她的飞船残骸。

1357903713.name: The Nine
1357903713.description: Enigmatic and reclusive, the Nine appear to take an interest in the affairs of Guardians.
1357903713.description_zh: 高深莫测且远离尘世，玖似乎对守护者的事物很有兴趣。

1838583129.name: Postmaster
1838583129.description: The postmaster handles deliveries destined for residents of the Tower, including lost items.
1838583129.description_zh: 邮政长负责处理高塔居民的包裹，包括遗落的物品。

24856709.name: Leviathan
24856709.description: Emperor Calus of the Cabal seeks champions.
24856709.description_zh: 卡巴尔的卡鲁斯大帝广寻勇士。

672350002.name: Chief Shipwright
672350002.description: Shipwright to the Tower, Amanda Holliday runs the Hangar like a finely tuned engine.
672350002.description_zh: 高塔船匠，阿曼达·霍利迪将机库运作得如同一台状态良好的引擎。

469305170.name: The Nine
469305170.description: Enigmatic and reclusive, the Nine appear to take an interest in the affairs of Guardians.
469305170.description_zh: 高深莫测且远离尘世，玖似乎对守护者的事物很有兴趣。

611314723.name: Vanguard Tactical
611314723.description: Complete Vanguard Ops. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.
611314723.description_zh: 完成先锋行动。每次升级均可获得护甲和武器奖励，升段还可获得强力奖励。

2677528157.name: Follower of Osiris
2677528157.description: Brother Vance leads the Followers of Osiris on Mercury, studying the life and teachings of Osiris and standing watch over the Infinite Forest.
2677528157.description_zh: 万斯修士在水星上领导奥斯里斯的追随者，研究奥斯里斯的生平和教导，守护着无尽森林。

3859807381.name: Voice of Rasputin
3859807381.description: Ana Bray oversees operations in the Hellas Basin, and serves as a liaison between the Vanguard and Rasputin.
3859807381.description_zh: 阿娜·布瑞监视着赫拉斯盆地中的各种行动，也是先锋和拉斯普廷之间的联系人。

4281866885.name: Queen's Wrath
4281866885.description: A warrior of the Reef, Petra Venj puts duty above all else.
4281866885.description_zh: 暗礁的战士，佩特拉·万吉将职责视作高于一切。

796555788.name: Rogue Lightbearer
796555788.description: Compete in Gambit. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.
796555788.description_zh: 在智谋中参与竞技。每次升级均可获得护甲和武器奖励，升段还可获得强力奖励。

2943125217.name: Mugunghwa Legion
2943125217.description: An exclusive gathering of merchants that provide support to membership Guardians.
2943125217.description_zh: 汇聚各色商人的专有商会，为会员守护者提供支持。

918027507.name: The Black Armory
918027507.description_zh: 一位黄金时代的精英武器匠

4026419037.name: Visage of Calus
4026419037.description: A magnificent statue of Calus, generously placed here for worthy creatures to kneel before.
4026419037.description_zh: 一座宏伟的卡鲁斯雕像，慷慨地置于此地，来让所有可敬的生物跪在他面前。

258170974.name: Bane of the Swarm
258170974.description: Once a Lightbearer, Eris Morn descended into the Hellmouth of the Moon where she lost her fireteam, her Ghost, and her Light to the Hive.
258170974.description_zh: 曾经的负光者埃里斯·摩恩在深入月球地狱深渊与邪魔族的战斗中失去了她的火力战队、她的机灵和她的光能。

685177497.name: Bound with Blood
685177497.description: A mechanism of the occult built by Eris Morn to harness even the most unstable of magics. Access the lectern to create gear using Nightmare Essences and collect bounties.
685177497.description_zh: 一个由埃里斯·摩恩制造的用于支配最不稳定的魔法的神秘机关。在附魔台使用梦魇精华打造装备和领取悬赏。

1687859061.name: Resonance Rank
1687859061.description: Countless unclear futures reverberate through your mind as you approach the obelisk. Strengthen the obelisk's bond to the Sundial by increasing its Resonance Rank.
1687859061.description_zh: 在你靠近方尖碑的同时，无数不确定的未来在你的脑海中回响。提升方尖碑的回声等级以增强它与日晷的联系。

4177752187.name: Hero of Six Fronts
4177752187.description: Compete in Trials of Osiris. Earn armor, weapons, and powerful upgrades when you rank up.
4177752187.description_zh: 在奥斯里斯试炼中竞技，获得护甲、武器，并在等级提升时获得强力奖励。

185244751.name: Resonance Rank
185244751.description: Countless unclear futures reverberate through your mind as you approach the obelisk. Strengthen the obelisk's bond to the Sundial by increasing its Resonance Rank.
185244751.description_zh: 在你靠近方尖碑的同时，无数不确定的未来在你的脑海中回响。提升方尖碑的回声等级以增强它与日晷的联系。

2468902004.name: Resonance Rank
2468902004.description: Countless unclear futures reverberate through your mind as you approach the obelisk. Strengthen the obelisk's bond to the Sundial by increasing its Resonance Rank.
2468902004.description_zh: 在你靠近方尖碑的同时，无数不确定的未来在你的脑海中回响。提升方尖碑的回声等级以增强它与日晷的联系。

2126988316.name: Resonance Rank
2126988316.description: Countless unclear futures reverberate through your mind as you approach the obelisk. Strengthen the obelisk's bond to the Sundial by increasing its Resonance Rank.
2126988316.description_zh: 在你靠近方尖碑的同时，无数不确定的未来在你的脑海中回响。提升方尖碑的回声等级以增强它与日晷的联系。

3258748553.name: Resonance Rank
3258748553.description: Countless unclear futures reverberate through your mind as you approach the obelisk. Strengthen the obelisk's bond to the Sundial by increasing its Resonance Rank.
3258748553.description_zh: 在你靠近方尖碑的同时，无数不确定的未来在你的脑海中回响。提升方尖碑的回声等级以增强它与日晷的联系。

3990611421.name: Cosmodrome
3990611421.description: A derelict spaceflight complex in the ruins of Old Russia.
3990611421.description_zh: 旧俄罗斯废墟中一处被遗弃的太空设施。

1729879943.name: Europa
1729879943.description: A desolate and frozen moon, testament to humanity's ambition and hubris.
1729879943.description_zh: 一颗荒无人烟的寒冷卫星，人类野心和狂妄的证明。

4088006058.name: The Crucible
4088006058.description: Hone your skills and win glory in battle against other Guardians.
4088006058.description_zh: 打磨你的技巧，在与其他守护者的对决中赢得荣耀。

3129078390.name: Vanguard Ops Playlist
3129078390.description: Join a fireteam of three and face the most feared minions of the Darkness.
3129078390.description_zh: 组成三人火力战队，面对可怖至极的暗影仆从。

1455639803.name: New Pacific Arcology
1455639803.description: Saturn's largest moon, with a lost Golden Age utopia beneath its waves.
1455639803.description_zh: 土星最大的卫星，在它的潮汐下，存在着一个失落黄金时代的乌托邦。

3607432451.name: Arcadian Valley
3607432451.description_zh: 不稳定半人马座，涅索斯
bubbles_zh: 不稳定半人马座，涅索斯
不稳定半人马座，涅索斯

2948602617.name: The Farm
2948602617.description: A refugee camp set up during the Red War for Guardians and non Guardians alike, on the outskirts of the EDZ.
2948602617.description_zh: 猩红战争期间，在欧洲无人区的市郊建立起了一座为守护者以及普通人服务的难民营。

4276116472.name: Unknown Space
4276116472.description: The Nine have sent an Emissary to test Guardians.
4276116472.description_zh: 玖派出使者对守护者进行考验。

1416096592.name: The Dreaming City
1416096592.description: A long-hidden stronghold sacred to the Awoken of the Reef.
1416096592.description_zh: 一处隐藏甚久的大本营，暗礁觉醒者将之奉为圣地。

3005692706.name: The Reckoning
3005692706.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
3005692706.description_zh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

1553550479.name: IX Realms
1553550479.description: Paracausal phenomenon created by the Nine.
1553550479.description_zh: 由玖所制造的超因果现象。

251989860.name: Prison of Elders
251989860.description: An infamous orbiting fortress where the Reef keeps its most dangerous enemies.
251989860.description_zh: 臭名昭著的环轨堡垒，暗礁将其最危险敌人关押于此。

3821439926.name: The Tangled Shore
3821439926.description: A patchwork wasteland on the edge of the Reef, in the Asteroid Belt.
3821439926.description_zh: 一片混杂不堪的废土，位于小行星带的暗礁边缘。

248695599.name: The Derelict
248695599.description: Hunt hostiles in active warzones. Reckon with greater powers. Be notorious.
248695599.description_zh: 在活跃的战区中追猎敌人。算算自己能否适应更高的能量。变得声名远扬吧。

1471216408.name: European Aerial Zone
1471216408.description: A ceremonial combat theater designed for training and meditation.
1471216408.description_zh: 为训练和冥想而设计的仪式战场。

3929841832.name: Earth
3929841832.place: Hub for Emergency Logistics and Maneuvers

2004354453.name: Battlegrounds Playlist
2004354453.description: Join a fireteam of three and face the forces of Empress Caiatl.
2004354453.description_zh: 组成三人火力战队，直面查厄托女帝的部队。

3871070152.name: Ishtar Sink, Venus
3871070152.description: Venus was once the site of great discovery—a paradise. Now, it is a monument to all that we have lost. The old stories say we built an academy dedicated to learning and research on the shore of a wondrous sea, and that the waters themselves boiled and rose up to shatter the coast, washing away all that we had built.
3871070152.description_zh: 金星上曾经有着各种伟大的发现，可谓天堂。现在它变成了一个用来纪念我们所有失去之物的纪念馆。据说，我们曾经在美丽大海的海岸上建造过一个专门用来学习和研究的学院，后来，海水沸腾并上升，冲毁了我们之前在海岸上建造的一切。

1449984089.name: Eternity
1449984089.description: A strange pocket dimension where multiple realities from across the paraverse converge and overlap.
1449984089.description_zh: 一个奇异的袖珍维度，有许多来自超宇宙的现实在这里交汇、重叠。

2244580325.name: Savathûn's Throne World
2244580325.description: The inner workings of Savathûn's mind, brought to life within a mysterious throne world of her own making.
2244580325.description_zh: 萨瓦图恩的内在思维模式，在她自己创造的神秘王座世界中重现了。
2244580325.place_zh: 萨瓦图恩之廷，王座世界

1925528349.name: Mars
1925528349.description: Back from the abyss, Mars has been altered by an unknown force.
1925528349.description_zh: 自深渊中归来时，火星已被一种未知的力量改变。

3354423374.name: The Europan Pyramid
3354423374.description: A remnant of the Black Fleet situated on the frozen tundra of Europa.
3354423374.description_zh: 黑暗舰队的遗留物，位于木卫二的极寒冻原上。

2023225122.name: Mars
2023225122.description: Back from the abyss, Mars has been altered by an unknown force.
2023225122.description_zh: 自深渊中归来时，火星已被一种未知的力量改变。

4081978654.name: Derelict Leviathan
4081978654.description: The transfigured remains of Calus's Leviathan.
4081978654.description_zh: 卡鲁斯利维坦的变形遗骸。

2481646875.name: Neomuna
2481646875.description: A hidden tech-metropolis, untouched by the Collapse.
2481646875.description_zh: 一座隐秘的科技大都会，未曾受到大崩塌的影响。

1615213322.name: Mars
1615213322.description: Back from the abyss, Mars has been altered by an unknown force.
1615213322.description_zh: 自深渊中归来时，火星已被一种未知的力量改变。

115307718.name: Neptune Orbit
115307718.description: In orbit above Neptune, the Shadow Legion fleet prepares for their invasion.
115307718.description_zh: 海王星上空的轨道中，暗影军团舰队正在为入侵做准备。

524525790.name: Themis Cluster
524525790.description: Group of main-belt asteroids, frequented by unsavory privateers.
524525790.description_zh: 一群主带小行星，经常有讨厌的私掠船队出没。

1138538228.name: Pirate Ketch
1138538228.description: An interstellar raiding vessel crewed by privateers.
1138538228.description_zh: 一艘由私掠船员组成的星际突袭舰船。

969538215.name: Seasonal Activity
969538215.description: Join a fireteam to overcome challenges and crush your foes.
969538215.description_zh: 加入一支火力战队来克服挑战，粉碎敌人。

3832342365.name: Seraph Facility
3832342365.description_zh: 遗忘已久的战争卫星轨道发射设施。

1057138507.name: The Black Garden
1057138507.description: Once home to the Black Heart, many other mysteries lurk in its overgrown corridors.
1057138507.description_zh: 这里曾经是黑暗之心的发源地，杂草丛生的走廊之中隐瞒着许多其他奥秘。

3998251206.name: The Pale Heart
3998251206.description: A surreal domain of memory within the Traveler, corrupted by the Witness.
3998251206.description_zh: 旅行者体内的一处超现实的记忆领域，受到了见证者的腐化。

4076196532.name: Kepler
4076196532.description: A lighthouse, beckoning from the sea of stars. A lost enclave, unmoored in time.
4076196532.description_zh: 宛如一座灯塔，在星海中召唤；似一块遗失的飞地，在时光中漂泊无依。

2221417565.name: Uncharted Space
2221417565.description: A mysterious pocket within Eris's throne world.
2221417565.description_zh: 埃里斯的王座世界内的一处神秘空间。

638702237.name: Cosmodrome
638702237.description: A derelict spaceflight complex in the ruins of Old Russia.
638702237.description_zh: 旧俄罗斯废墟中一处被遗弃的太空设施。

2171594315.name: Fireteam Ops
2171594315.description: A playlist with short operations for a full fireteam.
2171594315.description_zh: 为满员火力战队设计的简短行动游戏列表。

103806431.name: Arena Ops
103806431.description: A playlist with operations for up to 6 Guardians.
103806431.description_zh: 最多6名守护者参与行动的游戏列表。

4008773657.name: Solo Ops
4008773657.description: A playlist with short operations for a solo Guardian.
4008773657.description_zh: 为单人守护者设计的简短行动游戏列表。

1328964525.name: Tharsis Expanse
1328964525.description: A thriving Martian outpost, home to outlaws and outcasts on the fringes of society.
1328964525.description_zh: 一个繁荣的火星前哨站，社会边缘的不法之徒与流浪者的家园。

2777041980.name: The Crucible
2777041980.description: Hone your skills and win glory in battle against other Guardians.
2777041980.description_zh: 打磨你的技巧，在与其他守护者的对决中赢得荣耀。

2512542997.name: Strike Playlist
2512542997.description: Join a fireteam of three and face the most feared minions of the Darkness.
2512542997.description_zh: 组成三人火力战队，面对可怖至极的暗影仆从。

2612139675.name: The Last City, Earth
2612139675.description: Home of the Guardians. Gather beneath the Traveler to regroup, rearm, and form new alliances.
2612139675.description_zh: 守护者的家园。在旅行者的指引下集结，重整，铸就新的联盟。

2073151843.name: The Cosmodrome
2073151843.description: The ruins of an old Russian spaceport.
2073151843.description_zh: 旧俄罗斯宇航中心的废墟。

1199524104.name: European Dead Zone
bubbles_zh: 炽天使地堡：欧洲无人区

2388758973.name: New Pacific Arcology
2388758973.description: Saturn's largest moon, with a lost Golden Age utopia beneath its waves.
2388758973.description_zh: 土星最大的卫星，在它的潮汐下，存在着一个失落黄金时代的乌托邦。

126924919.name: Arcadian Valley
126924919.description_zh: 不稳定半人马座，涅索斯
bubbles_zh: 不稳定半人马座，涅索斯
不稳定半人马座，涅索斯

4188263703.name: The Farm
4188263703.description: A refugee camp set up during the Red War for Guardians and non Guardians alike, on the outskirts of the EDZ.
4188263703.description_zh: 猩红战争期间，在欧洲无人区的市郊建立起了一座为守护者以及普通人服务的难民营。

1402606356.name: Unknown Space
1402606356.description: The Nine have sent an Emissary to test Guardians.
1402606356.description_zh: 玖派出使者对守护者进行考验。

2779202173.name: The Dreaming City
2779202173.description: A long-hidden stronghold sacred to the Awoken of the Reef.
2779202173.description_zh: 一处隐藏甚久的大本营，暗礁觉醒者将之奉为圣地。

2038451695.name: Prison of Elders
2038451695.description: An infamous orbiting fortress where the Reef keeps its most dangerous enemies.
2038451695.description_zh: 臭名昭著的环轨堡垒，暗礁将其最危险敌人关押于此。

359854275.name: The Tangled Shore
359854275.description: A patchwork wasteland on the edge of the Reef, in the Asteroid Belt.
359854275.description_zh: 一片混杂不堪的废土，位于小行星带的暗礁边缘。

308974318.name: The Derelict
308974318.description: Hunt hostiles in active warzones. Reckon with greater powers. Be notorious.
308974318.description_zh: 在活跃的战区中追猎敌人。算算自己能否适应更高的能量。变得声名远扬吧。

1590276.name: Deep Six
1590276.description_zh: 土卫六，新太平洋生态园区

357679773.name: The Reckoning
357679773.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
357679773.description_zh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

897844116.name: Gambit Prime
897844116.description: Choose your role in this intense single-round evolution of Gambit. Send Blockers to drain Motes from the enemy's bank. Create a Well of Light by defeating envoys. Stand in the Well to burn down the Primeval and win.
897844116.description_zh: 在升级后的高强度单回合智谋中选择你的角色。派出阻绝者，汲取敌人萤光库中的萤光；消灭使节以制造光能源泉；站在光能源泉中消灭古昧，取得胜利。

2155983995.name: Nessus Orbit
2155983995.description_zh: 欢乐与欣喜在等待着你。

3158922420.name: European Aerial Zone
3158922420.description: A ceremonial combat theater designed for training and meditation.
3158922420.description_zh: 为训练和冥想而设计的仪式战场。

366956745.name: IX Realms
366956745.description: Paracausal phenomenon created by the Nine.
366956745.description_zh: 由玖所制造的超因果现象。

620798773.name: Cathedral of Scars
620798773.description: The Dreaming City, The Vestian Web
